ItemInfo_41300005_BgDescription: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.
ItemInfo_41400014_AttributesDescription: The Crownless's drop, a Resonator's Ascension item.
ItemInfo_41400014_BgDescription: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.
ItemInfo_41400014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The Crownless's drop, a Resonator's Ascension item.
ItemInfo_41400024_AttributesDescription: Thundering Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400024_BgDescription: The core of Thundering Mephis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.
ItemInfo_41400024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Thundering Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400034_AttributesDescription: Mourning Aix's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400034_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Mourning Aix, singing a never-ending elegy. Those who touch the Tacet Core will be overwhelmed by a great sense of loneliness and loss and will unconsciously shed tears. But this is not empathy, perhaps just a kind of emotional hypersensitivity.
ItemInfo_41400034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Mourning Aix's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400044_AttributesDescription: Inferno Rider's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400044_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Inferno Rider, surrounded by the never-ending fire of rage. The raging flames, fueled by the supreme clamor, vow to burn everything to ashes.
ItemInfo_41400044_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Inferno Rider's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400054_AttributesDescription: Feilian Beringal's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400054_BgDescription: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.
ItemInfo_41400054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Feilian Beringal's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400064_AttributesDescription: Impermanence Heron's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400064_BgDescription: The golden feathers of Impermanence Heron, from which a dirty and rotten smell constantly flows. A researcher once tried to seal the feathers in various metal containers, but the containers would corrode in a moment.
ItemInfo_41400064_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Impermanence Heron's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400074_AttributesDescription: Lampylumen Myriad's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400074_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Lampylumen Myriad, freezing the humming whispers. The surrounding sounds will be captured by the Tacet Core and turned into a cold absolute echo.
ItemInfo_41400074_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Lampylumen Myriad's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400084_AttributesDescription: Mech Abomination's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400084_BgDescription: The huge Clamorling hidden in the underground ruins of Court of Savantae, is a huge collection of countless program logics. The heterogeneous Tacet Core is stacked in disorder, just like the complex code of the mechanical puppet.
ItemInfo_41400084_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Mech Abomination's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400134_AttributesDescription: Tempest Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400134_BgDescription: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.
ItemInfo_41400134_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Tempest Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41100011_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100011_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a feeble Whisperin. It takes the form of a broken star. Faint and deep frequencies are still lingering within the core, yet the messages they try to convey remain elusive to all.
ItemInfo_41100011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100012_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100012_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a common Whisperin. It takes the form of a clear and complete star. Its Frequency Energy aligns with the hearing range of normal people. Yet, the question remains: what's the intention behind this imitation?
ItemInfo_41100012_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100013_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100013_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a powerful Whisperin. It takes the form of a star with sharp ridges along its outline—like an embodiment of its shrill Frequency Energy. Perhaps, its personification has already led to the Uncanny Valley effect.
ItemInfo_41100013_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100014_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100014_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a special Whisperin. It takes the form of an intricate star, bearing both recognizable and unfamiliar Frequency Energy. It seems that humans only know the tip of the iceberg of themselves.
ItemInfo_41100014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100021_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100021_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a feeble Howler. It is the remaining part of a Tacetite Bloom after it withers. Despite its astonishing accuracy in mimicry, it only ends one way—reducing to a mass of twisted Frequency Energy.
ItemInfo_41100021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100022_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100022_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a common Howler. After the Tacetite Bloom withers, a certain amount of Frequency Energy remains. Similar to the natural cycle of life, this frequency can probably serve as the sustenance for newcomers.
ItemInfo_41100022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100023_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100023_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a powerful Howler. The fierce and untamed Frequency Energy continues to reverberate within it. Evolution is all about adapting to the environment. Who will emerge victorious from the ordeal of the devastating Waveworm Phenomenon?
ItemInfo_41100023_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100024_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100024_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a special Howler. It takes the form of a seed emerging from a withered Tacetite Bloom. Life is brimming with endless possibilities. This core, akin to the seed of life, also contains infinite possibilities.
ItemInfo_41100024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100031_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100031_BgDescription: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.
ItemInfo_41100031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100032_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100032_BgDescription: A ring with bearable quality. Apart from helping the Exiles to recognize each other's identification, it also provides various functions such as basic communication, location services, and scanning. These features assist the Exiles to better survive in the wilderness.
ItemInfo_41100032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100033_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100033_BgDescription: An improved Ring, exclusive to a selected few. This ring stores a large amount of wilderness survival information. Certain entries detailing rare plants and special minerals hold academic significance compared to papers written by the Academy.
ItemInfo_41100033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100034_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100034_BgDescription: A ring made of special material using unique techniques. Its owner must boast a legendary experience. Much of the information stored within it is encrypted and challenging to decipher for details.
ItemInfo_41100034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200031_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200031_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus recruits. It seems to be used to suppress the rejection reaction induced by the integration of Tacet Discords. The side effect that comes with it is the suppression of the wearer's normal human emotions. Perhaps, that's one of the designer's purposes?
ItemInfo_41200031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200032_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200032_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus active members. Due to long-term use, its ability to stabilize frequency has been greatly mitigated. One can clearly feel the torment of being drowning in negative emotions from the mask.
ItemInfo_41200032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200033_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200033_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus veterans. The original owner has now had no turning back on the road of Overclocking. Would they have chosen to wear this mask if they had foreseen all the torment and suffering that lay ahead?
ItemInfo_41200033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200034_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200034_BgDescription: A very peculiar Fractsidus mask. It would be nearly impossible for a normal person to imagine the mental state of its owner. Judging from the residual frequency on the mask, one can perceive that the owner's emotions have become severely distorted, generating frequencies that resemble Tacet Discords.
ItemInfo_41200034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400094_AttributesDescription: Bell-Borne Geochelone's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400094_BgDescription: The ancient bell carried on the back of the Bell-Borne Geochelone. When the bell rings, the awakened past will leave a new mark in this era.
ItemInfo_41400094_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Bell-Borne Geochelone's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400104_AttributesDescription: Cetus the Tidebreaker's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400104_BgDescription: The blue spiral-shaped heteromorphic sharp tooth of Cetus the Tidebreaker, capable of cutting through waves. Legend has it that the water surface cut through by the Cetus's tooth will leave long-lasting ripples.
ItemInfo_41400104_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Cetus the Tidebreaker's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400114_AttributesDescription: Scar's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400114_BgDescription: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.
ItemInfo_41400114_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Scar's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400124_AttributesDescription: Dreamless's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400124_BgDescription: Emerging from the abyss with aspirations of ruling the land and the beings in Jinzhou, it now lies extinguished in the shadows, leaving behind only this feather.
ItemInfo_41400124_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Dreamless's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_42100020_AttributesDescription: Used to heal 20% of the current Resonator's Max HP, plus an extra 160 HP.
ItemInfo_42100020_BgDescription: An energy drink rich in vitamins that helps invigorate the mind.
ItemInfo_42100020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Used to heal 20% of the current Resonator's Max HP, plus an extra 160 HP.
ItemInfo_42100030_AttributesDescription: Instantly revives a selected Resonator. Can only be used once every 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
ItemInfo_42100030_BgDescription:
Single Revival Potion
[Effect] Stabilizes the Resonator's condition to a certain extent and aids in their recovery.
[Precautions] Long intervals between doses are recommended. Excessive use within a short period is not advisable.
[Warning] Prohibited to use in combination with the same type of potion or any frequency stabilizing potions.
ItemInfo_42100030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Instantly revives a selected Resonator. Can only be used once every 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
ItemInfo_42300010_BgDescription: An aquatic plant prized for its ornamental and practical value. Its seeds are renowned for their fragrance in Jinzhou.
ItemInfo_42300020_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300020_BgDescription:
The fruit of climbing vines that thrive on the exterior walls of buildings, which is often used in desserts.
When Jinzhou people move to a new residence, it's a tradition to take a cutting from the vine growing at their old house and plant it near the new home.
ItemInfo_42300020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300030_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300030_BgDescription:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of this place, this variant has a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.
ItemInfo_42300030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300040_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300040_BgDescription: A fungus that spreads across dark soil, resembling a black lotus. Once the cap matures and darkens, it begins to liquefy and makes the ground fertile for more mushrooms to grow, hence its name.
ItemInfo_42300040_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300050_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300050_BgDescription:
A fluorescent berry growing in caves.
Before miners get down the mine in the Tiger's Maw, their family will tuck a lanternberry into their pocket, hoping its glow will lead them safely home in the midst of darkness.
ItemInfo_42300050_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300060_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300060_BgDescription:
A vibrant flower, with its sap often processed into dye.
Known for its fragrance and water-resistant properties, the flower is commonly used to produce seal ink paste for official or personalized stamps.
ItemInfo_42300060_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300070_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300070_BgDescription:
Once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu, it nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.
ItemInfo_42300070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300080_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300080_BgDescription:
A special fungus associated with ancient trees. Its medicinal and curative properties have been recorded in numerous medical classics of Jinzhou.
An ancient specimen is preserved in the Academy, a living relic tracing back to the era when the towering Central Banyan in the Dim Forest was not so majestic.
ItemInfo_42300080_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300090_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300090_BgDescription:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.
ItemInfo_42300090_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300100_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300100_BgDescription: Violet Coral, commonly found trapped in the shallow beaches, is always revitalized with the flow and withered with the ebb.
ItemInfo_42300100_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300110_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300110_BgDescription:
A fruit of bitter taste and a childhood nightmare of many Jinzhou people.
Bittberry is often associated with phrases like "recall past bitterness, savor present sweetness" or "bitter food detoxifies the body".
ItemInfo_42300110_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300120_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300120_BgDescription:
Berries resembling feathers, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts.
It is said to be exceedingly nutritious for the brain. But it's never seen as edible because of its extreme bitterness.
ItemInfo_42300120_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310010_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310010_BgDescription:
Common countryside plants.
Mushed Pearl Leaves can quickly stop bleeding when applied to wounds.
Jinzhou pharmacopeia records an instance in which a Green Rabbit gnawed Pearl Leaves to accelerate the healing of wounds.
ItemInfo_42310010_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310020_BgDescription:
A scarlet Dewvetch. Natural moisture often builds on its buds, thus it is called Dewvetch.
It is a major nectariferous plant within Huanglong. Its honey has a natural, fresh fragrance, and it is refreshing and sweet to taste.
ItemInfo_42310030_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310030_BgDescription: If applied externally, Noctemint soothes inflammation and relieves itching; if brewed with tea, Noctemint refreshes the user's mind. It is a daily essential, especially for warriors from the Midnight Rangers stationed in the wild. Chewing a few leaves offers a refreshing sensation from tongue to brain, assisting warriors through the enduring night.
ItemInfo_42310030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310040_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310040_BgDescription:
Honeysuckle is named after its characteristic of two flowers blooming from one stem.
Besides its use in tea drinks and medicines, it is also a favorite ornamental pot plant in Jinzhou.
ItemInfo_42310040_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310050_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310050_BgDescription:
Perilla is not impressive to the eye, but is known for its unique, rich aroma.
The adding of Perilla to a dish not only removes unpleasant odor, but also enhances the ingredient's freshness.
ItemInfo_42310050_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310060_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310060_BgDescription:
A lone and tall herb. It seems that it can confront grave difficulties with a composed demeanor. In Jinzhou, it's affectionately known as the "'Cold Beauty".
This association sometimes sparks an intriguing comparison to a certain researcher from the Academy—yet, neither of them will comment on this.
ItemInfo_42310060_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310070_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310070_BgDescription:
An aromatic plant native to the New Federation. It exudes a unique citrus fragrance.
The stems and leaves of Lemongrass can be used to extract essential oil, which is an ingredient for perfume, soap, or seasoning to add a flavor twist to foods.
ItemInfo_42310070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310080_BgDescription:
A plant that grows on the edges of Tacet Fields. It blooms even in the harsh environment.
As a saprophyte, it cannot support photosynthesis with its pale leaves, and only absorbs nutrition from decayed organisms. As it is often found blooming in areas lacking vitality, it is named "Erodorchid" by Resonators who often travel around dangerous zones.
ItemInfo_42310090_BgDescription:
A fluorescent plant that grows by the riverbanks. They look like the lamps at the side of the ships anchoring for the night, hence the name Waterlamp.
The white pith inside Waterlamp's stem is used as wick, while the fibre of the stem skin is used for knit weaving and paper making.
ItemInfo_42310100_BgDescription: Common bladderwort in river crevices. An insectivorous plant that is not harmful to human. Its stamens secrete a unique fragrant substance that attracts insects.
ItemInfo_42310110_BgDescription: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.
ItemInfo_42310120_BgDescription:
Chromeshell is a pearl shell. Under illumination, its nacre will glow with a strange polychrome gloss.
When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.
ItemInfo_42310130_BgDescription:
A snail with strange wave-like patterns on its shells. Usually spotted after Retroact Rains.
Dripsnail's shell can store the sound waves of specific frequencies, and once the shell is crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain sound, hence the name.
ItemInfo_42310140_BgDescription:
The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.
ItemInfo_42310150_BgDescription:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.
ItemInfo_42310160_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310160_BgDescription: Legend has it that a traveler, who delighted in exploring mountains and rivers, stumbled upon this mushroom. Its shape, resembling a person sheltering from rain under an umbrella, inspired the traveler to name it "Umbragricus".
ItemInfo_42310160_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310170_BgDescription: A gem-like plant with scarlet, sweet, and juicy fruit, perfect for immediate consumption or sauce making.
ItemInfo_42310180_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310180_BgDescription: Edodes offers a richer and more tender flavor compared to common mushrooms. Simply boiling Edodes in fresh water with a pinch of salt yields a taste akin to Jinzhou Stew.
ItemInfo_42310180_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310190_BgDescription:
Gloom Slough is commonly found among the ruins of villages or cities, and is named for the glowing light that resembles a candle flame without the heat.
Gloom Cicada's diet is mainly fluorescent plants, and the sloughs they produce are left with the sedimented fluorescent matters from the insects' skin.
ItemInfo_42400010_BgDescription: Meat obtained from fowls. Freshly cut. Extra tender. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400020_BgDescription: Lightweight and soft feathers that are often used in crafting of accessories or toys.
ItemInfo_42400030_BgDescription: Meat obtained from animals, featuring a clean cut with distinct fat marbling. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400070_BgDescription:
A large butterfly. They are often active in dense vegetation areas in woodlands or other environments. They often fly in pairs at high altitudes and feed on nectar. Hard to capture.
It is the most commonly seen butterflies because of its high reproductive ability and adaptability to the living environment.
ItemInfo_42400080_BgDescription: Red Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly family. Its overly bright coloration renders it less adaptable to various environments compared to the common Phoenix Butterfly, making it more susceptible to predators. It ranks second in terms of both quantity and rarity among the three butterfly species.
ItemInfo_42400090_BgDescription: Blue Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly. Its genetic mutation gives it a dreamy scale color but also reduces its reproduction ability. As a result, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and most elusive of the three species.
ItemInfo_42400100_BgDescription:
Chrysopa possesses two pairs of wings made of transparent membranes with delicate reticulate veins resembling leaves.
It primarily preys on small insects and serves as a natural predator for many pests, making it a valuable resource for biological pest control.
ItemInfo_42400110_BgDescription: Golden-ringed Dragonfly is a wetland and water predator. Its diet includes flying insects and small fish and shrimp. It is known for rapid flying and predating speed.
ItemInfo_42400120_BgDescription: Meat obtained from fish, featuring a tender cut with a refreshing taste. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400130_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living in stone crevices or caves and other dark places. Their skin is covered with leathery scales, and their body has black and white ring-shaped patterns alternately arranged. They most feed on earthworms, snails, and insects.
ItemInfo_42400140_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living by waters or in wetlands. Their skin is covered with leathery scales. While their whole body is blue, musclar spines are found on their back. They favor wet, warm environments and small shrimp, crabs for diet.
ItemInfo_42400150_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, common lizards in grasslands, though occasional sightings in towns exist. They would hide themselves in parterres or plant trellis. However, as they are not poisonous, has a wide diet and a gentle temper, they are sometimes taken as pets by citizens.
ItemInfo_42400160_BgDescription: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. Their habitat is often established on lush bushes. When it rains, they often come out to feed on snails and earthworms. Therefore, after rain, Black-Striped Frogs can often be seen crossing the roads in an attempt to return to the waterside.
ItemInfo_42400170_BgDescription: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. A heterochrome species of Black-Striped Frog. Since it is relatively scarce and more vulnerable to enemies due to the color, some amphibian fans will catch Goldenback Frogs after rain and take them home as pets.
ItemInfo_42500010_BgDescription: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.
ItemInfo_42500020_BgDescription: A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has excellent toughness and stability.
ItemInfo_42500030_BgDescription: A widely distributed mineral. Its unique, profound purple distinguishes itself from other minerals. Due to its fragility, it requires careful processing with specialized equipment.
ItemInfo_42500040_BgDescription: Minerals formed over time from the remains of dead plants within Tacet Fields that had sunken into its terrains. Due to the retained woody plant-like structural appearances, these minerals were given the name "Floramber", though they are unrelated to ambers in terms of shape or form.
ItemInfo_42500050_BgDescription: A boost part disassembled from various weapons, featuring impressive versatility. By collecting enough quantity of these parts, you can apply them to enhance the performance of Tacetite Weapons.
ItemInfo_42500060_BgDescription: A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.
ItemInfo_42600010_BgDescription: A gift from birds, and a regular on dinner tables.
ItemInfo_43010001_BgDescription: A potion that can slightly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. It is especially beneficial for Resonators struggling with mastering their Fortes, as it greatly enhances adaptability. However, when consumed by Resonators who already exhibit excellent control over their Fortes, its effectiveness is somewhat diminished due to its fully diluted nature.
ItemInfo_43010002_BgDescription: A potion that can further enhance the user's frequency perception ability. By adjusting the mixture ratio, this potion is more suitable for Resonators with relatively good control over their Fortes. With a near-perfect cost-effectiveness, it is regarded as flawless except for its "notoriously" bland taste.
ItemInfo_43010003_BgDescription: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys high popularity among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.
ItemInfo_43010004_BgDescription: A potion that can significantly enhance the user's Frequency perception. Its formula is locked within a vault with the highest security. Rumor has it the inventor of this potion is a powerful Resonator in their own right, and their hope is to groom a successor capable of surpassing their achievements.
ItemInfo_43020001_BgDescription: Purified liquid energy extracted from Tacetite, its purity increasing with higher ratings. When injected into a weapon, it offers a corresponding bonus.
ItemInfo_43020002_BgDescription: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used to recharge the core modules of Tacetite Weapons. Routine preventative maintenance of weapons is advised for all Resonators, or they may find themselves caught off guard in the case of an emergency.
ItemInfo_43020003_BgDescription: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used in the core modules of Tacetite Weapons to increase power output. Weapons are the allies of Resonators and Tacetites serve as their food. Only by nourishing weapons well can they be handier and more powerful in battles.
ItemInfo_43020004_BgDescription: A supplement storing high-density Tacetite Energy, fully capable of powering most Tacetite Weapons. Experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat this supplement to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.
ItemInfo_43020011_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020011_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been greatly diminished. Its surface appears lackluster, covered with a dense layer of passivation film. However, under suitable temperatures, the residual Frequency Energy within it can still be utilized.
ItemInfo_43020011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020012_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020012_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been partially retained. Its surface presents a luster similar to that of Tacetites. As it is quite reactive, it needs to be stored properly upon collection to prevent any loss of Frequency Energy.
ItemInfo_43020012_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020013_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020013_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip with high activity. Its surface presents an amazing luster. This polarized matter only forms under extremely strict conditions, and the scientific world has yet to fully figure out its transformation patter.
ItemInfo_43020013_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020014_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020014_BgDescription: A special fluid metallic drip which can barely form naturally. It maintains a perpetual flow on its surface. Microscopic examinations of a few samples have revealed its intricate inner structure, resembling more of a living organism than an inorganic substance.
ItemInfo_43020014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020021_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020021_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified flame. Its unconventional appearance challenges Old Science. Typically, it contains a rather high level of impurities and thus requires specialized purification treatment for practical use.
ItemInfo_43020021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020022_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020022_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified candle flame. Its impurities are significantly reduced through a rough extraction and recrystallization process. This makes it simple even for those without expertise to distinguish between crystals of varying quality.
ItemInfo_43020022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020023_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020023_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified firework. After repeated purification, it is almost free of impurities. Its eye-catching and magnificent appearance not only holds practical utility but also elevates its collectible value.
ItemInfo_43020023_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020024_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020024_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a raging flame, known for its impeccable purity. As a result, some Resonators don't want to use these crystals solely for enhancement, instead opting to entrust professional craftsmen to process them into unique accessories.
ItemInfo_43020024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020031_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020031_BgDescription: A helix with soothing waveforms. Facing this remarkable substance, human beings finally realize what static vibration is about.
ItemInfo_43020031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020032_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020032_BgDescription: A helix with gentle waveforms. Researchers can extract and utilize the sealed Cadence Energy within it. However, it is worth mentioning that researchers cannot effectively analyze the content contained within this helix.
ItemInfo_43020032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020033_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020033_BgDescription: A helix with graceful waveforms, like a melodious song composed by nature. Instead of being studied by scientists, it might in essence be a subject best explored by researchers of aesthetics.
ItemInfo_43020033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020034_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020034_BgDescription: A helix with intense waveforms. Researchers are greatly captivated by the perfect harmony of movement and stillness it displays. However, to this day, no one knows how this harmony is formed.
ItemInfo_43020034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020041_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020041_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.
ItemInfo_43020041_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020042_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020042_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.
ItemInfo_43020042_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020043_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020043_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It maintains a delicate balance. When it is highly concentrated in a centrifuge, it produces products that have various applications.
ItemInfo_43020043_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020044_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020044_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is known for its astonishing balance. Due to its indispensable role in many high-tech fields, it is subject to the most stringent trade restrictions.
ItemInfo_43020044_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020051_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020051_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant seed. If you listen carefully, you can feel a pulse-like rhythm. However, in fact, this substance is not alive, and its structure is pretty similar to that of the Tacet Core of a Howler.
ItemInfo_43020051_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020052_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020052_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant bud. If you listen carefully, you can sense the pleasure of sprouting from the ground. However, it can never grow into a complete plant.
ItemInfo_43020052_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020053_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020053_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a new leaf. If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint rustle of it bathing in sunlight and sucking dew. In fact, it is able to absorb the wandering Frequency Energy from the environment.
ItemInfo_43020053_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020054_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020054_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a blossom. If you listen carefully, you can hear the petals unfolding. At the end of the silent time, a blossom of Cadence finally bursts into bloom.
ItemInfo_43020054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.

ItemInfo_44010025_AttributesDescription: Special drops from the Huanglong region, which can be used to exchange for various items in the Souvenir Store.
ItemInfo_44010025_BgDescription:
"In the Huanglong region, ancient buildings were traditionally built using wood, but it proved to be insufficient in meeting modern strength requirements. Hence, Huanglong began to explore alternative building materials that could replicate the traditional wooden texture while providing sturdiness.
These Wood-textured Shards can be found all throughout the region, with varying shapes and origins – from houses and shops to military camps and academies. Although uncovering the stories behind them is a challenging task, the Pioneer Association relentlessly pursues this endeavor. Each shard holds a piece of history waiting to be discovered.
ItemInfo_44010025_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Special drops from the Huanglong region, which can be used to exchange for various items in the Souvenir Store.

LoadingTipsText_1001_TipsText: Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.
LoadingTipsText_1002_TipsText: The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."
LoadingTipsText_1003_TipsText: The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
LoadingTipsText_1004_TipsText: The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.
LoadingTipsText_1005_TipsText: Individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects and manipulate their frequencies are known as "Resonators." These individuals exhibit unique "Resonance Abilities," also known as their "Fortes," through the "Tacet Mark" on their bodies. According to experts, a Resonator's abilities are often influenced by their past experiences and subconscious mind.
LoadingTipsText_1006_TipsText: Tacet Discords, created by the Waveworn Phenomena, are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess "Tacet Cores" and feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.
LoadingTipsText_1007_TipsText: Tacet Discords may leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Pangu Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.
LoadingTipsText_1008_TipsText: Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As we embark on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain our record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.
MapMark_3_MarkDesc:
The Pioneer Association, founded before the Lament, is a prestigious organization in science and education. 
The Pioneer Association continues to collaborate with scientists, photographers, and journalists to explore and document the world's wonders after the Ebb Tide. Their hard work leads to groundbreaking discoveries that captivate global audiences through mediums like magazines, maps, books, entertainment, and interactive media.
MapMark_3000_MarkDesc: Rediscover forgotten treasures in Solaris and exchange them with Relic Merchants for unique rewards. Search the world for scattered Sonance Caskets to revive these lost treasures.
MapMark_3002_MarkDesc: A weapon crafting table, courtesy of Uncle Wei. Wieh enough materials, you can create top-of-the-line weapons that would give you an advantage in battle.
MapMark_3003_MarkDesc: The Academy's Synthesis platform allows Resonators to create potions, construct materials, and purify substances with ease.
MapMark_3005_MarkDesc: Scattered throughout the region, these Wood-textured Shards attract curious merchants from all nations. They'd be happy to pay you with their various "souvenirs."
MapMark_3010_MarkDesc: Jinzhou's Panhua restaurant boasts open stoves and a bustling kitchen, making it the city's premier dining destination. With a steady stream of satisfied patrons, this establishment has earned a reputation as the culinary god of Jinzhou, representing its unique Huanglong food culture. Foodies flock here for delectable dishes and to immerse themselves in local gastronomy.
MapMark_3011_MarkDesc: A store selling a variety of pharmaceuticals, various daily medicinal drugs you need can be found here.
MapMark_3012_MarkDesc: Located in Huanglong's bustling city of Jinzhou, Mahe runs an honest grocery store. Despite being a practical worker, his insistence on using the best ingredients for tasty dishes has caused a rift with his wife. The couple now lives apart, their marriage strained by his unwavering dedication to quality.
MapMark_3014_MarkDesc: Exchange offices found in major cities, where you can use Interferences to exchange for rare supplies.

Thundering Mephis resembles a fusion of a human and a lizard. It can use Wutherons within the Tacet Field for high-speed maneuvers. Preliminary studies suggest that it results from the natural evolution of Tacet Discords. Rumor has it in Huanglong that it devoured a couple who had been together for life, tasted their sorrow and will to fight, and ultimately transformed into its current form during a thunderstorm.

Presumably this form is derived from a poor imitation of human behavior. The Tacet Discord's crazy rampage in the "vehicle" is unofficially known as "Flames of Fury" in Huanglong. However, Huanglong people would also say "Even the flames of fury will one day go extinct." Guess Huanglong can always get people's hope up.

However, It managed to use the pillar that binds it as its weapon and become the ruler of Hoochiefs. Now, it does what is done to it by human onto the human captured by the apes. So... Who's the one in cage actually?

 A copy of the Threnodian "Crownless". It resembles a white-armored knight in appearance, and when risen in power, it extends its blood-red wings, presumably made by its brief manipulation of the structure of Wutherons in its body, instantly increasing its mobility and attack power. Recently, it has also been observed that it can produce a body structure that mimics human "weapons". It is not known how far it can keep mutating, though one certain thing is that it is of Havoc, quite the opposite to its looks. "Don't judge a Tacet Discord by its cover", adapted from Huanglong's idioms.

Please be noted that this sound wave can deal permanent damage to broca area in human brains and cause permanent aphasia. Good thing that with current medical technology, we have 0.04% chance to reverse the damage.
MonsterHandBook_310000010_Descrtption: Binomially named "Resinacrustidum lapis", it is a member of the Resinacrustidum species. This Tacet Discord is often found active in packs within mines and mountainous areas, along with Fission Junrocks. Less dangerous.
MonsterHandBook_310000010_FightSkillDesc: The Vanguard Junrock mainly uses melee attacks. Dodging its attacks causes it to rush into the ground and be temporarily immobilized.
MonsterHandBook_310000020_Descrtption: Binomially named "Resinacrustidum lapis", part of the Resinacrustidum species. This Tacet Discord is often found active, along with Vanguard Junrocks. What makes the two species different is this has more Tacetite on its shell, thus is more energetically active and unstable. External impacts might trigger explosions. Cases of this being used as throwing weapons by other TDs are documented.
MonsterHandBook_310000020_FightSkillDesc: Fission Junrock can heal nearby allies. Prioritize it in combat.

However, It managed to use the pillar that binds it as its weapon and become the ruler of Hoochiefs. Now, it does what is done to it by human onto the human captured by the apes.
MonsterHandBook_330000050_FightSkillDesc: Feilian Beringal uses the pillar trapping it as its weapon. So the pillar is at the same time the threat and the weakness. Attacking the pillar may have unexpected result.

<color=#d4bf5f>[Spectro]</color>

 This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>high RES</color> against <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro DMG</color>.  



The Mourning Aix has an elegant shape, and a bird-like appearance. Originally found in pairs, however, the other aix was defeated by the humans, with its remains forming a "pillar" where the Mourning Aix nests itself. The “pillar” would launch supportive attacks corresponding to the Mourning Aix's squeals. This is deducted to be a kind of co-evolution of TDs.
MonsterHandBook_330000060_FightSkillDesc: The Mourning Aix can "grab" the invader with "both hands" and deal a large amount of damage. Launching Counterattacks can force the creature to release its grip. Similar to other Tacet Discords, the Tacecrux on its chest is its fatal weakness.

<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>. 

A copy of the Threnodian "Crownless". It resembles a white-armored knight in appearance, and when risen in power, it extends its blood-red wings, presumably made by its brief manipulation of the structure of Wutherons in its body, instantly increasing its mobility and ATK. Recently, it has also been observed that it can produce a body structure that mimics human "weapons". It is not known how far it can keep mutating, though one certain thing is that it is of Havoc, quite the opposite to its looks.
MonsterHandBook_340000010_FightSkillDesc: The Crownless does not immediately engage its opponent at the beginning of the battle. Rather, it prefers to test the opponent's strengths and weaknesses. By taking hits, it will gradually figure out the opponent's attack pattern and begin to evade. Once it has fully engaged, most of its attacks can be parried with Counterattacks.

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  



The ancient bell on the back of the Geochelone hides its Tacetreite core. When struck, the bell resonates with the core, exploding into a sound wave of Glacio energy. Please be noted that this sound wave can deal permanent damage to broca area in human brains and cause permanent aphasia.
MonsterHandBook_340000020_FightSkillDesc: The shell of the Bell-Borne Geochelone seems indestructible. Only the ancient bell on its back has a few cracks present. Perhaps the key to defeating it lies beneath the bell.
MonsterInfo_310000010_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its rock-like appearance.
MonsterInfo_310000010_DiscoveredDes:
A TD constructed with fragmented rocks. It has poor eyesight and a preference for rampaging. 
The clinks and clacks of its rock skin colliding with other objects help Vanguard Junrock identify its circumstances.

MonsterInfo_310000020_DiscoveredDes:

Different from the latter, Fission Junrock has a more active and unstable energy and easily explodes under impacts. Records show that it is sometimes used as a throwing weapon by other Tacet Discords.

Electro Predators' pulling of strings is as fast as thunders striking in the first springs. Taking the wastelands as its hunting ground, it takes delight in pursuit and prey.

This has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

MonsterInfo_310000180_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Mayfly-like animals with a light body. They have wings like those of butterflies. Good at circling their enemies with flexible moves.
MonsterInfo_310000190_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD that frequents the wild. It charges at incredible speeds.
MonsterInfo_310000190_DiscoveredDes:
Boar-like animals commonly found in forests, with a sensitive and irritable nature. 
Sharp tusks are the solution to every problem a Sabyr Boar encounters – it will always charge towards anything that intrudes its territory unrelentingly. 
A Huanglong idiom also compares "Sabyr Boar's charge" to reckless people.

MonsterInfo_310000200_DiscoveredDes:

Mole-like animals with excellent burrowing capabilities. They are able to excavate even concrete and steel. 
With their complicated underground passage system, Excarats can easily hide their traces and confuse their enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000210_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in mountainous areas. It usually follows and works in concert with Tacet Discords of larger sizes.
MonsterInfo_310000210_DiscoveredDes:

Large amphibian-like creatures mostly found in forests. Their hard skins are found to emit heat. 
Research has found that the tenacity of Viridblaze Saurian's skin has a positive correlation to the beast's body temperature.

MonsterInfo_310000220_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

While they are stationary, the core on their caps can gather and release light rays to attack passing creatures.

They are TDs within Huanglong borders found to manifest relatively sophisticated cognitive abilities, capable of emulating humans in the use of certain rudimentary weapons and tools. In this case flinging rocks.

MonsterInfo_310000260_DiscoveredDes: Scorpion-like animals found mostly in dim areas. Their thick, hard crystal claws are deadly weapons against enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000270_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in shallow waters. Judging from the records of charging humans on its own initiative, it might have a rather irritable temper.
MonsterInfo_310000270_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

A warmer surrounding will wake up a Hoartoise, as well as kindle its hot-tempered nature.

In order to fight against more powerful enemies, Annihilation Dreadmanes usually hunt in packs. Their operations are marked by the art of carnage.

A Humanoid TD that casts its power by playing the instrument. Imitating the human behavior of playing flutes to transmit messages, the melody it produces is only noisy and hoarse.

Humanoid TD that casts its power by playing the instrument. Imitating the human behaviour of playing bells and saying prayers, the words it emits are never blessing, but curses.

MonsterInfo_320000060_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
A tall TD guardian. Its figure resembles monolithic rocks from the mountains. 
Despite its appearance of an indestructible fortification, the nature of Rocksteady Guardian is never to protect, but to crush any obstacle that blocks its advance.

MonsterInfo_320000070_DiscoveredDes:

Despite its appearance of an indestructible fortification, the nature of Chasm Guardian is never to protect, but to crush any obstacle that blocks its advance.

Wolf-like animals that roam the plains, known for their opportunistic nature. 
In order to fight against more powerful enemies, Havoc Dreadmanes usually hunt in packs. Their operations are marked by the art of ambush.
MonsterInfo_320000110_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs. Records show that this TD can bend the power of the wind to their will and attack with it.
MonsterInfo_320000110_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

Unlike other Hoochiefs, Hoochief Cyclones can conjure air currents to not only launch long-range attacks but also restrict the movement of its targets.
MonsterInfo_320000120_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD inhabiting the forest. It is often found on high alert.
MonsterInfo_320000120_DiscoveredDes: Ferocious black bear-like animals. Their head and shoulders are covered with arrow-shaped clusters of sharp Tacetite, like indestructible thorns.
MonsterInfo_320000130_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD hiding itself in city ruins. Records show that its special camouflage methods present great troubles for people looking to identify it.
MonsterInfo_320000130_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
A TD living in discarded vehicles. It camouflages itself among ruins and foliage. Once disturbed, they exhibit a terrifying posture.
MonsterInfo_320000140_UndiscoveredDes: Leaders of the Exiles, usually found in the Exile Campgrounds. They have more combat experience and skills than the average Exiles.
MonsterInfo_320000140_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Leaders of Exile groups that oversee the allocation of resources and the arrangement of operations.
Most Exiles adhere to the law of survival of the fittest, thus the Exile Leaders are often chosen through numerous intense battles.
MonsterInfo_320000150_UndiscoveredDes: Technician members of the Exiles, commonly found in Exile Campgrounds. They are in charge of the repairing and making of weapons and equipment.
MonsterInfo_320000150_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Female Resonators of Exile groups. As mechanics, Exile Technicians are in charge of the repair and making of weapons and other equipment. 
Effective craftwork can significantly boost the group's survival probability, while deadly weapons can guarantee wins for the group in battle for resources
MonsterInfo_320000160_UndiscoveredDes: Loyal believers in the Fractsidus lurking in the shadows.
MonsterInfo_320000160_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Fractsidus' faithful cultists.
Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus they obtain the ability to render themselves invisible.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists' mentality and corrode their bodies. Executioners are tasked with the removal of the Fractsidus members in breach of rules or gone out of control.
MonsterInfo_320000170_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs. Records show that this TD is fractious and prone to stealing human objects.
MonsterInfo_330000010_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD hidden in Central Plains. It demonstrates combat abilities similar to those of a human.
MonsterInfo_330000010_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 
A powerful TD that roams the Central Plains. With the aid of thunderstorms, it keeps devouring human sounds of protection. Regarded as a vanguard of the Crownless.
MonsterInfo_330000020_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD located in the Port City of Guixu. The only existing records noted a unique movement method of it among other Tacet Discords.
MonsterInfo_330000020_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. 
A fiery "biker" born in the Port City of Guixu. It sets forth trials of courage with its unyielding flame for those who dare to trespass.
Throughout the long years, the truth of history gradually burns to ashes, and the knight who once sang boldly toward death becomes a harbinger of fear in the word of mouth among humanity.
"That is the rider who turns fear into fuel and brings calamity."
However, amidst the idle talk of the indigenous people in the Port City of Guixu, another version quietly spreads.
"When you face that mighty rider, set aside your fear and respond with your utmost reverence. Prove to him your courage to be the last one standing."
MonsterInfo_330000030_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Howler TD showing up in Desorock Highland. It is known to be ferocious and highly aggresive.
MonsterInfo_330000030_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
A giant avian creature that flies around Desorock Highland. Its three heads are respectively responsible for ingestion, offense, and guard. 
“Foolish left, wicked right. Center head's the greatest blight”, so would Jinzhou rhymes describe the heads.
MonsterInfo_330000040_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Howler TD lying dormant under Tiger's Maw. It lures preys deep into the mist it hides in before capturing them.
MonsterInfo_330000040_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. 
An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum. 
Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations. 
For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.
MonsterInfo_330000050_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Howler TD in Dim Forest. With a giant size, it boasts the sovereign of this land.
MonsterInfo_330000050_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. 
A giant ape-like monster that resides at the towering Central Banyan, guarding the apes' territory from intrusion. 
To avoid unexpected confrontation with it, the Midnight Rangers and the Huaxu Academy once collaborated in a special operation to fix the Feilian Beringal with a tracking bracelet, enabling the tracking of its movements within the forest.
MonsterInfo_330000060_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Howler TD hovering over Whining Aix's Mire. It soars the skies while singing elegies, and attacks fiercely any enemy that comes close.
MonsterInfo_330000060_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro damage</color>. 
A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. 
Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. 
Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix. 
In the loss of a lover, the bird became oppressive and violent, allowing no one to step into its nest of lost love. It only lingers in the heavens while singing the eulogy, in pursuit of an illusion that is no longer there among the clouds.
MonsterInfo_340000010_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD found outside Gorges of Spirit. Known to be bellicose, malevolent, and aggressive. Further observation is needed to better picture this creature.
MonsterInfo_340000010_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
Crownless is a Whisperin Tacet Discord born outside Gorges of Spirits along with the eruption of the strange Tacet Field. A vast mixture of human frequencies is detected within its physical form. For instance, the exhilaration and thirst for victory, the fear and resentment for casualty... Humans' long-suppressed barbarism is reified in Crownless and antagonized against themselves.
This creature is a pawn dispatched by the enemy in disguise, as well as a harbinger of the scourge of war.
MonsterInfo_340000020_UndiscoveredDes: A Calamity Class Howler TD lying dormant in Gorges of Spirit. Due to its permanent inactivity, records of its behaviors are scarce.
MonsterInfo_340000020_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. 
A torpid snapping turtle in the frozen lake, carrying an ancient bell on its back. 
Some researchers once tried to transcribe the inscriptions on the bell, but accidentally disturbed the gargantuan Chelonian's dreams. 
When it awakens, lasting toll will be echoing around the Gorges of Spirits.
MonsterInfo_340000030_UndiscoveredDes: A Calamity Class Howler TD under the depths of the seas. Melodies produced by it were recorded and found to resemble whalesongs.
MonsterInfo_340000030_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. 
The violent overlord of the ocean depths, roaming the waters in search of the chorus from its companion.
Between the surging tidal waves a lonely whalesong is heard, attracting curious voyagers that cheered and chimed in search of this "Ocean Composer".
MonsterInfo_340000050_UndiscoveredDes: One of the Fractsidus Overseers. His blazing inferno engulfs all order and rules, leaving chaos in its wake.
PhantomFetter_1_EffectDefineDescription: A seemingly calm but powerful Sonata that belongs to the powerful who can manipulate the thunder. Storms do not issue a warning, but no one can ignore their omen.
PhantomFetter_2_EffectDescription: Glacio DMG + 10% after releasing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack. This effect stacks up to 3 times, each stack lasts 15s.
PhantomFetter_2_EffectDefineDescription: A high-spirited and intense Sonata that belongs to the warriors who can conquer the battlefield. The burning flame is the beat of the march, the triumphant steps on the flame with burning convictions.
PhantomFetter_3_EffectDefineDescription: A mind-calming Sonata that belongs to the benevolent who can stick to themselves. The bell is a musical instrument as well as a ritual instrument. Those who follow the rules will naturally stay away from disasters.
PhantomFetter_5_EffectDefineDescription: A Sonata from a lost age that belongs to the uncrowned king. Some voices seem to be forgotten, but their awakening often requires but a short segment of a familiar melody.
PhantomFetter_6_EffectDescription: Electro DMG + 15% after releasing Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill. This effect stacks up to 2 times, each stack lasts 15s.
PhantomFetter_6_EffectDefineDescription: A noisy, wild but vibrant Sonata that belongs to the ever-flourishing lives. Those who profess to be extraordinary often show little patience to listen to the call of the wilder, until that voice is close to their ear.
PhantomFetter_7_EffectDefineDescription: A poignant, sorrow-evoking Sonata that belongs to the lonely bereaved. When the calling is never answered, even the wings that once soared the sky would have to fall to the ground.
PhantomFetter_8_EffectDescription: Aero DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Intro Skill.
PhantomFetter_8_EffectDefineDescription: An elusive, tenuous Sonata that belongs to those lost in the frost mist. The illusory dreamlands are far colder than reality. A careless touch may trap one in a never-waking dream.
PhantomFetter_9_EffectDefineDescription: A Sonata for the returning Rover, its harmonious melody to guide and steady their battle rhythm on the journey.
PhantomFetter_10_EffectDescription: Spectro DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Intro Skill.
PhantomFetter_12_EffectDescription: Havoc DMG + 7.5% after releasing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack. This effect stacks up to 4 times, each stack lasts 15s.

Text_AgeTip_Text:
1. Ця гра є грою з відкритим світом та діями, розрахованою на користувачів віком від 16 років і старше. Рекомендується неповнолітнім користуватися грою під наглядом батьків.

2. Гра заснована на вигаданому сюжеті та світі й не має зв'язку з реальною історією або подіями.

3. Згідно з вимогами законодавства, у грі діє система реєстрації особи. Користувачі без проходження реєстрації не можуть увійти до гри. Деякі функції і предмети гри вимагають оплати. Неповнолітні підлягають обмеженням: до 8 років — заборона на поповнення; 8–16 років — не більше 50 юанів за раз і не більше 200 юанів на місяць; 16–18 років — не більше 100 юанів за раз і не більше 400 юанів на місяць. Час гри для неповнолітніх обмежений: 1 година в п'ятницю, суботу, неділю та святкові дні з 20:00 до 21:00.

4. Гра пропонує основний сюжет, безліч побічних місій та відкритий світ для дослідження, яскраву графіку, якісне озвучення й інноваційні ігрові механіки.
