Flow_31000154_3: I'm Shui, an honorary member of the Overdash Club.
Flow_31000154_4: Actions speak louder than words. Let's get you Overdashing right away to feel the thrill!
Flow_31000154_5: Just to confirm, you're here because of our ad, right?
Flow_31000154_7: It's no surprise you're drawn to such an exciting event.
Flow_31000154_8: Hmm, looks like we need to ramp up our promotions...
Flow_31000154_9: But hey, now that you're here, why not give it a shot? It's free, after all!
Flow_31000154_10: I wish you'd put it a bit more tactfully...
Flow_31000154_11: Alright, let me run you through the event rules!
Flow_31000154_12: Overdash is all about racing through the air using Grapples to show off your skills.
Flow_31000154_14: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Flow_31000154_16: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Flow_31000154_17: Fantastic! By the way, let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development. We've got the green light!
Flow_31000154_21: A-Anyway, trust me! We've got all the permits!
Flow_31000154_22: As long as we stick to the designated area, we are good to go.
Flow_31000154_23: This time, we're racing on an "Easy" track on the outskirts of Jinzhou, perfect for beginners like you!
Flow_31000154_24: Normally, I'd guide newbies through their first Overdash, but I need to track down those documents, you know...
Flow_31000154_25: So, here's a trick instead. Pay attention, and stay safe, okay?
Flow_31000154_51: Step 1: Assess your surroundings. Step 2: Get your hook ready. Step 3: Warm up. Step 4: Let's go! Always keep an eye out for the next Grapple Point.
Flow_31000154_52: If you can't spot it, use your Glider for a better view. And remember, don't retract it mid-air or you'll fall straight down!
Flow_31000154_53: Even though it's a race, safety is priority number one. Got it?
Flow_31000154_54: It's normal to feel dizzy at first. I've got some antiemetics just in case. Hopefully, you won't need them...
Flow_31000154_56: Alright, get ready for your first Overdash! Meet me at the outskirts. Don't stand me up!
Flow_31000154_66: Can't be more familiar. Shall we start now?
Flow_31000154_69: Alright, here we are at the starting line. Feeling those butterflies fluttering?
Flow_31000154_70: Haha, every time I'm about to kick off an Overdash challenge, those nerves hit me like a wave!
Flow_31000154_71: Excellent! Can't wait to see what you've got!
Flow_31000154_73: Once you hit that track and leap forward into the air, all this jitter will vanish, replaced by pure exhilaration.
Flow_31000154_74: The wind whipping against your skin, the scenery blurring past you... It's like the entire world fades away, and it's just you out there.
Flow_31000154_75: Alright, enough talk. If I keep going, I might just jump into the challenge myself!
Flow_31000154_76: Go on! Overdash your way to that finish line! You've got this!
Flow_31000154_80: Bravo! You've conquered all the tracks! That's incredible!
Flow_31000154_81: If you haven't been practicing in secret, you must be an Overdash genius!
Flow_31000154_82: Haha, it's been ages since I've had a challenger who really gets my adrenaline pumping, ever since Chengchi stopped showing up.
Flow_31000154_83: Come on, follow me! Let's have a friendly race on the next track, shall we?
Flow_31000154_84: Hey, look! I've even managed to find the permits from the Ministry of Development.
Flow_31000154_89: Darn it! I thought it was just a formality. Didn't expect them to throw so many hurdles our way!
Flow_31000154_90: "Please <color=#e55c46>halt</color> Overdash Club activities until safety concerns are addressed..."
Flow_31000154_91: They just want to keep everyone safe.
Flow_31000154_92: Yeah, I know. I admit I did overlook those issues...
Flow_31000154_93: But it's still frustrating, you know?
Flow_31000154_94: Guess I'll have to rewrite the entire application from scratch. My head throbs just thinking about it.
Flow_31000154_95: How about you write it for me?
Flow_31000154_122: Oh, how I wish applications could write themselves!
Flow_31000154_124: I appreciate your honesty, but no worries. I'll handle my own affairs.
Flow_31000154_127: It seems I'll have to shut down the <color=#fef676>Overdash Club</color> for now. I'll get the members to work on track designs and maintenance during this downtime.
Flow_31000154_128: And you can use this opportunity to practice even harder!
Flow_31000154_129: When I've sorted out all the issues, I'll extend another invitation to you!
Flow_31000154_130: By then, you'll see <color=#fef676>brand-new equipment and track designs!</color>
Flow_31000154_131: They just want to keep everyone safe.
Flow_31000154_133: Guess I'll have to rewrite the entire application from scratch. My head throbs just thinking about it.
Flow_31000154_134: How about you write it for me?
Flow_31000154_138: Oh, how I wish applications could write themselves!
Flow_31000154_140: I appreciate your kindness, but no worries. I'll handle my own affairs.
Flow_31000154_141: I guess the Fellowship will have to shut down for a while, squatting to do some design and maintenance work at home.
Flow_31000154_142: You just take this opportunity to work out.
Flow_31000154_143: Once we've worked out our troubles, the Overdash Fellowship will once again extend an invitation to challenge you.
Flow_31000154_144: At that point, the new equipment and Overdash track design will make a handsome appearance!
Flow_31000073_2: Please... put away your weapon first.
Flow_31000073_3: Ouch! Please don't be like this!
Flow_31000073_22: I, I will not back down! I must protect Maqi!
Flow_31000011_49: Sorry, we're just here for an experiment. We'll leave right away.
Flow_31000011_50: Wait you're... Xuanyin? I'm Pushen from the Huaxu Academy. I heard from Qiaomu that you're researching animal language translation modules. Are you here for the Black-Striped Frogs?
Flow_31000011_52: Do you know what they want to say to us?
Flow_31000011_53: (Looks at you with an inquiring gaze.)
Flow_31000011_56: Actually, they were disturbed by humans and were signaling warning calls to their kind, urging them to escape.
Flow_31000011_57: Well, in that case, I think we'd better find another place for our date. What do you say?
Flow_31000011_58: Yeah. Thinking from their perspective, I would feel anxious too. Let's go.
Flow_31000011_60: My apologies! They said, "Good luck with your marriage!"
Flow_31000011_64: The romantic atmosphere is ruined, and the couple leaves disappointed.
Flow_31000011_65: Xuanyin manages to change the awkward atmosphere, making it lively once again.
Flow_31000011_66: What a dramatic night. Sometimes, the truth can hurt people.
Flow_31000011_67: Anyway, I need to go back. See you next time!
Flow_31000014_17: Feathers are scattered around the box, but the pigeons are nowhere to be found.
Flow_31000015_5: Oh no, the Tetras seem to be drowning and asking for help!
Flow_31000015_9: Are they a mutated population that no longer breathes through gills but hasn't fully evolved their lungs? Is that why they are now struggling to breathe in the water?
Flow_31000015_19: They're running out of air! {PlayerName}, we need to rescue them as soon as possible!
Flow_31000015_20: I'm not a good swimmer, so can you help me catch them? They will definitely make precious samples!
Flow_31000015_23: I worked overtime to improve the logic of this module. It's absolutely reliable!
Flow_31000015_24: I know it may sound crazy, but you need to believe in my talent and invention!
Flow_31000015_27: Xuanyin jumps into the water and fishes out the Tetra.
Flow_31000015_40: You managed to catch every Tetra in the water.
Flow_31000016_18: Xuanyin loads the Canine Language Translation Module onto your Pangu Terminal.
Flow_31000016_21: Why did it run away? Slow down! Slow down! I can't catch up with you!
Flow_31000016_22: {PlayerName}. Use your Sensor to scan for its whereabouts.
Flow_31000018_4: Oh, the installation was successful! Despite some gibberish, it works fine. Let's see what the kitten is saying.
Flow_31000018_5: Snacks! Give me snacks, and I'll let you pet me! Give me!
Flow_31000018_6: There have been quite a lot of people feeding cats in Jinzhou recently.
Flow_31000018_7: Offering snacks in exchange for the opportunity to pet a cute kitty is undoubtedly a stress-reliever for humans. However, it's essential to note that many human foods are not suitable for cats.
Flow_31000018_37: Just in case, I should post a sign next to it: "Please feed cat food, or it might get sick."
Flow_31000018_38: Hey, hey, hey. Quit pestering me. You won't let me leave without feeding you, huh? I recall that food rich in fish oil is beneficial for fur.
Flow_31000019_24: You attract more Green Rabbits with the Pearl Leaves. While they're eating, the tailless Green Rabbits are driven away and dare not approach.
Flow_31000000_147: Did you see a roaming soldier on your way here?
Flow_31000180_6: (The inscriptions on the rock wall have been worn out to the point where they can hardly be recognized, only a few scattered words can be made out, possibly left by the Lament a hundred years ago)
Flow_31000001_1: I just don't understand why they haven't started fixing the Sentinel's statue yet...
Flow_31000001_2: All the issues in the report… they're all solvable!
Flow_31000001_3: The mountains are unstable… and those Tacet Discords keep popping up…
Flow_31000001_4: You don't get it. Folks are really on edge. They're terrified those disasters will hit again.
Flow_31000001_5: If they could just fix the Sentinel's statue, it would lift everyone's spirits.
Flow_31000001_6: After all, we all grew up hearing stories about the Sentinel's power!
Flow_31000001_7: Do you think the report I sent to Yirou was too blunt? I really hope she doesn't take it the wrong way.
Flow_31000001_8: She and I don't see eye to eye on the restoration of the Sentinel's statue.
Flow_31000001_9: She's got this idealistic, optimistic way about her. I do like how determined she is to get the project moving.
Flow_31000001_10: It's not that kind of like, okay? Don't get the wrong idea!
Flow_31000001_11: I just don't think fixing the statue is our biggest priority right now. We've got more pressing stuff to deal with—like upgrading the border walls, for example.
Flow_31000001_12: Hmm, how do I put this nicely and get her on board?
Flow_31000001_13: This rock wall's way too loose. I barely pushed, and a chunk came right off.
Flow_31000001_14: Writing that report couldn't have been easy for Haobai. Wonder what Yirou's gonna think when she sees it...
Flow_31000001_15: Haha, it's not all about brute strength, you know.
Flow_31000001_16: As long as I can find the right launching point, I can pull off things that seem impossible.
Flow_31000001_17: I guess that's kinda my Resonance ability... sounds pretty basic, huh? Haha.
Flow_31000001_18: There's a rockslide caused by those monsters every couple of days. If one blocks the road, people end up stranded up here in the mountains.
Flow_31000001_19: If you hit any snags, especially with rockslides or blocked paths, just give me a shout.
Flow_31000001_20: Did you know water can speak?
Flow_31000001_21: Haha, very funny. No, I mean...
Flow_31000001_22: It's more like... the raindrops in the clouds are talking to me, telling me when they're coming and how long they'll stay.
Flow_31000001_23: You won't hurt my feelings if you tell me that this kind of Resonance Ability... is kind of useless.
Flow_31000001_24: I used to feel insecure about it, but since I started working on the Exploration Canal, my skills have been super helpful.
Flow_31000001_25: I realized that there is no such thing as a strong or weak ability, it's how you use it that matters.
Flow_31000001_26: Anyway, I just gotta live up to my name... no more sulking!
Flow_31000001_27: That's actually what Pops always wanted for me, to carve through mountains and guide rivers to the sea.
Flow_31000001_28: Just like him, I work for the Ministry of Development on water projects.
Flow_31000001_29: He was out there, digging canals in the Gorges of Spirits, right up until the Tacet Discord outbreak.
Flow_31000001_30: Nothing. Now I carry on his legacy and try to push forward with his unfinished business.
Flow_31000001_31: To be honest, that's where my own passion comes in, too.
Flow_31000001_32: Pops is probably smiling down on me right now.
Flow_31000001_33: Huh? Come on, we can't dig here. That would mess up the ecosystem.
Flow_31000001_35: There's a lot of research on Tacetite in the academy. I mean, with all these Tacet Discords, Tacetite weapons are the big thing. Projects get greenlit fast, and funding is rarely an issue.
Flow_31000001_36: Life is tough for us biologists... I just want to keep the research and development from wrecking the ecosystem.
Flow_31000001_37: Our world's hanging by a thread as it is.
Flow_31000001_38: That being said, from what I've figured out, there should be giant Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits' water system that mimic normal animals.
Flow_31000001_39: Never seen anything like it in the reports, though. Weird...
Flow_31000001_41: Good luck fixing that anytime soon.
Flow_31000001_43: Didn't know you had that kind of strength in you.
Flow_31000001_45: Is there a story behind your name?
Flow_310000000_1: What do I do now...? The water's too deep...
Flow_310000000_6: I'm screwed... There's no way I'm getting them back...
Flow_310000000_7: You really managed to get them back!
Flow_310000000_8: It's too late to go back now...
Flow_310000000_10: Now you'll think twice before coming back to mess with me again! Bah!
Flow_310000000_11: Aww, they're so cute... one... two... three...
Flow_310000000_12: Now I can deliver the goods normally, it's great!
Flow_310000000_15: Don't make me do this. Spit it out!
Flow_310000000_19: I don't have any money on me, really. I don't have any!
Flow_310000000_21: Huang! Huang! Where'd you run off to...?
Flow_310000000_23: I'm not going down there! There's no way I'm letting you take my packages!
Flow_31000078_11: Be careful, I'll go get help!

Character_JiYan_55_2: I'm going to write about the possibility of normal people participating in the Echo Riverside Games in my next project.

Character_JiYan_2_18: Of course! The Jinzhou Riverside Games is an event for all people to enjoy.
Character_JiYan_2_19: Indeed. I'm looking forward to your performance, {PlayerName}.
Character_JiYan_2_20: Only a few events specifically require participants to be Resonators. Other than that, there are no special restrictions for any event.
Character_JiYan_2_21: We haven't held the Riverside Games in years. Look at him, Jiyan still remembers the rules better than I do. Who would've thought?
Character_JiYan_2_22: During the preparation, I came across some pictures from past Games and instantly felt a rush of adrenaline. Ah, the memories of my youth...
Character_JiYan_2_23: It's a pity that the Midnight Rangers are always on the front lines, getting ready for emergencies. The Riverside Games is their only chance to relax and have some fun.
Character_JiYan_2_26: {PlayerName}, I suggest looking around for events to join if you're interested. Many of them are open to on-site registration.
Character_JiYan_2_28: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to confirm the safety of the surroundings before the race begins. You can consult Wenshu should you need any assistance.
Character_JiYan_2_29: Oh well, I didn't invite him over for that. I hoped he'd come and relax, not to find a new place to work.
Character_JiYan_2_30: On the other hand, we couldn't have brought the situation at the borders under control without Jiyan's prudence...
Character_JiYan_2_32: Sorry, I'm getting off track. The Gulpuff Relay is about to start, and I have to go to the scene in case anything happens.
Character_JiYan_2_33: Especially those still warming up in the backup lane. Gotta bring them over.
Character_JiYan_2_9: Thank you for the invite, Wenshu.
Character_JiYan_2_36: Don't always be so tense. Sometimes, you have to give yourself a breather. It's not good to push yourself too hard. So, how about picking up an event to participate in?
Character_JiYan_2_17: You mean I can participate too?
Character_JiYan_15_1: You should relax... Weekend... Who knows when is the next... Let's go... Come on... Go... Takeover...
Character_JiYan_15_5: Perhaps some people have been trapped in this place, or maybe...
Character_JiYan_15_9: Tacet Discords... They won't... No... I'm gonna... I can't... Help...
Character_JiYan_15_4: It's the cheers during the Riverside Games, mingled together with cries for help.
Character_JiYan_14_1: The rain is getting worse. If this persists, we will likely have to face a minor TD Outbreak.
Character_JiYan_14_2: {PlayerName}, I have your back. Stay focused on analyzing the voices.
Character_JiYan_13_3: The voices are coming from here.
Character_JiYan_13_5: It might be trying to tell us something... We need to decipher the message somehow.
Character_JiYan_12_1: It's the Retroact Rain... We need to hurry up.
Character_JiYan_11_5: The Tacet Discords are increasing. Let's take them down first.
Flow_31000195_44: The tusk of an unknown creature, huge in size.
Flow_31000195_62: Partially completed red packets and silk balls.
Flow_31000195_63: These should be lion dance props. The designs are delicate, and you can tell meticulous craftsmanship from them.
Character_LingYang_9_2: Wait... There's someone calling for help...
Character_LingYang_9_3: Over there! The Hoochiefs are attacking someone!
Character_LingYang_8_1: Sorry, but I'm not the one you're looking for. I never made any liondancing requests...
Character_LingYang_8_6: I received a strange request from the Bei Family. It didn't mention any specific requirements.
Character_LingYang_8_9: ...No, it can't be. Now, if there's nothing else, please excuse me.
Character_LingYang_8_11: Please, one moment! Bei Shi... do you have an older brother?
Character_LingYang_8_14: The client who called me had a mature male voice.
Character_LingYang_8_15: And since he said he's from the Bei Family, there is only one other possibility...
Character_LingYang_8_17: Bei Shi, has something happened to you?
Character_LingYang_8_19: I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. This is {PlayerName}.
Character_LingYang_8_21: ...It's about my brother, Bei Ji. It's been a week now, and he still hasn't come back home.
Character_LingYang_8_24: A week ago... That's when I received this request.
Character_LingYang_8_25: Was he acting strange the last time you saw him?
Character_LingYang_8_26: My brother and I stopped talking to each other a while back, after a big fight. I don't even know when he last left our house...
Character_LingYang_8_27: But... he still sends me packages from time to time. It's been a bunch of strange stuff...
Character_LingYang_8_29: This package has old Angelica flowers, they don't smell good anymore.
Character_LingYang_8_30: And these meats... They are almost bad, even though they're refrigerated... Anything else he told you?
Character_LingYang_7_1: Here we are. This is the place!
Character_LingYang_7_2: Heya, mister! Lionpeppers on the beam, may your profits always stream!
Character_LingYang_6_1: Alright! Just one more client to go! He's at the place where we'll be eating our dinner!
Character_LingYang_6_2: Uhh... My stomach's rumbling again. Can't wait for a big feast!
Character_LingYang_38_5: {PlayerName}, have you ever thought about this...
Character_LingYang_38_6: Since there are humans with Resonance Abilities...
Character_LingYang_38_7: ...Then, could there ever be beasts with the same kind of power?
Character_LingYang_38_10: Uncontrolled emotions in human Resonators lead to <ano=Overclocking>disasters</ano>. It's even more dangerous in beasts, as they follow instincts.
Character_LingYang_38_12: Over time, most of them died out, driven extinct by their unrestrained desires.
Character_LingYang_38_14: And the Jingle Beast... It happens to be one of them.
Character_LingYang_38_15: A long, long time ago, the Jingle Beast wasn't called the Jingle Beast. It used to have a name—
Character_LingYang_38_13: Beasts that can bring their power under control are extremely rare, but... they do exist.
Character_LingYang_37_1: I was once chased by a big creature in the wilderness. All I could hear was a bell ringing and my only thought was to run away.
Character_LingYang_37_2: Then I heard about the Jingle Beast, so I figured it must have been what attacked me.
Character_LingYang_37_3: But when I saw you perform today, it all came back to me! That's the same bell ringing sound I had heard back then!
Character_LingYang_37_4: So... I must have been saved by that bell.
Character_LingYang_37_5: The bell that sounded like it was chasing after me... It was actually guiding me away from danger.
Character_LingYang_37_6: The liondance inspires and empowers each person in a unique way. I'm glad my performance could give you courage and inspiration.
Character_LingYang_37_7: Yeah! I loved your performance! I think I can keep working as Explorer for the Pioneer Association now!
Character_LingYang_37_9: When you joined the Association, I was actually so proud... I'm happy you get to keep chasing your dreams...
Character_LingYang_37_11: I am upset, because you never told me anything... You always carried the burden alone.
Character_LingYang_37_12: Didn't even tell me you were gonna go kill the Jingle Beast... Don't you ever do something like that again!
Character_LingYang_37_13: I promise, I promise. Let me treat you to something as my sincere apology.
Character_LingYang_37_14: I know a nice food stall, it's right up ahead in the square. You should check it out.
Character_LingYang_3_2: Fivefold blessings grace your door, good luck and fortune evermore!
Character_LingYang_3_3: Aww, the Lucky Greetings... You're from the Liondance Troupe, I bet. Nice to meet you!
Character_LingYang_3_4: Are you here for my grandpa's birthday party?
Character_LingYang_3_5: I thought our reservation was tomorrow. Did you maybe mix up the time?
Character_LingYang_3_6: Ah, here's the thing. People from City Hall already booked a liondance show on the same day for soldiers leaving on an expedition.
Character_LingYang_3_8: But maybe we can combine your celebrations with this existing show...
Character_LingYang_3_9: My grandpa loves hanging out with people. He'd be so happy if you could do that for him.
Character_LingYang_3_13: Alright, I'll keep that in mind.
Character_LingYang_3_14: Then, I'll do six spins in a row as part of the celebration, which symbolize the six decades your grandpa has lived through!
Character_LingYang_3_16: Means I'll dance around our birthday star on the poles! It's a special birthday celebration dance.
Character_LingYang_3_17: One spin for a decade past, health and vigor forever last!
Character_LingYang_3_18: Thank you so much. I'm sure grandpa will be happy to hear that!
Character_LingYang_3_11: Nice! Just double-checking again: It will be your grandfather's 60th birthday, right?
Character_LingYang_2_1: Okay, let me think.. My first client's nearby. You might've seen them before.
Character_LingYang_14_1: This is... This is my brother's device.
Character_LingYang_14_3: How could this be... Is my brother really working for those bad guys?
Character_LingYang_14_4: Bei Shi, what kind of person is he?
Character_LingYang_14_5: He's shy and careful, but not sneaky. He may be timid, but he really loves me...
Character_LingYang_14_6: Bei Shi... Sometimes, we can't trust what we hear or see.
Character_LingYang_14_7: We have to use our hearts and logic to uncover the real truth, it's not always obvious.
Character_LingYang_11_2: That's the place. Let's look around and stay alert.
Character_LingYang_1_1: They... They say you have claws...
Character_LingYang_1_2: We heard you can tear those monsters into shreds...
Character_LingYang_1_11: See? He's not scary at all!
Character_LingYang_1_20: You must be that famous Rover.
Character_LingYang_1_23: Hiya! I've heard a lot about you, and now I finally get to meet you in person.
Character_LingYang_1_24: You can call me Lingyang, glad to make your acquaintance! Fare thee well, blessings swell!
Character_LingYang_1_27: You really are different from everyone else...
Character_LingYang_1_28: So we've shaken hands. Now we're good friends!
Character_LingYang_1_30: Hmm... So even you are scared of me, too...
Character_LingYang_1_31: ...Anyway! Welcome to the city of Jinzhou!
Character_LingYang_1_10: Try some! I hope these candies can make up for not showing you my impressive claws.
Character_LingYang_1_13: You're welcome! Do come by to see our liondance show tomorrow!
Character_LingYang_1_17: Hmm... you smell unfamiliar, yet so powerful, and so pure...

Character_JiYan_32_5: They've been trapped here for ten years, and now finally free. I hope they're in a better place.
Character_JiYan_32_6: What happened here goes far beyond what we know about the Waveworn Phenomena so far...
Character_JiYan_32_7: I've sampled some of the frequencies here with my Terminal. We should deliver the sample to the Academy.
Character_JiYan_30_1: ...Please... Can't let this one pass... Let's go together...
Character_JiYan_30_5: Don't worry... We have Jiyan on our side...
Character_JiYan_30_6: He's Jiyan! Of course he can...
Character_JiYan_30_7: The command... Go... There's no time...
Character_JiYan_30_8: We are leaving it to you... Jiyan...
Character_JiYan_27_7: During their first lesson, new recruits must pay tribute to fallen soldiers in Knell Square.
Character_JiYan_25_1: According to what we've learned, this battle happened a decade ago. Why are they only calling out to us now?
Character_JiYan_25_2: I think... It's because of you.
Character_JiYan_25_3: Me? But I didn't even know them.
Character_JiYan_25_4: I was wondering why this year of all times... When the Riverside Games had been held before.
Character_JiYan_25_5: And you are the only variable here.
Character_JiYan_25_6: You invited me to join your temporary team so Ganquan and Lingyan can still participate in the race.
Character_JiYan_25_7: We initially fell behind, but later reclaimed the lead... It's like a deja vu of the race from a decade ago.
Character_JiYan_25_9: And that's what triggered the resonance...
Character_JiYan_25_10: The fallen soldiers... They must have held on to those memories dearly. That's how they resisted merging with the Tacet Discords...
Character_JiYan_25_12: Yes... They have been silently fighting for us all these years, or we would've faced a TD Outbreak...
Character_JiYan_25_15: During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...
Character_JiYan_25_18: They probably didn't want it to happen again. All those deaths and losses...
Character_JiYan_25_19: ...And so they called out to us for help.
Character_JiYan_23_2: A decade ago, shortly after the conclusion of the previous Riverside Games, a sudden TD Outbreak struck the Desorock Highland.
Character_JiYan_23_4: Yes... The Midnight Rangers had to send its latest recruits to the frontline because of the situation's urgency.
Character_JiYan_23_1: Where on earth are these voices coming from...
Character_JiYan_23_3: So the voices are from that past battle?
Character_JiYan_23_15: How did the TDs acquire their memories?
Character_JiYan_22_1: Damn these monsters! Will they ever stop—
Character_JiYan_22_2: Stay focused. This is not a game.
Character_JiYan_22_3: Watch out... Don't let your guard down...
Character_JiYan_21_3: So is everything in this place like this?
Character_JiYan_21_4: Are these fallen soldiers manifestations of memories... or the Tacet Discords' imitations?
Character_JiYan_21_5: They're Tacet Discords. Stay close to me.
Character_JiYan_20_1: But why are they reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago?
Character_JiYan_20_9: They seem to be playing a game of imitation.
Character_JiYan_20_11: All of this... I have a feeling it all ties back to the temporary team.
Character_JiYan_20_6: I rarely ever mentioned it, but ten years ago, I was a part of that temporary team. Back then...
Character_JiYan_20_8: So those spectators were Tacet Discords too.
Character_JiYan_20_10: Those are nothing but empty shells, no matter how lifelike they may seem.
Character_JiYan_19_1: Come on! Are you seriously expecting teamwork among members of a temporary team?
Character_JiYan_19_2: No wonder they made a mistake. Such a shame.
Character_JiYan_19_7: It's the temporary team from a decade ago.
Character_JiYan_19_11: I'm fine. It brought back some memories.
Character_JiYan_19_12: According to Mortefi's speculation, this Sonoro Sphere was resonating with the Riverside Games' frequencies, and it led to the abnormal fluctuations we detected earlier.
Character_JiYan_19_14: Hey, look! Isn't that the temporary team? Their last runner is actually catching up!
Character_JiYan_19_16: Really? He... He's in the lead now?!
Character_JiYan_19_18: That kid... I remember he's a new recruit! Impressive!
Character_JiYan_19_21: It's the Tacet Discords... Watch out!
Character_JiYan_19_5: A temporary team? Are they talking about us?
Character_JiYan_18_1: Are these the spectators we saw earlier?
Character_JiYan_18_2: No. They are memory projections from the previous Riverside Games.
Character_JiYan_18_3: I can't quite describe it, but something feels wrong with them. It's almost as if they are...
Character_JiYan_17_2: Yes and no. Technically, it's a replica of the city made up of Remnant frequencies.
Character_JiYan_17_4: Simply put, it's an illusion made of memories. Scholars would call it a Sonoro Sphere.
Character_JiYan_17_5: The environment here is ever-changing. One misstep and you may fall. Stay close to me.
Character_JiYan_65_3: What are his plans for us now? Retreat or stand guard?
Character_JiYan_65_4: We have no choice! Jinzhou needs our protection! We must buy more time for our people... But how do we defend this place, and who's left to do so?
Character_JiYan_65_5: ....You know, those who stay may not make it back.
Character_JiYan_65_6: If we must stay to hold the lines, count me in. We can't let those monsters take this place.
Character_JiYan_65_7: But will our new captain make the right call in time?
Character_JiYan_65_11: Yes. That was the right decision... For the greater good.
Character_JiYan_65_8: The new recruit they're talking about...
Character_JiYan_65_10: So... They stayed to hold the line?
Character_JiYan_65_12: That's why the Desorock Highland didn't fall.
Character_JiYan_64_3: Are all of our bases compromised, leaving us with no seasoned soldiers?
Character_JiYan_64_5: Yes. The Tacet Discords devoured our fallen soldiers' frequencies to gain their memories...
Character_JiYan_64_7: Back then, we suffered simultaneous assaults on our defenses, and we had a critical shortage of troops. The situation was urgent, and we had to deploy our latest recruits as a last resort.
Character_JiYan_64_8: Many of us couldn't make it back...
Character_JiYan_64_4: Are these the memories from that past battle?
Character_JiYan_64_6: Why were the new recruits sent to the battlefield?
Character_JiYan_63_3: No... No! They're all dead! No one's coming for us!
Character_JiYan_63_5: This is the remaining memory of the dead. We can't communicate with him.
Character_JiYan_63_7: Yes. Trapped inside his own memories.
Character_JiYan_63_6: It seems he's reliving that day on the battlefield.
Character_LingYang_8_32: He mentioned hanging out with people from The Savages in one of his letters...
Character_JiYan_4_32: The team would be thrilled to have you.
Character_JiYan_43_25: So the departed soldiers can one day return home...
Character_JiYan_41_20: By the way! Can I enter your photo in a contest? Like, is it okay for you?
Character_JiYan_41_23: That's great! I'm pretty sure it's gonna be an award-winning entry! I'll give you a half of my prize money!
Character_JiYan_41_24: Okay then... I'll just submit the other photo.
Character_LingYang_12_2: Hehe, you're so smart, boss! That "Jingle Beast" rumor really did the trick!
Character_LingYang_11_1: Campsite near a broken tree, and visible from the guard tower... I think I know where it is.
ConfirmBox_125_Content: Are you sure you want to use the results of this tuning?

Character_LingYang_8_34: Why didn't you inform the Patrollers?
Side_CXLR_5_1: My friend joined the Midnight Rangers. I'm worried she might be in danger now.
Side_CXLR_5_2: New recruits generally aren't assigned to dangerous missions, right? I remember your brother joined last year.
Side_CXLR_5_4: But, in any case, they have to fight against those Tacet Discords. Just thinking about it gives me the shivers.
Side_CXLR_5_5: Yeah, thanks to their efforts, us ordinary folks can live in peace.
Side_CXLR_4_1: What do you have to explain, you liar!
Side_CXLR_4_2: Hold on, at least let's listen to his excuses.
Side_CXLR_4_3: Forget it, let him be! No matter what I say, he won't listen...
Side_CXLR_4_4: Have some tea, guys. As friends, everything can be talked over, huh?
Side_CXLR_3_1: Bro, not that I don't trust you, but you gotta show us how you take down those TDs at least once!
Side_CXLR_3_2: Hey, I would, but here's the problem.
Side_CXLR_3_3: Guys like you might get smashed into meat pulp standing by my side.

Flow_310000001_78: Because of the absorption, scattering, and reflection of light.
Flow_310000001_79: Because this pond is too shallow.
Flow_310000001_80: The fish in this pond don't blow bubbles.
Flow_310000001_81: Okay... I have the feeling I've heard of this from somewhere before.
Flow_310000001_82: I saw someone staring up at something, so I got curious and looked up...
Flow_310000001_85: Oh right, thank you for helping me get my packages back!
Flow_310000001_86: I might as well go to a shop to get some...
Flow_310000001_87: I can't figure out the life of me why these fools keep coming after me! I'm never taking this path again!
Flow_310000001_88: Good thing you came to help! Much obliged!
Flow_310000001_89: Yeah. See how interesting they look? They even got different relationships going on between the three of them.
Flow_310000001_90: Wait! Don't leave! Err... Can you help me get rid of them? They're actually blocking my way, so all I could do was stop and look at them.
Flow_310000001_91: Ugh... My salary is more important. So, please!
Flow_310000001_92: I'll leave you to it then. Goodbye.
Flow_310000001_93: I thought you said they were "cute"?
Flow_310000001_94: I'm sorry, what am I thinking. Don't take it seriously. Anyway, thank you for helping me deal with this trouble!
Flow_310000001_95: A parking lot full of fancy cars.
Flow_310000001_96: A time vortex leading to the other side of the planet.
Flow_310000001_98: Do I look like someone who would fall for that? You may as well tell me it's connected to the other side of the universe.
Flow_310000001_99: That sounds so romantic. I must find a way to get up there.
Flow_310000001_100: That's enough chit-chat, I'm running late. Bye!
Flow_310000001_104: That one cloud kinda looks like a bird, and it reminds me of the Tealfrill I once kept.
Flow_310000001_105: So it needed more love after all.
Flow_310000001_106: All right, All right, I get it. I wasn't doing enough. I will be more responsible next time.
Flow_310000001_107: I even showed them my pockets, and they still won't believe me. Our stations has all the supplies we need, so I don't usually need to carry any money on me.
Flow_310000001_108: Um, yeah... Hey! They're trying to take my clothes!
Flow_310000001_109: You sure its a good idea to say these things in front of them?
Flow_310000001_110: I'm so glad you helped me out. I need to get going and deliver this package now, or I'll be late for the order.
Flow_310000001_111: Well... Did you pack any extras?
Flow_310000001_113: Why did you bring him with you?
Flow_310000001_126: I didn't expect the stream to be this strong. They got washed away just like that. Well, they're gone already, there's nothing left for me to do besides going downstream to pick them up...
Flow_310000001_127: Huh? If you want to, sure. Thanks in advance.
Flow_310000001_128: You sure are calm about it.
Flow_310000001_129: I'll go get them for you.

Character_JiYan_56_1: Juicy sweet fruit! Come get yourself juicy sweet fruit!
Character_JiYan_56_2: Why is your fruit so much cheaper than his fruit?
Character_JiYan_56_4: Nonsense! Every fruit here is freshly picked.
Character_JiYan_56_5: That man hikes up the price due to high demand. That's why his fruit is expensive!
Character_JiYan_56_6: Young man, don't get so riled up! I'm just asking.
Character_JiYan_53_3: Pressure becomes motivation. After all, our goal is to break the record!
Character_JiYan_51_5: Oops! It just occurred to me that Wenshu was looking for me!
Character_JiYan_48_7: Hey, did you bully someone again? Come here!
Character_JiYan_46_3: My brother's running this year. It's been a while since I last hangout with him. I gotta find a good spot to watch the race.
Character_JiYan_45_4: Nanna, I want that small one!
Character_JiYan_45_5: We'll get one for you once the race is over. It's too expensive now.
Character_JiYan_44_7: Huh? When did I get hurt? I didn't feel it at all.
Character_JiYan_44_8: The adrenaline from excitement may have dampened your sensitivity to pain.
Character_JiYan_44_9: However, your nervous response betrays your condition. You right hand has been shaking involuntarily, likely because the wound has been left untreated.
Character_JiYan_44_10: Fortunately, it's not caused by the Gulpuffs. Please take this to relieve the pain for now.
Character_JiYan_44_11: Ouch... It's really starting to hurt now that you've mentioned it.
Character_JiYan_44_12: Alright. Have you calmed down now?
Character_JiYan_44_13: I'm sorry. I got a little carried away... Sorry again for the trouble I've caused.
Character_JiYan_44_14: Let's go have someone see to your wound.
Character_JiYan_44_17: I don't want to spoil your fun, but I'm afraid we need to suspend the race for now.
Character_JiYan_44_18: Can you fill us in on the data?
Character_JiYan_44_19: I checked the monitoring data as you asked, and I found unusual fluctuations near the upper waters to the north.
Character_JiYan_44_20: Why didn't the nearest Beacon pick up on this anomaly?
Character_JiYan_44_21: The Resonance Beacon is functioning properly, but we still don't know why it didn't issue a warning this time. I will investigate this further at a later time.
Character_JiYan_44_24: Animals are often the first to detect signs of danger.
Character_JiYan_44_25: Tacet Discords are similar to animals in this regard. They're very sensitive to any change in the frequencies in their surroundings. That's why those Gulpuffs went haywire.
Character_JiYan_44_26: I suppose that's why you asked me to check the monitoring data for you, Jiyan?
Character_JiYan_44_28: The timing of this change is concerning. Why did it happen precisely during the Riverside Games?
Character_JiYan_44_29: Perhaps the Riverside Games' frequency resonated with something in the upper waters?
Character_JiYan_44_32: The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, {PlayerName}, stay safe.
Character_JiYan_44_16: Jiyan and I are joining the relay race together.
Character_JiYan_44_22: Is it related to the Gulpuffs' strange behaviors?
Character_JiYan_44_30: Let's go check out the upper waters now.
Character_JiYan_43_3: There is something I wish to do with you today.
Character_JiYan_43_7: This is the seed of a resilient type of flower, which I asked the Academy to help me breed years ago.
Character_JiYan_43_9: From here, you can see all of Jinzhou city.
Character_JiYan_43_10: I thought... those who died for Jinzhou would want to see how it's thriving now.
Character_JiYan_43_11: This flower... We named it the Emortia.
Character_JiYan_43_12: Yes. The word represents both "departure" and "return."
Character_JiYan_43_13: Yes. I know there's nothing we can do to bring them back, but for us still living, we need something like this to hold on to.
Character_JiYan_43_14: Thank you, {PlayerName}, for finally bringing them peace. Now, they no longer have to fight.
Character_JiYan_43_15: And this is why I believe you should be the one to plant this seed here.
Character_JiYan_43_18: If one day I perish in battle and cannot return home... Could you please plant one of these flowers for me?
Character_JiYan_43_8: Did you plant all these flowers here?
Character_JiYan_33_25: Thank you. I need to pick up something first. See you at Knell Square.
Character_JiYan_15_7: Anyway, we have to figure it out.

Side_CXLR_9_1: These are the TDs that just attacked me.
Side_CXLR_9_2: Be careful. They seem to get extremely aggressive due to the awakening of Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_9_3: Even someone as experienced as me got caught up in a tough battle.
Side_CXLR_8_3: I'm fine. Just a bit careless to be attacked by those minions. Not a big deal. I scared them off effortlessly.
Side_CXLR_8_5: What's with that look! Seems like it's time for your first lesson as my apprentice.
Side_CXLR_8_6: Rule Number One for "TD Hunter"—"Never look down upon minions!"
Side_CXLR_8_7: Even weaker enemies can cause unexpected trouble. Got it?
Side_CXLR_8_11: Ahem, I intentionally put myself in danger to teach you a lesson.
Side_CXLR_8_12: Alright, it's your loss not listening to me. I'm speaking from experience.
Side_CXLR_8_13: Good, remember my words. They'll be useful to you one day.
Side_CXLR_8_15: Bell-Borne Geochelone lives in the Gorges of Spirits, which is the source of the Qing River flowing through here. I can sense the state of a TD through the remaining frequency in the medium.
Side_CXLR_8_17: I told you that only I can find the "Bell Spiriton," right? It's because Bell-Borne Geochelone emits a special frequency during specific periods, and only when defeating it during these periods can one get the "Bell Spiriton."
Side_CXLR_8_18: No matter how many times you defeat Bell-Borne Geochelone, as long as it's not the right timing, you can't get the "Bell Spiriton," and only my Resonance Ability can tell if it's the right timing.
Side_CXLR_8_20: We're pretty lucky. There's a high chance we'll get the "Bell Spiriton" if we hunt Bell-Borne Geochelone now.
Side_CXLR_8_21: Plus, it seems that those from the Pioneer Association are planning to go to the Gorges of Spirits along the river.
Side_CXLR_8_23: Seems like they're well-prepared. The Pioneer Association is really interested in Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_8_25: You wanna know? Curiosity is a good trait! The more you know about your enemy before a battle, the more confident you'll be.
Side_CXLR_8_26: Let's start from the question "how Tacet Discords are formed." Most people believe that they are born out of chaos, but there are some exceptions—some TDs seem to come from legends or even real history.
Side_CXLR_8_27: Legend has it that the ancient army in Huanglong used to sound a bronze bell in battle, inspiring soldiers to fight bravely and symbolizing the good wish of a triumphant return.
Side_CXLR_8_28: One day, the bell ringer saved a turtle along the Qing River by accident. From then on, that turtle became an indispensable part of the soldiers, sharing their happiness and sorrow.
Side_CXLR_8_29: Before the fierce battle ended, the bell ringer died. However, the sound of the bell still echoed on the battlefield. It's said that the turtle was the one who sounded the bell.
Side_CXLR_8_31: Yes, that's the story. Later, someone found a rusted ancient bell in the Gorges of Spirits, similar in style to the bronze bell the ancient army used.
Side_CXLR_8_32: Underneath that ancient bell was a giant turtle-shaped Tacet Discord. It witnessed the fierce war and bid farewell to the bell ringer and soldiers. These memories tied the heavy ancient bell to its back.
Side_CXLR_8_33: But it's just a story. After all, no one knows if TDs have memories and emotions.
Side_CXLR_8_34: No matter what happened in the past, this TD is now a hideous creature bringing nothing other than pain and torture to Huanglong.
Side_CXLR_8_35: You don't need to show any mercy. If it really had emotions, it wouldn't want to be a creature destroying happiness and peace of people in Huanglong.
Side_CXLR_8_36: Rule Number Two for "TD Hunter"—"Never show mercy to Tacet Discords!"
Side_CXLR_8_40: The Pioneer Association should have left not long ago. Let's follow their traces and catch up quickly!
Side_CXLR_8_41: Have you used the Scan function on the Terminal?
Side_CXLR_8_44: Wonderful. Let's follow the path displayed on the Terminal and track them down.
Side_CXLR_8_45: This is where having me as your master comes in handy. I can teach you everything you wanna know.
Side_CXLR_8_46: Turn on your Terminal and select the Scan function. You'll see a path displayed on the screen, and all you need to do is to follow it!
Side_CXLR_8_47: Understand? Great, let's follow the path displayed on the Terminal and track them down.
Side_CXLR_8_8: But you didn't seem to follow your own rule.
Side_CXLR_8_22: I can see signs of someone camping here.
Side_CXLR_8_30: The turtle carried on the duty of that bell ringer.
Side_CXLR_7_3: Aren't you afraid to fight against TDs?
Side_CXLR_7_4: I mean, Bell-Borne Geochelone is a very dangerous opponent. You might get hurt or even lose your life fighting it.
Side_CXLR_7_5: Though that mother and daughter are quite pitiful, you don't have an obligation to help them.
Side_CXLR_7_6: Even if you back out now, no one can blame you, including that mother and daughter.
Side_CXLR_7_7: Keep this conversation between us. I'll try to figure out a way to get the "Bell Spiriton" for you, so you don't have to risk your life.
Side_CXLR_7_8: Though we've only known each other for a short time, I don't want to see you die on my watch.
Side_CXLR_7_10: You've got some guts. Well, not bad.
Side_CXLR_7_12: Hmph. Are you doubting that I've never hunted that TD?
Side_CXLR_7_16: Fine, even though you said that, I can tell from your expression that you're not fully convinced.
Side_CXLR_7_17: Can't blame you. Honestly, I sometimes doubt if I'm a true "TD Hunter" myself.
Side_CXLR_7_18: Have you heard of the Overclocking of a Resonator?
Side_CXLR_7_21: You're quite knowledgeable. Have you ever encountered a Resonator after Overclocking?
Side_CXLR_7_22: Seriously? You've never heard of it? Given the fact you're a Resonator, that's a surprise. Overclocking is a negative phenomenon that occurs in Resonators. Different Resonators have different symptoms.
Side_CXLR_7_23: If left unchecked, it can lead to severe aftereffects, even completely altering a Resonator's personality.
Side_CXLR_7_24: For example, I'm one of the unlucky Resonators who went through it.
Side_CXLR_7_26: Perhaps, I don't really remember because the researchers at the Academy confirmed that I lost most of my memories after Overclocking.
Side_CXLR_7_27: Some memories, like how to fight those TDs, stay with me—no matter how hard I've tried to forget them.
Side_CXLR_7_28: Though in those memories, I always hunted them alone. There's always this strange feeling of unnaturalness... Forget it. You won't understand.
Side_CXLR_7_29: Anyway, not the right time to talk about this now.
Side_CXLR_7_30: Let's go. I'll head to the meeting point outside Jinzhou and wait for you there. I already sent the coordinates to your Terminal.
Side_CXLR_7_31: If you're ready, meet me there. Don't dawdle. We need to catch up with them!
Side_CXLR_7_9: You're experienced, so I'm safe with you around.

Side_CXLR_6_34: Tsk, are all members of the Pioneer Association this rude?
Side_CXLR_6_38: Shut up. Hey, what do you want?

Side_CXLR_6_49: Well, Rover, just wait for our good news! Bye!
Side_CXLR_6_50: Wait, that's too dangerous! You're all going to die! Hey, stop!
Side_CXLR_6_51: Just let them do their work, Lianfeng. You're being ridiculous.
Side_CXLR_6_54: I'm not a member of the Pioneer Association anymore. They can do whatever they want. I don't care.
Side_CXLR_6_55: But they're underestimating that TD. Members of the Pioneer Association are too focused on research and investigation. Sometimes, they forget they're dealing with extremely formidable creatures.
Side_CXLR_6_57: Mr. Lianfeng, let's go help them.

Side_CXLR_6_39: Well, we're heading to the Gorges of Spirits to investigate a giant Tacet Discord found there.

Side_CXLR_6_61: I'll tell {Male=him;Female=her} how to take down Bell-Borne Geochelone as {Male=his;Female=her} "Master"!
Side_CXLR_6_64: Well, as long as you're happy.

Side_CXLR_2_2: Rover, please help me. I've got no other options.

Side_CXLR_15_2: I'm looking for a man called Lianfeng.

Side_CXLR_14_7: So my daughter can be saved?
Side_CXLR_14_8: Yes, with this, your daughter can be cured.
Side_CXLR_14_9: But it looks so fresh. I thought Lianfeng got it a long time ago.
Side_CXLR_14_12: Hey, show me some respect. It's Brother Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_14_14: Just a little aftereffect of Overclocking. See, I'm totally fine.
Side_CXLR_14_15: Overclocking? But your symptoms don't seem like it. The aftereffect of Overclocking is supposed to be associated with a Resonator's Forte.
Side_CXLR_14_16: So what? My Forte is frequency perception.
Side_CXLR_14_19: Is there a possibility that you didn't really go through Overclocking, and some other incident caused your memory loss?
Side_CXLR_14_21: No way. I've never had any companions or teammates. My dear apprentice, you worry too much. I handle my affairs, and you handle yours.
Side_CXLR_14_26: I'll share with you the exciting battle between Rover and Bell-Borne Geochelone later. For now, let's make the medicine this lady's daughter needs.
Side_CXLR_14_28: No big deal. Taking down enemies of this level is just a walk in the park for a "TD Hunter".
Side_CXLR_14_29: Uncle Lianfeng, what do you think about continuing hunting those giant TDs? If you happen to get any rare materials, I'm still willing to buy them at a good price!
Side_CXLR_14_30: Call me "Brother"! Anyway, I've already retired. I'll leave the title of "TD Hunter" to my chief apprentice.
Side_CXLR_14_32: Really? That's good news. Rover's much more reliable than Uncle Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_14_36: Don't worry! I'll keep teaching you, hahaha!
Side_CXLR_14_37: Okay, fine, but not being a TD Hunter is surely a waste of your skills.
Side_CXLR_14_38: Great. Now you're the new "TD Hunter," and I'm sure you can do it well.
Side_CXLR_14_39: Right, and of course, you'll earn a fair wage for your work.
Side_CXLR_14_40: (Perhaps, I can find out the true reason for my memory loss in battles against TDs.)
Side_CXLR_14_41: Well then, my dear apprentice, if there's information about new large TDs, I'll contact you!
Side_CXLR_14_5: It's a long story. Here, take it.
Side_CXLR_14_17: But your symptom is memory loss.
Side_CXLR_14_20: I believe you had teammates fighting with you.
Side_CXLR_14_24: He insisted on being my master.
Side_CXLR_13_1: You really took down that monster all by yourself! That's astonishing!
Side_CXLR_13_2: That's my apprentice! It should be a piece of cake for {Male=him;Female=her} to deal with such a small fish.
Side_CXLR_13_4: Don't know about them, but I'm perfectly fine.
Side_CXLR_13_6: What are you worried about? It's just a small hiccup. Anyway, let me see the material you got from Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_13_7: Yeah, that's it—the "Bell Spiriton." It's actually the seed produced by the plant on Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_13_8: Haha? Really? Good to know! I need to note it down.
Side_CXLR_13_9: Oh my, can't you forget about your stupid research for one second?
Side_CXLR_13_10: Never mind. Forget about them. You need to hurry back to Jinzhou and give this to Koko. I'll contact the Pioneer Association to get them medical treatment.
Side_CXLR_12_1: Hey! Wake up! Can you hear me!
Side_CXLR_12_3: Ugh, you are… those people at the teahouse?
Side_CXLR_12_4: Enough talking. I'll check your injuries with my Forte.
Side_CXLR_12_5: No major organ damage, but there are multiple fractures. Did you fight against Bell-Borne Geochelone?
Side_CXLR_12_6: Ha, it can't be called a fight. We're completely crushed.
Side_CXLR_12_7: You should leave. Though it's calm now, no one knows when it'll wake up again.
Side_CXLR_12_8: It's not an opponent you ordinary people can deal with.
Side_CXLR_12_9: Ordinary people? You've got us wrong. I'm Lianfeng, a professional "TD Hunter," and this is my top apprentice.
Side_CXLR_12_13: You guys stay here and rest. Leave the rest to us.
Side_CXLR_12_14: {PlayerName}, listen carefully to what I'm about to say.
Side_CXLR_12_16: Do you see the large bell in the center of the "Bell-Borne Ravine"? Ringing it will awaken Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_12_17: Since it's giant, it moves and turns slowly, so we'd better…
Side_CXLR_12_20: Staying away from it will only force us into corners with its massive body. It can also use icy breath and condense water into ice crystals for indiscriminate attacks.
Side_CXLR_12_21: Though it may seem crazy, it's actually safer to get as close to it as possible.
Side_CXLR_12_22: Yeah, getting close allows us to take advantage of its blind spots during its turns and attacks. Smart move.
Side_CXLR_12_23: Its four legs, head, and tail are all highly offensive weapons. Don't underestimate them.
Side_CXLR_12_24: Also, its weakness is the big bell on its back, but it's relatively high and not easy to attack under normal circumstances.
Side_CXLR_12_26: You have a clear head, huh?
Side_CXLR_12_27: Bell-Borne Geochelone's feet are covered in hard ice, protecting them from hard.
Side_CXLR_12_28: However, it's also its weakness. Once the ice is shattered, Bell-Borne Geochelone will lose balance and fall down, which gives us a good chance to attack its most vulnerable point.
Side_CXLR_12_30: I'll draw its attention, and you seize the chance to attack.
Side_CXLR_12_32: Tsk, are you underestimating a "TD Hunter"? Once you figure out its attack pattern, dodging is easy. That's how we took it down before.
Side_CXLR_12_36: (In my memory, there's a group of people fighting alongside me.)
Side_CXLR_12_40: It's dangerous to confront Bell-Borne Geochelone on your own.
Side_CXLR_12_10: "Top apprentice"… You've only got one apprentice, okay?
Side_CXLR_12_12: Just leave it to me and my master!
Side_CXLR_12_25: Unless we can find a way to make it fall…
Side_CXLR_12_31: Won't that put you in danger?
Side_CXLR_12_33: We? I thought you defeated it on your own?
Side_CXLR_12_35: Was there anyone else who fought Bell-Borne Geochelone with you?
Side_CXLR_12_39: Don't push yourself too hard. You'd better take a rest in your condition.
Side_CXLR_12_41: It'll be fine. Leave it all to me.
Side_CXLR_11_3: It's a signal that Bell-Borne Geochelone is waking up.
Side_CXLR_11_6: Nothing, just a bit of a headache.
Side_CXLR_11_7: (Darn, it's happening again. It feels like something in my memories is about to be awakened.)
Side_CXLR_11_8: The problem is, the traces left by the Pioneer Association members seem to disappear here…
Side_CXLR_11_10: Right, they must be where the bell sound is. Let's go.
Side_CXLR_11_9: We can follow the sound of the bell.
Side_CXLR_10_3: Fine, staying here is also a job.
Side_CXLR_1_1: I'm begging you. Miss Koko, you must have some way to save my daughter.
Side_CXLR_1_3: Is it about the payment? I'll give you all my savings if that's what it takes.
Side_CXLR_1_5: {PlayerName}, you're here. But sorry, the shop's closed for now.
Side_CXLR_1_7: Don't worry. I'm okay. This lady here isn't a threat.
Side_CXLR_1_8: Her daughter's dealing with a rare illness—non-life-threatening for now, but it could get worse.
Side_CXLR_1_10: Doctors have tried everything, but regular medicine isn't working. There's one last hope, though.
Side_CXLR_1_11: Yes, my teacher handled a similar case before, and I still have the prescription from back then.
Side_CXLR_1_12: The issue is, the crucial "guide drug" is tough to get.
Side_CXLR_1_14: The "guide drug" is the most critical ingredient in the prescription. Currently, only some wealthy folks have the "guide drug" we need, and they probably won't sell it for money unless...
Side_CXLR_1_16: Unless you can find some rare items to exchange with them. Oh, by the way, Rover, have you ever heard of something called "Bell Spiriton"?
Side_CXLR_1_18: If we had that "Bell Spiriton," we could use it to exchange for the "guide drug."
Side_CXLR_1_19: It's not something easy to obtain.
Side_CXLR_1_20: Miss Koko, do you know how to get it? I'll do anything!
Side_CXLR_1_21: You can only find "Bell Spiriton" from a Calamity-Class Tacet Discord called Bell-Borne Geochelone. Have you heard of it?
Side_CXLR_1_25: Even Rover hasn't heard of it. Not that surprising, though. Only a handful of people have the chance to see it.
Side_CXLR_1_26: It's said to have a body as huge as a mountain, can crush an armored car with only one step, and freeze a river with a single breath!
Side_CXLR_1_27: Many tried to hunt it down in the past, but they all became revenants frozen in the river.
Side_CXLR_1_28: However, it doesn't usually leave its territory, so it's even rarer for people to see it.
Side_CXLR_1_29: People with sanity won't willingly pick fights with it, let alone risk their lives for an herb.
Side_CXLR_1_30: Yeah, you get how formidable it is. Nobody dares to challenge it, not to mention putting their lives on the line for an herb.
Side_CXLR_1_31: Seriously? You took it down? You're not pulling my leg, right?
Side_CXLR_1_32: Even so, you didn't get the "Bell Spiriton." That's a pity.
Side_CXLR_1_33: How can this be? Is there really no way?
Side_CXLR_1_36: Well, there's someone I know who might still have some "Bell Spiritons," but the problem is, he's a bit unreliable.
Side_CXLR_1_38: Not sure, but he did sell me plenty of rare TD materials before. It seems like he's got a few tricks up his sleeve.
Side_CXLR_1_39: Please tell me how I can find him. No matter how slim the hope is, I'll give it a try.
Side_CXLR_1_41: Thanks! So, let this lady stick around to help me prepare other herbs, and I'll leave the task of obtaining "Bell Spiriton" to {PlayerName}? Sound good?
Side_CXLR_1_43: His name's Lianfeng, and he hangs around the theater all the time. You should spot him there.
Side_CXLR_1_45: He goes by "TD Hunter" and talks a big game about hunting formidable TDs, although no one has actually seen him fight.
Side_CXLR_1_46: If you see someone being loud and boastful over tea at the theater, that's Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_1_6: Miss Koko, do you need any help?
Side_CXLR_1_24: Fought one, but didn't find any "Bell Spiriton."
Side_CXLR_1_42: No problem. Leave it to me.
Side_CXLR_1_44: How will I know who he is?

ComboTeaching_12030201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA and command the Woolies to attack a target, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_12030301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to fall from the air, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_12030401_DescriptionConten:
Summon Cloudy and Cosmos, and attack the target with high-temperature rays, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>.
After casting <color=#f4d582>Flaming Woolies</color>, Angry Points will appear around Encore. Use <color=#f4d582>Flaming Woolies</color> again now to perform 1 additional attack, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_12030501_DescriptionTitle: Encore: Forte Circuit Tutorial <color=#d4bf5f>Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy</color>
ComboTeaching_12030501_DescriptionConten: When Encore's "Mayhem" is full, use <color=#f4d582>Heavy Attack</color> to enter the Mayhem state and take reduced damage. After the Mayhem state ends, Cloudy Frenzy will be cast, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
ComboTeaching_12030601_DescriptionConten: Encore loses the ability to suppress Cosmos, who appears and starts attacking the target. Encore enters the <color=Highlight>Cosmos Rave</color> state, during which her Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, and Resonance Skill will be replaced with new ones.
ComboTeaching_12030701_DescriptionTitle: Encore: Forte Circuit Tutorial <color=#d4bf5f>Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture</color>
ComboTeaching_12030701_DescriptionConten: During <color=Highlight>Cosmos Rave</color>, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> when "Mayhem" is full to consume all "Mayhem" and enter the Cosmos Mayhem state. After the Cosmos Mayhem state ends, all "Mayhem" will be consumed to cast Cosmos: Rupture, dealing <color=#e15226ff>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
Flow_11000001_99: Mrs. Jué, I have news about the front.
Flow_11000001_100: Oh, thank you so much, my dear.
Flow_11000001_105: Mrs. Jué, everything's going well on the front and our troops are steadily pressing forward.
Flow_11000001_106: Yuzan's doing perfectly fine. He's in good hands.
Flow_11000001_107: You're a grown-up now, Yukun. Haven't you ever dreamt about going to other places far away and achieving great things?
Flow_11000001_108: Grandma... Sis has already signed up, if I leave Jinzhou too, who's going to be here with you? You'll be all alone by yourself.
Flow_11000001_109: Grandma's always trying to have me to sign up for the Rangers. Telling me how I should look up to my older sister more.
Flow_11000001_110: But I want to stay home. Where I can be there for her if something happens.
Flow_11000001_111: Mrs. Jué really has it thought out.
Flow_11000001_113: I know. Grandma always talks about how, "only when a nation is at peace, can families be at peace". But I can't just leave her by herself.
Flow_11000001_116: That's right. I've been learning boxing from Mister Yuanwu lately. I've got enough skills to protect Grandma against anything!
Flow_139000003_10: Hello, {PlayerName}, can you hear me? It’s me, Chixia.
Flow_139000003_11: I'm on the job and things have gotten pretty sticky... Can you come lend me a hand?
Flow_139000003_14: It’s a Havoc Warrior! Watch out!

Flow_139000003_33: I just had a hunch I can count on you, I guess...
Flow_139000003_34: But don’t worry, I’m sure I won’t let you help for nothing!

Flow_11000001_117: With most of the younger people gone off to war, the older people living in this area aren't very familiar with a Terminal.
Flow_11000001_118: Oh... I wonder how everything is going on the frontlines...
Flow_11000001_119: Guhong hasn't visited in a while... I hope the child's doing okay...
Flow_11000001_123: So I come to visit whenever I've got the time to see if they're doing well and give them news from the frontlines. A way to help them put their minds at ease.
Flow_11000001_128: That was too close... Luck for me you found me just in time, or else...
Flow_11000001_134: Mrs. Jué asked me to come find you.
Flow_11000001_135: I was careless and got ambushed. Got held back... I regret having Mrs. Jué feel worried.
Flow_11000001_136: Can you help me back to the city, Rover?
Flow_11000001_138: I wish to tell Mrs. Jué what happened on the frontlines in person.
Flow_11000001_141: Oh, Guhong. What happened to you?!
Flow_11000001_142: I'm okay, Mrs. Jué. Rover pulled me out of danger just in the nick of time.
Flow_11000001_143: Nonsense! Just look at those wounds! Whatever it is that you want to say, it'll have to wait. For now, you are in great need of rest.
Flow_11000001_146: Speaking of which, can I ask you a favor? Can you help these elderly make contact with me in case of an emergency?
Flow_11000001_147: Much obliged. Here's my contact information. You can also find me if you meet any trouble yourself.
Flow_11000001_149: Guhong? Last I heard he returned to the frontlines... You're saying even Mrs. Jué hasn't seen him since?
Flow_11000001_150: Mrs. Jué would like to know where she can find Guhong.
Flow_11000001_151: This is not good. Maybe something's happened to him...
Flow_11000001_153: Rover, do you think you can help find Guhong for me? Here's his contact information.
Flow_11000001_154: You checked your Terminal and found Guhong's contact information.
Flow_11000001_155: You can't help but feel a sense of unease. You make yourself stay focused and dialed the number.
Flow_11000001_156: Guhong is a Midnight Ranger, which is under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of War.
Flow_11000001_157: Let's pay the Ministry of War and ask about Guhong there.
Flow_11000001_158: We managed to hold the line thanks to everyone's efforts.
Flow_11000001_159: Good, good... That is certainly reassuring to hear.
Flow_11000001_160: Yuzan even earned himself a promotion, it's stirring up all that energy inside of him now.
Flow_11000001_161: And it all owes to young people like yourself. By the way, how are your wounds healing?
Flow_11000001_162: It's been healing pretty well. Thank you for asking, ma'am.
Flow_11000001_163: You should take care of yourself and get more rest. There's no need for you to visit every day.
Flow_11000001_164: We managed to hold the line thanks to everyone's efforts.
Flow_11000001_165: Yuzan even earned himself a promotion, it's stirring up all that energy inside of him now.
Flow_11000001_166: And it all owes to young people like yourself. By the way, how is your leg healing?
Flow_11000001_167: It's been healing pretty well. Thank you for asking, ma'am.

Character_LingYang_8_35: I didn't tell anyone, because I was worried my brother would get in trouble if I reported it to the police.
Character_LingYang_8_37: Yeah, The Savages seem shady. And there's talk of the Jingle Beast being connected to them.
Character_LingYang_8_39: But the return addresses on these packages are all different. How are we supposed to find him?
Character_LingYang_8_42: Bei Shi, leave it to me! I'll help you find your brother.
Character_LingYang_8_44: I get it, Bei Shi. You really want to find your brother.
Character_LingYang_8_45: But it's dangerous out there with the TD Outbreaks happening more frequently. I can't guarantee your safety if we run into a spreading Tacet Field.
Character_LingYang_8_46: I... I can handle it. I used to be a member of the Pioneer Association, too.
Character_LingYang_8_47: Us Pioneers never... never back down from a challenge...
Character_LingYang_8_51: If you insist... Okay, but we'll need to ask {PlayerName} about it.
Character_LingYang_8_52: {Male=He;Female=She} is a strong Resonator. With {Male=him;Female=her}, we'll be safer on our journey.
Character_LingYang_8_54: To be honest, I don't want to drag my friend into this... But this is an emergency, and Bei Shi want to tag along, so I'm asking a favor of you.
Character_LingYang_8_55: {PlayerName}, I know it's a big ask...
Character_LingYang_8_60: The guy who brings my packages is always the same dude, and I know where he works.
Character_LingYang_8_61: Okay, let's get this dealt with. {PlayerName}, are you ready?
Character_LingYang_8_40: We can go ask the package delivery people.
Character_LingYang_8_49: Don't bite off more than you can chew.
Character_LingYang_8_58: Okay, then, since you're asking for my help...
Character_LingYang_7_3: Oh hi! Isn't that the Lingyang boy?
Character_LingYang_7_4: What brought you here? My liondance request? I heard you're getting a ton of requests. I hope you can still fit mine in.
Character_LingYang_7_5: Look, I got the Lionpepper and everything. Just waiting for you to put on the lion head and chow down at my store opening!
Character_LingYang_7_6: Sir, there's something I need to tell you...
Character_LingYang_7_7: Yeah, I heard. My thing conflicts with the performance you're doing for the soldiers, right? Will you have to cancel?
Character_LingYang_7_8: Exactly. So I was thinking we could incorporate some "Lionpepper" elements into the show to make up for it...
Character_LingYang_7_9: Nah, no need to worry about my little shop, boyo. Just focus on your big performance!
Character_LingYang_7_15: Here, try this while you're here! A new snack I just came up with!
Character_LingYang_7_16: Go on, {PlayerName}. Dinner's on me. Mr. Shuncai is a great chef!
Character_LingYang_7_17: To really get to know a city, start with the food!
Character_LingYang_7_20: Let me do something for you. Anything! To help you attract more customers.
Character_LingYang_7_21: Oh my, that'll be my great honor!
Character_LingYang_7_24: Have you heard? There's a monster in the wild recently, one they call the Jingle Beast...
Character_LingYang_7_27: Yeah. Somehow the nickname sounds cute even!
Character_LingYang_7_28: But you know what? It does all the terrible stuff you can think of!
Character_LingYang_7_29: When hunting, it makes these jingling sounds... They say its tusks are over half a meter long and its claws shred prey with ease.
Character_LingYang_7_32: No, that's not true. The "Jingle Beast" doesn't look like that...
Character_LingYang_7_34: It... It's a... A friend of mine.
Character_LingYang_7_35: Well, actually... I need this one ingredient for my new snack, but the Jingle Beast has been messing things up. Can't find good meat anywhere right now.
Character_LingYang_7_36: Do you have other ways to replenish your stock?
Character_LingYang_7_37: There's only one place left to get it, and it's run by this Exile group called "The Savages."
Character_LingYang_7_38: Apparently, they're in cahoots with the Jingle Beast, and that's how they still have meat for sale.
Character_LingYang_7_40: I'm just a small shop, how am I supposed to afford that?
Character_LingYang_7_41: So... I can't make a lot of these snacks for you to hand out yet.
Character_LingYang_7_45: It suddenly struck me that there was another request to deal with... It should be right next to the tea house not far away. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must go!
Character_LingYang_7_14: Haha, looks like Lingyang has made a new friend.
Character_LingYang_7_19: Yum-yum! Hey sir, can we share this snack with the audience during our evening show? No snacks, no show!
Character_LingYang_7_39: But it's crazy expensive—five times the usual price! It's insane!
Character_LingYang_5_1: Blissful union, endless delight, love eternal in thee alight!
Character_LingYang_5_2: Oh my, look who's here! Come here, Lingyang!
Character_LingYang_5_3: We're getting the wedding candies ready. Here's one for you, and this one here...
Character_LingYang_5_6: Thank you for the candies! Actually, I'm here for that liondance request you made...
Character_LingYang_5_7: City Hall already booked a show for soldiers on the same day, so...
Character_LingYang_5_8: Really? So you won't be able to perform for us?
Character_LingYang_5_11: We are both born and raised in Huanglong, so we've been super looking forward to the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony during our wedding...
Character_LingYang_5_14: The bride and groom stand on either side of the liondance performer. When the lion head opens its mouth, they put their hands inside and it bites down.
Character_LingYang_5_15: It's called "Settlement". It symbolizes an unbreakable bond!
Character_LingYang_5_16: I know this wedding means everything to you, and I don't want you to have any regrets.
Character_LingYang_5_17: Your love is rock solid, and I can see that. The "Liondance Officiant" ceremony would just be the cherry on top of your unbreakable bond.
Character_LingYang_5_18: How about you two exchanging tokens when the lion head reaches the top during tomorrow's performance? It'll be a lively atmosphere with drums, gongs, and firecrackers bursting in celebration...
Character_LingYang_5_19: Even though it's not exactly the thing you wanted, isn't it still a unique way to exchange vows in front of your loved ones?
Character_LingYang_5_20: And it symbolizes... "To the world's end your hearts aligned, to the sky's edge your fates entwined!"
Character_LingYang_5_22: My partner's a soldier in training, headed to defend our borders soon. The liondance show for departing soldiers must mean a lot to him.
Character_LingYang_5_24: Sure, I'm happy to go along with whatever you want.
Character_LingYang_5_25: Okay. Hmm, we'll need some more time to think it through.
Character_LingYang_5_4: Blissful union, endless delight, love eternal in thee alight!
Character_LingYang_5_12: Is there anything special about this ceremony?
Character_LingYang_42_2: Let's not step on those bushes. Try not to make any noise!
Character_LingYang_4_1: Done! Now, onto the next client... Hmm, I remember it's a young couple.
Character_LingYang_34_3: My Master is super strict before our performances. He wants us to give our all for the people of Jinzhou. Can't disappoint them!
Character_LingYang_34_6: Liondance shows started as a way to cheer up returning soldiers and boost their morale before battles.
Character_LingYang_34_4: Why are liondance shows such a big deal in Jinzhou?
Character_LingYang_34_5: Hmm... Let's begin with the history of this tradition.
Character_LingYang_28_1: So, when you found out that Bei Shi lost her courage because of the Jingle Beast, you came up with a plan to get rid of it?
Character_LingYang_28_2: Yeah... I thought I could kill the Jingle Beast, and make my sister happy again...
Character_LingYang_28_3: And I heard rumors about an Exile group called "The Savages." Said they knew how to talk to that beast...
Character_LingYang_28_5: You wanted to find the Jingle Beast through them?
Character_LingYang_28_6: Yes... I wanted to prove my courage. Wanted to make her proud of me.
Character_LingYang_28_7: I just wanted to show her... If her timid brother could do it, so can she!
Character_LingYang_28_9: Being brave is not the same as being reckless.
Character_LingYang_28_10: But in the end, I couldn't achieve anything...
Character_LingYang_28_14: I'm just an incompetent coward. I've always been!

Flow_140000000_71: I... Wow, thank you so much! I'll treat you to something nice when you're back!

Flow_140000000_73: Tell him I sent you and the bill’s on me.
Flow_140000000_74: I hope you won’t mind the hassle. I'll make sure to treat you with our speciality dishes here!

Flow_140000000_79: I see. One moment please, I'll go get what you need real quick. Freshness guaranteed!
Flow_140000000_80: Mahe hands you a large bag, and you spy a freshly caught fowl among the other ingredients. Mahe's produce is always of the highest quality.
Flow_140000000_81: Let’s see here... Cooking oil, chili peppers, chicken. Perfect, we've got everything! Thank you so much! Now it's my turn to shine!
Flow_140000000_84: Panhua took your ingredients, and in a short while, a plate of Spicy Pulled Chicken was served.
Flow_140000000_85: Here you go, sweetie. Dig in.
Flow_140000000_87: Why are you crying again, honey? Not to your taste?
Flow_140000000_90: No, no, it's really delicious. Just too spicy...
Flow_140000000_92: As a child, I was always crying, and my grandpa would make pulled chicken to cheer me up.
Flow_140000000_93: He used to say that if I ate something spicy, all the bitterness of life would go away and there's no need to cry.
Flow_140000000_94: But now that I'm older, I don't cry as much. When my grandpa passed away, I didn't even shed a tear. I thought I'd lost the ability to cry...
Flow_140000000_95: But recently, I was under a lot of pressure and felt wronged, and I suddenly wanted to eat pulled chicken, but I couldn't find it anywhere. That's when I...
Flow_140000000_96: I'm really troubling you, but I just, I just miss my grandfather...
Flow_140000000_97: Thank you so much, both of you. The chicken was delicious. I'll definitely be back for more.
Flow_140000000_98: You can come by anytime, sweetie. Be sure to wear a big smile on your face next time!

Flow_140000000_103: I’m glad you stopped by to help. Wouldn’t have made the chicken for her in time without you.

Flow_140000000_105: Do you often run into things like this?
Flow_140000000_106: That's why I started this place. When I saw that little girl crying, it broke my heart. Thanks for lending a hand today, it means a lot to me.

Flow_140000000_108: Look, the pot is right there. I have copied the recipe for Spicy Pulled Chicken for you. If you follow the recipe to do the cooking, I guarantee it will be delicious!
Flow_140000000_109: Would you like to give it a try now? Here, I have some ingredients for you. There is some left, so you can make another dish!

Guide_PZ_9_5: It’s a family thing for us to take a picture here each year. I used to stand in the middle, with my dad having to hold me up just to get in the picture frame when I was younger.
Guide_PZ_9_6: After I grew older, I got big enough to wrap my arms around my parents' shoulders for the pictures.
Guide_PZ_9_7: The amount of family photos grew less after I left home for my job. Now, they're not here anywhere, but...
Guide_PZ_9_8: Taking another photo here at the same spot, can count as telling them I'm doing pretty well, right?
Guide_PZ_9_10: Yeah. I really appreciate your help today. If it wasn't for you, it would’ve been really hard for me to fulfill my wish of capturing the moments of Jinzhou!
Guide_PZ_9_11: I plan to mail these photos back to the publishing, crediting your name on them. Oh, dear. We’ve been so preoccupied with the photos, I haven’t got the chance to get your name yet.
Guide_PZ_9_15: You must accept these as your reward. Keep my camera as well.
Guide_PZ_9_16: It's an old pal of mine. Visited countless places with me over the years. I believe it deserves to continue its journey of capturing the beauties of the world with you.
Guide_PZ_9_17: I trust you and your talent. Also, how about considering becoming a journalist in your free time?
Guide_PZ_9_12: The esteemed Rover, at your service.
Guide_PZ_9_14: Got it. I am in your debt!
Guide_PZ_7_1: Well? Let see that cute furball.
Guide_PZ_7_3: Beautiful photo. Look how relaxed he is taking its nap. He looks so comfortable.
Guide_PZ_7_4: There used to be some small kittens around here as well. I’d come see them whenever I was back from a business trip.
Guide_PZ_7_5: And there was a calico just like this one. He grew pretty close to me.
Guide_PZ_7_6: I’d often come see him, bring him something to eat, stroke his hair.
Guide_PZ_7_7: It’s a shame that I was busy with work and traveled a lot, so I couldn’t bring him home.
Guide_PZ_7_8: One time, I was away on a long business trip and I couldn’t find him anywhere after I came back.
Guide_PZ_7_9: It made me a bit sad so I stopped visiting for while.
Guide_PZ_7_10: Then one day I happened to pass by and saw these kittens. There were also people coming over to feed and take care of them.
Guide_PZ_6_1: Right there. See those cats, you can go give them a pet if you’d like.
Guide_PZ_5_1: Nice. Let me take a look at it.
