Guide_PZ_5_4: Just look at the transparency of this pond!
Guide_PZ_5_5: I really liked this place when I was a kid. I’d always come here by myself to play.
Guide_PZ_5_6: My parents was worried that I might end up go swimming in it or something on my own, so they gave me a camera.
Guide_PZ_5_7: My dad said if I saw anything I liked, I should take a picture of it.
Guide_PZ_5_8: Well, with something expensive in my hands, I wouldn’t dare jump into the water with it.
Guide_PZ_5_9: But I ended up taking a lot of photos because of it.
Guide_PZ_5_11: That's how I started learning photography, which got better and better by the day. And so did Jinzhou started to thrive.
Guide_PZ_5_13: Okay, I think that’s enough mumbling. Please excuse me, I can't stop thinking about things like this once I start.
Guide_PZ_5_15: Oh! I’ve got an idea! Do you like cats?
Guide_PZ_5_10: There was this one time where I took a picture almost at the same angle as yours and mailed it to a magazine publisher. And whaddaya know! It got selected for one of their knew releases!
Guide_PZ_5_12: There were more people on the streets, more shops, and businesses more prosperous. It was a good time.
Guide_PZ_5_14: We should move on to the next scenery. And the place is...
Guide_PZ_3_2: Thank you so much for saving me. If you wasn't here, I might have faceplanted into the ground by now.
Guide_PZ_3_8: Yeah. I'm putting together a photo collection called "Old Memories of Jinzhou". Basically, it's a mix of old and new photos of the city.
Guide_PZ_3_9: I work for a magazine called Wutherium Geographic as a journalist with the Pioneer Association.
Guide_PZ_3_10: Our job is to take pictures and share the beauty of the world with people who can't travel.
Guide_PZ_3_12: But all of that is in the past. I'm getting old and close to retirement...
Guide_PZ_3_15: Really? Do you really mean it? I don’t know what to say! I-I'll credit you in the magazine and you’ll get paid for sure. Please, you're my only hope!
Guide_PZ_3_5: It's okay, I'm fine. As long as my camera is okay, everything’s okay. It's still working perfectly! But my hand... *sigh* What about the photos?
Guide_PZ_3_11: I've been working hard for this goal. I may not look the part now, but when I was younger, I traveled across mountains and rivers, taking countless photos, and some of which even won awards!
Guide_PZ_3_13: And now my hand is busted, which is just great. *sigh* With only three places left to go, too. I guess I won't be able to finish the last set of photos before I retire...
Guide_PZ_3_14: I can give you a hand.
Guide_PZ_2_1: Ack... My hand. Age is finally catching up to me, I guess...

Flow_11000001_231: But aiming for perfection isn't a bad thing. Hopefully, he'll refine his style as he learns more about penjing design.
Flow_11000001_233: Little Verina? She is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
Flow_11000001_234: She has been a great help. She knows a lot about everything plant-related.
Flow_11000001_235: All her penjings are something else! So vibrant and enchanting.
Flow_11000001_236: If only she were my granddaughter...
Flow_11000001_238: This penjing shop? It's been around for ages. I'm actually the fourth owner.
Flow_11000001_239: My daughter Linling, well, she's got her own dreams and doesn't seem to be interested in taking over the shop.
Flow_11000001_241: Let her be. I'm still feeling fine. I'm still going strong. As long as I can keep moving around, this shop won't close.
Flow_11000001_244: Hello dear, come choose a <ano=bonsai>penjing</ano> for yourself. Not only do they add a touch of green to your space, but they also freshen up the air!
Flow_11000001_245: Don't worry, even if you're not buying anything, I'm always happy to have company.
Flow_11000001_253: Where on earth is its recipient...
Flow_11000001_254: Such a strange name. Nobody around here goes by that...
Flow_11000001_256: There's always these weird names on packages, making deliveries a real puzzle...
Flow_11000001_257: Can you believe there's someone named "Ms. Vera's Dog"?
Flow_11000001_258: Well, at least it's a living thing. Then there's "Liv's Quilted Coat". How's a coat supposed to receive a package?
Flow_11000001_259: And this one, "Universe's Strongest Chief". We've got Midnight Rangers and Patrollers, but no chiefs. What's that about? There's no such position in the Ministry of War.
Flow_11000001_260: Sorry, no time for jokes now. Got a package to deliver, pronto.
Flow_11000001_269: Hmm, the centrifugal force of the separator is a bit too strong. Let me tweak it a bit...
Flow_11000001_279: She's thinking of leaving her job to lend a hand here at the shop. She's like, "With all this new technology, I could whip up a flavor that'll really catch on and take our business up to a new level!"
Flow_11000001_280: But you know, she's put in years of hard work, studying and landing a job at the prestigious Academy. It's no small feat. I'm not sure whether to support her in this...
Flow_11000001_281: Speaking of my granddaughter, Pinwen, she works in the Academy. Quite the achiever, you know? She's been a diligent student since her school days.
Flow_11000001_283: Jewel Boba is my pride and joy.
Flow_11000001_284: I've been running this shop for over thirty years. Many of my regulars have become dear friends.
Flow_11000001_285: They never seem to get tired of my dessert soups.
Flow_11000001_286: Eventually, those unfamiliar faces became the warm, familiar smiles of regulars. It's funny, you know. Back then they called me Auntie Pinrong, but as the years passed, I earned the title of Grandma Pinrong, haha!
Flow_11000001_287: However, I've noticed fewer young faces lately. Perhaps my granddaughter is onto something with her theory about fancy drinks.
Flow_11000001_292: Thirty years ago, when I first opened this shop, I was just like her, nose buried in recipes, trying to perfect my dessert soups.
Flow_11000001_293: My heart was warmed seeing my customers' smiles back then.
Flow_11000001_294: Perhaps she feels the same way now, right?
Flow_11000001_295: Jewel Boba is now the pride and joy of both me and my granddaughter.
Flow_11000001_296: With her new recipes, we've been welcoming new faces every day.
Flow_11000001_297: The first time I tasted the dessert soup my granddaughter made... It flooded me with the same joy I felt when I first made a dessert soup of my own.
Flow_11000001_298: After all these years, those newly introduced dessert soups back then have become classics, and now we've added another batch of new ones. You know, I believe all these new creations will eventually stand the test of time and become classics themselves, don't you think?
Flow_11000001_299: Whether it's an old classic or a new creation, as long as it brings a smile to my customers' faces, it's a success in my book.
Flow_11000001_300: Hey there! How about a cup of Chewy-Gummy-Yummy SweeTEA?
Flow_11000001_301: This tea's a special brew. I ground the tea leaves before steaming and brewing, giving it a smoother, delicate taste. And the boba? Made them with fresh fruits!
Flow_11000001_302: Hello there, feel free to give our Jewel Boba a try.
Flow_11000001_303: Our Jewel Boba boasts the same delightful taste over the past three decades. If you ask around, you'll find it accompanying the growth of people here.
Flow_11000001_304: Welcome, dear. Fancy trying our latest dessert soup? We call it Chewy-... Gummy-Yummy SweeTEA?
Flow_11000001_305: Quite the mouthful, isn't it? My granddaughter tells me it's all the rage with the youngsters these days. I tried it myself, and goodness, it's tasty!

Flow_109000003_412: This… isn't what I'm looking for.

Flow_109000003_424: The exam questions that year happened to coincide with the key points my teacher emphasized.
Flow_109000003_425: My sister didn't know this, so she thought I was smart enough to be admitted...
Flow_109000003_427: Let's keep moving. I'm eager to see what else she has in store.
Flow_109000003_439: The best school in Jinzhou? Sounds impressive.
Flow_109000003_441: I suspect she hid a gift there.
Flow_109000003_448: We're on our own up ahead.
Flow_109000003_476: Understanding the meaning of "hands" and "hearts" should be enough to find the gift.
Flow_109000003_481: Why were you unhappy after getting into the Imperial Academy?
Flow_109000003_486: There's something else your sister is trying to tell you.
Flow_109000003_487: Is that so? Sounds like my sister did say something along those lines.
Flow_109000003_488: You past self shaped who you are now.
Flow_109000003_489: Luck favors the prepared and capable.
Flow_109000003_490: These gifts were a record of my efforts, and I thought she was just trying to keep me working hard…
Flow_109000003_492: Back then, I didn't pay much attention to those words. I just felt I wasn't good enough.
Flow_109000003_493: Thank you for helping me understand my sister's thoughts.
Flow_109000003_494: Thanks for accompanying me all the way and helping me find these precious gifts.
Flow_109000003_495: By the way, Shiyu made her decision after climbing this mountain.
Flow_109000003_496: You're welcome. I'm glad you can finally understand what your sister was thinking.
Flow_109000003_498: She climbed to the summit of West Mountain... and that was when she decided to become a soldier, and fight on the frontlines.
Flow_109000003_499: I've never been to the top of West Mountain. Now, I kinda want to visit the summit she once conquered.
Flow_109000003_501: My sister's can't stay with me now, but I can still reach the summit she conquered on my own.
Flow_109000003_503: No! My sister managed to conquer the West Mountain on a rainy day. I don't want to lose to her!
Flow_109000003_504: Do you want to join me? Only a handful of people managed to climb to the West Mountain's top.
Flow_109000003_505: Great! I remember it might rain tomorrow. Let's climb the mountain together!
Flow_109000003_508: The road ahead looks even more rugged, but I won't be stopped.
Flow_109000003_513: What kind of person is Shiyu?
Flow_109000003_514: She's a bold and curious explorer, always uncovering fascinating finds. She shares her discoveries with the world through submissions to Wutherium Geographic magazine.
Flow_109000003_515: While she's daring, she's also very considerate.
Flow_109000003_516: If it weren't for her, I might not have as much experience, and I would be even more introverted than I am now.
Flow_109000003_517: She brought about a lot of positive changes in me.
Flow_109000003_520: This is… the token I made.
Flow_109000003_521: We exchanged the tokens we made, motivating and supporting each other to pursue our life goals.
Flow_109000003_522: I understand what my sister wanted to tell me. I won't let her down.
Flow_109000003_524: {PlayerName}, thank you for accompanying me on this short treasure hunting trip, and sharing in the beauty of this sunrise.
Flow_109000003_531: Hmm… I'd better wait here for a while.
Flow_109000003_532: I did encourage her to give it a shot, after all.

Character_LingYang_63_8: "Tread on the Dipper's stars, and no evil shall escape"... This is one of the reasons why people believe liondance can ward off evil and bring good luck.

Character_LingYang_62_5: But everyone knows them by these names now.
Character_LingYang_62_6: Nowadays, they prefer to stay behind the scenes and provide instructions, rather than be in the spotlight themselves.
Character_LingYang_62_7: If you wanna get to know them better, you might just need some good luck.

InfoDisplay_11890103_Text:
Date: [--02]
The C.V. laboratory is located in an abandoned site within Whining Aix's Mire. The main structure was built using a special material developed by C.V., which prevented severe weathering and corrosion. As a result, the building remained relatively intact. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the base level of the site for an artificial Tacet Field.
A few mechanical instrument abandoned by C.V. are left at the experiment environment. Outside the environment, a low-frequency lighting system was installed at a regulated distance and angle, ensuring permanent illumination of the experiment area.
The experimental environment center is composed of multiple bundled cables that secure a spherical metal device. The cables transmit the input and output data from within the metal device. Surrounding the spherical device are frequency detection instruments of the same specifications. These instruments are typically controlled by dials. When the dial is rotated clockwise, the electrical energy will drive the composite metal frame to rotate in a high angular speed clockwise around the central device for synchronizd frequency detection.
InfoDisplay_11890104_Text:
Experimental Environment:
Experiment Number A038 is assigned a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Environmental checks for the artificial Tacet Field are required every 6 hours.
To avoid impacting the subject, experiment personnel entering the designated area are prohibited from bringing in devices and tools incompatible with the standard specifications.

Detailed Record:
Initial observations confirm that A038 Tacet Discord, born in the artificial Tacet Field, can survive stably.
Subject has yet to exhibit specific physical features or simulate vocal behaviors. It lacks a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
Currently, A038 shows no clear behavioral objectives: mostly in a stationary state with low aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from expectations, further research is necessary.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency observed. Strict control of the standard frequency specifications in the experimental area is required.

Due to the unique nature of A038, we need more time to re-establish corresponding parameters and data language to gain deeper insight of its information. Considering our current technology and correlated data, this process will take a considerable amount of time.

Warning: Leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited.
Taking photos or recordings of subject without Professor Heisen's permission is strictly forbidden.

That concludes the records of initial observations.
To obtain more information on subject, future experiments and analyses are necessary.
InfoDisplay_11890105_Text:
Date: [--25]
We have succeeded. The TD numbered A038 has survived the artificial Tacet Field. Though the outcome may be somewhat underwhelming, now is not the time for nitpicking.
The days on duty are so unbearable. I have to stare at this dark mass all night long. It neither moves nor makes a sound, making the nights even more tedious than my stern supervisor. To maintain stability in the Tacet Field, Professor Heisen had removed all the clocks. Sigh, every minute and second feels like eternity. The usually amiable Professor Heisen is unexpectedly strict this time. Since the experiment began, I had hardly seen him smile. By the way, a researcher had accidentally brought a tool with a frequency exceeding the standard into the experiment environment last time, causing a huge commotion. The entire research site sounded the alarm. Fortunately, the Tacet Field and A038 seemed unaffected. However, the size of that mass seemed to have increased slightly. I don't think it made any difference. However, it was the first time I saw Professor Heisen angry.
Alright, I should stop here for today. There are still many issues to resolve. All the parameters and data language established lately have to be typed out manually, and everyone is working around the clock, though none complains. After all, without overwork, where else can we geniuses and maniacs go?
InfoDisplay_11890106_Text:
Date: [--08]
The experiment has reached its final stage, but it seems that everyone has become lazy. More and more colleagues suddenly disappear without a trace. Professor Heisen said some of them took leave to spend time with their families, while others decided to take a long vacation before returning. This is completely unlike their usual way. Previously, everyone was so engrossed in the research that they didn't even have time to sleep. Sigh, forget it. It's rare to have such tranquility. In these long nights, only this dark mass accompanies me. I don't know when you grew so big and started moving around. So many mechanical parts and metal chunks have appeared on you. Is that a diesel engine? I feel like I've seen it somewhere before...
Hm? I don’t quite feel like myself today. The body feels so faint it seems a bag of water, not mine.
You seem extraordinarily lively today, don't you? I never expected to see this side of you. It's not something I've seen in our previous encounters. This must be a new discovery. Let me jot it down in my personal memo.
The black spherical object split open, revealing a hidden assortment of items within. Steel plates, gears, clocks, giant drill bits, detectors, spotlights, blue liquid, surgical forceps, thick books, white lab coats, melted candies, adorable cats, electronic displays, and even substances resembling human bodies.
All things from the experiment site. I get it now, that diesel engine is something from the site, too.
Are you giggling? I haven’t heard you making sounds before, but it feels kind of familiar, like one of my colleagues.
My body and my mind feel just...

InfoDisplay_11010114_Text:
Here's Shiyu's stamp of approval: Shixia has officially reached the summit where this letter resides!

Shixia recently got accepted into the top school in Jinzhou and has set her sights on working for the Ministry of Development. She's come a long way and I can't help but feel proud and a little envious. Meanwhile, I'm still figuring out my own career path. Shixia joked about her intense studying habits again today, but I know she'll pass with flying colors — she's always been dedicated and doesn't even take breaks to hang out with me during vacation. I can hardly believe her good luck, but I couldn't be happier for her.
InfoDisplay_11010115_Text:
Here's Shiyu's stamp of approval: Shixia has officially reached the summit where this letter resides!

Shixia just got accepted into the top school in Jinzhou, and she's set her sights on working at the Ministry of Development. I couldn't be happier for her, but also a bit envious of her drive and success. Meanwhile, I still have no idea what I want to do with my life. Shixia keeps bragging about how she'll pass the exam with flying colors, but let's be real, she studies all day and night while I'm out having fun on vacation. She's like a mountain climber, reaching new heights with every achievement. Good for her!

Despite Shixia's initial hesitation, she ended up crawling up the steep terrain alongside me. And after reaching such great heights together, it was clear she wouldn't back down easily. Thankfully, she got into Leyi Academy, otherwise her legs would have been permanently stuck in her bedroom from all the studying. I've never seen someone with so many textbooks and a consistently lit bedroom for a whole year... the school bully must be terrifying! But Shixia seems to be enjoying herself. 

I just don't understand why she's suddenly in a bad mood after acing the exam... I should take the chance to ask her, since she’s busy enjoying the scenery right now.

Character_YinLin_11_14: Despite previously keeping a low-profile, they've recently become more active and are using people like Lirong to recruit new victims.
Character_YinLin_11_15: From what I've gathered, they're in cahoots with Fractsidus...
Character_YinLin_11_16: And a Fractsidus intervention would've only made things worse.
Character_YinLin_11_17: Lirong, once a Midnight Ranger, lost his daughter in a tragic accident.
Character_YinLin_11_19: He truly believes the puppets are living miracles. A godsent means of redemption.
Character_YinLin_11_20: He could have been a good father, but his obsession with losing his daughter consumed him.
Character_YinLin_11_21: Aside from recruiting new people in Jinzhou, Lirong and I were given another task. See the transaction record in your hands?
Character_YinLin_11_22: Some Fractsidus members ordered a batch of puppets from the Society. We're in charge of handling the deal.
Character_YinLin_11_24: Not until their collaboration started. The Fractsidus has been demanding prototype puppets regularly.
Character_YinLin_11_25: I plan to investigate these prototype puppets for manufacturer clues.
Character_YinLin_11_27: It's almost time for the deal… I need to bring Yuanyuan back to Lirong before he gets suspicious.
Character_YinLin_11_28: With the Fractsidus in play, things could go south very fast…
Character_YinLin_11_29: Now you know the nitty-gritty details, it's still not late to call it quits.
Character_YinLin_11_30: I want to find out who's making these puppets.
Character_YinLin_11_31: You don't seem to be mourning someone…
Character_YinLin_11_34: You've suffered a memory loss… I see.
Character_YinLin_11_35: Indeed, if they can make such lifelike puppets by tapping into people's memories, perhaps they could help you remember too.
Character_YinLin_11_38: Lirong and I are about to meet the Fractsidus for our deal. He will then leave to get the puppets at the storage house.
Character_YinLin_11_39: I need you to follow him and send me the coordinates once you're there.
Character_YinLin_11_41: I need to think it through…
Character_YinLin_11_42: And you're in already? Didn't even think twice?
Character_YinLin_11_45: I'll bring Yuanyuan to him... hopefully he won't suspect.
Character_YinLin_11_48: Miss Yinlin? W-where am I…? Where's Daddy?
Character_YinLin_11_5: Tell me about the Séance Society.
Character_YinLin_11_26: But Lirong keeps things very tight. He never takes me to his storage place.
Character_YinLin_11_33: They may have a way to recover my memories.
Character_YinLin_11_36: But we need to find them first... You can be my civilian investigator. What do you say?
Character_YinLin_11_43: Oh well. You seem really confident, and that's a good thing.
Character_YinLin_11_44: They're coming. You'll hide and watch Lirong.
Character_YinLin_10_3: You there. We heard some commotion coming from this area. What's going on?
Character_YinLin_10_4: Nothing, officer. We were just hanging out.
Character_YinLin_10_5: Really? Then what was that loud banging and shouting?
Character_YinLin_10_6: Oh. This girl just tripped over. Poor thing nearly cried her eyes out.
Character_YinLin_10_7: I'm sure it's just a misunderstanding.
Character_YinLin_10_8: Is that so…? Then what did you do after that?
Character_YinLin_10_9: It seems she can't find her father. We were just trying to help.
Character_YinLin_10_12: I see… So they're just being kind!
Character_YinLin_10_13: I don't have other questions, you can...
Character_YinLin_10_14: Leave the girl to us. We'll help find her father.
Character_YinLin_10_15: Thanks, but we've got this. Little one seems quite shy, she's just warming up to us. Wouldn't want to bother you further.
Character_YinLin_10_16: Don't worry, you're not bothering us. It's our job to help civilians in need.
Character_YinLin_10_17: Trust me, I understand how tedious a Patroller's job can get. That's why I want to help.
Character_YinLin_10_18: The name's Yinlin. I am also a Patroller… Here's my ID.
Character_YinLin_10_20: You sure this is real? Never seen her around.
Character_YinLin_10_21: You think I can't tell a fake ID when I see it? Shut your mouth.
Character_YinLin_10_22: No reason you would have seen me. I don't work here, just visiting Jinzhou on vacation.
Character_YinLin_10_24: Then we'll leave the girl to you. Thank you for your help.
Character_YinLin_10_26: Enjoy your day! Have fun in Jinzhou! Oh hey! Wait up, Captain!
Character_YinLin_10_28: Hmm? Do I not look the part?
Character_YinLin_10_30: I would've risked them finding out about Yuanyuan otherwise.
Character_YinLin_10_31: Why didn't you stop Lirong then?
Character_YinLin_10_33: Let your soul rest. Return to your true form, daughter of Lirong—Yuanyuan…
Character_YinLin_10_34: What the...!? Yuanyuan... Is she an android?
Character_YinLin_10_29: I didn't plan to blow my cover, but that Patroller was sharp…
Character_YinLin_10_35: Yes. A "puppet" to be exact… This helpless little girl before you, Lirong's beloved daughter, is nothing but a humanoid robot.
Character_YinLin_1_7: Huh? Is that your first reaction? Come on!
Character_YinLin_1_8: Anyway! You know, we could really use your help with this ongoing case!
Character_YinLin_1_9: Here's the thing, we could really use your help with this ongoing case...
Character_YinLin_1_10: We've been getting a lot of missing persons reports recently.
Character_YinLin_1_11: Nobody ever saw those people assaulted or anything, they just vanished.
Character_YinLin_1_12: Some of those people are even Resonators or they've served in the military!
Character_YinLin_1_14: Since you're always coming and going from the city, can you help me watch out for anything weird or suspicious?
Character_YinLin_1_16: Thank you so much! Knew I could count on you!
Character_YinLin_1_17: Ring me up when you spot anything sus, yeah? Laterz!
Character_YinLin_1_18: (You received a message right after hanging up with Chixia.)
Character_YinLin_1_5: Oh no. Did I break the law or something?
Flow_114000001_1695: (I should go take a closer look...)
Character_YinLin_29_1: No more markings in sight... This must be the safe house.
Character_YinLin_28_1: This must be the marking. That way.
Character_YinLin_27_1: These must be the coordinates. The Sensor may reveal more clues.
Character_YinLin_25_1: This puppet... Next to it is a tag with the recipient's name and identity.
Character_YinLin_25_2: "Identity... Wife of Fujie. Passed away from illness."
Character_YinLin_25_3: "I couldn't bear the sight of her enduring such pain… How I wished I could trade places with her."
Character_YinLin_25_4: "But now I am offered a chance to bring her back to my side. Thank you... Master Dollmaker."
Character_YinLin_23_2: "Identity... Twin sister of Linsi. Went missing in an accident."
Character_YinLin_23_3: "It's all my fault... If I didn't leave, she wouldn't have gone missing like that."
Character_YinLin_23_4: "It's been ten years... I just want to tell her I'm sorry."
Character_YinLin_21_7: Ooh, really? I'll sit back and leave it all to you next time.
Character_YinLin_21_8: We took care of them for now… but there's probably more trouble coming our way.
Character_YinLin_21_10: My, my... Are you worried about me?
Character_YinLin_21_11: What a surprise. I thought you never trusted me this entire time.
Character_YinLin_21_13: Fine, I'll spare you the teasing for now… Your serious face is quite cute though.
Character_YinLin_21_14: Don't worry, we took care of all the Fractsidus people here. If the Society becomes suspicious, I'll just pin everything on them.
Character_YinLin_21_15: They may still question me, but I've mastered gaining trust with lies. It's the key to being an undercover investigator.
Character_YinLin_21_16: Just like what I did to you… Try feeling your back.
Character_YinLin_21_18: A bug and a tracker. Yes. How else did you think I got here so quickly?
Character_YinLin_21_19: I put it there the first time we met.
Character_YinLin_21_21: "Don't trust anyone"… That's the first thing I learned in training.
Character_YinLin_21_22: You may not belong to any group, but you seemed to care for Lirong and Yuanyuan, and you want to recover lost memories…
Character_YinLin_21_23: I can't risk you betraying me by helping them run off or selling me out. Better safe than sorry.
Character_YinLin_21_25: Of course. Dollmaker... He must be a big deal in the Séance Society, or even their leader.
Character_YinLin_21_26: We're getting close to the truth... But we have another issue at hand.
Character_YinLin_21_27: I did a quick checkup on Lirong. He just passed out from Overclocking. Lucky for him it wasn't that bad.
Character_YinLin_21_29: Yuanyuan returned to her puppet form once Lirong fell unconscious. Not even I can reactivate her now.
Character_YinLin_21_30: I doubt she'll be reactivated any time soon. We've reached a dead end with Lirong.
Character_YinLin_21_32: Yeah, I was planning to. We may find some clues.
Character_YinLin_21_33: But we gotta move first. Can't stay here for long.
Character_YinLin_21_34: Go collect the puppets. I'll look after Lirong and Yuanyuan.
Character_YinLin_21_17: You planted a bug on me!?
Character_YinLin_21_24: Then I'm sure you overheard the name "Dollmaker"?
Character_YinLin_21_31: We can try the prototype puppets?
Character_YinLin_19_2: It's okay, Yuanyuan... They won't find us here.
Character_YinLin_19_3: Those scary people... Are they coming after me?
Character_YinLin_19_4: Not just you, Yuanyuan... They want all the puppets here. But I won't let them.
Character_YinLin_19_5: I'll make sure every puppet finds home, together with people who love and need them. I will NOT let those freaks use them for experiments!
Character_YinLin_19_6: Master Dollmaker… How could you be the first to betray our belief...
Character_YinLin_19_7: ("Dollmaker"… Is that the leader of the Séance Society?)
Character_YinLin_19_9: I... I'm not sure anymore. He was our hope... He saved us all, but...
Character_YinLin_19_10: (I guess they still have some morals. There's still things they won't do.)
Character_YinLin_19_13: You can't hide from this good ol' sniffer of mine!
Character_YinLin_19_15: I'll grab these puppets now. What about that guy, boss?
Character_YinLin_19_16: Ice him… We'll take that puppet behind him too.
Character_YinLin_19_17: Huh… Urgh… Huff... I will not... Let you! Aaaghhah!
Character_YinLin_19_18: (Lirong's going to severely Overclock at this rate.)
Character_YinLin_19_23: Hey! What the hell are you doing here?!
Character_YinLin_19_24: One {Male=man;Female=woman}'s not gonna make a difference. Get rid of them now!
Character_YinLin_19_22: Yuanyuan, take your father somewhere safe!
Character_YinLin_41_6: Well, yes. Master Dollmaker asked me to.
Character_YinLin_41_7: We had no other choice. You refused to join us.
Character_YinLin_41_9: No, why would I need to? They're not leaving here.
Character_YinLin_41_10: This is the only place where we can forever live with our loved ones.
Character_YinLin_41_12: I do. But I also know why we'll hold on to them no matter what.
Character_YinLin_41_13: Doctors can't save everyone. Not even the best of us can.
Character_YinLin_41_14: I could only watch as my better half passed away in agony...
Character_YinLin_41_15: Master Dollmaker saved us with his puppets. That's something no doctor can ever achieve.
Character_YinLin_41_16: What about you? Do you have someone you desperately need to see again?
Character_YinLin_41_20: You can ask Master Dollmaker for help. He'll bring them back.
Character_YinLin_41_21: Rather fortunate of you... or shall I say, unfortunate? To not have a single person that you cherish.
Character_YinLin_41_22: Feeling lost? I suggest taking a walk and go chat with everyone a bit. We're all for helping each other.
Character_YinLin_41_8: Did you poison everyone else here too?
Character_YinLin_41_11: You're a doctor. You should know how dangerous those puppets are.
Character_YinLin_41_17: As a matter of fact, I do.
Character_YinLin_40_3: I see… Whatever. I just want to stay with my son.
Character_YinLin_40_5: So what!? He's still my one and only son… What would you know!?
Character_YinLin_40_12: That's why I won't let anyone threaten our peaceful life ever again…
Character_YinLin_40_4: Your son… Is he a puppet too?
Character_YinLin_39_8: We served in the same unit. He Chang Overclocked trying to save me… In the end, he didn't make it.
Character_YinLin_39_10: I know the risks… I'm just... I'll do anything. Anything to make it up to him, if I still can.
Character_YinLin_39_7: Why stay with a puppet when you know it's dangerous?
Character_YinLin_39_9: What if you end up Overclocking too?
Character_YinLin_38_4: Grandma Guan patrols this place daily to keep us safe. She used to be a Midnight Ranger.
Character_YinLin_38_5: Sigh, there's no one like my precious boy. No matter how long this old lady ran her mouth, he'd always listen till the end.
Character_YinLin_38_8: Such a sweet boy he was… His parents died young. I was the only one he could rely on.
Character_YinLin_38_9: And they took him away from me, as if he hadn't suffered enough misfortunes...
Character_YinLin_38_10: How lucky I was to have Master Dollmaker bring him back to me... Praise the heavens for this miracle.
Character_YinLin_38_11: I'll do anything for Master Dollmaker. Nothing will ever be enough to repay his kindness...
Character_YinLin_38_12: But...Why would he make puppets for those Fractsidus devils…
Character_YinLin_38_13: I'm sure Master Dollmaker has his own reasons.
Character_YinLin_38_14: Yes... I'm just grateful to have my grandson back. Can't ask for more.
Character_YinLin_37_7: I have no interest in taking your life. Master Dollmaker wants to see you alive.
Character_YinLin_37_8: You're welcome. But save your gratitude for Master Dollmaker, since he asked me to keep you alive. We'd be in trouble if you died.
Character_YinLin_37_9: Why you insolent little whippersnapper. Show some manners when you're talking to Miss Yinlin.
Character_YinLin_37_12: Youngsters like you, always runnin' off and leaving yer family to rot.
Character_YinLin_37_13: It's "Family Reunion Day." Ain't no way I'm lettin' anyone leave this camp.
Character_YinLin_37_14: Go sit down next to the bonfire and stay there. Don't yer be thinking of slippin' off… Miss Yinlin, show 'em the way.
Character_YinLin_37_15: You heard the kind lady. Now keep your mouth shut and follow me.
Character_YinLin_37_17: You can try to escape. I wouldn't recommend it, though.
Character_YinLin_37_18: Without Dr. Wu Sheng's antidote, you wouldn't make it too far with that poison inside of you.
Character_YinLin_37_20: It's all up to you. Just know I have no reason to lie.
Character_YinLin_37_21: You were planning to ask Master Dollmaker about your memories anyway, so why not come with me?
Character_YinLin_37_23: It's the Séance Society's headquarters. We all live here.
Character_YinLin_37_24: Why don't you join the Society? Make things easier for all of us.
Character_YinLin_37_27: Good try. Try not to sound so obvious next time.
Character_YinLin_37_28: I expected as much. But you may have a change of mind later.
Character_YinLin_37_29: Come on. Joining or not, it won't hurt to introduce yourself first.
Character_YinLin_37_19: You expect me to believe that?
Character_YinLin_35_1: (I was trapped inside this box... It's easier to open now that I broke it.)
Character_YinLin_35_4: (A tablet with an encrypted transmitter? Messages sent through these are less traceable, I heard.)
Character_YinLin_35_5: (But why would I find it here...)
Character_YinLin_34_2: "Wu Sheng/Shunlian… Lianyue/Lian Xiaosheng… Jinlu/He Chang… Lady Guan/Xiaoguan…"
Character_YinLin_34_4: (Some of the names have been crossed-out.)
Character_YinLin_34_5: (These are probably the Séance Society members… The people who went missing.)
Character_YinLin_34_6: (Am I in their base of operation?)

Character_YinLin_58_2: As promised, I owe you a lot of explanation.
Character_YinLin_58_4: No, I wasn't expecting to meet you.
Character_YinLin_58_5: My order was to oversee our deal with the Fractsidus.
Character_YinLin_58_6: You were just a pawn in my plan to find where Lirong kept the puppets.
Character_YinLin_58_7: But I didn't expect him to try and escape with them. Couldn't risk exposing myself yet, so I had to track him down and retrieve the puppets.
Character_YinLin_58_8: Around that time, Dollmaker caught wind of your special abilities. He asked me to bring you to that safe house.
Character_YinLin_58_10: Hehe… Oh, really? I even upped the voltage for the best effect. Was that just a zap to you?
Character_YinLin_58_11: No wonder our Dollmaker took so much interest in that body of yours.
Character_YinLin_58_13: Unfortunately, no. He tried but couldn't gain access.
Character_YinLin_58_14: According to him, you possess a power beyond his understanding that prevented him from prying into your mind. You might be more special than you had thought.
Character_YinLin_58_15: Said he couldn't read your mind without risking his own sanity, let alone retrieve any information... I can't imagine what the hell is going on beneath your skull.
Character_YinLin_58_16: Who knows? Maybe you helped some strangers again only to mess with the wrong person, and ended up with your memories gone.
Character_YinLin_58_19: Don't think I need to, since you can handle yourself just fine. But... if you ever need my help, just let me know.
Character_YinLin_58_20: We have a lot in common. Both alone in this world.
Character_YinLin_58_21: Maybe I'll keep you in my thoughts. A reminder that I'm not the only solitary soul out there.
Character_YinLin_58_22: And eventually, we'll both learn to move through our lives with loneliness.
Character_YinLin_58_23: Perhaps the same loneliness was too much for Dollmaker to bear... That's why he gave up everything to resurrect my parents.
Character_YinLin_58_25: Yes… After my parents' death, we all became chess pieces to him, myself included.
Character_YinLin_58_26: Raised me to be a Patroller for his own agenda. He needed a mole in the Public Security Bureau.
Character_YinLin_58_27: In the end I did become a Patroller, but failed to stay by his side as he desired.
Character_YinLin_58_28: Maybe I'm indeed a heart-wrenching betrayer to him...
Character_YinLin_58_31: But if I had acted sooner, this whole mess could have been avoided. Why didn't I do something?
Character_YinLin_58_32: Perhaps… like everyone else in the Séance Society, I too held onto that naive pipe dream.
Character_YinLin_58_34: Deep down, I knew my dream was built upon the sacrifices of innocent lives... but I couldn't bear to shatter it.
Character_YinLin_58_36: Hmph... because I met you. A total outsider risking {Male=his;Female=her} life for me and for all those people...
Character_YinLin_58_37: A lot of it still remains unresolved. Dollmaker was merely a cog in the wheel. A bigger shadow lingers.
Character_YinLin_58_39: Yes. We must stay vigilant until we expose the true culprits and destroy their plans for good.
Character_YinLin_58_41: Don't tell me you're pulling out at this point?
Character_YinLin_58_44: It was a joke. Anyway, I should thank you... Because of you, I was able to accomplish far more and save many more lives than I imagined.
Character_YinLin_58_3: Had you been planning to get me involved?
Character_YinLin_58_9: You zapped me a little too hard back there.
Character_YinLin_58_12: So he couldn't recover my memories?
Character_YinLin_58_17: I say you should stop playing hero and take better care of yourself. You'll live longer that way.
Character_YinLin_58_24: He had companions, he just never cherished them.
Character_YinLin_58_30: Yes... We all have to face the consequences of our actions. I don't plan to defend him.
Character_YinLin_58_33: The dream of finally meeting my parents and having a real family... I indulged in it more than I care to admit.
Character_YinLin_58_35: In the end, you still fulfilled your duty. As a Patroller.
Character_YinLin_58_42: If you are, I may have to wipe my true identity from your head by force...
Character_YinLin_55_11: Unbelievable... We'd be toast without your help.
Character_YinLin_55_17: What? Come on, you need to be more specific… Whoever they are, sounds like they'll make for quite the Patroller.
Character_YinLin_55_19: Well, that's it for now. Ring me up when you find something unusual again. I'll catch you later!
Character_YinLin_55_14: An emissary of justice, hidden in the shadows.
Character_YinLin_55_16: I'm not sure whether she's a friend or foe.
Character_YinLin_55_18: I'll be sure to tell her that.
Character_YinLin_44_1: Surrender now! We've got you surrounded! You are the leader here, aren't you?
Character_YinLin_44_2: My, my. That's quite the party.
Character_YinLin_44_3: Hey! Who the hell are you? Let {Male=him;Female=her} go!
Character_YinLin_44_6: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I've got a hostage, you see?
Character_YinLin_44_8: I wouldn't try anything stupid if I were you. Can't risk the VIP of Jinzhou getting hurt, now can we?
Character_YinLin_44_9: Ugh, fine... Lower your weapons guys!
Character_YinLin_43_2: Miss Yinlin! The Tacet Discords are here!
Character_YinLin_43_8: You owe me the truth after this. Everything.
Character_YinLin_42_3: ...They're just some poor souls longing to see their loved ones again.
Character_YinLin_42_4: Master Dollmaker saves them, letting them make amends for their past regrets.
Character_YinLin_42_5: A noble cause, is it not?
Character_YinLin_42_7: Heh. How is it betrayal when we were never a team?
Character_YinLin_42_8: Having a cop on our side makes things easier for the Séance Society, don't you agree?
Character_YinLin_42_9: I was just a young orphan, never knew who my parents were. Master Dollmaker took me in.
Character_YinLin_42_10: He taught me combat, puppetry, temperance, and how to become a Patroller.
Character_YinLin_42_11: I owe my life to him.
Character_YinLin_42_13: Yes, his eyes are set on another ultimate goal...
Character_YinLin_42_14: We're all his subjects. He needs us to complete the last two puppets.
Character_YinLin_42_15: Every one of us has been aware of this, but still decided to join.
Character_YinLin_42_17: That's not for your ears. Members only, you see?
Character_YinLin_42_18: But I do admit you're not like the others.
Character_YinLin_42_19: You rescued Lirong and showed respect to the puppets. They weren't just objects to you, I could tell.
Character_YinLin_42_21: Look at you, ever so righteous...
Character_YinLin_42_22: Maybe you're better suited to be a Patroller than me.
Character_YinLin_42_25: Hmph, or maybe... I couldn't just stand by, either.
Character_YinLin_42_27: That's up to you. Trust is a delicate thing. You must follow your instincts and decide how much you're willing to give.
Character_YinLin_42_28: Enough chatter for now. I'll take you to Master Dollmaker's pl...
Character_YinLin_42_6: Is this why you betrayed me?
Character_YinLin_42_12: But he's in for more than just helping people.
Character_YinLin_42_16: What kind of puppet is he trying to make?
Character_YinLin_42_20: I couldn't just stand by and watch.
Character_YinLin_42_23: You were kind to those people and their puppets, too.
Character_YinLin_42_26: Can I trust your words this time?
Character_LingYang_41_22: I'm sure it's no longer feeling lonely... Not anymore.
Character_LingYang_37_27: Anyway, I'm super glad to hear that from you.
Character_LingYang_37_28: {PlayerName}, thank you so much for your help.
Character_LingYang_37_29: I couldn't have accomplished any of this without you.
Character_YinLin_53_3: We've sent those civilians back to Jinzhou for medicals.
Character_YinLin_53_4: But they weren't super excited to leave for some reason. They didn't want to be separated from those puppets, no matter what...
Character_YinLin_53_5: There was really not much we could do about it...
Character_YinLin_53_7: Oh, where's that woman who kidnapped you?
Character_YinLin_53_8: Don't tell me she's already gone... Quick, we're going after her!
Character_YinLin_53_10: Uhh.... Yeah, she's a slippery one. Unlikely we can track her down.
Character_YinLin_53_11: Also... Something about her seems.... not so evil? No, can't make assumptions. She's still a suspect!
Character_YinLin_53_12: Uh, we'll table that for now. Rover, you're a crucial witness. Please, come to the Bureau for a statement when you can.
Character_YinLin_53_2: I'm fine. What about the others?
Character_YinLin_53_6: They'll need some time to process.
Character_YinLin_53_9: I don't think that's necessary at this point.
Character_YinLin_51_3: How could you do this to me!?
Character_YinLin_51_4: I created this home for my followers. They found salvation through my puppets. I am their savior!
Character_YinLin_51_5: You too, Yinlin! You had the chance to reunite with your family! Why are you doing this to me?!
Character_YinLin_51_7: I never met my parents, but my actions are guided by their beliefs.
Character_YinLin_51_8: As a child, I bemoaned my misfortune, but I knew better than to harm others to make up for it.
Character_YinLin_51_9: The dead deserve peace. My parents are gone, and I can't change the past.
Character_YinLin_51_10: But the present is mine to control. I can still bring justice to those who caused their untimely end...
Character_YinLin_51_11: What's wrong with doing what I can for our happiness? Laws and principles are just tools for those in charge!
Character_YinLin_51_12: Is that why you must deprave others of their happiness? Using them as your pawns?
Character_YinLin_51_13: Ha! Suddenly justice matters to you? Don't tell me you still think you're a Patroller?
Character_YinLin_51_16: Yes, they may never allow me back... Doesn't matter now. It's a small price to pay to stop you and the greater evil you serve.
Character_YinLin_51_17: I don't need a recognized identity to do what's right. I can do it my way.
Character_YinLin_51_19: I should get going. I'm leaving the rest to you, Rover.
Character_YinLin_51_21: Next time we meet, I'll explain all, and I'll thank you properly, I guess.
Character_YinLin_51_6: Puppets can never replace real family.
Character_YinLin_50_2: Lightning has destroyed the control panel and hologram projectors. This is what the factory really looks like.
Character_YinLin_50_4: The Fractsidus... You got this from them? In exchange for being their pawn?
Character_YinLin_50_5: Me? Their pawn? Hah! I'm the one pulling their strings, sweetheart!
Character_YinLin_49_1: Ugh… Yinlin! What are you doing?!
Character_YinLin_49_2: It all ends here, Dollmaker… You're going nowhere.
Character_YinLin_49_3: You of all people should know why the Fractsidus offered their help!
Character_YinLin_49_4: Yinlin… You... How dare you betray me!
Character_YinLin_49_5: I have never forgotten who I am. My bloodline is one of Jinzhou's Patrollers. I will always uphold my duty, just like my parents before me.
Character_YinLin_49_6: They fought to the last minute of their lives, trying to save the innocent.
Character_YinLin_49_7: Everything I've done... I did it for them!
Character_YinLin_49_8: No... you did it to relive the kindness you once felt.
Character_YinLin_49_9: But my parents are gone. So are everyone else's loved ones... It's time we wake up from this dream you've been spinning.
Character_YinLin_49_11: The Exiles... He just let them in?!
Character_YinLin_48_1: Yinlin, you made it. Have those cops entered the factory?
Character_YinLin_48_2: Not yet. But those Exiles were Overclocking and I had to take them down.
Character_YinLin_48_5: They're a bunch of outcasts, willing to do whatever it takes to survive. No one would mourn them if they died.
Character_YinLin_48_8: Your Forte could have saved many, but you...
Character_YinLin_48_9: I could save them, I'm sure, but who's going to save me?
Character_YinLin_48_11: Stop it, Dollmaker... My parents would not consent to being brought back as puppets.
Character_YinLin_48_12: Yinlin... I thought at least you would understand me.
Character_YinLin_48_13: I don't blame you. You were too young when they passed away, after all. You hardly remember them.
Character_YinLin_48_14: And that's why I couldn't revive them from your memories. Not from my own, either.
Character_YinLin_48_15: This is where you come in, Rover. You're a godsend, a gift from above.
Character_YinLin_48_17: Precisely. With help from the Fractsidus, plus your body's data… I will finally create their puppets.
Character_YinLin_48_19: I was an outcast, alone and shunned... Until my mentor and his wife took me in. They were my true family.
Character_YinLin_48_20: I'll do anything to bring them back, no matter the price...
Character_YinLin_48_22: So what? Why should I care?
Character_YinLin_48_23: It's almost time. We'll have to leave the factory behind, but there's a couple of prototypes I need to bring.
Character_YinLin_48_24: My identity must stay hidden. Use explosives to stop them if necessary, Yinlin.
Character_YinLin_48_25: But our people are still inside the factory.
Character_YinLin_48_26: "Our people"? There's only the two of us. The rest of them are not worth my concern.
Character_YinLin_48_28: Same as before, Yinlin. Just knock {Male=him;Female=her} out.
Character_YinLin_48_29: No need to keep {Male=him;Female=her} intact this time, some level of basic consciousness is enough. The Fractsidus taught me methods to operate on a body like that.
Character_YinLin_48_30: I'll leave two puppets here. To pretend we're still holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage behind the closed door.
Character_YinLin_48_31: We'll need the data repository too.
Character_YinLin_48_32: Yes... My research data. That's more valuable than my life.
Character_YinLin_48_10: What are you planning to do?
Character_YinLin_48_16: You want to use me for that?
Character_YinLin_48_21: That doesn't mean you can hurt other people.
Character_YinLin_45_1: Yes... Some TDs found their way inside, and we're now surrounded by a bunch of cops. Hard to make it out of here with the specimens.
Character_YinLin_45_2: Fortunately you caught that Rover. Whether {Male=he;Female=she}'s useful for research or not, holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage will buy us some time.
Character_YinLin_45_3: What should I do next, Master?
Character_YinLin_45_4: Here's the coordinates. Bring {Male=him;Female=her} to me in the inner chamber.
Character_YinLin_45_5: {Male=He;Female=She}'s a sly one. Ready to bolt any moment.
Character_YinLin_45_7: We'll talk once you get there.
Character_YinLin_45_8: You heard him. You're in our turf. Better not get any bright ideas.
Character_YinLin_45_12: Hand it over. Don't try to deceive me.
Character_YinLin_45_17: You are a valuable test subject. I don't want to make things difficult for you, unless you force my hands... Got it?
Character_YinLin_45_19: (I'll be typing on this tablet for you to see. I want you to follow my instructions.)
Character_YinLin_45_23: You don't need to know. Now get moving.
Character_YinLin_45_24: (We're in the factory where the Dollmaker makes his puppets. The place is full of traps and his minions. Very dangerous.)
Character_YinLin_45_25: At least tell me what he's planning to do with me.
Character_YinLin_45_26: Hehe. Patience. You'll know once you see him.
Character_YinLin_45_6: I have trackers planted on {Male=him;Female=her}. {Male=He;Female=She}'s not going anywhere in our territory.
Character_YinLin_45_10: Well that's not your problem. Also, no one's coming to your rescue anytime soon.
Character_YinLin_45_11: I guess you managed to send out a distress call? Somehow it slipped past us. Ah… You had an encrypted transmitter tablet.
Character_YinLin_45_16: Funny you'd think you have a choice.
Character_YinLin_45_18: (Here's the thing. Dollmaker's listening to our every word. All my efforts will be wasted if he suspects anything.)
Character_YinLin_45_21: Very well, if you can refrain from unnecessary struggle, we won't have to do things the hard way.
Character_YinLin_45_27: (Dollmaker's in bed with the Fractsidus, trading Overclock-inducing puppets for resources and funds.)

Character_YinLin_43_3: Go tell your grandma. Get everyone somewhere safe.
Character_YinLin_43_5: What about you, Rover? Will you join them or flee while you can in this chaos?
Character_YinLin_43_7: So you want to help protect them. Knew it.
Character_YinLin_43_9: Everything, huh... The secrets I hold might be bigger than you imagine.
Character_YinLin_43_10: If you really want to know... You'll need to survive this first!
POI_HSGDLD_9_1: Hello there. Are you the ones who’s taken the cell?
POI_HSGDLD_9_2: Caramel? What caramel? We be eaten all the caramel if we had them!
POI_HSGDLD_9_4: Caramel, cellamel. They be the same.
POI_HSGDLD_9_5: It’s just an act. I’ve seen it all before.
POI_HSGDLD_9_6: You try talk sense to these airheads and all you’re going to get is a dead end.
POI_HSGDLD_9_7: Some good-old beating is the only way to deal with these clowns.
POI_HSGDLD_8_1: There's not a door to block us this time, but the Cell is missing.
POI_HSGDLD_8_2: *sigh* It's either one problem or the other. I can't even hand over my shift properly. How useless I am...
POI_HSGDLD_8_3: Err... This isn’t really your fault, is it?
POI_HSGDLD_8_4: Constant moaning about these matters won't do you any good... You are familiar with this place more than any of us. Why don't you try recalling where the Cell may be?
POI_HSGDLD_8_5: Come to think of it... Nearby Exiles sometimes come here to steal things.
POI_HSGDLD_8_6: But they usually go for food or scrap metals, stuff like that. They don’t have the guts to try and take something like this... What happened this time?
POI_HSGDLD_8_7: Hmm... It's a clue at least. Lead the way. We should talk with the Exiles nearby.
POI_HSGDLD_7_1: You work fast, {PlayerName}. You’ll make for a great engineer. Have you considered becoming one?
POI_HSGDLD_7_4: Ahh. That’s a shame. But I agree that one should decide their own path and walk it on their own free will.
POI_HSGDLD_7_5: Haha. You were quick to answer. Why don’t you give it some more experience before you come to a final decision?
POI_HSGDLD_7_6: Qiuwang utters as he continues to adjust the Induction Cell.
POI_HSGDLD_7_7: It is done! Data link complete... We now have access to the Tacet Discord incursion on record.
POI_HSGDLD_7_8: Incursion records? I thought restoring the data was all we needed to do?
POI_HSGDLD_7_9: Restoring the data is only a temporary solution. With this record, we can study the TDs’ behaviors, in order to better formulate measures to strengthen our defenses and eliminate future problems.
POI_HSGDLD_7_10: Which is also the ultimate goal of my assignment... Performing constant repairs is simply unfeasible long-term.
POI_HSGDLD_7_11: As you can see, all three surveillance stations are currently damaged. It will take a significant amount of time for even the most skilled engineers to repair and have them fully back and running.
POI_HSGDLD_7_12: Not to mention the numerous dangers they may encounter along the way...
POI_HSGDLD_7_13: Ahem. In short, our work at this station has concluded. We should move on to the next one.
POI_HSGDLD_7_14: I shall entrust you for protection if we come across anything unexpected.
POI_HSGDLD_6_1: Astonishing, {PlayerName}! Aren’t you just full of surprises?
POI_HSGDLD_6_2: Well... Let's see here. This Induction Cell seems to be intact. Once we install this back to where it belongs, all it takes for me is to adjust some settings to restore the station’s data.
POI_HSGDLD_5_1: Hmm... The door seems a little strange...
POI_HSGDLD_5_2: The rocks must’ve smashed the supporting beam, so the wall tilted inside and jammed the door.
POI_HSGDLD_5_3: Indeed. The roof has been punctured cleanly through by a large rock.
POI_HSGDLD_5_4: I wonder if we can repair it... *sigh*... Everything's breaking down all over the place lately...
POI_HSGDLD_5_5: It would seem repairs are unnecessary. Better to tear everything down and rebuild.
POI_HSGDLD_5_6: Well, things breaking down isn’t necessarily a bad thing. No construction without destruction. Don’t you agree?
POI_HSGDLD_4_2: I’m okay. Thank goodness you guys came in time. Almost thought I was a goner!
POI_HSGDLD_4_3: Phew... Good to hear. Can’t have any more people get hurt. Not on my watch...
POI_HSGDLD_4_4: Wait a sec... Your uniform. You're a Midnight Ranger? And who may this be...?
POI_HSGDLD_4_5: Yes, the name’s Hé Chou. Rearguard, Midnight Rangers. And this is {PlayerName}, a friend who’s got quite a few fighting skills under {Male=hs;Female=her} sleeves it seems like.
POI_HSGDLD_4_6: Ahh. Greetings. I’m Qiuwang. Engineer. I received orders from the Defense Division to report my new assignment. I have been briefed on the recent incidents regarding this area. Thank you for your hard work thus far.
POI_HSGDLD_4_7: Yet, regardless of how difficult the situation may be, we cannot put aside our tasks. Without further delay, let’s head to the surveillance station.
POI_HSGDLD_4_8: You... You do realize you were just attacked by TDs, right? Aren't you afraid? You sure you don’t want to rest up a bit?
POI_HSGDLD_4_9: I’m a bit frightened, yes. But rest won’t be necessary.
POI_HSGDLD_4_10: The risk of danger increases each minute the radar isn’t operational. As I was entrusted with this task, I am obligated to fulfill these duties.
POI_HSGDLD_4_11: Besides, there is something I wish to pursue...
POI_HSGDLD_4_12: The way you put it reminds of the old me who volunteered to come to the Desorock Highland.
POI_HSGDLD_4_13: I used to be full of ambition and eagerness to try out something new...
POI_HSGDLD_4_14: But after you get beaten down over and over again, those close to you disappear one after another...
POI_HSGDLD_4_15: And all you can do is just watch... standing there helplessly...
POI_HSGDLD_4_16: I’ll see if you can still keep that enthusiasm and high spirit of yours when the time comes.
POI_HSGDLD_4_17: When the time... Well, only time will tell!
POI_HSGDLD_4_18: All I know is that there is a task at hand, and repairs must be done at the surveillance station.
POI_HSGDLD_32_5: I’ve been doing much better lately, thanks for asking. The number of TD attacks has dropped, and the radar’s been in top shape.
POI_HSGDLD_32_6: After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
POI_HSGDLD_32_7: After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
POI_HSGDLD_32_8: It’s me, Hé Chou. Don’t tell me you forgot about me already? We were on the radar repair job last time. I was the one that always had my head hanging...
POI_HSGDLD_32_10: Yeah, after I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
POI_HSGDLD_32_11: Now that I've decided to stay here, I can’t be complaining all the time have to get my act together.
POI_HSGDLD_32_12: I mean, Qiuwang was able to develop such an amazing tech. I can't lose to him!
POI_HSGDLD_32_14: After he made sure that everything were the way they should be, he moved on to the next place.
POI_HSGDLD_32_15: He mentioned there are still more data that needs to be collected, and even more advanced technologies that need to be researched...
POI_HSGDLD_32_16: From that moment on, I knew that someone like him is destined go even further along the path he had chosen... There’s nothing in this world that could stop him.
POI_HSGDLD_32_17: And my job is to safeguard the Desorock Highlands and fulfill my duties as a soldier.
POI_HSGDLD_32_18: That is the path I have chosen.
POI_HSGDLD_32_9: You've changed so much I almost didn't recognize you.
POI_HSGDLD_3_1: The Tacet Discords over there surrounding the sentry tower...? Kind of strange...
POI_HSGDLD_3_2: ...Ah! There's a man trapped in the sentry tower! Let's eliminate those Tacet Discords and get him down!
POI_HSGDLD_26_3: ...I've managed to calm down a bit. I feel much better now.
POI_HSGDLD_26_4: To be honest. From the moment I received my mentor’s message, I had a feeling that his fate has been sealed.
POI_HSGDLD_26_5: Being a strict person that he always is, he never talks about anything other than research.
POI_HSGDLD_26_6: But in that message, besides the research data, there were also a few words of advice.
POI_HSGDLD_26_7: "This work proved to be a very dangerous one. Should you continue, you risk losing your loved ones, friends... and everything you hold dear till this day."
POI_HSGDLD_26_8: "Looking back from the end, the data you worked so hard to obtain is but a candle in the wind, always on the verge of being extinguished."
POI_HSGDLD_26_9: "If you still decide to carry on despite knowing all of this."
POI_HSGDLD_26_10: "Then come to the Desorock Highland. It's time for you to take over."
POI_HSGDLD_26_11: ...I didn’t realize you went through all of this... I even tried to act tough on you, and kept mumbling on and on...
POI_HSGDLD_26_12: You're in as much pain as I am... but you didn't stop or complain, and continued moving on...
POI_HSGDLD_26_13: I'm just... so useless. No wonder I can't do anything right...
POI_HSGDLD_26_14: Well, you’ve done quite well yourself all this time.
POI_HSGDLD_26_15: You were with us the whole time, providing information and clearing paths... You even brought along a  strong helper like {PlayerName}.
POI_HSGDLD_26_16: You and your squad have fulfilled your duties well.
POI_HSGDLD_26_18: On the battlefield, your sacrifices and resistance is what prevented the radar from suffering any major damage.
POI_HSGDLD_26_19: And later your tireless efforts paved way for the swift repairs of the radar.
POI_HSGDLD_26_20: All of this wouldn’t have been achieved without any of us.
POI_HSGDLD_26_24: We are in your debt, {PlayerName}. You had no obligation to do so, yet your aid is inmeasurable.
POI_HSGDLD_26_25: I shall double me efforts in studying these precious data we have worked so hard to collect.
POI_HSGDLD_26_26: I shall continue to study these precious data we managed to collect.
POI_HSGDLD_26_27: After analysing the waveforms, I have come to a preliminarily conclusion that the abnormal evolution rate of the Tacet Discords in this area is correlated to the surrounding environment and the simulation subjects.
POI_HSGDLD_26_29: The Rangers who fought till the end.
POI_HSGDLD_26_30: TDs imitate behaviors to evolve. The more they fight, the faster they evolve.
POI_HSGDLD_26_31: That's how they learned our tactics! Whenever we defended a surveillance point, they seized it. When we guarded an Induction Cell, they tried to capture it. And when we protected the researcher, the TDs rushed for him too.
POI_HSGDLD_26_32: Which means that the more we resist, the faster they adapt? What are we going to do about it?
POI_HSGDLD_26_33: TDs can only "imitate" and cannot truly learn. They are merely a jumble of chaotic frequencies, not intelligent beings.
POI_HSGDLD_26_34: They bear no distinguish between good or evil, right from wrong. They simply imitate, prey, and attack...
POI_HSGDLD_26_35: As long as we make use of this quality, we can bend the situation to our advantage and develop defensive technologies to prevent them from causing harm the surveillance and radar stations ever again.
POI_HSGDLD_26_36: The data that my mentor left behind for me at the end was a clear indication in this direction... I will devote all my efforts into promoting this technology.
POI_HSGDLD_26_37: What do we have here...? The radar's detection accuracy has gone up and revealed a few uncharted areas after it was brought back online.
POI_HSGDLD_26_38: My mentor once told me that these kinds of places usually store unknown treasures. Obtaining this precious data today is more than adequate for me, so I'll leave these treasures to you, {PlayerName}.
POI_HSGDLD_26_39: I hope you can also experience the surprise and excitement of exploring the unknown.
POI_HSGDLD_26_23: So, what do we do next?
POI_HSGDLD_25_1: The radar's beam of light shines on Hé Chou's tired eyes as it powers up. But after a few seconds, his eyes dim again—it's a light he’s seen countless times, only to be swallowed by darkness. No one knows how long it will last this time, but for someone about to leave, its duration no longer matters.
POI_HSGDLD_25_2: Qiuwang rushes to collect data, his fingers slightly trembling as he enters the inputs. Despite the nerves, his years of experience ensure he makes no mistakes.
POI_HSGDLD_25_4: Frequencies. Mixed with chaos and clamor...
POI_HSGDLD_25_5: Dozens of Elite Class TDs... and ten individuals who fought to their last.
POI_HSGDLD_25_6: Among them were nine elites and one untrained.
POI_HSGDLD_25_7: Ziqin, Zhiyou, Nianhan... It’s the nine Rangers that were stationed here together with me.
POI_HSGDLD_25_8: The nine people fought against the TDs while protecting the untrained.
POI_HSGDLD_25_9: The frequency gradually weakened and disappeared... Only one TD and the untrained person remained.
POI_HSGDLD_25_10: Later the frequency demonstrated a steady pattern, and the waveform resembled the comparative experiments often carried out in laboratories...
POI_HSGDLD_25_11: But this time, it was done on the field.
POI_HSGDLD_25_12: The slight tremors on the waveform reveal the agony of being torn apart...
POI_HSGDLD_25_16: After completing a set of comparative experiments, the person ended their own life.
POI_HSGDLD_25_17: After completing a set of comparative experiments, the person ended their own life.
POI_HSGDLD_25_18: The TD followed suit by performing the same action...
POI_HSGDLD_25_19: You mean to tell me that this person, knowing he’s got no way of escaping, collected the frequency of the TD’s evolution rate on the spot, and by using their quirk of of copying human behaviors, guided it to destroy itself?
POI_HSGDLD_25_20: To do this, you have to be someone with a heap of experience in TD research.
POI_HSGDLD_25_21: As far as I know, there’s only one person that checks the box ...
POI_HSGDLD_24_2: The place’s been like this ever since that battle...
POI_HSGDLD_24_3: There's one last approach—activate the radar.
POI_HSGDLD_24_4: Once done, we may find new information from the station’s data.
POI_HSGDLD_24_5: I can’t say for certain there will be any. But at this point, there’s only one way to find out...
POI_HSGDLD_24_6: The last data... Our last hope.
POI_HSGDLD_23_1: Data link complete... TD behavior record download complete...
POI_HSGDLD_23_2: Qiuwang gives a strange face after he carefully compares the data sets—his eyes sparkle with surprise, but the corners of his mouth curl down slightly into a bitter smile.
POI_HSGDLD_23_3: Just like my mentor said, the TDs in this area have evolved. They now coordinate their attacks and finish off their targets...
POI_HSGDLD_23_5: Yes. My mentor. The engineer that was last assigned to this station.
POI_HSGDLD_23_6: A while ago, I received a message from him mentioning the TDs in this area were evolving in abnormal speed. His speculations are now proven true after witnessing what had happened today for myself.
POI_HSGDLD_23_7: I've collected most of the data mentioned in the message, however...
POI_HSGDLD_23_8: The reason for this evolution remains a mystery. The same can be said about the whereabouts of my mentor...
POI_HSGDLD_23_10: Yes... I haven't heard from him since he sent me the message...
POI_HSGDLD_23_11: Considering the speed at which the TDs are evolving, I'm afraid he...
POI_HSGDLD_23_12: ...Don't give up. There's still a place we haven't been to yet.
POI_HSGDLD_23_13: The radar station. We should give the place a look.
POI_HSGDLD_23_9: So you were looking for your mentor.
POI_HSGDLD_22_2: Good thing I had {PlayerName} covering my back... Wouldn’t have done it without {Male=him;Female=her}...
POI_HSGDLD_22_3: So... Now that we’ve taken care of our TD problem. How about we check on the data transfer?
POI_HSGDLD_22_4: If it's already done, then my work here is almost complete...
POI_HSGDLD_22_5: One moment. The frequencies of these TDs seem very unusual. I’d like to collect some data.
POI_HSGDLD_22_6: Qiuwang collected a set of TD frequency data.
POI_HSGDLD_22_7: It is done. We should head back to the surveillance station for a further analysis.
POI_HSGDLD_21_1: Hmm... Now that the last Cell is back in place, the entire line has been connected, so it’ll take some time for the data to transfer.
POI_HSGDLD_21_4: Tsk... These guys look like they mean business...
POI_HSGDLD_21_5: They’ve got us outnumbered, what are we gonna do...
POI_HSGDLD_21_8: I admire your confidence, but be cautious not to get too overconfident.
POI_HSGDLD_21_9: You’ve got some skills I’ll give you that, but don’t get your guard down...
POI_HSGDLD_21_10: These TDs may look large in size, but as long as we can figure out their frequencies and exploit their weaknesses, we may be able to gain the upper hand.
POI_HSGDLD_21_11: We should take the initiative and attack from our side to widen our chances of winning.
POI_HSGDLD_21_12: Yeah, these TDs aren’t going anywhere anyway... Here goes nothing. I’m not letting anything get in my way of turning in this shift!
POI_HSGDLD_21_6: Don't worry. That’s what I’m here for.
POI_HSGDLD_20_1: Ahh. The Cell is right there in front of us.
POI_HSGDLD_20_2: This should be the last one, right...? Finally, I wrap this up now...
POI_HSGDLD_2_1: You there, kind {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Please, I’m in dire need of assistance...
POI_HSGDLD_2_3: *sigh* The Tacet Discords busted our radars again...
POI_HSGDLD_2_4: I don’t know what’s got into them lately. It’s like they’re on a rampage. We’ve lost count how many times the radars’ gotten totaled...
POI_HSGDLD_2_5: Fix, smashed, fix, smashed. Rinse and repeat... With our brothers going out like flies, even the engineers hightailed it. When is this ever going to end...?
POI_HSGDLD_2_7: My squadmates. Ah... excuse me. Forgot to introduce myself. I’m Hé Chou, <ano=Rearguard>Midnight Rangers</ano>. I’m from the unit stationed in this area.
POI_HSGDLD_2_8: With all the mess the TDs have been giving us, everyone’s... ran off left, right, and center.
POI_HSGDLD_2_9: And now I’m the only one that’s left... plain old useless me... with nothing I can do...
POI_HSGDLD_2_10: An engineer was supposed to report in for duty today, but he hasn’t even shown up yet...
POI_HSGDLD_2_11: Ugh. It’s my last assignment, too. I can’t screw this up...
POI_HSGDLD_2_12: Just my luck. How did I get myself into this mess?
POI_HSGDLD_2_26: All right, all right... Guess it’s the only thing I can do for now...
POI_HSGDLD_2_27: Well, it can’t get any worse than this...
POI_HSGDLD_2_19: But you’re right... There are TDs running wild all over the place as it is... Can’t have my bad luck passing on to others...
POI_HSGDLD_2_21: All right, all right... Guess it’s the only thing I can do for now...
POI_HSGDLD_2_22: By the way. I haven’t caught your name...
POI_HSGDLD_2_24: {PlayerName}... Got it. I’ll keep that in mind.
POI_HSGDLD_2_25: Also, once my shift’s over, remind me to get you a good luck charm to make up for all this jumble.
POI_HSGDLD_2_14: Want me to help you find him?
POI_HSGDLD_2_15: You’ll end up in a deeper mess if you don’t chin-up...
POI_HSGDLD_19_1: As I anticipated, there are also signs of structural collapse in this station... Likely caused by battle.
POI_HSGDLD_19_2: Judging from these markings, the significance of the amount of force exterted that led to this destruction cannot be underestimated.
POI_HSGDLD_19_3: Fortunately, it seems that the surrounding area is still safe for the time being... We should break the debris and get inside quickly.
POI_HSGDLD_18_1: Qiuwang installed the Induction Cell back in its place.
POI_HSGDLD_18_3: I’ve managed to gain acces of data on the TDs’ behaviors as well... So the reports about how quickly they’re adapting were true...
POI_HSGDLD_18_5: One more surveillance station to go and the radars can be back online.
POI_HSGDLD_18_6: It seems the only way we can solve this mystery is by getting the last set of data...
POI_HSGDLD_18_7: Before we do, there’s more work ahead of us.
POI_HSGDLD_17_1: Let’s hope this thing’s still working.
POI_HSGDLD_16_1: The Cell seems to be intact on the exterior. The only way to find out if it’s still functional is by going back to the surveillance station.
POI_HSGDLD_16_2: We should shake a leg then... The quicker we get it fixed up, the sooner I can say goodbye to this shift...
POI_HSGDLD_15_9: In the end, there’s always a balance in between fortune and misfortune.
POI_HSGDLD_15_10: Once a bad luck passes, a good luck would follow.
POI_HSGDLD_15_11: Think of it this way. We gained some useful items searching the first two garbage piles, and now we have the Cell as well.
POI_HSGDLD_15_12: I’d say it’s a fruitful outcome! A form of good fortune, wouldn’t you say so?
POI_HSGDLD_15_2: No need to get anxious. Every cloud has a silver lining. These items you found have their own uses. You should keep them.
POI_HSGDLD_15_5: Well, on a brighter note. We managed to gain a lot from all of this.
POI_HSGDLD_15_6: And by employing proof by exhaustion. There is only one pile left.
POI_HSGDLD_15_7: The Cell will soon be in our grasps!
POI_HSGDLD_14_5: In the end, there’s always a balance in between fortune and misfortune.
POI_HSGDLD_14_6: Once a bad luck passes, a good luck would follow.
POI_HSGDLD_14_7: Why don’t we take advantage of our good luck and search the other piles? We might find even more treasures...
POI_HSGDLD_14_9: Haha. Let’s leave the decision to {PlayerName}.!
POI_HSGDLD_14_2: No need to get anxious. Every cloud has a silver lining. These items you found have their own uses. You should keep them.
POI_HSGDLD_14_10: There are things we can use. Let’s keep them.
POI_HSGDLD_14_11: I can feel the spirit of exploration inside of you... I genuinely think you are a perfect match for our line of work, {PlayerName}.
POI_HSGDLD_13_1: It seems luck is on our side. We have the Cell!
POI_HSGDLD_13_2: Didn’t expect my luck to make a turn from digginig through a garbage dump...
POI_HSGDLD_13_3: You may be surprised at what you can find even in garbage. Perhaps there are items in those other piles that would prove useful to us as well...
POI_HSGDLD_13_4: Tell me you're not thinking what I think you're thinking...
POI_HSGDLD_13_5: *chuckle* I'm fine with either. Let’s leave the decision to {PlayerName}.
POI_HSGDLD_13_6: There are things we can use. Let’s keep them.
POI_HSGDLD_13_7: Is there even an end to this...?
POI_HSGDLD_10_1: Ow, ow, ow! Alright, Alright! I get it, Boss. I give up, okay!?
POI_HSGDLD_10_2: Out with it. Where are you keeping the Induction Cell?
POI_HSGDLD_10_3: I-Induction Cell? We've never even heard of it before.
POI_HSGDLD_10_4: It's a rectangular piece with smooth edges. It has a metallic frame, cold on the hands, and is rather heavy to carry...
POI_HSGDLD_10_5: Oh! That! Yes, yes. We’ve seen it before.
POI_HSGDLD_10_6: The TDs’ been coming over here a lot these days. And we saw them getting into a huge fight with those uniform guys the other day.
POI_HSGDLD_10_7: They were fighting over that big tin box like crazy. We thought it must be some kind of treasure, and brought it back after everything went all quite.
POI_HSGDLD_10_8: Couldn’t figure out for the life of us what it was or used for, so we just tossed it aside.
POI_HSGDLD_10_9: Enough yammering. Just tell us where it is!
POI_HSGDLD_10_10: Hey! Easy, easy buddy! I-I don’t remember where it is. It’s been a while since we tossed it. Okay...?
POI_HSGDLD_10_11: How about a physical reminder on the head. Eh?
POI_HSGDLD_10_12: Eek! I swear, I can’t remember!
POI_HSGDLD_10_13: Why... why don’t you go look for it yourself? It’s probably in that pile over there.
POI_HSGDLD_10_14: It appears we are short on screening options for the time being. We’ll just have to resort to the old-fashioned way.
POI_HSGDLD_10_16: One moment. There’s one more thing I’d like to ask.
POI_HSGDLD_10_17: Do you recall seeing anyone else besides the Rangers recently?
POI_HSGDLD_10_18: Oh, yeah. There was someone who wore the same uniform as you and was always repairing stuff near the surveillance station. Haven't seen them lately, though.
POI_HSGDLD_10_22: It’s a long story. Let’s focus on the task at hand first.

Character_LingYang_87_7: You'll often see him sprinting around the alleys, lending a hand wherever needed.
