ItemInfo_70140001_BgDescription: Developed by the Pioneer Association, this camera allows its users to capture samples with detailed data in the wild.
HuanglongXZ_9_1: What's wrong? Are you injured from the fight?
HuanglongXZ_9_4: You saw our Sentinel in your memories?
HuanglongXZ_9_6: Yes, the one we built this statue for. The <ano=Oracle Engine>Sentinel</ano> in Jinzhou. There is one capital and six cities in Huanglong, with each city having its own Sentinel. While they share some similarities in appearance, there are also differences.
HuanglongXZ_9_10: Sentinels are present where civilizations thrive. Huanglong stands out with the highest number of currently coexisting Sentinels, because of its long history and vast land.
HuanglongXZ_9_11: Records state the Sentinels in Huanglong were once a single entity. Now they are each responsible for a part of Huanglong.
HuanglongXZ_9_12: Naturally, there are Sentinels in other regions too, but far fewer compared to Huanglong.
HuanglongXZ_9_13: In Huanglong, most of the Sentinels take the shape of a <ano=dragon>Loong</ano>. In other regions, they manifest in various forms...
HuanglongXZ_9_14: You were standing face to face with our Sentinel?
HuanglongXZ_9_15: One can hardly see our Sentinel with their own eyes. Most people only get the chance during the Appointment Ceremonies.
HuanglongXZ_9_16: According to your description, you stood pretty close. Only the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is allowed in its proximity; for now, that person is the <ano=highest official>Magistrate</ano> of Jinzhou...
HuanglongXZ_9_19: Whoa! Darn... That must be an Elite Class!
HuanglongXZ_9_7: Are there other Sentinels outside Huanglong?
HuanglongXZ_9_8: What do the other Sentinels look like?
HuanglongXZ_9_9: I saw myself standing face to face with it.
HuanglongXZ_8_1: Bravo! So you still remember how to fight despite having forgotten everything, wow.
HuanglongXZ_8_2: Watch me lead the charge next time! No one messes with Ma Xiaofa... Ahem, I mean Chixia!
HuanglongXZ_7_1: It may seem all nice and quiet here now, but you never know when a Tacet Discord might pop up outta nowhere!
HuanglongXZ_6_1: Rover, I know you can't remember a thing, but there's one thing I'm 90%... no, 100% sure about you! You must be a Resonator too.
HuanglongXZ_6_2: You've got a Tacet Mark on the back of your hand, and you have a <ano=Terminal>gourd</ano>. These are proofs you're a Resonator. Your gourd's design looks a bit different from the ones we use though.
HuanglongXZ_6_3: Plus, not many people are gonna hang out in the wilderness these days, unless they're Resonators.
HuanglongXZ_5_1: Rover, I know you can't remember a thing, but there's one thing I'm 90%... no, 100% sure about you! You must be a Resonator too.
HuanglongXZ_5_2: Also, we have <color=Highlight>Resonators</color> who can detect the formation of Tacet Fields nearby, like what Yangyang just did. She can tell all kinds of information by reading the Streams in the wind—that's her Resonance Ability.
HuanglongXZ_5_3: —while I couldn't feel a thing, haha.
HuanglongXZ_5_4: Plus, not many people are gonna hang out in the wilderness these days, unless they're Resonators.
HuanglongXZ_4_1: Are you alright? Do you feel any discomfort?
HuanglongXZ_4_5: You can call me Chixia... And, she's Yangyang!
HuanglongXZ_4_6: We are in the Gorges of Spirits. It's on the outskirts of Jinzhou, Huanglong.
HuanglongXZ_4_7: Your attire doesn't seem local. Are you a roving traveler from afar, or... someone returning home?
HuanglongXZ_4_11: So you don't know why you're here, where you're from, or who you are...
HuanglongXZ_4_12: Baizhi didn't tell us you'd have these aftereffects when you wake up.
HuanglongXZ_4_14: The wind has brought us a warning. The Etheric Sea is converging. It seems a new Tacet Field is taking shape.
HuanglongXZ_4_16: That means it's probably gonna get dangerous here soon.
HuanglongXZ_4_17: Ugh, I knew it. Our <ano=Terminals>gourds</ano> are out of service because of the <color=Highlight>Etheric Sea's</color> influence. We can't send or receive messages for help now. We better hurry over to meet up with Baizhi at our gathering spot and get outta here.
HuanglongXZ_4_18: Guess you really can't recall a thing, but don't worry!
HuanglongXZ_4_22: We shouldn't stay here. If you don't have other plans, how about leaving with us for now?
HuanglongXZ_4_25: Oh, that's great! Let's go together!
HuanglongXZ_4_26: The terrain is complicated here, and we usually take that one route. If you don't mind, why don't we travel together for now? You can decide your future plans once we leave the gorge.
HuanglongXZ_4_19: Rover... can we call you that before you can remember your true name?
HuanglongXZ_4_20: You can call me that for now.
HuanglongXZ_4_24: Is there only one way out of the gorge?
HuanglongXZ_3_2: Let me see! Let me see!
HuanglongXZ_3_3: Thank goodness you're awake! Or I'll have to try my last-ditch move—Emergency Skills for Junior Patrollers, Lesson One: CPR!
HuanglongXZ_3_4: Erm, never did it on any living person though.
HuanglongXZ_25_1: Can you reenact what you did before?
HuanglongXZ_25_5: Hmm, maybe you can only absorb the powerful ones with your body?
HuanglongXZ_25_6: Or does it have to be a certain type of Tacet Discord?
HuanglongXZ_25_4: I don't have the feeling of being pushed like I did before.
HuanglongXZ_24_1: I'm gonna get you one you can absorb. I never go back on my promise! Your hero Chixia's on the hunt!
HuanglongXZ_23_1: It would be best for your well-being to have a thorough physical examination once we arrive in Jinzhou.
HuanglongXZ_23_2: While there don't seem to be any immediate side effects following the absorption of that Echo, we cannot rule out the possibility of other latent risks.
HuanglongXZ_23_3: Given our lack of data on you and your unusual physical signs, I suggest absorbing another Reverberation with your Terminal when we find one. That being said, please be sure to proceed cautiously.
HuanglongXZ_23_4: Yeah, don't go too hard on yourself. You should get a check-up just to be safe. Besides, Yangyang's very worried about you.
HuanglongXZ_23_5: If you feel any discomfort along the way, please do let us know.
HuanglongXZ_21_3: This is... a holographic message to all of Jinzhou from the City Hall.
HuanglongXZ_21_5: My fellow soldiers and citizens, I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
HuanglongXZ_21_6: As the <color=Highlight>Moon-chasing Festival</color> approaches, our city welcomes visitors from around the world. The festivities are highly anticipated by our people, and I, too, share in this joyful sentiment.
HuanglongXZ_21_7: Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks, safeguarding Huanglong. We have a heavy responsibility on our shoulders with no room for retreat or failure.
HuanglongXZ_21_8: It is the dedication of our warriors, along with the diligence of our citizens, that has allowed us to thrive in peace and prosperity.
HuanglongXZ_21_9: Despite the challenges of Tacet Discords, we remain steadfast and hospitable to visitors, upholding our enduring traditions.
HuanglongXZ_21_10: With that in mind, I have a favor to ask.
HuanglongXZ_21_11: Among our many visitors, there is one <color=Highlight>visitor</color> that holds utmost importance to me, the City of Jinzhou, and the entirety of Huanglong.
HuanglongXZ_21_12: We have awaited your arrival for a long time.
HuanglongXZ_21_14: Given the circumstances, you may be feeling bewildered at this time.
HuanglongXZ_21_15: You should have noticed some strange happenings related to you.
HuanglongXZ_21_16: If you plan to stay in Jinzhou for some time, I would be more than delighted to personally meet you in the City Hall of Jinzhou.
HuanglongXZ_21_17: While I cannot guarantee to provide all the answers you need, I will do my best to assist you and provide necessary permissions, if applicable.
HuanglongXZ_21_18: This is only my personal request. You can decide your course of action in any way you see fit.
HuanglongXZ_21_19: Therefore, I request the people and soldiers of Jinzhou to assist this esteemed visitor when the opportunity arises.
HuanglongXZ_20_1: What... What kinda power is that!
HuanglongXZ_20_3: You been playin' the fool all along?
HuanglongXZ_20_4: I've never seen a Resonance Ability quite like this. You got any other tricks up your sleeve? Like, eating a whole Tacet Discord? Grilling Echoes alive?
HuanglongXZ_20_10: Could it be related to your lost memories? Can you recall anything now?
HuanglongXZ_20_11: Indeed. So what would a Tacet Discord taste like? Spicy? Sweet?
HuanglongXZ_20_12: I heard some folks tried to cook Gulpuffs, and they even made it a local speciality, didn't they?
HuanglongXZ_20_13: Speaking of which, Gulpuff's a type of Tacet Discord, too!
HuanglongXZ_20_14: I'm even more curious now... Anyway, spicy food is always the best!
HuanglongXZ_20_17: Rover, are you feeling alright? Any discomfort?
HuanglongXZ_20_18: Could it be the side effect of fighting that Tacet Discord? Baizhi, can we take Rover to do a check-up at Huaxu Academy's Resonance Medical Department...
HuanglongXZ_20_22: Absorbing Echoes with the human body is not entirely unprecedented.
HuanglongXZ_20_24: I remember Comprehensive Mirror for Historians mentioned this in the Huanglong section's opening...
HuanglongXZ_20_25: “... A celestial being descended, commanding the <ano=universe>Qiankun's</ano> boundless power. Assuming mortal form, they condensed the primordial essence, creating Pangu. Cleaving heaven and earth apart, they aligned the celestial and terrestrial. Their radiance encompassed the four corners. Thus began the illustrious annals of Huanglong, as provinces were first demarcated..."
HuanglongXZ_20_29: There was a very strong person way back. Like they held the whole universe right in their hands. As there was no Terminal in those days, they absorbed the Tacet Discords with their bare hands!
HuanglongXZ_20_30: and the TD they absorbed was the most powerful of all. That person turned it into the first Echo ever.
HuanglongXZ_20_34: Actually... I'm not, I hope I was though. That was just some old tales my parents used to tell me, kinda like the Sentinel's Appointment thing.
HuanglongXZ_20_35: Yangyang's got an impressive memory for the ancient texts. Me? I just happen to roughly remember what the story's about.
HuanglongXZ_20_36: Please, Yangyang, stop reciting that! I'm beggin' you!
HuanglongXZ_20_37: Oh my, it's takin' me back to my school days, when I had to recite pages and pages of them... Anyway, that's just a made-up legend, isn't it?
HuanglongXZ_20_38: Come on, that was eons ago. Us Resonators do live a little longer, but we're still looking at 'bout a hundred years or so. And the known history of Huanglong stretches back at least a thousand years...
HuanglongXZ_20_39: If I may say, Rover, you seem quite "mysterious", too.
HuanglongXZ_20_40: That's where the names "Pangu Terminal" and "Qiankun Data Bank" come from.
HuanglongXZ_20_41: Whether it's true or not, that story happened a long time ago when Jinzhou didn't even exist.
HuanglongXZ_20_42: Could it be that Rover's like, the great-great-great-great-great-{Male=granddaddy;Female=granny} of us all?
HuanglongXZ_20_43: Let's not jump to conclusions without enough data and proper analysis.
HuanglongXZ_20_6: I have no idea what happened.
HuanglongXZ_20_7: It's not that different from eating it alive.
HuanglongXZ_20_8: How does that relate to my cooking skills...?
HuanglongXZ_20_31: Chixia, you must know a lot about history.
HuanglongXZ_20_33: What if I am that person...
HuanglongXZ_18_2: Are you alright? Are you hurt?
HuanglongXZ_18_4: I have never seen such a formidable Tacet Discord before, but Rover was able to completely defeat it.
HuanglongXZ_18_9: I... didn't really do much. It was all thanks to you, Rover.
HuanglongXZ_18_10: Rover, what was that last move called? That looked as cool as Fiamma's killer move!
HuanglongXZ_18_11: Aww c'mon, stop being modest! So you didn't even go all out earlier. I saw how you took down that fella with both of my eyes!
HuanglongXZ_18_12: You made a couple kicks and that thing vanished into thin air!
HuanglongXZ_18_14: That's strange. This place isn't known to be so dangerous...
HuanglongXZ_18_18: Wow! An Echo of the Elite Class... Someone got lucky today!
HuanglongXZ_18_19: My apologies. We got a little carried away. Does "Reverberation" or "Echo" ring a bell to you, Rover?
HuanglongXZ_18_20: Everything in our world is made up of frequencies, and every sound generates a reverberation.
HuanglongXZ_18_21: Those "Echoes" are the lingering Reverberations of Tacet Discords after they disintegrate. We can absorb them into the Data Banks in our Pangu Terminals.
HuanglongXZ_18_22: Oh, by Pangu Terminal, she means the gourd-shaped device every Resonator has, developed by researchers in Huanglong!
HuanglongXZ_18_23: But you see, it's not always we get to find these. Also, there's a limit to what your gourd can absorb.
HuanglongXZ_18_24: Absorption is only possible when your Data Bank's level is equal to or higher than the Tacet Discord's level. The Terminal can then convert its Reverberation into an "Echo" for use in battle.
HuanglongXZ_18_25: My Terminal issued a warning when it detected that Tacet Discord earlier. It should at least be an Overlord Class.
HuanglongXZ_18_26: Rover, would you mind checking your Data Bank level?
HuanglongXZ_18_27: No need for that! Rover, why don't you just try absorbing it with your Terminal?
HuanglongXZ_18_32: There should be some sweet Baby Roseshrooms 'round here. Let's go check those out, shall we?
HuanglongXZ_18_33: It won't take long before the Reverberations disappear and the Etheric Sea vanishes. Once that happens, the Resonance Beacon signals will come back.

HuanglongM1_1_12_22: Yeah! We've reported to the City Hall, the Ministry of War, AND the Academy. We've done everything we can so far.

HuanglongM1_1_1_5: I should go get my body check-up.

Huanglong_main_1_3_56_1: Rover, I'm afraid I won't be able to escort Zhiyuan back to the city.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_7: This is part of the reason.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_8: Actually, up to now, we have found Zhiyuan and seen that he is safe and sound, which is a good result that Mister Zongye has been concerned about.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_9: On this journey, I have seen a world different from before.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_10: The unity of the people of Jinzhou, the remembrance and longing on the square, the reliability of the Tian Gong defense, the strictness and responsibility of the officers, the destitution and wrong path of the wanderers...
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_11: And the busyness here, and the beliefs and courage of the people that Zhiyuan has shown me, whether in the past or now...
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_12: I haven't seen what the battlefield is like, but I seem to have some understanding of war.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_13: At this moment, the front not far away should be much more difficult and intense than what we have seen along the way.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_14: Countless lives have been lost in this war...
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_15: Master Rongfu once told me, "The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion."
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_16: I used to practice in the city, helping the poor, helping the weak, and punishing the evil, all with my own strength, helping with the small things I saw in life.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_17: This journey has made me start to understand the meaning of the first sentence in Master's words.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_18: So, I want to stay. This is what I want to do for Jinzhou now, and it is also an opportunity for me to continue to pursue and gain insight.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_20: You don't have to worry about me anymore, I have made up my mind!
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_22: I have decided to return to Jinzhou City and contribute to the war there!
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_25: Hehe, actually, the words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_26: It's true! These are all my heartfelt words!
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_27: The words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_28: And coming here, I have also seen the true face of the front line.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_29: I can't compare to the Resonators, and continuing to stay here might indeed be a burden, but after returning to the city, there are many things I can do!
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_30: So why shouldn't I go back to a place that suits me better? That way, I might be able to help more people, just like Master Jianxin, and also gain more recognition.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_32: That goes without saying, don't underestimate me.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_33: As for you, don't worry about me anymore. I feel bad enough for making you go through all this trouble.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_34: I'll wait here. If the rear troops return to the city, I'll go back with them. I won't cause any more trouble for the people here.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_35: After I go back, I'll take care of Grandpa first, and then I'll go help. You can rest assured.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_37: It seems we all have made new decisions.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_40: I understand. Since that's the case, why don't we part ways here?
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_43: Have a safe journey and hope to see you again.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_5: Is it because of Mister Zongye and Zhiyuan?
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_23: Why did you suddenly have a change of heart?
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_24: You're not tricking me, are you?
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_31: It seems you have really come to your senses.
Huanglong_main_1_3_56_39: But I can't stay here for too long.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_3: This monument was erected many years ago for a legion that sacrificed themselves on this land.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_4: Over thirty years ago, this was a battlefield filled with gunpowder. It was not until that legion pushed back the Tacet Discord and gradually reclaimed the front line that they had the opportunity to erect this monument here.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_5: The names of all of them are engraved on this stone monument.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_8: Although I don't know any of them, my grandpa talked about them so much that my ears have calluses!
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_9: When I was little, he rarely mentioned his experiences in the war. It's only in recent years that he has become less clear-headed and started to repeatedly tell me stories of his youth.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_10: Grandpa might be afraid of forgetting these things, so he always wants to tell them to remind himself!
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_11: Anyway, I've heard it countless times, I can't forget it even if I want to. Even if Grandpa forgets, I can remember it for decades.
Huanglong_main_1_3_55_12: Although I can't see clearly the names carved on the monument, I can recite them backwards.

InfoDisplay_31000020_Text:
[Entry]  
Tacet Discord  

[Known Types]  
Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, Staticoid
 
[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords. 
These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition. 
As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

[Appendix: Echoes] 
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization. 
Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord. 
This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo — a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.
InfoDisplay_31000021_Text:
[Introduction]  

Huaxu Academy, a renowned scientific research center in Jinzhou, boasts a rich academic heritage and cutting-edge technology. 
As a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, it has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. 
The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae. Comprised of four primary departments, each with its own specialized functions, Huaxu Academy conducts parallel and cooperative research initiatives. 
Ad hoc project teams are also formed to tackle major challenges as they arise. While the president oversees administrative affairs, the Principal Investigator serves as the academic leader of the academy.


[Departments]  

Department of Anomaly Studies:  
The Department of Anomaly Studies researches and analyzes abnormal occurrences, constructs theories based on these events, and devises preventative measures. This includes the Resonance Beacon network model and Wutherological Climate studies in Jinzhou.
Main Disciplines: Wutherology, Remnant Ecoacoustics.  

Department of Laboratory Evaluation: 
The Department of Laboratory Evaluation analyzes and simulates anomalies using different theories to find optimal solutions. They also design the internal structure of Resonance Beacon and Terminal for effective use.
Main Disciplines: -

Department of Safety: 
The Department of Safety researches and supports the elimination of Tacet Discord. They design models of the Tacetite Weapon for the Resonator and create countermeasure equipment for civilians.
Main Disciplines: TD Ecoacoustics, Resonology.  

Department of Resources:  
The Department of Resources primarily studies Waveworn substances, processes field materials for research samples, and contributes to the Department of Laboratory Evaluation and Safety.
Main Disciplines: Wuthermaterials, TD Ecoacoustics, Plant Ecoacoustics.
InfoDisplay_31000022_Text:
In the lower left corner, among numerous stone tablets, stands one that remains remarkably intact despite the passage of time and elements. It recounts the founding history of Jinzhou.
"The armies are poised for destruction as the black moon eclipses the sun…" 
"…In the midst of battle, a golden-eyed visitor appears in the hazy sky. Our troops raise their blades in anticipation, while the jade dragon soars overhead…" 
"…But even as they long for home, these conscripts do not falter in defending their land. And thus, in this world of strategic passes, Jinzhou was built and this monument erected to forever remember this momentous event…"
InfoDisplay_31000023_Text:
Jun 19
Today, a strange man came to our village. He said to call him brother, if I didn't mind. He was really friendly, but for some reason, he seemed different from the people in my village. He seemed to know a lot about me, even telling me that we were "of the same kind." 
He told me a really strange fairy tale. The ending of the fairy tale was kind of scary... but reality was even scarier, he said. He then asked: "What would you do if you were the little black lamb?" 
Before I could think of a reply, he had already left with a cryptic "See you next time." 
I told father about it, but he said no one like that had ever visited our village... 
Who could he be?
...
Jul 20
Sorry... I'm so sorry... (smudged water stains) 
If only I weren't so weak, I could've driven away those Tacet Discords... If Sissi didn't have to protect me...
There must be a way. Father said I can manipulate the frequencies of Tacet Discords... and humans.
Sissi, I'm so sorry you look like this now... It is only temporary. I'll do everything I can to return you to what you were before. I know you can still hear me.
Father promised me. He'll surely find a way to help.
...
Dec 17
It's been three months since that incident. Father doesn't seem to remember I'm still keeping a diary... He gave the notebook to me, but if he found out I'd been writing about everything, he'd be so mad.
He orders me to do what he says and use my powers to recombine frequencies of Tacet Discords.
But if anyone finds out about the truth — that Sissi, who went missing, actually died trying to protect me, and then I turned her into a horrifying Tacet Discord...
They will see me as a monster. I will be banished, and no one will ever understand or accept me with what I can do... No one... except Him.
But will the dead really come back through frequency manipulation? And if so, what would happen to their shattered souls, trapped inside their new bodies?
I really don't know...
...
Feb 8
Every day, I feel more and more uneasy. The people in the village are disappearing, and those Tacet Discords father has brought back...
I can't shake the feeling that something is very wrong. But I am trapped, like a moth to a flame, unable to escape this dark path.
I don't know what my father did... It must have been something terrible for the tension and unease here. I am not allowed outside anymore, and when I ask why, he just brushes it off.
If the price for my wish to come true is more bloodshed... I...
...
(No date)
The villagers have surrounded our house. They must have learned about it all.
The murderer... is that what they call me now? Or perhaps my father, too? At this point, what difference does it make?
After all that has happened... Can someone come and save me?
If I must pay the price for Qichi Village...
If there is a god... I hope they can...
Save my village...

(At the end of the last diary entry, you see a message in another handwriting.)
"It seems you are the luckier one."

Flow_11000001_325: Is this your first time coming here for a show?

Flow_11000001_341: Take it easy... That's right... Keep pushing, no time for rest...

Flow_11000001_344: Ah, I really wish I could improve faster, so I could play the character I've always wanted to...
Flow_11000001_345: Are you here to see Sister Qinghe's play too?

Flow_11000002_1: Hi there! You don't seem like a local. If you need any help, just let me know, and I'll be happy to assist!
Flow_11000002_2: What do you like to eat? Stir-fry, hot pot, or something fried?
Flow_11000002_3: In that case, I recommend Panhua's Restaurant. Miss Panhua's dishes never disappoint!

Flow_11000002_8: Little box? Oh, you mean a Sonance Casket, right?
Flow_11000002_9: Okay, okay, I'll teach you after work... Oh, sorry, how can I help you?
Flow_11000002_12: If you want a hot meal at this time, Panhua's Restaurant is the place to go!
Flow_11000002_13: After work, I take my kids there too. They love Miss Panhua's dishes and always finish everything!
Flow_11000002_14: Souvenirs? My kids love that stuff, too. They often visit Ganxue to buy Pioneer Association merchandise.
Flow_11000002_15: Badges, cards, and tickets, and so much more... It never fails to blow me away!
Flow_11000002_16: Little box? Oh, you mean a Sonance Casket, right?
Flow_11000002_18: My son mentioned that Uncle Chenpi loves collecting these. If you have any, you can take them to him. He'd love to have them!
Flow_11000002_19: Did you get hurt? You don't need to tough it out, why don't you go see Koko for some medicine?
Flow_11000002_22: Dad, today I also practiced hide-and-seek with Mingming!
Flow_11000002_23: Good, I knew Doudou and Mingming were good kids.
Flow_11000002_24: Do you have any new hiding techniques to teach us?
Flow_11000002_25: Er... I'm still at work. Can you be patience for a little longer?
Flow_11000002_26: Of course! We'll wait patiently for you here, Dad!
POI_HKSMCS_9_3: Hello, I'm Qingshu, an engineer on Magnetic Cube puzzles.
POI_HKSMCS_9_7: He was due this morning, but I didn't meet him. And I went to the field only to find the puzzles cracked, and he was neither there.
POI_HKSMCS_9_8: I ran down the challenge record of the puzzle and found your ID, so I called to ask. Hope I didn't bother you.
POI_HKSMCS_9_11: I'm sorry for this sudden request, but I have no other choices.
POI_HKSMCS_9_15: Since it's such an emergency. I don't think I can expalin everything quite clearly over the call. Let's meet and talk.
POI_HKSMCS_9_16: You will have your proper compensation. I promise.
POI_HKSMCS_9_4: Have you seen an unfathomable engineer recently?
POI_HKSMCS_9_9: He talked about entering the pit.
POI_HKSMCS_9_10: What?! Can you be so kind as to come here yourself?
POI_HKSMCS_9_14: Thank you so much! You will have your proper compensation. I promise.
POI_HKSMCS_8_1: Puzzles solved faster than 99% of existing attempts... {PlayerName}, you're indeed the chosen!
POI_HKSMCS_8_2: How did you know my name?
POI_HKSMCS_8_4: And I saw the playback of your actions. They were just... brilliant!
POI_HKSMCS_7_1: You see, some unstable obstacles can be destroyed.
POI_HKSMCS_7_2: Identify them to progress even more!
POI_HKSMCS_6_2: Only one left. Let's get it done!
POI_HKSMCS_5_1: Take care of the obstacles, which can prevent Magnetic Cube from moving. You'll have to remove them first before trying to move the Magnetic Cube.
POI_HKSMCS_4_1: Impressive! Your technique and efficiency are just like those of an engineer who studies these mechanics for a living!
POI_HKSMCS_4_2: If you can keep on solving them like this, the remaining two won't take much time.
POI_HKSMCS_3_1: Strike those Unordered Magnetic Cube not in place to move them to the next base on the direction of your strike.
POI_HKSMCS_20_1: {PlayerName}, Mi'zhi is awake now, and he's looking for you.
POI_HKSMCS_20_3: I don't know how I could repay you. You solved the puzzles with ID recorded for me, and you saved from the pit...
POI_HKSMCS_20_4: ... And most importantly, you helped me find the ultimate Automatic Mechanics!
POI_HKSMCS_20_7: I went down the pit for the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics, but I was just almost frozen to death.
POI_HKSMCS_20_8: The moment I entered it, the freezing air overwhelmed me, and a voice kept saying in my head that the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics was just hidden in the cold and that I should touch the air.
POI_HKSMCS_20_9: And as soon as I touch the air, yowls started to crowd my mind... They sounded just like the hopeless wails human would make before dying.
POI_HKSMCS_20_10: I saw those engineers before me in a trance... They were struggling desperately... and finally consumed by the cold.
POI_HKSMCS_20_11: Looking back now, the voice calling me was maybe just a bait. Sigh... there wasn't any "ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics" down there.
POI_HKSMCS_20_6: Yes, you! Don't look around, it's just you.
POI_HKSMCS_2_2: Solve the puzzles, and that block will disappear. Then I'll be able to enter.
POI_HKSMCS_17_2: We have to take him to the infirmary now. I can't take him on my own. Give me a hand.
POI_HKSMCS_15_1: You solved such a difficult puzzle in such a short time?!
POI_HKSMCS_15_3: The access is open, I should get going.
POI_HKSMCS_14_1: The difficulty of it... I wonder what got into the designer's mind.
POI_HKSMCS_14_2: It was simply designed to embarrass! You handled it perfectly, though.
POI_HKSMCS_14_3: The progress reached 60%! We should be finishing this soon.
POI_HKSMCS_13_1: Though I've seen this in the record, it still amazes me to see this in reality.
POI_HKSMCS_12_1: Some bases can be transported between two locations. The available locations are marked with holographic projection.
POI_HKSMCS_12_2: Use that switch here to control the transport.
POI_HKSMCS_12_3: Oh, please be noted that bases won't be transported when Magnetic Cube are on them because of magnetic force.
POI_HKSMCS_11_1: Excuse me, you are {PlayerName}, right? You just said that Mi'zhi went into the pit?
POI_HKSMCS_10_1: Mi'zhi is gone... the puzzles are altered... what now, what now...
POI_HKSMCS_10_2: So freezing... and a Ice Chrysalises?
POI_HKSMCS_10_3: It looks strange... Isn't it quivering?
POI_HKSMCS_10_4: Sorry, maybe I'm just too anxious and mistook something.
POI_HKSMCS_10_5: Let's just break it and look inside.
POI_HKSMCS_1_1: Magnetic Cube frequency... proton radius... spin quantum number... suspension dynamics...
POI_HKSMCS_1_3: I'm in the pursue of the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics... it's just I'm met with some bottleneck.
POI_HKSMCS_1_4: The ultimate Mechanics is calling me from inside the pit. It's so close, yet so unreachable...
POI_HKSMCS_1_5: Why don't you go in there?
POI_HKSMCS_1_6: Ha, can't you see I'm obstructed?
POI_HKSMCS_1_8: Is this how far I, the great Mi'zhi can go?
POI_HKSMCS_1_16: No. Engineers don't trap people! Look, this is my identification.
POI_HKSMCS_1_20: As you know, treasure means nothing to me. What only interests me is Magnetic Cube Mechanics.
POI_HKSMCS_1_7: You see the block here? Someone locked the entrace with a puzzle.
POI_HKSMCS_1_9: No, I will not stagnate on the path to the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics! And you, your presence here must be the turning point!
POI_HKSMCS_1_18: If you can help me overcome this, you will be rewarded the access to treasure!
Character_YinLin_61_7: Hmph. That's more like it. Remember to capture every detail. I'll be watching you.

Flow_310000002_91: Yes, My Lady, everything has been taken care of. Don't worry.
Flow_310000002_92: We ran into an unexpected situation... Yes… They sent us a message, and I happened to be in the vicinity.
Flow_310000002_93: I need to escort this researcher to the Tower. I'll be back shortly.
Flow_310000002_98: I was assisting Madam Magistrate with certain matters, and as I happened to be close to that place, I arrived slightly ahead of you.
Flow_310000002_102: I was instructed by Madam Magistrate to discuss a confidential project. Would you mind if I ask about it now, since we're here?
Flow_310000002_103: While the project is still confidential, if you are interested to join, it can be arranged with Madam Magistrate's authorization. Are you interested?
Flow_310000002_104: I am currently escorting this injured researcher to that place.
Flow_310000002_105: If you could spare a moment, would you mind coming along? Explaining on-site might be more efficient.
Flow_310000002_106: Since it's already been dealt with, I'll be heading back.
Flow_310000002_107: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Flow_310000002_111: Hey, what happened? How did you get injured?
Flow_310000002_112: Can you believe it? I was just doing my routine specimen collection, and a Howler-type TD just pounced at me out of nowhere! What a lucky encounter!
Flow_310000002_113: You think getting injured is lucky?
Flow_310000002_114: Well, it didn't hurt that much. More importantly, it was an unidentified special variant! This discovery will surely enrich our database.
Flow_310000002_115: My little injury today might save countless lives in the future!
Flow_310000002_116: As you can see, the Tower Project, formally known as the Tower of Adversity, is an artificial Sonoro Sphere program in development dedicated to combat simulation.
Flow_310000002_118: Simply put, it's a man-made Sonoro Sphere.
Flow_310000002_119: We renovated a large experimental site left behind by the Court of Savantae to build this place.
Flow_310000002_120: This is a surreal space that can record specific information from a specific time and situation through our intervention.
Flow_310000002_121: Regarding the Court of Savantae... There is a lot of information we need you to know. We shall discuss it at a later time.
Flow_310000002_122: Within this simulated environment, adversaries can materialize from the subject's recollections.
Flow_310000002_123: As you delve deeper, tougher opponents will emerge, because of the difference in energy distribution pattern.
Flow_310000002_124: Our esteemed Magistrate intends to integrate this technology into military training for a more authentic experience.
Flow_310000002_125: This could potentially reduce casualties during real-life combat scenarios.
Flow_310000002_126: {PlayerName}, would you be willing to participate in our preliminary tests?
Flow_310000002_130: As I mentioned, enemies in the simulation are based on the tester's memories and their strength depends on their perception.
Flow_310000002_131: For example, if I were to enter, my fear of Tacet Discords might cause me to imagine them as stronger than they actually are, which would impact the accuracy of data.
Flow_310000002_132: This is why we rely on testers like you and Lady Sanhua, who possess both mental and physical fortitude, to provide realistic data for our research.
Flow_310000002_133: The data we gathered from Lady Sanhua's past simulated battle against an Elite Class Tranquilite greatly aided us in our recent fight.
Flow_310000002_134: Madam Magistrate values this project greatly. As we discussed, our soldiers' lives are at stake.

POI_SMBD_5_1: Like it or not, we've already declined their package. Let's just pretend this order never existed.
POI_SMBD_5_2: You didn't ask anyone before sending that rejection, did you?
POI_SMBD_5_3: Even if I had, do you seriously think we could've delivered it?
POI_SMBD_5_4: Of course! No order is too tough for us to handle! "We Promise, We Deliver!"
POI_SMBD_5_5: So why did you even make the promise in the first place? Ugh...
POI_SMBD_5_6: You're talking about the Sea of Flames in Guixu Port City. There's no way I'm letting any of our staff go to such a dangerous place!
POI_SMBD_5_8: Besides, who would order anything to a place like that? It's obviously a prank. What was even in the package?
POI_SMBD_5_9: Uh... it was some food, medicine, and warm clothes for one person...
POI_SMBD_5_10: Think about it! Whoever made the order must be trapped there, starving and freezing. That's why they ordered those things!
POI_SMBD_5_11: Even if that's the case, and I'm not saying it is... We wouldn't make much, just barely enough to cover our costs.
POI_SMBD_5_12: Listen, if they really needed it, wouldn't they just place another order?
POI_SMBD_5_13: What if they can't just place another order?
POI_SMBD_5_14: Enough! This is my call to make as manager. Leave it.
POI_SMBD_5_15: This isn't a blame game. We tell our customers “We Promise, We Deliver.” Is that all just for show?
POI_SMBD_5_18: Wait... This is the rejection email I sent out! How did it end up here...?
POI_SMBD_5_19: Mimika! You must have sent it to the wrong recipient when you grabbed my touchpad earlier!

POI_SMBD_5_21: Oh my... I can’t stand this...
POI_SMBD_5_23: I'm really sorry we wasted your time because of our mistake...
POI_SMBD_5_27: Mimika! Come here and apologize to the customer.
POI_SMBD_5_29: Thank you so much for understanding. You are one of those rare, generous individuals.
POI_SMBD_5_30: I-idle, is it? Hmm, what a luxury... Ahem! Hehe, that is a relief.
POI_SMBD_5_31: Anyway, it was entirely our fault that caused all this...
POI_SMBD_5_32: We'll issue a formal apology later, but for now, please allow me to sort out this strange order.
POI_SMBD_5_34: Do you not know about Sea of Flames, {Male=sir;Female=miss}?
POI_SMBD_5_38: Your knowledge is truly impressive! In that case, I needn't blabber on about how dangerous that place is.
POI_SMBD_5_39: Hm. The flower there is spectacular for sure, but it's lethal at the same time.
POI_SMBD_5_40: You really don't know? The Sea of Flames is a vast field of Incinero Petals whose pollen is extremely toxic.
POI_SMBD_5_41: Not to mention the horrible TDs! Few have made it out there alive, as far as I know.
POI_SMBD_5_42: Now you see how dangerous it is, Mimika?
POI_SMBD_5_43: And that's exactly why we're needed!
POI_SMBD_5_44: That customer must know that only Lollo Logistics can deliver what he needs there.
POI_SMBD_5_48: Just take no for an answer... Ugh, she's so stubborn. {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}, could you help me convince her?
POI_SMBD_5_51: You heard it? Those are words of reason! Don't go there!
POI_SMBD_5_52: I will go! If I don't, we may as well tell all of our customers that our slogan is a lie.
POI_SMBD_5_53: That's right! No matter what, we have to fulfill our orders! That's what we do at Lollo Logistics!
POI_SMBD_5_55: Now, just let me take it from here!
POI_SMBD_5_56: I'll take full responsibility as the courier for this job! Is that fair enough?
POI_SMBD_5_58: Mimika grabs the touchpad, puts on her delivery gear, and hurries away.
POI_SMBD_5_59: Damn it! What now... She must have left for the Sea of Flames!
POI_SMBD_5_60: Why? Of all places, why there...
POI_SMBD_5_62: Sigh... We don't let our employees go near the Sea of Flames. That place is off-limits.
POI_SMBD_5_63: The incident dates back to when Lollo Logistics established our first Jinzhou branch.
POI_SMBD_5_64: That place got overrun by Incinero Petals, spewing toxic pollen that drove everyone away.
POI_SMBD_5_65: And to make things worse, the Center for Wutherological Climate Studies found those Gravity Storms raging in the area. Talk about adding insult to injury.
POI_SMBD_5_66: If that pollen ever got swept up into the upper atmosphere by those storms, it would spell disaster for Jinzhou and the surrounding regions.
POI_SMBD_5_68: Absolutely. At the time, the researchers figured out that the only way to stop the spread was to deactivate the Tacet Mark core of those flowers.
POI_SMBD_5_69: The Huaxu Academy created Explosive Spears to do the job, but the terrain was too dangerous for any regular vehicle to get through.
POI_SMBD_5_70: Most of the Tacetite vehicles were tied up at the frontlines with the Midnight Rangers, fighting off the TD Outbreak, so we couldn't get the Spears to the center of the Sea of Flames.
POI_SMBD_5_71: That left Lollo Logistics to step in with our spare Tacetite vehicles and deliver them. The plan was for the Midnight Rangers to use them to take out the Tacet Marks, risking their lives in the process.
POI_SMBD_5_72: Everyone knew how dangerous the job was, but we took it on anyway—after all, our motto is "We Promise, We Deliver."
POI_SMBD_5_73: But... we couldn't get there in time. Our couriers tried their best, but they couldn't deliver the Spears in time.
POI_SMBD_5_74: In the end, only one Spear made it through, and even though we fell short, the Midnight Rangers thanked us for our help.
POI_SMBD_5_75: They had most of their people escort our couriers to safety, while a few brave souls stayed behind to charge at the Tacet Mark, knowing it could cost them their lives.
POI_SMBD_5_77: Then why is there still pollen there?
POI_SMBD_5_78: Sigh... The Spear got damaged during transport, so it didn't fully deactivate the Tacet Mark when it hit. The explosion never went off.
POI_SMBD_5_79: But, at least the attack weakened the Tacet Mark enough to stop the spread of the Incinero Petals, and the pollen concentration dropped to a level that no longer threatens Jinzhou.
POI_SMBD_5_80: Even though no one blamed them, the survivors at Lollo Logistics were wracked with guilt, thinking their mistake cost those brave soldiers their lives.
POI_SMBD_5_81: That mission left a permanent scar on our company. After that, we made it a rule that any major order had to be handled by Resonators with combat skills.
POI_SMBD_5_82: "We Promise, We Deliver"... It's just easier said than done...
POI_SMBD_5_83: Now you see why that place is such a taboo for us. We don't want couriers like Mimika getting mixed up with the Sea of Flames.
POI_SMBD_5_84: All right. That's enough blabbering from me. Let’s focus on finding Mimika...

POI_SMBD_13_16: Ugh... I wasn't always a manager, you know. I used to be a top courier, and getting people out of danger was just part of the job.

POI_SMBD_13_62: Ah, Mortefi. You finally deign to respond to my calls, eh?
POI_SMBD_13_63: Sorry for the delay. Even for someone like me, digging up old records takes time. Your request is from years ago, after all.

POI_SMBD_16_13: This is why we need the Explosive Spears.
POI_SMBD_15_18: Haha, I will. Goodbye for now!
POI_SMBD_15_19: Great, the order is finally done. It feels good to wrap this job up.
POI_SMBD_15_21: To be honest, I once thought it was no more than a publicity slogan, too. No one would really take each and every order so seriously, right?
POI_SMBD_15_22: But I changed my mind when I received a package delivered by Lollo Logistics. It was something my late father left.
POI_SMBD_15_24: Yes. He was a Midnight Ranger. I was told at a young age that he passed away at his post, and that his body was not even found.
POI_SMBD_15_25: The delivery guy said my father was injured in a battle against the TD Outbreaks. He was trying to protect his friends when he fell into a valley.
POI_SMBD_15_26: A Lollo Logistics employee found him, but they could not save him.
POI_SMBD_15_27: They told me that until his dying breath, he didn't stop thinking about me, saying that his daughter was about to turn ten, and he... he couldn't even see her one last time.
POI_SMBD_15_28: He hoped that Lollo Logistics would deliver the doll he carried with him as a birthday present to his daughter.
POI_SMBD_15_30: Yes, but it was far more complicated. Father passed before he could say the address and identity, and no identifications could be found with him by then.
POI_SMBD_15_31: However, couriers from Lollo Logistics didn't give up. They kept asking and investigating while they delivered other goods.
POI_SMBD_15_32: Finally, after all those difficulties, they found the girl. That girl was me.
POI_SMBD_15_33: But by the time I received this present, I was already over the age of playing dolls. It was my 18th birthday.
POI_SMBD_15_34: Lollo Logistics inspired me. I wanted to join and stick to the motto: We Promise, We Deliver!
POI_SMBD_15_38: One order done. Next up, we have a bigger order to deliver!
POI_SMBD_15_39: My colleagues and I will go with you to the research centers Mr. Mortefi mentioned. We'll try to find those spear parts and bring them back.
POI_SMBD_15_40: I got the coordinates from him. Let's move.
POI_SMBD_15_20: You honored your slogan. You delivered on your promise.
POI_SMBD_15_29: So that was the package you received?
POI_SMBD_14_8: Well, I even felt a bit relieved... I thought, "Great, I won't have to risk my life searching for a customer in the Sea of Flames anymore."
POI_SMBD_14_9: But then I heard someone calling for help. A girl's voice... It must've been her who placed the order!
POI_SMBD_14_12: No! Please believe me... I really heard it, even though it was faint.
POI_SMBD_14_13: Yes. Considering when the order was placed, she must have been stuck there for a long time.
POI_SMBD_14_14: Fortunately, my manager found me and rescued me just before I passed out from the toxins in the air...
POI_SMBD_14_15: I know I'm being naive, but there is someone out there in need of Lollo Logistics' service. Someone who believes that "We Promise, We Deliver"...
POI_SMBD_14_16: And that's why I still want to fulfill this order!
POI_SMBD_14_17: But my manager is right. I can't do it alone... So I'm asking for your help. Please, will you come with me to the coordinates and help search again?
POI_SMBD_14_19: Thank you! I understand. You can find the coordinates on your Terminal now!
POI_SMBD_14_10: Could it be just your imagination?
POI_SMBD_14_11: Looks like someone really is trapped there.
POI_SMBD_14_18: Alright, but promise me that if we can't find her, we'll turn back right away.
POI_SMBD_13_74: By the way, Mimika, the courier, was looking for you. She's waiting at the Resonance Nexus.
InfoDisplay_101400001_Text:
Date: [--02]
The <ano=CSC>Court of Savantae</ano> Laboratory is an abandoned site in the Whining Aix's Mire. Due to the use of specialized materials developed by the CSC in the main structure, the building is well-preserved and undergoes minimal weathering and corrosion. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the lower levels of the site to create an artificial Tacet Field for experimental purposes.
There are a few abandoned devices left in the experimental area. Low-frequency lighting systems are positioned at specified distances and angles, ensuring consistent illumination in the experimental area.
At the center of the experimental area, multiple bundled cables secure a spherical metal device. These cables also transmit input and output data from the spherical metal device, and identical frequency detection devices are arranged around the spherical metal device. 

These devices are typically operated with dial plates. Clockwise rotation increases electric energy, causing a metal frame to rapidly rotate around the central device for frequency detection.
InfoDisplay_101400002_Text:
Date: [--16]
Assembling machinery in a modular way... this "Automata Mechanics" is quite something. Thanks to it, we easily built our new lab. Of course, we couldn't do it without the financial support of that Fractsidus Overseer. Annoying to have someone meddling in our research, given his generous contributions, it's all tolerable.
After all, no choice left. Got expelled from headquarters, so the only way was to move to the Whining Aix's Mire. Sure, the workload increased, but there's an advantage. No one's gonna bother coming to this remote place.
I still remember the moment Professor Heisen announced the trial's success at the meeting. He told us, "I'm getting old, but there's still plenty I can do. And you, you're still young with endless possibilities. I believe each one of you, genius or not, would rather leave your mark in history than end up living an uneventful life in a place like this."
If successful, our names could be immortalized with Professor Heisen's in history, known for generations to come even as ordinary people.
We were once prohibited from research due to the so-called "dangerous activities", expelled from headquarters. We were resentful and frustrated. But now, we've let go of those pointless emotions, focusing solely on paving the way to the future.
Setting aside personal stories, I think, it's more because we've all witnessed "miracles".
InfoDisplay_101400003_Text:
NO. SY-A038
Date: [---]

Subject A038 has been assigned to a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Regular environmental checks must be conducted every 6 hours for the artificial Tacet Field.
Entry into the designated area is strictly limited to experiment personnel and any devices or tools that do not meet standard specifications are forbidden to prevent interference with the subject.

Preliminary observations indicate that Subject A038, who was born in the artificial Tacet Field, is able to survive stably.
However, it is worth noting that the subject has yet to exhibit any specific physical features or vocal behaviors. It appears to lack a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
At present, A038 shows no discernible behavioral objectives and remains mostly stationary with low levels of aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from our initial expectations, further research is required to gain a deeper understanding of the subject.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency has been observed. Strict control of standard frequency specifications within the experimental area is imperative.
Given the unique nature of A038, additional time is necessary to establish appropriate parameters and data language in order to gain valuable insights into its information. This process will require a considerable amount of time given our current technology and available data.

WARNING: Any leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited. Taking photos or recordings of the subject without express permission from Professor Heisen is strictly forbidden.
This concludes the initial observations recorded for Subject A038. To obtain more comprehensive information on the subject, future experiments and analyses are crucial.
InfoDisplay_101400004_Text:
Dated: [--25]
The rain in the lab lasts much longer than outside... Falling for a good four years, eleven months, and two days since.
The impact of witnessing the "Suspension" for the first time is gradually overshadowed by overwhelming despair. Disappointment and frustration spread in the lab like moss, resilient and unavoidable. Working in this damp environment is a kind of torture both physically and mentally.

Research on the Retroact Rain has entered its second phase, yet contrary to expectations, there's been no progress whatsoever. Perhaps everyone, including Professor Heisen, has questioned if we're doing it wrong. But all evidence points to the fact that "it" has indeed visited the Whining Aix's Mire. That's one of the reasons we moved here.

What we pursue is merely to use the Retroact Rain to relive the "miracle" and seek enlightment. Despite exhaustion, doubts, and countless arguments, we must continue the research. However, time is not on our side. Eventually, we decided to transition to the "Plan B".

Is it a worthwhile choice? Hard to say. Professor Heisen said the risks are high, but success could bring us closer to the answers. Yet, we've failed 37 times. 37 lives lost in the process. Finally, the subject named A038 survives. It's a huge breakthrough, but not many were excited, because we all knew it was a replica... nothing more than an absurd imitation of "God".

Night shifts are tough. Due to understaffing, I'm the sole one on duty. All night, observing this invisible stuff who is unable to speak or move. It's more boring than staring at my tutor's face. And to maintain the stability of the Tacet Field, all clocks were removed. Every minute feels unbelievably long...

Professor Heisen, once kind, has become particularly strict this time. Since the experiment started, he hasn't smiled at all. Speaking of which, a researcher once brought above-standard tools into the experimental area, triggering alarms throughout the lab. Fortunately, neither the Tacet Field nor A038 seemed affected, but for some reason, A038 feels a bit larger. By the way, that was the first time I'd ever seen Professor Heisen lose his temper.

Let's call it a day. There are still some issues, and I need to manually input the reconfirmed parameters and data. We were all insanely busy. Despite the workload, no one complained. After all, we have nowhere else to go but here. 
It's time to feed frequency again? And seriously, I think we've been feeding it too many things. Anyway, it's Professor Heisen's order, so maybe it's best to just follow it...
InfoDisplay_101400005_Text:
Date: [--08]
We've reached the final stage of our research, but it seems we've slowed down our progress. Colleagues are leaving one after another. Even Professor Heisen said he's going back to be with his family... He did say that, right? 
Somehow, I'm not so sure about this. I just vaguely remember he mentioned something like this at some point, but did he actually tell us that? Or did he whisper it in my ears?

During long, boring nights like this one, this little thing is my only companion. It's hard to believe how much it has grown and changed. Metal parts now adorn its once simple form: steel plates, cogs, clocks, detection devices, blue liquids, white lab coats... and… Is that a diesel generator? Anyway, I can finally see it with my own eyes, without the aid of observation devices.

Hello? How are you feeling today? You seem surprisingly energetic. But it's no wonder, being trapped your entire life. Longing for freedom, I imagine. 
Our lab is rarely this quiet. I think no one would notice if I broke the rules a little bit. 
Ah... I see. So this is how your body feels to the touch. 
Is that how you laugh? This is the first time I've heard your voice... It sounds familiar, like my colleagues.
I can see it... It’s the Gate we've been searching for. 
Why am I feeling dizzy? My body, it’s so soft now… like water... not my own.
My consciousness, floating in the air...
Hello everyone… So you've all entered the Gate already…
"Don't cross over," you say… What do you mean?
No, something's not right... 
The Miracle we witnessed... This shouldn't be happening...
