Huanglong_main_1_6_14_30: Anyway, this black flower does look very special. There are hardly any similar plants in nature.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_31: So, I'm thinking it might be a newly cultivated species.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_32: Also, its veins are somehow cross-shaped... I can feel some faint traces of frequency fluctuations on it too. It's a sign of overflowing Remnant Energy.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_33: So, my guess is it should be an unique Remnant plant, created by a certain type of Resonance Energy.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_34: But in order to figure out the right soil for it, or exactly what type of Resonance Energy it is, I need more than just a picture.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_35: Gosh, help us out, someone! We don't know what kind of flower it is, and we haven't seen anyone wearing it either...
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_36: Speaking of that... How does it even work? If I wore this flower on me right now, do I automatically become one of them?
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_37: Chixia, wait, what did you just say?
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_38: Uhhh... Yeah? I was just saying if I wore this flower, would they immediately see me as one of their own...
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_39: If this black flower is indeed their symbol, the Black Shores members should immediately notice it on you.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_40: But to all the other people, it would only look like a peculiar flower.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_41: Given that... if they are indeed in Jinzhou city, we may only need to wear this flower to lure them out...
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_42: Ohh, I see... but how do we get our hands on one?
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_10: What if we were some bad guys? Aren't you worried?
Huanglong_main_1_6_12_1: A bridge of flowers... That's impressive...
Huanglong_main_1_6_11_1: This should be the shortcut to the back mountain. Once we cross the waterfall, we'll reach Mt. Pingting.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_1: Oh, hello! Chixia, Yangyang, what brought you here?
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_2: Hey, Grandma Lin! We're here for some stories today, and here's our new friend!
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_3: Ta-da! We've got the ultimate badass here! The one who can crush TDs, cook up Echoes, knock Inferno Rider flat, and KO Feilian Beringal with a single punch! The legendary Rover!
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_7: Haha, so you are the famous Rover! Oh, youngsters these days are really something.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_8: Haha, that's just how Chixia talks. Please don't mind her.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_9: Oh my, you're such a sweetheart!
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_10: Grandma Lin, since you're the flower expert, I've got a favor to ask.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_12: Have you seen flowers like this one before?
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_13: Hmm... I'm familar with most of the flowers local to Jinzhou, but this one... it doesn't match anything we have here.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_14: I don't think I've seen anything similar, not even in the plant encyclopedias...
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_15: Oh no... If not even a flower expert like you can recognize it, who else could help us?
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_16: Oh, Chixia, I'm far from an expert. We've got a plant-type Resonator here in Jinzhou, remember? She knows the plants much better than me.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_17: Oh, are you talking about that young lady? I always see her helping out at your store.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_18: Yes, she has been a great help. She knows a lot about everything plant related.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_19: And she is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_20: I'd call out to her: Lil Starflower, it's dinner time! And she'd always answer with her brightest smile. What a lovely girl.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_24: She's probably up in the back mountain doing some field research.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_25: My apologies, but I don't remember... I'm too old to work these fancy stuff...
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_26: She's probably up in the back mountain doing some field research.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_27: Oh, how I wish she was my granddaughter...
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_28: She's probably up in the back mountain doing some field research.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_29: I said I wanted a field in the back mountain and she offered to help right away. That's where she is now, checking it out.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_30: Go in that direction, and soon you'll see a waterfall. Walk right through the waterfall, then you'll reach the back mountain.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_31: Thank you so much, Grandma Lin.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_32: Oh, anytime, dearie! Don't forget to visit my Penjing shop. I'll have treats ready for you!
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_5: No, I didn't... Please don't listen to her...
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_6: This lady looks too young to be called a Grandma.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_14: It's the middle of the night. Course you're tired.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_15: It's the middle of the night. Course you're hungry.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_17: Huh? Are you not gonna investigate the tokens?
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_18: Oh right, I still owe you a meal! The night markets are closed though. Let's grab breakfast at Panhua's Restaurant tomorrow before my shift. Meet you guys there in the morning. Be there or be square!
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_21: Time to hit the hay, obviously. Don't tell me you're planning on some nightly activities?
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_26: Then you'll feel right at home with the Midnight Rangers. Or more like the "Midnight Danger".
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_27: What? You're hanging out with our Magistrate already? Quit bluffing.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_29: Do you have a place to stay, Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_35: Talk about hospitality! Boy, I wonder what it's like to live in the City Hall.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_36: I-I have a vacant guest room in my house, and if you don't mind coming over...
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_37: Aren't you forgetting something, Yangyang? Rover told us this morning that {Male=he;Female=she} has been offered a stay at the City Hall...
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_40: Alright, enough chatter or the sun's gonna come up. Let's get Rover back to the City Hall and we'll leave the rest to tomorrow!
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_12: Looks like you had a fruitful day.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_13: Do you want me to come along tomorrow?
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_22: Night is the time to beat up Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_23: Night is the time to meet up with Jinhsi.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_30: Sanhua has prepared a room for me.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_31: I'll be staying at the City Hall.
Huanglong_main_1_4_70_45: I can feel it in the Streams... Over there. Follow me.
Huanglong_main_1_4_70_44: I broke free from it all thanks to you.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_9: You don't want to disappoint me so soon, Rover.
Huanglong_main_1_5_79_100: ...It is nothing to be concerned about.
MonthCardDes_1: Obtain 300 Lunites and 2700 Astrites in total
HuanglongXZ_9_23: This is the statue of Jué, the <ano=Oracle Engine>Sentinel</ano> in Jinzhou, in the shape of a <ano=dragon>Loong</ano>.
HuanglongXZ_9_24: There are one capital and six cities in Huanglong, with each city having its own Sentinel. While they share some similarities in appearance, there are also differences.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_1: What's the matter? Are you alright?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_3: I was worried... You just stood there and gazed into the distance. You were unresponsive when I tried talking to you. What did you see?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_4: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_7: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a <ano=teal dragon>Qingloong</ano>...  The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_8: The front lines are not far from here. General Jiyan must be there, fighting alongside our soldiers to keep the Tacet Discords away.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_11: It doesn't seem like a coincidence. We arrived near the battlefield right when General Jiyan was leading an attack against the Tacet Discords...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_12: A woman in red who can control the Tacet Discords...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_21: Could it be... One of the Fractsidus...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_22: Your vision... It might be what was happening on the battlefield not far away...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_15: The battle itself is a clear sign of an anomaly.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_17: The Streams from the Norfall Barrens feel more suffocating than ever.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_18: Rover... something on that battlefield must be connected to you, though we have no idea what it is.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_28: But I didn't hear anything... or sense any frequencies.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_19: I may have resonated with a Tacet Discord.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_1: Thank you for your assistance. You must be tired. Please take some rest.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_3: Don't worry. They've received proper treatment now. They will recover in time. Thanks to General Jiyan, we've seen a significant drop in the number of casualties.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_4: I've heard from veterans that our soldiers used to be ordinary people, not Resonators. The battles were even brutal back then, with the stench of blood lingering through the rain.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_6: Each injury represents countless Tacet Discords eliminated by our brave soldiers.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_7: Resonators in the Midnight Rangers are incredible warriors. Those who have to retreat from injury must have already taken out hundreds of enemies.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_9: They are the ones keeping our people safe. What I've been doing is not worth mentioning compared to them.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_10: Please don't put it like that. Without your help. we couldn't have helped so many wounded soldiers in such a short time.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_50_3: I'm okay... just... a little... out of breath...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_1: Like I said, it's not a big deal! No need to fix me up! Let me go!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_2: Please calm down. Your wound is still bleeding.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_3: That's barely a scratch! You can't stop me!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_5: That's not bravado! My wounds can close on their own. It's my Resonance ability. The medics should go take care of other people in need!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_6: Stop squirming, will you? We're here because you need our help. Calm down and stay where you are!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_7: Please hold him still for me.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_4: Now is not the time for bravado.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_1: I know another shipment of supplies has just arrived. I've confirmed it, but it's not nearly enough. We must reach out to the city again and demand more supplies immediately.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_2: But the approval process is going to...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_3: Tell them it's an emergency. We are working around the clock here. Any delay could mean the end of our defense. Do they not comprehend? Here's the list of what we need.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_4: I'll talk to them if you can't make them listen! Now go go go!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_5: Move, move! What is it? Why are we still not done distributing these?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_7: You new here? Are you backups too?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_8: Wait, you don't look like one of us...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_9: I am Yangyang, an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. And they are...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_29: Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_11: Careful! This chest holds vital medical supplies. If the wounded return and find no medicine, it's on you. Handle with care and precision!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_12: An Outrider? So you are part of the backup force, right? Now, I've got wounded soldiers coming soon, and you're just in time to help.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_15: An Overclocked Resonator? Understood. I'll be there immediately.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_16: I'm sorry... Erm, could you do me a favor?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_17: The wounded soldiers are being sent back from the frontlines. We need someone to escort them to the medics, but I've got to deal with the Overclocked Resonator now. Could you please take care of them?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_18: What exactly do you need us to do?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_19: Just make sure they are safe. The medics will take care of their wounds.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_22: It's so busy here... Looks like they don't even have the time to catch their breath.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_24: Supplies, medical care, equipment maintenance, personnel management, and logistics... They must carefully manage these matters to provide vital support for our fighters.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_25: So this is what a real war looks like. I had no idea it could get this bad.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_26: Most people would never have the chance to witness any of this. It's natural for you not to know.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_27: I think this is exactly what our military strives for—to ensure peace and safety for our citizens. It's a sacrifice made so others don't have to live in fear.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_28: The wounded soldiers are here. Let's go check on them.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_47_2: This is my first time on a battlefield. It feels so different here...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_46_1: Awesome, we've got the second Beacon fixed.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_45_2: Yes. Let's go and check on the next one.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_1: We're beggin' ya, stop! We surrender. Take us in!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_2: Why did you attack us when I already gave you food and funds?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_3: Do you have other mouths to feed, aside from what we see here?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_8: They seem trained... These are not ordinary people.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_10: O-of course we are ordinary people! We just... we just joined the Exiles recently.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_11: We done some wrongs. Tried to run from them Patrollers and left the city, but dang, didn't know the battles up north were so crazy. Our new boss ran outta food before we could even figure out the camp. Figured we'd be better off just go back to the city and get locked up...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_12: Then we ran outta food and cash halfway. So we turned to thieving.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_13: We ain't got the balls to rob the army, but with stuff just sitting around, why not?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_14: Hey, since you're being so generous, how about you throw a little extra cash our way? There's a bunch of us, some injured too. Your first amount ain't gonna cut it for us to survive.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_16: Wait. What I gave them was more than enough for them to make it to Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_17: I used to travel alone when I left my Master. I know how much it takes for someone to survive.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_18: Hey! What's wrong with you, girlie? It won't hurt to give us more!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_19: Pain comes with coveting. He who knows he has enough is rich. It was only meant to sustain you long enough for you to reach the city.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_20: You don't understand, girl. You don't make money very easily in a time like this. If we can't find jobs in the city, we gonna starve again.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_21: I came from a seclusive place, learning the ways of the world from scratch. It's been a hard time, but even I have managed to make a living with my own hands.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_22: If you really can't find any job in the city, come to Liuxian Teahouse and ask for Jianxin. I'll gladly help you search for jobs and work alongside you.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_25: Hurry, move! Let's get outta here. I'm not listening to this lecture anymore.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_26: I wasn't trying to... Wait, please put that down.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_27: Ugh, quite the sharp eye you got. Fine! Here you go!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_28: Is this the only Detection Beacon you messed with?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_29: Heck yeah! Just the first one we were trying to steal and you bumped right into it.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_30: Really? Then why does that one over there seem broken too?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_31: That ain't got nothing to do with us! It has been that way for ages. Plus, we ain't ever reaching it with all those thorns.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_32: I see. You may leave now.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_33: The military's base is not far from here. Shall we fix the Beacons before going?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_2: P-please don't arrest us! We really had no choice!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_3: What happened? Do you need help?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_4: The battles are getting real bad up north, and we couldn't live there anymore. Figured we have to go back to the city.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_5: We ain't eaten in ages, and we're broke. Some of us can barely move 'cause we're so damn hungry.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_6: Then we found some expensive looking stuff here. Now that the military's out there fighting and nobody's really using these thingies, we thought it might get us a few pennies.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_7: A damaged Detection Beacon might result in a sudden TD invasion from the direction it covers.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_8: Our frontline troops would face attacks from both sides. Have you thought about the consequences?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_9: We ain't got the time for that! If we don't steal, we'd starve to death before the Tacet Discords kill us.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_10: You shouldn't be stealing public property. Please return the parts.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_11: There's still some distance from here to Jinzhou city. Here, you can have my flatbreads.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_12: And here's some money. This should be enough for you to reach the city.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_13: You're giving us... all of these? Thank you. Thank you!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_14: Hey! You! Come over and say thank you before you eat!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_15: It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men, and abandons none."
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_42_1: Greetings. What might interest you here? It's dangerous.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_42_2: Oh. We, uh... Nothing, really. You see, we're just on our way south, to the city.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_42_4: Excuse me, about this Detection Beacon...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_1: Hmph, a tough nut, aren't you?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_2: I just helped you. Why did you attack us?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_3: You're not feedin' all of us with ya bread and pennies.  Hand over your goods and grub or face the consequences.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_4: We ain't messin' with no kids, but don't test our patience. Just do as you're told!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_5: Don't make it tough on yourselves. Or you'll be lucky to leave in one piece.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_6: I will not bend to injustice.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_400_7: Rover, Yangyang, please step back as I handle them.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_1: You don't look like soldiers. Why are you here? The frontlines are right up ahead.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_2: I am Yangyang, an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_3: Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge and Jianxin asked him about Zhiyuan.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_5: The one you're looking for. Is he an average person? Not a Resonator, I suppose?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_6: Yes, have you seen him? Is he alright?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_7: I met him once. He's not officially enlisted, but he seemed determined to join us. He's been secretly following our troops since last year.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_8: He must be in the Rearguards camp. He can't be anywhere else; the actual frontlines are right up ahead, and we the Midnight Rangers would never allow non-servicemen to approach and risk getting killed.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_13: Now if you're heading that way, I have a request for you, my Outrider comrade.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_14: On your way there, you should run into two Detection Beacons. They just went offline. Could you go check on them?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_16: Great. I'll send the coordinates to your Terminal.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_1: Jianxin explains why she wants to leave the city. She tells you about the person she is looking for.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_2: So you're looking for the relative of a veteran, and you believe he's in the Midnight Rangers camp in Desorock Highland?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_9: His name is Zhiyuan. I don't know him in person. On my way down the mountain, I ran into his grandfather, who was looking for his grandson on his own but ended up lost.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_10: I couldn't just leave an elderly person like him out there. So I thought I'd escort him to the nearest city and make further plans once we're safe.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_11: You're willing to go to such lengths for someone you don't know...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_12: You have a kind soul, Master Jianxin.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_13: It's all thanks to many kind-hearted people. Without them, Mr. Zongye and I wouldn't have made it to Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_14: Mr. Zongye seemed confused. He's gone through a lot searching for his enlisted grandson. Lending a helping hand was the least I could do.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_15: I reported his situation to the Patrol Station, but with the chaos on the frontline, Mr. Zongye has been extremely worried about his grandson's safety... He'd sneak out to look for his grandson the moment no one was watching. I'm really worried about him.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_17: It's got some fresh-looking leaves, soft springy skin, and eight fleshy segments fully ripened inside. It looks like a nice fruit.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_22: Oh, one more thing I forgot to mention. There's a bruise at the bottom. If you don't eat that part soon, it'll spoil.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_23: I grew up in my sect on a mountain. Spent most of my time training with my masters.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_24: One day, I was told training in seclusion was not enough. I must engage with the world to further my skills.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_25: So I started my self-cultivating journey. I've been to various cities and gained valuable lessons, but there is still so much more to learn.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_26: ...According to what I've gathered, Mr. Zongye's grandson is very likely in the Desorock Highland.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_27: Thanks to your help, I can finally leave the city to find him.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_4: What's your relationship with the person you're looking for?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_5: Why is it so important for you to find him?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_6: Do you know anything about the mangosteen?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_19: Well... thanks for the tip on how to pick out the good ones.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_28: That's where we are heading too.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_30: Master Jianxin, please keep us safe.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_1: Access Pass is required if you're heading to the Norfall Barrens. That place is now off-limits.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_3: What is your business, young lady? It's my third shift and you're still here.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_4: Oh, you must be the soldier on duty at noon yesterday. Nice to see you again.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_5: I'm a Resonator and a trained martial artist. I can handle myself. Please, I need to go look for someone.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_6: I've promised the missing man's grandfather to bring him back. Would you let me through?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_7: Be that as it may, I cannot let you given the current circumstances. My apologies.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_8: Well, everything seems fine in the city. Are things really that bad on the frontlines?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_9: That's why we must stay vigilant, so people in the city can go on peacefully with their lives.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_10: Besides, General Jiyan is currently there at the Norfall Barrens base. Dangerous as it is, he will keep an eye on every soldier, including the one you're looking for.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_11: We have already sent a report on your case. You could just go home and wait for the good news. What's the point of staying here?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_12: Thank you, but I have already asked the Patrol Station for help and tried every method I could think of. Please, let me through. I promised him, so I gotta give it my all.

InfoDisplay_104134000_Text: The room was filled with clocks. I listened to the hands slowly ticking in the darkness. I opened my eyes, but there was nothing here, only the primitive darkness. I quickly got up and picked up a pen to record everything, the dream, yes, it was a dream. This time, I finally caught it and recorded it clearly. I do not possess the talent of a bard, nor do I have the fascinating legends of a traveler. I am simply an ordinary storyteller, combining the dream that troubles me with words. It all begins from the long winter season. The old captain at the harbor always had the same opening lines before setting sail, as a way to welcome the newly recruited young sailors. “The ocean is always unknown to humanity. Although humans have grasped the helm of progress time and time again with wisdom and bravery, the ocean will never bow down to humanity... Countless disasters have befallen those ambitious individuals who venture into the ocean, and this tragedy continues to unfold.” The old captain uttered each word with a dull tone, but it didn't matter. The sailors, excited for the upcoming voyage, simply applauded and cheered, without paying much attention to the words. The ship slowly left the shore, and the young sailors felt nauseous from the rough voyage, with constant vomiting slowly draining their enthusiasm. A huge creature leaped out of the ocean, causing the young sailors to hide in the cabin, while the captain and the old sailors stood calmly on the deck. "I will forgive your timidity this time, as it is your first encounter with it. Please remember its appearance. We call it the ancient whale. It is the disaster caused by the ocean, mysterious and immensely powerful. It is the embodiment of demons of nature. Of course, when dealing with such unknown creatures, humans will not succumb. This is the first lesson of your voyage..." Intermittent gunfire broke out on the sea surface, and more and more sailors joined the one-sided attack. Continuously pulling the trigger made them gradually get their fear and also the reason why they were attacking the giant creature in front of them, which had not harmed them. Under the smoke, the ship slowly moved forward along the blood-red trail...
InfoDisplay_104134001_Text: I sat in one corner of the square table, and piles of research materials were pushed in front of me by him. He was clearly talking incessantly with his mouth wide open, but all I heard were fragmented words and phrases... the Mine, survival, balance... These words appeared one by one from beneath my pen without any connection. Yes, we were arguing. After pushing the materials aside, I forcefully hammered the table, releasing all the pent-up anger accumulated over the days.
InfoDisplay_104134002_Text:
The mine has been getting colder and colder lately, and the miner brothers operating at the bottom say that they still hear strange noises occasionally, and such rumors have now become the nightly talk among miners, but it's better to investigate the bottom.
Busy all day, and then eat a bowl of Jinzhou chowder, the taste ...... don't mention it, the strange thing is that the bottom of the bowl is stuck with a note, which is painted with a messy stone pattern, do not even need to think about it, this note is sitting on the opposite side of the dining table the boy wrote, learning from the story according to the Gourd draw a dipper, saying that this is to facilitate the communication of the unique language. I didn't expect the ever-steady Dr. Hua to get involved, but it's nice to eat noisily with three people like this.

Huanglong_main_1_6_9_1: Maybe he's got his own personality to blame...
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_3: Oh? You want my take on it?
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_4: I'm not very familiar with the history, but I did hear some rumors about General Geshu Lin.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_5: Compared to all the past Midnight Rangers Generals, Geshu Lin wasn't that big on commanding his troops from behind. He preferred being right there on the battlefield, leading the charge.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_6: To achieve his strategic goal, he didn't even hesitate about sending people to their deaths...
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_7: People said the troops he commanded were disciplined, but I guess the soldiers obeyed him more out of fear than respect.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_8: So, I think you can pretty much have an idea about General Geshu Lin's personality.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_9: Honestly, I think he deserved it. The moment he lost his soldiers' support, his failure was pretty much unavoidable.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_10: And considering the heavy losses he caused... Yeah, he should be called a criminal.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_2: (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_1: Tough break... It's just plain bad luck.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_3: So you want to learn more about that battle? Not many youngsters care these days! I'm happy to talk about it with you!
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_4: People blamed Geshu Lin for his decision to push for an attack during the Retroact Rain.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_5: But he's ultimately jut a human like the rest of us. Him having a powerful Resonance Ability doesn't change that.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_6: Fate can be a funny thing... Nobody could've predicted that weird rain happening.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_7: If our soldiers hadn't held onto the defense lines in the Norfall Barrens to the last minute, Jinzhou might have fallen too.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_8: So, I don't think Geshu Lin should be painted as an unforgivable criminal.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_9: General Jiyan is a capable leader no doubt, but let's be real, he only rose to fame for showing up at the right time.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_10: Sigh, that's just how fate works sometimes...
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_2: (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_1: Is it a coincidence? Is it fate? Nah, no...
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_3: Oh oops, are you talking to me? My bad, I was lost in my thoughts.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_4: I'm a student at Jinzhou Imperial Academy studying history, and I'm especially intrigued by everything related to the Sentinel.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_5: The Sentinel plays a crucial role in Jinzhou's history. But here's something interesting, I'm not sure if you've noticed...
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_6: In our local folklore and tales, the Sentinel is always portrayed as an omnipotent being that transcends human understanding.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_7: But I believe there must be a pattern in its thought process. The people chosen to become Magistrates must share some similar traits.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_8: So, I wonder: what criteria does the Sentinel use to select future leaders?
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_10: We were all confident and determined to defeat the <ano=Ovathrax>Threnodian</ano> before. But after that crushing defeat, everyone's confidence took a hit.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_11: Interestingly, the newly appointed General and Magistrate both seem to be the calm and cautious type.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_12: Perhaps the Sentinel chooses our leaders based on the public consensus at the time.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_13: But hey, that's just me thinking out loud. I'm all ears to your opinions. Your take might just open my eyes!
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_2: (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)

POI_WXZSYJ_29_10: What? That lab? But it's too dangerous! Lots of Hoochiefs are lurking there!
POI_WXZSYJ_29_13: Thank you, Rover. Qiaomu, no matter what you're going to say, I'll go too.
POI_WXZSYJ_29_14: You wish for everyone's safety, and achieving that depends on completely solving this issue, doesn't it?
POI_WXZSYJ_29_17: Fine, fine! Just come with us. BUT! Promise you'll take care of yourself, okay?
POI_WXZSYJ_29_12: I'm with you. I can protect you.
POI_WXZSYJ_27_2: Qiaomu, Rover, look that at the Violet Banyan.
POI_WXZSYJ_27_5: It's shocking, really. The Violet Banyan was kept safe from contamination, but now...
POI_WXZSYJ_27_6: Remember what I said? The Offshoot Cores regenerate because we haven’t destroyed the Main Core. It seems to be the case here too...
POI_WXZSYJ_27_7: No, it's even worse. It indicates the spread of the Offshoot Cores. If we can't destroy them immediately, they'll...
POI_WXZSYJ_27_8: I'm setting up the devices, and let's clear this Offshoot Core! Rover, I'll leave it to you!
POI_WXZSYJ_26_2: That's... Hoohoo?! It's fighting those enraged Hoochiefs!
POI_WXZSYJ_26_3: They've been contaminated. If we don't treat them in time, they will...
POI_WXZSYJ_24_3: The new one we just made is slightly better than before, but still... This is not enough to protect us in heavily contaminated areas.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_4: Do you remember? My mentor was determined to find a cure for those contaminated Hoochiefs, putting all her efforts into antibody research.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_5: The short-acting antibody she left is enough for our daily work, so we held off on further research in this area.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_6: Looking back, it seems we might have taken things to another extreme. My mentor used to say, "As researchers, we need to see beyond the superficial details"...
POI_WXZSYJ_24_7: What on earth have I missed...
POI_WXZSYJ_24_11: Hoohoo... Wait, why are you starting to copy Hoohoo?
POI_WXZSYJ_24_12: That’s because Hoohoo is likely the missing piece we overlooked!
POI_WXZSYJ_24_15: Contaminated Hoochiefs? What's so odd about that? I suppose there are plenty in the forest?
POI_WXZSYJ_24_16: Energetic Hoohoo? Hasn't it been energetic all the time?
POI_WXZSYJ_24_18: With the spore concentration going up, lots of Hoochiefs were affected and thus attacked us. Thankfully, Rover handled them effortlessly!
POI_WXZSYJ_24_19: However, the spore concentration was so high, I couldn't endure it. Not even after taking the antibody. Even though Hoohoo supposedly has stronger resistance than us, theoretically, it shouldn't stay unaffected.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_20: But you see? Hoohoo can't be more energetic right now!
POI_WXZSYJ_24_23: Actually, this reminds me of my mentor's diary. She recorded her interactions with Hoohoo in the lab.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_24: Hoohoo was one of the contaminated Hoochiefs, but its symptoms were mild. After taking the antibody developed by my mentor, Hoohoo's condition improved significantly.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_25: Perhaps the treatment back then enhanced Hoohoo's resistance. Anyway, we can't safely draw a conclusion this yet.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_33: Hoohoo! What happened? Why did it just run off like that?
POI_WXZSYJ_24_34: It seems to be running towards the Violet Banyan.
POI_WXZSYJ_24_30: Seems like it has something to say.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_2: The spore concentration has returned to normal... Phew, the air feels fresher now! Thank you, Rover! The Offshoot Core here has been successfully destroyed!
POI_WXZSYJ_23_3: How are you feeling? Are you okay?
POI_WXZSYJ_23_8: Oh no! Let's get you to rest now!
POI_WXZSYJ_23_9: Wow! Anyway, glad to know you're okay.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_12: Our cute Hoohoo seems happy as usual! Totally different from those contaminated Hoochiefs!
POI_WXZSYJ_23_15: Yeah, Hoohoo's one of the Hoochiefs Senmin's mentor saved. It was Hoohoo who took us to find her mentor.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_16: Unfortunately, we were still late. If only we had arrived a bit earlier...
POI_WXZSYJ_23_18: I'm alright, Hoohoo. It's in the past now. I'm so glad you haven’t been affected by those spores. That's a relief.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_19: You're a tough one, Hoohoo. Even with a short-acting antibody, it was a struggle for me at that concentration.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_20: It's strange. It's understandable that you're unaffected as a Resonator. However, Hoohoo is an ordinary Hoochief, similar to those already contaminated. How can that happen?
POI_WXZSYJ_23_22: Well, actually, the spore concentration here wasn’t that high before, so... it didn't catch our attention.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_24: Don't worry, Hoohoo! No matter what, you're still our best Hoochief friend!
POI_WXZSYJ_23_25: Rover, let’s head back and update Senmin on what we found.  We can also see how her experiment is going.
POI_WXZSYJ_23_6: I can crush ten more of those!
POI_WXZSYJ_23_14: It seems unaffected by the spores.
POI_WXZSYJ_22_4: Great! I’m turning on the devices. Rover, get ready for calibration!
POI_WXZSYJ_21_1: Seems like the second contaminated area's right here. It's expanded a lot...
POI_WXZSYJ_21_3: Okay! I'm setting up the devices! Rover, I'm counting on you for this one too.
POI_WXZSYJ_18_2: The red light is getting brighter.
POI_WXZSYJ_18_3: Cough, so does the concentration here...
POI_WXZSYJ_18_5: We're approaching the next Offshoot Core. Rover, be careful!
POI_WXZSYJ_17_1: Here too... These scratches are fresh.
POI_WXZSYJ_16_3: Yeah, they've been affected by spores. You see? There are scratches on them.
POI_WXZSYJ_16_6: Let's hurry up. You two take care.
POI_WXZSYJ_15_1: Fantastic, Rover! With the Offshoot Core destroyed, the spore concentration in this area has decreased. Besides, Hoohoo and I collected its core!
POI_WXZSYJ_15_2: It's a precious research material! We've rarely encountered a complete core like this before. Maybe at that time they weren't fully formed...
POI_WXZSYJ_15_4: Alright! The next Offshoot Core's in the northeast direction. Let's go.
POI_WXZSYJ_13_4: Great! I’m turning on the devices. Rover, get ready for calibration!
POI_WXZSYJ_12_1: The first Offshoot Core's... right here. Rover, please lend me your hand to destroy it.
POI_WXZSYJ_12_2: I'll set up the devices and turn them on! These devices will release sound waves that can destroy the Offshoot Cores.
POI_WXZSYJ_12_3: But for us non-Resonators, it's hard to figure out where the sound waves are coming from.
POI_WXZSYJ_12_4: But you should be able to perceive the source of those sound waves. I'll lead the way. Please help me calibrate the devices!
POI_WXZSYJ_12_9: Take your time, Rover! Just tell me when you're ready!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_1: Phew... Good, you're stable now. I just finished treating you. How are you feeling? Can you stand?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_2: Yeah, I'm feeling much better. Thank you, Qiaomu.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_3: I think you owe me an apology! You were already struggling with health problems and you still put yourself in danger! Do you know how worried I was?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_4: If you want to thank someone, thank Rover. {Male=He;Female=She} took great pains to get you out in time!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_5: I'm really sorry for causing you such trouble. Rover, you don't know how grateful I am for your help!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_6: But I had my reasons for doing this... Did Qiaomu tell you about the situation in the Dim Forest?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_8: I see. Let me explain in detail then.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_9: The Dim Forest is infested with toxic spores. Hoochiefs exposed to these spores turn aggressive.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_10: Contaminated animals are dying, and inhaling too many spores also affects people’s health. That's why I told you to be extremely careful.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_11: Therefore, our exploration team has been working to resolve this issue. For example, my mentor tried to find a solution by researching Hoochiefs...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_12: ...while we focused on the spores and finally found a way to solve this issue.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_13: The spores in the Dim Forest have been spreading steadily, and we suspect there are cores continuously producing and spreading them.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_14: Therefore, if we can destroy those cores, we can solve the issue.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_16: Yeah. However, it's easier said than done.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_64: We've located several of these cores, some with scratches on their shells. It looks like someone tried to destroy them.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_17: Like I said, the cores are protected by hard shells. Regular attacks won't even scratch them, so we developed a device that can burn through them!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_18: Now, here's another problem. Those cores quickly regenerate after being destroyed. It's quite a headache.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_19: If we don't do anything, the spores will spread even faster, so we have to regularly clear these cores. That's why we're here today.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_20: True, but there's really no need for you to venture so deep into the forest. What on earth happened?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_21: I detected a sudden surge in spore concentration at the central banyan tree. It's the first time this has happened, so I had to figure out the causes.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_22: Guess what? I found the Main Core.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_23: Wait, are you serious? Does that mean we can actually solve the issue?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_24: Indeed! The reason why we struggled to solve the problem for so long is that, we never solved the core of this issue—namely, the spore's Main Core. It's probably been hiding at the roots of the central giant banyan.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_25: And now, the Main Core has finally appeared, right at the top of that tree.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_27: Then we can solve this issue! But...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_28: But getting close to that core isn't easy for us, I'm afraid. The antibodies we currently have can't support us going up there.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_29: Besides, if we don't deal with those Offshoot Cores—oh, that's what we researchers call those cores constantly producing spores—the spores will spread faster than we can imagine...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_32: You're right. Here's the plan: Rover and I will go clear the Offshoot Cores as planned, and you head back to our camp to work on improving the antibodies.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_34: This should be the fastest solution for now, Senmin.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_35: Besides, the antibodies represent your mentor's hard-earned achievement, and you've been eager to improve them to fulfill your mentor's wish, haven't you?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_36: Leave it to us; we can surely handle it well!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_38: I see. Thank you. I'm going back to work on improving my antibodies!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_40: Don't worry about me, Hoohoo. You should go help Rover and Qiaomu. Be a good boy, okay?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_42: Rover, Qiaomu, I'm counting on you!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_44: It's never easy to get someone as stubborn as her to do something...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_47: That obvious? Rover, I'm sorry I made this decision without discussing it with you.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_48: Senmin has been trying to address the toxic spore issue in the Dim Forest.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_49: When I just joined the exploration team, Senmin's mentor was still around. Back then, we tried to find a solution by studying those aggressive Hoochiefs.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_63: Given the aggressive behaviors of Hoochiefs, we used to think that humans couldn’t get along with them.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_50: Her mentor used to say, "There are always more things hidden in a phenomenon. That's why we need to see below the surface."
POI_WXZSYJ_11_51: So her mentor kept communicating with the Hoochiefs as well as treating them. She locked herself up in the lab, immersed in her research.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_52: But one day, when she was interacting with the Hoochief... When we arrived, we found her lying on the ground...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_53: Our lab was occupied by the Hoochiefs, so we could only hastily leave the lab with our research data and essential experimental equipment.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_54: After that, Senmin changed. She took on her mentor's wishes and responsibilities and changed the direction of her research, starting to study the spores themselves.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_55: Slowly, we've made some progress, and now we finally see the hope of solving the problem.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_56: So I don't want her to fall here. I may not be as talented as Senmin and not that helpful in solving this issue... I just want everyone to be safe. That's what matters the most to me.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_57: I can't stand another accident like that. I...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_59: I'm fine, Hoohoo. Your safety is more important! What we're planning to do only matters if all of us can return safely, right?
POI_WXZSYJ_11_62: Y-yeah! Thank you, Rover! Now, let's go get rid of those Offshoot Cores!
POI_WXZSYJ_11_26: So if we manage to destroy the Main Core...
POI_WXZSYJ_11_30: We need to improve the antibodies.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_31: We need to clear the Offshoot Cores.
POI_WXZSYJ_11_46: Fortunately, you successfully had her go back and take a rest.
POI_WXZSYJ_10_5: I'll get you out of here.
Flow_106000000_544: The situation's complicated there. Be careful!
Flow_106000000_651: It seems this is Senmin's notes, where did she go... Continue to use the Sensor to see.
Flow_106000000_933: While you were cleaning the Offshoot Core, I've been trying to adjust the antibody formula, now it's almost the last step...
Flow_106000000_934: However, what I'm going to do is time-sensitive, so it would be helpful if both of you could lend me a hand.

Flow_135000003_195: Only by snagging those powerful Echoes can we keep our streak alive...
Flow_135000003_196: We've got some time before the match kicks off. How about we squeeze in a bit more practice?
Flow_135000003_197: Nah, too many eyes here. We'd spill our tactics.
Flow_135000003_198: We're counting on you to boost our ranking and reclaim our stuff!
Flow_135000003_199: Only by obtaining powerful Echo can you keep winning...

HuanglongM1_1_23_73: You are free to visit any part of Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_1: Us running into Master Jianxin was a one-off incident. If the mangosteen indicates something about war, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_6: Have you thought of something, Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_11: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us about the TD outbreak?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_12: If those Tacet Discords break through our defenses, it would be a disaster for not just Huanglong, but for all of humanity...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_13: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us something about the mangosteen's route of transportation?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_14: That quartermaster said the mangosteens are transported by boat from the <color=Highlight>South</color>.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_15: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us about General Jiyan, or about the war against Tacet Discords?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_16: We haven't reached the frontlines yet, but I can already smell the iron in the air... I sense tension and unease. Our soldiers stationed at the borders... I hope they are okay...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_2: That civilizations are born from war and suffer from war.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_3: Perhaps she wants me to meet someone.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_4: Perhaps the moment hasn't arrived yet.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_5: She's just giving me a chance to do a certain thing.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_1: Master Jianxin, have you found the person you're looking for?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_2: Yes, I've found Zhiyuan. We will return to the city with the logistics team. We will go find Mr. Zongye to let him know he is safe.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_5: Zhiyuan is a man full of courage. Influenced by his veteran grandpa's tales, he longs to join the military and aid in humanity's battle against Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_6: The journey with you has exposed me to immense suffering, but the battles on the frontline must be even more brutal than what I've witnessed.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_7: Countless lives have been lost in this war...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_8: Master Rongfu once told me, "The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion."
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_9: I do share some of Zhiyuan's feelings.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_10: However, Zhiyuan disagreed with the intense training and tests required to join the military. He saw no distinction between ordinary people and Resonators, and believed he could contribute on the battlefield, however small that contribution might be.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_15: I, too, found what Zhiyuan said was reasonable to an extent, and I couldn't change his mind with words. So I tried to imagine what my masters would do. They'd set up a spar in this case. And if I won, they'd let me do what I wanted.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_31: I didn't mean to beat him up for nothing. My masters taught me valuable lessons through sparring, and I gained important insights from those fights. Now, who do you think won that fight?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_20: "The shape changes, but not the forms; the more it moves, the more it yields. Less thinking, more knowing. Simplify for clarity.”
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_21: Yes, I pretended to lose, but Zhiyuan saw it through.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_22: After our fight, Zhiyuan admitted he saw the gap between Resonators and ordinary people. He seemed to realize how he was still far from being able to fight the Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_23: He realized how he was just trying to convince himself that he could make a difference, not wanting to acknowledge his own limitations. Fighting on the battlefield requires physical and mental strength, and he was not yet prepared for that.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_24: “All tangles untied, all glare tempered, all dust smoothed. It is like a deep pool that never dries. ” How true! I've come to understand this line more.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_25: I promised not to use my Forte in the battle, but Zhiyuan still couldn't take a single blow from me.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_26: After his defeat, Zhiyuan seemed to realize his weakness. Talking about confronting the Tacet Discords on the battlefield would be mere lip service, he said. He was just trying to convince himself that he could make a difference, not wanting to acknowledge his own limitations.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_27: I heard you two still have other matters to attend to. When you have the time, let's catch up at Liuxian Teahouse.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_28: It's my great pleasure to have met you.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_3: I heard Zhiyuan didn't want to leave?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_12: Everyone has a part to play.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_13: He's only causing trouble by staying on the battlefield.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_14: He can contribute better without fighting on the frontlines.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_17: Anything that works for you, I guess.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_58_2: According to Baizhi, the leaf showed residual fluctuations of Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_58_3: Those fluctuations pointed to a certain set of coordinates.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_58_4: And that is... Qichi Village, in the Central Plains.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_11: Now that they are all safe, you should go and take care of your own issues.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_12: Thank you. May I ask where the quartermaster is?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_13: The quartermaster isn't here. He's on the floor above, directing munitions distribution. Just take that lift and you should find him there.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_14: Rover, where are we going next?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_17: Here are some recipes for dietary supplements from my sect. They might help the wounded recover sooner.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_18: Oh? Great. You have my thanks.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_16: I want to talk to the quartermaster, too.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_1: Have you confirmed the inventory? What about the spare list? Sort out the consumables as soon as possible. Check our communication lines while you're at it...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_2: Yue, deliver this list to Ase. Oh, you're not Yue. Where is she? What do you need?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_30: Excuse me. I'm an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. This is Rover, and this is Master Jianxin who came here to look for someone.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_7: Jinzhou is the gateway to Huanglong, and the Desorock Highland is the gateway to Jinzhou. A single breach could have dire consequences. Our defense must hold at all costs.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_8: The Tacet Discords are not humans. They don't do truces or ceasefires. For as long as they exist, this war will rage on endlessly.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_9: Supply is the lifeblood of our army, and I am tasked with keeping it flowing. But now, we are facing a shortage.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_10: I saw you help arrange the wounded there. Xiulan would need your help more than I do.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_11: Thank you, but I must remain to oversee vital military supplies.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_12: Jianxin asked the quartermaster about Zhiyuan's whereabouts.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_14: So he never sent a letter home? Not even once?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_15: The Midnight Rangers are no longer recruiting non-Resonators lately, but Zhiyuan was a stubborn boy. Last year when the battles hadn't gotten so intense, he would trail us Rearguards, eager to join the frontline.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_16: We sent him back to the city, time and time again, and he just kept finding ways to come back. Eventually I caved and took him in to help us here at the base.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_17: With the battle escalating, it's getting increasingly dangerous out here. I shouldn't keep him here any longer. I was just thinking about having the logistics team bring him back to the city when you guys showed up.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_18: Oh, now I remember. He should be currently on the floor above.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_31: Sure. Please excuse me. I'll join you later.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_38: Jianxin did a brief salute and left.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_22: Oh... Please excuse me. Thought that was a grenade... Is this... a mangosteen?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_26: It's a type of old-fashioned explosive. The Lament caused a global technological regression and shortage of resources.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_27: While Tacetite Weapons were being developed, most people had limited knowledge of Tacetite as an energy source. As a result, primitive products combining old and new technology emerged.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_28: The hand grenade was one of them. With the rapid growth of Tacetite Weapons, these crude explosives were eventually phased out in favor of more advanced weaponry.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_29: Well... it's not a local fruit, so we can only get it through imports. But, with the recent Tacet Discord outbreaks, we've had to prioritize bringing in the essentials. We'll get back to importing more of these after General Jiyan makes his triumphant return.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_36: Currently, there's only one waterway open, from Port Gunchao in the <color=Highlight>south</color> of the city. The Rearguards would regularly go there to escort goods.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_37: Hmm... What more do I know... The military rarely buys this fruit for rations due to its short shelf life. Plus, it looks too much like a grenade, and that could cause some issues.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_5: (Tell him about the person Jianxin's looking for.)
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_6: Master Jianxin, do you want to go look for Zhiyuan first?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_32: We'll be meeting up with you.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_24: What do you know about the mangosteen?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_17: I think a quartermaster of the Rearguards escorted him away, so if he's not in the city...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_46: Thank you for your help! I really appreciate it!
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_40: It's indeed beautiful data... Good taste. Well, since you've put it that way...
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_41: Rover... Mr. Mortefi's expression seems to have softened, don't you think?
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_45: We haven't even asked him to help us with assembling...
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_49: It looks like Mr. Mortefi needs some more time. Maybe we should give him some space to concentrate?
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_50: Rover, let's come back later, shall we?
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_42: Yeah, he looks like a purring cat now.
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_46: ...and he's already started working on it.
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_47: ...and he just naturally lent us a hand.
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_48: I guess the Academy people are just passionate about solving problems.
Huanglong_main_1_2_7_10: It's an internal forum of the Academy for casual chit-chatting. You can find basically anything here!
Huanglong_main_1_2_7_11: Oh no. No no no... I really should stop and focus on my assignment now! The deadline is today!
Huanglong_main_1_2_7_14: Oh wait! I know what I should do!
Huanglong_main_1_2_7_12: Hurry, go finish your assignment first.
Huanglong_main_1_2_7_13: Wouldn't hurt to procrastinate a bit more.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_67: Do you have any questions before we begin?
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_46: The current classification levels, from lowest to highest, are Common, Elite, Overlord, and Calamity. Additionally, there is a special type of Tacet Discord, and we call them the Threnodians.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_51: When a Resonator's mental capacity is overwhelmed, they may lose control of their <ano=power>Forte</ano>, causing an overflow of Resonance energy.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_52: This is known as "Overclocking" and is categorized into three levels based on severity. The excess Resonance energy harms both the Resonator and their surroundings.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_53: In extreme cases, the excess energy can even manifest as destructive Tacet Fields.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_54: We have established a comprehensive Overclock diagnosis process to accurately predict potential risks of Overclocking.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_55: Your waveform graph shows a remarkable level of stability, surpassing any Resonator I've encountered. Your risk of Overclocking should be minimal.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_56: You don't need to worry about that for the time being.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_57: I can't say without sufficient data.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_58: Your test results don't indicate any trauma, so your amnesia may not be linked to traumatic events.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_59: As for your ability to absorb Echoes, I can't make a connection between that and your amnesia based on the current data.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_60: To put it simply, it seems there is another dimension or... a creature, hiding inside your body.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_64: I used that as a metaphor to express my speculation. If such a thing existed within you, scientists would be eagerly seeking to understand it.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_65: There are so many mysteries about you worth exploring.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_66: A universe. That's a poetic and intriguing comparison.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_47: What kind of impact will it have on me?
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_48: Does this have anything to do with my amnesia?
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_62: Sounds like a cool terrarium idea.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_63: Sounds like I have a little universe within me.
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_13: Oh dear! Thank the heavens you saved it in time, Jianxin!
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_14: Here's your tea. Off to the customers you go!
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_15: Mister Zongye, you're back! Are you hurt?
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_16: *Chuckle* Oh, it's you Jianxin, you silly girl.
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_17: H-how's Mister Zongye able to recognize you? Weird!
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_18: Jianxin, disciple in training. We've met before.
Huanglong_main_1_2_40_19: Are you the one's that brought back Mister Zongye? Thanks so much!
Huanglong_main_1_2_1110_1: A well-used photo album rests on the table, its cover slightly curved from frequent leafing through.
Huanglong_main_1_2_1110_2: A single photograph lies inside, seemingly cut from a newspaper. It depicts a woman in a white coat gazing at an infant, her face hidden from view. The paper looks well kept.
Huanglong_main_1_2_1110_3: Rover, I don't think we'll find what we need here...
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_20: The archives here are organized in a unique way. You can start by searching the keywords at the lobby terminal.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_29: Remember when I said don't force it open?
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_30: Crank that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_31: The Earthly Branches and Four Symbols...
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_32: These symbols are related to the Sexagenary Cycle. It's an intricate way of recording time in Huanglong. Nowadays it is mainly reserved for calendars, numerology, and indexing, but it's falling out of daily use.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_33: Now what kind of information could it represent...
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_35: Most of Huanglong's libraries and databases still use this method to organize their archives. Namely, the Grand Libraries.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_39: Yes. The large data repositories located in Huanglong's major cities.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_40: Exactly. Languages may evolve, names may change, but time remains constant.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_42: The Academy's public archives are organized in this manner, too.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_37: So it's like a time-based filing system?
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_44: Let's go find the archives about this sugar pearl.
Huanglong_main_1_5_79_101: The Fractsidus plans to advance another Lament and cause disasters worldwide.
Huanglong_main_1_4_66_7: You find some markings on the walls.
Huanglong_main_1_4_66_8: As you lean in closer to look, you notice some faint markings on the wall.
Huanglong_main_1_4_66_9: Words like "MONSTER", "WITCH", "BANISH HER" and "ALL HER FAULT" are written thickly on the wall.
Huanglong_main_1_4_66_10: A crumpled page from a children's book, silently resting on the ground.
Huanglong_main_1_4_64_14: A crumpled page from a children's book, silently resting on the ground.
Huanglong_main_1_4_63_16: The tree branches are loaded with paper slips, each containing someone's wish. The words on most of the notes are soaked and no longer legible.
Huanglong_main_1_4_63_18: Another crumpled page from a children's book, half-buried in the mud.
Huanglong_main_1_4_62_12: A crumpled page from a children's book rests on a torn piece of diary paper with childish handwriting.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_12: C'mon. No need to get so worked up.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_13: I see you're itching for a fight, but our game isn't over yet.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_14: Strike now and risk being crippled. And what a shame it would be to miss out on these crucial clues right in front of you.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_15: After all this effort, do you truly want to throw it all away?
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_18: Aww, are you seriously going to judge me off of those rumors alone?
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_19: I knew it... Gentle lambs like me are bound to suffer. Never given a chance to speak for ourselves...
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_20: Well then, I suppose I'll have to be a little more ruthless with you.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_21: Play nice and go investigate the clues in this village, then I might show your girl some "gratitude" for leaving us be.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_22: Otherwise... You may have to bid her farewell. Forever.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_26: HAHAHAHA! You never cease to amaze me!
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_27: Such a burning desire for battle... How could I have the heart to decline?
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_25: Shut up and fight me properly!
Huanglong_main_1_4_60_61: My goal is simple. I just want to deepen our mutual understanding, nothing more.
Huanglong_main_1_4_60_62: Come on. Observe the surroundings a little more, and tell me what you see.
Huanglong_main_1_4_60_63: As you learn more about this world, your true desires will surface, and our little game will become... even more entertaining.
Huanglong_main_1_4_60_64: So. Go ahead, what do you see?
Huanglong_main_1_4_203_1: Look, the water is going down!
Huanglong_main_1_4_202_1: You placed the wooden plaque on the stone. Soon after, you heard the roaring of flowing water.
Huanglong_main_1_4_201_1: It's the missing half... We can piece them together now.
Huanglong_main_1_4_200_1: Rover, do you still have the plaque we found earlier? The one broken in half.
Huanglong_main_1_4_200_2: Yes, as I thought... I just felt a similar vibration from that direction. Please follow me.
Huanglong_main_1_4_107_3: That girl just wanted to save her village...
Huanglong_main_1_4_107_4: But those sacrifices didn't lead to redemption.
Huanglong_main_1_4_107_5: I guess the Tacet Discord we saw stayed here to convey her last wishes...
Huanglong_main_1_4_107_2: It's getting a bit too cold here... Can we head back now?
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_4: Something's not right. Why wouldn't it attack us?
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_13: It seems to only repeat these lines... This is not a common Tacet Discord.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_14: Tacet Discords attack other living beings, because they need to feed on those frequencies to make themselves whole again. When frequencies are scattered and recombined, a new Tacet Discord is born.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_15: This one probably devoured the frequencies of... humans.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_16: Turning the last bits of a human's consciousness into such monotonous mumbles... Are these words the last cries of someone innocent? Who is behind this twisted plot?
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_17: W-wait! It doesn't look like it's trying to attack us...
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_22: It seems to only repeat these lines... This is not a common Tacet Discord.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_23: Tacet Discords attack other living beings, because they need to feed on those frequencies to make themselves whole again. When frequencies are scattered and recombined, a new Tacet Discord is born.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_24: This one probably devoured the frequencies of... humans.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_25: Turning the last bits of a human's consciousness into such monotonous mumbles... Are these words the last cries of someone innocent? Who is behind this twisted plot?
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_26: Yangyang crouches down, hand on the Tacet Discord's head. As she focuses on the Streams, sorrow fills her expression.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_18: Do Tacet Discords have consciousness too?
Huanglong_main_1_4_100_1: I think I've found something, Rover.

InfoDisplay_101400006_Text:
Today, Master Dollmaker told me stories about Mommy and Daddy again. He said they were brave Patrollers who were betrayed by some really bad people. 

Master Dollmaker only seems to get happy when he talks about this. He promised me that he'd bring them back to me, and when that happens, they'll get their revenge. 

I do miss Mommy and Daddy, but I don't remember much about them. Do they want to become puppets? And get revenge? I don’t know. But if they came back, we'd be happy every day. Right?
InfoDisplay_101400007_Text:
Sparrow here. Day 14 of our undercover investigation. Canary and I managed to get hold of the date and location of the transaction, but we've yet to find any key evidence.
Based on various intel, we suspect that Cuckoo has already planted a mole inside the nest. Meaning our cover could be blown at any given time.
With our hatchling barely out of its shell, I had instructed Canary to abort the mission and return to the nest for the sake of safety, to which she refused... She suggests that nowhere is safe if the mole has already planted a target on our backs, rather our optimal plan of action is to stick together and seek out the evidence and the mole as quickly as possible.
We have already entrusted the hatchling to the care of a junior with whom we place our complete trust. We now have no worries. We can and must bring evil to justice.
InfoDisplay_101400008_Text:
Close... So close... 
Almost there. Almost.
My own memories failed me, and Yinlin is no longer an option. 
I've spent over a decade on these two puppets. I live for finishing this project.
I'll do whatever it takes, even teaming up with those I once despised. 
Sacrifices will be made. I will see it through, no matter what.
InfoDisplay_101400009_Text:
Master Dollmaker,

Do you remember this notebook? You said it was a gift from my parents when you became a Patroller. It contained their wisdom and advice, and it was your most treasured possession. It was my greatest inspiration, too.

I've completed my training today. I am now a qualified Patroller. I've decided to become an undercover agent, following in my parents' footsteps. While this may deviate from your expectations of me advancing in the Public Security Bureau, I feel drawn to this path. I may not come back here very often from now on. 

Lately, I've been hearing worrying rumors from the Séance Society. I understand you're facing challenges in your research, but if you've resorted to working with criminals, then you'll be no better than them.

If you stumble upon this message in our camp, please destroy it after reading. I don't know if you'll ever find it, but I hope you do.

I miss our talks, Master Dollmaker. I've been thinking about my parents, and there is something I have to tell you. Please, let's talk again.

Character_YinLin_75_16: What if those monsters come at us again? We'll have no one to stop them!

LoadingTipsText_1009_TipsText: Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.
Flow_114000002_259: This is the place. This bridge... it's always the same.
HuanglongM1_1_11_1: Anything I can help you with, Rover?
HuanglongM1_1_11_7: With pleasure. What do you wish to know about Jinzhou?
HuanglongM1_1_11_12: The Midnight Rangers, under General Jiyan's command, are a garrison in Jinzhou. They consist of the Vanguards for offensive operations against Tacet Discords, and the Rearguards for city defense.
HuanglongM1_1_11_49: Additionally, there is a detachment unit called the Outriders, mostly made up of volunteers or reservists who serve as reconnaissance agents.
HuanglongM1_1_11_13: Most of the servicemen of today are comprised of Resonators.
HuanglongM1_1_11_16: Jinzhou is not the most populated city in Huanglong. As a border city, it is the frontline in countering Tacet Discord Outbreaks.
HuanglongM1_1_11_51: ...Jinzhou holds a special place in my heart.
HuanglongM1_1_11_18: ...I can't say I am too familiar with my hometown, but I do feel a homely sense of attachment to Jinzhou. Maybe it's because here lives a person who changed my life.
HuanglongM1_1_11_19: Hmm. If I were to introduce Jinzhou in my own words, I'd say it's a city one would easily grow attached to.
HuanglongM1_1_11_21: Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
HuanglongM1_1_11_26: Our Magistrate's birth name was Hsi. She took on the name Jinhsi when she became the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
HuanglongM1_1_11_27: Nowadays, she is usually addressed as "Madam Magistrate."
HuanglongM1_1_11_28: She is also known as the "Loong Maiden", because of her Resonance connection with our Sentinel, "Jué", who manifests in the shape of a <ano=Dragon>Loong</ano>.
HuanglongM1_1_11_29: The ways Huanglong's Magistrates interact with their corresponding Sentinels can differ. In Jinzhou, our Magistrate seems to share a familial bond with the Sentinel.
HuanglongM1_1_11_31: Though... This is what I understand from what she has told me. I have only seen our Sentinel a handful of times.
HuanglongM1_1_11_32: It depends on Madam Magistrate, and...
HuanglongM1_1_11_47: It depends on your decision, Rover.
HuanglongM1_1_11_48: Please pardon me. This is all I can say at the moment.
HuanglongM1_1_11_33: With pleasure. What do you wish to know about the tokens?
HuanglongM1_1_11_39: I suggest looking into where these tokens come from.
HuanglongM1_1_11_40: Examine their locations of origin, and explore the sites or past events they represent... Then you should uncover the message Madam Magistrate wanted to convey, and hopefully learn everything you want to know.
HuanglongM1_1_11_41: Of course. It is fully up to you.
HuanglongM1_1_11_42: Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
HuanglongM1_1_11_45: I'm afraid not. I have never seen you before.
HuanglongM1_1_11_46: If I had, I would never forget you.
HuanglongM1_1_11_3: I have questions about the Magistrate.
HuanglongM1_1_11_4: I have questions about the tokens.
HuanglongM1_1_11_10: How about an introduction of the city?
HuanglongM1_1_11_17: Care to give me an introduction that's not from the books?
HuanglongM1_1_11_22: I'd like to learn more about the Magistrate.
HuanglongM1_1_11_23: What is the relationship between Magistrate Jinhsi and the Sentinel of Jinzhou?
HuanglongM1_1_11_35: How should I make use of the tokens?
