Tutorial_50006_Title: Transform into the Inferno Rider: I
GuideTutorialPage_50001_Content:
When Resonators enter the <color=#ffd12f>Sea of Flames</color>, they become eroded by the Incinero Petal Pollens, causing a <color=#ffd12f>steady decline in their HP</color>.
This effect will gradually disappear within seconds after the exposure stops.
GuideTutorialPage_50002_Content:
Resonators can use the <color=#ffd12f>Shooting Mechanism</color> to train their shooting skills. Hitting different targets will trigger different effects:
Normal Targets: Yellow. Hit all of them to proceed to the next stage.
Explosive Targets: An explosion symbol marked on it. When hit, it will trigger an explosion, breaking the surrounding targets.
Trap Targets: A prohibition symbol marked on it. When hit, your points will be deducted.
GuideTutorialPage_50003_Content: After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to connect the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> to the remaining section. Adjust the direction of the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> by rotating them with the Levitator.
GuideTutorialPage_50004_Content: Attack the spear barrel with your weapon to build up the Hit Gauge displayed at the top.
GuideTutorialPage_50005_Content:
After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to throw the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color> at the enemies, dealing AoE multi-stage DMG.
Defeat all Tacet Discords and protect the three Sound Emulators to complete the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_50006_Content:
Transform into the Inferno Rider and speed along the track created by the floating highways.
As you race, you can control the Inferno Rider to wield its blade to <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> obstacles in your path and <color=#ffd12f>avoid</color> road signs.
GuideTutorialPage_50007_Content: You can equip an <color=#ffd12f>Ultrasonic Pulse Chip</color> to launch a Water Vortex. The Water Vortex can <color=#ffd12f>clear</color> the mud along the path. Upon hitting the enemies, it can <color=#ffd12f>remove</color> the enemies' <color=#ffd12f>Mud Shields</color> and knock them back. Upon hitting the Swamp Vortex, it can trigger an <color=#ffd12f>AoE DMG</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_50008_Content: The Swamp Vortex <color=#ffd12f>knocks back</color> the units it hits and deals <color=#ffd12f>minor damage</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip can dispel the Swamp Vortex, dealing <color=#ffd12f>a large amount of damage</color> to the enemies within the range.
GuideTutorialPage_50009_Content: After activating the Suppressor, you must <color=#ffd12f>remain within its range for a period of time</color> to advance the repair progress. When <color=#ffd12f>mud</color> and <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> appear within the range, the Suppressor will cease to function.
GuideTutorialPage_50010_Content: The mud <color=#ffd12f>blocks the mechanisms and grants the enemies special Mud Shields</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip and the Swamp Vortex can remove the mud and the shield it grants.
GuideTutorialPage_50011_Content:
To address the issue in the Dim Forest, try to eliminate the Offshoot Cores.
When the drones light up, use either <color=#ffd12f>melee or ranged</color> attacks to rotate them, directing the sound wave emitted by the central drone towards the Offshoot Core. If successful, you'll eliminate the Offshoot Core and obtain a valuable Offshoot Core sample.
HelpText_37_Content:
[Introduction]
Built on the principles of ancient sonar technology, this detector locates special collectibles by scanning their specific frequencies within an area.
 
[Instructions]
1. Sonar Circuits are required to use the Casket Sonar. Sonar Circuits can be synthesized at the Synthesizer, and the Synthesize recipe for Sonar Circuits is unlocked by increasing your Pioneer Association Level.
2. Once special collectibles are located, the Casket Sonar will stay activated. It will deactivate once all identified items are collected. You can locate up to 5 collectibles at once.
3. The Casket Sonar can only be used in areas where a Use Permit has been obtained. Special collectibles in unauthorized regions cannot be located.
HelpText_38_Content:
[Introduction]
Lootmapper allows its users to locate nearby collectible Supply Chests by detecting their frequencies. The Lootmapper carves a useful advantage for seekers of adventure.

[Instructions]
1. Place a Lootmapper to locate nearby collectible Supply Chests within a certain confine.
2. You can only place 3 Lootmappers at once. If you exceed the limit, the first one you placed will be taken back automatically. You can also manually retrieve them.
HelpText_39_Content:
[Introduction]
Waypoints are temporary location markers with the same functionalities as a Resonance Beacon. Its high portability makes it an essential tool when traveling in the wild.
 
[Instructions]
1. Consume a Waypoint Module to place a Waypoint. Waypoint Modules can be obtained via Synthesis at the Synthesizer. Raise your Pioneer Association Level to unlock the recipe for Waypoint Module.
2. You can fast-travel to the coordinates of the Waypoint after placing it. Please note that Waypoints cannot be placed at some coordinates.
3. You can only place 10 Waypoints at once. If you exceed the limit, the first one you placed will be automatically removed. You can also manually retrieve them.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_9_1: This is the second Sonodisk. I should bring it to the Symphodai.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_1: “...Multiply fifty-four with four thirds for the Frequency you seek. Find this note in the West, while the prophet is beyond reach."
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_2: I suppose it's telling me where I can find the next Sonodisk... I think it mentioned a direction. What does that last sentence mean, though...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_3: That sound... It's coming from the west.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_1: Tacet Discords... Inside the City Hall?
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_2: No, they are not real... They must be some kind of digital simulation. It seems they are the guards here. Interesting how I'm not hearing sirens, despite having destroyed every one of them.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_3: Apart from the simulated Tacet Discords, It's unusually quiet in this place...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_6_1: A new walkway has shown up. I must have solved the first puzzle.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_6_2: Seems I will need to look for more Sonodisks in there.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_5_1: A Bell just raised out of the water... So that's what it meant by having the Bells guide my path.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_4_1: Part of the Scoreholder just lit up. As I expected.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_4_2: The drum over there seems to have unlocked.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_3_1: This must be one of the missing notes. Now... How do I connect it with the Symphodai?
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_1: So this is the "Grand Library." It's said to hold the answers to every question imaginable...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_2: I'm not seeing anyone here. I guess the Magistrate is yet to arrive.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_3: Well, it wouldn't hurt to browse the archives for a bit as I wait for her to show up.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_23_1: Now I should have access to the Database...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_22_1: I have the last Sonodisk ready. Time to go back to the Symphodai.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_21_1: This is the last one. They've prepared quite the welcome for me.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_20_1: Now the water is all gone.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_19_1: This is the fourth missing note.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_18_1: It seems the guards only show up when someone approaches a Sonodisk.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_16_2: ”The Bells will lead my path," huh. I'll go work out the passageways.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_15_1: I've retrieved the third Sonodisk. Time to head back.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_14_1: Here it is. Time to deal with the guards.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_14_2: (Jinzhou's City Hall is the political hub, while the Grand Library holds vital data. Considering how I just took out all those guards, this place is oddly under-protected. If my guess is correct, the Magistrate may have other plans for me...)
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_13_1: The music I just heard... It must be the Sonodisk.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_1: So this is the right way to go.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_2: I am being fed just enough information to work out the puzzle. This does look like Miss Magistrate's doing.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_11_1: It seems locked... Guess I'll need to activate the other one first.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_10_1: The water level just dropped again. There's another two drums, one in the east, and another in the west.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_10_2: I may find more Sonodisks down there.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_1: A hidden passage... As I expected.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_2: That must be the entrance to the Database.

Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_4: When I'm happy, I'll take out Lulu for some kisses. And when I'm having a bad time, I'll use Lulu for a snuggle. How does that sound?
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_5: Like this. A few kisses here... Mwah, mwah... And another kiss there... Mwwaaah!
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_9: Oh, I'm sorry, I lost myself there for a moment...
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_10: Don't be afraid. It's just... how I show my love for cats, that's all.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_13: Oh, really?! I was worried that I gave you a startle, hehe... From now on, you're welcome to visit and play with Lulu any time you want! You can give me some kisses if you want. Here! He likes you.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_14: Now, thank you so much for helping me find Lulu! I should have you and Lulu join in marriage!
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_12: I see... I can see where you're coming from.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_1: Strange. Where did he run off to...?
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_3: I'm looking for my cat Lulu. He likes to wander off a lot, but usually not very far away.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_4: I need to head out to the city to stock up on some supplies, but I'm worried about leaving him out there.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_5: Oh. Where are my manners? I'm Xiaoju, the owner of this here restaurant.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_6: Are you here for a bite to eat? Sorry, but we're not open for the day yet.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_9: Oh, you mean it? That's great!
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_7: How about I go look for Lulu while you're gone?
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_8: I just saw Lulu not long ago.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_11: I'll bring him back for you.
Side_DSDPJ_9_1:
Applicant: Duying
Request: Replacement of the upper garment
Reason: While rescuing a researcher kidnapped by the Exiles, the upper garment was pierced through by bullets.
Side_DSDPJ_9_2:
Applicant: Kelin
Request: Replacement of the hat
Reason: Accidentally offended Gray Crested Gulls and therefore received their gifts dropping from the sky all the time.
Side_DSDPJ_9_3: Looks like Wujing is going to face some challenges too...
Side_DSDPJ_9_4:
Applicant: Wuheng
Request: Replacement of the boots
Reason: Carrying heavy loads led to severe wear on the heels, causing frequent falls.
Side_DSDPJ_9_5: The description seems to align with the shoe print characteristics near the supply box. Just to be sure, go and confirm with the individual involved.
Side_DSDPJ_8_2: Sorry, but I'm in the middle of counting the newly arrived field uniforms.
Side_DSDPJ_8_4: Indeed. The soldiers' field uniforms are regularly replaced. Some time ago, we collected applications for new uniforms, and some of the reasons on the applications were really... amusing.
Side_DSDPJ_8_5: There are reasons like pants torn by the fangs of a Sabyr Boar or a hat stolen by the Hoochiefs in the Dim Forest...
Side_DSDPJ_8_6: I've placed all those application forms on the table in the corner. If you're interested, you can take a look there.
Side_DSDPJ_8_8: Mingyi left for another business for a little while, and during that time, I helped in counting the inventory.
Side_DSDPJ_8_9: Another team member, Wuheng, was responsible for loading and unloading the supplies outside the warehouse on her own. I didn't notice anything unusual in the warehouse.
Side_DSDPJ_8_1: There's something I want to ask you.
Side_DSDPJ_8_3: Did they come with yesterday's supplies?
Side_DSDPJ_8_10: Maybe the application forms can be a breakthrough.
Side_DSDPJ_7_1: Rover? Did Captain Beiwang send you over?
Side_DSDPJ_7_2: I reported the missing supplies. I stepped away for a moment during the stocking, and it happened.
Side_DSDPJ_7_5: I asked Tianlang to take over for me when I stepped away.
Side_DSDPJ_7_6: Tianlang and Duying can both vouch for me! I have an alibi!
Side_DSDPJ_7_8: There was a package for Duying in the supplies, so... so I just happened to take it to him.
Side_DSDPJ_7_9: I had no other suspicious intentions! I promise!
Side_DSDPJ_7_3: Did you leave for a moment?
Side_DSDPJ_6_3: Someone spilled the food along the way. The Gray Crested Gulls smelled it and came in swarms. I can't drive them away!
Side_DSDPJ_6_4: It took me great effort to clean it up here. Look at what these birds did to me!
Side_DSDPJ_6_6: Well, in that case, you should look for Mingyi. She's the one responsible for the storage area in the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_6_7: Usually, Mingyi handles checking the inventory and stocking supplies, while Tianlang and Wuheng take care of loading and unloading supplies.
Side_DSDPJ_6_8: Oh, you reminded me. I'll need to go ask Mingyi. I'll find out who did this!
Side_DSDPJ_5_1: The supply box of Lollo Logistics. The moment it's opened, a pungent fragrance swarms out, but the box is disappointedly empty.
Side_DSDPJ_5_2: At the box's bottom, a faint sheen of oil lingers. The delightful scent... can't be mistaken! It's Panhua's Restaurant's Poached Chicken.
Side_DSDPJ_5_3: The more you inhale, the hungrier you become. It's probably wise to leave this spot promptly. Perhaps a chat with the nearby Midnight Rangers could shed light on any observations they've made.
Side_DSDPJ_4_1: Heavy footsteps. The pace isn't far, as if the person was hauling something weighty.
Side_DSDPJ_4_2: The shoe prints at the heels show numerous cracks, signaling significant wear and tear at the back of the shoes. It suggests the person walked with a backward-leaning posture.
Side_DSDPJ_3_1: No one entered or left the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_3_2: Maybe I should brace myself for the worst. If that's the case, the thief could only be someone from within the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_3_3: While you were looking into the entry and exit records, I took the chance to review the surveillance footage from when the supplies were loaded and unloaded.
Side_DSDPJ_3_4: Mingyi, Tianlang, and Wuheng were present throughout the entire process of loading, unloading, and stocking supplies. You might want to start with them to see if you can uncover any useful clues.
Side_DSDPJ_3_5: Oh, by the way, the unloading area is a blind spot in the surveillance. Rover, you might discover some hidden clues there. I'm counting on you!
Side_DSDPJ_2_1: Hi, Rover! What can I do for you?
Side_DSDPJ_2_3: Oh, you want to look into the entry and exit records, huh?
Side_DSDPJ_2_4: Even though I just started this post this morning, I can check the duty log for you. It has all personnel entry and exit records. Just give me a moment.
Side_DSDPJ_2_6: Other than the Lollo Logistics delivery folks, there aren't any other entry and exit records.
Side_DSDPJ_2_9: General Jiyan asked all members of the Midnight Rangers to assist you in any way possible.
Side_DSDPJ_2_10: So, whatever your reason is, I'm glad I can help you.
Side_DSDPJ_2_8: Aren't you curious about why there's an investigation going on?
Side_DSDPJ_13_1: Rover, thank you for your help.
Side_DSDPJ_13_3: She left her hometown at a young age and has been stationed at the camp for years. No one ever taught her how to handle mistakes, which is why she dealt with them in such a straightforward way.
Side_DSDPJ_13_4: As a soldier, she left her post without permission, trying to solve a problem that was beyond her ability. She should have placed more trust in her comrades. There's still much for her to learn.
Side_DSDPJ_13_5: As for those spilled dishes, I'll let Wuheng make up for it by cooking them for us.
Side_DSDPJ_13_6: Rover, when I return to Jinzhou, let's meet again at Panhua's Restaurant!
Side_DSDPJ_11_2: Well, I also have a preliminary speculation. Rover, who do you think took away the supplies?
Side_DSDPJ_11_6: It's a bit different from what I expected. Maybe it's someone else.
Side_DSDPJ_11_7: It's a bit different from what I expected. Maybe it's someone else.
Side_DSDPJ_11_8: Seems like we're on the same page. Let's go talk to Wuheng.
Side_DSDPJ_10_2: What… what can I do for you?
Side_DSDPJ_10_4: Ugh, I went back to Jinzhou not long ago. I accidentally splashed some on while eating at Panhua's Restaurant.
Side_DSDPJ_10_3: The oil stains on your clothes…
Side_DSDPJ_1_1: Rover? What a pleasant surprise. I've heard a lot about you!
Side_DSDPJ_1_2: I'm Beigu, the captain of the camp. Currently caught up in an investigation regarding a theft case.
Side_DSDPJ_1_4: Lollo Logistics regularly delivers supplies to the camp, covering all our needs. When they unloaded the supplies, the quantities matched our order perfectly.
Side_DSDPJ_1_5: However, during the nightly inventory check, a team member responsible for counting noticed one box missing, though it was not something important.
Side_DSDPJ_1_7: You're right. It's packed with everyone's favorite hometown dishes.
Side_DSDPJ_1_8: To treat the soldiers here,  I secretly asked Panhua to prepare a batch of pre-made dishes—
Side_DSDPJ_1_11: My apologies. It's been a while since I last visited Jinzhou. I miss the hometown dishes so much.
Side_DSDPJ_1_12: Anyway, I hope you can keep our conversation between us. Unfortunately, I can't conduct the investigation myself.
Side_DSDPJ_1_13: For the soldiers here, trust is often more valuable than their lives. It's built through shared experiences and overcoming challenges together. I don't want this incident to sow even the smallest seed of doubt.
Side_DSDPJ_1_16: As a token of gratitude, I'll treat you to a feast at Panhua's Restaurant.
Side_DSDPJ_1_18: Without further ado, you can start by checking the guard post. Investigate the entry and exit records from yesterday afternoon until now.
Side_DSDPJ_1_6: But we still need to figure out where it went.
Side_DSDPJ_1_14: So you want me to find out the truth for you?
Flow_135000000_210: So, I wanted to go back to Jinzhou to replace those spilled dishes, and you caught me before I could leave.
Flow_135000000_211: I put the remaining dishes in the refrigerator, right at the bottom of the reservoir! I didn't eat them alone! Please believe me!
Flow_135000000_212: (Tell Beigu the information you found from the application form)
Flow_135000000_213: Okay, I see. Rover, could you do me a favor and grab the refrigerator? I need to have a few words with Wuheng.
Flow_11000006_32: I don't recall Liondance Troupe putting on a show for a while. What a pity...
Flow_11000006_36: You want to see the Liondance Troupe's performance?
Flow_11000006_37: Sure! But perhaps it's better that you don't run around or make a lot of noise.
Flow_11000006_39: Yes, yes! Do you also like the Liondance Troupe?
Flow_11000006_40: My wish is that, one day, I can just get off work, stroll into this theater, and kick back and watch a performance by the Liondance Troupe without disruptions.
Flow_11000006_41: That would be great! But I have to finish my work first, everyone is still waiting for me!
Flow_11000006_43: The last show by Lingyang of the Liondance Troupe was spectacular!
Flow_11000006_45: The last show by Lingyang of the Liondance Troupe was spectacular!
Flow_11000006_49: Sure! But perhaps it's better that you don't run around or make a lot of noise.
Flow_11000006_50: Yes, yes! Did you also watch Lingyang's performance?
Flow_11000006_51: It seems that I've been working overtime a lot recently and our captain granted me a day off to watch the show!
Flow_11000006_53: I can still see Lingyang landing on the highest pole without a flinch or stagger right before my eyes.
Flow_11000006_54: Please do not run around or make a lot of noise here.
Huanglong_main_1_6_9_11: ...Makes sense that he'd refuse to let his troops retreat.
Huanglong_main_1_6_8_11: Anyone, even someone like me, would've probably given a similar order in that situation.
Huanglong_main_1_6_7_14: We still wanted to win, to eliminate that dreadful monster once and for all, but... we became more cautious.
Huanglong_main_1_6_6_36: People only showed their respect to Madam Jinhsi because they trusted Jué's judgment...
Huanglong_main_1_6_6_37: Uh, what is that saying again? Real gold never loses its shine!
Huanglong_main_1_6_55_55: They were likely studying an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", but later got denounced from the CSC due to their extreme methods.
Huanglong_main_1_6_55_56: And we've seen what that ended up with. It turned into a monster driven by the frequencies of "hunger," devouring everything in its path.
Huanglong_main_1_6_55_57: And, I suspect, the Fractsidus Overseer mentioned in that log may have something to do with it all.
Huanglong_main_1_6_55_58: This Blake Bloom is a product of that overflowing energy on the island.
Huanglong_main_1_6_54_11: Most of the researchers were driven by their obsessions. Some wanted to relive a particular experience, while others yearned to reunite with their loved ones...
Huanglong_main_1_6_4_21: ...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.
Huanglong_main_1_6_33_26: What really put them on the map isn't that; it's all the bizarre experiments they did.
Huanglong_main_1_6_33_27: We've set up Resonance Beacons worldwide to monitor the Lament, collecting data in real-time. This is how we predict when the next Lament is happening.
Huanglong_main_1_6_33_28: That's why we've been sent here, to investigate the case.
Huanglong_main_1_6_24_29: Ugh, you know! You saw her earlier! It's that girl!
Huanglong_main_1_6_23_16: Chixia did say she found someone suspicious... Look, it's him.
Flow_31000124_458: It's okay! I've marked potential hiding spots on the map. Can you go check them out?
Flow_106000000_938: The noxious fog stifled your breath. You struggled to breathe as poisonous spores clogged your airways. You narrowly escaped, before darkness consumed your vision.
GuideTutorialPage_301401_Content: Resonators gain Concerto Energy when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat. Switch Resonators when the Concerto Energy is full to consume all Concerto Energy and trigger the exiting Resonator's Outro Skill, and at the same time trigger the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.
Text_EditFormationSkill_Text: When <color=#ffd12f>Concerto Energy</color> is full, switch characters to trigger <color=#ffd12f>Outro Skills</color> that provide various buffs and effects.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_3: But... the rain's getting heavier. Should we take shelter for the time being?
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_4: One of our combat medics claims it's no ordinary downpour, and he strongly advises holding off any moves until it clears.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_5: Though young, his sharp intuition has been proven in previous battles. You've seen it firsthand.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_6: However... I do agree this will be our last chance at organizing another attack.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_7: ...The medic you mentioned. What is his name?
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_13: The rain just happened out of nowhere. It's indeed unusual. But...
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_15: The enemy we've been yearning to destroy is finally right before us.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_16: And now you're asking me to sit back and do nothing because of some Phantoms?
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_18: Silence... Is this your response? Or is it fear holding your tongue?
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_19: Ah... I see. You’re no different. We fear, we bleed, we suffer, and in the end, we'll all die on the battlefield.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_20: But what about your brethren, friends and comrades? As you witness them viciously slain before your eyes, one by one...
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_22: There is no other choice. We must trample the pile of corpses at our feet and push on. Keep barking orders, keep fighting until every last one of those monsters is gone.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_23: The Retroact Rain merely creates illusions of past events. My soldiers will not succumb to those hallucinations. I will not allow it.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_26: We'll crush anything in our path, no questions asked.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_27: If tens, hundreds, thousands more of my men will die… So be it. We will win this battle, by any means necessary.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_28: Jiyan, I have a question for you... What would you have done on that day, if you were in my position?
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_29: Whatever you say... I'll never answer those brave souls with such silence and cowardice.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_30: And I will pave the way for us all with my Forte.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_21: Will you still remain silent when their souls demand an answer?
Huanglong_main_1_7_7_3: Droplets of water can be seen on it. Are these the tears of this mighty weapon?
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_4: General, the Retroact Rain's effects are subsiding. We are observing a sharp decline in the number of Tacet Discords in the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_5: The Disruptor is fully charged and ready to fire. But...
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_6: It takes a lot of energy to fire the Disruptor. If we missed...
Huanglong_main_1_7_46_13: ...Yes, we will win. Please... rest in peace.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_10: One of our top priorities now is to protect the Disruptor from Tacet Discord attacks.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_11: It's a powerful anti-Threnodian weapon from when Jinzhou was founded. We need it to break through this barrier.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_12: I'll leave it to the professional to explain the details.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_29: Creating such a powerful weapon with limited technology back then… whoever did it was truly a genius, I must say.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_30: If we were to unleash its full power on Jinzhou city, it might launch the entire place into the air.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_32: No matter how fast I build it... Jinzhou won't be able to hold out that long.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_37: The Disruptor has been surrounded by the Tacet Discords, with more of them slowly closing in.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_38: After we recapture the nearby emplacement, it will take some more time for the Disruptor to recharge. You may need to hold out a little longer.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_39: I'll send you the coordinates of the Disruptor and its backup energy port. We wish you the best of luck.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_41: Rover, Yangyang, please go secure the Disruptor and fix its backup energy outlet.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_42: Jianxin, please stay and guard the base. I’ll draw those Tacet Discords away.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_21: Can we blow up the Threnodian with this?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_22: Why is it still powered by pre-Lament energy?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_23: Can you make some more Disruptors?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_1: Good. Are we all clear on what to do?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_4: Our next move is to reclaim the Disruptor and break through the Groundwave Barrier.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_8: Rover, do you see that iridescent veil?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_9: That's the Groundwave Barrier. Ovathrax set it up to absorb weapon frequencies in the Norfall Barrens without interruption.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_14: How's the preparation going on your side?
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_15: We've got good news and bad news. Good news is, we've established connection to the Disruptor and we're ready to go.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_16: Bad news is, the Disruptor’s electric capacitor is damaged.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_17: Simply put, it’s out of power.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_18: Fortunately, there should be a backup power outlet.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_19: To use the Disruptor, we'll have to repair that outlet first, then wait for a full charge.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_25: In theory, we could. In practice, it's difficult.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_26: First, it could dodge our attack. Not even a perfect hit can kill it. It will be gravely injured, but not dead.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_27: Threnodians have been proven to be way stronger than we imagined. Our Disruptor can't handle the Ovathrax, but it can certainly break through that Barrier.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_28: That's because this ancient Disruptor dates back at least to the founding of Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_33: Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_35: Rover, I am currently monitoring the Tacet Discord attacks from the Academy to design a safer route for you.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_36: We just received word from our soldiers at the emplacement. A large number of Tacet Discords are targeting the Disruptor, and our troops are doing their best to defend it.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_3: Master Jianxin? Didn't know I'd be seeing you here...
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_4: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_6: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping...
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_7: Master once told me life and death should follow a natural course. The heavens and the earth form a vast chamber, where spirits freely depart and return.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_8: Countless brave souls have been trapped here by the evil powers of Ovathrax. I want to help set them free.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_11: Our main goal is to contain the reviving Threnodian, but we must beware of the Tacet Discords too. They have shown unpredictability in every past battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_12: The Academy determined they were not native to the Norfall Barrens, and instead had been conjured by a mysterious power.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_14: After analyzing their behavior, I believe the source of said power is none other than that statue.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_15: While the Ovathrax is still weakened, we must seize the opportunity to act.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_16: With looming danger from the continued onsets of TD Outbreaks, and many of our units injured and unable to fight, it is crucial to plan our attack wisely.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_17: Please, join me in mapping out the strategic plans.
Huanglong_main_1_7_41_1: Ovathrax's towering statue, built from repurposed weapons and debris, has long loomed over Jinzhou as a foreboding symbol of our ongoing struggle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_41_2: We managed to gravely injure it three years ago, making the statue sink into the water. And now, it just resurfaced... Our enemy must be eager to strike.
Huanglong_main_1_7_41_3: The Vanguard Base is right up ahead. Let's hurry over.
Huanglong_main_1_7_39_1: I've taken care of all the Tacet Discords nearby on my way here. The path ahead should be relatively safe now.
Huanglong_main_1_7_39_2: Keep going, and we'll reach the base soon.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_3: The Thundering Mephis is a blend of countless fallen soldiers' Reverberations.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_4: As long as more soldiers are still dying here, it will always return. Not to mention…
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_5: Countless souls of our brave soldiers remain trapped in this rain, to this day.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_13: Yes, allow me to introduce myself. I am Jiyan, the current General of the Midnight Rangers.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_14: Is that so? You're a mysterious individual with vast experience. If we had crossed paths before, I wouldn't be surprised.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_15: The Phantoms are mere replicas of the past. Since this is our first time meeting, I wouldn't recognize you if I was one of them. But I do wish we could've met sooner, Rover.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_16: Madam Magistrate and Taoqi have informed me of your willingness to assist us. Thank you for lending us a hand.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_17: I should properly welcome you with Huanglong's formalities, but as the current situation forbids that, I'll brief you on our plans as fast as possible.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_19: I've heard about your deeds from Madam Magistrate. You are a trustworthy ally according to her.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_20: Here. It's the Retroact Rain antidote, developed by the Academy.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_21: While the antidote cannot shield you from its effects entirely, it should at least lessen the hallucinations.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_23: For someone to show up as a "Phantom" in the Retroact Rain, two conditions must be met:
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_24: Prior exposure to the rain, and a deep connection to the affected area.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_25: You were found in the Gorges of Spirits only recently, and this is your first time setting foot in Jinzhou, ruling out that possibility.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_26: Moreover... you possess a similar ability with the legendary hero who once absorbed a Threnodian. Jué prophesied about your arrival.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_27: I was told you'd come to the Norfall Barrens one day... To reclaim your lost power from Ovathrax.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_28: I'll do everything in my power to help you make that happen.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_31: Yes. Madam Magistrate might not be aware of this, as it happened before she was appointed.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_32: On the day I was selected to be the next General, Jué told me this...
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_33: "Beneath the full moon, guide the returning one to confront Threnodian. From the threat itself, {Male=he;Female=she} shall reclaim the power to conquer it."
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_35: And if you are indeed the "returning one" mentioned here, we may actually get rid of that monster once and for all.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_36: You might have noticed something off about that moon. We call it the "Void Plenilune".
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_37: Once it fully takes shape... Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War, would be reawakening soon.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_38: It is an ancient terror that reigns over our land, capable of devouring weapon frequencies to enhance itself.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_43: Any suggestions for music at my funeral?

HelpText_41_Content:
[Equip Echoes]
Equip Echo to gain attributes, Echo Skills, and specific bonuses.
Drag and drop for faster equipping.

[COST]
The number of Echoes you can equip is limited by the total COST. The COST of equipped Echoes cannot exceed your current COST limit. 
Collect Echoes of new types to upgrade your Data Bank level and increase the COST limit.

[Echo Skills]
The Echo assembled in the main Echo position (first position) can activate the corresponding Echo skills. Switch the "Summary" button to view the detailed and brief descriptions of Echo skills.
When Echo skills are in use, the corresponding main Echo cannot be replaced or unloaded temporarily.

[Sonata Effects]
Every Echo comes with its own "Sonata." When the number of Echo assembled with the same Sonata reaches 2 or 5, the corresponding Sonata Effect can be activated.
Multiple Echo with the same Sonata and the same name equipped will only count towards the Sonata Effect once.
Echo with the same name may carry different Sonata due to data differences.
HelpText_42_Content:
[Echo Enhancement]

Enhancement boosts an Echo's Mainstat. Improvement in Mainstat is guaranteed, and not randomized.
Echo Enhancement also adds new Substat slots every 5 levels. 
The maximum level of enhancement varies for different rarity Echoes.

[Echo Tuning]

By Tuning an Echo, you can unlock the new random Substats to release its full potential. Keep in mind that once Tuned, the slot cannot be used again. 
(Echoes with the lowest rarity may not be able to be Tuned due to data interference.)

Broken Radio: (Radio Static)
Robotic Voice: Systems Activating... Performing Onboard Analysis... Alert: Leg Components, Not Found. Main Motor Module, Malfunctioning... Requesting Shutdown...
Annoyed Voice: Dang it, still not working. HQ, this is Rabbit 2, over. Rabbit 2 to HQ, do you copy? Over...
—
Annoyed Voice: Rabbit 2 here, I've attempted multiple radio contacts with HQ and received zero response so far... All I can hear out here is Blu checking itself over and over again, and... the wind.
Exhausted Voice: After fighting those TDs for so many years, I never expected to get stuck in this kind of place... Now Blu's busted, can't stand up or walk, let alone carry me back...
Exhausted Voice: Home... It's been a while since I last went home. I hope my family's still doing okay... It's raining, and the rain won't even give me an answer.
Exhausted Voice: Those Exiles, heh, they don't give a darn where your home is. All they care about is how to intercept your comms and steal your motor and power unit when you're least suspecting...
Exhausted Voice: Best of all, I've been looking for Blu's legs all over the place, and turns out they were snatched by Excarats... Haha...
Exhausted Voice: You can't run away from bad luck, I guess. Blu, run another check.
Robotic Voice: Systems Activating... Performing Onboard Analysis... Alert: Leg Components, Not Found. Main Motor Unit, Malfunctioning... Requesting Shutdown...
Exhausted Voice: Don't you fall asleep on me just yet, old pal. You're the only chat buddy I have right now.
Exhausted Voice: ... *sigh* Time to go find that motor of yours. You stay awake no matter what, all right?
—
Rover: Excarats traces. I should follow it. And those Exiles must have their communication device around the camp. Should as well check it out.

POIXLXJQR_1_16: Static. That's all you hear until the radio grows completely silent.

Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_2: You look like you're interested in our training. I’m training a footwork unique to Liondance—the backflip!
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_3: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Xiuyi, a Liondancer at Liondance Troupe! I'm a peer of Lingyang.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_6: Liondance is a dance style derived from martial arts. The postures and footworks often take root in traditional Huanglong martial arts, in which the backflip is an essential move.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_7: Most of the time we practice it on Plum Blossom Poles at Central Plains. While I was in Jinzhou and the space was limited, I set up a temporary platform for the practice. It attracted a great audience to my surprise.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_8: It has gradually become a major street recreation here, so I decided to open it to the public. Everyone can try to do the backflip, and I hope this boosts the popularity of Liondance.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_10: Imagine the platform before you is a Plum Blossom Pole, and underneath it is a rushing, freezing stream.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_11: Another lion confronts you, attempting to take your territory. Now, you have to drive it away, yet the space doesn't allow you to perform martial arts, so you have to depend on the footwork. After all, you don't want to soak your fur in the freezing water.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_12: What you do is you <color=yellow>leap high</color> and Dash without a direction while you're airborne to perform an excellent backflip, which will not only blow away your opponent, but land you steadily on the Pole in one fell swoop.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_13: To win my challenge, you have to successfully perform a number of backflips in a <color=yellow>limited time</color>. No "soaking", no help from any other items.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_14: You wanna give it a try?
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_18: Perfect for beginners. Great introductory practice for every Liondancer. Get some warm-up and we'll start right away.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_19: Looks like you've grasped something about the backflip. Brace yourself for a good challenge!
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_20: R, really? That’s courageous of you, just like a lion! Good luck, {PlayerName}.
Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_9: How should I do the backflip?
Flow_109000011_37: Give it a try if you're interested in lion dance!

Flow_311000002_1: Phew, all the goods have been delivered on time!
Flow_311000002_2: Just another day I live up to our slogan. "We always deliver," baby!
Flow_311000002_4: Every package, from sender to receiver, represents our client's deep trust in our service.
Flow_311000002_5: I put in 120% effort to ensure every package arrives on time and in perfect condition.
Flow_311000002_6: Ah, what a nice day. It's perfect for soaking up some sun!
Flow_311000002_10: You seem really dedicated to Lollo Logistics.
Flow_311000002_11: Hehe, of course. Being a courier is not just about delivering things, you know.
Flow_311000002_12: This one's headed for the Central Plains, and that one's off to Tiger's Maw Mine...
Flow_311000002_13: Sure. With transportation only continuing to improve, the orders at Lollo Logistics keep piling up.
Flow_311000002_14: Enough talking, I need to pick up the pace. I can't let Lollo Logistics' average drop!
Flow_311000002_18: Yeah, yeah, I'll get to it in a bit. Absolutely. You bet. No rush here. Why the worry, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} Not-My-Boss?
Flow_311000002_19: Peipei never seems to run out of energy... Hard to say what keeps her so busy.
Flow_311000002_22: Watching her go is exhausting. That's it, I definitely need a break now...
Flow_311000002_25: Not great weather today, better stay in and rest at the station.
Flow_311000002_26: Is it okay to slack off like this?
Flow_311000002_27: Slacking off? I'm not slacking off. I'm just conserving my energy.
Flow_311000002_28: Being a courier, I conserve energy to handle any surprises that might come up.
Flow_311000002_29: You think this cool composure is just for looks?
Flow_311000002_30: Done. This one's off. Onto the next...
Flow_311000002_32: Whew... Whew... At last, time for a little break.
Flow_311000002_33: Tiring, sure, but can't rest now... With so many paths blocked since the Lament, it's on us to get these deliveries through.
Flow_311000002_34: Is working as a courier really that tough?
Flow_311000002_35: It's tough, yet knowing that we, Lollo Logistics, are the lifeline after all other transportation is cut off really boosts my drive.
Flow_311000002_36: Eh? What? You're speaking to me?
Flow_311000002_37: Plea-Please don't talk to me. I-I'm working.
Flow_311000002_39: Huh? What happened to "We always deliver"? Why not accept my order?!
Flow_311000002_40: I heard stories of a city in the clouds, with buildings floating and connected by skywalks... I want them to express deliver me there!
Flow_311000002_42: Their ads claimed, "Where you desire, our packages never tire!" But I came all this way only for them to tell me they can't transport living people...
Flow_311000002_43: I just want to see it with my own eyes. What's so wrong with that?
Flow_311000002_44: Oh, the hamster at Lollo Logistics is so cute!
Flow_311000002_45: Excuse me, are you here to see the hamster too?
Flow_311000002_46: The little, chubby hamster icon is just too cute... and so is his suit... even the sound it makes in the wind is adorable... everything is just so cute!
Flow_311000002_47: They're not only cute, they're also really cool! Once, when Xuan Xuan ran into some trouble, it was someone in a hamster suit who saved her!
Flow_311000002_48: No matter how many times you see it, it's still... just... SO CUTE!
Flow_311000002_49: I know, I know! Papa told me that they give nice things to good kids.
Flow_311000002_52: People who wear hamster suits are always good people!
Flow_311000002_54: Besides... my daughter Xuan Xuan is watching me, so I can't slack off.
Flow_311000002_55: Yeah, that's their symbol, isn't it?
Flow_311000002_56: Do you think my papa could be one of those people in hamster suits, too?
Flow_311000002_58: He always brings me nice things every day.
Huanglong_main_1_yindao_9_3: As I make myself reflect on my goals and plans, those voices in the Streams become clearer and everything starts to make more sense.
Huanglong_main_1_yindao_9_4: Rover, perhaps you can give it a try?
Huanglong_main_1_yindao_8_1: The thorns are blocking our path. Weird. We'll have to clear them before we can reach the Beacon.
Huanglong_main_1_yindao_8_2: Please be careful, they look sharp. Maybe we can find something nearby to help us deal with them?
Huanglong_main_1_yindao_7_1: We Resonators can boost our combat abilities with special items. Our Echoes can use them too.

POI_HKSM_XZ_9_5: Oh, {PlayerName}. What brings you here? And Huaxi?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_22: Did Doctor Huayu send you as peacemakers? He knew my fight with Modee?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_6: What are you talking about, Uncle Lei'li? My brother asked me to work with {PlayerName} to reboot the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_8: Refinery Tower reboot? So you found Uncle Hong?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_9: You tell Lei'li about the journal and Uncle Hong's memories.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_13: So that's what it's about. I didn't know Uncle Hong could be so fragile. He's always so sound and capable.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_23: Though I work alongside him a lot, I can't tell that. Now give it to me, what help do you need?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_16: Yes, rebooting the Refinery Tower requires sufficient power. Uncle Lei'li, you know the best about the power equipment. What's your advice?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_17: Well, it's not as hard as you might imagine. We have a double circuit power system at the bottom of the Mine. Either one can sustain the normal function of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_18: However, they cannot run in parallel. Forcing them to run in parallel could result in the breakers all around the Mine to trip.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_19: What we can do is setting additional power from the outside and shutting down some devices from within, so we can focus the power on the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_20: Now, I'll shut down the necessary device, and you'll find the spare power around the bottom of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_21: Then you'll set them up at the base of the Refinery Tower. I'll let you know when everything's ready, okay?
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_25: Ha, nothing serious. I always have fights with Modee.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_26: I just don't like his attitude. He works with a fantasy on his mind.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_27: Bragging about his idea of coexistence with TD to people in and out of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_28: Saying that it's a crucial survival skill to coexist with novelty, and that we should give some thought about a life with TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_29: Some thought. Ha. It makes no sense keep thinking. I say he is a fantasist living in the ivory tower, not ready for the real struggles.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_30: And he becomes irritated whenever I say a few more words.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_31: Forget it. It's getting me furious again. Let's get back to the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_14: About the power supply of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_9_24: Can you tell me about that fight you mentioned?
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_3: Sigh. Running around without an aim only brings more trouble to the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_4: Though the Refinery Tower is offline, most of our production is still running as usual.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_5: To keep the production running, Lei'li, Modee, and others have to go back to their places.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_43: However, the Refinery Tower's issue must be addressed.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_7: Did you find anything around the transport lorries?
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_11: Maybe written by the miners. Though the Tiger's Maw Mine is not far from Jinzhou, they are constantly kept from going home due to the work.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_12: People who visit me out of sickness often talk about the pancakes their mothers make.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_15: Seems like a book popular with miners. It is only things like this that give life to the Tiger's Maw Mine, where there is nothing but buzzing machines.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_16: However, I don't think Uncle Hong can be a fan of rock and roll, given his poor hearing.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_18: A cover made of newspaper. I think I've seen this somewhere.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_21: If I'm not wrong, this is Uncle Hong's journal. He always takes it with him.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_44: This helps me make sense of things.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_22: As he ages, his memory starts to show deviations. He starts to forget things.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_45: It's like a rubber that keeps erasing his past.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_23: He asked me of methods to slow down the fading of memories. I taught him two day-to-day tricks as supports to the therapy.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_24: One is keywords, and the other is journaling.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_46: Keywords help him to find the general picture, while journals help him to correctly walk every step.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_27: Possible. If Uncle Hong follows my advice, he may be recording the important pieces of his days.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_48: If that's the case, something must be here that can help us fix the Refinery Tower. Let's read it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_49: Possible. If Uncle Hong is recording the important pieces of his days, he must have said something about the Refinery Tower. Let's read it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_50: That's right. If Uncle Hong is recording the important pieces of his days, he must have said something about the Refinery Tower. Let's read it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_28: Huayu and you read the journal.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_29: “Back at Jinzhou today with the transport truck. Everyone I met said I grew old and mean. So I looked in the mirror and found that few of my leaves are there...”
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_51: “Heavy rain today. Everyone got off work early. I don't know when this started but I grew more and more scared of the dark. Nights are getting long and dull...”
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_52: You can tell that the symptoms are getting serious for Uncle Hong in the journal.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_54: Maybe. You can sense that your functions are in recession, and that you are getting older. Let's keep on reading.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_30: “The issue detection and reboot of the Refinery Tower...”
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_31: Right. The picture and the text are both consistent with the real Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_39: If we follow the instuctions in the journal, maybe we'll be able to fix the issue of the Refinery Tower, but our manpower is just too limited...
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_41: Really? We don't have many people available for now, so it's only too great if you're willing to help. You might be unfamiliar with the Mine, though...
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_42: I've arranged a helping hand for you. You'll meet him by the Elevator.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_25: Can there be clues about Uncle Hong in the journal?
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_26: Can there be clues about the Refinery Tower in the journal?
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_47: Lost items are important traces of their original owners.
POI_HKSM_XZ_6_53: Is that how the world feels to an old man?
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_7: The entry is mostly about an argument with a researcher. No information about a passcode.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_20: So you've heard about it? Yes. Even if the probability is as small as 0.0001%, it still makes sense to me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_21: I heard from a co-worker about what you're up to, and I thought you might find difficulties in passing the verification, so I came.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_22: Looks like it's right on time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_24: A fight? The journal? Haha, may I see the journal myself?
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_25: Modee takes the journal and starts reading.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_26: Uncle Hong is a de facto teacher of mine, so I won't have fights like this with him.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_27: On the contrary, I respect him a lot, because he taught me one thing.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_28: There are not only cold hard figures in science, but also lively fantasies.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_29: For example, we often encounter the infinity symbol when doing research. To some scholars, the lazy eight symbol might look like radio waves crossing the space.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_30: And what does Lei'li do? He would always respond to me with “full of crap” and neglect all those less probable things.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_31: Is this what you call a researcher's sensitivity to digits?
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_10: The locking of the console will only delay the reboot of the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_14: This feels like what would happen between me and Lei'li, but that researcher isn't me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_8: Maybe we try this with brute force...
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_12: Just follow the steps to pass the verification of the console and everything should be fine. We meet again, {PlayerName}.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_32: Is this what you call a researcher's obstinacy?
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_32: The tall guy beside me is Lei'li, head of miners here. And this is Modee, an expert of minerals from the Academy.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_33: I heard of the sample appointment betweem the Mine and the Ministry a couple of days ago. Now, what should I call you?
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_35: Similar events happened before, but our on-site engineers were always quick to fix them and put us back on track.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_42: However, he got injured recently when carrying out maintenance works on other equipment, so he was transferred to Jinzhou for recovery.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_43: And Uncle Hong was due to take up the fixing job. He was responsible for the Refinery Tower back when he was young, so he's totally competent.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_38: When there were offline events, Uncle Hong was always there to troubleshoot and coordinate our forces to fix the problems.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_39: With his absence, the Mine is having all kinds of difficulties dealing with the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_40: I propose we all go back to our places and carry on with our jobs. The Mine has to keep functioning even with the Refinery Tower offline.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_41: He'll show once he gets his rest.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_44: Let me be of some help.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_30: Clues... The miners said they met Uncle Hong around the transport lorries. We are sending more people to look if he's there.
POI_HKSM_XZ_2_31: More people mean greater possibility. Thank you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_21: Now that this isn't a dream, then you are...

POI_HKSM_XZ_16_25: True. The real point of the story remains unstated. Plus there is a decent blank space.
POI_HKSM_XZ_11_3: One last step before ready. The switches to shut down the devices come in pairs. I might need you to switch down the other one simultaneously.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_17: This little bottle of samples is a result of multiple fussy processes.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_18: Luckily, our researchers have found a new direction after countless tries, that is liquefaction, which will allow us to look into some unknown natures of the mineral.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_19: The only problem is that the equipment in our labs cannot provide the condition for appropriate liquefaction. Carrying out the processing there will probably destroy the material's structure.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_20: But then, it came to our notice that the Tiger's Maw Mine, the mineral's origin, might possess the key methods and equipment.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_21: So we made an appointment with the Mine, that samples will be tried today, however an emergency meeting dragged our feet.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_23: No. We don't put off what can be done today. Things will only get trickier if we deal with it tomorrow.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_24: Could you send the samples to the Tiger's Maw Mine for me, if possible? Of course, the Ministry of Development will reward you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_25: No problem. Leave it to me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_26: Doesn't sound too much of a problem.
POI_HKSM_XZ_1_28: So I'll take that as a yes.

Flow_133000004_20: It, was so dreadful. I'll never come here again. So dreadful...
Flow_133000004_21: I, I was only trying to collect some s-s-soil samples. I, I never knew this could happen!
Flow_133000004_22: I, I only ha, ha, have a banana as a weapon. Don't, don't get any closer...
Flow_133000004_27: Why, why is my box broken?
InfoDisplay_11040120_Text: It seems like the Hoochiefs here have split into two groups, with the two leaders of the old and new factions fighting for control of this cave territory! The ones on the left are launching a fierce attack on the right! A successful uppercut, beautiful! Awesome! Now the gorilla on the right stumbled a bit, let's see... Great! Stability, stability! He regained his balance with a strong will! Great job! A sweeping kick...oh no, it failed! The opponent dodged it and the gorilla on the right fell to the ground instead. Ahh... Let's see what happens next...

Flow_114000002_276: What's in it for me if I help?

Flow_11000007_1: I wonder how Qingning is doing... When that girl is working, she doesn't even have time to eat.
Flow_11000007_2: Another batch of recruits left today, I hope everything goes smoothly for them on the front line...
Flow_11000007_3: I haven't had a good rest for a while... Oh well, let's just get through this period.
Flow_11000007_4: You are on military premises. So make sure you follow the rules, my friend.
Flow_11000007_6: Is there anything I can help with?
Flow_11000007_7: I see... If you're requesting a visit, please register here... and go through the security search. Hmm... You're all set. Please remember, "Keep quite while you're in the military facility."
Flow_11000007_8: Excuse me, are you the... Rover? The one who helped Jinyue find that "treasure" a while ago?
Flow_11000007_9: Jinyue told me everything. I'm so sorry for the troubles my younger brother has caused you.
Flow_11000007_10: Oh, allow me to apologize on his behalf. For you've helped out Jinyue, as his older brother, I should show my gratitude. Feel free to come to me if you have any difficulties in the future.
Flow_11000007_11: The numbers don't add up... Hmm, I should count again.
Flow_11000007_12: What an ingenious way to use this thing! Those years of service in logistics certainly taught you a few things... I'd take notes.
Flow_11000007_14: Forty-six... Forty-eight... Fifty... What's the matter? Are you looking for me?
Flow_11000007_15: Yes, the inventories won't do themselves.

Flow_311000003_257: Listen, the mourning of the planet before the apocalypse—
Flow_311000003_258: It's a broken symphony of sounds, the sighs of the tide, it's your, your...
Flow_311000003_259: Yes, yes! We'll cut it here. The energy is just right...
Flow_311000003_261: What? Oh, pfft, I couldn't be better! This is the end of my apocalypse, the beginning of a creative stretch of poems, and the embodiment of my love for literature!
Flow_311000003_262: Writer's block? Nonsense... Just put a period where you're stuck—
Flow_311000003_519: What should I write in the letter to Lianyue?
Flow_311000003_520: Yeah... I shouldn't have said that my work is about to be published. The editor rejected my poem again, and Lianyue asked me for the number of the issue where my work is published...
Flow_311000003_521: Well, I- I'll say that the editor wants me to write two more, and the whole collection will be published together!
Flow_311000003_522: But it's not good to keep going like this...
Flow_311000003_523: Well, I- I'll stick to this excuse- no- reason.
Flow_311000003_525: Children. One by one. Take your time. No need to rush.
Flow_311000003_282: Let's start with Xinxin. What does Xinxin want to show the teacher?
Flow_311000003_527: Good work, Xinxin. You always finish fast. I'll read them carefully.
Flow_311000003_528: What about Ling'er? How's her essay coming along? Xinxin said before that Ling'er liked being alone and didn't seem to talk to everyone.
Flow_311000003_529: Well. When it comes to Ling'er...
Flow_311000003_530: She doesn't like to talk and likes to keep things to herself. Her parents passed away while she was young and there's no one to take care of her.
Flow_311000003_531: Yuyi's used to worry for Ling'er the most. During the holidays, she always asked me about how's Ling'er doing in school and in life.
Flow_311000003_533: She said that she loved these children the most, and always worried about if they were healthy and getting the stuff they needed.
Flow_311000003_534: Alright, children, it's time for class. Please be quiet.
Flow_311000003_535: You may play all you want after class. But during class, please listen carefully.
Flow_311000003_536: If you ever catch yourself snoozing off. It's okay. You can stand up for a while to keep yourself awake. Learning requires patience. We can take it slow, okay?
Flow_311000003_537: Mr. Bosong! I finished my essay! I'm the first again!
Flow_311000003_538: Oh, these kids... I wonder what Yuyi would do if she were here...
Flow_311000003_597: Ah, you're still here. Yuyi... She's my lover...
Flow_311000003_598: Both she and I attended this school. After she had graduated, she became a teacher. She had always treated these students as her children.
Flow_311000003_599: She's a great teacher, but fate can be cruel... Now, I just want to fulfill her last wish and help these children grow up well.
Flow_311000003_601: Yay! I'm the first one to turn in my essay again! Now I'm the first place again!
Flow_311000003_602: This time I wrote an amazing adventure story. It's so interesting!
Flow_311000003_604: Do you want to read it as well? Come on, let's read it!
Flow_311000003_605: Hmm... Mr. Bosong always tells me to play with everyone more.
Flow_311000003_606: But I really like to play with Ms. Yuyi...
Flow_311000003_607: But I haven't seen Ms. Yuyi for a long time. I wonder how she's doing... Ms. Yuyi is a very good teacher.
Flow_311000003_608: Look, Mr. Bosong is over there. He always alone at night.
Flow_311000003_610: Though I'm used to this solitude, it feels different now.
Flow_311000003_611: Did we make him angry? But recently, Ling'er has been a good girl. Or is it because Ms. Yuyi hasn't come back yet?
Flow_311000003_612: But Mr. Bosong said that Ms. Yuyi had gone on an official trip.
Flow_311000003_613: Then Ms. Yuyi will come back in a while, right? Why is Mr. Bosong still sad?
Huanglong_main_1_7_91_1: "Stronger emotional connection to the affected area leads to more intense hallucinations"... That's what they said.
Huanglong_main_1_7_91_2: I should go for another round of inspection. Make sure everything is going as planned.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_2: Greetings. How are you feeling after the antidote?
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_3: I feel much better, but the Phantoms are still coming back from time to time...
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_4: Three years... It's been three years already.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_5: I was on the vanguard team during that battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_6: Memories of my teammates lost their minds fighting those Phantoms haunts me to this day...
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_7: Those Phantoms... Illusions of both soldiers and those monsters... They were not real, but somehow they could injure and kill us.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_8: We had to strike them down to survive.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_9: But then… Our dead comrades were coming back to life, ready to stab us behind our backs... It was chaos. We were terrified, couldn't tell friend from foe...
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_10: The Retroact Rain contains Remnant energy that can recreate past events and project them as Phantoms.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_11: Those Phantoms can transform into familiar people or objects by resonating with living humans in the rain, through their frequencies.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_12: During that battle, the rain's effect was further enhanced by the Threnodian's power.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_13: That was why the Phantoms gained physical forms, and why the rain could recreate very recent events, like bringing back soldiers dead minutes ago.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_14: Unaware of the mechanism behind it, we tried to eliminate all the Phantoms, and it only worsened the situation.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_15: Now we know the Phantoms are merely replicas of past events.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_16: While not a perfect solution, the antidote for Retroact Rain can lessen its effects and help us differentiate between reality and hallucinations.
Huanglong_main_1_7_7_7: Why am I seeing this here... Is it another illusion caused by the Retroact Rain?
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_1: The plan is simple. We will use the cliffs as a boundary to divide the battlefield into two.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_2: Our ranged units will secure the high ground while our ground forces charge through the narrow valley.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_3: Meanwhile, we will deploy Resonators to the Suspended Ruins, where most of the Tacet Discords are located.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_5: Squads two and three will flank while General Geshu leads Squad one to break their front line.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_4: Our goal is to shift from defense to offense and disrupt their strategies. Everything is at stake here.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_6: In a word, it's victory or death.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_7: Our strategic plan was crafted 3 years ago, taking into account the terrain in Norfall Barrens. Its value remains crucial today.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_8: But now, our enemies are even stronger than before.
Huanglong_main_1_7_6_9: There could be unknown risk factors… We must devise a new plan for the current situation.
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_1: This guy packs a serious punch. It's already so powerful in my hands when I'm just an ordinary person. Now, if I was a Resonator…
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_7: Careful. Tacetite weapons are not so safe to operate.
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_8: Rest assured. I’ll take out those monsters before it blows up in my face!
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_2: The Ministry of Development once designed a weapon for non-Resonator units to combat Tacet Discords…
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_3: As non-Resonators lacked the necessary <ano=special power>Forte</ano> to control the weapon, and prolonged exposure to Tacetite energy posed health risks, designers limited its output for safety reasons.
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_4: That's why the weapons couldn't operate at full power.
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_5: After taking over as General, I revamped the Midnight Ranger's recruitment tactics. Our primary combat units now consist of Resonators, with a significant decrease in non-Resonator members who have been reassigned to support roles.
Huanglong_main_1_7_5_6: I still remember the admirable courage in those ordinary people's eyes, as they volunteered to join the military… but I cannot let more unnecessary casualties happen.
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_20: May victory prevail the lasting night. I pray for your safe return.
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_21: Attention, all units. Do everything you can to assist. You are authorized to use the Disruptor!
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_40: I trust we all understand the situation now.
Huanglong_main_1_7_23_15: Please update me on the situation in Jinzhou city.
Huanglong_main_1_7_23_16: Under Madam Magistrate's command, the barrier has been activated and citizens are being evacuated to the safe zone.
Huanglong_main_1_7_23_19: Huaxu Academy and Ministry of Development are on standby for further instructions. Bazhi is overseeing operations at the Academy while Mortefi has arrived at the Ministry. Rest assured, we are all safe in the city.
Huanglong_main_1_7_23_20: And that Rover... {Male=He;Female=She} is heading over to meet you. Yangyang is coming with {Male=him;Female=her}.
Huanglong_main_1_7_23_21: I will go pick them up as soon as possible.
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_46: It seems the rain is not stopping anytime soon...
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_48: Rest assured. You can count on me!
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_53: Hehe, as you can see. Everyone's ready to defend our city.
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_55: I've informed General Jiyan that you're heading to his place. He will be meeting up with you soon.
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_56: May victory prevail the lasting night!
Huanglong_main_1_7_2_4: That day... As the rain fell, we watched in uncertainty, unsure whether it was a sign of hope or disaster.
Huanglong_main_1_7_2_5: The Retroact Rain should have been a harmless Waveworn Phenomenon.
Huanglong_main_1_7_2_8: However... The Threnodian's influence enhanced its effect, turning that battle into a brutal slaughter.
Huanglong_main_1_7_2_9: Our city cannot endure another tragedy like that...
Huanglong_main_1_7_19_53: I'll NEED to take a very long nap after this.
Huanglong_main_1_7_12_8: This wave of TD attacks should be over now.
Huanglong_main_1_7_12_9: We knew this was coming and we were ready, but oh boy, the amount of TDs is insane.
Huanglong_main_1_7_12_10: Thanks for coming in time, Rover. It would've taken us much longer to handle this.
Huanglong_main_1_7_12_11: Oh, Director Taoqi is here too. For a better run down of the situation, you can find her near the city gate!
Huanglong_main_1_7_1_4: We have five hundred remaining soldiers prepared and medically cleared for combat. After receiving the antidote for Retroact Rain, they have reported minimal hallucinations and no adverse effects.
Huanglong_main_1_7_1_5: However, a few veterans still reported sporadic sightings of Phantoms in the rain...
Huanglong_main_1_7_1_6: I see. Stay alert, we will continue as planned. Report any signs of potential TD Outbreaks immediately.
Huanglong_main_1_7_1_7: We march on to the Norfall Barrens as soon as the rain stops.
Flow_140000002_1149: Hang on! This wave of attack is almost over!
Flow_114000002_282: It's right here, please, help me take a photo.
Daliy_DYBL_9_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…
Daliy_DYBL_7_1: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Can you go up from here?
Daliy_DYBL_7_3: What? Don't play tricks on me. In my entire life, the two things I'm most proud of are…
Daliy_DYBL_7_6: How... how do you know so many details?
Daliy_DYBL_7_9: How do you know them? Did we really meet before?
Daliy_DYBL_7_11: Hold on... I could’ve sworn I don’t know you, but something about you feels so familiar… I just can't recall.
Daliy_DYBL_7_12: No wonder Santong kept nagging me to keep a diary and I got so annoyed, saying “What the use of keeping one?”
Daliy_DYBL_7_13: Whenever I shared a joke I learned with him, he laughed like he had to force it, as if he'd heard it many times before!
Daliy_DYBL_7_15: No, I can't go on like this. I need to cure my forgetfulness.
Daliy_DYBL_7_16: Nonetheless... These flowers for Shiying— I might need to ask you to deliver them for me.
Daliy_DYBL_7_7: I also know Qiu and The Lion are your comrades.
Daliy_DYBL_6_1: Hey, you're back so soon! Did you find my flowers? I need to send them to The Lion.
Daliy_DYBL_6_4: What's the matter? She didn't like them? That shouldn't be the case. All the flowers I picked were her favorites…
Daliy_DYBL_6_5: Well, I'll try something different next time. Anyway, thanks for your help!
Daliy_DYBL_6_6: Really? That's fantastic! Thanks for your trouble! Now I can stand guard in peace.
Daliy_DYBL_5_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…
Daliy_DYBL_4_1: Hello there, stranger. Nice to make your acquaintance. I can tell you're not from Jinzhou, are you?
Daliy_DYBL_4_2: I've been stationed in Jinzhou for a good while. Sometimes, I watch the passersby. Eventually, I can naturally tell who's a local and who isn't with just a glance!
Daliy_DYBL_4_4: Don't tease me. In my entire life, the two things I'm most proud of are landing every shot and never forgetting a face.
Daliy_DYBL_4_5: By the way, could you lend me a hand and deliver these flowers to someone? I can't leave my post right now. Just take them to The Lion from our regiment.
Daliy_DYBL_4_7: Oh, indeed. How did you know? I've already gathered the flowers, and all you need to do is take them to her.
Daliy_DYBL_4_8: Even though we called her The Lion back in the days on the battlefield, and she is still as brave and carefree as a boy, I know she loves these beautiful flowers.
Daliy_DYBL_4_9: Hm? Where are the flowers? I remember seeing them this morning!
Daliy_DYBL_3_1: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Could you do this old man a favor and check why General hasn't approved my return application?
Daliy_DYBL_3_3: Delivered what? Are you here to tell me the approval has gone through?!
Daliy_DYBL_3_4: When did you come back? How's everything going?
Daliy_DYBL_3_6: That's wonderful. I hope Qiu can sense how much I miss him.
Daliy_DYBL_2_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…
Daliy_DYBL_19_1: That's fast. Was your delivery smooth?
Daliy_DYBL_19_3: Great, thank you! When they smell this flower, they know they are still being missed.
Daliy_DYBL_18_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…
Daliy_DYBL_17_1: Rover, long time no see. Do you remember me?
Daliy_DYBL_17_3: Ugh, hahaha! Yes, I remember now.
Daliy_DYBL_17_4: Sorry, I caused you a lot of trouble before.
Daliy_DYBL_17_7: Y-yes, thank you for your help.
Daliy_DYBL_17_8: It's okay. I'm already familiar with it.
Daliy_DYBL_16_1: You're back so soon. It feels like you just left. Was your delivery smooth?
Daliy_DYBL_16_3: Great! Thank you! When they smell this flower, they know they are still being missed.
Daliy_DYBL_15_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…
Daliy_DYBL_14_1: Ah, there you are. It's been a long time since our paths crossed.
Daliy_DYBL_14_3: Of course! You're Lee from next to Santong's place, right? How could I forget you? Why are you here? On leave?
Daliy_DYBL_14_4: Hm? Wait a minute, no... Come closer. Let me take a good look.
Daliy_DYBL_14_5: Almost mistook you, sorry. Now I see clearly. You're Yao from the Ministry of Development.
Daliy_DYBL_14_6: Am I right? I didn't get your name wrong, did I?
Daliy_DYBL_14_10: Oh, so you're really Lee. Sorry, seems like my eyes are getting worse as well.
Daliy_DYBL_14_11: Since you're still around, can you do me a favor? Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me?
Daliy_DYBL_14_12: I knew it. I couldn't have mistaken you for someone else.
Daliy_DYBL_14_13: Why are you here? Are you here to maintain the front-line defenses again? You've been working hard to give us a peaceful life. Thank you.
Daliy_DYBL_14_14: If you happen to have spare time today, can you do me a favor? Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me?
Daliy_DYBL_14_15: Hm? None of them are correct? Rover… sounds familiar.
Daliy_DYBL_14_16: Well, what was I going to do?
Daliy_DYBL_14_17: Right! Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me? I want to give them to my comrades.
Daliy_DYBL_13_1: You're back so soon. It feels like you just left. Was your delivery smooth?
Daliy_DYBL_13_3: Fantastic. When he smells the fragrance of these flowers, he'll know I miss him.
Daliy_DYBL_13_4: Yuandong, you used to say our home is right beneath our feet. Now, this place has truly become the home for your family.
Daliy_DYBL_13_5: You can rest assured, guarding them here…
Daliy_DYBL_12_1: You put the flowers in front of the tombstone and inform Yuandong about his granddaughter...
Daliy_DYBL_11_1: Well, if it isn't Rover! Long time no see!
Daliy_DYBL_11_2: How do I know your name? That's strange. Sorry, young {Male=man;Female=lady}.
Daliy_DYBL_11_4: How did you know I was about to send flowers to my friends?
Daliy_DYBL_11_8: I wanted to head to the cemetery and give this bouquet to Yuandong. It was only when I got there that I realized civilians couldn't get access to the cemetery anymore.
Daliy_DYBL_11_10: Can you go there? It might be too much trouble for you.
Daliy_DYBL_11_13: Alright, thanks for your help. Can you pass a message to Yuandong?
Daliy_DYBL_11_14: Really? Did I trouble you before? Sorry, I'm getting forgetful...
Daliy_DYBL_11_15: Thanks for lending a hand. Can you pass a message to Yuandong?
Daliy_DYBL_11_16: His granddaughter has joined the Branch of Resonmedical Science at the Academy, so his unfulfilled wish is finally realized.
Daliy_DYBL_11_3: Do you need me to help you deliver those flowers?
Daliy_DYBL_11_12: I've done this for you before.
Daliy_DYBL_11_17: Sure, I'll pass on the message.
Daliy_DYBL_10_1: I can't leave you here alone. It's too dangerous. Please come back with me!
Daliy_DYBL_10_2: All my comrades are here. I'm not going anywhere!
Daliy_DYBL_10_5: Nice to meet you. I'm Santong, and this is my grandpa.
Daliy_DYBL_10_6: I asked my grandpa where he went every day, and he mentioned meeting up with his old friends.
Daliy_DYBL_10_7: Only now do I realize he's been coming here daily! I just wanted to convince him to return to Jinzhou, but he wouldn't listen. So frustrating!
Daliy_DYBL_10_8: I hope he hasn't caused you any trouble. I apologize on behalf of my grandpa.
Daliy_DYBL_10_11: Thank you so much. I'm trying to persuade him to go home and get proper treatment, hoping it will help him recover sooner.
Daliy_DYBL_10_12: Oh no, I'm really sorry! I'm trying to persuade him to go home and get proper treatment, hoping it will help him recover sooner.
Daliy_DYBL_10_15: Hey, young {Male=man;Female=lady}! Shiying must be happy to see someone visit him!
Daliy_DYBL_10_16: Grandpa, now that the flowers are delivered, how about we head back home?
Daliy_DYBL_10_17: No, I have to stay with them. I promised them, so I have to keep my word.
Daliy_DYBL_10_18: Stop being stubborn, grandpa! You’re trying to enter a military facility! You're no longer in service and you’re obstructing the military officers!
Daliy_DYBL_10_19: I did NOT obstruct anyone! I didn't even try breaking into it! I was just standing here! You kids... Can't you kids just let this old man have his peace?
Daliy_DYBL_10_20: I won't cause any trouble. I just want to spend a little more time with them.
Daliy_DYBL_10_21: We promised we'd always be friends and stick together, but they weren't as fortunate as me. Let me stay here and have a chat with them. Is that too much to ask?
Daliy_DYBL_10_24: Alright, as long as you're happy...
Daliy_DYBL_10_25: But, if you can't find your way home or cause any trouble for the soldiers or Patrollers, no matter what you say, I'll take you home, okay?
Daliy_DYBL_10_10: It's a bit of trouble, but it's fine.
Daliy_DYBL_1_1: Wonder why there's still no reply...
Daliy_DYBL_1_3: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Could you do this old man a favor and check why General hasn't approved my return application?
Daliy_DYBL_1_6: General promised to let me come back and visit my comrades.
Daliy_DYBL_1_7: Look, I brought a bunch of flowers for Qiu.
Daliy_DYBL_1_8: I've told them General has already given me permission, but they still won't let me through! Why won't they listen?
Daliy_DYBL_1_9: Young {Male=man;Female=lady}, could you kindly take these flowers to him for me?
Daliy_DYBL_1_10: If it weren't for them stopping me, I'd want to visit them in person and tell them I haven't forgotten about them.
Daliy_DYBL_1_12: That's great. Thank you so much.
Daliy_DYBL_1_11: I'll help you deliver these flowers.
