Flow_11000008_1: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Hello! Welcome to the Pioneer Association's Jinzhou Branch.
Flow_11000008_2: Of course. One moment please, we're connecting to your Terminal.
Flow_11000008_3: Me? I'm the receptionist here. My job is to help our members in Jinzhou, and bring in new ones when I can!
Flow_11000008_4: The Pioneer Association, formerly known as the "Post-Lament Geological Society", is dedicated to expanding humanity's knowledge of the world.
Flow_11000008_5: Do you know the adventure stories of the Icebreakers? They are legends in the history of the Pioneer Association, my idols!
Flow_11000008_6: On the polar regions, up the volcanoes, deep in great rifts, and across the wetlands... their footprints are spread across every corner of the world. This is what adventurers should be like.
Flow_11000008_9: As written on the front page of "Tidal Geography": Go see the world and witness history in the making.
Flow_11000008_10: Go see the masterpieces of humanity, paintings, architecture, and inventions, and find joy in the journey.
Flow_11000008_12: The seniors always tell me to wait a little longer. I guess it's because I don't have the Resonance Ability that they never took me on the expeditions.
Flow_11000008_13: I've tried every way, but I can't persuade him. What should I do... Rover, you came at the right time. Help me think of a solution.
Flow_11000008_14: It's about my junior, Zhuyi. He recently joined the Pioneer Association and is now working as an intern photographer.
Flow_11000008_15: According to the regulations, new members are required to participate in the regular "Fireside Chats" to share and learn the history and culture of the Pioneer Association.
Flow_11000008_16: To be honest, when I was young, I was just as hotheaded as him. Always at the forefront of the team.
Flow_11000008_17: Photography is like magic. Click. And you freeze a moment in time.
Flow_11000008_19: There has been an arms race of photography gadgets. But, at the end of the day– Isn't it down to who uses it? My only criterion for a gadget is that it does the job.
Flow_11000008_22: Hello! Are you also here to submit to "Tidal Geography" of the Pioneer Association?
Flow_11000008_25: Well... If you don't mind, could you take a look at the submission I prepared this time?
Flow_11000008_26: Thank you. The publisher started a new column called "Return to the Front Tide" in collaboration with big-shot photographers of the New Federation and the Pioneer Association. It's open for public submission regularly.
Flow_11000008_27: I started making submissions not long ago, and I don't know if everyone likes my photos.
Flow_11000008_28: There's no requirement for experience and themes, which means even a nobody photographer like me can take a shot.
Flow_11000008_29: I heard that the selected photos will be used for image reconstruction using AI to restore the scenes of the world before the Lament.

InfoDisplay_31000031_Text:
Welcome to the digital documentation of SR-461's classified manual. Only members of our top-secret organization have access to this interface, so if you're not one of us, scram before we track you down.

Now, for my fellow members, let's get down to business. As outlined in Article 1, it is crucial to differentiate between Suppressor 1 and Suppressor 2. Mixing them up could lead to disastrous consequences. We don't want that, do we?

Moving on to Article 2 - surprise, there are three suppressors in total! And they all need monthly check-ups and maintenance. Don't forget to download your keys from the main console before you head over to inspect and update their logs.

But hold your horses, folks. Before you start celebrating with sugary carbonated beverages, know that these activities will be recorded and could disqualify you from the end-of-the-month raffle event. Yes, even the daily intake of smelly rice noodles in the conference room is a no-go. No amount of aromatic reagents can cover up that stench.

And speaking of stench, let's talk about puns and dad jokes. We all love them (or pretend not to), but too much can be a nuisance for everyone else. That's why anyone caught making puns or cracking corny jokes will have to suffer through a week's worth as punishment. Just try not to repeat them — that's just unforgivable.

Lastly, remember that this manual can only be adjusted three times per quarter. Any additional changes will have to wait until the next quarter.

So there you have it, folks. The 21 articles carefully crafted by the brilliant minds of SR-461. Let's all abide by them and avoid any unpleasant consequences.
InfoDisplay_31000031_Title: "TOP SECRET - FOR YOUR EYES ONLY (DO NOT OPEN UNLESS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY)"
InfoDisplay_31000032_Text:
Entry No. 14
1. Status of suppression device: Reactivated. Functions, normal. Rate of fog suppression continues to decline.
2. Data analysis and additional notes: Recent suppression results, unsatisfactory. Assuming the effectiveness of the suppression device remains constant, I can only infer that the increase of energy intensity within the fog's source is present.
Test results have revealed that the fog carries energy of similar frequency, as detected in the mud-like substance found within the marsh. I can confirm with high confidence that these phenomena are derived from a unique and unified source in this area.
In addition, it has been observed that <color=Highlight>the Mourning Aix performed repeated entries into the fog carrying reactants of high energy intensity</color>. Followed by <color=Highlight>a plummet in the efficiency of the suppression device</color> after its departure. I believe that Mourning Aix correlates with the source.
However, I am puzzled to find that <color=Highlight>the Mourning Aix's vital signs</color> weakened each time it departed from the fog. Lacking data... Further observations needed.
Recorder: Shi'er, SR-461
InfoDisplay_31000033_Text:
Entry No. 18
1. Status of suppression device: Reactivated. Functions, overloading. Rate of fog suppression only at 34.265%.

2. Data analysis and additional notes: Recent suppression results, unsatisfactory. Suppression rate continues to decrease. If the power of the suppression device is not further amplified, it is only a matter of time before we lose suppression effectiveness and experience a further spread of the fog.

However, considering that the effectiveness of the suppression device has already received two increased adjustments, as well as the changing of the fog's intensity from weak to strong, further increase would only result... It feels as if the fog's source has engaged in a match of tug of war with us. 

No, this isn't possible. Judging from the frequency band drawn, there are no large life forms within the fog area, but... Is it really possible? Must a life form be identified by humans? We have been unsuccessful in making actual contact with the source of the fog up till this day, thus we cannot completely rule out the existence of human intelligence.

In addition, I have read Shi'er's log (not that I wanted to. It was only because he came looking for me), and I believe that additional manpower and equipment should be allocated to further survey the movements of the Mourning Aix.

I have not witnessed the creature's behaviors inside the fog area like Shi'er did, yet I have seen it perform frequent circles and landings within proximity of the deceased avian Tacet Discord. It still possesses longings for the avian Tacet Discord and has lost its sanity because of it.

Similarly, I still hold the speculation that avian Tacet Discord bears human emotions and human intelligence.

Normally, we would be led to believe that the harmony between the two Tacet Discord is nothing more than a simulation of some form of biological behavior. Yet I have witnessed... During the Tacet Discord Outbreak, one of the creatures dragged its dying partner to safety as it let out a mournful cry toward humans.

It gave a shrilling cry as it kneeled down seeking the humans for help. At that moment, I seemed to have seen its "soul", one that is no different from a human (I am aware that this is an emotional expression inappropriate to this recording, but I insisted on its inclusion.).

Recorder: Qiqi, SR-461
InfoDisplay_31000034_Text:
When we speak about the concept of "love", we often analyze it from a psychological perspective and conclude it is an emotional motivation. When analyzed from a biological perspective, it is due to the secretion of hormones. However, all are conducted from the perspective of human beings themselves, without any exception. The love between animals or other creatures, on the other hand, seems to be less complex and sophisticated, and more inclined to biological instinct, reproduction, companionship, and courtship, as they do not possess any form of human intelligence.
Now, what of those two Tacet Discords? As entities that carry information and embody energy, are they forbidden to garner the instinct to "love"? Do they sing and cry as the information they carry is love mimicked from humans? Or is it due to the self-consciousness that prompts such actions on their own from a certain cause?
We have no way of knowing for certain. But as you have found out yourself, the question returns to its roots: What is the true meaning of "love"?
From a researcher's point of view, I would perhaps say that "love" itself is merely unique information in the form of energy. An afterglow of the Big Bang. And we are all just carriers who are fortunate enough to carry it. It is just that different carriers produce varying interpretations, and the difference between us and the creatures in love lies precisely in ourselves.
Thus I will not be left in sorrow due to farewell, as I was able to convey this information owing to our meeting.
You have materialized the love inside my body, transforming me into a much-perfected individual.

Flow_11000006_517: I need to work my muscles more. I haven't stretched for a few days and I feel dead on my feet.
Flow_11000006_518: Shiyu... Well, she's a nice girl. Hard-working. But you can tell she's keeping a lot to herself.
Flow_11000006_519: The work is not easy recently... Hello, what can I do for you?
Flow_11000006_520: When Debiao was young, he loved to spar with people. Then, I don't know what had happened, he looked so depressed when I found him after I had returned from the army.
Flow_11000006_521: When you have time, train more, or find someone to spar with.
Flow_11000006_523: She's trying to look out for everyone, but it's not that easy.
Flow_11000006_524: You say she's into liondances now? Haha, it's good to have a new interest.
Flow_11000006_525: Next time when the Liondance Troupe has a performance, I'll give her a day off to watch it.
Flow_11000006_526: Those guys over there do it. But they haven't beaten me yet. So take your time.
Flow_11000006_529: But now he's more active, and he trains hard every day. He'll be able to beat me sooner or later.
Flow_11000006_530: He's still obsessed with challenging me to a duel. He's lost thirty times already...
Flow_11000006_531: But he almost got me this time. He's improving.
Flow_11000006_532: This kid, Debiao, he's lost forty times, but he still wants to fight me!
Flow_11000006_536: That's the spirit—refusing to give in. He just needs more training.
POI_YNAQGS_15_1: Every single day, it's been fog and nothing but fog... When is it ever going to end?
POI_YNAQGS_15_2: This weather pretty much sums up my life. No end in sight and no clear direction.
POI_YNAQGS_15_3: I think... this fog's got something to do with that Mourning Aix!
POI_YNAQGS_15_5: Every time the Aix flies into the fog, there's always thunder and lightning. My friends and I have all seen it...
Flow_310000003_661: Curses...! We took the same old verified path as before, and still we got attacked!
Flow_310000003_663: Stop your whining. With no end to this fog, those TDs have only gotten more ruthless.
Flow_310000003_664: Should I go gather some more Angelica and send them over? If we already have enough, we can just use it as our daily supply.
Flow_310000003_665: Hey, have you heard about the "phantoms"? All big, dark, and gloomy...
Flow_310000003_666: Cut that out, all right? And talk like a normal person... Who are you trying to scare?
Flow_310000003_667: Got you scared? I know you more than you think I do.
Flow_310000003_668: Tsk. I go out with the scavenging team all the time. I've even seen the Mourning Aix, what's a blob of shadow gonna do?
Flow_310000003_669: Okay, then we'll go check it out tomorrow night.
Flow_310000003_670: On second thought... Hasn't it been getting more dangerous out there lately?
Flow_310000003_671: Ooh, getting scared now are ya?
Flow_310000003_672: Laugh it up all you want. Me, scared? Let's go then, I'm not afraid of anything!

POI_HKSMCS_8_10: Rest assured. When I find the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics, I'll call you in for the treasure.
POI_HKSMCS_8_11: Just a little patience is all you need.
POI_HKSMCS_8_3: Oh, this puzzle records the challengers' ID. I just checked up from the backend.
POI_HKSMCS_8_5: If I wasn't so dying to enter the pit, I should sit right here and have a session with you about the design and solving of Magnetic Cube Mechanics.
POI_HKSMCS_8_6: Anyway, thank you for the help. I'll send you the reward. Take some rest.
POI_HKSMCS_8_9: When I find the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics, I'll call you in for the treasure.
POI_HKSMCS_5_2: A controller down there can move the obstacles. Use of them wisely.
POI_HKSMCS_28_3: Yes, we're both responsible for Magnetic Cube puzzles now.
POI_HKSMCS_28_4: Miss Qingshu always does things carefully, and her techniques are also great. Working beside her I feel I'm even more lively.
POI_HKSMCS_28_5: Why didn't I find these spotlights of hers before?
POI_HKSMCS_28_7: Hee hee, you're right. To be honest, this is thanks to you too. Not only did you help me find the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics, but you made me discover that I had long lost sight of.
POI_HKSMCS_28_8: Life is made of everything around you, not just work.
POI_HKSMCS_28_9: Maybe it's because I have found the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics and my life now is easy now that I say things that sound not so ambitious.
POI_HKSMCS_28_10: Didn't know that I could be a person to say such things... Anyway, thank you.
POI_HKSMCS_26_1: Mi'zhi, you're lucky to be alive thanks to Rover. Never take such risks again.
POI_HKSMCS_26_3: Miss Qingshu, I promise I won't do that again.
POI_HKSMCS_26_4: Because in my heart, there is something more important that Magnetic Cube Mechanics now...
POI_HKSMCS_26_6: I only knew what was truly meant for me after I nearly lost my life.
POI_HKSMCS_26_7: The pursue for Magnetic Cube Mechanics is endless, but I shouldn't lose sight of the people beside me for that.
POI_HKSMCS_26_8: You by my side, Miss Qingshu, and all these seemingly bland days. These are the real precious things. I learned that after I almost lost them.
POI_HKSMCS_25_1: It's all thanks to you that I could have reached the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics.
POI_HKSMCS_25_2: When that was discovered, all my pain was gone and all my worries fade away. I was so relieved it felt like I'm no longer sick. Thank you so much!
POI_HKSMCS_25_4: Oh yes, I should thank Qingshu. If it weren't her who was always updating the puzzles and trying to stop me from entering the pit, I wouldn't have studied it so hard and progressed so dramatically.
POI_HKSMCS_25_8: What, what should I see? Oh!
POI_HKSMCS_25_9: Yes... Got to thank Miss Qingshu.
POI_HKSMCS_25_10: I've been in my head too much and thinking about Magnetic Cube Mechanics. My messing around has caused Miss Qingshu and {PlayerName} trouble.
POI_HKSMCS_25_11: Now that I have developed such great Magnetic Cube Mechanics, I should stay put and refrain from causing trouble.
POI_HKSMCS_25_12: I have saved some money privately, originally for the purpose of Magnetic Cube Mechanics studying, but now that {PlayerName} has helped me find the ultimate Magnetic Cube Mechanics, you should have the money.
POI_HKSMCS_25_13: That's the treasure I talked about. I'll send you the coordinates. Don't forget to collect it.
POI_HKSMCS_25_14: And Miss Qingshu... What would you like? I don't know your favorites yet.
POI_HKSMCS_25_15: I don't need anything. Your health means more than anything.
POI_HKSMCS_25_17: Then, I'll make up for it when we work together later.
POI_HKSMCS_25_6: Can't you see other things than Magnetic Cube Mechanics?
POI_HKSMCS_24_2: The timeing, the steps. You made that exact and fitted. A textbook solving.
POI_HKSMCS_24_3: Right, why don't we just write that into a textbook? My Magnetic Cube Mechanics and your techniques.
POI_HKSMCS_24_4: Only now Magnetic Cube Mechanics reached the ultimate.
POI_HKSMCS_24_5: Only the Magnetic Cube Mechanics developed step by step by myself is so fulfilling.
POI_HKSMCS_23_1: The way you solved it... It amazed me still though I've watched this before.
POI_HKSMCS_22_1: Well done. Seems like you can use some more…

FavorStory_140501_Content: The girl lived in the mountains. She slept under the sky, rested on the earth, befriended green hills, and played with animals. Agile and free, she roamed the fields with her animal companions. As Shiling ventured into the forests, a strange noise caught his attention. He glanced over and saw a child among the branches, with pure eyes and an innocent demeanor. Such a rare, untainted soul, untouched by the world's corruption. Enthralled by her gaze, Shiling cautiously approached, but the girl retreated higher, wary of him. Shiling noticed her thin frame and ragged clothing, so he pulled out a piece of flatbread for her. She eagerly snatched it, shielding it with her body in a feral manner. Her behavior seemed undomesticated, as if she had forgotten her humanity. In response, Shiling placed another piece of flatbread next to hers. Should I bring this child with me and make her my apprentice? Sitting cross-legged next to her, Shiling pondered while watching her eat the flatbread. But we are currently short on funding... It may be difficult support another child, he thought. Ultimately, he decided to let the girl choose her own path. "Hey, kid, you see this path ahead? This is the only path up the mountain, where my sect is located. Our founder spent every effort to open it up back then. If you can catch up with me and climb to its top before sunset, I will make you my new apprentice. How about that?" Despite his offer, the girl continued to eat as she blinked at him nonchalantly, as if she didn't understand what he was saying at all. Having set his heart on the promise, Shiling stood up and started to climb up the mountain. He looked back now and then, hoping for a change of heart from the girl, but she remained rooted in place, fixated on her meal. Disappointed, Shiling resigned himself to leaving her behind and continued on towards the top. As he neared his sect atop the mountain, faint laughter drifted from near the hall gate. Approaching, he saw his students crouched, offering water to the girl he had just left behind. "Master, you're back. Look, this kid climbed up the mountain all by herself." "W-When did she arrive?" "I don't know. I have been here for a while, and she was here before I arrived." Without saying anything else, Shiling extended his hand to the still girl, who remained motionless, not understanding the meaning behind his gesture. Shiling took her hand and placed it firmly in his. He guided her up, and they walked side by side into the hall.
FavorStory_140502_Content:
The girl knows her life's purpose: to perfect one move at a time. All she wants is to master her martial arts, a feat that requires intense focus and dedication. It's a level of concentration that eludes most, but for her, it's the ultimate goal.

"Master Deqing, any other misses in my moves?"

"Three. Here, I'll show you once more. Do take note. You don't have to memorize everything right now, as long as you get it right in the end."

"Jianxin, it's already late. Practice tomorrow."

"I'll go back once I'm done with this! You should go rest, master!"

In the darkening practice ground, the girl tirelessly repeated her moves. From cautious to swift, she practiced until they became second nature.



The girl's pure heart guides her choices, free from fear and weakness. Her mind is simple, yet unwavering in its convictions.

"Jianxin, he's too strong. Let's run. We'll let him have those supplies."

Jianxin, however, prepared herself for a fight, "I'm not leaving. I know we're outmatched, but I want to give it a try."

"What? A try? This is no joke! We're leaving!"

"I'll try to take back our stuff without getting injured."

"Wait! Ugh... Here she goes again..."
FavorStory_140503_Content:
One day, on her way up the mountain to collect some bamboo, Jianxin encountered another Taoist on Qingyang Bridge. 

She didn't know this person or where he came from. 

However, Rongfu, the Taoist, upon seeing Jianxin, stopped in his tracks. 

"You have potential indeed, but you are not yet a human," he commented.

"Me? What do you mean? I am a human," Jianxin argued. 

"To love is human, yet you don't love," Rongfu stared into her eyes and said, "You are pure to the extreme, but still empty inside."

"I know how to love. I honor my Masters and follow etiquette. I revere the elders in my sect, always trying to assist them." 

"When I said 'love', I meant to help those in need and care for the suffering people in this troubled world," Rongfu explained. 

"Master Shiling once said something similar. But what good does it do?" Jianxin questioned.

"The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion. Tao cannot be attained solely through solitude or meditation. It is through real-life interactions with others that one can achieve both spiritual freedom and physical elevation. Seeking personal gain and lacking in meditation shows a misguided pursuit of Tao. Instead, seek insight into your path and strive for perfection in all aspects of life."

"Then how can I learn to love?" Jianxin asked.

"You have never left this mountain, have you?" Rongfu asked. 

"No," Jianxin replied. 

"Perhaps it wasn't time for you to leave. But now, the time has come. How can you truly attain Tao without truly experiencing the world?"

Rongfu sat beside Jianxin, and the two of them talked for a long time on the bridge about what it means to love people.





"Master Rongfu, long time no see!"

"Jianxin, since our paths have crossed again, why not join me in helping those in need?"

"Sure do!"
Hearing their heartfelt thanks and feeling the warm touch of their unfamiliar hands, Jianxin knew her actions had made a small impact. A smile lit up her face, replacing any previous confusion.
FavorStory_140504_Content:
"This is my final treat, Jianxin. You must provide for yourself and earn your own money for food from now on."

"But Master, I don't know how to read palms or divine fortunes."

"You don't have to make money by doing the typical Taoist stuff! You can do anything. You're a fast learner, and that's one of your strong suits."

Jianxin traveled the world, working hard and using her earnings to support herself and help others. She took on even the most insignificant tasks with diligence and determination, building a strong reputation for herself along the way.

"Hey Jianxin, tour customer flow has really improved because of you! By the way, could you share those dietary recipes? They've been a hit with customers and we can make them our signature dish. Here's your pay for the month, keep up the great work!"

"Of course! I'll write them down for you."

"Ever since you started working here, the shop has been so much cleaner. You're amazing! We're lucky to have you."

"I used some cleaning tricks I learned from my previous job. Would you like me to write those down, too?"

"By the way, did you know the last customer paid with a new invention from the Academy? A silver card!"

"A card? What card? How did he pay?"

"He just tapped it here, and boom—payment made."

"Hold on, that's not a real thing. He's trying to pull one over on you for a free meal."

"What? So that's not a new invention... I'll track him down and get the money back."

"Just be careful, don't hurt him too much! It's not worth it for me!"

"I won't go too far. Don't worry!"
FavorStory_140505_Content:
Jianxin's relentless pursuit of martial arts excellence drives his growth. Yet, pushing the limits of mind and body can be a daunting challenge. Enlightenment is a solitary journey. Answers must be found alone, with one's own hands and unique approach. No one can aid her in this pursuit.

"Listen to your heart and forge your own path. Life's lessons are more than chance encounters. Harness their power and let your soul flourish with wisdom." 

With Shiling's guidance, she embraced self-spiritual cultivation and let go of her past achievements. Taoism's natural principles taught her to appreciate and love the world around her, harnessing the emotions of others as her own strength. In a state of intense concentration, she relied on simple martial arts techniques to connect with the world around her. It was a near-madness state, but one that brought unity and harmony. Her fists and palms held the world and her ego, merging into one. Each punch carried compassion and benevolence, repeated three thousand times. Turbulent thoughts settled into a stronger spiritual power. 

She stood in the same place, mastering basic techniques three thousand times, regardless of the seasons. Sitting on the grass, she became one with nature. Breathing in harmony with the wind and feeling the vitality of the surrounding greenery, she entered a state of symbiosis. Mind, body, and environment merged into a natural flow, cultivating peace within.

When the mind is calm, the strength becomes gentle. When the strength is gentle, the essence becomes solid. When the essence is solid, the spirit becomes vigorous. 

Now, Jianxin's martial arts practice has evolved beyond physical boundaries, fueled by a strong inner power that is impervious to external influences. In her world, every moment is focused and intense, a reflection of the vibrant natural world. Her punches move at invisible speeds, harnessing the power of wind with gentle force. Through her softness, she conquers all obstacles with love and reverence for the world around her.

Flow_11000009_1: You know- if the Midnight Rangers protect the city from the outside, then we at the Defense Division support the city by maintaining its stability from the inside.
Flow_11000009_2: Everything you see, from the shield over our heads to the high-precision instruments deployed on every street, are the work of the people who came before us.
Flow_11000009_3: I wonder when I will be able to catch up with them, especially Senior Taoqi!
Flow_11000009_4: Although She has a nonchalant air around her like she's trying to slack off, she always notices the things that everyone else overlooks.
Flow_11000009_5: The question that's been troubling me all day is finally answered: the time when our brain is at peak activity is different for each individual.
Flow_11000009_6: Maybe there is some truth to it. My brain usually comes alive only after the sun sets.
Flow_11000009_8: Sometimes a complete new idea defense setup would just come to me after dark.
Flow_11000009_9: It's difficult to set up a defense that's watertight all around. I'm constantly put in a dilemma where I put heavy forces in one place and expose ourselves in another place.
Flow_11000009_10: Brother Bai, I'm back again. I have a new idea about the Tacetite weapons. You must hear me out this time.
Flow_11000009_11: You mentioned before that the Resonators can activate the energy in the Tacetite and convert it into a new form they can control.
Flow_11000009_12: That's why the Tacetite weapons are so compatible with the Resonators, even though all current Tacetite weapons use only a small chunk of Tacetite in the core module.
Flow_11000009_13: So, if we could process the Tacetite into raw materials for other components, the "Tacetite content" of the entire weapon would increase dramatically!
Flow_11000009_14: They say that a quantitative change can lead to a qualitative change. Maybe a weapon like this can deliver a fatal blow to the Tacet Discord.
Flow_11000009_15: A quantitative change leading to a qualitative change is not just about the quantity. Have you factored in the weight?
Flow_11000009_16: The weight distribution of the weapon will affect the accuracy, speed, and even the effective range of the attack.
Flow_11000009_19: The current designs have an even weight distribution compatible with most wielder's habits, which was approximated by the Ordnance Division through rounds of trials and modeling.
Flow_11000009_20: Ah, peace at last. Finally, I can have some time for me to think about the iteration of the Tacetite weapons.
Flow_11000009_21: The most important in research is to block out frequent external disruptions. As a rookie researcher, I had the opportunity to collaborate with Mortefi before.
Flow_11000009_22: He said that the research process is like playing a musical piece, the melody should be coherent and uninterrupted by any distractions from the audience.
Flow_11000009_23: Though the grand tower of Tacetite studies is almost established, there are still two clouds obscuring the sky above it.
Flow_11000009_24: Welcome to Wenshu Repair, we fix your broken things and broken backs. How may I be of help, sir?
Flow_11000009_25: The old neighbors around here consider me a "fix-it" guy when it comes to daily items. Although, I'm not sophisticated enough to repair high-end items.
Flow_11000009_26: As long as it's a day-to-day thing found around the house, I can always fix them when you come to me.
Flow_11000009_27: The elders are used to living in frugality and don't have a habit of throwing away things that are old or broken. That's why some out-dated electrical parts can only be found here.
Flow_11000009_28: Oh, you're speaking of Wenmo. He's my son. That boy always likes to be alone, tinkering with mechanical things.
Flow_11000009_29: He has been watching me repair these things since he was a child, and perhaps he has memorized the steps just by watching.
Flow_11000009_30: Sometimes, I have to read an instruction manual for some of the more complex items customers bring in, but he'd be able to understand and start dismantling the structure in a few minutes.
Flow_11000009_31: Once I caught him completely disassembling an item to its last gear. I panicked so hard as I thought there had been no way to restore it. But he put it back together in moments like it was brand new.
Flow_11000009_32: This repair shop has also been on this street for many years. Maybe it's eligible to be a AAAA tourist destination in Jinzhou in another few decades.
Flow_11000009_33: Well, I'm not ashamed to crack this to you: I opened this shop because I had no talents. My late grandfather was once a prominent craftsman in the Ministry of Development.
Flow_11000009_34: I didn't match his talents and had to live under his halo as the grandson of the celebrity craftsman.
Flow_11000009_36: A top-heavy structure. Will it be more solid?
Flow_11000009_37: That thing is too high. I can't see the design of the other side. Oh how I wish to grow taller.
Flow_11000009_38: Wow, a device I've never seen before, what would happen if I disassembled it?
Flow_11000009_45: {Male=Big brother;Female=Big sister}, are you also interested in these tall protective walls and mechanical devices?
Flow_11000009_48: I am too, but I am too short. I can't see some things clearly, so I can only come here every day.
Flow_11000009_49: I remember their shapes and structures little by little, {Male=Big brother;Female=Big sister}, you can also tell me what you know.
Flow_11000009_50: {Male=Big brother;Female=Big sister}, you are here again, shh... wait a moment.
Flow_11000009_51: I'm at a crucial step in the disassembly, if I messed up the order, it can never be restored.
HelpText_44_Content:
[Event Update: Phantasm Amass]
New Resonators available: Camellya, Lumi, Youhu, Shorekeeper, Encore, Verina, Calcharo, Lingyang, and Mortefi.
Exclusive level boosts will be available in Thought Evolution. Activate corresponding bonuses to increase all Resonators' levels in the Illusive Realm.

Explore all-new scenes and face off against new enemies! Step into the ever-shifting dreamscapes and uncover the secrets that lie within!

[Exploration]
Embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm and choose your Resonator from a diverse pool including Rover: Spectro, Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi, Taoqi, Jiyan, Yinlin, Jianxin, Sanhua, Jinhsi, Changli, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Yuanwu, Danjin, Camellya, Lumi, Youhu, Shorekeeper, Encore, Verina, Calcharo, Lingyang, and Mortefi.
The Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators may be carried over in the event but the Echo Skills and Stats will be ineffective.
Utilize powerful boosts such as Illusive Echoes, Metaphor, Character Enhancement, and Token to defeat challenging enemy combinations.
Collect Metaphors to unlock unique skills of the Illusive Echoes for the Resonators.
With higher levels of difficulty, each playthrough offers new challenges and rewards. As you progress through the levels, higher difficulties and better rewards become available in the Illusive Store.

Symphony Rank is activated during battle.
All combat actions will progressively raise your Symphony Rank, while being attacked will significantly lower it.
During battles, if you do not achieve a Symphony Rank within a specified period, your Symphony Rank will decrease over time.

Symphony Rank is categorized into 6 tiers: D, C, B, A, S, and SS. If you achieve Rank A or higher, you'll obtain special buffs.
Rank A: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 100%.
Rank S: After performing a Dodge Counter, the Cooldown of all skills is reduced by 30%.
Rank SS: Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG are increased by 100%, and your Symphony Rank will not drop below SS for a brief time.

[Thought Evolution]
By successfully navigating through Illusive Realm, you can earn valuable Memory Points. These points can then be used in Thought Evolution to unlock powerful enhancements, ultimately making the Resonator a force to be reckoned with in the Illusive Realm.

[Anomaly Investigation]
Complete the exploration under designated conditions to unlock exclusive achievements and rewards.

[Illusive Store]
Complete the exploration of the Illusive Realm to earn Illusive Specimens and exchange them for exclusive rewards in the Illusive Store.
Illusive Specimens will expire at the end of each event period, so don't forget to use them in time.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the dream mass found at the deepest parts of the realm. Use Reward Attempts to collect its rewards.
Remnant Crystal Reward Attempts reset every Monday at 04:00 A.M. server time.
The Remnant Crystal grants equal rewards across all Phantasm Amass difficulties.

HelpText_46_Content:
[About]
Shui is actively seeking new members for the prestigious Overdash Club. If you're interested, go have a friendly conversation with him to learn more.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest: Chapter 1 Act 2.

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to challenge several Tactical Hologram: Overdash Tracks. You can fast-travel to any available track to start the challenge.
2. After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time and try to collect as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
3. There are various modules available in Tactical Hologram: Overdash. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to mind the traps at the same time.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_1: We should be safe here. Thank you for saving me and escorting me all this way.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_3: By the way, I was so nervous that I forgot to ask your name.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_6: Thank you so much, Rover. If it wasn't for you coming at the time, I can't even imagine how miserable my fate would have been.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_7: Thank you so much, {PlayerName}. If it wasn't for you coming at the time, I can't even imagine how miserable my fate would have been.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_8: I don't have anything to repay you at the moment, so I'll tell you where Haixing's treasure cave is at and the password to it!
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_9: I already know their password when I went there last time. I'll mark the location for you. If you're brave, go and take a look at it as soon as you can. You might even find some decent treasure!
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_10: I have to get going, I've wasted too much time already. I wonder how progress have been over at the Desorock Highland.
Side_LFZYDSPH_42_11: Well, this is where we say goodbye. You've accompanied me far enough. Farewell!
Side_LFZYDSPH_41_1: Are you the only one they sent to come rescue me? Do you know how to fight? Can you take on three or four camps worth of Exiles on your own?
Side_LFZYDSPH_41_4: Great. I'll be counting on you!
Side_LFZYDSPH_41_5: Then you just need to cover me while I sneak into the camp for some materials, make some explosives!
Side_LFZYDSPH_41_2: I'm the best there is. No need to worry!
Side_LFZYDSPH_41_3: I not too sure about that last part.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_1: Goodness gracious, someone's finally here to save me!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_2: You must've gotten my distress signal.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_4: I dug a small hole and stuffed a note through the back!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_5: I'd tap out the passcode on the wall every midnight!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_6: And today, I even managed to hold off their guard exchange for a full five minutes!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_7: Which clue did you get to find me?!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_10: Yes! I won't just sit here to rot!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_13: Enough talk. We have to leave. There's too many Exiles around. They'll find us if we don't.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_15: Ugh, don't even get me started. I was originally tasked with providing assistance in building fortifications over at the Desorock Highland, but those Exiles intercepted me on the way.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_16: They took notice of my clothing and asked if I was an engineer from the Ministry of Development. I replied yes, and they just grabbed me!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_17: I didn't get it at first. What's wrong with being an engineer? I didn't do anything to them.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_18: All I've heard was that some Exiles hate Jinzhou government employees, but I didn't expect myself to get caught in it this time.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_19: I've only been on the job for a few years, but I know that a colleague got hurt by some Exiles once.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_22: Ah! Yes! I was just getting to it.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_23: Then he was rescued by the Patroller, they caught the Exiles who kidnapped him, and after some questioning they found out that...
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_24: That the leader of the Exiles failed the exam for a position he was applying for for ten years straight, so out of fury he resorted to becoming an Exile, and gets mad at every government employee he sees.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_25: After I was kidnapped, their leader, Haixing, told me that she wanted me to help them repair a collapsed treasure cave.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_26: I pretended to comply at first, I even went to the cave to check on it, and then I stalled for as long as I could to wait for rescue.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_27: Maybe I stalled for too long or it's just my bad acting, anyway, they found out what I was planning, and that's when they showed their true colors! They even threatened my life!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_28: I'm not the kind of person you'd kidnap and still expect me to help you fix something. No way!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_29: Didn't their mothers teach them how to say "please" when they were young? Those little crooks!
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_31: There was no chance in hell I'd do as they say! And then... They stopped giving me food.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_33: Let's talk as we walk, we can't be just standing here, I don't want to get caught again.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_8: I heard you calling for help.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_9: That's a lot of work you did.
Side_LFZYDSPH_40_11: But I only heard your cry for help.
Side_LFZYDSPH_38_2: Patrol, patrol, nothing but patrol all day. This is so boring...
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_1: Hey, I saw our boss and Haixing on a secret date the other day.
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_3: You sure it was him? I thought Haixing was dating with that adjutant of hers?
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_4: No doubt about it. But I'm sure Boss isn't in it for the real.
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_5: There's something else that I found out.
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_7: The boss and Riloong are planning to take over their camps. I saw it in one of their private messages.
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_8: With our numbers...? Is he for real...?
Side_LFZYDSPH_37_9: What are you afraid of? We won't be part of the action. Our boss's really in it for Haixing's treasure.
Side_LFZYDSPH_35_1: Boss, this new weapon of yours looks really good on you! It gotta be worth a fortune?!
Side_LFZYDSPH_35_2: Hehe, I wouldn't go that far. It's just a small toy from Fiver.
Side_LFZYDSPH_35_3: That's our boss! Even Fiver's gotta show some respect in front of you!
Side_LFZYDSPH_35_4: Darn right. They'd already be at war if it weren't for us being here. We made work of the area's security and put a balance in between them. They can't live without us!
Side_LFZYDSPH_35_5: Yeah, Boss! We're sticking with you till the end!
Side_LFZYDSPH_1_1: Come on! What are you waiting for?! Punch him again!
Side_LFZYDSPH_1_3: What a swing, that's gotta hurt...
Side_LFZYDSPH_1_4: You call that a punch? Just give up already!
Side_LFZYDSPH_1_5: You two done yet? Get it over with.

InfoDisplay_11040128_Text:
Chapter 13: The Contract of Doom

The Magistrate's menacing gaze pierced through the trembling woman like a hot knife through butter. "Sign this here contract and you'll belong to me, my dear. And as long as you don't break any of the rules for the next three years, I'll make your ex-husband beg for mercy and pray for a swift death."

The woman crumbled to the ground in tears, her once glamorous face now stained with mascara. She clutched onto the papers like they were her last chance at redemption. In an ironic twist of fate, her former nemesis had become her savior. Her hair was no longer the envy of onlookers, but rather hung lifelessly around her face like a wilted flower. "Fine," she choked out, "but I have one condition."

The Magistrate leaned back with a smug smirk on his face. "Go on," he purred.

"That woman? She needs to disappear from this world," the woman demanded, a glint of revenge flashing in her eyes.

The Magistrate's brow furrowed in confusion as he watched her tears. "Sure, " he said quickly, lifting her up with one hand and causing her to stumble into his arms. As she struggled against him, the Magistrate's expression softened and a hint of amusement danced in his eyes.

"Don't touch me!"

"Ha! Don't flatter yourself, sweetie," the Magistrate chuckled. "I wouldn't touch you with a ten-foot pole."
Guide_SX_3_1: Now, if you have any other questions, please ask away.
Guide_SX_3_6: Haha, well... I’m afraid you should ask Patroller Chixia herself.
Guide_SX_3_7: Rover, you... Can we please not talk about this? My old name was cringy, that’s all…
Guide_SX_3_8: No, I don’t mean to hide anything from you...
Guide_SX_3_9: You see, “Ma Xiaofang” just sounds so lame. Heroes in the Hero Plays I watch never use any name like that.
Guide_SX_3_11: Yeah, I’m not quite a hero yet, but I’m giving it my all.
Guide_SX_3_14: Aww… Please, spare me that, Rover.
Guide_SX_3_15: Okay... Because we’re besties, I’ll give in a little. You can call me Ma Xiaofang when it’s just us, but please don’t do that when there’s other people.
Guide_SX_3_16: That’s right! Chixia, Chixia... oh, what a magnificent name! I came up with it all by myself. This is the culmination of all my life experiences and knowledge!
Guide_SX_3_17: Rover, feel free to call me by any name, but... Ahem, just so you know, that name is for our ears only, okay?
Guide_SX_3_18: Yeah, I wanna know too. You’re all about exploring the past, but people always say we should be looking ahead, so what’s the deal?
Guide_SX_3_19: Yeah, I wanna know too. Why are you so keen on collecting Sonance Caskets, Uncle Chenpi? Those… Fragments of past data, are they really that important?
Guide_SX_3_20: The past has influenced how things are today and will be in the future, as everything we see has changed a lot over many years.
Guide_SX_3_21: The seeds of yesterday give root to the flowers of tomorrow. In the absence of historical knowledge, how can we engage in discussions about the future?
Guide_SX_3_22: The past serves as a reminder of our origins, ensuring that we do not lose sight of our original intentions amidst the overwhelming current of history.
Guide_SX_3_23: Ah… I see. That sounds really cool. Thank you, Uncle Chenpi.
Guide_SX_3_25: Oh right. Uncle Chenpi’s the best treasure appraiser in town.
Guide_SX_3_26: I appreciate the compliment, Chixia. There are numerous talented individuals in Jinzhou, and I am far from being one of the best.
Guide_SX_3_27: If the art of appraising treasure piques your interest, it may be worthwhile to seek guidance from a young girl known as “Master Youhu” if you cross paths with her in the future.
Guide_SX_3_28: I am not nearly as skilled as her. Youngsters these days are seriously talented.
Guide_SX_3_29: Ugh, speaking of that, I haven’t seen Youhu for a while now. Hopefully she didn’t get into trouble again…
Guide_SX_3_30: If you ever find other Sonance Caskets, please consider selling them to me.
Guide_SX_3_31: Don’t worry, the pay will make it worth your while. I’m not stingy when it comes to money.
Guide_SX_3_3: (Ask him why he is collecting Sonance Caskets.)
Guide_SX_3_4: (Ask if he can teach you treasure appraisal.)
Guide_SX_3_10: So your dream is to become a hero.
Guide_SX_3_12: You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Ma Xiaofang.
Guide_SX_3_13: You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Chixia.
Guide_SX_2_1: Hello, Xiaofang. You seem to be in a hurry. What’s the matter today?
Guide_SX_2_2: Shh... Uncle Chenpi... Please don’t call me that, remember?
Guide_SX_2_3: Oops, my bad. I should call you Chixia, Patroller Chixia.
Guide_SX_2_4: So… This youngling here must be a friend of our great Patroller Chixia, yes?
Guide_SX_2_5: Uncle Chenpi, please stop teasing me.
Guide_SX_2_7: Uncle Chenpi, this is my friend Rover, hehe. I brought {Male=him;Female=her} here today for some help...
Guide_SX_2_9: Wow, this thing is really hard to find. I’ve been out in the wild searching for something like this...
Guide_SX_2_10: I’m so lucky to meet you today, Rover.
Guide_SX_2_12: It might look like a box, but it’s actually some kind of energy entity that doesn’t have a physical existence.
Guide_SX_2_13: On the other hand... One could consider it a box, in a way. The usual boxes contain physical items, but the Sonance Caskets contain records of the past.
Guide_SX_2_15: Well... my young friend, this is a data fragment that survived the collapse of a Sonoro Sphere. These Sonance Caskets, just like the Sonoro Spheres, hold onto sounds from bygone days.
Guide_SX_2_16: Within these Caskets, one can find the most treasured artifacts from the magnificent civilization that existed before the Lament, as well as the profound human emotions experienced during the catastrophe.
Guide_SX_2_17: Ah... They represent the final remnants of a bygone era, washed away by the relentless tide of history.
Guide_SX_2_18: I have a selfish request to make.
Guide_SX_2_19: Could you please let me have this Sonance Casket?
Guide_SX_2_22: Of course, I’ll give you something in return.
Guide_SX_2_23: To be frank, the Sonance Casket doesn’t hold any financial worth.
Guide_SX_2_24: Yet for those of us who are relic hunters, the information stored in these Sonance Caskets is highly coveted.
Guide_SX_2_25: I can pay you with Shell Credits, or other valuable items.
Guide_SX_2_26: Long story short, it’s a sweet deal for you. I’ll make sure you’re happy with what you get.
Guide_SX_2_27: Rover, you can trust Uncle Chenpi. He is a famous treasure appraiser in Jinzhou, definitely not a bad person who'd try to slip one past you.
Guide_SX_2_28: Besides, I, Chixia, am a Patroller. If he ever lies to you… Hmph, justice will punish him.
Guide_SX_2_29: Aww, Chixia... You know I’ll never do something like that…
Guide_SX_2_30: Just kidding, Uncle Chenpi! You’re so kind, no hard feelings, okay?
Guide_SX_2_31: It’s a deal, then. (Hand over the Sonance Casket)

Flow_11000010_2: Two thousand and ninety-eight, two thousand and ninety-nine... Hey, it's you, number three thousand! Congrats on being our three thousandth visitor to Jinzhou today!
Flow_11000010_3: Everyone's been saying, "Make the most of the land, and the people's wisdom will follow." Jinzhou's feats of construction have been the talk of the town!

Event_DRSL_1_8: Second Coming of Solaris... It's the fiction that everyone's talking about across Huanglong. It has been a bestseller for three weeks in a row!
Event_DRSL_1_9: Its author, Karl, is from the New Federation. It's his debut work and he's already been named one of the top-earning writers in recent years with this single book.
Event_DRSL_1_10: It rivets nearly all the attention of our editors from the headquarters.

Event_DRSL_1_19: The development is still at a very early stage. The basic framework is complete, but we're still working on the production of a huge body of art assets.

Event_DRSL_1_29: You don't need to worry about that. We have a deep budget for the game and you'll be well compensated for your efforts.

HelpText_48_Content:
[Data Bank Level]

More Echo data can help the Terminal improve its computational capabilities.
Rovers can unlock new Echoes to gain Data Bank EXP, improve Data Bank level, and receive corresponding rewards.
Unlocking higher quality of existing Echoes grants Data Bank EXP.
Unlocking new Echoes or higher quality of existing Echoes also grants Union Level EXP.

[Base Drop Rate]
When a Tacet Discord is beaten, there's a chance to retain and convert its lingering frequencies into an Echo. 
Upgrade the Data Bank to increase your chance of getting Echo drops .

[Enhanced Drop Rate]
Your Terminal can consume extra computational power to enhance its Echo absorption (for Overlord Class and Calamity Class) and increase your chances of getting Echo drops. It can perform up to a total of 15 enhanced absorptions, and then it will need time to recharge.
*Cooldown resets at server time 04:00 every Monday.

[Highest Drop Rarity]
Upgrade the Data Bank to increase your chance of getting Echoes of higher Rarity.

[COST Limit]
The total COST of equipped Echoes must not exceed your current COST Limit.
Upgrade the Data Bank to raise your COST Limit and equip more powerful Echoes.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_1: I have split all combat units into three factions:
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_2: The ranged units team will provide fire support from afar while the infantry team engages in close combat. Lastly...
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_3: We have the special task force of Rover, Yangyang, Jianxin, and me.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_4: Allow me to introduce Konglin, leader of the ranged units team.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_5: And this is Yuehui. He's in charge of the infantry team.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_6: This is a topographic map of the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_7: The Ovathrax's power limits our reach. Outrider scouts can't go beyond the Norfall Barrens and Valley junction.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_8: The deepest we ventured was three years ago, when we discovered the Suspended Ruins in its hinterland.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_9: But the terrain is treacherous; narrow and flanked by high cliffs on both sides, leaving only one path for our troops to travel.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_10: On the other hand, our enemies must take the same route if they want to attack us.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_11: With the Ovathrax reorganizing their frequencies and bringing them back, we will face endless waves of attacks.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_12: Every time we cut down an enemy, it gains more power.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_13: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford a prolonged battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_14: We must swiftly and safely get our strongest units in the heart of the battlefield, reach that statue, and take down Ovathrax in time.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_15: Rover, let's plan carefully and use each team's strengths to our advantage.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_20: First, our ranged units. Armed with long-range weapons, they can strike from a distance.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_21: But we need to strategize based on the terrain, topography, and enemy forces.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_22: If we manipulate the terrain to our advantage, their strikes will be more effective and cover a larger range.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_23: Where should we deploy the ranged units?
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_27: Deploying our ranged units high above the valleys in advance...
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_28: This way, they'll provide cover for our close-combat forces while staying safe themselves. We'll use their range advantage to the fullest. It's a smart move.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_29: (Our main battlefield will be at the valley's bottom, where space and vision are limited.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_30: (Placing ranged units behind infantry can slow their aim, making it counterproductive... This may not be the best strategy.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_31: (Mixing ranged and infantry units may seem versatile, but it wastes the advantage of ranged units... This may not be the best strategy.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_32: Next, the infantry. They have been trained and equipped for close combat.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_33: The heart of Norfall Valley is our main battleground, where we'll fight our enemies head-on. We need to plan our attack wisely.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_34: How should the infantry engage enemy targets?
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_38: Now that the narrow terrain has dictated an inevitable confrontation...
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_39: The infantry will attack head-on, breaking their line. Then our task force can strike where they're vulnerable... A reasonable choice.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_40: (We could divert some forces to flank the enemy, disrupting their formation and gaining an edge...)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_41: (However, a successful outflank requires a wide battlefield, but the small passage of Norfall Barrens limits our options for movement.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_42: (And we can't predict everything that will happen on the battlefield… Our diversion could leave our frontline vulnerable. It may not be the best strategy.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_43: (To infiltrate enemy lines, a small group of our forces will enter through gaps in their formation and attack from the rear.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_44: (This maneuver takes time and requires caution to avoid detection, particularly in a valley where evasion is difficult.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_45: (Small infiltration forces may stay hidden but risk being overwhelmed by enemy attacks. Alternatively, diverting forces could lead to losing on the main front.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_46: (We have little knowledge of what's happening behind enemy lines... Better not act rashly. This may not be the best strategy.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_47: Lastly, the special task force, all Resonators with powerful abilities. They have superior mobility and combat skills.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_48: If the chance arises, they will be responsible for taking down the Ovathrax.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_49: What should the special task force do?
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_53: We'll join our effort to break through their defenses and crush their source of power. This is the only way to completely rout the enemies.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_54: It's a risky but necessary move under our current circumstances.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_55: (Hmm... flank tactics aim to avoid direct confrontation and exploit enemy weaknesses to take them down slowly.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_56: (However, our combat power could be drained by the endless enemy assaults if we don't eliminate the Ovathrax in time.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_57: We can't afford to prolong engagement… There may be more effective tactics available.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_58: (We could split into two groups to cover each other during our mission. It could increase safety and efficiency.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_59: (But if we further split up our small team of four, we risk getting outmatched in extreme situations.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_60: (Also, finding cover for everyone may prove difficult during an intense fight.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_61: (Perhaps we should consider other options... There may be more effective tactics available.)
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_62: Thank you, Rover. The battle plan is clear.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_63: I will now recap our plan:
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_64: Konglin, your team will take the cliffs for fire support.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_65: Yuehui, your team will charge enemy lines to pave way for the special task force.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_67: And I'll join Rover, Yangyang, and Jianxin to create an opening for our main forces and take down the Threnodian.

Huanglong_main_1_7_43_26: Among infantry units, they will charge as one.

InfoDisplay_10900002_Text:
I. Objectives
1. Assess the feasibility of spore essence extraction.
2. Investigate the diverse effects of spores at different concentrations.
II. Materials
Hoochiefs, with one uncontaminated and one contaminated specimen per group; 1ml syringe, saline solution.
III. Procedure
1. Group two Hoochiefs with similar body weights, weigh them, and assign unique identifiers.
2. Extract spore essence from contaminated individuals, blend it with saline solution, and establish concentrations of 0.2%, 0.4%, and 0.8%, categorized by groups.
3. Administer various concentrations of the spore extracts to uncontaminated individuals, observe their activity, and record findings.
4. After completing the experiment, conduct statistical analysis on the results and formulate conclusions.
IV. Conclusions
1. The spore essence extraction process results in approximately 58% loss, but extraction remains viable.
2. The 0.4% concentration of the extract exhibits the optimal effect, although outcomes may differ based on subjects and necessitate further validation.

Note: Achieved interim success. Transitioning the experimental subjects to humans is authorized.

FavorGoods_110403_Content:
The mysterious Longevity Lock Lingyang was wearing when he first met the Liondance Troupe people. 
After arriving in Jinzhou, the Liondance Troupe traveled the streets and helped Lingyang find several merchants to talk to, trying to work out where the pendant came from, but to no avail. All they heard was, "It's an ancient design I've never seen before." 
Considering the vigorous movements of the liondance would inevitably cause damage to it, Lingyang chose to leave it in a wooden box for safekeeping. 
No matter who made it, the Longevity Lock holds the same good wishes for health and happiness. By sharing it with you, Lingyang is sending his sincere hopes for your well-being.
FavorGoods_130303_Content: An antiquated gauntlet, long since out of production. Its exterior shows clear signs of wear and tear from extensive use, with most of its interior components exposed. Yet it has been carefully cleaned and maintained, to the point that every line and crevice on the weapon is still starkly visible.
InfoDisplay_102801006_Text:
After my mentor passed away, I have been practicing swordsmanship on this mountain for twenty years. Cold or hot, rain or shine, I have been wielding my blade, hoping to one day reach the ultimate state of swordsmanship. During this time, I have defeated countless enemies with this Sword, including martial artists who held contempt for me like I held to them, and terrifying TDs that arose from nowhere. Every day, I had to endure endless battles and hatred.
I am convinced that this Sword is sharp enough to defeat enemies, but not possible to resolve the confusion in my heart... It seems that I need a new weapon. As for this Sword, I will leave it to someone destined for it.

Twenty years have passed, and I believe I have gained a deeper understanding of swordsmanship. I have abandoned the light, sharp Sword, and opted instead for this heavy Broadblade. It lacks the intensity and agility of Sword and even appears somewhat clumsy. However, these are merely prejudices born from a lack of insights into blades. Actually, the mix of impetus and inertia of Broadblade is like a dance, always catching my foes off guard. The seemingly plain and unadorned moves are, in essence, a product of exquisite control of strength.
However, as I gaze upon the Broadblade in my hand, I am acutely aware that neither it nor I can ever truly reach the pinnacle of perfection, and that I must continue my search... This blade, I shall leave it to someone more suited. 

Over the hasty course of twenty years, I have gradually come to understand the essence of swordsmanship. It is not about being confined to the form of the weapon in my hand, nor about the countless techniques I have spent my life mastering.
As long as there is a blade in my mind, any kind of weapon and technique can achieve the purpose of defeating the enemy.
Take this "blade" as an example. No matter how far the enemies may be, they cannot escape from its sharp edge. Besides, it is swifter than any technique! It can be said to be the epitome of a blade. Unfortunately, I realized this far too late. My aging body can no longer control it for much longer. Thus, I have hidden it somewhere in the depths of Port Town of Guixu. I hope someone flexible enough may find it.
As for myself, perhaps in the final stages of my life, I will take on a student and impart to him my lifelong understanding of the art of swordplay.

To remember where I buried them, <color=Highlight>I took three photos from this hilltop</color> — if there is truly someone destined, then perhaps they can make use of these photos to find these three knives that recorded my life.

A plate of Loong Buns made by Jinhsi herself, each adopting a pink hue and a sprinkling of osmanthus powdered sugar.
Each Loong Bun has a unique filling: custard, lotus seed paste, or sweet bean paste...
"Our honored guest awaits just beyond the threshold... I wonder which flavor will tick the box..."
FavorGoods_130402_Content: The Magistrate of Jinzhou is constantly overwhelmed with work. From military matters to city defense and civilian security issues, she must handle everything. The City Hall is always filled with pending documents, but they alone cannot aid her in making accurate judgments. Jinhsi prefers to be present and listen to the people's demands firsthand. To make this possible, she asked Xiangli Yao to create an electronic to-do list that she could access on-the-go, allowing her to review documents while attending to other tasks.
FavorGoods_130403_Content:
Jinhsi had frequent nightmares in her childhood. 
Once, she was drowning in her dream, caught in the surf and about to sink to the bottom of the ocean. A piece of driftwood floated by, and she clung to it, returning to shore against the tide. 
When she woke up, what she was holding in her hand was a piece of scale. If you look closely, you'll notice that the scale looks similar to the ones on the Sentinel's body...
FavorGoods_140501_Content: As a child, Jianxin was gifted a precious trinket by her master. It held a set of mirrors, with some missing pieces. Throughout her training, she used it to reflect on herself and her progress, understanding that self-cultivation and martial arts require patience and dedication. On her return to the sect, her master carefully replaced the missing mirrors. It was then that Jianxin saw her reflection in the completed piece—a symbol of all the teachings and growth she had experienced on her journey.
FavorGoods_140502_Content: Jianxin learned to collect all kinds of coupons the first time she followed her master down the mountains to live in the city. To her, it is not only a unique way to survive, but also a symbol of people's friendliness. "Exclusive dishes... FREE!" Jianxin didn't understand the deeper meaning of the businessman's use of font size to create a visual focal point, not to mention the staggering list of additional conditions that followed.
FavorGoods_140503_Content: The plant stood tall and strong, as if still swaying in the winds of its mountain home. Its very sight brought a refreshing sense of being atop the highest peaks. This particular species is on the brink of extinction, with only traces remaining in Jianxin's brief description. Even after thorough investigation, the Academy still could not pinpoint where she had found it. All that is known is that this rare plant was once in her possession. Some believe it holds mystical powers, while others see it as a symbol of resilience and survival.

InfoDisplay_11040129_Text: Jinzhou is a fortress city on the southeastern border of Huanglong. It is the first land-based port for all foreign ships entering the nation. Foreign personnel and goods must be inspected and offloaded at Port Gunchao. Port Gunchao features a well-established container management system, along with large-scale berthing facilities. It is a comprehensive main hub port and container trunk port with the highest throughput out of any port in Huanglong. Currently, Port Gunchao has reached long-term strategic partnerships with Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association. We welcome business cooperation of any form.    Office of Commerce, Port Gunchao

InfoDisplay_11040134_Text: "Field Investigation Notes of CSC Ruins - No. 13"  The mystery of the CSC's disappearance has not been solved by the re-investigation of the site. Documents of the site, transcripts of residents from surrounding areas, and the archives of the Huaxu Academy... All remain very few in quantity even combined. Some remarked that CSC paid the price for their arrogance, and others said that CSC led the way toward the future of mankind.  But what exactly did the most advanced research institute at the time intend to achieve when they left behind these perplexing facilities all across Jinzhou?  (No offense intended! Personally, I believe CSC's behavior of leaving equipment everywhere is not very environmentally friendly. I condemn them only from my personal point of view.)

InfoDisplay_11040136_Text: "Field Investigation Notes of CSC Ruins - No. 7"  A simple residential area, built with military facilities. Living conditions are poor. The surrounding environment remains harsh, with frequent fog weather, and moss and rust everywhere. The ruins have long been rummaged by the Exiles who are active nearby, leaving nothing behind.
InfoDisplay_11040137_Text: Hardness: 6 Density: 3.0-3.5 g/cm? Compressive Strength: 3000-5000 kg/cm? The specimen is named Moire Stone, characterized by its fine structure, high hardness, and strong compressive strength. It exhibits excellent chemical stability and can withstand extreme temperature variations. Moire Stones are widely distributed in the Gorges of Spirits, forming large-scale deposits that faciliate easy mining. Sizable blocks can be easily mined. All these factors make Moire Stones excellent construction materials suitable for large-scale sculptures, exterior walls of buildings, and hard paving. Note: It is used in the construction of Jinzhou and the creation of the Sentinel sculpture.
InfoDisplay_11040138_Text: Work Overview: The initial phase of mapping for the distribution of the Exploration Units has been completed, allowing for a preliminary determination of the orientation for constructing a new route leading to the inner Huanglong. While collecting image data, the survey team encountered a small-scale onslaught of the Tacet Discords. As the special operation forces of the Midnight Rangers provided timely support, only two team members sustained minor injuries. However, the exploration equipment suffered heavy damage. New equipment is scheduled to arrive one week from now. Until then, all exploration activites will be temporarily suspended.
InfoDisplay_11040138_Title: Work Report on Exploration Site Selection-Part One
InfoDisplay_11040139_Text:
Today, the captain had another discussion with me. He hoped that, as a technical backbone, I could provide a decisive opinion on whether the exploration work could still be completed as scheduled. Both he and I, and even everyone else, understand the importance of excavating the second long-distance transportation route. This route, starting from Jinzhou, passes through the Gorges of Spirits to connect the remaining areas in Huanglong. It is important for Jinzhou to have closer and more convenient interactions with other territories in Huanglong. To put it bluntly, in case there are issues with one transportation route in the future, we can still rely on the other, avoiding falling into a desperate situation.

Recent monitoring indicates the potential emergence of Tacet Fields around the Gorges of Spirits at any time, but we can't stop now as we have already come this far. If we stop now, all our hard-earned achievements will be in vain. However, if we don't stop, we may risk the lives of our team members.
InfoDisplay_11040139_Title: Work Report on Exploration Site Selection-Part Two

InfoDisplay_11040152_Text:
Position:
[Express Delivery Courier]

Requirements:
Age: No restrictions; candidates of all age groups are encouraged to apply.
Driving License: Must possess a valid driving license from any country.
Responsibilities: The ideal candidate will adhere to company standards, ensuring the safe, efficient, and accurate completion of daily collection and delivery tasks.

Work Location:
Candidates will be assigned to a nearby distribution point based on their preferences and the current availability at each distribution point.

Work Hours:
Duration: 9 hours per day, 5 days a week. Starting around 7 AM and concluding around 7PM, with approximately a 3-hour break at noon. 
Overtime: Any work beyond these specified hours will be considered overtime and compensated at double the standard rate.

Salary and Benefits:
1. Earn per package with unlimited potential earnings.
2. The company provides personal safety insurance, transportation vehicles, accommodation, and specialized collection and delivery skills training (including but not limited to hazardous material identification, harmless treatment of pollutants, first aid, etc.). The company issues corresponding professional qualification certificates upon completion;
3. Triple salary on holidays;
4. Free supply of work unifroms throughout the year;
5. Personal safety protection will be provided for collection and delivery in dangerous zones (including but not limited to material support, armed support, dedicated escorts, etc.), with all expenses covered by the company.

InfoDisplay_11040154_Text:
The Dim Forest is unquestionably the most significant treasure trove in the entire Huanglong region, boasting unparalleled species richness in the world.
Upon setting foot at the entrance of this gate, I could distinctly hear the plants whispering and their summons.
It is said that deep within the forest, the former site of the Department of Ecoacoustics holds image records of numerous plants, including a delectable species known as Ivory Banana, originating from the Dim Forest. Ivory Bananas were once a primary food source for Hoochiefs, and, in return, Hoochiefs exploring the forest in search of Ivory Bananas became excellent pollinators.
Since the spread of the toxic spore mist, wild Ivory Bananas have disappeared from the Dim Forest, and information about this species can now only be found in historical records.
The Lament might be an inevitable process of natural selection.
InfoDisplay_11040154_Title: Ecological Survey of the Dim Forest 1
InfoDisplay_11040155_Text:
Guided by the fluorescent plants, I discovered a large purple tree.
Considering its characteristic of resembling an entire forest on its own, I speculated that this tree is likely a sub-species of the Ficus genus. The mysterious purple color on its leaves remains unexplained and requires further research and verification.
Due to the season, I failed to collect samples of the flowers and fruits of this tree, and there were no traces of pollinating insects in the vicinity. Surprisingly, the Violuna Banyan hasn't been contaminated by the toxic spores. Many mysteries still surround it, waiting to be unveiled.
I am certain that this is the first time this tree species has been discovered, and I have temporarily named it the Violuna Banyan.
InfoDisplay_11040155_Title: Ecological Survey of the Dim Forest 2
InfoDisplay_11040156_Text:
After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.
InfoDisplay_11040156_Title: Ecological Survey of the Dim Forest 3
InfoDisplay_11040157_Text:
It's been a while since I had such an intense workout.

The contaminated Hoochief exhibited an astonishing lack of fatigue in their relentless pursuit of its prey—unfortunately, that prey was me. However, when escaping, I didn't feel panic and my brain started racing. I was well aware that the toxic spores are a direct consequence of the Waveworm Phenomenon. Based on the Ecoacoustics standards, how should we classify those contaminated Hoochiefs? Furthermore, how do those toxic spores contaminate Tacet Discords and is meditation a viable solution for Tacet Discords contamination?

Utilizing the Grapple function, I skillfully swung onto a hidden branch. The contaminated Hoochief lost track of its target and scanned around in confusion. It looked like a lost kid, whimpering and coughing, and it seemed to lose spatial perception. Each intense cough released a burst of toxic spores into the air. The spores, driven by their innate instinct to propagate, further pushed the already weakend body of the Hoochief to its utmost limit.

I started wondering: is it a form of co-evolution, or does it represent a parasitic relationship?
InfoDisplay_11040157_Title: Ecological Survey of the Dim Forest 4
InfoDisplay_11040158_Text:
The social behavior of Hoochiefs is even more astonishing than imagined, establishing them as the dominant species in the Dim Forest.

According to my survey, the toxic spore mist constantly spreads outward from the Central Banyan. To avoid the invasion of those spores, Hoochiefs disperse into different groups, seeking refuge in various safe zones, gradually forming communities characterized by "paternalism". The intelligence displayed by those Hoochiefs seem to be unique among Tacet Discords. Besides, near the Hoochief communities, sightings of activities from other Tacet Discords are notably scarce, which I attribute to a possible manifestation of "territorial consciousness". This consciousness prompts Hoochiefs to take different jobs and collaborate in repelling intruders from their territories.

What makes me even more curious is the response of a community if a Hoochief becomes contaminated. I am left wondering about the decisions such communities would make in such a scenario. Along the frequented path of the Feilian Beringal, I caught a glimpse of some grave-like mounds. Unfortunately, I didn't have the time to examine them carefully.
InfoDisplay_11040158_Title: Ecological Survey of the Dim Forest 5

The Feilian Beringal refused to leave the forest and lingered around the Central Banyan. While there are no apparent symptoms of parasitism, prolonged exposure to the high concentration of toxic spores has evidently affected its mental well-being.
