InfoDisplay_11040167_Text:
How long have we been sunken into the haze? A few seconds, or perhaps a few minutes? I have yet to recover from the ordeal; the hypothermia is still causing my entire body to tremble. I feel as if I have just been pulled out of a freezer, stiff and curled up. My ability to think has almost come to a standstill.
What was it? What did we go through? Where are we?
The miners taken away by the haze, where are they?
...
I will keep jotting things. It keeps my brain running. Until I figure this out.
InfoDisplay_11040167_Title: Logs of Hazy Depths Prospecting Team, I
InfoDisplay_11040168_Text:
Chisu left his backpack to me, and I knew he was prepared for a risky rescue. I was filled with fear, afraid that he might not return, and even more afraid that he might come back something else... Tacetite Weapon should never be used against comrades.
Especially the one he left me with.
InfoDisplay_11040168_Title: Logs of Hazy Depths Prospecting Team, II
InfoDisplay_11040169_Text:
Hmm... I believe that was Chisu's voice. He spoke calmly, just like he always did when comforting me, "It's alright"...
My mood unexpectedly calmed down with his voice, but my hands trembled uncontrollably.

The readings of the decibel counter remained unchanged. I knew it wasn't him. It was a shoddy trick of the TD.
InfoDisplay_11040169_Title: Logs of Hazy Depths Prospecting Team, III
InfoDisplay_11040170_Text:
Jack's mother asks Jack what job he would like to do. Jack says he wants be a miner.
Mother doesn't understand because Jack is not a hardworking boy. Jack says: "I can take everything 'mine when I'm a miner."

Comments in small fonts: Nice one. Be careful of the "hissers" underground though.
InfoDisplay_11040171_Text:
Tan: Are you really working the night shift at the mine?
Jing: I decided to find myself a means of livelihood before the water and food run out at home. Saves me from starving myself.
Jing: It wasn't as terrible as I had imagined, though. I kept staring at the "grand elevator" on that side, trying to kill time. It must have gone up and down at least fifty times this evening.
Tan: Isn't it too frequent?
Tan: Moreover, I heard that the mine has recently reduced the night shifts. So why is there still so much activity?
Jing: I don't know either. Let me check with my night-security-adapted Forte.
Jing: Something's definitely wrong...
Tan: What is it?
Jing: Nobody's in the elevator. I checked the platforms across the levels. No one's waiting... I have to go and check for myself.
Tan: Hey hey hey. Don't get ahead of yourself yet. If this was a movie, the thing waiting for you out there definitely would not be what you expected.
Jing: That's not true. I have to take care of more than my own safety, now that I'm in this job. Besides, you should start to be rational. Didn't you brag about being the new generation of Jinzhou? Why do you believe in this kind of thing more than those squares?
Jing: Maybe it's just mechanical malfunctioning, or my co-workers being naughty? The work here is so dull. Maybe they decided to "surprise" me a little?
Tan: Sentinel bless you. Good luck, then.

InfoDisplay_11040176_Text:
Who said music must be played by instrument?
During my time working in the mine, I kept hearing strange sounds. At first, I thought it was the rumored "sound" everyone talked about... But later on, I discovered that these strange sounds actually came from the minerals themselves, and even more astonishingly, they formed a unique tune!
The shape the Tacetite is cut into and the quality of the Tacetite both dictates how this tune goes.
I sorted through the recordings across the years and arranged them into a song, which is now known as "Tune of Rocks".
I don't feel quite vigorous lately... But fortunately the Pioneer Association Radio has received the mastertape of "Tune of Rocks". My wish has been fulfilled!

This cookbook is falling apart, I'd say we just leave it. -What would you know! Wherever this cookbook goes, there will be the taste of home. InfoDisplay_11040180_Text:
The ancient tree "Loong's Gaze", is located in the northern parts of Loong's Gaze Outskirts, Central Plains. Based on records found inside "Plants of Jinzhou", the Loong's Gaze is estimated to be between 1400 and 1500 years old, having withstood the test of the Lament and continues to stand tall. Its twisting roots are like a python wrapped around a loong banner, its branches as though piercing claws, both showing the tree's unrestrained nature. This unshakable ancient tree has long since become an icon of the land, as people seek to it as a beacon of hope. As long as the Loong's Gaze stands, the day of the Central Plains' rebirth will sure to come.

*Reminder: Please do not carve on the bark or branches of the tree. We all share an equal responsibility to safe keep the ancient tree's well-being.

InfoDisplay_11040183_Text:
~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.80, Standard Edition

*Event Guide* Bounds of Gathering
The very first Flower Tossing Festival in Xiehua Village ended in a success. Unlike previous years, we invited many of our friends from the army to participate and celebrate the victories of their battles on the front lines, as a way of saying thanks for their hard work.
Flower Tossing is a local custom of the residents of the Central Plains. In March, residents throw freshly-picked flowering branches or petals into running water, as a way of embracing the vitality of early spring within the pools of water. They pray that the joys of new life can flow into people's hearts, no longer confined by sorrows left by the destruction of the Lament.
In addition, there is a small pond near our station. All visiting guests who are interested can feel free to throw a handful of petals into the pond during a stroll after dinner time. It may not be as big as the Yuhua Lake of Qiqi Village in the past, but the hopes and joys are the same.


~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.100, Special Commemorative Edition

*Special Postscript* Final Farewell
Who would have thought, the Qingyan Courier Station has accompanied travelers of all walks for another two years, and our monthly read has now reached its 100th issue. At the end of this commemorative issue, we would like to bid farewell to each and all of you.
The Lament has completely changed the Central Plains. Frequent outbreaks of disasters have made management of the station more and more difficult. Under these circumstances, I regret to say that the Qingyan Courier Station can no longer live up to its name and provide guests with a truly safe and comfortable living experience.
However, Qingyan's farewell will not be as unexpected as the appearance of a Tacet Field! We will soon be holding a charity sale of all the items inside the station. The proceeds from the sale will be used to help everyone rebuild their homes.

I hope you'll all look forward to it.  I hope that we can meet again in Jinzhou in the not-so-distant future.

Daliy_SLHJ_9_1: That's it! Deconstruct the reality. Use the diversity of human minds as the lead. Leverage the collective memory and emotional resonance of humanity to create a surrealistic rendition of reality.
Daliy_SLHJ_9_4: Well, I don't understand a word of what's coming out of my mouth. I visited the exhibitions of other renowned artists. People there all talked like this.
Daliy_SLHJ_9_6: Maybe that's what I've been missing. Don't laugh. When I say these things, I immediately feel like I'm part of the contemporary art world.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_3: Because my business is slow. People keep saying my paintings can't keep up with the trend.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_4: I can't make a living just by painting… At the end of the day, all that talk about art and spiritual gratification won't pay the bills.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_5: I thought after graduation I could make money from painting to repay my parents for the money they'd spent to put me in art school. It seemed like I was daydreaming.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_6: I've been thinking whether I should switch careers recently. Maybe I'm just not good at portrait painting?
Daliy_SLHJ_8_7: Look, yesterday I went out of Jinzhou to sketch landscapes.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_8: Do you think I should continue to paint portraits or switch to painting landscapes?
Daliy_SLHJ_8_12: Really? Do you have any other opinions?
Daliy_SLHJ_8_15: My style… that makes sense. Why didn't I think of that before?
Daliy_SLHJ_8_16: My career... I haven't thought about that at all.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_17: I wouldn't even think about it. I still love painting. Even if no one appreciates my pieces and no one pays for them, I still don't want to give up what I truly love and enjoy.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_18: Maybe changing my style is a good choice.
Daliy_SLHJ_8_19: Wait, an idea suddenly came to me. Quick, take a seat. Let me put it into practice.
Daliy_SLHJ_16_1: What can I help you with today?
Daliy_SLHJ_16_3: Oh? Already completed all of them? Haha, he's quite motivated, isn't he?
Daliy_SLHJ_16_4: He's been talking about how he's out of the woods now. Still... who's to say if he's yet in another swamp?
Daliy_SLHJ_16_6: Haha, nothing serious. I'm just worried about him. I know what he's capable of, and all this success came quite suddenly...
Daliy_SLHJ_16_7: I'll take the paintings. No need to worry. I'll ensure they reach their collectors safely.
Daliy_SLHJ_16_2: I'm here to drop off paintings for Dianran.
Daliy_SLHJ_15_4: Hahaha! I appreciate your sense of humor. It does remind me of the days when you posed as my model.
Daliy_SLHJ_15_5: You know, with so many visitors here, I hate turning any of them down.
Daliy_SLHJ_15_6: These are completed commissioned works for my international clients. Can you help me deliver them to Huaipu Mining Firm?
Daliy_SLHJ_15_7: I'm good friends with the boss there. I used to buy mineral pigments from them. They've agreed to help me get these paintings to the collectors.
Daliy_SLHJ_15_3: Want me to pretend to be your customer again?
Daliy_SLHJ_14_5: Don't you think I'm even faster than before? Haha.
Daliy_SLHJ_14_1: Oh, by the way, take this.
Daliy_SLHJ_14_3: Actually, my new exhibition is opening next week at a very modest venue. And by modest I mean three thousand square yards.
Daliy_SLHJ_14_4: We'll be showcasing over ninety pieces of my art. On the opening night, we'll hold a seminar and a banquet. I'll send you the invitation later. Do come!
Daliy_SLHJ_13_1: Dianran completes the work in a few strokes.
Daliy_SLHJ_12_8: Relax. These are my friends and fans. All of them are art enthusiasts.
Daliy_SLHJ_12_9: Everyone! This is the person I've mentioned multiple times, my muse, the one who has influenced my creation the most, Rover!
Daliy_SLHJ_12_10: Without {Male=him;Female=her}, I wouldn't have achieved what I have today!
Daliy_SLHJ_12_12: Rover, I owe all of this to you.
Daliy_SLHJ_12_13: Remember the last time I joined the tender with my painting with a new style?
Daliy_SLHJ_12_14: That piece was quickly secured by a foreign art collector with a handsome offer!
Daliy_SLHJ_12_15: My works are the new buzz on the overseas market. I'm booked full until next year.
Daliy_SLHJ_12_16: So, I'm settling down with this new creative style. You see? They all come here for my work!
Daliy_SLHJ_12_17: Finally, I can hold my head high. I no longer need to paint for a living, let alone beg people to buy my work. If I ever sell my art again on the street, it'll be nothing but a hobby to keep me entertained.
Daliy_SLHJ_12_18: I really appreciate your advice. Let me paint one for you again!
Daliy_SLHJ_12_6: There are so many people here.
Daliy_SLHJ_10_1: I abstracted the subject and adopted a symbolistic approach to explicate the emotions. What do you think?
Daliy_SLHJ_10_5: Never mind. I had fun painting it. Whether the audience understands it or not is not my concern.
Daliy_SLHJ_10_6: Hey! You're already picking up the lingo! And... you sound very convincing.
Daliy_SLHJ_10_7: I saw that the gallery is advertising a public tender again, and I'm to try my luck again with these pieces with a new style.
Daliy_SLHJ_10_9: Take this landscape painting as a gift. Hehe, keep it well. Who knows, maybe one day it'll be worth a few grand.
Daliy_SLHJ_10_8: Anyway, thanks for your help! You're my muse. Wish me luck!
Daliy_SLHJ_10_3: A large dark blob. Can't understand what you're trying to express…
Daliy_SLHJ_10_4: Not bad. Seems to metaphorize the commonality of human emotions.

POI_SMBD_45_1: Sigh, it was close... Never mind. We still have a lot of <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color> left.
POI_SMBD_45_2: Tell me if you’d like to challenge it again. The goal is to protect the three Sound Emulators against Tacet Discords.
POI_SMBD_45_3: Let me give it a try.
POI_SMBD_44_1: Hm, perfect. The data should suffice now.
POI_SMBD_43_1: Yes, yes. Let me calculate the explosion range now... Oh, don’t mind me. Carry on.
POI_SMBD_42_1: Hello, are you that Rover? Pleasure to meet you.
POI_SMBD_42_3: Oh I almost forgot. I'm a researcher from Huaxu Academy.
POI_SMBD_42_4: Mr. Mortefi instructed to me to stay here and test the power of those <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color>. I’m just getting ready to do the previous test another time.
POI_SMBD_42_5: By the way, do you want to join me, Rover? You’re a pro now, aren’t you?
POI_SMBD_42_6: Tell me if you’d like to challenge it again. The goal is to protect the three Sound Emulators against Tacet Discords.
POI_SMBD_42_7: Let me give it a try.
POI_SMBD_41_1: Okay. We have everything we need now. Time to leave.
POI_SMBD_40_1: This one’s good, too. Now we just need another one.
POI_SMBD_39_1: Hm, this one looks good. You just found our first standard <color=Highlight>barrel</color>. Two more to go!
POI_SMBD_38_1: Remember, you need to attack the <color=Highlight>barrels</color> until the Durability Bar above them is fully charged. That's how you’ll know if they're good enough.
POI_SMBD_37_1: Bad luck. Just a few days left unattended, and the thorns just grew again and entangled themselves with the chest.
POI_SMBD_37_3: Yes. Though the items within it are not so important, we do want to keep using this chest.
POI_SMBD_37_4: But I don’t think I can cut open the thorns with this blade. What should I do...
POI_SMBD_37_6: Oh, you just reminded me. There’s a <color=Highlight>flamethrower</color> not far from here, but I just don’t know how to activate it.
POI_SMBD_37_7: Well, if you can get this done for me, you can take the items inside as a thank you from me.
POI_SMBD_36_1: The thorns didn’t last long on fire, did they? Was kind of relaxing to watch them burn...
POI_SMBD_36_2: The items are yours now. Don’t forget to take them. And thank you very much!
POI_SMBD_34_7: A swarm of Tacet Discords is coming! Show them the power of the <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color> and give us a spectacular show,  {Male=young man!;Female=young lady!}
POI_SMBD_33_3: They're fine. The <color=Highlight>barrels</color> that passed the test have already been shipped to the assembly site by Lollo Logistics.
POI_SMBD_33_4: We don't have much time left. Professor Woodrow is here too. Let's go meet up with them!
POI_SMBD_32_13: You're right, {PlayerName}. If they were standard <color=Highlight>barrels</color>, they wouldn't break so easily.
POI_SMBD_32_14: And those <color=Highlight>defective barrels</color>, once destroyed, contain a substance that can help neutralize the toxicity of Incinero Petals. This should allow you to stay in the Sea of Flames a bit longer.
POI_SMBD_32_12: I guess we just attack them with weapons?
POI_SMBD_31_1: Yes, that's it. We should return the <color=Highlight>filter</color> to the Third Research Center as soon as possible.
POI_SMBD_20_6: Honestly, I'm not sure. The assembly worked, but it's a replica of an old CSC design with outdated information.

Event_DRSL_9_1: Speaking of the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color>, I do visit Bogu's Arbor around the business area when off shift.
Event_DRSL_9_2: If you want to inquire about something related to plants, you can ask Grandma Lin, the owner there, for some information.
Event_DRSL_8_1: Let me explain our job today.
Event_DRSL_8_2: In this chapter, they passed right by a valley on their way to Mt. Moore.
Event_DRSL_8_3: It goes: "We ventured through the valley as the night fell..."
Event_DRSL_8_4: "In the sole darkness of night, the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color> seemed to fall noir... Pressed between petals and leaves, we walked as clothes uttered gentle friction..."
Event_DRSL_8_5: "Pale and silent as it was, the night permitted our disturbing existence. No, I heard murmurs upon the waves, saying "O travelers O winds..."
Event_DRSL_8_8: Yes. I find inner peace in this.
Event_DRSL_8_9: But to think of what comes after this chapter, I slow down my pace...
Event_DRSL_8_10: Anyway, we need the reference for the <color=highlight>Sea of Flowers</color> to create the valley according to this chapter.
Event_DRSL_8_11: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.
Event_DRSL_8_7: A relaxing scene, as it is.
Event_DRSL_43_1: All chapters of Tiancheng have been completed.
Event_DRSL_43_2: The Pioneer Association would like to thank you for your continued support, {PlayerName}.
Event_DRSL_43_6: Same here. I'll let you know if we have any progress.
Event_DRSL_43_7: By the way, Mr. Karl has heard stories about this. He would like to meet you if possible.

Flow_11000001_597: If you love these flowers, feel free to come and enjoy their beauty, but please don't destroy my design.
Flow_11000001_598: It's the most cherished penjing in our store, meticulously designed and crafted by Ms. Verina herself! It's truly one-of-a-kind!
Flow_11000001_599: Hmm... how can I make this penjing more alive...
Flow_11000001_600: Maybe I can put a pebble here, some moss there, and then add a miniature penjing...?
Flow_11000001_601: Darn it. No matter how I craft it, it still looks so artificial.
Flow_11000001_602: How does Ms. Verina manage to make her penjings look so naturally dynamic? What's her secret?
Flow_11000001_603: The next time she swings by, I'll have to figure it out.
Flow_11000001_604: Let her make her own decision. It's her life.
Flow_11000001_605: Perhaps I ought to let her make her own decisions, though. She's not a child anymore.
Flow_11000001_606: Maybe you should let her do what she wants.
Flow_11000001_607: Jewel Boba, timeless taste! Welcome to come in and give it a try!
Flow_11000001_608: New release! Freshly brewed and suitable for all ages! Come in and give it a taste! You won't be disappointed!
Flow_11000001_613: No wonder Linglong chose to open a branch here.
Flow_11000001_614: Wait, you haven't heard of her? She's a total fashion icon! Her brand "Longyue" is like a global sensation. People literally camp out to get their hands on her latest drops.
Flow_11000001_615: Linglong aims to make fashion more exciting and accessible. That's why she's opening up stores all over the world!
Flow_11000001_616: Guess what? Longyue, Linglong's original brand, is making its way to Jinzhou soon!
Flow_11000001_617: Come take a look at our official merchs!
Flow_11000001_618: Welcome! Our products are meticulously designed by our Association members. Found anything that catches your eyes?
Flow_11000001_619: Check out the frosty mountain badge crafted from Hoartoise shells, it even feels a bit icy when touched!
Flow_11000001_620: We also have a fun Roseshroom ink case. Just tap the button right here, and... it sprays out ink like the real thing!
Flow_11000001_621: What do you say? Cute, isn't it?
Flow_11000001_623: Sorry, but you can't redeem this yet...
Flow_11000001_624: Great choice! I love that too.
Flow_11000001_625: We didn't take advantage of them, right?
Flow_11000001_626: Dad, trust me. We didn't take any advantage. We've been loyal customers, and with my staff discount, this is the right price.
Flow_11000001_627: Good, good. Remember, son, fair play keeps the business rolling.
Flow_11000001_628: Hello dear, what kind of penjing are you looking for?
Flow_11000001_629: Just take your time. Let me know if anything catches your eye.
Flow_11000001_630: Well, most penjings are made of plants, but... I've heard rumors that some Remnant Creatures can be used in them too.
Flow_11000001_631: Yes, some of those creatures look just like ordinary plants, but they're something else entirely
Flow_11000001_632: Are all the penjings made with plants?
Flow_11000001_635: But after all these years running this shop, I've yet to come across one made of those Remnant Creatures.
Flow_11000001_636: Probably just a tale. This old lady is just rambling. Don't take it seriously, my dear.
Flow_11000001_638: Hello. What type of medicine are you looking for today? I might be able to make it taste good.
Flow_11000001_637: *sigh* Medicinal dishes are even harder to make than I expected.
Flow_11000001_639: Looks like you don't have enough credits yet. Hmm... I'll be working on a cheaper alternative for you!
Flow_11000001_640: Be sure to pay close attention to the contraindication and side effects of your medication!
Flow_11000001_641: Yeah, I've been trying to make better Caltrop Soup.
Flow_11000001_642: But it's tough finding the right mix of health benefits and flavor.
Flow_11000001_643: I might need to look for new ideas and adjust the recipe a bit.
Flow_11000001_646: "Good medicine tastes bitter", they say, but  it's important to make it easier for patients to take.
Flow_11000001_647: That's why I focus on making medicinal dishes that taste delicious and are still effective in treating illnesses.
Flow_11000001_648: I once made some medicine pancakes with Lemongrass and Caltrop. They were a real hit!
Flow_11000001_650: Hehe. Just doing what I'm supposed to do as the owner of a pharmacy!
Flow_11000001_652: Is it from a famous Hero Play?
Flow_11000001_653: Maybe... It's been ages since I watched a Hero Play. Work's been non-stop.
Flow_11000001_654: Anyway, enough chatter. Time to hustle and get these packages where they need to be.
Flow_11000001_655: Can't afford to mess up our reputation as "We Promise, We Deliver".
Flow_11000001_657: There's nothing quite like being on duty in a bustling commercial area. All that time I spent applying for this job feels worth it.
Flow_11000001_656: Yeah. I'm not someone with great ambitions. Just wanna live a peaceful life.
Flow_11000001_659: Look around. Business is booming, and it's all thanks to Patrollers like us!
Flow_11000001_661: Haha, thanks. If you ever run into trouble, no need to argue.
Flow_11000001_662: Just say my name and everything will be smoothed over.
Flow_11000001_663: Don't worry. I'm a man of connections.
Flow_11000001_664: Sorry, fully focused on my molecular cuisine right now. Please don't talk to me.
Flow_11000001_665: By extracting them, the fruit's sweetness is kept intact. Take a bite of the boba, and you'll feel the burst of fresh juice in your mouth!
Flow_11000001_666: I always knew using molecular gastronomy for dessert soups would be a hit! Haha, glad my efforts paid off.
Flow_11000001_667: Getting the right balance of each ingredient is like doing research. It takes dedication and time. Every little step makes a difference.
Flow_11000001_668: You know what? Seeing my customers' smiles is as rewarding as getting published in a top-tier journal.
Flow_11000001_669: Come on, don't miss out on trying Jewel Boba's new release, "Chewy-Gummy-Yummy SweeTEA"!
Flow_11000001_671: I've been worrying about my sister lately. Not sure what to do to lift her spirits...
Flow_11000001_672: Thanks. You and Lingyang helped me see what the "Jingle Beast" truly is.
Flow_11000001_673: Tried everything to make her happy, but nothing seemed to work...
Flow_11000001_674: Looks like there's only one way left... Bring back the "Jingle Beast" by any means necessary!
Flow_11000001_675: Though it may be a bit dangerous, I'll do whatever it takes to cheer my little sister up!
Flow_11000001_676: Being a "Jingle Beast" doesn't require one to be physically strong or do risky things...
Flow_11000001_678: Hello there, would you like a cup of our special Shuyun Herbal Tea?
Flow_11000001_679: Shuyun Herbal Tea, refreshing and heat-clearing!
Flow_11000001_680: Brewed from carefully chosen herbs, it's the perfect remedy for clearing away the heat.
Flow_11000001_681: While traditional herbal teas can be bitter, mine are sweet and refreshing!
Flow_11000001_682: You know, it was quite a journey to find just the right herb to make herbal teas.
Flow_11000001_683: But I've heard those heat-clearing herbal teas are bitter...
Flow_11000001_684: By adding it, I've not only boosted the tea's effects but also toned down the bitterness, making it much easier to enjoy.
Flow_11000001_685: Then, why not tell me what that herb is?
Flow_11000001_686: Ahem, that's my secret recipe! Can't give that away to anyone!
Flow_11000001_689: With you fighting on the frontlines protecting us, we old people are doing just fine.
Flow_11000001_690: You should take care of yourself and get more rest. There's no need for you to visit every day.
Flow_11000001_691: With you fighting on the frontlines protecting us, we old people are doing just fine.
Flow_11000001_693: *sigh*... If it weren't for my age, I'd want to go up there and have a look for myself...
Flow_11000001_694: {Male=Young man;Female=Young lady}. Can you help an old lady find Guhong?
Flow_11000001_696: Thank you. Do be careful on your way.
Flow_11000001_699: I can't thank you enough. As you can see, I'm still on my sentry duty and cannot leave the post unattended, so I have no choice but to leave the task to you.
Flow_11000001_702: We're not out of the woods yet. We should head back to Jinzhou.
Flow_11000001_703: See these muscles? I bet you wouldn't even believe it if I told you I used to get sick all the time back in the day. I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my bigger brother looking after me.
Flow_11000001_705: It's been a while with Aming not around. But here I am, still keeping this here food stall running on my own.
Flow_11000001_704: Would you look at the size of these puffy white dumplings? Don't they just make your day!
Flow_11000001_708: The two of us used to run this food stall together. But now I'm the only one left.
Flow_11000001_711: Oh, don't be. It's all a thing of the past.
Flow_11000001_712: With this food stall still here, and the stream running up the air per usual. It's as if nothing's changed.
Flow_11000001_714: Well, if isn't the insightful Rover? Here to support my business with more Sonance Caskets again?
Flow_11000001_713: Thanks to my kind patrons, this small relic business of mine has been thriving despite having no storefront.
Flow_11000001_716: "Value" is a complex term. In the business world, money talks. But once it becomes the sole measure of worth, we must proceed with caution.
Flow_11000001_717: A mutually beneficial agreement is what I strive for.
Flow_11000001_718: One's discarded items can hold great value for another, especially in my line of work as a collector of relics.
Flow_11000001_719: Should you come across any Sonance Caskets in your travels, I'd gladly take them off your hands for a price that'll make it worth your while.
Flow_11000001_720: Remember to stop and look around as you explore. Maybe there are ancient relics on those faraway mountains. Who knows?
Flow_11000001_721: Sorry, I'm closed for today, Come back tomorrow during regular hours, will you?
Flow_11000001_722: Every small discovery adds up to the bigger picture. Today's findings can lead us to uncover age-old mysteries about human civilization.
Flow_11000001_723: Giving relics the chance to see the light of day again. Now that's the joy of doing business... See? Even Bajiao's getting excited.
Flow_11000001_725: When a regular customer enters the teahouse and sit down with their teacup ready, I would know exactly what tea they want to have.
Flow_11000001_724: Thanks to the patronage from my lovely neighbors, Liuxian Teahouse is still driving after all these years.
Flow_11000001_726: Chenpi likes to have Pu'er, Pianyu prefers white tea, and as for Master Yuanwu...
Flow_11000001_727: I'd roast some fresh Trine Tea myself every day, wrap it in oil paper, and then bring it over to his boxing gym.
Flow_11000001_728: It's a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself. I usually pick the tea leaves and roast them here at the teahouse.
Flow_11000001_729: Sometimes I feel that relationships between people are like tea leaves. The more they are encompassed in warmth, the more fragrant they become.
Flow_11000001_731: Eek! You startled me for a moment there... If it isn't the Night Champion, {PlayerName}?
Flow_11000001_730: The lost heart is like a flower blooming alone in the Dim Forest. Its scarlet color remains, but fragile and indistinct, with scars running down its body.
Flow_11000001_733: Through fading thorns, has the hero finally arrived to rescue the maiden wounded by the spikes?
Flow_11000001_734: You must've gotten the wrong person.
Flow_11000001_735: Have I? It seems that the dusty memories cannot be awakened by a single sentiment after all.
Flow_11000001_736: You and I are like two meteors flying off in opposite directions, only til we fall can we seek redemption from the sins of convergence...

InfoDisplay_102801007_Text:
...Don't just focus on the superficial details; we must look beyond them to uncover the truth. This is what I've always been telling my students. However, I must admit, I too have been misled by the superficiality. For a long time, I've been attempting to improve the antibodies, hoping that they can aid us in exploring the Dim Forest more efficiently. I also aimed to use them to cure Hoohoo. Yet, my research has yielded no results so far. What should I do? It appears that Hoohoo's time is running short. It's more than a Tacet Discord but a true friend. The antibodies I make merely postpone its symptoms and fall short of a complete cure. Is this contamination irreversible? Can I find a way to neutralize it?
...Recently, I discovered that the purified spore cores we've extracted no longer contaminate their surroundings, so I tried to add them to the antibodies. Hoohoo showed no adverse reactions after taking them, and its health condition even improved. Perhaps this time, I've successfully made an effective antibody! However, there's been a surge in spores nearby lately. That's not a good sign...

Side_QTDWZS_19_3: You always manage to stumble upon important places.
Side_QTDWZS_19_4: This is a holy dating spot for couples. It's said that if couples come to this pond and make a wish to the sky while the frogs croak, they can stick by each other as long as they live.
Side_QTDWZS_19_6: This grassy slope and pond are indeed nothing special. The key, however, lies in the call of the Black-Striped Frogs.
Side_QTDWZS_19_9: Doesn't that sound like "always"? Couples think that means "always and forever", and wish this will bless their love.
Side_QTDWZS_19_10: They even give the Black-Striped Frogs a nickname, "Alwa Frog".
Side_QTDWZS_19_11: Well, it's just couples project their own expectations on an animal.
Side_QTDWZS_19_13: Well, for me, it's more like a faith-shall-work-wonders thing.
Side_QTDWZS_19_14: Anyway, we're taking this a little too far. Let's install the module first.
Side_QTDWZS_19_15: Xuanyin loads the Frog Language Translation Module onto your Pangu Terminal.
Side_QTDWZS_6_1: A Gray Crested Gull grabs the Star Flakes from you by surprise and flies away, hovering above your head and mocking you.
Side_QTDWZS_6_3: According to the information I've looked up, aside from Star Flakes, other fried foods are also very appealing to them.
Side_QTDWZS_6_4: As the Gray Crested Gulls enjoy stealing others' food, they are also known as "Pirate Gulls".
Side_QTDWZS_6_6: Yes. They are frequently spotted around "wharves" and places where potato fries are sold.
Side_QTDWZS_6_8: Why is the module freezing? I'd better uninstall it for now. Seems like there is no storage on your Pangu Terminal.
Side_QTDWZS_6_9: Xuanyin uninstalls the Bird Language Translation Module from your Pangu Terminal and transmits the related data back to her.
Side_QTDWZS_6_10: Ah-choo, ah-choo, I need to hurry back and warm myself up. See you next time.
Side_QTDWZS_5_1: Give! Me! Give! Me! Gimme, gimme, gimme!
Side_QTDWZS_5_3: I heard that the Gray Crested Gulls have a thing for human food, especially Star Flakes. Are they asking us for food?
Side_QTDWZS_5_5: You're a hidden chef, aren't you? I'm counting on you this time too!
Side_QTDWZS_5_6: By the way, the Gray Crested Gulls are infamous for their appetite for snatching food from others. If we have food in our hands, they should be rushing in to grab it.
Side_QTDWZS_5_7: Ah-choo. Sorry. I stayed up all night, trying to build good relations with them.
Side_QTDWZS_5_8: Ended up not only losing my food but also catching a cold. Haha.
Side_QTDWZS_5_4: We'll know when we give them Star Flakes.
Side_QTDWZS_4_2: Can you guess which animal translation module I brought this time?
Side_QTDWZS_4_4: Excellent hearing! Yes, it's the Bird Language Translation Module. The water areas around Jinzhou are a crucial route for the Gray Crested Gulls' migration. However, some stupid idiots often feed them...
Side_QTDWZS_4_6: My apologies. From my observations, due to the increasingly harsh environment, a small number of the Gray Crested Gulls have abandoned their instincts of migration and become resident birds.
Side_QTDWZS_4_7: The language of these resident birds has also evolved. In addition to communication among their kind, there are some calls directed at humans.
Side_QTDWZS_4_8: Perhaps they're attempting to communicate with humans. Let's collect some samples to find out.
Side_QTDWZS_4_9: Xuanyin loads the Bird Language Translation Module onto your Pangu Terminal.
Side_QTDWZS_4_3: I picked up the call of the Gray Crested Gull from a distance.
Side_QTDWZS_28_2: Looks like the pigeons stood us up.
Side_QTDWZS_28_3: Is having a condescending attitude towards humans a common trait shared by birds?
Side_QTDWZS_28_5: Come on! I'm full of fight now! I've got to get an explanation from them!
Side_QTDWZS_28_7: Next time, I must catch them and find it out!
Side_QTDWZS_28_4: Why should we humans care about the opinions of birds? What's the business?
Side_QTDWZS_25_2: The pigeons fly away after saying that.
Side_QTDWZS_25_3: Hey! How dare you fly away after name-calling! Are you trying to pick a fight?
Side_QTDWZS_25_4: Those impolite pigeons! I won't let them get away with it! Quickly scan to see where they flew off to.
Side_QTDWZS_24_1: {PlayerName}, I've got good news for you! The Gray Crested Gull language samples we collected last time were a big help!
Side_QTDWZS_24_2: The Bird Language Translation Module is almost complete. I'm planning to test it with other birds to see if there are any areas for improvement. By the way, I have something serious to tell you.
Side_QTDWZS_24_4: Hold on! We have volunteers here!
Side_QTDWZS_24_6: Well, let me think… There are plenty of grains on the ground, but they don't seem interested. Seems like we need to find another way to attract their attention.
Side_QTDWZS_24_7: Let's hear what they're talking first.
Side_QTDWZS_24_8: Xuanyin loads the Pigeon Language Translation Module onto your Pangu Terminal.
Side_QTDWZS_24_5: Do we need to attract them with food?
Side_QTDWZS_9_3: Sigh, this is a necessary sacrifice for closing in on the truth. Rest in peace. I will pay tribute to them too in the acknowledgments.
Side_QTDWZS_9_5: Hey, don't say that. I genuinely appreciate everyone who helped me, including animals.
Side_QTDWZS_9_6: To cherish their remaining value, why don't you take it home? I heard it tastes fine...
Side_QTDWZS_9_7: As for the translation module, I didn't expect so many malfunctions occuring this time. I need to check it out carefully.
Side_QTDWZS_9_8: I was wondering why it didn't show any garbled text. Turns out it crashed a long time ago, haha. Alright, let me uninstall it while I'm at it.
Side_QTDWZS_9_4: Great, now you can remove my name from it.
Side_QTDWZS_7_1: Hi, {PlayerName}. Come and take a look at these Tetra. Move gently.
Side_QTDWZS_7_3: Perfect guess! Strictly speaking, it can't be called a language module. After all, fish don't have vocal organs. Their ways of speaking are diverse.
Side_QTDWZS_7_4: They "speak" via grinding throat teeth, vibrating muscles, and compressing swim bladders.
Side_QTDWZS_7_5: As water is much denser than air, we need to use special techniques to collect the "sounds" emitted by them.
Side_QTDWZS_7_7: Wow, Resonators' perceptions are indeed more sensitive than us ordinary people.
Side_QTDWZS_7_8: However, I've developed a technology that can help ordinary people grasp those subtle vibrations. Don't you think I'm a genius? Hehe.
Side_QTDWZS_7_10: Well, you're right. Let's listen to what these Tetra are saying.
Side_QTDWZS_7_11: Xuanyin loads the Fish Language Translation Module onto your Pangu Terminal.
Side_QTDWZS_7_2: So it's the Fish Language Translation Module this time?
Side_QTDWZS_7_6: I can sense subtle vibrations in the water.
Side_QTDWZS_7_9: Only if the results are reliable and accurate.
Side_QTDWZS_18_1: Seems like the thing the dogs are most concerned about is their two-legged friends.
Side_QTDWZS_18_3: Some dogs, after training, can take on complex tasks. That's the original purpose of humans domesticating them.
Side_QTDWZS_18_4: It's surprising that dogs and wolves share the same origin but are different. Dogs lack the ferocity of wolves, you know.
Side_QTDWZS_18_5: They've established a deeper connection with humans.
Side_QTDWZS_18_6: Wolves hunt in packs in the wilderness, whereas dogs find a home in human households, viewing their two-legged friends as lifelong companions.
Side_QTDWZS_18_7: That's why they conceal their sharp teeth and claws.
Side_QTDWZS_18_9: So touching... I can't help crying!
Side_QTDWZS_18_10: You uninstalls the Dog Language Translation Module from your Pangu Terminal and transmits the related data back to her.
Side_QTDWZS_18_13: You're so considerate, {PlayerName}. I'll go back and analyze the data. Goodbye, friend. Sobbing.
Side_QTDWZS_17_3: Where have the kittens gone? Can't find any lately. Days without fluffy foot pads are so grueling... lucky the puppies are here.
Side_QTDWZS_17_4: Dogs are not a "substitute" for cats.
Side_QTDWZS_17_5: I know! I love them both!
Side_QTDWZS_17_6: Fine, as long as you're happy.
Side_QTDWZS_16_3: Haha, true. After all, most of my research subjects are out in the wilderness.
Side_QTDWZS_16_4: I feel a bit strange to rejoin a civilized society after roughing it out in the field. I prefer to play with dogs rather than deal with other people.
Side_QTDWZS_16_6: Yes, they're all my old friends, so it won't take too long to collect data as before.
Side_QTDWZS_16_7: See this pit bull? Its white eyebrows are pretty cute, huh? That's why I call it "Heroplay".
Side_QTDWZS_16_9: Hahaha, actually, it's because it loves to hang out near the entrance of the Jinzhou Theater.
Side_QTDWZS_16_11: Seems like it has something to say. Let's install the translation module and check it out.
Side_QTDWZS_16_2: I'm great. Rare to meet you in Jinzhou.
Side_QTDWZS_16_5: So it's the Dog Translation Module this time?
Side_QTDWZS_16_8: Is there a cause-and-effect relationship in this?
Side_QTDWZS_15_2: The program crashed! Seems like this module can't be used on TDs! Quick, kill the background processes!
Side_QTDWZS_15_4: Let me see. Well, though they are all interjections, they still have great scientific potential.
Side_QTDWZS_15_5: I shouldn't have messed with a TD. Fortunately, you were here.
Side_QTDWZS_15_7: Today's trial and error was very valuable. Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}.
Side_QTDWZS_14_2: Looks like it has something to say!
Side_QTDWZS_14_4: OH MY GOODNESS! It's tail is swinging over! The invincible {PlayerName}, do something!
Side_QTDWZS_13_1: Silver-Banded Lizard, Azure Lizard, Green Pit Lizard... Oh, hey, {PlayerName}, you're here.
Side_QTDWZS_13_3: Dishes? Where would you find such specialties?
Side_QTDWZS_13_4: Oh my, where was I? Well, I'll start over again later.
Side_QTDWZS_13_5: I was counting the language samples of lizards. The dialects of the lizards are almost catching up with the fish. It took me months to collect them all, but the performance of the translation module is somewhat not ideal.
Side_QTDWZS_13_7: Huh? The Viridblaze Saurian? I really haven't considered that.
Side_QTDWZS_13_8: In terms of classification, the Viridblaze Saurian is a mimicry Tacet Discord, classified as a Howler.
Side_QTDWZS_13_9: Though the Viridblaze Saurian and ordinary lizards have lots in common, it's a TD in essence. I don't have the courage to research it.
Side_QTDWZS_13_10: But now with you here, I think I can give it a try.
Side_QTDWZS_13_6: Do you have samples of the Viridblaze Saurian?

Guide_BWHC_8_1: Well, well, if it isn’t our Xiaofang. Back so soon? Didn’t I just fix up your pistols last week? You broke them again already?
Guide_BWHC_8_2: ...Aw, please don’t call me Xiaofang! It’s Chixia!
Guide_BWHC_8_3: Oh no, I'm doomed. It seems everyone knows my other name now.
Guide_BWHC_8_4: Haha, you’re exaggerating. As far as I know, only we, your old pals, are calling you that.
Guide_BWHC_8_7: Cool, cool. Let’s get to business then.
Guide_BWHC_8_8: {PlayerName}, you too?! No, please no... Let’s keep that name between us, alright?
Guide_BWHC_8_9: Anyway, we're here to help Auntie Panhua recreate the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_8_10: The recipe says we need to stir it with a golden-handled spoon once it starts bubbling. And Koko mentioned you happen to have a pyrite spoon with that exact name, right?
Guide_BWHC_8_12: That’s right. The golden handle spoon, indeed the pyrite spoon I have. And let me tell you, I have a bit of history with this Essence Medley Soup. Any guess what this soup is all about?
Guide_BWHC_8_16: Just a simple brew of herbs, really. Barely qualifies as medicinal cuisine in my book.
Guide_BWHC_8_17: Well, I don’t think it’s a formal dish, seeing as we just throw a bunch of ingredients together.
Guide_BWHC_8_18: Haha, you have the point. It’s indeed a chowder, but not an ordinary one.
Guide_BWHC_8_19: You youngsters didn’t witness the making of this soup. Back then, Jinzhou was still under construction, right around the year-end. Every household would bring out their cherished foods to share. And if they had nothing, they’d whip up some medicinal soup. If that wasn’t an option, they’d pitch in however they could.
Guide_BWHC_8_20: And that’s when I forged this large pyrite spoon. Made stirring that big pot a breeze. What a shame though, those border guards insisted on every bit of metal being used for weapons. Otherwise, you’d still see it around.
Guide_BWHC_8_23: No wonder Auntie Panhua said it’s passed down through word of mouth, sparking debates over its flavor.
Guide_BWHC_8_24: Seems like this recipe is more of a shopping list than a detailed guide.
Guide_BWHC_8_27: Absolutely! Every household pulled out their secret stash of ingredients to brew up this soup. It’s gotta be divine.
Guide_BWHC_8_28: Even if it doesn’t require any fancy cooking techniques, those good reviews can’t be bogus, right? Just like Auntie Panhua said, it’s brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients...
Guide_BWHC_8_29: Now I’m even more eager to get a taste, knowing the backstory! Uncle Wei, mind lending us your big pyrite spoon?
Guide_BWHC_8_30: The reason that the spoon affects the soup's flavor is because it releases a few minerals while stirring. You could use a smaller pyrite spoon instead.
Guide_BWHC_8_31: That makes sense... By the way, doesn’t Auntie Panhua already have one on standby?
Guide_BWHC_8_32: Since we’re here, might as well make the most of it. Can you lend a hand and check out my friend’s weapon?
Guide_BWHC_8_33: Ah, I remember you. New to Jinzhou, right? You’re that... that...
Guide_BWHC_8_36: That’s right. Madam Magistrate mentioned you’re Jinzhou’s guest.
Guide_BWHC_8_37: Let’s have a look at your weapon... Hm, this wear and tear... Can’t let youngsters like you wander around with a weapon in this state.

Guide_BWHC_5_9: Seriously, don’t you have work to do? Who keeps tabs on this stuff anyway!
Guide_BWHC_5_10: Alright, let’s cut to the chase. {PlayerName} and I are here to get you to check out this recipe Auntie Panhua handed us.
Guide_BWHC_5_11: Essence Medley Soup? I felt like I heard it from my grandmother or someone of her generation.
Guide_BWHC_5_12: Really? C’mon, wrack your brain for it! Uncle Mahe thinks it’s more of a medicinal cuisine than a regular dish.
Guide_BWHC_5_13: Let's see... Caltrops, Kudzu, Honeysuckles, a handful of Gemberries, and some pulled poultry breast. Simmer with water from the Monkvyrid. Once it's boiled, give it a stir with a golden-handled spoon... Water from the Monkvyrid? Isn't that the medicinal soup made from Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass?
Guide_BWHC_5_14: Who knew the medicinal soup could serve as a base... In a way, it leans towards medicinal cuisine. But with so many ingredients, wouldn’t it dilute the medicinal effect? There’s always something new to learn in dietary therapy.
Guide_BWHC_5_17: No need to go through all that trouble. Remember where you are? A pharmacy! I’ve got some pre-made medicinal soup right here.
Guide_BWHC_5_18: Good medicine often tastes bitter, so I've been thinking of ways to make it more palatable.
Guide_BWHC_5_19: By making it into medicinal cuisine, we preserve its healing qualities while getting rid of the bitterness, so it’s enjoyable for everyone.
Guide_BWHC_5_20: This recipe seems ancient. The Monkvyrid water is an old term from pharmacies, referring to that medicinal soup. Hold on, I’ve got the pre-made stuff for you.
Guide_BWHC_5_21: Oh, and here are some new recovery and synthesis potions. Consider them a bonus.
Guide_BWHC_5_23: Don’t be like Chixia, just barging in and scaring everyone.
Guide_BWHC_5_3: Wow, quite the enthusiastic welcome there.

Guide_BWHC_5_16: Are you interested in dietary therapy?

Guide_BWHC_3_1: Well, well, look who’s here. Chixia, back at it with the deliveries, eh?
Guide_BWHC_3_2: Nah, that makes me sound like a delivery person. Besides, I’ve got a whole bunch of other stuff on my plate, you know? But hey, I’m here to ask you to check out this recipe.

Guide_BWHC_3_15: Never mind. Relationships are like tangled webs, even I can’t untangle them!
Guide_BWHC_3_16: Of course! I’m like a walking encyclopedia for all things in Jinzhou! Worries and woes, they’re all part of the package when dealing with relationships!
Guide_BWHC_3_17: ...Ah, I see. This recipe seems to be quite old. It uses old-fashioned aliases instead of the ones we’re familiar with, making it tricky to decipher.
Guide_BWHC_3_18: Let me see... The red gems here must be Gemberries. Sweet roots are Caltrops, and there’s also Kudzu, Honeysuckles... Lucky for you, I’ve got all these ingredients. I’ll sort them out for you later.
Guide_BWHC_3_20: Absolutely! Uncle Mahe’s the go-to guy for anything and everything in Jinzhou. Not only food ingredients, he can get you many strange things!

Guide_BWHC_3_26: I know every food alias in the book, and these two are clearly not food ingredients.
Guide_BWHC_3_27: I’m not good at cooking, but this recipe looks like it could be a medicinal cuisine or a chowder because it has many different ingredients in small amounts. What’s your take?
Guide_BWHC_3_29: Maybe...? I got it! If it’s a medicinal recipe, we can go ask Koko at Shifang Pharmacy! She’s all about that medicinal recipe life, so she might just have the hookup.
Guide_BWHC_3_30: Thanks for the inspiration! Uncle Mahe, how much are these ingredients? I’ll cover the bill.
Guide_BWHC_3_31: Hey, they’re free. You’ve been an enormous help, and I appreciate it. Plus, I have a thing for Panhua... er, for what Panhua wants to make. Count me in for a taste, alright?
Guide_BWHC_3_32: You betcha! If Auntie Panhua whips this up, you’re getting a front-row seat to taste it!

Guide_BWHC_3_9: Hey, Uncle Mahe, did you catch any hints?
Guide_BWHC_3_11: I see. They’re doing that whole "acting-cold-but-secretly-caring" thing, right?
Guide_BWHC_3_12: Oh my, it’s like a puzzle! Impossible to crack.
Guide_BWHC_3_13: Chixia, you seem to know a lot.
Guide_BWHC_3_19: Uncle Mahe’s got quite the collection here.

Guide_BWHC_2_8: No, no, no, Auntie Panhua, just forget that name! I’m begging you!

Guide_BWHC_2_11: Any preferences or dislikes? Sweet, salty, sour, spicy, just let me know what you like. There’s always a Jinzhou cuisine for every taste!
Guide_BWHC_2_15: Alright, something light... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Guide_BWHC_2_16: Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious pairing of sweet Candied Caltrops and slow-cooked Jinzhou Stew made you hungry.
Guide_BWHC_2_17: Alright, something spicy... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Guide_BWHC_2_18: Before long, Panhua serves the dishes. The saucy Poached Chicken, complemented by the spicy and numbing Mapo Tofu, whets your appetite.
Guide_BWHC_2_19: Hmm... The Candied Caltrops is fresh with just the right sweetness; the Poached Chicken sauce is Auntie Panhua’s original, unmatched anywhere else. Oh, and the Jinzhou Stew! It’s something you can only find here. I bet you’ve never tasted anything like it! Trust me, you don’t wanna miss out on this!
Guide_BWHC_2_20: I’ve decided. Let’s get all of them.
Guide_BWHC_2_23: We Patrollers don’t get paid a lot, but I love treating my friend to a feast once in a while. It’s just one meal, I won’t go broke!
Guide_BWHC_2_24: To cater to all appetites, Auntie Panhua’s rolled out a small portion menu. Same fantastic flavors, just less food waste. So, no need to fret about over-ordering!
Guide_BWHC_2_25: Alright, find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Guide_BWHC_2_26: Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious mix of Candied Caltrops, Poached Chicken in sauce, and Jinzhou Stew made your mouth water.
Guide_BWHC_2_31: You got it! Next time, we’ll bring Yangyang and Baizhi along. Food’s always better with more pals, right? But what should we get then?
Guide_BWHC_2_32: If you come next time, I’ll have to treat you to a taste of my famous Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_33: That’s all? Seriously? Not even Auntie Panhua’s culinary magic can shake you?
Guide_BWHC_2_34: Looks like I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_35: Something special? Hmm, give me some time to think.
Guide_BWHC_2_36: In that case, I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_38: It's brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients. Every essence is simmered and distilled into a single bowl. Some gourmets claim it's the epitome of Jinzhou's flavor, captured in a nutshell.
Guide_BWHC_2_42: Even though I just polished off my plate, there’s always room for soup in my second stomach. Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?
Guide_BWHC_2_43: Whoa, did you hear that? Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients! My taste buds are tingling already... Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?
Guide_BWHC_2_44: It's not that I'm unwilling to make it right now... In fact, it's an old wartime dish, a recipe lost to the ages. We keep it alive through word of mouth, preserving its memory. Now, about its taste, people have a lot of fun debates about it, but one thing's certain: it's like a warm, fresh hug, absolutely delightful and unforgettable.
Guide_BWHC_2_45: However, while searching through old books, I stumbled upon its recipe. Though, calling it a recipe might be a stretch. See, back then, they used names for ingredients that are like riddles to us now. “Red beads,” “sweet roots,” “Monkvyrid,” “golden handle spoon”... I have no idea what they are.
Guide_BWHC_2_46: Speaking of peculiar ingredients, it does remind me of someone...
Guide_BWHC_2_48: Stop beating around the bush. Just tell me. I won’t take offense.
Guide_BWHC_2_50: Hmph, he’s always bragging about how he can get any ingredient, but if he’s clueless about these, he’s just wasting his time in this business.
Guide_BWHC_2_51: Just so we’re clear, I won’t go to him for answers, but if you want to give him a shot with this recipe, it’s your call.
Guide_BWHC_2_52: Auntie Panhua! You’ve got the sweetest heart. I always knew it!
Guide_BWHC_2_53: Alright, I’ll copy the recipe for you.

Guide_BWHC_14_1: Wow, can you believe we’ve covered almost half of Jinzhou in just one day?
Guide_BWHC_14_2: Tiring, but so worth it! I’m usually tied up with patrols, so catching up with so many friends all at once like this is a total first for me.
Guide_BWHC_14_3: Introducing you to everyone, shooting the breeze... It’s like reconnecting with old friends all over again. Wait, didn’t I promise to treat you to a meal? How did it end up with you being my tour buddy instead?
Guide_BWHC_14_4: But hey, thanks to you, I finally get why folks rave about the Essence Medley Soup as they do.
Guide_BWHC_14_5: Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients, with every essence distilled into a single bowl... The real treasure lies in everyone’s willingness to share their most prized grub, don’t you think?
Guide_BWHC_14_7: Exactly! If we were back in wartime, Auntie Panhua reminding me to eat on time, Uncle Mahe caring about my work, Koko fretting over my safety, Uncle Wei dropping knowledge bombs on me, and all the other folks in Jinzhou...
Guide_BWHC_14_8: They’d all without a doubt open up their pantries and share their most cherished grub with us.
Guide_BWHC_14_9: As for me, I wanna be someone who can protect every single soul in Jinzhou... including you! I wanna keep you safe too! I’ve had a great time hanging out with you.
Guide_BWHC_14_10: So, while we’re in Jinzhou, let me shoulder your worries and troubles, alright?
Guide_BWHC_14_12: You can bet on this Jinzhou Speedster’s determination!
Guide_BWHC_14_11: Looks like I can’t say no.
Guide_BWHC_13_1: After some dedicated effort, you successfully prepared the Essence Medley Soup together.
Guide_BWHC_13_2: You, Chixia, and Panhua taste the Essence Medley Soup together.
Guide_BWHC_13_3: The combination of bitter medicine and delightful ingredients creates a unique taste on your tongue. You notice the same intricate expression mirrored on the faces of the other two.
Guide_BWHC_13_4: Well, how can I put it... It’s not exactly terrible, but...
Guide_BWHC_13_5: Not good either. At the very least, it’s a far cry from the other dishes you make.
Guide_BWHC_13_11: Maybe I’m the legendary God of Cooking.
Guide_BWHC_13_12: Looks like I’ll have to start calling you teacher.
Guide_BWHC_13_13: That’s not flattery. I’ve got eyes, and I saw you handle each step with ease.
Guide_BWHC_13_14: Alright, after all this effort, it’s time to take a rest.
Guide_BWHC_13_6: Oh no, we've come this far. Like in a typical story, it's time we proudly declare, "Thanks to our persistence, we've discovered the perfect flavor," right?
Guide_BWHC_13_7: Is this one of those lessons from Hero Plays?
Guide_BWHC_13_9: Seems like Rover's got some skill in the kitchen. Even though it's not a complex dish, you handled it like a pro, especially for a novice cook.
Guide_BWHC_12_1: Upon returning to the restaurant, you and Chixia recounted the entire tale to Panhua and shared the authentic recipe for Essence Medley Soup with her.
Guide_BWHC_12_2: ...I see. So that’s how it is. The Essence Medley Soup isn’t a fancy dish, just a simple recipe that’s often made and enjoyed at home. No wonder everyone’s talking about it being made from the finest Jinzhou ingredients and distilled into a single bowl.
Guide_BWHC_12_3: And the reason it’s so prestigious isn’t necessarily because it’s mind-blowing in terms of taste... In that case, I suppose I won’t be needing this recipe after all.
Guide_BWHC_12_4: Auntie Panhua, how about giving me and {PlayerName} a shot at it together?
Guide_BWHC_12_5: While it may not end up being a regular menu item, we’ve put in a lot of effort to gather the ingredients, so it would be a shame not to at least try it. Besides, there are loads of folks out there dying to give it a try.
Guide_BWHC_12_8: True. You’ve gone through all the trouble to gather the ingredients. It’d be a shame not to give it a try. Come on, everyone. The stove’s right here. Let’s whip it up together!
Guide_BWHC_12_7: We won’t know how it tastes until we give it a shot.
Guide_BWHC_11_1: How do you feel? Quite handy, huh?
Guide_BWHC_11_2: With technology getting fancier by the day, life’s becoming a breeze around here.
Guide_BWHC_11_3: I’m kinda curious, though. If we rallied everyone up again and asked them to bust out their most prized grub, what do you think they’d bring this time?
Guide_BWHC_11_4: Oops, got a bit carried away there. Let’s hustle back to Auntie Panhua’s restaurant! Who knew making a dish would be such a mission...
Guide_BWHC_10_1: And here we are. This is the <color=Highlight>Synthesizer</color> Uncle Wei mentioned.
Guide_BWHC_10_2: Aside from crafting materials and beefing up their quality, you can also whip up some basic potions here. It’s like a one-stop shop for all your needs, whether you’re kicking it in the city or out on an adventure.
Guide_BWHC_10_3: I’ve got some synthesis materials right here. Go ahead, give it a try.
Guide_BWHC_10_4: It might seem a bit tricky just hearing about it, but once you try it hands-on, you’ll get the hang of it real quick.
Guide_BWHC_1_1: Hey ya! Long time no see, {PlayerName}. How’s it going?
Guide_BWHC_1_2: Well, just calling to see what you're up to. Are you free now?
Guide_BWHC_1_4: No worries at all! It’s no biggie, really. Well, not as huge as diving into those tokens, that’s for sure.
Guide_BWHC_1_5: Remember my promise? About treating you to a nice meal? Well, since I’ve got a few days off and figured you’d be around, now’s the perfect time to cash in on that promise and invite you out.
Guide_BWHC_1_6: So, what do you say? How about this Jinzhou Speedster takes you on a culinary adventure at Auntie Panhua’s Restaurant?
Guide_BWHC_1_7: The Maocai she cooks is an explosion of spice and flavor! One gulp and you’ll feel the buzz in your bones!
Guide_BWHC_1_11: You know, that’s what I like. But hey, no pressure if spicy isn’t your thing. Auntie Panhua’s a culinary genius, whipping up many treats like Poached Chicken, Rising Loong... you name it! It’s all authentic Jinzhou cuisine!
Guide_BWHC_1_12: Didn’t expect you to be a foodie too. Next time I’m on patrol and find something tasty, I’ll make sure you get a taste.
Guide_BWHC_1_13: So, we’re on for a date, right?
Guide_BWHC_1_14: Let’s meet at Panhua’s Restaurant on Gourmet Street. Time-wise, just let me know before you’re ready.
Guide_BWHC_1_15: I’ll be eagerly waiting to hear from you!
Guide_BWHC_1_8: Alright, it sounds spicy just as I expected.
Guide_BWHC_1_9: Where there’s delicious food, there’s me.
Flow_11000006_537: Come on, do you want to practice again?
Flow_11000006_538: Come on. Let's train more while we can. We need to be on duty afterward.
Flow_11000006_539: Do your logistic duties and the tasks assigned to you by the city government. It is only when the city is stable that those on the frontline can focus on their jobs.

Flow_11000006_547: So, this journey of a thousand miles, it all starts with this bit by bit training.
Flow_311000000_336: I have something else to do.

Flow_311000000_359: He's a brilliant strategist and warrior now, but it's said he started out as a medic.

Flow_311000000_363: They say if he's in a good mood, he can create anything. Maybe even something like a sound amplifier that lets you hear conversations miles away... hehe.

Flow_311000000_375: When making clear soup, add a couple more Edodes while simmering. It makes the soup more flavorful and the color brighter.

Flow_311000000_389: You've asked the right person. The secret is just one thing: salt!

Flow_311000000_391: If the salt is right, the soup is perfect!

Flow_11000007_549: Phew... If only I could go to the front line like the seniors of Vanguard... All I do now is count these stupid boxes every day. There's no end to this job...
Flow_11000007_550: You are the buttress that supports the battles on the front line.
Flow_11000007_551: I believe you can become the Vanguard.
Flow_11000007_552: Thank you, I will try my best. But, enough with my whining. If I can't even handle these trivial matters, I won't make it to the front line.
Flow_11000007_553: Although the Rearguard is in charge of logistics and defense on the back, I heard many of the former Rearguard members earned honors no inferior to those of the Vanguard. Perhaps my mundane task is a form of training. I can't beat myself up anymore.
Flow_11000007_554: You're right, Qingxi says this to me as well. I was too being short-sighted.
Flow_11000007_555: Even the simplest logistic duties concern the safety of Jinzhou and the livelihood of the comrades on the frontline. There's no room for mistakes.
Flow_11000007_556: It's nothing, I'm just wandering around.
Flow_11000007_557: No trouble at all, just a piece of cake.

Flow_11000001_741: Exorcise demons and monsters and become an undying legend... You're seeking the right stuff!
Flow_11000001_742: Oh? But I see a firm and pure determination in your eyes. I guess it's not that you don't have a reason, but you're always ready to lend a hand, right?
Flow_11000001_743: So that's how it is... Wait, I've got an idea! Thanks, I'll get back to my rehearsal.
Flow_11000001_749: Next up, the Torch Sword! Let its flames burn, let the sparks fly and lighten up tonight!
Flow_11000001_750: Sorry, I got carried away again. Please forgive my manners.
Flow_11000001_751: I've performed this Hero Play hundreds, even thousands of times.
Flow_11000001_752: Playing Fiamma over and over, it feels like we're becoming one entity.
Flow_11000001_753: But you know, I'll keep playing the Fiamma role. After all, every time the show ends, I feel happy seeing the bright eyes of the children in the audience.
Flow_11000001_754: If the performance can move and inspire people, it doesn't matter how tiring the rehearsals can be.
Flow_11000001_755: It was Chixia who made me realize this. She was a dedicated audience to my play when she was a kid. Now she's a Patroller. More and more people will know her as Chixia!
Flow_11000001_756: Well, I think she fits the real Fiamma of Jinzhou better than me. I'm happy for her.
Flow_11000001_757: Same old arrangements. "Speedster" and "Fiamma" are taking turns to perform, making sure the Fluffernox doesn't wreak havoc on the human world.
Flow_11000001_758: But we're also working on a new play. Don't forget to come and see it yourself when it's out!
Flow_11000001_759: Alright, feel free to look around. If you have any questions, just ask me.
Flow_11000001_761: That's why I love Qinghe's plays so much!
Flow_11000001_765: Now, this stage belongs to these young folks, and watching them gives me a real kick.
Flow_11000001_766: The performances are precious. Try not to scare them away with your silver tongue, okay?
Flow_11000001_767: After all, life's a stage, and all the men and women are mere players...
Flow_311000008_1: Hey, did you hear about our new guest? Well, words on the street that {Male=he;Female=she} is a like problem-solving machine!
Flow_311000008_2: Who is the person always hanging around the City Hall?
Flow_311000008_3: Yeah, but I wonder who it could be...
Flow_311000008_4: Wait, are we talking about that Rover?
Flow_311000008_13: Rumor has it, Rover's the guest Magistrate referred to, capable of tearing Tacet Discords apart single-handedly! Quite the feat!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_36: Wait. What I gave them was enough for them to make it to Jinzhou, even when they are so many.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_50_7: You brought the medic over to take care of Xinyu.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_9: After some chaos, you helped medics in treating the wounded.

ItemInfo_70139305_BgDescription: A heavy, dark fruit, just the right size for a hand, emitting a subtle fragrance, it doesn't seem to have anything unusual.
ItemInfo_70139306_BgDescription: An ordinary fruit that somehow bears a striking resemblance to the old model of Tacetite Grenade. This is not an indigenous species, as its growth conditions don't agree with the climate of Jinzhou. It's imported by water via the Gunchao Port located in the South.
ItemInfo_70139307_BgDescription: A round, pearl-shaped candy ball hidden inside a simple sweet wrapper.
ItemInfo_70139308_BgDescription: A sweet oral vaccine, reminiscent of candy for children in Jinzhou, symbolizes their triumph over the epidemic.
ItemInfo_70139309_BgDescription:
A finely crafted small device, the surface is engraved with ancient text. The inner ring represents the Four Spirits of Heaven, indicating the location.
"East, the Teal Loong, West, the White Tiger, South, the Vermillion Bird, North, the Black Tortoise".
The outer ring represents the Twelve Earthly Branches, indicating the time.
"Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai".
ItemInfo_70139310_BgDescription:
This sundial has a secret compartment. 
Rotate the two disks to the right positions to unlock it and discover its hidden contents.
ItemInfo_70139311_BgDescription: An unlocked Sundial-shaped puzzle box. The direction and time symbols on its disks have been rearranged. However, you have already obtained the key information given by the Jinzhou Magistrate. Now, it appears to be an ordinary small sundial. Only upon closer inspection can you see a faint light source at the top and the shadow of the needle is distorted, almost like a hushed whisper.
ItemInfo_70139312_BgDescription: A purple leaf with a faint, peculiar energy.
ItemInfo_70139313_BgDescription:
A purple leaf with traces of dual Tacet Discord frequencies. The asynchronous fluctuations of the frequencies caused them to cancel each other out and rendered them hard to track.
Could it be that there were actually two separate Tacet Fields surrounding the tree where this leaf originated from?
ItemInfo_70139314_AttributesDescription: A small gift from a child. She hopes you enjoy a sweet time in Jinzhou.
ItemInfo_70139314_BgDescription: A popular treat among the children of Jinzhou, the candy's wrapper bears signs of being eagerly clutched by tiny hands, its folds and creases revealing its cherished history.
ItemInfo_70139314_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Restores some HP for the whole team

ItemInfo_70139315_BgDescription:
The archives stored in the Huaxu Academy, Jinzhou Campus, record the research information related to "Tacet Discord".
"The information energy body composed of Reverberation, has a mimicry of life activities, and its core behavior goal is to devour and absorb the frequency it needs."

ComboTeaching_16050101_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_16050201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to cast a Plunging Attack mid-air, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_16050301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Within a short time after casting Heavy Attack, cast Basic Attack to trigger Basic Attack Stage 4.
ComboTeaching_16050401_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_16050501_DescriptionConten: When "Umbra" is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Enter <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color> state after casting <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>. Under this state: <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with enhanced Basic Attack, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_16050701_DescriptionConten: During <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast the Chain Heavy Attack on the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Chain Heavy Attack to cast enhanced Basic Attack 3.
ComboTeaching_16050801_DescriptionConten: Condense sounds into blades, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_16050901_DescriptionConten: Gather sounds in the palm to attack targets in the front, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040101_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 5 attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. When Lion's Spirit is not full, cast a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040401_DescriptionConten: Cast Resonance Skill to attack your target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040501_DescriptionConten: When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3, 4, or 5</color> hits a target, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Ancient Arts</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color>. Gain Lion's Spirit when Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color> is cast. <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color> do not reset the Basic Attack cycle.
ComboTeaching_11040502_DescriptionConten: When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3, 4, or 5</color> hits a target, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Ancient Arts</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color>. Gain Lion's Spirit when Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color> is cast.
ComboTeaching_11040503_DescriptionConten: When Lion's Spirit is full, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state, gaining the ability to attack in the air. When Lion's Spirit is not full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11040601_DescriptionConten: Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and receive the blessing of <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color>. During Lion's Vigor, the duration of Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> is extended to a maximum of 10s. Cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color> if Lion's Spirit is full to enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.
ComboTeaching_13010101_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13010201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13010301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to perform a Heavy Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13010401_DescriptionConten: Swing the blade to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Extermination Order</color> can be cast up to 3 times but will be put on Cooldown if not repeated shortly after the previous cast. This Resonance Skill does not reset the Basic Attack cycle, and grants 1 "Cruelty" for each hit on hit.
ComboTeaching_13010402_DescriptionConten: Calcharo's Resonance Skill will not interrupt the cycle of Basic Attacks. Each hit deals Electro DMG and grants 1 stack of "Cruelty".
ComboTeaching_13010403_DescriptionConten: <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Mercy"</color> when Calcharo is not under Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state and has 3 "Mercy". Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Mercy"</color> consumes all "Cruelty" to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13010501_DescriptionConten: Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to targets nearby and enter <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state. Under <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> are enhanced. The Forte Gauge is replaced with "Killing Intent", and when "Killing Intent" reaches 5, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>"Death Messenger"</color>. <color=Highlight>"Death Messenger"</color> consumes all "Killing Intent" to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> recovers 1 "Killing Intent" on hit.
ComboTeaching_13020101_DescriptionConten: Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13020201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA and command the puppet "Zapstring" to crash to the ground, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13020301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA and control the puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13020401_DescriptionConten: Control the puppet "Zapstring" to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to targets within a range and enter <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>. Cast again to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> once, and end <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>.
ComboTeaching_13020402_DescriptionConten: During <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>, the puppet "Zapstring" will keep discharging and empower <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> to trigger Electromagnetic Blast on hit. Each <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> can only trigger this once, up to 4 times.
ComboTeaching_13020501_DescriptionConten: When Yinlin's "Judgment Points" are full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced with <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color>, which consumes all "Judgment Points" and deals a wide-range <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, replacing "Sinner's Mark" with "Punishment Mark" on hit. "Thunder of Judgment" will befall all targets with "Punishment Mark", dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> when a target with "Punishment Mark" takes damage. This can be triggered up to once per second. Attacks restore "Judgment Points" on hit.
ComboTeaching_13020601_DescriptionConten: Deal AoE <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. A thread is left connecting the puppet "Zapstring" to the target on hit, while marking it with "Sinner's Mark".
ComboTeaching_14050101_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 4 attacks with vigorous martial arts, dealing <color=#46c3d4ff>Aero DMG</color>. <color=#f4d582>Normal Attacks</color> grant "Chi" on hit.
ComboTeaching_14050201_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to perform a plunging kick, dealing <color=#46c3d4ff>Aero DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_14050301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Gain "Chi" on hit.
ComboTeaching_14050401_DescriptionConten: Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to take a stance and get ready to parry the enemy's next attack, and gain "Chi". If an enemy attack is parried, ignore the damage of that attack, counterattack to deal <color=#46c3d4ff>Aero DMG</color>, and gain "Chi". Interrupt the stance and launch an attack to deal <color=#46c3d4ff>Aero DMG</color> by releasing the Resonance Skill button, and gain "Chi".
ComboTeaching_14050501_DescriptionConten:
When "Chi" is stacked to its max, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to start charging. Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to a nearby area and gradually consume "Chi". For each stage progressed, gain a temporary shield and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, progressing up to <color=Highlight>Major Zhoutian: Outer</color>. Release <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to interrupt the charging, and cast an attack according to the current stage.
<color=Highlight>Prior to Minor Zhoutian</color>: Obtain a level-1 shield, and cast <color=Highlight>Pushing Punch</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to enemies in front when the charging is interrupted.
ComboTeaching_14050502_DescriptionConten: <color=Highlight>Major Zhoutian: Outer</color>: Obtain a level-4 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to the surrounding targets.
ComboTeaching_14050601_DescriptionConten: Create a strong wind field, continuously pulling targets within the field to the center and dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When the wind field disappears, deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets within the range again.
