InfoDisplay_31000035_Text:
July 4
The citywide alarm blared incessantly throughout the day, sounding three to four times. Yōu was so frightened that she clung to me tightly, refusing to let go. I felt powerless in comforting her, so I held her even tighter.
We're leaving tomorrow, and I hope everything can go smoothly, allowing Yōu to get a restful night's sleep.
InfoDisplay_31000036_Text:
July 5
The platform was swarming with people. All in chaos. I was overcome with fear of being separated from Yōu, so I abandoned one of our bags and hold onto Yōu's hand tightly. Thankfully, we successfully boarded the train.
There was a foul smell inside the carriage, as if something was rotting. The lights flickered on and off and the door was broken as well, almost trapping a young man's arm. I wondered if a broken train like this could truly lead us to safety.
InfoDisplay_31000037_Text:
July 9
Today marked the fifth day since the collapse. I feared it might be my last, but then a young man discovered an unburied cave. It offered us air and protection from the falling rocks and bitter cold. We took turns searching for food and water in the carriages. Perhaps we can make it through...
InfoDisplay_31000038_Text:
July 15
Who would have thought there were Tacetites underground...
The camp was no longer a safe place, and we had to abandon all our hard-earned supplies. Everyone here has lost their minds, pressuring me to leave Yōu behind. Yet, without her, what's the point of boarding this train...
InfoDisplay_31000039_Text:
July 15
It's been two weeks, and only four of us remain. How did the Tacet Field suddenly appear in this place? I saw scary monsters, countless monsters...
No matter what happens, I will protect Yōu, even if it costs me my life.
InfoDisplay_31000040_Text: Our luck hasn't run out. There's still a small patch of soil suitable for planting. We planted the seeds we risked our lives to collect, and some have sprouted under our care. As long as the plants can grow, there is hope for our survival. I believe someone will come to rescue us. We won't die here. We will be saved.
InfoDisplay_31000041_Text:
Dates don't mean anything to me anymore. Only I and a young man survive. Why am I keeping this diary? I don't know. Maybe someone will discover my diary someday? But what good will it do?
The young man mentioned that the rock wall here seems thinner, suggesting that if we tried to dig together, we might find a way out. However, he's currently leaning against the rock wall, his eyes tightly shut, and he hasn't moved for hours.
I lack the courage to check his breathing. I feel terrible. My body is burning up, and my head is aching as if it's about to explode. I keep hearing Yōu's voice. Perhaps she's here to relieve me from all this pain.
InfoDisplay_31000042_Text: The ground is covered with broken rocks and gravel. The traces of digging spread across the broken rock wall, accompanied by trails of aged brown bloodstains. Faint glimmers cast their eyes through the crevices, throwing specks of light onto the saddened ground. Placing your hand on the rock wall, you exert a gentle force. With a thunderous roar, the rock wall gives way, releasing a gust of fresh air that rushes in, breathing new life into the train carriage once more.

03.12

Hi, I'm ███! I found a new home and the nice uncle gave me this cool new book to writes in. Our old home was scare by monsters, so we went on a super long jurney to find this new place. I askd when mommy and daddy will catch up with me and uncle said really soon! Can't wait for them to join us here. The new place is so sunny and has a huge tree that grows peaches. Not many ppl from here go to the big city though. I just want mommy and daddy to find me quick.

...

12.5

Today it's my birtday! Everyone is being really nice, saying I'm their lucky charm bcuz I can keep those mean monsters away. I'm really happy and everyone likes me lots. We had cake and noodles and I got presents too! It's been forevz since I saw mommy and daddy tho, hope they come back. Will they come back?

...

December 05

This marks my fourth birthday here, and our village head made it official I'm his daughter now. But before that, everyone was already been taking care of me and shared with me delicious meals. My father told me I'm a child of the Qichi Village, and I should consider myself lucky. I feel really fortunate to be loved by so many people. Even though my powers are still small, I'll do my best to continue protecting the village from being invaded by Tacet Discords!

InstanceDungeon_1503_DungeonDesc:
Jinzhou is home to one of Huanglong's unique database centers, managed by the Sentinel and controlled by the Jinzhou Magistrate. It uses time as an index and precisely records information related to the city's establishment, making it a comprehensive and objective resource. The class books of Jinzhou, stored in City Hall, hold important data collected since ancient times. This vast database holds answers to any question one may have about Huanglong's history.
Recommended Character Level: Level 40

MonsterInfo_310000290_DiscoveredDes:
The Fractsidus' faithful cultists.
Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus they become strong enough to wield gigantic hammers.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists' mentality and corrode their bodies. They choose to mask themselves to conceal their twisted face.

This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 
Created in the CSC labs, this Mechanical TD has evolved by consuming machine wrecks. Upon discovering traces of human frequencies, it became fixated on achieving perfection and grew larger as it improved its composition. A haunting symbol of humanity's relentless pursuit of scientific advancement, its presence serves as a subtle reminder of our obsession and descent into madness.
MonsterInfo_340000060_UndiscoveredDes: A Staticoid TD that hides beneath an abandoned CSC facility, its physical form comprises a conglomerate of various objects. Threat level: Overlord Class.
MonsterInfo_340000070_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
Along with the eerie Void Plenilune, this Whisperin TD appeared at the end of the Norfall Barrens. 
Its very presence is an ominous reminder of the devastating war that once ravaged this land. Born from the residual energies of battle, it continues to evolve and has become the most feared weapon in the Threnodian's arsenal. With merciless destruction, it reawakens humanity's primal fear of warfare. And now, it greets its ruler, ready to unleash chaos upon the world.
MonsterInfo_340000070_UndiscoveredDes: A Whisperin TD discovered in the Norfall Barrens, exhibiting more prominent characteristics of the human female form. There is a suspected link to Threnodian, surrounded by other TD sub-class aggregates. Due to its hazardous environment, there remains insufficient information and records, it has been classified as a Calamity Class.
Side_JZKW_1_1: The textbooks are boring enough already, sis. Can’t we make the magazine just a little more interesting?
Side_JZKW_1_2: Why don’t we just go to the theater and hire a storyteller to add a few finishing touches for us?
Side_JZKW_1_3: How many times have I told you, writing a publication is a very serious matter, even if it’s an extracurricular one?
Side_JZKW_1_4: If the magazine is boring, how can you expect it to become popular with students?
Side_JZKW_1_5: Wouldn’t it contradict the very purpose behind starting the magazine?
Side_JZKW_1_6: You’re right. A popular magazine needs to set itself apart from an academic journal. I should think from our readers’ perspective.
Side_JZKW_1_7: Thanks for the reminder. I nearly got caught up in the details again!
Side_JZKW_1_8: Well, I’m a potential reader too, you know!
Side_JZKW_1_9: Potential reader... That makes sense. I should listen to people’s thoughts and opinions more!

Side_JZKW_1_13: Oh! I’ve heard of the name. The incredible Rover.

Side_JZKW_1_15: Don’t worry, it won’t take you long. It’s really just a small favor, please!

InfoDisplay_310000281_Text:
[Entry]  
Tacet Discord  

 
[Known Types]  
Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, Staticoid

 
[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords. 
These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition. 
As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

 
[Appendix: Echoes] 
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization. 
Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord. 
This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo — a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.
InfoDisplay_310000291_Text:
[Name] 
 Huaxu Academy, Jinzhou Campus
 
[Introduction]  

Huaxu Academy, a renowned scientific research center in Jinzhou, boasts a rich academic heritage and cutting-edge technology. 

As a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, it has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. 

The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae. Comprised of four primary departments, each with its own specialized functions, Huaxu Academy conducts parallel and cooperative research initiatives. 

Ad hoc project teams are also formed to tackle major challenges as they arise. While the president oversees administrative affairs, the Principal Investigator serves as the academic leader of the academy.




[Departments]  

Department of Anomaly Studies:  
The Department of Anomaly Studies researches and analyzes abnormal occurrences, constructs theories based on these events, and devises preventative measures. This includes the Resonance Beacon network model and Wutherological Climate studies in Jinzhou.
Main Disciplines: Wutherology, Remnant Ecoacoustics.  

Department of Laboratory Evaluation: 
The Department of Laboratory Evaluation analyzes and simulates anomalies using different theories to find optimal solutions. They also design the internal structure of Resonance Beacon and Terminal for effective use.
Main Disciplines: -

Department of Safety: 
The Department of Safety researches and supports the elimination of Tacet Discord. They design models of the Tacetite Weapon for the Resonator and create countermeasure equipment for civilians.
Main Disciplines: TD Ecoacoustics, Resonology.  

Department of Resources:  
The Department of Resources primarily studies Waveworn substances, processes field materials for research samples, and contributes to the Department of Laboratory Evaluation and Safety.
Main Disciplines: Wuthermaterials, TD Ecoacoustics, Plant Ecoacoustics.

Abstract: 

NovaFei is an acute infectious disease with no effective treatment, primarily affecting children under six years old. It is highly contagious with severe symptoms including fever, limb pain, and muscle atrophy. To combat this disease, a live attenuated vaccine has been developed and successfully passed phase III clinical trials on <color=#ffd12f>June 16 at 3:00 p.m. </color>. The Medical Section established a specialized team for this vaccine's development. This review aims to analyze the progress of the vaccine research and provide valuable insights for further studies. Results have shown promising immunization outcomes, making this vaccine a potential solution for preventing NovaFei infection.

1. Preliminary application of a neutralizing antibody detection method for NovaFei pseudovirus
2. Efficacy of live attenuated vaccine against NovaFei pseudovirus via injection
3. Clinical trial report of oral administration of "Sugar Pearl" live attenuated vaccine against NovaFei pseudovirus

Title: Oral NovaFei Fever Vaccine, Live Attenuated Mass Production Quality Standards and Transportation Overview of "Sugar Pearl" 
Reporting Officer: Medical Officer III, Huaxu Academy 
Report No.: MD-E0510 

Abstract:

This report details the importance of delivering Huanglong's medical supplies to Jinzhou, which served as the front line of defense against TD Outbreak. The Midnight Rangers valiantly defended the city from the fierce outbreak, but due to transportation line blockages, the second-generation Sugar Pearl vaccine - known for its stability and suitability for children - faced challenges in reaching the city. This report outlines the quality standards for mass production and transportation of the vaccine and other medical supplies during the war, with a focus on ensuring their efficacy and safety. The innovative use of the more stable second-generation vaccine played a crucial role in protecting the citizens of Jinzhou from TD Outbreak, making it a valuable contribution to the battle against this deadly disease.

1. Quality Standards for Mass Production of Vaccines
2. Management Guidelines for Storage and Transportation of Vaccines
3. Assessment of Current Vaccine Transportation Methods

The transportation of the second-generation Sugar Pearl vaccine is a critical step in combating the TD Outbreak. In response to the challenges posed by interrupted main transportation routes and the treacherous terrain, a thorough plan was implemented. Refrigerated trucks equipped with temperature-monitoring equipment were used, accompanied by professional technicians to ensure proper storage and transport conditions. Additionally, due to the severity of the epidemic and the time sensitivity of vaccine delivery, medical supplies were divided into seven teams for transportation. The assistance of Resonator counterparts was vital in navigating through difficult terrain and potential Tacet Fields. As of August 5, only one team successfully arrived within the vaccine expiration date, thanks to the efforts of an unknown Resonator who escorted us and eliminated the TDs.

...

Comment from Researcher #31: 

Concerning the test report... The Resonator that accompanied the supplies through a fierce battle displayed astounding stability in its waveform. This data is truly remarkable; however, I can't shake the feeling that I've seen it before. Yet, there are no registered Resonators in our database with similar characteristics. What could this mean?

Another Comment from Researcher #31: 

After some searching, I discovered that the data closely resembles the "First Resonator" I came across earlier. However, since we didn't have standardized resonance test reports at that time, it was not included in our current database. I have duly noted and placed it in the pending section for further investigation.

(P.S. Due to health reasons, my supervisor has advised me to take medical leave. As a result, I have entrusted this matter to Section 34, and they will complete the handover tomorrow.)

Comment from Researcher #34: 

The report doesn't seem right. It mentions a person who existed during the founding of our state, but the time span is too long for it to be the same person in both reports. Perhaps this character is from history? I'll wait until the 31st to recover and then inquire about this potential mistake. He's worked three consecutive nights without rest. For now, I'll keep this report with me.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies ████ as a Congenital Resonator.

During the Battle of Gorges of Spirits, a Resonator engaged in combat with an unidentified Tacet Discord ("the Crownless"), resulting in a high-risk victory and resolution of the crisis. FavorWord_110249_Content: Lately, my lady prefers to wake up earlier, so I've been waking her up on time every day… Huh? She sometimes prefer to stay in bed a bit longer?! Is that what she told you? What else did she say? Please, do tell me in detail.
FavorWord_110250_Content: Jianxin... her soul has a beautiful golden hue, and she is a person of respectable character.
FavorWord_110251_Content: That young liondancer? His soul appears in a unique shape, similar to that of an animal... I'm a little ashamed to admit that I once mistook him for a beast from the wild... Ahem. Don't worry, I have since made a formal apology to him, and we've cleared up the misunderstanding.
FavorWord_110252_Content: Baizhi is a brilliant scholar. I once worked with her on a collaborative project, assigned by Madam Magistrate. She will no doubt become a prominent scholar at the Huaxu Academy, and eventually a significant contributor to the study of Remnant Ecoacoustics in Huanglong.
FavorWord_110253_Content: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.
FavorWord_110254_Content: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.
FavorWord_110259_Content: My luck seems better with you around.
FavorWord_110260_Content: Found something you like? Keep them as you will.
FavorWord_110349_Content: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.
FavorWord_110350_Content: When I first met Chixia, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed... She was always vibrant and lively, and her way of thinking was very different from mine. As our understanding of each other grew, we created a unique synergy. Our differences complemented each other perfectly.
FavorWord_110351_Content: We didn't converse frequently, but our cooperation was always seamless. He may experience minor inflammation-related health issues because of his Resonance Ability, so I suggest bringing him Bittberry tea next time. A single cup can relieve his symptoms for a whole day.
FavorWord_110352_Content: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.
FavorWord_110353_Content: The tea Mr. Yuanwu brews always tastes sweeter than those served in teahouses, even if the same recipe and ingredients were used. He told me it was only because he put his sincerity into it. Sincerity... How does it affect the flavor of tea?
FavorWord_110354_Content: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.
FavorWord_110355_Content: Once again, you have demonstrated an unimaginable feat. But compared with how it worked, I am now more curious about you as a person. What kind of new possibilities are you going to show me? I have never felt so much anticipation before... Clearly, you are special to me unlike anyone else.
FavorWord_110362_Content: You found it, and it's yours to keep.
FavorWord_120249_Content: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?
FavorWord_120250_Content: Whoa! You've made me so much stronger than I could have ever imagined! Now I'm finally the superhero I've always wanted to be! You've been here for me every step of the way, and you'll forever be the one I want to protect the most!
FavorWord_120267_Content: Ohhh... please have something good this time!
FavorWord_120268_Content: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!
FavorWord_120269_Content: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.
FavorWord_120270_Content: She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.
FavorWord_120271_Content: Sometimes they'd perform lion dance between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!
FavorWord_120272_Content: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?
FavorWord_120352_Content: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!
FavorWord_120353_Content: Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time!
FavorWord_120354_Content: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time...
FavorWord_120355_Content: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!
FavorWord_120356_Content: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!
FavorWord_120357_Content: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.
FavorWord_120358_Content: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!
FavorWord_120359_Content: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!
FavorWord_120366_Content: There has to be more. Right?
FavorWord_120449_Content: It was Jiyan who rescued me from the wilderness and referred me to the Academy, and I've been thankful for that... I have solved a lot of problems for him in return, of course. For example, all the Midnight Rangers currently use a one-piece medical kit of my design.
FavorWord_120450_Content: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.
FavorWord_120451_Content: Baizhi and I are almost colleagues, though we don't work in the same department. I've only interacted with her briefly on a few occasions, but I had the chance to read some of her writings. Her paper was well-thought-out and carefully expressed, featuring an intriguing perspective. If I may comment, she is an excellent scholar of Remnant Creatures.
FavorWord_120452_Content: Speaking of Chixia, she's a regular visitor at my lab, often bringing children along. She's a straightforward person, which I like. Besides, those who get along with kids are never bad people. Kids are incredibly perceptive of a person's true character.
FavorWord_120453_Content: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!
FavorWord_120454_Content: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.
FavorWord_120455_Content: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.
FavorWord_120461_Content: Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?
FavorWord_130250_Content: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.
FavorWord_130251_Content: Being skilled as a Patroller doesn't necessarily make one suited for undercover work, but curiously enough I see potential in you. Have you considered applying to the Bureau? Just kidding, unless you're interested.
FavorWord_130252_Content: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?
FavorWord_130253_Content: This special power you have entrusted me... Should I take it as a sign of trust in my abilities? Or...perhaps a token of affection for me? Either way, I appreciate the gesture. Your straightforwardness is quite endearing.
FavorWord_130351_Content: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.
FavorWord_130352_Content: Since you've gifted me such a precious treasure, I should give you a matching gift in return. Please, take this Tea Pet—it grants you free access to all the boxing gyms and teahouses in Huanglong. And... if you ever need me, just hand it to any one of the shopkeepers. I will come to your aid as soon as possible, no matter what.
FavorWord_130356_Content: Nice. Let's go check it out.
FavorWord_130357_Content: Found what you're looking for? Good.
FavorWord_130359_Content: Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.
FavorWord_130360_Content: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.
FavorWord_130361_Content: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.
FavorWord_130362_Content: Every morning, when I opened the gym, Chixia was already patrolling the street with exuberant energy. *chuckle*... I must keep up with my exercises too. Can't be outdone by the younger generations.
FavorWord_130363_Content: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.
FavorWord_140249_Content: On the dangerous frontiers where we suffered immense losses, it was General Jiyan who stepped up to protect everyone, making all the tough decisions to ensure our safety. As the backbone of the Midnight Rangers, he has led us to countless victories as our Qingloong. The weight on his shoulders is beyond our imagination.
FavorWord_140250_Content: "When in trouble, ask Chixia, the Ally of Justice!" This statement, while playful, rings very true. With her surging passion, seasoned prowess, and abundant vigor, Chixia already meets every quality a hero should have, helping the people in need.
FavorWord_140251_Content: Baizhi has a unique approach to comprehending and accomplishing tasks, but that doesn't make her a difficult person to talk to. When you ask her for help, you may notice a flicker of surprise on her face, but you will never receive a refusal.
FavorWord_140252_Content: I met Danjin a few times on different occasions. I could tell how much she values justice. She is very clear about when to unsheath her blade, and for what she fights, despite being surprisingly young. Her actions reflect her belief in an ideal world—one that she is determined to create.
FavorWord_140253_Content: Ms. Taoqi is always gracefully poised. She is the kind of person to quickly produce multiple solutions with ease in the most urgent situations, with a smile on her face: "Don't worry. I've got it sorted." Her seemingly unhurried demeanor must have been earned through hard work that we don't know about.
FavorWord_140254_Content: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.
FavorWord_140255_Content: This is it... Rover, you have already done so much for me, I shouldn't ask for more. From now on, I want to be the one taking care of you. Please... will you let me? I hope I can be the one to embrace all that you are, and share with you all that you carry.
FavorWord_140258_Content: This is the answer to our endeavor.
FavorWord_140259_Content: This should suffice for a while.
FavorWord_140349_Content: Say, buddy, we should probably take care of those bills you owe me. Let's see here… Hmm, you know what? I actually made a good chunk of change from the intel you asked for, so why don't we just call it even? Swing by anytime and let's do more business!
FavorWord_140352_Content: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?
FavorWord_140353_Content: Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.
FavorWord_140354_Content: Being the Jinzhou Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.
FavorWord_140355_Content: Oh, Miss Chixia. Our first convo didn't go quite as planned. I was doing some business in Jinzhou at the time, then she tried to arrest me, probably thought I was some crook. Lucky for me we worked it out later.
FavorWord_140356_Content: Miss Yangyang? We haven't talked much, but the way she can tap into the "Streams" for intel is definitely something. As someone in the information game, that really sounds handy. I should see if she's interested in being my informant.
FavorWord_140357_Content: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.
FavorWord_140358_Content: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.
FavorWord_140359_Content: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.
FavorWord_140360_Content: That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the New Federation. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."
FavorWord_140452_Content: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.
FavorWord_140453_Content: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to Jinzhou, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.
FavorWord_140454_Content: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.
FavorWord_140455_Content: She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.
FavorWord_140456_Content: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.
FavorWord_140457_Content: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.
FavorWord_140458_Content: Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.
FavorWord_140459_Content: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.
FavorWord_140460_Content: I have never regretted braving the long night.
FavorWord_140461_Content: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.
FavorWord_140465_Content: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.
FavorWord_150349_Content: Miss Yangyang was curious about my plant growing skills, and she asked me many questions earlier. Then, she patiently listened to me explaining details for a long, long time. Hanging out with her feels like basking in a gentle breeze.
FavorWord_150350_Content: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.
FavorWord_150351_Content: Did you know? "Baizhi" is actually an old name for Angelica, a plant that can bloom beautiful flowers in freezing temperatures. It kinda makes me think of Miss Baizhi herself—some might say she seems a bit chilly, but I have a feeling she's got a warm and gentle heart underneath.
FavorWord_150352_Content: Mr. Mortefi's dedication to his work is remarkable, but I do worry about his well-being... I mean, we all know how important the research project is, but a good night's sleep is just as crucial! Whenever I go and check on the nocturnal plants at night, I can see the lights on in his lab from a distance.
FavorWord_150353_Content: Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her "little"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.
FavorWord_150354_Content: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.
FavorWord_150355_Content: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!
FavorWord_150356_Content: As of late, my thoughts have turned to the wondrous ways in which life flourishes. The fish dance in the sea, the trees root deep in the earth, and the birds take flight in the sky...all thriving and growing in unique ways. You seem to always inspire me to new wonders, too... Would you like to hear about them?
FavorWord_150357_Content: Are those little flowers growing inside?
FavorWord_150358_Content: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.
FavorWord_160149_Content: People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine.
FavorWord_160150_Content: Oh, I wish I had someone like Sanhua. Imagine how much easier my work would be with her help. Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard? I'll have to ask her about it next time we meet.
FavorWord_160151_Content: Mr. Xiangli? Yes, he is a great collaborator of ours at the Ministry of Development. Our work partially overlaps with the Academy's research projects, and I consult him daily. Despite his genius intellect and quick thinking, I have no issue keeping up with his ideas.
FavorWord_160152_Content: General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being.
FavorWord_160153_Content: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?
FavorWord_160154_Content: You have opened my eyes to things I've never noticed before. Safety isn't found in one person building a "wall." It comes from supporting each other, and cherishing shared moments. Thank you for always being here for me. If we could stay like this forever, I... Hmm? You didn't catch that last sentence? Hehe, I'll say it again for you, then...
FavorWord_160163_Content: My luck seems good like always.
FavorWord_160248_Content: Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again.
FavorWord_160249_Content: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.
FavorWord_160250_Content:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze. 
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.
FavorWord_160251_Content: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.
FavorWord_160252_Content: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.
FavorWord_160253_Content: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.
FavorWord_160254_Content: My eyes have been opened... I'm starting to realize how there's so much more to the world than just fighting for justice. There are countless amazing things waiting to be discovered, and the best part is having you by my side.
FavorWord_160261_Content: Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great...
FavorWord_130101_Content: Misconceptions about us abound. Violence is just one tool in our arsenal, not our sole means to an end. Cooperation is our usual aim, but in a world of betrayal and deception, we must make sure backstabbing us is never worth the risk. To maintain efficient cooperation, we demand an ironclad contract with consequences... and that's where necessary violence comes in play.
FavorWord_130102_Content: You're quite good with your sword, but in a world like this, fighting alone will not suffice. Picture this: a single hound may not scare you, but what about a pack? Fear creeps in as you're trapped alone, with no one to guard your back, surrounded by enemies on all fronts. They aren't leaving without blood. Strength comes in numbers... Keep that in mind.
FavorWord_130103_Content: As a leader, one must excel in the art of deception, projecting an image of unwavering composure and offering false reassurance... Every decision you make could change lives. If a day comes when you are in charge of other people, or even the entire world, what choices will you make? Will you bear the weight of their fate, or prioritize your own desires above all else?
FavorWord_130104_Content: You've done your homework on us, it seems. As mercenaries, we take on any job and always deliver... The pay is our only concern. Wherever war and chaos go, the Ghost Hounds will follow. We exist, because there is always demand for our service. How do you perceive us? Though I couldn't care less about others' opinions... I'm open to your thoughts.
FavorWord_130105_Content: Someday, I may need your aid. If my actions steer the Ghost Hounds off course, I'll count on you to right my wrongs... or put an end to my existence. For now, I am happy to enjoy our current alliance.
FavorWord_130106_Content: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.
FavorWord_130107_Content: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...
FavorWord_130108_Content: Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.
FavorWord_130109_Content: ...Out in the wild, food preferences don't matter. I only care about what's edible.
FavorWord_130110_Content: Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.
FavorWord_130111_Content: The deaths of our kind are likely to go unnoticed. It's our destiny—fleeting, like dust in the wind. Each of us bears a dog tag with our name and story etched upon it, as a form of legacy... A symbol of our existence, no less than a declaration of it.
FavorWord_130112_Content: In the Underworld, it's all about survival of the fittest. Either you dominate as the apex predator, or you're doomed to be devoured by those above you. It's the brutal law of the land. In a world where might makes right, we must rise to the very top to remain free from others' schemes, and preserve our autonomy.
FavorWord_130113_Content: He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from Huanglong, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.
FavorWord_130114_Content: Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.
FavorWord_130115_Content: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.
FavorWord_130116_Content: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.
FavorWord_130117_Content: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.
FavorWord_130118_Content: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.
FavorWord_130122_Content: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
FavorWord_130124_Content: You should have the payment ready by now.
FavorWord_130125_Content: Curious you'd want me to join you in person...
FavorWord_130126_Content: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.
FavorWord_130127_Content: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?
FavorWord_130128_Content: ...Your kindness, I have certainly received. Naturally, I'll work for you in return.
FavorWord_130129_Content: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.
FavorWord_130130_Content: *amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.
FavorWord_130131_Content: I owe you a debt that cannot be easily repaid. The Ghost Hounds have their stance to maintain, and I cannot make decisions for my people lightly. However, I am willing to accept this "contract"... on my own terms. Speak, and your wish will be granted, no questions asked.
FavorWord_130138_Content: Let slip the dogs of war!
FavorWord_130167_Content: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.
FavorWord_130168_Content: I trust you can use it to the full.
FavorWord_110403_Content: Words hold incredible power. In Huanglong, we believe spoken words may manifest into reality. Then if even jokes have a chance to come true, why not good wishes and blessings? That's why we should always express our positive thoughts out loud. Who knows, maybe there is a higher power listening and ready to grant our desires. So, I make sure to say my Lucky Greetings to everyone, as often as possible!
FavorWord_110404_Content: I wish I could show you my hometown, but it's not the same anymore. It's been turned into a Tacet Field, without any life or joy. I prefer living in vibrant places, where there's energy and excitement. But one day, when we overcome the Lament and bring back the beauty of this land, I'll take you there. You'll see the tallest trees, twinkling fireflies, and a river glittering with stars... Yes, we'll see that day...
FavorWord_110405_Content: I'm no longer afraid of letting people see my real appearance, but... I guess I still look rather different, and not everyone is so accepting of that. Sometimes I just want to lend a helping hand, and they'd assume I'm trying to claw at them or something... Erm, what do you think, Rover? Do I look scary to you?
FavorWord_110406_Content: I love people-watching. It's fascinating to see so many different faces and backgrounds come to watch the liondance. Each person brings their own story and personality... I guess they're just, just like... leaves? I've never come across two identical leaves. Every one of them is unique. And you, Rover, I want to know more about you so bad... Tell me more, please?
FavorWord_110407_Content: "Feel the drum and dance along," they say. In lion dancing, there isn't really a set melody we dance to. It's all about finding the perfect balance between movement and music. Everyone in our troupe must attend both Mr. Wufang's liondance classes and Mr. Qixing's drumming classes. And let me tell you, I struggle with the drums. Catching the beat is always tricky. I do better in the liondance class, but I often get lost in the dance and forget to keep up with the beat... Luckily, I can still manage to pull off the performance smoothly, thanks to my fellow troupe members. They often tweak the drumbeat tempo to match my rhythm. As my Master likes to point out, I'm a classic case of being "good at some things but not so much at others".
FavorWord_110408_Content: Medium-rare is the way to go for grilled meat. That tender texture with a hint of secret spices... mmm, delicious! Trust me, I know all about it. Have you tried those "Medium Rare" skewers in Jinzhou? I'm the genius behind them, and now they're all the rage!
FavorWord_110409_Content: Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better?
FavorWord_110410_Content: The liondance tradition is all about banishing evil, guarding fortune, and beckoning blessings. I want to be the best dancer out there to keep this tradition thriving. My Master always reminds me not to aim too high and bite off more than I can chew. I know there's still a long road ahead in perfecting my skills, but as long as I keep moving steadily from one pole to another, like we do in the tournaments, I'll surely reach my goal, no matter how high or far away it may seem.
FavorWord_110411_Content: Why do I keep this liondance head with me? Well, when I first got to Jinzhou, I was afraid to take it off. I didn't want people to see that I looked different from everyone else. Wearing the head made me feel safe, like I could hide my appearance and just focus on dancing. Maybe back then, I thought that only by wearing the liondance head could I truly be myself without judgement.
FavorWord_110412_Content: For some reason, people seem obsessed with my tail. Sometimes my seniors like to play their little drums to the beat of my swishing tail. But honestly, I have no idea how to control it. It's more like some kind of... reflex? When I feel happy—like right now, it just starts wagging on its own.
FavorWord_110413_Content: In Jinzhou, the liondance tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our Liondance Troupe has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.
FavorWord_110414_Content: Liondance is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding.
FavorWord_110415_Content: The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the Ministry of Development. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.
FavorWord_110416_Content: Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!
FavorWord_110417_Content: Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our Liondance Troupe! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand!
FavorWord_110418_Content: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!
FavorWord_110419_Content: I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place!
FavorWord_110420_Content: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'Tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was...
FavorWord_110421_Content: Happy birthday! May your life be filled with joy and delight, as you chase your dreams and reach new heights. May happiness follow wherever you go, may your journey be a wonderful show! Hehe, I've come up with a special liondance just for you! Can you spend some more time here with me today? Because, well, this dance might run a little long.
FavorWord_110423_Content: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!
FavorWord_110425_Content: Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums...
FavorWord_110426_Content: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!
FavorWord_110427_Content: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!
FavorWord_110428_Content: Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in!
FavorWord_110429_Content: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?
FavorWord_110430_Content: Here's to a safe journey ahead.
FavorWord_110431_Content: Great! That's a new move for me!
FavorWord_110432_Content: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.
FavorWord_110433_Content: So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.
FavorWord_110434_Content: My Master once told me this: Never lose reverence for the "highest pole", no matter how much you've achieved. There's always someone better, and always more to learn, so we should always stay humble. I'll keep cultivating myself with this reverence in mind. Besides, there's someone right in front of me that I want to catch up to.
FavorWord_110435_Content: Legend has it that the liondance was created by ancient sages, inspired by the movement of constellations in the sky. True mastery of it allows one to draw power from the world, to form a miniature cosmos within. ...Now I think I've finally caught a glimpse into that realm. I've still got a long way ahead, but at least I can better protect you now.
FavorWord_110441_Content: Beat the drum. Ready to prance!
FavorWord_110481_Content: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!
FavorWord_140501_Content: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!
FavorWord_140502_Content: Erm, actually... I wonder just how you seem to know so much. I've been to the cities a few times, but I know very little compared to you. Can I ask you for help next time I run into things I don't understand? Please bear with me, though, as it may take me some time to catch on...
FavorWord_140503_Content: I grew up in my sect, on a remote, secluded mountain. Most people may find it a bit challenging to make it there, but it should be easy for you. I can take you there if you want. Hehe, honestly, I've always wanted to bring you home as my guest!
FavorWord_140504_Content: I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.
FavorWord_140505_Content: I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.
FavorWord_140506_Content: My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.
FavorWord_140507_Content: Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.
FavorWord_140508_Content: My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.
FavorWord_140509_Content: There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.
FavorWord_140510_Content: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
FavorWord_140511_Content: I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.
FavorWord_140512_Content: To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.
FavorWord_140513_Content: Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.
FavorWord_140514_Content: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.
FavorWord_140515_Content: I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!
FavorWord_140518_Content: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...
FavorWord_140519_Content: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
FavorWord_140520_Content: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.
FavorWord_140522_Content: What will I learn from this fight?
FavorWord_140524_Content: This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.
FavorWord_140525_Content: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!
FavorWord_140526_Content: This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!
FavorWord_140527_Content: Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!
FavorWord_140528_Content: Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.
FavorWord_140554_Content: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
FavorWord_140555_Content: Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_3: I will be going on a temporary leave. During my absence, please help me handle my responsibilities in Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_4: Understood. Should I continue protecting that Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_5: No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more than enough paperwork for you to handle.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_6: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_7: Please pardon my intrusion, but {Male=he;Female=she} just faced an ambush in the Central Plains. What if...
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_8: Regarding that incident... We tried to warn {Male=him;Female=her} about the Fractsidus, but they were more cunning than we thought.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_9: If {Male=he;Female=she} runs into another powerful enemy like Scar, {Male=he;Female=she}'ll eventually have to confront them on {Male=his;Female=her} own.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_10: Sanhua, you can place more trust in Rover and me.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_12: My lady... No matter what happens, my sword is always yours.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_13: Both the interrogation and my appointed meeting with Rover have already finished.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_14: Scar only needed the two of you as his audience. We already knew what he wanted, and we let him have as much.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_15: {Male=He;Female=She} decrypted every message we intended to convey. It's only proper you meet {Male=him;Female=her} in person, as the one who crafted those puzzles.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_16: Such intricate puzzles... I guess only Rover has the patience to solve them all.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_17: No detail is too small. I'm sure {Male=he;Female=she} understands. Besides... Not seeing the opponent heightens the thrill of the game.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_18: If everything goes according to the prophecies of Jué, I will meet {Male=him;Female=her} in person eventually.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_19: So... What did our captive from the Fractsidus tell you about Jué?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_20: ...That Jué had predicted I will have to fight it one day. A fight that will shape Jinzhou's future.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_21: Well, that is... unexpected. But you don't seem all that surprised, do you?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_22: Can't say I am. I had suspected as much from our previous conversations, and the message it left me... His words only confirmed it.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_23: Where was it when you last sensed its presence?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_24: It was... In Mt. Firmament. Unlike Jinzhou city, that mountain is still resting in "stillness."
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_25: The place where the first people of Jinzhou lived, and where Jué first manifested before us humans... I see.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_26: I'll find Jué and bring it back as soon as possible.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_27: Our enemies could have planned it as a trap. We have a bigger goal to focus on, remember?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_28: I understand. I will not let anything or anyone disrupt the peace in Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_29: Would you let what you heard from Scar sway your determination?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_30: No, he cannot ever turn me against Jué. If anything, his words only confirmed my theory.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_31: I am the Magistrate of Jinzhou, appointed by the Sentinel itself.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_32: The prophecy speaks of a decisive incident for Jinzhou's future, where I will be a key player. The fight between me and Jué is only a precursor.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_33: My job remains unchanged. I will fulfill my duty as Jinzhou's Magistrate with my own judgment.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_35: A single strand's neglect births mountainous upheaval. You taught me that, remember?
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_36: The safest option is for me to go in person.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_38: Since we are already mid-game, I will let you decide our next move.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_39: This time, I shall be a pawn in your hand.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_40: Remember I will always stand by your side, in this crisis or any other.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_41: ...Am I a player or a mere pawn? I suppose there is no difference at this point.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_42: No matter what, I will do what I must.
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_3: I see... The Black Shores must have a deep connection to your past.
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_4: Since you are likely being closely monitored by the Fractsidus now...
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_5: I suggest keeping an eye out for the Black Shore members. They could prove to be your valuable allies.
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_6: I'll do my best to find Jué, and tell you everything I learned from it once I return.
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_9: Yes. Please leave it to me.
Huanglong_main_1_5_82_2: I saw something... I was wearing the Blake Bloom...
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_3: ...Sorry, Rover. What he mentioned about our Sentinel is... highly sensitive. I cannot disclose it yet, not before verifying it myself.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_4: Is it a ploy to create distrust among us, or... I must first find our Sentinel to uncover the truth.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_6: Jué is the Guardian Sentinel of Jinzhou. It is responsible for assisting Jinzhou's Magistrate in administrative affairs.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_7: While I am final decision maker... Without the assistance of Jué, I cannot guarantee I'm always making the best choices for my people.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_10: T-Thank you. I am glad you think so.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_11: Jué can predict the future, and up to this point, every one of its prophecies have been proven true.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_12: Jué can predict the future, and up to this point, every one of its prophecies have been proven true.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_13: While justice may not be universally agreed upon, its decisions have consistently served the best interests of Huanglong.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_16: For that... I suppose we will have to talk to it in person to find out.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_17: In addition, Rover, Jué once told me to deliver a message to you.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_18: "To the Awakened One: When raindrops fall upstream, please head to the Norfall Barrens, and seek General Jiyan of the Midnight Rangers."
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_21: I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_22: But the ongoing war has made it a very dangerous place to go.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_23: Since you won't need to go there right now, not until when the "raindrops fall upstream"...
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_24: I know you're here for clues about your true identity, and I don't want you to leave the city empty-handed.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_25: Have you heard about the Black Shores, Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_26: It's an organization shrouded in mystery, with a secretive membership process and members who usually keep their identities hidden.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_27: Upon your awakening, one of their members discreetly contacted me to gather information about you.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_28: But please don't worry. The Black Shores developed a special Lament prediction system, and has established partnerships with countries worldwide.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_29: While operating in secrecy, they are not an extremist group like the Fractsidus.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_30: They have been monitoring the situation in Jinzhou to provide assistance when needed.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_31: Thanks to their extra help, my meeting with you went smoothly.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_32: This Blake Bloom is their symbol. The Black Shores members usually wear it on their person.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_36: The Black Shores once provided us significant insights into the relationship between the moon and Threnodians.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_37: This time, they've come to inform us a Threnodian is about to resurrect near Jinzhou.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_38: Apart from that, I am not sure what else they may be hoping to achieve.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_39: Rover, after the recent series of events, I trust you have gained a general idea of who you might have been.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_40: Before you fell into that deep slumber, you likely played a significant role in important historical events, shaping the course of history in some way.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_41: Ultimately... I suppose it is up to you to discover the final definitive answer for yourself.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_42: Yes, I suppose it does make them stand out. On the other hand, they presumably possess extraordinary abilities to stay anonymous.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_43: This photo is yours to keep. I will return with Jué shortly, and the Black Shores may be worth your try during this time.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_5: How important is Jué to Jinzhou?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_8: You seem to be doing well enough on your own.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_9: Why are you so sure Jué is always right?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_14: Perhaps it left to set Jinzhou's future right.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_15: Perhaps it intended to let you make your own decisions.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_19: So I'll need to find this General Jiyan?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_20: So I'll need to go to the Norfall Barrens?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_33: What do they want to achieve in Jinzhou?
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_34: There sure are a lot of people keeping an eye on me.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_35: Wouldn't that make them easy to spot?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_1: Scar, you are now under arrest for committing multiple felonies in Huanglong. Do you have anything to say?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_2: What do I want to say, huh? While I'd love to tell you another story... I guess that's not what you want to hear.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_3: Let's cut to the chase, “Madam Magistrate.” I'm getting bored already.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_4: Very well. You will answer only our questions from now on.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_5: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_11: A <ano=Oracle Engine>Sentinel</ano> such as Jué can predict and "correct" future events. It gets in our way of achieving our sublime vision.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_12: We merely wanted to topple the set future built on lies, and take control of our own destiny.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_13: The Threnodians... They hold the key to our ideal.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_14: Together they will bring us the promised "true Lament," and we will embrace the new world that is bound to come.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_15: What is the Lament? Disaster? Curse? Some kind of punishment? Ha! People only see the surface...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_16: The Lament brings death, destruction, and countless Reverberations.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_17: Reverberations that will be reflected, overlapped, and interwoven during the Lament... They will be our salvation, the only path to a new lifeform and a new civilization.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_18: Our goal has always been the same... We want you. Want you to join us.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_21: Forces battle over you, causing all this strife, and yet you remain unaware of your own worth... Are you really that naive, or are you just dense?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_22: Whatever. Our interest in you is not affected by such trivial matters.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_23: Too bad. We will then be forced to kill you, by any means necessary...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_24: But I'm sure you'll willingly come to us... When the time arrives.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_25: You kidnapped Jué and revived the Threnodian, accelerating the next Lament... This is proof enough that you are the enemy of Jinzhou, and all humanity.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_26: Stop dreaming you can force Rover to join you. {Male=He;Female=She} is our honored guest, and I will not allow any harm to come {Male=his;Female=her} way.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_27: Ha! How confident you sound. As the Threnodian's resurrection approaches, Jinzhou is barely holding on. How much longer do you think you can keep up this facade?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_28: Thank you for your concern. We have crushed your schemes once, and we can do it again.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_29: I have one last question for you. Abducting "Jué," stalking Rover, and setting up an ambush in Qichi Village... You couldn't have accomplished that all on your own.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_31: Unless I'm not the only Overseer in Jinzhou, right? Hahaha...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_32: I have answered all your questions with full honesty. I don't mind you knowing, because it won't make any difference.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_33: You can try to stop us with all you have... But it's too late to change the course of history.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_34: Now, I have one question for you...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_35: You seem convinced we caused the disappearance of Jué... What if I told you there was more to it? Would you be curious?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_36: About Jué... What else do you know?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_37: Come closer and I'll tell you, Madam Magistrate... It's a secret for your ears only...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_38: How dare you! Madam Magistrate, I...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_40: Shocked, aren't you? But there's more...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_41: What if I told you... Your Sentinel had made this prophecy a long, long time ago?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_42: Your all-seeing Sentinel abandons you now of all times. Need I say more?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_43: We're merely adding a touch of extra fuel to the fire that will soon consume all.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_44: Rover, care for a wager? I know you've been searching for answers about your past, and I've got news for you—
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_46: You are one of us, the "black lambs," and you have been chosen to join us ushering in the new world...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_47: Once you discover what you really are, you will come to us with no hesitation.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_48: The Fractsidus awaits your arrival with open arms.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_49: And I look forward to that day in sincere anticipation...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_51: After the interrogation, Scar is put in jail...
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_7: Why are you obsessed with reviving the Threnodian?
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_8: What on earth is the Lament?

HelpText_51_Content:
All new content Phantasm Amass is now available!

[About]
As the Somnoire's expansion comes to a halt, the domain beyond the gateway appears far from restoring its former peace. New chaos emerges from abnormal dreams trapped in a spiral of fallacy. Hearing the whispers from your subconscious, you find yourself standing before that very gateway once again...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "When the Night Knocks" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Only certain available Resonators are available in the Depths of Illusive Realm challenges.
The Illusive Realm harbors a special power that nullifies the Resonators' Echo stats. However, exclusive Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, Tokens, and special Resonator enhancements await those who explore.
Experiment with party lineups and builds for different combat experiences.
Explore the Illusive Realm for great rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the dream mass found at the deepest parts of the realm. Use Reward Attempts to collect its rewards.
Remnant Crystal Reward Attempts reset every Monday at 04:00 A.M. server time.
The Remnant Crystal grants equal rewards across all Phantasm Amass difficulties.
