GuideTutorialPage_1000001_Content: When a Tacet Discord is defeated, the remaining frequency may become an <color=#ffd12f>Echo</color>. You can obtain <color=#ffd12f>Data Bank</color> EXP by absorbing an Echo for the first time. Level up Data Bank to raise the probability of Echo drop.
GuideTutorialPage_1000002_Content: Damaging or defeating enemies grants <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Energy</color>. When Resonance Energy is full, the powerful <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Liberation</color> becomes available.
GuideTutorialPage_1000003_Content:
After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_1000004_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.
GuideTutorialPage_1000005_Content: Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_1000006_Content: When the enemy is about to use certain moves, a <color=#ffd12f>Weakness Halo</color> will appear. Attack in time to trigger a <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> to block the incoming attack and gain an upper hand.
GuideTutorialPage_1000007_Content: Perform Dodge at the right moment to avoid enemy attacks. A successful <color=#ffd12f>Dodge</color> grants <color=#ffd12f>damage immunity</color> for a limited amount of time, allowing you to perform <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counter</color> in your next Basic Attack.
GuideTutorialPage_1000008_Content: Deal damage to reduce enemy <color=#ffd12f>Vibration Strength</color>. <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> greatly reduces enemy Vibration Strength. When the Vibration Strength is fully depleted, the enemy is <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> and cannot take any action for a period of time.
GuideTutorialPage_1000009_Content: When some enemies are <color=#b49f50>Immobilized</color>, you can use <color=#b49f50>Finishing Attack</color> to deal great damage to them. After taking the Finishing Attack, they will recover from Immobolized.
GuideTutorialPage_1000010_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Grapple module</color> can help to overcome complex terrain. When it is used directly, the operator can <color=#ffd12f>leap</color> a short distance upwards.
GuideTutorialPage_1000011_Content: There are <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color> in overworld, and you can make a long-distance leap by aiming your Grapple at them.
GuideTutorialPage_1000012_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> module in the Utility helps reveal valuable content in the scene, such as <color=#ffd12f>collectibles</color>, <color=#ffd12f>enemy weaknesses</color>, etc.
GuideTutorialPage_1000013_Content:
Resonators gain <color=#ffd12f>Concerto Energy</color> when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat.
When Concerto Energy is full, the other Resonators' icons will glow up.
GuideTutorialPage_1000014_Content: By reaching a higher <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color>, you will have the opportunity to gain more <color=#ffd12f>rewards</color> after defeating enemies or clearing Sonoro Spheres. However, be warned that the enemies you encounter will also be more <color=#ffd12f>dangerous</color>, and vice versa.
GuideTutorialPage_1000015_Content: After clearing Tacet Fields, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and the <color=#ffd12f>collected Echoes</color> of the corresponding Sonata set.
GuideTutorialPage_1000016_Content: Tacet Fields will revive periodically, so you can challenge them repeatedly for materials. It should be noted that you need to consume the Waveplates to obtain the materials.
GuideTutorialPage_1000017_Content: A Simulation Training Ground located in Jinzhou. Complete the trials to obtain necessary materials for Resonator upgrade and development. Increase <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color> to unlock more rewarding trials.
GuideTutorialPage_1000018_Content: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. If you are lucky enough to discover one, the <color=#ffd12f>Relic Merchants</color> will gladly exchange valuable items for it.
GuideTutorialPage_1000019_Content: The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
GuideTutorialPage_1000020_Content: The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
GuideTutorialPage_1000021_Content: A common general-purpose training mechanism. Find and hit all the mechanisms to complete the training.
GuideTutorialPage_1000022_Content: A common intelligent training target. Different targets have different <color=#ffd12f>training rules</color>. After activation, drones will be released. Hit all the drones to complete the training.
GuideTutorialPage_1000023_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Propulsion Flux</color> is a gravitational anomaly in the overworld. <color=#ffd12f>Use the Glider</color> in it to <color=#ffd12f>lift</color> the Resonator.
GuideTutorialPage_1000024_Content:
Accumulate <color=#ffd12f>Union EXP</color> to increase <color=#ffd12f>Union Level</color> and unlock more quests and activities.
You can quickly obtain Union EXP through the following ways: 
I. Complete the <color=#ffd12f>Daily Activity</color> quests.
II. <color=#ffd12f>Consume Waveplates</color>.
III. <color=#ffd12f>Complete various quests</color>.
IV. <color=#ffd12f>Open Supply Chests</color> and complete gameplay activities in the overworld.
GuideTutorialPage_1000025_Content: Absorb Echoes to increase Data Bank level. The higher the level, the higher the <color=#ffd12f>Drop Rate</color> of Echoes and the higher the <color=#ffd12f>max absorbable Rarity</color> of Echoes.
GuideTutorialPage_1000026_Content:
Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Gulpuff</color> to take on the challenge and reach the finish line within the specified time.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Dash</color> button to speed up the Gulpuff. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Jump</color> button to make the Gulpuff jump.
GuideTutorialPage_1000027_Content: Tap the button when the <color=#ffd12f>frequency signal</color> reaches the <color=#ffd12f>designated area</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_1000028_Content: For <color=#ffd12f>short signals</color>, tap the button briefly. For <color=#ffd12f>long signals</color>, hold the button and release it according to the signal length.
GuideTutorialPage_1000029_Content: Some special frequencies will form visible Acoustic Prints. Follow the Acoustic Prints and find the source of the sounds.
GuideTutorialPage_1000030_Content: Select and use the Zoom Camera via the wheel to locate targets.
GuideTutorialPage_1000031_Content: The requirements of the photo are shown on the left. When met, they turn green. Tap the camera icon on the right to shoot.
GuideTutorialPage_1000032_Content: Once you've taken the photo, if a "Goal Completed" pop-up appears at the top, tap the upper-right corner to exit.
GuideTutorialPage_1000033_Content:
The <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color> emits a golden light, with unstable energy contained within it.
After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab it.
GuideTutorialPage_1000034_Content: After grabbing <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color>, you can either throw it <color=#ffd12f>directly</color> at the target or use <color=#ffd12f>Aim</color> to <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> where it lands. Once thrown, the Tacetite Fulminate will trigger a violent explosion.
GuideTutorialPage_5000301_Content: Connect the pipelines to ensure the fuel in the tank smoothly reaches the ignition device, enabling the flames ejected to achieve the firepower required to activate the sensor.
GuideTutorialPage_5000401_Content:
A poor-quality spear barrel will be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full, granting the Resonator a temporary <color=#ffd12f>Immunity</color> to the surrounding Incinero Petal Pollens.
A good-quality spear barrel will not be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full. It can be used to assemble the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_5000601_Content: You can crush the scrapped vehicles and boxes along the road. They may contain useful materials.
GuideTutorialPage_32001_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> to interrupt enemy actions.
GuideTutorialPage_32002_Content: Most of your enemy's moves can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>. Frequently use Counterattacks to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength and put it into an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32003_Content: When the Impermanence Heron raises its wings to protect its head, it will enter a defensive state. Use the Intro Skill to reduce its Vibration Strength, putting it in an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32004_Content: When Inferno Rider casts its charge, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>special Echo</color> to defend. Successful defense will put it in a <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32005_Content: You can avoid ground shock attacks by getting to a higher ground.
GuideTutorialPage_32006_Content: When Lampylumen Myriad is in the air, you can attack the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Chrysalises</color> on the ground to shoot it down. Your <color=#ffd12f>Freeze Meter</color> will grow as you are exposed to the attacks of Lampylumen Myriad, the attacks of the Ice Chrysalises, and the fog on the ground. When your Freeze Meter is filled, you will be <color=#ffd12f>Frozen</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32007_Content: The grab attacks deal massive damage. Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> to block the grab attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32008_Content: After taking a certain amount of damage, Mech Abomination shapeshifts and releases a powerful attack.
GuideTutorialPage_32009_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Destroy the legs, head, and the ancient bell</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength. Using <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> against the giant ice balls will also greatly deplete its Vibration Strength, <color=#ffd12f>but it's not an easy task to achieve</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32010_Content: After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32011_Content: After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32012_Content: After entering the berserk state, it will gain a shield and <color=#ffd12f>great DMG Reduction</color>. When the <color=#ffd12f>shield</color> is destroyed, its Vibration Strength will be greatly depleted.
GuideTutorialPage_32013_Content: When the Roseshroom enters the charging state, target the <color=#ffd12f>core at its head</color> with <color=#ffd12f>Pistols</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength.
GuideTutorialPage_32014_Content: The Hoochief Cyclone can generate a wind field to restrict the movement of Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_32015_Content: The Autopuppet Scout can generate an ice wall to block ranged attacks from Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_32016_Content:
The Fusion Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Fusion</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which greatly increases the damage they deal.
The Fusion Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent damage bonus for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32017_Content:
The Glacio Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Glacio</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which grant them Super Armor (their moves won't be interrupted when hit).
The Glacio Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Super Armor state for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32018_Content:
The Spectro Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Spectro</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which periodically grants them a shield.
The Spectro Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent shield for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32019_Content:
The Havoc Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Havoc</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which allows them to deplete Resonators' Resonance Energy with their attacks.
The Havoc Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Energy Depletion effect for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32020_Content: When an Excarat burrows underground, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to force it to surface.
GuideTutorialPage_32021_Content: The Traffic Illuminator can put Resonators in a <color=#ffd12f>stagnant</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_34001_Content:
In the wild, where Tacetite clusters develop freely, sometimes <color=#ffd12f>Spikes</color> can be found blocking the path or <color=#ffd12f>sealing off</color> items or puzzles.
Look closely around the Spikes for <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color>. They will dissolve the Spikes.
GuideTutorialPage_3400101_Content:
After interacting with Corroders nearby, the <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color> will temporarily <color=#ffd12f>follow</color> you.
Bring them <color=#ffd12f>close to Spikes</color>, and they will dissolve the golden pillar to the side, eventually dissolving the Spikes.
GuideTutorialPage_34002_Content:
Use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the Induction Cell Socket to turn on or off the mechanical device.
Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Sockets of corresponding colors</color> to activate the puzzles, or the Induction Cells will be popped.
GuideTutorialPage_3400201_Content: Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the corresponding colored Induction Cell Sockets to activate the puzzles.
GuideTutorialPage_34003_Content: Use Levitator to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Changer</color> to change the operating mode of the Induction Cell, and <color=#ffd12f>change</color> the current <color=#ffd12f>color</color> of the Induction Cell.
GuideTutorialPage_34004_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Fragile rocks</color> can be destroyed by means like Basic Attacks. You might find good things inside.
GuideTutorialPage_34005_Content: Touch the <color=#ffd12f>signs</color> to restore a certain amount of <color=#ffd12f>STA</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34006_Content: After activation, it will summon enemies in the form of a projection. <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> all <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> to complete the challenge and receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34007_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34008_Content: After activation, <color=#ffd12f>reach the finish line</color> or <color=#ffd12f>collect a certain amount of Target Points</color> within the specified time to claim the corresponding rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34009_Content: When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Jump</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
GuideTutorialPage_3400901_Content: When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Speed</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>launched</color> in the direction of the arrow.
GuideTutorialPage_340090102_Content: When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Slow</color>, STA consumed will increase and their <color=#ffd12f>Movement Speed will be reduced</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34010_Content: When the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Hub</color> is locked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Consoles</color> that are connected to the Signals Hub but hidden in a different location.
GuideTutorialPage_3401001_Content: After interacting with the Signals Console, you will start the <color=#ffd12f>Decryption</color>. The Signals Hub will only be unlocked after all Signals Consoles are decrypted.
GuideTutorialPage_34011_Content:
The Weight Block is located near the Pressure Platform. Use the Levitator to grab the Weight Block, and then use the Levitator again to position it at the intended landing spot.
Unlock the Utility to access this feature.
GuideTutorialPage_3401101_Content:
The Weight Block is placed near the Pressure Table. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the <color=#ffd12f>Weight Block</color> and place it at the intended <color=#ffd12f>landing</color> spot.
When the Weight Block is placed on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color>, it will <color=#ffd12f>stick</color> to it.
GuideTutorialPage_3401102_Content:
You need to <color=#ffd12f>place an object</color> on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color> to <color=#ffd12f>activate</color> it.
When there is <color=#ffd12f>no object placed</color> on the Pressure Table, the item(s) controlled by it will be <color=#ffd12f>locked</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34012_Content:
After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color>
to place the scattered <color=#ffd12f>Components back to the Matrix</color>.
While using Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction of the Components.
GuideTutorialPage_34013_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Key Repeaters</color> emit the Decryption Pulses in different directions. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to place the Key Repeaters on the Encryption Blocks. While using the Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction in which the Decryption Pulse is emitted.
GuideTutorialPage_34015_Content:
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Shooter</color> to launch temporary <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color>, facilitating swift movement of the Resonators.
Unlock the Utility to play this.
GuideTutorialPage_34016_Content: When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Flobble</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
GuideTutorialPage_34019_Content: Following the instruction on the track, <color=#ffd12f>attack the Magnetic Cube</color> to move it along the specified direction. When Magnetic Cubes <color=#ffd12f>reach</color> specified <color=#ffd12f>Magnetic Conveyors</color>, the challenge is completed.
GuideTutorialPage_34020_Content:
Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Cruisewing</color> to take on a flying challenge and collect as many Coins as possible within a specified time to earn points.
The higher your points, the better rewards you can unlock.
During the flight, <color=#ffd12f>rotate your view</color> to change your route. Hold the Accelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>speed up</color>, and hold the Decelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>slow down</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34021_Content:
These mysterious Tacet Discords are scattered across the world, holding a special interest in human items. Unexpected rewards often await where they linger.
<color=#ffd12f>Blobflies</color> follow a <color=#ffd12f>fixed route</color>. If they fly too high, try shooting it down using <color=#ffd12f>ranged attacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34022_Content: After gliding through the <color=#ffd12f>Gravitation Vortex Ring</color>, you will be granted <color=#ffd12f>acceleration</color> in the specified direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34024_Content: Tap the button when the frequency signal reaches the designated area.
GuideTutorialPage_3402401_Content: Tap the button briefly for short signals. For longer signals hold the button for a while and release it according to the signal length.
GuideTutorialPage_34025_Content: Use Lingyang's Plunging Attacks to destroy the obstacles or avoid them along the path to your destination.
GuideTutorialPage_34026_Content:
After interacting with the puppet mechanism, you will enter the <color=#ffd12f>Puppet Control</color> state.
In this state, you can leave the puppet where it is <color=#ffd12f>whenever necessary</color> and <color=#ffd12f>switch back</color> to control your Resonator.
Utilize the puppet to access places beyond your reach and deactivate the laser mechanisms obstructing your way.
GuideTutorialPage_34027_Content: Interact with the special mechanisms to rotate and shift the scene.
GuideTutorialPage_34028_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to hit the mechanism on the ground to match the random patterns with the <color=#ffd12f>Target Patterns</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34029_Content: Use the <color=#ffd12f>Spinning</color> Device to <color=#ffd12f>connect pathways</color> and complete the information transmission.
GuideTutorialPage_34030_Content: The areas contaminated by toxic spores are highly dangerous. Prolonged exposure may cause limited visibility and difficulty in breathing. If you encounter such areas during exploration, please <color=#ffd12f>leave</color> the contaminated areas as soon as possible.
GuideTutorialPage_34031_Content: After the challenge starts, use the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charges</color> and other means reasonably to <color=#ffd12f>hit</color> as many <color=#ffd12f>targets</color> as possible.
GuideTutorialPage_34032_Content: The Overdash Club has set up various tracks for the challenge. You can choose any one of the unlocked tracks for your challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_3403201_Content: After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time while collecting as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_3403202_Content: The Overdash Club has set up various modules in the tracks. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to avoid the traps at the same time.

Flow_11000008_31: The recent adventure story was about the Icebreakers, who ventured into places far and between, like the distant polar oceans, the revived volcanoes, and the Great Rift Valley after the Lament occurred.
Flow_11000008_32: They reported about nature's warning signs that they spot around the world and became the first witnesses of countless powerful Tacet Discord.
Flow_11000008_33: After hearing these stories, Zhuyi suddenly became restless and applied to the Association to join the next expedition to the unchartered danger zones.
Flow_11000008_34: I'm worried that he's moving too fast and might make the mistakes I made before.
Flow_11000008_35: Later, in one of the missions, I rushed forward without properly surveying the terrain and accidentally fell into a cave.
Flow_11000008_36: As a result, I injured my thigh, and since then had to gradually retire from the field. Now I'm starting to think about transferring to support.
Flow_11000008_37: What if he makes my mistake again?
Flow_11000008_38: Rover, if you have a solution, you must tell me.
Flow_11000008_40: We can see the former glory of the skyscrapers from the remnants, and what used to be a lustrous sea of flowers from the withered petals.
Flow_11000008_41: Just like magic. Takes everyone back to the past.
Flow_11000008_42: But there are also members of the Icebreakers who discovered their Resonance in times of crisis. Perhaps it's the same for me.
Flow_11000008_43: You'll never know if you never try.
Flow_11000008_44: Oh, and we're now accepting pre-orders for our new merchandise. What do you say, wanna snag one for yourself?
Flow_11000008_46: We record and share the progress of human civilization's revival and reconstruction.
Flow_11000008_47: Our skilled photographers are always out capturing the world's latest marvels!
BackgroundCard_80060003_AttributesDescri: A symbol of triumph and hope, never to falter or fall.
BackgroundCard_80060004_AttributesDescri: Purify the mystical mirror to align with heaven's will.
Flow_11000009_53: I am wondering if Taoqi's "slow response" is deliberate.
Flow_11000009_54: This way, there is more time to see what is happening around you. Should I also try to learn it?
Flow_11000009_55: But if I leave a deliberate opening in the setup to guide the enemy's attack in another direction, you'd be more targeted and prepared in your defense.
Flow_11000009_56: Hehe, my idea is not bad, right? This theory is not only limited to Jinzhou. It can also be extended to other places.
Flow_11000009_57: But I've sensed I didn't come up with the idea myself. I got the inspiration elsewhere. Perhaps, in the textbook, or in one of Taoqi's sharing sessions?
Flow_11000009_58: Well, let's try this direction first.
Flow_11000009_59: Instead of strategizing on paper out of pure imagination.
Flow_11000009_60: It's normal for ordinary people to be curious about the unknown Tacetite weapon, but if you're serious about studying it–
Flow_11000009_61: –you should master the basics of Tacetite before you get ahead of yourself.
Flow_11000009_62: Like this, asking me every day, the work in my hands is almost too busy.
Flow_11000009_63: Not far away, you can vaguely see a few small dark clouds drifting. What we have to do is to clear the clouds and let the sun shines through.
Flow_11000009_64: After hearing this, it's like I was awakened from a daze and suddenly I found a path forward.
Flow_11000009_65: Isn't it the reason why I set foot on this path to see the views behind those dark clouds? At the very least, I need to try to keep up.
Flow_11000009_66: So that I can reach the highest point of the Tacetite building with everyone.
Flow_11000009_67: Hey, I gradually grew attached while repairing these old gadgets. After all, we're all a bit nostalgic.
Flow_11000009_68: He also fixed those things. So, I let him do his things from then on. Later, he became increasingly more sophisticated with it.
Flow_11000009_69: Maybe one day he can become a great inventor. And I'll be known as the father of a great inventor.
Flow_11000009_70: Like "If it's him, he can definitely do it...", but I can't be as perfect as my father.
Flow_11000009_71: Later, I left the Ministry of Development and opened this shop. Now I'm content with this life of fixing things for the folks of Jinzhou.
Flow_11000009_72: But the talent of Wenmo was as high as his grandfather's, and he may be able to accomplish what I have not done in the future.
Flow_11000009_73: I really hope to see that day.
Flow_11000009_74: Because the Moon-chasing Festival is coming soon, I like the colorful lanterns hanging on the street and the lively lantern riddle activities.
Flow_11000009_75: But sometimes the weather would be difficult during Moon-chasing Festivals, and the lanterns hanging on the street would be easily blown away because they were too light.
Flow_11000009_76: So I was thinking if I could mimic the devices invented by the Ministry of Development and create a special shield for the lanterns
Flow_11000009_77: So that we don't need to worry about the weather during the Moon-chasing Festival. But this is a secret between you and me. Don't tell others.
Flow_11000009_78: I want to give everyone a surprise.

MonsterInfo_340000050_DiscoveredDes: Has increased RES to Fusion DMG while in human form. When enraged, transform into a grim goat reaper with increased RES to Spectro DMG and Havoc DMG. One of the Fractsidus Overseers. A rebel who revels in Overclocking, disregarding the ideas of beauty and order. He enjoys destruction and chaos, delighting in the suffering of others. He disregards rules and fame, using any means to reach his goals. With an introspective sobriety driving him, he seeks you out to witness the birth of a new world, still in its infancy. "New life blooms from scorched earth, rising through the ashes."
Flow_311000010_1: That's it for today's work. Time for some fun! Hmm? Oh, it's you—what's up?
Flow_311000010_2: Hehe, that's because I’m all about "energy conservation." I don't waste time on unnecessary things and finish what needs to be done with the least effort.
Flow_311000010_3: I get a lot of flack for this, but isn't it perfectly normal to clock out as soon as your work is done?
Flow_311000010_4: The key to conserving energy is learning to adapt. And by that, I mean not adapting to the work’s pace, but making the work adapt to yours.
Flow_311000010_5: So, ready to say goodbye to that energy-draining work life with me?
Flow_311000010_6: For example, you could check out the residential block. You might not be able to bring all of Jinzhou to a mining site, but you can recreate parts of it.
Flow_311000010_7: Like enjoying local dishes at the food stalls, sharing tea with friends around a table, or playing a few rounds of chess with the retired miners...
Flow_311000010_8: Over time, this little corner has become a miniature Jinzhou to us miners.
Flow_311000010_9: Words don't do it justice. Check it out yourself if you can.
Flow_311000010_10: I think it's still business hours, right?
Flow_311000010_11: Oh, the Moon-Chasing Festival is coming up, and last year was too swamped to get the chance to see the lanterns with my Xiaobao.
Flow_311000010_12: This year is my chance to make up for it. I wonder what kind of gift would be good for the child?
Flow_311000010_13: Toys? I don't really understand the likes of children. I have to ask that kid, Chixia, for help.
Flow_311000010_14: She often helps me babysit my Xiaobao, who treats her like a real sister and tells her everything.
Flow_311000010_15: Food? I work down in the mine all year round. To be honest, my knowledge of food in Jinzhou is as good as yours. So I should ask you for recommendations.
Flow_311000010_16: Quality time with Xiaobao... Yes, I haven't been able to spend time with the child because of work.
Flow_311000010_17: Last year the child had a huge tantrum because he didn't see the lanterns with me, and it took a long time to calm him down.
Flow_311000010_18: Moon-chasing Festival, the festival that children are always talking about... I'm actually quite looking forward to it. To be honest, I was once one of the Exiles.
Flow_311000010_19: In the past, even on the day of the Moon-chasing Festival, we had to worry about the supplies needed for survival.
Flow_311000010_20: It was only after we were accepted by Jinzhou that we started to enjoy the Moon-chasing Festival like everyone else.
Flow_311000010_21: Thank you for your suggestion. I will think about it after work...
Flow_311000010_25: You... don't seem to work here. Is there anything I can help you with?
Flow_311000010_27: You want to know about the past and present of the mine, right? I've only been stationed here not for long.
Flow_311000010_28: But occasionally I can hear the miners talking about it. It is said that the Tiger's Maw Mine was built on the ruins of a city.
Flow_311000010_29: Affected by the Lament, Jinzhou underwent some drastic tectonic changes, in which the ore mines buried deep were turned out and exposed to the surface.
Flow_311000010_30: So the Tiger's Maw Mine became an indispensable source of energy supply in the founding of Jinzhou.
Flow_311000010_31: After the mineshafts were built, the mine gradually started to form its own ecosystem as the production and research facilities, and living quarters, as well as other amenities, were set up.
Flow_311000010_32: As for the ore... Although I'm not an expert, I picked up a few things over time as I spent enough time around here.
Flow_311000010_35: Apart from the Tacetite, which is the largest in demand, the Tiger's Maw Mine also produces Lampylumen.
Flow_311000010_36: I heard from the researchers that it's a special kind of ore where the veins of minerals distribute evenly along the same direction.
Flow_311000010_37: And the veins are composed of a variety of minerals, which can be processed into raw materials that can be used in advance technologies like terminals and cores of intelligent devices.
Flow_311000010_38: However, the Academy and the Ministry of Development didn't stop their research from there. So, maybe one day they'd discover a field of application.
Flow_311000010_41: Yes, the dispute about the deployment of the new technology has been escalating recently, and I'm worried that the workplace party next week will turn into a chaos.
Flow_311000010_42: New technologies always meet resistance at the start. Because it's not only about technology, but also about people behind it.
Flow_311000010_43: The old miners represent experience and skills from the old times, and the young miners are the promoters of new technology.
Flow_311000010_44: As more and more young miners join in, these dynamics are thrown off balance. So the conflict was set off.
Flow_311000010_45: As for me... I'm not one of the miners, but a Patroller who carries out the duties as required.
Flow_311000010_46: The concerns or reasons for disagreements aren't as many as they appear to be. I think it's natural for things to iterate and evolve, isn't it?
Flow_311000010_47: Just like the law of physics we all learn in textbooks: the entropy of a system is bound to increase over time. And the systems of the world aren't isolated.
Flow_311000010_48: So as they recombined, they'd return to a low entropy state before the entropy rises again.
Flow_311000010_49: Isn't this the law of the world?
Flow_311000010_51: Geez, I can finally take a breather now. Lately, I've been bombarded with people trying to sell me rocks...
Flow_11000004_121: I'm not sure if Chenbi and Shuhe are up for this challenge...
Flow_11000004_122: The number of applications for meetings at City Hall is on the rise.
Flow_11000004_123: Hello, to schedule a meeting with the Jinzhou Magistrate, please submit the necessary paperwork.
Flow_11000004_124: Someone has already completed the procedures for me.
Flow_11000004_126: Hmm... It's part of my duties as a City Hall guard.
Flow_11000004_127: But you know, they're young, and already a few days on guard duty has them so stressed. I do find it concerning.
Flow_11000004_128: Very well, our main goal is to maintain order in City Hall, no matter the circumstances.

Flow_11000004_131: If you need help with any legal matters, we're here to assist.
Flow_11000004_132: What can I assist you with today?
Flow_11000004_133: I'm good, actually. I'll be on my way.
Flow_11000004_135: For some reason, things are picking up again.
Flow_11000004_136: All these case files from the Midnight Rangers need prompt attention...
Flow_11000004_137: But I will keep an eye on you.
Flow_11000004_139: Ahem, okay, please don't interfere with the duties of personnel on duty!
Flow_11000010_11: I bet it's linked to the Moon-chasing Festival. Oh, and since this is your first Jinzhou festival, I hope you have a great time!
Flow_11000010_12: I should use my day off to get ready for the festival. What should I do first?
Flow_11000010_13: Great idea. Back in the day, my family would go all out buying decorations and festival toys.
Flow_11000010_14: How about starting with the food?
Flow_11000010_15: But in the end, we realized we often overdid it. As for meals... we typically eat out now.
Flow_11000010_16: If we start with food... cooking a nice, homemade meal surrounding by family and friends... sounds amazing just thinking about it!
Flow_11000010_17: Speaking of which, I've seen Mr. Ma from the grocery store quite often lately. He must be prepping for the Moon-chasing Festival too.
Flow_11000010_18: He's famous as the 'ingredient expert' around here, very knowledgeable about wild ingredients.
Flow_11000010_19: Like guarding Jinzhou's gate, prepping food needs strategy. I'll head over to him after work.
Flow_11000010_20: The land was used to its fullest, and everyone did their part. Together, we built Jinzhou brick by brick with our skills.
Flow_11000010_21: I think it's not only the high wall that keeps Jinzhou safe, but all of us who stand behind it.
Flow_11000010_22: Thinking about this makes the dullness and weariness of guarding the gate fade away.

Huanglong_main_1_4_199_44: Little lambs cowered and huddled in their village, terrified of the relentless wolf packs.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_45: Until a shepherd arrived, bearing the gift of wishes and providing shelter and sustenance.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_46: Slowly, the shepherd gained control over the flock, and the lambs lived contented lives... but this is not the end of our story.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_47: The shepherd found the solitary black lamb in his flock, and offered to grant any wish it desired. In exchange, he wanted one of its companions as a sacrifice.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_48: The black lamb refused, and it was shunned by its flock, left without shelter or sustenance.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_49: After the black lamb's exile, more lambs continued to vanish...
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_50: The shepherd then blamed that black lamb for breaking the rules, and withheld his wish-granting power as punishment.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_51: From the very beginning, the lambs knew the risk of making wishes—they too could become sacrifices for those of others.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_52: But they always believed it wouldn't be them.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_53: Meanwhile, some lambs reasoned that since they had already risked being sacrificed for someone else's wish...
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_54: It was then only fair to pass on that risk for a chance at fulfilling their own desires. And so, they continued to play the game.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_55: They all knew the consequences, but chose to remain silent.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_56: Fearful yet greedy, they followed the shepherd's orders and made wishes again and again...
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_57: Until one day a brave black lamb spoke up, shattering their façade of a peaceful and happy life.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_58: The black lamb got in their way and the shepherd's greedy pursuit, sparking hatred in their hearts.
Huanglong_main_1_4_199_59: Suddenly, they could no longer ignore the blood and ashes of past sacrifices littering the ground.
Flow_11000011_1: It's dangerous beyond this point. No trespassers!
Flow_11000011_3: Even Resonators need to be careful. The front line is intense...
Flow_11000011_4: Don't go up the slope near Camp Overwatch. It's strictly off-limits.
Flow_11000011_5: It's close to Norfall Barrens, an unpredictable territory of threats... Even powerful Resonators shouldn't underestimate it.
Flow_11000011_6: I find the wind extremely unsettling tonight... I sense a desperate voice from it.
Flow_11000011_7: An old friend, who has been here for decades.
Flow_11000011_9: I can't leave him here for the lonely night. So I come here every night to keep his company.
Flow_11000011_10: If you happen to run into Zongye back in Jinzhou City, remember to say hi for me.
Flow_11000011_11: And remember to keep my secret.
Flow_11000011_12: One, two, three... These Green Rabbits should be enough to last a week.
Flow_11000011_14: As you can see, I'm processing the ingredients. First, wash them, then peel them, and finally chop them into small pieces. Add scallions, ginger, and garlic, and stir-fry them...
Flow_11000011_17: Freshly cooked rabbit meat has a soft texture and delicious taste... Just thinking about it makes my mouth water!
Flow_11000011_18: Because rabbit meat is delicious! Freshly cooked rabbit meat has a soft texture and delicious taste... Just thinking about it makes my mouth water!
Flow_11000011_19: Desorock Highland is far from Jinzhou. Even fresh meat will become dry and tough after being transported here.
Flow_11000011_20: It's better to have some fresh meat here and satisfy our cravings.
Flow_11000011_21: Desorock Highland is far from Jinzhou. Even fresh meat will become dry and tough after being transported here.
Flow_11000011_22: It's better to have some fresh meat here and satisfy our cravings.
Flow_11000011_23: Norfall Barrens is now under threat...
Flow_11000011_24: Tacet Discords kept attacking, and it was only through the desperate resistance of the Midnight Rangers that Camp Overwatch was defended...
Flow_11000011_25: Although I've often read about the horrors of war in books. Seeing it with my own eyes is a whole different experience...
Flow_11000011_26: Even my heart feels like it's been drenched by the Retroact Rain, losing its color just like the view of Withering Frontline...
Flow_11000011_28: *Sigh* Thank you. I should gather myself up.
Flow_11000011_29: Even though I can't join the Midnight Rangers on the front lines, there's still something I can do.
Flow_11000011_30: I want to capture the moment of where the desperate resistance shines upon those nameless graves.
Huanglong_main_1_5_74_51: (So this is the last message the Magistrate has for me. This is... the location of Jinzhou's Grand Library.)
Flow_311000011_1: Do we really need Dark Knights in the wilderness of Jinzhou...
Flow_311000011_2: It's a trending topic among the Patrollers. Recently there have been fewer cases involving the Exiles.
Flow_311000011_3: Because in addition to the efforts of the Public Security Bureau to contain the Exiles, there is an upsurge of these so-called "Dark Knights" in the wild.
Flow_311000011_4: These are a group of armed civilians who serve punishments to the criminal Exiles in vigilante style outside of the judicial system.
Flow_311000011_5: A righteous course by the look of it, if it's bound to cause chaos if everyone does this.
Flow_311000011_6: Jinzhou has always had different punishments for the Exiles committing different degrees of crimes.
Flow_311000011_7: They are more lenient towards misdemeanors. Only those considered a threat to public safety may be taken restrictive measures against.
Flow_311000011_8: But, if everyone serves their own version of justice, chances are ill-intent individuals may administer unjust penalties for crimes, which could be ten times worse than the initial offense.
Flow_311000011_10: I think everyone should calm down and reconsider their actions.
Flow_311000011_12: Hmm, the air outside is so much better. I feel alive again.
Flow_311000011_13: Unlike the damp and musty smell in the confession room, which I seemed to have gotten used to. I've become a regular in the confession room.
Flow_311000011_14: Hey, it's just some minor "procedural noncompliances". After becoming a patroller, I realized that I could quite agree with some of these regulations. I have my own ways of justice.
Flow_311000011_16: I value justice as shown in the substantive results, not the tedious proceedings. In extraordinary times, you need to use extraordinary means.
Flow_311000011_17: In this case, had we gone through all the required procedures when we tried to retrieve the stolen mineral resources from the Exiles, they would have sold it off by now.
Flow_311000011_18: So, I had to use some *unconventional* methods to trick them out. Yet, I got scolded for it. But... at least I got the results I wanted.
Flow_311000011_19: Well. It's not my first time. I guess my partner, Baichuan, has reported it to the supervisors again.
Flow_311000011_20: He always talks about laws being like a compass, the circles drawn with a compass is bound to be better than drawn with hands.
Flow_311000010_54: Yeah, because aside from selling ores, we're now buying them too.
Flow_311000010_55: People have been eager to sell the "ore" they found to us. Sadly, most of it was just worthless rocks.
Flow_311000010_56: That's why I thought, maybe we should team up with the Pioneer Association to create a special magazine issue about identifying ores.
Flow_311000010_57: We could give readers tips on how to distinguish them by color, shine, and other traits.
Flow_311000010_58: Mind giving me a few pointers after I finish my first draft?
Flow_311000010_59: Hi, there. Let me know if you're ever in need of ore! We've got all types.
Flow_311000010_60: Hope this helps! Thanks and come back soon!
Flow_311000010_61: Sorry, but you need more credits. Come back when you have enough, yeah?
Flow_311000010_62: With just a few simple ingredients, I can whip up endless delicious dishes. Don't underestimate the power of flavor combinations!
Flow_311000010_63: Right you are. With the miners' health in mind, I've jazzed up traditional Jinzhou recipes to keep them both satisfied and nourished.
Flow_311000010_64: My version of the Jinzhou Stew packs in fresh vegetables and a flavorful broth while cutting back on greasy and salty ingredients, all without sacrificing taste.
Flow_311000012_1: If only every day could be so peaceful and calm...
Flow_311000012_2: Hello, I'm the patroller here. Is there anything I can help you with?
Flow_311000012_24: The distribution center is an important part of the Tiger's Maw Mine and a crucial node in the mine's logistics system.
Flow_311000012_25: At the distribution center, the ores excavated are unloaded, sorted, and then sent to various destinations.
Flow_311000012_26: Our job as patrollers here is to maintain the order of operations and the temporary storage of mineral resources.
Flow_311000012_27: So, are you interested in joining us?
Flow_311000012_29: A little girl carried her doll to the garden. The doll suddenly let out a loud cry and called for her mother. The mother came and spooned up the doll instead of her daughter... How about it? Scared yet?
Flow_311000012_30: Oh, this is your first time listening to a horror story, isn't it? The fact that it still gets the ones who haven't heard of it proves it's a classic macabre rhyme.
Flow_311000012_31: The essence of horror stories is about eerie things taking place in day-to-day scenes. Like the tune I just hummed.
Flow_311000012_32: If you pay attention, you see it's not the girl who's crying but the doll. That's why the second half is added.
Flow_311000012_33: I thought it's just a nice nursery rhyme.
Flow_311000012_34: Dad and Mom are arguing, and the little girl is crying. The little girl calls for Mom. M-mom is gone.
Flow_311000012_35: Dad just fertilized the garden trees, the cherry tree turned new leaves. Curiously I dug underneath, and found my doll buried deep...
Flow_311000012_36: I don't know when I became obsessed with them. Maybe it's because horror stories have a clear representation of karma.
Flow_311000012_38: Behind the twists and turns of the gloomy plots is a pursuit of romantic ideals.
Flow_311000012_39: I have always suspected that there are real horror stories around me, just between you and me.
Flow_311000012_41: To think of something ominous might lurk in the darkness under the cold industrial surface of this jungle of steel and bolts... Phew... I've got goose bumps.
Flow_311000012_42: Stop right there. I can sense the pulsating restless energy emanating from you.
Flow_311000012_44: That is something more dazzling than the morning sun, more profound than the sea- You must my alley in justice!
Flow_311000012_46: Of course... I heard it from Chixia. She said she recently became friends with someone with a stern cold face and dresses all in black.
Flow_311000012_47: Haha, actually it's Xiaofang... Ahem, Chixia is my senior from the previous year.
Flow_311000012_49: At that time, I was quite a lone kid. She would often come to the backyard of my home to play games with me.
Flow_311000012_50: Later, under her influence, I gradually opened up and we began to talk about fantasies of us saving the world.
Flow_311000012_51: However, after becoming a Patroller, I realized that everything was not quite as I imagined. Not all Patrollers has the cool and commanding air.
Flow_311000012_52: Personal disputes, Exiles's scams, petty thefts... every day is just the same... These are the norm of the work.
Flow_311000012_53: Sometimes, you forget the birthdays of the important ones in your life while you still remember container sorting numbers at the logistics center.
Flow_311000012_54: I'd get tired of these trivial matters, but...
Flow_311000012_55: On weekends, when I take off the Patroller's uniform and see the ordinary people passing by while wandering around.
Flow_311000012_56: I see busy couriers rushing on the road, Pioneer Association members going on expeditions, and workers returning to Jinzhou to visit their families...
Flow_311000012_57: At moments like this, I'd see how our efforts have maintained the peace and order of this city.
Flow_311000012_59: Before placing an order... Ask yourself, why would anyone sell you such flawless ores at such a low price?
Flow_311000012_60: The- the streets aren't p- paved with gold... They're lined with traps laid up by ill-intent people. D- Don't fall for the tricks. Let's stay alert to frauds.
Flow_311000012_61: Hello, can I bother you for a moment?
Flow_311000012_62: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just a little scared to talk to strangers. Actually... I'm doing anti-fraud publicity.
Flow_311000012_63: Recently, near the Tiger's Maw. There have been Exiles posing as ore merchants, selling fake ores. It's just one of their many cunning scams.
Flow_311000012_65: You have a lot of sweat on your forehead.
Flow_311000012_66: Some male exiles even dress up as females with fake sweet voices to swoon the customers into buying goods. But you can easily see pass it as long as you don't believe in becoming rich overnight.
Flow_311000012_67: And their scam will fail... Phew... Thank you for listening to me. Don't forget to share this with your family and friends.
Flow_135000005_6: I'm here, just chilling and watching Slowy, while it's here, taking in the scenery. We're always together, but we don't bother each other.
Flow_135000005_7: I don't really get why it doesn't give me any trouble. Maybe we just get along pretty well…?
Flow_135000005_8: But, you know, watch out for the other turtles around here. They're not as friendly as Slowy.
Side_DTMZ_8_1: Come to think of it. TDs are so unpredictable. There's no way of knowing where and when they're going to pop out.
Side_DTMZ_8_2: I can't even imagine how people managed to deal with them back in the old days.
Side_DTMZ_7_1: Chief asked me to get some parts for him to help with the repairs on that old lighthouse. It was supposed to be an easy job...
Side_DTMZ_7_2: But I didn't expect all these TDs to come out of nowhere. Now what am I going to do? Chief's gonna blow a fuse.
Side_DTMZ_7_3: Rover, if you're making your way up to that lighthouse, do you think you could escort me there?
Side_DTMZ_6_1: Taken an interest in this here lighthouse have you, Rover?
Side_DTMZ_6_4: The lighthouse looks like it was built ages ago. Should be operational with some patching up here and there.
Side_DTMZ_6_5: We're still missing a few parts for the repairs. I already had my assistant go fetch some at the edge of the hill.
Side_DTMZ_6_6: She's been gone for quite a while now. I'm guessing she's probably caught in some trouble. What will I do with her...

Side_DTMZ_4_8: Mateo is a soon-to-be graduate student on a research assignment from his professor.
Side_DTMZ_4_6: They were supposed to meet right by the lighthouse. He's a month late, wonder if they'd kicked him out of the school for it by now.

Side_DTMZ_31_5: Yet I have been unsuccessful in deciphering the information inside the lighthouses' consoles... However, I did manage to discover that the console will send out a certain alarm signal when its system is being interfered with.
Side_DTMZ_31_6: I accidentally connected to your Pangu Terminal while I was investigating these signals. It appears that your Terminal's ID was transmitted to me as an intruder alert.
Side_DTMZ_31_8: Ahh, yes. I really wish to know the stories surrounding these lighthouses in detail. Do come find me in Jinzhou city when you have the time, and we'll discuss it in person.

Side_DTMZ_28_4: Your passion for history is much greater than that of my own pupils. This brings tears to my eyes.

Side_DTMZ_28_8: No. It's just that it is not worth searching for it anymore.
Side_DTMZ_28_9: According to those coordinates, I can say with confidence that this Stingray is the same ship that we salvaged near the harbor of the Whining Aix's Mire a few years prior.
Side_DTMZ_28_10: Inside the wreckage, we found some of the crew's logs, although broken into pieces, we still managed to link them with the stories found in the consoles.
Side_DTMZ_28_12: Unfortunately, we also discovered six bodies inside... Based on the information we have, they belong to Moak and his crew members.
Side_DTMZ_28_14: Further investigations found that the deaths of the other five members date back even further than the time when Moak made his first recording in the lighthouse.
Side_DTMZ_28_15: In other words, Moak had been sailing on the sea alone all this time, and his crew members had long since fallen victim to the TDs...
Side_DTMZ_28_16: Experiencing such losses, Moak refused to accept such an ending. So he fell into a fantasy, that he and his crew members all found the lighthouses one by one, found their own homes, and left the Stingray safely.
Side_DTMZ_28_17: In the end, only he himself completed the voyage and forever laid in that seabed with the Stingray.
Side_DTMZ_28_19: I cannot make any guarantees, as these are just my own speculations. Yet, unfolding forgotten stories, is what makes history fascinating.
Side_DTMZ_28_20: Regardless, I'm really grateful for letting me see the whole story. Your passion for history truly deserves these rewards.

Side_DTMZ_24_4: This morning, I received a communication from Xie Qi. The bastard actually managed to make contact with some survivors.
Side_DTMZ_24_5: He tells me that the disaster is over. All the monsters have been wiped out, and the crisis of humanity has been resolved.
Side_DTMZ_24_6: Best of all, the crew members that stayed behind on land are all safe and sound. It's news nothing more worth celebrating.
Side_DTMZ_24_7: Our seventeen-month-long voyage on the sea has finally come to an end. I'm preparing to return to the harbor where it all began. This journey of suspense is finally over.
Side_DTMZ_24_8: I don't plan on bringing the remaining supplies back with me, so I buried them somewhere near the lighthouse. Maybe they can come in handy for someone in need oneday.
Side_DTMZ_24_9: *chuckle* But it wouldn't be fun if they're too easy to find, would it? I left behind a little riddle. I'm sure anyone who happens to listen to this recording can solve it.

Side_DTMZ_22_3: Stingray here... Acting Captain Moak recording...
Side_DTMZ_22_4: I say Captain, but I'm actually the only one left on this ship. This morning, Espey, my last companion, also quietly left the Stingray unnoticed.
Side_DTMZ_22_5: It was already late evening when we found this lighthouse on the mountain yesterday, so we made an approach and prepared to go on land and check the place out after dawn, as we have done in the past.
Side_DTMZ_22_6: It wasn't until dawn that I found Espey had already gone missing... I'd thought that he had escaped with all the remaining supplies.
Side_DTMZ_22_7: But I was quickly put to shame by my own suspicions—the supplies were untouched. Espey left them all for me.
Side_DTMZ_22_8: He knew fully well that the remaining supplies weren't enough to support two people on sea, so he left the last hopes of life to me and went ashore to seek for survival.
Side_DTMZ_22_9: What an idiot... Even if we both were to die at sea, I would never have the thought of abandoning my crew.
Side_DTMZ_22_10: So I left some supplies at these coordinates, hoping that they would be useful to him... From here on out, this will be the final voyage for me and the Stingray.

Side_DTMZ_14_5: At long last we spotted another lighthouse on the edge of this forest. No traces of those monsters.
Side_DTMZ_14_6: Chances of finding fuel in this forest is non-existent, but at least there's plenty of fruits and mushrooms to go around.
Side_DTMZ_14_7: Qi Shuqing and Rana agreed to disembark and start a living here. They plan on building a wooden house, raise a vegetable field, and become self-sufficient. A small home of their own.

Side_DTMZ_12_3: This is Acting Captain Moak of the Stingray... Today is our forty-third day since our departure from the harbor.
Side_DTMZ_12_4: Xie Qi reported the ship's first sighting of a lighthouse's light beam from up on the highlands. We followed it and arrived at these coordinates in preparation for landing...
Side_DTMZ_12_5: To our surprise, not a single person was found on the shores, only the lighthouse projecting its lonely light... Not a very assuring sight to say the least.
Side_DTMZ_12_6: Xie Qi insisted on staying... As an engineer, he wanted to stay behind and modify the communications equipment of the lighthouse.
Side_DTMZ_12_7: In his words, with necessary modifications in place should make communication with other survivors possible. He'll inform us when the time comes... We hope his efforts will not go in vain.
Side_DTMZ_12_8: Since Xie Qi's the brightest out of any of us, he wouldn't have suggested it if he didn't know what he was doing. We respected his decision and provided him some of the supplies before setting sail again.

Flow_31000001_57: Remnant Energy replays old events. When the rain flows up, you get these mirages of the past showing up in it.
Flow_31000001_60: If you can't tell what's real and what's not, those mirages can mess with your head. I guess everyone's got someone they can't let go of...
Flow_31000001_61: So if you run into Retroact Rain, stay sharp. Don't let your emotions get the better of you.
Flow_31000001_62: I can't hear the Retroact Rain, only the ordinary kind... Do you think my Resonance Ability is weak?
Flow_140000006_1: So a new story is about to begin?
Flow_140000006_2: Oh, actually... It's not that much of a big deal.
Flow_140000006_3: I've been conducting uninterrupted observations at this weather Observation Station...
Flow_140000006_4: Recent observation data shows that the weather changes in the surroundings share similarities with the storms happening here in the past...
Flow_140000006_5: But the similarity are still in the cradle. I can't jump to conclusions now.
Flow_140000006_6: Don't worry. I'll keep an eye on this.
Flow_140000006_7: That's right. The hero embarks on a journey in the vast wilderness, battling against the harsh natural environment and engaging in thrilling fights with bounty criminals...
Flow_140000006_8: I'm captivated by such a fearless and firm belief.
Flow_140000006_9: If you're into Westerns too, I'd be more than happy to share my long-cherished movie list with you!
Flow_140000006_10: The storm formed by the abnormal gravity field seems to be returning...
Flow_140000006_12: So the storm is happening again?

Flow_311000004_356: So, every night, I come here and tell her what happened during the day.
Flow_311000004_358: The dishes you cooked were better... Sob... Sob...
