Flow_311000004_364: I suppose you don't know how bad the war between Jinzhou and the Tacet Discords was in the past.
Flow_311000004_365: Things are better now, but on the front lines, soldiers are still risking their lives every day.
Flow_311000004_366: Huh... Tell me, young friend, do you think I'll live to see the end of the war as a veteran?
Flow_311000004_367: Yes... the war never seems to end.
Flow_311000004_371: You will live to see its end.
Flow_311000004_374: If I can't make it, young friend, please bear witness to that day for me.
Flow_311000004_375: I had a dream last night. It was about a future without war.
Flow_311000004_376: When I woke up, I realized I was dreaming about the past.
Flow_311000004_377: I'm old now and have spent decades of my youth under fire.
Flow_311000004_378: These days, I'm just reminiscing. Please forgive this old man.
Flow_311000004_379: I'll stay a little longer... and then I'll be on my way.
Flow_311000004_380: I come every day to check. If Huaijin's name's not here, he must be fine.
Flow_311000004_381: Don't worry, I'm sure he's fine.
Flow_311000004_383: Are you a Patroller? Anything happened here?
Flow_311000004_384: No, no, don't worry. I just got off work and decided to pay a visit.
Flow_311000004_385: There are names I know here... they're lonely souls, so I visit them from time to time.
Flow_311000004_386: And as you can see, there are lots of seniors here. If anything happens, I'll be around to help out.
Flow_311000004_387: Even though I'm off duty, as long as I'm wearing this uniform, I'm still a Patroller, and I have a duty to protect people.
Flow_311000004_389: The fingers on my injured hand are useless... Can't even hold a pen to write. How pathetic.
Flow_311000004_390: Are you thankful to her, too?
Flow_311000004_391: There are letters, there are eulogies... There are wills...
Flow_311000004_392: The soldiers never know when their time's up. I can understand that.
Flow_311000004_394: Ah, that might be a little too hard to understand...
Flow_311000004_397: Would you stop coming around here all the time? You're making us all nervous.
Flow_311000004_399: Well, you don't miss people by doing this. What kind of man stares at a list of fallen soldiers every day, looking for his sweetheart's name?
Flow_311000004_400: And the list hasn't even been updated for so long... If you carry on like this, your life is over!
Flow_311000004_401: I'm worried about her! She hasn't responded to my calls for over thirty-six hours!
Flow_311000004_402: They're fighting on the front lines. What do you think they're doing, camping?
Flow_311000004_403: You're right... I'll go back to Mr. Yhan later and sign up for ten more training sessions!
Flow_311000004_404: If I train hard, maybe I'll get a chance to join her on the frontlines.
Flow_311000004_405: This is getting to sappy for us. We won't tag along again!
Side_DTMZ_29_1: Hello Rover, do you still remember me? I'm a historian from the Imperial Academy.
Side_DTMZ_29_2: It appears you have activated all five lighthouses. I'm sure you must have learned a great deal about the Stingray.
Side_DTMZ_29_3: Please, come back to the city and tell me all about them when you have the time to spare.
Side_DTMZ_29_4: Maybe this time, we can finally solve this unknown piece of history!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_9_1: Hmm... the medicine seems to be working better this time.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_9_3: Yes, this is my patient, Niu. He's got a strange illness, and the usual meds don't work well on him.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_9_4: So I decided to try a new medicine, hoping it'll do the trick.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_1: Yes, even though my specialty is in pharmaceuticals, we can't develop new medicines without studying the Tacet Discords...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_2: If you have questions about Tacet Discords, feel free to come to me.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_8: Despite resembling organisms, Tacet Discords are essentially an energy construct made up of Reverberations.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_9: Tacet Discords doesn't follow ordinary biological evolution or hereditary rules.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_10: They may take the form of real-world objects, but it's mere camouflage.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_11: Although Tacet Discords lack biological connections between themselves...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_12: For the sake of observation and understanding, we still categorize all the discovered Tacet Discords we come across.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_13: The five defined types include Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, and Staticoid.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_14: While Tacet Discords may vary, they all pose a threat to us humans.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_15: Naturally, we devised a threat level classification system.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_16: We determine the threat by assessing the strength of the Tacet Discord's characteristic frequency. Folks tend to think the higher the frequency, the stronger the Tacet Discord.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_17: The ranking goes from lowest to highest: Common, Elite, Overlord, and Calamity.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_18: Because Tacet Discords are essentially aggregates of Reverberation energy, they turn back into disordered frequencies upon elimination.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_19: That being said, there's a small chance these frequencies might recombine into new, specific substances.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_8_20: These substances exhibit unique appearances and compositions, and have special medicinal properties used in making medicine.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_1: Should I join Mr. Mortefi's project? ...Koko, would you support my decision?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_2: Ah, you must be the Rover. What can I do for you?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_5: Koko is my little sister, and she's currently the acting manager of Shifang Pharmacy.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_6: Yesterday, Mr. Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_7: But joining would mean spending even less time with Koko.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_9: I don't want to pass up this chance. It's more than just a project. Being able to working alongside Mr. Mortefi is an honor itself.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_10: He's probably the most respected researcher here, just behind our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_11: He's great at fending off unreasonable client demands. He rejected over 40 of them in his first week alone!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_12: He even treats us to afternoon tea. He really looks out for us.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_14: Mortefi's been trying to outdo him in research, but it's not easy. Xiangli is just... built different.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_15: About Mr. Xiangli... You'll see what I mean when you meet him.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_8: Why is this project so appealing to you?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_13: Who's more talented than this Mortefi?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_1: Phew... Everyone else is working, but I'm here slacking off and loving it... Haha!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_3: Hang on, you're not planning to snitch to Mr. Mortefi, right...?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_5: Mr. Mortefi is scarier than my own mentor.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_6: His words can be brutal... If he sees me slacking off, he'll probably say something like...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_7: "Taking a little break, I see. You must enlighten me about your vast knowledge of avoiding work."
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_8: Just so you know, that's the 17th most brutal line from Mr. Mortefi, as per our rankings on the Huaxu Hive.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_10: Oddly enough, some people don't mind his scolding... In fact, they seem to provoke him on purpose.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_11: I really can't understand what those people are thinking...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_1: Crownless... No way, the progress on the frequency calculations is only at 7%...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_3: I'm analyzing the Crownless data. I've never seen such a complex Tacet Discord before.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_4: By the way, did you know? Miss Baizhi actually came up with the term "Crownless." What a pity.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_6: Don't you think the name is a bit... uninspired? Miss Baizhi is a genius at everything, except naming Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_7: Everyone on the forums wants a more memorable name. They even held a virtual contest for suggestions.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_9: My favorite is "Savage God of Torn Wings." What do you think, Rover?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_13: No way... Did Miss Baizhi blackmail you??
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_14: Haha, Rover, you've got great taste!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_15: In the end, Miss Baizhi, as the discoverer, has the final say.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_10: I think "Crownless" is a better name...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_11: "Savage God of Torn Wings" is the better name.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_1: The war in the Norfall Barrens has finally ended.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_2: That Retroact Rain was horrible, wasn't it?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_3: The Retroact Rain was already scary enough as an illusion... but then actual "ghosts" appeared!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_5: Yeah, we thought so too. The Threnodian seemed on the brink of awakening... and its recent activities have already had such a terrible impact.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_6: Can you believe the Fractsidus wanted to hatch such a terrifying creature...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_7: I heard Fractsidus members were part of this Threnodian revival too. Rover, any insights?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_9: Ah, too bad. I was hoping to get more information from you...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_4: It could be caused by the Threnodian's awakening.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_10: Where did you hear all these rumors, anyway?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_1: The Disruptor's a good weapon, but man, it's a pain to keep it in shape...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_3: You witnessed the Disruptor launch up close, huh? Must've been quite the spectacle.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_4: Once that cannon fires, the Tacet Discord won't stand a chance.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_6: But the Disruptor's charging system got fried after the launch. We're grounded for now.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_7: That's the price of such a powerful weapon... But hey, where else will our motivation to make better weapons come from?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_8: I can see it now, someday we'll going to make something with even more juice than the Disruptor!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_9: Jinzhou won't have to fear the Tacet Discords anymore, and my scientific research will begin in earnest!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_2: Talking about the Disruptor Cannon in the Norfall Barrens?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_5: It is a very powerful weapon.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_1: So, Rover, did you really cross paths with that Fractsidus Overseer in Qichi Village?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_4: If you're saying it too, then it has to be real.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_5: But I heard he said a bunch of weird stuff to you, didn't he? What did he say?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_6: Bad guys sure love to talk. What'd he say to you?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_8: No wonder there's been a surge of Qichi Village claims on the forums lately...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_9: Everyone claims to know the story of what went down there.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_10: There are tons of variations, each story wilder than the last.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_12: Ah! Darn it... I almost forgot about my project deadline!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_2: Yes, he was a strong enemy.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_3_7: About the tales surrounding Qichi Village.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_1: Hmm... Tacetite weapons have their limits, you know...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_3: Oh, hey! I was just discussing a new weapon project with the department head.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_4: Your timing is impeccable. I have a question for you.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_5: You know what? We just had this epiphany! So, regular Tacetite weapons are like, for one person, right? They don't have much impact on a big battle?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_7: But imagine this: a Tacetite weapon that needs a whole team to operate. That would pack a serious punch!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_12: Ugh, yeah... Still a bunch of kinks to work out...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_8: Can it actually move at that size?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_29_10: What if you're surrounded by Tacet Discords?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_1: Man, every time I read Mr. Mortefi's research, I learn something new...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_3: No way, you were there too?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_4: Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_5: Seriously! Who's the genius behind these thoughtless demands on our R&D?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_6: Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_8: I've always looked up to him. His genius and fearless attitude...I hope to emulate that one day.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_9: Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_2: You're the researcher I've seen before.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_7: It seems you admire him a lot.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_27_3: Alright!! Enough! I'm fully awake now!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_27_4: I've never felt so awake! Thanks a bunch.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_27_5: (Better hurry back to the lab, or I'll be out like a light if I keep this up.)
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_26_1: Zzz... Huh!? What am I doing? No, can't sleep yet!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_26_3: I'm trying to stay awake, enjoying the evening breeze. Otherwise, I'll... zzz..
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_26_5: Ah! Did I just nod off again!? Oh no...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_26_6: Could you please, like, hit me when I start dozing off?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_25_1: Am I awake? Or is this a dream!?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_22_1: No, I'm about to fall asleep...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_21_1: Why is it not morning yet...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_2_1: Hey, did you hear? Because of the Crownless, the Gorges of Spirits is becoming a center of attention.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_2_2: The Huaxu Hive is exploding with posts. Everyone's panicking about the possibility of even worse Tacet Fields.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_2_3: Even the Pioneer Association keeps bombarding us for the latest investigation updates.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_2_4: Looks like I'm pulling overtime again... Ahhh...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_1: Ugh... I really wish I could create a clone of myself when things get this hectic.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_3: I heard Resonators can create clones. I'm so jealous...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_4: If I could figure that out, my stomachache would be cut in half.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_6: People will think I'm useless if I ask for help, won't they?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_7: I'm not as smart as everyone else, so I need to work harder if I want to stand out.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_8: I'm okay, just need a short break... The real work happens at night.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_19_2: Splitting myself in half wouldn't be enough.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_18_1: Hey, Siqi! This data's for me, right?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_18_2: Siqi, bro, how do I use this gadget?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_18_3: Eh? Okay, okay... one at a time...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_1: Ugh, I finally convinced them to extend the report deadline to tomorrow after some serious convincing.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_2: Hey, you're the Rover, right? Got important business here?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_5: Wow, that's impressive... You've been given a big responsibility...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_6: That sounds cool... If you're chilling like that, you must have finished everything ages ago.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_7: Ugh, I can barely get a research report done.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_8: Honestly, everyone here at the institute is a genius... The pressure working here is insane.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_9: My stomach... it hurts again, no, I can't afford this now... I still have to finish this report.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_16_1: Director, I'll for sure have the investigation report ready tomorrow!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_16_2: You'd better hand it in by then... Otherwise not even I can help you!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_1: Wow, a visitor in the archives! This place is usually so boring.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_3: In other words, if the Huaxu Academy is like Jinzhou's main library, then the archives are like the library within that library.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_4: Everything about this academy can be found here. There's nothing about it that I don't know.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_5: Did you come here with any questions?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_8: You're in luck because I'm here every day sorting out info, so I know the Huaxu Academy inside out.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_9: Huaxu Academy is Jinzhou's research center, a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, and a respected academic institution.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_10: Huaxu Academy, the heart of Jinzhou's research, is a branch of the esteemed Huanglong Huaxu Academy, and a respected academic institution.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_11: There are various departments, including the Department of Anomaly Studies, the Department of Laboratory Evaluation, the Department of Safety, and the Department of Resources. Occasionally, a Special Project Team is also established.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_12: Every department at Huaxu Academy is at the forefront of research. Pretty impressive, right?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_15_6: Tell me more about the Academy.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_1: That weapon on you seems well maintained. You must be a Resonator.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_3: Yeah, I can tell. You're holding a Tacetite Weapon, after all.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_4: You've probably used it countless times by now, but I'm sure you're not familiar with how it's made.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_5: The more you understand, the handier it will be. If you're curious about Tacetite weapons, feel free to ask me anything.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_9: Tacetite Weapons are designed for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_10: These weapons are adaptable in form and size for different needs. They're all essentially the same thing.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_11: There are five main types of Tacetite Weapons. Pistols, Gauntlets, Rectifiers, Swords, and Broadblades.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_18: Pistols are compact firearms that use Resonance Energy to create powerful bullet projectiles.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_19: The amount of energy used determines the bullets' effects. You'll understand once you try it yourself.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_20: Compared to traditional guns, these Tacetite pistols have low recoil and do not require frequent reloading. Perfect for ranged combat.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_21: Gauntlets are arm-mounted combat gear, commonly worn as gloves or vambraces.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_22: With a limited range, their design prioritizes both offense and defense capabilities.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_23: This makes them highly selective in terms of material and the physical abilities of their wielders.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_24: Rectifiers capture and amplify specific frequencies. I'd say they work more like musical instruments.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_25: While not as lethal, they have the strongest amplification effect on Resonance Abilities, or Fortes as we call it.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_26: Additionally, Rectifiers can scan and interfere with the unique frequencies of Tacet Discords. As a type of Tacetite Weapon, Rectifiers test the user's skills.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_27: Swords are a staple weapon for Resonators like you, with their balanced and agile design.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_28: They're versatile and efficient in combat, making them a popular choice for dealing with different enemies.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_29: That being said. Swords are also the hardest to master among of all Tacetite Weapons. They may seem simple, but there's more to them than meets the eye.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_30: Need a weapon to take down tough Tacet Discords? Then the Broadblade is your choice. It does a lot of damage.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_14_7: Tell me about different types of Tacetite Weapons.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_13_1: I didn't expect such a terrifying Tacet Discord to be hidden under the mine...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_13_2: Thanks for getting rid of them all, otherwise I wouldn't know when my hallucinations would go away.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_13_3: But Liuqing told me to come here for his inspection tonight.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_13_4: He's worried about any side effects I might have, but also really curious about what happened.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_13_5: Ah, the spirit of a true researcher, I get it.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_12_3: Even though it's not cold out, I feel like I'm freezing every night.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_12_4: I've been to so many doctors, but no one can figure it out, so I had to turn to Liuqing for help.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_12_5: He thinks my symptoms might be caused by Tacet Discords, which can make you hallucinate... but I haven't been near any recently.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_12_6: I wonder if it's related to the weird stuff going on in the mine lately...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_12_8: Not sure, but if you're free, you could check out the Tiger's Maw.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_1: Huaxu Academy is filled with talented people... I'm so jealous.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_3: Who wouldn't be jealous of working in a nice, bright office, doing research that shapes the future?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_4: And the pay must be great! I want that kind of life too...
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_5: I've actually been using my free time to study Imperial Academy courses, and I'm almost done.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_6: As soon as I graduate, I'm leaving that filthy mine and getting a decent job.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_8: Yeah, it's pretty far from the life I dreamed of. Definitely don't want to be a miner though.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_11_2: Do you want to join the Academy too?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_1: Rover, is that you? You're still up at this hour?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_2: You gotta get more sleep, or you'll end up like us, unable to sleep even when you want to.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_5: You know what? Koko might actually be right. I've seriously considered quitting my job to join her, running the pharmacy.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_6: But after mulling it over, I still preferred to stay and do research.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_7: Our current medicines can handle most diseases.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_8: However, with the discovery of more diseases and the spread of new treatments, we're also facing an increasing number of pathogens.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_9: So, meds gotta stay up to date, and my job is to give more powerful tools to those battling diseases.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_1: Hmm... Haha, is that for real?
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_3: Oh, nothing, just browsing the Huaxu Hive. These latest posts are hilarious.
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_4: It's an internal forum for the Academy. You can find all sorts of gossip and updates there!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_5: Oh no. No, no, no... I really should stop and get back to my assignment! The deadline is today!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_10: You can use my account to browse the forum. Since it only allows one login at a time, I won't be able to get distracted, and you can enjoy the forum! Win-win!
Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_1_7: You should focus on your assignment.

Flow_311000004_406: Even if he can't join Midnight Rangers, at least he'll be able to protect himself.
Flow_11000012_2: Um... Does he mean "What's your business at the Vanguard Base"?
Flow_11000012_5: He means "If you have nothing to do, don't loiter around here".
Flow_11000012_6: I'm sorry! My brother can be a bit rude... Let me explain for him!
Flow_11000012_7: The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outrider, Vanguard, and Rearguard, all under the command of General Jiyan.
Flow_11000012_8: The Vanguard is the vanguard force of the Midnight Rangers, mainly responsible for frontline combat. This is the Vanguard Base.
Flow_11000012_9: We are very close to the frontline here, and there are often Tacet Discord sightings around. If you have nothing important, please do not linger around, especially do not proceed further to the east.
Flow_11000012_10: Has the situation on the battlefield become more intense?
Flow_11000012_11: How do you understand what he's saying?
Flow_11000012_12: Although he doesn't talk much, he is very dedicated to his work and skilled, which is why General Jiyan specifically appointed him to guard this place.
Flow_11000012_13: Hmph, with the two of us, the Vanguard Base is impregnable!
Flow_11000012_14: That's right, even some of the soldiers who were originally stationed at the base have recently been deployed to the battlefield...
Flow_11000012_15: In order to defend this place, we can't leave our posts to ensure your safety, so please stay away from the front lines as much as possible.
Flow_11000012_16: Ah... Well, we grew up together, so even without words, I can understand what he means just from his expression.
Flow_11000012_19: How is the situation at the front lines?
Flow_11000012_21: It seems like my leg really doesn't hurt anymore...
Flow_11000012_23: Huh? I'm sorry, is there anything I can help you with?
Flow_11000012_25: Uh... Yes, the Tacet Discord in Norfall Barrens is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
Flow_11000012_26: Last week, we, the defenders, successfully repelled ten attacks from the Tacet Discord. It's already good that I only have these minor injuries.
Flow_11000012_27: But luckily, General Jiyan is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.
Flow_11000012_29: Yes, that day he noticed that my legs seemed a bit strange after standing for a long time, and he quickly brought me ointment.
Flow_11000012_30: I don't know how he could see the symptoms at a glance, and I didn't expect him to pay attention to such small details...
Flow_11000012_31: He took the time to personally deliver the medicine and told me how to take care of myself. Look, I'm already jumping around now. It's amazing, isn't it?!
Flow_11000012_32: Hehe, I didn't expect him to be such a caring person.
Flow_11000012_34: How is the situation on the front line?
Flow_11000012_35: General Jiyan has been leading the Vanguard in battle for more than ten days and has not returned. This situation is very rare...
Flow_11000012_36: Although communication has not been interrupted, but...
Flow_11000012_37: According to the General's previous instructions, if the army does not return after two days, the remaining defenders in the camp will have to follow the planned route to support the front line.
Flow_11000012_38: The number of Tacet Discord near our base has recently decreased. Could they have concentrated on the frontlines?
Flow_11000012_39: No, I have to be fully alert here and share the burden with my comrades on the frontlines.
Flow_11000012_40: I'll go to the frontlines tomorrow to capture some footage!
Flow_11000012_42: Huh? Ah, that's how it is for ordinary people!
Flow_11000012_43: But for me, precisely because it's dangerous, I should personally experience it and truthfully convey this feeling through the lens to inform more people and keep everyone updated on the situation.
Flow_11000012_45: Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Qingling, a war journalist. I was previously working on a special feature on the homeland inside Jinzhou, and now I'm here to assist Senior Huowen with the filming.
Flow_11000012_46: Being on the frontlines and reporting the truth is the duty of us journalists. Don't worry, I have experience in war reporting, so I won't encounter any major dangers.
Flow_11000012_47: It's not you, you don't seem to be a Midnight Ranger. Be careful here!
Flow_11000012_48: You have a strong sensitivity to the angle of shooting, but you are not careful enough in your actions...
Flow_11000012_50: Oh, I'm talking about my junior, Qingling. She has been helping me with the shooting recently and has submitted a lot of good materials.
Flow_11000012_51: As a war reporter, her daring and adventurous personality has helped her excel in her missions, which is quite impressive. I can even see my younger self in her.
Flow_11000012_52: However, the Tacet Discord is rampant here, and the ferocious Tacet Discord can appear from anywhere. The shallow waters beneath your feet are unstable, and the ruins are filled with precarious dangers...
Flow_11000012_53: Even walking can easily lead to encounters with long-abandoned dangerous weapons.
Flow_11000012_54: In such a dangerous environment, her fearless determination worries me a lot.
Flow_11000012_55: I have advised her countless times, but she never listens. If you see her, please help me persuade her.
Flow_11000012_56: Based on my past adventure experiences, it's better to be cautious in your actions here.
Flow_11000012_57: If nothing unexpected happens, we will definitely win this war.
Flow_11000012_58: After fighting for a lifetime, we can always summarize some battle experience and conclusions.
Flow_11000012_60: Although everyone is still tense, overall, the Midnight Rangers will no longer be trapped in a bloody battle like the previous war when facing Tacet Discord.
Flow_11000012_62: The Battle Beneath the Crescent many years ago... Oh, come to think of it, it's been a long time since I talked to someone about these things.
Flow_11000012_63: I was young back then, and I had never seen such a battle before...
Flow_11000012_64: The unstoppable tide of Tacet Discord almost engulfed the entire army, and the comrades in chaos suddenly started killing each other...
Flow_11000012_65: The endless war slowly dragged each of us into the vortex of weariness, and a moment of relaxation in the mind could take away your life.
Flow_11000012_66: Countless people fell in that war, even my dear friend who grew up with me was not spared.
Flow_11000012_67: Those nightmarish days, I can't even distinguish now what was real and what was fake...
Flow_11000012_68: Those who have experienced that war find it hard to completely move on. I once left the army and lived in the city, but I found that I can only find peace in the barracks.
Flow_11000012_69: ... I still can't let go of my comrades, whether it's the past or the present, haha.
Flow_11000012_70: There are new supplies to be counted today.
Flow_11000012_72: Hmm? Do you need any help? Just let me know, I will ensure your well-being!
Flow_11000012_73: The more intense the war, the better we should eat and drink, and be in high spirits! Morale is also an important factor in the outcome of the war, right? Hahaha!
Flow_11000012_75: As a logistics support personnel, I not only want to take care of my comrades' material needs, but also to uplift their spirits a bit!
Flow_11000012_76: Hehe, actually, I once went to chat with Fusheng when I didn't understand. I wanted to make him feel relaxed, but I ended up hitting a wall...
Flow_11000012_77: Since then, I have realized that fighting is already tough enough, and everyone has endured a lot...
Flow_11000012_78: "Self-righteous" consolation only brings sadness, so why not let me bring everyone a moment of simple joy!
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_1: {PlayerName}, I was caring for frostbitten miners and couldn't reach you in time. Thank you for coming and helping us.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_2: Actually, this is also Uncle Hong's request. He looked at the information recorded in the journal about you and insisted that you help.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_3: Finally you guys from Ministry of Development caught up. We don't have much time, let's get moving, and don't get lost.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_59: Hey, what is this noise? You brief {Male=him;Female=her} about what happened. I'll see the reason of the noise.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_60: Uncle Hong left you and started talking with the researchers and miners.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_6: Did they tell you about Uncle Hong?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_8: Blame him for it. Just when Uncle Hong was about to speak during the fight, he suddenly let out a lot of words and choked Uncle Hong.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_9: Don't you rat on me. It was you who raised your voice and covered Uncle Hong's.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_10: What? You wanna continue? Can't you open your eyes and see if it's the right time?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_11: In the argument just now, Uncle Hong was suddenly transformed and accused them. He even referred to them with wrong names.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_12: Uncle Hong took Lei'li for himself and called him Hong. He accused the latter of caring only for his own ideas and never others'.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_13: He questioned whether it was absolutely right to exterminate anything that was unknown and frightening...
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_14: ...and whether it was possible to find the substitute for Lampylumen when Lampylumen Myriad is taken out.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_15: And when facing Modee, Uncle Hong called him Chengwen.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_16: He asked whether, though coexistence was a good idea, preparations were made if the coexistence were to bring another disaster.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_17: Unconventional thinking always returns to quietness in the end.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_20: He was one of the previous heads of the Mine, and a close friend of Uncle Hong's.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_21: However, his ruthless actions dragged the Mine into a crisis, and himself to death.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_22: That's right, he was a close friend of Uncle Hong's, and his ruthless actions dragged the Mine into a crisis.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_24: No. I would say a certain scenario during that fight excited his memory.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_25: And what Uncle Hong just said to you also proves my theory.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_29: Exactly. The past crisis was partly due to Ministry of Development and time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_30: Back then, the route connecting the Mine and Jinzhou wasn't clearly defined, so the Ministry's rescue took a lot of time on their trip.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_31: It was indeed something about time, but the point was in his first sentence: “You guys from Ministry of Development caught up”. Back then, the route connecting the Mine and Jinzhou wasn't clearly defined.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_32: The Ministry's people didn't arrive within the perfect rescue window, so the Mine staff has to establish our own defence against the TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_33: The point was in his first sentence: “You guys from Ministry of Development caught up”. Back then, the route connecting the Mine and Jinzhou wasn't clearly defined.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_34: The rescue didn't arrive within the perfect window, so the Mine has to establish its own defence against the TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_35: When a scenario from the past collides with the present, maybe Uncle Hong mistook them for one another.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_36: In that crisis, maybe Uncle Hong and Chengwen had a similar fight, just Modee and Lei'li.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_38: That's half true. I think Uncle Hong mixed now with the past and went through a strange yet familiar crisis.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_41: Maybe an onlooking miner, or a common old man. His tone was just like one.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_43: Now all we can do is follow Uncle Hong's ideas. The stimulating memories can help relive a story.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_44: A story that meant so much to him.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_46: {PlayerName}, we'd have to ask you to work with Uncle Hong to solve the crisis this time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_48: I already have the plan. The reason for the failure of the reboot lies in the temperature monitoring system of the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_61: The noise went away around you. Uncle Hong joined you after comforting the miners.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_49: This system detects the current temperature and adjust the parameters accordingly to ensure the normal running of the Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_50: Now, the influence of the chill has disabled this system, so the whole Tower went paralyzed.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_51: We must put the temperature back to the normal range before we can successfully reboot the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_52: And when the Tower is online, as the greatest source of heat in the Mine, it will control the chill.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_54: Yes, but since our power is limited, we have to ask the Ministry for help.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_57: Lampylumen Myriad isn't an easy foe. Take good care.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_4: What is Uncle Hong talking about?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_19: The previous head of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_23: Was Uncle Hong really off his head?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_26: You guys from Ministry of Development caught up?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_37: Uncle Hong took now for the past.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_40: Then who does Uncle Hong think he is?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_42: How can we take Uncle Hong back?
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_45: And a story that shows us the truth of the past.
POI_HKSM_XZ_34_53: So we must defeat Lampylumen Myriad now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_3_1: A scrunched paper that reads: "The Mine is getting so cold even though it's summer... Miss you, mum."
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_3: What is she mumbling about to herself?
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_6: Ha? That's amazing. Then we should leave her be. Let's go quietly.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_11: Hmph. So adults look equally foolish to me when they wake up. Brother's a liar.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_12: A {Male=young man;Female=young lady} in black, and a... kid? Who are... Am I still in a dream?
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_19: Because the Refinery Tower is offline, the experiment has to stop, so I've come here to refresh myself.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_20: But I couldn't help but fall asleep. Maybe I'm just too tired after overnight experiment.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_24: Huaxi and you tell the drowsy researcher what happened.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_25: So many accidents while I'm locked in the lab!
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_32: Right, if you're looking for the console. There is one outside the Academy.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_33: Now I've had my rest. Should be back in the lab. Good luck!
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_4: She seems to be asleep standing.
POI_HKSM_XZ_18_13: You can pinch someone to check.
POI_HKSM_XZ_16_29: Right. Let's move on to the next step of the instructions.
POI_HKSM_XZ_16_23: I feel the same. Plus, the lower half of the page is left blank.
POI_HKSM_XZ_16_26: No matter what, this story looks like a half finished one.
POI_HKSM_XZ_16_27: The beginning of the story says that this is a recording of a dream. Do you think the feeling is a result of the dream itself?
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_32: I'm not peeping at others' privacy. Instead, I just found an excellent way to find Grandpa Hong.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_33: One of the stories I collected is about an uncommunicative detective and his assitant, a doctor, who work together to solve a lot of conundrums.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_9: The detective in the story sometimes try to find clues from the suspects' past.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_34: That's why I think though focusing on today's entry is definitely the right direction, earlier entries are still important resources.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_15: Most of Grandpa Hong's entries are brief. He just describes the happenings and feelings of the today in a few sentences.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_18: But I did find some long, detailed entries, which I think are key to his whereabout, such as this one.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_31: You should read something without the owner agreeing.
POI_HKSM_XZ_14_11: Because a person's past often contains hints of all the motives of that person's current behaviors.
Flow_130000000_1152: Take this. That's the sample you are delivering. And this is the Ministry's ID. We're counting on you.
Flow_130000000_1153: In the meantime I'll try my best to find Uncle Hong. Thank you again for helping us to fix the Refinery Tower.
Flow_130000000_1155: As Lei'li continues to speak, you see Huayu rushing over with Uncle Hong, gesturing you to come over.
GeographyHandBook11_Descrtption: Nestled amidst towering peaks, the city glimmers with a million lights.
GeographyHandBook12_Descrtption: As the flickering light dances atop the refining tower, it resembles the pulsing heart of a tiger.
GeographyHandBook13_Descrtption: The Incinero Petals wilt slowly, mirroring the fading flame in the sky.
GeographyHandBook14_Descrtption: The lively chatter has faded, leaving only the gentle lull of the tide as company.
GeographyHandBook1_Descrtption: "Shattered tiles and crumbling walls, echoes of war haunt these halls."
GeographyHandBook2_Descrtption: "Loong's Gaze stands tall, dressed in shimmering water."
GeographyHandBook3_Descrtption: Where the journey begins, and restless souls find rest.
GeographyHandBook4_Descrtption: "A crimson galaxy that belongs to the Dim Forest."
GeographyHandBook5_Descrtption: "All moons gathered but she was gone, leaving me an everlasting dawn."
GeographyHandBook6_Descrtption: The clouds rise and the Loong soars.
GeographyHandBook7_Descrtption: Gentle rain beckons visitors to linger, lamenting phantoms from days gone by.
GeographyHandBook8_Descrtption: Hidden within blankets of mist and sky, the sorrowful birds remain to gently cry.
GeographyHandBook9_Descrtption: As the veil of sorrow lifts, the waters bloom with fresh green life.

The method of making it is simple, just dry the fresh Honeysuckle, stir-fry it with Lemongrass, and pour it into boiling water. Add a little Caltrop before drinking to add sweetness. The finished product is sour and sweet, with a slightly bitter aftertaste, which helps digestion, so it is often seen on the festival table.

POI_HKSM_XZ_13_1: It's working. The devices are being shut down. The power supply for the Refinery Tower should be sufficient now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_13_2: Thank you for the help. If things are fine here, I'll be back to my job.
POI_HKSM_XZ_13_3: Got a whole lot of things to do. Please carry on with the good work with the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_13: You, you... Aren't you that researcher who was fighting with Grandpa Hong, in the journal?
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_34: In another case, the symbol is an overturn to the knowledge of life in a sci-fi epic theater play that was on in Jinzhou.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_36: Haha. It's just an example that just crossed my mind. You can have a look yourself at the Jinzhou Theater yourself if you're interested.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_37: The play was about a catastrophe. To cope with it, human decide to set their mother planet on a journey. In the play a similar symbol was mentioned to hint at the relationship between digital life and reality.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_38: One symbol, and yet it is able to sketch so many colorful worlds in different ways, though maybe they are kind of hard to comprehend as of now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_39: But so many truths are born in such unrealistic, fantasy-like languages. I always grow energetic when I think of this.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_33: Hahaha, you do know a lot, {PlayerName}. Now let's get on with the issue with the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_41: The console's verification is done by line drawing. When you start the verification process, random images will be generated on a grid.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_42: You have to put your hand on the grid, and the system will draw a line to connect the coordinates you touch. Repeated coordinates will not be recorded.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_43: Only when the order and the direction of the line you draw is right, the verification is passed. All right, let's have a try.
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_40: The question about the coexistence with TD?
POI_HKSM_XZ_21_9: You may not want to do that. If you fail to pass the verification for certain times, the console will be locked, and the system will be forced shutdown.

POI_HKSM_XZ_26_2: You tell Xiaoyu what happened back at the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_3: Sounds like a lot of twists and turns at the Mine. So we'll have to collect the samples on another day.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_7: An argument over whether to coexist with TD or not. It seems to me that they take you as a member of the Ministry.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_14: And let you know their secret inadvertently.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_12: There was a crisis of TD years ago at the Mine... Wait, I have a message.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_15: Sigh, some follow-up work to do about the meeting just now. Was trying to chat with you a little more.
POI_HKSM_XZ_26_13: Maybe next time. Take this, it's the reward from the Ministry. I'll see you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_1: Bye, Uncle Hong. Take care when you go back, eh?
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_2: Okay, okay. Tastes just like the old days, but I just can't help feeling empty.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_19: What was I going to do?
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_4: We finally found you, Grandpa Hong. Everyone's been looking for you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_7: You are... Huaxi. Why look for me?
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_21: What are you talking about? I think you lost me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_22: Huaxi and you tell the boss what happened in a low voice.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_23: Ah, that's why. I thought Uncle Hong came here after the maintenance work of the Refinery Tower, as usual.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_24: I'm telling you, my culinary skills are passed down from my fathers.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_25: Uncle Hong would always come here and have a good meal of Jinzhou Stew each time he finishes work.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_26: My father would always say food shortens the distance from home, and the distance between souls.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_27: That's why Jinzhou Stew is not only a simple dish, it's an association of feelings.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_28: What's more, Jinzhou Stew is particularly important to Uncle Hong, because the people sitting beside him here change all the time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_30: It feels lonely to have meals on one's own. No wonder Grandpa Hong looks dull.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_31: Uncle Hong took the journal. Despite the initial resistance, he read faster and faster as his hand turned the pages.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_10: Journal. That's it. I feel much settled now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_14: Right. Grandpa Hong, we found your lost journal, and fixed the reboot issue of the Refinery Tower.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_15: Besides, the guest from Ministry of Development is here to deliver the samples as agreed. That's this {Male=big brother;Female=big sister} beside me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_16: Yes... I do. Everything feels familiar again with the presence of this journal. I'm sorry for the fuss.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_17: Grandpa Hong still looks a bit strange. Let's take him to my brother.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_18: It's kind of late now, {PlayerName}. Like Uncle Modee said, the samples can't be tested as of now. Why don't you come here another day?
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_12: Maybe we shouldn't ask too much now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_25_32: Do you have any recollection of that?
POI_HKSM_XZ_24_1: The fights with Lei'li is making me sleepless. I always enjoy looking at the sky with my back lying on the grass when I can't sleep.
POI_HKSM_XZ_24_2: Look at the stars. When will we touch them?
POI_HKSM_XZ_24_3: Now, if we can push science to progress forward, one small step at a time, generation after generation, maybe one day...
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_1: You're here. {PlayerName}, this is the map you asked for.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_2: It took you some time to mark the places mentioned in the journal on the map correctly.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_4: A large area indeed. The places Grandpa Hong goes to are centered at three different regions of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_6: I get your point. It's similar to triangulation.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_7: Draw three circles with the three regions as centers, and the overlapping area is the area where Uncle Hong is most likely to show up.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_11: This greatly reduces the area we have to search. Nice idea!
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_8: Though I don't know what you're talking about, it sounds amazing. Well done, {PlayerName}!
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_9: The overlapping area is a corner in the upper living quarter. Let's go there and have a look, {PlayerName}.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_14: Oh, by the way, you can hand me the samples now, {PlayerName}. When the reboot is finished, we will start the procedures.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_15: However, it can't be done today, as the reboot can take some time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_10: Mark the places in the journal on the map.
POI_HKSM_XZ_23_5: Draw a circle with each of these regions as the center.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_16: Just a lift of finger. When the pararmeter reset is successful, the system will adjust the Refinery Tower and the reboot will be done.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_17: Now the reboot can take some time. All we need is wait. Thank you for your effort.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_43: We don't have any information about Grandpa Hong's whereabouts, though.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_18: Hm... I did find a pattern in the previous entries. Though the events are various...
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_45: ... They all happen at a few limited places.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_46: For example, Grandpa Hong often visits my brother's clinic: “Went to the clinic today and had a routine examination as per Doctor Huayu's instructions.”
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_47: “Went to the clinic today. The medication is getting so bitter. Lucky Doctor Huayu didn't find out I hid candy in my palm.”
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_48: Furthermore. Grandpa Hong always remind the lorry drivers at the transport quarter of the purchase of day-to-day items the Mine needs.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_49: Their conversations are also kept here.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_21: It feels like the routes are set, and what Uncle Hong does is to walk them time after time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_22: Then, if Uncle Hong's memory goes wrong, will he go to these places in the journal as he is used to going there?
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_51: However, these places are distributed throughout the Mine. If we were to look for him at these places, it would take a lot of people.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_41: Have you come up with something, {PlayerName}?
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_52: I have one at the Mine's institute. Just a few moments. Meet me at the gate in a while.
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_44: Why don't we read more of the journal now?
POI_HKSM_XZ_22_53: Give me a map of the Mine.

POI_HKSM_XZ_44_3: Oh, you're back, {PlayerName}. Thank you for lifting us through this crisis.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_4: Keep on calling me Uncle Hong.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_6: Yes, with the help of this plate, which I found when I left the cave.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_7: Chengwen told me in my dream that this kind of plate is made of a special mineral, and that words inscibed on it won't be worn away after years.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_8: Look, {PlayerName}. He didn't lie. His name is inscribed on it in a perfect condition.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_9: It was all in my dream, but now it's here before our eyes.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_10: I only understand now that the dreams were real things.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_12: I don't know why, but it feels like I losing the ability to feel as I forget things. No matter it is sadness or regret.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_13: What is left was only scenarios. They keep overwhelming me until I lose breath.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_14: {PlayerName}, will you listen to the other half of my boring dream?
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_16: After Lampylumen Myriad was awakened, Chengwen and I walked the same path as we do today.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_17: We broke Ice Chrysalises, removed the block at the entrance, and managed to suppress Lampylumen Myriad.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_18: However, the Refinery Tower wasn't built in the dream. Suppressing Lampylumen Myriad could only buy time for the rescue from Jinzhou to arrive.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_19: Chengwen was heavily injured in the combat, and he didn't make it on the way back to Jinzhou for healing.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_20: Later, when the Ministry started to investigate the reason of the crisis at the Mine, I was ready for being held accountable.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_21: But what met me was actually applause and medals, which I only found strange.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_22: It was Chengwen, who took all the responsibilities himself on the way back to the Ministry.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_23: It was only out of his simple belief that I could rebuild the Mine, and that the Mine couldn't afford to lose two heads.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_25: After that I started to study the documents Chengwen left. I picked up the piles of research materials that I myself pushed to the ground.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_26: And I found that we were both wrong. The coexistence wasn't a job to do at the two ends of a line, but one to do on the middle point.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_27: I found the initial ideas of the Refinery Tower from his notes, and it became what it is now after iterations.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_28: We managed the balance by suppressing Lampylumen Myriad's chill with the Refinery Tower's heat, so as to prevent it from awakening.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_29: It was with this report that Ministry of Development agreed on the proposal that the Mine coexists with the TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_30: This was the way of survival that he and I joined efforts to find, but his name was forever wiped from the Mine's documents, and marked as a sinner.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_31: And now, even I am losing his memories. I want to write something down, but my brain is just blank.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_32: I often go to the places he spent time at, but his traces are only disappearing, because the Mine is changing so fast.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_33: Lucky I have some fragments that I can put down on the journal. These stories and arguments, and Jinzhou Stew that we both love.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_35: Yes. What if one day I stop distinguishing the current from the past and forget myself?
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_36: What if I get swallowed in a woven world, just like today?
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_39: Walked out... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_40: Faced everything... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_41: And I don't want the kids to walk down my path again.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_42: Maybe this crisis is a chance for growth for them. It will correct their overdependence on the experience of previous generations.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_43: The balance of our coexistence with TD is forever changing, and the Refinery Tower is only one part of it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_44: Interestingly, this is the first time I've seen Lei'li and Modee work together.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_45: Thank you, {PlayerName}, for listening to this boring dream until the end.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_46: You should be tired after all this, right? I already informed the food stall.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_47: You must come and have a taste of the special Jinzhou Stew of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_11: You are calmer than I think.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_34: So the journal is a recollection of the past.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_37: The past is irrelevant. You walked out of it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_44_38: The past is irrelevant. You faced everything.
POI_HKSM_XZ_43_1: The communication returns normal, and the temperature is rising too. {PlayerName}, looks like you succeeded.
POI_HKSM_XZ_43_2: Uncle Hong is safely back too. The Mine is rebooting the Refinery Tower. Thank you for your efforts!
POI_HKSM_XZ_42_1: (Listen close. The chilling wind is mingled with slight sounds...)
POI_HKSM_XZ_42_2: (Wind, murmur, crushing ice... all mingled together, and closing in)
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_1: Everything was similar just now, but it feels so different from here.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_5: I was a coward in the dreams. Wasn't man enough to stand on this frost ground.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_6: No, actually I hate that me in the dreams. I was running from everything like a coward.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_7: I rushed into this plan to eliminate Lampylumen Myriad in the dream, but it only made things even worse.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_8: After I made the disaster happen, I wasn't held accountable in any form, but became the hero of the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_9: Everyone I met said “well done”, “thank you”, “you're a hero” and so forth.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_10: But it feels reassuring to be standing here. I don't, and won't run.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_11: I won't be able to help further from here, so I'll wish you luck.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_14: Lampylumen Myriad is closely associated with Ice Chrysalises. You have to take care doing this alone. Then I'm counting on you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_3: What were things like in dreams?
POI_HKSM_XZ_41_4: You kind of cling to the dreams.
POI_HKSM_XZ_40_2: The entrance is open now. Let's go, Rover.
POI_HKSM_XZ_39_1: You picked up a metal meal box, which seemed to be used to keep the food warm.
POI_HKSM_XZ_39_2: This makes me nostalgic. The Mine in my dreams were so simple.
POI_HKSM_XZ_39_3: After work, Chengwen and I were sitting right at that corner, and the box was filled with hot and steaming Jinzhou Stew.
POI_HKSM_XZ_39_4: I didn't know that meals only taste better when they are shared.
POI_HKSM_XZ_39_5: Sorry for the blabbering. Let's move on.
POI_HKSM_XZ_38_1: This Ice Chrysalises looks different from the last one.
POI_HKSM_XZ_38_2: Maybe due to the chill. It feels even colder here than just now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_1: You picked up a clay statue from the broken Ice Chrysalises. It looked like a huge fish.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_2: Maybe the miners left it here. They did learn a lot of crafts during their off time.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_4: Huge fish... Haha, it reminds me of that whale in my dream.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_5: Due to Lampylumen Myriad, Chengwen and I had an argument. We sat in one corner of the square table.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_6: He pushed piles of research materials in front of me in an effort to persuade me, and all I did was hitting the surface of the table and yelled with a voice louder than the noise of the table.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_7: After that, he visited me again with my favorite food, and he suddenly brought up this story about human's relationship with whales.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_8: And he stopped in the middle, said the other half wasn't written yet.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_9: He asked for my view on the half of the story, but I was able to find where he was really getting at.
POI_HKSM_XZ_37_10: The first encounter with whale was kind of similar to the then situation of the Mine. He wasn't asking for my opinion about the story, but my attitude towards the events.
POI_HKSM_XZ_36_1: The entrance is blocked by ice.
POI_HKSM_XZ_36_2: Yes, maybe due to the Ice Chrysalises. It is a product of the awakening of Lampylumen Myriad.
POI_HKSM_XZ_36_3: Defeat it to remove the block of the entrance.
POI_HKSM_XZ_35_1: The temperature went down so fast.
POI_HKSM_XZ_35_2: How's it going, {PlayerName}. Can you hold on?
POI_HKSM_XZ_35_3: By the way, this feels the same as what I saw in the dream. Only in that dream, I was Uncle Hong.
POI_HKSM_XZ_35_4: Let's go. We have to find the entrance to the bottom of the cave first.
POI_HKSM_XZ_33_1: When Modee tried to continue, you saw Huayu, together with Uncle Hong, rushed here and made a gesture that urged you to join him.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_1: Judging from the trend of the diffusion of the chill, the time it reaches the upper level will be only earlier. Before that, we will have to...
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_2: Oh? {PlayerName}, you're here. I heard it when Doctor Huayu asked you for help. Do you need any assistance?
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_4: So he told you all that. Then he must have told you the secret about the TD under the ground.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_5: I have always had a different view with him about the coexistence with it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_6: It's only that the event this time ignite our dissension.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_7: The reason why I insist on coexistence is simple. Do you know the TD's name, {PlayerName}?
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_10: That's right. This common name implies the reason of my insistence.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_11: It's Lampylumen Myriad. This name implies the reason of my insistence.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_12: Lampylumen is a fairly rare mineral. The conditions of its formation is so critical that even manual interference can hardly control them.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_13: However, it can naturally crystalize and deposit and solidify as raw ore in the Tiger's Maw Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_14: It was until the discovery of Lampylumen Myriad, which lies dormant underground and creates a chilling atmosphere, that we understand the source of the unique underground cave here, a product of the chill and the geography here.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_15: The cave is the optimal environment for the mineral to grow. That's why we should find a way to coexist with it.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_19: You can say that again. I just wonder why Lei'li can't see this.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_20: Yeah, I know, but we just can't give up on all this and restrain ourselves from even trying for this probability.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_21: This is the answer I work out after careful evaluation. I don't move.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_23: Uncle Hong should be a supporter of mine, but something strange happened at the fight just now...
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_18: Maybe we should reevaluate the pros and cons.
POI_HKSM_XZ_32_22: What is Uncle Hong's take on this?
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_1: Is everyone evacuated from the bottom? I want no one trapped down there.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_2: But the chill can't be stopped now. Not before long the upper parts of the Mine will be affected.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_6: Oh? So the help that Doctor Huayu mentioned is you. We just had a fight.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_7: You're well-informed, aren't you? Doctor Huayu told you, right? He talked about a help when we were fighting just not. So it's you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_8: In the meantime, as an outsider, you are the perfect judge for the two of us.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_10: As you can see, the reboot wasn't successful, and there is even a strange chill invading from the bottom.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_11: Now that Doctor Huayu has called for your help, I won't hide anything from you.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_12: Responsible to this all is the Tacet Discord under the ground of the Mine, Lampylumen Myriad.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_13: But it's not geographical location that made the Tiger's Maw Mine a deposit of so many unique, special minerals...
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_14: ...but this special ecological relationship between the Mine and the TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_15: Though both the Ministry and the Mine claim that this TD is in a stable dormancy, and that we should look for a balanced way of coexistence...
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_16: ...we only feel dread and terror, as its most immediate neighbor.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_17: This talk about balance and development.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_18: Since their birth, TDs are representatives of catastrophe. This kind of unknow, dangerous things should be exterminated.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_19: I was telling what the miners and me really think just now...
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_20: ...when Modee suddenly got mad and started to argue with me.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_21: Tell me, {PlayerName}, is what I said wrong? Aren't the facts clear enough?
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_22: Isn't this TD to blame for everything that has happened to the Mine?
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_26: You can say that again. I just wonder why Modee can't see this.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_27: But it is a ticking bomb. I must restate this.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_28: I don't know about these abstract things. All I know is seeing is believing. My view stays the same.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_30: ...Hmm. I would say Uncle Hong is in favor of Modee, because I gather he was the one that put forward the idea of coexistence.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_31: And when we were fighting just now, he... Forget it, {PlayerName}. I'll keep on counting heads.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_5: I heard the Mine is faced with a trouble.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_23: The TD is indeed a danger.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_24: Coexistence did bring benefits, didn't it?
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_25: Maybe we should reevaluate the pros and cons.
POI_HKSM_XZ_31_29: What is Uncle Hong's take on this?
POI_HKSM_XZ_30_1: Hey, I was almost frozen to death. I told you that thing underground is a ticking bomb.
POI_HKSM_XZ_30_2: Sigh, the detectors are not responding from the bottom of the Mine. The data they recorded is probably lost. All those efforts in vain.
POI_HKSM_XZ_30_3: Have you heard about it? The shutdown of the Mine wasn't a simple accident. It's because...
POI_HKSM_XZ_30_4: What are they talking about? Are they Lei'li and Modee?
POI_HKSM_XZ_30_5: I should go and ask them what happened to the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_29_1: Is it {PlayerName}? Now, it might be a sudden call, but the Mine is in a crisis now, and I don't think the signals are stable.
POI_HKSM_XZ_29_2: I don't have time, but we do need your help, please...
POI_HKSM_XZ_29_3: Seems like the Communication is cut off.
POI_HKSM_XZ_29_4: He sounded urgent. Maybe the Mine is facing some problem again.
POI_HKSM_XZ_29_5: Let's go take a look. Maybe we'll find more about the Mine's secret from the witnesses.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_1: You're here, {PlayerName}. It's a pity we didn't finish the story about the Mine's crisis.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_4: I didn't know the truth of it all before some time since I joined the Ministry.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_5: There is a colossal Tacet Discord under the ground surface of the Tiger's Maw Mine. A serious conflict was incurred among the Mine staff when it was discovered.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_6: Then, one of the heads of the Mine, Chengwen acted on impulse and speeded up the aggravation of the TD, which finally led to a grave crisis over the whole Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_7: It was Uncle Hong who rebuilt the Mine piece by piece, and put it back to order the way it had been.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_8: Though Chengwen died protecting the Mine in the crisis, his name was still linked to wrongdoing...
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_9: ...and deliberately omitted in all the documents related to the Mine.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_10: Similar discussions were provoked for times within the Ministry on the handling of this TD.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_11: It was Uncle Hong who insisted that coexistence was in the interest of the Mine. And the crisis finally quieted down.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_13: It is said that Uncle Hong was able to produce a reasonable plan and persuade people, but I don't have the details.
POI_HKSM_XZ_28_14: {PlayerName}, I think your Terminal has been ringing for a while now.
POI_HKSM_XZ_27_1: Rover, do you have time to continue our unfinished conversation from last time?
POI_HKSM_XZ_27_2: If you do, I'll be waiting for you at the Ministry of Development.

Huanglong_main_1_6_90_1: Why?! Have we been doing it all wrong from the beginning?
Huanglong_main_1_6_89_1: Our new lab is finally built.
Huanglong_main_1_6_89_2: This time... We'll stop at nothing to finish our research!
Huanglong_main_1_6_88_1: The way this thing's designed... It looks familiar...
Huanglong_main_1_6_88_3: Nuh-uh, don't touch that. What if you end up breaking things again?
Huanglong_main_1_6_87_1: Watching this really gets my creative juices flowing. O magnificant rain, you are a gift of the heavens...
Huanglong_main_1_6_87_2: And Encore's drinking it all up!
Huanglong_main_1_6_86_1: The gaps between each "mist figure" are shrinking... Over there, at the end of that alley!
Huanglong_main_1_6_85_1: The "mist figure" of Aalto. It's posed in a weird way, as if he's making a heart with his hands.
Huanglong_main_1_6_85_2: ...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.
Huanglong_main_1_6_85_3: In front of the "mist figure", there is a floating line of handwriting, also made out of fog: "Patience please, the answer is right around the corner!"
Huanglong_main_1_6_83_1: The "mist figure" of Aalto. It's posed in a weird way, as if he's stretching his arms wide for a welcome hug.
Huanglong_main_1_6_83_2: ...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.
Huanglong_main_1_6_83_3: In front of the "mist figure", there is a floating line of handwriting, also made out of fog: "Fate brings us together; may our friendship endure forever!"
Huanglong_main_1_6_82_2: Would it disappear if I touched it?
Huanglong_main_1_6_82_3: Oh! Now I've got new ideas for a party dance!
Huanglong_main_1_6_81_1: The "mist figure" of Aalto. It's posed in a weird way, as if he's an eagle spreading his wings.
Huanglong_main_1_6_81_2: ...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.
Huanglong_main_1_6_81_3: In front of the "mist figure", there is a floating line of handwriting, also made out of fog: "We value integrity and quality above all else! New customers enjoy 20% off!"
Huanglong_main_1_6_80_2: Hehe, I can do this move too!
Huanglong_main_1_6_80_3: No, don't do that, it's not for kids to try!
Huanglong_main_1_6_79_1: Oh my, what a beautiful lady!
Huanglong_main_1_6_79_2: Can I take a selfie with you, please?
Huanglong_main_1_6_78_1: Damn it! Our plan's all busted!
Huanglong_main_1_6_77_1: Oh, how I love these stories...
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_1: There is still some time before the next session. Here are some books to keep you entertained before that, dear listeners.
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_3: So you want to learn more about that battle?
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_4: They say storytelling inevitably carries some subjective bias, all to enhance the ebb and flow of the narrative.
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_5: But when it comes to the "Battle Beneath the Crescent," we typically avoid adding any of our personal commentary, focusing instead on accurately retelling history.
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_6: But even just telling the story carries a heavy emotional weight.
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_7: Was Geshu Lin truly an unforgivable sinner? Was General Jiyan the perfect hero?
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_8: The sudden onset of the Retroact Rain, the decision of our Sentinel, and the timing behind this series of events...
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_9: I guess it will be up to future generations to figure it all out, haha.
Huanglong_main_1_6_76_2: (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)

Guide_BWHC_5_26: Are you for real right now? My reputation as the Jinzhou Speedster is...
Guide_BWHC_5_27: I-I had no other choice! How can I remember all those safety rules when there are bad guys coming at me? They’d only slow me down... Okay, okay, next time, I’ll watch out!
Guide_BWHC_5_28: So, are you two heading back to help Auntie Panhua with this Essence Medley Soup? If so, count me in on learning that recipe too!
Guide_BWHC_5_29: Just let Auntie Panhua know. It should be cool for you to join in!
Guide_BWHC_5_30: But there's still one last piece of the puzzle to crack: the golden-handled spoon. If we whip up the soup without figuring out what that is about, the flavor might not hit the mark, right?
Guide_BWHC_5_31: Wait, isn’t the golden handle spoon that big pyrite spoon from Uncle Wei’s shop? I thought you both knew.
Guide_BWHC_5_34: Seriously? No way! Who’d have guessed that!
Guide_BWHC_5_35: Oops, looks like I gotta step down from my role as the Jinzhou encyclopedia. I’ve never even heard of that pyrite spoon!
Guide_BWHC_5_36: Haha, no worries. I spotted that spoon the last time I dropped off medicine at Uncle Wei’s and asked out of curiosity.
Guide_BWHC_5_37: Why does the best weapon maker in Jinzhou have a big pyrite spoon tucked away? Well, I’m counting on you to solve that mystery, along with the last step of the recipe.
Guide_BWHC_5_32: The answer was right in front of us all along.
Guide_BWHC_5_33: That makes sense... After all, pyrite is called fool’s gold.
Guide_BWHC_13_15: Here you go, everyone. The rewards I promised. Three meal vouchers. Anytime you’re craving Auntie’s dishes, just swing by. One voucher equals one free meal, and there’s no limit on how many dishes you can order!

LoadingTipsText_1010_TipsText: Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.
LoadingTipsText_1011_TipsText: The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.
LoadingTipsText_1012_TipsText: In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite" — a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.
LoadingTipsText_80020101_TipsText: A mysterious gateway has appeared, leading to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...

Flow_11000004_141: Sir, perhaps we can handle this another day...
Flow_11000004_143: Sir, what seems to be the problem?
Flow_11000004_144: Why give up just because Sanhua turned you down?
Flow_11000004_145: Is there something I can do for you?
Flow_11000004_146: You don't understand, this is important. I need to speak directly with the Jinzhou Magistrate.
Flow_11000004_147: But now everyone is talking about an important guest coming to Jinzhou, and even City Hall can't keep up...
Flow_11000004_148: Maybe... maybe I should come back another day?
Flow_11000004_150: I did see Sanhua though! Just a fleeting glance, but it was her!
Flow_11000004_151: Please, let's keep it down a bit, everyone.
Flow_11000004_152: The crowd's growing. Where's this important guest everyone's talking about?
Flow_11000004_159: Why are you here all by yourself?
Flow_11000004_160: I'm waiting for Father to finish work.
Flow_11000004_161: He usually finishes around this time...
Flow_11000004_162: But he's told me he has to finish all his work before leaving.
Flow_11000004_163: He also told me that a very, very important guest is arriving in Jinzhou.
Flow_11000004_166: Just you? Isn't that a bit dangerous?
Flow_11000004_168: There are no monsters in Jinzhou that come out to eat kids at night.
Flow_11000004_169: Plus, with Uncle Yingda and the others around, City Hall is safe!
Flow_11000004_170: Hello, are you also here to meet with the Magistrate?
Flow_11000004_171: Make sure your papers are ready...
Flow_11000004_173: Ever since the Magistrate announced an important guest was visiting, the number of visitors to City Hall is growing by the hour.
Flow_11000004_175: Times like these, we can't let our guard down. Everything needs to be done by the book.
Flow_11000004_176: The crowd keeps growing. Where is this important guest anyway?
Flow_11000004_179: Seems like a lot of folks think they are the important guest the Magistrate spoke about.
Flow_11000004_180: But it doesn't matter, because the Magistrate and Lady Sanhua are the final judge of that. That's why so many are turned away at the door.
Flow_11000004_181: Maybe Lady Sanhua knows, but it's like casting a wide net hoping the big fish takes the bait...
Flow_11000004_182: Ah, if your paperwork is ready, better hurry and request a meeting with Lady Sanhua.
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_1: (Now I have retrieved the Magistrate's message for me from the puzzle box.)
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_2: (But it only points me to where the Grand Library is. There's no meeting time... Something is still missing.)
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_3: (I've solved the puzzle, the disks have been rotated, and the two symbols are now glowing.)
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_4: (With this glowing light, a shadow is cast on two other symbols.)
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_5: (The Black Tortoise of the North... North to the City Hall.)
Huanglong_main_1_5_5555_6: (And the time reads... The <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Chou, in the Wei hours of the morning.)

Huanglong_main_1_6_4_22: A storyteller near the theater once told us something like this...
Huanglong_main_1_7_108_1: This thing is weakening. I'll shield you from its attacks!
Huanglong_main_1_7_108_2: Rover, find a chance to strike its core!
Huanglong_main_1_7_107_1: Watch out for its ranged attacks!
Huanglong_main_1_7_107_3: It avoids attacking the "moon" behind. That "moon" must be the core of our enemy.
Huanglong_main_1_7_106_1: This is the swordsmanship we teach our new recruits... How dare you!
Huanglong_main_1_7_104_1: That "moon" has cannibalized the Crownless's remaining frequencies to created another monster.
Huanglong_main_1_7_104_2: I remember... I saw it during the Battle Beneath the Crescent...
Huanglong_main_1_7_103_1: Those frequencies we just crashed... The "moon" is drawing them in?
Huanglong_main_1_7_101_1: It's been immobilized. Time to strike!
Flow_311000000_393: Oh my! {Male=Young man;Female=Young lady}, you look worn from travel. Are you here for tea, or heading somewhere else?
ItemInfo_70010069_AttributesDescription: A recipe detailing the ingredients and method for Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010069_BgDescription: A recipe found in an old book by Panhua, it is said that following this recipe can recreate the long-lost wartime dish, the Jade Treasure Soup that people describe as “a condensed bowl of Jinzhou". However, through time, the terms written in the recipe have become obscure and difficult to understand. Before cooking, it is necessary to further confirm the specific ingredients.

ItemInfo_70010070_AttributesDescription: Special ingredient pack for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.

ItemInfo_70010071_BgDescription: Luohan Clearwater, an unrecognizable term for Mahe, is used among pharmacies years ago, referring to the potion made by boiling Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass. To make the Jade Treasure Soup, Koko gave you a portion.

Huanglong_main_1_2_5_68: It seems we need a simulated combat to figure out what happened in your body.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_69: Please hold your Terminal tight and stay still.
Huanglong_main_1_2_134_2: Baizhi, what happened just now? The connection was suddenly cut off...
Huanglong_main_1_2_134_3: ...Rover. Do you still remember what you saw?
Huanglong_main_1_2_132_1: Mrs. Panhua, g'morning! Three bowls of extra spicy noodles, please!
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_1: Can you give us some more details?
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_4: A giant Tacet Discord with a scythe... It doesn't sound like the Crownless. Might be even higher-ranked.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_5: An enormous moon looming above you... Now, this reminds me of the unusual sightings that supposedly happened during a past war...
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_6: This is the first time we've run into anything like this since we put the training ground into use...
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_7: The Sonoro Sphere captures everything that once happened in a specific time and place, be it good or bad.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_8: Our goal was to extract pure Remnant Energy with the simulated Sonoro Sphere, but we cannot guarantee that all "abnormal frequencies" were eliminated.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_9: Your arrival may have revived the "abnormal frequencies" we accidentally captured.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_10: Remnant Energy sometimes give rise to memory manifestations of sentient beings. You may have encountered one such manifestation.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_11: I suspect it could have something to do with your unconscious mind.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_12: Such anomalies could have been hiding in the simulation, and they 'resonated' with your subconscious. Or perhaps... they were lifted from your subconscious in the first place.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_13: I'm afraid I can't give you a conclusion yet. Not until we've run a thorough analysis on the data collected.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_14: I'll also check the simulated Sonoro Sphere again to see what on earth happened to it.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_15: In terms of bodily functions, you seem to be in perfect health... In fact, all the data look quite good.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_16: But if you feel anything unusual, please come find me any time.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_2: A giant Tacet Discord with a scythe...
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_3: An enormous moon fading in and out of the sky...
Huanglong_main_1_2_126_1: I'm back to the same spot again...
Huanglong_main_1_2_126_2: And this... Moon? What is happening...
Huanglong_main_1_2_125_2: The comm line is dead... Something's wrong. Gotta be cautious.
Huanglong_main_1_2_124_1: We have gathered all the data we need. The test is ending soon. Rover, you can find the exit straight up ahead.
Huanglong_main_1_2_123_1: Not the slightest fluctuation in your frequency energy... So it was not your Resonance Ability, either...
Huanglong_main_1_2_123_2: Hmm. I suppose we'll do another round to fully test your potential...
Huanglong_main_1_2_122_1: Hmm... As You'tan had previously detected, your bodily functions are in good condition, and you seem entirely unaffected by the Crownless' energy.
Huanglong_main_1_2_122_2: Now, we will temporarily boost your Resonance Ability for further testing.
Huanglong_main_1_2_121_1: This is the Academy's simulated training ground. Don't worry, Yangyang and I will assist you.
Huanglong_main_1_2_121_2: Please fight the simulated Tacet Discords like you normally would.
