Flow_140000002_2309: That statue... It just showed up again...

Huanglong_main_1_4_4_1: Guess you won't need my self-introduction. Aww, I spent so much time on it.
Flow_11000001_778: Hello, I'm Chie, the drummer of the Liondance Troupe.
Flow_11000001_779: If you're interested in the Liondance performance, you can leave a message over there.
Flow_11000001_780: Hi, Rover. Are you here for Lingyang?
Flow_11000001_781: That kid has been training even harder recently...
Flow_11000001_782: The new drumstick doesn't feel quite right. I'll have to ask Lingyang to help me refine it a bit...
Flow_11000001_783: Is there anything I can help? If you're interested in a Liondance performance, you can go over there to register!
Flow_11000001_785: Would you like to join our Liondance Troupe? Haha, just kidding.

Flow_11000001_786: The lost heart is like a flower blooming alone in the Dim Forest. Its scarlet color remains, but fragile and indistinct, with scars running down its body.
Flow_11000001_788: Eek! You startled me for a moment there... If it isn't the Night Champion, {PlayerName}?
Flow_11000001_789: Through fading thorns, has the hero finally arrived to rescue the maiden wounded by the spikes?
Flow_11000001_790: You must've gotten the wrong person.
Flow_11000001_791: Have I? It seems that the dusty memories cannot be awakened by a single sentiment after all.
Flow_11000001_792: You and I are like two meteors flying off in opposite directions, only til we fall can we seek redemption from the sins of convergence...
Flow_11000001_794: Though I've tasted a lot of food during my journey, when it comes to cooking, I'm a bit of a... what's the word...
Flow_11000001_797: But salt is the ultimate seasoning for every dish. Add some salt, you can't go wrong.
Flow_11000001_798: The recipe for the Braising Sauce? Hehe, I happen to know it.
Flow_11000001_799: So, what kind of precious, shiny, commemorative coin are you going to trade with me, huh?
Flow_11000001_801: Ah, forget it. You seem unwilling to answer my quiz. It's not fun at all.
Flow_11000001_802: I'll just tell you. The secret is a small amount of sugar, melted over a low heat and stirred for a certain amount of time, and then added to the Braising Sauce. That's it.
Flow_11000001_803: As for the timing and the duration, well, I'll leave that for you to figure out!
Flow_11000001_804: Even though it's called a broth, a lot of ingredients are added during the cooking process.
Flow_11000001_805: As far as I know, while the methods vary, the most common main ingredient is fowl.
Flow_11000001_806: I personally recommend adding more fowl, you know. It's nutritious, relatively low in fat, and good for your health.
Flow_11000001_808: Hey, are you interested in Overdash too?
Flow_11000001_809: I get it, since Overdash is a sport with a long history and wide audience.
Flow_11000001_810: Not only does it strengthen your body, it may as well save your life in a pinch.
Flow_11000001_811: It's true. I heard that during the war, those who could master the Overdash technique survived better than those who couldn't.
Flow_11000001_813: I have to mention the connection I've had with Overdash since birth!
Flow_11000001_814: If it weren't for my mom being... uh... captivated by my dad's Overdash on the training field... Well, I wouldn't be here today!
Flow_11000001_816: I'm getting off track here... What I'm trying to say is, Overdash might just bring you some unexpected connections!
Flow_11000001_817: So, does it sound exciting, right?
Flow_11000001_818: We Overdash enthusiasts have formed a fan club, and we're eagerly recruiting new members!
Flow_11000001_819: Once you join, you'll have senior members to guide you, various offline activities to participate in, and even international exchange competitions!
Flow_11000001_820: Unlike those clubs, we won't charge you for entry! It's totally free!
Flow_11000001_821: Absolutely no membership fees of any kind! Just leave an e-signature here on the terminal...
Flow_11000001_823: Hey, hey, hey, hey, don't go—
Flow_311000007_896: Interested in weapon crafting, are you?
Flow_311000007_897: Oh? Besides my skills, what else could you possibly want from an old-timer like me?
Flow_311000007_899: I'm a Crafting expert, and you're asking me about cooktops? What's going on in that young head of yours?
Flow_311000007_900: Oh, no. That's not why we're here today.
Flow_311000007_901: Do you know how to make the marinade?
Flow_311000007_903: Wait, hold on, I never said I didn't know.
Flow_311000007_904: I'm not sure about the specifics, but my wife always puts Fowl in the pot before she makes the marinade.
Flow_311000007_905: She says it makes everything taste meaty, and our son loves it... hmm.
Flow_311000007_906: A Resonator's life is crucial, but their weapon comes close. Pick a reliable one in my place.
Flow_311000007_908: How about it? Feeling fresh with your new weapon? Haha.
Flow_311000007_910: Feel free to come again when you feel like changing things up.
Flow_311000000_398: Second-rate cooks might make a broth that tastes good on first sip, but lacks richness of flavor after a while.
Flow_311000000_399: Don't underestimate that pinch of sugar. It makes all the difference in the taste and depth of flavor!
Flow_311000000_400: That's why you asked me. I don't share this with just anyone.

GuideTutorialPage_32022_Content:
Some special enemies on Solaris-3 are exceptionally violent and <color=#ffd12f>hard to defeat</color>. Utilize <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> or <color=#ffd12f>Intro Skills</color> to deal meaningful damage to them.
It's worth noting that these special enemies do not grow stronger with your SOL Phase. If they are hard to beat now, consider leveling up your characters and try again later.
These special enemies will <color=#ffd12f>regenerate</color> sometime after being defeated.

POI_SMBD_24_19: Hey, Rover, you see that big building? The Tacet Mark core of all these Incinero Petals is right there…
POI_SMBD_24_20: I think the only option is to escape from the Gravity Storm and give it a try up close.
POI_SMBD_24_21: Hey Rover, remember when you met the Inferno Rider and it whispered “Rush… Till the end...”?
POI_SMBD_24_22: Maybe inside that TD, the wishes of the fallen Midnight Rangers still linger.
POI_SMBD_24_23: Rover, if you can outrun that TD, those fallen solders may help you… Help you reach the end, the finish line…
POI_SMBD_24_25: Hey, Mimika. The catapult is all set.
POI_SMBD_24_26: All right. The rest is yours, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. This time, we will put an end to it all!

SOL3 Phase is raised through Union Level. <color=HighlightB>Every 10 Union Levels raises SOL3 Phase by 1.</color>

Once you've reached Union Levels <color=HighlightB>20, 40, and 60</color>, complete the corresponding <color=HighlightB>Phase Ascension</color> quests to further increase your Union Level.

Proceed to the Quests menu to complete the Phase Ascension quest, raising the Union Level cap.

POI_YNAQGS_78_2: The familiar murmur is back, and this time "phantom" is unmistakably in front of you.
POI_YNAQGS_7_10: Because of water temperature differences, there's a large <color=Highlight>vortex</color> deep in the marsh. It used to be considered a local spectacle, but now with the bizarre fog, it has stirred up dangerous <color=Highlight>mud</color> and spilled it everywhere.
POI_YNAQGS_7_11: By installing these chips, we can utilize the resonance of ultrasonic pulses to dissolve the <color=Highlight>mud</color>.
POI_YNAQGS_42_48: The river you step into again will never be the same river you stepped into for the first time, and things that perish cannot truly be resurrected.
POI_YNAQGS_25_7: Our predecessors were unable to find an answer, but at least they left behind these clues. It's on us to keep their legacy alive and move forward.
POI_YNAQGS_21_6: A research facility for the fog... Hmm... That explains why the facility is equipped for observation, with environmental simulators and a central control panel in the center.
POI_YNAQGS_21_8: No need to worry! The Huaxu Academy has dedicated procedures set in place when it comes to matters relating to the Court of Savantae. Prior to my departure, Mr. Xiangli Yao told me everything I needed to know.
POI_YNAQGS_21_9: I will share with you the coordinates of the facility. But... are you really planning on going there?
POI_YNAQGS_21_11: I'm aware that you must've done a great deal of research regarding the fog. Yet once you've gone inside, you'll soon realize that the reality is completely different.
POI_YNAQGS_21_12: *sigh* With all the TDs growing ever so restless, plus those weird "phantoms"... and the mud, it's all over the place...
POI_YNAQGS_21_13: Don't worry, it's nothing we can't handle.
POI_YNAQGS_2_1: Thank you for your help back there. Could have been a tough fight.
POI_YNAQGS_19_9: Sure it can. It's something that was uniquely popular among us older generations. And all you need, get ready for it...
POI_YNAQGS_19_11: A leaf? You sure you can really play music with it.
POI_YNAQGS_19_23: So now only one of the two TDs is left?
POI_YNAQGS_10_38: Yes. As Hui mentioned before, Ecoacoustics and Ecology are two deeply connected disciplines of study. Through unraveling hidden secrets in the fog, we may gain a comprehensive understanding of these "phantoms."
Guide_YXQJ_18_2: It looks tough to deal with. You should make good use of the Illusive Echoes and Metaphors you've gotten so far.
Guide_YXQJ_16_4: But it seems you've become somewhat accustomed to the battles here. That's good.
Guide_YXQJ_13_1: I'm not sure what that thing was, but the Metaphor it provided should come in handy.
Guide_YXQJ_13_2: There is no such thing as an objective reality in this realm of dreams and memories. The more obscure something is, the more possibilities it holds.
Guide_YXQJ_13_3: Here they come again. Such a relentless mob of monsters.
Guide_YXQJ_11_1: They aren't supposed to be here. This Memory Zone must have been corrupted, too.
Guide_YXQJ_11_2: Don't underestimate them, Rover. Be careful. We have no idea what kinds of enemies may appear in the current Somnoire.

Huanglong_main_1_7_163_1: We have almost reached the top. That giant rock... We've got to remove it somehow.
Huanglong_main_1_7_162_1: The obstacle is gone. We can now remove the rock fragments blocking the airflow!
Huanglong_main_1_7_161_1: Another rock blocking our way... But this one isn't buldging. It seems stuck...
Huanglong_main_1_7_161_2: Hmm. The obstacle must be got rid of first. Let's rid the airflow and try to find the obstacle from another direction.
Huanglong_main_1_7_160_1: More rocks... Let's remove them once we find a foothold.
Huanglong_main_1_7_159_1: There are some more floors up there... but how are we going to climb up?
Huanglong_main_1_7_159_2: I can see a Gravity Stream up ahead. It's currently blocked off. We'll pull the rocks away first, then let it carry us up there.
Huanglong_main_1_7_158_1: Let's try pulling the floating boulders together. This should make our path ahead.

Huanglong_main_1_7_33_5: You... You are... Jun! No... No no no, what have I done?!
Huanglong_main_1_7_33_6: Sorry... I'm so sorry. I can't tell the differences... I really can't... Ahhh...
Huanglong_main_1_7_32_2: Orders are orders. No one's leaving!

Huanglong_main_1_7_31_1: Did you all see that? The moon... why is it all blurry now?
Huanglong_main_1_7_31_2: Pull yourselves together. The moon is none of our concern. General Geshu told us to keep fighting no matter what.
Huanglong_main_1_7_30_1: Ugh... When will we ever see the end of this...
Huanglong_main_1_7_30_2: General Geshu has already brought us this far. We'll be over this soon!
Huanglong_main_1_7_30_3: That must be the lair of the damned Ova-something. We just need to get rid of it, and that's all.
Huanglong_main_1_7_30_5: Yeah. Let's not drag our General's feet at least. Gotta step up our game...
Huanglong_main_1_7_28_1: The Phantoms contain a lot of Remnant Energy... These Tacet Discords might be coming after it!

Huanglong_main_1_7_27_1: The soldiers... Watch out, they're not real! And the Tacet Discords are coming at us!

Huanglong_main_1_7_25_5: I wonder what other anomalies await us ahead...
Huanglong_main_1_7_18_3: It's too dangerous here. Please go back.
Huanglong_main_1_7_172_1: We should be safe now. I hope he's alright... Let's go check on him.
Huanglong_main_1_7_170_2: All Tacet Discords nearby have been dealt with. Now, the city's defense...
Huanglong_main_1_7_169_2: Our enemies are spent. Hold your ground!
Huanglong_main_1_7_168_1: Defend the south gate! Enemy attack weakening. This wave is almost over!
Huanglong_main_1_7_153_1: The Retroact Rain's effects are worsening... We must proceed with caution.

Huanglong_main_1_7_147_1: Disruptor's fully charged! Rover, let's take out the remaining Tacet Discords together!
Huanglong_main_1_7_146_1: Disruptor's at 80%! Their offense is weakening. Hold on just a little longer, Rover!
Huanglong_main_1_7_145_1: Disruptor 50% charged... Enemies ahead. Watch out, Rover!
Huanglong_main_1_7_144_1: Our soldiers are still fighting to hold on…
Huanglong_main_1_7_142_1: Something's wrong. This TD Outbreak seems different, unlike the previous ones caused by Retroact Rain.
Huanglong_main_1_7_142_2: According to the Academy people, we should see converging energy trails.
Huanglong_main_1_7_142_3: But no energy trails this time, the Tacet Discords are appearing out of think air, as if summoned…
Huanglong_main_1_7_142_4: You mean… It is the Threnodian’s work?
Huanglong_main_1_7_142_5: Likely so. We have to find and stop it before it’s too late.
Huanglong_main_1_7_141_1: Greetings, Rover! I've heard about you!
Huanglong_main_1_7_141_2: I'm Yuehui, in charge of our infantry. This is Konglin, our ranged units leader. We're making battle plans.
Huanglong_main_1_7_141_3: You see, the valley’s got a tricky terrain. We'll need a way to maximize firepower.
Huanglong_main_1_7_141_5: We must consider all options and brace for the worst.
Huanglong_main_1_7_140_1: The terrain's narrow, we'll be forced into close combat.
Huanglong_main_1_7_140_2: We can cover you from the cliffs, like this...
Huanglong_main_1_7_139_1: The battle is upon us... This is our last chance.
Huanglong_main_1_7_139_2: We must defend Jinzhou and all we hold dear. Victory will be ours!
Huanglong_main_1_7_138_1: The battle is upon us. Are you ready?
Huanglong_main_1_7_138_2: We must defend Jinzhou and all we hold dear. Victory will be ours!
Huanglong_main_1_7_138_4: We will prevail the lasting night!
Huanglong_main_1_7_136_2: Fully healed. I’m ready to go!
Huanglong_main_1_7_136_3: Don't push yourself too much. Stay safe in the upcoming fights.
Huanglong_main_1_7_135_3: Good. Can't be careless in this battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_131_1: Thank you! Some of us are still fighting in there. We must go help them!
Huanglong_main_1_7_130_1: The Tacet Discords here have been dealt with. Let’s go reinforce the outpost, it's still under attack.
Huanglong_main_1_7_129_1: They'll get a taste of our conviction!
Huanglong_main_1_7_128_1: Our morale is unbeatable. Let's keep it up and crush all our enemies!
Huanglong_main_1_7_127_1: I'm ready to help. Please hold on a little longer!
Huanglong_main_1_7_124_1: Hold on! Reinforcement's on their way!
Huanglong_main_1_7_123_1: Get lost! You're not getting closer!
Huanglong_main_1_7_122_1: Shhh... It's okay now... I'm here with you...
Huanglong_main_1_7_121_1: Please stay still. I'll help you patch it up...
Huanglong_main_1_7_120_1: Any update on the protective barrier?
Huanglong_main_1_7_120_2: We've put in all our resources to repair it as soon as possible, but...
Huanglong_main_1_7_118_1: Hello, Rover. This is our temporary storage site. Help yourself to anything you need.
Huanglong_main_1_7_118_2: People have generously donated a lot of supplies, and we must not disappoint them. Our mission is to defend this location at all costs.
Huanglong_main_1_7_118_3: If you have questions, talk to Director Taoqi at the nearby pass. She's in charge.
Huanglong_main_1_7_115_1: Fight... Until the last of them is wiped out.

InfoDisplay_102801008_Text:
A small military transport aircraft crashed during a cruise towards ■■■. The cause of the crash was under investigation. At approximately 8,000 feet, the Flight made an initiation of a descent towards ■■■. The aircraft disintegrated as it crashed to the ground. All crew members were killed in the accident.
Shortly after the departure, the Flight reached 8,400 feet at 13:46. The craft issued a "Deviated from Course" alert at 14:40:25, after which it drove out of cruising altitude. The crew failed to respond to the alert.
Last recorded status: 
Standard pressure altitude: 4,234 meters; Course: 108 degrees. 
No recorded radar signal afterward.
The aircraft is entitled to a valid flight certificate with no necessity for large-scale repair during the last inspection. All crew members possess valid and legal licenses to operate the Flight. Normal safety inspection procedure conducted before boarding.
Along the cruise, all navigation and surveillance facilities functioned normally until 14:41:36 the flight plan was interrupted by temporary haywire indicators. Upon the investigation of the wreckage, the aircraft found no attack trace by EMP. Unable to identify the probable cause of the accident under the Waveworn Phenomenon, the Board demands an urgent change in approaches to investigate this case.
The follow-up investigation is ongoing.
...
30 days after the crash of ■■■ Transport Flight, the black box was retrieved for further investigation on the tapes and recording. It's acknowledged that the crew members had taken safety precautions to record all anomalies.
According to the black box, a glitch appeared on the monitor screen at ■■■. They encountered an upsidedown metropolis in mid-air, while dense fog prevented the aircraft from pressing on. This was reported as a typical phenomenon of the Etheric Sea. The crew made difficult adjustments, to no avail. Out of control, the captain was hit on the head compelled by the abnormal gravity. The co-pilot applied unsuccessful emergency breaks, after which the aircraft went straight to ■■■.
...
To conclude, it's accepted by all that the detrimental effects of the Lament are defying our technology, as no scientific grounds can be used to explain such accidents. In recent reports, the Etheric Sea is spreading with troubling Retroact Rain that affects residents. To survive these disasters, we need to take measures to unravel the underlying truth of our world.
InfoDisplay_102801009_Text:
As the Express through the Rain I
The door swings open with a creaking. I turn around, portraying the raindrops with my eyes. Shall they end up in the sea upon the skies? I don't know, nor the destination of this express. Now and then I remember the past, when you and me crouch in one silhouette on those rainy nights. Will we return, back to days of blooming petals and neon lights?

As the Express through the Rain II
I remember, I do. Wet neon, frantic traffic, they all dance like Tetras. We don't care about umbrellas. As we shuffle through shallow depressions on the ground, our swirling skirts willingly embrace the splash. We dance to the tune of rain, dreaming without concerning the days. I wish I could dance with you till we catch the sun; I wish the rain never ends; I wish we never part ways.
That's when we see the flashing light. Bathing in those glowing drops, we chuckle out in the pouring rain. As the car chimes hard, I hear your voice: Can we continue the dance, continue without a finale? I say yes, no finale. We'll stop for no one.
Unsullied by doubt, you nod. In your full skirt, the rain is returning to the skies.
The express, descending from the air, carries you away with strong whistles.
Then, silent neon lights are smashed to the ground and feed me the splashes.
Then, the rain is gently consumed by the flames.
Then, I get swallowed by that rainy night.

As the Express through the Rain III
All our dreams disappear in the heavy rain, as they evaporate in the aching land.
The spreading fire burns every vein and valve, so as the rain drops about to meet the ground.
I see crawling petals come out of the soil, tearing down the foundation with their bodies. I can only escape, stumbling through the night and howling rains as I cling to the past shadow of you.
The scorching land permits the failure of our dreams. I lose you.
But the rain revisits here, along with the same old train.
In playbacks I see the express, welcoming me with open doors. Everything is still the same.
So I take a step forward. The door closes with a simultaneous broadcast. Am I seeing phantoms, mimicry of dizzy passengers in every cabin?
But that doesn't matter. As I find you, I ask you for permission to sit by your side. Same as you inviting me over a never-ending dance.
The answer is yes. Nothing will stop the express, not the rain nor the broken rails, until it greets the next desperate passenger.
InfoDisplay_102801009_Title: As the Express through the Rain
InfoDisplay_102801010_Text:
Jinzhou Folklore Journal I
Jinzhou is the newest city of Huanglong. It rests on the frontier where perilous monsters lurk. Devoting all its strength, Jinzhou thrives against continuous threats and moves steadfastly on a buoyant path.
Adjacent to other cities, the Gorges of Spirits marks the throat and the inevitable gate on every route. Through Jinzhou, visitors can find their way to the entire Huanglong. Embracing such geographical pre-eminence, Jinzhou continues to enlighten poets and merchants, bringing forth inspiration and fortune.
The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal II
In the distant past, Gorges of Spirits was known as the crawling nest of Tacet Discords. In dying will, soldiers of Huanglong safeguarded their homeland against the approaching storm of destruction. Shed blood converged into a solid dome that intercepted their enemies before they cast the final dice.
Suddenly, a long cry came from under the Gorges, shaking the ground with Loong's mighty existence. Cutting a chasm in the sky, this creature set the stage amidst an overwhelming light. As the bell clanged, a fighter with golden eyes descended, piercing a sharp blade through the Crownless. Like blares of horns support arrived from all sides, filling the battlefield with cheers and fighting wills.
After this battle, the Gorges of Spirits was appointed as the defending border, protecting Jinzhou and the people of Huanglong.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal III
The statue of Sentinel is located at the exit of the Gorges, a dominant figure and a permitted talisman standing between all chaos. The Sentinel of Jinzhou "Jué" represents one star of Qingloong, carrying a message to cleanse evil and bathe Jinzhou in its pure blessings.
Whenever a Magistrate is chosen, or every decision is about to be made, Jué will be present as a guiding hand.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal IV
The common rendezvous for the festivities of Jinzhou starts from Knell Square to the Statue of Sentinel. People pray for blessings in front of the silent statue, no matter if it's for yield or peace.
During the Spring Loong Festival, the streets of Jinzhou will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year.
The Midnight Rangers too follow these etiquettes. As they stand tirelessly to ward off Tacet Discords in those prevailing nights, citizens of Jinzhou could gather in joyous reunion.
InfoDisplay_102801011_Text:
"Here comes a beast, akin to a lion. It exudes might and intellect, embraces a human's act..."
Long ago, a recluse beast "Suan'ni" inhabited the distant jungle of Huanglong.
Legend had it these great fighters abhorred evils as deadly foes, endowing humans with generous courage. Its figure frequently led the fight troops, overwhelming enemies with great strength. One against a hundred, it disrupted the offensive Tacet Discords, hence honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by its human companions.
To commemorate such success and pass down its blessings, human created the Liondance that adopted their moves into dancing footwork. To this day, the Liondance still embraces many successors among Huanglong.
This precious friendship lasted for hundreds of years hereafter.
Unfortunately, the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish, devouring living beings and the vibrant jungles where the connection between humans and Suan'ni moored.
Later on, rumors ruled upon the civil tongues that Suan'ni had adopted a vicious nature.
It was said that they encroached upon human territories and repelled all living creatures within their reach... And they were the harbinger of Tacet Field.
Some objected, saying Suan'ni was an early warning that protected humans from the approaching Tacet Field danger.
Difficult to tell their nature, people raised a big question mark on the existence of Suan'ni... In mere speculations, I tend to mark those evil ones as a narrow slice of Suan'ni.
As for the reason... perhaps it has possible connections to the loss of territories, struggles of power induced by depleted resources... Or the Waveworn Phenomenon should have contributed largely to their raging mutation.
As researchers achieved further discovery, it's acknowledged by most that Resonance Ability can be an acquired strength that stems exactly from one's heart. Without proper treatment, it begets destruction. In later research, it was confirmed that Suan'ni possesses a special power similar to the Resonance Ability. Even a powerful Suan'ni can "Overclock" like Resonators.
Many scientists believe Suan'ni accepted eventual extinction as they failed in the war against inner brutality.
However, I believe the survivors of Suan'ni will recall the past friendship with the human race.
Out of a natural curiosity toward legends of beasts, I decided to venture into the realm once Suan'ni resided. If anyone finds this interesting through my article, my efforts will not yield fruitless.
Next stop, the Violet Banyan.
InfoDisplay_102801011_Title: Study on Mythical Beasts in Huanglong
InfoDisplay_102801012_Text:
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part One
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Being a courier, the most comforting sound is the early whistle of vessels arriving at the port. Every day, Port Gunchao witnesses the busiest waterways in Huanglong, transporting both cargo and stories from afar—I know all of these from Miss Lumi!
According to Miss Lumi, Port Gunchao constitutes the largest freight transportation port in Huanglong! Every cargo to Jinzhou must travel through this port! As ships rest upon the morning bank, a long whistle utters in the air, announcing the arrival of new freight and the start of a busy day.
Couriers like me must fulfill every order without mistakes as they bear anticipation from every inch of SOL3 through mountains and seas. Recently, frequent delivery requests from Tiger's Maw Mine appeared on my list. The thought excites me that I could help to convey these precious vehicles of love and voice to Shuzhou, Shaozhou, and places on the distant corners of Huanglong. 
And senior couriers in my branch told me about a fabled island located in the most faraway place on the planet. Only the brightest ones could access the mystic portal to it! If my mail could finally reach its shores, perhaps I'd earn myself the title of a valuable courier! I'm sure that I'll find the chance! Hehe!
Because our topic here is: Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today! Hmm, I nearly forgot... Address... What's the address for our next order...

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Two
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Now that I've mentioned sounds, maybe the friction when the breeze gently laps on our uniform deserves to be on the list! I could hear the roaring gales as I ride the express car to deliver my orders. It serves as a reminder during my journey, urging me to hurry my pace with louder chants.
But please note that safety is the first on the road! Because you may bump into dangerous Tacet Discords that look pretty alike to traffic lights. Just follow the rules: red for stop and green for go, keep this in mind every time! Or you'll catch the attention of vicious monsters! No one can predict the situation around the port, since Tacet Discords are haunting us with their looming existence... It even gets worse when we have to commute between here and the obsolete port... 
Oh, that used to be a place of glamour like Port Gunchao, according to Miss Lumi. But the transportation was ruined by the sudden appearance of the fault zone. To make things worse, Tacet Discords started to pop up from nowhere... Later, the port could only bid farewell to its busy days and sink into dust. Such a waste. I think many packages are held up in the port to this day... Well, that's not what you expect of an express. I wonder if these packages could finally meet the right ends...
Maybe our new supply station will do the trick? Okay, my next workplace is settled then! Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Three
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Continuing our topic on the sound... I don't think I can skip the strange murmurs from Whining Aix's Mire. No, those are totally INSANE!
Let me explain in detail: I've made a transfer request to the new supply station. But some Exiles lurking in the neighbors just raided our camp and robbed us blind. I can't believe this... I know these aren't just common packages, they're potent representations of feelings. Miss Lumi agrees with me. On our first encounter, I already knew her as an impressive navigator. Though young, she deals with every order with delicacy, and that allows her to locate the fastest route despite all the obstacles and rubble along the way. When she delivers a package, intact as it is, to her customers, she ends her service with a radiant smile. How sweet...
By the way, Exiles are just one subtle part of our difficulties. Take the dense fog in Whining Aix's Mire for example. It usually signifies an accompanying thunderstorm and shrill screams that bring up a ripple of sadness and... a sense of longing. That's where the navigation tends to fail as the fog gradually consumes you.
Devastating events. I can't quite picture myself overwhelmed by such dense fog and Siren sounds... Eek! I can't dwell on this. Time to get back to work and be a proud courier today!
InfoDisplay_102801013_Text:
Untitled Family Letters I
Dear Daddy, Mommy asked me to write a letter to you, but I don't know what to write because you aren't going home for a long, long time! A few days ago, Ms. Yuyi asked us to write about our own dads, but I can't pick a topic. Normal dads would take their kids out to play, treat them to lots of snacks, and tell them lots of stories, while I can't write anything because I'm forgetting your face... I can only write in my essay that my dad follows General Jiyan to fight monsters in Desorock Highland! Those monsters must be taller than the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma! But my dad can knock them out in just one blow because he is a big hero! But my classmates said I was bragging because the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma are so powerful that even Fiamma could have a hard time! But I don't know, I've never seen it... When are you coming back, Daddy? Can you take me to see the Hero Play when you're back? Just let me tag along! Mommy says I am a great helper now! I made scrambled egg rice the other day, and Mommy said she loved the taste! Come back and you can try it out! Oh and Verina gave a flower to me. She said it would last a long time. I attached it to this letter so you can see! Mommy said it's very pretty and you should take a look!

Untitled Family Letters II
I found this letter after Xiaobao went to bed.
Don't worry... Everything is fine now. Xiaobao helped me a lot. Though strange things happened under the mine, that's no sweat at all to my job. We take care of ourselves, and you should too.
You reminded me of my father, a soldier who seldom came home. I missed him so much and kept asking my mother the same question: When would he come back? But the war was escalating and those Tacet Discords were approaching our doorsteps. I remember a courier delivered a mail on a rainy day. I could tell right away that it was from my father. I came out of my room with a happy smile, when the courier paused for a conversation with my mother. Turning around, she cried over my shoulder, shedding tears upon that letter I dared not to read it myself.
I know they sacrifice a lot to drive those Tacet Discords out of Desorock Highland... and you're now suffering in bitterness at the front line. That gentle knock on the gate still chants a scary echo for me to linger upon the slightest thought that you would die like my father. So I told the couriers to leave those letters on my doorstep.
Enough of the past. Are you doing fine on the front line? Don't worry about us, you just need to do your job. We love you, as always.

Untitled Family Letters III
Worry not, dear. I'm doing fine these days. We managed to defeat a small group of Tacet Discords, while the Ministry of Development is working on some large-scale defense projects. They really know how to use their wit. We will triumph in this battle, believe me. And I miss you too, with all my body and soul.

Untitled Family Letters IV
...I don't know how to start this letter. General Jiyan, I want to say thank you. Thanks to you, his message finally reached us like this.
I recall days with him from time to time. He said someone should be the protector, even if this means sacrifices. In those distant portrayals of the battlefield, you stood unwaveringly against the enemies, supporting him and other soldiers with your might. He said you saved his life countless times. You are his icon, the best soldier who possesses a fighter's heart and a giver's will. He wants to be the same. Although he'd sacrificed his life to cover his teammates, I don't think he'd ever regretted it.
That's what you told me, that he always protects other soldiers even when facing the greatest threats, that he deserves to be a hero.
That night, I met him in a heart-breaking rainy dream that ominously resembled the day when the death of my father arrived. He opened the door, greeting me with his comeback. The early reunion obliged me to ask him: Why did you come back? I thought the war was still raging.
He replied: I just want to check if you're safe. Xiaobao is asleep, right? I'll be leaving now if everything is okay.
And then he added: Everyone on the battlefield just can't mellow out one bit when the war is drawing to an end. They're prepared to go for the killing blow.
I nodded: Just do your job and don't worry about us. Be a fearless fighter and beat those monsters. His steps paused upon a hesitant yes. I urged him to go back, and in anxiety, I met his open arms. He asked me: What if I die in the battle? What about you and Lil. Bao?
Questioned by such a dilemma, I asked in return: Do you ever regret joining the army?
He said no, not if he can protect our homeland.
"So am I." I said.
When I woke from that dream, I was visited by a sudden idea to see the Hero Play with Xiaobao. In the Theater, the heroine in Fiamma wielded a sword bravely against the Fluffernox while the stage bathed in flames. Attacked by the monster, she fell to the ground again and again. As she gathered herself from continued sufferings, tears coursed through my face. I told Lil. Bao that his father is a hero who can rival the Fiamma.
Xiaobao answered this in excitement: I want to be a hero just like him!
I promised to share all these stories with him and all living souls.
General, I would remember this till the end of life, and carve those names upon an eternal stone.
InfoDisplay_102801014_Text:
I received a message the other day.
Nothing special, just a message from the train station to the delayed passengers. It reads: "The Future Express apologizes to you with utmost sincerity. We'll keep our service full and complete until you reach the destination." I finished reading and deleted it, thinking "This must be a mistake by the station. I haven't traveled by train for a long time."
But this was just the beginning. I kept receiving strange messages about this Future Express now and then. I transferred them to the spam at first. I live in the moment. Those sorts of long travel and future seem out of my realm. I'm busy running errands around the mine, listening to frequent complaints from those researchers. Even a small miner like me gets a little bit nervous as the year draws to its close.
But these constant messages are killing me. Once I snatched a moment from my job to check them up and one particular piece had captured my attention (probably from a kid): "Daddy. The steward tells me to sit tight because the train is about to leave. We'll be in the future in no time! She would cast a spell that keeps us safe until the train arrives at the future. But I don't know about the future..." These words reminded me of my daughter, the same ever-curiosity when she was young. I haven't seen her in a while, though. I didn't want to disappoint this young sender with all the delay and wait. So I replied: I know the future. Future is where you get to eat Star Flakes and realize all of your dreams.
Several days later, this message thing struck my terminal again with a delay notice: "We're sincerely sorry for the delay. The Future Express will seek for soon departure while ensuring you a safe and happy journey with our best." It even ends with something like "The Future Express will meet you in the future." Another text comes right in: "When do we get to leave? Lil. You keeps asking me about this. I can only respond with empty promises, telling her that 'Soon we will be leaving for the future.' The lobby is full of anxious passengers, each clutching to an urgent desire to leave. And myself included. I received some food from a good Samaritan and that relaxed my nerves a bit. *sigh* When do we get to leave..." This looks like a message for the train station to me but somehow it reached my terminal. Glad that I had a soft time those days. Urged by a passing thought to cheer the sender, I replied: The train will leave soon. Be patient.
It never really cuts off the messages. I still receive them now and then. During a meal with my colleagues, I brought up the topic and all those intricate and haywire messages in my terminal. I sometimes felt compelled to comfort those frustrated passengers.
They said in utter doubt, that there was no such thing as the Future Express.
So I showed those messages to them and met their confused stares. The elder one of my colleagues chimed in, recalling some sort of rail station around the place in the past. It was used as an escape route during a horrible disaster. People named this train "The Future Express", carrying a message that you could ride with it until the bitter end and arrive at the future. Ages had veiled the rest of the story when they only came along the tongues of the past generations. Even he didn't know what happened later. I can't help but think, if the Future Express truly belongs to a forgotten past, then why would I receive these messages...

Daliy_DYBL_6_8: How's it going? Did The Lion like it?
Daliy_DYBL_20_1: Uh, Rover, it's been a long time.
Daliy_DYBL_20_3: That old man's flowers? Here they are. He left them here this morning.
Daliy_DYBL_20_4: Bless him. That old man looks troubled to me. He’s always trying to bring flower bouquets to the graves every other day.
Daliy_DYBL_20_5: It might have worked in the old days, but now Desorock Highland is so close to the front line that the people are no longer allowed to go up there.
Daliy_DYBL_20_6: Do you know him? If so, you'd better advise him to go back to the city. It's dangerous to stay here all the time.
Daliy_DYBL_20_8: I can understand the old man's desire to return to the troop. Sometimes when I’m free, he’d have me listening to stories from his past.
Daliy_DYBL_20_9: He called us by a different name each time, so I guess he thought of us as his comrades in arms.
Daliy_DYBL_20_10: Even when he’s lost touch with reality, he still clings on to these memories and the thought of sending them flowers ... They must have shared a special bond.
Daliy_DYBL_20_11: Truth be told, sometimes when I look at him, I always feel like I see my future self.
Daliy_DYBL_20_12: Sorry, I was caught in my emotions. You can have the flowers.
Daliy_DYBL_20_2: Have you seen Gongming's flowers, please?

InfoDisplay_102801015_Text:
Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: I
We conducted a comprehensive survey and inspection of the Dim Forest and have come to the decision to revive the old research site of the Forest Nature Reserve. A rearrangement and categorization of the legacy data stored inside was conducted. During this process, we even discovered seeds and specimens of some plant species that have long since been deemed extinct. These precious seeds and specimens can help us gain a better understanding of the ecological changes the Dim Forest has experienced and the impact the Lament has placed on this area. 
Next, we will perform a comprehensive survey of various resources of the Forest, such as soil, water, etc., and focus on studying the local TD population of Hoochiefs. Based on previous reports, there have been several assault cases involving these Hoochiefs. Explorers who have encountered these TDs claimed that they frequently appear in groups. With this information in mind, we require all investigators entering the Dark Forest to travel in teams and take precautionary measures when necessary. 
(Cangmin: This is information regarding the establishment of the Dim Forest’s Department of Ecology. Long after the ending of the Lament, the situation in the Forest gradually stabilized, inviting researchers to conduct studies.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: II
10:00 A.M.
Several Hoochiefs were found near the research institute. Through observation, it was found that these Hoochiefs possess group consciousness to a certain degree and perform physical gestures to communicate with each other. All personnel in the institute have been notified to maintain a safe distance with the Hoochiefs.
1:00 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief.
2:45 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief group. A small-scale conflict occurred between the two groups. One of the groups seemed to be covered in some kind of spores. The Hoochiefs without spores were defeated and fled the scene.
6:00 P.M.
The Hoochiefs attacked the research institute and one was captured. The institute will shelter the Hoochief.
The behavioral characteristics of these Hoochiefs will be recorded and the engineering team are requested to install bionic cameras for our research. In the mean time, the Waveband of the Hoochief will be thoroughly analyzed.
(Cangmin: Study currently at preliminary stage)
(Qiaomu: The spores were later confirmed to be poisonous.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: III
We deployed several bionic cameras to observe the Hoochief groups. The following cameras were deployed. Three in the form of bushes, two in boulders, and one in Hoochief form. The Hoochief camera was able to imitate their movements to a certain extent, but were relatively robotic and failed to perform complex actions. In this round of filming, two bush cameras were destroyed, with the boulder cameras being used by the Hoochiefs as throwing weapons, resulting in critical damage to their lenses.
The Hoochief camera continued to follow the Hoochiefs and filmed their leader. The Hoochiefs did not show any aggression towards it, but the camera was immobilized due to a malfunction in its motion systems. The Hoochiefs later performed a "burial" for it around the banyan tree.
We will sweep the area around the banyan tree and recover the cameras.
(Qiaomu: The bionic cameras really came in clutch. Real MVPs!)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: IV
The sheltered Hoochief is covered in spores emitting a red glow. Researchers who came into close contact with the Hoochief for an extended period of time exhibited signs of coughing and difficulty breathing. As a result, researchers have been restricted from making close contact. 
Days later, the Hoochief began to show signs of crazed tendencies. It continues to devastate its surroundings while scratching its own body and coughing constantly. 
Further observation of the Hoochief is required. 
Additionally, we have observed an increase in the appearances of Hoochiefs near the research institute, likely influenced by the sheltered Hoochief's frequency. This requires special attention. 
An investigation into the Hoochief leader is to be carried out as soon as possible.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: V
Feilian Beringal, Howler, Overlord Class Tacet Discord. 
Based on our studies, the Feilian Beringal resides around the Giant Banyan and is the leader of the Hoochief group. The creature maintains highly aggressive territorial behavior and will show strong hostility towards intruders. Several of our survey teams received major setbacks during their investigation of the Beringal.
The Feilian Beringal, along with the Hoochiefs under its command, are mimetic creatures capable of imitating the behavior of the apes that once existed in the Dim Forest, bearing a certain level of intelligence. they copy humans to wield simplistic tools and weapons, and will also comfort and protect their companions.
In the meantime, further spread of spore infection was observed. Hoochiefs covered in spores tend to be more aggressive. Caution is advised.
Research studies of this phenomenon are currently underway.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VI
With the assistance of the Midnight Rangers, we carried out a special operation on the Feilian Beringal. Through great efforts, we managed to put a tracking bracelet on the Beringal, which will help us monitor its movements in the forest and avoid any direct confrontations.
During this operation, we discovered that the number of Hoochiefs infected with the spores was much higher than we had initially estimated, and the rate of the spore's spread was faster than the prediction models had shown. The spores can significantly affect the qualities of surrounding soil, water resources, and other environmental substances, and cause near-irreversible damage to the human body. Given that the Hoochiefs are the source of transmission of the spores, their expulsion from the area will be put in place. However, some researchers believe that the Hoochiefs are not the source of the infection itself, and have submitted a secondary proposal to begin research on spore antibodies.
(Senming: My mentor was the one who initiated the antibody research. She placed hopes to resolve the Forest's complications through this way.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VII
Progress on the research of antibodies has been considerable. We believe a result is soon within reach.
Haste expulsion of the Hoochiefs failed to yield meaningful effects, and in turn, triggered more frequent Hoochief attacks. To minimize and avoid escalation of this situation, we've changed our approach and instead focused on sheltering the apes by helping to remove the spores from their bodies and alleviate their emotions.
We hope that this will help us to better carry out our work.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VIII
A series of complications, in forms such as Hoochief disturbances, led to the loss of the majority of our research data.
However, while scavenging for data, we were still able to witness the valiant efforts made by our predecessors on the Dim Forest.
<ano=Ecoacoustics>Ecological</ano> research is a complicated study. Topics such as finding critical entry points and how to begin our research are all topics we need to be mindful of.
Fortunately, we now have more time to ponder.

InfoDisplay_10900006_Text: As I grow old and reflect on my life, I am haunted by the regret of not fulfilling a legend someone once told me. They said that if the most important person in your life is willing to fulfill this legend, your relationship will be blessed by the heavens until death do you part. I missed my chance and have always felt like we were just passing through each other's lives. But now, as I face my impending death with only regrets, I feel compelled to find the place where we promised to meet and fulfill the legend. Even though it may be too late for me, I hope this notice can reach young people who still have a chance to hold onto their loved ones. So please, kind lady at the Pioneer Association, share this unknown legend and perhaps someone can finally solve its mystery. Under the crescent moon, we roam On a screen court, stars dance and moan Timeless, by this heart-shaped lake Together, hand in hand we take Starry-eyed, our love shall never break.

Huanglong_main_1_4_994_12: If a sane person manages to survive in a realm of lunatics, would you call them the last one of reason... or the sole apostle?
Huanglong_main_1_4_994_13: Think about it. The shepherd is not the preordained embodiment of truth. Once he is gone for good, the black lamb can reclaim the trust of its herd...
Huanglong_main_1_4_994_14: Then... eventually, there will be none left to be "victims" or "oppressors"!

Event_YBFYZB_4_1: Alright, here we are at the starting line. Feeling those butterflies fluttering?
Event_YBFYZB_4_5: Haha, every time I'm about to kick off an Overdash challenge, those nerves hit me like a wave!
Event_YBFYZB_4_6: Excellent! Can't wait to see what you've got!
Event_YBFYZB_4_8: Once you hit that track and leap forward into the air, all this jitter will vanish, replaced by pure exhilaration.
Event_YBFYZB_4_9: The wind whipping against your skin, the scenery blurring past you... It's like the entire world fades away, and it's just you out there.
Event_YBFYZB_4_10: Alright, enough talk. If I keep going, I might just jump into the challenge myself!
Event_YBFYZB_4_11: Go on! Overdash your way to that finish line! You've got this!
Event_YBFYZB_1_5: I'm Shui, an honorary member of the Overdash Club.
Event_YBFYZB_1_6: Actions speak louder than words. Let's get you Overdashing right away to feel the thrill!
Event_YBFYZB_1_7: Just to confirm, you're here because of our ad, right?
Event_YBFYZB_1_12: It's no surprise you're drawn to such an exciting event.
Event_YBFYZB_1_13: Hmm, looks like we need to ramp up our promotions...
Event_YBFYZB_1_14: But hey, now that you're here, why not give it a shot? It's free, after all!
Event_YBFYZB_1_15: I wish you'd put it a bit more tactfully...
Event_YBFYZB_1_16: Alright, let me run you through the event rules!
Event_YBFYZB_1_17: Overdash is all about racing through the air using Grapples to show off your skills.
Event_YBFYZB_1_22: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Event_YBFYZB_1_24: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Event_YBFYZB_1_25: Fantastic! By the way, let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development. We've got the green light!
Event_YBFYZB_1_29: A-Anyway, trust me! We've got all the permits!
Event_YBFYZB_1_30: As long as we stick to the designated area, we are good to go.
Event_YBFYZB_1_31: This time, we're racing on an "Easy" track on the outskirts of Jinzhou, perfect for beginners like you!
Event_YBFYZB_1_32: Normally, I'd guide newbies through their first Overdash, but I need to track down those documents, you know...
Event_YBFYZB_1_33: So, here's a trick instead. Pay attention, and stay safe, okay?
Event_YBFYZB_1_34: Step 1: Assess your surroundings. Step 2: Get your hook ready. Step 3: Warm up. Step 4: Let's go! Always keep an eye out for the next Grapple Point.
Event_YBFYZB_1_35: If you can't spot it, use your Glider for a better view. And remember, don't retract it mid-air or you'll fall straight down!
Event_YBFYZB_1_36: Even though it's a race, safety is priority number one. Got it?
Event_YBFYZB_1_39: It's normal to feel dizzy at first. I've got some antiemetics just in case. Hopefully, you won't need them...
Event_YBFYZB_1_41: Alright, get ready for your first Overdash! Meet me outside the city. Don't stand me up!
Event_YBFYZB_1_20: Can't be more familiar. Shall we start now?

GuideTutorialPage_3000102_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Echoes</color> are an important source of a Resonator's strength. Resonators can use the <color=#ffd12f>Echo Skill</color> of the Echo equipped at the top.
GuideTutorialPage_3000103_Content: Increase the Data Bank level for a higher <color=#ffd12f>Max STA</color>. Explore the world and absorb different Echoes!
GuideTutorialPage_3001401_Content:
Switch your Resonator when Concerto Energy is full to trigger the exiting Resonator's <color=#ffd12f>Outro Skill</color>, and consume all the Concerto Energy to trigger the incoming Resonator's <color=#ffd12f>Intro Skill</color>.
Each Resonator has their unique <color=#ffd12f>Outro Skill</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Intro Skill</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3003603_Content: Some <color=#ffd12f>Fissured Ledge</color>, eroded by the Waveworn phenomenon, cannot be destroyed through conventional means. You can use Levitator to grab the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color> and <color=#ffd12f>throw</color> it to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color> to destroy the Fissured Ledge.
GuideTutorialPage_31002_Content:
Some <color=Wind>Aero</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> to the target.
While the <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> lasts, it deals periodic <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100202_Content:
The damage of <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> scales with its stacks.
Dodge attacks to avoid the buildup of the <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> stacks.
GuideTutorialPage_31003_Content:
Some <color=Thunder>Electro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Electro Flare Effect"</color> to the target.
When the <color=#ffd12f>[Electro Flare Effect]</color> lasts, it affects the target based on the number of active stacks.
GuideTutorialPage_3100302_Content:
When the number of <color=#ffd12f>"Electro Flare Effect"</color> stacks is 4 or below, the target's ATK is reduced by 5%.
When there are 5 stacks, the ATK is reduced by 7% instead, and the target is applied <color=#ffd12f>Magnetized</color>, affecting their movement when encountering certain mechanisms.
If stacked to its max, "Electro Flare Effect" reduces ATK by 10%.
It is recommended to always keep an eye on the stack count of <color=#ffd12f>"Electro Flare Effect"</color> to avoid unfavorable combat situations.
GuideTutorialPage_31004_Content:
Some <color=Ice>Glacio</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Glacio Chafe Effect"</color> to the target.
Each stack of <color=#ffd12f>"Glacio Chafe Effect"</color> reduces the target's movement speed.
GuideTutorialPage_3100402_Content:
When <color=#ffd12f>"Glacio Chafe Effect"</color> is stacked to its max, the target will be <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color> and all stacks of <color=#ffd12f>"Glacio Chafe Effect"</color> will be removed. Struggle to accelerate your recovery from the <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color> state.
Dodge attacks to avoid the accumulation of <color=#ffd12f>"Glacio Chafe Effect"</color> stacks.
GuideTutorialPage_31005_Content: Some <color=Fire>Fusion</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Fusion Burst Effect"</color> to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100502_Content:
When <color=#ffd12f>"Fusion Burst Effect"</color> is stacked to its max, all stacks will be removed to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>, dealing great <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to the target.
Dodge attacks to avoid the accumulation of <color=#ffd12f>[Fusion Burst Effect]</color> stacks.
GuideTutorialPage_31006_Content:
Some <color=Light>Spectro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> lasts, the number of its stacks is periodically reduced by 1 to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100602_Content:
The building up of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> greatly increases the DMG it deals.
Dodge attacks to avoid the accumulation of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> and effectively reduce the DMG taken.
GuideTutorialPage_31007_Content:
Some <color=Dark>Havoc</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Havoc Bane Effect"</color> to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>"Havoc Bane Effect"</color> lasts, the number of its stacks is automatically increased by 1 periodically.
GuideTutorialPage_3100702_Content:
<color=#ffd12f>"Havoc Bane Effect"</color> can stack up to 2 times. When it is stacked to its max, all stacks will be removed to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> to the target, while applying <color=#ffd12f>"Havoc Bane Effect"</color> to the surrounding Characters.
Dodge attacks to avoid the spreading of <color=#ffd12f>"Havoc Bane Effect"</color> among the teammates.
GuideTutorialPage_3401103_Content:
When <color=#ffd12f>objects</color> are placed correctly on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Platform</color>, the locked mechanism will be <color=#ffd12f>unlocked</color>.
Maybe something other than Weight Blocks can be placed on the Pressure Platform?
GuideTutorialPage_3401202_Content: Use the component to <color=#ffd12f>fill</color> the <color=#ffd12f>highlighted area</color> of the matrix to activate it.
GuideTutorialPage_3401302_Content: The Decryption Pulse activates the Encryption Blocks as it passes through them. When <color=#ffd12f>all Encryption Blocks</color> are <color=#ffd12f>activated</color> simultaneously, the decryption is completed.
GuideTutorialPage_3401703_Content:
Rewards are locked within the <color=#ffd12f>Vine Trap</color>, which cannot be destroyed by regular attacks or skills.
Resonator will be <color=#ffd12f>knocked back</color> when they <color=#ffd12f>approach</color> the Vine Trap directly.
GuideTutorialPage_3401704_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Detonate</color> the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charge</color> that grows near the Vine Trap to ignite and <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> it.
GuideTutorialPage_34034_Content: After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to restore the incomplete mural on the left to its original pattern.
GuideTutorialPage_34035_Content:
Transform into Mourning Aix to start an aerial chase battle.
When the lock-on halo appears, use your Basic Attack to hit the enemy.
GuideTutorialPage_3403502_Content: You can accumulate energy by hitting the enemy with Basic Attacks. The skill will be available once the energy is full.
GuideTutorialPage_3403503_Content: When you are too far from the target in the chase, Dash to quickly catch up.

Character_ChangLi_41_4: It might look kind of scary, but actually... it doesn't hurt at all.
Character_ChangLi_41_6: Of course. I'm a Resonator too, you know. My Forte is a powerful one. I control fire.
Character_ChangLi_41_7: Nothing's brighter and warmer than the fire... it can burn away the cold and drive away monsters.
Character_ChangLi_41_10: T-That's because I don't know how to properly control it yet...
Character_ChangLi_41_11: The Resonator who taught me about my "Forte" said if I don't use it properly, I'll die young.
Character_ChangLi_41_14: They also said a lot of things I couldn't understand... Told me I shouldn't use it too often.
Character_ChangLi_41_15: But... if I don't use my Forte, I'd get eaten by the Tacet Discords, or killed by the bad people...
Character_ChangLi_41_16: What's the point of living a longer life if I can't even survive?
Character_ChangLi_41_17: I want to live. I want to become a strong grown-up.
Character_ChangLi_41_18: I want to have good control of my power, and protect the people who protected me in the past.
Character_ChangLi_41_19: And then... And then I'll make a peaceful and prosperous world for everyone.
Character_ChangLi_41_22: Yes. According to the village teacher, that means children will no longer be in danger from monsters. We'll all have enough to eat and stable lives.
Character_ChangLi_41_23: But I've still got lots to learn... so I'll need to find someone really strong, and learn from them.
Character_ChangLi_41_27: I want to become as strong as you are...
Character_ChangLi_41_30: I-I understand... I'll do my best.
Character_ChangLi_41_8: But the fire could burn yourself too.
Character_ChangLi_41_20: A peaceful and prosperous world for everyone...
Character_ChangLi_41_24: You will find a great mentor.
Character_ChangLi_41_25: And you'll become very strong yourself.
Character_ChangLi_41_29: Promise me you'll take good care of yourself, okay?
Character_ChangLi_40_1: The village I lived in got destroyed by those scary monsters.
Character_ChangLi_40_2: They hid me in a safe basement... While everyone else died or ran away... No one except me made it out alive.
Character_ChangLi_40_3: When I came out... No one was there anymore.
Character_ChangLi_40_4: Now, I must get to somewhere safe...
Character_ChangLi_40_5: It's okay, you're not alone anymore.
Character_ChangLi_40_6: Let's go find somewhere safe together.
Character_ChangLi_39_5: Don't worry, I won't hold you back...
Character_ChangLi_39_6: I'm not just any kid! I am strong, you know.
Character_ChangLi_39_2: Leave the fighting to me. You're injured.
Character_ChangLi_39_3: I can't let you fight them alone.
Character_ChangLi_38_1: These are... The villagers, attacked by Tacet Discords...
Character_ChangLi_38_3: Why... There weren't any of them here before...
Character_ChangLi_38_4: Don't worry. My Forte is strong! I will get rid of them and protect you,
Character_ChangLi_37_1: We'll be safe once we get out of here.
Character_ChangLi_37_2: Hmm... This place seems a bit different from what I remember.
Character_ChangLi_36_5: I-I'm fine! It's my Forte... I'm used to it.
Character_ChangLi_36_6: You... Stay away from me, or you'll get burned.
Character_ChangLi_36_9: This village was attacked by Tacet Discords. There's nothing left.
Character_ChangLi_36_10: Why did you come here? No one but the Exiles are willing to stay here now.
Character_ChangLi_36_16: Whatever you're looking for... There's nobody here but me and the Tacet Discords.
Character_ChangLi_36_18: I'm the only one here besides the Tacet Discords.
Character_ChangLi_36_20: ...When I'm here, no one's afraid of me, and I won't hurt anyone.
Character_ChangLi_36_21: Anyway... You should hurry up and leave, it's not safe for you to be here.
Character_ChangLi_36_27: Why did you stop talking? Are you lost?
Character_ChangLi_36_30: I... I can take you somewhere safe. I know a shortcut that leads to a safer village.
Character_ChangLi_36_4: You got burned. Let me help you.
Character_ChangLi_36_8: You won't burn me. I'm very tough.
Character_ChangLi_36_14: ... I'm not, I'm looking for someone.
Character_ChangLi_36_23: (She doesn't seem lost in the Sonoro Sphere...)
Character_ChangLi_36_26: (Whatever the case, I can't leave her here alone.)
Character_ChangLi_36_29: Can you help me out of this place?
Character_ChangLi_35_1: An unfamiliar space... No sign of the Fractsidus. Changli's also nowhere to be seen.
Character_ChangLi_35_2: I need to find her quick.
