Character_ChangLi_54_1: I guess this is another riddle from my master...
Character_ChangLi_53_1: Do you have to go, master?
Character_ChangLi_53_2: My time in this world is up, my child. I have my own destination to head to. I can only accompany you so far on this journey.
Character_ChangLi_53_3: Are you going to a dangerous place alone? Why can't I go with you?
Character_ChangLi_53_4: It's not your turn to go there yet, Changli. You are a very gifted child, and you will surely achieve greatness one day.
Character_ChangLi_53_5: But the price you pay for forcefully employing your Forte can never be erased. Your lifespan is doomed to be much shorter than that of ordinary people.
Character_ChangLi_53_7: Remember what I have taught you. Ponder carefully, plan meticulously, and shield yourself wisely. For when you have grown into the person you aspire to become... Your impact on this world shall be great.
Character_ChangLi_53_8: Changli will remember your teachings by heart, master.
Character_ChangLi_53_9: But master... This person you want me to find... How should I find them?
Character_ChangLi_53_10: When the time comes, you will know, and you will have my aid.
Character_ChangLi_53_11: You need only use your wisdom to offer that person some necessary guidance.
Character_ChangLi_53_12: {Male=He;Female=She} is the only one who can truly change this world. You must find {Male=him;Female=her} and help {Male=him;Female=her}.
Character_ChangLi_53_13: This way, the world of prosperity you seek will soon be within reach.
Character_ChangLi_53_14: (I believe... I've found that person, master.)
Character_ChangLi_53_15: (...This Weiqi board, and the Sonoro Sphere... They are both a puzzle and an answer.)
Character_ChangLi_53_16: (The end of this Sonoro Sphere... Turns out it's exactly where {Male=he;Female=she} is.)
Character_ChangLi_52_2: My dear, you've come all this way. What do you need from me?
Character_ChangLi_52_3: I-I am... You gave me some food before, I haven't thanked you yet...
Character_ChangLi_52_4: You misunderstood my intentions. When I sought shelter in your hideout during the rain, I gave you rations as a small token of thanks. No need to be troubled by it, little one.
Character_ChangLi_52_5: B-but, you told me... The path to safety lies in embracing fortuitous moments. I didn't understand what you meant by that...
Character_ChangLi_52_6: Well now, I only said those words on a mere whim. Never expected you to remember them so clearly...
Character_ChangLi_52_7: I've heard Master Xuanmiao is a wise hermit guru who helps people. Can you, maybe, take me as your apprentice? I've been searching for you for so long... Please, will you consider it?
Character_ChangLi_52_8: I want to live, learn to control my power, and become stronger... Or I won't see a peaceful and prosperous world...
Character_ChangLi_52_9: Do you know... What defines a peaceful and prosperous world?
Character_ChangLi_52_10: I think... I think it means people can take care of themselves and have a place to call home.
Character_ChangLi_52_12: I... I'm a Resonator too! I have a strong Forte! Look!
Character_ChangLi_51_1: (This place... This is where master once lived in seclusion.)
Character_ChangLi_51_2: (The spaces are a jumbled mess inside this Sonoro Sphere...)
Character_ChangLi_50_1: Ma'am, are you okay? There's been a lot more Tacet Discords lately...
Character_ChangLi_50_2: I'm fine, thank you for driving those monsters away... But honey, these cuts and bruises all over you, some new and some old. They never seem to fully heal...
Character_ChangLi_50_3: I'm a Resonator. These wounds are nothing.
Character_ChangLi_50_4: *sigh*... Oh honey. You shouldn't be trapped in this place like we are for the rest of your life.
Character_ChangLi_50_5: You should go to the city. With a powerful Forte like yours, you'll surely find a wonderful future for yourself there.
Character_ChangLi_50_6: But ma'am, what about you and the others...
Character_ChangLi_50_7: You go out there and make something of yourself. Make us proud. And when you're ready, come back for us. What do you say, dear?
Character_ChangLi_50_8: And these... Take these with you on your way there.
Character_ChangLi_49_1: Huff... Hah... I-I can do it...
Character_ChangLi_49_2: (Yes, back then, I didn't know how to control my flames. I could only brute force my way out it, and my body was always covered in burns...)
Character_ChangLi_48_2: Don't try to play me, you little thief.
Character_ChangLi_48_3: I found these all by myself...!
Character_ChangLi_48_4: Ha! You think I'm buying this story? How the hell does a little homeless brat like you score all this food?
Character_ChangLi_48_5: This is our turf. Better scurry off if you know what's good for you...
Character_ChangLi_48_6: Why don't we... let her stay? See, she's a...
Character_ChangLi_48_7: ...We've got plenty of mouths to feed already. Unless you're planning to have her eat from your plate?
Character_ChangLi_47_2: This thing... Umm, if I burn it a bit with my fire... I can eat it, I guess?
Character_ChangLi_46_4: (These are my memories... recreated inside this Sonoro Sphere.)
Character_ChangLi_46_5: (As I stepped inside, both Rover and the Fractsidus vanished into thin air. The frequencies are constantly changing, and the flow of time is chaotic, just like it had been on Mt. Firmament...)
Character_ChangLi_46_6: (A Sonoro Sphere affected by Temporal Disruption… Once someone enters, there's a risk of being stuck inside forever. And if my master had planned all of this...)
Character_ChangLi_46_7: (Did he do this to mislead, to separate, or perhaps...)
Character_ChangLi_46_8: (I should be careful. Whatever the case... I must find {PlayerName} first.)
Character_ChangLi_45_1: What is this all about? I don't understand...
Character_ChangLi_44_1: There's a piece of paper... It has turned yellow.
Character_ChangLi_44_2: ...When the village was raided, I failed to protect anyone with all my efforts. Now all I'm left with are these old injuries and the rest of my meager life, and some food to spare for anyone who passes by.
Character_ChangLi_44_6: It's a thing of the past now.
Character_ChangLi_43_3: I found some dry rations... They look well-kept, should be still edible!
Character_ChangLi_43_4: It's a bit frozen... No worries, I can use my fire to heat it up.
Character_ChangLi_43_5: Are you hungry? I haven't seen you take a single bite...
Character_ChangLi_43_9: If you don't eat anything for too long, you won't be able to walk.
Character_ChangLi_42_1: What a strange place... It's supposed to look familiar, but there are so many things I've never seen before...
Character_ChangLi_42_5: ... I don't know why, but I keep getting the feeling that I've been here before, it's so weird...
Character_ChangLi_42_6: Let's look around... Maybe we'll find something.
Role_1503_ShareDesc: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!
Role_1203_ShareDesc: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?
Role_1301_ShareDesc: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
Role_1405_ShareDesc: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
Role_1104_ShareDesc: You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember me as how I look, without the lion head!
Role_1404_ShareDesc: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.
Role_1302_ShareDesc: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.
Character_ChangLi_1_1: ...The Weiqi pieces were scattered, but the guru remained calm. "It's getting late," he said gently to the woodcutter. "Shouldn't you be heading down the mountain?"
Character_ChangLi_1_2: As he glanced at the sky, the woodcutter was shocked to see how much time had passed. "It couldn't have been more than two hours," he thought in disbelief. Feeling apologetic, he prepared to leave, worried that the guru would be annoyed with him.
Character_ChangLi_1_3: But when the woodcutter turned around, he nearly jumped out of his skin. The hermit guru, who had been playing Weiqi and drinking wine, was now gone. In his place lay a shattered Weiqi board and a heap of decaying bones.
Character_ChangLi_1_4: The woodcutter was so scared that he dropped his bamboo basket and ran down the mountain without even looking back.
Character_ChangLi_1_5: As he reached the mountain's base, he was hit with a stark realization. The quaint village he remembered had bloomed into a bustling town, with sturdy brick houses replacing the humble thatched cottages. And where his home once stood, only an empty wasteland remained.
Character_ChangLi_1_6: He noticed a date on the calendar that he had never seen before. In shock, he grabbed a passerby and urgently asked, "Excuse me, can you tell me the current date and time?"
Character_ChangLi_1_7: As he heard the answer, his legs went weak. Everything had changed—time had passed and his loved ones were gone. No one remembered him anymore.
Character_ChangLi_1_8: So the woodcutter left Mt. Firmament, but how was he still alive and kicking? With a hundred year's worth of time inside him, shouldn't he...
Character_ChangLi_1_9: Your story... It's a bit far-fetched, don't you think? I mean, if I wasn't from Hongzhen, I might have fallen for it.
Character_ChangLi_1_10: ...Well! That's the whole point. The truth is stranger than fiction, my friend. Every detail in that story is based on real events.
Character_ChangLi_1_11: Let me share with you the other legend of Mt. Firmament, for deep within its sacred peaks lies a powerful secret... the "Secret of Immortality"!
Character_ChangLi_1_12: We all know that Mt. Firmament is the abode of the Sentinel, gathering spiritual energies from both heaven and earth for countless eons. Over time, even the mountain itself has taken on the form of our majestic Sentinel!
Character_ChangLi_1_13: Living in the mountains for long stretches of time, surrounded by fresh air and drinking from nature's own bounty, can add years to one's life span!
Character_ChangLi_1_14: It all starts with that game of Weiqi, one that the woodcutter stumbled upon. Too bad those secrets have been long forgotten...
Character_ChangLi_1_15: Gather around now, people. You're in for the story of a lifetime...
Character_ChangLi_1_21: *yawn* What's with the ruckus... Huh, what’s that in your hands?
Character_ChangLi_1_23: Hmm... "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaw into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
Character_ChangLi_1_27: I see I've got no clue at all!
Character_ChangLi_1_30: I get the very last part, at least! She’s asking you out! Well that's a fancy way to write stuff...
Character_ChangLi_1_33: How did you manage to get all that hidden meaning?
Character_ChangLi_1_36: But the buildings in Hongzhen all look pretty much the same. Which one exactly was she talking about?
Character_ChangLi_1_22: Changli gave it to me a moment ago.
Character_ChangLi_1_25: Do you know what it means?
Character_ChangLi_1_26: Ooh... So that's how it is...
Character_ChangLi_1_29: Wow, I'm so shocked to hear that.
Character_ChangLi_1_31: ...The first part reads like it's about the meeting spot.
Character_ChangLi_1_32: According to the description, it's somewhere in Hongzhen.
Character_ChangLi_1_34: I'm experienced. Dealt with Jinhsi's riddles already.
Character_ChangLi_1_37: We can ask around to find out. I’ve done this before.
Guide_YFSH_9_1: Whew, finally done! Let me see...
Guide_YFSH_9_2: Whoa, two more Echoes to go! {PlayerName}, you’re so lucky!
Guide_YFSH_9_3: You know, the chances for Echoes to appear after taking down Tacet Discords are slim, not to mention bagging two at once!
Guide_YFSH_9_4: They say the stronger your Terminal, the likelier it is for Echoes to pop up. That's because... because... Anyway, your Terminal must be crazy powerful! Right?
Guide_YFSH_8_1: Wow, there is indeed a Tacet Field! Grandpa Jingzhu, you really know a lot!
Guide_YFSH_8_2: Hehe, I already told you, this old man had his fair share of adventures in his prime!
Guide_YFSH_8_3: Now, it’s your moment to shine. Clear this Tacet Field and you should be able to capture some Echoes.
Guide_YFSH_7_1: Check it out, Grandpa Jingzhu! These massive scythes are just too cool, huh?
Guide_YFSH_7_2: Mm, not bad. She should be pleased this time.
Guide_YFSH_7_3: I hope, just this once, she’ll stay long enough to hear me out before walking straight away...
Guide_YFSH_7_4: Ooh, I’ve got an idea! What if we transformed into the Scythes? That’d definitely impress her!
Guide_YFSH_7_5: Oh, please don’t, dear. She might be scared. Perhaps we should gather a few more, just to be sure.
Guide_YFSH_7_6: Havoc Warrior is undoubtedly impressive, but relying on a single Echo might not be enough to capture her heart...
Guide_YFSH_7_7: We need a collection, a display of multiple Echoes to truly leave an impression!
Guide_YFSH_7_8: Yep! Having a bunch of Echoes following behind turns head, but how can we snag more?
Guide_YFSH_7_9: To <ano=A place where TDs gather>Tacet Field</ano>! Tacet Discords are drawn to those grounds like moths to a flame.
Guide_YFSH_7_10: Shh... I think I sense it. The frequencies of the Tacet Field...
Guide_YFSH_6_1: Hehe, knew we could pull it off! We’ve got an Echo now, easy peasy.
Guide_YFSH_6_2: Hey {PlayerName}, hurry and absorb it before it poofs away!
Guide_YFSH_5_1: We’re almost there. Stick close to me!
Guide_YFSH_5_2: Grandpa Jingzhu, are you feeling alright?
Guide_YFSH_5_3: I’m feeling perfectly good. Instead of worrying me, let’s focus on these <ano=Energy entities with chaotic frequencies>Tacet Discords</ano>.
Guide_YFSH_5_4: You’re right. There’s a whole bunch of Tacet Discords around. Which one do you think we should capture first?
Guide_YFSH_5_7: Exactly, that’s my goal. Let’s aim to capture the most impressive of them all!
Guide_YFSH_5_8: The formidable ones are always the most impressive. It’s one and the same.
Guide_YFSH_5_9: Ah, let me think... the most formidable and impressive one around here is... Havoc Warrior! Let's capture it!
Guide_YFSH_5_10: Havoc Warrior is the monster with those big scythes, right? It’s indeed impressive! Grandpa Jingzhu, I had no idea you were so knowledgeable about Tacet Discords!
Guide_YFSH_5_11: Of course! Back in my prime, with my captain, we captured all kinds of Tacet Discords...
Guide_YFSH_5_12: Hm? There are several Havoc Warriors ahead. Let’s go!
Guide_YFSH_4_1: Grandpa Jingzhu, you’re already done with treatment? That was quick!
Guide_YFSH_4_2: Don’t let this old man’s age fool you. I’m still strong and these injuries hardly slow me down!
Guide_YFSH_4_3: Really? Um... though it does seem like you’re totally fine now.
Guide_YFSH_4_4: Of course! I’m used to injuries. Anyway, I’m feeling perfectly fine now. Shall we go?
Guide_YFSH_4_5: Are you coming with us, Grandpa Jingzhu?
Guide_YFSH_4_6: Of course, how could I let you youngsters handle my affairs while I sit around? It’s dangerous outside Jinzhou and I’m familiar with the situation there. I’m sure I can be of some help.
Guide_YFSH_4_8: Haha, don’t worry! This old man used to be quite something in his day! Even though I’m old now, I can still hold my own against any danger.
Guide_YFSH_4_9: Okay, Grandpa Jingzhu, promise me you’ll take care of yourself. If anything dangerous pops up, don’t try to tough it out. Just give me a holler right away!
Guide_YFSH_4_10: After all, it’s part of my Patroller duties.
Guide_YFSH_3_4: No worries. Take your time to sharpen your weapons.
Guide_YFSH_3_5: Awesome, let’s do this! Grandpa Jingzhu said it’s the best time for Echo-catching, and I’m ready to snag a bunch!
Guide_YFSH_29_1: It seems Grandpa Jingzhu was rejected again.
Guide_YFSH_29_3: Grandpa Jingzhu, are you okay? Please don’t be sad... I-I’ll do everything I can to cheer you up.
Guide_YFSH_29_4: Hmm? Sad? Not in the slightest! Even if I were, it’d be but a mere act.
Guide_YFSH_29_5: Thirteen failures down, but I’m not about to throw in the towel! I’ll persist, be it the fourteenth, fifteenth, or beyond...
Guide_YFSH_29_7: For I’ve resolved to become the wise and valiant soldier that matches Linghan’s ideals!
Guide_YFSH_29_8: I feel bad for rendering your efforts futile.
Guide_YFSH_29_12: Thank you. You two are really kind-hearted!
Guide_YFSH_29_13: Don’t worry. I’ll ensure you receive adequate compensation.
Guide_YFSH_29_14: Well, this is a little embarrassing... Still, being happy is good for your health, right? At least I made someone happy. It’s not too terrible.
Guide_YFSH_29_15: Well, this is a little embarrassing... Still, being happy is good for your health, right? At least I made someone happy. It’s not too terrible.
Guide_YFSH_29_16: Thirteen consecutive rejections... Perhaps it’s time for some introspection on my approach...
Guide_YFSH_29_17: Perhaps, Linghan isn’t used to such direct and impassioned displays of affection?
Guide_YFSH_29_18: That makes sense... Grandma Linghan does seem rather serious, so perhaps it’s time to switch tactics?
Guide_YFSH_29_19: Hmm... What alternative approach should I try?
Guide_YFSH_29_21: That’s a great idea! Start by engaging her in a topic that grabs her attention, and you might find yourself getting closer to her. Then, asking her to be your partner might just fall into place naturally!
Guide_YFSH_29_22: Indeed, it seems Echoes are the only thing that captures her interest.
Guide_YFSH_29_23: I’ll have to think carefully about how to improve the Echo. Actually, my captain taught me a lot back in the day, but age has dulled my memory.
Guide_YFSH_29_24: Alright, let’s call it a day. I need to go home and think it over. Here, this is your payment for today’s efforts.
Guide_YFSH_29_6: Why are you suddenly fired up?
Guide_YFSH_29_10: As long as you’re not stingy about the payment.
Guide_YFSH_29_11: It was quite amusing to watch all of this unfold.
Guide_YFSH_28_2: Sorry, what was the reason for your visit again? Ah, to show me the Echo?
Guide_YFSH_28_3: NO! Grandma, he’s here to give you Noctemints!
Guide_YFSH_28_6: Yingying seems to be quite lively today, and that helped me a lot.
Guide_YFSH_28_7: Yingying is certainly brimming with energy today, isn’t she? That helped me a lot.
Guide_YFSH_28_8: I suppose I should seize this opportunity. Yes, that’s right. I did come to bring you Noctemints. Would you like to spend the rest of your life with me?
Guide_YFSH_28_9: Oh dear, this is quite the headache. Thank you, but I'm not presently interested in seeking a partner. Even if I were, I'd prefer someone akin to my former lover...
Guide_YFSH_28_10: He was a wise and valiant soldier, and even his Echoes were impressive. Compared to him, everyone else falls short.
Guide_YFSH_28_11: So, feel free to ask me anything Echo-related, but let’s keep everything else off the table.
Guide_YFSH_28_12: Alright, then... Sorry to bother you. I shall take my leave.
Guide_YFSH_27_2: It’s strange. Lately, about ten gentlemen have brought me Noctemints.
Guide_YFSH_27_4: And now I'm the thirteenth one... Hold on, those before were all me too…
Guide_YFSH_27_5: Remember what you told me last time? One can’t judge an Echo solely from its appearance.
Guide_YFSH_27_6: That actually makes perfect sense! So I’ve honed these scythes even sharper!
Guide_YFSH_27_7: You can interpret it that way.
Guide_YFSH_27_8: What a relief to hear that! Alright, let me present to you what we’ve managed to achieve this time!
Guide_YFSH_26_1: Back here again, in this familiar spot.
Guide_YFSH_26_2: Grandpa Jingzhu, you’re here to see Grandma, right?
Guide_YFSH_26_3: I heard you're... um, what's the word? Courting Grandma?
Guide_YFSH_26_4: Oh my! Hold on, Yingying. You’re too young to understand what that means.
Guide_YFSH_26_5: I even learned a new term! Late-life love!
Guide_YFSH_26_6: Anyway, Grandpa, you should go for it! I’ll go tell Grandma you’re here!
Guide_YFSH_26_8: Grandpa Jingzhu is back with more Noctemints for you, Grandma!
Guide_YFSH_26_9: Oh my, oh my, kids these days are something else.
Guide_YFSH_25_8: I’m still surprised at the revelation that Grandpa Jingzhu was once a Midnight Ranger.
Guide_YFSH_25_9: Hmph, I’m used to keeping a low profile. Bide my time to impress Linghan.
Guide_YFSH_25_10: Make her fall in love with me with only one shot!
Guide_YFSH_25_11: With my natural charm and these finely honed scythes, I’m confident this time I’ll win Linghan’s heart and let her accept my Noctemint!
Guide_YFSH_25_15: What makes Grandpa Jingzhu so sure that having a powerful Echo will win Grandma Linghan’s heart?
Guide_YFSH_25_16: I’m with you on this one. What makes Grandpa Jingzhu so sure that having a powerful Echo will win Grandma Linghan’s heart?
Guide_YFSH_25_17: Of course, it’s not just the Echo I’ve prepared! Linghan once shared her criteria for an ideal partner.
Guide_YFSH_25_18: She said her ideal partner is a wise and valiant soldier wielding a handsome greatsword, accompanied by a majestic Echo, facing countless foes with unrivaled poise.
Guide_YFSH_25_19: You see? Apart from the majestic Echo, everything else fits me to a tee!
Guide_YFSH_25_22: Why the look? Do you lack faith in me? It’s understandable, given the generation gap between us.
Guide_YFSH_25_23: But when it comes to matters of love, especially for us seniors, trust me. I’ve got this!
Guide_YFSH_25_24: Alright, all set and ready. Let’s pay a visit to Linghan.
Guide_YFSH_24_1: Ah, you still recognize this old face, Yhan.
Guide_YFSH_24_3: We do and for a long time.
Guide_YFSH_24_4: In the days of the Midnight Rangers, Mr. Jingzhu commanded my utmost respect.
Guide_YFSH_24_5: It’s been a while since we last met. Mr. Jingzhu. You still look spirited... though your legs don’t seem as nimble?
Guide_YFSH_24_6: Ahem, just a minor accident. You see, I’m getting on in years. A little slip while hiking. Nothing to worry about!
Guide_YFSH_24_7: I’ve been resting and should recover soon.
Guide_YFSH_24_8: Your injuries seem to have healed well, but don’t underestimate the importance of rest.
Guide_YFSH_24_9: You’re as talkative as ever, boy. Back in the day, we endured far worse and still fought valiantly in battles. Remember?
Guide_YFSH_24_10: But you have retired for a long time...
Guide_YFSH_24_11: Retired I may be, but the fire still burns within me! It’s been quite some time since I retired, and opportunities to mingle with you youngsters are rare these days.
Guide_YFSH_24_12: And here stands Chief Instructor Yhan. You’ve been keeping well, I trust?
Guide_YFSH_24_13: I’m merely fulfilling my duty. And how fare your old comrades?
Guide_YFSH_24_14: Except for Captain and myself, they all... Ah, never mind. Let’s focus on happier topics during this once-in-a-while reunion.
Guide_YFSH_24_15: The past is the past. When you reach my age, you’ll realize that the present moment holds the most significance in life!
Guide_YFSH_24_16: Live in the moment and cherish each passing day. That’s how we honor our comrades’ sacrifices.
Guide_YFSH_24_17: Indeed, Mr. Jingzhu. The present demands our full attention.
Guide_YFSH_24_18: Exactly, then let’s talk about the present. You know what I need now. Are you willing to lend a hand?
Guide_YFSH_24_19: You’re as spirited as ever, Mr. Jingzhu.
Guide_YFSH_24_21: These should be enough for your needs. Take them.
Guide_YFSH_24_30: Instructor Yhan doesn’t seem half as evil as the rumors make him out to be.
Guide_YFSH_23_1: Whoa! It’s even more impressive now! Check out those scythes—they’re seriously intimidating!

Guide_YFSH_33_1: Nailed it! {PlayerName}, you’re really mastering this!
Guide_YFSH_33_2: We did find some Tuners! I gotta admit, I was kinda wondering why you seemed so at ease out in the wild.
Guide_YFSH_33_3: But now that I know you used to be a Midnight Ranger, it totally clicks!
Guide_YFSH_33_4: My captain taught me a lot... from uncovering Tacet Fields to identifying various Tacet Discords, even the places to find Tuners...
Guide_YFSH_33_5: However, memories tend to play tricks as you age, so I must see it with my own eyes to be certain.
Guide_YFSH_33_6: Even in the wild, I find myself relying on you young ones to help me reach my objectives.
Guide_YFSH_33_7: But enough dwelling on the melancholy. As long as the Echo gets stronger, I’m content.
Guide_YFSH_32_1: Ah, finally arrived. It’s just around the corner.
Guide_YFSH_32_2: Sorry, but I must take a brief rest. I’m relying on you, young ones!
Guide_YFSH_31_2: When I heard Grandpa Jingzhu needed a hand, I zipped over here using my amazing overdashing skill!
Guide_YFSH_31_3: No need to hurry. Take a moment to catch your breath, young one.
Guide_YFSH_31_4: No worries, I’m bursting with energy! So, Grandpa Jingzhu, what’s the plan?
Guide_YFSH_31_5: Alright. I must say, {PlayerName}’s suggestion seems quite practical. Find a subject that piques her interest and proceed gradually...
Guide_YFSH_31_6: So, I’ve devised a plan to enhance the Echo. Once we make the Scythes stronger, I’ll be ready to present it to her.
Guide_YFSH_31_8: Yeah, what else can we do? The Scythes is already pretty impressive. Can we kick it up a notch?
Guide_YFSH_31_9: Let me share a little secret with you. There’s another valuable asset in Tacet Fields... known as Tuners!
Guide_YFSH_31_11: Yes, Tuners have the ability to fine-tune the frequencies of Echoes, eliminating any unwanted noise and bolstering their strength!
Guide_YFSH_31_12: Oh, right! It’s that round or square thing, isn’t it? How could I forget?
Guide_YFSH_31_13: Our goal for today is to acquire some Tuners from Tacet Fields.
Guide_YFSH_31_14: Great! For stronger Echoes! Let’s get moving!
Guide_YFSH_30_1: Hey there, it’s Jingzhu! I’m reaching out once again to ask for the help of you young folks.
Guide_YFSH_30_4: As usual, I’m doing just fine!
Guide_YFSH_30_5: A valiant Midnight Ranger like myself won’t be deterred by a few setbacks!
Guide_YFSH_30_6: Since we last met, I’ve been pondering a more practical approach...
Guide_YFSH_30_7: And I’ve finally devised one! Eager to put it into action!
Guide_YFSH_30_10: Hehe, yes. I’ve thought it over and I do need the help of you young folks.
Guide_YFSH_30_11: You don’t sound very enthusiastic, but it doesn’t matter. Once you arrive, you’ll be immediately convinced that my plan will work this time!
Guide_YFSH_30_12: I’ll be waiting for you at the Jinzhou Theater, and that red-haired Patroller will be joining us as well.
Guide_YFSH_30_13: And don’t you worry, I’ve already prepared your payment. I won’t let you work for free.
Guide_YFSH_30_3: What can I do for you?
Flow_139000006_367: At that moment, there comes the ringing of the bell.
Flow_139000006_462: (Linghan stretches out her hand tremblingly and accepts the Noctemint.)

Huanglong_main_1_7_90_4: Our loved ones are counting on us! If we fail, Jinzhou falls!
Huanglong_main_1_7_90_5: Easy for you to say! We're just ordinary folks with no powers!
Huanglong_main_1_7_90_6: We have our will and bodies! Those monsters aren’t going anywhere, not when I'm still alive!

InstanceDungeonEntrance_2031_Description: A mysterious space in the Crownless Statue's heart, where chaotic flames of war are born.
Character_ChangLi_8_6: Thank you for accepting my invitation.
Character_ChangLi_8_8: Oh? And what makes you think so?
Character_ChangLi_8_11: Sorry, {PlayerName}. Jinzhou faced multiple threats back then, and we had to be cautious. We did not intend to inconvenience you. I regret our lack of hospitality.
Character_ChangLi_8_15: This time... *chuckle* I just wanted to see you. The brilliant mind that always understood my unspoken words.
Character_ChangLi_8_16: ...I am very grateful you decided to come.
Character_ChangLi_8_20: Apologies for giving you that impression, Rover. That’s not how we treat our saviors.
Character_ChangLi_8_22: I merely have a few questions, and I was wondering if you may have the answers.
Character_ChangLi_8_23: Does this game of <ano=Go>Weiqi</ano> look familiar to you, Rover?
Character_ChangLi_8_28: There is a local tale about the "Secret of Immortality" being hidden on Mt. Firmament. Have you heard about it?
Character_ChangLi_8_30: Yes. I have a slightly different version of this tale to share.
Character_ChangLi_8_31: Centuries ago, a Taoist cultivator met an enigmatic visitor on Mt. Firmament. Despite their age difference, they soon became friends and often played Weiqi together.
Character_ChangLi_8_32: One day, a woodcutter stumbled upon them, having lost his way home. Their game mesmerized him so much that he didn't notice the red tie on his basket rotting away… Panicked, he bumped into the Weiqi board.
Character_ChangLi_8_33: Despite the interruption, the visitor remained unfazed. They offered the woodcutter some tea, then guided him down the mountain, shielding him from dangerous Temporal Disruptions. After that, the visitor disappeared.
Character_ChangLi_8_34: Many years later, the Taoist cultivator became a legendary hermit guru. Upon returning to Mt. Firmament in his final years, he reunited with that elusive visitor.
Character_ChangLi_8_36: But that's how old tales go, slowly losing their truth as they're passed down.
Character_ChangLi_8_39: The legend may be shrouded in myth, but that game of Weiqi was real. Embedded within its records lies a cryptic message: "This game record can solve the crisis of time."
Character_ChangLi_8_40: From what I know, only the Sentinel in its prime has the power to manipulate time through its possession of a complete Temporal Mandate. For us mere mortals, controlling time is indeed similar to gaining immortality.
Character_ChangLi_8_41: As the records state, it only reveals itself when Mt. Firmament emerges. But how it ties to the Temporal Mandate remains an enigma... at least for now.
Character_ChangLi_8_45: Yes. We may find a way to heal them.
Character_ChangLi_8_46: If that is the case, we’ll be able to heal the Sentinel's wounds.
Character_ChangLi_8_47: But... our chances are looking slim. That game record could just hold my teacher's memories, not any real value.
Character_ChangLi_8_48: So I am presenting this as merely a personal request.
Character_ChangLi_8_49: I am planning to go find that record. Could you please join me?
Character_ChangLi_8_53: Thank you for lending me a hand. I promise it will be worth your while.
Character_ChangLi_8_54: As we have been to Mt. Firmament before, I imagined it would pique your interest, as the tale concerns our Sentinel.
Character_ChangLi_8_55: And, moreover... You are special to me, and… to Mt. Firmament. I hope I have provided enough reasons to clear your doubts.
Character_ChangLi_8_56: In addition… I promise to aid you in any way I can after we return with the record. How does that sound?
Character_ChangLi_8_57: Very well. Let's meet on the gallery road outside Hongzhen.
Character_ChangLi_8_58: I still have some preparations to do. Please go ahead, I'll join you later.
Character_ChangLi_8_4: It's fine. I just got here too.
Character_ChangLi_8_5: Something tells me you've been here for a while.
Character_ChangLi_8_7: I see you really love your riddles.
Character_ChangLi_8_10: Those tokens from Jinhsi... It was your idea, was it not?
Character_ChangLi_8_12: It's okay. Jinhsi had explained your reasons.
Character_ChangLi_8_13: I'm more or less used to it by now...
Character_ChangLi_8_14: It's a thing of the past.
Character_ChangLi_8_17: What's the deal this time? Another Tacet Discord to beat?
Character_ChangLi_8_19: Let's cut to the chase. What do you want from me?
Character_ChangLi_8_29: The one I heard in Hongzhen?
Character_ChangLi_8_35: You mean this game in front of us?
Character_ChangLi_8_37: You mean the other folklores may hold some truth too.
Character_ChangLi_8_44: There might be an undamaged sample of Temporal Mandate.
Character_ChangLi_8_52: I’ll consider it, but what's in it for me?
Character_ChangLi_7_1: (A ring, she wrote... Should be this ring-shaped ancient structure, I guess?)
Character_ChangLi_7_2: Wow, it’s really huge now that we look at it.
Character_ChangLi_7_3: Next, hanging eaves... If we look from here... Is it that pavilion?
Character_ChangLi_5_1: Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
Character_ChangLi_5_4: Hmm... You humans make everything so complicated.
Character_ChangLi_5_5: Well, at least now we know what she wanted to say.
Character_ChangLi_5_7: Now that’s much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn*... I’m getting sleepy again.
Character_ChangLi_5_9: Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?
Character_ChangLi_5_12: The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.
Character_ChangLi_5_13: With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.
Character_ChangLi_5_14: We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.
Character_ChangLi_5_19: We're all indebted to you, Hongzhen and its people alike. If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.
Character_ChangLi_5_20: I couldn't help but notice you've been asking around. Is there something you need assistance with?
Character_ChangLi_5_21: (Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)
Character_ChangLi_5_23: You tell Xinyi about your encounter with Changli and what the passersby said about her.
Character_ChangLi_5_24: Hmm... I see. That sounds like something Changli would do.
Character_ChangLi_5_25: Even though we're not that close, I know a bit about her personality. She wouldn't just hand over something that symbolizes her identity to anyone, especially when...
Character_ChangLi_5_27: I think it would be better for her to tell you personally.
Character_ChangLi_5_28: The Magistrate's Counselor is shrouded in mystery, and her motives are often hard to decipher...
Character_ChangLi_5_29: When she wants something done, it's never as straightforward as it seems, and few can grasp the true meaning behind her plans.
Character_ChangLi_5_30: The rumors and controversies surrounding her never cease, but she seems unfazed.
Character_ChangLi_5_31: However... I believe one has to get involved personally to truly understand Changli's intentions, regardless of public opinion.
Character_ChangLi_5_34: About the riddle... it seems you have already figured it out by yourself.
Character_ChangLi_5_35: But remember, it's not just about the answer, but also what she wants you to understand.
Character_ChangLi_5_37: If there's anything else you need here in Hongzhen, please do not hesitate to let me know.
Character_ChangLi_5_2: She doesn't seem to have ill intents.
Character_ChangLi_5_3: We'll have to figure it out ourselves.
Character_ChangLi_5_6: "Let’s meet at the highest place in Hongzhen, in the early afternoon."
Character_ChangLi_5_10: It's nice. The place is bustling with life.
Character_ChangLi_5_11: It's much more lively than before.
Character_ChangLi_5_16: Couldn't have done it without everyone.
Character_ChangLi_5_17: That job was a beast. You better have my money ready.
Character_ChangLi_5_33: I'm very curious about her plans.
Character_ChangLi_4_1: Uhh... How did she disappear like that? Wait, are you that legendary Rover who saved Jinzhou?!
Character_ChangLi_4_3: Well, you've come to the right person! I'm here to compile a new travel guide for Hongzhen!
Character_ChangLi_4_4: "Next to a ring and hanging eaves"... Oh! I know where that is. You'll need to stand on the tallest building in Hongzhen to see what you're looking for.
Character_ChangLi_4_5: It's on the northeast side of the town, can't miss it. You'll see it once you get there.
Character_ChangLi_4_6: Say, that person earlier... that was Lady Changli, right?! I saw you talking to her!
Character_ChangLi_4_8: Of course! Everyone in Jinzhou knows about Lady Changli, even though she rarely appears in public.
Character_ChangLi_4_9: As Master Xuanmiao's disciple, she excels in the arts of politics and diplomacy. Her travels have taken her across the four seas, and as Secretary-General, she has commanded respect from all who cross her path!
Character_ChangLi_4_11: Yeah! And she came all the way to Jinzhou to help out Magistrate Jinhsi for the sake of peace in Huanglong. She's been working tirelessly behind the scenes since then, fully dedicated to her task...
Character_ChangLi_4_12: How could anyone not revere such a selfless act?
Character_ChangLi_4_13: *sigh* I could've sworn I just saw her. Where did she go? I wish I could take one more look...
Character_ChangLi_4_2: (Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
Character_ChangLi_4_14: Are you sure you're just here for the travel guide?
Character_ChangLi_3_1: What do you want? I've done nothing wrong!
Character_ChangLi_3_3: Huh? Uh... You're just asking for directions...? Sorry, I'm not a local, can't help you there.
Character_ChangLi_3_4: Wait, you... you were the one talking to Lady Changli earlier, weren't you?
Character_ChangLi_3_5: The young man begins looking around warily, as if in fear of something terrible hidden in the shadows.
Character_ChangLi_3_6: If I were you, I'd steer clear of her. She's a deceitful woman who enjoys toying with people's hearts. A cunning villain who will manipulate you without you even knowing it.
Character_ChangLi_3_8: Haven't you heard? She left her government job to come here, to this small town. There's gotta be a reason behind it.
Character_ChangLi_3_9: I heard she chose to quit her job, but I bet she messed up back in the capital and got demoted here as punishment.
Character_ChangLi_3_12: Then I guess you've also been fooled by her looks. That woman will stop at nothing to get what she wants, while you remain oblivious to her true intentions. And by the time you catch on, you'll already be caught in her trap.
Character_ChangLi_3_13: Wait a minute, has she actually achieved anything substantial during her time in Jinzhou? Or did Madam Magistrate just fall for her clever words and let her slack off?
Character_ChangLi_3_16: Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
Character_ChangLi_3_17: I... I have my reasons to believe so!
Character_ChangLi_3_18: I heard she tricked that VIP guest of Jinzhou into going to Mt. Firmament. Just think about how dangerous that place was!
Character_ChangLi_3_19: She must have been afraid of {Male=him;Female=her} getting too close to Madam Magistrate and ruining her plans... What a sinister woman! Fortunately, that guest was a skilled fighter, and {Male=he;Female=she} managed to escape unharmed.
Character_ChangLi_3_20: I hope you don't mind my frankness. Just giving some advice, 'cause you look pretty innocent and gullible... Not from Jinzhou judging by your outfit, right?
Character_ChangLi_3_25: Oh shoot, I completely forgot about something I need to do. Sorry, gotta run...
Character_ChangLi_3_2: (Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
Character_ChangLi_3_10: ...It's not nice to badmouth people like this.
Character_ChangLi_3_11: Not everyone values power and fame.
Character_ChangLi_2_1: What can I help you with?
Character_ChangLi_2_3: "When snow thaw into streams"? Ah, you’re not from around here, I bet? When we say that in Hongzhen, we mean the <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Wei. Early afternoon, the warmest hours of a day.
Character_ChangLi_2_4: Legend tells of a visitor who ventured here some centuries ago. Back then, local villagers were struggling with no firewood due to heavy snow. This visitor opened up a path with their Forte and diverted a hot spring to provide warmth and aid.
Character_ChangLi_2_5: People say it was once a stunning sight, with mist and ice flowing westward down the streams, as if many celestial beings were returning to the sea. Now the sight has unfortunately disappeared, but the saying sticks. We use it to describe time in local speech.
Character_ChangLi_2_7: Well, it's what Grandpa Zou tells everyone. I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but when it comes to stories like this one... They're usually made-up.
Character_ChangLi_2_9: Hmm... Not that I don't want to believe them, but... Oh, you were listening to one of his stories earlier too, right? What did you think?
Character_ChangLi_2_21: Really? So you're into stories and anecdotes too?
Character_ChangLi_2_22: Looks like we have that in common.
Character_ChangLi_2_13: Haha... Maybe Grandpa Zou can learn a thing or two from you in terms of humor.
Character_ChangLi_2_14: Grandpa Zou's great-grandfather was a descendant of the first inhabitants of Hongzhen. He grew up hearing stories about Mt. Firmament. Recently he heard Madam Magistrate had resolved the crisis, so he decided to visit and learn more about his roots.
Character_ChangLi_2_15: People in town are curious about the outside world and how they are perceived. Grandpa Zou is happy to answer their questions and has unknowingly become popular among them. Before he knew it, everyone was coming to talk to him...
Character_ChangLi_2_18: It's funny to hear outsiders describe my hometown, Hongzhen, as mysterious. We're just a normal place with our own quirks...
Character_ChangLi_2_19: Especially lately, with so many people from Jinzhou coming on some kind of expedition. They're obsessed with us, like we're some kind of ancient relics. Can you believe they actually asked if our Pavo Plums have magical powers?
Character_ChangLi_2_20: Time truly is a formidable force...
Character_ChangLi_2_2: (Ask about the riddle in Changli’s note.)
Character_ChangLi_2_8: You don't believe in those stories?
Character_ChangLi_2_11: It was a bit too exaggerated.
Character_ChangLi_2_12: I wasn't mentioned in the story, so a thumbs down.
Character_ChangLi_2_16: And it turned into a storytelling session...
Character_ChangLi_2_17: He must be a fan of that storyteller in Jinzhou.
Character_ChangLi_13_1: Signs of climbing... Someone may have been here before us.
Character_ChangLi_12_1: We can see the whole of Hongzhen from here.
Character_ChangLi_12_2: I never noticed how beautiful it looked during my previous visits.
Character_ChangLi_12_3: It's the same place as always. I suppose it's my state of mind that has changed.
Character_ChangLi_12_6: I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.
Character_ChangLi_12_8: Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!
Character_ChangLi_12_9: No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...
Character_ChangLi_12_10: Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...
Character_ChangLi_12_13: C’mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!
Character_ChangLi_12_16: It's in the same direction we’re going. Could it be...
Character_ChangLi_12_11: (How could there be any Tacet Discords in Mt. Firmament?)
Character_ChangLi_12_15: Tacet Discords could be assaulting people over there.
Character_ChangLi_11_1: You seem curious about that ancient structure.
Character_ChangLi_11_2: It looks familiar... Like the abandoned Court of Savantae facility I saw, but bigger in scale.
Character_ChangLi_11_3: I heard it first appeared along with our Sentinel. Later, the Court of Savantae based their Chronosorters on its design.
Character_ChangLi_10_4: The notes only provided a vague idea of where the game record is. I've determined the most likely location on my last visit.
Character_ChangLi_10_5: We’ll be heading there. See if we can find anything new.
Character_ChangLi_10_8: But one can only do so much alone. This is why I need your help.
Character_ChangLi_10_3: I trust you’ll guide me well, Miss Wayfinder.
Character_ChangLi_10_7: That’s surprisingly straightforward, especially coming from you.
Character_ChangLi_10_9: Lucky for you, I'm very good at finding things.
Character_ChangLi_10_10: Gotta throw myself a challenge from time to time.
Character_ChangLi_10_11: I'm not planning to go back on my own words.
PhantomCollectTaskDesc_2_Desc: Despite his advanced age, Grandpa Jingzhu insists on capturing Echoes. What could be his reason? Go find out from Chixia and lend a helping hand!
HelpText_67_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Details]
Complete the following three quests to obtain corresponding rewards.
1. Search for and absorb specific Echoes. Tap the image to navigate to Echo Collection to track the target.
2. Data Bank level reaches 10. Unlock new Echoes or higher rarity of existing Echoes to obtain Data Bank EXP.

Event_SYHJ_1_1: Hmm, I wonder what’s in that crevice... and why does my alloy glow...
Event_SYHJ_1_2: I really can't seem to figure it out.
Event_SYHJ_1_5: Huh? Excuse me if I'm disturbing you by talking to myself.
Event_SYHJ_1_6: A crevice appeared in the mine underground lately.
Event_SYHJ_1_7: From the looks of it, it seemed like an entrance to some unstable Sonoro Sphere.
Event_SYHJ_1_12: However, several miners who work with my ore shop told me that with this crevice, they are afraid and unwilling to go down the mine recently.
Event_SYHJ_1_13: They can easily find other jobs, but without their supply, my shop would go bankrupt.
Event_SYHJ_1_16: It's a small business. If I want to stay in this game, I have to fight a price war.
Event_SYHJ_1_17: And if I lose these old suppliers who offer lower prices, I simply cannot compete with those monopolies like Huaipu Mining Firm...
Event_SYHJ_1_18: Let me see... well, I appreciate your kindness, but you don't have enough to keep me stocked. So keep it for yourself.
Event_SYHJ_1_19: At this point, we have to figure out what’s inside the crevice...
Event_SYHJ_1_20: As long as we confirm that it is not dangerous, I can convince the miners to keep working with me.
Event_SYHJ_1_23: I can't believe there is someone as friendly as you...
Event_SYHJ_1_24: If you can confirm the situation inside the crevice and help me get my shop back up and running, I'll be sure to thank you with a large sum of money!
Event_SYHJ_1_27: You're a good person, but a businessman's reputation is on the line. Since I made a promise, I have to give you the payment.
Event_SYHJ_1_28: Of course, my word is my bond.
Event_SYHJ_1_29: Before you go, please bring this "Sample Alloy" with you.
Event_SYHJ_1_31: It's an alloy I smelted myself. The formula is still under review...
Event_SYHJ_1_32: But my goal is very clear: I will make the best-performing alloy material in the world!
Event_SYHJ_1_33: Back to the point... I found that my alloy glows when it gets close to the crevice.
Event_SYHJ_1_34: I don't quite understand how it works, but I have a hunch it might help you.
Event_SYHJ_1_36: Right. Go on, then. I’ll wait for your good news!
Event_SYHJ_1_14: Can't you find someone else for your stock?
Event_SYHJ_1_15: I have some ore with me.
Event_SYHJ_1_22: I am familiar with Sonoro Spheres.
Event_SYHJ_1_25: It's okay. I didn't come here for the money.
Event_SYHJ_1_26: Please pay me a lot of money.
Event_SYHJ_2_4: I didn't know it was so dangerous there... Are you hurt?
Event_SYHJ_2_8: Did, did it really?! How did it help you?
Event_SYHJ_2_10: My alloy strengthened the bearer in this Sonoro Sphere...
Event_SYHJ_2_11: I, I'm really good at smelting!
Event_SYHJ_2_12: Tell you what, I'll give you some more alloys, and you help me test them in the Sonoro Sphere!
Event_SYHJ_2_15: That's not the point. Two days out of business won't kill me.
Event_SYHJ_2_16: Even though I'm a businessman, I have a dream.
Event_SYHJ_2_17: If I can make the most powerful alloy in the world, then all the mine companies will remember my name!
Event_SYHJ_2_18: Compared to that, a temporary business setback is no big deal.
Event_SYHJ_2_3: There were a lot of Tacet Discords inside.
Event_SYHJ_2_7: Your alloy helped me a lot.
Event_SYHJ_2_9: It seemed to have strengthened me.
Event_SYHJ_2_13: What happened to eliminating the threat of the crevice?
Event_SYHJ_3_1: Though I've been tweaking the recipe for my alloy, the progress of its improvement has always been limited.
Event_SYHJ_3_2: I really can't compare myself with the academics and engineers at the academy who specialize in weapons materials.
Event_SYHJ_3_3: But this crevice in the mine seems to have a special connection to my alloy.
Event_SYHJ_3_4: Only my alloy glows near this crevice...
Event_SYHJ_3_5: I was excited and scared at once.
Event_SYHJ_3_6: Excited, because I felt my efforts were recognized, and my alloy was special in this Sonoro Sphere.
Event_SYHJ_3_7: But I'm also scared that if the crevice disappears, will my alloy become meaningless?
Event_SYHJ_3_8: Every time I think about this, I stop worrying about my business, and I even hope the crevice lasts a little longer...

Character_ChangLi_19_3: I... I'm okay. Wait, you... Are you THE Rover...?
Character_ChangLi_19_5: You're that hero who fought against the Threnodian, and you also resolved the time crisis here with Madam Magistrate. Everyone's been talking about you...
Character_ChangLi_19_6: And Lady Changli... I-I never thought I'd have the chance to see you in person...
Character_ChangLi_19_7: ...Without your help, I would've been a goner for sure...
Character_ChangLi_19_8: I can't die here. Not when I've got someone waiting for me...
Character_ChangLi_19_9: I've finally, finally found it... After all this time... Ugh...
Character_ChangLi_19_12: While we've solved the crisis in Mt. Firmament for the time being... Public access to the mountain is still restricted. Before entering the mountain, any explorer must submit a request and can only do so while accompanied by the Midnight Rangers.
Character_ChangLi_19_13: Sir, could you please share your reasons for traveling here alone?
Character_ChangLi_19_14: I, I heard about Mt. Firmament's legend... So I came to find its secret...
Character_ChangLi_19_15: I've only been in the mountain for half a day, everything was going smoothly before those monsters pounced on me on my way back... *cough*...
Character_ChangLi_19_16: I must get back... Fuling... She's still waiting for me...
Character_ChangLi_19_19: It seems he is still hiding something from us.
Character_ChangLi_19_20: He needs to go back to Hongzhen for proper medical attention... Time is against us.
Character_ChangLi_19_24: The appearance of Tacet Discords is indeed unusual… We can ask him later when he's recovered a bit more.
Character_ChangLi_19_25: Indeed. Tacet Discords appearing in such numbers on Mt. Firmament, of all places… This is unusual, to say the least.
Character_ChangLi_19_26: We can continue our conversation later, after getting him to safety.
Character_ChangLi_19_27: On that note, we still don't know his identity... Judging from this uniform, he might be affiliated with the Pioneer Association.
Character_ChangLi_19_30: Good point, Rover. Let's head back.
Character_ChangLi_19_10: Take it easy. Everything's all right.
Character_ChangLi_19_11: Relax. Your wounds look pretty bad.
Character_ChangLi_19_17: He doesn't look like he's only been here for half a day...
Character_ChangLi_19_21: We’ll need to escort him down the mountain.
Character_ChangLi_19_22: Something feels strange about this place.
Character_ChangLi_19_28: The Association has a presence in Hongzhen right now.
Character_ChangLi_19_29: He mentioned someone waiting for him.
Character_ChangLi_20_3: H-How may I help you today, Lady Changli? Oh and, hello {PlayerName}! The person on your back... Is he okay?
Character_ChangLi_20_4: We found him on Mt. Firmament. Do you know where his companions might be?
Character_ChangLi_20_5: Isn't this Wuli? What happened to him?
Character_ChangLi_20_10: I remember he went on sabbatical months ago, and he left with Fuling...
Character_ChangLi_20_12: Yes, Fuling, his girlfriend. I think they're visiting Hongzhen together. They're staying at the inn over there.
Character_ChangLi_20_13: Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.
Character_ChangLi_20_14: Speaking of... Is he really okay? Perhaps we should get him to a hospital first...
Character_ChangLi_20_15: No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...
Character_ChangLi_20_16: Don't worry. We'll help you find Fuling.
Character_ChangLi_20_6: He was attacked by Tacet Discords.
Character_ChangLi_20_9: He's one of the Pioneer Association's explorers, but we don't see him around Jinzhou too often.
Character_ChangLi_21_3: *cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...
Character_ChangLi_21_5: Yes, I am... Can you please tell me what happened?
Character_ChangLi_21_7: Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...
Character_ChangLi_21_8: Great news, Fuling! ...I found it! Finally!
Character_ChangLi_21_9: I've found a way to slow down your illness. No more pain, my love... We can finally be together, forever!
Character_ChangLi_21_10: You mean... that legend? It's real?
Character_ChangLi_21_11: Fuling... Are you... Are you not happy?
Character_ChangLi_21_12: No... I am... I'm so glad to hear it.
Character_ChangLi_21_15: You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.
Character_ChangLi_21_16: Thank you, {PlayerName}, Lady Changli. You saved his life...
Character_ChangLi_21_19: May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...
Character_ChangLi_21_23: So... He said he only spent half a day in the mountains?
Character_ChangLi_21_25: No... I've been... I've been waiting for almost a week.
Character_ChangLi_21_26: It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
Character_ChangLi_21_28: Wuli, he... He did it for me.
Character_ChangLi_21_29: I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.
Character_ChangLi_21_30: A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.
Character_ChangLi_21_34: Despite his efforts, we couldn't find any cures... Until two weeks ago, when he brought me to Hongzhen. Said he had a surprise for me.
Character_ChangLi_21_35: I thought it was just going to be a relaxing trip, but he disappeared for seven days. Now he's back, rambling about having found a way to stop my condition from progressing...
Character_ChangLi_21_37: Mt. Firmament's "Secret of Immortality", I presume?
Character_ChangLi_21_38: Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...
Character_ChangLi_21_39: ...It cannot fully cure me, but at least we can spend eternity together.
Character_ChangLi_21_40: At first, I thought it was just a myth... But then you brought up how he only spent half a day in the mountains...
Character_ChangLi_21_43: Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.
Character_ChangLi_21_46: Mt. Firmament used to have Temporal Disruptions caused by its tumultuous history. However, thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi and Rover, these disruptions have been dealt with. Or so we had hoped.
Character_ChangLi_21_48: So there are still unaddressed Temporal Disruptions in the mountains. And unfortunately, Wuli has stumbled upon one, mistaking it for the legendary cure he was searching for.
Character_ChangLi_21_49: But little did he know, it would only put him in more danger.
Character_ChangLi_21_51: ...So that's why there were rumors of Rangers being here to take care of the leftover Tacet Discords, and block off access to the mountain...
Character_ChangLi_21_52: Then... if this Temporal Disruption you speak of is truly so dangerous...
Character_ChangLi_21_53: {PlayerName}, Lady Changli, please help us get rid of it. For the sake of everyone here.
Character_ChangLi_21_55: He truly thinks it's the only way to save you. He's willing to take a slim chance, just for you.
Character_ChangLi_21_57: *cough* I... I'm okay. I haven't talked this much in a long time.
Character_ChangLi_21_60: ...I'm just a little tired. I'll be fine after some rest.
Character_ChangLi_21_61: Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.
Character_ChangLi_21_62: If you have any other ideas, just tell him.
Character_ChangLi_21_63: But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.
Character_ChangLi_21_65: {PlayerName}, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.
Character_ChangLi_21_27: What's his obsession with the mountains?
Character_ChangLi_21_36: He was saying something about the "legend"...
Character_ChangLi_21_42: He may have run into Temporal Disruptions.
Character_ChangLi_21_47: Looks like there might still be some of them.
Character_ChangLi_21_58: I'll go get a doctor for you.
