Huanglong_main_1_7_175_2: Move! We're running out of time!
Huanglong_main_1_7_176_1: This wall... We should be able to <color=Highlight>Pull</color> it away with our Grapple.
Character_ChangLi_14_1: A compass buried in the ground. It resembles those commonly used by the Pioneer Association.
Character_ChangLi_15_1: Multiple footprints with varying levels of depth. They suggest a person was hastily running away from something.
Character_ChangLi_16_1: Get away... from me! Ugh... I can't hold up much longer...
Character_ChangLi_18_2: Please stand back. We'll take it from here.
Character_ChangLi_18_3: I-I can fight! Let me help!
Character_ChangLi_60_2: We're almost done dealing with the aftermath of the previous incident. We're currently questioning the remaining Fractsidus members we caught at Mt. Firmament.
Character_ChangLi_60_3: They wanted to get their hands on the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game, with the intention of unleashing chaos in Mt. Firmament once again. But thanks to you and Changli, their plans were foiled.
Character_ChangLi_60_4: Changli recounted to us that a Fractsidus Overseer had entered the Sonoro Sphere and was injured by her fire. They were lucky to escape, but have not been seen since.
Character_ChangLi_60_6: I've put together a thorough report for City Hall. We will strengthen our defenses to make sure this doesn't happen again.
Character_ChangLi_60_9: We parted two days ago on the coast, and then she returned to Jinzhou.
Character_ChangLi_60_10: Perhaps she's just taking some time to rest and recover... It must have taken a lot out of her to summon that much fire at once.
Character_ChangLi_60_13: Changli knew you’d be worried, and she wanted me to relay this message to you...
Character_ChangLi_60_14: Meet her at the pavilion on Mt. Firmament. She'll be waiting for you there.
Character_ChangLi_60_15: She also said... No more riddles this time.
Character_ChangLi_60_5: They just don't know when to quit...
Character_ChangLi_60_8: I haven't seen her these days.
Character_ChangLi_62_1: How are you feeling, {PlayerName}? Well-rested, I hope.
Character_ChangLi_62_4: Aww. Can't you see I'm perfectly fine, sitting right in front of you?
Character_ChangLi_62_7: Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We are only having a casual conversation today. Nothing taxing.
Character_ChangLi_62_8: Besides, you only agreed to join me here for more questions, right?
Character_ChangLi_62_11: Oh, is that so? I'm curious then.
Character_ChangLi_62_12: Sure, ask away. I'm happy to answer them to the best of my ability.
Character_ChangLi_62_16: It all started a century ago, when my mentor, Master Xuanmiao, had a brief encounter with a certain peculiar visitor.
Character_ChangLi_62_17: During a TD Outbreak, my master was rescued by that individual. {Male=He;Female=She} exuded a unique energy and was always elusive. My master dug through ancient texts and unearthed {Male=his;Female=her} presence in long-forgotten history.
Character_ChangLi_62_18: After searching for several years, he finally met that person on Mt. Firmament again. They played a game of Weiqi together, and that was how the legendary game record came into being.
Character_ChangLi_62_19: At first, I thought my master meant the game record held actual information about the time crisis. But it was just a clue. The real key was finding you, the person behind it all.
Character_ChangLi_62_20: And lastly, the Secret of Immortality... It's most likely just the woodcutter's own spin on the tale.
Character_ChangLi_62_21: My master and the mysterious "visitor" had set a trap with the Sonoro Sphere, using the Weiqi game as a guise. They hid it with the Court of Savantae's Chronosorters, and it would only activate once the time flow on Mt. Firmament was restored to its normal state.
Character_ChangLi_62_22: Pure coincidence or the calculated workings of the Fractsidus, the explorer stumbled upon the Weiqi board, setting off its defense mechanisms.
Character_ChangLi_62_25: The Sentinel was already damaged when it arrived here. My master had foreseen the disasters that would befall Mt. Firmament, so he created this mechanism as a precautionary measure.
Character_ChangLi_62_26: The Sonoro Sphere would devour all who attempted to enter, unless they knew the solution to that puzzle.
Character_ChangLi_62_29: The only way to escape was by burning the Sonoro Sphere without hurting anyone inside. It required masterful control of Forte. Thinking back, it was probably his ultimate test for me.
Character_ChangLi_62_32: That was his first goal with this Sonoro Sphere.
Character_ChangLi_62_34: Before leaving, Master entrusted me with a mission: To find that individual... The one who played Weiqi with him. The one who left behind that game record.
Character_ChangLi_62_35: After my master's passing, {Male=he;Female=she} would be the only one who could control the Sonoro Sphere. By now, you should know who {Male=he;Female=she} is.
Character_ChangLi_62_41: That's why you needed me as your Wayfinder.
Character_ChangLi_62_42: My master often mentioned you before his passing.
Character_ChangLi_62_43: And from the moment you arrived in Jinzhou, I had my suspicions about your true identity. Our journey to Mt. Firmament solidified my beliefs.
Character_ChangLi_62_44: And finally, the Weiqi board in that Sonoro Sphere sealed the truth for me.
Character_ChangLi_62_45: Indeed... Those memories... They were all real.
Character_ChangLi_62_48: Yes... That's all in the past, just a little homeless girl with no name.
Character_ChangLi_62_49: I never thought we could make new memories in the Sonoro Sphere, where only the past repeats itself.
Character_ChangLi_62_50: A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.
Character_ChangLi_62_53: I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?
Character_ChangLi_62_54: What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.
Character_ChangLi_62_55: Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.
Character_ChangLi_62_56: We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.
Character_ChangLi_62_60: I see. Perhaps this is why... It's so hard to leave this beautiful world behind.
Character_ChangLi_62_61: Then... Would you be willing to finish that game of Weiqi with me instead?
Character_ChangLi_62_6: Is Mt. Firmament back to normal?
Character_ChangLi_62_13: About the game record and "Secret of Immortality"...
Character_ChangLi_62_15: About the little girl in that Sonoro Sphere...
Character_ChangLi_62_27: The solution? You mean burning down everything?
Character_ChangLi_62_30: It also thwarted the Fractsidus's plans.
Character_ChangLi_62_31: Didn't know someone could plan so much ahead...
Character_ChangLi_62_39: But I don't even remember that Sonoro Sphere.
Character_ChangLi_62_40: I see that's why you seemed to know a lot about me.
Character_ChangLi_62_46: I saw... a little girl in the Sonoro Sphere.
Character_ChangLi_62_47: I assume that was a younger version of you?
Character_ChangLi_62_51: But I wasn't really there for you. Not in the real past.
Character_ChangLi_62_52: If there isn't a Secret to Immortality, what about you...
Character_ChangLi_62_57: I live in the moment, just like you do.
Character_ChangLi_1_39: And now... this next sentence, "eternal snow thaw into streams"... What is that supposed to mean?
Character_ChangLi_1_40: Maybe it has something to do with local folklore.
Character_ChangLi_10_15: Well... As the Wayfinder, I do know a couple shortcuts.
Character_ChangLi_10_17: After dealing with those Artificers, I ruled out the other locations on my way to join you.
Character_ChangLi_10_14: Wasn't expecting you to arrive before me.
Character_ChangLi_19_31: Some of those injuries are older than half a day...
Character_ChangLi_19_32: Then perhaps that "someone" is in Hongzhen. Could be his friend or an acquaintance.
Character_ChangLi_21_67: Freezing my own time... I don't think I should do that. It's not my best option. I appreciate your concerns, but I'll be fine.
Character_ChangLi_21_68: Dreams always come to an end. Eventually we have to wake up, and keep moving forward.
Character_ChangLi_22_1: What brings you here at this time of the day?
Character_ChangLi_22_3: You explain the events that have transpired.
Character_ChangLi_22_4: I see. Strange appearances of Tacet Discords in the mountains, and undiscovered Temporal Disruptions...
Character_ChangLi_22_5: There are several questionable details according to {PlayerName}'s description.
Character_ChangLi_22_6: What do you make of Fuling's words from earlier, Rover?
Character_ChangLi_22_8: He claimed to have spent only half a day in the mountains, but it's been seven days since he returned to Hongzhen... That does sound like some kind of Temporal Disruption, one that wasn't strong enough to affect Hongzhen.
Character_ChangLi_22_9: After Jinhsi's battle with the Sentinel, she ordered Midnight Rangers to patrol Hongzhen and inspect Mt. Firmament for any lingering Temporal Disruptions before reopening it to the public.
Character_ChangLi_22_10: {PlayerName}, you've been exploring the mountains lately, so I'm sure you have a good grasp on Mt. Firmament. But if there are any hidden disruptions we missed...
Character_ChangLi_22_13: Precisely. Yet... Why did it reappear at this point?
Character_ChangLi_22_16: Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.
Character_ChangLi_22_17: He was utterly convinced of his discovery, and he somehow managed to run into Temporal Disruptions in half a day’s time. Also… when I questioned him, he evaded my inquiries.
Character_ChangLi_22_20: Lies that are most challenging to detect aren't usually outright falsehoods, rather they hide parts of the truth.
Character_ChangLi_22_21: The explorer wanted to save his friend indeed, but he was also hiding something.
Character_ChangLi_22_22: ...I've become rather curious about the truth behind this "Temporal Disruption."
Character_ChangLi_22_27: For someone with a terminal illness, they should hold onto any chance of survival—no matter how slim... Is that what you think?
Character_ChangLi_22_28: Maybe she's come to terms with her destiny, or maybe... she never planned on continuing to live like that forever.
Character_ChangLi_22_33: The frequency disturbance here is weak. It's similar to past Temporal Disruptions at Mt. Firmament, but not exactly the same.
Character_ChangLi_22_34: Master Xuanmiao's records show that this is where the game record last appeared. This is also where we found that explorer.
Character_ChangLi_22_35: ... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.
Character_ChangLi_22_37: Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.
Character_ChangLi_22_38: The explorer did not tell us about his source of information.
Character_ChangLi_22_39: But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.
Character_ChangLi_22_43: Got it. The Midnight Rangers will block all entrances to the mountain for now. And Changli, you still have the power to send in garrison troops as needed.
Character_ChangLi_22_44: We left Mt. Firmament in a hurry. I need to go back up the mountain and investigate further... I have some theories that could use confirmation.
Character_ChangLi_22_45: We're still unsure about the exact location and range of the Temporal Disruption. Regardless, its reappearance is a pressing issue that needs our attention.
Character_ChangLi_22_51: Thank you again for your help. You were supposed to be here for a relaxing time... but it seems another crisis has popped up.
Character_ChangLi_22_2: There's been a bit of an incident.
Character_ChangLi_22_11: It must've appeared after Wuli entered the mountains.
Character_ChangLi_22_14: Maybe it has something to do with Wuli.
Character_ChangLi_22_15: Maybe it needed a specific trigger.
Character_ChangLi_22_23: About Fuling's attitude towards all of this...
Character_ChangLi_22_25: She accepted the reality a little too quickly.
Character_ChangLi_22_26: Why did she want to get rid of the Temporal Disruption?
Character_ChangLi_22_31: About the anomalies in that area...
Character_ChangLi_22_36: The complete Temporal Program indicated in that game record...
Character_ChangLi_22_41: Something bigger is behind all of this.
Character_ChangLi_22_42: We need more information. Let's not act rashly.
Character_ChangLi_22_48: I haven't fulfilled my promise yet.
Character_ChangLi_22_49: Then having another person onboard makes it less dangerous.
Character_ChangLi_27_1: Now it has become quite clear what the two were thinking.
Character_ChangLi_27_5: Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
Character_ChangLi_27_6: If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.
Character_ChangLi_27_7: That is not what she wants for him.
Character_ChangLi_27_8: Her ultimate desire is for her lover to embrace her inevitable passing, and to realize the joint aspirations they hold in her place.
Character_ChangLi_27_9: She hasn't given up, but rather clings to hope for their future, even if she won't be there to see it unfold.
Character_ChangLi_27_14: Is that how you see me? Hmm... Perhaps for some, death is just a destination. There are more significant things to focus on.
Character_ChangLi_27_15: I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.
Character_ChangLi_27_17: Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.
Character_ChangLi_27_18: It's no coincidence. All the clues point to a correlation between the Temporal Disruption and the legends of the Weiqi game. Or maybe... someone's trying to make us connect the dots.
Character_ChangLi_27_20: Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.
Character_ChangLi_27_21: I guess our "old friends" have still not given up.
Character_ChangLi_27_22: They went to great lengths just to lead us here. It would be rather rude of us to not respond in some way.
Character_ChangLi_27_23: According to the information in my master's notes, and Wuli's map...
Character_ChangLi_27_24: ...The place we're looking for should be just ahead.
Character_ChangLi_27_2: So this is what she had on her mind...
Character_ChangLi_27_3: Did you know about it all along?
Character_ChangLi_27_10: Would you make the same choice... If it had happened to you?
Character_ChangLi_27_12: It seems you don't care that much about your own death.
Character_ChangLi_27_13: You seem to understand Fuling deeply.
Character_ChangLi_28_1: Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?
Character_ChangLi_28_4: The abnormal time flow here is most likely caused by the Chronosorters. Perhaps there is a way to fix it.
Character_ChangLi_28_3: Could it have anything to do with the game record?
Character_ChangLi_29_1: Marvelous play, truly remarkable. Occupying both solid territory and influence. An extraordinary move.
Character_ChangLi_29_2: Never have I imagined I'd experience such a great game of Weiqi on Mt. Firmament. You may look young, my friend, but there's so much more to you than meets the eye.
Character_ChangLi_29_4: Please, no need to be so modest. I can tell the difference between our skill levels.
Character_ChangLi_29_6: ...This is my master's voice. The voice of the other person seems deliberately erased.
Character_ChangLi_29_8: Who do you think the other person looks like?
Character_ChangLi_29_13: Changli seems to be in deep thought and does not answer.
Character_ChangLi_29_11: Is this why you brought me here?
Character_ChangLi_30_1: It has been decades since we last met, but you, my friend, still look the same.
Character_ChangLi_30_2: Turns out I had already met you all those years ago, my life saver… and you're older than me. I should have been more respectful back then.
Character_ChangLi_30_3: So you remember our promise. I am overjoyed...
Character_ChangLi_30_4: A new city is about to be established. Having accomplished so much, why do you choose to retire now?
Character_ChangLi_30_6: ...I may have spoken out of turn. If you're not in a rush to depart Jinzhou, how about another round of Weiqi with me?
Character_ChangLi_31_1: *cough*... Well played. Even after twenty years, I still have no chance of winning against you.
Character_ChangLi_31_2: Haha... I barely noticed how so much time has passed.
Character_ChangLi_31_3: Every move in Weiqi is fluid and unpredictable. Even if we start with the same opening, the outcome can never be predetermined... We see this in our game, and it's true for all the lives out there.
Character_ChangLi_31_4: My clan are a group of hermits. We view the world as a game of strategy, manipulating the ebb and flow behind the scenes...
Character_ChangLi_31_5: But you, my friend, chose to enter the game yourself. It's a dangerous path with no end in sight. I want to help, but my time is running out. I won't be there when you finally succeed...
Character_ChangLi_31_6: Please don't feel sad for me. If I die, it would be an honor to rest at the Sentinel's feet.
Character_ChangLi_31_7: When the time comes... the one who shall finish this game of Weiqi with you will not be me, but rather my apprentice.
Character_ChangLi_31_8: Do my plans seem too risky to you?
Character_ChangLi_31_9: No need for concern. With her intelligence and quick thinking, she'll surely be able to solve this puzzle.
Character_ChangLi_31_10: The result of this game will decide the fate of Jinzhou, and even the entire world.
Character_ChangLi_31_11: The road ahead is long and treacherous... Our final game, let's make it...
Character_ChangLi_32_3: You've come this far and followed us here, yet you hesitate to reveal yourselves. Guess I'll have to take the lead and extend an invitation.
Character_ChangLi_32_4: ...Don't assume you'll always be in control, Changli.
Character_ChangLi_32_6: Our friendly chat is over. It's time to say goodbye.
Character_ChangLi_33_1: Still not giving up yet, Changli?
Character_ChangLi_33_2: We know more than just that unfinished game, we are well aware of the price you have paid... You're dangling at the end of your rope.
Character_ChangLi_33_3: Your unwitting trail has led us straight to our target.
Character_ChangLi_59_2: Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...
Character_ChangLi_59_6: Did you find what you were looking for?
Character_ChangLi_59_8: Thank you for your help. The Midnight Rangers have successfully apprehended all remaining Fractsidus members in the mountains, and the effects of the Temporal Disruption have now vanished.
Character_ChangLi_59_9: I lost all contact with you during this whole time. Did you run into any trouble?
Character_ChangLi_59_11: Temporal Disruption hidden inside a Sonoro Sphere... It makes sense now why it stayed hidden for so long.
Character_ChangLi_59_12: I never thought the solution would be to burn down the entire Sonoro Sphere from the inside...
Character_ChangLi_59_13: You went too far back there, Changli.
Character_ChangLi_59_20: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.
Character_ChangLi_59_21: After all, it's been almost five days...
Character_ChangLi_59_23: I never properly thanked you for bringing me back to Hongzhen. I heard about the attack by the Fractsidus in the mountains. I... I'm so sorry...
Character_ChangLi_59_24: *chuckle* No need for that. I understand.
Character_ChangLi_59_25: The Fractsidus had their eyes on the same thing as we did. They've been planning an ambush on us for a long time. Why would we blame it on you?
Character_ChangLi_59_26: We will never forget how you saved us. You gave us the opportunity to witness such a breathtaking sight. Thanks to your help, this journey holds no regrets for me.
Character_ChangLi_59_27: As for the truth behind the so-called Secret of Immortality... Fuling has told me everything.
Character_ChangLi_59_28: I had a gut feeling it would turn out to be a disappointment, but I couldn't give up. And in the end, I lost sight of why I even started this journey...
Character_ChangLi_59_29: ...But this isn't the first time this has happened. Let's just call it another adventure coming to an end.
Character_ChangLi_59_30: I've talked about it with Fuling. From now on, I'll take her on more trips to see more new places together.
Character_ChangLi_59_32: Until the day... when I can no longer hold a pen. I've already talked to the folks at the publishing house, and they're happy to let me continue painting for them.
Character_ChangLi_59_33: My eventual departure may be unavoidable, but I want to give it my all until the very end.
Character_ChangLi_59_36: I know you have already looked past death, but remember... There are people who care about you. They want you to live on and be happy.
Character_ChangLi_59_37: Yes, I understand. Sometimes, I wish...
Character_ChangLi_59_38: ...we could stay together a little longer, if only for a while...
Character_ChangLi_59_39: Of course, Fuling, I... We've always been...
Character_ChangLi_59_40: It's not time to be sad yet, is it?
Character_ChangLi_59_41: I've compiled a list of renowned doctors in Huanglong. They're highly skilled and may offer assistance for your medical condition, which is challenging but not impossible to cure.
Character_ChangLi_59_46: Lady Changli, I truly can't thank you enough...
Character_ChangLi_59_48: Hmm... If you're feeling generous and want to repay me, I hope to see Fuling's work in the next issue of "Artists of Huanglong".
Character_ChangLi_59_49: Everyone's been missing seeing their favorite landscape artist's work lately.
Character_ChangLi_59_52: Are you surprised? Well, now I'm curious. What kind of a person do you see me as?
Character_ChangLi_59_53: Now that the situation has been resolved, you should return to Hongzhen. You deserve some good rest.
Character_ChangLi_59_54: After going through so much, you must be exhausted, {PlayerName}.
Character_ChangLi_59_56: Me? Well, I think Lady Xinyi could use the extra help with dealing with the aftermath.
Character_ChangLi_59_59: Well, It wouldn't hurt to have a little more faith in me, {PlayerName}.
Character_ChangLi_59_61: It's getting late. Maybe we should wait until we get back to discuss anything else.
Character_ChangLi_59_15: Yeah, that was a bit too risky.
Character_ChangLi_59_22: So it's already been five days...
Character_ChangLi_59_34: No matter what happens, please take care.
Character_ChangLi_59_51: Didn't know you were a magazine reader.
Character_ChangLi_59_57: Are you sure you'll be okay?
Character_ChangLi_63_1: Every winter, my hometown buzzed as people left their mark in the fresh snow, hoping for dreams to come true when it melted.
Character_ChangLi_63_2: Did you try it too, Changli?
Character_ChangLi_63_3: No, I only watched from afar... My Forte always melted the snow faster than I liked.
Character_ChangLi_64_1: Isn't that Wuli? What happened to him?
Character_ChangLi_64_3: Not really... He showed up in town and started asking weird questions to all the older folks. They've been avoiding him ever since.
Character_ChangLi_64_4: The Secret of Immortality... I've found it...
Character_ChangLi_64_5: *sigh* He really went up the mountain, didn't he? Oh my... Quick, get him to a doctor!
Character_ChangLi_64_6: No... I'm fine... Go find Fuling...
Character_ChangLi_64_7: Sir, do you know where his companions might be?
Character_ChangLi_64_8: I'm not sure. There are lots of other people in town who are dressed just like him. Why don't you try asking them?
Character_ChangLi_64_9: We will. Thanks for the tips.
Character_ChangLi_65_1: His companions? Hmm... Sorry, I just joined the Association not long ago. I don't really know them.
Character_ChangLi_65_2: His gear though, these are last year's designs... Perhaps you should go ask Youning? She's been a member for quite some time. She might know him.
Character_ChangLi_7_4: It does look quiet. Should be a nice place for meetings... *yawn* Ugh, getting 'eepy again…
Character_ChangLi_7_5: That must be the place, then.
Character_ChangLi_8_59: ...Apologies. I heard about your memory loss. Please pardon me.
Character_ChangLi_8_61: The two resumed their unfinished game. People believe the visitor shared their Secret of Immortality through cleverly-placed Weiqi pieces, as a final parting gift.
Character_ChangLi_8_62: Yes... and no. This game is missing the final twenty moves. It is unfinished.
Character_ChangLi_8_64: That was a bit different from what you heard before, I guess? The story changed over time, infused with fantasy in each retelling.
Character_ChangLi_8_65: I am interested in this tale too.
Character_ChangLi_8_66: I see. Then I have no reason to not go.
Character_ChangLi_8_68: It's still early. How about we set off now?

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1: {PlayerName}, did you hear that? My stomach is growling.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_2: Hello? Are you with me? {PlayerName}, you seem a bit distracted.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_3: With so much delicious food right in front of you, aren't you gonna try any? Well if you're not interested, I'll gobble it all up!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_4: You've been absent-minded the whole day. Still bothered by that dream from last night?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_5: Wait, so you had a dream about the Sentinel? Like the one from your flashback when we saw the Sentinel statue after you lost your memory?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_7: This time, I saw something different.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_8: Hang on, let me get this straight... The Sentinel swooshed you off to a mountain shaped like a dragon...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_9: And then there were all these bad things going on with lots and lots of Tacet Discords, but the Sentinel saved the day!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_10: How exactly did it protect everyone again... Oh, in your dream it made the time different there?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_11: Yeah... The time in the mountains seemed to have slowed down from the outside, away from the Tacet Discords.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_12: The Sentinel must have created a barrier by manipulating the flow of time, keeping those monsters out.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_15: It's no shock that you have awesome powers, being friends with me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_16: Hmm... What was that place you dreamed about called?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_17: I'm not entirely sure I heard it correctly, but in my dream, the Sentinel mentioned a place called Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_20: Hold on! Did you just say Mt. Firmament?!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_21: Oh my! Did that Echo just... talk?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_22: It's a good friend of mine.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_24: Come on, man, relax. You don't hear an Echo talking every day, but it's not that uncommon either!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_27: Oh, you're not from around here? Well, that explains why you don't know about Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_33: The past few days, especially this morning, I caught this unique smell from the southeast. From that mountain they just mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_34: A unique smell... What do you mean?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_35: It's like a strong energy pulsing through the air, but I can't quite put my finger on it. It feels kind of weird though, doesn't smell natural...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_36: Could it have anything to do with what you said? A place where time passes slowly?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_38: I had a flashback about seeing their Sentinel... Perhaps that happened on Mt. Firmament...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_39: I can feel an unknown force guiding me, urging me to go there and find something...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_40: Jinhsi said she'll go search for the Sentinel and update me on its whereabouts.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_41: But so far, I have not heard anything from the City Hall yet...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_42: Then... Shall we go check it out together? It feels really suspicious.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_43: Let's go ask Jinhsi about it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_13: It was a safe haven from all the disturbances caused by the Tacet Discords, where people lived peacefully...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_14: Also... In my dream, I wasn't affected by the slowed time and could freely move in and out of the barrier.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_18: Mt. Firmament? Never heard of it...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_19: You never heard of Mt. Firmament? Then I'm sure you're not from around here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_25: I heard there's a country called Ri... Rinas... What? Anyway, the Echoes there are next level.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_26: What's up with this Mt. Firmament?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_28: Legends say Mt. Firmament is where the first people of Jinzhou lived. it looks like a giant statue of our Sentinel Jué.

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_20: If you die, what will happen to Jinzhou?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_21: Jinzhou... The city of Jinzhou will be no more.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_23: Ever since one descended upon Mt. Firmament, using the power of Temporal Mandate to repel Tacet Discords, time has been in disarray within this location. The fate of Jinzhou was sealed from that moment on.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_24: Over the past millenia, one has defied the laws of nature and sustained Jinzhou at the cost of one's own life force.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_25: Otherwise, the Temporal Disruption would wreak havoc not only on Mt. Firmament, but on the entire region of Jinzhou. If this were to happen, all life will be engulfed in a chaotic storm of twisted time flow.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_27: Jinzhou shall forever remain frozen in time. The past and the future meld into one, rendering life indistinguishable from death. The ceremonial rituals and endless battles persist, intertwining joy and sorrow into an eternal blur.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_28: All inhabitants of Jinzhou shall endure this perpetual fate until time itself ceases to exist.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_30: In the coming days, one will exert every ounce of strength to freeze the time in Jinzhou at the cost of one's remaining life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_31: In that moment, Jinzhou will fall into stillness, but not perish. In the distant future, the people of Huanglong may discover a method to rescue Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_32: Is there truly nothing else we can do?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_33: This is not the optimal solution, but it suffices as an option.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_34: Please forgive me... but I cannot do as you say.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_35: A decade, a century... What if nobody comes up with a solution? By that time, the world will have turned its back on this forgotten city...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_36: ...And who would be willing to spend precious resources rescuing a small city in a far-off corner of the world?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_37: Jinzhou's fate deserves better than an uncertain future.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_38: Whilst one may not live to witness the future, one can still envision endless possibilities yet to come. In my deduction, this method proves to be the most effective and stable.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_39: Magistrate Jinhsi, as you express doubts, pray tell how do you propose to solve this issue?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_40: The flow of time upon Mt. Firmament is in disarray, and it can only be contained through one's utmost effort.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_41: If one does not freeze the time now, the situation in Jinzhou shall surely worsen a hundredfold, or even a thousandfold, after one's passing.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_42: ..You once predicted a destined battle between us... Is it true?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_44: ...I was lost at first, struggling to grasp the prophecy's meaning. Only when I learned of your actions alongside the Court of Savantae did it all become clear—
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_45: By clashing two resonating powers, a Second Resonance Awakening can be induced. Through this, I am able to push my Resonance Ability beyond its limits and invoke the Temporal Mandate to restore the flow of time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_48: ...Though I will be forced to raise my blade against you...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_50: If you clash with my Resonance power, even the smallest mistake will result in Overclocking and leave you nothing but an empty husk.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_51: You are well aware of its excruciating effects. The pain you feel now is but a faint scratch in comparison to its true torment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_52: Moreover, you will be trapped within the fissures of time itself. Your being will be relentlessly shredded and mended, day after day, denied any respite for eternity.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_53: But I can restore the errors in the flow of time. Isn't that why you saved me all those years ago? I'm just doing what you've been doing all along... Going against fate to keep Jinzhou safe.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_54: Jinhsi, you are given one last opportunity. Let me freeze the time, and I can ensure your safety.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_56: What if I help her? I am here for a reason.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_57: Is there really no chance for her to live?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_58: You are only here to witness before the right time arrives.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_59: But you are not compelled to remain idle. Should you intervene, we may augment Jinhsi's odds of survival by a fraction.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_60: Command me to transfer my Temporal Mandate access to Jinhsi at the right moment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_61: —The moment of her Resonance Ability's depletion, when she is teetering on the brink of Overclocking and near death. Then, we may still save her life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_62: Miss that moment by even the slightest margin, and Jinhsi's fate will be sealed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_29: ...It is this one's own doing, and one must put an end to it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_1: This entrance leads to one's Sonoro Sphere. Magistrate Jinhsi, one shall await you there.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_2: {PlayerName}, this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_3: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_4: Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_8: I will open the entrance once you're ready.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_9: There will be no turning back...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_10: I have been preparing for this moment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_11: I understand. I have made up my mind since before I stepped foot on Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_12: Leaving Jinzhou behind fills me with regret, knowing I may never again bask in its glorious sunshine or witness the purity of its snowflakes.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_14: Our city has a rich history, with generations witnessing endless sunrises and sunsets at the border. Our people have sacrificed their blood and tears to protect Huanglong's safety.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_16: I want to protect Jinzhou in my own way, as Jinhsi, as a citizen of Jinzhou, and as Jinzhou's Magistrate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_6: Now, please let us know your choice.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_13: But that's why I'm here—to ensure that others can still experience the wonders of nature.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_1: Jinhsi has recovered. One will soon send her back to Jinzhou for recuperation. Please do not worry.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_2: With all matters resolved, as per the agreement, it is time for one to address you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_3: One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_10: You, {PlayerName}, are my Arbiter, and my former master.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_11: In bygone days, I stood by your side as you established  Jinzhou City. You tasked me with safeguarding its prosperity.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_16: You said you planned to participate in history, to make choices and witness the development of civilizations.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_17: One had previously requested for permission to transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, as that is how one is designed to function.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_18: Every ounce of my existence, from life to death and even the passing on of power, is subject to your approval.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_19: Since Jinhsi has inherited my power, the Temporal Programs are now complete. Jinzhou is no longer under threat.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_20: Jinhsi has fully assumed the mantle of leadership. From this day forth, one shall only offer aid when it is truly needed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_22: This situation has been analyzed before, but the number of variables made reaching a safe conclusion impossible.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_23: To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_24: Today was not the ideal moment for our destined battle to unfold, but the Fractsidus has remarkably escalated its arrival.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_25: The flow of time on Mt. Firmament has been restored to its natural pace, but the citizens of Hongzhen must still contend with shortened lifespans should they attempt to depart.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_26: Fortunately, with Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, they can stay safe as long as they remain on the mountain.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_27: For lack of a better solution, this is the best we can do.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_28: Through countless ages, the imposing Mt. Firmament stood firm against the storms. But as spring brings thunder and change, one feels a spark of transformation in the air.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_29: The people of Hongzhen have a bright future ahead, one that can be steered in the right direction within mere days. With proper leadership.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_34: Is it you, big thing?! Huh?! How dare you, I'm gonna teach you a le...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_35: Hmm? Wait, pause... I don't think it has any bad intentions... It smells like the "unnatural" smell I smelled in Jinzhou before...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_37: Ooh, so you must be that Sentinel! Hehe, hello there big one!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_38: {PlayerName}, why didn't you wake me up earlier? I've got a feeling I missed out on a lot of fun!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_39: ...It does feel similar to me, but there is some difference.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_40: Do you know what it is?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_41: ...This entity is unfamiliar to me. As it resides within your Tacet Mark, one can only assume you granted it access intentionally.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_42: Then who else can answer my questions?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_43: {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter, have you heard of the Black Shores?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_50: Your Tacet Mark... There is something unusual.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_7: (Ask about the current situation in Hongzhen.)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_9: I am Jué the Sentinel, the guide of Jinzhou's civilization. Everything about Jinzhou has been stored in my mind.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_12: So why did I lose my memories?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_14: This one begs your pardon, for it is not all-knowing. All my knowledge came from you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_15: In the past, one was granted the key to that Sonoro Sphere by your hand.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_21: Why didn't you tell Jinhsi about it earlier?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_31: Abby, wake up. Someone's asking about you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_36: Well, about the Sentinel I was looking for...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_44: The Black Shores? I've heard of them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_46: The Black Shores is the starting point of your journey in this world. If you have doubts, this one suggests a visit to that island.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_49: The wuthering waves ebb and flow. They shall send you back to where you belong.
Character_ChangLi_34_1: The Sonoro Sphere is open. Go!
Character_ChangLi_34_3: Sorry, but you're not getting past me.
Character_ChangLi_34_4: Jué's formidable time-bending abilities, at their peak... All trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, as I'm sure you are well aware.
Character_ChangLi_34_6: Do you really want to chase after this legend when you don't even know if it's real?
Character_ChangLi_34_7: So what? Wouldn't it be a sight to behold as this Sonoro Sphere consumes everything in its path, while the Temporal Disruptions bring death?

Character_ChangLi_55_4: I think I'm remembering something... but it's all just a blur, I can't make out any clear images...
Character_ChangLi_55_5: I've been looking for something... for a long, long time...
Character_ChangLi_55_7: I don't know... I just remember that it's very, very important, something that can change the world...
Character_ChangLi_55_8: But I'm starting to wonder why I'm even here... Everything looks so different from what I remember...
Character_ChangLi_55_9: And... Why do you look so familiar? We've never met before...
Character_ChangLi_55_14: We might be able to open that door with it!
Character_ChangLi_55_15: What will we find behind that door?
Character_ChangLi_55_10: Maybe we've met in the future.
Character_ChangLi_55_11: (Is this an effect of the Temporal Disruption, too?...)
Character_ChangLi_55_13: Is this... a missing part of the device?
Character_ChangLi_55_16: Maybe it's what you're looking for.
Character_ChangLi_56_1: A scheme be grander than naught. Vanquish malevolence in its nascent guise.
Character_ChangLi_56_6: Now that you have found the answers you seek... it is time to begin your journey.
Character_ChangLi_56_7: From this moment on, the choices you make and the plans you lay out...
Character_ChangLi_56_8: They will all lead to that future.
Character_ChangLi_9_1: Two days have passed since Changli told me that she and Xinyi would handle the aftermath. I wonder how she's doing...
Character_ChangLi_9_2: Are you worried? Let's just go ask her then.
Character_ChangLi_9_3: Might as well. Changli can be difficult to find. Let's go ask Xinyi first.

FavorRoleInfo_1105_Info: An artist for hire trying to make a living. Reserved and timid, she is not good with words but speaks volumes through her art, where her creations come to life with impossible authenticity.
Character_ChangLi_36_35: (Mirages in a Sonoro Sphere shouldn't be able to hold a conversation like this. Are these... phantoms pulled from Changli's memory, generated by Retroact effect?)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_4: I've lived in Jinzhou my whole life and never ventured into Hongzhen, yet even I know of the legend.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_5: To me, Jué is more than just our Sentinel or a revered divine being... It raised me and saved me from certain death.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_6: I've been thinking about it on our way here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_7: If the Sentinel predicted our fight, why would it even bother saving me in the first place?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_10: ...In our Sentinel's prediction, the battle between us is supposed to happen in the distant future.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_11: It had been waiting for an opportunity, a right moment to tell me the truth. That's why it didn't explain.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_12: Now may not be the opportunity the Sentinel has been waiting for, but my body cannot hold up much longer...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_13: I have to go and face it while I still can… to learn about the truth, or complete our destined battle.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_15: As your friend, I don't want to see you suffer.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_16: Give up... my duty? I never thought about it...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_17: To be honest... I did doubt myself many times.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_18: It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_19: Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_20: Jinzhou holds everything that's dear to me. Even without the title of Magistrate, I could never leave Jinzhou behind.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_23: The pain I'm feeling is nothing compared to those trapped in the Temporal Disruptions.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_24: I must find the Sentinel as soon as possible. We draw from the same source of power—saving it means saving myself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_25: Do you have to fight the Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_27: Then I will have to fight it. I refuse to back down.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_30: But let me make one thing clear—I am not planning on dying yet. I am here to fight for a chance at survival, no matter how slim that chance may be.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_8: Now I understand why. Because I am the Sentinel's Resonator. I may not have any extraordinary abilities, but I do possess the Temporal Program that it accidentally lost.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_9: If Jinzhou ever faces a similar time crisis, I... I might be the only one who can set things right.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_26: If there is truly no other option in the end...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_28: I will fight. To protect the Sentinel, and to defend Jinzhou. One life may be lost, but many will be saved.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_29: If it means keeping everyone safe, then I have no regrets giving my own life.
Character_YinLin_1_19: (Chixia just called me. I wonder what's happening...)
Character_YinLin_29_2: Look, there's a device on that wall.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_1: What did I tell ya? Nothing beats a bowl of spicy noodles in the morning!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_6: Looks like Baizhi's locked herself in the lab again, hasn't left since yesterday. Bet we won't see her til she's done with her research.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_7: No, wait. Since you're the subject of that research, we could use you as bait to lure her out. We can tie you up at the Academy's entrance...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_8: And with just a few tugs of the rope, I bet every researcher will come running at you, with Baizhi leading the pack. Hook, line, and sinker!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_13: In case of an emergency! Rover, roll out!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_14: Oops. I got carried away. My bad!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_15: By the way. Now that we've figured out the sugar pearl and the sundial, all that's left is that weird leaf and run-of-the-mill mangosteen, right?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_16: So it only took us one trip to the Academy to solve half of our problems. Either Rover's really smart, or Madam Magistrate was gonna make it easy for us to begin with.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_17: What's our next plan of action, Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_22: As for the mangosteen, we've got people selling these at the market nearby. Might find some clues there.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_23: Mangosteens are not from Jinzhou. These fruits are usually brought in by boat. Should we start from the harbor?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_27: Do you think the token is guiding us outside the city?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_28: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_29: Then we must leave the city to pursue this lead.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_30: Yes, that may work too. Any plans for the next two days, Rover?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_34: An ocean of stars... A dark-haired girl... An inverted Etheric Sea... And the Resonance Chord flowing from your Tacet Mark...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_35: And you said it was flowing in a certain direction. The nearest places are the Gorges of Spirits and the Norfall Barrens...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_39: The Etheric Sea and Resonance Chords in your dreams are real, possibly leading to the Gorges of Spirits and Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_40: Perhaps... It was more than just a dream.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_41: That girl might be the key to recovering your memories. Madam Magistrate's information aside, it seems to me your dream points toward the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_42: It's the site of the Threnodian War and the source of all TD Outbreaks. The Midnight Rangers' frontlines base is stationed there as well.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_43: The Access Pass may be another hint...
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_44: There are usually no checkpoints set up in the city besides the City Hall. A pass isn't required unless you have to leave the city borders.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_45: Now why didn't I think of that? Gotta hand it to ya, Yangyang!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_46: That's the spirit! Been beating my brain up until now, it's time to get these joints cracking for a change!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_50: Whoooah! {Male=He;Female=She}'s fast! {Male=He;Female=She}'s furious! {Male=He;Female=She}'s a TD killing machine!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_52: It's a no-go for me if you're leaving the city, my shift's coming up. Protect Rover well and shoot me a message if you need anything, alright Yangyang?
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_3: I haven't had my first bite yet.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_5: I love it. It's just the way I like!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_9: We could give it a try.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_19: Look into the strange leaf first.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_20: We've got two more days. Might as well just wait.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_31: (Tell them about the dream you had.)
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_32: Madam Magistrate gave me the Access Pass for that.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_37: I couldn't find the right moment.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_38: I thought it was just a dream.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_47: I don't know who I am.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_48: I don't know why I'm here.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_49: All I know is I must kill!
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_53: I'm sure you meant the other way around.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_55: You can just wait for the good news.

Flow_109000011_82: Oh, can't afford to underestimate our Rover!
Flow_109000011_85: Impressive skills and footwork... I'm overwhelmed by your talent!
Flow_109000011_86: Mr. Wufang always says: Observe others and correct yourself. I learned a lot from your footworks.
Flow_109000011_87: If you're interested in joining the Liondance Troupe, Lingyang and I would love to give you a referral.
Flow_109000011_88: A reward for you to commemorate your success!
Flow_11000007_17: You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.
Flow_11000007_576: Break time is over. All stand up! The training resumes. Attention!
Flow_11000007_579: Sir! I have a question about TD—
Flow_11000007_580: Sir, I wonder how I handle a weapon malfunction during a fight...
Flow_11000007_581: Finally, after all the applications I've filed over the years. Finally, I'm going to the front line!
Flow_11000007_582: S-sir! How many soldiers have you trained!
Flow_11000007_584: Get in teams of two and we'll do another simulation battle.
Flow_11000007_585: Perseverance is not the same as recklessness. Do you hear me?
Flow_11000007_587: The moves aren't pretty but they work ...... Well, it's still important that they work.
Flow_11000007_588: I've figured out Xiaohua's moves. Hey, I can't lose this time!

NPC_ZQTD_10_1: Approaching the war zone ahead, Jinzhou residents without passage rights, please do not cross the line.
NPC_ZQTD_11_1: I've fought hard for this opportunity. I hope I don't let Mr. Yhan down with my performance.
NPC_ZQTD_12_1: Everything's normal. No anomalies to report.
NPC_ZQTD_13_1: I think there's room for improvement. Look at these data.
NPC_ZQTD_13_2: We need more samples. Any changes to weapons already in use need to be handled with the utmost caution.
NPC_JC_53_1: I heard the front lines were pretty intense.
NPC_JC_53_2: Yes, I've heard about it too. Thankfully, it's all over now, and the rain has stopped.
NPC_JC_54_1: The goods have been piling up for so long. Finally, we can start shipping them out!
NPC_JC_54_2: Yes. All thanks to that Rover.
NPC_JC_55_1: Mom, mom! Where is that powerful person?
NPC_JC_55_2: {Male=He;Female=She} will be here in a minute. How about we listen to the storyteller's tale of that person first, okay?
NPC_JC_56_1: You're back, hero! With that monster gone, Jinzhou will be bustling again in no time!
NPC_JC_56_2: It's gonna be a blast! Oh, right, the Moon-Chasing Festival is coming up! You should stick around and enjoy the fun!
NPC_JC_57_1: Ah, it's {Male=big brother;Female=big sister}! Magistrate's guest!
NPC_JC_58_1: Thank you, Rover. You ended the conflict with the least price to pay and saved the lives of many Midnight Rangers.
NPC_JC_58_2: Seeing you and the general back here safe and sound, I just...
NPC_JC_58_3: ...Sorry, I got a bit too excited. Anyway, nothing matters more than coming back safely.
NPC_JC_59_1: Oh, it's you. I was just thinking that it's about time I paid you a visit.
NPC_JC_59_2: I've been here telling stories for many years, recounting countless legends, tales, and anecdotes. Now, for a change, I can be a listener.
NPC_JC_59_3: You've become part of a new story. If you've got time, come over for a chat with me!
NPC_JC_60_1: You're back, Rover. Must've been a tiring journey back to the city, right?
NPC_JC_60_2: Last time we met was at the Rearguard Camp. I was too busy then... I didn't realize you were the guest Magistrate mentioned. I didn't even get a good look at you. Now, you're a hero of the Midnight Rangers.
NPC_JC_60_5: Things are much better than before. The war is over, no more casualties, and the medical staff can finally catch their breath.
NPC_JC_60_6: However, as a Rearguard, there are a lot of trivial matters that I've got to attend to. This rain... it's just too heavy.
NPC_JC_60_7: But everything will be fine. Whether it's about Rearguard or Jinzhou.
NPC_JC_60_8: Pretty much the same as before, I'll have to get back to work after our chat.
NPC_JC_60_9: Even though I've been given a vacation... now's not the time. I've got to sort out the aftermath.
NPC_JC_60_10: Only after the rush do I feel the aches all over my body. Once I've wrapped up my current tasks, I plan to take a break.
NPC_JC_60_11: And you should also take some time to relax from all the hustle and bustle.
NPC_XZJC_1_1: Oh no, I think I forgot my weapon at the station during the unloading.
NPC_XZJC_1_2: Check out the size of that hamster!
NPC_XZJC_1_3: Hamster? Oh, you mean the hat's design. This is one of Lollo Logistics' must-haves—protects us from wind, sun, rain, and fog!
NPC_XZJC_1_5: Shh... Listen. When the wind blows, it makes this cool whistling sound against our uniform!
NPC_XZJC_10_1: How'd your City Hall Entrance Examination go on?
NPC_XZJC_10_2: Ugh, let's not talk about it. Third time's the charm, they say, but not for me.
NPC_XZJC_10_3: Ever thought about trying a different path? You might be barking up the wrong tree.
NPC_XZJC_10_4: I've thought about it, but my parents... You know how they are. They think those who work outside the City Hall are all nobodies.
NPC_XZJC_11_1: Please return. If anything changes, we'll post it on the notice board.
NPC_XZJC_11_2: I'm not trying to rush you, but this lockdown's dragging on. Us merchants need to make a living, you know?
NPC_XZJC_12_1: Hey, Grandma, check out that massive peach tree! Has it always been here?
NPC_XZJC_12_2: Yup, that tree's been around longer than me. It's like the guardian of our generation.
NPC_XZJC_13_1: When I was a kid, I used to make wishes on that peach tree during the Moon-chasing Festival.
NPC_XZJC_13_2: I wanna make a wish too!
NPC_XZJC_13_3: Take it easy. That peach tree's been watching over Jinzhou's kids for generations.
NPC_XZJC_14_1: Hello, welcome to Jinzhou. Need help with anything?
NPC_XZJC_14_2: How do I get to the City Hall?
NPC_XZJC_14_3: Are you here to see the Magistrate? Cross the bridge and take the elevator up. Someone will meet you there.
NPC_XZJC_14_4: Have a pleasant time in Jinzhou.
NPC_XZJC_15_1: I've never seen so many visitors here at the City Hall. Who's our special guest?
NPC_XZJC_15_2: The Magistrate said they're important to Jinzhou, even the whole of Huanglong. Must be someone pretty impressive then!
NPC_XZJC_15_3: No, think about it. Whoever they are, they've gotta be old and wise. Like a master strategist.
NPC_XZJC_2_1: Hi there. I heard that Pioneer Explorers are informed travelers. Maybe you can answer my friend's little question here?
NPC_XZJC_2_2: There's so much talk about the Magistrate's guest. My friend thinks... it's actually him!
NPC_XZJC_2_3: My friend's a seasoned traveler. He walks a thousand miles a day and lifts a thousand catties with his bare hands...
NPC_XZJC_2_4: Hold on. You're talking about yourself, aren't you?
NPC_XZJC_3_1: Did you hear about last night? There was drama on the Main Street. A girl knelt down and begged in public.
NPC_XZJC_3_2: She was bawling, saying she'd do anything. It's gonna be quite the scandal if it's not cleared up...
NPC_XZJC_4_1: It's not just here, rumors about the guest are spreading outside Jinzhou, too. It's all anyone's talking about.
NPC_XZJC_4_2: But... the guest is just a visitor. Feels like everyone's getting a bit too excited about this.
NPC_XZJC_5_1: Hey there! Fate must have brought us together today. Interested in reviving Jinzhou Conversations with us?
NPC_XZJC_5_2: Oh, let me introduce myself first. I'm Tracy Jacks, the host of Jinzhou Conversations. And these two here are our fellow members.
NPC_XZJC_5_4: Just nicknames! Can't be too careful with online comments, you know.
NPC_XZJC_5_5: At Jinzhou Conversations, we keep our eyes and ears open to know everything within arm's reach. Pretty impressive, isn't it?
NPC_XZJC_6_1: Grandpa, this snack looks weird... Is it even edible?
NPC_XZJC_6_2: Haha, you won't know until you try!
NPC_XZJC_6_3: Hmm... Oh, it's tasty! Still could do with a better presentation.
NPC_XZJC_6_4: As you grow older, you'll realize that any local food reflects the essence of a place.
NPC_XZJC_6_5: Just like Jinzhou—a humble border city with a warm heart, welcoming all. We as its citizens should do the same.
NPC_XZJC_7_1: I'm quite the storyteller, huh? Last time, we talked about... um, let me think.
NPC_XZJC_7_2: It was about the Teal General and the Battle of Norfall Barrens.
NPC_XZJC_7_3: Right! See? Ah, seems our guests have better memories than me.
NPC_XZJC_8_1: I see many listeners today. Thank you for joining us! But before we begin, let us begin a new subject.
NPC_XZJC_8_2: It's not about the Teal General or the Battle of Norfall Barrens...
NPC_XZJC_8_3: Today, let's talk about Jinzhou, the fortress city we call home. Huanglong boasts one capital and six cities, and Jinzhou is the gatekeeper.
NPC_XZJC_8_4: The name "Jinzhou" itself is rather special. Its spoken and written form have layers of meaning.
NPC_XZJC_8_5: It sounds like the word for "gateway," and when its written, resembles the shape of a dragon's roar. Hence, we call this place "Jinzhou."
NPC_XZJC_8_6: And as for what "Jin" really means, it also signifies the beginning, where every journey starts. That's why Jinzhou is always ready to welcome travelers from far and wide.
NPC_XZJC_8_7: It's a fitting name, isn't it?
NPC_XZJC_9_1: This lake brings back memories of my days by the sea...
NPC_XZJC_9_2: Grandpa, you always talk about the sea. What's beyond it?
NPC_XZJC_9_3: Haha, beyond the sea lies boundless freedom, my child.
NPC_MZGC_20_1: Zhiyuan, stop sulking! I won't stop you. I'm just worried about you.
NPC_MZGC_20_3: Sir, you're mistaking me for someone else.
NPC_MZGC_20_4: You... You're not Zhiyuan?... Oh, right. You're not...
NPC_MZGC_20_5: I'm getting old and confused. I'm sorry, I'm sorry...
NPC_MZGC_20_6: Why don't you come home, Zhiyuan...
NPC_HSGD_10_1: Have you memorized the rescue rules? There's no time for you to review them on the battlefield.
NPC_HSGD_10_4: Soon. Triage is a priority. Everyone, be careful when you're rescuing.
NPC_HSGD_11_1: Did you figure out what the problem was?
NPC_HSGD_11_2: Hold on. Let me try to fix it myself.
NPC_HSGD_11_3: If it doesn't work out, submit a report and get more people. We're short-staffed right now.
NPC_HSGD_11_4: Alright. I'll keep an eye on the other side of the device for you.
NPC_HSGD_5_1: I heard that Withering Frontline is undergoing a harsh and long battle.
NPC_HSGD_5_2: The Rearguard Camp has been operating at full capacity recently, due to the significant increase in the number of wounded soldiers from the battlefield.
NPC_HSGD_6_1: The TD Outbreak is the biggest threat to Jinzhou. Unable to severe it entirely, the Midnight Rangers are feeling exhausted.
NPC_HSGD_6_2: I'm really worried about the soldiers on the front line... We must also be ready to provide support.
NPC_HSGD_7_1: Is General Jiyan still fighting on the front lines? I heard that he hasn't taken a rest for a long time.
NPC_HSGD_7_2: Yeah, no one could talk him out of it. Sigh, General Jiyan used to be a doctor. He should know better than anyone else...
NPC_HSGD_8_1: Get some more sleep and you'll feel better soon...
NPC_HSGD_8_2: The injury is just too terrible. No one knows how long it'll take to get back. Baishan's still over there...
NPC_HSGD_8_3: I know you're worried, but the less you can endure, the longer the recovery time you'll need.
NPC_HSGD_9_1: Xiulan once said, it's crucial to inspect and protect your Tacetite weapon.
NPC_HSGD_9_2: I'll be heading to the front lines to help my comrades soon. I need to be of help, not a trouble.

InfoDisplay_102801016_Title: Monitoring Report on Abnormal Spectrum Performance of C-001
InfoDisplay_102801016_Text:
Title: Spectrum Anomaly Monitoring Report for Subject C-001

Entry: #H-C-6947

Abstract:

The data presented in this report were obtained from spectrum evaluations performed on Subject C-001, also known as "Jué," from June ████ to December ████.

During a preliminary experiment conducted on June 14th, ████ researchers observed a 15-second frequency loss in Subject C-001's spectrum. Five additional tests were later conducted through the following day, and all data obtained reflecting the frequency loss were highly consistent (Margin of error averaged below 0.02).

The recorded data of the Resonance Spectrum on the 3rd, 6th, 11th, 23rd, and 30th of the subsequent month indicated a gradual lengthening of Subject C-001's frequency loss. The data exhibited significant increases with varying patterns. It was postulated that this event occurred due to the presence of Subject C-002, also known as the "Mianloong Chamber." Subsequent thirty-two one-factor experiments confirmed a significant correlation between Subject C-002 and the duration of frequency loss in Subject C-001. Notably, Subject C-002 exhibited an inhibitory effect on the duration growth of Subject C-001.

Based on spectrum monitoring data of Subject C-001 from June ████ to December ████, the following preliminary conclusions can be drawn:

1. Subject C-001 bears defect/malfunction.
2. Subject C-002 can temporarily slow down the escalation of Subject C-001's defect, but cannot make up for Subject C-001's frequency loss.

Appendix-1 (Source: Research Memo #C349)

With the help of the "peculiar visitor", we were given the opportunity to converse with Subject C-001 directly. It was a meaningful and mutual conversation, though we didn't get as much information as I had hoped for.

But at the very least, the conversation proved one point: Our previous research was effective, and there was no defect in C-001. As per C-001's own declaration, "One of the Temporal Programs was lost," and during its prime, C-001 had the capability to manipulate time by decelerating or even halting it, rewinding it, and making corrections as needed. Nonetheless, the current condition of C-001 can be described as one of sickness, with irreversible disruptions to time rendering any attempts at correction or restoration ineffective. Consequently, Mt. Firmament has been transformed into an isolated entity amidst the vast oceans of time, despite the initial purpose being one of redemption.

Appendix-2 (Source: Research Memo #C382)

By running through time flow models, we came up with two hypotheses:

Hypothesis #1: C-001's "defect" is none congenital, and this "defect" may have taken place around the period of C-001's first arrival at Mt. Firmament (it has been confirmed that the "defect" cannot be reversed, see report #H-C-7426).

Hypothesis #2: The discrepancy in temporal progression between the interior and exterior of the "time bubble" has been progressively widening. Based on data comparisons, there exists a correlation between the deceleration rate of time flow in Mt. Firmament and the growth rate of the duration of C-001's frequency loss.

Expanding on the second hypothesis... If C-001 were to eventually cease to exist, the uncontrolled flow of time in Mt. Firmament would likely surpass its limitations and impact a broader range of regions… Such as, the entirety of Jinzhou.

…This might be why that "peculiar visitor" offered to work with us in the first place…

Appendix-3 (Source: Research Memo #C457)

Efforts are being made to advance the development of the artificial Resonance Object. Although we have not yet achieved success, we have decided to name it the "Chronosorter" in honor of our recent progress.

I know we have our "peculiar visitor" to thank for every progress we've made so far. If the "Chronosorter" project is successful, it's a win-win for everyone involved. As I had anticipated, they intend to restore and utilize C-001's complete power in order to rectify the temporal distortion, with the aid of a Resonance Object.

There is still a significant journey ahead of us. This is merely the starting point.
InfoDisplay_102801018_Text:
Research Memorandum — #C532
Date: [--05]
As our 903rd experiment ended in yet another failure, we couldn't help but reminisce about our initial excitement when we completed the first Chronosorter prototype. However, we were always aware that it was a crude replica of C-001's power. My calculations showed that the Chronosorters could only function within a specific distance and would become useless once removed from this region's time barrier (although they may still work at the Luminous Shore).

Despite this, I clung to hope. The concept of a "Secondary Resonance" was more than just a theory to me; it was my life's work. It was terrifying to think it could all be a mere fantasy.

Research Memorandum — #C545
Date: [--26]
The 931st Chronosorter, like its predecessors, was destroyed by intense resonance shock. But it successfully restored time for a brief 1.29 seconds, making it a valuable sacrifice.

I was right... My belief in the Secondary Resonance theory has been confirmed! When two entities resonate at high intensity, the weaker one can exert much greater Resonance power than its original capacity.

The only issue is how the Chronosorters we've been making are too fragile for this task. I need a more powerful Resonator, but the risk is too great. No one can withstand the resonance shock of C-001 without enduring catastrophic overclocking.

Note: I must speak to our visitor. I saw them telling C-001 something. I am convinced that there is a connection between what they did and the brief success of Chronosorter No. 931. Yes, I had seen it with my own eyes; C-001 must have transmitted some form of unknown energy to Chronosorter No. 931, just when I had deemed the experiment a failure...
InfoDisplay_102801019_Text:
Reply: That Child
Unfortunately, C-001 did not respond to the matter concerning that child. However, the fact remains that the dead baby did come back to life. We do not need C-001 to confirm anything for us, or else the strange occurrences of that day would be meaningless. As for the child's identity, there can be no other answer besides ■■■.
As for how the dead baby was brought back to life, I suspect it has something to do with the turning back of time, but neither you, I, nor the people of Hongzhen are able to remember the events of that night in detail. If we rule out the possibility of a collective hallucination, this at least indicates that the phenomenon of turning back time on that day only affected individual entities and not all of Mt. Firmament...
A citizen of Hongzhen told me that a child is now being fostered in the town. Maybe we should go and take a look...
InfoDisplay_102801020_Text:
Research Memo #C501
Date: [--19]
Our visitor shared intricate details about the outside world, describing a new civilization that rose from the ashes of the old. Their narrative held a serene tone, void of personal emotion, as if they were an impartial observer, rather than the one who saved said civilization in the first place.
It became clear to me that they were not like us - their humility and goodwill were meant to guide and integrate us onto a predetermined path.
Despite this, I was grateful for all the knowledge they shared with me. I yearned to see this new world for myself, realizing that I had been cooped up in Mt. Firmament for too long...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_2: Don't worry. {PlayerName} is special. The Temporal Dusruption can't hurt {Male=him;Female=her}.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_4: I gave my word to be your pawn and I intend to keep it. As your teacher and courtier, it is only right for me to do so.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_5: And let's not forget, without me playing the Wayfinder for {PlayerName}, we wouldn't even have {Male=him;Female=her} here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_6: {PlayerName} has a strong connection to this place. You need {Male=his;Female=her} help to resolve Mt. Firmament's crisis.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_7: But... We already owe {PlayerName} a lot.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_8: I don't mind helping you again.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_9: I'm here to find out about my past.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_11: As we headed toward Mt. Firmament, {PlayerName} mentioned a strange dream {Male=he;Female=she} had. It may have been a flashback of {Male=his;Female=her} lost memories.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_12: {PlayerName}, Jué, and Mt. Firmament... There must be some kind of crucial connection between the three. {PlayerName} also has {Male=his;Female=her} own reasons for being here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_14: {PlayerName}, I will do everything I can to rescue the Sentinel as soon as possible, then we can finally talk to it in person. It will surely have the answers you want.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_16: What did you find in Truthseeker's Pass, Jinhsi?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_17: To reverse the rapid aging effect from Temporal Disruptions, I must deliberately collide with the Sentinel's Resonance power during combat—triggering my Second Resonance Awakening. That will enhance my power beyond its limits.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_18: According to the Court of Savantae's records... the Sentinel was already injured upon its arrival at Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_19: As time passed and its condition worsened, the flow of time became unstable here, causing Temporal Disruptions that could potentially threaten Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_20: Only the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator can restore its <ano=ability to control time>Temporal Mandate</ano>...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_22: Let's say you can achieve all that, but Jinhsi... Do you understand what is at stake for yourself?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_24: ...I share a Resonance connection with Jué, but I never took the time to truly get to know it... I've been blind to its suffering for so long...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_25: Sentinel Jué has been guiding us since the city's founding with its wise words and well-crafted decisions.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_26: The Temporal Disruptions we face are just a side effect of its efforts to protect local people.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_27: ...Without the Sentinel blocking out Tacet Discords through its time-manipulation power, Jinzhou would be a barren wasteland today.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_28: So what do you plan to do, Jinhsi?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_29: If the Sentinel's condition is indeed incurable... Nobody knows how far the Temporal Disruptions will continue to spread.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_30: Today it's Mt. Firmament, but tomorrow it could be all of Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_32: If it truly comes down to that, I'll fulfill Jué's prophecy myself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_33: It's the only way to save Mt Firmament, protect Jinzhou, and help the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_34: Have you thought about the consequences, Jinhsi?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_35: Trying to trigger a Second Awakening by fighting the Sentinel... It could make you Overclock at any moment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_36: We both know what that means. You could lose your mind forever, or even disintegrate into dust... You don't want to end up like those Chronosorters, shredded under immense pressure.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_38: On top of that... Do you honestly believe you can fight in your current condition?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_190_1: Interesting. It seems the one who was immune to the Temporal Disruption provided insights on the invention of Chronosorters.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_190_2: That was to say, the Court of Savantae had such a thorough understanding of Temporal Disruptions, and there was a trace of it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_230_1: The Sentinel never tried to interfere with natural death before. Why did it make an exception?
Flow_31000069_1040: You will meet... the same fate...
Flow_31000069_1042: Pay for your insurrection… in blood…
Flow_31000069_1043: The war… never cease… We… will return…

HelpText_70_Content:
[Data Merge]
You can merge 5 unenhanced Echoes into 1 random new Echo in the Terminal. You cannot merge upgraded Echoes.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.

[Batch Merge]
You can merge over 5 unenhanced Echoes into multiple new Echoes using Batch Merge.
The other rules for Batch Merge are the same as those for Data Merge.

[New Echoes]
The Rarity of the new Echo is subject to your Data Bank level. It is not determined by the Rarity of merged Echoes. Upgrade your Data Bank to get Echoes of higher Rarity from Data Merge.
Data Merge and Batch Merge only produce Echoes that are already unlocked.

[Extras]
Data Merge produces at least one random new Echo, and sometimes extra Echoes.
Merge Echoes of higher Rarity and COST for a higher chance to produce extras.

[Auto Select]
Auto Select lets you quickly select available Echoes to merge. You can change the sort and filter settings to determine what Echoes will be selected.
