NPC_YJY_35_1: I'm not sure if the administration will approve the funding, but hopefully it won't take forever.
NPC_YJY_36_1: The Institute has sent us a lot more work, so I think we might get another hazelnut on the permit.
NPC_YJY_36_2: How much is missing? Let me do the math…
NPC_YJY_37_3: You go about your business. I'll let the neighborhood Patrollers know if anything happens.
NPC_YJY_38_1: Hmmm? A report on the inspection and speculation about the First Resonator...
NPC_YJY_38_2: Isn't this an ancient post? How did it get bumped up again?
NPC_YJY_39_1: Is that an analysis thread on Mr. Xiangli's latest research? That I'll have to check it out.
NPC_YJY_39_2: This complaint really needs to go through, it's my last shot...
NPC_YJY_40_1: Hopefully, they'll just temporarily lock my account this time...
NPC_YJY_41_1: Hey, check it out! It's the first Resonance Nexus in Huanglong, part of our institute's collection. Isn't it gorgeous?
NPC_YJY_41_2: Back when I was a student, I visited the institute once. When my hand touched its surface, the metal felt chilly, almost as if it was saying hello.
NPC_YJY_41_3: That's when I realized I had to work here someday. I wanted to stay with it.
NPC_YJY_42_1: This antique item is more weathered and robust compared to other versions of the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou. It's now a historical artifact of great significance.
NPC_YJY_42_2: But it's consistently harder to maintain than other models and requires several specific parts for repairs.
NPC_YJY_43_1: How long will you be gone this time? When are you leaving?
NPC_YJY_43_2: I'm not sure. I'm planning a trip to Huaxu Academy HQ.
NPC_YJY_44_1: The Detection Stage lets us see all of Jinzhou's terrain, helping the Institute spot abnormal energy spikes quickly.
NPC_YJY_44_2: Xiaoshi swings by regularly with updates. The Midnight Rangers are out there holding the line and can sometimes spot signs our devices miss.
NPC_YJY_45_1: Ms. Zhang is super attentive. She's helped us dodge danger more times than I can count, and she's been on the job since I joined the Rangers.
NPC_YJY_45_2: She intimidated me at first with her serious demeanor.
NPC_YJY_46_1: Has the report been brought up yet?
NPC_YJY_46_2: No, I wanted to confirm again.
NPC_YJY_47_1: Why isn't it finished yet? How long has this been dragging on...
NPC_YJY_48_1: Did you find those Ecoacoustics reports? The ones filed recently?
NPC_YJY_48_2: Hold on, let me see. Did they contact you?
NPC_YJY_48_3: Yeah, they want to review them again.
NPC_YJY_49_1: These are some docs Mr. Xiangli put together for us, sort of like... extra homework? A little gift from our resident genius.
NPC_YJY_49_2: He's always making breakthroughs so quickly, we struggle to keep up.
NPC_YJY_49_3: But we have to keep up. If you can't even try to keep pace, why bother being an academic?
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_2: Do you know why there are names engraved on the abandoned turrets here?
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_5: Many years ago, the battlefield was filled with smoke as the Jinzhou Garrison regiment fought bravely and successfully pushed back the TD tide, reclaiming a small portion of the front line.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_6: In those times, the majority of soldiers were ordinary people, and the demands of war were such that not everyone who departed left something behind.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_7: Engraving the names of fallen comrades onto stone monuments might just be a way of commemorating their sacrifice and creating a sense of unity.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_8: The group then devised a method to engrave the names of the deceased soldiers onto the turrets and continue the tradition.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_9: The engravings here are their names.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_10: You weren’t even born then, were you?
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_13: I didn’t know any of them, but my grandpa said them so many times that I just remembered them all!
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_14: When I was a kid, he barely mentioned his war experiences. Lately, he has become increasingly forgetful and tends to reminisce about his younger days.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_15: Grandpa was probably scared of forgetting, so he wanted other people to remember in his place.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_16: Anyway, I’ve heard it a million times and can’t forget it even if I tried, and even if Grandpa forgets, I’ll remember it for a few more decades.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_17: I can recite the names engraved on the monument backwards now.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_20: Look, this is Shenyin, he’s nicknamed the Divine Eagle because of his incredible marksmanship.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_21: He stuck to the front line with his gun for two whole days so that the others could retreat without harm. When he eventually returned to rescue him, he discovered that his leg had been shattered, he had lost a significant amount of blood, and yet he had managed to stay in his firing position until his last breath.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_22: This is... Little Bean, she doesn’t have a name, that’s what everyone calls her.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_23: She died as the first one to rush out and pull the alarm when the TD wave suddenly erupted, getting the TD’s attention and giving the others a chance to react.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_24: Do you still want to hear more?
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_27: This one is Yuandong... next to this one is Beimo...
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_28: Yuandong was a military doctor, and when the TD wave broke out, he died fighting without any medical support.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_29: Beimo was discovered in a cave-in after a week-long battle, and he rescued around twelve soldiers from starving to death beneath the sealed ground.
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_30: Here is Ziyu, and this is Xiaohua...
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_31: Do you still want to hear more?
HSGD_ST_ZY_1_33: Well, then I’ll stay here a little longer.
Flow_11000001_854: Dong's just got a sharp tongue.
Flow_11000001_855: He really knows about play. But he has to learn how to deliver it in a less outright way and let the young ones figure it out themselves.
Flow_11000001_856: When will he learn to restrain his complaints? We'd have no play to see if he scares those performers away.
Flow_11000001_857: I hope Qinghe's new play can satisfy his appetite, so he can stop nagging all day long.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_1: What a lucky coincidence, Rover. No way, you're actually here listening.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_2: What do you think? Bet you're pumped to have your exploits told by a storyteller, right?
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_3: I dream of being as famous as you, Rover...
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_4: Now everyone knows me as “the Rover”.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_5: I’ve come up with a name of my own. It’s {PlayerName}.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_6: Ah, I see. So people are calling you "Rover" because you’re a roving traveler here.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_7: People will likely associate the word "Rover" with their idea of “Hero” for a while!
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_8: {PlayerName}... This name will soon spread like wildfire in Huanglong, I reckon!
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_9: Make sure to relax and enjoy the hospitality of the people in Jinzhou, okay?
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_11: General Jiyan kicked me back here to heal after the Norfall Barrens battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_12: Don’t worry though! My injuries aren't too bad.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_13: Our extensive pre-war plans paid off. All units did great and we had way fewer casualties than usual.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_14: I'm pretty good at fighting Tacet Discords, and I usually end up with a few scrapes and bruises. No biggie.
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_15: Speaking of that... General Jiyan got messed up pretty bad in the last battle. But he's already back at work, leading the recovery efforts on the front lines...
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_16: Ugh, I wish I could go and help him!
Huanglong_main_1_7_179_17: ...My bad, I got sidetracked. Anyway, thank you so much for helping us!
InfoDisplay_102801021_Title: Hongzhen Chronicle Volume XIX: Major Events I
InfoDisplay_102801021_Text:
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>March. Various lands were ravaged by TD Outbreaks, and 31 victims climbed the mountain.
<alignleft/>April 9. A TD Outbreak approached Mt. Firmament. On the night of the same day, a stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff. (Note: Empyrean Cliff was later renamed as Loong's Crest)
<alignleft/>April 21. Two townspeople lured an outsider to the place where the stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff.
<alignleft/>April 22. A TD Outbreak invaded Hongzhen. The Sentinel called Jué emerged from Empyrean Cliff, slowing the flow of time with its Temporal Mandate to repel the TD Outbreak and forming Mt. Firmament.
<alignleft/>April 23. An outsider visited Hongzhen with the Sentinel Jué and left the mountain with 17 other townspeople later.
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>July 3. The outsider returned to Mt. Firmament, seemingly unaffected by the Temporal Disruptions. The locals have been referring to them as "that peculiar visitor" ever since."
InfoDisplay_102801022_Title: Hongzhen Chronicle Volume XIX: Major Events II
InfoDisplay_102801022_Text:
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>March 5. Thunder started roaring at about 21:00–23:00, and the Sentinel Jué returned with a dead baby.
<alignleft/>March 6. The thunder stopped around 01:00–03:00. Something strange was happening in the sky, and the stars were moving in reverse.
<alignleft/>At 05:00–07:00 of the same day, the Sentinel Jué came to Hongzhen to entrust the baby to the townspeople. The baby looked completely normal with no signs of lifelessness.
<alignleft/>(Note: It should be impossible for a dead baby to be brought back to life. I would never believe this if this was not my personal experience.)
<alignleft/>...

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_1: You'll regret it when you learn what I'm capable of!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_2: That poker-faced researcher was absolutely shocked when she examined me! Said I'm not just any Echo, I'm a super duper cool one. Rarest of them all! Heh heh!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_3: You sure you didn't add anything extra?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_4: That doesn't sound like the Baizhi I know...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_5: Yeah, no way Baizhi talks like that. She's more of a data dump kind of person. "Super duper cool"? Nah, too extra for her.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_6: Seems like you're trying to boost your ego a bit!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_7: Oh, actually... While those aren't Baizhi's exact words, that is what she meant.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_8: She mentioned highly intelligent Echoes that can act on their own in other countries. Said they are involved in every aspect of human life, with unique abilities beyond our imagination.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_9: Those Echoes are rare though. Neither I nor Baizhi, an Ecoacoustics expert, have ever seen one in person. But this little thing here… It could be one of those foreign Echoes.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_10: Yeah, makes sense! Now we just gotta figure out where it came from. Who knows, we may find other cool Echoes in that place!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_12: Are you seriously buying all of this already?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_14: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_15: I'll admit, the thought of someone else having an Echo inside them sounds pretty crazy to me. But with you, anything's possible.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_16: You can absorb Reverberations with just your hands, like the legend says. So maybe one day you just stumbled upon this little thing and soaked it up like a sponge. Sounds feasible, I guess?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_18: Do you know where exactly {Male=he;Female=she} absorbed you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_19: Huh? How am I supposed to know... Why don't you just ask {Male=him;Female=her}?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_20: Because they know I don't remember.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_21: Sure, she can ask. It's not like I have the answer.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_22: Yeah. It happened before {Male=he;Female=she} lost all memories, so we have to ask you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_23: Tsk tsk... Don't take that tone with me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_24: But... even if Echoes can have memories, they probably wouldn’t remember things earlier than their first manifestation. I wonder if that's the case with this little one, too?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_25: Aha, finally someone with common sense.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_26: That green-haired serious guy asked me a similar question. Sorry to disappoint, but I really don't remember anything before I showed up.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_27: Hmm. Maybe... maybe I was just sleeping inside {Male=him;Female=her} this whole time, so of course I don't remember!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_28: Sleeping? Seriously? It's been so long! All those happenings, all that fighting, and you didn't hear anything? Well that's... Your sleeping quality is really something.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_29: I'd prefer it to NOT stay awake all the time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_30: Uh, please no. There are things I don't want it to hear...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_31: Oh, so you've got privacy to be respected.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_32: Don't worry! Your body's sound insulation is amazing. Dive into it and everything goes quiet.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_33: The only problem is, I never know when I'll wake up again. And when I do wake up, I get tired, hungry fast, so I have to crawl back in for more rest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_34: Hmm... I know! It's all because I'm not eating enough!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_35: That's why you kept disappearing. You went back to sleep from lack of energy. Makes sense. Regular Echoes need to be powered by the Terminal too.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_36: Hmm, I thought you'd be really different from the usual ones we see. Turns out you share a lot in common.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_37: So you probably don't know your denomination, or a nick name? No wonder everyone's been calling you the "little one"...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_39: The universally agreed terms for special Echoes, like names for humans. They are named based on their characteristics, abilities, and places of origin.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_40: My denomination... It's... It's... I don't know. Do I not have a name at all?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_41: No way! Nooo way! That's not fair! If all the special Echoes have names, how can I not have one?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_42: I don't wanna be called the "little one" all the time. It doesn't sound cool at all!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_43: How about this: you help me come up with a name, and I will let you have some of the food...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_1: Alright. Ahem! All eyes on me!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_2: W-what's going on? I... I'll try again! Just you see!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_4: J-Just a little slip, that's all! I can do it! You gotta trust me!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_5: Back then, I just stood in front of {Male=him;Female=her}, and that big bad Threnodian monster thing just... just... left.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_6: So... you didn't really do anything?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_7: Huh? No, I... I definitely did something!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_8: Like I said, I was asleep, and then all of a sudden, I smelled something really yummy coming closer and closer… It was like nothing I ever smelled before!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_9: I didn't have time to think. I just had to show up and reach out for it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_10: So... maybe Abby's power activates automatically under certain circumstances? Perhaps Abby can’t control it yet.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_11: Yeah, it looks that way. You can't even hold your shape for very long yet...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_12: Hey, hey! Stop looking down on me! Like I said, it was just a little slip, really!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_13: But think about it! I just stood there and did nothing and ended up beating a THRENODIAN! Imagine what I could do if I actually tried!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_14: Hey, {PlayerName}! Get behind me next time we run into anything, 'kay? I'll keep you safe, promise!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_15: You're so real for that, Abby.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_16: You bet! I said I'm super strong. I'll protect {Male=him;Female=her}!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_17: That's very reassuring to hear. But... it seems we're stuck again. I can't think of anything else to check out.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_18: Let’s take our time. There's no hurry.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_19: We'll still need to figure out my past first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_20: Knew it. Nothing about {PlayerName}'s ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. Xiangli Yao, and all the researchers in Jinzhou... No, in the entire Huanglong together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_22: I said NO! Told that poker-face researcher already!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_23: I'll make it clear. I am to stay with {PlayerName}.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_24: I agree. Abby cannot leave {PlayerName}'s side, but we can't just trap {Male=him;Female=her} here for research.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_25: Where did you absorb Abby, what are Abby's powers, and what exactly happened between you two... There are so many questions we can't figure out yet.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_26: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_27: Now that the Threnodian crisis is over, perhaps you can consult our Magistrate and our Sentinel again. I’m sure they can offer you some more useful guidance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_28: I'll pay Jinhsi another visit once she returns.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_29: We'll have to wait for now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_30: Relax, relax! You have me now, remember? Meeting up with that Jinhsi person? Getting your memories back? I've got you!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_31: Speaking of that, so this Sentinel can predict the future? That sounds cool. The name "Jué" sounds pretty cool too. It's almost as cool as mine!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_32: What does it look like? Where is it? Since we're paying it a visit, this Sentinel should treat us with food, right? I wonder how the food's gonna taste...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_33: Our Sentinel protects every one of us. Of course it's cool!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_34: But... why are you talking about food again. Didn't you just stuff your face? What? Is your stomach a black hole?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_35: I can't help it. I'm always starving…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_36: After parting ways with Yangyang and Chixia, you travel around Jinzhou with Abby while waiting for replies from Jinhsi, trying to look for more clues about your past.

NPC_MSJ_28_1: Great food, great value! Come take a look!
NPC_MSJ_30_1: Come again if you need anything. Since it's your first time here, here's fresh treats on the house, all handpicked.
NPC_MSJ_32_1: Everything here is fresh and carefully selected. We take pride in our produce and proteins, handpicked and prepped each morning.
NPC_MSJ_32_2: They taste amazing even without any seasoning!
NPC_MSJ_32_3: Just make sure to cook everything thoroughly to avoid an upset stomach!
NPC_MSJ_32_4: Oh, also. Please don't try to cook weird meat. Like... Gulpuffs.
NPC_MSJ_32_5: A young girl visited my store with her sheep dolls, looking for ingredients for a dish she was making. She asked for Gulpuffs, claiming to have had them before without any issues.
NPC_MSJ_32_6: I mean, no one in their right mind would think it's a good idea to give a child Gulpuffs to eat... If I ever find her parents, they're in for a helluva lesson on food safety.
NPC_MSJ_33_1: You've been visiting quite often lately. Bet you cook a lot in your free time!
NPC_MSJ_33_2: Me? I happen to know a thing or two about cooking.
NPC_MSJ_33_3: Has Panhua been talking your ear off about proper seasoning techniques? Well, let me give you the real secret to delicious food: preserving the ingredients' natural flavors.
NPC_MSJ_33_4: Take Milky Fish Soup for example. It only requires simple ingredients, but with care and dedication, you'll get incredible results.
NPC_MSJ_33_5: The fish becomes tender and melt-in-your-mouth, while the soup retains its fresh taste. No need to drown it in seasonings!
NPC_MSJ_33_6: In fact, I'm going to bring her a bowl right now and show her how it's done. I'll make her see the difference!
NPC_MSJ_35_1: Great food, great value! I've got a wide variety of produce for you to choose from. Hello again. What brings you in today? Or would you like to chat? I'm all ears!
NPC_MSJ_36_1: Don't have enough credits yet? I'll hold these for you.
NPC_MSJ_37_1: Thank you for shopping at Mahe's! Your order is ready.
NPC_MSJ_38_1: I see. Do come again if you need anything.
NPC_MSJ_39_1: If you want authentic Jinzhou cuisine, you've come to the right place.
NPC_MSJ_40_1: Hmm, I've been trying out a new recipe lately. Well, somewhat new-ish.
NPC_MSJ_40_2: Life used to be tough for us before coming to Jinzhou. We had to do whatever we could to feed ourselves.
NPC_MSJ_40_3: Our Ma Xiaofang was just a child then, but she was always so kind and selfless. She gave as much of her food to the elderly as she could.
NPC_MSJ_40_4: It broke my heart to see her go hungry at times. But one day, I managed to catch a wild rabbit and made a stew with some fresh greens for her. I still remember that smile on her face to this day.
NPC_MSJ_40_5: And now, our Xiaofang... Should I call her Chixia now? She's all grown up and even works as a Patroller! She dropped by recently and told me how she missed that stew.
NPC_MSJ_41_1: How to make food taste better? Well, buckle up, you're in for a treat.
NPC_MSJ_41_2: Heat control, choice of spices, when you should turn up the heat for stir-fry, when to slow cook your stew... Every detail matters.
NPC_MSJ_41_3: Mahe would say it's important to get fresh ingredients, and he's right on that, but seasoning is even more important.
NPC_MSJ_41_4: At my restaurant, nothing less than perfection is acceptable. Seasoning is crucial for a good dish! Mahe... He just won't get it.
NPC_MSJ_41_5: Well, he does make some good fish soup, though...
NPC_MSJ_42_1: You're here for some grub? Finally found the time to drop by today, huh?
NPC_MSJ_43_1: What are you in the mood for today? I'll fire up the wok!
NPC_MSJ_44_1: How was that? I hope you enjoyed it.
NPC_MSJ_45_1: What's the matter? Are you low on appetite? Tell me what else you'd like to eat. I'll fire up the wok for you!
NPC_MSJ_46_1: Welcome! We've got a variety of produce here.

Character_ChangLi_2_23: You're such a great storyteller, like everyone else I met here.
Character_ChangLi_2_24: Oh please, I'm only repeating what I've heard from him. He's been on a roll with his stories lately. But let's not take them too seriously, they're just for entertainment.
Character_ChangLi_27_25: Since the Fractsidus already know so much about the Sentinel...
Character_ChangLi_34_10: Anyway... {PlayerName}, thank you for letting us into this Sonoro Sphere.
Character_ChangLi_34_11: You are indeed very special, as the Excellency foretold.
Character_ChangLi_4_17: Ahem... what can I do for you?
Character_ChangLi_4_19: I can't help but feel envious. I wish I could speak to her like you did, but she refuses to do interviews with the Pioneer Association. Plus, I doubt we have anything in common to talk about anyway.
Character_ChangLi_62_63: Despite the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament being saved, the Fractsidus would not go down without a fight. They were convinced that the Temporal Mandate was hidden within the game of Weiqi, but little did they know, they had already fallen into a trap.
Character_ChangLi_75_3: Nothing, {PlayerName}. I just thought... the snow is beautiful today.
Character_ChangLi_76_2: The chaotic Temporal Disruptions are even clearer to see.
TowerChallengeBuff_92008019_Desc: When Resonators cast Resonance Liberation, their ATK is increased by 8% and DMG Reduction by 5% every second, stacking up to 6 times and lasting for 14s. The effect ends when the Resonator is switched off the field.
TowerChallengeBuff_92008020_Desc: When Resonators cast Intro Skill, they obtain a Shield that lasts 8s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration. Upon obtaining any kind of Shield, Resonators' ATK is increased by 20% and Crit. DMG by 30% for 12s.
TowerChallengeBuff_92008021_Desc: When Resonators cast Resonance Skill, their ATK is increased by 20% for 7s, stacking up to 2 times. The effect's duration resets with each new stack.
TowerChallengeBuff_92008022_Desc: Casting Resonance Skill grants 60% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s. Casting Resonance Liberation grants 60% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 15s.
TowerChallengeBuff_92008023_Desc: Resonators gain 20% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus. Targets hit by Resonance Skills will take additional <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> every second for 18s.
PhantomItem_60000020_AttributesDescripti: Unlocks the Phantom Appearance of the corresponding Echo.
Character_ChangLi_8_72: I asked you about the unfinished Weiqi game, because I believe it may have something to do with your past.
Character_ChangLi_8_74: Yes… After all, it takes two to play Weiqi, right?
Character_ChangLi_8_75: If my speculation is correct… That game of Weiqi may hold clues to your lost memories.
Character_ChangLi_8_77: Thank you for accepting my invitation.
Character_ChangLi_8_78: You looked adorable, focusing on the Weiqi board. I didn't want to interrupt you.

Guide_YFSH_10_8: As you already know, each Echo has its own unique frequency. When we gather several Echoes together, it's like...
Guide_YFSH_10_9: It's like having a bunch of people playing different instruments. Most of the time, the melodies clash and it's a total mess.
Guide_YFSH_10_10: But there are times when melodies blend together perfectly, creating a beautiful harmony!
Guide_YFSH_10_11: Forming an Echo team is just like that!
Guide_YFSH_10_12: I hope that made sense... Anyway, why not give it a shot yourself? It's the quickest way to understand!
Guide_YFSH_12_5: Hehe, I can already picture the look on her face!
Guide_YFSH_12_6: No rush. I also need to make some preparations. What should I say to her…

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_30_24: If the Fractsidus really has imprisoned our Sentinel, causing it to lose control of its powers, that could explain the Temporal Disruptions... which means Mt. Firmament is basically a dead end with no way out.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_30_25: And you are heading straight into that dead end.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_11: Why hasn't this brilliant invention spread beyond Mt. Firmament?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_12: This Chronosorter was built beyond the Temporal Barrier, so its creator must have already paid the price for leaving.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_13: But even if they died, there are countless other <ano=Court of Savantae Committee>CSC members</ano> who could replicate it. How did such advanced technology become lost?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_14: Or... do these Chronosorters stop functioning once they are removed from Mt. Firmament?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_16: This Chronosorter, weathered though it may appear, bears no signs of neglect. Someone has tended to it diligently.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_56_2: It's the Photon Barrier. Another invention from the Court of Savantae.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_56_3: Specific steps must be followed to undo the barrier. {PlayerName}, I'll guide you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_57_2: Use long-range weapons on the Photonvaults to cut off its energy.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_58_1: Once we reach the cave's end, we'll enter the domain of Mt. Firmament. Proceed with caution.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_3: Is this the effect of that strange time pattern you mentioned?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_4: Time on Mt. Firmament used to simply flow slower than in the outside world. Visitors were safe as long as they remained within the Temporal Barrier.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_5: But what we're seeing now is different. The flow of time has gone haywire. This is what we call the Temporal Disruptions...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_6: What was once slow and steady has become chaotic and turbulent. Some areas are frozen in time, while others speed up or slow down unpredictably.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_7: No one knows how much they'll age after leaving Mt. Firmament, but aging from youth to old age may be a blessing compared to the unknown fate that awaits.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_8: Leaving Mt. Firmament could turn any mortal to dust in just a moment. Such is the power of time within its walls.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_9: These poor creatures, trapped in the Temporal Disruption, are the most pitiful of all... Their bodies and minds have been ravaged by the chaotic time, leaving them in unimaginable suffering...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_10: So, it looks like the Fractsidus did manage to capture our Sentinel, leading to the Temporal Disruptions we are facing now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_11: I had wished that my theories would turn out wrong...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_13: ...As expected, my Terminal isn't working. We can't reach Jinhsi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_166_1: One of the Photonvault always ends up blocked off. We can't seem to break three of them at once... {PlayerName}, perhaps we'll need to use the Chronosorter.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_167_1: Good. Did you see the Tacetite Fulminate on that cliff? Perhaps we can create an opening in this disk with an explosion.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_168_1: I see. Are we going to aim the opening in that disk at the Photonvault in the middle?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_169_1: It worked! The opening fits right onto the middle Photonvault.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_169_2: {PlayerName}, now we can hit the three Photonvaults simultaneously.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_170_1: The blockade has been lifted. Let's go in.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_171_1: Why are there Tacet Discord here? No, these monsters... They don't look like the usual Tacet Discords.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_171_2: These, too, look like the works of the Court of Savantae.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_171_3: Did they create these simulated holograms to protect this place?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_175_1: That thing up ahead... Is it another mechanism?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_175_2: It seems to have unlocked after we got rid of those holograms. Let's go and have a look.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_1: The glowing patterns on that gate... It's a Flare Crest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_2: Did the Court of Savantae build this too?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_3: Yes. The Flare Crests have a complex structure, but they can be deciphered with patience.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_4: See how each star represents a Flare Stone?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_5: That mechanism we accidentally solved earlier should be one of them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_6: That's why the corresponding star has dimmed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_7: Yes, we still need the other two Flare Stones to open it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_177_1: Decades have passed, but those researchers' presence still lingers in this place...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_1: The Sentinel's situation is worse than we thought. It had already sustained severe injuries when it descended upon Mt. Firmament...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_2: "With one of the Temporal Programs lost"... It no longer had the power to restore time, instead it could only stop and rewind it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_3: So the Sentinel protected Hongzhen with its power, but it couldn’t return things back to normal?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_5: According to their theories, the Sentinel's injury would worsen over time. And if the Sentinel perishes... the Temporal Disruptions will spiral out of control, engulfing all of Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_7: So the Fractsidus just added a pinch of salt to the already gaping wounds on Mt. Firmament...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_8: Is there any way to cure the Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_9: There is nothing we can do. At least that's what it says in these records.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_10: Only the Mianloong Chamber can provide temporary relief for the Sentinel, but it won't heal it completely.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_11: In the end, the Sentinel and a "peculiar visitor" who was immune to Time Disruptions would have to come up with a last resort.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_14: The Sentinel couldn't be fixed, so they decided to replicate its power onto a Resonator through induced Resonance...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_15: Their experiments resulted in the first Chronosorter—a manmade Resonance Object.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_179_17: No. A Chronosorter can only rewind time within a narrow range. It's no match for the Sentinel's immense power.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_192_1: Another Chronosorter... The second Flare Stone should be behind this gate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_192_2: {PlayerName}, let's restore the collapsed gate with this Chronosorter.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_193_1: There is still another Photonvault to break. We can't reach it from here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_193_2: We may need to look around for a better vantage point.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_194_1: Another Chronosorter. Let's give it a try.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_195_1: The stone slates have formed a path. Now we can bring the Tacetite Fulminate across the water.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_196_1: This hidden area may allow us to reach that Photonvault.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_197_1: One last Flare Stone to go. There's a Carrier Lift nearby... Is the Flare Stone on the floor beneath us?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_197_2: We should be able to find Jinhsi soon...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_3: So, this file confirms that the Chronosorters are artificial Resonance Objects.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_4: They activate when hit with a strong impact to create the corresponding Resonance Effects.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_5: And this also answers my previous question: the Chronosorters rewind time through resonating with the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_8: No, it was nowhere near enough. The Chronosorters shut down once they are removed from the Sentinel's range or the abnormal time flow on Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_9: Plus, as artificial Resonance Objects, their capacity is limited.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_10: According to the Court of Savantae researchers, there was a hypothesis that could potentially make them more powerful—the Second Resonance Awakening hypothesis.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_11: Which states the collision between two resonating frequencies might cause a Second Resonance Awakening...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_13: A destined fight between Jinhsi and the Sentinel...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_14: ...Yes. That fight has to happen to trigger a Second Resonance Awakening for Jinhsi, so she may exert even stronger Resonance Abilities... Ones that allow her to restore the flow of time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_15: Did the Court of Savantae's research succeed?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_16: Countless Chronosorters were made to collide with the Sentinel's frequencies, but they were no match. All the machines turned to dust.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_19: One Chronosorter briefly showed the power to restore time before breaking apart.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_220_1: Something above the Carrier Lift seems stuck.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_222_1: Look, our last target. On those floating floor tiles. We need a way to restore them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_223_1: It's not working... We may need to follow a specific order.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_224_2: The Court of Savantae set many traps here. They must have worked hard to protect Mianloong Chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_240_1: I'm done with all three Flare Stones.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_240_2: Good. Let's head back to the entrance. We should be able to access the Cipher Key now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_300_2: The Sentinel is telling us... We need to find the three Flare Stones corresponding to the Flare Crest, then we will be able to lift the confinement set by the Fractsidus.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_300_3: But I'm not seeing any Flare Stones. Or any kind of entrance to another chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_300_4: There seems to be something underwater. Let's start with the Chronosorter here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_305_2: It's the Flare Stone. On that rock!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_310_2: Two more to go. Let's look for them nearby.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_315_1: The Flare Stone is right here, but we have to open this Photon Barrier first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_315_2: {PlayerName}, this barrier will break down once the corresponding Photonvaults are destroyed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_315_3: ...One of the Photonvaults is in there.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_320_1: We need to find a way to destroy the Spikes with the Corroder's help... Same as last time, let's locate the Photonvault first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_325_1: The remaining Photonvault is hidden behind the Fissured Ledge.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_325_2: Fissured Ledge... If only there was a Tacetite Fulminate...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_340_1: There are stone slabs above. Try using the Chronosorter to restore them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_345_1: Good. Now we can work that Flare Stone.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_365_1: One last Flare Stone to go.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_370_1: The Flare Stone is up there... We need to raise the water level with the corresponding Chronosorter first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_372_1: All set. The Sentinel should be able to break free now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_372_3: Let's head back to the Sentinel's place.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_5: In a single day, we've greeted both the Magistrate of Jinzhou and her trusted Counselor in Hongzhen. I can only assume something significant happened.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_7: I heard you stepped down from your position and moved to the countryside.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_8: And now here we are, meeting again after all this time, in such unfortunate circumstances...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_9: For years I lived secluded, no longer concerning myself with the matters beyond Hongzhen.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_10: But the current situation in Jinzhou is volatile. It has reunited us in an unpredictable moment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_11: And you, young {Male=sir;Female=lady}... What shall I call you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_14: My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_15: Please follow me this way. It's not safe to talk here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_19: But with our limited technology, we still struggle to comprehend its workings.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_20: Speaking of which... Our Sentinel's health is worsening. Lately, it has been spending longer periods of time in the Mianloong Chamber, essentially going back to "sleep" more frequently.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_21: We've tried asking about it, but no response.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_22: The defense mechanisms outside Mianloong Chamber were built by the Court of Savantae.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_23: Back in the day, researchers from the Court of Savantae would often come to Mt. Firmament to study the strange time fluctuations. This caused tension with the locals.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_24: Local people believed it was disrespectful to the Sentinel, especially when they tried to enter Mianloong Chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_25: After some deliberation, local people understood that the Court of Savantae posed no threat to the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_26: A deal was struck: the locals would refrain from disrupting their research, and in return, they would build defense mechanisms to keep outsiders from interrupting the Sentinel's rest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_27: The Sentinel was believed to have agreed to this compromise by remaining silent during negotiations.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_28: Activating the Cipher Key is a complex process, and we've stored the Mianloong Chamber's controller separately.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_29: It's an extra safeguard. By splitting the key and its control panel, it'll be harder for malicious individuals to access them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_30: Long ago, the Sentinel protected people of Hongzhen from Tacet Discords, and it also revealed a harsh truth—
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_31: Leaving Mt. Firmament shortened one's lifespan exponentially. The longer someone has lived inside the Temporal Barrier, the less likely they can make it out alive.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_32: Later, a group of brave young people who could afford the aging left Mt. Firmament, and they eventually built Jinzhou city.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_33: Others stayed and worshiped the Sentinel as their god, vowing to protect it for generations and carving its likeness into the mountain.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_35: I pray for your safe return. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have other responsibilities to attend to.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_1: Did Xinyi and Jinhsi know each other?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_2: Jinhsi was chosen as a baby for her Resonance Ability, and raised in City Hall to become the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_3: All the government workers there helped care for and teach her at some point, including Lady Xinyi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_4: She grew up with immense responsibilities, forced to suppress her true nature from a young age. Thinking back, Jinhsi was only a teenage girl when she became the Magistrate...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_5: She has been burdened with unimaginable weight that most cannot fathom.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_8: Nothing. I was wondering, how did the Court of Savantae create such an advanced mechanism using the Sentinel's power? Mortals aren't supposed to be able to comprehend it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_9: I've never heard of any human civilization having the ability to manipulate time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_10: Unless the Sentinel willingly taught them... But why?
PymTips_1_Description: Use the Chronosorter to reverse time in a small area and raise the water level. Stand on the still water surface to reach the Flare Stone hanging in the air.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_1: The Mianloong Chamber is open now. You can proceed inside.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_2: Before you go, there's something important I need to tell you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_3: About how the Fractsidus imprisoned your Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_4: Changli was right. They used the Court of Savantae's research to trap our Sentinel in its resting chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_7: Our captured Artificer revealed that the Fractsidus sent a death squad to invade Mt. Firmament. They had a two-fold plan…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_8: First, to place the Chronosorter in the Mianloong Chamber while it was still operational; and second, to lure the Sentinel back to Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_9: Although their death squad was no match for the Sentinel, by forcing its hand, the powerful Resonance Ability of the Sentinel would clash with the energy of the Chronosorter. This would ultimately cause harm to itself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_10: Would that really make any difference?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_11: How could some Chronosorters trap the Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_12: What if the Fractsidus modified those Chronosorters?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_13: A whole bunch of them, pushed to their limits, all working together to deliver one massive blow.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_14: But not even that was enough to take down the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_15: After the first hit, they set up modified Flare Crests in the Mianloong Chamber to form a special force field along with those Chronosorters.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_16: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_17: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_18: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_19: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_20: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_21: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_22: Yes, I will tell you everything.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_23: Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_24: So the Sentinel is actually injured, and it's been getting worse... The Fractsidus attacked while it hasn't healed yet. Their plans are devious as always.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_25: Madam Magistrate, you've already laid out this plan so far.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_26: It's always a challenge to decipher the Sentinel's intentions, but there were many theories about it in City Hall at the time. I couldn't fathom why it went through such great lengths to retrieve you from Mt. Firmament and raise you within our walls.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_27: But now that I reflect on it, perhaps the Sentinel saw in you the potential to one day restore the Temporal Program and ensure the survival of Jinzhou's inhabitants.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_28: I just never thought.. You'd be willing to follow through with that prophecy…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_30: It was here on this very mountain that I first encountered the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_31: Back then, I was too young to remember anything. Even the image of Mt. Firmament has slipped from my mind.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_32: But this time... As soon as I stood at the base of Mt. Firmament, I felt a wave of recognition wash over me. Memories long buried resurfaced with sudden clarity.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_33: Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_34: But my duty as its Appointed Resonator is not the only reason for my decision.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_35: ...I'm following the heart of my younger self before I became Jinhsi: The girl who used to laugh with pure joy as she felt the snow from Mt. Firmament on her face.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_36: I am a seed, born on Mt. Firmament, carried by the wind to every corner of Jinzhou. But now, I have returned to my place of origin.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_37: It's time for me to take root and grow into something greater...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_38: Sigh... No matter what happens or what choices you make, please remember: the people of Hongzhen will always have your back.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_39: Mt. Firmament has been stagnant for eternity. Perhaps a sudden crack of lightning is what we need to break through the fog of uncertainty that has lingered over us for far too long.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_18: The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_19: But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_407_1: One suggests heading back to Hongzhen to reunite with your companions, {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_407_2: With Mt. Firmament no longer posing a threat, surely Hongzhen will undergo significant changes.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_1: Mt. Firmament glowed with the sun's light, high above the clouds and snow. Then suddenly, they vanished, revealing a distant blue sky.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_2: And amidst it all stood a white-haired maiden, like a goddess descended from the heavens.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_3: With a mere wave of her hand, she brought forth a new season, transforming the streets below.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_4: This maiden was none other than the dead infant, now reborn as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_5: "When thunder roars in spring's embrace, the sun shall shine upon this place."
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_6: "For only through death and strife, can one truly embrace new life."
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_7: Hmm... I see. Doesn't matter. That’s not important for our goal.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_8: We have the answers we wanted already.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_9: —With the Second Resonance Awakening, we will tap into powers that rival the Sentinels... Complete control of the artificial Resonator Awakening process is within reach.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_12: This trip was worth it. We've collected many wonderful notes, haven't we?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_14: Get moving. Can't let a certain someone wait too long behind bars.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_39: I can see right through your façade, Jinhsi. You're essentially committing suicide at this point.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_40: You're one to talk, my teacher.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_41: I learned from the best. When have you ever backed down from risking your life for what you believe in?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_42: Oh? I don't remember ever teaching you that.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_43: We all die eventually, but we need to stay alive as long as we can to achieve more.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_44: Jinhsi, you must live and inherit the Sentinel's power. Then you can save and protect these people for years to come.
Character_ZheZhi_1_1: {PlayerName}, it's almost time for the dispute hearing.
Character_ZheZhi_1_2: I... I still hope you'll come with me.

Character_ZheZhi_10_8: Zhezhi, you can't keep avoiding things! You've got to take action, or you'll never get what you want! You only live once, right?!
Character_ZheZhi_10_10: Well, that's a bit too much...
Character_ZheZhi_10_11: Yes... Mr. Shilang is right. Rover, I've actually been meaning to tell you something.

Character_ZheZhi_10_13: Of course, I'd be happy to.
Character_ZheZhi_10_14: Hey, what are you waiting for?
Character_ZheZhi_10_15: Eh? I... um... Okay! I can do this!
Character_ZheZhi_10_18: (That was a pretty obvious slip of the tongue...)

Character_ZheZhi_6_5: Fortunately, they haven't caused much harm. I think it's because they always show up and vanish in the dead of night.
Character_ZheZhi_6_6: If you ask me, these monsters are a new type of Tacet Discord. Since they're unrecorded, our Terminal can't trigger an alarm when they're nearby.
Character_ZheZhi_6_7: For safety reasons, we have increased our patrols around the mine.
Character_ZheZhi_6_8: Did you notice anything else unusual?
Character_ZheZhi_6_9: Could it be related to the Arcane Artist?
Character_ZheZhi_6_10: Anything else unusual? Hmm... Yes there was one thing.
Character_ZheZhi_6_11: Do you mean the mysterious painter who can bring fantastical creatures to life? That could explain it, but a Forte tied to painting is rare.
Character_ZheZhi_6_12: Aside from the blurred silhouettes I saw that night, I remember hearing voices—like people talking.
Character_ZheZhi_6_13: The voices came from where those silhouettes were, but they sounded like... vague muttering.
Character_ZheZhi_6_14: Thinking about it now, if it was a human voice, how could someone get so close to those monsters without crying out for help?
Character_ZheZhi_6_15: I see. Thank you for the information.
Character_ZheZhi_60_1: You... who exactly are you people? You don't look like you're Patrollers... What do you want?
Character_ZheZhi_60_2: If it's the paintings you're after, take as many as you want! We can always make new ones.
Character_ZheZhi_60_3: Oh, so you're also here for the money? Look, name a figure, we'll pay double if it'll make you shut up! How does that sound? Take it and scram!
Character_ZheZhi_60_4: Then what the hell do you want from me?!
Character_ZheZhi_60_5: ...I-I want to expose everything to the public.
Character_ZheZhi_60_7: Aside from reporting you to the Patrollers, I want to let the public know about all the forgery and smuggling you've been doing.
Character_ZheZhi_60_9: I like the idea. You have my support.
Character_ZheZhi_60_11: I...I can't remain silent about this any longer. This is the only way more people can learn about the truth...
Character_ZheZhi_60_12: You'd better think this through! The Shanyun Art Exchange is not a group you wanna cross...
Character_ZheZhi_60_13: I never painted for the Art Exchange's approval. If no one else dares to speak up, then... then I'll be the one to do it!
Character_ZheZhi_60_14: I might have just the plan.
Character_ZheZhi_60_15: First, we keep these guys on close watch. Then, we need to catch them off guard, and the best way to do that is...
Character_ZheZhi_60_16: Forcing people to make copies like a factory line... it's disrespecting the creators' dignity.
Character_ZheZhi_60_17: Oh, it's just a couple of stones and trees on a piece of paper, for crying out loud. Even I can draw one with a flick of the wrist, who cares if they're real or not...
Character_ZheZhi_60_18: For the amount of paint and ink that goes into them, I'd even go so far as to say paying those painters 20 credits each is a rip-off.
Character_ZheZhi_61_1: That's quite the story. At best, this merely proves our involvement in the incident at best, yet the real culprit remains unknown. Your accusations are groundless.
Character_ZheZhi_61_2: Allow me to remind you, she was the one who created those paintings, insisted on selling them, and concocted the entire terrifying incident.
Character_ZheZhi_61_3: Do you honestly believe her paintings would've earned a single penny without my intervention?
Character_ZheZhi_61_4: B-Before we proceed, I wish to present this audio recording to the court.
Character_ZheZhi_61_5: "Ugh, Mr. Baici stopped by again, grumbling about the delay in getting Mingyan's paintings to the Shanyun Art Exchange..."
Character_ZheZhi_61_6: "If Yinfeng hadn't pushed her, she wouldn't have gotten hurt. Now she can't even paint, and our order is gonna be late."
Character_ZheZhi_61_7: "She's been rebellious and a bit too smart for her own good lately. I just wanted her to keep her head down and work. Who knew she'd crack and cause that mess."
Character_ZheZhi_61_8: Mingyan was initially only making copies. Everything changed after you stepped in.
Character_ZheZhi_62_1: When I was a child, painting was the only way I could express myself freely.
Character_ZheZhi_62_2: Everything I did and didn't understand... it all flowed through the tip of my paintbrush.
Character_ZheZhi_62_3: All that I saw, lived within my paintings.
Character_ZheZhi_62_4: This power to turn fantasies into reality gradually caught the interest of many.
Character_ZheZhi_62_5: I took great joy in my skills improving, however...
Character_ZheZhi_62_6: They were sold at unbelievable prices.
Character_ZheZhi_62_7: Some sought beauty in enchanted worlds...
Character_ZheZhi_62_9: My own abilities had led my paintings astray.
Character_ZheZhi_62_11: My parents scolded me for it.
Character_ZheZhi_62_12: After the family business fell apart, my parents vanished without a trace.
Character_ZheZhi_63_1: Well, that was certainly a touching story. But I'm afraid your words alone won't be enough to prove you created this painting.
Character_ZheZhi_63_2: ...Madam Juyao, to prove my statement, I request your permission to use and paint with one of these copies.
Character_ZheZhi_63_4: Are you sure you want to do this?
Character_ZheZhi_63_5: Yes. Mingyan's experience has made me realize something.
Character_ZheZhi_63_6: The paintings I drew in the past... they were heartfelt creations, pieces of my life. They formed my past and shaped who I am today.
Character_ZheZhi_64_2: Th-these paintings are really coming to life?!
Character_ZheZhi_64_4: Why is the world inside this painting so distorted?
Character_ZheZhi_64_8: I've painted it exactly like hers...
Character_ZheZhi_64_11: It's all right. It's okay, she's gone now. Soon... I'll be an even better painter than she ever was!
Character_ZheZhi_68_1: When I learned the truth, I was heartbroken...
Character_ZheZhi_68_2: I believed that by sealing my Forte, no one would get hurt because of my paintings. I never expected them to continue causing harm after all these years.
Character_ZheZhi_68_3: But {PlayerName}'s words made me realize something.
Character_ZheZhi_68_4: It was never about the paintings themselves, but rather those who sought to use them to hurt others.
Character_ZheZhi_68_5: Mr. Baici, you run a highly esteemed calligraphy and painting institution, yet you've suppressed the creative spirit and violated these artists' dignity, all for the sake of wealth.
Character_ZheZhi_68_7: Everything they cherished has now become a tool for profit... The works they held dear are just tools for your gain, insulting to both the original artists and their imitators.
Character_ZheZhi_68_8: Set before you is the original painting from many years ago and the one I've just completed. Now, everything has been brought to light.
Character_ZheZhi_68_9: We received word from the Public Security Bureau ten minutes ago that they have taken the Exiles into custody and found the location where the paintings were hidden.
Character_ZheZhi_68_10: Mr. Baici, do you have anything else to add to your defense?
Character_ZheZhi_68_12: Very well. We will re-evaluate Mingyan's charges, determine the Shanyun Art Exchange's involvement in the incident, and conduct a comprehensive investigation as soon as possible.
Character_ZheZhi_7_1: I've gathered enough information. It's time to check the scene where those monsters were spotted.
Character_ZheZhi_8_2: That figure... that paintbrush... Could it be...
Character_ZheZhi_9_1: Nothing here. That's odd... Did I just imagine that?
Character_ZheZhi_9_2: Unfortunately, I'm... not very good at investigating, so I haven't found any major clues yet.
Character_ZheZhi_9_10: I'm fine. Why are you here?
Character_ZheZhi_9_13: The night... often sparks my creativity...
Character_ZheZhi_9_14: ...Don't tell me you are actually the Arcane Artist.
Character_ZheZhi_9_17: I... I heard about the tale of the Arcane Artist and hoped to find out who they are...
Character_ZheZhi_9_19: You too? Why are you investigating this?
Character_ZheZhi_9_20: Are you also a ghost story enthusiast?
Character_ZheZhi_9_21: Bringing painted creatures to life, making fantasies real—it sounds like a fairy tale, but when the Arcane Artist first caught people's attention in Jinzhou years ago, it was more than just a tale.
Character_ZheZhi_9_22: Yes, there was once an artist who could create paintings that felt so real, you could almost step into them...
Character_ZheZhi_9_27: I'll go with you. It's linked to the case I'm investigating.
HaveEmptyPlayer: There are still undeployed Resonators. Are you sure you want to start the challenge?
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_1: Gather 'round, I have a tale to spin! Our feather-haired maiden faces a horde of beasts…
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_2: And just in time, a ray of light!
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_3: Sunbeams burst through the clouds, banishing darkness out of sight.
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_4: From the statue emerged two… Guess who we have?
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_5: None other than General Jiyan and the legendary Rover!
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_6: And lo! Ruins fell, a colossus shattered. The Overthrax meets its defeat.
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_7: Mountains and rivers exulted in glee, as the war's finale came to be.
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_8: As they say, why fear when fate is ours to take?
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_9: Amidst setbacks, heroes will rise to conquer. Their determination fuels the fire of hope in the darkest hour.
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_10: Under starlit skies we battled, divine Loong roaring above.
Huanglong_main_1_7_178_11: Now victorious, our songs of triumph shall shake the clouds!
InstanceDungeon_1_2_BOSS5_DungeonDesc: The fulfilled wishes are twisted into hollow shells, echoing with obsessive ravings. Muffled murmurs and tangled emotions weave together, forming this Sonoro Sphere. PrefabTextItem_3241982029_Text: Tap Start Chat to chat with a friend.
Character_ChangLi_70_1: Uh... Was there something like this here before?
Character_ChangLi_70_2: These mechanisms... They need to be unlocked from both sides at once.
Character_ChangLi_70_3: Okay. Let's each handle one side. I'll go over there.
Character_ChangLi_73_1: More Tacet Discords... I'll handle them.
Character_ChangLi_74_1: Is this... The key to that door?
Character_ChangLi_74_2: Yes... And those Tacet Discords just devoured the frequencies of the guard on door duty…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_1: Erm... Next time! Next time I'll definitely save some for you! Just... give me a name! Please!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_3: Yes, I want it now! Look, your name's Chixia, your name's Yangyang, and you... Uhhh, your name is...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_5: {PlayerName}? ...That sounds interesting. Wait, didn't you forget everything? How do you still remember...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_6: I just came up with it. It's my new name now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_7: With your old name and memories all gone, it's a good idea to go with a new one. It makes everything more convenient and represents a fresh start.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_8: Yeah, exactly like she said! Every one of you has a name, and I want one for myself too! Really not asking much.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_9: I just want a name that sounds a little cool, a little special and epic and super smokin'!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_10: That's a long list of descriptors...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_11: Yeah, you having a name should make things easier.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_12: Names are a big deal, you know? Like, once you have one, it's stuck with you for life. Gotta make sure it's a good one!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_13: Can't have people not scared of me when they hear it. No time for regrets here!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_15: Let's see... You want a cool one... What about "Echo the Invincible"? What do you say?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_16: Nah, nuh-uh, absolutely no! That's too straightforward. It's-It's no better than calling me the "little one"!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_17: Hey, it makes every difference in the world! "I am Echo the Invincible!" That's what a Hero Play character would say as their transformation call!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_18: Or maybe... Since you can fly and you've got those long ears... why don’t you call yourself... "Righteous Raptor"? Or "Valor Hawk"? "Flying Fury"?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_19: No, absolutely no. Why do they all sound so... cringy...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_20: Why? I love it when people call me the Jinzhou Speedster. Doesn't that sound awesome?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_21: Uh... Haha, sure, if you say so... Anyway, they all sound like anything but my name. ABSOLUTELY NO!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_22: Absolutely no this, absolutely no that. What do you want?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_23: Let’s make it simple. Why don't you just call yourself Abby.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_24: Aha! I knew {PlayerName} would come up with a good... Wait. Why does it sound so random?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_25: You didn't just pick two random syllables, did you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_27: Abby means joy. It's what you bring to us.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_28: I mean... Yeah, it's simple, easy to remember. l can imagine myself yelling it out loud, and at least it sounds better than Chixia’s cringy titles... But you know, it doesn’t feel quite majestic enough...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_29: So... Is it because I've been saying "Absolutely no" a lot...?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_33: (Maybe I should come up with a better one...)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_34: (Hmm... Why is it suddenly so quiet? Is it not happy with the name? Why though... Can't think of anything better that's catchy, impactful, and clever all at once.)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_35: (Uh, I meant to tease it as a joke, but I can tell it's upset now. On second thought, a name is indeed very important. Maybe I'll have to come up with a different one...)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_38: What's wrong? What are you muttering about? Abra... what? Sounds like you're reading a spell.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_39: ...Erm, I don't know, but... I just have this feeling that... this is what my name should be. Okay, ready?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_40: Abby! I like the sound of that. That's my name!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_41: I thought you didn't like it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_42: Good. Saves us time thinking of another one.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_43: Of course I like it! You came up with it for me! I was just... trying to get used to it, that's all! Besides, I feel attached to this name now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_44: My name is Abby. You will NOT call me the "little one" again!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_46: Well, that didn't work out. I was hoping we could get some answers from the little... I mean, from Abby, but now we're back at square one.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_47: I really thought we could figure out where Abby came from. It might not lead us to other special Echoes, but it's at least a starting point to uncover {PlayerName}'s past. Then we'll have something to do before asking Madam Magistrate and our Sentinel about it again.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_48: Maybe we can start with Abby's special abilities instead?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_49: Each special Echo has a unique ability. We can compare what Abby does with our records of other Echoes to see where they came from. Besides… It was Abby’s power that helped {PlayerName} defeat the Threnodian, I suppose?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_51: Why do you sound so unsure? Didn't you see it all with your own eyes?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_52: It happened too fast. I didn't get a clear look.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_53: I'd be more sure if I can see it again.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_54: Hmm… Abby, can you show us again? I'm super curious how you did that. Who knows, we might learn something.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_55: Well, since you asked, I'll show you how it's done! But... this place is too crowded. Let's move to that open spot over there.

InfoDisplay_102801026_Text:
Years ago, there were two close friends who lived on Mt. Firmament. One of them loved stories about the world and wanted to travel around the world, collecting stories while adventuring like the protagonists of stories. When the Sentinel was about to seal Mt. Firmament, this person left Mt. Firmament on horseback.
The other person loved the sounds of the mountain, such as the gurgling water and chirping birds. She hung windchimers everywhere in the mountains and played the guqin on the mountain every day because she wanted to hear the music of the mountains and valleys.
They made a promise to reunite here after a few decades. At their reunion, one would tell stories of the world, and the other would play the beautiful music of the mountains and forests.
However, time flowed differently on Mt. Firmament, and one day there was equivalent to a few decades outside. Time passed mercilessly. The one who left could no longer return home, and the one who stayed could only watch as her guqin decayed.
In this vast expanse, every goodbye could be a farewell for life.
Be well. Farewell.

Character_ZheZhi_44_1: So this Shanyun Art Exchange has been involved in Mingyan's case right from the start.
Character_ZheZhi_44_2: No wonder they got all shifty when we brought up Mingyan earlier...
Character_ZheZhi_44_3: Masquerading as Exiles is indeed cunning.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_113_1: Someone fought here against those Fractsidus...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_113_2: Must be Jinhsi. Her trails led to this location.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_113_3: Using her Resonance Ability too much would only worsen her condition...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_113_4: But she must have had a reason. Was she helping the people of Hongzhen find refuge?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_125_1: This vase on the stone table seems rather peculiar.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_40: In this place she was born, and in this place she returns. Our Magistrate's fate is bound to Mt. Firmament...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_43: In that case, I probably won't... wake... up...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_11: We need to focus on items related to the Court of Savantae in Truthseeker's Pass. Maybe we can find some clues there.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_290_8: {PlayerName}, let's go. I still need more information to determine what we should do next.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_63: I will do everything I can to keep Jinhsi safe.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_64: So a fight between you two is unavoidable.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_30: If you're curious, just head southeast. Mt. Firmament is on the east side of Whining Aix's Mire, and you can see it from a distance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_6_2: Let me... take a quick nap, all right? I've got keen ears. If anything goes down, just give me a holler, and I'll be... I'll be up in a jiffy… I swear…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_14: The Temporal Disruption is preventing it from functioning.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_16: We can't waste a moment. Jinhsi's fate isn't the only one at stake—all the inhabitants of Mt. Firmament are in danger.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_17: We need to hurry to Hongzhen, a town nestled at the heart of Mt. Firmament. Jinhsi would likely pass through there on her search for the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_33: Thank you for placing your trust in me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_34: Come to think of it, many good things have happened to me since you arrived in Jinzhou.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_36: I am always here for you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_37: I'll make sure you turn out safe.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_38: I'll go meet the Sentinel with you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_39: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_40: But don't worry, I'm prepared. This isn't about succumbing to destiny, it's about embracing it fully.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_41: I am grateful to have you by my side through it all.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_42: We're not in a situation where death is our only option, are we?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_46: ... Jinhsi, I don't intend to stop you. I know you've made up your mind.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_48: You may have already guessed it. {PlayerName} is indeed the hero who fought by our Sentinel's side during Jinzhou's early days. {Male=He;Female=She} is also the mysterious visitor spoken of in tales about Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_49: All evidence we've gathered points to this being true.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_50: If anyone can help us with the situation at Mt. Firmament, it must be {PlayerName}.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_51: I don't remember anything, but I can fight.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_52: I'm strong. It wouldn't hurt to help.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_54: Thank you, my teacher... Jinhsi will keep your words in mind.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_55: Lastly, we still don't know for sure how the Fractsidus is keeping our Sentinel trapped. This will determine if you can actually meet it face to face.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_56: Maybe the Fractsidus are just really strong...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_57: They might be using the Court of Savantae's mechanisms.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_58: Maybe they manipulated the Sentinel's weakness.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_59: Yes, it could be any of these scenarios. Lady Xinyi is already on the case. We should get an answer soon.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_60: The Cipher Key should be inside the stone chamber, behind its entrance gate. There is one more Flare Stone to work out. Let's get moving.
Huanglong_main_1_5_200_1: I think I heard a low, grumbling noise...
Huanglong_main_1_5_201_1: The vase didn’t budge at all. Not this one. I should go check on the other vases…

InfoDisplay_10900007_Text:
I recently received an invitation from the Pioneer Association to explore the culinary delights of Jinzhou. Eager to embark on this food journey, I wandered through the city's streets, savoring every dish the city has to offer. My journey led me to uncover delightful surprises that have now come together to form this unique booklet—a comprehensive food map of Jinzhou. I hope that as you read these pages, you will feel inspired to embark on your own food exploration—then my hard work is worth it. For it is in the moment when flavors dance upon your taste buds, igniting a symphony of sensations that resonate deep within, that the true essence of these delicacies lies.
<color=Highlight>Panhua's Restaurant</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆
While writing this booklet, I found myself seated at a small table at Panhua's Restaurant, enveloped by the vibrant buzz of lively conversations. It was here that I witnessed a heartwarming gathering involving a Patroller who had just completed her duty, her friend wearing a blue beret, and another friend in an icy demeanor. Before the Patroller could sit down, she swiftly placed an order for Poached Chicken, Perilla Salad, and Maocai before being joined by her friends. They shared anecdotes with each other, and the vivid expressions and gestures of that Patroller made the atmosphere even more lively. This experience makes me confident that Panhua's Restaurant has the ability to provide a relaxing and spirited dining environment, making it a standout choice for any culinary enthusiast.

As I penned these words, the Poached Chicken arrived at my table. While the chicken itself appeared flat, when immersed in the restaurant's specially crafted sauce, it provides an unforgettable flavor. As I savored each bite, the meat juices burst forth, accompanied by a fresh aroma that lingered in the mouth. The accompanying vegetables, stir-fried to perfection, boasted a vibrant green, complemented by sizzling oil droplets. Paired with tender and fluffy rice, the dish left me with only one word in my mind—"delicious". 

So I couldn't resist having another serving:)
<color=Highlight>Jewel Boba</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆
I found myself longing for more as I savored the delightful Jewel Boba, each sip leaving me yearning for another taste. If I had a second stomach dedicated solely to desserts, there's no doubt it would be reserved for the delicious dessert soup offered here in Jinzhou.. And if I were to recommend just one, Jewel Boba would undoubtedly be my top choice. Boasting over thirty years of renowned excellence, this sweet treat remains as delicious and affordable as ever.
During my visit, I ordered the new buy-one-get-one-free dessert soup. The owner told me that its launch was inspired by a happy couple celebrating their anniversary at the shop—the owner, pleased with their happiness, presented them with a specially made drink. As the couple highly praised its taste, the owner decided to share its taste to more customers. After listening to this warm story, I, who was holding two cups alone, couldn't shake the bitterness of coming here alone. Luckily, the sweetness of the Jewel Boba somewhat lifted my spirits.
<color=Highlight>Liuxian Teahouse</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆
Liuxian Teahouse boasts its Bittberry Tea with distinctive bitterness, which forces you to question everything with a single sip. However, beneath the initial shock, a subtle sweetness emerges, with great persistence in the mouth. 
Unlike the bustling Panhua's Restaurant, Liuxian Teahouse provides a tranquil atmosphere where one can recline in a chair, fan in hand, and while away the hours immersed in the peaceful embrace of life unfolding around them.
<color=Highlight>Borderland Cuisine</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆

InfoDisplay_10900008_Text:
Loong Buns, Jinzhou Stew, Star Flakes... Before delving into the numerous specialties of Jinzhou, let me introduce you to a time-honored dish—"Rising Loong".
<color=Highlight>Rising Loong</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆
For anyone exploring Jinzhou, tasting Rising Loong is a must. The dish presents itself with a captivating golden crispiness, with its preparation involving intricate steps to reproduce the scene where a carp looks up to the sky, aspiring to become a dragon. This dish narrates the awakening of Jué. Back then, countless carps leaped from the water to pay homage to it. It is an event seem auspicious by Jinzhou people. Therefore, if you seek good fortune, don't miss the chance to savor Rising Loong!

<color=Highlight>Food Ration Bar</color>, rating: ☆☆☆
Although I've given it only three stars, the significance of Food Ration Bar goes beyond its taste. Its major characteristic lies in its convenience, accessibility, and ample nutritional value, making it available for every soldier who fights bravely and relentlessly on the frontlines.
More importantly, each Food Ration Bar comes with a note, expressing Jinzhou people's thoughts, wishes, and gratitude to the soldiers who safeguard the peace and prosperity of Jinzhou.
Even though countless challenges may lie ahead, Jinzhou and its people consistently stand in support of the soldiers. The soldiers courageously protect Jinzhou with their lives, and in return, Jinzhou becomes their steadfast shield.

InfoDisplay_120101001_Text:
To the Moontree Lodge,

I'm tired. I'm really tired.
The many failed experiments and our unachievable goal have filled me with despair.
I'm not the right person for the work of the academy, nor am I good at communicating with others. I don't even have what it takes to apologize after hurting the only person who would listen to me.
I'm rotten to the core and unworthy of pursuing the truth.
Even if I make a wish, I bet no one would want to make my wish come true.
But on the off chance... even if there's only a one in ten thousand chance that someone will see this...
Please make me disappear from this world. I hope that nobody will remember me and nobody will be sad because of my disappearance.

InfoDisplay_120101004_Text:
To the Moontree Lodge,
 
They say that Moon-Chasing Festival is a time for family reunions, but my son is no longer here. The house feels so empty without him. I miss the old days, with him by my side, the both of us together, sharing conversation... Is he as lonely in that other world as I am in this one? Should I go be with him? But I promised that I'd live a long, full life and take care of myself... Oh, Moontree Lodge, I've gotten so old, what do I have to wish for anymore? If you really can pull off miracles as they say, please, tell me. What should I do?

Heying
InfoDisplay_120101006_Text:
Almighty Moontree Lodge,

I have a secret to tell you.
Shhh—I might have awakened my incredible abilities like the heroes in hero plays.
Well... I'm saying this because... I could only eat one bowl of rice for lunch in the past, but now I can finish two large bowls! Also, I used to have to step on a small bench to touch the branches of Grandpa Tree, but now I only need to jump casually to touch them!
I feel like something amazing is burning inside my body. Is this what it feels like to become a great hero? I've been waiting for ages now. I wonder when I'll be able to use amazing powers like Blaze Ranger...
Moontree Lodge, oh Moontree Lodge, the adults all say that you can make any wish come true... Can you help me become a great hero?

Mahn
