Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_1: Over here! Been waiting for ya!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_2: I thought Yangyang said you had a super cool lil' buddy to show us. Where is it?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_4: Did it just... pop out of your Tacet Mark...?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_6: So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the Norfall Barrens?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_8: As I fought off those Tacet Discords, a burst of energy erupted from that statue...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_9: Two forces clashed and collided, and later one of them emerged victorious, vanquishing the other in a violent clash.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_10: General Jiyan and Rover later told me it was this little thing coming out of Rover's body. It was blocking, or even "consuming" the overflow of Threnodian power.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_11: It reminded me of how Rover once absorbed frequency energy with {Male=his;Female=her} body in a similar fashion. So we took {Male=him;Female=her} to the Academy for a check-up with Baizhi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_12: Apparently... this little one is what we had detected before. It’s the speculated "Space" or "Organism" hidden inside your body. Now we finally know.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_13: It shares similar frequencies with Tacet Discords' Reverberations. It resembles an Echo processed by the Data Bank, stored inside your body instead of a Terminal.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_14: In other words, it's your own Echo, captured or absorbed at some point. Without you, it can't manifest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_15: That's why Baizhi couldn't confirm just how you absorbed that Echo back then. Was it you? Was it the little one? Or maybe, the two of you together?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_16: And Baizhi discovered more after analyzing your spectrums.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_17: She found a new power source within you, similar to the Crownless but even stronger. This power comes from the Tacet Discord you defeated in Norfall Barrens.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_18: So, the excess energy this little thing had "consumed" somehow ended up in your body, available at your disposal. In other words, there's a deeper connection between the two of you. Or, according to Baizhi, it’s a Convergent Codependency.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_21: Uh, to put it simply... you are connected. While you are two separate individuals, your energies and vitals can affect each other, for better or for worse. You may even feel each other's emotions.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_22: The bond between you and this creature is symbiotic. As it strengthens, so do you. However, if one is harmed, the other suffers.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_23: Fortunately, since it can't ever leave your side, it's not an easy target for attackers. And if they do strike, it can seek shelter inside your body for safety.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_26: Okay, now that's... pretty much it. Baizhi was going to explain it to you herself, but she has to go check on a newly appeared Sonoro Sphere in Zhaozhou...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_27: Wait, wait! This is too much information for me to process! Let me get this straight. So, it helped Rover fight off the Threnodian?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_28: Seriously? This teeny tiny thing could do that? Hmm. Seems unlikely...

Each <color=#ffd12f>Flare Crest</color> corresponds to one <color=#ffd12f>Flare Stone</color>. Flare Crests can be extinguished by approaching and activating the corresponding Flare Stones.
After all Flare Crests of a set have been extinguished, the seal will be lifted.
GuideTutorialPage_34040_Content:
Transform into Clang Bang and fill in the missing ice cube to complete the challenge.

GuideTutorialPage_34043_Content: Windchimers are scattered across Mt. Firmament and can be collected using <color=#ffd12f>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#ffd12f>Ranged Attack</color>. Someone has a keen interest in them. Gather Windchimers to exchange for valuable resources with her.
GuideTutorialPage_34044_Content: Smash Ice Piles with attacks, and they might drop unexpected rewards.

After activating Tactical Hologram: Ski, throw the Grapple at the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> ahead to begin skiing.

Ski: Earn <color=#ffd12f>points</color> as you ski and reach the finish line within the specified time. Aim for higher points to receive better rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_34049_Content:
A special creature that huddles up and hides underground to protect itself when approached or attacked head-on.
Attack the <color=#ffd12f>weak point on Frostbugs' backs</color> <color=#ffd12f>from a distance</color> to defeat them.
GuideTutorialPage_34050_Content:

It is necessary to stand in the position in the light and <color=#ffd12f>change the viewing angle</color> to align the <color=#ffd12f>Loong's Pearl</color> on the rite platform with the <color=#ffd12f>mouth</color> of the dragon-shaped peak of Mt. Firmament in the distance.

MonsterInfo_310000350_DiscoveredDes:
This emeny has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
A larvae-mimic TD mainly inhabits areas beneath the tundra, near geothermal heat sources.
By absorbing geothermal energy, it can produce lava through a special organ to melt the frozen soil and dig tunnels extending in all directions.
Lava Larva traces often lead to locations rich in geothermal energy.
MonsterInfo_310000350_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD. It inhabits areas beneath the tundra and is skilled in digging extensive underground tunnels.
MonsterInfo_310000360_DiscoveredDes:
An endemic ratite-mimic TD inhabiting Mt. Firmament. Being flightless and non-hardy, it can only survive in areas below the mountain ridge.
Its name has two etymological origins within the Huanglong language family. One stems from a description from the Hongzhen Chronicle: "This ratite-mmic TD is plump and seemingly lack of intelligence."
The other is originated from the local dialect. Locals use the word to describe creatures that "look dumb".
MonsterInfo_310000360_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD. Despite its wings, it is entirely terrestrial and highly sensitive to the cold.
MonsterInfo_320000190_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
A wolf-mimic TD rampant in the snowland, gifted in stealth. 
Glacio Dreadmanes utilize teamwork and mimicry as weapons against powerful opponents.
MonsterInfo_320000190_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD widely distributed in the snowland. Glacio Dreadmanes are social TDs that usually move in packs.
MonsterInfo_320000200_DiscoveredDes:
The enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Lumiscale Constructs are composed of Jué's defensive modules, commonly known as "Loong's Scales." 
They are found throughout the Court of Savantae ruins in Mt. Firmament, tasked with eliminating intruders and potential threats to Jué.
MonsterInfo_320000200_UndiscoveredDes: A mechanical construct guarding the ruins in Mt. Firmament. It takes direct orders from the Sentinel and functions as their guardian.
MonsterInfo_320000210_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
An enormous feline-mimic TD, only sighted in Mt. Firmament in Huanglong.
According to the Hongzhen Chronicle, it is a solitary TD with four claws and a scaly back. It is called "Lightcrusher" because of the glowing tracks left in its wake.
MonsterInfo_320000210_UndiscoveredDes: An Elite Class Howler TD. It is solitary and leaves behind luminous traces as it moves.
MonsterInfo_340000090_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, and <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
One of the Sentinels of Huanglong, taking the shape of a Loong. The guiding force behind Jinzhou's civilization.
A majestic "deity" with unquestionable power, omniscient of Jinzhou's past, present, and future. Jué, the wielder of time's flow, sees eons as mere moments. In an instant, Jué can change the universe forever.
"Seasons shift by decree, and all beings abide by their laws. Such is the nature of the universe."
MonsterInfo_340000090_UndiscoveredDes: One of the Sentinels in Huanglong that takes the shape of Loong. With the ability to manipulate time, Jué guides the development of Jinzhou's civilization.
RogueBuffPool_910312000671_BuffDesc: Additionally unlock the Resonator's Resonance Chain.
RogueBuffPool_910312000671_BuffDesc_0:
Jinhsi recalled Jué telling her in her youth that Jinzhou had once been a wasteland due to its remote location at the border.
Turning Jinzhou into a flourishing haven—like a seed sprouting in barren soil—was what Jinhsi dreamed of when she first tapped into her Forte.
RogueBuffPool_910312000672_BuffDesc: Upgrade the Resonator after obtaining a certain number of Attribute Orbs.
RogueBuffPool_910312000672_BuffDesc_0:
At first, Jiyan wasn't great with a spear.
Like all Midnight Rangers, he was only trained to use swords. But in that fateful battle, when he rose to lead his comrades out of a dire situation, the wind itself became the long spear he now wields.
RogueBuffPool_910312000673_BuffDesc: Upon obtaining a Metaphor from White Cat, there is a chance of gaining an additional Metaphor.
RogueBuffPool_910312000673_BuffDesc_0:
Lucky Greetings Collection, edited by Lingyang, has become a must-read for the Liondance Troupe.
"Moms won't have to worry about their kids being tongue-tied ever again!"
"'The moon shines above, pure and bright, tonight we gather in its light.' What a beautiful greeting! Memorize Chapter 13, and you'll have nothing to fear when visiting elders during the Moon-Chasing Festival!"
At the end of the book, more and more heartfelt recommendations from members of the troupe are being added.
RogueBuffPool_910312000674_BuffDesc: Restore HP upon defeating an enemy.
RogueBuffPool_910312000674_BuffDesc_0:
Once during her training, Jianxin controlled several leaves with her palms, making them rise and fall three thousand times.
Though never touched them, she felt connected to their essence. Three thousand raindrops danced upon their foliage, three thousand beams of light penetrated through them, and three thousand breezes made them flutter like butterflies. Finally, as three thousand specks of dust settled upon them, the leaves became nourishment for three thousand more lives.
RogueBuffPool_910312000675_BuffDesc: Obtain Dream Fragments based on the current Dream Fragments owned.
RogueBuffPool_910312000675_BuffDesc_0:
When Changli arrived in Jinzhou, Jinhsi was still in her youth, and the region was in dire straits.
No one knew how she managed to juggle the interests of various factions and push forward progress across all sectors with a limited budget.
It was said that Changli avoided electronic media during this time, instead recording notes in a booklet. To this day, people continue to search for this elusive booklet, hoping to uncover the secrets of Jinzhou's past. However, no one has ever succeeded, and there's no evidence to even confirm its existence.
RogueBuffPool_910312000676_BuffDesc: Obtain Dream Fragments equal to the multiplier of the current Attribute Orbs owned.
RogueBuffPool_910312000676_BuffDesc_0:
During times of desperation, many sought assistance from Calcharo. Despite their willingness to give up everything for his help, Calcharo asked for just one Shell Credit and one condition: becoming his informant.
Anyone could be Calcharo's informant—it might even be the lady selling groceries in the alley... Much like the mounting pile of Shell Credits, Calcharo's web of spies grows steadily, unwittingly turning him into the "Protector" of the oppressed.
RogueBuffPool_910312000677_BuffDesc: Summon a lightning strike every once in a while during battle.
RogueBuffPool_910312000677_BuffDesc_0: Yinlin is accustomed to walking in shadows, much like the threads of lightning in her hand. These threads silently ensnare her prey, delivering an unexpected fatal blow. With the charge gathered at her fingertips, she metes out punishment to those who deserve it. Once the myriad threads are lifted, everything in her grasp becomes nothing more than lifeless puppets.
RogueBuffPool_910312000678_BuffDesc: Reduce DEF and obtain more Dream Fragments.
RogueBuffPool_910312000678_BuffDesc_0:
He loathes the frail bodies and contemptible souls of humanity, convinced of their incorrigible malevolence.
In his eyes, humans are beyond redemption. His sole desire is to annihilate all in his path.
RogueBuffPool_910312000679_BuffDesc: Lose all Dream Fragments and obtain random Metaphors.
RogueBuffPool_910312000679_BuffDesc_0:
Rules are nothing but cages and shackles. Only by breaking them down can we get closer to the truth.
To him, the world is a dull cube with six identical sides. Only the hues of chaos can inject vibrancy to its monotony. And if that proves futile, then twisting and tearing it apart are the only options left.
RogueBuffPool_910312000680_BuffDesc: Increase Resonance Skill DMG. Casting Resonance Skill consumes STA.
RogueBuffPool_910312000680_BuffDesc_0:
His mother used to tell him countless fairy tales when he was little, the only tender moments in their family. Yet, he couldn't bring himself to believe in those stories.
In every tale he recounted to others, there was always a sacrificial figure. Innocent and virtuous, these were good people who did nothing wrong.
Yet, he interpreted their kindness as sins. The kindness of the meek is not a virtue, but rather a flaw, a trait destined for sacrifice.
RogueBuffPool_910312000681_BuffDesc: Deal more damage upon entering a new Memory Zone. This effect is removed upon taking damage.
RogueBuffPool_910312000681_BuffDesc_0: Humanity's evil is like a flickering spark—transient yet enduring, dancing amid the delicate balancing act of human lives. He takes pleasure in orchestrating the perfect moment to ignite those sparks, watching as people succumb to the ensuing pain and bloodshed.
RogueBuffPool_910312000682_BuffDesc: Reduce the Max HP and increase the progression efficiency of Symphony Rank.
RogueBuffPool_910312000682_BuffDesc_0: He has shattered the invisible shackles of concepts and rules. Fresh thoughts and ideals now proliferate in the shadows, driven by his conviction that they'll one day emerge into the light as universal truths. When that moment comes, he'll once again cast off all restraints and step into true freedom.

Flow_312800004_88: Sorry, but we've run out of prizes. I'll go back and check again... Maybe next time, you will win the grand prize!
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_1: The honorable Madam Jinhsi, our great magistrate of Jinzhou, was handpicked by Sentinel Jué. Her status as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is rare among all past magistrates.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_2: Our Jinzhou was leaderless for years until Jué finally chose her to be the next Magistrate, and she answered the call.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_3: To further elaborate, we must start with the "Battle Beneath the Crescent"...
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_4: The Norfall Barrens, scarred by countless wars... Discarded weapons scattered like bones.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_5: Our soldiers had fought to reclaim the land for years, to no avail.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_6: Ovathrax, the dreadful Threnodian monster, fed on the frequencies of "weapons" turning our fallen soldiers into deadly Tacet Discords...
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_7: General of the Midnight Rangers, Geshu Lin, bravely rose to confront the threat.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_9: As twin moons aligned, General Geshu Lin vowed to vanquish evil, raising his blade against the blood-red crescent that foretold destruction.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_10: His sword blazed with black flames, laying waste to all who dared stand in his way. Victory seemed certain...
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_11: ...Until the Retroact Rain began to fall.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_12: Raindrops fell upwards as in the past. Monsters raged, loyal souls fell to blood-soaked sands... Infernal carnage!
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_13: Sacrificing his body to the black flames for power, Geshu Lin charged at the Ovathrax with all his might... And he was never seen again.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_15: After the fall of their leader, the remaining soldiers despaired... Until a deafening roar of the <ano=Teal Dragon>Qingloong</ano> struck like lightning. A lone youth bravely stood up to lead. A hard-won retreat!
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_16: After the battle, that young man who tamed the wind ascended to fame, becoming the new General of Midnight Rangers, selected by Sentinel Jué.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_17: On the other hand, General Geshu was blamed for the massive losses that occurred under his command, earning him a notorious reputation in Huanglong...
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_18: That battle struck us hard, but our Sentinel rose from its long slumber to select a new Magistrate who guide us into the future.
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_19: Despite the previous disaster, Jinzhou was off to a promising start under our Sentinel and the new Magistrate's guidance. The people held hope for a better tomorrow...
Huanglong_main_1_6_5_20: Issuing his last command, Geshu Lin demanded all soldiers stand firm, no matter what happened.

InfoDisplay_102801201_Text:
...What's so special about the Court of Savantae Ruins? If you ask me, those people from the Court of Savantae were no good. Dead though they may be, their excessive protection measures still got several of my brothers killed. Tsk, I don't get why those people from Fractsidus are so obsessed with the moldy books and scrap metal of the Court of Savantae. All they have done over the last three days is dig up the ground and move the Court of Savantae's junk out of the ruins. I wouldn't humor them at all if they weren't paying so well.
—Yao Shisi

Reply to Yao Shisi
Are you really that crazy about money, or do you have a death wish? The Fractsidus are a ruthless bunch who will swallow you whole. Why not just search Mt. Firmament for something valuable and sell them in Jinzhou instead. That way you'd make a pretty penny, too.
—Kui
Side_CXSQJD1_1_2: Yep, all of them, exactly the amount you asked for.
Side_CXSQJD1_1_3: Hold it, man. Be patient. We need to see the money first…
Side_CXSQJD1_1_4: Money? You wish! Go collect 'em in your dreams!
Side_CXSQJD1_1_5: What? You dare to fool us! I'll smack the heck out of you!
Side_CXSQJD1_10_1: Oh no... The box is missing... The bad guy stole it...
Side_CXSQJD1_11_2: Sounds like there's a little cat in that pile of boxes...
Side_CXSQJD1_15_1: They're not scared of humans... and look well and healthy. Someone must be taking care of them.
Side_CXSQJD1_15_2: But why are they wandering in this place...
Side_CXSQJD1_17_1: Are they going back home? That looks like the way to Hongzhen.
Side_CXSQJD1_2_1: So you had an ambush all set up? Guess I underestimated you.
Side_CXSQJD1_2_2: You serious? Bring your man here and tryin' to play the victim now? Don't even make me laugh!
Side_CXSQJD1_25_3: Tabbie and Patchie like you very much, {Male=Big Brother;Female=Big Sister}.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_5: The tabby kitten circles around you and then meows anxiously at Little Tang.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_6: What is it, Tabbie? Hmm, you mean this {Male=Big Brother;Female=Big Sister} saved you from the bad guy?
Side_CXSQJD1_25_8: I see. Thank you so much, {Male=Big Brother;Female=Big Sister}.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_9: Come on, you two. Say "Thank you!"
Side_CXSQJD1_25_13: Why did the Exiles take them?
Side_CXSQJD1_25_14: …Granny told me some bad uncles and aunties are doing bad things in the town recently.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_15: Tabbie and Patchie like to sleep in the box. Maybe those bad guys thought there was a "treasure" inside, like others said, so they grabbed the box and took Tabbie and Patchie with them.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_16: I've been looking for them for quite a long time... Thank you for bringing them home safely.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_17: Don’t worry. I’ve taught them to behave.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_18: Wow! You are so cool! I need to be stronger and protect Tabbie and Patchie.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_19: And I made a new home for them using a beautiful new box! I put it in my home, so it's safe there.
Side_CXSQJD1_25_20: You are welcomed to come and play with us at any time!
Side_CXSQJD1_5_1: Are you sure it’s gonna work? I mean… hiding the box in the sea? Underwater?
Side_CXSQJD1_5_2: What else do you want, genius?
Side_CXSQJD1_5_3: Right, let's just carry it and swagger through the streets. Make sure everyone knows we found a treasure box!
Side_CXSQJD1_5_4: If you can't suggest anything useful, then just keep your mouth shut and wait for the ship. Once it docks, you can pull the box up from the water.
Side_CXSQJD1_5_5: Talk gibberish again and I'll toss you into the sea.
Side_CXSQJD1_7_1: Another blockhead messing around? I'll teach you a proper lesson!

InfoDisplay_120101011_Text:
When "the Genius" Meets "the Ordinary": An Exclusive Interview with the Mysterious Polymath

Q: This is your first time speaking to the public, right? Are you nervous? Everyone's been so curious about what the legendary "genius" is like.
A: Haha, actually, I've interacted with many of you on various topics without you even realizing it. Maybe you would recall discussing proton lifetime with someone named Cream Cat.

Q: That science writer Cream Cat? So it's also you! What a surprise! By the way, does this pseudonym have any special meaning?
A: It's from a little "aha" moment. Let me ask you this: ever accidentally dropped a cream cake? If you have, you've probably noticed the creamy side always hits the ground first, just like a cat always lands on its paws. Now, imagine this: stick the non-creamed side onto a cat's back, and voilà! You've got yourself a cream-cat perpetual motion machine, spinning 24/7—a true scientific marvel.

Q: It must take a whimsical and creative mind to come up with such an interesting idea. I wonder if your research on Automata Mechanics is just as imaginative.
A: To answer that, let's raise our heads and look at the starry sky through the window above. What do you see at first glance? And if you look further, what do you see next?

Q: First, the moon and stars. Beyond that, maybe planets crashing into each other or the starry sky mirroring the world we live in.
A: Now, are these just your imagination or scientific facts waiting to be confirmed? You can't find the answer if you don't imagine it first, right? It's the same with my research: imagination is part of scientification. Researchers today often focus too much on the utilitarian side of science, abandoning imagination to ensure their work contributes to mankind and the world as a whole, even if it goes against their intuition. Applied research is undoubtedly necessary for post-Lament reconstruction, but that's no reason to give up imagination, the breeding ground of science. So, my advice is... just think about how to make the science work. As for what it might yield, well... (smiles)

Q: How enlightening! Speaking of advice, do you have any for your gifted son, Xiangli Yao? As a genius yourself, you must have high expectations for him.
A: That might be a lot for a young boy to handle, <color=Highlight>but... I just hope he inherits my way of seeing things. So that one day, when he steps out of his room and tries to make sense of this world, he can look up at the sky and find the answers there.</color>
InfoDisplay_120101012_Text:

InfoDisplay_120101014_Text:
Dad and Mom always take different paths when we go hiking. Dad likes heading up to the summit, and I enjoy climbing with him. After reaching the top, we sit under a big tree and count the stars in the night sky. Mom, on the other hand, always goes down the mountain. Today, I decided to go with Mom.
I didn't even know there was a village at the bottom of this remote mountain! Everyone there smiled and nodded at Mom like they knew her well. Does Mom come here for her job all the time?
The villagers gathered around and thanked Mom, expressing their praises, just like those mentioned in the newspapers. But I also heard them say something else.
"I wasn't sure if Dr. Xiangli Yan would really give us checkups for free every month, but she did it! And she still does, even after the big disaster..."
"She's so sincere and considerate. But don't you think it's a waste of talent for her to work in our village? I mean, someone of her expertise should be doing more important things!"
On the way home, I couldn't shake off what the villagers had said, even finding myself muttering those words. Mom noticed and took my hand, asking about counting stars with Dad. I told her I could recognize every star, even the faintest ones in the distance. Mom said even though she wasn't up on the mountain with us, she was still gazing at the stars. The difference was that she kept her feet firmly on the ground so she wouldn't fall while looking at the sky. As she spoke, a man came up to her asking for help, so I went home alone. But this time, the starry sky looked different from what Dad showed me back on the mountaintop.
InfoDisplay_120101015_Text: Failed experiments, unmet goals... I've had enough! I just want to be heard...
InfoDisplay_120101016_Text: I promised my boy I'd witness the Ovathrax's defeat and the peace he had fought so hard for.
InfoDisplay_120101017_Text: I wanna be a great hero like Flame Ranger from the hero plays. He's strong, he's brave and tough in the face of despair, and he has a squad of awesome friends. We need every one safe and sound together to truly protect what we care about.

Side_CXSTSSJ_1_1: Hello, {Male=good sir;Female=good lady}! Would you be so kind as to lend me a few minutes? Sorry to bother you, but have you ever seen a bell-like object encircled by muscial notes in the mountains?
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_4: Does it look similar to this bell adorned on my clothes?
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_5: Here, let me show you. It looks like this bell adorned on my clothes.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_6: It is called Windchimer, which can capture and preserve a variety of sounds, converting them into usable energy. Perhaps you can think of it as a sophisticated recorder to help you better understand how it works.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_7: There are many Windchimers scattered in the mountains. If you happen to find one, you may ring it to release the "sounds" within.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_8: And with the Terminal, you can absorb the converted energy.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_9: I've been collecting these gadgets to amass the energy, which can be used to repair this Guqin. Please, have a look at it.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_12: I don't have the money to buy it.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_13: What keen observation you have! If I manage to repair it, its melody will surely resonate across the mountain! No, even beyond!
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_14: Indeed, but if I manage to repair it, its melody will surely resonate across the mountain!
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_15: You got me wrong. I wasn't planning to sell it.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_16: However broken it is, I can still feel the myriad of stories it carries, which is precisely why repairing it is worthwhile.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_17: To make sure the Guqin is well-tuned, I need the energy from the Windchimer.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_18: Therefore, I would appreciate it if you could collect the Winchimers and send them back to me.
Side_CXSTSSJ_1_19: And your efforts won't go unpaid. Don't worry, I know the rules. Payment for services rendered—that's what we'd call an equal exchange.
Side_CXSTSSJ_2_1: It's you! Good to meet you again. Did you collect any Windchimers recently? If so, I'd be happy to take them.
Side_CXSTSSJ_3_1: Hello again. I wonder what "sounds" you would bring me today.
Side_CXSTSSJ_4_1: Thank you very much! It should speed up the repairing.
Side_CXSTSSJ_5_1: It's you! Good to meet you again. Did you collect any Windchimers recently? If so, I'd be happy to take them.
Side_CXSTSSJ_5_4: Here, see this bell adorned on my clothes? This is the Windchimer.
Side_CXSTSSJ_5_5: It captures and preserves sounds before converting them into usable energy, which is the best repair material for my broken Guqin.
Side_CXSTSSJ_5_6: However broken it is, I can still feel the myriad of stories it carries.
Side_CXSTSSJ_5_7: After it's repaired, I'll share these stories with you. But until then, I'm relying on you to bring me the Windchimers.
Side_CXSTSSJ_6_1: The broken Guqin is finally repaired! Thank you for your help!
Side_CXSTSSJ_6_2: Can you feel the stories now? They are all woven into the melody it plays.
Side_CXSTSSJ_6_3: I'll transcibe them to text later. Feel free to read them if you like.
Side_CXSTSSJ_6_4: I'll stay here, playing the Guqin from now on. If you revisit, you'll always be greeted with my music.
Side_CXSTSSJ_6_5: Please take good care of yourself, my friend. Until next time.

NPC_HZ_100_1: Excuse me, would you mind lending me a hand...
NPC_HZ_100_3: Sorry, but I don't have the time.
NPC_HZ_100_4: Hehe, it's nothing really, just that Hongzhen has gotten a lot busier now that it's easier to come to Mt. Firmament.
NPC_HZ_100_5: But my business is still the same as always, neither good nor bad. Most of my customers are regulars from the town.
NPC_HZ_100_6: The visitors just come in, browse, and leave without buying anything.
NPC_HZ_100_7: So I thought maybe I should get something new in, stuff I've never sold before.
NPC_HZ_100_8: Are you looking for advice from me?
NPC_HZ_100_9: Yes. You're not from here, so you probably their preferences more than I do. So please, give me some suggestions.
NPC_HZ_100_13: That makes sense. People from other parts of Jinzhou aren't used to our stuff, anyway.
NPC_HZ_100_14: Besides... if I could bring in some goods from Jinzhou, the regulars here in Hongzhen could also try something new.
NPC_HZ_100_15: True, the things we're used to seeing in Mt. Firmament might be interesting to outsiders.
NPC_HZ_100_16: Not a bad idea. Artisans aren't in short supply here. Throw some local flair on the souvenirs and they should sell like hotcakes.
NPC_HZ_100_17: Thanks a lot. You've been a great help.
NPC_HZ_100_18: You're busy? Sigh. It's okay, then.
NPC_HZ_100_19: Feel free to look around. Let me know if you see anything you like.
NPC_HZ_55_1: Come, try my freshly dried fruit.
NPC_HZ_55_4: Come on, don't be shy. Take it!
NPC_HZ_55_5: Mrs. Qiu stuffs a handful of dried fruit in your hand.
NPC_HZ_55_6: Give it a try. How is it? Do you like it?
NPC_HZ_55_9: Grab more if you like it. I was worried it wouldn't suit your foreign taste buds!
NPC_HZ_55_11: That's easy. Let me show you.
NPC_HZ_55_12: You get some berries in advance and wash them in cold mountain spring water.
NPC_HZ_55_13: Then you cut them up, marinate them in a jar of sugar overnight, sun-dry them on a warm day, and they're guaranteed to be a treat.
NPC_HZ_55_16: It does sound simple, but my child still can't manage it for the sake of his life. Sometimes he tries to help me, but usually, he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.
NPC_HZ_55_17: Hehe, you are just like my child. He thought it was hard, too. Though he still tries to help me sometimes, usually he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.
NPC_HZ_55_18: Sigh. He's no longer in town now. I have no clue how he's doing outside Mt. Firmament...
NPC_HZ_55_19: Not your taste, huh? Well, I have no clue what you foreign kids like or dislike. Guess I'll try something else when I return home.
NPC_HZ_56_1: Here's the dried fruit you wanted, Danhua.
NPC_HZ_56_2: Where do you want them? I'll put them up for you.
NPC_HZ_56_3: No worries, Mrs. Qiu. You just take it easy and leave the heavy lifting to me.
NPC_HZ_56_4: Oh, I have something I would like to talk to you about.
NPC_HZ_56_5: The dried fruit you made is wonderful, but there just isn't enough of it. Even we Mt. Firmament locals have a hard time getting them, let alone folks from other places.
NPC_HZ_56_6: So, is it possible for you to make a couple more baskets at a time?
NPC_HZ_56_7: Well, I still have a jar at home. Just tell anyone who wants it to come to me.
NPC_HZ_56_8: But a couple more baskets... That's going to be tough.
NPC_HZ_56_9: As you know, my son left Mt. Firmament some time ago, leaving me all alone in the house. I just don't have the energy to do it all by myself...
NPC_HZ_56_10: It's all right. I was just wondering. The decision is all yours, naturally.
NPC_HZ_56_12: That's the case for everybody. I used to complain about him causing trouble when he was home. Now that he's gone, I have no one to help me and I miss him so terribly.
NPC_HZ_65_2: Did you come back to visit or see Lady Xinyi?
NPC_HZ_65_4: I know you, you are Shoufeng.
NPC_HZ_65_5: Well, we met each other briefly in the secret chamber during the Temporal Disruption, though we never got to talk much.
NPC_HZ_65_6: But I remember you very well, hero of Hongzhen.
NPC_HZ_65_8: What have you been up to lately?
NPC_HZ_65_9: Standing guard, working my shift... The usual.
NPC_HZ_65_10: Of course, that used to be my and Bingge's duty, but now that the Midnight Rangers are here, I'm not needed as much.
NPC_HZ_65_11: You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
NPC_HZ_65_12: The arrival of Midnight Rangers should make things easier for you.
NPC_HZ_65_13: Well, I'm a local, after all, so of course I know more than the rangers. Lady Xinyi sent me and Bingge to assist them probably for the same reason.
NPC_HZ_65_14: But I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.
NPC_HZ_65_15: That should be the case, but I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.
NPC_HZ_65_16: In Bingge's words, it's a style clash... and that frustrates me.
NPC_HZ_65_17: Embrace the differences and stay true to your own style.
NPC_HZ_65_18: Just take it easy, they'll understand.
NPC_HZ_65_19: You're right. I'm a country bumpkin and don't know much, but I know the ancestors came here from all over because of the due to TD Outbreak, yet they all got along in the end.
NPC_HZ_65_20: Maybe Bingge did hit it on the nail. You can't rush friendship.
NPC_HZ_70_1: {PlayerName}? You're an honored guest. Please feel free to ask anything and make yourself at home.
NPC_HZ_70_2: (About how things are in Hongzhen lately.)
NPC_HZ_70_6: Thanks for asking. Thanks to the Magistrate's plan, Hongzhen is getting back on track.
NPC_HZ_70_7: The old era is over. Mt. Firmament is no longer isolated. To the people of Hongzhen, it means more opportunities and possibilities.
NPC_HZ_70_8: But not everyone will come here with a noble intent...
NPC_HZ_70_9: Yes. This is still not the time to let our guard down. Luckily, the worst is behind us. We just need to give Hongzhen some time and faith.
NPC_HZ_70_10: Though the Mianloong Chamber lies vacant now, the Sentinel still returns to Mt. Firmament occasionally. After all, this is where they first descended, and it holds many remnants of their past.
NPC_HZ_70_11: Without all the politics, Sentinel has more freedom now as well.
NPC_HZ_70_12: Hongzhen belongs to Jinzhou, so it's logical for the Midnight Rangers to be here.
NPC_HZ_70_13: Not to mention with the new waterway access, there are unscrupulous parties eyeing Mt. Firmament, especially the ruins and relics.
NPC_HZ_70_14: Considering most folks in town are civilians, safety is a concern.
NPC_HZ_70_15: I think the Magistrate sent the Rangers to keep peace in Mt. Firmament and Hongzhen.
NPC_HZ_70_16: How are things with the Midnight Rangers?
NPC_HZ_70_17: Bingge should be working with them right now.
NPC_HZ_70_18: Shoufeng should be working with them right now.
NPC_HZ_70_19: Mt. Firmament has been in isolation for too long, so the rangers naturally have problems communicating with the locals.
NPC_HZ_70_20: I sent Bingge and Shoufeng to work with the rangers. They both grew up in Mt. Firmament without much outside contact, but they are reliable and smart.
NPC_HZ_70_21: I believe it's also a matter of time before the City Hall takes over Mt. Firmament.
NPC_HZ_70_22: It's good to look around and visit old friends.
NPC_HZ_75_1: Hey... Wait, haven't we met before?
NPC_HZ_75_2: That's right. In the chamber, right? I remember seeing you with a pink-haired girl and the Magistrate too.
NPC_HZ_75_3: Left quite an impression on me.
NPC_HZ_75_5: Trinkets and knickknacks. I'm just a small merchant trying to make a living.
NPC_HZ_75_6: My wife got hurt during the Temporal Disruption, and that drove up the expenses.
NPC_HZ_80_1: There's nothing about this plant anywhere...
NPC_HZ_80_3: Oh, what you got there is a Silver Lotus. We use it for food. It's nothing special.
NPC_HZ_80_4: If you're interested, I can give you some from my house.
NPC_HZ_80_5: Thank you, ma'am, but it's all right. I can pick some when I do my research in the mountains.
NPC_HZ_80_7: Come over for dinner, I'll make my signature Silver Lotus dish.
NPC_HZ_80_8: Won't that be too much trouble?
NPC_HZ_80_9: No trouble at all! You don't get that outside Mt. Firmament. It is said Silver Lotuses only grow in snow patches where the Sentinel has been.
NPC_HZ_80_10: What? Silver Lotuses have something to do with the Sentinel? It sounds like a myth, but still, it could be a nice subject for a paper...
NPC_HZ_85_1: Why is this treasure chest not spitting anything out...?
NPC_HZ_85_2: That's not a treasure chest, Great-Great-Grandpa. It's a vending machine.
NPC_HZ_85_5: See, you feed it Shell Credits according to the listed price.
NPC_HZ_85_6: Then press the button underneath the item you want.
NPC_HZ_85_7: Okay, okay, I got it now.
NPC_HZ_85_8: Isn't this just a stall in the form of a machine?
NPC_HZ_85_9: Well, you could say that, yes.
NPC_HZ_86_1: You're not from around here, are you?
NPC_HZ_86_3: How about the old man from earlier in the day?
NPC_HZ_86_4: What a coincidence. I'm from Jinzhou, here to trace my roots. I should be around for a while.
NPC_HZ_86_5: We're all outsiders. Why don't we get acquainted, so we can help each other out in town?
NPC_HZ_86_6: You mean Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong? I walked him home before the night got cold.
NPC_HZ_86_8: According to my family history, he's my grandfather's grandfather.
NPC_HZ_86_9: But given how unstable time moved in Mt. Firmament before, it could be off.
NPC_HZ_86_10: Nevertheless, Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong is our patriarch. That's for sure. He could recognize all the stuff our family brought with them when they moved from Mt. Firmament to Jinzhou.
NPC_HZ_86_11: The reason I came to Mt. Firmament is to trace my roots. The older folks in my family always wanted nothing more than to return to their hometown and reunite with long-lost relatives.
NPC_HZ_86_12: But they passed away before making it happen...
NPC_HZ_86_13: So you could say I've come with all their wishes and dreams on my shoulder. I feel grateful and blessed to have met Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong.
NPC_HZ_86_14: How are you two getting along?
NPC_HZ_86_15: It doesn't seem like you're communicating well with him.
NPC_HZ_86_16: He's treating me just fine, especially given the generation gap between us. Then, you add Mt. Firmament's isolation on top—of course, there are communication issues.
NPC_HZ_86_17: Well, one step at a time.
NPC_HZ_90_1: Yes, it's nice to have someone to chat with. This is relaxing for me.
NPC_HZ_90_2: To be honest, I still feel a lingering fear whenever I think about the Temporal Disruption in Mt. Firmament. Even though it's in the past now, I'm still tense as a tightrope.
NPC_HZ_90_4: It's just that I'm worried I won't be able to manage everything or that the supplies in my shop might run short.
NPC_HZ_90_5: Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with the Magistrate and Lady Xinyi holding down the fort.
NPC_HZ_90_6: That's why I've seen a lot of patients lately. Some have injuries that could cause complications later if not treated correctly.
NPC_HZ_90_8: I can't deny it's hard work, but it's also my duty as a healer to treat patients. I chose to do it, so no complaints.
NPC_HZ_90_9: Sigh, I just hope everyone will get well soon.
NPC_HZ_95_1: Sigh, it's great to be young, not like this old body, aches, and pain everywhere.
NPC_HZ_95_2: Can't even leave the house without Zhonglin’s prescriptions and those magic Sagaci Springs.
NPC_HZ_95_5: Zhonglin's been studying medicine in his grandfather's footsteps since childhood and is now our most trusted doctor here. He's the one we see to treat illness.
NPC_HZ_95_6: His prescriptions don't always conform to convention, but you can't argue the result.
NPC_HZ_95_7: Not to mention after all these years, he knows our conditions the best, so I trust him.
NPC_HZ_95_8: Haha, you're asking the right guy. I can be a chatterbox when it comes to our local Sagaci Springs.
NPC_HZ_95_9: I don't know much about the medical theory behind it, but I know I feel great and relaxed when I get into one.
NPC_HZ_95_10: Head south down that road and you'll find a delightful hot spring.
NPC_HZ_95_11: You should check it out when you get a chance.  Trust me, Mt. Firmament's Sagaci Springs will not disappoint.

NPC_HZ_150_1: The last we left off, the TD Outbreak had just hit and ravaged the land. Our Hongzhen ancestors staunchly defended the mountain but were on their last legs...
NPC_HZ_150_2: In the bleakest moment, however, a powerful figure came riding in from the East!
NPC_HZ_150_3: The figure's eyes shined like stars under the dark clouds. {Male=He;Female=She} merely pointed a finger for the Mianloong Chamber to open and the Sentinel to pierce through the sky.
NPC_HZ_150_4: In the Sentinel's glory, the Tacet Discord could not move another inch or cause any harm.
NPC_HZ_150_5: As the dark clouds dispersed and light returned to Mt. Firmament, the people were safe once more.
NPC_HZ_150_6: As for who the mysterious figure was and the legendary tales that followed, stay tuned until next time!
NPC_HZ_30_1: Hey, we got a big crowd today. This is great.
NPC_HZ_30_2: Any more than this and my eyes won't be able to keep up.
NPC_HZ_30_4: It's those brats again... I told them not to mess with the guests' stuff. What's so interesting about those walking suitcases, anyway?
NPC_HZ_30_5: This won't do, I need to go over and have a word with them.
NPC_HZ_31_1: Three new faces... Yup, got it.
NPC_HZ_32_2: Uneventful is the best event we can hope for.
NPC_HZ_33_1: It's quite chilly today. Gotta remind Jiye to keep warm at night when I'm back.
NPC_HZ_34_1: Nothing suspicious happened last night, right?
NPC_HZ_34_4: Same old, same old for the both of us.
NPC_HZ_34_5: Say, since the Midnight Rangers are here, shouldn't we retire?
NPC_HZ_34_7: Look at you with that stubborn temper of yours. I was just spewing random thoughts. Why are you taking it so seriously?
NPC_HZ_34_9: Sigh. You know, the future of Hongzhen is in young people's hands. It's time we let go.
NPC_HZ_35_1: You're... What is it again... {PlayerName}! Right?
NPC_HZ_35_5: Hehe, you're the savior of Mt. Firmament, {PlayerName}. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
NPC_HZ_35_6: You kids sure love to joke around. I may be old, but my eyes are still sharp.
NPC_HZ_35_7: You're the savior of Mt. Firmament, {PlayerName}. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
NPC_HZ_35_8: Hehehe, there's nothing in town I don't know about, much less you and the Magistrate. You're the saviors of Mt. Firmament.
NPC_HZ_35_9: Hongzhen suffered the TD Outbreak generations back. It was Sentinel who preserved the town.
NPC_HZ_35_10: But the joy we're relishing now is all thanks to you kids.
NPC_HZ_35_11: Out with the old, in with the new. The younger generation is pushing forward. Times sure are changing.
NPC_HZ_40_1: The old man seems to be napping. Best not to disturb him.
NPC_HZ_42_1: The old man is watching every passerby with sharp eyes.
NPC_HZ_45_1: Xunwei and Lili aren't in town today. I wonder where they went...
NPC_HZ_46_2: I want to be like them...
NPC_HZ_47_1: Yi'an has been feeling down lately...
NPC_HZ_47_2: Talk to him when you have the time.
NPC_HZ_48_1: Excuse me, but did you just get back from the mountain? Did you see Xunwei and Lili?
NPC_HZ_48_2: They are both researchers from Huaxu Academy, wearing uniforms, and are about my age.
NPC_HZ_48_5: Maybe, but I can't recall for sure.
NPC_HZ_48_6: I see, so they did go into the mountain for research.
NPC_HZ_48_7: It's okay. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
NPC_HZ_48_8: It's okay. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
NPC_HZ_48_9: I'd really like to see Xunwei and Lili's work routine. I think I can learn a lot even just by watching them work.
NPC_HZ_48_10: But you're from Hongzhen, so how did you know them?
NPC_HZ_48_11: There was a blizzard a few days ago. They and Wei took shelter in my house. We chatted and got to know each other.
NPC_HZ_48_12: From then on, they come to see me whenever they're free and share all kinds of interesting things.
NPC_HZ_48_13: Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves...
NPC_HZ_48_14: I never thought I could see the world through such a perspective. Things I thought couldn't be any more ordinary turned out to be so interesting and... valuable.
NPC_HZ_48_15: Maybe I'm daydreaming here, but I thought perhaps I could become a Huaxu researcher, too, like Xunwei, Lili, and Wei.
NPC_HZ_48_16: At least I'm working toward that goal.
NPC_HZ_48_17: Being a researcher takes a lot of effort.
NPC_HZ_48_18: That's a nice aspiration, but how do you plan to achieve it?
NPC_HZ_48_20: Lili told me that, too, but I'm determined.
NPC_HZ_48_21: I think there are very few things in this world that are easy... If they all take an effort anyway, might as well do what you like.
NPC_HZ_48_22: I plan to head to Jinzhou to study.
NPC_HZ_48_23: I must take my first step. More doing, less talking. That's what I learned from Xunwei.
NPC_HZ_48_24: But before I do that, I want to say goodbye to Yi'an.
NPC_HZ_48_25: Yi'an is my best friend. We grew up together. I don't want him to be troubled by my decision.
NPC_HZ_50_1: I don't get it. Why leave Mt. Firmament?
NPC_HZ_51_1: Sigh... How should I bring it up to Yuanzhi?
NPC_HZ_52_1: I don't see anything wrong with relaxing in the sun every day.
NPC_HZ_52_2: I'd live that way for the rest of my life if I could.
NPC_HZ_53_1: You're not a Hongzhen local, are you? Where are you from? Jinzhou?
NPC_HZ_53_6: Well, still an outsider, no matter how you slice it.
NPC_HZ_53_7: Can you tell me what's cool or interesting out there, then?
NPC_HZ_53_8: I got a friend... who's been talking about leaving Mt. Firmament to see the outside.
NPC_HZ_53_9: But I just don't get it. What's so special out there that it's worth giving up this comfortable life for?
NPC_HZ_53_10: Uh, if I may... I've noticed that a lot of people from outside are always so busy, rushing around as if they've got something urgent to attend to, and they never seem to stop.
NPC_HZ_53_11: I... I don't want my best friend to end up like that too...
NPC_HZ_53_12: It's a much more fulfilling and colorful life outside Mt. Firmament.
NPC_HZ_53_13: We're not rushing, just working hard.
NPC_HZ_53_14: You can relax and have fun anywhere if you want to.
NPC_HZ_53_15: Maybe your friend doesn't enjoy this kind of life.
NPC_HZ_53_16: But Mt. Firmament has its appeals, too. There are lots of things I haven't done yet.
NPC_HZ_53_17: Ahem, just to be clear, I'm not lazy or anything. I still take care of my responsibilities and do what needs to be done.
NPC_HZ_53_18: But the lifestyle outside Mt. Firmament has to be different, right? I just don't see her living the same carefree life out there.
NPC_HZ_53_19: Let me put it this way... I grew up with Yuanzhi, so I know full well what she likes.
NPC_HZ_53_20: But ever since Mt. Firmament connected with the outside world, it's like she's become another person...
NPC_HZ_53_21: Why don't you go ask her how she really feels?
NPC_HZ_53_23: I've never discussed things like this with her before... Let me think about it...
NPC_HZ_54_1: Have you talked to Yuanzhi yet?
NPC_HZ_54_3: She told you everything, I presume?
NPC_HZ_54_4: She wants to go to school in Jinzhou and maybe become a researcher... That's what she said.
NPC_HZ_54_5: Being a researcher doesn't sound that impressive to me...
NPC_HZ_54_6: I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great.
NPC_HZ_54_7: There are pros and cons in either choice.
NPC_HZ_54_8: What Yuanzhi needs is your understanding.
NPC_HZ_54_9: You're just afraid of losing a friend.
NPC_HZ_54_10: Well, I'm not trying to say who's right or wrong. Everybody has their own perspective.
NPC_HZ_54_11: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
NPC_HZ_54_12: We've been friends for years, so I can understand her...
NPC_HZ_54_13: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
NPC_HZ_54_15: I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
NPC_HZ_54_16: The gap between me and her seems to grow wider and wider...
NPC_HZ_54_17: Regardless, I still respect her decision to become a researcher. After all, it's the path she's chosen for herself.
NPC_HZ_54_18: I wouldn't like it either if she were telling me how to live my life.
NPC_HZ_54_19: She's my friend, so the least I can do is wish her happiness.
NPC_HZ_60_1: It's you, {PlayerName}. It's been a while.
NPC_HZ_60_2: How's your trip so far? Hongzhen has changed a lot, hasn't it?
NPC_HZ_60_3: It's a lot busier than before.
NPC_HZ_60_4: It's a lot safer than before.
NPC_HZ_60_5: Not as much as I imagined.
NPC_HZ_60_6: Well, Hongzhen is what it is now, all thanks to you and the Magistrate.
NPC_HZ_60_7: Yeah, thanks to you and our Madam Magistrate, the old Hongzhen is back.
NPC_HZ_60_8: Haha, that is true. Hongzhen was a peaceful, happy town before the Temporal Disruption.
NPC_HZ_60_9: Yeah, thanks to you and our Madam Magistrate, the old Hongzhen is back.
NPC_HZ_60_10: Oh, you should stick around longer this time. Try the Sagaci Springs, or check out the Water Plums.
NPC_HZ_60_11: Sorry I can't hang out with you this time. Lady Xinyi's got me joining up with the Midnight Rangers from Jinzhou, so I'll be pretty occupied for a while.
NPC_HZ_60_13: I prefer to be alone, anyway.

HelpText_73_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered. There's a maximum limit to the number of Technical Points that can be earned from each challenge.

[About]
Uncle Fu says that he has a magical item.
It's said that this item is shaped like a scale and has a magical power called Chrono Trace that can make people relive moments from their past...

[Eligibility]
Complete the prerequisite side quest Scale of Past.
The side quest Scale of Past unlocks after completing the main quests Jinzhou Rising: Thaw of Eons.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...

This system is permanently available, and Traces of Mt. Firmament can still be accessed via Trace Scale after the event ends.

Daily_BWGJ_1_3: My stomach hurts... I got food poisoning from accidentally eating the wrong herb to be more precise.
Daily_BWGJ_1_4: Should I take you to a clinic?
Daily_BWGJ_1_5: No need, I'm a doctor myself. I've checked my pulse and it's nothing too serious.
Daily_BWGJ_1_6: I just didn't expect this herb to be poisonous. It was supposed to be safe. I should've been more careful.
Daily_BWGJ_1_7: What herb did you take exactly?
Daily_BWGJ_1_8: According to the Supplement to Great Pharmacopoeia, it's a herb called the Loong's Pearl.
Daily_BWGJ_1_9: The pharmacopoeia says that it isn't poisonous—on the contrary, it can dissolve toxins from plants, wood, metal, and stones.
Daily_BWGJ_1_10: I suspect there might be some errors in the pharmacopoeia, or maybe I mixed up two similar herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_1_11: May I take a look at it?
Daily_BWGJ_1_12: Uh... sure. I've got it with me. Here.
Daily_BWGJ_1_14: What is it? Did you find anything?
Daily_BWGJ_1_15: There's a note in the appendix in fine script.
Daily_BWGJ_1_16: Really? Let me see... "The Loong's Pearl is a fine medicine, but where fine medicine grows, poison also flourishes. Neighboring the Loong's Pearl there usually grows a poisonous herb known as the Yunjiao Gall, which causes unending stomach pain when consumed."
Daily_BWGJ_1_17: "It resembles the Loong's Pearl, so be careful not to mix them up."
Daily_BWGJ_1_18: I see... Sorry, I should have read more carefully.
Daily_BWGJ_1_19: Wait, there's more. It also mentions an antidote: "Loong's Pearl can counteract the poison. The most potent ones thrive under waterfalls and have a strong fragrance."
Daily_BWGJ_1_21: An antidote growing near poisonous herbs... It aligns with the pharmacological theories. Looks like this isn't a mistake.
Daily_BWGJ_1_22: Could you help me find a Loong's Pearl beneath the waterfall? I'd go myself, but I really can't walk now.
Daily_BWGJ_2_1: You... you're back... Did you find the herb?
Daily_BWGJ_2_3: Hmm... the slight blue hue, the faint glow, and the aromatic scent. Yes, it matches the description in the pharmacopoeia.
Daily_BWGJ_2_4: According to the records, it can be consumed directly if in an emergency, although it might be more effective after processed.
Daily_BWGJ_2_6: You might not have time to wait that long.
Daily_BWGJ_2_7: Shinong puts the Loong's Pearl in his mouth and begins chewing. His pain visibly eases.
Daily_BWGJ_2_8: Phew... Much better. It looks like the pharmacopoeia's description of the Loong's Pearl was accurate. Thank you.
Daily_BWGJ_2_9: Why did you eat the herb in the first place anyway?
Daily_BWGJ_2_10: Ah, that's a long story. Allow me to formally introduce myself. I'm Shinong, a doctor from Jinzhou.
Daily_BWGJ_2_11: I've been studying ancient pharmacopoeias and medical books from all over Huanglong.
Daily_BWGJ_2_12: While the medical practices of Huanglong share the same roots, many ancient texts have been lost over time.
Daily_BWGJ_2_13: Luckily, Hongzhen has managed to preserve some texts that may have been lost elsewhere.
Daily_BWGJ_2_14: But over the years, as supplements are made, all pharmacopoeias and medical books inevitably suffer from confusions and omissions.
Daily_BWGJ_2_15: They even include some superstitions that are completely unrelated to medicine.
Daily_BWGJ_2_17: For example, there's a remedy that involves holding a rooster at exactly noon, jumping three times under the eaves, and then spinning around three times. It's said that if the rooster crows at that moment, it will drive away any plague.
Daily_BWGJ_2_20: While it might be a fun folklore activity, in practice it doesn't do anything to treat any illnesses.
Daily_BWGJ_2_21: That's why I wanted to revise these pharmacopoeias—to remove the unnecessary parts and correct the errors.
Daily_BWGJ_2_22: And the best way to do this is to try each herb personally and observe any reactions.
Daily_BWGJ_2_23: This way, I can determine their effects and uncover any side effects not mentioned in the texts.
Daily_BWGJ_2_25: Don't worry. After generations of supplements and revisions, I'm certain any herb that poses significant health risks are all highlighted in these pages.
Daily_BWGJ_2_26: Worst-case scenario, it would just be minor mishaps, like what happened earlier. Such risks are predictable and entirely manageable.
Daily_BWGJ_2_27: Oh, as a token of gratitude, here's some tonic that I brewed.
Daily_BWGJ_2_29: Don't worry. I brewed it using my proven recipe.
Daily_BWGJ_2_30: Until we meet again, friend. I wish you good health.
Daily_BWGJ_3_2: You didn't eat any odd herbs today, did you?
Daily_BWGJ_3_4: I read an anecdote in Hongzhen Chronicles about a young man from a few hundred years ago who discovered that Pavo Plums has temporary memory-enhance effects.
Daily_BWGJ_3_5: He memorized all the texts of Hongzhen with the help of Pavo Plum's incredible effects, earning him the nickname "the Walking Bookshelf."
Daily_BWGJ_3_6: So... you know. I want to try it.
Daily_BWGJ_3_8: You sure something like that exists?
Daily_BWGJ_3_9: I agree that the story might be fictional. But there might be some truth behind it.
Daily_BWGJ_3_10: I've always been gathering Pavo Plums from around this area. But according to Hongzhen Chronicles, only those "found near the hot spring and that can slightly heat up" has medical effects.
Daily_BWGJ_3_11: But I've searched everywhere near the hot spring and haven't found any Pavo Plums like the ones described.
Daily_BWGJ_3_12: I could give you a hand with it.
Daily_BWGJ_4_1: {PlayerName}, did you find any heated Pavo Plums?
Daily_BWGJ_4_2: Exactly as the chronicles described... I didn't expect it to exist. Interesting... But it could be a mutation.
Daily_BWGJ_4_5: H-haha. Don't be upset. Presumption is the first step toward truth.
Daily_BWGJ_4_6: I suspect that the surrounding heat might have induced some changes in these Pavo Plums... potentially altering their medicinal effects.
Daily_BWGJ_4_7: Now, {PlayerName}, could you please say something after I eat the Pavo Plum?
Daily_BWGJ_4_8: Sure, what would you like me to say?
Daily_BWGJ_4_9: Anything will do, preferably something long and complicated. I want to test if it truly helps improve memory.
Daily_BWGJ_4_10: As soon as Shinong finishes the Pavo Plum, his face twists into a peculiar expression.
Daily_BWGJ_4_12: What is it? Is it poisonous?
Daily_BWGJ_4_13: It's so SPICY! I've tasted countless herbs, but I've never tasted anything this SPICY before!
Daily_BWGJ_4_14: Wait, I think it's working... Say something, Rover. Anything!
Daily_BWGJ_4_15: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if—
Daily_BWGJ_4_16: Oh, my lord, I beg your forgiveness—
Daily_BWGJ_4_17: You effortlessly recite a passage from a tongue twister.
Daily_BWGJ_4_18: You passionately perform a monologue from a movie film.
Daily_BWGJ_4_20: Did you catch all of that?
Daily_BWGJ_4_22: Whole thing sounded like a bust from the get-go.
Daily_BWGJ_4_23: That doesn't mean all myths are false.
Daily_BWGJ_4_24: After all, it's just a fictional anecdote that can't be taken too seriously. But you never know unless you give it a try.
Daily_BWGJ_4_25: Perhaps. If I've learned anything from revising these pharmacopoeias, it's never to underestimate the wisdom of those who came before us.
Daily_BWGJ_4_26: Anyway, these Pavo Plums don't show any special effects, even though they can absorbe heat... and are extremely spicy. Well, that's a small discovery, at least.
Daily_BWGJ_4_27: Thank you, {PlayerName}. There are still quite a few herbs from the pharmacopoeia that I haven't tried yet. I'll go and search for them now.
Daily_BWGJ_5_3: I fell off the hill by accident. Luckily I got away with only a swollen leg.
Daily_BWGJ_5_4: According to the pharmacopoeia, a herb called Elderflower grows on the hilltop, which is far more effective for treating external injuries than other herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_5_5: However, it appears I overestimated my athletic abilities.
Daily_BWGJ_5_6: Anyway... Ahem, I'll need your help again, {PlayerName}. Could you go to the hilltop and pick some Elderflowers for me?
Daily_BWGJ_5_7: Elderflowers grow at the top of that hill, so please be careful. But given your abilities, I'm sure it will be a piece of cake.
Daily_BWGJ_6_2: According to the pharmacopoeia, simply grind them into paste and apply it to the injury. It takes effect almost immediately.
Daily_BWGJ_6_3: Shinong applies the paste to his leg, wincing at the sharp sting it causes.
Daily_BWGJ_6_4: Ah... All right, this should do it now.
Daily_BWGJ_6_6: Much better... I should be back on my feet after a bit of rest.
Daily_BWGJ_6_7: You must find it strange, {PlayerName}. Why am I out here risking my life instead of treating others back at the clinic in Jinzhou?
Daily_BWGJ_6_8: Many believe that I'm doing this for fame and attention.
Daily_BWGJ_6_9: For minor ailments that could easily be treated with injections or pills, using herbs involves a lot of effort, including collecting, concocting, and refining the herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_6_10: ...They think it's meaningless, just a form of performative art and self-satisfaction. What do you think, {PlayerName}?
Daily_BWGJ_6_11: It's about carrying on the tradition.
Daily_BWGJ_6_12: Plus, many people still rely on it.
Daily_BWGJ_6_13: Exactly. These pharmacopoeias are the legacy of our ancestors' wisdom. Yet, nowadays, few are willing to put in the time to revise them.
Daily_BWGJ_6_14: As a result, the errors in these pharmacopoeias keep piling up, making them less and less trustworthy. Many people who could have been cured end up having their conditions worsen or prolonged due to incorrect treatments.
Daily_BWGJ_6_15: I'm not doing this for fame. I just want to preserve our ancestors' tradition and help more people avoid suffering.
Daily_BWGJ_6_17: ...No, it's just a simple wish. The wish of a doctor.
Daily_BWGJ_6_18: Maybe I'm just a humble doctor, but at least I have the courage to see it through.
Daily_BWGJ_6_19: I wish you all the best!
Daily_BWGJ_6_20: Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}. Don't worry, I'll get back in town soon.
Daily_BWGJ_7_1: Hello there, can you hear me? Hello?
Daily_BWGJ_7_3: ...Yes, I believe it's a type of migraine.
Daily_BWGJ_7_6: Based on my observation, he has a rare disease that is only documented in a pharmacopoeia.
Daily_BWGJ_7_8: ...It's tough. The disease can't be completely cured, and can only be alleviated with medication. However...
Daily_BWGJ_7_10: I found a prescription in a medicinal book... The note says it has little effect on this kind of migraine, but I think there is a flaw to it.
Daily_BWGJ_7_11: The prescription uses Silver Lotuses as the main ingredient, but it's not effective for the symptoms.
Daily_BWGJ_7_12: I recall from the Complete Interpretation of Lost Prescriptions that regular Silver Lotuses and those that are over ten years old have opposite effects.
Daily_BWGJ_7_13: After observing the migraine's symptoms and checking his pulse, I believe Silver Lotuses which have bloomed for over ten years should be the correct remedy.
Daily_BWGJ_7_14: In conclusion, the medicinal text likely mixed them up.
Daily_BWGJ_7_15: It's possible. There's a chance that a minor omission occurred during the transcription. Unfortunately, this small mistake was enough to render the disease untreatable.
Daily_BWGJ_7_16: I've administered some relieving medicine to the patient. {PlayerName}, could you go to the nearby hill and collect some Silver Lotuses that are over ten years old? I'll wait here for you.
Daily_BWGJ_8_1: This is it! It fits perfectly with the description in the pharmacopoeia. Well done, Rover!
Daily_BWGJ_8_2: I'll start concocting the medicine now... Please wait.
Daily_BWGJ_8_3: After a while, the patient takes the medicine and quickly regains consciousness.
Daily_BWGJ_8_4: ...Um. Wh-what happened? Did I... Oh right, I passed out again.
Daily_BWGJ_8_6: Did you help me? It's an old ailment. I've been managing it with medication, but I often...
Daily_BWGJ_8_7: ...Huh? But I feel so much better than before. How is that possible?!
Daily_BWGJ_8_8: I'll write you a prescription. Take the medicine as directed for a week and you should fully recover. If you still feel unwell, feel free to contact me anytime.
Daily_BWGJ_8_9: Fully recover? But my doctor said my condition is incurable. Are you... some kind of miracle workers?
Daily_BWGJ_8_11: Where is your clinic? I'll make a banner for you and send it over as soon as I get home!
Daily_BWGJ_8_12: No, no, there's no need for that. {PlayerName} is the one who gathered the herb. I just...
Daily_BWGJ_8_15: ...I just did what any doctor would do.
Daily_BWGJ_8_16: Nevertheless, please accept my deepest gratitude and respect for both of you.
Daily_BWGJ_8_17: I've made a lot of progress recently and have finished revising the  pharmacopoeias in Hongzhen.
Daily_BWGJ_8_18: I'll send them to the clinics. Hopefully, what I'm doing can benefit more people.
Daily_BWGJ_8_20: Next? There's a long journey ahead. The world is vast, and there are countless pharmacopoeias to rectify. I'm not sure how many I can complete.
Daily_BWGJ_8_21: But I will do my best.
