Activity_100600002_Desc: Dark flames dance in the Somnoire. This time, near the edge of dreams, you glimpse a familiar figure… At least here in your dreams, his ambition to engulf the world in flames shall forever burn.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_1_1: Check out these stones... All mined from Jinzhou!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_1_2: Our company's stones are top-notch and budget-friendly, with a wide range of options to choose from... And we can even deliver them right to your doorstep...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_1: Hey, it's you, {PlayerName}. Come, grab a drink.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_2: I totally screwed everything up. These past few days have been a complete waste of time. I barely made any money, and I haven't been able to get a foothold in the market at all.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_3: My transfer order should come through any day now. After that I'll be back in Jinzhou explaining to my boss how I messed everything up.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_5: Excuse me, {PlayerName}, I have to take this.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_6: Yongxin has a brief exchange with a client through his Terminal. Though a bit nervous, you can see a true salesman emerging right before you.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_7: ...So, did you just land a big deal?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_8: Yeah... I really didn't expect that.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_9: He said he's a merchant from Mengzhou looking to invest in tourism around Mt. Firmament.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_10: The mountain passes around Hongzhen have long fallen into disrepair and are no longer suitable for travel, so he plans to buy some stones and pave them up.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_11: He actually did not consider buying from us at first, but he happened to meet that researcher in Hongzhen on a business trip.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_12: After learning we supplied a batch of stones at a low price to support the scientific effort in Hongzhen, he seemed to think that demonstrated... a certain quality of our company.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_14: True. Good things tend to happen to good people, perhaps?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_15: I'm glad I made the right call that day, all thanks to you, Rover.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_17: For as long as I can remember, whether it was my family, teachers or colleagues, no one believed I could achieve anything.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_18: They would leave the most menial, insignificant jobs to me and never ask for my opinions.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_19: If it weren't for you, who were willing to put faith in me and believe that even someone like me could do it...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_20: I don't think... I would have never had the courage to make a decision.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_21: Why are you getting so emotional all of a sudden?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_22: It's not that big of a deal.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_23: I'm probably just too excited because I finally got a big deal.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_24: But I meant everything I just said.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_25: Okay, things are going to get busy from now. Thanks for helping me out, {PlayerName}.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_26: I learned a lot over the past few days. I feel like I'm ready to handle any sales opportunity that comes my way.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_27: Confidence is the key, after all.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_28: The beginning is always the hardest.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_29: That's right. But once you succeed, it's much easier the second time around...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_30: Oh, I gotta run back to Jinzhou. There's this big deal waiting for me to take care of.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_10_31: Thank you, Rover. I'll definitely be the greatest stone salesman in all of Jinzhou when we meet again!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_1: Please, everyone... at least look at what I'm selling.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_6: Oh... Are you a customer? Sorry, I thought everybody left.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_7: So, are you interested in our stones?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_9: I mean, who would buy stones on the street?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_10: Sigh. I know, right? I honestly don't know what the boss was thinking...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_11: I mean, who would buy this kind of stuff around here? See, all the houses here are built out of either wood or bricks.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_12: Not to mention most of the locals don't even have a Terminal.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_13: What do terminals have to do with selling stones?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_14: A lot. Before I got into sales, I worked in customer service.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_15: I just needed to type in some words online and everything's done.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_16: As for in person sales... I've never done that. And, uh, I get the jitters when I talk to people face-to-face.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_17: Plus... people on the street aren't interested in stones at all. I wouldn't know who to sell them to even if I wanted to...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_18: Relax, what can your stones be used for anyway?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_19: Fixing houses, generally, but hardly anyone does that even in Jinzhou nowadays.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_20: Or maybe paving roads? But that's not something anybody can just get up and do...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_22: Well, let me think... Oh, right, making statues!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_24: Thanks! I know who would want the stones now!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_25: Oh, would you... mind coming with me? There's no way I'll be able to get a deal on my own.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_26: Sure. I'm not doing anything right now anyway.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_2_27: Wow, thank you so much! I'll get stuff ready and meet you at the souvenir store in town!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_3: Yes! Is this your first time in Hongzhen and looking to buy something? Well, you've come to the right place!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_4: What would you like? We have Mt. Firmament oolong tea, made from tea leaves freshly picked this year using ancient techniques. It's only ten Shell Credits an ounce, with a money-back guarantee!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_5: Wait, we're not here to buy.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_6: Ah, it's you, {PlayerName}. Do you know this gentleman?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_9: Well, since it's your friend, I can give him 20% off all items in the store!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_10: (He's so much more professional in sales than I am...)
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_11: Ahem. No, actually, we're here... to sell.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_12: Sell? You mean like the herbs you found and gathered on your trip?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_14: Yes... yes, and quality stones for sculpting at that! We offer all kinds of them! Here's a sample... for you to... take a look.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_15: It does look nice, both the texture and color... But this is not from Mt. Firmament, is it?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_16: No, it isn't. I brought it with me from Jinzhou!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_17: Wait, is there something wrong with it?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_18: Not in the slightest! Our company has been in the stone business for over 10 years in Jinzhou. And we... we've always offered the best there is at affordable prices...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_19: Sounds a bit suspicious. If the rocks are fine, why are you so nervous?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_20: This is his first crack at sales. Please understand.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_21: I see. That explains a lot. When I first worked here, I couldn't even get a whole sentence out. It's okay, you just need more practice.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_22: All right, then let's get down to business. What's the price?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_24: That really is pretty cheap... I've heard that they have to rely on heavy-duty machinery to mine rocks out there, but this...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_25: Do you find the offer appealing?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_28: Is the price too high for you? That's fine, I'm sure we can work something out...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_29: It's not about the price. These statues were carved out of Mt. Firmament rocks.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_30: Mt. Firmament rocks...? Are they different from the ones in Jinzhou?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_31: Of course. Every rock in Mt. Firmament had been blessed by our great Sentinel.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_34: Well, I'm not joking with you. Don't believe me? Just take a look at that!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_35: Out the window? Is that... the Loong's Crest? Wait, the shape... Don't tell me...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_36: That's right. Not just Loong's Crest, the appearance of the entire Mt. Firmament was hand-chiseled by the ancestors of Hongzhen to resemble our Sentinel!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_38: It's okay, you're not the first to be blown away by this marvel. Like I've always said, the story of Mt. Firmament's Sentinel statue really should be included in the tourism pamphlet...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_39: All right, I got to get back to work. Hongzhen's been bustling with visitors lately. Catch you later, {PlayerName}.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_47: I guess I still got a lot to learn about Hongzhen... I'll hang around and see if I can get new clients. If I work hard... I can definitely...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_48: You still have to conquer your anxiety first.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_49: My mind just... goes blank and I don't know what to say.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_50: Say what you say best, of course.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_51: Just repeat the words you were typing before.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_3_52: That's it...? That does make sense... Let me dwell on it. Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_3: And that's a lot of sweat.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_4: It... it's too hot here for sure. That's hot springs for you. Even the air feels hot...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_6: Here you are, finally. Tongchuan Pharmacy sent you, right? Do you have any idea how busy I am today, and you just got here? Where's my shipment?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_8: The medicine I ordered for spa therapy. Wait, why are you empty-handed?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_9: And {PlayerName}... when did you start working for Tongchuan Pharmacy?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_11: You got us mixed up with someone else.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_13: Oops, my mistake. He didn't look familiar to me so I thought he was from Tongchuan Pharmacy.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_14: But I don't have time for that right now. As you can see, I'm swamped here... And the fact that the medicine from Tongchuan Pharmacy still hasn't arrived yet makes it even worse.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_15: Oh, right! Can you check on the delivery for me, {PlayerName}? If I don't have the spa ready soon, I'll get complaints.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_5_17: Yes! I knew I could count on you!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_6_2: Here for some herbs? I just got a fine batch in from Jinzhou. They work wonders for both internal and external use.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_6_3: I'm here for the herbs for Spring's Taste.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_6_4: Oh my, can't believe that slipped my mind.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_6_5: I was going to send someone over this morning, but the guy called in sick. Xinyang must be getting impatient by now...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_6_6: Let me see... Yeah, should be these. Thanks for delivering them, {PlayerName}.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_2: Yes, this is it. I spent a lot of money on this new recipe. Now, all I have to do is put it in the hot spring.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_3: Dip in the hot spring just for fun, twice to dodge the flu and run, thrice for muscles feeling fine, four times to make sickness decline!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_4: Oh, the fellow over there... What did you want to see me for again?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_5: Excuse me, but... do you need stones for your hot spring?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_6: Stones? You mean for renovating the pool? No, because we're in peak season so it will cost me a lot of money to renovate now.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_7: How about rockery, got any of that?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_9: Tell me about your best product.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_10: ...Well, our rockery comes in a variety of styles, such as the Jinzhou border style, the Mengzhou garden style, and the newest luxury style from Huanglong capital. We also offer customization based on your own design, dear customer!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_11: Dear customer, you can order now for free shipping to Hongzhen, plus a three-year warranty! If you have any questions or need more information, please leave a message and I will...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_12: Ahem. You can stop right there.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_13: ...Is this how people from Jinzhou sell stuff nowadays? Sounds a bit weird... but it's actually kind of appealing?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_14: The best bang for your buck, dear customer.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_15: Your hot spring deserves the enticing look, dear customer.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_16: Hm... Indeed, I do think the spring is missing something, so if I added this...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_17: Phew, I guess that's one deal closed. Now I can face the boss.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_18: You seem to be under a lot of stress.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_19: Well, my boss was never optimistic about Hongzhen, or he would've never sent a low-man-on-the-totem-pole like me here.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_20: But I did it... I've taken the first step, and that's because I have your encouragement and help...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_21: So, what's up with the "dear customer" thing?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_22: Didn't you want me to say what I say best? That's all I know...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_23: I still came off a little nervous, but much better than before.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_7_24: Then I'll have to keep working at it. Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_1: It's simple, really. If we create a macroscopic node with Resonator A, we can use that as the coordinate to perform a three-dimensional expansion through inverse anisotropic frequency...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_2: So you want us to build a three-meter-tall marble control station from your model?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_3: No, no, I said three-dimensional expansion. It means, uh, taking apart the model's original four-dimensional structure...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_4: You need a four-legged stand, too? No problem. It can all be done as long as we have the blueprint.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_6: {PlayerName}! I was just telling this gentleman here about our latest project, but he... seems to be proposing a bolder, more profound approach.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_7: To be honest, some of the suggestions are quite inspirational, like the four-directional magnetic restraint he mentioned, despite the lack of practical proof...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_8: ...How did you two manage to communicate?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_10: How much of that did you get?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_11: This'll be a great learning experience.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_12: (Frankly, it's like a foreign language to me, except he's not a foreigner.)
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_15: He's here to make a sale.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_16: Oh, right, I remember now. Pardon me. I've been knee-deep in the new project...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_17: Phew... Thanks, {PlayerName}. Now we can finally get back to business.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_18: You must be the hunter we hired to collect Scarefrost Deer samples, right?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_20: He's the stone merchant you were looking for.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_21: Ha.. haha... Oh, is that so? Oh right... I think I did mention something like that.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_22: Actually, we've been working on a new project that mainly focuses on the impact of the Sentinel's time barrier on Mt. Firmament's ecology.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_23: As you can tell, even though the time barrier is gone, the residual effect caused the snow to be permanent, leading to the unique ecology you have now.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_24: The environment may appear stable now, but who can guarantee it won't collapse or become disastrous for Mt. Firmament in a few years or decades?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_25: What's that got to do with stones?
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_26: The people of Hongzhen believe that Sentinel's power has seeped into the rocks of Mt. Firmament.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_27: Therefore, comparing the frequencies of the rocks of Mt. Firmament to those from other areas could give us a clue to what's really going on.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_28: Ahem... but there's a... big hurdle.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_29: We're running out of budget. It's the director's fault. No matter how miraculous Mt. Firmament is, we just can't afford all these projects at once...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_31: So... can you give me a discount? Please, the future of Mt. Firmament is at stake.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_32: But what I'm offering is already really low... We still have to haul the stones all the way from Jinzhou, and we might even run into Tacet Fields on the way...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_33: This is a very crucial study, so please...
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_35: It's your decision to make, Yongxin.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_37: But I... I can't make the call. I'm a nobody... I'm not even a professional salesman.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_39: *sigh* I must be out of my mind... Fine, I'll sell them to you at cost price.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_40: Really? That's wonderful! I'll put in a budget request right now!
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_41: This probably isn't going to work out for me... The boss might fire me on the spot when I get back.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_43: I don't know. But they seemed so passionate... and committed.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_44: I looked into the research station before I came. They declined generous offers in Jinzhou and other places to work in these makeshift conditions.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_45: I don't understand exactly what they're studying, but I know it's important.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_47: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I feel much better now.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_48: I'm still a little bummed-out about it, though... It took me so long to get to this point.
Daliy_CLKSCWJPTXYB_9_49: Your hard work will pay off.

POI_ZLYZ_3_2: It smells delicious! Let's feed her, quick! And hey, don't forget to save some for me!
POI_ZLYZ_3_3: (Feed the unconscious girl some Milky Fish Soup.)
POI_ZLYZ_3_5: The girl regains consciousness and slowly rises to her feet.
POI_ZLYZ_3_6: Phew... Thank you. I feel much better now.

NPC_HZ_8_7: I'm afraid I'd give the wrong information. I have no confidence at all.
NPC_HZ_8_9: Yes, I'm from Hongzhen, but most of my knowledge about the town comes from my family. I'm no expert.
NPC_HZ_8_10: I haven't even been to many of the places in Mt. Firmament.
NPC_HZ_8_11: Practice more and you'll be more confident.
NPC_HZ_8_12: Learn more and you'll be more confident.
NPC_HZ_8_13: I see... Thanks for the suggestion. I'll work on that.
NPC_HZ_9_1: Hongzhen was founded very early. It was thriving when Jinzhou was just an idea.
NPC_HZ_9_2: Back then, Hongzhen rivaled Jinzhou now.
NPC_HZ_9_3: That's also the reason many scholars believe Hongzhen is not only the ancestral land of the early settlers of Jinzhou, but also the predecessor of Jinzhou itself.
NPC_HZ_9_4: As you can see, the houses that have been preserved in town share many similarities with Jinzhou architecture.

Side_HZBJT_1_1: Ah, you must be the Rover!
Side_HZBJT_1_4: Let me introduce myself. I'm Xunjing, an editor for Wutherium Geographic.
Side_HZBJT_1_5: Word travels fast at the Pioneer Association. I heard you're the hero of Jinzhou and Hongzhen. If I wasn't working for a geography magazine, I'd snatch the chance to feature you in a heartbeat...
Side_HZBJT_1_6: Haha... Sorry, occupational habit. Ahem, speaking of which, I'm in the middle of a career crisis.
Side_HZBJT_1_8: Well, um... our magazine's cooking up something special about Hongzhen's cultural scene.
Side_HZBJT_1_9: Unfortunately, we're staring down the barrel of the deadline, and we're missing a few crucial snaps in our stack...
Side_HZBJT_1_10: If I mess this up, the editor-in-chief will have my head!
Side_HZBJT_1_11: I hate to admit it, but I'm not exactly a pro with a camera, despite running the photography column.
Side_HZBJT_1_12: And it's too late to call in a photographer from Jinzhou now. Say, you've got a knack for photography too, don't you?
Side_HZBJT_1_15: Ha! You're just as modest as they say you are.
Side_HZBJT_1_17: In that case, if you have time... Could you take a few photos for me? Just three, four shots.
Side_HZBJT_1_19: Thank you! You'll be doing me a great service.
Side_HZBJT_1_20: Oh, right, mind if I accompany you? I could use a bit of a wander myself, you know, just in case a bolt of inspiration decides to pay me a visit!
Side_HZBJT_2_1: Hongzhen is famous for its Sagaci Springs. Let's go take some photos of the hot springs.
Side_HZBJT_3_1: Here we are! Let's look for the perfect spot...
Side_HZBJT_3_2: Oh, look at that ancient tree! Such a picturesque sight! Come, let's capture it!
Side_HZBJT_4_1: A quaint hot spring, nestled under the shade of an ancient tree... The setting is perfect!
Side_HZBJT_4_2: While the world changes around us, Hongzhen's timeless traditions live on.
Side_HZBJT_4_3: Here, people soak in the same springs their ancestors did, washing away their worries with the same clear waters.
Side_HZBJT_4_5: Now, back to business... I spotted some peculiar rings on the mountains across the gate. Let's capture them.
Side_HZBJT_5_1: Wow... quite the spectacle. I wonder what these massive rings are for. Could they be... ancient ceremonial sites of Hongzhen's forebears?
Side_HZBJT_5_2: No... they might be relics from the Pre-Lament era. Hmm... Perhaps colossal colliders or planetary engines? Anyway, let's snap a picture.
Side_HZBJT_6_1: Let me have a look... Hm, this turned out pretty good. Maybe we'll feature it in an "Explore Hongzhen" column. Already got the headline: "The Mountain Town's Unsolved Riddle."
Side_HZBJT_6_2: But let's include the peaks flanking the rings in our shot. That'll give a sense of how enormous and awe-inspiring they are.
Side_HZBJT_7_1: Oh, perfect! That's the angle we want! This shot will be a winner.
Side_HZBJT_7_2: Stand over here to take it!
Side_HZBJT_8_1: Hmm... Can we get a panoramic view of the whole of Hongzhen from here?
Side_HZBJT_9_1: From up here, every part of the town is visible. Ancient relics and market stalls dot the landscape, connected by winding footpaths.
Side_HZBJT_9_2: What's surprising is, despite the ancient lore painting Hongzhen as an isolated paradise, what I see is a vibrant, bustling community.
Side_WQDMX_1_2: It appears you've been busy lately.
Side_WQDMX_1_3: You're right. With Hongzhen back to normal, we've been swamped here at the gate... I never thought life here could get this busy.
Side_WQDMX_1_4: So, {PlayerName}, have you come to help us?
Side_WQDMX_1_5: Is there something I can help with?
Side_WQDMX_1_6: Of course! In fact, there’s a job that would be just right for you.
Side_WQDMX_1_7: There are a few hot springs around Hongzhen. Ordinarily, we monitor the water periodically to check for contamination from Tacet Discords or the like.
Side_WQDMX_1_8: But as you can see, we've been short on manpower lately. Inspections were due days ago, but we haven't had anyone available to send...
Side_WQDMX_1_10: Equipment? No, no, no, we don't bother with that sort of thing here. Here in Hongzhen, we rely on the Pavo Plums by the hot springs to check the water, just as our ancestors did.
Side_WQDMX_1_12: How... how do you use them?
Side_WQDMX_1_13: The Pavo Plum plant is highly sensitive to its environment. It absorbs harmful substances from its surroundings, leading to slight changes in its appearance.
Side_WQDMX_1_14: Basically, I just give the Pavo Plum a good whiff, check its hue, and give it a quick lick. That’ll tell me all I need to know about the water's quality.
Side_WQDMX_1_16: Hey, don't give me that look!
Side_WQDMX_1_17: I'm as local as it gets! Ever since I—no, ever since my Grandpa was a baby, we've always done it this way.
Side_WQDMX_1_18: Now, there are three hot springs needing inspection, and they're just a stone's throw away. I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}!
Side_WQDMX_3_1: This is my analysis. Hmm... It lacks adequate theoretical support and empirical validation, but I am resolved to... maintain my stance.
Side_WQDMX_3_2: Save it, please. This is art. Creation. It defies the cold logic of mere numbers!
Side_WQDMX_3_8: Ah... it's {PlayerName}! You have perfect timing. We were just discussing which foods taste better when cooked in hot spring water.
Side_WQDMX_3_9: Trust me, I've been around. When it comes to cooking things in a hot spring, your first thought would be an egg, right?
Side_WQDMX_3_10: I beg to differ. An egg has a shell! Boiling it in a hot spring is no different than boiling it in regular water.
Side_WQDMX_3_11: Corn, however, can really absorb all the good stuff from the hot spring. But eggs? ZERO ABSORPTION!
Side_WQDMX_3_12: ...Like I said, cuisine is an art, not a science!
Side_WQDMX_3_13: Who likes plain old boiled eggs anyway?!
Side_WQDMX_3_14: This is what you're arguing about?
Side_WQDMX_3_15: We're at a stalemate here, so it's up to you—yes, you! Which food do you think tastes better when cooked in a hot spring?
Side_WQDMX_3_18: Look, even {PlayerName} agrees. Eggs boiled in hot springs are the best! That's what I call art!
Side_WQDMX_3_19: Hmph, just as I expected. {PlayerName} always makes judgments with wisdom and reason.
Side_WQDMX_3_20: At this moment, an elderly man shuffles over unsteadily.
Side_WQDMX_3_21: I could hear you quarreling from a mile away... Cough, none of you are from Hongzhen, are you?
Side_WQDMX_3_22: This spring's barely warmer than body heat. It's not even good for a hot bath, let alone boiling food in it.
Side_WQDMX_3_24: How embarrassing... We should have inspected the hot spring first before our discussion...
Side_WQDMX_3_25: If it's spring fare you're after, make your way to Spring's Taste.
Side_WQDMX_3_26: They've got a spring nearly boiling over—perfect for cooking up local specialties. It's a well-known delight in Hongzhen.
Side_WQDMX_3_27: That water’s hot enough to perfectly steam a chicken, let alone eggs or corn.
Side_WQDMX_3_29: My mouth is already beginning to water!
Side_WQDMX_3_30: In that case, should we go take a look later?
Side_WQDMX_4_1: Look at that! Finally, an unguarded hot spring!
Side_WQDMX_4_2: We traveled so far and endured so much, all... all for this moment.
Side_WQDMX_4_4: You feel it, don't you? Our hard work paid off! Ah, and that faint scent of sulfur... Just standing here is already washing away all the exhaustion.
Side_WQDMX_4_5: Um... It's not that. Boss, I'm trying to say...
Side_WQDMX_4_7: Does that person over there... look familiar?
Side_WQDMX_4_8: Ah... it's that... What were they calling {Male=him;Female=her}?
Side_WQDMX_5_2: How was that even possible? We had the numbers...
Side_WQDMX_5_3: Are you here for the hot springs?
Side_WQDMX_5_4: Of course. We pulled off a mission just days ago, now today we need to—
Side_WQDMX_5_5: —That's right! We heard that the hot springs in Hongzhen were the best, so we left Jinzhou looking for them. We've been behaving ourselves perfectly all the way, I swear!
Side_WQDMX_5_6: Forgive us, we didn't know you were in charge of this hot spring. It's just, we weren't allowed in Hongzhen, so we had to—
Side_WQDMX_5_8: No, no! That’s not it, you see, what I meant was... We couldn't pay the admission! Yes, we couldn't pay the admission fee to the hot spring!
Side_WQDMX_5_10: Really. Ever since the day when you and that monk showed us a better way, we've been reforming our ways. We even helped Lollo Logistics to deliver goods the other day!
Side_WQDMX_5_11: Ha... Well, this was all just a misunderstanding. Let's skedaddle, shall we?
Side_WQDMX_5_12: Don't let me catch you a third time.
Side_WQDMX_5_13: You got it. From here on out, we'll be model citizens, contributing positively to society.
Side_WQDMX_5_14: The exiles leave in a hurry.
Side_WQDMX_6_1: Good, I've gathered all the Pavo Plums Bing'ge requested.
Side_WQDMX_6_2: I'll head back to town now to deliver them.
Side_WQDMX_7_1: Oh, you're back. Did everything go well?
Side_WQDMX_7_2: Time for a little inspection... Hmm, color checks out. And the smell... all good.
Side_WQDMX_7_3: Now, onto the taste... Mmm... Yup, spot on.
Side_WQDMX_7_4: The zesty bitterness hits the spot. Seems like these hot springs are clean. Whew, I can finally breathe easy.
Side_WQDMX_7_5: By the way, happen to see anything interesting along the way?
Side_WQDMX_7_6: Flying fish in a hot spring?
Side_WQDMX_7_7: Two people arguing about eggs and corn?
Side_WQDMX_7_9: What in the world... Ha, that's got to be one heck of a story!
Side_WQDMX_7_11: But I'm on duty now. Ugh, should've skipped work to see it myself. This endless grind is driving me crazy!
Side_WQDMX_7_12: Anyway, thanks for the help, {PlayerName}. Until next time!

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_1: ...Please pardon my rudeness earlier. I... I didn't know you  were here to help Madam Magistrate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_3: You were just doing your job.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_5: First the Temporal Disruption, and now the Fractsidus. When will we ever get a break? If trouble finds us again, our people won't stand a chance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_6: Anyway, I still want to make it up to you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_7: Just give me a call if you need anything at Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_1: How are you feeling, Xiangping? Are you hurt? I'll call for help.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_4: Don't worry, my dear. No need to trouble the young ones.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_5: We were in a hurry and accidents happen. I'll be fine. I can handle it myself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_6: But... Are you sure? You've been feeling unwell for years, and now...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_1: You there, young {Male=man;Female=lady}. I bet you have more important things to do. Don't let an old man like me hold you back. Go and accomplish your tasks with purpose.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_3: My eyes may be old and blurry, but my mind is sharp as ever.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_4: I've lived my whole life in Mt. Firmament, but people are all the same no matter where you go. Our actions reveal our true character.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_5: And now, at this crucial turning point for Mt. Firmament, your arrival... Yes... It is no mere coincidence.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_6: In these troubled times, you may hold the key to bring about much-needed change.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_1: How did it go for you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_2: I saved as many people as possible and directed them to safety. But there were others... I did what I could.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_3: Don't beat yourself up, we acted quickly and saved a lot of lives.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_4: *sigh* It's all thanks to Lady Xinyi...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_5: I was so overwhelmed, my mind went blank. If she hadn't been there to give orders, I wouldn't have even made it out alive, let alone save anyone.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_6: It's rare to hear that from you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_7: I remember how much you opposed Uncle Fu's decision to let her take the reins back in the day.

NPC_HZ_88_1: What's wrong? Let me take a look.
NPC_HZ_96_1: Come one, come all... That's the phrase I learned from foreign customers. What do you think?
NPC_HZ_97_1: Anything you like over here? Affordable price, guaranteed.
NPC_HZ_98_1: All right, feel free to come back.
NPC_HZ_99_1: Say, why don't you pick out something else?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_250_1: How rude. This is not how we greet people here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_250_2: Allow me to demonstrate the proper etiquette.
Flow_312900000_3: I dreamed of something cool. I was planning to share it with you!
Flow_312900000_5: I'm happy to see you again.
Flow_312900000_7: I dreamed of a new world rising from the ashes of the old.
Flow_312900000_9: When did you escape from that prison?
Flow_312900000_10: Escape? There's no escaping the rolling wheels of history.
Flow_312900000_11: And you're about to witness my small contribution to the fire that will soon consume all...
Flow_312900000_12: Yeah, yeah, sure. In my dream or not...
Flow_312900000_13: ...you're just gonna be you, I guess.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_295_1: I can feel the Sentinel's presence inside, but it's not responding...
POI_ZLYZ_4_1: Hmm… The device in the mural is identical to this one. It must be what starts the Rite of Offering.
POI_ZLYZ_4_2: Looks like the young lady's right. We need that lamp to activate this device.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_1: ...I should have died a long time ago... but I was lucky enough to be saved by you, allowing me the chance to see the glittering lights of Jinzhou for myself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_2: ...You rewinded time to save me. I am responsible.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_3: Jinzhou is my home. If it's ever in danger, I will do everything in my power to protect what I hold dear, even at the cost of my own life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_5: Do you know the weight of this decision?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_6: I understand your concerns. I will reach my Second Awakening with our destined confrontation, and restore the time flow.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_7: Are you willing to bet on me?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_8: You are my Resonator, but your strength is only a fraction of mine.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_9: There is little chance for you to retreat unscathed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_10: But I can at least win some hope for our people!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_11: Even if it costs me my soul, my everything... I cannot die without trying.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_12: I may only bear your power for a fleeting moment... It's all I need to secure a better future for Jinzhou, defying all of your predictions. And I can keep you safe.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_13: If there is anyone who can face you in a fight...That person has to be your Resonator.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_14: I will be your final winning move in this game.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_16: Are you truly ready to challenge a being worshipped by your kind? Will you not regret it when you meet your bitter demise?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_17: I will not regret it, no matter what.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_19: Come to the summit. Demonstrate your prowess!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_20: Show me how you shall be my triumphant ace.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_383_21: Restore the time flow? Pray, from where does this confidence arise?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_1: {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter, one is curious about your choice this time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_2: Wherever the tides may take us, you will bear witness to our fight.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_3: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_4: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_5: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_6: What do you think of this world?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_7: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_8: A guiding light is not easily lit.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_390_9: That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.
