HelpText_76_Content:
[Memetic Tuning]
Before exploring the Illusive Realm, Memetic Tuning can be selected to adjust the difficulty of the exploration and the reward rate (Memetic Tuning can only be used in Difficulty Ⅳ, V, and VI).
Memetic Tuning affects Resonators' combat experience and enemies' abilities in the upcoming Illusive Realm exploration. The reward rate will be applied to the Illusive Specimens and Memory Points obtained after completing the upcoming exploration.

Reverie Memes: Reduce the overall difficulty and the reward rate of the upcoming exploration.
Nightmare Memes: Increase the overall difficulty and the reward rate of the upcoming exploration.
InfoDisplay_102001601_Text:
(The first half of the note is clearly printed and has become difficult to read after the ink has become stained.)
Reco■■ 03-27: Fewer samples were captured than expected. At the suggestion of ■■, Team ■ set up traps on the south side of the foothills... (the next part is illegible)
Record 03-28: Experiment 3. After doubling the dosage of the frequency inhibitor, ■■■■■■■■, and the sample dissipated. Team ■ was ■■■■■■■ because they did not conduct a risk assessment on the experimental process, and ■■ decided to restart the test plan.
Memo Entry 0x002: An unexpected entity was discovered. This entity is rather cautious and has been wandering around the camp. It is speculated to be an Elite or higher Tacet Discord and is considered to be a direct threat to the experiment. ■■ ordered Team ■ to contain this entity, so that once the experiment is successful, it can be... (the next part is illegible)
Record 03-29: A mysterious person appeared near the camp, but this person escaped after making contact with the unexpected entity. It is speculated that this person is a resident of Hongzhen. ■■ gave the order to perform experiments more frequently to attempt to complete the experiments successfully before Hongzhen can react.
■■■■■■■: Preliminary success was achieved in the experiments, and the technique of performing ■■■■■■■■ on samples was reproduced. ■■ proposed to launch a plan to contain the unexpected entity as soon as possible. Team ■ thought this was too risky, but they were overruled (the next part is illegible)...
(The last half of the note was written hastily in extremely messy handwriting, making it practically illegible.)
We failed to contain... It went berserk... an Elite Class threat... It was completely unexpected. We need to abandon the camp and evacuate to camp 2... Run...
(The last part is completely covered with ink.)
InfoDisplay_102001602_Text:
I've always known that I'm useless... and beyond saving. When that monster rampaged through the camp, I was the first to run. Should I really be ashamed for doing that? I just did what anyone would do in that situation.
All overseers like to paint a pretty picture—things like human evolution or venturing into a new era. Maybe the other artificers believe them and think these ideals are worthy of all their sacrifices and efforts, but I'm not one of them... I'm a coward, not a warrior who is willing to immolate myself for an ideal that might never be realized. But... those overseers were right about one thing: the world is coming to an end, and only the strong can survive.
I've heard stories of TD Outbreaks wiping out entire tribes of exiles silently, as if they were dying flames in the ashes of a campfire. I've heard about the horrors that they witnessed in the Tacet Field, horrors far beyond my imagination, and I don't want to end up like them. I don't want to live like a rat hiding in the wilderness, surviving by eating scraps dug out of garbage, and at risk of being killed at any time.
There's also some good news though. The boss said the experiment was successful. If we can control that Tacet Discord, the overseers will start taking us seriously, and we might even be promoted. Maybe... we'll be able to settle down and won't need to live life on the edge anymore.
Stronger. I must become stronger. If I can use the power of a Tacet Discord, then I'll fuse myself with a Tacet Discord. If I can use the power of an Echo, then I'll get my hands on one at whatever the cost. If getting my hands dirty means that I can live for one more day or even one more hour, then I'll do anything without any hesitation.
—I won't let this world chew me up and spit me out until there's nothing left. I won't.
InfoDisplay_102001603_Text:
Record 03-43: I've arrived at Camp 2, and the experiment is progressing smoothly there. I've completely mastered the Photonvault.
Comment: The Court of Savantae is nothing but a bunch of sanctimonious hypocrites. Such a powerful device should be used as a weapon, not a decoration or a toy. To not let their efforts go to waste, we must use the Time Stasifier in our plan. That should bring them solace in the afterlife.
Record 03-44: Team C has been ordered to take the Time Stasifier to Camp 1 to capture the escaped entity.
Comment: Don't mess it up this time.
Record 03-52: The escaped entity has been captured. Team C will go to Xuanji Ridges to start preparing. Team D has been sent to Camp 1 to assess the damage and recover materials if the opportunity arises.
Comment: That person called Ogo in Team D always manages to mess things up. If he screws up again, have him lead the experiment. I guess this counts as making the most of things.
Record 03-53: A message has been received from Ogo. He encountered the Rover at Camp 1. No signs of involvement from the forces of Hongzhen have been observed yet.
Side_CFYW_1_2: It feels like forever. How are things going in Hongzhen?
Side_CFYW_1_3: There is still much to be done, but things are finally looking up for Hongzhen. We've weathered the storm, and the darkest times are behind us.
Side_CFYW_1_4: The Sentinel's barrier is gone, and Mt. Firmament can be seen once more. Now, Hongzhen and other parts of Huanglong are reconnected.
Side_CFYW_1_5: At such a pivotal moment, it is even more essential to document our recent events in detail for future generations.
Side_CFYW_1_6: To that end, the Magistrate and I have gathered a team of scholars from Jinzhou to revise the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_1_9: A scholar named Qianyue is cataloging recent tales around Hongzhen.
Side_CFYW_1_10: However, she mentioned certain... strange phenomena in her reports.
Side_CFYW_1_11: This world is stranger than any supersition.
Side_CFYW_1_12: I bet there's more to the story.
Side_CFYW_1_14: There's surely someone or something with wicked intentions at play here.
Side_CFYW_1_15: I fear some exploit this chaos to spread discord. A thorough investigation will expose these troublemakers.
Side_CFYW_1_16: Rover, I ask for your help. Assist Qianyue in uncovering the truth so peace may be restored to our town!
Side_CFYW_10_1: Fantastic! I think we captured everything noteworthy around here.
Side_CFYW_10_2: Rover, could you scan the area again? I want to make sure we haven't missed anything.
Side_CFYW_11_2: It's long and deep… What could've left this?
Side_CFYW_11_3: It's gotta be a big one. Seen any beasts around here that could've done this?
Side_CFYW_11_4: Hey, you two! This stuff is ours! Hands off!
Side_CFYW_12_2: Didn't you hear me? Drop it! Leave now and maybe I'll spare you. Otherwise…
Side_CFYW_12_3: Have you lost your mind? It's that Rover! Even Mr. Scar is no match for {Male=him;Female=her}!
Side_CFYW_12_5: We endured so much, paid such a high price… No, with this new power nothing will stand in our way!
Side_CFYW_12_6: Our mission isn't to cause a scene! We're here to assess the camp's condition. We should try talking, not wrecking everything in sight—
Side_CFYW_12_7: This opportunity is being handed to us! With our numbers, we can easily deal with them.
Side_CFYW_12_8: Don't you want to prove your worth? Then join me against the Fractsidus's enemies!
Side_CFYW_12_9: I-I don't want to do crazy stuff like this!
Side_CFYW_12_10: Hey, get back here, you idiot!
Side_CFYW_12_11: Coward! I'll definitely report him to the boss.
Side_CFYW_12_12: No biggie, we still have the upper hand. Let's go. Take them down!
Side_CFYW_12_13: Find a place to hide, Qianyue.
Side_CFYW_13_1: That was… AWESOME! Like, bam, pow, and they were down!
Side_CFYW_13_4: Me? I'm totally fine. They didn't get within a mile of me!
Side_CFYW_13_5: Scared? Why? They're no Tacet Discord, and not even close to a real monster.
Side_CFYW_13_6: The Fractsidus caused Jinzhou and Hongzhen so much misery. Honestly, seeing them get beaten up... Oops, I mean punished, is kinda satisfying, not gonna lie.
Side_CFYW_13_7: Jinzhou's been my home since I can remember.
Side_CFYW_13_8: These guys have robbed and killed. If I were a Midnight Ranger or even a Patroller, I'd have taught them a lesson!
Side_CFYW_13_9: It's not as easy as you think.
Side_CFYW_13_10: Together, we stand strong! Even an ordinary person like me, with the right tools, can fight! Can defend MY home!
Side_CFYW_13_11: Hmph, I should've joined the Midnight Rangers instead of the Imperial Academy. Spending all day writing dull editorials... Too late now.
Side_CFYW_13_12: Oh, almost forgot our mission. We've got all the clues, so the truth must be…
Side_CFYW_13_13: The Fractsidus was doing experiments here.
Side_CFYW_13_14: The herb collector saw a beast.
Side_CFYW_13_15: Right! The Fractsidus caught some animals and Tacet Discords… all for some kind of experiment.
Side_CFYW_13_16: They must've stumbled on that big one, the same one the herb collector saw. Luckily it must be harmless, so the collector got lucky.
Side_CFYW_13_17: The Fractsidus set a trap but ended up provoking it. They had to bail when it fought back.
Side_CFYW_13_18: But I wonder if that "snow monster" was their doing too?
Side_CFYW_13_21: The Fractsidus… items left by the Court of Savantae… frozen animals… experiments using Tacet Discords...
Side_CFYW_13_22: There's gotta be a link, but what?
Side_CFYW_13_23: Anyway, let's go to Loong's Ridge first. Maybe we'll find answers there.
Side_CFYW_14_2: This is… a pretty steep hill…
Side_CFYW_14_3: Are you alright? Do you want to take a break?
Side_CFYW_14_4: I'm beat. Never hiked anything like this... Guess I'm not cut out for the Midnight Rangers.
Side_CFYW_14_5: It's okay. We're almost there. I can hang on a bit longer...
Side_CFYW_15_1: We made it! I don't think I walked this much all of last year...
Side_CFYW_15_2: Look! Items left by the Court of Savantae. This should be the place. Rover, let's search around.
Side_CFYW_16_2: Must be used to store a certain device. Whatever was inside, the Fractsidus must have taken.
Side_CFYW_16_3: But they left all their supplies at Loong's Crest. Hmm… maybe whatever was inside is important to them?
Side_CFYW_17_1: These devices look like what those Court of Savantae guys make. Their designs clearly aren't based on modern Automata Mechanics.
Side_CFYW_17_2: They're called "Photonvaults." They're able to halt time within a certain range.
Side_CFYW_17_3: So you mean those animals were… Yeah, that should be it.
Side_CFYW_18_3: Looks like it's just a diary. I guess a Fractsidus member accidentally left it behind.
Side_CFYW_18_4: They must've left in a hurry, leaving personal items behind like that.
Side_CFYW_19_1: Rover, this must be the Fractsidus's experiment log.
Side_CFYW_19_3: If what's written here is true, it's awful…
Side_CFYW_2_1: ...And then that monster popped up right in front of my friend! Its eyes were as big as lanterns, and its teeth as long as rolling pins!
Side_CFYW_2_3: My friend knew enough not to turn his back on the monster—he'd be an easy meal!
Side_CFYW_2_4: So he backed away slowly and stepped on a rock. He bent down and used everything he had to pick it up and... guess what?
Side_CFYW_2_5: He drove the monster away with the rock?
Side_CFYW_2_6: No, the monster just vanished into thin air! Not even a footprint in the snow!
Side_CFYW_2_8: I'm telling you, it's no ordinary monster! It's a ghost, the vengeful spirit of a slain beast...
Side_CFYW_2_9: Don't you have a better story?
Side_CFYW_2_11: You don't believe me, do you? I'm not making this up! My friend told me himself!
Side_CFYW_2_12: Yeah? If not, where could this story have come from? My friend who got eaten?
Side_CFYW_2_13: Fine, believe what you want. My throat's parched from all this yapping. I'm off to grab a cup of tea.
Side_CFYW_2_14: Oh, by the way, he lives just around the corner. Go ask him yourself if you think I'm pulling your leg.
Side_CFYW_2_15: With that, the resident shrugs and strolls off.
Side_CFYW_2_16: Well, it's good to have a witness at least.
Side_CFYW_2_18: Yes, that's me. And you must be the Rover, the hero Madam Xinyi spoke of from Jinzhou and Hongzhen?
Side_CFYW_2_21: Don't be modest. Your heroic deeds are already recorded in the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_22: I'm just a newbie intern, so I don't get to write those epic tales... yet.
Side_CFYW_2_23: But that's fine, I have my own mission. I'm investigating the two Mt. Firmament incidents. Once I piece it all together, it'll go into the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_25: Yes, one is the sighting of a huge monster, as the gentleman mentioned.
Side_CFYW_2_26: The other comes from a hunter who found animals and Tacet Discords frozen solid in a valley.
Side_CFYW_2_27: Sounds like someone is up to something.
Side_CFYW_2_28: Indeed. I've read through the Hongzhen Chronicle, and it says the Sentinel's barrier keeps out Tacet Discords, even Elite Class ones.
Side_CFYW_2_29: The rare Elite Class Tacet Discords are only spotted in far-off places. In the Chronicle, they're dubbed "beasts," "scourges," or even "blessings."
Side_CFYW_2_31: Yeah, probably because Elite Class Tacet Discords are super rare, they're almost mythical, seen as omens of good or bad luck.
Side_CFYW_2_32: Anyway, based on these witness accounts, I think there's a link between this monster and the "beast" in the Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_33: Rumors have been flying around, getting all exaggerated, but I’m still unclear on where these incidents actually happened.
Side_CFYW_2_34: But here's the kicker—I've tracked down the rumor spreaders.
Side_CFYW_2_36: Yep, one's a herb collector from Hongzhen, and the other's a hunter. Makes sense, given their line of work.
Side_CFYW_2_39: Well, I do think Tacet Discords are behind all this, but still I can't help but wonder... do ghosts really exist?
Side_CFYW_2_43: I-I suspected as much. I've studied Remnant Ecoacoustics, so I know it's just a natural phenomenon caused by Reverberations!
Side_CFYW_2_44: For real? Have you seen a ghost before, Rover?
Side_CFYW_2_45: Y-yeah, just a natural phenomenon. Nothing to be scared of!
Side_CFYW_2_47: This is excitement, not fear! Exploring the unknown is my jam!
Side_CFYW_2_48: Let's go, Rover! It's time to uncover the truth!
Side_CFYW_20_1: Alright, I think I've probably got things figured out.
Side_CFYW_20_3: The Fractsidus calls this place "Site 2" and ran experiments with the "Photonvault" created by the Court of Savantae.
Side_CFYW_20_4: Those frozen animals? They must be the device's test subjects caught in time.
Side_CFYW_20_5: And the monsters at Loong's Crest must've been captured with it, too.
Side_CFYW_20_6: But what's their plan? The memo from Site 1 mentioned a frequency suppressor… What’s that for?
Side_CFYW_20_7: To suppress the Tacet Discords' innate frequencies?
Side_CFYW_20_8: Yes… So they can control them, like in the diary.
Side_CFYW_20_11: It is their style, after all.
Side_CFYW_20_12: Are they all mad? Why would they do this?
Side_CFYW_20_16: For power? Is it really worth all this?
Side_CFYW_20_17: For dreams? I doubt these killers know anything about dreams.
Side_CFYW_20_18: But cities like Jinzhou or Hongzhen offer protection. Folks can go about their daily lives, so why go looking for this kind of trouble?
Side_CFYW_20_19: I just... can't wrap my head around it. There's no excuse for this.
Side_CFYW_20_20: We have more important matters to attend to.
Side_CFYW_20_21: You're right. We have to stop the Fractsidus. We can't let them get away with this.
Side_CFYW_21_1: We've arrived, Rover, it's right over there!
Side_CFYW_21_3: Don't bother going over. It's too late…
Side_CFYW_22_1: Boss, all systems are go. We’re ready to roll with the next experiment whenever you give the word.
Side_CFYW_22_4: Who else? You want to live, right? You want power, don’t you? That’s exactly what the Fractsidus is all about.
Side_CFYW_22_5: We turn the weak into the mighty, the nobodies into somebodies, and mere mortals into… gods.
Side_CFYW_22_7: Relax, it’s just another tweak. Like the upgrade you had before—only this makes you stronger and less constrained.
Side_CFYW_22_8: Look at this beast—gorgeous, isn’t it? Strong, too. Those sharp claws, that glossy fur, those bulging muscles…
Side_CFYW_22_9: Listen, Tacet Discords are not curses, they’re miracles. And now, you get the honor of harnessing that miracle. Don’t let me down.
Side_CFYW_22_11: Of course, Ogo. The Fractsidus isn’t pouring money into this just for kicks.
Side_CFYW_22_12: Just fire up that machine over there, and you’ll be... transformed. No one will be able to touch you, much less take you down.
Side_CFYW_22_13: I'll take it upstairs. Once you get stronger, you'll move up the ladder too. Say goodbye to grunt work.
Side_CFYW_22_15: Ogo trembles as he approaches the machine. With no other option, he entrusts his fate to this experiment he neither understands nor cares about.
Side_CFYW_22_16: Initiating frequency suppressor injection… triple unit. Ogo's frequency detected, causing effective interference with the Tacet Discord's frequency. Synchronization rate: 95.27%.
Side_CFYW_22_17: HAHAHA! We did it! Such a genius move, using human frequencies to take down Tacet Discord’s!
Side_CFYW_22_18: As long as Tacet Discords understand our language, we can boss them around however we want!
Side_CFYW_22_19: Shut down the Photonvault and release our new friend… I mean, old friend! Even that Rover won't stand a chance!
Side_CFYW_22_20: The Artificers turn off the Photonvault.
Side_CFYW_22_22: Ogo? Can you hear me? How’s your new body feeling? I get it, four legs might be a challenge at first. Take your time.
Side_CFYW_22_23: Hold on, boss. Ogo's frequencies… they're gone.
Side_CFYW_22_24: What? Don’t be stupid. We combined his with the Tacet Discord’s frequencies. Of course you can’t see his, moron!
Side_CFYW_22_25: No… the Tacet Discord’s frequencies are unchanged. His were completely devoured.
Side_CFYW_22_26: This isn’t funny! Ogo, wake up! Now isn’t the time for a nap… No, no… Stay back! STAY BACK!
Side_CFYW_22_27: In those final moments, Ogo's response was neither what he hoped for nor expected.
Side_CFYW_23_1: What did the Fractsidus do…? He was one of their own…
Side_CFYW_23_2: Take cover somewhere safe. I'll handle this.
Side_CFYW_24_1: Is it… is it over? Is Ogo…
Side_CFYW_24_4: I see… That's okay. We did… we did everything we could.
Side_CFYW_24_5: I read his diary. All he wanted to do was survive, but… he's not as lucky as we are.
Side_CFYW_24_6: He didn't have a safe place to call home or the means to protect himself.
Side_CFYW_24_7: I used to think justice was everywhere in Huanglong, just like in Jinzhou.
Side_CFYW_24_8: We have the Midnight Rangers guarding us and the Patrollers keeping order. Everyone lives in peace.
Side_CFYW_24_9: To me, Tacet Discords and Tacet Fields were just distant stories, less real than the monsters in fairytales.
Side_CFYW_24_10: But today, I realized that… they're right here.
Side_CFYW_24_13: Ha… I’m not blaming myself. I just feel… like I’ve been slacking off all this time.
Side_CFYW_24_15: I'm still the little girl who once looked at the Midnight Rangers believing they could solve every single problem…
Side_CFYW_24_16: I never thought about who needed help, let alone took action. Looking back, I feel ashamed…
Side_CFYW_24_18: But first, I gotta figure out what my heart wants.
Side_CFYW_24_19: Anyway, I have all the details recorded. When I get back to Hongzhen, I'll write them in the Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_24_20: Next up... I might just join the Pioneer Association and travel the world. I want to see what lies beyond Jinzhou's walls with my own eyes.
Side_CFYW_24_21: Taking that first step is key.
Side_CFYW_24_22: You're right. I've got to take that first step.
Side_CFYW_24_23: Thank you, Rover. Let's head back to Hongzhen.
Side_CFYW_25_1: Your efforts seem to have borne fruit. What conclusions have you drawn about the incidents, Rover?
Side_CFYW_25_2: You tell Xinyi about what happened.
Side_CFYW_25_3: So, it was the Fractsidus behind these disturbances, all to push their disgraceful goal. How despicable.
Side_CFYW_25_4: Thank you for bringing this vital information to light. I shall ensure that patrols around Mt. Firmament are intensified to prevent any further attempts by these miscreants.
Side_CFYW_25_5: Oh yes, and Qianyue seems to have found her footing since she returned.
Side_CFYW_25_6: This journey did make her grow.
Side_CFYW_25_7: There is no better teacher than experience itself. I hold high hopes for her future contributions.
Side_CFYW_25_8: Once again, Rover, I'm grateful for your assistance in this matter.
Side_CFYW_3_4: Story…? It's not a story! It really happened to me!
Side_CFYW_3_5: I was almost killed on that mountain! Just the thought of it sends shivers down my spine, like it's still lurking out there, watching...
Side_CFYW_3_6: Look behind me, you don't see anything, do ya?
Side_CFYW_3_8: That's a relief. With so many people in Hongzhen, I bet that thing wouldn't dare show its face. But that place… I wouldn't set foot there again.
Side_CFYW_3_9: What do you mean by that place? Where is it?
Side_CFYW_3_10: Curiosity killed the cat, they say. Getting mixed up with that monster will only spell disaster. I must've lost my mind insisting on checking it out…
Side_CFYW_3_12: We're gathering tales for the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_3_13: Madam Xinyi…? So, she heard the rumor too? Not surprising, she always takes everything here seriously.
Side_CFYW_3_14: Gathering tales…? I've heard those pages are filled with countless regional folktales, so it’s only natural you’d want to add this.
Side_CFYW_3_15: Alright, if you're here to listen, I'll tell you exactly what happened.
Side_CFYW_3_16: Hold on! Let me start the recording first… Alright, please go on.
Side_CFYW_3_17: It all began three days ago. I was deep in the mountains hunting for a rare herb and lost track of time.
Side_CFYW_3_18: By the time I stumbled upon the herb, night had fallen. Fearful of beasts prowling after dark, I decided to take a shortcut back to Hongzhen.
Side_CFYW_3_19: When I reached Loong's Crest, I heard some... strange noises coming from the darkness. They sounded like metal clashing and scraping, mixed with eerie cries.
Side_CFYW_3_20: I thought it was just a poor Scarefrost Deer caught in a trap, so I pressed on. But the deeper I went, the creepier it got.
Side_CFYW_3_22: Hard to describe. Whimpers? Howls? Whatever it was, it wasn't human, and it sure as hell wasn't any beast I'd ever crossed paths with.
Side_CFYW_3_23: More like a twisted combination of both.
Side_CFYW_3_24: The noises gave me goosebumps. Then I remembered the story my grandmother once told me.
Side_CFYW_3_25: Long ago, the Sentinel and the Court of Savantae worked together, using their bizzare creations to seal some real vicious monsters.
Side_CFYW_3_26: Their bodies crumbled to dust over the years, but their evil souls hung around, craving revenge on the Sentinel.
Side_CFYW_3_27: Revenge on the Sentinel? That's wild!
Side_CFYW_3_28: Ahem, I'm talking here, young lady. Interrupt again and I won't say another word.
Side_CFYW_3_30: Where was I? Ah, yes, the evil souls. I was in a dilemma, you know. Terrified as I was, curiosity gnawed at me, urging me forward…
Side_CFYW_3_31: Suddenly, out of nowhere, two lanterns appeared in front of me. It happened so fast, I didn't even realize it was impossible to have lanterns out in the wilderness like that.
Side_CFYW_3_32: The lanterns seemed to float, barely visible. They flickered once, then a few seconds later, flickered again.
Side_CFYW_3_33: It wasn't until then that I realized they weren't lanterns at all, but eyes! Eyes as big as lanterns. How big would its head be?
Side_CFYW_3_34: I turned and ran, and that monster kept howling behind me. Believe me, I've never heard anything so bone-chilling.
Side_CFYW_3_35: I didn't dare look back, just ran for my life. I lost track of time, but eventually, I saw the lights of Hongzhen and knew I was safe.
Side_CFYW_3_36: I heard you passed out at Hongzhen's entrance, right? Thank goodness the night patrol found you. Otherwise…
Side_CFYW_3_37: Non-nonsense! I didn't pass out! Just… a bit tired from the running! Yeah, I was tired!
Side_CFYW_3_38: Anyway, whatever was chasing me must be the souls of those monsters! One wrong step, and I'd have been its next meal!
Side_CFYW_3_39: Alright, that's all been recorded. What's your take, Rover?
Side_CFYW_3_40: I doubt it's some evil ghost.
Side_CFYW_3_41: Yes, I agree. I've heard nerves can make you see things that aren't real. Maybe it was just a Scarefrost Deer... or a passing Tacet Discord?
Side_CFYW_3_44: If you're really curious, go see the monster for yourself. I spotted it near Loong's Crest. Just remember, I did warn you.
Side_CFYW_4_2: Yes? You are…? Oh, I see. You folks are here for the snow monster too?
Side_CFYW_4_4: Imagine a tank-sized ape, with the power to freeze everything around it into ice sculptures.
Side_CFYW_4_5: I saw it once as a kid, just a glimpse of its back while tagging along with my dad in the mountains.
Side_CFYW_4_6: (Sounds like a Tacet Discord with freezing abilities.)
Side_CFYW_4_7: So, how do you intend to find the snow monster this time?
Side_CFYW_4_8: This time? I never actually encountered it. If I had, I wouldn't have lived to tell the tale!
Side_CFYW_4_9: But, I did come across… evidence of its hunting.
Side_CFYW_4_11: Okay, long story short.  I went hunting in the mountains and found some strange contraptions at the base of Loong’s Ridge.
Side_CFYW_4_12: I thought they were left by the Court of Savantae. No idea what they were for. You know, I haven't found anything related to the Court of Savantae there before.
Side_CFYW_4_13: Maybe they have a secret vault nearby?
Side_CFYW_4_14: That's what I thought. So I followed the contraptions trying to find it.
Side_CFYW_4_16: Of course not. This is a tale about running into a snow monster,  not about a thief hitting the jackpot with a vault!
Side_CFYW_4_17: I trekked up the mountain and saw some... animals. Oh, not just any animals, there were Tacet Discords too.
Side_CFYW_4_18: Tacet Discords? They didn't attack you?
Side_CFYW_4_19: Nope. When I found them, they were all frozen solid.
Side_CFYW_4_20: Birds, deer, even the Tacet Discords—every one of them frozen stiff. You could see every hair crystal clear.
Side_CFYW_4_21: Can you believe it? Even the snowflakes around them were frozen. Gave me the creeps, I tell you.
Side_CFYW_4_22: So you think the snow monster did all this?
Side_CFYW_4_23: Who else would it be? What else could turn living creatures into those… terrifying ice sculptures?
Side_CFYW_4_24: I totally forgot about the vault and ran like the wind, terrified that the snow monster would jump out from nowhere and turn me into a popsicle like the rest of them.
Side_CFYW_4_25: The snow monster and the Court of Savantae…
Side_CFYW_4_27: Yes, why didn't I think of it sooner... The Court of Savantae must've sealed that monster with one of their contraptions, and someone let it out by mistake!
Side_CFYW_4_28: That explains everything! No wonder it's been centuries since the last time people saw the snow monster…
Side_CFYW_4_29: Hold up, didn't you say you saw it as a kid?
Side_CFYW_4_30: Did I? Ha… Hahaha, well, yes, besides ME, it's been centuries since anyone saw the snow monster!
Side_CFYW_4_31: Uh, wait! And my father! He saw it too.
Side_CFYW_4_32: Qianyue doesn't ask more questions, but the skeptical look on her face suffices to show her opinion.
Side_CFYW_4_33: Ahem, well, thank you for your help.
Side_CFYW_4_35: By the way, if you're planning to hunt the snow monster, why not grab some of my poison arrows? They're made to take down wild beasts quickly.
Side_CFYW_4_38: Think about it. You'll be out there, staring down that snow monster, wishing you had something to defend yourself with. Trust me, you'll regret not taking these.
Side_CFYW_4_39: Smart move. Here. It took me years to craft these beauties.
Side_CFYW_4_40: But… they look just like regular arrows?
Side_CFYW_4_41: Hey, open your eyes! These are no ordinary arrows. The tips are poisoned. The one I used is colorless, odorless, safe for humans, but deadly to beasts!
Side_CFYW_4_42: …Well, maybe keep them to yourself for now.
Side_CFYW_4_43: Fine, your call. Just don’t say I didn’t warn you when the time comes.
Side_CFYW_4_44: Anyway, you're not the only ones curious about that snow monster. Excuse me, got another customer… adventurer to attend to.
Side_CFYW_4_45: The hunter leaves in a hurry, taking his deadly, invisible, and odorless poison arrows with him.
Side_CFYW_4_46: Well, I've got all that recorded. I'll sort through it later.
Side_CFYW_4_47: I can't help but feel… these two incidents aren't quite what I had pictured.
Side_CFYW_4_49: The herb collector didn't even get a clear look. From his description, sounds more like a rare Tacet Discord than a monster.
Side_CFYW_4_50: But the whimpering or howling he mentioned does pique my interest. If it was a Tacet Discord or a monster… why didn't it attack him?
Side_CFYW_4_52: It might be friendly to humans.
Side_CFYW_4_53: That makes sense. Maybe a Tacet Discord got stuck in a trap or wedged in a crevice?
Side_CFYW_4_54: That makes sense. I've heard some Tacet Discords are friendly towards humans.
Side_CFYW_4_55: Hmm, now that could be the real story behind this "evil ghost."
Side_CFYW_4_56: As for the hunter, he gave a really detailed account.
Side_CFYW_4_57: If he were making it up, he wouldn't have included verifiable details like the creations of the Court of Savantae.
Side_CFYW_4_58: Which means the frozen animals are real. The Court of Savantae creations are real, but…
Side_CFYW_4_59: The snow monster might be a lie.
Side_CFYW_4_60: That's right! No snow monster, just a ruse to sell those poison arrows.
Side_CFYW_4_61: He did see the frozen animals, but he didn't know who did it and how.
Side_CFYW_4_62: Spreading rumors about the snow monster was just a way to lure in hunters.
Side_CFYW_4_63: Now, there's only one question left.
Side_CFYW_4_64: Yeah, who froze those animals? Tacet Discords? Doesn't quite add up.
Side_CFYW_4_65: Something's off about these two sightings. Maybe we need to visit the locations for answers.
Side_CFYW_6_1: Are those… cages? Who would put cages out here?!
Side_CFYW_6_2: Seems like they were used to lock something up. Good news is, it wasn't a person, judging from these claw marks.
Side_CFYW_6_3: Let's take some pictures, just in case.
Side_CFYW_7_1: This cage must be for the really big one.
Side_CFYW_7_2: But it looks brand new. I don't think it's been used.
Side_CFYW_8_2: Looks like they were used to store equipment.
Side_CFYW_9_2: There's a memo attached to it, but it seems to be stained with ink.
Side_CFYW_9_4: So, someone was experimenting on animals and Tacet Discords here…?
Side_CFYW_9_5: But something went wrong, so they had to bail.

Event_WWQH_18_2: You want me to pet you?
Event_WWQH_18_3: That would be nice... Just kidding. You'll be petting animals for other people. The demand has been growing lately.
Event_WWQH_18_4: There are many animals roaming in the city. People living in other places would like you to pet and feed the animals in their place.
Event_WWQH_18_5: Actually, I once dealt with a similar order as a courier. The sender was a human, but the recipient was a hound named "Mimi"...
Event_WWQH_18_6: And the customer told me... "I bought some jerky in Rinascita. Please help me feed the jerky to Mimi the dog in Jinzhou city!"
Event_WWQH_18_7: At that time, I was totally lost because offering that service wasn't something we did, but it really got me thinking about a whole new business opportunity.
Event_WWQH_18_8: Ding! You have a new petting order.Please fulfill the order in time.
Event_WWQH_18_9: And this time we're looking for... a tabby cat named "Wangcai"? Oh my, I know this cat. I even have an emoji of it on my Terminal!
Event_WWQH_18_10: I must have the emoji. Send it to me!
Event_WWQH_18_11: Let's see here... The emoji, and Wangcai's location... There, I've forwarded them to you! Remember to bring Wangcai's favorite fish fillet!
Event_WWQH_19_1: We have too many people trying to feed it at once. It looks scared. Step back, everyone!
Event_WWQH_19_2: Got it! Wangcai is hiding in the braces behind the light box, but his primordial pouch is too fat. He's stuck.
Event_WWQH_19_4: Let me try the cat language translation module!
Event_WWQH_19_5: Wangcai said: "Numb. Something's zapping me inside the light box. My tummy feels numb. Please get me out quickly."
Event_WWQH_19_6: Quick. Turn off the circuit module, and I'll go save Wangcai.
Event_WWQH_20_1: You and Xuanyin join forces to save Wangcai, prompting cheers from the crowd. After thanking you, Xuanyin takes Wangcai to the Academy's medical department. It seems you'll have to wait until next time to feed Wangcai.
Event_WWQH_21_1: You tell Maji about the event, leaving him speechless for a moment.
Event_WWQH_22_2: Being a cat is way better than being a human.
Event_WWQH_22_4: I can't write today's report in this case, but if I were a cat, I would never have to write any report. Sob sob...
Event_WWQH_22_5: You can try another of your business ideas tomorrow.
Event_WWQH_22_6: You're right. Let me cope with this now. Everything will be fine tomorrow.

Character_Encore_6_3: (Is that Encore? I should go check it out.)
Character_Encore_7_1: You must be new to this place! Are you also searching for the Gateway of Wishes?
Character_Encore_7_2: (Gateway of Wishes? Looks like I'm inside Encore's story somehow...)
Character_Encore_7_4: I just want to find my way back.
Character_Encore_7_5: That's great! How about we team up? I have a wish I want to make, too!
Character_Encore_7_6: Then we'll be going in the same direction! If we reach the end of this journey and find out about the Gateway of Wishes, we'll be back to the real world in no time!
Character_Encore_7_7: Since it's your first time here, everything must feel strange to you, huh?
Character_Encore_7_8: This is the Wooly Kingdom, a land filled with lots and lots of woolies. Look, even the clouds are shaped like them!
Character_Encore_7_9: You're in luck, I know this place like the back of my hand. I can be your tour guide!
Character_Encore_7_11: I want to look around on my own.
Character_Encore_7_13: Oh. Okay then... I mean, we're heading in the same direction anyway. You can look at your part and I'll look at mine.
Character_Encore_7_14: Fairy Cloudy told me that as long as we walk along this path, we'll get there eventually!
Character_Encore_7_15: Once we're there, I gotta make her tell us where all the treasure is hidden...

Character_Encore_10_1: "Beware." This is where many Wooly stories begin.
Character_Encore_10_2: When the story gets longer, so will the paths ahead. We might even come across broken bridges and stuff.
Character_Encore_10_3: Since we'll only be telling the beginning of the story this time, we should get to the end pretty soon.
Character_Encore_11_1: There! A treasure chest! It's all yours!
Character_Encore_12_1: Look at all these monsters. Let's beat 'em up!
Character_Encore_13_1: Ohhh... You're finally here. Those terrible monsters. Baa...
Character_Encore_13_2: This is Cloudy Fairy. She gets scared pretty easily, but she's really nice and will give us directions.
Character_Encore_13_3: (She's even got all the settings prepared and everything...)
Character_Encore_13_4: So you're searching for the Gateway of Wishes? Baa. All you need to do is follow this path and collect three relics. Baa...
Character_Encore_13_6: Yes! The first relic is the Sword of Courage. To obtain it, you'll have to face all of your challenges head-on. Be careful...
Character_Encore_13_7: Next, the Shield of Faith. This is a tricky one, but so long as you believe in yourself, you'll find it eventually after searching every nook and cranny.
Character_Encore_13_8: And finally, the Wreath of Hope. A crown of flowers that can reflect a person's thoughts. Never withers, forever blossoming.
Character_Encore_13_9: Once you've gathered all three relics, the Gateway of Wishes will open before you.
Character_Encore_13_10: Perfect. Now that we have clues about the relics, Wooly Warrior's adventures are officially a go.
Character_Encore_13_11: All we need to do now is go through this door and we'll be back to the real world!
Character_Encore_13_12: You're very welcome, dear! If you have any more questions, do come back anytime. Baa-Baa now!
Character_Encore_42_1: Would you look at the sky... So this is the Wooly Kingdom.
Character_Encore_42_4: {PlayerName} and I can be your guide!
Character_Encore_42_5: Oh, I love the repetition. This is the Wooly Kingdom.
Character_Encore_42_6: This story is gonna be longer than the last one. It looks like there'll be more puzzles to solve, and more monsters to fight.
Character_Encore_42_7: And the door to make wishes should be in the deepest part.
Character_Encore_42_11: Yes! I wanna find the Gateway of Wishes and then see my mom again.
Character_Encore_42_12: Great! The adventure of Wooly Warrior can finally have an ending!
Character_Encore_43_4: Y-Yeah. Mom gave me this sword that can cut through anything! Take this!
Character_Encore_44_2: Encore knows what to do! Encore played these with mom before. All we need to do is match the patterns on the wall, and it'll open a secret door!
Character_Encore_44_3: It's one of the most important puzzles in Wooly Warrior's story!
Character_Encore_45_2: Don't worry, stuff like this happens all the time.
Character_Encore_45_3: This means the story of the Wooly Kingdom is changing, but that's not enough to beat the warriors!
Character_Encore_46_1: We're almost there. After passing every trial set before 'em, the Flower of Hope is finally within the warriors' reach behind this door.
Character_Encore_46_2: Maybe this door leads to the Gateway of Wishes, where countless warriors once hoped to pass through to have their wishes come true.
Character_Encore_46_3: And now, the warriors will find out what kind of monsters or treasures are hidden behind the door.
Character_Encore_46_5: R-Ready... I'll be able to see my mom soon...
Character_Encore_46_8: Right. Through the door, we go!
Character_Encore_46_9: It's okay, why don't we rest here for a while? Once we're all in top shape, we'll open the door together!
Character_Encore_47_1: Out of nowhere, a group of Gulpuffs appear, but they are no match against the mighty warriors.
Character_Encore_47_2: With the Sword of Courage in their hands, there's no fear holding them back, as they slice through these monsters with ease.
Character_Encore_47_3: The monsters strike, but our shield stands strong. Now, our warriors know victory is ours!
Character_Encore_8_1: Please don't hurt me. Baa... I'm just an ordinary box. Baa...
Character_Encore_9_1: Tee-hee. You're in for some surprises! Baa.
Event_WWQH_23_1: You might not believe what the business plan is when I tell you.
Event_WWQH_23_3: Your encounters yesterday inspired me. I've developed a new business overnight.
Event_WWQH_23_4: What business? We go begging for food?
Event_WWQH_23_5: Nah! We're helping people eat stuff! And we make money from that! It's called "Lollo Eater"!
Event_WWQH_23_7: Jewel Boba has launched a collab event with the popular game, "Second Coming of Solaris."
Event_WWQH_23_8: Players can buy collab drink at Jewel Boba for a chance to get limited edition redemption codes. The hype is crazy!
Event_WWQH_23_9: They get the codes, we get to drink boba and make money. It's a win-win!
Event_WWQH_23_11: How many cups before we get the guaranteed?
Event_WWQH_23_12: Let me see... One cup for one pull....
Event_WWQH_23_13: Wait! The fine print here... is this the lottery probability rules?
Event_WWQH_23_14: ...Starting from the 50th cup, the probability of winning increases, and the guaranteed drop appears by the 60th cup.
Event_WWQH_23_16: Before placing an order, you have to shout the slogan: Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!
Event_WWQH_23_21: Ding! You have a new order...
Event_WWQH_23_22: Ding! You have a new order... Ding! Ding! Ding!
Event_WWQH_23_23: If I gain extra weight from this, it'll be on you.
Event_WWQH_23_24: Can I apply for a work injury compensation?
Event_WWQH_23_26: It's not too late to give up.
Event_WWQH_23_27: Don't underestimate me! Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!
Event_WWQH_24_1: Welcome to "the Second Coming of Solaris: Jewel Station". How many cups would you like?
Event_WWQH_24_2: Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris! I'll have 100 cups of boba!
Event_WWQH_24_3: And make half of them large, no ice, and less sugar please!
Event_WWQH_24_8: Now, please shout out our slogan loudly.
Event_WWQH_24_9: Present endless treasures to the Second Coming of Solaris!
Event_WWQH_25_1:
Order #1: 5 cups, 0 code.
Order #2: 30 cups, 1 code.
Order #3: 22 cups, 1 code.
Order #4: 1 cup, 1 code.
Order #5: 10 cups, 2 codes...

With 68 cups of boba in your stomach, you and Maji call it quits earlier than you expected.
Event_WWQH_26_1: Sorry. I underestimated the enthusiasm of those players... Hic! I won't ever try something like this again.
Event_WWQH_26_2: Hic! It's okay, I understand. I forgive you.
Event_WWQH_26_3: Thanks. That's very sweet of you to say.
Event_WWQH_26_4: As sweet as the boba, yeah.
Event_WWQH_26_5: I can't do this. Hic... I can present no more treasure. Won't be able to work as a courier again if I go out of shape from this...
Event_WWQH_26_6: You are no longer a courier, though.
Event_WWQH_26_7: Hic... I forgot. Haven't gotten used to my new occupation yet.
Event_WWQH_27_3: I will name it "Lollo Take-in". I was inspired by a post on Lollo's internal forum.
Event_WWQH_27_4: Take-in? Are you trying to say takeout food?
Event_WWQH_27_5: Here, I'll show you. Read this article!
Event_WWQH_27_6: "A non-native customer placed a Lollo cold-chain order, wanting a Pulled Chicken from Panhua's Restaurant..."
Event_WWQH_27_7: "But I only found that I forgot to take the food when I arrived at the customer's location. Careless of me..."
Event_WWQH_27_8: "To make up for my slip, I rode the customer to Panhua's Restaurant, so he could order the chicken himself and have a fresh taste!"
Event_WWQH_27_9: Now, I contacted this courier and got his authorization...
Event_WWQH_27_11: The traditional food delivery takes the food to the customer's home. In that case, it might be difficult to balance time-efficiency and the condition of the dish.
Event_WWQH_27_12: And that's why our "Lollo Take-in" will go the other way: we deliver our customers to the food!
Event_WWQH_27_13: I already came up with a slogan: Eat wherever you want with Lollo Take-in!
Event_WWQH_27_15: Something feels off, but I can't name it.
Event_WWQH_27_16: Ding! You have a new take-in order. Please pick up the customer on time.
Event_WWQH_27_17: An order! That looks like a faraway location, though... I don't think I've ever seen any people living there?
Event_WWQH_27_19: Okay. Call me if everything turns out fine.
Event_WWQH_27_20: Then I'll drive there to pick up the customer.
Event_WWQH_28_1: Bad news, boss! Ain't that the Lollo Hitman?!
Event_WWQH_28_2: Dang, no way! Who the heck called Lollo Hitman?
Quest_11900018_QuestDesc_11_1:
Uncle Fu says that he has a magical item.
It's said that this item is shaped like a scale and has a magical power called Chrono Trace that can make people relive moments from their past...
LevelPlay_313900006_ChallengeConditionSu: Enemies appear on the east side
Guide_CLLJ_1_5: I'm the one who had witnessed Hongzhen grow into what it is today before I handed it over to Xinyi.
Guide_CLLJ_1_6: Alas, let the past stay in the past… Just call me Uncle Fu.
Guide_CLLJ_1_7: So, what do you think about Hongzhen nowadays?
Guide_CLLJ_1_10: Ah, you're quite optimistic, young one.
Guide_CLLJ_1_11: You've seen the crisis at Mt. Firmament, yet you're not scared, are you?
Guide_CLLJ_1_13: You remind me of Xinyi the first time I saw her.
Guide_CLLJ_1_14: You are both someone who lived through turbulent times and stood tall against all odds.
Guide_CLLJ_1_15: Forgive me, I've lost myself. I wanted to see you because I have something to give you.
Guide_CLLJ_1_16: Uncle Fu takes out a scale-like object and hands it over to you solemnly.
Guide_CLLJ_1_19: When I first became the Mayor of Hongzhen, I came across this thing on one of my walks in the mountains.
Guide_CLLJ_1_20: At first, I was intrigued by its peculiar shape, so I brought it back to town with me. But afterward, it revealed some truly amazing power.
Guide_CLLJ_1_23: Well, no... Listen, I might be old, but I've always let nature take its course.
Guide_CLLJ_1_24: People age and die, even in Hongzhen. The Sentinel's power could only slow down time but not reverse it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_25: This scale—It seems like it has captured Hongzhen in a frozen slice of time.
Guide_CLLJ_1_26: A few nights after I found it, I dreamed of the moment I picked it up.
Guide_CLLJ_1_27: The dream felt as real as life. I could even see the falling snow clearly—as if time had frozen.
Guide_CLLJ_1_30: Yeah, I was elated by the surprise like you did.
Guide_CLLJ_1_31: I kept going back to it for the better half of a month until I finally realized I wasn't dreaming that night.
Guide_CLLJ_1_32: Though small, this scale contains unimaginable power. When I carry it, it records my experiences and lets me relive them later.
Guide_CLLJ_1_33: I call this ability "Chrono Tracing". With it, I can see and hear everything I've experienced before and even talk to those people in the Chrono Trace…
Guide_CLLJ_1_34: I used this ability to record every detail in Hongzhen. It certainly made the compilation of the Hongzhen Chronicle much easier.
Guide_CLLJ_1_35: During the day, I'd go through the archives and visit residents. At night, I used this magical token to organize the information I'd gathered.
Guide_CLLJ_1_36: As I was ankle deep in the governing affairs... I couldn't picture what a lousy job I would have done on my official duties without its help.
Guide_CLLJ_1_38: Maybe it's better to give it to Xinyi?
Guide_CLLJ_1_39: Why don't you keep it yourself?
Guide_CLLJ_1_40: Hahaha, before I answer your question, let me ask you one.
Guide_CLLJ_1_41: Guess what I recorded the most with this scale?
Guide_CLLJ_1_44: At first, I used it solely for important events. But as time passed, I changed the way I handled it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_45: You're right. After I had stepped down as the Mayor of Hongzhen, I was no longer involved in Hongzhen's affairs.
Guide_CLLJ_1_46: When I handed over the position to Xinyi, I gave this scale to her as well.
Guide_CLLJ_1_47: But she was a considerate one and soon returned it to me.
Guide_CLLJ_1_48: For she saw that I found I needed it more. So rather than using it to archive the nitty-gritty of her work, she allowed me to record the people I cherished.
Guide_CLLJ_1_49: I watched many kids in Hongzhen grow up and leave.
Guide_CLLJ_1_50: At first, I thought they’d come back someday, but I realized I'd never see many of them again.
Guide_CLLJ_1_51: Over the years, I've really missed those young folks who left Mt. Firmament for new lives.
Guide_CLLJ_1_52: So, I used the scale to create a Chrono Trace for nearly every resident in Hongzhen.
Guide_CLLJ_1_53: Whenever I missed them, I visited and talked to them in those Chrono Traces.
Guide_CLLJ_1_55: Alright, enough talk about me. Let's talk about you, {PlayerName}?
Guide_CLLJ_1_56: Something tells me this scale is related to Jué.
Guide_CLLJ_1_57: Back then, I thought Hongzhen needed Xinyi more than me, just like Jinhsi did Jué.
Guide_CLLJ_1_58: I've built my life around this town, but you, {PlayerName}, you're not restricted to Hongzhen or even Huanglong.
Guide_CLLJ_1_59: There's a world of expanse out there awaiting your exploration and many interesting souls for you to bond with.
Guide_CLLJ_1_60: You'll need this scale more than I do... Or, rather, you two fit right together.
Guide_CLLJ_1_61: You can give it Chrono Traces that I can't, showing it truly important moments.
Guide_CLLJ_1_63: I'll make good use of it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_65: I have a feeling you're different from those who never return.
Guide_CLLJ_1_66: However far you go, when you're tired, you're always welcome back to Mt. Firmament.
Guide_CLLJ_1_67: You know where to find me. Let me know when you want to catch up over a pot of tea.

InfoDisplay_121000001_Text:
April 8
The doctor recommended Fuling receive palliative care at home. Fuling smiled and explained that it wasn't about losing hope, but rather a chance to finally visit the magical destinations we've always talked about exploring together... I understand her illness is serious, but as long as it brings her happiness, I'll support her wholeheartedly. And me? Well, I'm not one to give up without a fight.

April 15
Fuling asked me to map out our journey, and she took on the task of delving into success stories of her illness, pinpointing potential treatment spots. A few of the locations she picked were incredibly isolated. I was worried she wouldn't make it to those places. However, she brushed off my concerns with a carefree assurance, claiming she was perfectly capable and full of vigor.
Not wanting to dampen her spirits, I agreed and promised to take good care of her.

May 1
The famous doctor we visited in Mingting said she couldn’t do anything about Fuling's rare symptoms.
It's okay; we have other options. There must be a way to cure her.

May 30
Despite everything we've tried, we haven't found a treatment that can fully cure Fuling. Her condition has worsened, and the illness has made it difficult for her to travel long distances. To cheer her up, I rented a hologram projector from the Pioneer Association for her. She enjoyed the projected scenery, but I couldn’t ignore the yearning and sorrow in her eyes. She concealed them well, but I sensed them, and it pained my heart.

June 13
Fuling, in her gentle way, had requested snapshots of the landscapes I stumbled upon during my travels. She believed that by seeing these images, she could somehow accompany me on my journey. Despite her well-meaning gesture to console me, her absence left a void that tainted even the most breathtaking views with melancholy.

June 15
Encountered a Tacet Field on my path today, diverting me onto a detour that led me to a hidden lake nestled deep within the forest. 
The sight before me was beyond words—the wind carried petals from the trees, creating a mesmerizing dance of colors in the sky. My camera failed to capture the fleeting magic of that moment. Enthralled by the enchanting view, I momentarily lost touch with reality. 
Yet, as quickly as joy enveloped me, sorrow and fear washed over, realizing that such beauty held no meaning without her presence beside me. 
It felt like fate as I journeyed in search of a cure for Fuling, passing through places we had once dreamt of exploring together. Some spots were meant to surprise her during our planned adventures. 
If only Fuling were here, her artistic touch would breathe life into these places once more; even the most desolate ruins would flourish under her paintbrush.
...If only she were here with me.

June 16
I encountered a strange man in red today. His pretentious attitude put me on edge. Despite my unease, he shared a weird story with me, almost as if it was intentional.
He knew I was seeking a cure for Fuling and claimed to have a way to save her. However, he only revealed half the truth and insisted on me doing him a favor before sharing more details. Honestly, I'm not sure if I should trust him.

June 17
My next destination is Jinzhou, the home of a painter Fuling admired. She is so excited about this. I haven't seen her like this in a long time.
I've discovered the true identity of that man in red. Apparently, he belongs to a dangerous organization that I shouldn't meddle with, but...

June 20
The information shared by that man and his organization was beyond anything I could have imagined. The truth behind that tale, the Sentinel's power to manipulate time, the secret realm in Mt. Firmament... if they are all real, then Fuling can be cured.
According to the deal I made with them, I need to use my identity as an adventurer to find a certain object hidden in the mountain, and this object, as they promised, is the key to saving Fuling's life. They seemed unusually obsessed with it, but their intentions were none of my concern. All I need to do is keep Fuling alive, and for that, I'll pay any price.
I must give it a try.
InfoDisplay_121000002_Text:
My Dearest Wuli,

How are you? I wonder if you're still continuing our adventure as you read these words.

You've visited several places on our list of future adventures. I intentionally picked them under the guise of seeking treatment for my illness, as you may have noticed. I wish I could go with you, Wuli… I don't have many days left, but I trust you'll find and enjoy the wonders we once dreamed of sharing.

We've traveled through diverse lands, witnessing lives rebuilding from devastation, and immortalizing extraordinary moments for a wider audience to savor. In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair. This is our quest, and I hope you will carry this essence with you as your journey unfolds.

Our adventures have always been shared with companions. We met, journeyed together for a time, and eventually diverged onto separate paths. Perhaps we will reunite on our next escapade, or perhaps destiny will guide us on divergent routes indefinitely. The bravery to explore and forge ahead will forever reside within us.

This truth holds for our past journey and for the ones ahead for you.

The day will inevitably come when we must bid each other farewell, just as it will when our paths cross once more. So, my love, please, continue your journey... and carry our joint aspirations into the future.

With all my love,
Fuling
InfoDisplay_121000004_Title: Record: Temporal Disruption and Sonoro Sphere
InfoDisplay_121000004_Text:
The Temporal Disruption and the Sonoro Sphere became intricately linked because of malfunctions in the Sentinel's Temporal Mandate, making them inseparable. To safeguard against any deviations, my old friend offered to encase the Sonoro Sphere within a specific medium, turning it into our fail-safe plan.

My new apprentice’s Forte of Flame Manipulation is crucial for destroying the Sonoro Sphere, a task that only she can accomplish. On the other hand, my old friend is the only one who can unlock said Sonoro Sphere. Both individuals are vital to the success of our goal. Yet, unleashing the full power of Flame Manipulation would exact a toll far too heavy for a mere child to endure.

It seems this game shall stay unfinished for many moons to come.
HelpText_77_Content:
[About]
Complete the Lollo Campaigns proposed by Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

Hello, stranger!
If you're reading this message, you must have been selected as the first audience member of our Chelonian Dance Troupe!
A long time ago, I stumbled upon an instrument that can work miracles—the melodious music it plays can make me, animals, and even Tacet Discords dance to its tune. Of all the dances, the dance of tortoises is the most moving.
Since I was a child, I've always dreamed of becoming a performer who sings and dances. Unfortunately, probably due to my lack of talent, I've never been able to sing and dance well despite how much time and effort I've devoted to my training.
However, the moment I saw the tortoises dance, I set a goal for myself—to found a dance troupe!
With my guidance, the Chelonian Dance Troupe has been established for some time now, and our members' rehearsal efforts are beginning to bear fruit.
Now, it's time to pick up the instrument and let the music play!
Let's get moving, Chelonian Dance Troupe! Show the audience a dance they will never forget!
—Founder of Chelonian Dance Troupe

Photograph the strange loop structure in the distance
Side_HZBJT_10_1: That about does it. I can't thank you enough for these wonderful pictures!
Side_HZBJT_10_4: Yes, yes, I will arrange payment as soon as I can!
Side_HZBJT_10_5: But I practically dragged you all over Hongzhen for these photos, didn't I?
Side_HZBJT_10_6: Just gotta deliver these photos before the deadline. Then it's onto the nitty gritty—editing, typesetting, and printing...
Side_HZBJT_10_7: ...Just thinking about all that work makes me depressed.
Side_HZBJT_10_8: The folks in Hongzhen seem to have it easy. No tyrannical editors breathing down their necks with deadlines every day. They can just relax and enjoy that gorgeous mountain view every day.
Side_HZBJT_10_9: I'm tempted to quit and move to Hongzhen myself...
Side_HZBJT_10_11: Maybe things aren't as good as they look.
Side_HZBJT_10_12: Ha! Just kidding. Our editor-in-chief is scarier than a TD Outbreak. If anyone even thinks about quitting, they'd be torn apart.
Side_HZBJT_10_13: You're right. Grass isn't always greener on the other side, huh? Sigh...
Side_HZBJT_10_14: Okay, thanks for everything. I better get back to the office. Until next time, Rover.
Side_HZBJT_8_2: Right! Let's snap an overhead shot of Hongzhen. Our special edition still needs a cover photo, and this will give readers a wonderful perspective of the town.
Side_HZBJT_8_3: Because you know, to most folks, Hongzhen is still an enigmatic, secluded place.

Heihaian_main_1_3_10_3: Here, the story both ends and begins anew.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_4: I am pleased to see you back on these shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_5: Wherever you venture, be it Huanglong or Rinascita, I will always be here, waiting.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_6: No matter how far you wander, you will always find me here... on these black shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_4: Is it really you? No, no, don't let this be a dream… At last! You've come to me, to the Black Shores!
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_7: We need to hurry. Time is one luxury we do not have. Let's save the rest for the road.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_8: Phew, finally out of the cave.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_9: But why is the fog still so thick? I can't even see you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_11: Because you're at Veiled Rock, your vision is veiled. Now, how about explaining what brings you here, uninvited guests?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_12: Wait, what? This is the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_14: But how did you manage to get here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_15: You recount to Aalto the events that led to your arrival here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_16: I see… Tsk, the situation doesn't look good.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_17: That Hoda might not be one of us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_18: Ahem... Anyway, let's not get carried away. We should head to the Greenhouse. The abnormal frequency you collected needs to be uploaded to the Tethys System as soon as possible in order to avoid another Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_22: As for the information you're after—
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_1: Hey! Can you hear me! Is that you, Rover? Are you okay?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_2: We couldn't reach you for so long! Yangyang was freaking out!
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_4: Someone must have teleported us away from the Port City of Guixu when things went south.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_5: You know, in the blink of an eye, we were back in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_6: Hey, is that the sea behind you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_1: Aalto, there you are. And this is…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_2: The Rover just arrived. {Male=He;Female=She} is the one we invited earlier—the mysterious Resonator who appeared in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_3: So you're the Resonator who confronted the Threnodian? I honestly didn't expect to meet you in person!
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_5: I was supposed to show you around, but things are quite hectic right now. My apologies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_6: You heard about what happened in Guixu, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_8: Exactly. We need Tethys functioning normally to fully resolve this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_11: Hoda? No, I don't recall any Bloom Bearer by that name. Why do you ask?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_12: You tell Monica what happened in the Port City of Guixu…
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_32: But retrieving the abnormal frequency was a significant step forward.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_33: Ahem, sorry, I got a bit carried away. My name's Monica, the chief administrator—or "housekeeper" around here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_34: Those Bloom Bearers didn't sacrifice themselves in vain…
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_36: Efforts to stabilize the Tethys System are underway.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_37: Good to hear. By the way, since you deal with all our contacts, does the name "Hoda" ring any bells? She claims to be a Bloom Bearer.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_2: Aalto? I've told you before, when it comes to the classic games on the TR-1200, you don't stand a chance against me. Not in the slightest!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_5: Well, in a sense, yes. They're directly linked to the Tethys System, their voice frequencies are encoded into languages we could understand. If you think about it, they could be considered a unique living race of their own.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_6: Anyway... let me introduce you to KU-Money. They manage the cash flow and keep tabs on robot terminals across the region. They're the shrewd profiteer of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_7: Yo, hold up! You can't call me that! Every move I make is about stacking those chips for the Black Shores!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_21: I haven't heard of anyone with such an ability either.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_22: Gravity control? Sounds farfetched. I'd sooner believe in someone minting Shell Credits.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_23: Unlikely that exists in any universe.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_24: Keep me posted if you find one.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_25: Well, it's a big world, after all. Since we already know someone who can resonate with the Sentinel… you never know.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_27: Sure thing! We can split the Shell Credits they generate, 30-70. I'll take the 70, you take the 30. That's the deal!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_29: As for Hoda... If she's a Bloom Bearer, there should be a record of her in the system. And if such a Resonator existed, the Black Shores would definitely know.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_31: She's not from the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_32: Yeah, that's one possibility. Not to worry, if the machine route doesn't work, there's another way...
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_33: Let's go to the Greenhouse. Most of us like to gather there, and Monica, our chief administrator, is stationed there as well.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_4: Well, well! Look who I bumped into—a Midnight Ranger!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_8: So you're the Rover, huh? Delighted to make your acquaintance.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_9: To uncover clues about hidden antiques, of course! Since Mt. Firmament reopened, Master and I noticed artifacts from there popping up in the market.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_10: Aside from Court of Savantae gadgets, there are still plenty of mystery items that don't exactly scream Mt. Firmament, ya know?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_13: So I'm betting they're from the Port City of Guixu!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_16: Yes, I remember you mentioned wanting to learn more about your past ties to the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_19: I'm touched you remember what I said.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_22: You, er, brought it up before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_23: I still have this Blake Bloom that Aalto gave me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_24: This should lead me to them, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_28: Since we're on the same trail, how about teaming up?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_31: Let THIS master be your guide! You and me, dream team. Nothing is going to slow us down.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2_32: Not to boast, but epic adventures tend to have a way of finding me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_2: I thought an intel broker like you always stays cool-headed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_3: I'm frustrated with myself. Got too carried away by your presence to think straight.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_4: I thought we could easily resolve that issue by uploading the data you brought back to the system. Never considered the possibility of an infiltrator lurking inside.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_5: We need to figure out who's behind all this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_6: Does the Tethys System mean that much to the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_11: Yeah, the Black Shores' every move hinges on its decisions, big or small. Without Tethys, it'd just be a barren Tacetite.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_22: And if you're after the truth, you'll need its assistance too.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_23: Actually, KU-Money, Monica, and I don't have top clearance to the Tethys System. Our access is limited.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_24: With higher clearance, you could uncover the answers you're looking for…
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_26: Alright, let's pick up the pace. We need to find the KU-Water siblings and check on the Modulation Device.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_27: This is your chance to ask anything you want.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_29: If anyone has answers, it's Tethys.
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_30: I can't guarantee you'll get everything you're after, but it's worth a shot, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_20_31: The Greenhouse's just ahead. Let's move.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_1: This piano is playing by itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_2: Hmm? Do you know how to play the piano?
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_3: No. It's doing that all by itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_4: I guess the Black Shores have earned their mysterious reputation. They even have a self-playing piano.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_7: So you do know how to play!
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_10: I don't have a musical bone in me, but that sounded good.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_13: In every sound and frequency lies an emotion.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_14: Hey! Wake up! What was that?
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_17: What's happening? Run! We need to get out of here!
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_3: There was a spike in the anchor frequency of the Tethys algorithmic array. It caused other abnormal frequencies to escape.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_4: Analysts are still investigating. We're already en route for repairs.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_8: Right now, the data stored in Tethys is materializing by drawing energy from the massive Tacetite beneath the Black Shores. It's making digital constructs out of real life entities.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_12: KU-Money already logged your info in Tethys. Now you can command the robots across the Black Shores to fix and upload the corrupted data. That'll restore the anchors.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_13: We're heading to Veiled Rock's anchor. Rover, can you help at the Haven of Sprouts? It's our comms hub.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_16: I'll be helping with the repair at Veiled Rock. Such a pity I won't be there to witness Jinzhou's savior in action once more.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_17: No... I'll miss seeing my friend in action again.
Heihaian_main_1_3_23_18: Maybe that's why you saw the other you in that vision?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_1: That's weird. These parameters are correct, but nothing's happening. What's going on…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_2: Are you a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_8: Oh!? So… y-you're the one Aalto invited earlier?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_10: Ohhh! Sorry I didn't recognize you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_11: Golden pupils and this Blake Bloom. Yeah, it's you alright!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_12: I'm Niya, a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores. Didn't expect to meet someone as important as you under these circumstances...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_15: I know it's unusual, but… could you help me out now that we're working together?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_16: Hold on, I haven't decided if I want to join the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_17: Yes, that's why the Tethys System sent us to locate and recover this frequency as soon as possible, to prevent a potential disaster.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_18: Our agents relayed the coordinates, but...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_19: Since then, I've lost contact with them, which doesn't sit well... I'm stuck here monitoring, can't leave my post.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_20: Do you think you could help check out what happened?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_21: If things aren't looking good, we might need to inform Jinzhou's City Hall, like we did before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_22: We will need to act fast, then.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_23: By the way, what do you mean by "abnormal frequency"?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_24: Could be the Reverberations or something in the Sonoro Spheres.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_25: In Solaris, frequencies can be anything. One thing's for sure though, this frequency represents gravity.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_26: It's abnormal because... it has its own gravitational center. You should be able to feel a palpable anomaly near it. That's how you can locate it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_28: I trust you'll handle it smoothly. But remember, your safety matters most. Don't hesitate to retreat if you run into any real danger.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_29: And once you're back, we'll hurry to the Black Shores to upload it to the Tethys System… Oh! I forgot you haven't been to the Black Shores, have you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_31: No worries. I'll be your guide then.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_32: Really? But Encore mentioned you'd be joining soon...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_33: Can you explain what's going on first?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_34: Actually, we're monitoring abnormal parameters and detected a problematic frequency that needs to be taken back to the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5_1: What's the big deal? Just some pawns. I won't even break a sweat.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5_2: Something feels... different about them. Be careful.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5_3: I sense the presence of Tacet Discords below.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_1: All right! All the repairs are finally done.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_4: Without you leading the charge, we would have barely made it—
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_12: Oh, I forgot to tell you. We finally found out her true identity.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_13: She wasn't lying when she said she was a Bloom Bearer. She worked as a field medic.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_14: Then how is any of this possible?
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_15: Hoda is but one of us. In the Tethys System, our registered name is… Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_16: We are forever trapped on the event horizon of the black hole, falling into an unending darkness…
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_17: Beneath the Lament's wheels we are but dust, pitiful souls cursed to suffer dreadful eternity, denied the solace of death.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_1: You stand on these shores once more. Welcome home, {PlayerName}.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_2: You saved me back in the Port City of Guixu?
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_3: I wished to keep you from any harm.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_4: Forgive me for acting on my own accord.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_5: Was that you on the beach before?
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_8: Sad? Pardon me, such emotions are not mine to show…
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_9: Long ago, when you first brought the Black Shores into existence on this island, I assisted you in managing this place.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_10: You once wove the threads of this world together, but then you left, roving the boundaries between this realm and the next.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_11: I don't remember any of this…
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_12: You have lost far more than just your memories.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_14: Since your departure, the Tethys System has been the sole leader of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_15: You have more important matters to attend to than dealing with everyday trifles. That is why you entrusted the Tethys System with the Black Shores' governance.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_16: This time, only you have the ability to end all of this. Completely.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_19: This is also your first step towards the future.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_1: Th-thank goodness, you're finally awake! I-I thought you fell so hard th-that you wouldn't be able to make it…
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_4: Y-you're at the Bank of Life. As you can see, i-it's an underground seed bank.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_5: M-me? I-I am KU-Nana, an underground Gardener. I-I take care of the flowers here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_6: So I'm already in the underground area, huh?
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_9: Usually, no one comes to the Bank of Life except the Shorekeeper…
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_11: Hmm, as far as I can remember, she seems to have never left this place.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_12: She used to come to the Bank of Life once in a while, choosing a flower to plant in her own "garden." But she hasn't come for a very, very long time.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_13: To be exact, it's been twenty years, five months, and seventeen days since her last visit.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_15: I need to fix Tethys' errors.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_17: Then you need to go to the Data Hub where the Stellar Matrices... I mean collections of stars are stored. Unfortunately, it's been out of commission for a while now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_19: The Shorekeeper has probably been too busy trying to fix it to visit.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_27: If the Shorekeeper places her trust in you, then y-you shall have our trust too.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_29: KU-Money shared your information with us through the Tethys System.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_30: I only know how to take care of plants, and I can't do much in this situation… but I still want to help if the Black Shores, my home, is in crisis!
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_32: I'll give it to the Shorekeeper.
Heihaian_main_1_3_32_34: Go straight ahead, and you'll leave the Bank of Life!
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_1: This is what the Black Shores really looks like.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_3: To be exact, my body is composed of Sonoro Spheres, and the projection you see is but a shadow of the Sonoro.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_4: I cannot leave my post. As the core computational unit of the Tethys System, I must remain to ensure its proper functioning.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_5: Yet, I still wish to be with you. This is the only way.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_6: That is the Necrostar, once known in ancient astronomy as a "black hole."
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_7: Please bring it back to the Modulation Hall, and I shall correct it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_8: Then, the Tethys System will be restored, and harm will be no more.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_9: My only hope now... is that we are not too late.
Heihaian_main_1_3_36_1: Thank you, thank you! You saved the day!
Heihaian_main_1_3_36_2: These Tacet Discords are such a pain! Luckily, we've got a way to get rid of them!
Heihaian_main_1_3_36_6: KU-Nana said you have important things to do, right? Go on, then. Leave the rest to us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_36_7: Madame Beatrice and the Agents also need your help.
Heihaian_main_1_3_36_8: Don't worry, we'll keep this station secure.

HelpText_78_Content: [Event Rules] The Pioneer Association has selected Mt. Firmament as the focal region in the most recent edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special exploration of Mt. Firmament. Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association. [Quest Reset] Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00 (UTC-08:00). Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_85_2: It seems the Fractsidus had infiltrated Mt. Firmament even before the disaster struck.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_7: Well, we're alive at least. Can't complain. A few scrapes and bruises are nothing compared to what could've happened.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_8: Goodness, that kind young lady saved our lives from the Disruption. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't still be breathing today.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_9: A kind young lady? You mean...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_10: Oh, come on. That's not just any young lady. She's the Magistrate of Jinzhou!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_11: ...Oh, my, so she is our Magistrate? She looked so young...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_8: ...Well... I thought she knew nothing about our town as an outsider...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_9: But it was too late, the decision had been made based on the support she received. In the end, I just accepted the inevitable.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_11: Uh... Have you never heard about Uncle Fu?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_12: ...{Male=He;Female=She} must be the esteemed guest from Jinzhou Lady Xinyi mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_14: That man in the white shirt is Uncle Fu, former leader of Hongzhen. Despite having stepped down from his position, he still commands respect from the townsfolk.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_15: He's said to be over a hundred years old, making him the oldest person in town.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_16: Sigh... It must be tough for him, enduring all this chaos at his age...

HelpText_79_Title: About the Tales from Mt. Firmament
HelpText_79_Content:
[About]
Mt. Firmament is a secluded haven, detached from the rest of the world. It is rumored to be the very place where the Sentinel Jué descended...
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Mt. Firmament in the main quest "Voyage to Firmament."

[Event Rules]
The event consists of four phases, with each phase unlocking progressively as you advance through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available while in certain game scenes.

This gentle but mysterious Wayfinder extends a rather special invitation to you...
