Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_1: Have you seen the Magistrate of Jinzhou... She looks familiar...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_2: She looks like the baby our Sentinel brought back all those years ago...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_3: ...She appears to be 16 or 17 years old though. It doesn't make sense...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_4: Time works differently here in Mt. Firmament, remember? Good luck figuring out the math.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_1: Nothing I've tried so far is working.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_2: The Nexus is completely out of commission...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_3: Can't tell if it's the Temporal Disruption or the Fractsidus' doing.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_4: So we can't use our Terminals to locate those missing people?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_160_3: Don't worry, I'm here with you...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_160_4: Hang in there. I'll have you patched up in no time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_2: Sorry, ma'am. You must stay here. It's too dangerous.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_3: My child... She's been... the Temporal Disruption...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_4: I'm begging you, please... I need to go save her...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_287_1: A Fractsidus Artificer frozen in time by the Sentinel. They must belong to the death squad Xinyi mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_288_1: A Fractsidus Artificer gravely injured by Mianloong Chamber's defense mechanism. They must belong to the death squad Xinyi mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_62_1: A Scarefrost Deer caught in the Temporal Disruption. It is now forever frozen in the instant before the disaster struck.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_62_2: Though appearing still and serene from the outside, internally it is being torn apart by the chaotic forces of time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_7_1: Did you hear about the fog over the waters around Mt. Firmament?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_7_2: They say it's as thick as a brick wall.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_7_3: Well, that's why they call it "Restricted Waters".
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_7_4: Remember that notice from City Hall? How long has it been up?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_86_1: A resident of Hongzhen, suspended in time by the Temporal Disruption. They are now forever frozen in the instant before the disaster struck.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_86_2: Fortune had turned its back on this unlucky soul.
POI_ZLYZ_10_2: *coughing* Sorry, I-I got a bit carried away…
POI_ZLYZ_10_4: Uncle Fu said there are a total of five parts of this ritual, and we have to go all over Mt. Firmament for them...
POI_ZLYZ_10_5: Uncle Fu didn't give clear hints about where to take the remaining four steps, just some brief clues.
POI_ZLYZ_10_6: He said the first is located <color=Highlight>north of Xuanji Ridge, at the boundary of yellow and white</color>; the second is located <color=Highlight>south of Hongzhen, where the waterfalls converge</color>.
POI_ZLYZ_10_7: The third is located <color=Highlight>above the Loong's Ridge, at the peak of the arch-shaped rock</color>; and the fourth is located <color=Highlight>on the southeast side, among the shoals and islands</color>.
POI_ZLYZ_10_8: That's all I know. Sorry, but it seems you'll need to figure out the exact locations yourself... I'm counting on you!

POI_ZLYZ_2_2: Hey! Wake up! Can you hear me?
POI_ZLYZ_2_3: Her hands are so cold. Oh no.
POI_ZLYZ_2_4: But she doesn't seem badly injured.
POI_ZLYZ_2_7: Seems like she's out cold from hunger and, well, cold. I might not know what cold feels like, but hunger? That's a killer!
POI_ZLYZ_2_8: Let's whip up something for her, shall we?
POI_ZLYZ_2_9: Something delicious, warm, and easy to the stomach!
POI_ZLYZ_2_11: Oh great, now I'm hungry too! Make some more, I'd like some soup too!
POI_ZLYZ_21_1: So, we're all done with the ritual. Time to get you back to Hongzhen.
POI_ZLYZ_21_2: Hold on! It's not done yet!
POI_ZLYZ_21_4: Yeah, I just found a note left by Uncle Fu. Turns out it was once a simple coming-of-age tradition for the people of Mt. Firmament.
POI_ZLYZ_21_5: Only the Flamebearers who passed the trials of wisdom and strength were recognized as adults, proving they could protect the Sentinel and Hongzhen.
POI_ZLYZ_21_6: But later, it transformed into a ceremonial activity of blessings and worship.
POI_ZLYZ_21_8: The previous trials only tested the Flamebearer's wisdom. The Flamebearer would still need to prove their strength.
POI_ZLYZ_21_10: Oh, it's time for the final ritual. Rover, please go to this place with the glazed lamp I gave you.
POI_ZLYZ_26_1: Rover, what happened? I saw a huge meteor falling down!
POI_ZLYZ_26_2: You explain the details of the final ritual to Shicheng.
POI_ZLYZ_26_4: I never realized Uncle Fu has been performing this ritual alone all these years, praying for the Sentinel.
POI_ZLYZ_26_5: Hopefully the Sentinel will hear our prayers and get better soon.
POI_ZLYZ_26_7: I've made up my mind. I will help Uncle Fu preserve this tradition and spread awareness about it.
POI_ZLYZ_26_9: Alright then, I guess it's time to say goodbye. I’ll stay here a bit longer to organize the records on this ritual.
POI_ZLYZ_20_1: Wow, so you've completed every step of the ritual already?!
POI_ZLYZ_20_2: Is this really it, though? I still feel like something’s missing.
POI_ZLYZ_20_3: Rover, could you go back to the cave in Xuanji Ridge? We may have missed some clues there.
POI_ZLYZ_5_1: The mechanism has been unlocked. It seems we still need to guide the light to the final destination.
POI_ZLYZ_5_2: So we need to remove anything that may get in the light beam's way. Hmm, it looks a bit complex.
POI_ZLYZ_6_1: Let me see. This should be where the final step takes place. By the look of it, is this... the place called Loong's Crest?
POI_ZLYZ_6_2: We need to align the <color=Highlight>pearl</color> with its <color=Highlight>mouth</color>… Alright, I've got the hang of it.
POI_ZLYZ_22_1: That giant rock landed by the seaside. Quick! Let's go check it out!
POI_ZLYZ_16_1: Look! There's something engraved on this device!

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_1: ...Once Tacet Discords terrorized the land. The region of Jinzhou was under siege.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_2: A mother and her newborn child were hiding in ruins, trying to avoid the deadly creatures
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_3: They weren't safe for long as the Tacet Discord found them. The mother sacrificed herself to protect her child
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_4: ...but with her gone, it was difficult for the newborn to survive. In a couple minutes, its loud cries gradually died out
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_5: Fortunately, the newborn's cries echoed through the forest, with a unique resonance that reached the ears of the mighty Sentinel
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_6: With a burst of energy, our Sentinel dispelled the surrounding evils
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_7: But sadly, it was too late
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_8: That night, Mt. Firmament shook with the roars of a Loong, and dark clouds gathered. The Sentinel returned with a dead infant in its embrace
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_9: As if by magic, somber clouds parted and shooting stars lit up the sky. With Mt. Firmament's unique flow of time, the Sentinel brought the deceased infant back to life
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_355_10: The resurrected infant became known as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, and went on to become the Magistrate of Jinzhou...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_400_1: {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter, may this one transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_400_2: This one has heard your decision.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_400_4: The transfer has been carried out as you instructed.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_400_6: Jinhsi, one shall honor one's promise and restore Jinzhou's future to you and its people.

ItemInfo_80000033_BgDescription:
One of the specialties in Mt. Firmament. It resembles the fruit of the Silver Lotus. In fact, the residents of Mt. Firmament do incorporate Silver Lotus into this pastry.
It is said that the Silver Lotus only grows in thick snow, blooming amidst the cold. The residents on Mt. Firmament believe that this flower blooms in deep snow to show gratitude to the forest and to uphold a belief in eternal blossoming. Thus, they have wrapped this promise within this pastry. As the stars rise and the moon sets, as snow falls and melts, the people of Mt. Firmament will never forget their promises.

InfoDisplay_311000002_Text:
It suddenly dawns on me that I've been copying her paintings for over a year now. I've employed the same rendering technique, the same wrinkle method, and the same composition. Yet, my paintings lack her vividness, their visions unsteady as well. My Forte mirrors hers closely, only that her work conjures more vibrant and stable visions. I could achieve the same. Once I manage to conjure visions with the same vividness, people will recognize me as the best painter!
...

Mr. Baici, a man who has collaborated with numerous renowned artists, came to visit me. He had heard that I, too, could create paintings that summon vivid illusions. He came to express his admiration and encouraged me to continue. At first, I thought someone had finally recognized my talent. But his true intention was to recruit me into his shady business, buying all Forte works for dubious purposes. I had heard of the Shanyun Art Exchange, but never imagined their dealings would be so unscrupulous. While I did copy those paintings for practice, the choice of what and how to paint was mine alone. These dealers think they can buy me—what a joke.
...

The Shanyun Art Exchange sent me an authentic painting so I could study the vision's frequency. They claim they have superior methods to help me achieve the desired effect if my own Forte fall short. My Forte is not inferior to hers. They simply haven’t seen its full potential. Yet, with the authentic work in hand, progress would indeed be swifter.
Their condition is that I collaborate with them and hand over all my copies. These paintings are mere stepping stones to my success, destined to be discarded. So, why not accept their terms? I don't care what they do with the paintings. They assure me they've been conducting such transactions for years without incident. With such a powerful patron, there should be no trouble.
I'll do anything to make it happen.
...

Having an authentic work in my hands makes all the difference. The frequency fluctuations of the painting have allowed me to glimpse her energy. I need to examine her original painting once more. A perfect replica is just the beginning. One day, I will be the only painter capable of bringing paintings to life, surpassing even her achievements.
...

Why do my paintings still fall short after all this time? They lack her artistic depth! Wait—I think I understand. If I use their method to alter the painting's frequency, I might be able to achieve it...
...

Mr. Baici is truly a connoisseur of art. He says my recent works are nearly indistinguishable from the original. Some have even exhibited power beyond the original piece. I knew it. The gap between us is merely a slight difference in ability. With their technical support, my Forte has easily reached the next level. Surpassing her should be simple, let alone mere replication.
...

No, something is wrong... Why do my paintings attract Tacet Discords? The visions are more unstable now. How is it that her painting has none of these problems? There's something amiss here. I... I just want to surpass her! I never meant to harm anyone! The Shanyun Art Exchange is still not giving me a clear answer... This was not our deal!
...

I'm tired, truly, deeply tired...
I won't create any more paintings that harm others.
This isn't what I wanted!
But they have evidence of what I've done and won't let me go...
What should I do? What should I do?
Can anyone help me... anybody...
I’m not afraid of being caught anymore... As long as I can get out of this...
Help me...

Character_ZheZhi_10_52: Oh... but those ore buyers from a while back, they seemed a bit suspicious.
Character_ZheZhi_10_53: Thieves don't deserve my business or respect.
Character_ZheZhi_12_36: Oh, is this not a good time?
Character_ZheZhi_12_37: That's okay! Just tell me if you need any help!
Character_ZheZhi_12_38: Why not? Maybe we'll find some clues useful to our case.
Character_ZheZhi_12_39: You could be right, but there's one other thing...
Character_ZheZhi_13_37: Why are you apologizing all of a sudden?
Character_ZheZhi_13_39: Thanks... Uh, wait, I haven't said why.
Character_ZheZhi_13_40: What I'm trying to say is...
Character_ZheZhi_13_41: If I had been clearer, you wouldn't have had to explain things to Chixia for me.
Character_ZheZhi_13_42: She's really nice. It's just... we're not that close, and I'm not sure how to respond to how friendly she is... I didn't want to be rude, so I... I couldn't bring myself to turn her down.
Character_ZheZhi_13_45: I'll do my best not to trouble you and express my feelings properly next time...
Character_ZheZhi_13_48: Then both of you decide to ask people around about the situation.
Character_ZheZhi_15_14: What's the situation with the artist?
Character_ZheZhi_15_15: She fessed up when I first started talking to her, but clammed up when I tried to dig deeper.
Character_ZheZhi_16_4: Yes, we used to take painting lessons together.
Character_ZheZhi_16_7: I... I hurt them... it... it was a mistake...
Character_ZheZhi_16_8: You mean... you hurt those people?
Character_ZheZhi_16_14: Mingyan appears to be done talking about the matter.
Character_ZheZhi_2_25: Hmm... S-should I take the stand myself? What do you think, little kitty?
Character_ZheZhi_2_26: Ah, maybe we can do a little show of... um... paws. Raise your left paw if you think I should testify, or your right paw if...
Character_ZheZhi_2_27: W-wait! You raised your left paw before I even finished my sentence... No, that doesn't count. Let's try again.
Character_ZheZhi_2_28: Okay, if you raise your right paw, I'll... let someone else handle it.
Character_ZheZhi_2_29: Hmm... right paw, huh? Well... I did actually want to tell everyone the truth myself. Let's give this another shot.
Character_ZheZhi_2_30: Ms. Zhezhi, the hearing is about to start. If you would, please join us.
Character_ZheZhi_2_31: Now? Y-yes, Madam Juyao! I... I'll be there in a minute!
Character_ZheZhi_2_32: I just handed over all the evidence we gathered from Mingyan's studio and the Exile's camp to the Patrollers.
Character_ZheZhi_2_33: Now the Shanyun Art Exchange can't deny the fact they were producing and trading art forgeries.
Character_ZheZhi_2_34: But... there is one more thing. The Patroller said we still need someone to testify in the hearing.
Character_ZheZhi_2_35: Do you want me to testify?
Character_ZheZhi_2_36: You're really kind, but... um, I'll be fine to do this myself. You've already helped me so much, even just having you here is a huge relief.
Character_ZheZhi_2_37: Some things, I've got to face on my own.
Character_ZheZhi_2_38: That said... I, uh, didn't... didn't expect there would be so many spectators coming to watch...
Character_ZheZhi_2_39: If I get nervous and mess up any details, could you please help to remind me?
Character_ZheZhi_2_41: Thank you! Having you here helps, more than you know.
Character_ZheZhi_2_42: It's about time. We should probably go in, huh?
Character_ZheZhi_2_43: H-how about... you do the talking, and, um, I'll add details... if, if I have to?
Character_ZheZhi_2_44: I was the one who chose to uncover the truth behind this case. I can't back down now, not when it matters most.
Character_ZheZhi_20_4: It's a good thing they caught that painter. Can't imagine what could've happened otherwise.
Character_ZheZhi_20_5: I've met my fair share of artists, but none that would gamble with lives for the sake of their work. That's a first for me...
Character_ZheZhi_20_6: I heard stuff like "Don't stop me!" "I've... I've already won!" and "Who doesn't want fame and fortune!"
Character_ZheZhi_21_4: They repeatedly describe witnessing bizarre, otherwordly visions.
Character_ZheZhi_21_5: The researcher indicated they were created by the artist's Forte.
Character_ZheZhi_21_6: So... Mingyan channeled her Forte into the painting, creating temporary phantasms.
Character_ZheZhi_21_7: People saw her abilities and spread the rumor, believing she was the Arcane Artist from the tale.
Character_ZheZhi_21_8: And the Tacet Discords were being drawn to her Forte.
Character_ZheZhi_21_9: The monsters described in the rumors were probably just exaggerated phantasms seen by scared people at night.
Character_ZheZhi_21_10: So she was there at the same time we were... I didn't even notice her presence...
Character_ZheZhi_21_13: She kept squeezing my hand and trying to tell me something, but I couldn't understand what she was saying...
Character_ZheZhi_21_14: I think she wants me to continue the investigation. Maybe there's more to this story than I thought...
Character_ZheZhi_21_16: It's linked to my case as well.
Character_ZheZhi_21_23: Huh? A-are you sure? I definitely won't say no to your help! Actually, I... I've wanted it since we last met at the mine!
Character_ZheZhi_21_24: Then... if you're up for it, I hope you can join me in the investigation. Consider it a formal invitation, {PlayerName}!
Character_ZheZhi_21_28: You want me to decide? To be honest, I haven't really thought it through...
Character_ZheZhi_21_29: Hmm... I remember meeting Mingyan in an art studio in Jinzhou before. I wonder if she kept going there after I left...
Character_ZheZhi_21_31: I've never tried to investigate anything, so I'm not sure if this is the way to go...
Character_ZheZhi_21_32: I think it is. After you, then.
Character_ZheZhi_21_37: In fact, I had sensed something odd at the mine. But after we met, I thought it was coming from you, so I didn't give it much attention.
Character_ZheZhi_21_38: Come to think of it now, it might've been Mingyan's Forte fluctuation.
Character_ZheZhi_21_39: But... what could have driven her to create such dangerous paintings?
Character_ZheZhi_21_40: One witness said she probably did this for personal gain.
Character_ZheZhi_21_41: From what I know of her, she doesn't seem like someone who would take such risks for personal gain.
Character_ZheZhi_21_42: Besides, I don't recall her having a Forte before...
Character_ZheZhi_21_43: Maybe this has something to do with me...
Character_ZheZhi_21_44: Should that be our first stop? She may have left some of her artwork behind. That could be a good start...
Character_ZheZhi_24_22: How do you know so much?!
Character_ZheZhi_24_23: Buy three, get one free; buy five, get two free; and then there's the additional weekly coupons—I know everything there is to know about the discounts! Hehe...
Character_ZheZhi_27_16: It's a shame the clothes are stained forever, but it's worth it to see how different inks behave on fabric.
Character_ZheZhi_29_5: That's why there are so many copies of the original artwork.
Character_ZheZhi_29_6: But I have some other thoughts about it.
Character_ZheZhi_29_7: The Shanyun Art Exchange is a renowned institution that manages the exchange of calligraphy and paintings in Huanglong. For an artist to have their work selected is a great honor, bringing with it immense prestige.
Character_ZheZhi_29_8: According to Mingyan's diary, the Art Exchange had been collaborating with her... until some terrible mishap occurred...
Character_ZheZhi_29_11: But I have some other thoughts about it...
Character_ZheZhi_29_12: Being picky about one's work is second nature to an artist.
Character_ZheZhi_29_13: I'm no exception... There's never been a moment when I saw my art outshining someone else's. I've always admired my fellow artists, hoping that one day I could be as good as them, perhaps even surpass them.
Character_ZheZhi_29_14: "This needs to be refined, it's not quite there yet..." "Still short of perfect... Will my client be disappointed?"
Character_ZheZhi_29_15: I had these kinds of thoughts every day while I painted. It started creeping into my daily life too...
Character_ZheZhi_29_18: It's true that one might find motivation in these thoughts, but they can also lead one astray.
Character_ZheZhi_29_21: I felt trapped for ages... until I finally figured out the path I ought to follow.
Character_ZheZhi_29_23: Embrace my emotions fully, and create the art my heart yearns for. This is of the greatest importance to me.
Character_ZheZhi_29_24: But if I found myself in the same situation as Mingyan, perhaps... perhaps I'd react similarly and lose my way...
Character_ZheZhi_29_25: She was forced into this and was looking for a way out... I can't just turn a blind eye and let them charge her! There must be a way to uncover the truth and save her.
Character_ZheZhi_29_26: Yes, we should continue our investigation now.
Character_ZheZhi_29_27: I kept painting and improving, but no matter how hard I tried, I always felt it wasn't good enough...
Character_ZheZhi_3_26: Ms. Zhezhi alleges that the guilty party, Mingyan, implicated in the Tacet Discord Assault, was coerced into committing art fraud under duress.
Character_ZheZhi_3_27: Mr. Baici, I remind you that any evidence or arguments presented before and during the hearing are valid.
Character_ZheZhi_3_28: If you would like to add further information, you are welcome to do so at any point.
Character_ZheZhi_3_29: Now, without further ado, either party may begin their opening statement.
Character_ZheZhi_3_31: I demand they compensate us for our losses and issue a public apology!
Character_ZheZhi_3_34: I was entrusted to investigate a certain "Arcane Artist" in the Tiger's Maw.
Character_ZheZhi_31_8: Then... I'll share it with you...
Character_ZheZhi_32_3: (I bet the water on the floor is from the fishbowl... Huh? Why is that water mark in the shape of a Gulpuff...)
Character_ZheZhi_32_4: (Okay, I've figured it out! That must be the reason. {PlayerName} will definitely be impressed with my deductive skills.)
Character_ZheZhi_33_9: It's okay. You just need more clues.
Character_ZheZhi_33_10: Is that so? I-I'll practice more often!
Character_ZheZhi_33_11: I see... I guess I jumped to conclusions. I'll do better next time!
Character_ZheZhi_33_12: By the way, was that your Forte just now?
Character_ZheZhi_33_13: Oh, yes, these are... phantasms I can create with my brush. They only exist for a short while.
Character_ZheZhi_33_14: I haven't done this for a long time. I'm a bit rusty now...
Character_ZheZhi_33_15: Haven't done this for a long time?
Character_ZheZhi_33_16: Yes, I rarely need to use my Forte in daily life.
Character_ZheZhi_33_17: An artwork created with Forte is indeed mesmerizing, nearly flawless, but that's not my goal...
Character_ZheZhi_33_18: So, I've used this ability less over time.
Character_ZheZhi_33_19: Do you think Mingyan's case has something to do with you?
Character_ZheZhi_33_20: Yes. It could be related to my Forte...
Character_ZheZhi_33_21: We'll talk about this later. Let's look outside now.
Character_ZheZhi_33_22: My family used to have an aquarium at home with lots of Gulpuffs. I thought it was a popular trend...
Character_ZheZhi_33_23: When it comes to painting, I prefer the traditional way. It helps me to understand my progress and improve my skills.
Character_ZheZhi_33_24: But it's fine to use it for the investigation.
Character_ZheZhi_37_5: I took a look and noticed that these pigments were handcrafted from these specific ores...
Character_ZheZhi_37_6: Standard pigments adhere well and last a long time, but these makeshift pigments smear with the slightest touch.
Character_ZheZhi_37_9: I did mention this back in the studio... when my clothes got stained by Mingyan's pigments.
Character_ZheZhi_37_10: They are similar. Did she... buy these low-quality pigments from the Exiles? But why did these people break into her studio...
Character_ZheZhi_37_13: Was the pigment in Mingyan's studio the same as this?
Character_ZheZhi_37_14: Did she... buy these low-quality pigments from the Exiles? But why did these people break into her studio...
Character_ZheZhi_38_10: Did something happen to her recently?
Character_ZheZhi_38_12: My guess? She's dabbling in some new, secretive art piece. I spotted her taking risky stabs at painting out in the wild.
Character_ZheZhi_38_13: Well, now that you mention it, I do remember her talking about making art you could "step into" or whatever.
Character_ZheZhi_38_14: But her little art excursions stirred up some unstable Frequencies. We warned her, but did she listen? Nope.
Character_ZheZhi_38_15: That's right! I saw her paintings myself! Tried to steer her clear, and what do I get? A lecture! Artists, always on their own wild wavelength, aren't they?
Character_ZheZhi_38_16: Sorry to interrupt, but mind if I ask what you normally do for a living?
Character_ZheZhi_38_17: Us? Oh, the usual. A bit of hunting, some gigs here and there. Just the everyday grind.
Character_ZheZhi_38_19: You don't buy ore to make your own pigments?
Character_ZheZhi_38_20: Nope, not many jobs around, just enough to scrape by.
Character_ZheZhi_38_21: Uh... Oh! Right, haha, you reminded me. We do make and sell pigments occasionally.
Character_ZheZhi_38_22: Oh yeah, Mingyan buys from us often. We give her the lowest price, just as friends do!
Character_ZheZhi_38_23: I see. Thank you. We'll leave now.
Character_ZheZhi_38_24: We're here for Mingyan's painting. She's our friend.
Character_ZheZhi_38_26: If it's her paintings you're after, why are you here?
Character_ZheZhi_38_27: She... she wasn't in her studio, so we thought we could ask around.
Character_ZheZhi_38_28: I see. Just wait for her here. When she leaves, it usually doesn't take long for her to return.
Character_ZheZhi_38_29: You're here to buy paintings? That's not how this works. Go on, get out of here.
Character_ZheZhi_38_30: W-we are actually here for Mingyan's paintings. She wasn't in her studio, so we thought we could ask around.
Character_ZheZhi_38_32: What did you mean just now?
Character_ZheZhi_38_33: ...It's nothing. Just wait for her here. When she leaves, it usually doesn't take long for her to return.
Character_ZheZhi_39_4: I noticed some of the Exiles' hands were blackened... The thought suddenly hit me, what if it's from constant exposure to ink?
Character_ZheZhi_39_5: If so, they must be making a lot of pigments and ink sticks...
Character_ZheZhi_39_6: But they lied to us and tried to cover it up.
Character_ZheZhi_39_7: The painting they showed us and the artworks in the studio... they all match what Mingyan described in her diary.
Character_ZheZhi_39_8: Her diary shows us she had major mood swings, which really affected her art.
Character_ZheZhi_39_9: We can investigate the camp again tonight. What do you say?
Character_ZheZhi_39_10: Maybe there's more they're trying to hide.
Character_ZheZhi_39_13: Did you wanna say something just now?
Character_ZheZhi_39_14: All these strange things... started happening after the Shanyun Art Exchange got involved.
Character_ZheZhi_4_3: Things are getting awfully strange around the mine lately. Figured you're just the one to untangle this mess.
Character_ZheZhi_4_4: With your knack for solving mysteries, you'll figure this out in no time!
Character_ZheZhi_4_6: I don't know if you've ever heard of it, but there's a special folktale in Jinzhou...
Character_ZheZhi_4_7: Word has it, there's this mysterious Arcane Artist whose paintings come to life as they paint, as if each brushstroke has a life of its own.
Character_ZheZhi_4_8: Once their canvas dries, whatever they've painted leaps right off the page. Mythical creatures, the whole shebang—all real as day!
Character_ZheZhi_4_9: The thing is, anyone who might've seen these paintings? Well, they vanish into thin air...
Character_ZheZhi_4_10: What does the mine have to do with all of this?
Character_ZheZhi_4_11: Sounds like a Forte to me.
Character_ZheZhi_4_12: I've never heard of such unique Forte.
Character_ZheZhi_4_13: Lately, I've been receiving reports about eerie monsters wandering the mine at midnight. Some witnesses even ran into them more than once!
Character_ZheZhi_4_14: These monsters, they look like paintings from a distance. But approach them and they're as docile as can be.
Character_ZheZhi_4_15: Reading these reports, I couldn't shake the tale of the Arcane Artist from my mind.
Character_ZheZhi_4_16: But with rumors swirling, folks are getting jittery. Can't let things escalate. That's why I reached out to you.
Character_ZheZhi_4_17: Let me take it from here.
Character_ZheZhi_4_19: Great! Counting on you to crack this case wide open.
Character_ZheZhi_4_20: Deal! I'll pay whatever it takes to keep the goosebumps coming. I can't wait for you to uncover the truth!
Character_ZheZhi_4_21: Oh, and you might want to chat up the witnesses. Got their names right here for you.
Character_ZheZhi_4_22: Sure, some say it's just a prank or some new Tacet Discord variant...
Character_ZheZhi_42_3: We should go before anyone else spots us.
Character_ZheZhi_43_2: It's them! They were here asking about Mingyan earlier today!
Character_ZheZhi_43_3: What were you saying just now?
Character_ZheZhi_43_4: Who do you think you are?! We don't need to tell you a thing!
Character_ZheZhi_43_5: We just want the truth of Mingyan's case.
Character_ZheZhi_43_7: W-wait a second! Things don't need to get violent! We'll talk, okay?
Character_ZheZhi_43_8: About Mingyan... Didn't my men answer your questions already? That's everything we've got on her, I swear. What more do you want?
Character_ZheZhi_43_9: Spill the truth or we won't let you go.
Character_ZheZhi_43_11: Alright, alright! I'll tell you everything!
Character_ZheZhi_43_13: What? Can't you see that we're no match for {Male=him;Female=her}? Go ahead and pick a fight if you want, but I'm not risking my life for this.
Character_ZheZhi_43_14: Now what else do you want to know? Just ask!
Character_ZheZhi_43_15: Did Mingyan get hurt because of you?
Character_ZheZhi_43_16: Why are you really making pigments and ink sticks?
Character_ZheZhi_43_17: Are you with the Shanyun Art Exchange?
Character_ZheZhi_43_19: If Yinfeng hadn't pushed her so hard, she wouldn't have gotten hurt. Now, she can't even pick up a paintbrush, much less finish this batch of paintings.
Character_ZheZhi_43_20: Oh, quick to sell me out, huh? All I did was remind her to focus on her paintings.
Character_ZheZhi_43_21: She's been rebellious and a bit too smart for her own good lately. I just wanted her to keep her head down and work. Who knew she'd crack and cause that mess.
Character_ZheZhi_43_22: To cut our costs and keep our cooperation with the painters going. What else could it be?
Character_ZheZhi_43_23: We... we're with the Shanyun Art Exchange. We're only pretending to be Exiles because our boss, Mr. Baici, wants this business kept quiet.
Character_ZheZhi_43_24: You shouldn't have told them! Mr. Baici said no one can find out about the Art Exchange's involvement, no matter what!
Character_ZheZhi_43_25: You just can't stop talking back, can you?
Character_ZheZhi_43_26: So the Shanyun Art Exchange has been involved in Mingyan's case right from the start.
Character_ZheZhi_43_27: No wonder they got all shifty when we brought up Mingyan earlier...
Character_ZheZhi_43_28: Masquerading as Exiles is indeed cunning.
Character_ZheZhi_43_31: It was his signature on Mr. Shilang's transaction record.
Character_ZheZhi_43_32: We spoke right where it happened.
Character_ZheZhi_43_33: When I asked him about the incident, he put all the blame on Mingyan, saying she had ulterior motives.
Character_ZheZhi_43_34: The Exiles we questioned during the day did the same, trying to divert attention and cover up their own involvement at the scene in the first place.
Character_ZheZhi_43_35: These distractions led us to concentrate solely on Mingyan, ignoring other possible angles.
Character_ZheZhi_43_36: I have a theory... but we need that "batch of paintings" they mentioned to test it...
Character_ZheZhi_43_37: Let's give the area another sweep.
Character_ZheZhi_43_38: But there are so many more people in the camp now! How will we get in?
Character_ZheZhi_43_40: Huh? Why are you staring at me? Wait, I've told you everything I know! Aaargh—
Character_ZheZhi_43_41: With the Exile clothing in hand, the two of you quickly change into your disguises.
Character_ZheZhi_43_43: They might hide all the evidence if we barge in like that...
Character_ZheZhi_43_44: Then we'll just have to "blend in."

Character_ZheZhi_47_4: Wow, thanks. I'll go take a breather then. Right, the rest of the supplies are in the northern warehouse...
Character_ZheZhi_47_5: What did you just say?! That's it, I'm heading to the northern warehouse right now! Wait till you see me carry a hundred of those supplies... in one go!
Character_ZheZhi_49_1: Rinse, grind, separate the pigments, then thin it out...
Character_ZheZhi_49_3: You're right... Wait a minute. How do you know how to make paint?
Character_ZheZhi_49_4: I thought you were talking in your sleep...
Character_ZheZhi_49_6: She memorized it just so she could help out.
Character_ZheZhi_5_22: No way... Those monsters showed up in an empty field at midnight, so there was no one around to prank. Besides, what's the point of tricks if there's no one to see them?
Character_ZheZhi_51_1: And the next route should be...
Character_ZheZhi_51_2: Hmm? What are you looking at? This isn't for you to see. Go away, shoo.
Character_ZheZhi_57_1: This must be the warehouse they were talking about...
Character_ZheZhi_57_2: There's still some leftover ink lying around.
Character_ZheZhi_57_5: So all those copies from the studio...
Character_ZheZhi_57_6: These aren't just simple copies anymore... It's obvious now... she was working with them to create forgeries... for her own gain.
Character_ZheZhi_57_7: In the end, this is the path she chose... I-I suspected as much, though I couldn't quite... I mean, I wasn't sure until I saw the paintings myself.
Character_ZheZhi_57_9: Wait. This painting... it's the "Serenity of Xiehua Village" original. Not a copy... Shouldn't it be at the studio?
Character_ZheZhi_57_10: Oh, I see it now. This was the painting they stole from the studio!
Character_ZheZhi_57_11: How can you tell them apart?
Character_ZheZhi_57_12: These copies, they're almost identical to the original... but there are some details, subtle ones, that reflect the artists' quirks, not just their technique. The painter copied them well.
Character_ZheZhi_57_14: How do you know so much about the original painting?
Character_ZheZhi_57_16: This batch is all "Serenity of Xiehua Village"... Mingyan's work.
Character_ZheZhi_57_17: But if you look closely, you'll find that the finishings are a bit, um, more rigid in some areas.
Character_ZheZhi_60_19: How could you measure the value of creation in such a way...?
Character_ZheZhi_60_21: The way you coerced the painters... a-and put their lives at risk for profit... I'll expose it all!
Character_ZheZhi_61_9: Trickery, misinformation, and later on even threats... She was led down the path of forging artworks for you.
Character_ZheZhi_61_10: I do understand that... if her own heart hadn't wavered, none of this would've happened... But there was already no turning back by the time she wanted to quit.
Character_ZheZhi_61_11: So, saying she was the mastermind behind it all... that's just not fair.
Character_ZheZhi_61_12: Even so, how is forgery a valid accusation? Nothing like that was mentioned in your recording, now was it?
Character_ZheZhi_61_13: We found the original painting in the hidden warehouse.
Character_ZheZhi_61_14: We found evidence of forgeries being bought and sold.
Character_ZheZhi_61_15: This evidence clearly shows that these paintings are no ordinary copies, but your way of making a profit.
Character_ZheZhi_61_16: Heh, there's no such thing as real or fake paintings. You're not fooling anyone.
Character_ZheZhi_61_18: ...Mr. Baici, do you recognize this painting?
Character_ZheZhi_61_19: Well, of course. It's "Serenity of Xiehua Village," the work of the Arcane Artist.
Character_ZheZhi_61_20: Then can you tell the difference between this one and the others?
Character_ZheZhi_61_21: Of course, this piece possesses a lifelike quality unmatched by any other, all thanks to the Resonance ability of the Arcane Artist—Mingyan.
Character_ZheZhi_61_22: However, judging from these paintings, it seems Mingyan's ability never stabilized successfully, except for this original piece.
Character_ZheZhi_61_23: What does this have to do with anything? Do you have solid evidence to prove the differences between these paintings?
Character_ZheZhi_61_24: What you're saying is all speculation. There's no guarantee a painter won't make mistakes, is there?
Character_ZheZhi_61_25: Artists seeking perfection always choose the highest quality pigments for their most important pieces.
Character_ZheZhi_61_26: The original paintings had pigments that were purer and brighter, able to blend more naturally and retain color for longer.
Character_ZheZhi_61_27: In contrast, the forgeries used pigments made from mineral scraps. These don't hold up the same, smudging at the slightest touch.
Character_ZheZhi_61_28: We can distinguish the real paintings from the fakes simply by analyzing the ink used.
Character_ZheZhi_61_29: Doing so only proves the so-called "original painting" is created differently from the others. Are you implying that Mingyan is only allowed to use a single kind of pigment throughout her work?
Character_ZheZhi_61_30: How is this supposed to prove that we are behind the forgeries?!
Character_ZheZhi_61_32: Because the original creator of "Serenity in Xiehua Village" is me.
Character_ZheZhi_61_33: No... Mr. Baici, you're changing the subject.
Character_ZheZhi_61_34: How ungrateful. She ensnared us in this debacle, and now you dare to lay the blame at our feet?
Character_ZheZhi_61_35: For it to be forgery, there has to be another original artist. These paintings are all the work of Mingyan. Even if she made dozens of identical copies, it wouldn't be considered forgery.
Character_ZheZhi_61_36: During our investigation of the studio, I accidentally got paint on me and discovered something interesting about the materials used in these paintings.
Character_ZheZhi_62_14: Xiehua Village was my first stop upon arriving in Jinzhou alone.
Character_ZheZhi_62_15: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain.
Character_ZheZhi_62_16: A poem I wrote, inscribed on "Serenity in Xiehua Village."
Character_ZheZhi_62_17: And that painting, well... it became the "Arcane Artist's" final piece of art.
Character_ZheZhi_62_19: Whatever I thought, I painted into reality.
Character_ZheZhi_62_20: Tales of the Arcane Artist spread far and wide.
Character_ZheZhi_62_21: I discovered, to my dismay, that my parents were using my creations to turn a quick profit.
Character_ZheZhi_62_22: Using the paintings as a distraction from reality.
Character_ZheZhi_62_23: To inflict torment upon those they desire.
Character_ZheZhi_62_24: They were being exploited, and everything was spiraling out of control.
Character_ZheZhi_62_25: I began to fear holding a brush.
Character_ZheZhi_62_26: I tried to paint without relying on my abilities, but...
Character_ZheZhi_62_27: They called anything painted without using my abilities worthless.
Character_ZheZhi_62_28: They may have left behind a considerable mess...
Character_ZheZhi_62_29: But freedom has also been returned to my brush.
Character_ZheZhi_62_30: Colors of vanity washed away; the painted world fades, forgotten today.
Character_ZheZhi_62_31: I know it's not that well-written.
Character_ZheZhi_62_32: But it's proof of my decision to stop everything I was doing.
Character_ZheZhi_62_33: Paintings with special abilities gradually faded from everyone's minds.
Character_ZheZhi_62_34: And I never used my abilities to paint again.
Character_ZheZhi_63_7: It's not just about proving a single painting... it's about so much more...
Character_ZheZhi_63_8: If my Forte is the cause behind all this, then I must take responsibility... I can't just let this go on and hurt others.
Character_ZheZhi_63_9: To create art that truly resonates, I must first accept myself.
Character_ZheZhi_64_15: This place must be a manifestation of Mingyan's mind when she created it...
Character_ZheZhi_64_16: So why is everyone still praising her work...?
Character_ZheZhi_72_1: It's finally over... I didn't miss anything important, did I?
Character_ZheZhi_72_4: Huh? No, not at all... I was just coming up with things to say as I went. My palms were sweating the whole time...
Character_ZheZhi_72_5: I definitely couldn't have done it if you weren't there with me... Thinking about the feeling when we were investigating the case together is what kept me calm during the trial.
Character_ZheZhi_72_6: Wh-what I meant to say is, back then, everything I said felt right, like I could just be myself around you. It felt so good to be that relaxed...
Character_ZheZhi_72_7: Thank you for helping me through this. You... you helped me find the courage to believe in myself. Thanks to you, look at everything we accomplished.
Character_ZheZhi_72_8: The Shanyun Art Exchange is undergoing investigation. It'll be the end of their businesses... And the painters they coerced are finally set free.
Character_ZheZhi_72_9: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I haven't felt this happy in a long time!
Character_ZheZhi_72_12: I want to pay Mingyan a visit. After all, she was involved in all of this, and I want to tell her everything.
Character_ZheZhi_72_16: My commission started with her, plus you and I solved the case together. Why don't you come with me?
Character_ZheZhi_72_18: Yes, I already had it taken care of the day we found out the truth.
Character_ZheZhi_73_3: The researchers have taken good care of me. A chat won't hurt. And you must be... the Rover?
Character_ZheZhi_73_5: I heard about everything you did. Thank you for freeing me from those nightmares.
Character_ZheZhi_73_6: You know what, Zhezhi? You may seem soft and gentle on the outside, but if your boundaries are crossed, I think you can be tougher than anyone else.
Character_ZheZhi_73_7: And... I still owe you an apology.
Character_ZheZhi_73_8: Forgive me. Because I was so obsessed with wanting to be you... to be better than you, I've caused you so much trouble...
Character_ZheZhi_73_9: ...The pain of these injuries managed to put a stop to my obsession with imitating your paintings.
Character_ZheZhi_73_10: Heh. Maybe... I was never meant to be a painter to begin with...
Character_ZheZhi_73_13: Mingyan accepts a scroll of painting from Zhezhi, staring at it for a long time after opening it.
Character_ZheZhi_73_14: Hehe, see...? Only you can create a painting with such life. I still have a long way to go.
Character_ZheZhi_73_16: It's the one you gave me when we first met.
Character_ZheZhi_73_17: I... Hehe... How ironic. I've been trying to imitate you for so many years that now I can't even tell my own paintings apart anymore.
Character_ZheZhi_73_18: Your paintings were never inferior to mine. Just look at this piece, even you approve of its value. It doesn't matter who painted it.
Character_ZheZhi_73_19: Mingyan, I hope you can find your true self, whoever she is. I know you can do it.
Character_ZheZhi_73_20: Mingyan opens the scroll painting once again and stares at every detail for a long time. She appears lost in thought. Zhezhi and you leave quietly after seeing this.
Character_ZheZhi_73_21: ...Thank you for bringing me this painting... Really.
Character_ZheZhi_74_1: I think it's safe to say she'll give it some thought.
Character_ZheZhi_74_3: During the few times we met, she was always passionate about discussing art with me. I think that fire inside her won't just fade away.
Character_ZheZhi_74_4: Come to think of it, the deep discussions we had and the painting duels back then felt like true friendship.
Character_ZheZhi_74_5: I think she understood what you meant earlier.
Character_ZheZhi_74_10: To be honest, I didn't just see this case through to correct mistakes or help the artists. Deep down, I...I didn't want to let you down.
Character_ZheZhi_74_11: I wanted to tell you this back at the mine, but the words just didn't come out right...
Character_ZheZhi_74_12: It's fine, I understand what you're trying to say.
Character_ZheZhi_74_13: I'm glad you finally said it.
Character_ZheZhi_74_14: Thank you for being my friend and helping me through all of this, {PlayerName}.
Character_ZheZhi_74_15: I can say the same to you.
Character_ZheZhi_74_16: While I have yet to uncover my past and who I am, every moment with you is a new and special memory.
Character_ZheZhi_74_17: Thank you for your help, Zhezhi. This experience has helped me understand you and the world a little better.
Character_ZheZhi_74_18: You seem to be pretty slow on the news, {PlayerName}.
Character_ZheZhi_74_19: So you know how to tell jokes now?
Character_ZheZhi_74_20: Hehe... You've given me the courage to joke around.
Character_ZheZhi_74_21: Does that mean you can do the same in front of others?
Character_ZheZhi_74_23: Let's take it slow for now.
Character_ZheZhi_74_24: So... seeing her in so much pain, I just had to help.
Character_ZheZhi_74_25: I don't want Mingyan to lose hope and have someone who loves painting so much just disappear...
Character_ZheZhi_9_28: Sorry, did I scare you just now?
Character_ZheZhi_9_29: Sorry I lied to you, I just... didn't want to drag anyone else into this...
Character_ZheZhi_9_30: N-no, I'm not into ghost stories.
Character_ZheZhi_9_31: Now this story is making the rounds again. Most don't see the dangers it holds. As someone who feels the threat, I... I want to uncover the truth before it's too late.
Character_ZheZhi_9_32: The Arcane Artist showed up before?
Character_ZheZhi_9_33: But these paintings, they strayed from the artist's original intentions and... caused a lot of trouble.
Character_ZheZhi_9_34: I don't know who's behind these latest events, but if it's really the Arcane Artist... their paintings will bring nothing but trouble. T-that's why I... I have to stop them, to prevent the past from repeating itself...
Character_ZheZhi_9_35: I'm here for the Arcane Artist, but also hoping to meet an old acquaintance. Maybe he knows what happened in the mine...

Heihaian_main_1_3_8_11: Time... is running out. Hoda. My name is Hoda.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_13: Eugh! What does any of this have to do with me?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_14: Where did it go? No, wait. Don't go over there, {PlayerName}!

zhuiyuejie_first_1_2: How've you been? Is life in Jinzhou treating you well? You know I'm here if you ever need anything.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_3: Oh, Yangyang! What's there to be shy about? If you want to see {PlayerName}, just tell {Male=him;Female=her}!
zhuiyuejie_first_1_4: So, what have you been up to these past few days? Feelin' lonely without us around?
zhuiyuejie_first_1_5: Wanna go see some fireworks? How about some Moon Shooting? With the festival just around the corner, there's a really cool spot we can take you to.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_7: Yes. It'll be the Moon-Chasing Festival in a few days.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_8: Though we celebrate this festival every year in Huanglong, given everything that has happened, this year's Moon-Chasing Festival in Jinzhou is sure to be quite special.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_9: Yep, I caught them hanging lanterns all around City Hall. Every street and alley is gonna be glowing, I can't wait to see it all lit up!
zhuiyuejie_first_1_10: And we’ve got special Jinzhou traditions you won’t find anywhere else.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_11: Like Taoyuan Vale! Folks go there a few days before the festival to write their wishes onto paper, then hang them on branches or toss 'em into Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_12: Wanna give it a go, {PlayerName}? All you gotta do is write down your wish, real simple! Yangyang, Baizhi and I are already here.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_16: They say wishes made during these days are sure to come true. Works like a charm.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_2: Where have you been lately? Hehe, did you miss us?
zhuiyuejie_first_5_3: Oh, anything exciting happened while you were out there? "{PlayerName}'s Wild Adventures." Come on, let us in on it!
zhuiyuejie_first_5_4: You tell Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi what happened at Mt. Firmament.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_5: So... so you mean that big Mt. Firmament thingie that shocked all of Jinzhou, no wait... that shocked all of Huanglong, was all because of you?!
zhuiyuejie_first_6_1: Moon-Chasing Festival. Wishes. Moon-Chasing Festival. Wishes, wishes, wishes...
zhuiyuejie_first_7_1: Excuse me, have you seen this robot before? Do you know where it's from?
zhuiyuejie_second_1_2: Panhua's got a must-try dish for the Moon-Chasing Fest—heard about it? Can we go try it? Puh-leeze?
zhuiyuejie_second_1_3: Sure. Let's go try it out.
zhuiyuejie_second_49_1: Hahaha... I made it! Almost there... So close...
zhuiyuejie_second_49_2: Replicate the Tacet Field! Replicate the Waveworn!
zhuiyuejie_second_49_3: My friend's quest for truth was genuine till his last breath!
zhuiyuejie_second_49_4: I will not let you... tarnish his goal like that!

zhuiyuejie_first_13_4: Initiating analysis. This individual wishes to "disappear from this world," indicating a desire to terminate their existence and for all associated social connections to be erased.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_5: Feasibility: 0%. Causing physical harm or manipulating human memories are actions strictly prohibited.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_7: This is Xiang-LEE, Patty's work buddy. Patty gathers and analyzes the wishes, and Xiang-LEE helps make them become a reality.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_9: It seems very much up to the task.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_10: Hmm... Xiang-LEE is the first prototype of its series, and we used to call it by its serial number.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_11: My colleagues at the Academy began calling it Little Xiangli out of convenience, and over time, it became the name we use now...
zhuiyuejie_first_13_12: Well, it seems to like this name a lot, so consider it... a birthday gift from everyone at the Academy.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_13: You have a good eye, {PlayerName}. Xiang-LEE is indeed a very reliable companion.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_14: Analysis Conclusion: The wish exhibits strong self-denial and self-destructive tendencies, indicating a high level of danger. Prompt physical care and psychological intervention are advised.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_15: Patty does not understand. This wish. Patty does not. Cannot. Hurt humans.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_16: Just as I've suspected. This is the reason why this wish failed to be interpreted. The desire to "disappear" directly conflicts with Patty's underlying logic of not being able to harm humans.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_19: It is often the case that words spoken aloud sometimes contradict our innermost thoughts.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_20: Those willing to entrust their wishes to the Moontree Lodge hope their desires will be chosen and fulfilled. This suggests that Xiaosheng still hopes for his voice to be heard.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_21: This is just my personal belief, but I suspect he's not truly ready to give up. I think the thought pains him.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_24: Yes. I believe that is the case.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_25: {PlayerName}, I want to uncover the true desire hidden in his wish and help him fulfill it.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_26: Will fulfilling his "true wish" help to ease his suffering?
zhuiyuejie_first_13_30: We should start by locating the wisher. If I recall correctly... there is no Xiaosheng at the Academy, so it's likely a pseudonym.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_31: And this paper... it's from a type of notebook commonly used at the Academy. There are faint traces of another type of writing on it — seems to be some kind of code.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_33: I'll decipher these codes, and then we can... Oh, excuse me...
zhuiyuejie_first_13_35: Investigator Xiangli...! We have a problem! We've got trouble in the lab!
zhuiyuejie_first_13_36: Prototype 49's core has gone out of control, emergency protocols failed, and it's overheating as we speak...
zhuiyuejie_first_13_37: Already sent to your Terminal, sir.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_38: All right, tell everyone to stay calm. We still have time.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_40: There's been a momentary setback in the research. I need to handle it right away.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_41: I'm afraid I'll have to leave the task of finding Xiaosheng to you, {PlayerName}.
zhuiyuejie_first_15_1: Might as well ask another researcher...
zhuiyuejie_first_15_2: Detected. Individual meeting search criteria. Analyzing target identity: Researcher of the Department of Laboratory Evaluation, Huaxu Academy. Suggested topics of inquiry: "Xiaosheng" or "Work Stress."
zhuiyuejie_first_15_4: Rest assured. When discussing heavier topics, I will employ a light and humorous inquiry method.

Day 21... Oh no, it's 22 now. Got too thrilled to remember the correct date. The experiment yesterday was indeed invigorating.
"When people are hungry, they work to earn credits to buy food. But when my mind hungers for knowledge about this world, what can I offer to satisfy that craving?"
The words of that researcher have been echoing in my mind ever since then...
By observing the Tacet Fields, we will definitely be able to find the cause of this disaster and redefine the science of our times.

Same research conditions and same observation procedures, but how could the result change this time? It was ███ in the last experiment.
No, it can't be. There must be a malfunction with the automated observation machine, or perhaps we made a mistake in one of the procedures.
Gotta try again, just one more time...
We've put so much effort into building this system! It can't be wrong!
InfoDisplay_120101024_Text:
This is the ███th observation on Tacet Field HL-057, conducted by 11371A Automated Observation Machine.
Recorded content: None.
Because it's all futile.
InfoDisplay_120101025_Text:
More researchers have left... No one's going to continue the research on the Tacet Field.
It feels like everything we've been studying is akin to planting a seed in a Petri dish out in the Tacet Field. And guess what? That seed might germinate, dissolve into the culture solution, or even mutate into a monster and burst out.
Our research is just as chaotic. Experimental data that should remain constant at 3.74 can suddenly skyrocket to 7.65 the next moment. Is this the truth we've been pursuing? How bitterly ironic!
I would feel somewhat relieved if such an impossible error was due to my own incompetence. But if the Lament has already overturned the very order of this world, what's the point of scientific inquiry?
zhuiyuejie_first_18_1: Attention. During our conversation with Shifan, another researcher was detected within close proximity.
zhuiyuejie_first_18_2: The individual has been eavesdropping on our conversation up until this moment.
zhuiyuejie_first_18_4: Uploading the researcher's location to your Terminal.
zhuiyuejie_first_18_5: Finally, some useful information for once.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_1: Excuse me. You must be Mrs. Heying. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_2: Oh, hello... Happy Moon-Chasing Festival. Who might you be?
zhuiyuejie_first_27_3: My name is Xiangli Yao, and this is the Rover. I apologize for the unannounced visit, ma'am.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_1: Oops, sorry! We didn't mean to hit your door! We're just playing cornhole here.
zhuiyuejie_second_13_1: That looks like something from Xiangli Yao's childhood. Could his memories be affecting this Sonoro's frequencies?
zhuiyuejie_second_13_2: Maybe it's not just his memories.
zhuiyuejie_second_22_1: It worked! Your intuition can be really sharp.
zhuiyuejie_second_35_1: I can't do this anymore... It's over... I'm useless...
zhuiyuejie_second_35_2: Nonsense... It's all nonsense... Countless errors... No solution!
zhuiyuejie_second_35_3: It’s not me… It’s them! No, it's the world! The whole world is wrong! Hahahaha!
zhuiyuejie_second_36_1: This is the third time we've circled back here!
zhuiyuejie_second_39_1: Finally, we're out... but this new place looks even creepier.
zhuiyuejie_second_40_1: So tired... I wanna disappear... Screw everything!
zhuiyuejie_second_40_2: Hey, ain't that the Shifan guy?
zhuiyuejie_second_40_3: He smells delicious... Ahem! I mean, he looks even worse than yesterday, when he wrote down his wish...
zhuiyuejie_second_40_4: The others are probably no better than him...
zhuiyuejie_second_41_1: My son... I miss you so much... Take me away with you...
zhuiyuejie_second_41_3: Even that granny has gone crazy...
zhuiyuejie_second_42_2: Watch me take on anything! Let the world burn, I'll still come out on top!
zhuiyuejie_second_42_3: ...Well, this one doesn't sound too depressing...
zhuiyuejie_second_42_4: But if it ever comes true, I have a feeling it's gonna be hella dangerous!
zhuiyuejie_second_42_5: Hmm... I think I know who the remaining two will be.
zhuiyuejie_second_43_2: We knew it! We knew it right from the start! The Waveworn Phenomenon defies all laws of physics!
zhuiyuejie_second_43_3: And the worst part? It’s completely random! We need more data!
zhuiyuejie_second_45_1: His wish... achieved... He is not guilty...
zhuiyuejie_second_45_2: Must... trigger... the Waveworn... Tacet Field...
zhuiyuejie_second_46_1: The innermost area of this Sonoro Sphere... Pascar, are you there?
zhuiyuejie_second_48_1: The Waveworn... Show me the Waveworn...
zhuiyuejie_second_48_2: Pascar, listen to me! This isn't what you wished for!
zhuiyuejie_second_48_3: Tacet Fields... must be finished... by us... by me!

Heihaian_main_1_3_37_2: No, no, no! Not the Tacet Discords again!
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_3: Yes, she's here. Don't worry, you'll be fine.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_5: Stay with us, the medical team will arrive any minute.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_6: I fulfilled my duty... as a member of the Black Shores...
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_8: Your actions will shine bright like the stars, a beacon for all to see.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_10: An entire Necrostar was forcefully discharged into the Error Cell without warning.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_11: The error codes spilled out as a result. At its worst, it looked a lot like virtual blood seeping through the ground.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_12: We had to seal the underground gate to protect the Control Room. But someone had to retrieve the key...
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_13: He did what was necessary, even if it meant risking his own life.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_15: He is severely infected with abnormal frequencies... It could be fatal.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_20: We will. Have a good rest now, you've done enough.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_3: It might sound abrupt, but... I have begun to sense a change within myself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_4: More precisely, it's the part of me that rests in my garden. I feel... something different.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_5: Something... I don't know how to describe...
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_7: I've done this before, by imitating the you I remember from many years ago.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_8: You did what a leader must, but when I looked into your eyes, I could feel it—the emotion humans call sorrow.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_9: Maybe… I should express that emotion in situations like this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_12: You led the Black Shores with empathy, and it's my responsibility to carry it forward in your absence.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_13: I see. Well, it is our utmost priority to deal with the Necrostar to prevent further harm.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_14: The only way to achieve this is by bringing the Necrostar to the Modulation Hall and initializing it within Tethys.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_15: Gravity caused the destruction of Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_16: I have the highest access to the Tethys System. Bring the Necrostar to the Modulation Hall, and I'll erase its corrupted data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_17: Once it's done, Tethys will function as it should, and no one will get hurt again.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_18: But as I mentioned, I'm only a projection without physical form... Could you assist me with this?
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_20: I'm here to help and protect you, just like I always have.
Heihaian_main_1_3_43_1: Please be careful. The object contained in the center is the Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_1: The floating device appears to be made out of Tacetite. It emanates a strange aura.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_5: Hey! Don't just eat whatever's in front of you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_6: This looks awful! Ugh, like the worst stew ever made!
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_11: This frequency has dwelled within you for millions of years...
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_12: I'll keep an eye on it. We have more important matters at hand.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_13: Wait, are you saying I'm not important here?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_15: Why did you wake up again, Abby?
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_16: 'Cause you were about to gulp that hotchpotch of who-knows-what stuff! Go grab something normal if you're hungry. But this? Absolutely no!
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_17: This thing... It's like a dark, spooky hole. Once you fall in, you'll never crawl back out.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_18: Precisely. This is the Necrostar, a black hole that will suck anything close to it into oblivion.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_22: That little creature is able to perceive objects by their frequency...
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_23: Just as it described, the Necrostar's frequency is indeed incredibly complex.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_24: Speaking of which, are you feeling discomfort anywhere?
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_25: Not at all. The black hole doesn't affect me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_26: No, I'm referring to that creature...
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_27: Do you feel anything unusual when interacting with it?
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_30: The Necrostar's singularity has been retrieved. Let's take it to the Modulation Hall.
Heihaian_main_1_3_46_31: I'll stand by you until the very end of this journey.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_1: Apologies. I should have controlled my Sonoro vision.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_6: I was entrusted to lead the Black Shores in your absence.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_8: It's through this duty that I can protect you and what you cherished.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_9: Though I've never witnessed the Lament firsthand, others have shared their experiences with me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_10: I've encoded them into observable stars, enabling the Tethys System to issue Lament alerts.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_28: This disaster could have been prevented... if only I had been more dedicated to understanding those experiences and emotions.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_30: I will give it my all, even if I must sacrifice my Sonoro, or myself...
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_31: This is the only way to protect the stars... and you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_32: I made my vow to you long ago, {PlayerName}. It remains just as true today.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_35: I will break the shackles of fate.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_36: I will unravel the Möbius loop that binds you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_37: I will give my all to honor my commitment.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_38: How do I describe this feeling...? Is it guilt, dismay, or perhaps... longing?
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_39: What emotion should I express now?

Heihaian_main_1_3_54_1: Ah, good! You made it here safely.
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_2: Everything is ready. We just need the Necrostar's core now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_3: Got it. How are the other Agents doing?
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_4: They've been battling to retrieve the major Matrices since the Tethys System malfunctioned. The operation is going well.
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_5: We, the Black Shores, always work together as a team.
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_6: What should we do next about the Necrostar's core?
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_7: Please place it on the analyzer, and then we can proceed with the remodulation.

Character_ZheZhi_26_2: Why do these paintings all look the same...
Character_ZheZhi_26_3: There is a difference. The brushwork on this one, see how heavy it is? You can tell Mingyan was in low spirits. And this one, the strokes are light and fluid. That tells me she was happy when she painted this.
Character_ZheZhi_26_4: The feelings a painter has during the process of creation often linger in the brushstrokes without them knowing. They're present in every line, even if the artist tries to hide it.
Character_ZheZhi_26_5: You can understand the painter's feelings through their work?
Character_ZheZhi_26_6: Yes. To me, painting is like a window into the heart of the artist. When words fail, these feelings can be depicted through brushstrokes instead.
Character_ZheZhi_26_7: It is strange, though. She keeps reproducing the same painting over and over... using techniques that aren't her usual style.
Character_ZheZhi_26_8: Something's written on the painting. Waters and... what is this?
Character_ZheZhi_26_9: "Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away. The painted world fades, forgotten today."
Character_ZheZhi_26_10: This artwork is titled "Serenity of Xiehua Village." It captures the scenic landscapes seen from the village itself...
Character_ZheZhi_26_12: Ah, the pigment! When did it get on my clothes...
Character_ZheZhi_26_13: Huh? It came off with just a little wipe... Hmm... It shouldn't come off the fabric so easily...
Character_ZheZhi_26_15: Zhezhi stands stunned before the painting. Words hover on her lips, yet remain unspoken.

zhuiyuejie_second_12_2: Please don't blame our boss. It's my bad, I threw it!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_3: No, no... It's my fault... I wanted to play cornhole...
zhuiyuejie_second_12_5: R-really? You aren't angry at us? Thank you, you're so nice...
zhuiyuejie_second_12_6: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. My name's Pascar. They're Modi and Ryan.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_9: Xiangli Yao? Geez... You're Mrs. Xiangli Yan's son!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_10: Wow! So you're that genius everyone's been talking about?!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_12: Wow! I heard you've never been second to anyone in school!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_14: No way! I heard you finished an entire school year's classes in one week!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_16: That's amazing! And you've solved a century-old problem for the Academy too?!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_17: Huh? Is that what they've been saying about me?
zhuiyuejie_second_12_19: Chill, boss. You might scare him.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_20: You're just like my big sis when she meets her idol.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_22: Ahem... Sorry, I got ahead of myself.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_23: By the way, we're going to the Moonlit Fair. Care to join us?
zhuiyuejie_second_12_25: 'Course you can! We can make you the new boss even!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_27: Yeah, like, our leader... But that's not important. The real question is, do you wanna play with us?
zhuiyuejie_second_12_30: Sorry... I think I'll stay at home. I must wait for my dad...
zhuiyuejie_second_12_31: Your dad? The big inventor mentioned in the headlines? Said he's gone missing...
zhuiyuejie_second_12_34: W-we gotta go now. Come find us anytime you wanna play!
zhuiyuejie_second_12_35: I don't like being alone. Don't know if you feel the same.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_36: Anyway, we're here when you need a chat or someone to hang out with.
zhuiyuejie_second_14_1: We can go through that door now. Let's move.
zhuiyuejie_second_15_2: A Wishing Stall? But the decorations don't match this year's theme.
zhuiyuejie_second_15_3: Do we need to touch anything or read anything here, like we did in the last room?
zhuiyuejie_second_15_4: There are some wish tags on the floor. Let's read them.
zhuiyuejie_second_19_1: Hoping to be heard, missing a departed son, wanting to become a hero... These are the wishes of the people I've helped.
zhuiyuejie_second_19_2: There are two more wish tags.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_3: Can't believe I actually got a zero. What a bummer. I'm not even in the mood for wishes now...
zhuiyuejie_second_23_4: Still upset about what happened in class?
zhuiyuejie_second_23_5: I mean, aren't we supposed to learn by doing? That's what we've been taught since day one.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_6: We know next to nothing about the the Waveworn Phenomena and our equipment is useless. Shouldn't we go explore it firsthand?
zhuiyuejie_second_23_7: But how? Shall we set up a lab by a Waveworn site, like you said in class? It's too risky. If something goes wrong, the staff won't make it.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_8: But this is the martyrdom of science, the necessary sacrifice! Like chemists who sampled unknown substances, we must risk it all for the ultimate truth.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_9: Really? Do we have to risk it all?
zhuiyuejie_second_23_10: Of course! You want food, you pay. You want pay, you work. Give something to get something.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_11: When the truth of this world—the ultimate knowledge—is on the line, one must be willing to give up everything they have.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_12: ...We'll discuss it later. Modi and Ryan want to catch up. How about meeting them today?
zhuiyuejie_second_23_14: You've been avoiding them since they failed the entrance exam.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_15: It's necessary. As intellectuals, we must walk a solitary path.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_16: Those who can't keep up will only hold us back. It's best to leave them behind sooner rather than later.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_17: Why would a genius like you care about their feelings anyway? With your father as a role model, distractions should be beneath you.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_18: Come on. What if they drag you down?
zhuiyuejie_second_23_19: But... I don't think we have to be lonely as intellectuals.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_20: ...Remember that old Moontree Lodge tale from a decade ago? Write a wish, hang it on the Wishing Tree, and presto—your wish comes true.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_21: But let's be real, there's gotta be a person running that show. Because when the word got out, it just stopped working.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_22: More wishes were made, but how many actually came true? Not many.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_23: See? Not even that "Unsung Hero of the Lodge" had time to grant every wish.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_24: Our time in this world is limited, so let's focus on the truth, not trivialities.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_26: Trying to organize your arguments to refute me? ...Go ahead if you must, Mr. Genius.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_27: You know, I only said that because I value you as my only friend and opponent.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_28: I just don't want you to get distracted. It's not satisfying to outdo someone when they're not at their best.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_29: Well, that's enough talk for today. I'll make my wish now.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_30: Let's see... Well, Wishing Tree, please make the Waveworn happen. Then I can finally study it up close.
zhuiyuejie_second_24_1: As an intellectual, I must prioritize my pursuit of truth, even if it means a life of solitude…
zhuiyuejie_second_24_3: Then, father... Why did I find driveshafts of your design in the Moontree Lodge...
zhuiyuejie_second_24_4: You were never home during Moon-Chasing Festivals... Were you busy helping other people?
zhuiyuejie_second_24_5: If that's what you did... Does it mean I don't really have to be alone...
zhuiyuejie_second_24_7: Hey, Xiangli! What are you doing there? C'mon, we gotta go now.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_1: The festival must mean something different to him. Is that why he's running the Moontree Lodge after his father's passing?
zhuiyuejie_second_25_2: Is that a form of human connection too?
zhuiyuejie_second_25_4: Are we sharing that kind of connection right now?
zhuiyuejie_second_25_5: I'd say you've been haunting me. Like a ghost.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_6: Haunting? Hmph! No way. Admit it, I'm just living rent-free in your head.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_7: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_8: So? Isn't that pretty normal in a Sonoro like this?
zhuiyuejie_second_25_9: But why can't we get through the "doors" before Xiangli Yao opens them?
zhuiyuejie_second_25_10: Hmm... Strange indeed. It's almost as if he owns this place!
zhuiyuejie_second_25_11: Or maybe... he holds the key? Is it similar to what Scar did to me... No, I can't tell for sure yet.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_12: Let's press on. We need to go deeper to uncover the truth.
zhuiyuejie_second_7_2: I'm glad the Sonoro didn't throw us out.
zhuiyuejie_second_7_3: But why us? What did we even do?
zhuiyuejie_second_7_4: Maybe... it has something to do with that Pascar person?
zhuiyuejie_second_7_5: Anyway, we should find Xiangli Yao first.

zhuiyuejie_first_14_41: But I'll let you know if I do.

zhuiyuejie_first_14_44: It's unlikely she has anything to do with the wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_14_45: Affirmative. The individual showed no signs of abnormalities when mentioning the name "Xiaosheng."
zhuiyuejie_first_14_46: Let's go ask around somewhere else.

zhuiyuejie_first_22_29: Xiang-LEE and {PlayerName} are researching Echoes but have hit a dead end. They heard that Mr. Shifan is an expert in this particular field and are seeking his help.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_31: That was a long time ago... Oh, very well. What do you want to know?
zhuiyuejie_first_22_32: ...The data you gave me is packed with motion values. I would start by understanding how the Echo adapts to different geographies.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_33: And these numbers... If we cross-reference them with standard values, the fitting coefficient nearly hits 1. It looks like your model’s direction might be on track...
zhuiyuejie_first_22_34: Ohhh... The more I look at this data, the more I think... had it reached me earlier, things might have been different...
zhuiyuejie_first_22_35: This data. How much do you want for it? I'll pay anything!
zhuiyuejie_first_22_36: No... Even with this, I can't do it on my own...
zhuiyuejie_first_22_37: Is this your true wish, Xiaosheng?
zhuiyuejie_first_22_39: You have always had regrets, both for your friend and for your Echo research.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_40: I... I don't get your meaning. There was a serious accident during the experiment, and I was the one who shut it down. How could I...
zhuiyuejie_first_22_42: We saw the wish you made at the Moontree Lodge, but it seems that may not be what you truly wish for.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_43: Your true wish is to continue your research of Echoes with the one and only friend who understands your passion. Is this correct?
zhuiyuejie_first_22_45: Heh... I never thought my wish would actually be heard.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_46: You're right. I am Xiaosheng. The loser who spends his nights complaining in bed. A washed-up "expert."
zhuiyuejie_first_22_47: I worked hard to get myself into the Academy. My best friend was a real genius, and I was just an ordinary person who had to work my ass off in order to catch up with him.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_48: We promised to push the boundaries in Echo research. I always believed we could produce groundbreaking results, maybe even touch the essence of the Lament through our research. But due to my carelessness, he lost his chance to walk through that door completely.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_49: Yet, my stubbornness in continuing the experiment without adequate samples led to irreversible harm to my friend.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_50: Not once did I visit him during the final test periods, and I was the only one left on the project. It wasn't a surprise the experiment failed in the end.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_51: It wasn't until I sat alone in the empty lab that I realized... Maybe everything I sacrificed, even my friend's future, was all for nothing.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_52: But when I lie in bed awake at night, I feel regret all over again. I know I can't give up Echo research. My obsession torments me, but I don't deserve to pursue it anymore.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_59: I'll tell you right now, I never blamed you for what happened. I felt the same as you, right from the start!
zhuiyuejie_first_22_60: On our path of pursuing new discoveries, I was willing to pay any price. What I don't accept is you calling quits halfway!
zhuiyuejie_first_22_63: It blows my mind that this is why you stopped talking to me. While I'm at it, you haven't changed a bit since we were kids. You'd get into the habit of running away from any problems you face that are non-research-related!
zhuiyuejie_first_22_66: It is wonderful to have someone to support you on the journey to achieve greatness in research.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_67: It seems even without our help, this wish has been fulfilled...
zhuiyuejie_first_22_69: This in turn indicates that Xiaosheng's wish is not the source of the abnormal codes.

zhuiyuejie_first_22_74: You don't deny you are Xiaosheng?
zhuiyuejie_first_22_75: I had hurt my friend, given up on a career, and worked on something I wasn't actually interested in.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_78: Yes. There are more wishes to decipher.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_79: I grow ever more confident with you around, {PlayerName}.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_80: ...I appreciate your hard work. It's thanks to you, we were able to fulfill the first wish so quickly.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_81: Now... we should make our way back to the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_82: You signal Xiangli Yao to transfer the Echo data to Shifan's Terminal.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_83: I chose to continue the testing. That's why he missed the window for treatment.

zhuiyuejie_first_38_3: His wish comes from a place of real valor and sincerity...
