zhuiyuejie_first_5_18: Shoot, we got so distracted with everything else, I almost forgot about your wish for the Wishing Tree.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_19: It's a huge deal—you won't wanna miss it!
zhuiyuejie_first_5_21: That's right. Remember what I told you about wishes made under the Wishing Tree coming true?
zhuiyuejie_first_5_22: There are stories of it flying around... Especially in recent years, the wishes people make on the eve of the Moon-Chasing Festival seem to come true in one form or another.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_23: A few years ago, Jinzhou had endless rain. Yangyang wished for clear skies for the Festival and a perfect Moonlit Fair.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_24: And guess what? The rain stopped, and the moon was full and bright.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_25: Exactly. I thought I'd try my luck, but it actually happened.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_26: Perhaps just a pleasant coincidence? The Moon-Chasing Festival does have a history of such coincidences. Maybe there's something to the Wishing Tree's magic after all.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_27: Or maybe there's a mysterious hero inside the Wishing Tree, making our dreams come true!
zhuiyuejie_first_5_28: Just like you, {PlayerName}. You save the world without anyone noticing. If you’re not in the next season of Hero Plays, I’m out.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_29: All right, better get to it before we chatter ourselves away again.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_30: The Wishing Tree is just up ahead. Off you go.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_33: Mine's for the Moonlit Fair to draw in a huge crowd and for everyone to have a fantastic time.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_34: As for Yangyang, she wished for endless happiness and happy reunions for all families.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_36: She, um... She's not really into wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_37: Don't mind me, I tend not to make wishes. But if I did, it would probably be similar to Yangyang's.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_38: There, you're the last one left, {PlayerName}. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_41: Yawn... Who's there...? What's going on...?
zhuiyuejie_first_5_42: Want to make a wish at the Wishing Tree?
zhuiyuejie_first_5_43: Make... A wish...? I'm tired... Just make one for me...
zhuiyuejie_first_5_44: I want... lots of goodies to eat... I don't ever want to be hungry again...
zhuiyuejie_first_5_45: Okay, go back to sleep now.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_46: Never mind, go back to sleep now.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_48: Well, after you're finished at the Wishing Tree, come see us at the Moonlit Fair. Chixia and I will be helping out with preparations.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_49: Hehe, I'll be over at Qingxi's Moon Shooter stall. It's not fully set up yet, but I can give you a sneak peek.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_52: Then it's a deal! Mark my words, with us around you'll be in for a Moon-Chasing Festival you'll remember for life!
zhuiyuejie_first_5_53: Everyone in Jinzhou will be there. There's a high chance we'll run into some familiar faces.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_2: Fetching Data. Error. Analysis Failed... Patty. Lost. Wishes. Danger... Xiang-LEE. HELP! HELP!
zhuiyuejie_first_9_5: Something seems to have malfunctioned with you. I'll take care of it... One moment.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_7: Command Initiator: Xiangli Yao. Authentication Confirmed. Performing Onboard Diagnostics: No. 231... Onboard Diagnostics Failed...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_8: Filtering... Wishes... beep, beep... Wishing for a brighter future... glory on the battlefield... abandon hope of loved ones returning home... beep, beep...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_9: Hmm... It's possible that Patty's memory is overloaded with wishes, leading to anomalies mixed within.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_10: ...Wishes... Analyzing Cause. 21 solutions have been provided... Correction... 12... Correction... 4...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_11: (Wishes... and solutions...? Could this relate to what Chixia said about "someone" at Moontree Lodge making wishes come true? And Xiangli Yao... The name sounds familiar.)
zhuiyuejie_first_9_13: Xiangli Yao reaches for a cable-like object at the back of the robot and connects it to his Terminal.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_14: Isolating abnormal data. Running data correction... There, give it another go, Patty.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_15: Performing Onboard Diagnostics... All Systems Normal. Patty feels full...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_16: That should do the trick for now. But where could the anomalies have...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_17: I apologize for keeping you waiting.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_18: It's okay. Will the robot be okay?
zhuiyuejie_first_9_20: It's just a temporary measure. I'll need to conduct a thorough examination later.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_22: Thank you for returning him to me, {PlayerName}.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_26: Yes, I've heard a lot about you from my colleagues at the Academy. Many of them are eager to meet you... I hope their enthusiasm hasn't been too overwhelming for you.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_27: Apologies, I haven't even introduced myself yet...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_28: Well, um... I'd appreciate it if you'd call me by my name instead of "Principal Investigator."
zhuiyuejie_first_9_29: Xiangli Yao, a pleasure to meet you. I regret that I was away during your first visit to the Academy, but I'm glad to finally have the chance to meet you.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_30: Thank you for your help with the Sundial.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_31: I merely provided a few ideas, but I'm glad I was able to help. I was assisting the Ministry of Development with a damaged surveillance tower. By the time I returned to the lab, you'd already left...
zhuiyuejie_first_9_32: The next time I heard any news about you was regarding the battle at the Norfall Barrens. This year's Moon-Chasing Festival could only have proceeded thanks to your efforts.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_34: Well... Come to think of it, I should be thanking you personally. The Moontree Lodge wouldn't have opened as planned if it weren't for you.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_35: You're welcome. Is this place yours?
zhuiyuejie_first_9_36: So you're the mysterious hero granting wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_37: I'm afraid I'm not the owner of the Moontree Lodge. I'm just here to assist, collecting and trying to fulfill everyone's wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_38: Hero...? It's not as grand as that. It started by trying to help children fulfill their wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_39: However... I do hope you can keep that between us.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_40: I see you prefer to work behind the scenes.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_41: Your secret is safe with me.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_42: Imagine how disheartening it would be for people to learn their wishes were granted by a single person.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_44: Seeing everyone's wishes come true and everyone enjoying the festival is enough for me.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_45: Fulfilling wishes! Happy! What will you taste like, important guest?
zhuiyuejie_first_9_48: Apologies. Patty doesn't mean anything strange by that.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_50: Patty was born in the Moontree Lodge. It deciphers the emotions behind wishes, analyzing their "structure" in a unique way.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_51: To Patty, every wish has a unique "taste." You can think of it as Patty's way of understanding the world.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_52: Besides bringing Patty back, I presume you're here to make a wish as well, {PlayerName}?
zhuiyuejie_first_9_54: I'd like a tour of the place.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_55: In that case... May I suggest we head over to the Wishing Stall for a chat? It's not far from here.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_94: I just want to do something within my power to pass on the joy we've all felt at least once in our lives.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_1: Tacet Field... Hate... Pascar... The world...
zhuiyuejie_second_5_2: Is that... the smell of Sonoro?!
zhuiyuejie_second_5_4: Patty is now a portal to a Sonoro Sphere.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_5: Its built-up frequencies likely resonated with something and created this.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_6: Should we alert the Midnight Rangers? But then...
zhuiyuejie_second_5_7: Then people might think there's another TD outbreak. Since a major fight has just happened, I think we should...
zhuiyuejie_second_5_10: You're already planning to do so, I can tell. It's written all over your face.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_11: Yes... I've thought it through. I believe that would be the most practical solution.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_12: If the Sonoro is benign, we can all breathe a sigh of relief.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_13: And worst-case scenario, if it turns malignant, you'll have no trouble handling it.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_14: I just didn't expect you to bring it up first. Guess I wasted time hesitating.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_15: You hesitated... because of the name "Pascar"?
zhuiyuejie_second_5_16: Yes. He was a close friend of mine...
zhuiyuejie_second_5_17: He died from the Waveworn. I think... if this Sonoro Sphere is related to him, it must contain his messages for me.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_18: This is my personal request, {PlayerName}. Please help me.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_19: Sure thing. In fact, I'm also doing this for a personal reason.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_21: I promised my friends we'd enjoy the Moonlit Fair together tonight. Can't let this incident ruin the festivity.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_22: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Let's enter the Sonoro now.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_3: I found some unusual frequencies inside its body. Not sure if that's the Sonoro Sphere's influence.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_4: Out of safety concerns, I locked it up for the time being.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_5: I thought you'd dive right into studying the cause.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_7: Normally I would. But not this time, because I promised you a gift.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_12: I know you're going to the Moonlit Fair. Here's a camera to capture memories for you to keep.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_13: Is this a perk of working for the Moontree Lodge?
zhuiyuejie_second_58_14: It can be. Maybe I should include it in the employee handbook.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_16: Not yet. That's why I'm about to write one.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_17: I couldn't have solved this so fast without you by my side.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_18: Those wishes were their cries for help. Someone had to act fast and save them, or there could have been severe consequences.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_19: Thanks to your help, people can see their wishes come true.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_20: The fulfilled wishes bring warmth and comfort to be shared by many more.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_21: In the end, the Moontree Lodge kept its promise... to everyone, including Pascar.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_22: What about you? What is your wish?
zhuiyuejie_second_58_23: My wish? I haven't really thought about it in a while... But I may already know the answer to your question.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_25: It's the same reason why I'm taking care of the Moontree Lodge: I want to follow in our pioneers' footsteps.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_26: Those who forsake everything in pursuit of truth, and those who dedicate their lives to the welfare of others.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_27: My parents each embodied one path. They were my role models, and I have strived to emulate them both.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_28: Their passing left me searching for answers, for a way to find balance between the two.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_30: That was why I inherited the Moontree Lodge. Still, I've often questioned: how closely should I follow my parents' paths?
zhuiyuejie_second_58_31: Should I abandon all social connections in pursuit of the elusive ultimate truth, like in a certain story?
zhuiyuejie_second_58_32: But in the end, you didn't do that.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_33: No, I didn't. Because Pascar found me and brought me out of my room. Without him, I never would've known about my father's ties to the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_34: When Pascar left the Academy, I considered going with him.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_35: Perhaps we are the same kind of people after all.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_36: I wanted to give up everything for the ultimate truth, but I still craved companionship. That's why I hesitated.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_37: Seeking truth can be futile. It's like constantly pushing a boulder uphill, only for the Lament to send it back down every time.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_38: In this disaster-stricken world, our beliefs, innovations, even entire societies risk falling into oblivion in an instant.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_39: Still, someone must push the boulder of curiosity and explore uncharted territories beyond that hill.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_41: I've longed to push that boulder, Rover. Perhaps one day, I'll give in to the urge... Even if it means leaving everything behind.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_42: Because it's there. Hard to resist the temptation when truth feels so close, almost within reach.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_43: I've been trying to tell you for so, so long... I just want to let you know...
zhuiyuejie_second_58_45: It's alright. You can venture as far as you need to. You will always return to open arms.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_46: The way how you've always tried to clear Pascar's name, how he's done his utmost to tell you the truth. That's what we call a human connection.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_47: That's why your memory worked as a "key" in the Sonoro Sphere.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_48: Have more faith in humanity. The hero who pushed the boulder of truth for us all will be remembered, and the bond between people will endure.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_49: Because we are here for you, always.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_51: Your friends are calling out to you.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_54: {Male=They say some vendors offer discounts to people visiting together?;Female=They say the Moon-Chasing Festival is a time for reunions?}
zhuiyuejie_second_58_56: {Male=Come with me, then. Make it another perk of working for the Moontree Lodge.;Female=Come with me, then. It's not a reunion when you're left alone.}
zhuiyuejie_second_58_58: You have a promise to keep, remember?
zhuiyuejie_second_58_59: Thank you, my friend. Please... Please witness the world we've protected... on my behalf...
zhuiyuejie_second_58_69: What's up with you two, {PlayerName}? C'mon, let's go!
zhuiyuejie_second_26_1: Our research has been great. Hopefully we'll keep this momentum going into the next year.
zhuiyuejie_second_26_2: With the progress we've made so far, we'll surely figure out the Tacet Fields one day.
zhuiyuejie_second_26_3: Well, we have Pascar and Xiangli Yao to thank.
zhuiyuejie_second_26_4: Yeah. Where did Xiangli go? He's never here with us during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
zhuiyuejie_second_31_1: Another failed experiment! When will we invest in better equipment for accurate results?!
zhuiyuejie_second_31_2: This is pointless! The Waveworn has destroyed all our theories. There's no pattern at all!
zhuiyuejie_second_31_3: Our research has been a waste of time! It's all your fault!
zhuiyuejie_second_31_4: We need Xiangli Yao... Pascar, where is Xiangli Yao? Where the hell is he!
zhuiyuejie_second_32_1: Did we just end up back in the same place?
zhuiyuejie_second_35_4: Where is Xiangli Yao?! You're nobody compared to him, Pascar!
zhuiyuejie_second_36_2: Let's look around and get out of here quick.
zhuiyuejie_second_43_4: How are we supposed to study the Tacet Field in this chaos?
zhuiyuejie_second_43_5: I knew it... We never have enough samples! Now, if we could make Waveworn disasters happen more often...
zhuiyuejie_second_43_6: Don't you try to stop me, cowards! You don't even have the guts to sacrifice for the truth!
zhuiyuejie_second_43_7: You all despise me, thinking I'll never surpass Xiangli Yao, right?
zhuiyuejie_second_43_8: Ha! If this were his idea, not a single one of you would object!
zhuiyuejie_second_43_10: Hahaha... I did it! Now I'm just a heartbeat away from success!
zhuiyuejie_second_43_11: Stay back! Stay away from here!
zhuiyuejie_second_45_4: So he's gonna trigger the Waveworn disaster like Pascar planned to?!
zhuiyuejie_second_45_5: We shouldn't jump to conclusions yet. Not based on a few broken words.
zhuiyuejie_second_45_6: He's willing to go to great lengths for other people. He wouldn't want to do that.
zhuiyuejie_second_45_7: My friend's quest for truth was genuine till his last breath!
zhuiyuejie_second_45_8: I will not let you... tarnish his goal like that!
zhuiyuejie_second_45_9: It's Xiangli Yao! He's right behind this door!
zhuiyuejie_second_46_3: Sorry, Rover... I must go and face him myself.
zhuiyuejie_second_46_5: Stop hiding, Pascar. We can talk it out.
zhuiyuejie_second_47_1: Hate... The world... Rest... Turn back time... Destruction...
zhuiyuejie_second_47_2: These frequencies... They belong to more than one person...
zhuiyuejie_second_47_4: A genius like you will never get it!!
zhuiyuejie_second_50_2: What did I miss? Am I too late?
zhuiyuejie_second_50_3: No, you are right on time.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_1: Stay back! Stay away from here!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_2: Pascar, it's me, Xiangli Yao. Do you recognize me?
zhuiyuejie_second_51_3: Stay back... The Waveworn's coming! Stay away from here!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_4: Huh? Didn't he set it off in the first place?
zhuiyuejie_second_51_5: Calm down, we are safe here. No Waveworn or Tacet Field around.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_9: Pascar. What do you want me to know?
zhuiyuejie_second_51_10: I… I should've stayed at the Academy. Shouldn't have taken anything without permission…
zhuiyuejie_second_51_11: But I did it! I figured it all out! The Tacet Field's frequency!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_12: Made a prototype detector too! It predicts where the Tacet Fields are forming!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_13: I-I should've kept the documents... Should've informed you...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_14: I was thrilled... blinded by the success...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_15: But then my prototype... gone. Everything... gone...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_16: The margin of error was too big. Not enough time, not enough range...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_17: When I got there, the Waveworn had already...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_18: Ah, I see. So the Waveworn had devoured me, and the last person I saw was...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_20: Yes... Yes, I remember... It's all coming back to me now...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_21: I didn't trigger the Waveworn! That's what I've been trying to tell you!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_22: And, what else... Pen! Give me a pen!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_23: I must write down my research results! I must show you!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_25: I've been trying to tell you for so, so long. I just want to let you know...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_26: It's all in vain... Now everyone must see me as the culprit...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_27: Ha, can't blame you... After what I said, of course you'd...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_28: No... Your sacrifice was not in vain.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_30: I identified the Tacet Field's special frequency! I never hated you! I just... I wanted to save the world...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_33: Yes, it's your theory. We named it after you.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_42: So... my research actually helped others...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_43: It did, and it will keep on benefiting people.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_45: Thank you, my friend. Please... Please witness the world we've protected... on my behalf...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_46: My wish has come true. Thank you, Wishing Tree...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_47: Rover... Let's witness Pascar's wish. Together.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_55: Our classmates and I… We found your notes after the Waveworn receded.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_56: After filling in the missing information, we restored this theory and named it after you.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_58: Yes, and we all know it wasn't your fault.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_59: We're still searching for a way to recreate your prototype. But the 'Pascar Spectrum' theory has gained global recognition, and is advancing Tacet Field research.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_60: Your research has inspired many, even attracting interest from the Black Shores, that mysterious organization. They've actually sent one of their Consultants to learn about the theory.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_62: Their faces couldn't hide the shock. It was truly a sight to behold. Even I burst out laughing.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_63: Look, Abby. You've got a fellow ghost.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_64: Again, I am NOT a ghost!
zhuiyuejie_second_51_65: The Waveworn gobbled up and then spit out some weak frequencies, but this one smells… strange. Was it affected by something else?

zhuiyuejie_first_27_4: Rover, Rover... why does that sound so familiar...
zhuiyuejie_first_27_5: Oh, I remember now. You're the hero of Jinzhou, aren't you? Defeated that terrible beast. Everyone's been talking about it.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_6: My thanks to you. You've realized my son's vision. Oh, how joyful he'd be, seeing Jinzhou now.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_8: Since he was little, my boy dreamed of shielding me, and all of Jinzhou.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_9: He'd always say, "I'll conquer the Threnodian one day so everyone can live peacefully." That's what drove him to join the Midnight Rangers.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_10: You must've been happy for him.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_11: You must've been really proud of him.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_12: Once, he and some Rangers stayed behind during a mission to give folks like me a chance to flee.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_13: I know he did it to chase his dreams, but... but now he's gone, and he'll never witness the defeat of the Threnodians.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_14: I just... sigh... We used to celebrate every Moon-Chasing Festival at the stalls, and he'd make wishes at the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_15: Haha, yes, I always had faith that my son would achieve his dreams. He never stopped striving.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_16: His mischief sometimes tried my patience, but now, the silence is overwhelming. I can't help but wonder if... if he's lonely wherever he is? Oh, perhaps I should join him?
zhuiyuejie_first_27_17: But before he left, he made me promise to be witness to the day the Threnodians are finally gone. What am I to do...
zhuiyuejie_first_27_18: Oh dear, I've rambled on about my boy again. What brings you here today, dear?
zhuiyuejie_first_27_19: We... We're here for the wish you made.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_20: Do you remember the wish you made at the Moontree Lodge, Mrs. Heying?
zhuiyuejie_first_27_21: Well, of course. I do. Everyone knows the Moontree Lodge has magical powers. I see, you must've been sent here to help me fulfill my wish, is that right?
zhuiyuejie_first_27_23: When deciding your answer... Oh yes, {PlayerName}, I recall they say it's best to speak the answer in front of the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_25: Xiangli Yao gives you a slight nudge.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_27: Mrs. Heying, might you consider a visit to the Lodge with us? The Taoyuan Vale is preparing for the Moonlit Fair, and the atmosphere is quite lively. Perhaps a walk will lift your spirits.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_28: A walk... My heart hasn’t really been in it since I lost my son. And, well, my legs don’t carry me as well as they used to...
zhuiyuejie_first_27_30: Well... okay. If you think it might help find the answers, then perhaps we should try.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_31: You granted his wish beautifully. I trust you might do the same for mine, though really, I have nothing much left to ask for.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_32: As I've mentioned in my wish, I find myself at a crossroads, unable to decide. I hope the Moontree Lodge can clear my doubts.
zhuiyuejie_first_29_5: Indeed it is! Look at the crowd! So many things I've never seen before, it's quite exciting...
zhuiyuejie_first_29_6: You young folks must be thrilled with all this. Go on, enjoy yourselves. Don't mind this old lady.
zhuiyuejie_first_29_7: (Mrs. Heying has been doing her best to stay cheerful since we arrived at Taoyuan Vale. Let's take her to see more of the fair.)
zhuiyuejie_first_29_8: This year's Moon-Chasing Festival sure is lively.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_1: Happy Moon-Chasing Festival! Would you like to browse our fan paintings?
zhuiyuejie_first_30_2: This one is exquisite! Just look at the fireworks bursting to life on the fan. I've never seen anything like it.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_3: The fireworks seem to fly to the other side of the fan. And these capes...
zhuiyuejie_first_30_4: You have excellent taste, ma'am. This fan is the creation of Ms. Zhezhi. It's the Moon-Chasing Festival from her imagination.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_5: Ah, yes. They represent the Midnight Rangers. A special touch from Ms. Zhezhi.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_6: She hopes that everyone who sees this fan will feel the liveliness of the Moon-Chasing Festival, and remember that the festivities are all thanks to the brave Rangers.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_7: The fireworks flying to the other side are meant to share the celebration with the soldiers on the front lines.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_8: This year's fireworks display will be the biggest yet. Even the soldiers should be able to see it. You won't want to miss it.
zhuiyuejie_first_30_9: I'd like to buy one of these fans...
zhuiyuejie_first_31_1: Ah, the Moon Shooter gallery? My son was so good. Every year at the Moonlit Fair, it was his favorite.
zhuiyuejie_first_31_2: Mrs. He... Ahem. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival everyone. Want to give the Moon Shooter game a try? Lots of rewards to be had!
zhuiyuejie_first_32_1: Wow, very impressive shooting skills. Here are your prizes.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_3: Qingxi carefully hands the prizes to Mrs. Heying. While not especially luxurious looking, they seem practical.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_4: These prizes... Did you make them yourself?
zhuiyuejie_first_32_5: That's right. The Moonlit Fair is about community, so we thought practical items would be more meaningful.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_6: A Ranger instructor taught us how to make them. Even though he's no longer with us, his instructions and methods continue to guide us.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_7: These tools were a great help when we first joined the Rangers. We've now improved them to help even more people.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_8: Please take them, Mrs. Heying. I'm sure Xiuyuan would want you to have them.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_10: You might not remember, but after Xiuyuan passed, I tried to visit you. You didn't want to see me then. I never expected we'd meet here.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_11: It's good to see you out and about. Xiuyuan always talked about how good of a mother you were.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_12: By the way, some of the soldiers who served with Xiuyuan are here today. I'm sure they'd love to see you. Look, here they come.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_13: A group of soldiers walk over to the gallery as Qingxi waves at them.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_14: It's an honor to finally meet you, Mrs. Heying. Xiuyuan was an incredible mentor to me. I wouldn't have the nerve to wield a weapon now if it wasn't for him.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_15: I heard you were the one who taught him how to overcome his fear of the water...
zhuiyuejie_first_32_17: One by one, the Rangers share their stories of Xiuyuan with Mrs. Heying, as you and Xiangli Yao stand quietly listening on.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_18: ...So, the boy taught you everything I taught him.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_20: Oh, I'm still here. Please, go on. I'd love to hear more stories about Xiuyuan's time with the Rangers.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_21: Of course, ma'am. Why don't we go have a seat over there first? We've got plenty of stories to share with you.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_23: Before that... Thank you, Xiangli Yao and {PlayerName}.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_24: Just as I said before. I knew that both of you would make my wish come true.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_25: But before I visit the Moontree Lodge for the answer, I'd like to walk around a bit more on my own.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_26: I trust that this answer will be right for you.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_27: Heying thanks you as she follows the Rangers away.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_30: Do you think Mrs. Heying understood the promise she made to her son?
zhuiyuejie_first_32_31: We can't be sure just yet. But at least she's made a good start, don't you agree?
zhuiyuejie_first_32_33: Now she isn't just going along with us, she's searching for the life her son wanted for her.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_34: But it means this wasn't the wish affecting Patty either. We'll have to keep digging.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_35: At any rate, more stalls are being set up in Taoyuan Vale. Care to explore further...?
zhuiyuejie_first_32_36: I believe she'll uncover her answer someday and make her own choice, without relying on the Moontree Lodge.

Side_ZZDATE_1_2: (She's been standing there since the afternoon...)
Side_ZZDATE_1_3: Hmm... "Capture the stalls and the Wishing Tree together, to show the festive atmosphere... ideally with the moon in the background." Ugh... should I find another spot to paint?
Side_ZZDATE_1_5: With these requirements... the composition... isn't right either...
Side_ZZDATE_1_6: Oh...! Sorry, are-are you talking to me?
Side_ZZDATE_1_8: Actually, I was talking to the hand floating behind you.
Side_ZZDATE_1_11: Please, don't s-scare me like that...
Side_ZZDATE_1_12: Sorry... I didn't notice you there just now...
Side_ZZDATE_1_14: (So {PlayerName} remembers me? But wait... did I tell {Male=him;Female=her} my name? We've only met once, so it's natural if {Male=he;Female=she} can't remember me...)
Side_ZZDATE_1_15: (Should I introduce myself one more time...? I should do something so it doesn't get awkward, right? Ugh, what to do...)
Side_ZZDATE_1_18: Y-yes! I'm Zhezhi. You got my name right.
Side_ZZDATE_1_20: I-I remember you too! You said you go by the name Rover.
Side_ZZDATE_1_21: The festival's over. Aren't you going home?
Side_ZZDATE_1_22: No, the Artists of Huanglong have requested a painting for the Moon-Chasing Festival, and I'm still searching for inspiration... It's been a bit of a struggle, but I'll head back once it's done.
Side_ZZDATE_1_24: Well, it's not that... Wait, is that the time already?!
Side_ZZDATE_1_26: That's... that's okay. I prefer quiet places... Plus, I live right here in Jinzhou, not too far away...
Side_ZZDATE_1_27: (Leaving her alone here... doesn't sit right.)
Side_ZZDATE_1_30: Me? I'm not really that hungry—
Side_ZZDATE_1_32: Let me cook something for you.
Side_ZZDATE_1_33: I borrowed Uncle Li's stove. Come on, give it a try.
Side_ZZDATE_1_34: Really? Thank you... But I still haven't finished my painting—
Side_ZZDATE_1_35: Can't work on an empty stomach.
Side_ZZDATE_1_36: You can eat and look for inspiration at the same time.
Side_ZZDATE_1_37: You're right... Don't mind if I do!
Side_ZZDATE_1_38: It's sooo delicious! It's almost as good as Uncle Li's... No, it tastes even better with those extra seasonings.
Side_ZZDATE_1_40: Oh, by the way, how was your Moon-Chasing Festival?
Side_ZZDATE_1_41: Oh, um... It was okay, I guess. Nothing much, really... Hehe.
Side_ZZDATE_1_43: (Oh, should I be honest? No, no, I can't worry {Male=him;Female=her}. A little white lie won't hurt, right?)
Side_ZZDATE_1_45: Sitting at the stall was exhausting. Just an hour there, and I think I'd need a day to recover.
Side_ZZDATE_1_46: Anyway, I couldn't find anyone to go to the festival with me. I feel like I can't breathe in crowded places, but going alone also felt awkward...
Side_ZZDATE_1_47: (Wait, did I just blurt out everything?! Is it normal to spill my guts to someone I barely know? Weird... I'm not even feeling jittery... am I always this awkward?! Oh dear...)
Side_ZZDATE_1_49: (Does {Male=he;Female=she} think I'm complaining? Am I coming across as too annoying?)
Side_ZZDATE_1_50: I, uh, I'm not saying I didn't have a good time! Thanks to the festival, I've had lots of work, and I got paid for looking after the stall. I've made enough in just these few days to pay off three or four months of debt!
Side_ZZDATE_1_51: (WHAT AM I SAYING! This just makes me sound miserable!)
Side_ZZDATE_1_52: Well, I guess we're enjoying the festival together now.
Side_ZZDATE_1_53: Even though it's just the two of us.
Side_ZZDATE_1_54: (...The two of us? Does that mean we're on a... No, no, no, I'd better stop here. What am I thinking!?)
Side_ZZDATE_1_55: It's good... just the two of us. Actually, it feels... right.
Side_ZZDATE_1_56: Most of the stalls are closed...
Side_ZZDATE_1_57: But we can still make wishes.
Side_ZZDATE_1_59: Have you ever made a wish?
Side_ZZDATE_1_61: Why not take this chance to make a wish?
Side_ZZDATE_1_63: Before I make a wish, Rover, can I ask you a favor...?
Side_ZZDATE_1_64: Can-can I put you in my painting? You'll only need to stand there for ten minutes... or maybe five... or three, I promise!
Side_ZZDATE_1_67: I-I don't know! I just have this overwhelming urge... I want to include you in this painting. I feel like I need to... No, I want to!
Side_ZZDATE_1_69: Wouldn't it be a bit inappropriate to include me?
Side_ZZDATE_1_70: No, I'm not talking about the painting I'm being paid to create...
Side_ZZDATE_1_71: This painting, I want it to be... Just for myself.
Side_WYLY_1_1: Xiangli Yao? What are you doing here...
Side_WYLY_1_2: Still working on unfulfilled wishes from the Moontree Lodge?
Side_WYLY_1_3: Not exactly. Thanks to you, every wish has been fulfilled.
Side_WYLY_1_4: As for what I'm doing... Consider it some kind of after-sales service.
Side_WYLY_1_5: I light and hang the fulfilled wishes. When the wisher cannot do it themselves, I do it for them.
Side_WYLY_1_6: You should have counted me in!
Side_WYLY_1_8: Then we can do it together next year. I had just finished with the last one before you arrived.
Side_WYLY_1_9: Most of the fulfilled wishes had already been put up during the festival. There weren't many left from the beginning.
Side_WYLY_1_10: Don't worry about it. You've already been a huge help. It's your first time celebrating Moon-Chasing Festival in Jinzhou, you deserve to have more fun.
Side_WYLY_1_11: I can handle the rest on my own.
Side_WYLY_1_12: Nice! I'll enjoy the festival, then!
Side_WYLY_1_13: Let me help. I happen to have some time to spare.
Side_WYLY_1_14: Yes, you deserve to have fun and rewind. Taking a necessary break is not a waste of time. Don't let this opportunity pass you by.
Side_WYLY_1_15: Well, you've been busy since your first day in Jinzhou. If you have some time to spare, that's more the reason to save that time for yourself.
Side_WYLY_1_16: Time files when we're having fun.
Side_WYLY_1_17: As the festivities wind down, the Moonlit Fair's stalls remain open. Perhaps you'd like to visit for one last round? You may even find some deals and specials at this time.
Side_WYLY_1_18: You really know a lot about the Moonlit Fair.
Side_WYLY_1_19: Now you sound like a real pro at this.
Side_WYLY_1_20: Having been to the fair every year, I always make time to explore the stalls that catch my interest.
Side_WYLY_1_21: Stay with us in Jinzhou for a couple more years, then I'm sure you'll become very familiar with the fair too.
Side_WYLY_1_22: Really? I thought you'd be doing researches instead.
Side_WYLY_1_23: Haha, indeed I find joy in scientific research. Immersing myself in data and theories, verifying various possibilities... It's a blissful experience.
Side_WYLY_1_24: But sometimes, taking a break from work to join the jubilant crowd brings a different kind of joy.
Side_WYLY_1_25: Then which one is your favorite stall so far?
Side_WYLY_1_27: My favorite stall? You've probably been there already. Hmm, but if I have to choose one... Shall I just show you in person?
Side_WYLY_1_28: Xiangli Yao leads you to a certain place...
Side_WYLY_1_29: Is that the Moon Shooter game over there?
Side_WYLY_1_30: Yes. I remember you seemed to enjoy it last time.
Side_WYLY_1_31: {PlayerName}, with your exceptional prowess in combat, I bet you're good at shooting too?
Side_WYLY_1_32: There’s still room for improvement. I’m not even in the first place.
Side_WYLY_1_33: Yep, I'm confident in my shooting skills.
Side_WYLY_1_34: Then, may I suggest something more challenging?
Side_WYLY_1_36: Moon Shooter is very popular. While the stall owner changes the targets daily, the frequent use has caused some wear and tear.
Side_WYLY_1_37: That's why we need to lower the muzzle a bit. Make it easier to hit the bull's eye.
Side_WYLY_1_38: Now here's the exciting part: rotate the gun slightly and align it with the rabbit's ear, then you may hit two targets simultaneously. It's all about finding the right angle, and the bullet might rebound toward the next one.
Side_WYLY_1_40: Yes. You'll need to use the right angle and utilize the momentum. It's kind of like stone skipping.
Side_WYLY_1_42: Sounds pretty crazy. You sure it's possible?
Side_WYLY_1_43: I first tried it two years ago. On a good day, I could hit three targets at once.
Side_WYLY_1_44: They've been using my record as a promotional gimmick, offering an exclusive souvenir to anyone who can break it.
Side_WYLY_1_45: An exclusive souvenir? Now we're talking...
Side_WYLY_1_46: So the record holder is here right before me.
Side_WYLY_1_47: Good. I was a bit worried it wouldn’t interest you.
Side_WYLY_1_48: With {PlayerName} as the new challenger, I may not hold that record for long.
Side_WYLY_1_49: Have you ever tried one-shotting all the targets?
Side_WYLY_1_50: Hmm... If I were to try that, I'd have to calculate the bullet trajectory to two decimal places.
Side_WYLY_1_51: Which technically isn't impossible with my prosthetic hand... but I'll probably get banned from ever playing again.
Side_WYLY_1_52: {PlayerName}, I'll stick to using my left hand to keep it a safe and fair competition.
Side_WYLY_1_53: Well, jokes aside, I value the process more than the outcome. To me, it's all about having a good time.
Side_WYLY_1_54: After all, this isn't a scientific inquiry, and there's no end goal. We're here to enjoy ourselves, and I want to do that to the fullest. What do you think, {PlayerName}?
Side_WYLY_1_56: Of course. That's the whole point!
Side_WYLY_1_57: Glad we're on the same page. Can I make a request, then? Will you join me for next year's Moon-Chasing Festival, {PlayerName}?
Side_WYLY_1_59: We're making plans together for next year already?
Side_WYLY_1_60: You heard me. The idea came to me as we gazed at the moon, side by side. While I'm not sure where you'll be, or what you'll be doing then... I want to invite you anyway.
Side_WYLY_1_61: I’m not planning to have you help me with the wishes at Moontree Lodge again. Maybe we'll try another game of Moon Shooting, or go sample some new treats at Yumyum Haven. Or we'll just follow the crowd, and see where it takes us...
Side_WYLY_1_62: Though it's still a long time before next year's celebration, I can't help but imagine what we might do together.
Side_WYLY_1_63: I don't have a specific plan yet, but with you, {PlayerName}... I have a feeling it's going to be fun.
Side_WYLY_1_64: Since you've put it that way...
Side_WYLY_1_65: Now I do have some ideas for next year.
Side_WYLY_1_68: I see. So this is the wish you made for next year's Moon-Chasing Festival.
Side_WYLY_1_69: As the caretaker of Moontree Lodge, and as Xiangli Yao...
Side_WYLY_1_70: I promise to make it come true.
Activity_100900001_Desc: A new Resonator has entered the Simulation Training. Make use of their powers to complete the challenge and gather relevant data for rewards.
zhuiyuejie_first_33_1: The third wish... Let's see what's written this time.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_1: Ugh, this again... I'm so over this cheesy old play...
zhuiyuejie_first_35_2: There are way better ones... Come on, switch it up! What about "Rainbow Mirror"? I'll be Flame Ranger, you be his sidekick being controlled by the monsters!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_3: No way... Why do I always have to be the one getting beat up? I don't wanna play the bad guy.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_4: We pinky-sweared last time, remember?! If I don't get to play as Flame Ranger, I'm not playing with you anymore.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_5: All right, all right. Let me think...
zhuiyuejie_first_35_6: Then let's do "Deep Sea Rescue." You can be Flame Ranger, and I'll be the sidekick.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_8: ...Oh, I see what you're up to, Momo... trying to trick me again... In "Deep Sea Rescue," the Flame Ranger falls into the villain's trap and gets beat up at the start!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_9: So I'll still be the one getting whacked.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_10: ...Hmph. I'm gonna tell Mahn if you keep doing this. Wait till he comes back, he'll give you a knuckle sandwich.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_11: Pfft, you think telling Mahn's gonna help you? With him around, you'll never get the chance to be Flame Ranger!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_12: At least I won't get beat up by you all the time!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_13: Do any of you know Mahn?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_14: Hey. Where did this weird grown-up with a flying bunny come from...?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_15: Mahn's not here, I'm in charge! Wanna play with us? Okay, then you can be a monster!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_17: Processing speed increased to 150%. Processor temperature: 90℃, 91℃, 92℃...
zhuiyuejie_first_35_18: We're not here to play games.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_22: I'm here, don't worry. I'm overriding Xiang-LEE's processor. One moment, please.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_24: Phew. I almost wet my pants...
zhuiyuejie_first_35_25: So... You're looking for Mahn, huh?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_26: He's not here right now, but if it's important, you can tell me, and I'll pass it on to him, word for word.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_27: Pfft. Li's being a show-off again.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_28: We haven't seen Mahn for days. No way you can tell him anything.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_29: Not true! We're doing one of his favorite plays tomorrow, he'll definitely show up!
zhuiyuejie_first_35_30: We did a play yesterday and one before that. Hmph, I don't remember him showing up. Where was he?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_34: Any ideas where I can find Mahn?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_35: Well... We usually play together in the city or watch Hero Plays at the theater. Oh... and we have a secret base.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_37: Can you tell me where it is?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_38: Do you think he'll be there?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_39: Hmm... Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_40: Hmm... Maybe. Are you going to go look for him?
zhuiyuejie_first_35_41: But Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_42: I'm here to help him become a great hero.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_44: Um... He did mention before that there's this Flame power growing inside of him, and he's about to become a great hero just like Flame Ranger.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_45: Well... I guess you don't look like a bad person, so...
zhuiyuejie_first_35_46: Li leans close to your ear and whispers the location of the secret base to you.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_49: Err... If you do find him, please don't tell him I told you about the secret base.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_50: Oh, oh! And remember to tell him to come back and play with us soon.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_1: ...Whoa, that was rad! How did you do that? You gotta teach me!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_3: Why are you out here all alone?
zhuiyuejie_first_37_5: Well, you did just save me from that TD so...
zhuiyuejie_first_37_6: All right. You can be the only grown-up that I tell.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_7: Ahem! I, Mahn, am about to awaken my Forte!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_9: Well, you know. In the Hero Plays, every great hero is a Resonator with their own unique, super cool Forte.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_10: Some of them are born with it, and some have to journey to distant mountains and secret caves to train all alone.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_11: And then—"After years of training, a Tacet Mark finally appears. Forte awaken." Hehe, that's my favorite part!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_12: That's why I've been eating all my veggies and going to bed early lately. I want to be ready to spend the whole day at this secret base training.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_13: I try to practice every move I can think of from the plays, hoping my Forte will awaken soon. I've been so busy, I haven't even watched any Hero Plays lately.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_14: So, has your Forte awakened yet?
zhuiyuejie_first_37_16: But I've come up with a new plan. You know how Flame Ranger gets stronger the more danger he's in? They call it a "Forte Boost"!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_17: So I thought, why not find a scary monster and try to fight it?
zhuiyuejie_first_37_18: So that Tacet Discord just now...
zhuiyuejie_first_37_19: Uh... That was an accident... I've no idea where it came from...
zhuiyuejie_first_37_20: If I'm gonna a great hero, I have to find an enemy that's even stronger than a TD.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_24: Then, you tell me. What should I do to awaken my Forte?
zhuiyuejie_first_37_25: Having a Forte is really so important to you?
zhuiyuejie_first_37_26: Absolutely, it's a must! Every hero in the plays is a Resonator with a Forte.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_27: Becoming a hero means I can protect all my friends. None of us will ever need to be scared again.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_28: Besides... being a hero is just the coolest. Every Hero Play, all my friends cheer like crazy for Flame Ranger. I don't plan on being the lame sidekick, no way.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_29: You don't need a Forte to be a hero.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_30: If you know so much about it... Then what should I do? Tell me, tell me!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_34: Ugh. You sound like my mom. Come on, don't treat me like I'm just some kid.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_35: I do know... a few warriors. They know firsthand what it means to be a hero.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_36: What if I write down some of their quests and daring feats for you? Real heroes, real stories... it might give you some ideas.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_37: Wow, really?! Are they even more awesome than the heroes in the plays??
zhuiyuejie_first_37_38: When will you show me these stories? I want Li and Momo to see 'em too.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_39: Time. Location. Event notification. The Moonlit Fair.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_40: (The Moonlit Fair, right in the middle of the festival? It would be the perfect draw for the children in Jinzhou.)
zhuiyuejie_first_37_41: (Thankfully, I've still got some time to get everything ready for Mahn's wish before it starts.)
zhuiyuejie_first_37_42: How about this? The Moonlit Fair, on the day of the Moon-Chasing Festival. I'll have the stories with me. Pinky promise.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_43: YES!! It's a pinky promise, then!
zhuiyuejie_first_37_44: Can't wait to see you there!
Quest_880000032_ChildQuestTip_880_24: Go back and find Xiangli Yao
zhuiyuejie_second_2_2: Hey, {PlayerName}! You've been to the Wishing Tree, right? What did you wish for?
zhuiyuejie_second_2_3: Did it come tru— Oh wait, it can't be that fast...
zhuiyuejie_second_2_8: Almost finished! It's crazy here with all these people bustling around!
zhuiyuejie_second_2_9: You hear the buzz from our side?
zhuiyuejie_second_2_10: Need to double-check the procedure. Hmm? Did I just see Madam Magistrate... Was it just me?
zhuiyuejie_second_2_11: Sorry! I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to bump into you! Ugh, I should've just stayed home to avoid causing trouble.
zhuiyuejie_second_2_18: Everyone's really giving their all for this year's Moon-Chasing Festival!
zhuiyuejie_second_2_19: Oh, and the Loong Dance performance is happening tonight! Come and watch it with us, {PlayerName}! I've secured the best seat!
zhuiyuejie_second_2_23: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...
zhuiyuejie_second_2_25: You are? Whew... I thought someone else had beat me to it.
zhuiyuejie_second_2_26: We'll be waiting for you then!
zhuiyuejie_second_2_28: Before we hang up, anything you wanna say to {PlayerName}, Yangyang?
zhuiyuejie_second_2_30: Okay, erm... How're you doing today, {PlayerName}?
zhuiyuejie_second_2_31: I'm looking forward to enjoying the Moonlit Fair with you tonight.
zhuiyuejie_second_2_35: People have been preparing for the Moonlit Fair for many weeks.
zhuiyuejie_second_2_36: {PlayerName}, I just sent the coordinates to your Terminal! See you there!
zhuiyuejie_second_2_38: Haha, get ready to be blown away!
zhuiyuejie_second_3_1: Hmm... Are we not going to that restaurant, then?
zhuiyuejie_second_3_2: Let's eat there with Yangyang and the others later.
zhuiyuejie_second_3_5: Hello, {PlayerName}. Can you come to the Moontree Lodge?
zhuiyuejie_second_3_6: Hey, you done deciphering that fourth wish?
zhuiyuejie_second_3_7: Yes. As I suspected, Patty's malfunction was caused by something else.
zhuiyuejie_second_3_9: Thank you. I'll see you in the usual spot.
zhuiyuejie_second_3_10: I smell something delicious! It's the real deal for my empty tummy, I just know it!
zhuiyuejie_second_4_1: More trouble to solve eh? Wait... didn't you just promise Yangyang we'd hang out tonight?
zhuiyuejie_second_4_2: Yeah, I did. Let's go handle it quickly so we can still make it on time.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_1: Are you alright? It's not uncommon to feel a bit queasy after leaving a Sonoro Sphere.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_2: I'm fine. Not feeling off at all.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_3: Sonoro Spheres? More like my playground.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_6: Given the situation is now under control, it should be fine. I will check on Patty, just to be safe.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_7: (He might need some time alone to process what just happened...)
zhuiyuejie_second_52_9: Don't worry about me, {PlayerName}. I can handle the rest myself. It's just a quick checkup on Patty.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_10: Go join the celebration down the mountain. Remember those kids you promised to meet up with? They must be waiting for you.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_11: Besides, I need some time to prepare a small gift for you, as thanks. I'll... catch up with you later.

Side_CFYW_5_1: H-here we are... This should be the location mentioned by the herb collector.
Side_CFYW_5_2: Let's investigate the surroundings. Look, I've got a camera. I'll make sure to take pictures of anything unusual!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_13: Mr. Rabbit said you're tough and will be okay. He told us not to worry about you.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_14: But... Come on, there's no way we wouldn't worry! How can people just disappear? My mom said it only happens in hero plays.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_15: So you've been waiting for me all this time?
zhuiyuejie_second_53_16: Yeah! We had a plan! If anything went wrong, our boss and Momo would run super fast downhill to get help from the grown-ups.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_17: And I'll keep watch in case anything goes down. My eyes don't miss a thing!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_19: You show the footage recorded in the Sonoro Sphere to the children.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_20: Hm? The hero in this video... is that you?
zhuiyuejie_second_53_22: That's awesomel! No wonder you beat that monster with only a few moves! You're a true hero!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_23: And the guy fighting with you is incredible! I don't recognize him, but his mecha arm looks SO COOL!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_24: I want to be just like you! But... I don't know how to use Forte... or what it takes to be a hero...
zhuiyuejie_second_53_26: Despite wanting to go to the Moonlit Fair, you chose to stay here and protect us.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_27: You walked the walk, sacrificing your own enjoyment for the sake of others.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_28: This is exactly what the Flame Ranger would do.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_30: A-are you saying that... We are the Flame Rangers now?
zhuiyuejie_second_53_31: Just like me and my "mecha-arm" partner.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_32: So, I'm a hero now... and I have my hero squad, with Li, Momo, and Mr. Rabbit! The Moontree Lodge really made my wish come true!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_35: Mahn? Why are you kids here?
zhuiyuejie_second_53_36: Well... the Moonlit Fair was starting, but we saw you were busy with something else... so we...
zhuiyuejie_second_53_37: We followed you up the mountain and saw you chatting with someone, and then, poof! You two just vanished into thin air.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_38: We tried to ask for help, but all we found was a rabbit robot.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_39: Hehe, you're welcome. Since you're safe now, can you show us... the hero play you mentioned earlier?
zhuiyuejie_second_53_41: Oh! I know! Grandpa told me you are the hero who saved Jinzhou!
zhuiyuejie_second_53_42: I think you're already a hero.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_43: Yes. With your swift feet and keen eyes, you'd make a formidable team, ready to face any challenge together.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_35: I can't even get in, let alone find what I need...
zhuiyuejie_second_54_36: Have you seen Xiangli Yao's room? It's a perfect example of "order out of disorder." I learned it from the genius.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_37: And you always find things no matter where I leave them. Man, you know my room better than I do.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_39: Are you here for the Moonlit Fair too?
zhuiyuejie_second_54_40: Yes, our colleague Zhixiu organized this event called "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim." We're here to show support. Plus, Shifan never misses Tacet Discord events.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_41: Haha, you know me. Zhixiu's interested in those monsters too. Should we invite her to join our research? More brains, better ideas.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_42: Let's get the creative juices flowing!
zhuiyuejie_second_54_43: Glad to hear you're having fun.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_45: Oh, hey. Good to see you again.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_47: Thanks to you, Jiuli and I can restart our Tacet Discord research. With our past experience, I'm sure we'll get better results this time.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_48: We've been busy moving the equipment to our new lab.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_49: Speaking of that, can you please clean your room? Only been a few days and it's a mess already. Piled high with papers, devices, and take-out...
zhuiyuejie_second_55_46: Packaging. I wrapped the pastry up to keep the warmth. It'll taste better...
zhuiyuejie_second_55_47: Please have a bite, Mrs. Heying, I made this myself. And this one's for you, Shangyun.
zhuiyuejie_second_55_49: Mr. Xiuyuan made this pastry for us during previous Moon-Chasing Festivals...
zhuiyuejie_second_55_50: ...Yes, I really liked it, so I asked him for the recipe.
zhuiyuejie_second_55_51: But... My son never learned to cook... When did he make this for you?
zhuiyuejie_second_55_52: He could make a feast out of even the simplest ingredients. That's how good he was!
zhuiyuejie_second_55_53: Cooking's not that hard. I can do it too.
zhuiyuejie_second_55_54: Shall I make a meal for you when I get some leave, Mrs. Heying?
zhuiyuejie_second_55_55: (Mrs. Heying's not alone. It's good to see.)
zhuiyuejie_second_55_57: No rush, child. Take a breath.
zhuiyuejie_second_55_58: What took you so long, Wenyu?
zhuiyuejie_second_55_59: He learned it in the military. At first, the food he made was... um, average, but he got better over time.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_1: You are... Whoaahh! Sorry, I couldn't see you! My glasses were smudged...
zhuiyuejie_second_56_2: A-Are you... still looking for that researcher named "Xiaosheng"? I asked around but... no luck...
zhuiyuejie_second_56_3: I'm so sorry for being so useless... I... I can ask more people if you want!
zhuiyuejie_second_56_4: Y-You can pick any of my paintings, as an apology? Please choose one, I insist...
zhuiyuejie_second_56_5: It's okay. I've already found Xiaosheng.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_6: Thank you, but I've already found Xiaosheng.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_7: Really? Whew... That's good to know...
zhuiyuejie_second_56_11: Yeah, lots of people. I can see all of Taoyuan Vale from here.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_12: What do you want to draw?
zhuiyuejie_second_56_13: Um... I guess it's everyone down there... I'm not good with people, but... their smiles make me feel warm inside too.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_14: It's like... when I pick up a paintbrush... the warmth just spreads through me.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_15: Looking forward to your stunning artwork.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_16: S-stunning... No, you flatter me. It's not that good... just average...

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_267_1: Lady Xinyi, Madam Magistrate has returned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_269_1: Honored to be in your presence, Magistrate Jinhsi.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_2: Another one of those sad wishes...
zhuiyuejie_first_25_3: Are they wishing for an answer?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_4: Hmm, this wish does bear some similarities to the one written by Shifan.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_5: This shows that, just like Shifan, the woman who wrote this wish is desperate for help. We need to consider this carefully.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_6: Their questions might not reflect their deepest wishes, and it's not our place to answer them. It's sad that she seems to be in the same place that Shifan was...
zhuiyuejie_first_25_7: But they both wanted help. That is why they made these wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_8: So aside from helping her make a choice, there are other factors we must consider.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_9: The problem that led their wish?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_10: Indeed. The wish shows a struggle between her longing and a promise she made to her son.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_11: She speaks of "another world," likely hinting her child has passed away, leaving her alone with nobody to care for her.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_12: We can't draw a conclusion solely based on words alone. I'm curious as to what drove her to write these words.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_13: Heying and her son... What's their story? What promise did they share?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_14: What is it, {PlayerName}? Is there something on your mind?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_15: No, nothing. It's just that... Is it really for us to take on a wish tied to life and death?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_16: She knows the pain of separation from a loved one better than anyone else. If we handle this wrong, it might...
zhuiyuejie_first_25_17: So that's what you're worried about. It seems what Baizhi said about you is true. You do have a gentle soul.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_18: Ever thought about becoming the mysterious wish granter of Moontree Lodge yourself?
zhuiyuejie_first_25_19: You're right to be concerned, but... the Moontree Lodge's very existence is to have every wish be heard.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_20: Ignoring people's pain isn't right. Besides, we're not trying to force Mrs. Heying to make a choice.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_21: Our role is to listen, understand, and reflect. Ultimately, the choice lies in Mrs. Heying's hands.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_22: But it's getting late. Let me know when you're ready for our next task.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_24: I need to think about it.
zhuiyuejie_first_26_1: Ah {PlayerName}, are you ready for our next task?
zhuiyuejie_first_26_3: I need to think about it.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_2: Hehe...It was just a little trick to get Mrs. Heying to join us at the Lodge. You probably sensed it after hearing her story.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_3: The promise between Mrs. Heying and her son wasn't just about seeing his wish granted but about finding peace in her life.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_4: In her grief, Mrs. Heying overlooked what her son truly wished for.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_5: His wish for his mother represents not just life's simple joys, but also the courage to keep living.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_6: Though I can't say for certain, the Moonlit Fair in Taoyuan Vale holds the dreams of many.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_7: Perhaps there's something her son wanted her to see, a reason to embrace life.
zhuiyuejie_first_28_8: Heh, how are you youngsters falling behind an old lady? Come on, I'm waitin' on ya!
zhuiyuejie_first_28_9: I believe he wanted her to see Jinzhou uniting to defeat the Threnodian and the joy and security he sacrificed himself to safeguard.
zhuiyuejie_first_7_3: Ah, it looks like one of those robots from the Moontree Lodge. One of its parts must be broken.
zhuiyuejie_first_7_4: Where can I find this Moontree Lodge?
zhuiyuejie_first_7_5: It's like the wishing well under the Wishing Tree. People toss their hopes and dreams in there, and poof! Before you know it, someone makes them come true.
zhuiyuejie_first_7_6: You can even say it's part of the Wishing Tree, but wishes made at the lodge are more... public. It's up to the wisher if they want to share.
zhuiyuejie_first_7_7: Anyhow, I saw that robot hovering around there earlier. Maybe that's where you should start your search.

Side_WGST_1_4: Yeah, see this little turtle right next to me? That's Slowy. Been my companion for quite a while.
Side_WGST_1_5: Just strolling along, nice and slow…
Side_WGST_1_6: I'm here, just chilling and watching Slowy, while it's here, taking in the scenery. We're always together, but we don't bother each other.
Side_WGST_1_7: I don't really get why it doesn't give me any trouble. Maybe we just get along pretty well…?
Side_WGST_1_8: But, you know, watch out for the other turtles around here. They're not as friendly as Slowy.
Event_WWQH_35_1: You're here just in time. The cargo truck made it to Port Gunchao in one piece, but it broke down completely shortly afterwards.
Event_WWQH_35_2: Here's your pay for today. You keep that momentum rolling for tomorrow, all right?

Moonfiesta_Entrust_4_Content:
"I can't remember its name, but I can still taste it like it were yesterday."
Many long for the delicious meals they once enjoyed. By describing the flavors and ingredients, perhaps these dishes can be recreated to rival even their fondest memories.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_5_Content: Uncle Li at Yumyum Haven is a keen experimenter of various recipes to cater to his guests' preferences. To that end, he is always in search of rare ingredients. Guided by his belief in knowledge from practice, he compiled an Ingredient Handbook and made a wish for someone to inherit his work.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_6_Content:
"How I wish to make my family a great Moonlit Fair feast from scratch."
Many find the sharing of food bonding, and the Lodge has received many such wishes. Maybe a Chef's Masterclass at Taoyuan Vale's kitchen could fulfill these wishes.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_7_Content: A legend persists that throwing items into the tree's hollow will repair them, hence the piles of old objects there. Each crack and chip on them silently tells a story of their past.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_8_Content:
"Can someone help me draft a letter?"
Some may find it difficult to adequately convey their feelings in words. Talk with these wishmakers to learn their intentions and help them craft their letters with beautiful and accurate wording.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_9_Content:
Xieyang is currently preparing themes for his riddles. 
To ensure the riddles are appreciated by all, Xieyang is looking for an assistant to help him gather inspiration from the crowd.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_10_Content: Join the Jinzhou Theater as they recruit part-time actors for a special Hero Play written for the festival. Be part of creating unforgettable moments for your audience!
Moonfiesta_Entrust_11_Content: A troupe of unique performers has arrived in Taoyuan Vale. The Academy hopes to showcase some of the cute and charming Echoes in the Moonlit Fair's performances, highlighting the potential of Echoes to the audience. To ensure the Echoes perform reliably, they need someone to help capture specific Echoes and collect related data.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_12_Content:
"What fireworks will people want to see?"
The fireworks stall is troubled by the show it must present for the Fair. The owner is waiting for someone to assist him in creating beautiful fireworks of various shapes and colors.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_13_Content: Soldiers stationed at the border have submitted their wishes to the Moontree Lodge—photos, dishes from their hometown, and essential supplies. If there were ever a time to make these wishes come true, it would be during the Moonlit Fair.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_14_Content: Researchers stationed in the wild sent the Moonstree Lodge a photo of the moon. Engrossed in studying lunar phases and their influence on the lifecycle of certain plants, they seek additional photos of the moon's phases from different locales to complete their records.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_15_Content: The piles at the Moontree Lodge consist not only of wish tags but packages of all sizes. People separated for various reasons wish to send tokens of their affection. The Lodge seeks "express couriers" to assist.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_16_Content: The Moonlit Fair at Taoyuan Vale offers a glimpse into local customs and traditions in Jinzhou. To assist first-time visitors in fully experiencing the Moon-Chasing Festival, Taoyuan Vale is seeking tourist guides to enrich their visit.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_17_Content: The Fan Drawing Stall is designing a series of fans themed "Memories of Moon-Chasing," aiming to capture the festival's beauty for travelling visitors. They are now calling for photos to serve as their inspiration.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_18_Content:
"Can you help me find them?"
Among the foreign guests are special groups revisiting Jinzhou not for the first time, but for a past promise or item. Finding these memories has proven elusive due to changes in Jinzhou. Is there truly no wish that cannot be made a reality?

Character_chun_1_2: It's been a while, my sweet seed of fate.
Character_chun_1_3: Are you here for the flowers? Perfect timing. They're about to bloom.
Character_chun_1_4: Consultants roam all across Solaris, and when they return, they always bring rare flower seeds as souvenirs.
Character_chun_1_6: Nah-uh, I just enjoy planting them.
Character_chun_10_1: What a show. You never disappoint me. With you around, the days ahead will be so much fun.
Character_chun_12_1: {Male=He's;Female=She's} sooo slow. Hehe, looks like I'm gonna win.
Character_chun_2_1: {PlayerName}, there you are! It's been a while, and you still look great.
Character_chun_2_2: Since you came to the Black Shores, so many unexpected things have happened… Even the Shorekeeper made an appearance.
Character_chun_2_3: Anyway, let's get to the point. Do you remember what the Error Cell is for?
Character_chun_2_6: Great, your memory is as sharp as ever.
Character_chun_2_7: Well, it's basically a "prison" for containing hazardous waste like corrupted Stellar Matrices.
Character_chun_2_8: The problem is, one of the "prisoners" has escaped.
Character_chun_2_9: It's headed towards the Necrostar and seems to be trying to go even deeper.
Character_chun_2_10: The Shorekeeper is tied up with modulation and can't leave.
Character_chun_2_11: That's why I need your help to recapture it and prevent any more incidents. You're the best person for the job.
Character_chun_2_14: Don't worry, I'll make it worth your time.
Character_chun_2_15: The escapee is hiding, but we can use the remnants of its data to track it down.
Character_chun_2_19: While investigating, I discovered that a few years ago, a Consultant accessed these data.
Character_chun_2_20: She was out in the field recently and just returned to the Black Shores. You should check in with her first.
Character_chun_2_21: Alright. I'll call if I get anything.
Character_chun_2_22: Thank you. I'm counting on you!
Character_chun_25_1: (KU-Riri is pacing back and forth, seemingly eager to say something.)
Character_chun_25_2: Master, the Overclocked Resonator known as "Lady Flora" has breached containment and left her medical pod.
Character_chun_25_3: The target is currently located in… located…
Character_chun_26_1: It's locked... So Camellya, in her Overclocked state, damaged the locked door's security system, when her mind was unclear?
Character_chun_26_2: I need to restore the security system first.
Character_chun_27_1: The mutated plants have grown so large… Camellya in this timeline has severely Overclocked.
Character_chun_5_1: I guess I have no choice but to catch up with Camellya first.
Character_chun_6_1: Oh, you're quick! I knew you wouldn't keep me waiting.
Character_chun_7_1: While you were handling the troubles at the Black Shores, I was stuck in a medical pod and missed the whole show.
Character_chun_7_2: What a pity I couldn't witness it in person… Show me. Your blade, your strength.
Character_chun_8_1: Hehe, you should always stay focused in a game.
Character_chun_9_1: The fresh, pulsating despair from my enemies is always delightful...
