zhuiyuejie_first_10_76: Welcome... I wish I could extend a warmer greeting, but Patty has run into some technical difficulties and we cannot accept new wishes at Moontree Lodge until I resolve the issue.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_77: I apologize for the inconvenience... I would be glad to take note of your wish and have it prioritized once everything is resolved.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_78: There's so many I don't know what to pick...
zhuiyuejie_first_10_79: I can't think of any on the top of my head...
zhuiyuejie_first_10_80: My wish is for everyone's wishes to come true.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_81: Take your time. We still have a little while before the Moon-Chasing Festival.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_83: ...Speaking from my own experience, of course. Feel free to do as you like.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_84: How intriguing... In that case, I promise to do everything I can to make your wish a reality at the festival.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_85: For now, I must concentrate on restoring the Moontree Lodge as quickly as possible.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_87: In a nutshell, it appears Patty's malfunction is more than a straightforward data error.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_88: At first, I suspected an overload of Patty's analysis module due to an accumulation of wishes over the years.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_91: Additionally... although it was only for a brief moment, I detected abnormal frequency fluctuations after connecting Patty to my Terminal. In theory, a robot's data should not generate such fluctuations.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_92: Did someone tamper with the wishes?
zhuiyuejie_first_10_96: It's too early to draw a conclusion just yet, but I can't leave the matter unresolved.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_97: It'll only be a matter of time before all the wishes stored in the Moontree Lodge are devoured by this abnormal code.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_98: Xiangli Yao pulls out a tablet showing you four indecipherable files.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_101: I've isolated the four wishes with unreadable codes, pinpointing the source of the discrepancies.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_102: I see... Why don't you take a tour around the Vale? Jinzhou is filled with festivities during this time, and losing yourself in the crowds could very well bring your wish into sharper focus.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_103: What's wrong with the Moontree Lodge?
zhuiyuejie_first_10_104: However, during my recent testing, I discovered unusual codes embedded within Patty's database. Like a virus, they spread drastically with the addition of each wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_105: I plan to track down whoever made these wishes, try to fulfill them, and uncover the root cause of these anomalies.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_106: But before that, I need to try to decode the wishes corrupted by these anomalies...
zhuiyuejie_first_10_107: To minimize data loss, it would be best to complete this a week before the Moon-Chasing Festival. With careful planning...
zhuiyuejie_first_10_109: It does have its challenges, but everyone's hopes and dreams for the festival are in these wishes. I don't intend to let them down.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_110: (Yes, Yangyang and the rest... have set their hearts on this festival.)
zhuiyuejie_first_10_111: Anything I can do to help?
zhuiyuejie_first_10_112: I appreciate the gesture... but I wouldn't want to trouble you.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_113: I don't want people losing their wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_114: I'm still counting on you to make my wish come true!
zhuiyuejie_first_10_115: I see. Thank you, {PlayerName}. Well, then... The Moontree Lodge welcomes its newest member!
zhuiyuejie_first_10_116: Seems we have a new friend now, Patty.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_117: {PlayerName}, Xiangli Yao, and Patty. Wishes come true. Organize Moonlit Fair...
zhuiyuejie_first_10_119: Yes. The Lodge opens to the public before the Moonlit Fair, but it still remains an important element of the festivities. The market vendors like to tailor their offerings according to everyone's wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_120: There will be many interesting activities on the day of the Fair, and preparations are well underway. Perhaps some of your friends will be among those attending?
zhuiyuejie_first_10_121: If you're interested, you can go and take a look yourself.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_123: I'll check it out if I have the time.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_1: Been tossing and turning all week. Can't switch off these thoughts at night... I can't take it any longer.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_2: Been scrolling through the forums lately? There's this thing blowing up called "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" on the Huaxu Hive.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_3: (Definition of noun: "Nighttime Blues Syndrome"—A popular term used to describe the state of today's youth that have lost their enthusiasm towards life due to excessive work and life stress.)
zhuiyuejie_first_16_4: (Symptoms include avoiding social engagements, reluctance to work, insomnia, and signs of depression.)
zhuiyuejie_first_16_5: (Further analysis reveals an 87% correlation between the syndrome's traits and the emotional state of "Xiaosheng," inferred from the wish made at the time.)
zhuiyuejie_first_16_6: A few colleagues from other departments even used it as an excuse to ask for leave yesterday. They wrote, "The world is such a wonderful place, filled with different kinds of sadness to experience each day."
zhuiyuejie_first_16_7: Eh...Lucky bastards. Taking time off whenever they want. And look at us, sweating bullets over research with no results in sight. How are we supposed to sleep?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_8: Is that the latest thing? You know I don't usually visit those forums, but this term... Maybe it's because everyone's feeling the pressure lately.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_11: Relax, take some time off. You can leave the rest of your work to me. Don't let it get into your head. Smile, and everything will be A-okay.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_12: Hmph, you sure are optimistic at a time like this.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_13: Anyway, I really need to pass out for a while. She's all yours.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_14: With heavy steps, the researcher heads back inside the Academy.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_15: Um. Hello... Were you listening to our conversation the whole time? Anything I can help you with?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_16: There's something we'd like to ask.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_17: Wait a second. It's you, isn't it...? The one who sucked in a Tacet Discord with your bare hands... {PlayerName}?!
zhuiyuejie_first_16_19: I didn't expect to meet you at a place like this... Are you here for something? Is it about the monsters? Or maybe Ech... No, never mind...
zhuiyuejie_first_16_20: Do you know anyone going by "Xiaosheng"?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_21: ..."Xiaosheng"? A pretty average name, if you ask me. But I've never heard of anyone with that name at the Academy. Can you... provide any extra information?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_22: Uh, maybe I can help you find him.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_23: Searching "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" and "Xiaosheng" as keywords. There are 417 relevant results found.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_24: Search results consist of forum posts made under the username "Xiaosheng." Example result: "Another crappy day today..."
zhuiyuejie_first_16_25: Wait a minute, analyzing someone's online behavior without their consent is a violation of robotics protocols!
zhuiyuejie_first_16_26: Searching protocol... Confirmed. Violation of protocol detected... Xiangli, I'm sorry. Initiating self-destruct sequence...
zhuiyuejie_first_16_27: Now's not the time for jokes, Xiang-LEE.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_29: Xiang-LEE does that sometimes. I hope you don't mind.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_30: Sorry, Xiang-LEE was just trying to lighten up the mood...
zhuiyuejie_first_16_31: Hahaha. Its creator gave it some good features. It's fine. But do you mind me asking... why are you looking for Xiaosheng in the first place?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_32: This question involves the individual's privacy. We are unable to disclose any details to those not directly involved.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_33: I understand... Speaking of which, this robot looks rather familiar. Could it be from the Moontree Lodge by any chance?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_34: How did you figure that out?
zhuiyuejie_first_16_36: I see... I heard that making wishes at the Moontree Lodge tends to come true. I was thinking of trying it out myself at some point.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_38: Hmm... it's almost time to set up the centrifuge. I need to make my way back and check on the samples.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_39: You notice Shifan appear a bit flustered for a moment, but he quickly returns to his easygoing and friendly demeanor, politely bidding you farewell.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_40: No information was obtained regarding Xiaosheng's identity. Acquired new keyword.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_42: Yes, we can always check the forums for any updates later.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_43: Now then, let's try our luck somewhere else.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_9: Well, it's obvious just by looking at the two of you. That robot you have there is from the Moontree Lodge, right? I may not look the part, but I am an actual researcher.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_10: My name is Jiuli. Xiaosheng's my friend, and I know who he really is.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_11: And as a matter of fact... you've already met him.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_15: Precisely. So you already guessed it.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_16: He probably realized who you were as well. Explains why he made up an excuse and left in a hurry. Hmm... still running away from his problems, by the looks of it.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_17: He seemed different from the Xiaosheng in the wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_18: I was just as surprised as you were when I first found out that "Xiaosheng" was actually Shifan. The two of us grew up together, went to school together, and entered the Academy together.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_19: He's always been the center of attention, easygoing, always fitting in effortlessly...
zhuiyuejie_first_19_20: But at some point in time, he started writing these negative posts on the forums. It didn't take me long to figure out "Xiaosheng" was him. I know his writing style too well.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_21: Every time I asked him, he'd always wriggle his way out of it. And... he started distancing himself from me and even transferred himself to another project team.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_22: Jiuli pulls out his Terminal and shows you a picture of him and Shifan. You notice his hand trembling slightly.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_24: Oh, that's from an accident during an experiment involving Echoes a while back. It wasn't too bad, but it did leave a few symptoms. I haven't been able to operate any precision instruments since then.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_25: At first, I thought that maybe Shifan started distancing himself from me because I couldn't continue to work on his project anymore. But deep down I knew he was not that kind of person.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_27: I want to know what kind of wish he made... And if possible, I want to help make it come true. I want to know what happened to him.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_28: The integrity of Jiuli's information is estimated to be at around 99%. In order to fulfill the wish, providing relevant information is recommended.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_30: You tell Jiuli the whole story and the contents of Xiaosheng's wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_31: So that's how it is... Is he blaming himself for my injury? But that's not true, I've never felt that way!
zhuiyuejie_first_19_32: He wrote that wish, but he's still the man he was before. He still smiles and comforts others, and helps people whenever they're in a difficult spot...
zhuiyuejie_first_19_33: Which makes me feel even more worried for him.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_34: We want to understand his true wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_35: We want to respond to his wish.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_36: Thank you for telling me all this. I'm afraid Shifan and I aren't on talking terms at the moment... But maybe he'll listen to you, {PlayerName}.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_37: He's been fascinated by Echoes ever since he was a child. Echo-related research was all he'd been working on before he left our project.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_38: He loves Echoes so much, and now he's given up on it completely...
zhuiyuejie_first_19_39: I think this might be a good place to start to have him open up to you...
zhuiyuejie_first_19_42: Please, if you find out what his wish is, be sure to let me know.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_1: Hi there {PlayerName}, how are things on your end?
zhuiyuejie_first_20_3: ...Fantastic. It appears everything has been going smoothly.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_4: Long story short, I've managed to decipher the code from earlier.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_5: It's Echoes. The code mentions three Echo sample datasets Shifan once needed for his research.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_6: According to the Academy's archives, his research partner, Jiuli, had an accident while searching for these Echoes. Shifan shut down the project shortly after.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_7: I hope this data can be of help to you. Once I've wrapped up here at the Academy, I'll meet you as soon as I can.
zhuiyuejie_first_20_8: Well then... It's time to look for some Echoes.

Heihaian_main_1_3_8_39: So, they're the agents Niya was waiting for...
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_41: Astral Modulator, the Rover {Male=himself;Female=herself}. We have awaited this reunion for a long time.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_42: Is this your doing with the Bloom Bearers?
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_43: Remember your past, the past you turned your back on… The past as one of the Black Shores...
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_44: And respond... respond to the promises you made, to the future we're bound to share.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_45: Salvation... is forging a world where saving is no longer needed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_28: A monitoring register. We, Black Shores members, place these around the world to keep an eye on the Sentinels. If anything happens to them, we'll know immediately.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_29: Looks like it was also used to record abnormal frequencies in the Port City of Guixu…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_35: But why was I teleported here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_36: Maybe the Tethys System has a soft spot for you? But without more details, I can't say for sure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_37: Since your arrival, has anything unusual caught your eye?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_38: You tell Aalto about the person you met on the beach…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_39: A person in light blue… Could it be the Shorekeeper?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_41: Yes, the elusive guardian of the Black Shores, who is said to be always watching our true leader, shielding us from danger. It seems you've had quite the encounter.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_42: In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores. Fantastical or not, that's all we've got to go on.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_43: There must be a reason she went to such lengths for you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_44: Given that we've already lost enough of our own to it, we need more Bloom Bearers to handle this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_45: Seems like the Tethys malfunction is getting worse.

Flow_313700000_5: Sanhua looks at you, surprised. It was a bit cold when you approached her, but your warmth quickly dispels it.
Flow_313700000_6: She nods gratefully, believing you made the right choice.
Flow_313700000_7: Amidst the silence, there is only a puppet before you, creaking and moving its head.
Flow_313700000_8: When you look for the source of the string above the puppet, you see a masked woman with red hair, caught in an invisible "web."
Flow_313700000_9: As the last mask is removed, she looks at you blankly.
Flow_313700000_11: She stops moving but appears to nod, as if to say thank you.
Flow_313700000_13: A Blake Bloom falls into your hand, but you only find a handful of mist when you try to grasp it.
Flow_313700000_14: Accidents happen in investigations. Thank you for dealing with the Exiles...
Flow_313700000_15: He looks at you surprisedly and starts to laugh out loud.
Flow_313700000_16: Haha, interesting. So you think this is a deal? All right, I take it. What do you want me to look into?
Flow_313700000_19: The TDs disappeared, though I still wonder why they showed up in the observation camp... Thanks for your help.
Flow_313700000_20: The girl nods at you, then squats down to examine something you cannot see.
Flow_313700000_21: ...Great. The data always carries more weight when it's gained with firsthand fieldwork or research.
Flow_313700000_22: When getting up, you notice something on the research log she holds:  the "name" column is filled with various names.
Flow_313700000_23: She nods as usual, but you notice something on the research log she holds: the "name" column is filled with various words.
Flow_313700000_24: You recall seeing these names in the Academy's database. They were researchers who died during the Remnant Studies expedition on the ice field.
Flow_313700000_25: A sudden floral scent pulls you into Verina's dream. You realize the scent might be the key to entering her dream.
Flow_313700000_26: One candle, two candles... Right, that's seven. Daddy, mommy, and Star, let's blow the candles together and wish me a happy birthday!
Flow_313700000_27: Surprised, Verina comes close to you and exclaims that this is life's miracle.
Flow_313700000_28: Is this... my birthday gift? Then I don't have to eat up the whole cake alone.
Flow_313700000_29: She blows out the candles, cuts the cake into neat slices, and presents them to the dolls around her. Looking at the cake, you join her in silently wishing...
Flow_313700000_31: The girl no longer looks fragile like when she was trapped. She puts away the tempting jade, splits her Loong Whiskers Crisp in half, and offers you a piece.
Flow_313700000_32: You should leave here. You don't smell like "them." Take this as a token of my gratitude, and I wish you a safe journey.
Flow_313700000_33: You clumsily piece together the two halves of the Loong Whiskers Crisp. She is amused.
Flow_313700000_35: But the girl stays at the place. She seems to be searching for something, but you can't sense her purpose.
Flow_313700000_36: What is Danjin searching for in her dream?
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_8: Comm's dead? Don't worry. It happens a lot around here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_9: The Black Shores sits atop a massive Tacetite, wreaking havoc on standard communications.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_11: Once we reach the Greenhouse, you can patch them in near our beacon.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_12: Only our beacons can cut through the Tacetite's interference.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_38: Yes, we received word from Jinzhou's City Hall about their actions. We also alerted them to the Tethys System's likely warning of a potential Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_40: The data you brought back has been uploaded to the system, but as you know, Tethys has been unstable.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_41: It could have been much worse if they hadn't risked their lives to transmit the coordinates back to Niya. And thank you for risking your life to retrieve the data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_35: Easy there. Let's get back to business.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_36: The recent quake's stirred up Tacetite's interference. How's your underground connection holding?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_37: Rock solid. As long as Tethys is up, we're wired tight.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_38: That's comforting. Hey {PlayerName}, you can give the abnormal frequency to KU-Money. They'll handle the upload.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_39: You hand over the card Youhu gave you to the peculiar robot.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_40: This a new rookie? You've got skills if you snagged that abnormal frequency from Port City of Guixu. Better not underestimate you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_45: How's the upload? Already sent the data back to Tethys?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_48: Since you're linked to the Tethys' data bank, can you check if there's a Bloom Bearer named Hoda registered?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_49: She seems to be able to control gravity.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_50: She referred to herself as a "we."
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_51: A Bloom Bearer whose Forte is controlling gravity… I've checked all records of both Resonators and Bloom Bearers, but I didn't find anyone matching your description.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_55: KU-Money is right. Just in case, the Tethys System is very likely to send out a warning to Jinzhou about an imminent Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_58: KU-Money takes out a large sum of money…
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_60: Each Black Shores member is allocated a specific fund, and this is yours. Find me when you burn through it all.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_61: That's not fair. You've never given me that much before!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_62: I deducted the money you lost to me in games. It was all you had left!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_63: Oh, by the way! Are you heading to the Greenhouse?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_64: If a Bloom Bearer dies outside the Black Shores, we bring their body back and keep Monica in the loop.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_65: As for the Tethys System, imagine it as a supercomputer. The Black Shores relies on its calculations to observe, forewarn, and solve anything Lament-related.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_66: What's going on, Aalto? I never see you this serious.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_67: The Tethys System has been shaky lately. You've noticed, right.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_68: What's worse, along with the data, we received some terrible news. The Bloom Bearers we sent to the Port City of Guixu… We lost them all.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_71: She might have something to do with the deaths of our people.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_72: Oh, we need to send out a warning as usual. There's still a lot to do...
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_3: Hey, you scared us to death!!!
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_4: Sorry, the Tacetite's interference was too strong.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_5: I'm in the Black Shores now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_6: Glad to know you're all right.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_10: Yeah! Just so you know, we got the Black Shores' warning, so we cranked up the defenses in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_11: As for the Bloom Bearers who have passed, we'll bring their bodies back to the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_12: I know the Black Shores hold many answers for you—your memories, your past…
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_13: Though the road ahead is uncertain, I hope you find the truth you seek.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_14: And please remember, you never have to bear the weight alone... I... We are here with you. Always.
Heihaian_main_1_3_171_15: The Midnight Rangers are preparing to secure the Port City of Guixu, and…
Heihaian_main_1_3_172_2: Can robots grow a desire for money, too?
Heihaian_main_1_3_172_6: You ever play those RPGs? Each character's got a backstory, right? Well, these robots are no different.
Heihaian_main_1_3_172_7: The Tethys System gives them all their own personalities. Take KU-Money, for instance. Tethys programmed it to be a crafty dealmaker.
Heihaian_main_1_3_172_8: Who knows, maybe one day you'll come across a robot you really click with.
Heihaian_main_1_3_172_9: Once you're ready, we'll head over to the Greenhouse and meet Monica.
LevelPlay_134000034_ChildQuestTip_134_6: Talk to the Tethys Terminal KU-Key and gain clearance once more
LevelPlay_134000034_ChildQuestTip_134_9: Talk to the Tethys Terminal KU-Key and gain clearance once more
Character_chun_1_7: Watching them grow, waiting for them to bloom—you know, waiting makes the fruits so much sweeter.
Character_chun_1_8: Of course, I have my own special seed.
Character_chun_1_9: Every day, I'm consumed by the urge to see it thrive, trembling with excitement for its bloom, the soft touch of petals unfolding in my palm... This feeling… I can't wait to make it mine!
Character_chun_1_10: Hehe, it's the best thing ever to watch and protect it as its breeder.
Character_chun_1_11: Just a little fun of mine. Well, how's it going, {PlayerName}? Enjoying your time here?
Character_chun_1_12: I heard you got the Shorekeeper and all of us out of a huge mess, huh?
Character_chun_1_15: If I remember correctly, you weren't here back then...
Character_chun_1_16: Hehe, I expected as much. You've shown great potential since you arrived in Jinzhou.
Character_chun_1_17: Well... I'm a Bloom Bearer, and a Bloom Bearer knows what they want to know.
Character_chun_1_18: Aww, you're a sharp one. Yes, I had something else going on, couldn't say hi to you first. What a pity.
Character_chun_1_19: Didn't know the Shorekeeper would entrust a newcomer with such important tasks... She trusts you. A lot.
Character_chun_1_21: Hey, {PlayerName}. It's Beatrice. Remember me from the Error Cell?
Character_chun_1_22: I hate to ask, but could you come back to the Error Cell?
Character_chun_1_24: We've run into some trouble, and honestly, you're the only one the Shorekeeper trusts to handle it.
Character_chun_1_26: Thanks a lot! And don't worry, there'll be a reward for you.
Character_chun_1_27: Duty calls. I have to go.
Character_chun_1_29: If only you could be mine… I'd root you in my garden, where only I could savor your sweet, robust vitality… Hehe, just kidding. Hope you don't mind.

Heihaian_main_1_3_21_2: Grow and bloom, my sweet little flowers…
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_3: Ahh! Don't sneak up on me like that!
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_5: Of course! As a capable Gardener, I always give ultimate care to all these flowers.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_6: Planting, watering, pruning, airing, and giving them sunshine!
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_7: Oh, hold on! Please plant a flower.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_10: In the Black Shores, each member plants a flower here. Most choose flower seeds from their hometown.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_14: Hmm... Aalto didn't plant a flower but a tree. A money tree, I remember…
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_15: I forget, but Encore didn't bring a seed from her hometown.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_16: Camellya? She planted so many! Countless. She created an entire garden of flowers…
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_17: So, what kind of flower seed would you like to plant from your hometown?
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_18: My hometown? I don't remember where I'm from.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_19: Um… So you're a wandering traveler, right? Then a Blake Bloom would probably suit you well.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_23: Of course! Even if you don't remember your hometown, the Black Shores can be your new home. The Blake Blooms we give each member symbolize that!
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_26: Yeah, you could say that… Um?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_27: Wait! KU-Water, are you feeling that? You... you're getting the same feeling, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_28: Hmm, yeah… You look familiar, but I can't remember where we met...
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_30: But the Tethys System reacted to your face...
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_33: Strange. I found a record of you in the system, but it suddenly disappeared...
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_34: What happened? Why did Tethys suddenly tell us to leave... Alright, let's go, KU-Water. KU-Money is waiting for us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_36: Under the instruction of the Tethys System, the two robots leave.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_38: Upstairs! See that piano? That's the Modulation Device.
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_39: It seems like the Tethys System is hiding something from you…
Heihaian_main_1_3_21_40: However, KU-Water and KU-Plant have already departed. Your best course of action now is to inspect the Modulation Device.
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_18: Just like this, expressing what's on your mind through music…
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_19: It's something even you can do. You'll give it a try, won't you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_20: Ugh, what? It's just been the two of us here this whole time!
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_19: But more importantly, she died in the Lament that destroyed the Port City of Guixu a few hundred years ago.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_20: In short, she couldn't be alive.
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_22: My mentor… the one I follow…
Heihaian_main_1_3_27_23: Please… I beg you to end this Möbius loop, this endless cycle...
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_30: This place, built by your hands, holds all its resources at your disposal.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_38: Most have never seen you, and that is all by your design.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_42: You tell the Shorekeeper what happened in the Port City of Guixu.

Heihaian_main_1_3_34_10: The Tethys System transforms data into stars, observing the entire Solaris, and discarded data are cast into the Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_11: Seeing a sky like this down here is a real surprise.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_12: This place holds records of every Lament across Solaris—those that have passed, those happening now, and those yet to come.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_13: Here, a planet's Lament transforms into stars that fill the sky.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_15: Does that name have something to do with this place?
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_16: Astral Modulator, Guide of Civilizations, Mastermind of the Black Shores…
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_17: Before you severed ties with your past, it was indeed one of your names.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_21: I would call you by your true name, {PlayerName}.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_23: The abnormal frequency you encountered in the Port City of Guixu is part of it—or rather, it is the Necrostar itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_24: Go ahead. I am always with you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_34_25: I have always addressed you as such. In the past and present, through countless years.

Heihaian_main_1_3_38_23: Your effort won't be wasted. We will restore everything to normal and ensure everyone's safety.
Heihaian_main_1_3_38_25: I admit... I am surprised to see the Shorekeeper here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_21: But... I'm currently unable to fully comprehend this feeling.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_22: Does the Necrostar have any connection to the Port City of Guixu?
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_24: This Necrostar is the black hole that destroyed the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_25: Is the Black Shores experimenting on the Lament?
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_26: Yes. You've questioned this approach before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_31: That's why I aim to change it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_32: But this time, I will bring everything to a proper end.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_37: I don't see any reason not to.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_40: It's clear that the Agent's condition is terminal.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_41: But still, I lied to him...
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_42: I'd do the same if I were you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_45: When the Lament struck the city, many were unable to escape and were drawn into the black hole.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_46: The data you brought back is directly related to that event.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_48: Did I do the same thing 20 years ago?
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_50: Let's talk again once we're done with all this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_51: There are many things I need to understand.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_52: Of course... We have plenty of time for it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_40_53: Long enough to talk about the past, the present, and the future.
Heihaian_main_1_3_43_4: Use the portals to reach the platform.
Character_chun_1_25: I'll explain everything when you get here.
Character_chun_13_1: Pathetic! Get out of my way, you weaklings!
Character_chun_14_1: Hehe, finally, something that gets my blood pumping.
Character_chun_15_2: Good, good. Please me! Delight me! Entertain me!
Character_chun_15_3: Oh yes, that's what I want! Keep struggling! MORE!
Character_chun_16_2: The way you fought really makes my heart race… Such power, such vitality…
Character_chun_16_3: Ugh, I wish I were the one dancing this deadly, bloody, beautiful waltz with you…
Character_chun_16_5: Hehe, I know. I was just overwhelmed with joy… Cough! Ugh…
Character_chun_16_6: You're on the edge of Overclocking. And you were in a medical pod before... Does this happen often?
Character_chun_16_7: Yeah. Oh, are you worried about me?
Character_chun_16_9: …I'm just worried that you might endanger the Black Shores.
Character_chun_23_1: {PlayerName}, I'm sorry. That matrix is more cunning than we anticipated… My mistake.
Character_chun_23_3: Do you know where she is?
Character_chun_23_4: Camellya is still inside that Stellar Matrix.
Character_chun_23_5: She was trapped inside and started to sink deeper—that's why you couldn't go any further.
Character_chun_23_6: Besides, Camellya has found the matrix core. Without her, it might have escaped again.
Character_chun_23_7: Now, we'll create a symmetrical Stellar Matrix, and that will allow you to reach the previously inaccessible areas.
Character_chun_23_9: There will be various simulated areas. To reach the destination, you need to <color=Highlight>find and jump to the correct timeline junctures</color>.
Character_chun_23_10: Due to a mutated Stellar Matrix, you may not reach the destination in one go.
Character_chun_25_6: Target is in the room ahead. Your need to calm her down and transfer her back to the medical pod.
Character_chun_25_7: "Lady Flora" is dangerous—her mind and language skills are impaired, making her prone to reckless behavior. She is a threat to the Black Shores' internal facilities.
Character_chun_25_8: As for the other residents of Petalfall Village, we have confirmed that they have all perished.
Character_chun_25_9: We couldn't save them in time. The situation worsened too quickly after we received the unusual signal until you arrived.
Character_chun_25_12: (The previous recording mentioned <color=Highlight>a few survivors from the Tacet Discord Outbreak, but in this Petalfall Village, everyone perished except for Camellya.</color>)
Character_chun_25_13: (The situation here seems to differ from my timeline.)
Character_chun_25_14: When did I bring Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?
Character_chun_25_17: Please calm her down as soon as possible. Prolonged Overclocking will put greater strain on her body.
Character_chun_25_18: KU-Riri turns and looks at the door a short distance away.
Character_chun_29_1: Camellya disappeared… So, does that gate lead to a new juncture?
Character_chun_29_2: Lady Flora once Overclocked so much that her mind was heavily damaged, and her language abilities degenerated… Then, the Camellya I know…
Character_chun_30_1: I'm... back on the surface of the Black Shores island?
Character_chun_32_1: These Tacet Discords… The Stellar Matrix must've noticed us. It's trying to hold me back.
Character_chun_32_2: Camellya is trapped deep inside... She must be in danger now. I need to find the correct juncture fast.
Heihaian_main_1_3_51_40: Things could've been a lot worse without your help.

Heihaian_main_1_3_3_37: That's the worst-case scenario. If we contain the frequency as the Tethys System advises, nothing bad will happen.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_39: As an Outrider, it's my duty to safeguard the peace.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_40: Guess I'll take charge. No surprise there.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_41: You're right. We can't just sit this out.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3_42: Thank you! It's reassuring to have a Midnight Ranger with us. I'll send you the coordinates of the abnormal frequency.
Side_YCJZ_7_1: Dang it. What are these rocks made of? They're impossible to get through!
Side_YCJZ_7_3: Best you save your energy while you can. You're not getting anywhere unless you've got some explosives.
Side_YCJZ_8_1: Hehe. Oh, I know it's a tough. Why else would the boss give me this job?
Side_YCJZ_8_2: As long as we can dig this place up, get to what's underneath... Hehe. Just imagine the raise we'll get...
Side_YCJZ_8_3: Come on! Just a bit further!

Quest_142000006_QuestDesc_142_1: An old captain named Davide is preparing for the last voyage of his life. But this time, his sights are set on something above the seas...
Moonfiesta_FailDialog1: There remain many problems worthy of our consideration...
Moonfiesta_FailDialog2: An error...? Let's tweak the method and go again, shall we?
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog3: Good luck, says the token! Luck is on our side.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog4: Hah hah, we will be getting what we want.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog4: We see accidents like this in our Liondance shows from time to time. It's normal, don't lose heart.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog5: It's about giving back when you can. I believe I've done my best to assist those in need.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog6: Ta da! It's my spark magic!
Moonfiesta_FailDialog6: Sob sob... I don't like bad endings. The Wooly Warrior mustn't be defeated!
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog7: Wishes symbolize hope, something I hold dear.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog7: You can't win them all. We learned something, didn't we? We'll get it next time.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog8: Why so surprised? This is a basic skill ever undercover agent possesses. Shh... confidentiality is key.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog8: Hmm, bad timing. Let's wait for a better one.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog9: Start steady, end strong. Was my last move a stroke of genius or what?
Moonfiesta_FailDialog9: Maybe we missed something in our planning... Hm. Let's find a way to solve it.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog10: Did, did I contribute to this...? Phew, great.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog10: I-I messed up. I p-p-promise I'll working hard t-to improve...
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog11: Whenever we fulfill a wish, I feel it in the Streams. It feels... warm.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog11: Haste makes waste... We need to understand these wishes better.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog12: Woah! Best condition ever. The festival has been fire so far!
Moonfiesta_FailDialog12: No... This is way worse than I expected. Hm... Gotta cheer up.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog13: It's okay. Relax. We'll make it next time.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog2: Want to join me in turning "possibility" into "reality"?
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog3: This falls out of the Bagua's scope...
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog4: Things always work out in the end. See? An opportunity.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog5: Twists... Hm, I've gotten used to them.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog6: Heh, I know! This is what they call a "turning point” in a story.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog7: Opportunities come and go. Stay focused.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog8: Looks like we've stumbled onto a fresh lead.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog9: Plans change. We need to find a way to turn it to our advantage.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog10: Wasn't daydreaming... O-okay, maybe a little. I just saw something weird. D-do I have to say?
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog11: The wind heard you loud and clear. Whatever happens next, I'm glad for this moment.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog12: Hey hey. A challenge to the unknown!
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog13: Is this... the Wishing Tree's response to us?
Moonfiesta_NewPartner2: The hero of Moontree Lodge... Let's keep that between us.
Moonfiesta_NewPartner3: Goodwill first, right? That's why I'm here.
Moonfiesta_NewPartner4: The Liondance Troupe wishes you a happy Festival. Got the blessings?
Moonfiesta_NewPartner5: Thanks for inviting me. But I suppose this can count as being on the job too, hm?
Moonfiesta_NewPartner6: Encore writing the story? Baa... Even the Woolies want in!
Moonfiesta_NewPartner7: Big events like this worry me. Have to stay sharp! If you run into any trouble, turn to me or another Ranger.
Moonfiesta_NewPartner8: Blending in and soaking up the excitement while keeping an eye out? This suits me just fine.
Moonfiesta_NewPartner9: I like to help. Mind if I tag along?
Moonfiesta_NewPartner10: Should I join you...? Oh don't worry... I-I'll be brave.
Moonfiesta_NewPartner11: Need help? The wind's will tell us... Listen, the wishes are talking!
Moonfiesta_NewPartner12: Chixia, Ally of Justice, reporting for wishes!
Moonfiesta_NewPartner13: We meet again. Shh, keep it quiet. I want to be part of the crowd today.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat2: Ever wonder why the Wishing Tree always delivers? Stick around, you'll figure it out.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta2: Let's go, we have wishes yet unanswered.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel2: Let's go for a walk. Maybe we'll stumble upon a solution to our problems.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat3: Feeling stressed? Try this... Feel better? Clear mind, clear heart. That's my trick.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift3: I can't accept a gift without doing something to earn it... How about this, I'll do a Bagua reading for you!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta3: Give me your hand. Let's try this palmistry method from the books — first the shape, then the Bagua...
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel3: Sunrise on Mt. Pingting slows everything down. Everything down there suddenly becomes... so quiet.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat4: I plan to take on an even taller Plum Blossom Pole this year. Think you'll come cheer for me?
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift4: What a curious object! Is it for me? Oh, hehe, thank you!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta4: It's okay, falling is all part of practice. Let me give it a few more tries again to the beat.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel4: What's a better time to relax than the festival? I know the best place fto sunbathe, wanna join me?
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat5: The chill's fading... No, not your imagination. Even the weather's deciding to behave for this moment.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift5: No need for fancy wrapping. I can appreciate the sentiment without all of that.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta5: Do you enjoy the Plumpcake's new flavor?
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel5: This moment of peace. If only I could hold on to this forever...
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat6: Are we setting off? Encore's ready for the adventure!
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift6: Oh, is this what the grown-ups call a festival gift? I love it!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta6: Colors, shapes... There are endless possibilities for fireworks!
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel6: Off to the secret haven. Promise you won't tell anyone!
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat7: The border's not as busy as Taoyuan Vale, but we share the same hopes. Let's ask the moon to hear them.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift7: Were you worried I wouldn't like this? Silly... I love it. Thank you.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta7: Have to be prepared just in case.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel7: Should we go on another walk? The more patrols the better!
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat8: Puppets play many roles, just like their masters. So then, think what you see reveals something real about me?
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift8: Looks like you've mastered the art of surprises. Is this your big reveal?
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta8: Hearing voices? Ah, you mean this puppet. Quite a magical craft, isn't it?
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel8: I'm feeling sleepy... While I nap, you make sure I sleep soundly, okay?
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat9: Let's not bother with other matters. A Weiqi game with you right here right now is time well spent.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift9: You're full of surprises. Guess I owe you one!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta9: Why don't you play guide this time? What's the plan?
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel9: If you're cold, come closer. My flames should warm you up.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat10: What do I want to draw? I... can't quite put into words. Why don't you see my art later at the Fair!
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift10: I haven't received a gift for a long time. I... I will cherish it!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta10: Brush, canvas, ink... All set! But why is everything blurry? Oops, forgot my glasses!
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel10: No. I don't want to paint it down right away. Just want to enjoy this moment.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat11: Your journey ahead might take you far away, but this city and everyone here will always welcome you back. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival, Rover!
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift11: I'm touched. It's not about the cost, it's the thought that counts. I felt it when I opened it.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta11: We got some time left. Don't rush, let's tick the boxes off the list one by one.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel11: Close your eyes and feel the streams. Hmm... I hear your heart racing.
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat12: Great, teaming up again! This campaign will be our best one yet!
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift12: Whoa, is this for me? Who knew the day could get even better!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta12: Challenge accepted! No holding back. Allow me to test its difficulty!
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel12: I'm always in a great mood after good food! Want another bowl? What about you, Abby?
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat13: My wish? Maybe you've already granted it without realizing.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift13: How thoughtful... I'll treasure it, along with tonight's moonlight.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta13: Let me add some strokes to this scene of Taoyuan Vale.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel13: Walking through the city, seeing life flourish, my wishes feel like they're really taking shape.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro3: Reading fortunes... Heh, let me check my master's notes first.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro4: Lions dance under the moonlight. Let the Troupe be part of the festivities!
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro5: Festival's here, hoping everyone enjoys this year's treats.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro6: Wait for me, Woolies. Those aren't toys!
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro8: Puppet show? Zapstring's not made for this. Need some other puppets.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro9: Surprises coming from the unknown... Hm, interesting.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro10: New scenes to paint—the lanterns, fireworks... everything.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro11: Riddles may be plain, but they carry our feelings to the future, like the wind.
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro12: I want to break my personal best in "Moon Shooter" this time!
Moonfiesta_ShopIntro13: Loong's dances ward off misfortune. May Jinzhou remain in peace.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild3: "Great Fortune Upon Us." That's the divination stall's blessing to the moon for our fair preparations. This is an auspicious moment!
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild4: Liondances ward off evil and bring blessings. May they endure.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild5: Care for a taste of a past Moon-Chasing Festival? Taste this from Yumyum Haven.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild6: Wow, fireworks! Encore loves things that can light up the sky!
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild7: Smart move, adding boat races to the festival.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild8: Don't come close. Zapstring is onstage now... The show is about to start.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild9: Guaranteed prizes? There's a limit to what I can offer. Just relax and spin the wheel to see if it's your lucky day.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild10: Did everyone see what I saw?
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild11: Up for a challenge? Riddle answers hide festival traditions and meanings.
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild12: All set! How about a friendly sparring match now?
Moonfiesta_ShopBuild13: Let it chase the moon and our wishes. Who is "it"? You'll know at the Fair...
Moonfiesta_GroupFight1: Some risks still need to be addressed.
Moonfiesta_GroupFight2: Our efforts are showing. Keep it up!
Moonfiesta_GroupFight3: This peaceful holiday atmosphere is a result of everyone's efforts.
Moonfiesta_GroupMeal1: The recipe doesn't seem right. Maybe try something else.
Moonfiesta_GroupMeal2: We're getting closer to the perfect taste.
Moonfiesta_GroupMeal3: The air is filled with the savory scents of festive flavors.
Moonfiesta_GroupRelax1: It's okay. These things normally start out slow...
Moonfiesta_GroupRelax2: We need a way to attract more attention!
Moonfiesta_GroupRelax3: They seem to enjoy it. I should make the Moonlit Fair even more memorable for everyone.
Moonfiesta_GroupOutside1: Plan in advance for a smooth field operation.
Moonfiesta_GroupOutside3: Everyone feels the Moonlit Fair's spirit now.
Moonfiesta_GroupVisit1: We have to work harder to impress the new visitors.
Moonfiesta_GroupVisit3: It seems the Festival has been a hit with the out-of-towners.
Moonfiesta_EvaluateUnchange: No matter the result, every bit of our effort contributes to a perfect Moonlit Fair.
Character_chun_20_1: A part of a broken stone, hidden under the dense veins, faintly reveals itself, bearing some chiseled marks.
Character_chun_20_3: Veins are everywhere. Overly dense. The plants here are abnormal.
Character_chun_21_1: Many years have passed, and here I am again...
Character_chun_21_2: But I'm not gonna stay at the Black Shores and live off old memories.
Character_chun_21_3: Ugh! My body's giving out... Hah... Need a place to rest soon.
Character_chun_22_2: Since she mentioned "sealed her memories" and "returned", this must be the cave from twenty years ago.
Character_chun_22_3: Did Camellya seal her memories because of my choice?
Character_chun_22_6: Something's not right. I'll get you out of the Stellar Matrix first!
Character_chun_22_7: The surroundings turn dark, and you feel yourself being lifted out of the Stellar Matrix. You open your eyes, and find yourself back to the Black Shores.
Character_chun_35_1: Hmph, this little troublemaker is clever, having set all these traps.
Character_chun_35_2: But now its core is cornered here, it can't run any further. I can handle it easily when I find it.
Character_chun_36_2: Guess I'd better not use my Forte, or I'd be at a disadvantage when {PlayerName} catches up later.
Character_chun_37_2: If this is indeed the final moments before you sealed your memories, let me find out the reasons.
Character_chun_37_3: Let me see why you made that choice.
Character_chun_38_1: After all these years, {Male=he;Female=she} still made that choice…
Character_chun_38_2: I never asked {Male=him;Female=her} much about the Black Shores or {Male=his;Female=her} past.
Character_chun_39_1: Haha, for the Black Shores, a better future must mean saving Solaris.
Character_chun_39_2: I don't care about that at all.
Character_chun_39_3: Why? Why do I have to lose my only beloved playmate, my most cherished opponent!
Character_chun_39_4: Here at the Black Shores, {Male=he;Female=she}'s the most trapped one... by far.
Character_chun_39_5: Ugh, is this an illusion from the past? Looks like I used to be quite… sentimental.
Character_chun_39_6: Though I had this guess while in the previous junctures—{PlayerName} was indeed the former Black Shores leader.
Character_chun_40_1: My Rabelle Index has worsened. The doctors and the Shorekeeper said I need a rest.
Character_chun_40_2: ...Hmph. They mean well, but… I know myself better.
Character_chun_41_1: But now, thinking about the past will only make my Overclocking worse.
Character_chun_41_2: {PlayerName} is gone. I can choose to wait, but will {Male=he;Female=she} really return?
Character_chun_42_1: What happened? My chest feels so tight, and I feel… a little unwell?
Character_chun_43_1: Even with treatment, I'll barely be able to maintain my current state.
Character_chun_43_2: But constant Overclocking and forced corrections will ruin me in the end.

Heihaian_main_1_3_1401_1: The island is quiet and serene.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1401_2: It appears these islands have deliberately formed a circle, leaving a void in the center.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_13: So, this is related to that abnormal frequency…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_15: That theory doesn't hold water. Not only are traitors incredibly rare in our history, they are all documented.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_16: And there's no record of her in the system. Was she trying to mislead us?
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_19: Well, looks like she's made herself at home in Tethys.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_20: I'll check with KU-Money to assess the current situation underground. We need to do everything in our power to protect Tethys from any harm.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_21: {PlayerName}, could you please accompany Aalto to the Greenhouse? We need you to find the KU-Water robots.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_22: Also, ensure the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse remains secure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_28: …I'm sorry. You were meant to have a pleasant time here…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_29: When the dust clears, I'd like to formally welcome you to join us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_43: She told me I was once part of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_44: Hmm, that's strange, because we just added you to the recruitment list recently.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_45: She's quite the mystery... Monica, can you try to gather more info about this Hoda for us?
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_46: Of course. If it concerns the security of the Black Shores, it's my job.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_47: If this... "person" was truly residing in that abnormal frequency, "she" could be responsible for those deaths.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_49: If she was residing in that abnormal frequency…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_50: —Damn it, we've been tricked. We just fed it back into Tethys!
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_52: Did we just upload it to…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_22_22: The piano seems to respond to your touch.
Heihaian_main_1_3_29_2: She even showed up in person. That means…
Heihaian_main_1_3_29_4: I haven't seen the Shorekeeper in all my time in the Black Shores. I've only heard the stories about her.
Heihaian_main_1_3_29_5: If the Shorekeeper is revealing herself to you, it can only mean one thing. I think you know what I mean.
Heihaian_main_1_3_29_6: The gateway to the underground has been opened. I'm sure the answers lie ahead.
Heihaian_main_1_3_29_7: Go ahead. Leave the rest to us, buddy.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3001_1: The new Final Fancy Defense comes out tomorrow.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3001_2: Ugh, still have to wait a week to get my shell credits…
Heihaian_main_1_3_3002_2: Oh, sweetheart, it's just ten minutes away. It won't be long.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3002_3: Grandpa and Grandma are making your favorite dishes.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3003_1: They're too short-sighted to spare a glance at the stars above.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3003_3: Those who don't revere the stars will eventually fade into history.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3004_1: Oh my… Where's my pocket watch?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3004_2: …Oh, I sent it for repairs yesterday.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3004_3: How come I forgot something from just yesterday?
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_2: I need to learn more about this thing. My master and I guessed it's from the Black Shores, and now it looks like we were right!
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_4: The abnormal frequency definitely links to the deaths of those Bloom Bearers.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_5: Now it's hiding in this object, but I can still feel its strong attachment to the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_6: Solving this issue is beyond our capabilities. Besides, they also mentioned Rover and the fall of the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_7: We should meet with that Bloom Bearer first and explain the situation. This is best left to the experts.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_8: You're right. We need to keep her informed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_9: Let's go, {PlayerName}. I've a bad feeling about this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_10: I sense there's more to this than meets the eye…
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_11: Port City of Guixu must hold secrets waiting to be discovered.
zhuiyuejie_second_60_1: When I'm older, I'll be the best scientist ever! I'll help people and everyone will love me! I'll lead the way in making lots of cool discoveries!
zhuiyuejie_second_60_2: Pascar... You've been here with us all along...
zhuiyuejie_second_60_3: Wow, so that's the real story... We've helped make four wishes come true now!
zhuiyuejie_second_60_5: Five? But we only have four wish tags here.
zhuiyuejie_second_60_6: That must be the exit. Let's get out of here first, Yao.
zhuiyuejie_second_60_7: Hey! What did you mean? Tell me, tell meeee!
