Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_5: It appears the Necrostar has been successfully contained underground.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_6: And... the gate is now sealed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_12: Indeed. With my abilities, you don't need to worry about this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_13: Though I am but a projection, I've been by your side all along.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3702_1: We can wipe out all the corrupted data just like we did before!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3702_2: Use the portals to connect the device and the core, then we'll be in the clear!
Heihaian_main_1_3_43_5: According to pre-Lament laws of physics, gravity warps the fabric of space and time.
Heihaian_main_1_3_43_6: The voices I hear... They're coming from people in another dimension.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_1: Wait! Zhezhi, don't tell me you plan on finishing all that by yourself?
Event_THCQDYBF_1_3: But there are so many requests... Darling, I can't let you do all of this alone.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_4: Dianxiao, it's okay. I'll finish them on time.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_5: I never doubted that. I know you just pulled all-nighters for another project. It's only been a couple days, you need rest...
Event_THCQDYBF_1_6: And if you take this job, you'll have to travel around for inspiration… It's not going to be light work.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_7: Are you sure you'll be alright?
Event_THCQDYBF_1_8: Y-yes. Please let me take this job…
Event_THCQDYBF_1_9: I... I'll start working right now. Thank you, Dianxiao.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_12: Oh, hello, {PlayerName}. Are you here to buy a fan?
Event_THCQDYBF_1_13: I saw Zhezhi leaving in a rush…
Event_THCQDYBF_1_15: Well, here's the thing. I set up a fan-drawing stall at the Moonlit Fair and was planning to ask a few of my artist friends to draw some fans.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_16: But none of our other artists had open slots... I didn't know what to do. Then Zhezhi stepped up to take on all the commissions herself.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_17: So many requests to work on…
Event_THCQDYBF_1_18: That sounds like a lot of work.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_19: Zhezhi never misses deadlines, but I don't want her to overwork herself.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_20: Anything I can help you with?
Event_THCQDYBF_1_21: You're gonna help us? Really? Let me think…
Event_THCQDYBF_1_22: How about taking photos of the landscapes she chose? That way, she can just use those photos as references.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_23: She can stay home and focus on her art instead of traveling. It'll save her time and energy!
Event_THCQDYBF_1_24: Can you help us with that? I'll pay you, of course!
Event_THCQDYBF_1_26: Great! Thank you so much! Zhezhi should be painting peach trees on a slope near Taoyuan Vale right now, so I think you can skip that place.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_27: Now... We still need pics of the waterfall at Bell-Borne Ravine and the Jinzhou city.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_28: When you're finished, please bring them back to me and I'll pass them on to Zhezhi.
Event_THCQDYBF_1_31: That's a relief. Thank you, Zhezhi will be so happy to have those photos!
Event_THCQDYBF_10_1: I wish you fame that shakes the ground!
Event_THCQDYBF_10_3: Oh, that's a sweet one! Lingyang, you're truly a master of lucky greeting couplets!
Event_THCQDYBF_10_4: What are you guys talking about?
Event_THCQDYBF_10_5: Hi, {PlayerName}! We're coming up with some lucky greetings.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_6: It's the Moon-Chasing Festival, so we're coming up with some new lucky greetings for the festivity. You know, two heads are better than one.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_7: Yeah, I heard those researchers call it brain… brain…?
Event_THCQDYBF_10_11: Yeah! Wanna join us? It can be really fun! Gets your creative juices flowing!
Event_THCQDYBF_10_13: Alright then, Mingzhui, can you be the judge?
Event_THCQDYBF_10_15: One person starts the couplet, then the other completes. After that, we switch roles.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_16: I'll be the judge of your creations.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_18: Oh, I almost forgot the most important rule.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_19: You don't have to rhyme or follow strict rules. Just make sure they'll make the receivers happy.
Event_THCQDYBF_10_21: Exactly! Now let's find a stage for your duel.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_1: Alright, I'll start with an easy one. Listen up, {PlayerName}!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_2: I wish you great fortune and success!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_7: It doesn't seem to rhyme with Lingyang's line...
Event_THCQDYBF_11_8: It's no big deal! After all, happiness is what matters the most!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_9: Well, since Lingyang is okay with it…
Event_THCQDYBF_11_10: Now, it's your turn to start, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_13: I'd say the rhymes are great, and the content is amazing, too.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_14: Let's save this couplet for students preparing for exams. They'll be glad to hear it.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_16: Oh yeah, how about this one!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_17: May your business grow and soar!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_20: I'd prefer a better expression than "more and more."
Event_THCQDYBF_11_21: Hey, don't be so picky! It makes perfect sense!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_24: I bet shop owners and businessmen will be happy to hear it!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_25: Looks like {PlayerName} has the upper hand. Now, you go first, Lingyang.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_27: May the fierce lion chase evil away!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_28: May peace and light forever stay!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_29: Wishing you joy and peace everyday!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_30: Impressive! My master said there's a trick to everything. Once you find it, things get done better.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_31: I say you've mastered the trick of giving lucky greetings!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_33: Put yourself in their shoes and think what they crave.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_34: Then whip up some rhymes—it'll hit the mark!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_35: I see, that's the magic of "empathy."
Event_THCQDYBF_11_36: The best greetings are the ones we all want to receive. They're what truly connect us.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_37: So, do you want those lucky greetings too...
Event_THCQDYBF_11_39: Well… maybe, but it's okay if I don't get any!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_40: After all, seeing everyone happy because of my lucky greetings makes me happy too!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_41: It means my efforts are being appreciated, right?
Event_THCQDYBF_11_42: Perhaps I can come up with one for you?
Event_THCQDYBF_11_43: Wait a minute, you want to do it for me? That's fantastic!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_45: Aww, that's so sweet… Wait, wasn't that what I came up with before?!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_48: Haha, it really is a good one.
Event_THCQDYBF_11_49: Thank you so much, {PlayerName}! I'm really, really happy to hear that!
Event_THCQDYBF_11_50: In return, I wish that all things go your way, and your dreams come true every day!
Event_THCQDYBF_12_1: {PlayerName}... What do you need from me?
Event_THCQDYBF_12_3: I have a favor to ask.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_4: I see. So the puppet show performer couldn't make it to the Moonlit Fair, and now you need me to save the show.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_5: Sure, I don't have much on my plate right now, so I can fill in for a few days—If you can afford my fees, that is.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_6: And if we want to perform at the Moonlit Fair, we'll need some puppets that match the vibe.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_8: A fox chasing after a rabbit?
Event_THCQDYBF_12_9: Rover and the Threnodian, recreating the legendary battle?
Event_THCQDYBF_12_10: Like that traditional fairy tale? Good idea. Cute animal puppets should be popular with the kids.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_11: Like those Hero Plays? That could work. The battle between good and evil might be a big hit…
Event_THCQDYBF_12_12: Starting from scratch is probably too late. Fortunately, I know a place that sells ready-made puppets.
Event_THCQDYBF_12_14: Yes. In Jinzhou, you can buy ANYTHING with the right connections...
Event_THCQDYBF_12_15: Is it a black market or something?
Event_THCQDYBF_12_17: Just kidding. Come, let's get going.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_1: Welcome to the Pioneer Association Store! Hey there, {PlayerName} and Ms. Yinlin! What can get for you today?
Event_THCQDYBF_13_3: Absolutely! We just received a fresh batch of new arrivals.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_5: Our Pioneer Association has highly skilled puppet makers who trust us to sell their creations.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_6: But not many customers come to us looking to buy their own puppets, so we only display them when requested.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_7: But thankfully, there's still interest from collectors and professionals like Ms. Yinlin here who purchase these puppets.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_9: I'll go check our stock real quick. One moment please, I'll be right back…
Event_THCQDYBF_13_10: In no time, Ganxue locates the puppets Yinlin needs and brings them to you.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_11: Thanks a bunch! Hope to see you both again soon!
Event_THCQDYBF_13_12: Done! Let's go back to Taoyuan Vale.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_13: Hold on. I think I just saw someone I know.
Event_THCQDYBF_13_15: Interesting… He shouldn't be here. Let's follow him and see what he's up to, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_15_1: The person you're after... Is he an Exile?
Event_THCQDYBF_15_2: Exactly. Exiles aren't allowed in Jinzhou. To sneak in, he disguised himself and didn't wear the Exiles' uniform.
Event_THCQDYBF_15_3: His name is Lei. He used to involve in petty crimes and just got out of prison a few days ago.
Event_THCQDYBF_15_4: Used to be my informant before I became an undercover agent myself, but he fled at a critical moment.
Event_THCQDYBF_15_5: Something feels off about him being here... It seems he's talking to someone. Let's find out what he's up to.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_1: Big Lei, are you saying… You got a new hustle for us?
Event_THCQDYBF_16_2: Hell yeah. You know who I used to , right? The Savage Beasts. Lots of cash for you.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_3: Sweet! I'm listening. Money's been shit lately.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_4: You know the Moonlit Fair? Lots of snobs, easy cash for the taking.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_5: Just got outta the slammer, remember that big boss I was talkin' about? He's got the connections, loyalty, and street smarts.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_6: Stick with him, we'll clean up at the Moonlit Fair. Soon we'll be swimming in cash!
Event_THCQDYBF_16_8: What, so you can ditch me for him?
Event_THCQDYBF_16_9: No joke! I'm a loyal guy. Just curious, that's all.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_10: Then come with me and see for yourself. And keep your mouth shut! This deal's ours alone.
Event_THCQDYBF_16_11: Big boss wants us there, 2-4 AM, east side of Taoyuan Vale. Don't mess it up! Get ready!
Event_THCQDYBF_16_12: Got it! You can count on me!
Event_THCQDYBF_17_1: Looks like they're planning something. {PlayerName}, what do you think we should do?
Event_THCQDYBF_17_4: You're the expert. I'll follow your lead.
Event_THCQDYBF_17_5: I agree. Lei mentioned a 'Big Boss'. That man must be the mastermind behind their scheme.
Event_THCQDYBF_17_6: Lei isn't the true culprit. The so-called Big Boss must the mastermind behind their scheme.
Event_THCQDYBF_17_7: We should track down that Big Boss. He must be the mastermind behind their scheme.
Event_THCQDYBF_17_8: We know when and where they're meeting. Maybe we can pay them a surprise visit... What do you say?
Event_THCQDYBF_17_10: Hold on. We don't want to tip off our target. Let's scope it out first, just the two of us.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_1: Big Lei, when is he gonna showing up?
Event_THCQDYBF_18_2: Just wait! Big shots always show up late!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_3: Oh, he's here! Straighten up and say hello!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_4: A familiar figure emerges from behind the tree and approaches Lei. It's someone you know all too well.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_8: Uncle Li…? Stay put. Let's listen in first.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_9: Sorry I kept you waiting, Lei.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_10: Ha, no way. We just got here. Hurry up, greet our boss, Uncle Li!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_12: Hehe, youth. If I were a few decades younger, I wouldn't have needed to bother you lot.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_13: No problem, boss. We're just hustling for cash!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_14: Well, I'm not in this for the money… anyway, you wouldn't believe me if I told you. Where's my stuff, Lei?
Event_THCQDYBF_18_15: Over there in the box. I once ran with the Savage Beasts for a spell, so I know a thing or two... But feel free to take a look yourself, if you want.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_16: Yeah. Given how important this is, I'd better—
Event_THCQDYBF_18_17: Uncle Li is about to speak when the roars of Tacet Discords interrupt him.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_18: That sound... Damn, it's a Spearback! Must've smelled our goods!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_19: M-mr. Li, since you're the boss, you need to protect us, right…?
Event_THCQDYBF_18_20: If I could be twenty years younger, I wouldn't break a sweat dealing with it! But now… Cough cough!
Event_THCQDYBF_18_21: They're being attacked by Tacet Discords.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_22: Interesting… From what I know, Uncle Li isn't a bad person. If he was actually hiding his true nature this whole time, I have to give him some credit for fooling me.
Event_THCQDYBF_18_23: Let's take care of the monsters first. Then we can have a proper chat with him.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_1: {PlayerName}, and… Yinlin? What brings you here?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_2: Thank you, thank you for saving our lives... Wait, you are...
Event_THCQDYBF_19_3: Keep an eye on them, {PlayerName}. I'll go see what they have here… Might be dangerous substance.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_7: ...Just some meat, fresh and nice. No hidden compartments, and it's not poisoned.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_8: Alright, tell me your story. What are you doing here?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_9: I'll spill everything! It was all Uncle Li's idea!
Event_THCQDYBF_19_10: Hold on, {PlayerName}… Is buying meat illegal now?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_12: Yeah, I've been working on a new dish—Special Jinzhou Skewers. I'm trying to sell it at the Moonlit Fair, but the taste wasn't quite right.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_13: So, I thought about using top-quality meat and grilling it over charcoal for that perfect flavor.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_14: But what does it have to do with the Exiles?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_15: What? Exiles? I left that life behind when I got out of jail.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_16: Uncle Li knows life ain't easy for a man with a past like mine. Used to run with the Savage Beasts, know how to hunt, so he hired me and my crew to fetch meat for him.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_17: Then why are you dressed up like this?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_18: What do you mean by "we'll clean up at the Moonlit Fair"?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_19: Why are you meeting up here at midnight in a remote place?
Event_THCQDYBF_19_21: We were goin' huntin'. Can't wear clothes that tear easy, right? These are better for the job.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_22: Well, because the Moonlit Fair's got easy targets everywhere... I mean, rich folks. Mr. Li's skewers are gonna sell like crazy! And he gives us a generous cut!
Event_THCQDYBF_19_23: Since I have a stall to attend to, I have to wait till the wee hours when all the customers are gone to get my supplies. Besides, look at them? They won't be allowed into the venue dressed like that.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_24: I see… There are no holes in your answers. Thank you for cooperating with the investigation. I apologize for the confusion.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_25: Uh, no need to apologize to us, ma'am. I know what's up now. Gotta work on my language, drop those old habits.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_26: I totally thought we were gonna break some laws too... No wonder they'd grow suspicious...
Event_THCQDYBF_19_27: Good to know you're doing legit work.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_29: I will. Jail taught me, gotta make honest cash to stay outta trouble and find some damn peace in my life.
Event_THCQDYBF_19_30: Uncle Li, heading back to the stall already? Let us handle the boxes. We'll get 'em close to the venue, but the rest...
Event_THCQDYBF_19_32: Oh, great! Thank you, all of you!
Event_THCQDYBF_2_1: "The waterfall near Bell-Borne Ravine"… This should be the place.
Event_THCQDYBF_2_2: I'll find a good spot for my photo.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_1: The puppets are ready. I'm all set for tonight's performance, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_3: Of course. I've been spending most of my time dealing with criminals.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_4: Many of them have lost all scraps of humanity. As long as they're alive, they'll keep doing harm. I've stopped some, but there's always more out there.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_5: Lei used to steal, but he's not a lost cause. He lacks bravery and brags, but he knows there are other ways to survive.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_6: Now he's turned his life around, and as someone who fights crime, it brings me joy to see that change.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_7: This isn't the only reason, right?
Event_THCQDYBF_20_9: You discovered the truth long ago.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_10: Heh… Of course you'd see through my lies, {PlayerName}. Alright, I didn't think this level of performance would fool you either.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_11: But I'm curious. How did you figure it out?
Event_THCQDYBF_20_15: Indeed. Lei was my informant. I had to keep an eye on him to make sure he didn't rat me out.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_16: So, it didn't make sense for me to not know he had gone straight… That was a glaring flaw in my words, yes.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_17: Your theory makes sense—Uncle Li is known for his exquisite taste, and the items he bought just happened to attract attention from greedy Tacet Discords like Spearback.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_18: Plus, Lei's past with the Savage Beasts suggests he has strong hunting skills. It would be easy to put two and two together from here.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_19: Heh, your instinct is sharp indeed. Noticed that since the first time we met.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_20: But that's not the main reason behind my conclusion.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_22: You are a great undercover agent. Very experienced.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_23: …So, you believe I wouldn't mess up such a simple case?
Event_THCQDYBF_20_24: Hehe, I see. So {PlayerName} really does trust me a lot, huh?
Event_THCQDYBF_20_25: I had a lot of fun today.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_27: Same here. I haven't felt this happy in a long time.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_28: I should be the one thanking you, {PlayerName}. I haven't felt this happy in a long time.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_29: You make me feel like I can be myself, no masks or pretending. I can do whatever I want, without any masks. You are... the only one.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_30: "So Yinlin really does trust me a lot, huh?"
Event_THCQDYBF_20_31: Sure I do. But earning my trust is no easy task.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_33: Can you do something for me, {PlayerName}?
Event_THCQDYBF_20_35: Don't worry. I won't ask for anything outrageous. It's simple.
Event_THCQDYBF_20_36: No matter how busy you are, remember to come watch my performance. I'll be waiting until you show up.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_2: Jiyan? Did something happen on the front lines?
Event_THCQDYBF_21_3: Don't worry. I'm not calling you for work this time.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_4: We have contained the hatching Threnodian. Any new threat from the Tacet Discords will likely take time to materialize.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_5: It wouldn't have been possible without you, {PlayerName}. Thank you.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_6: With the Moon-Chasing Festival near and our borders secured, I've granted leave for soldiers who haven't taken any in too long. They deserve time with loved ones.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_7: I will remain on post with the rest to ensure continued safety.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_8: That reminds me... Some of the soldiers on leave have lost their families to Tacet Discords.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_9: I'm not sure how they'll spend this time or if they need help. Maybe I will...
Event_THCQDYBF_21_10: No need. You can count on me.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_11: I'll go check on them for you.
Event_THCQDYBF_21_12: You... *smile* Then I'll gladly accept your help, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_2: Yanwu! Where are the yummies you promised last time?
Event_THCQDYBF_22_5: ...Hahaha, just kidding! I got you some Loong Buns from the Moonlit Fair. Eat them while they're hot, they're the best that way!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_6: Wow! Loong Buns! Thank you, Yanwu!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_7: C-can I go to the Moonlit Fair too...?
Event_THCQDYBF_22_8: Of course! Just let Auntie know and you can go!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_10: Count me in! Come on, Lele! Let's go find Auntie!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_11: The children run off with Loong Buns, playfully chasing each other.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_12: Take it easy, kids! Watch your step!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_14: Oh hey, {PlayerName}! I remember seeing you during the last battle!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_15: What brings you here? Thought you'd be at the Moonlit Fair.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_17: You explain why you're here to Yanwu.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_18: I see. General Jiyan was thoughtful to send you, but there's no need for that. I'm doing great. He worries too much.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_19: I grew up in the orphanage nearby. Autie Director takes care of us like her own. The orphanage is my home now.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_20: I'm not lonely at all. Look, my family's right here.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_22: They're all orphans like me. Whenever I get leave, I stop by to catch up with them and chat with Auntie.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_23: It gives me a sense of purpose, knowing I'm out there on the front lines fighting those monsters to protect them.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_25: Help? Nah, nothing comes to mind. Maybe repainting the orphanage walls...
Event_THCQDYBF_22_26: But nevermind, I can knock that out in an hour, tops!
Event_THCQDYBF_22_27: Thanks for coming over to check on me, {PlayerName}! It means a ton.
Event_THCQDYBF_22_28: Alright, time for me to get cracking. See you around!
Event_THCQDYBF_23_3: ...Hello, {PlayerName}. Are you visiting someone you know?
Event_THCQDYBF_23_4: I am here for something else.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_5: ...No, I don't know any of them.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_6: I see... These graves hold fallen soldiers from before your arrival in Jinzhou. You probably don't know them.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_7: They're all soldiers who gave their lives in battles, protecting Jinzhou.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_8: The name on the grave marker in front of Ke Ni catches your eye—that surname is the same as hers.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_10: It's my brother's grave. He served in the Rearguard. During a transport mission, his team... ran into an ambush.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_11: They fulfilled their duty, forming a human barricade to protect the carts from those monsters.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_12: By the time reinforcements came... it was too late. None of them survived.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_14: Thank you. I'm sure he'd be happy to hear that from Jinzhou's savior.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_15: By the way... What brought you here today?
Event_THCQDYBF_23_16: You explain why you're here to Ke Ni.
Event_THCQDYBF_23_17: Ah, I see. That does sound like something General Jiyan would say. Thanks for offering to help. Hmm, let me think...
Event_THCQDYBF_23_18: If you don't mind, could you fetch some Lemongrass for me? My brother loved its scent, despite not being a fan of flowers.
Event_THCQDYBF_24_1: Thank you... It smells refreshing as always.
Event_THCQDYBF_24_2: It reminds me of when mom was alive... She always used Lemongrass in her fish soup. It wasn't the best, to be honest.
Event_THCQDYBF_24_3: The lemon grass and fish created a weird taste that I couldn't quite put my finger on.
Event_THCQDYBF_24_4: But she insisted it would make us taller. I couldn't handle it, so I'd pour mine into my brother's bowl. Well, he did grow really tall…
Event_THCQDYBF_24_5: I guess he loved Lemongrass because it reminded him of simpler, happier times...
Event_THCQDYBF_24_7: Sorry, {PlayerName}. I got carried away talking about my family... Haha, now I'm starting to miss my mom's fish soup.
Event_THCQDYBF_24_9: Since you brought me so much Lemongrass, I'll make that fish soup during my leave!
Event_THCQDYBF_24_10: It'll probably taste worse since I'm eating alone though. Oh well...
Event_THCQDYBF_25_1: You here for some sight-seeing too, {PlayerName}?
Event_THCQDYBF_25_2: Well, I know you're not. Ain't nobody got as much free time as me during days like this.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_4: Oh, no worries. Just a scratch from a few days back. It's all patched up now.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_5: You don't seem to be enjoying your leave.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_6: The leave... If I was a rookie, I'd be over the moon.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_7: Think about it. Leave's all about food and friends and family reunions for most people, I bet.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_9: You can go do all of that too.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_12: My village got swallowed up by the Waveworn, sunk right into the ground.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_13: Like a stone skippin' on water, a few ripples and poof, gone for good.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_14: Friends, family, everything I ever loved... vanished in a blink.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_15: Had no idea what to do, but I wanted to live.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_20: Haha, you know what that fool... ahem, I mean General Jiyan did? He tried to recruit me! Asked if I wanted to help combat the Tacet Discords. Funny, isn't it?
Event_THCQDYBF_25_21: As if that'll make a difference... Tacet Discords and the Waveworn stuff, those are natural disasters. They just happen. What can I even do about it?
Event_THCQDYBF_25_22: But I said yes anyway. He made it sound real good. Figured dying on the battlefield beats starving in the wild.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_23: Alright, you've heard it all. You should know my answer now.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_24: How do I know what you're gonna ask? Well, Jiyan's been asking us the same darn question every leave!
Event_THCQDYBF_25_25: And my answer stays the same—thanks but no thanks! I'm good being alone. As long as there's still Tacet Discords to fight. Keeps my fists busy.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_27: Sure, now go. Oh, and take this with you.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_28: Jiyan never seems to stop working. He keeps skipping meals once he gets busy.
Event_THCQDYBF_25_29: Me and the boys made this stew with what we've gathered. He can have some.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_1: Tacet Discord remains contained to Norfall Barren. We should consider pushing our outpost positions further north.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_2: Deploy new observation posts on the outskirts. This will give us early warnings and time to ready for future outbreaks.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_4: The messenger salutes and hurries away.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_5: {PlayerName}, what brings you here? Aren't you supposed to be in Taoyuan Vale?
Event_THCQDYBF_26_6: Came back from one of the soldiers you mentioned. Wanted to check on you too.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_7: I see. It's got to be Ningwei and his crew.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_8: I told them to make the most of their leave... But they won't stray far from camp, even after years on the front lines.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_9: Because they already consider it home.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_11: Ah... They must have told you a lot, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_12: They have a gift for you too.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_14: You set the bowl of stew in front of Jiyan.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_15: Ha, knew it. Ningwei made it, right?
Event_THCQDYBF_26_16: He probably mentioned how I recruited him, but I bet he didn't tell you the whole story.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_18: I love stories. Tell me more.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_19: I wasn't the general back then. Just another medic on duty, returning to base after dark.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_20: Made a stew for myself with whatever I had. That's when I saw Ningwei wandering alone in the wilderness.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_21: He lost everything in a Waveworn disaster. He was all alone, didn't know what to do.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_22: I shared my stew and listened as he talked about his struggles. About what happened after his hometown was gone.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_23: His eyes were filled with hopelessness. He wanted to live, but couldn't find a reason to go on.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_24: You already know what happened next. I asked if he'd want to enlist in the army. He said yes.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_25: After that, Ningwei often makes stews to share with me during his leaves. Maybe to repay me for the stew from that night.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_26: ...Nevermind, he's probably just showing off his cooking skills. Mine are lacking, to say the least.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_29: Nice story. Your stew is getting cold, though.
Event_THCQDYBF_26_31: Shall we eat together, {PlayerName}? You must be hungry, having walked all the way here.
Event_THCQDYBF_3_1: From here I can see the entirety of the Jinzhou City.
Event_THCQDYBF_3_2: I should take a photo here.
Event_THCQDYBF_4_2: Hmm... I should leave more space to make the contrast pop. And perhaps I'll do some wet in wet, add a touch of vermilion here, to bring out the peach trees?
Event_THCQDYBF_4_3: No, that might make it too blurry. The customers at the Moonlit Fair prefer more realistic details...
Event_THCQDYBF_4_4: (Zhezhi seems deeply focused. She should have no problem working on the paintings. I'll get going and do Dianxiao's request…)
Event_THCQDYBF_4_5: As you leave, Zhezhi glances back, puzzled.
Event_THCQDYBF_4_6: Uh... Did I just see someone out of the corner of my eye?
Event_THCQDYBF_4_8: Nevermind… I'm probably just seeing things after staying up too late.
Event_THCQDYBF_5_4: Fantastic! Great angles, great details. Yes, they would make excellent reference images.
Event_THCQDYBF_5_5: Thank you so much. I'll pass them on to Zhezhi once she's back!
Event_THCQDYBF_7_2: Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_3: No, I'm here for work today. Madam Jinhsi entrusted me with this letter for you.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_4: As you're involved with the Moonlit Fair, she may have something important to discuss with you.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_5: As you open the letter, you realize it contains no pressing matters. It simply mentions that Sanhua has been shouldering a heavy workload at City Hall.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_6: Jinhsi expresses concern and suggests taking her to the Moonlit Fair for some much-needed relaxation.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_7: Have you finished reading it, {PlayerName}? Do you have any messages you would like me to convey?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_8: (Tell her the content of the letter.)
Event_THCQDYBF_7_9: How about taking a walk with me?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_10: Indeed, I have many affairs to attend to, but I think Madam Magistrate was exaggerating.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_11: "Sanhua has eight hundred matters to handle simultaneously," she wrote… That's impossible. Not even the Academy's computers could do that.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_12: W-why are you making that suggestion all of a sudden?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_13: … I know. Madam Jinhsi must have said something in this letter.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_14: Is there anything you want to do?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_15: I suggest we first patrol the nearby area. The Moonlit Fair has attracted many visitors, and any incursion by Tacet Discords or criminals could have dire consequences.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_16: Or, we could survey the visitors to evaluate their interests, providing reliable data for future events.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_20: Yes, {PlayerName}? Is there something wrong with my plans?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_21: I want to know what YOU want to do.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_23: I apologize. I forgot I'm not in City Hall handling affairs right now.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_24: Something I want to do… Please give me a moment.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_25: I remember you were eyeing the desserts at Yumyum Haven?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_26: Yes, I've never actually seen anyone make that dessert before. It's called... Plumpcake, right?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_27: Similar to Wuthercake but with different fillings and shapes. I bet it has a unique taste.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_28: Would you like some of that?
Event_THCQDYBF_7_29: No, I simply want to learn how to make it, then I can…
Event_THCQDYBF_7_30: Great. Then let's learn how to make Plumpcake!
Event_THCQDYBF_7_31: Sure. I've watched them make it enough to have a general idea of how to do it myself.
Event_THCQDYBF_7_32: Besides, I have some new ideas… Can we go gather the ingredients together?
Event_THCQDYBF_8_1: These are the Twin Lotus Seeds I wanted. I think we have picked enough of them.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_4: My main duty is to protect Madam Jinhsi.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_5: I also assist her with paperwork, meet visitors, and convey her orders to other departments.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_7: Let me think… I sometimes drink flower wine… but not too much, as overdrinking leads to mistakes, which would affect my performance as a guard.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_8: Other times, I listen to the storytellers. I learn about how other people live their lives, how they respond to life's ups and downs, and everything in this world that I cannot witness myself.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_9: In fact, I learned from a story that Twin Lotus Seeds taste better than ordinary ones.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_10: But I don't have much time for that. After all, Madam Jinhsi's safety is always my top priority.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_12: I'm afraid so. Jinzhou is located on the borders, and safety has been a constant concern. But my workload may lessen in a few years.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_13: The Threnodian is no longer a threat, and everything is getting back on track. I am positive life will be tranquil for our people soon.
Event_THCQDYBF_8_14: I'm looking forward to that day.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_1: Welcome, {PlayerName} and Lady Sanhua! What can I get for you?
Event_THCQDYBF_9_2: We want to learn how to make Plumpcake.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_3: Haha, you've come to the right person. Plumpcake is a traditional dessert that's been around for at least a few hundred years.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_4: Not many people can make it nowadays. I bet most of the youngsters have never seen one.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_5: Though it might seem easy, making Plumpcake takes a lot of effort.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_6: Kneading the dough and preparing the fillings are just the beginning—every step has its secrets. It takes at least a year or two of practice to get that perfect crispy texture with a lingering aftertaste.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_8: You know, when I learned how to make it, I spent three whole days just memorizing the recipe!
Event_THCQDYBF_9_9: Anyway, let's give it a try first.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_11: You can count on me. I just observed the baking process a bit more, and I have memorized it all.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_12: Alright, I'll let you use my stove.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_14: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Please peel the lotus seeds for me.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_16: Twin Lotus Seeds, freshly picked. Baking them at high temperatures brings out their fresh fragrance. I'll be using them to enhance the taste.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_17: But these are said to only grow in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire, where many monsters live...
Event_THCQDYBF_9_18: ...On second thought, with {PlayerName} and Lady Sanhua, getting those seeds would be a breeze. Can't wait for your Plumpcake!
Event_THCQDYBF_9_19: Soon, Sanhua effortlessly recreates the Plumpcake with her incredible talents.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_20: Onlookers pause to applaud her mastery in action.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_21: Done. {PlayerName}, please give it a try.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_25: Thank you. I'm glad you like it.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_26: …{PlayerName}, you are not fooling me with your expression and change in frequencies. You find it delightful, don't you?
Event_THCQDYBF_9_27: Sanhua boxes up the fresh Plumpcakes, then hands a box to you.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_30: That is for Madam Jinhsi. Since you enjoyed the Plumpcakes I made... I think she'll like it too.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_31: What about you? You haven't tasted any yet.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_32: Me? I don't need it. Eating cake isn't part of my duty.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_33: But Jinhsi wants you to enjoy the festival.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_34: I see… So that's what Madam Jinhsi really wanted to convey?
Event_THCQDYBF_9_35: ...Don't tell me you're only getting it now...
Event_THCQDYBF_9_36: Life isn't just about work, you know.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_37: As Sanhua gazes at the bustling scene unfolding before her, her mind seems elsewhere, captivated by the brilliance of fireworks and streetlights reflecting in her eyes.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_38: Now I get it. Festivities like this help people let go of the past's sorrows and the future's unknowns…
Event_THCQDYBF_9_39: It's a chance to live in the moment with their loved ones. Finding joy in the little things in life.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_41: She just wanted you to be happy.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_42: Thank you for your company, {PlayerName}. I had a great time today.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_43: What would you like to do next?
Event_THCQDYBF_9_44: I don't have a plan yet. I will probably continue enjoying the Moonlit Fair, just as Madam Jinhsi hoped. Perhaps the tasks on my to-do list aren't as urgent as they seem.
Event_THCQDYBF_9_45: If you need me for anything, you need only call. I'll be by your side right away, {PlayerName}.

Character_Encore_1_2: Yeah, we wanna hear the rest of the story!
Character_Encore_1_3: Oh, settle down you two. The Wooly Warrior will come out once everyone's nicely in their seats.
Character_Encore_1_4: Plus, Encore's still waiting for a friend. Ah, there {Male=he;Female=she} is!
Character_Encore_1_6: Encore finally got to see you again!
Character_Encore_1_7: Encore was wondering if you'd come, and even had Cosmos and Cloudy go scouting for you.
Character_Encore_1_9: Encore wants you to come play with us and listen to our stories!
Character_Encore_1_10: Everyone was so busy the last time Encore's here in Jinzhou, we didn't even get to play together.
Character_Encore_1_11: But Encore won't let that happen again, cuz Encore's here on vacation this time!
Character_Encore_1_12: Didn't know they gave vacations at Black Shores.
Character_Encore_1_13: Vacation? Is your homework done yet?
Character_Encore_1_14: Of course, they do. Everyone at Black Shores is really nice. Even someone as busy as Aalto gets to have them.
Character_Encore_1_15: What? Encore doesn't know anything about any homework.
Character_Encore_1_16: Anyway, since we finally got some free time, I told Aalto I wanted to visit some friends in Jinzhou.
Character_Encore_1_17: But he just lay in his chair, bragged about how he has so much grown-up stuff to worry about and was too busy for playtime.
Character_Encore_1_18: Oh, poor grown-ups, they're always so busy. They don't even have time for stories.
Character_Encore_1_19: Well, too bad for Aalto. All I could do was come here by myself with my stories and Aalto's wallet.
Character_Encore_1_20: Right, let me introduce you to everyone, but I think most of them have heard about you already.
Character_Encore_1_21: Gather round everyone. Encore presents to you {PlayerName}! Savior of Jinzhou. Hero of heroes!
Character_Encore_1_23: I'm not too sure about that last part, Encore.
Character_Encore_1_24: Oh, really?! So you're the big hero Encore was talking about. She said you took out that giant TD like this, this, and that! So cool!
Character_Encore_1_25: Oh, stop trying to hide it already!
Character_Encore_1_26: Yeah! Encore told us how you took out that giant TD like this, this, and that! So cool!
Character_Encore_1_27: Are you here for some stories, big hero?
Character_Encore_1_29: Yup! Encore's stories are really fun, last time we had one about a big bad wolf that can turn itself into mist.
Character_Encore_1_31: Oh, oh. There's this other story about a golden-eyed kitty and its little birdie friend with gray feathers.
Character_Encore_1_33: Uh-huh! There's plenty more of them! This time Encore's got a whole new story to tell!
Character_Encore_1_34: It's about the adventures of the Wooly Warrior. You'll love it.
Character_Encore_1_37: That's right! Adventures are the best!
Character_Encore_1_38: Wait till you hear the actual story. I don't wanna spoil anything just yet!
Character_Encore_1_40: If you enjoy stories, Rover, you might even get to go inside one. Whaddya say, Woolies?
Character_Encore_1_42: (Go inside a story... Is Encore using some kind of metaphor? Doesn't hurt to check it out I guess.)
Character_Encore_1_44: I've got other things to do.
Character_Encore_1_45: Great! Come, Encore's even saved a front-row seat just for you!
Character_Encore_1_46: All right. Settle down everyone. The story's about to start!
Character_Encore_1_47: Well, that's too bad. I guess you have more important things to take care of...
Character_Encore_1_48: But, if you ever wanna hear some stories, come find Encore. Encore's saved a front-row seat just for you!
Character_Encore_14_1: {PlayerName}, welcome back from the Wooly Kingdom!
Character_Encore_14_4: Really? But you have to admit, the part where Wooly Warrior kicked monster butts was suuuper cool, right?
Character_Encore_14_5: Encore really enjoys this story. In it, Wooly Warrior and her companions worked their way out of all kinds of trouble. Just like we did.
Character_Encore_14_6: Mom said that as long as you believe, the stories will give you strength. So whenever I think of them, it makes my heart feel warm.
Character_Encore_14_23: Because Encore loves to play and adventure with you! It's just that everyone was so busy last time...
Character_Encore_14_24: But, this time Encore's here on vacation! Curious about what happens next in the story, Rover?
Character_Encore_14_25: If you are, you should join Encore's adventure team, that way we can go and find out its ending together!
Character_Encore_14_26: Can I be the team captain?
Character_Encore_14_27: Is this turning into a make-believe game...?
Character_Encore_14_28: Umm... Sure, you can be captain and Encore will be the vice-captain!
Character_Encore_14_29: Ohh, it's not make-believe, this is a serious adventure game! I've been playing it ever since I was little, it'll be a blast! This time, you can be the team captain and I can be the vice-captain!
Character_Encore_14_30: Now, for our first team assignment, let's go find out everyone's thoughts on the story!
Character_Encore_14_31: The joys of the story should be shared with everyone. It's not just my story.
Character_Encore_14_32: Once we know what the audience thinks, we'll know how to work on the story going forward!
Character_Encore_14_33: After all, it's the applause that makes for a curtain call!
Character_Encore_14_36: Yuppers! It's where all the Wooly stories begin. Cosmos and Cloudy's home!
Character_Encore_14_37: With their help, Encore can even invite friends for a visit!
Character_Encore_14_38: But not everyone though. The Wooly Kingdom won't welcome anyone who thinks the stories are just made up.
Character_Encore_14_39: You're different. You're one of Encore's best friends and have listened to my stories. So Encore wanted to give you a surprise!
Character_Encore_14_41: The fights were a bit too realistic for me...
Character_Encore_14_42: I know, right? You and I work great as a team!
Character_Encore_14_43: And Encore wants to share this warm feeling with you and make you happy too!
Character_Encore_14_45: Look! That girl by herself over there, Encore wonders what she thinks about the story... Come on. Let's go ask her!
Character_Encore_15_1: Wow... Become a warrior and make dreams come true! You think they'll get all the relics in the end?

Character_Encore_40_6: The flower typically blooms in pairs, representing companionship and support. Perfect for conveying friendship.
Character_Encore_40_8: And these. These are Encore's picks!
Character_Encore_40_9: That's quite the selection, Encore. What do they all represent?
Character_Encore_40_10: Have a look at this one. It's gold and shiny, and it matches the color of your eyes, Rover!
Character_Encore_40_11: Encore picked flowers that resemble everyone. If we put them together, they can represent our whole team.
Character_Encore_40_12: That's pretty special! I'm sure it'll look really nice once they're all together.
Character_Encore_40_13: Uh huh! Oh, one more thing, Verina. Can you leave a spot here on the wreath?
Character_Encore_40_16: We don't know what kind of flower represents Ying's feelings, so we should leave a spot, and let her decide which feeling to put on there.
Character_Encore_40_17: Got it. I'll take it from here.
Character_Encore_40_18: Rover, when the wreath is done, we can go tell Ying the rest of the story.
Character_Encore_41_2: Told ya I won't be late.
Character_Encore_41_4: You're right on time. Encore has just set everything up.
Character_Encore_41_5: Of course not, you're right on time. Encore has just set everything up.
Character_Encore_41_6: See this little stage? Cosmos and Cloudy helped me set it up. Pretty impressive, don'tcha think?
Character_Encore_41_9: Are you getting ready for an audition?
Character_Encore_41_10: Cloudy says, "Right on. That's teamwork for ya!"
Character_Encore_41_11: "Hmph. Give us some extra time, and we can make one bigger than that giant gate of Jinzhou. Baa!" Says Cosmos.
Character_Encore_41_12: Audition? That actually sounds like a good idea. Then you can be part of Encore's cheerleading squad, {PlayerName}!
Character_Encore_41_13: I know this is just a small stage for storytelling. I wanted to try the way Mom used to do it. She and I started the Wooly Warrior story after all.
Character_Encore_41_14: Besides, it'll be more fun this way!
Character_Encore_41_15: Encore wonders if Ying will show up today. We didn't really pinky-promise...
Character_Encore_41_23: All right. Now that Team Wooly's fully assembled, is everyone ready for the story?
Character_Encore_41_25: This is the small stage Encore made for the play, where the warrior's adventure continues.
Character_Encore_41_26: Does anyone remember where we last left off?
Character_Encore_41_27: I know...The Wooly Warrior was trying to find the three relics, but I'm not sure if she will find them or not.
Character_Encore_41_28: That's right. The Wooly Warrior sets out to find the three relics. This time she is not alone. She tries to climb to the top of the highest mountain with her trusty companions.
Character_Encore_41_29: With the mountain being so high up, the waves raging below them, she nearly falls several times, but her friends manage to keep her steady.
Character_Encore_41_30: In the end, she obtains the legendary Sword of Courage.
Character_Encore_41_31: Later, she arrives at a beach, filled with sand as far as the eye can see. She searches and searches, and all she can find are just some tiny shells.
Character_Encore_41_32: But with the help from her friends, the Shield of Faith is uncovered. Only the Wreath remains.
Character_Encore_41_34: Unfortunately, no. After reaching the mythical Sea of Flowers, all the flowers have withered. No matter where she searches, the Wreath of Hope is nowhere to be found.
Character_Encore_41_36: Yet, her companions want to finish this adventure for her.
Character_Encore_41_37: They gather flowers and weave their feelings into the shape of a crown.
Character_Encore_41_38: The pink flowers are meant to make her feel happy, the blue flowers are hopes that she will not be scared of any obstacles...
Character_Encore_41_39: This wreath brings together all the feelings and emotions of the companions during their adventure. Their gift to her.
Character_Encore_41_40: And that... is the moral of the story.
Character_Encore_41_42: Her companions remark so. The wreath isn't fully completed. It's missing a very important flower.
Character_Encore_41_43: Ying, this wreath is missing the flower that represents your feelings and wishes.
Character_Encore_41_45: I know. It's missing an iris. I've always wanted Mom to see a garden full of blooming irises.
Character_Encore_41_46: But those irises have already withered...
Character_Encore_41_47: What if we could find one?
Character_Encore_41_49: What if we can find an iris and the Gateway of Wishes? Will you want to continue on this adventure, Ying?
Character_Encore_41_50: I... Of course! But I thought there was no such thing as the Gateway of Wishes. It only exists in the story...
Character_Encore_41_51: If there isn't one in reality...
Character_Encore_41_52: We can find it in the story.
Character_Encore_41_54: That's right! Because stories aren't just stories. When you believe in them, they'll really exist.
Character_Encore_41_55: Just like how it is now. With everyone's feelings combined into the wreath, it slowly turns into a door. A door that leads to the deepest parts of the Wooly Kingdom.
Character_Encore_41_56: Inside, the irises continue to bloom.
Character_Encore_41_57: So, do you believe in it and choose to continue this adventure?
Character_Encore_49_1: And just like that, the little warrior's wish's come true, putting a perfect ending to this adventure story.
Character_Encore_49_2: The warrior finally gets to meet her mother, telling her all the stories and words she has always wanted to tell.
Character_Encore_49_3: But the warrior's journey won't end here, as the path ahead is a long one.
Character_Encore_49_4: Encore, {PlayerName}. Thank you both so much.
Character_Encore_49_5: I-I finally got to see her, and we talked so much. I told her how much I've missed her, how I found the treasures she left behind, and how I met both of you...
Character_Encore_49_6: I never thought I'd see her again.
Character_Encore_49_7: So, I want you to have this.
Character_Encore_49_9: Yes! I know you still have more adventures ahead, so I'd like this wreath to keep you company.
Character_Encore_49_10: I want to go back and tell my dad this story now, and tell him what my mother said to me. So, this is where we say goodbye.
Character_Encore_49_12: Be sure to share our story with everyone!
Character_Encore_49_14: Time for another feedback session from the audience. What do you think of this story?
Character_Encore_49_15: It's a story with a very happy ending.
Character_Encore_49_16: The fights were still a bit too realistic for me.
Character_Encore_49_18: But the parts where everyone was fighting as a team were super, super cool!
Character_Encore_49_23: It was a really good ending.
Character_Encore_49_24: Yeah, Encore had never thought of such an ending when telling the Wooly Warrior story in the past.
Character_Encore_49_25: I really enjoyed how it ended.
Character_Encore_49_26: The story of the Wooly Warrior's search for the relics is finished, and my vacation is about to end. It's time to head back to Black Shores...
Character_Encore_49_27: That was a really short vacation.
Character_Encore_49_28: Don't forget to finish your homework.
Character_Encore_49_29: Well, we are kinda busy over there most of the year.
Character_Encore_49_30: Oh, enough with the homework already.
Character_Encore_49_31: No biggie. Even though this story is over, Encore will make sure to prepare a new adventure next time we meet!
Character_Encore_49_32: Let's be on the same team together, and you can still be the captain! Wanna do a pinky promise?
Character_Encore_49_35: The Wooly Warrior finally fulfilled her wish, and she got to tell her mother all her stories.
Character_Encore_49_36: About the companions she got to meet.
Character_Encore_49_37: Who she went on adventures with, defeating all kinds of monsters that stood in their way!
Character_Encore_49_38: Their search for the sword and shield as a team, and how they put together the Wreath of Hope.
Character_Encore_49_39: We've been to many places together, but there's so much more to go, and so many adventures and stories to write about.
Character_Encore_49_40: These stories are an extension of life, they are...
Character_Encore_49_42: Yeah. Stories with happy endings! Mom said the same thing.
Character_Encore_49_45: You reach out and lock your pinky with Encore's. Gazing into her eyes, you see the Wooly Warrior's earnest expression as she makes a heartfelt wish.
Character_Encore_49_46: I pinky promise that we'll write as many stories as we can together...
Character_Encore_5_1: All right. Settle down everyone. The story's about to start!
Character_Encore_5_2: Is it about the gray birdie? We didn't get to finish it last time.
Character_Encore_5_3: Nope, today's story will be about the Wooly Warrior and how she makes her wishes come true.
Character_Encore_5_4: The story begins in a land of boundless imagination known as the Wooly Kingdom...
Character_Encore_5_5: Legend says, that deep within the kingdom's castle lies a magical gateway. Whoever passes through it can have any wish come true!
Character_Encore_5_6: To reach this gateway, you must first go over a great many obstacles.
Character_Encore_5_7: Yet, countless adventurers still choose to embark on this journey, for each holds wishes to fulfill.
Character_Encore_5_8: Before setting off on their quests, Fairy Cloudy will ask them:
Character_Encore_5_9: "Should you pass through this mythical gateway, you will be granted endless wealth and honor, along with a treasure trove of unforgettable memories."
Character_Encore_5_10: "Now answer me this... What drives you to venture on this risky journey?"
Character_Encore_5_11: If you'd ask me... I'd choose wealth, that way I can buy all the Star Flakes I can eat!
Character_Encore_5_12: Pfft. I'd definitely choose honor, that way I'll be famous, and everyone would shout my name whenever they see me, wherever!
Character_Encore_5_13: "What about you, brave adventurer? Do you seek riches or fame? Baa."
Character_Encore_5_18: Thus you shall accompany the merchants and travel across the high seas to Rinascita.
Character_Encore_5_19: They say treasures fill its lands, and you'll gain a fortune beyond your wildest dreams!
Character_Encore_5_20: It appears you're already quite renowned! Baa. Just traverse countless lands along the boundless horizon, and all shall know your name!
Character_Encore_5_21: Ooh, so this is the kind of choice a grown-up would make!
Character_Encore_5_22: That's something the Wooly Warrior would say! Maybe the two of you can team up and adventure together!
Character_Encore_5_23: See? Everyone's wishes are different, which also make their journeys unique!
Character_Encore_5_24: And among these people, there's a small adventurer that goes by the name of "Wooly Warrior." When asked about her desires, she replies:
Character_Encore_5_25: "I do not seek wealth or honor. Baa."
Character_Encore_5_26: Fairy Cloudy, greatly puzzled by this reply, goes on to ask:
Character_Encore_5_27: "If you desire neither wealth nor honor, why do you choose to venture to the Gateway of Wishes?"
Character_Encore_5_28: "I have but one wish, to be reunited with my family."
Character_Encore_5_29: Fairy Cloudy nods in approval and offers her guidance to the little warrior.
Character_Encore_5_30: Very well... then believe in my tale, and close your eyes, Little Warrior and her companions.
Character_Encore_5_31: When you open your eyes, a brand-new adventure shall unfold before you.
Character_Encore_5_32: Once we've completed this story together, your wishes will all be granted!
Character_Encore_5_33: So, does the Wooly Warrior's companion accept this invitation?

POI_SWYH_1_1: You've come just at the right time, friend. I just got my hands on an antique.
POI_SWYH_1_2: It seems tied to a legend about Mt. Firmament, but the records have been lost over the years.
POI_SWYH_1_3: Now if you're interested, why don't you take a look at it for me?
POI_SWYH_1_4: Is this... a creation of the Court of Savantae?
POI_SWYH_1_5: Ha, you've got a keen eye! This is indeed a CSC creation. A key specifically, I think. As for what door it opens and how it works, that's beyond my knowledge.
POI_SWYH_1_6: Rover, you are the one who have solved countless puzzles left by the CSC. I wonder how this strikes you.
POI_SWYH_1_7: It looks like two parts that can fit together.
POI_SWYH_1_8: It does, and I've tried doing so, but it made no difference. Nothing special came out of it.
POI_SWYH_1_9: You can still try that yourself, though. Things might turn out differently.
POI_SWYH_1_11: As you fit the two parts together, the assembled antique lets out a "click," and projects a miniature image.
POI_SWYH_1_12: Oh? How fantastic. Looks like it's connected with you.
POI_SWYH_1_13: The projection seems to be a map. It points to... the Tianqu Tree, and has a note beside it, "Woodveil Hall."
POI_SWYH_1_14: Tianqu Tree... That giant, dying wood?
POI_SWYH_1_15: Precisely. I've also heard about this while I was in Hongzhen a few days ago trying to buy some good stuff.
POI_SWYH_1_16: In its prime, Tianqu Tree was luxuriant and worshipped as a protection of Hongzhen.
POI_SWYH_1_17: However, it started withering away in the late episode. The whole of Hongzhen pities.
POI_SWYH_1_18: Maybe Tianqu Tree's fate is sealed... Anyway, this key is yours, my friend.
POI_SWYH_1_21: I am a merchant, that's for sure, but I think I told you this when we first met...
POI_SWYH_1_22: ...I'm not stingy when it comes to money. It's more about serendipity and belief.
POI_SWYH_1_23: This key looked so ordinary in my hands, but now, its connection to you is clearly revealed.
POI_SWYH_1_24: In that case, why should I lock it away in my cabinet and make everything it stands for remain a mystery?
POI_SWYH_1_25: I cannot betray my belief simply out of greed. So take it, friend.
POI_SWYH_1_27: I will bring back the story behind it.
POI_SWYH_1_28: Ha. That sounds proper. Then I'll wait for your story.
POI_SWYH_10_1: Arrived at the target security node. No traces of TD found. Speculation: The node is yet to discover for TDs.
POI_SWYH_10_2: Now, we have to manually close up the energy circuit to power the security node.
POI_SWYH_11_1: Caleb, tell me what Woodveil Hall was built for.
POI_SWYH_11_2: ...Sorry, I can't find the relevant data. Please consult a researcher with a higher access.
POI_SWYH_11_3: Searching for the researcher payroll... Sorry, no valid results found in the database.
POI_SWYH_13_1: Mutiple Tacet Discords detected... On your guard, Rover. They have spotted us.
POI_SWYH_13_2: We must buy the time for the node to reboot, or we are doing this in vain.
POI_SWYH_13_3: Suggestion: Freeze time with the Chronopin to hinder the enemy and help our mission.
POI_SWYH_14_2: We are ahead of schedule. Everything will be fixed soon if we keep the pace.
POI_SWYH_2_1: "Chrono Sign" detected. Confirming identity... Welcome, ████ Civilization ██... Data error found. Searching secondary databases... Hello, Rover.
POI_SWYH_2_2: You... know me? Who are you?
POI_SWYH_2_3: You fit the descriptions in the profile titled "Rover." Minor date discrepancies are ignored.
POI_SWYH_2_4: I am Caleb, a research assistant AI created by the CSC. You now have the supreme authority over Woodveil Hall Laboratory. Best of luck with your research.
POI_SWYH_20_1: Interesting. Security node here is still running... Accessing log.
POI_SWYH_20_2: TDs triggered the security node here. Prepare for combat, Rover.
POI_SWYH_21_2: Backup energy ready. Available for activation.
POI_SWYH_22_1: Great. All nodes are back online.
POI_SWYH_22_2: Planning route... This way, Rover. A shortcut back to the Prototype Chronosorter.
POI_SWYH_25_1: What a fantastic sight, Rover. I'm sure the frequency of this tree was... faint until just now.
POI_SWYH_25_2: Analyzing... It appears the Prototype Chronosorter has positively impacted the local ecology, besides rewinding the time for the equipment in Woodveil Hall.
POI_SWYH_25_3: It wasn't designed for this. It seems more like an accident, caused by unknown factors.
POI_SWYH_25_4: It didn't resurrect the dead or grant immortality to the living, but it did reverse what should be a natural cycle of life.
POI_SWYH_25_5: It's a pity my creators aren't here to witness this.
POI_SWYH_25_6: Did you remember who they were?
POI_SWYH_25_7: Yes, Rover. My memory data has been corrupted over a long course of time. I've even lost their names.
POI_SWYH_25_8: But since you restored Woodveil Hall, the data has... somehow come back to me.
POI_SWYH_25_9: I thank you on behalf of the Research Director Prof. Bram S., Junior Researcher Victor Christopher, and the other thirty-three faculty members.
POI_SWYH_25_10: I thank you for restoring the Lab, despite the failure of their research. You have given me the chance to continue their work and finish what they started.
POI_SWYH_25_11: Whether it takes a century or even a millennium... I will continue this work. It is my mission, and it is Victor's wish.
POI_SWYH_25_14: You tell Caleb the event at Mt. Firmament, and make clear the role Chronosorters played.
POI_SWYH_25_15: So you're saying, the Chronosorters did save Mt. Firmament. Is that true, Rover?
POI_SWYH_25_18: So it all paid off... Please forgive me Rover, what I'm feeling right now is beyond the capacity of my emotional module.
POI_SWYH_25_19: Some of the researchers... grew doubtful of their work, thinking it was mission impossible.
POI_SWYH_25_20: While those who stayed left this world with regret and unfulfilled wishes.
POI_SWYH_25_21: Now it becomes all clear... Their work wasn't in vain. They would feel relieved too, if they were to learn this.
POI_SWYH_25_22: Thank you Rover, for telling me all this.
POI_SWYH_25_24: Maybe... With the supreme authority in hand, you are now in the place to determine my tasks going forward.
POI_SWYH_25_25: Suggestion: You may instruct me to continue the research here. Many mysteries around Mt. Firmament remain unsolved. I'm confident we'll uncover the truth one day.
POI_SWYH_25_26: Go on then, if that is your wish.
POI_SWYH_25_27: You may have your well-deserved rest.
POI_SWYH_25_29: I'd like to observe this tree for a bit longer, Rover. My work began the day it was just a seed.
POI_SWYH_25_30: And now... it has become the shelter of the whole Lab. How time flies...
POI_SWYH_26_1: How was your adventure, friend? I presume you have learned the secret of the key.
POI_SWYH_26_4: Ah, I can tell by your look that you've met something extraordinary.
POI_SWYH_26_6: The story I heard was impressive.
POI_SWYH_26_7: Oh? Then why don't you share it with me, now that neither of us is in a hurry?
POI_SWYH_26_9: An AI left by the CSC? And it's been continuing the research its creator wanted, all these years since they passed away?
POI_SWYH_26_10: This isn't the weirdest story I've ever heard, friend, but it is... intriguing.
POI_SWYH_26_11: Don't overthink. Tragedy or comedy, it's always part of destiny.
POI_SWYH_26_12: Keep this key, friend, as a reminder.
POI_SWYH_26_15: Haha! Just bring me some more good stuff next time!
POI_SWYH_3_1: Apologies, Rover. Maintenance devices are severely damaged here. Deicing the slope is impossible.
POI_SWYH_4_1: Rover, as you might have noticed, some areas in Woodveil Hall are blocked with rocks for security reasons.
POI_SWYH_4_2: You can lift them by freezing the time around them with the Chronopin here.
POI_SWYH_4_3: Access to the Chronopins is granted to your Terminal. Feel free to check the tutorials anytime.
POI_SWYH_5_1: Well done, Rover. You have found the trick to this.
POI_SWYH_5_2: Please proceed carefully through the tunnel below, as I am unable to shut down the light-beam defense system due to a connection failure.
POI_SWYH_6_1: My creator, Victor, was thrilled with these rocks. They seemed to somehow... fulfill some of his childhood dreams.
POI_SWYH_6_3: ...Sorry. I can't retrieve relevant information since my database is down. I'm not sure why I mentioned that name.
POI_SWYH_7_1: Some Tacets Discords have broken into the Woodveil Hall lately, disabling the security nodes around.
POI_SWYH_7_2: Worse still, even the energy core was damaged, and I can't fix it... Luckily, you are here now, Rover.
POI_SWYH_7_3: A Prototype Chronosorter is deployed at the heart of the lab. Once activated, it will restore the entire facility.
POI_SWYH_8_1: This is the Prototype Chronosorter. Despite its designation, it was actually a blueprint, which the CSC kept building upon.
POI_SWYH_8_2: As you can see, it is bonded to the energy core of Woodveil Hall.
POI_SWYH_8_3: The tree roots surrounding the energy core belong to the massive tree above Woodveil Hall. Some of the energy emitted from the core nourishes the tree.
POI_SWYH_8_4: However, the damage caused by the TDs to the energy core has led to excessive energy leakage, which is killing the organism... If this continues, the tree is estimated to perish in 10 days.
POI_SWYH_9_1: As you press the button on the Prototype Chronosorter, nothing happens.
POI_SWYH_9_2: Running system test... Bad news, Rover. The Chronosorter is locked due to potential security risks within the facility.
POI_SWYH_9_3: We must reboot and repair all the security nodes in the facility before the Chronosorter can be activated.
POI_ZLYZ_6_3: Isn't that pole in the mural the <color=Highlight>one we saw</color> outside of the cave? The <color=Highlight>pearl</color> has been sent to the top of it, right?

HelpText_86_Content:
[About]
As the songs echo once more, let those musical scores guide you on a journey to rediscover this world.

[Event Details]
During the event, you can claim daily rewards through the 7-Day Login event, and earn points to unlock special rewards by completing goals set in the Returnee Quests.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_2: Existence precedes essence—how should one comprehend this sentence?
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_5: Excuse me? Could you tell me where I am?
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_6: Ah, my apologies, I was immersed in contemplation and didn't notice you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_7: This is Eidoscope, a garden linked to the Tethys System, where the Shorekeeper resides.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_9: Well, this is her garden. It's only natural for her to be here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_10: Though she often takes the guise of the Sonoro, she has revealed herself recently. It's been some time since I last saw her.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_11: As for this garden, it's where she assists Tethys' computational analysis in observing the stars.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_12: Ahem, that explanation should suffice. Back to the question now...
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_13: Existence... Hmm, is it real? If it is, what about me? Do I truly exist?
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_14: It appears there's little point in continuing the philosophical debate with the robot.
Heihaian_main_1_3_49_15: Perhaps checking on the Shorekeeper is the more pressing matter.
Heihaian_main_1_3_52_1: Digitalized Tacet Discords are gathering here...
Heihaian_main_1_3_52_2: They have their mission to fulfill.

HelpText_87_Content:
[Event Rules]
The Pioneer Association has selected Desorock Highland as the focal region in the most recent edition of "Wutherium Geographic." To that end, the association has organized a special exploration of Desorock Highland.
Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association.

[Quest Reset]
Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00 (UTC-08:00). Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Event_TXCQDEBF_1_1: What's that, Mr. Li? Looks really yummy!
Event_TXCQDEBF_1_2: It's called the Plumpcake. A traditional dessert passed down in Jinzhou for thousands of years. Try it, you'll love it.
Event_TXCQDEBF_1_3: Thousands of years... Then there's gotta be cool stories about it. Right, Mr. Li? Do you know any?
Event_TXCQDEBF_1_4: Hmm... Actually, I do. Let's see...
Event_TXCQDEBF_1_5: This is a story that dates back to the two Sentinels of Huanglong...
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_1: ...Hello, {PlayerName}. Reminds me of my daughter, that little girl... Can't stop talking when it comes to stories and whatnot.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_2: My daughter's gotten herself into fireworks again lately, and she's been bugging me about seeing some.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_3: Luckily for her, her father's quite the handyman. So I went ahead and set up a stall here for the festival.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_4: Must be tough being a father...
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_5: Hehe, tell me about it. But that big smile on her face whenever she sees the fireworks... It really gets me going.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_6: Said she wanted to see the biggest and prettiest fireworks.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_7: And so, I've been trying these few days, but she's not impressed with any of my experiments yet. See the failures behind me?
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_8: I'm sure you can do it!
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_9: Without a doubt. Tell you what... I think I've managed to get my hands on an ancient fireworks formula just recently.
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_10: The ingredients seem kinda sketchy, but as the saying goes, "The weirder it is, the cooler it gets."
Event_TXCQDEBF_2_11: I don't think that's a thing...

Heihaian_main_1_3_54_28: We've also detected the Shorekeeper's presence within these Matrices. She's been recovering the affected frequencies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_54_29: Once it's completed, the data overflow from the Tethys System will cease.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_1: You place the Necrostar on the analyzer...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_3: Would you like to start the remodulation?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_5: Loading backup data from the Necrostar. Simulating the Port City of Guixu...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_6: It's the city destroyed by the Necrostar...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_8: That's the digital entrance of the Matrix! It worked!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_9: So to complete the remodulation, just enter the Matrix and collect Tethys' redirected data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_11: The Tethys System now uses less of my computational power since the Necrostar was controlled.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_12: I can assist you, {PlayerName}. Please, let me come with you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_15: It's fine, I can link with more Sonoro Spheres to stay functional.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_16: My duty must be fulfilled as long as I still physically exist.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5401_17: I'll be fine. From now on, no one will ever be harmed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_29: She's been watching over us all along...
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_30: We'll bring her back, no matter how long it takes.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_31: Ma'am, we've pinpointed the Shorekeeper's location in Tethys!
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_32: And not just her, we've identified the relative positions of everyone captured by the black hole beyond the event horizon!
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_33: To rescue them from the Necrostar, we'll have to redesign it using the principles of the new world.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_35: We must fight against the Tethys System.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_36: But the Tethys System's programming is impeccable, almost otherworldly... Is it really possible to do that?
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_37: Besides, we still need a decoy with the highest-level access to divert its computational power so we can find the Shorekeeper.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_40: We can't be sure if the rescue will suceed, and we can't afford to lose another member!
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_41: And there isn't anyone with higher access than the Shorekeeper.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_2: What? How do you have top security clearance?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_3: The Shorekeeper transfered her access to me in our last moments.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_4: She gave you her access? Are you somebody important that we should know about?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_6: In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores forward.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_9: Our focus now is the Tethys System.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_10: Members of the Black Shores have followed Tethys' calculations and commands.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_11: Even the Shorekeeper herself is used as a pawn.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_12: But humans shouldn't be treated as mere tools. History teaches us this, and we should never forget it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_13: No system is flawless, just as no human is perfect. That's why we have the right to question Tethys' decisions.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_14: In Jinzhou, I learned an old saying: "We can't change the past, but we can shape the future."
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_15: That's what we need to do now—learn from our mistakes and build a better future.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_16: The Black Shores exist for one reason: to protect everyone on this planet, because people are the heart of civilization.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_17: We can fix broken systems, but without people, civilization has no soul.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_18: Sorry to jump in but... I couldn't help overhearing what you've been saying...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_20: Do what you have to do. Leave the ground area to us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_23: I'll bring her back, mark my words!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_25: Attention all units! Readiness Level One enabled. Switch the Tethys System to full recursive search mode. Prepare to open the transmission passage!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5701_26: Rover, we're counting on you to save the Shorekeeper and the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_1: From the distant past to the far future, everything begins and ends here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_2: When you established the Black Shores to unite Solaris, the Tethys System already existed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_3: Later, you discovered it relied on emotions from the Lament to fuel its calculations. Without them, it cannot function.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_4: Using the Lament against itself is like walking on a Möbius loop with no end in sight.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_5: We have tried for millennia to break this cycle without success.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_6: And then... you left the Black Shores to look for other solutions.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_7: But deep down, you already knew the best solution. It was one you couldn't accept.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_8: That solution is me—the tool always meant to become Tethys' core.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_9: If I don't do this, you, as the Modulator of this system, will be chosen as the core. I must fulfill my duty to protect you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_10: But... I want to be by your side, to see the skies you've seen, to tread the paths you've walked. I want to understand... what happiness really means.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_11: When I first discovered these emotions, I didn't know what to do...
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_12: So I lied to you, thinking it was the best choice for both of us...
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_14: Sorry for putting you in harm's way...
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_15: "Salvation is about building a world where people no longer need to be saved."
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_18: This is why we return to this shore.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_20: No one should be treated as a mere tool.
Heihaian_main_1_3_68_23: We're back at the Black Shores now, back to our home.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_5: About that frequency dwelling within you...
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_8: It seems to be "hungering" for something.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_9: Have you ever felt anything unusual?
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_11: Abby's been unusually quiet these days.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_12: My Sonoro can sense even the most minor changes in frequencies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_13: So I can tell that there's something strange about that frequency.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_14: I'll search for more information in the Tethys System and share what I find with you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_15: How is the Tethys System now?
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_16: After being fixed, it's executing the master command given at its creation.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_17: The core computational unit has now been replaced by a special frequency that shares similar properties as the Lament.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_18: But this one is... more harmonious and mild.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_19: What about you? Are you still confined to this place?
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_21: Although I must stay here to watch over the Black Shores, I'm now able to bath in the sunshine and feel the sea breeze with you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_22: This is what freedom feels like.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_24: I know you have your own journey to finish.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_25: You can entrust the Black Shores to me, and I'll carry out my duty as always.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_26: You have the full support of the Black Shores, no matter where you are or how far you go.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_27: And... despite all the many names you bear, I see you for who you truly are.
Heihaian_main_1_3_699_28: Wherever your path leads, I hope to walk it with you.
