(The first half of the note is apparently printed and has been smudged by ink, making it difficult to read.)
■■ Sequence 03-27: Sample capture falls below expectations. On ■■'s suggestion, Team ■ set up animal traps on the south side of the foothills (subsequent unreadable)
Log Sequence 03-28: Third experiment. After ■■■■■■■■ of doubling the Frequency Suppressor dosage, samples dissipated. Team ■ suffered ■■■■■■■ due to failure to conduct risk assessment. ■ decided to reconduct the experiment.
Memo Entry 0x002: Unexpected subject found. This subject appears cautious, lingering near the camp. Presumed to be an Elite Class or above Tacet Discord. Temporary assessment deems this subject not an immediate threat to experiments. ■■ ordered Team ■ to capture this subject for potential use after experiment success (subsequent unreadable). 
Log Sequence 03-29: Unidentified figure spotted near the camp, but fled upon contact with the unexpected subject. Presumed to be a Hongzhen resident. ■■ ordered increased experiment frequency to complete experiments before Hongzhen reacted. 
■■■■■■■: Preliminary success achieved. The technique of ■■■■■■■■ samples can be replicated. ■■ suggested initiating a capture plan for the unexpected subject as soon as possible. Team ■ deemed the risk too high but was overruled. (The remainder of the text is illegible.)
(The last half of the note is hastily written in messy handwriting, making it difficult to read.) 
Capture failed... raged... Elite-Class threat... Abandon camp, relocate to Site 2... RUN... (The final paragraph is completely smudged by ink.)
Side_CFYW_19_2:
Log Sequence 03-43: Arrived at Site 2. Experimentation progress at Site 2 is satisfactory, achieving full proficiency in utilizing the Photonvault.
Comment: The Court of Savantae are a bunch of fools. Such a powerful device should be used as a weapon, not merely as a decoration or toy. To honor their efforts, we must ensure its integration into our plans—a tribute to their legacy.
Log Sequence 03-44: Commanded Team C to transport the Time Stasifier to Site 1 for the capture of the escaped subject.
Comment: Don't mess this up again. 
Log Sequence 03-52: Capture succeeded. Team C will proceed to conduct preliminary work near Xuanji Ridges. Concurrently, Team D is dispatched to Site 1 for reconnaissance and resource retrieval. 
Comment: Ogo from Team D always screws things up. If he messes up again this time, put him in charge of the experiment. Let's make the most use of it. 
Log Sequence 03-53: Communication received from Ogo. Encounter with a Rover at Site 1. No apparent intervention from Hongzhen forces at present.
Side_CFYW_18_2:
I've always known I'm useless… and beyond redemption.  When that monstrosity wreaked havoc in the camp, I was the first to flee. Was I ashamed? No, who wouldn't run if they were in my shoes?
Overseers talk about grand plans all the time, like human evolution and a new era. I guess it works well for other Artificers, because that's what they all chase. But not me. I'm a coward afraid of any sacrifice, much less sacrifice for intangible ideals. But I do agree with one thing they say: the world is doomed, and only the powerful will survive.
I've heard of Exiles vanishing during Tacet Discord onslaughts, like candles in the wind. Survivors speak of the horrors they saw in Tacet Fields. I don't want to be like them. Struggling to live out there like rats, surviving on scraps, fearful of being killed at any moment. 
Luckily, there's good news from the boss. He said the experiment was a success. The experiment was a success. If we can control Tacet Discord, we'll be valued by the Overseers.Maybe even promoted! Maybe... finally some peace and stability.
I want power. I want to be strong. If it's the Tacet Discord's power, I'll take it. If it's an Echo's, I'll take it, no matter what. If getting dirty keeps me alive, I'll do it without hesitation.
I won't be the prey. I won't let this world swallow me whole. I won't.

Heihaian_main_1_3_26_1: The TD Observatory is where we observe Tacet Discords across the world to predict the Lament.
Heihaian_main_1_3_26_2: It handles data collection, storage, and transmission of anything related to these creatures.
Heihaian_main_1_3_26_3: That's why this place is the trickiest… We had a severe leak in data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_26_4: You'd better find the robot first. It's familiar with this place. The observatory keeper should know where to find it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2602_1: Watch out! More Tacet Discords incoming!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2603_1: Thank you. I'm the keeper of the TD Observatory.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2603_2: That was an impressive battle, I've heard about your skills from my colleagues in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2603_4: Yes, but regardless of our origins, we're united by a common ideal here.

Flow_313700000_55: Snow? You watch her turn around, putting her guard up to protect you. This is Sanhua's dream, you realize.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_2: Hi! I'm KU-Key. Tethys sent me to assist you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_3: Welcome to the Haven of Sprouts, where Black Shores members live and rest. The anchor here is our communication hub, linking all beacons worldwide.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_4: Currently, the leaked corrupted data has been spreading.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_5: But time is on our side, and our Agents are on it. Damage control is already underway.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_6: Okay, tell me how I can help.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_7: Right! Since we're connected to the Tethys System, I give you clearance and you collect all that bad stuff up!
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_8: But for it to work, you can't go too far from me. There's a distance limit.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_9: Oh! Almost forgot. Do NOT touch the corrupted data. They still pose a threat.
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_10: I see some nearby. Why don't you start your housekeeping over there?
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_11: I'll follow you. Just aim and BOOM. Easy peasy!
Heihaian_main_1_3_24_12: Ku... Ku... KU-key! Top clearance activated.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2401_1: You're indeed as capable as KU-Money said!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2401_2: But be careful. This corrupted data is dangerous.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2401_3: The authorized keys are one-time use and work within a limited range. They deactivate after use or if you're too far from me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2402_1: There you are! Quick on your feet, huh?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2402_2: How did you get down here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2402_3: Huh? What do you mean? I've been here all along.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2402_4: We've got one more spot left. Time for another Aerial Tactic!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2402_5: Luckily, not all the leaked data is corrupted. Some of it helps us make useful gadgets.

Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_1: The earlier disruptions on the island seem to have settled.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_2: This is the beginning of a new story.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_4: Everything is as it was—even time leaves no traces on the Tacetite.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_5: This world has not yet begun, but we have already seen its end.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_6: They too... will be as fragile and lost as we once were.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_7: But this time, we will show them what we believe in.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_9: An illusion caused by those abnormal frequencies…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_10: But it felt all too real…
Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_12: Ah, Rover. Thanks to you, the abnormal frequency index in the Haven of Sprouts has dropped.

Heihaian_main_1_3_2403_14: It monitors the Etheric Sea across all of Solaris. Since the Tacetite there is more powerful, the interference is stronger, so there's not as much infrastructure there.

Event_THCQDYBF_35_1: I'm sorry. Though I do practice Taoism, geomancy and fortune-telling aren't my strong suit.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_2: Moreover, this matter concerns chance, and you can't force it.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_3: I see. Sigh, then I'll come up with something else.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_4: That might be the best solution.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_6: Oh, hi, {PlayerName}. It's nothing big. Uncle Dong asked me to help him decipher a divination lot, but… I'm not skilled in that art.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_7: It's a long story. Although I know a bit of divination, I'm self-taught. So, I decided to find something to lend some credibility to my efforts.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_9: Yeah. Long ago, a famous diviner visited Jinzhou, rumored to possess the gift of communicating with spirits and predicting destinies. People flocked to him for guidance.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_10: His moon-reading skill was said to be exceptional. Uh, I guess you're not familiar with it, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_11: You half fill a specially crafted porcelain bowl with pure water, recite an incantation, and observe the reflection of the full moon in the water to discern fortune and misfortune. That's the moon-reading divination.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_12: When that diviner performed it, the water would emit a golden glow, adding a touch of mystery to the moon's reflection.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_13: Unfortunately, no one knew where he went. It's said that when he left Jinzhou, he left a letter and a divination lot.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_14: In the letter, he mentioned meeting a mysterious person in Jinzhou. After a deep conversation on divination, he felt his understanding was too shallow and lost interest in reading divination books.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_15: Frustrated, he decided to give up his career, but he couldn't bear to part with the porcelain bowl that had accompanied him for years. So, he hid it somewhere in Jinzhou.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_16: Then, he left a divination lot as a clue, hoping someone would find it one day.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_17: Is that the divination lot you wanted Jianxin to decipher?
Event_THCQDYBF_35_18: That's right. Since the bowl belongs to that famous master, it must be great for divinations. So I want to have it on my stall and enhance my credibility.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_19: Though I haven't heard of this divination master, Uncle Dong does have a point. In this line of work, possessing powerful artifacts does lend credibility to one's abilities.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_20: I bet that master would be happy to see his treasure recognized by people again.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_21: What did the divination lot say?
Event_THCQDYBF_35_22: Oh, haha, I almost forgot our main business. It says, "To seek your true self, observe the lake at a deck. Place your trust in innocent young souls."
Event_THCQDYBF_35_23: This lot doesn't seem related to fortune-telling, so I'm a bit confused. Any thoughts, {PlayerName}?
Event_THCQDYBF_35_25: A deck where people can appreciate the lake… Do we have a place like that in Jinzhou?
Event_THCQDYBF_35_26: I've been to several places that match the description. Found nothing so far. Perhaps the time wasn't right.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_27: Anyway, as long as we have a clue, there's a way to find it! Uncle Dong, we'll help you find that porcelain bowl!
Event_THCQDYBF_35_28: Yeah, you can count on us.
Event_THCQDYBF_35_29: Great! I'll be sure to pay you a hefty sum! Best of luck, Jianxin, {PlayerName}!
Event_THCQDYBF_36_1: "Observe the lake at a deck"… Seems like this is the place the divination lot implies.
Event_THCQDYBF_36_2: And the next line… " The pure heart of a child shouldn't be doubted." We may need to look for children nearby.
Event_THCQDYBF_36_3: You're right. There might be clues around here.
Event_THCQDYBF_37_3: Hi? How can I help you?
Event_THCQDYBF_37_5: Something strange…? I come here a lot, but something strange...
Event_THCQDYBF_37_8: Yeah, that's right! There's a spot around here where cats love to stay.
Event_THCQDYBF_37_9: Often saw them just sitting there, not moving at all. Mom said they're fishing in the lake but...
Event_THCQDYBF_37_17: Haha, of course not. We're here for a long-lost treasure.
Event_THCQDYBF_37_20: But Mommy probably won't let me join you. Never mind, I'll cheer you on from the sidelines!
Event_THCQDYBF_37_21: Thank you, young miss. We'll definitely find the treasure!
Event_THCQDYBF_38_1: Look! I found it! It's a wooden casket. Hmm? What is that smell?
Event_THCQDYBF_38_3: There must be some kind of medicine in here that lasts a long time and attracts cats.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_4: It's interesting, but I just don't get it... Could someone actually predict a kid would solve this puzzle years later?
Event_THCQDYBF_38_5: Maybe he trusted a child's curiosity.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_6: Maybe there indeed was a way.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_7: True. Kids have pure hearts, free from adult worries. They often have a keen eye for details that we miss.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_8: My master was right; divination isn't just about lies and trickery… Sadly, I'm not gifted with the talent to fully master it.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_9: Shall we open this casket? We may find the porcelain bowl inside.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_10: You and Jianxin open the porcelain bowl. However, except for some herbs wrapped in silk pouches, there is only a yellowed piece of paper.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_11: "I seek my true self, but the paths are unclear. Blurring my vision, fueling my fear. I hesitate, I question, and I wander. My cart dust-covered, yet no path feels right, I ponder." Seems quite similar to that divination lot.
Event_THCQDYBF_38_13: I can't seem to figure out what is says. Any idea, {PlayerName}?
Event_THCQDYBF_38_15: Great! Knew I can count on you!
Event_THCQDYBF_39_1: "My cart dust-covered…" Oh, look, there's an old cart. Looks like it hasn't been maintained for years.
Event_THCQDYBF_40_2: Another wooden casket. But it feels way too light... Don't tell me there's another piece of paper inside…
Event_THCQDYBF_40_4: That master really thought he was being funny, I guess.
Event_THCQDYBF_40_5: "Seeking my true self, I travel wide. In the stall where fortunes amass, emptiness resides." This must be the next clue.
Event_THCQDYBF_40_6: "In the stall where fortunes amass…" That probably means the Main Street?
Event_THCQDYBF_40_8: You're getting good at reading divination lots!
Event_THCQDYBF_40_9: Haha, just a guess. We still don't know if I got it right.
Event_THCQDYBF_40_11: Sure! We'll find out soon enough!
Event_THCQDYBF_41_1: There are so many stores on the Main Street… I guess we have to search them one by one.
Event_THCQDYBF_41_2: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall" we can probably cross out large stores from our list.
Event_THCQDYBF_41_3: Good point. We should focus on the small vendor stalls, right?
Event_THCQDYBF_42_1: {PlayerName}, you're right. The clue does point to a vendor stall.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_2: This wooden casket is heavy. I think the porcelain bowl is inside. Shall we open it, {PlayerName}?
Event_THCQDYBF_42_4: The treasure left by that divination master is inside… The thought makes me a bit nervous.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_5: You and Jianxin open the wooden casket. Inside there is an ordinary looking black porcelain bowl.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_6: Is this the treasure we've been searching for? But it looks…
Event_THCQDYBF_42_7: It looks like an ordinary porcelain bowl.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_8: I see. Just as the saying goes, "Great music has the faintest notes; the Great Form is without shape." Maybe the more precious the treasure, the less eye-catching it is.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_9: Perhaps it only shines when used in divination.
Event_THCQDYBF_42_12: Anyway, let's bring it back to Uncle Dong.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_1: Oh, you're back! How's it going? Did you find the bowl?
Event_THCQDYBF_43_3: It doesn't look like a treasure.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_4: Thank you. It's okay. According to the record, we need to fill it with fresh water and recite the moon-reading incantation…
Event_THCQDYBF_43_5: When the moon casts its reflection on the water, you'll witness its magic.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_6: Wow, that sounds amazing! Hurry, let's try it out, Uncle Dong!
Event_THCQDYBF_43_7: Uncle Dong fills the porcelain bowl halfway with water and recites the incantation, but nothing happens.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_11: …Well, I'm certain the bowl you found is the one left by that master of divination.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_12: But now, it seems to be an ordinary bowl used for divination, and that's all.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_14: I'm actually not surprised the bowl didn't work. These kind of stories are usually just hearsay, and it looks like this one is no different.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_15: That master might have been good at divination, but people exaggerated his skills.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_16: I love operas and shows, but come on—heroes performing impossible feats and warriors moving mountains? It's all embellished for entertainment.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_17: So you mean the bowl is useless?
Event_THCQDYBF_43_18: No, far from it! While it may not have "magic," it's still a treasure worth cherishing. Remember, what defines a treasure is not its practicality, young one!
Event_THCQDYBF_43_19: It's the story behind it that matters. A good story. A story rich in twists and turns.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_21: Anyway, thank you, {PlayerName}, Jianxin. Thank you for helping me find this bowl.
Event_THCQDYBF_43_22: With the presence of this porcelain bowl, my reputation as a professional fortune-teller will surely flourish!
Character_Encore_54_1: An airstream. We can use it to fly up!
Character_Encore_54_2: A-Are you sure I can fly?
Character_Encore_54_3: Of course, you can. Nothing's impossible in the Wooly Kingdom.
Character_Encore_55_1: Looks like we've reached the end. That was fun... I have to tell Mom about it once I see her!
Character_Encore_55_2: Okay. Time to find the exit.
Character_Encore_56_1: It's another one of those puzzles... I know, let's look around for clues.
Character_Encore_57_1: Monsters. I'm not scared, I have Mom's sword and shield with me...
Character_Encore_58_1: Wow. You solved it in one go!
Character_Encore_59_1: I should be able to break through this wall. Take a step back.
Character_Encore_60_1: Sounds like an airstream appeared. Let's head back and check it out.
Character_Encore_62_1: The wind is so strong. Is it taking us straight to the Gateway of Wishes?
Character_Encore_63_2: Those markings in the other room must be clues. Shall we go take a look?
Character_Encore_64_1: Hmm... How do we solve this one...?
Character_Encore_66_1: Feeling stuck? Why don't we search around for clues?
Side_ZZDATE_1_90: I didn't get to enjoy it much. I've been swamped with tasks lately, and I had to help Miss Xiao at her fan drawing stall.
Quest_880700003_ChildQuestTip_880_3: Listen to the words of the children
Event_THCQDYBF_28_1: Wow, it looks amazing! Where did you get it?
Event_THCQDYBF_28_2: Yumyum Haven. Uncle Li made it fresh! Madam Magistrate said it's good too!
Event_THCQDYBF_28_3: (Magistrate? Is Jinhsi here, too? I should give Yumyum Haven a visit...)
Event_THCQDYBF_29_2: Dewvetch's nectar is sweet and delicious, truly the highlight of this sweet porridge.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_3: I recall there is a method to enhance the sweetness even more. Something like… soaking it in sugar water first…
Event_THCQDYBF_29_4: Oh? {PlayerName}, what a pleasant surprise. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?
Event_THCQDYBF_29_5: Yeah. Jinhsi, I didn't know you had a sweet tooth.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_6: Hehe, Uncle Li is having people taste-test some pastries. I happened to be passing by and decided to stop in.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_7: Actually, I came to see if I could help with something, but Uncle Li told me that…
Event_THCQDYBF_29_8: My bakery is all set for this Moonlit Fair sales. Everything's been going smoothly.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_9: But I'm not sure if people will dig our new pastries, so I'm having them taste and give feedback.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_14: Alright, thanks for your advice. I'll adjust it based on your suggestions.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_15: This is merely our personal preference. It may be helpful to get others' input as well, Uncle Li.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_16: Haha, don't worry. I take every single customer feedback seriously. That's how I get the inspirations for new flavors.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_17: Here, take these snacks and enjoy them while you explore the fair. It'll be lovely to walk under the moonlight and snack on something delicious, don't you think?
Event_THCQDYBF_29_18: Come grab a bite if you get tired and hungry anytime. You'll enjoy the fair more on a full stomach!
Event_THCQDYBF_29_19: Thank you, Uncle Li. If you need any assistance, please let me know. I'll be sure to help.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_20: Great, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks, Madam Magistrate! Now go and have fun!
Event_THCQDYBF_29_21: {PlayerName}, how has the Moonlit Fair been for you? I just found some time to come over and take a look, and I ran into you right away.
Event_THCQDYBF_29_22: Since it's such a delightful coincidence, how about we take a stroll together from here on?
Event_THCQDYBF_30_1: What else… Lemme think… I can't let the riddle updates fall behind…
Event_THCQDYBF_30_2: Oh, Madam Magistrate! Are you here to solve riddles or perhaps share some new ones?
Event_THCQDYBF_30_3: You came up with the riddles?
Event_THCQDYBF_30_4: Yes. When I was reviewing the stall applications earlier, I noticed a lantern riddles stall. I remembered a couple riddles I had solved before, so I wrote them down.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_5: But I'm not sure if they were selected.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_6: Those riddles you provided are just perfect! They're so simple and clever. I've put them all up.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_7: Unfortunately, no one has solved them to claim the special gift you prepared yet.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_9: A special gift from Jinhsi? I wanna try.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_10: Sure! Now, the first riddle is... Oh, why don't we let Madam Magistrate tell you herself?
Event_THCQDYBF_30_11: Alright. Here's a riddle… "What finds joy in making others smile with glittering lights, even at its own cost?"
Event_THCQDYBF_30_14: Hehe… I knew it would be easy for you to solve. Guess my special gift has finally found its owner.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_15: Jinhsi blinks in astonishment, then quickly breaks into a smile.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_16: Hehe, you always surprise me, but unfortunately, that's not the right answer.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_17: Looks like I can't get your special gift.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_18: If you want it, I can always make another one for you.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_19: There are still plenty other riddles to solve. Those give various gifts too! Give them a try!
Event_THCQDYBF_30_20: {PlayerName}'s going to take home all the rewards at this rate, I'm afraid.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_21: I'm not that good at solving riddles.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_22: Then I have to quit for other people's sake.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_23: You're too modest. Indeed, this event is for everyone. Others deserve a chance to win, too.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_24: Hehe, indeed, this event is for everyone. Others deserve a chance to win, too.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_25: {PlayerName}, how about we check out other stalls?
Event_THCQDYBF_30_26: Mr. Xieyang, excuse us. We'll leave you to your riddle-making. May your creativity flow and your inspiration never end.
Event_THCQDYBF_30_27: Thank you! Happy Moon-Chasing Festival to you both!
Event_THCQDYBF_31_1: Fireworks! Fireworks! Fireworks of all kinds! You can even make your own!
Event_THCQDYBF_31_2: Madam Magistrate, wait up! See any fireworks you like? My treat, take your pick!
Event_THCQDYBF_31_3: Without your help, this stall wouldn't be set up so smoothly.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_5: Yeah, Madam Magistrate did me a big favor.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_6: I used to keep all my goods in a warehouse across the river.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_7: You know, fireworks need special care to prevent accidents, so I tried to take fireproof and waterproof measures, did whatever I could.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_8: When Madam Magistrate heard about it, she helped me find a better storage place.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_9: Otherwise, the quality could've suffered, and there might've been safety risks.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_11: Here, take these fireworks as a gift! Thanks to you, these beautiful colors remain intact.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_13: But storage's tough for this one. Any temp or humidity change can mess up the colors.
Event_THCQDYBF_31_14: I see. We will make sure to handle them carefully. Thank you!
Event_THCQDYBF_31_15: You're welcome! Feel free to come back for more!
Event_THCQDYBF_34_3: I'm so glad our hard work paid off. Seeing the Moonlit Fair's success is truly heartwarming.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_4: I always knew we could do it, but witnessing it firsthand is truly touching.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_5: Then let's spend some more time here.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_6: I've already had the most out of it.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_7: As I walked around, I saw genuine smiles on the visitors' faces, and the vendors were passionately running their stalls.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_8: Everyone here is enjoying the fair… and this is exactly what I wished to see.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_9: {PlayerName}, thank you for showing me around. It's been a truly joyful experience because you are here with me.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_11: But... have you had enough fun yet?
Event_THCQDYBF_34_12: You've made my wish come true. Now let's go do what you'd like to do.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_13: We are already doing just that, walking under the moon together.
Event_THCQDYBF_34_15: "May we meet under the full moon's light, our bond unbroken, ever bright."
Event_THCQDYBF_44_1: So this is it. Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}.
Event_THCQDYBF_44_2: Sigh... I wanted to see the legendary golden glow and its extraordinary power, but it turns out to be just an ordinary bowl.
Event_THCQDYBF_44_4: Yes, a little bit. But Uncle Dong seemed happy. Maybe that ordinary bowl is indeed a treasure to him.
Event_THCQDYBF_44_5: Honestly, I'm more embarrassed than frustrated.
Event_THCQDYBF_44_6: You've been with me the whole time, searching and solving riddles, but we've just come up empty...
Event_THCQDYBF_44_9: No! I can't just let it go. I must repay you somehow for all the work you've done for me.
Event_THCQDYBF_44_10: But how… well, let me think…
Event_THCQDYBF_44_11: Oh! I know! I just got a new paycheck. I should treat you to a meal!

Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_1: The Port City of Guixu... It once embodied the metropolitan dream.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_2: Confidence and ambition fueled its growth, pushing the entire world forward.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_3: People sailed every sea, explored every land. Everyone had food and shelter, living in peace.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_4: Their spirits were high, optimism as tall as the skyscrapers. A bright future was surely inevitable, or so they thought.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_5: See that brightly lit building? It was the tallest, reaching high enough to touch the heavens.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_6: It sounds like a time of great hope...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_7: It was an era of high aspirations and big dreams. Life had infinite possibility.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_8: Humanity's aspirations soared beyond the stars, searching for the edge of the universe itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_10: Yes, because it was there, well within our reach...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_13: I've never been to this city myself, not even in the Sonoro.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_14: You were the one who told me about its rise and fall.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_16: But perhaps you had already foreseen its end and the issues that threaten us today.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_17: The city looks safe for now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_18: The Lament will strike here in one hour.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_19: My computations only recreated the city as it was in its final hour before disaster.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_20: Hard to imagine such a city turning to dust...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_21: The more steps we take, the closer we draw to the inevitable destruction.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_22: The moment the Lament starts is our chance to retrieve the data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_23: I'm sorry. We could never change history... or the "future" that already happened.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_24: As one who has already walked this path, what did you experience? How did you... feel about it?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_25: Does the Tethys System command you to ask about this?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_27: I ask... because "I" want to know.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_28: ...Would you like to share it with me?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_29: I remember your smile when you described how prosperous it was.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_1: We are about to see the beginning of the Lament...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_3: Back then, the Black Shores issued a Lament warning to the city.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_4: Unfortunately, the Lament swept through much faster than the Tethys System anticipated.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_5: You dispatched all available personnel to assist Huanglong in evacuation.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_6: But in the end... some lives couldn't be saved.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_9: Yes. She was one of the many casualties.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_10: As a Bloom Bearer, she was on the front lines of evacuation and rescue efforts.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_11: Yet human strength... is a mere whisper against the Lament's roar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_12: No life should be lost in vain.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_14: The Black Shores uphold this belief, and so did Hoda.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_17: But I'm not sure if seeing her is the right thing to do.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5616_1: This is the highest point in Guixu Port City, where the Lament descended.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5616_2: Gravity anomalies crushed this building into rubble.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5616_3: Tacet Discords closer to the Lament's origin are more dangerous.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5691_2: An object in free fall between two portals will keep accelerating.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5691_3: You can send the target to the designated location this way.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5691_4: Authorization granted! Give it a try!

Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_3: This gate looks even more familiar to me now.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_4: I feel you. It looks just like the gate to Somnoire.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_5: I think we deserve an explanation.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_9: What are your motives behind all this?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_10: That's why I hate sharp people...
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_12: Now you have all the rewards I promised and you must be tired after all these battles so maybe you should get some rest oh and I still got something to attend to so bye!
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_13: Cosmos dashes through the gate at an astonishing speed.

Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_20: I don't get it, but I think you're saying that this guy is doing something bad to pose as a member of the Black Shores, right?

RG_WuWangZhe_1_1: We meet again, but you don't look very well.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_2: Relax. From now on, you will only hear my voice, and I will count to three...
RG_WuWangZhe_1_4: The sound of "one" drags on, accompanied by the dull rhythm of droplets or a swinging metronome by your ears.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_6: No... Don't come close. Snow, snow all over the sky...
RG_WuWangZhe_1_8: Leave here. You don't smell the way "they" do... Greed, wrath, envy...
RG_WuWangZhe_1_10: *Noise*... Those three seconds felt endless. So many sounds mingled together, drifting through your mind.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_12: You look much better now, but before I answer your question, do you... remember the "name"?
RG_WuWangZhe_1_15: My name, hmm... I guess that kind of works. Sorry to interrupt, but the name is really important to dream "onlookers" like us.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_16: Correct. Sorry to interrupt, but the name is really important to dream "onlookers" like us.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_17: Especially now in a deep dream. Condensation, symbolism, refinement… they're all here to make this dream whole and harmonious.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_18: So, when you enter a deep dream as an onlooker, you'll feel repulsion. No dreamer wants the hassle of outsiders, right?
RG_WuWangZhe_1_19: I seem to have heard more than one sound. Are they real?
RG_WuWangZhe_1_20: Yes, they're real. Like I told you when we met, Somnoire is in chaos.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_21: I'm an onlooker who only recently entered the gate to the deep dream, just like you. We're both trying to uncover the truth behind all these strange interferences.
RG_WuWangZhe_1_22: Now let's move on. In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.

RG_WuWangZhe_3_1: Conflicting directions, mismatched objects—all coexist in one space harmoniously. A strange experience, isn't it?
RG_WuWangZhe_3_2: Is it due to Somnoire's natural creativity?
RG_WuWangZhe_3_3: Is it caused by the chaos in Somnoire?
RG_WuWangZhe_3_4: Sure, fantasies and creativity are part of dreams, but Somnoire is different. It requires real memories and experiences.
RG_WuWangZhe_3_6: Remember the different sounds you heard? If we combine them with what we're seeing now, it seems this deep dream belongs to more than one dreamer.
RG_WuWangZhe_3_7: They might come from different times and places, have different feelings, likes, and dislikes, and see things in various ways.
RG_WuWangZhe_3_8: Their dreamscapes, however, are mixed together due to the anomalies in Somnoire, disrupting the usual laws and order of space.
RG_WuWangZhe_3_9: I see you still don't quite get it. Let's move on then. In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.

Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_2: Cosmos? Why are you alone here?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_3: Ms. Encore has been preoccupied with numerous other matters recently. Therefore, I, the Black Wooly, will temporarily serve as your business representative in her stead.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_4: We invite you to participate in an experiment for our corporation this time.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_5: You talk in a suspicious way.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_7: Did you say experiment? What experiment?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_8: It's a stability test of the dream links. This is the entrance to the experiment zone. You will conduct the testing on the other side, {PlayerName}.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_9: {PlayerName}, I smell something fishy about his offer.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_11: Of course I... Wait, why that look?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_12: Where did you learn about the Black Shores and Encore?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_13: Why do I have to do it?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_14: I-I… Please, {PlayerName}, I have no one else to turn to. What can I do to make you accept? I'll do anything within my power.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_15: How serious are you about that?
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_16: I've got a ton of rewards ready for you, {PlayerName}. My entire collection is all yours if you complete the experiment!
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_20: There are only two simple rules: One, <color=Highlight>protect the experiment device on the other side of the gate from being destroyed</color>. Two, <color=Highlight>eliminate all the Tacet Discords there</color>.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_21: Oh, and to ensure the success of the experiment, you'll also get my special <color=Highlight>Echoids</color>.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_23: That's all! Please, {PlayerName}, without you, I'll...
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_25: Thank you! Please let me know when you're ready. We can do this any time!
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_1_26: Use the Echoids against the TDs, for our cause!

Event_TXCQDEBF_14_1: Oh, Rover! Ya wanna give this a shot?
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_3: Well, you're lookin' at it. Moon Shooter. Been helping Qingxi test out the new targets.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_4: Just beat my personal best, but.. I'm still nowhere near the all-time record.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_5: I mean, that record holder hit multiple targets with one shot, can't top that. It's crazy how they pulled it off.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_6: You're very good at it already.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_8: Ready for the real deal, Chixia? I've made some intense Moon Shooter challenges just for the pros.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_9: But I ran out of space here at the Fair... So I moved them to a safe area nearby.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_10: These aren't like the ones you tried at my stall—trust me, they'll be the craziest challenge of your life!
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_11: Jeepers! I gotta try that out!
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_12: Go ahead, knock yourself out. You can even help me get a feel for the difficulty while you're at it.
Event_TXCQDEBF_14_13: What are we waiting for, {PlayerName}? Let's go!
Event_TXCQDEBF_15_2: Hehe... I hope Qingxi's not gonna disappoint.
Event_TXCQDEBF_16_1: You're probably just not warmed up yet. C'mon, another one!
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_1: ...That's it? Welp, Qingxi was right about these being harder than the ones back at the stall. Just a teeny bit though.
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_3: It's already pretty difficult for the average folk.
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_4: Guess we'll have to look forward to Qinxi's ultimate challenge. She's definitely saving the best for last.
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_5: She must have tougher challenges for us. Instructor Yhan wouldn't have asked her to train the rookies otherwise.
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_7: And that's exactly what you want, right?
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_8: Alright. She's got me all fired up now!
Event_TXCQDEBF_17_9: Bring it on, Qinxi. I'm game for whatever you're gonna throw at me!
Event_TXCQDEBF_18_2: Time to give this ultimate challenge a spin!
Event_TXCQDEBF_19_1: Well, that was something... Humph. But it'll take more than that for me to call it quits! Oh, no, you don't!
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_1: Nice. Haven't broken so much sweat while target shooting in a long time. Ha. Not bad, Qingxi. Not bad at all...
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_2: That's way over the top for an amusement game.
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_3: That was so intense my hands were shaking.
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_4: That last challenge was really something, huh? But we made it through either way! Gimme five, Rover. Yeah!
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_5: Chixia raises her hand in excitement as she gives Rover a high five.
Event_TXCQDEBF_20_6: Haha. When we team up, we're unstoppable!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_1: You're back. Looks like you managed to beat all the challenges.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_3: Well? How did it feel, Rover?
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_7: Hmm... If you say so, then it's safe to say these extra challenges are ready for a broader audience.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_8: Still a bit on the easier side, huh? Which means... I'll need to turn it up a notch.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_9: Ha. Even Rover thinks they're too much of a challenge. I see, then I'll probably have to tone it down a bit...
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_11: Pfft. Ya think? Oh, I know what you're thinkin', all right—
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_12: Easy as shooting fish in a barrel.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_16: Care to give me some pointers on pistol training, Chixia?
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_17: Who knows? Maybe we can promote your skills among the Rangers!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_18: Tips? It's just hard work, hard work, and more hard work!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_19: Just hard work? Hmm... That's not much advice.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_20: Okay, then, lemme think... I'd say we also need the "heart of a hero."
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_21: Gotta be quick on the draw to protect the innocent, and shoot with absolute precision to stop evil. As a hero, I must strive for perfection!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_24: True, having a strong will to protect is just as crucial.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_25: Thank you. I'll be sure to tell the instructor what you said today.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_27: Oh... By the way, {PlayerName}, you found any good stuff to eat?
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_28: The Moon Shooter game had me all wrapped up. Totally forgot I came here for some snacks.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_29: Now with all that done and dusted, my stomach's starting to grumble...
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_30: There are plenty of food stalls.
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_31: You should give "Fish Balls with Spicy Gravy" a try!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_32: Nice... Food Hunter Chixia is ready!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_33: Fish Balls with Spicy Gravy... It's got me drooling just saying that name!
Event_TXCQDEBF_21_38: Okie dokie! Enjoy the Moonlit Fair, {PlayerName}!

InstanceDungeon_8161_MonsterTips:
Rupture Alloy:
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces Resonance Liberation Cooldown and regenerates Resonance Energy.
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> reduces all party members' Resonance Skill Cooldown, increases their Resonance Skill Crit. Rate for 3s, and boosts their Resonance Skill Crit. DMG. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8162_MonsterTips:
Empyrean Alloy:
While the active Resonator is <color=highlight>in mid-air</color>, increase their Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG each second. Whenever a Mid-air Attack hits the target, it triggers an additional attack that deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
The additional attack increases the Resonator's <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8163_MonsterTips:
Aftersound Alloy:
Increase inactive Resonators' DMG when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target. This effect can be stacked.
All party members gain extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target.
Increase all party members' Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG for 8s when <color=highlight>Intro Skill</color> hits the target.
InstanceDungeon_8164_MonsterTips:
Fervor Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> Cooldown.
Defeating an enemy regenerates extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
Defeating an enemy also increases the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of all party members' <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8165_MonsterTips:
Crescent Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. At the beginning and end of an <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>, cast a Crescent Slash beside the active Echo, dealing Echo Skill DMG to the enemy.
Defeating an enemy increases all party members' Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG.
InstanceDungeon_8166_MonsterTips:
Stagnation Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> inflicts a Stagnation effect on the enemy and marks it. Every marked enemy takes extra DMG.
InstanceDungeon_8167_MonsterTips:
Devouring Alloy:
Increase the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>. This effect can be stacked.
Defeating an enemy with <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces the Resonator's Echo Skill Cooldown and Resonance Skill Cooldown and regenerates a certain amount of Concerto Energy.

RG_WuWangZhe_10_1: We'll keep going through more doors and diving even deeper into the dream. Scared now?
RG_WuWangZhe_10_3: Good. Let's go. The culprit behind the chaos in this dream is somewhere on the other side.
RG_WuWangZhe_10_4: In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.
RG_WuWangZhe_11_1: The disruption is getting stronger, just like when we last saw that strange thing.
RG_WuWangZhe_11_2: The other side of the door could be way more dangerous. Do we proceed?
RG_WuWangZhe_11_3: In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.
RG_WuWangZhe_11_4: Hah, so you are starting to embrace this land of dreams. Then go push it.
RG_WuWangZhe_12_1: There is nothing here except for it. All the sweet dreams and nightmares are kept out of this room.
RG_WuWangZhe_12_2: Does it still look like the Dreamless in your eyes? Take care. I can feel the repulsion is getting stronger in this space.
RG_WuWangZhe_13_2: Are those sounds coming from it? What does it want to say...
RG_WuWangZhe_14_2: A harsh scream drowns out all other sounds.
RG_WuWangZhe_14_3: …It finally quiets down. It seems that the scream was there to blur its indistinct words. What was it…
RG_WuWangZhe_15_1: It disappeared... However, something still feels off around here. The connections within the dream are still here...
RG_WuWangZhe_15_2: Anyway, do you have the answers to those questions now?
RG_WuWangZhe_15_4: ...It's okay. There's more about the dream behind that door. I trust you'll find the answer someday.
RG_WuWangZhe_15_5: We've been here long enough. Too many factors could disturb us. Let's call it a day. We'll go deeper into the dream next time.
RG_WuWangZhe_15_7: In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.
RG_WuWangZhe_16_1: It's showing up again. Be careful. It's a mixture of too many things—sweet dreams, bad dreams, every dream we've ever seen.
RG_WuWangZhe_16_2: No wonder it wears different faces. It's causing even stronger repulsion in the space now compared to the last time we encountered it.
RG_WuWangZhe_17_3: Its sounds are clear this time...
RG_WuWangZhe_18_1: Sweet dreams, bad dreams, ordinary dreams, heroic dreams, empty dreams... They will all continue.
RG_WuWangZhe_18_2: They will continue to exist... To put an end to them, we need to... need to find...
RG_WuWangZhe_18_3: No, I'm not an "onlooker" of the dream... Only an onlooker in the dream...
Event_TXCQDEBF_10_2: So we just set it on the ground, light it here... and ta-da! It's a fireworks show!
Event_TXCQDEBF_10_3: Something's not right... Encore, throw that thing away!
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_2: That was... way too big of an explosion.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_4: Encore's alright. Not a scratch. Wasn't scared at all.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_5: But... Are fireworks supposed to be like that?
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_6: Not really... These are some very powerful firecrackers.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_11: Hmm, I see... I guess his daughter is gonna feel let down this year.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_13: TDs. They must've been drawn by the explosion.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_14: TDs. And quite a few of them too.
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_15: Hey, Encore has an idea. How about we use the rest of these firecrackers on them, {PlayerName}?
Event_TXCQDEBF_11_17: Yep, trying new things is a big part of adventuring!
Event_TXCQDEBF_12_1: ...Phew. That's most of the firecrackers. Those TDs didn't even stand a chance!
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_1: {PlayerName}, Encore! How did it go? Did the fireworks go out with a bang?
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_2: It was a really loud bang...
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_7: I'm so sorry, {PlayerName}. Are you alright? Did you guys get hurt?
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_8: No, not at all. {PlayerName} had me covered!
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_9: *Sigh* I'm glad to hear that. I should get rid of that formula.
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_10: On second thought. Maybe... It can be put to use elsewhere.
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_11: Wait... you're saying we can use this against the TDs? That might actually work out...
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_12: I'll talk to the guys at Lollo Logistics and see if they'll give it a shot... Thanks for all your help today, you two!
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_13: Don't mention it, Mr. Xisha! Encore got a super cool story out of it!
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_14: {PlayerName} and the Woolies vanquished all the monsters in the forest. Despite not finding her flowers, the princess brought peace back to the woods!
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_15: ...Do you understand what she's talking about, {PlayerName}?
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_18: Whew, I wish I could... Then I may figure out where my daughter's getting all those wackadoo ideas from.
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_19: Ha... My daughter's like that too. Kids these days, you never know what's going on in their heads.
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_20: Speaking of my daughter. Thought I finally got it right this time... But it seems I'll have to keep tweaking my formulas. Can't give up just yet.
Event_TXCQDEBF_13_21: You can do it, Mr. Xisha! I believe in you!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_1: The lantern riddles look fun. Would you like to give them a try?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_2: Well, {PlayerName}? Are you up for the challenge?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_3: Look, I've got some tough riddles fresh from the press. Solve three and you'll win the jackpot. It's a collector's item, trust me!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_6: I might need some backup on this!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_7: Together? Is that allowed in the rules?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_8: Then, if that's allowed in the rules... I'd like to take on this challenge together with {PlayerName}.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_9: Of course, it's a festival after all. What could be more important than having fun? Yangyang, you seemed totally into our riddles. I bet you'd enjoy solving them yourself!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_10: Plus, my riddles are tough! Wouldn't want to have {PlayerName} make a fool out of themselves, now would I?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_11: I won't be so sure about that.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_13: All right! How about we get you warmed up with an appetizer? Riddle Number 1: Round as the moon, with a belly just as white. In the air it may leap, in the waters it may creep.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_15: It's round in shape with a white belly, able to swim in water... Could it be...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_23: That's right. You got it. It's a Gulpuff!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_24: A Gulpuff really does remind you of the moon when it jumps up in the air, doesn't it?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_25: I remember when I was little... I loved the Moon-Chasing Festival. We'd make Plumpcakes in all sorts of shapes, mostly cute round animals...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_26: We all loved the Gulpuff Plumpcakes.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_27: Haha, truly a kids' favorite. Now... On to the next riddle! This one might be a bit trickier!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_28: You're given a cage full of chickens and rabbits. You count 14 heads and 38 legs...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_29: Question... How many chickens and rabbits are there in total? Your five-minute timer starts… Now!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_31: Yeah... Isn't that more like a math problem than a riddle...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_32: Ahem... You see, it's a question with a definitive answer. And since it's hanging under a lantern, let's call it a riddle.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_33: ...If you say so. Still, it feels a bit off...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_34: I remember learning how to solve it in class, such as the "half-leg method"...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_35: You got this one in the bag. Right, Yangyang?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_37: Okay, I'll see what I can do...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_38: Done! The answer is... 5 rabbits and 9 chickens!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_39: (First, suppose that all of them are chickens, then calculate the difference in the number of legs, getting the amount of rabbits... I see.)
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_41: Correct! You figured it out even faster than Mr. Bosong. I'm impressed.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_42: For the last riddle, how about we change things up a bit? You two can pick one from any of the lanterns.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_43: (Xieyang gestures to a row of lanterns above, adorned with swaying riddle slips.)
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_44: Umm... I don't really see any riddles...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_45: Oh, the riddles here are written in special ink. You'll have to hold them close to a lantern in order to see.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_47: Of course. The more suspense, the better! Solving lantern riddles is like a journey of discovery. You'll have to trust your instincts!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_48: I see... That does make things more interesting.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_49: I'll leave it to you, Yangyang.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_50: Huh? Me? Well... Then I'll choose, this one.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_51: Alrighty! Let's see... The riddle has revealed itself！
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_52: I am made up of many, but can also be one. I bring people together and make them have fun. What am I?
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_54: Made up of many, but can also be one...
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_57: Ooh. Close, but not close enough!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_60: Bravo. You've completed all 3 riddles. The special prize is yours!
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_61: Xieyang brings out a beautifully crafted lantern adorned with drawings of "The Fox and the Moon" tale.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_64: Yangyang, you seem to like it a lot.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_65: Well, it's not just any lantern.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_66: I was little when I last received a lantern like this... I really miss those times.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_67: We were lucky to get this lantern from a renowned collector for our special occasion.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_68: It's said that Sentinel "Hsin" handcrafted it and hid many more in the woodlands, making it a prized possession. Finding one is like getting a year's worth of blessings.
Event_TXCQDEBF_34_69: How's that for a souvenir? Congratulations! Endless fortune be with you!
Event_TXCQDEBF_35_2: Can we... go on a walk together?
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_1: I remember always looking forward to the Moon-Chasing Festival when I was a child.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_2: Fireworks light up the night sky, lanterns dot every street corner, and we indulge in family-made plumpcakes. Every face I see is filled with joy...
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_3: ...Those memories have grown fuzzy, but I still remember the heartfelt smiles of my loved ones.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_4: I joined the Midnight Rangers to protect their happy smiles... Even if my strength alone won't make much difference, I'll do what I can.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_5: See, everyone's having a great time.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_7: Yes! This is why I love Jinzhou. I love what we've fought to protect.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_8: Maybe a little... But I'm okay.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_9: While I can't be with my family today, the laughter in the air is already making me feel delighted.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_10: As I look at the bright moon, I know they are having a great time somewhere.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_12: I feel so happy for this moment, and for all you've done.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_13: This year's Moon-Chasing Festival... You've made it feel very special to me.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_14: There's still plenty of the Moonlit Fair to enjoy.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_15: I'm sure future festivals will only get better.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_16: Indeed! Any other places you'd like to visit, {PlayerName}?
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_17: Let's take a little break here before moving on to more spots.
Event_TXCQDEBF_36_18: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I hope... we can always celebrate together, for every festival, just like we do now.
Event_TXCQDEBF_4_1: So this is Flarepowder... Looks like ordinary dirt to me.
Event_TXCQDEBF_4_2: You sure we can make fireworks out of it?
Event_TXCQDEBF_5_1: Charcoal. Hmm... Maybe we can find some around the bonfire.
Event_TXCQDEBF_6_1: This must be the Low-frequency Charcoal... Aaand, into Encore's pouch you go!
Event_TXCQDEBF_6_2: There, that's all of 'em! Let's go find Mr. Xisha!
Event_TXCQDEBF_9_1: Well, that was quick. You got everything?
Event_TXCQDEBF_9_3: Ha... Stick around for a bit while I go get these fireworks ready, {PlayerName}.
Event_TXCQDEBF_9_4: After a while, Xisha returns and cautiously hands you the finished fireworks.
Event_TXCQDEBF_9_5: Hmm... these are different from my usual fireworks, and they don't look like firecrackers either.
Event_TXCQDEBF_9_6: I might have to ask you guys to go test fire a couple of 'em where it's wide and open and with not many people around, {PlayerName}...

ItemInfo_80000035_BgDescription:
A common dish that has become a hallmark of Huanglong cuisine. Golden and exquisite, it is a breakfast plate beloved by people of all ages.
As it is always found on the dining tables of Huanglong, most folks see it as an everyday indulgence. But those who have been away from their homes always find themselves longing for its delicate fragrance.
ItemInfo_80000036_BgDescription:
A cake that is baked in every kitchen in Huanglong when the Moon-Chasing Festival is around.
Shared on the reunion dinner among the elder and the young, who exchange good wishes in the moonlight sifting through the lush leaves of the osmanthus trees. Over the moon-chasing tale that's been told a thousand times before, everyone bites down on this sweet, fragrant treat and savors the joy of reunion.

InfoDisplay_102801032_Text:
//By Bram
I have seen my end. Before death arrives, I... must repent.
I am not a pure scholar.
I envy my colleagues... Victor, Alaia, Vasily, Chen Xuefeng... They all have ideals, and beliefs. They sincerely hope that their efforts will better humanity. They want to surmount the Lament and ward off crises.
I am different. I work for selfish reasons, masquerading my ambition as ideals like theirs. I joined the research on Retroact Rain in Whining Aix's Mire and then relocated to Mt. Firmament, all to prove that time is a river. We are merely carried along by it and someday we will also find a way to go against the current.
Like a drowning man, I grasped at any straw, seeking salvation where none exists... Isn't it ridiculous, Vivian?
I don't know why I have you in my mind at this moment... Or should I say... you never left. The miracles at Mt. Firmament once fueled my unrealistic fantasies. I sacrificed everything and exhausted all the knowledge I had acquired throughout my life, just to bring you back from the dark, hazy underworld, and hold you in my arms once again.
But I failed. My fingers started to tremble, my head grew dizzy, and I could no longer operate those delicate instruments. I see you now, standing by the river, separated from me only by a thin veil. I've been drifting down, and down, and down... But you, you stayed somewhere upstream, for eternity.
Fortunately, I won't have to worry about this much longer. I'm about to run aground, and I hope I have the chance to sail upstream and find you.
InfoDisplay_102801033_Text:
Date: [––]
Testing, testing… Ah, great! So the recording function still works.
I, Victor Christopher, the last Research Director, am leading this experiment in my own name—no precedent, no animal tests, no ethical reviews. Honestly, making the decision was torture to me—my science ethics is wearing thin. But none of those were possible. I'm running out of time. It's just me and Caleb, that assistant AI, now.
Still, I'm recording what I'm about to do. I'm not recording in proper formatting, 'cause this is but a desperate act by an unresigned old man. I hope this won't bother anyone who should find this memo.
I've set up a few Chronopins—to prevent energy breakdown, I'll overload each of them—which should, theoretically, create a lasting, irreversible time bubble, trapping me inside like an insect in amber. I hesitate to call it immortality—it's more like sentencing myself to life. The only comfort is that my consciousness will be kept still too, so I'll stay sane during this long slumber.
The reason I'm doing this instead of welcoming death with calm is… I have to wait for that one's return.
That one once helped us develop the technology of [data corrupted], helped us reconstruct what was a tiny chip of the Sentinel's supreme power. They showed us a glimpse of a god's world, even if just for an instant. And I just… want to meet that one again, even though they might not give us the answers we long for.
By then, what will that one say to this foolish, dying old man? Will they call me a complete idiot? Will that one compare our research to child's play, with that scorn theirs? Or will they appreciate our work... before our tombs?
I don't know. It's been too long. My memory of that one has blurred. The only part about them that's left in mind is that they were so caring, and so indifferent, at once.
Okay, it's about time. Gotta get in my amber. I'll see you in a million years, my friends, or in a few seconds… They're the same to me.

InfoDisplay_102801035_Text:
Date: [---].
I am Victor. This is a routine voice journal.
Today is another beautiful day. Most of the researchers have left. They will leave Mt. Firmament. Mr. Bram and I advised them to calm down and at least wait until we resolve the issue of shortened lifespan before making a decision. But they didn't listen.
I didn't leave. Research requires perseverance, which was the first lesson Mr. Bram taught me. He always leads by example. Ha, to him, I'll always be that immature young boy.
Date: [---].
I took some time to create something new: a simple AI. I named it Caleb after the iron-headed thing who traveled with a man and dog in an old movie I watched as a kid. Not many people are left here, so someone has to take care of the minor work. An AI is always useful.
I also created some interesting rock puzzles, powered by the many unoccupied Chronosorters in this place. It reminds me of playing with building blocks in my childhood. Those were the days. However, Mr. Bram doesn't seem very happy. Maybe his age prevents him from accepting too many new things...? Or perhaps his worsening leg condition makes these rock puzzles a hassle for him to navigate.
I don't mind. Life isn't just about work and research, right?
Date: [---].
It is quite enjoyable to educate an AI from scratch. It's like painting on a blank canvas—I need to stay focused to avoid turning a meticulous artwork into a careless scribble.
I answer any questions it raises and write new database entries for it every few days. I teach it everything I know about the world, using the methods Mr. Bram taught me. This feeling... is wonderful. Its camera reflects the world as I see it, and it thinks with my logic, allowing me to examine myself again through its actions.
Date: [---].
Caleb learns quite quickly. Initially, I only intended for it to help with cooking and tidying up the facility. I never expected its potential to far exceed our imagination. It seems that it is time to change its title from "Life Assistant" to "Research Assistant".
Mr. Bram has been ill for several days, bedridden, and unable to go anywhere. I miss the energetic man who used to scold us apprentices one by one. But now I have become a middle-aged man myself, too. It's been days since I last shaved, but it seems trivial now.
Date: [---].
Mr. Bram… didn't make it through that long winter.
Caleb and I buried him on a hill nearby without a tombstone. It wouldn't help anyway, as no one will know who we are or what our names are. People might just laugh about how a bunch of lunatics indulge themselves in illusions when they see our negligible legacy.
Caleb was with Mr. Bram until his very last moment. And Mr. Bram… taught it everything he knew. I understand why.
I once read a story about a man who was determined to level a mountain, despite everyone thinking he was out of his mind. But he made it, with the help of his sons, his grandsons, his great-grandsons, and so on.
I hope Caleb will shoulder this responsibility. I've told it about this. Human life is too short, but Caleb is immortal. It might accomplish what is impossible for us.
I will not live to see that day, but I will do everything I can while I'm alive to press forward. I promise, in the name of Bram, my mentor.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5605_9: Perhaps we could plant a few in the Greenhouse...

Heihaian_main_1_3_5605_14: You have enough on your shoulders.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5605_16: If I know you will enjoy it, it's no trouble for me.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5607_2: I'd recommend this iced tea. Trust me, it won't let you down.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5607_3: The city's night view is always mesmerizing. Closing your eyes on such a beautiful night would be a crime.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5607_4: Sorry if I'm staring too long, but honestly, you two make a perfect duo.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_1: You really seem to like it here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_4: This city and its people belong to the old era. They embody exactly what a civilization needs to thrive.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_5: Whenever you spoke of this, I could feel the joy radiating from your words.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_6: However, prosperity and harmony are rare and fleeting in a world twisted by the Lament.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_7: Perhaps we can only catch glimpses of them replicated by the Sonoro.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_8: The feeling humans have in a vibrant city like this... is it called happiness?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_9: Yes, a feeling unknown to those scarred by war and disaster.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5608_10: One day, the people of Solaris will once again return to such an era.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5611_3: Take my daughter... My poor baby girl... She can still live...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5612_1: You're with the Black Shores? Huh... Too late.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5612_3: Nobody will make it out alive. This building... this building is our grave...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5612_4: A grave... for fools who attempted to touch the heavens...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_1: Don't give up hope! We'll save you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_2: I'm a doctor from the Black Shores. Calm down, let me examine you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_4: Yes, and you... Wait a moment... {PlayerName}? It's you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_6: Allow me to introduce myself properly. I'm Hoda, the Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_7: It's been a long time since we talked face to face, my mentor.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_8: You've been trapped here all along?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_9: Ever since that day, both I and those engulfed by the Lament have become part of the black hole.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_10: The Tethys System later contained it, turning it into a new Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_11: I have always known about this...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_12: But the Necrostar integrated into the core logic of the Tethys System, so I could not interfere.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_13: So Tethys is actually using the Lament.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_14: Tethys can observe the Lament because it understands its nature.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_15: The best way to fully understand something is to study a perfect replica in a controlled environment.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_16: Tethys has been selectively containing Lament sources to drive its analysis of other occurrences.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_17: You mean Tethys is using the Lament as a tool against itself?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_18: It's the only effective solution so far.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_20: That's why Tethys contained this Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_22: I'm part of it now, but I've never forgotten my duty as a Bloom Bearer, not for a moment.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_27: Despair, obsession, resentment, remorse... Emotions stirred by the Lament have torn us apart, much like the tidal forces around a real black hole.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_28: But just like the Lament itself, those emotions are also frequencies. Tethys likely harnesses them in order to—
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_30: The Tethys System is attempting to activate the Necrostar program again!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_32: Please free us... from this endless cycle...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_34: It's the only law... from the old world... that still holds true today...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_35: For those in disaster, the name "Black Shores" brings hope.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_36: You're the one keeping the Necrostar in check from within...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_37: I did my best, just like you are. The only difference is, I'm just a shadow.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_38: I've lost track of how long it's been, but at some point, I realized that the Lament follows patterns and can be controlled, much like the Necrostar itself. But I couldn't share my theories with anyone...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_39: Nothing escapes a black hole. I could only hope for your arrival one day.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_40: We once felt as lost as you do now, but your wisdom showed us a path we could follow.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_1: It seems the Tethys System has been hiding things from us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_4: We're still unable to fully explain issues related to gravity with post-Lament science.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_5: Perhaps that's why Tethys even risked integrating the Lament and Necrostar into its core logic...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_6: But our time is running out. We have to terminate the Necrostar to complete remodulation.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_8: Please allow me to accompany you, {PlayerName}.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_9: This is my request as a member of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5614_10: And it's also... my personal... request.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5615_1: Severely corrupted data detected... It's right behind this gate.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5615_2: I'll work to stop it spreading. Please be careful.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5617_3: Please be careful. This place is filled with... hatred.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5618_2: Core computational unit installation in progress...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5618_9: No... Your journey will not end here!
Heihaian_main_1_3_5618_10: Tell me this story later, when we meet again.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_2: I didn't expect us to find each other here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_4: This is the deepest part of the Tethys System, our shore... just for us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_6: I used to think my duty was to guard the Black Shores, obeying the Tethys System's every command.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_7: But... you showed me another way.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_26: I'm grateful to have you here on this shore. I couldn't ask for more.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_28: No matter how far you go, I will always be here... watching over you.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_36: My journey ends here, but yours must continue.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5619_37: No one will ever be harmed again, just as I promised.

InfoDisplay_102801036_Text:
Greetings, dear friends! It's your old friend Riddle Master D! Or you can just call me Mr. Riddle!
Since you've managed to make it this far, then it means that you're just one step away from my deepest secrets. "Oh, the horror! My deepest secrets! I must not let that happen!"
Gotcha didn't I? Well, quite the opposite! These challenges are placed here specifically designed for curious minds such as yourselves! Enjoy the thrill of these puzzles to the fullest and uncover the treasure I've hidden within!
Oh, goodness. I almost forgot to give you a bit of a hint. Don't want to have you test out each one individually. No, no, that won't do. Now, time for everyone's favorite, the hints:
The mechanisms are marked in four colors: red, green, blue, and yellow. They are numbered one to four based on the order in which they are supposed to be activated. Only one of the following hints is true, study them wisely:
(1) Mechanism No. 1 is red.
(2) Mechanism No. 2 is purple.
(3) Red and purple cannot be activated back to back.
(4) Mechanisms No. 1 & 4 are neither blue nor purple.
Rather simple, right? Better hop to it then! But do keep in mind, that you've only got five minutes to solve this puzzle! Muahahaha!
InfoDisplay_102801037_Text:
Greetings, dear friends! It's your old pal, Riddle Master D again! Or you can just call me Mr. Riddle. Whichever you prefer!
Oh, hold on, I've already mentioned that in the previous message. Anyway, there's always the possibility that someone might have missed the previous one and actually finished all 24 attempts before finally getting in. You'll never know!
Anyway. Sorry if you feel disappointed, but as you can see there's no treasure here. Not in the form of riches or anything like that at least. Instead, I have left you with something you may find even more delightful: "Riddle Master D's Latest Horror Riddles—Ultimate Collection"! This masterpiece is the culmination of my life's work, the one and only existing piece in this world! I’m sure this is exactly what you've been searching for!
Hmm? Not interested in books? Only treasures of glistening gold and silver have the power to spur that unyielding heart of yours, you say?
Ahem. Well, I figured as much... In that case, I believe this is a matter that calls for Riddle Master D’s credo: The true essence of a riddle lies not in the reward it conceives, but in the very process of resolve it entails! Did you not enjoy the thrill of the riddles? You would be lying to yourself if you said no. Then that's all that matters, is it not?
I hope you enjoyed yourselves. Until next time!

Event_TXCQDEBF_22_1: ...H-How can this be? I was this close...
Event_TXCQDEBF_22_3: Hmph. Step aside, it's my turn! I've always had a lucky hand!
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_3: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. I'm watching these people try their luck in the lucky draw.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_4: Aren't you going to give it a go?
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_5: I guess it wouldn't hurt to give it a try.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_6: Changli walks over to the stall and casually spins the wheel.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_7: ...And there it is. Lady Changli wins again. Just like last year, no, just like those every other time you participated in the draw.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_8: Did you achieve that with strategy?
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_9: Not really... It's probably just luck. This draw's results are solely based on chance, making it impossible for even the most attentive strategy to predict.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_10: Wait, Lady Changli! I just checked the list. Looks like you've won the one and only surprise grand prize of this year's Moonlit Fair!
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_13: That's right. Well, I'd say... it's more of a treasure map? Or clues to the actual prize?
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_15: Just some context: our Pioneer Association team found this mysterious platform near Jinzhou.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_16: It was sealed with intricate puzzles, probably the work of the elusive Court of Savantae. We tried everything, but not even one puzzle budged.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_17: Then, someone joked about relying on luck to solve it.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_18: So you took that joke seriously.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_19: Yup. I realized this was the perfect candidate for Hsin's Fortuity grand prize. Only someone with ridiculous luck could win it.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_20: And who knows? Maybe they'd use that luck to uncover its hidden secrets.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_21: Well, Changli might actually be able to...
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_27: Nice. I'll upload the keycode we found and the coordinates of that platform to your Terminals.
Event_TXCQDEBF_23_28: I wish you two the best of luck!
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_1: ...Hmm, these mechanisms remind me of the Court of Savantae's technique.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_2: Interesting. They used overlapping layers instead of their usual designs.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_4: It has four mechanisms that need to be solved in the right order within time limit.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_6: In the worst case, this platform could trigger its self-destruct mechanism and things might not look so good for us...
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_7: Just kidding. I bet the Pioneer Association have attempted to solve this puzzle numerous times.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_8: If they knew there was a fail-safe, they wouldn't have made finding this place a prize.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_9: I guess it will just revert to its initial state.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_10: Well, that makes things easier. Let's test the combinations one by one.
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_11: We should look around for clues...
Event_TXCQDEBF_24_12: A viable approach. I estimate a total of 24 combinations... If you don't mind, {PlayerName}, we certainly can test them out one at a time.
Event_TXCQDEBF_26_2: Have you come up with a solution, {PlayerName}?
Event_TXCQDEBF_26_7: Very well. Think before you act, and success will follow.
Event_TXCQDEBF_26_8: The correct order should be: Yellow, Blue, Purple, and finally, Red.
Event_TXCQDEBF_26_9: Come, it's time we solve this riddle.
Event_TXCQDEBF_28_2: I'd like another look at the hints.
Event_TXCQDEBF_29_2: I wonder what it has in store for us.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_1: It appears there are no treasures here.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_2: Yeah. No treasure, just a book.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_3: Hmm... interesting. This must be the "Riddle Master D's Latest Horror Riddles - Ultimate Collection" mentioned in that memoir.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_4: As I guessed... The book is full of codes and diagrams on Automata Mechanics. It's complex, but it seems to be a guide for creating machines.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_6: The Riddle Master's not making it easy for us.
Event_TXCQDEBF_31_7: Nothing else to see here. Let's make our return.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_1: {PlayerName}. You're back! So? Did you find the treasure?
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_3: A book? Wait... Could it be... Can I have a look, {PlayerName}?
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_4: You hand the book to Xianchen.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_5: I... I knew it, this is the yet-to-be-discovered latest work of Riddle Master D!
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_6: Th-This is wild! I thought these books only existed in legends!
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_8: "Riddle Master D's Super-Cool Magic Riddles", "Riddle Master D's Popular Hangout Riddles", "Riddle Master D's Ultimate Brainstorming Riddles"...
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_9: These books are our treasures, filled with masterpieces from the Court of Savantae's Riddle Master D.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_10: Our engineers dream of deciphering his works. It could aid explorers in navigating ancient traps.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_11: Do you mind putting this book under the Pioneer Association's care? Please!
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_13: You can have them, since they obviously mean a lot to you.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_14: Oh, thank you! Thank you so much! We'll make sure to pay you handsomely for your help!
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_15: Xiancheng bows to you and Changli before leaving with the book.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_16: Hmm... Judging from the end results alone, we did manage to find the treasure, did we not? Only... in a slightly different way.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_17: Something tells me you saw that coming.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_18: ...So you've noticed? Yes, I've encountered this Riddle Master D in the archives before.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_19: The records mention his numerous creations and literary works. The Pioneer Association should be well-informed on him, since they frequently explore the wilderness.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_20: Though, I wasn't really interested in the so-called treasure to begin with.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_21: For me, the biggest gain today is not the treasure, nor the precious works of Riddle Master D.
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_23: Oh well... I wonder what it could be...
Event_TXCQDEBF_32_24: I'll let you figure it out, {PlayerName}. Hehe... Until we meet again, then.

Heihaian_main_1_3_28_43: She was indeed a Bloom Bearer, but mysteries still surround her and the departed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_44: The departed, whom you saw in the Port City of Guixu, caused those abnormal frequencies. Only you can mend those errors.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_45: Rest assured, I shall always be by your side, to assist you as before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_47: I am sorry, but I must keep this secret from you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_48: Perhaps, as you restore the Tethys System, you will uncover the reasons for severing ties with your past…
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_50: Are you satisfied with your journey and stories in Jinzhou?
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_51: The people in Jinzhou are nice.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_52: I'd say it's been a good start to the adventure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_53: Is that so? I'm glad to hear that.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_54: In Solaris, Jinzhou is but the beginning of your journey.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_55: Please, have faith. The path ahead shall be as splendid as you desire.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_58: The gate to the underground has been opened. Pass through it, and you will reach the depths of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_59: Your journey has only just begun.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_60: Beyond the Black Shores lies Solaris itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_61: Before you go, can I ask a favor?
Heihaian_main_1_3_28_62: When all is settled, will you share your stories from Jinzhou with me?

Side_XYHTZST_35_5: I'm sure Madam Magistrate feels the same. It's great to see her smile. She really should do that more often.
