Flow_313700003_1: Exhausted and disoriented from wandering the dream, you are about to collapse when the Ivory Gatekeeper catches you just in time.
Flow_313700003_2: Worn out by your journey, aren't you?
Flow_313700003_55: You have been traveling the lands of dream as an "onlooker" all along. Now, why don't you try being a dreamer yourself?
Flow_313700003_56: He offers four cups of bedtime drink, hoping to relieve your fatigue and help you sleep peacefully.
Flow_313700003_66: A researcher is shaking a beaker.
Flow_313700003_67: That's not the exact color predicted by the theory. Was my reagent concentration too low?
Flow_313700003_68: Since you're not following, he shows you his theory: a way to suppress the cognitive interference caused by Retroact Rain.
Flow_313700003_69: Only two reagents with vastly different concentrations remain on the shelf, which leads to two speculations.
Flow_313700003_70: A violent reaction occurs soon after mixing. Despite your fear that the container might explode, the researcher sets his jaw and lets it proceed.
Flow_313700003_71: Woah, look. What a beautiful color. Just as the theory predicted!
Flow_313700003_72: The reaction starts with the mixing, and the color gradually changes. For an instant, You think you see the "Milky Way in a Cup," but it quickly vanishes, and the reaction stops.
Flow_313700003_73: The reaction isn't going as planned, but we're getting close. I need to find another way.
Flow_313700003_74: If the concentration is too high, it may trigger a dangerous reaction; if it's too low, there might be no reaction at all. On that note, you suggest...
Flow_313700003_76: With a round of applause and a spotlight on your face, you find yourself in the theater.
Flow_313700003_77: You are sent to the center stage from the auditorium and meet the lady from the Pioneer Association.
Flow_313700003_78: It's been a while, our winner today. Welcome to the grand lucky draw!
Flow_313700003_79: Now, just a few steps, and you'll have a chance to win great souvenirs the Association brings back from across the world! Same as always.
Flow_313700003_80: If you're ready, just shout out our slogan: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders!
Flow_313700003_97: An old man is fishing by the lake. He asks if you can get the spare bait in the backpack for him.
Flow_313700003_98: Surprisingly, along with the usual grain baits, there's a ring inside the clear plastic bag.
Flow_313700003_99: Hah-hah. Some fish are hard to catch not because of their size and speed...
Flow_313700003_106: Hah, you might need to keep searching for the right bait.
Flow_313700003_107: The old man swings the ring before your eyes and deftly sets it up on the hook. You look around and spot another fishing rod nearby. You decide to...
Flow_313700003_108: Having let out all your emotions, you close the magazine with a hint of satisfaction.
Flow_313700003_109: You meet the shabbily dressed man again, who fervidly greets you and asks for your opinion about the New Federation magazine.
Flow_313700003_110: Sir, do you want to take a look at other titles this time?
Flow_313700003_111: You notice a billboard beside him with the heading "This Magazine Is Amazing." At the very bottom of it, in a strange font, it says, "Buying back issues."
Flow_313700003_112: The four magazines take you through four different sensory adventures.
Flow_313700003_113: The man hands you the money and starts introducing the popular list.
Flow_313700003_115: An adventurer holds your hand with excitement and gives you a booklet.
Flow_313700003_117: Interested? I'm an adventurer, and this booklet is a collection of my experiences from a seafaring nation.
Flow_313700003_124: You flip through a few pages and grow interested in his offer after reading some images and texts.
Flow_313700003_125: Fantastic, now that you're in, let's start with the Echo you want to train.
Flow_313700003_126: He skips to the last page, where some black sketches are presented, with no annotation.
Flow_313700003_127: Sorry, I hand-drew these. See if any one catches your eye.

Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_4: The Black Shores welcomes your return.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_5: I am expressing myself through music... just like you taught me.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_6: I asked you here to talk about Abby. Have you noticed an increase in its hunger or fatigue lately?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_8: Yes, it's been more noticeable lately.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_10: The unusual frequency I noticed is from Abby. The change is subtle, but it's getting stronger.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_12: Abby was worried about how this might affect you and has been asking for my help.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_13: ...The one I'm trying to protect might be facing danger because of me. I can sense how anxious Abby is.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_14: I've looked into the most viable solution for Abby's weakening frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_15: Before I explain, you should see a past record stored in Tethys. It's important for you to see it yourself.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_1: That should do it. It's good to meet you, my future...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_3: Now that you have this record, I trust that you've resolved the core issue with the Tethys System. And the Shorekeeper must be connected to it too.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_4: As Chief Steward, you now have full access to the Black Shores data banks, which hold thousands of years' worth of records. However, you may have noticed that all information about you is missing.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_5: That's because I erased most entries about myself, the "you" of the past.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_6: Long after my memory is wiped, "I" will awaken for the first time and become "you."
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_7: Once again, "we" will rove Solaris-3 and walk among the people.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_8: You've witnessed a taste of civilization's struggles, and you may have questions. But I'm afraid I can't answer them yet.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_9: What you see before you is a memo, or rather, a beacon I've set for myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_10: If that one has also awakened...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_11: Seek out "Imperator." We made a pact long ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_1: I found this when searching for information about Abby.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_2: It remained hidden until the core leak in the Tethys System was finally resolved.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_3: It's no coincidence you're finding it now.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_4: (That message... I think I should trust it.)
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_7: It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_8: Rinascita, also called the Land of Echoes, is renowned for its Echo technologies. It's home to many like Abby who have physical forms.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_9: (Rinascita? I may finally learn who Abby really is...)
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_10: It just so happens that the best time to visit Rinascita is now.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_13: As the celebrated Carnevale returns to Rinascita, the Montelli family, proud organizers of this grand festival, extend an invitation for you to grace Ragunna with your esteemed presence and partake in the celebrations.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_15: In the spirit of goodwill, we have arranged a modest sum for your use during your stay in Rinascita. These funds are available at your convenience at the Averardo Bank.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_16: The Montelli family holds in high regard each of its many friendships. Should you choose to place the Blake Bloom upon the Golden Scale, we shall consider you our most honored guest and a lifelong friend of the family.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_17: The Montelli family eagerly awaits your arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_19: The Montellis are one of the leading families in Ragunna, a city-state within Rinascita. Their trade connections with the Black Shores prompted this invitation.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_20: It is Rinascita's grandest festival. During this time, Ragunna's port relaxes its regulations to welcome visitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_23: Yes. It's also an excellent travel destination.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_24: However... Rinascita is particularly special to the Black Shores.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_25: The Threnodian's revival in Jinzhou has triggered similar reactions in other countries, with Rinascita as the one exception. We've detected no frequency fluctuations related to Threnodians there.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_28: While many of our Bloom Bearers have visited Rinascita city-states before, our presence is often met with a hint of skepticism.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_29: Given the circumstances, the best approach would be to visit as a guest of a prominent family.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_31: How can we get to Rinascita?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_33: Please wait... I'll open a portal for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_36: Opening a portal will drain your computing power. I think it's better served for Black Shores operations.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_37: You needn't worry about this small matter.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_38: It would be better to keep a low profile.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_40: I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_1: There you are! I've got your ship readied!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_2: You'll have to sail to Rinascita, but the Threnodian ruckuses everywhere have left you with only the dinghies.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_3: Don't worry, behold my private stash. Remarkably fit for keeping a low profile, if I may say so myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_8: Tiny but mighty. It's got all the essentials.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_9: Ah, stuck on "bigger is better," are we? Haven't you heard "less is more"?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_10: This is cutting-edge gear from the New Fed World Expo. Nearly lost my shirt haggling for it. Planning to stock up for the Black Shores.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_11: Word is, Ragunnesi treat the Sentinel like a god—churches and all. Real holy rollers. When in Ragunna, do as the Ragunnesi do, ok?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_12: Now, let me work my magic on the autopilot. Before you know it, you'll be cruising into Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_13: Just give me a holler when you're ready to go.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_15: I still need to pack up.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_16: Then off we go. Our destination is—
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_19: This better be a safe journey...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_20: Hold onto your britches! We're about to go from zero to light speed!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_1: So, are you ready now, captain?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_3: I still need to pack up.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_4: Then off we go. Our destination is—
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_7: This better be a safe journey...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_8: Hold onto your britches! We're about to go from zero to light speed!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_5_9: No problem. You can always find me here.
Event_FSHHMDDZYM_2_21: Hmph. We'll make him talk when we catch him.

Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_6: Shh, it's probably napping! But its frequency is way off from the other Echoes...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_7: *Sniff* Nah, doesn't smell like an Echo to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_8: No way that's a supply chest! Its frequency is weird...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_9: This chest? It's our first mate's personal haven.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_10: All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_12: Well, you see, she's rather reserved. Her way of being friendly… is an acquired taste.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_13: This coin is one of her prized possessions. I'd wager it's her way of saying "Nice to meet you."
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_15: Haha... Maybe she's taken by your rapport with Abby.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_2: You'll find Echo boats ahead to ferry you straight into the heart of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_3: Are you not going into town?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_4: Well, the Carnevale hasn't started yet. We're just passing through, lending our friends a hand.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_5: And a quiet arrival? That's not our style. We'll sail into Ragunna with flair—complete with a dazzling show and the loudest of ovations.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_6: Don't forget to stash some confetti in your pockets for the occasion!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_9: My pleasure! Speaking of which, where's that charming little companion of yours?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_11: Is it asleep? The fog likely caused this. Don't worry. Echoes will recover when they're out of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_12: Oh, and do yourself a favor, try our Nectarwine. They say one drop of the "Gocce di Divino" will let you rendezvous with the Sentinel in your dreams...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_13: Ha! That might just be your shortcut to seeing the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_14: May the winds be in your favor!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_16: Hmm... Wha... Huh? We docked already? Where is Brant and the crew?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_18: I tried waking you up just now.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_19: You did? I didn't hear a thing.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_20: Whoa, this is Ragunna, huh? How do we get into town?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_21: Let's take a look around first.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_22: Go forth, dear pilgrims, on your sacred journey. May the Sentinel guide you as it has guided the returning ships.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_23: Go forth, Andreas... "The Fool." The benevolent Primus has blessed you with this sacred pilgrimage. May you find the righteous path on your voyage.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_24: If you're all so righteous, why don't you join the pilgrimage yourselves!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_25: Our duty remains here, to shepherd the lost. I grieve for you, my brother... for you have strayed from the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_26: Ha... Haha... Truth... Don't make me laugh...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_27: Your transgression is absolved before the sacred Pilgrim's Sail. Go now, and board with humility.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_28: Wait a moment, traveler... While you may harbor doubts, I implore you not to disrupt their pilgrimage.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_29: Perhaps staying silent now would better serve your interests.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_31: Pardon my intrusion. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a modest playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for my latest work.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_33: A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm working on a play—tales of pilgrims striving to reach the Sentinel's promised land...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_34: Word of a new Pilgrim's Sail about to depart brought me here. I came hoping to glean fresh ideas.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_1: Ah, new allies born from the perils of the high seas! What better way to begin an epic story?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_3: Merely my duty, dear friend. The mists thicken once more, shrouding this ever-tumultuous path. A maiden voyage for you, I presume?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_4: These waters teem with colossal, mystical Tacet Discords. That behemoth you saw is called "Cetus the Tidebreaker."
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_5: It is a gentle giant that usually keeps to deep waters and exhibits no aggressive behavior...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_8: I saw something odd on its hide. Could that be the cause of its madness?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_9: That big fella smells of sadness and anger all over...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_10: Well, well, who's this little beach ball? A talking Echo! Clever little thing! Got a name?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_11: What? First off, I'm not little! And beach ball? Really? Also, spill your name before you go askin' mine!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_12: Oh my, where are my manners? I do apologize.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_13: Brant's the name, captain of this fine vessel. As you can tell, we are a troupe, a merry band of fools chasing freedom across the seas!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_14: Please forgive the lack of propriety. Now, travelers from afar, may I know your names?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_17: I'm the watcher of the realm, master of both light and darkness.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_19: Whoa, hold up! My name's Abby! This is {PlayerName}!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_20: Aw, c'mon, enough with the fancy talk!... My name's Abby, and this is {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_21: Hehe, {PlayerName} and Abby! Splendid! "All who step aboard, guests of honor be! With names exchanged, friendship's born at sea!"
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_22: Ahoy, crew! Let's give our new mates a proper welcome!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_23: Welcome to the one and only Troupe of Fools!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_25: Are those… Echoes? Incredible! Never seen 'em like this before. Hmph, they're almost as special as me… like, 60, no, 70% as special! *Hiccup*
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_27: Ha ha ha, your little companion is quite amusing. I presume you must be headed to Rinascita for the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_28: Yes. We heard it's a big festival.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_29: Indeed it is! The crown jewel of Rinascita's calendar. Ah, the endless masquerades, the sumptuous feasts, the wine flowing like rivers, and the music that never sleeps! For a few glorious nights, all your cares disappear!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_30: And at the Carnevale's peak, our Sentinel Imperator will crown the festival's finest performer with the "Laurel."
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_31: Does the Laurel get you an audience with the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_32: Ha! Of course not. No mortal's ever laid eyes on the divine Sentinel up in the heaven of heavens. But the Laureate may hear the Sentinel's voice.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_33: We've got a real Laureate in our troupe. Shame he didn't sail with us today. Oh, the tales he would tell! You'd love to hear about his glory days.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_34: Chatting with the Sentinel if you get the Laurel? That's somethin'!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_35: Are you also attending the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_36: Absolutely! It's been a decade since the last Carnevale. We're not about to miss this one.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_37: Sentinel or Laurel, it matters not...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_38: The Troupe of Fools shall forever breathe freedom and unbridled joy into that city.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_41: Fog? Ew, I don't like the smell coming from the sea now.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_42: Beware, my friends. The fog can affect Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_43: This isn't just bad weather. It's a Waveworn Phenomenon. Many Tacet Discords lurk in the fog, ready to obliterate any passing ship.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_44: But fear not! Our vessel shall not perish here! Before you stands a seasoned captain!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_45: Hark, brave crew! Secure the lines and unfurl the sails! The helm is mine to command!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_46: The final curtain shall not fall here! Our saga must endure!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_9_1: The mysterious and giant Echo bellows a deep, resonating greeting.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_9_7: …It's stumped about why fries don't get some seagulls…
Main_Linaxita_2_0_9_8: Quit with the wacky noises already!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_9_10: It happily bobs its head, careful not to affect the ship's hull.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_2_1: Seems like there's been a lot of mist lately, hm?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_2_2: It's not a good sign. The Carnevale is fast approaching...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_3_1: Andreas... That ship... No, no, I must stop that ship!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_3_2: ...Have you gone mad? You can't stop the Pilgrim's Sail. The Order will arrest you!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_4_1: Hello there! Need a lift to the city? Hop on this Gondola right here.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_4_4: Correct! In Ragunna, we sail in Echoes. They are trusted and reliable helpers, gifts from divinity.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_4_5: A third of a Ragunnesi's life is spent on a Gondola. Pretty amazing, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_4_6: This little one will get you there safe and sound.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_1: I didn't know all the ships in Ragunna are Echoes. That troupe isn't as special as I thought...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_2: Now I can't even imagine what kind of Echoes we might see in the city.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_3: Maybe we'll come across some that look like you, a whole pack of them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_4: You're kidding me... Even in the Land of Echoes, I, Abby, will always be the most special one!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_7: Excuse me. First-time visitors must cooperate for inspection.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_9: Reserved Terminals should be declared upon entry. May I see your declaration form, please?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_12: These are the rules. I'll need you to cooperate.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_13: Forgive the inconvenience. By the Order's decree, all visitors must undergo customs clearance to ensure safety...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_17: Ah, I see you are a guest of the Montelli family. You are granted permission to bring your Reserved Terminal into Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_18: We apologize for any trouble caused. All Echoes, even those in Reserved Terminals, are seen as Divine Envoys. Once they are baptized, they too will receive Imperator's blessings.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_19: Does that mean I can see the Sentinel in person?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_20: I don't have any plans to do that.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_21: Naturally! We are all "united" under the Sentinel's influence, free from "division."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_22: The Sentinel is with you, me—all of us.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_23: Their presence is eternal in our hearts, guiding us always...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_24: Rest assured, for our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. Laud Their name, and you will find solace!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_25: Their presence is eternal in our hearts, guiding us always...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_26: Preach with respect and patience, lest you induce doubt and confusion.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_28: I'll take it from here. Greetings, esteemed guest. I am Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_29: The city of Ragunna welcomes your arrival. Many visitors are here for the upcoming Carnevale. To ensure everyone enjoys the festival safely, the Order has tightened the customs procedures and added new regulations...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_30: Some information might be overlooked on your declaration form. Please accept our apologies.

Side_XYHTZST_11_3: Interested in the Moon Shooter? It's a traditional activity in Jinzhou.
Side_XYHTZST_11_4: These past years, TD waves have kept us all on edge. Who's got time for celebrations with monsters at our doorstep?
Side_XYHTZST_11_5: But this year's different. Thanks to your contributions, I get to celebrate again.
Side_XYHTZST_11_7: I just did what needed to be done.
Side_XYHTZST_11_8: Haha, such modesty. Alright, I'll let you enjoy the game.
Side_XYHTZST_11_9: This shooting game should be easy for you. No battlefield pressure here, just fun.
Side_XYHTZST_13_1: The fighting in Jinzhou is finally calming down, giving us a break at Rearguard Base. I finally got some time off.
Side_XYHTZST_13_2: My sister Qingning suggested we make the most of it and enjoy the festival in Taoyuan Vale, so here we are, joining the celebrations.
Side_XYHTZST_13_3: I've trained new soldiers for so long, I've become quite good at shooting myself. Qingning always says I'm too focused on work even during downtime.
Side_XYHTZST_13_4: I won't deny it—I take pride in the duty I carry.
Side_XYHTZST_13_5: Maybe I'll even find a few promising recruits for the Midnight Rangers. Who knows?
Side_XYHTZST_15_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. Have you ever heard the tale of the Fox and the Wheel?
Side_XYHTZST_15_2: Doesn't ring a bell to me.
Side_XYHTZST_15_4: The Fox is one of the Sentinels in Huanglong. People often call it "Hsin."
Side_XYHTZST_15_5: Like our Sentinel "Jué," Hsin has its own state to protect.
Side_XYHTZST_15_6: But Hsin loves to join in the celebrations with its people.
Side_XYHTZST_15_8: It's said that if you hear the leaves rustling, it must be Hsin wandering in the woods. Sometimes, it even leaves behind small, whimsical gifts, like this lottery wheel here.
Side_XYHTZST_15_9: People consider this a good omen, as the sound of the spinning wheel mimics the rustling leaves in the tale.
Side_XYHTZST_15_12: True or not, people love blessings. It doesn't matter if it makes sense, it's part of the local culture's charm.
Side_XYHTZST_15_13: You have to admit, spinning a lottery wheel is always a thrill.
Side_XYHTZST_16_1: Come and spin for good luck here! Win amazing prizes on this special day! Don't miss out!
Side_XYHTZST_17_1: My shoulders are so stiff... guess I don't have the same energy I once had.
Side_XYHTZST_17_2: Most of the prizes are the latest designs from the Pioneer Association's production department. There's some all-new ones too, so they'll get some buzz.
Side_XYHTZST_17_3: If someone wins a prize and spreads the word, it could be the next big thing!
Side_XYHTZST_17_4: The Pioneer Association really needs a makeover. We need more appeal to get new recruits, you know?
Side_XYHTZST_17_5: How about giving it a try yourself, {PlayerName}?
Side_XYHTZST_19_1: A full moon hangs in the midnight sky...
Side_XYHTZST_19_2: Waves crash and echo, cliffs stand high...
Side_XYHTZST_19_3: Excuse me, is this for the lantern riddles?
Side_XYHTZST_19_4: You're in the right place! See these lanterns? They are all set for the game!
Side_XYHTZST_19_5: The Moon-Chasing Festival fuels my brilliance! It ignites my creativity, setting the stage for my next masterpiece!
Side_XYHTZST_19_6: Don't worry about running out of riddles. I'll keep up with your guessing speed...
Side_XYHTZST_19_7: A promise made is a promise kept!
Side_XYHTZST_19_8: By the way, your name sounds familiar. {PlayerName}... Aha! You must be that legendary hero! The one as knowledgeable as I am!
Side_XYHTZST_19_9: Eyeing the prizes? Haha, solve the lantern riddles and they're all yours!
Side_XYHTZST_2_1: ...Peel the shrimp, leave the tails, coat them all with bean flour... Once that's done, arrange them in the shape of a fan...
Side_XYHTZST_2_4: Oh, look who's here! Good to see you, {PlayerName}. Been hearing all about your adventures at the tea house. Must be pretty busy, huh?
Side_XYHTZST_2_5: See what I'm making? It's a secret, ancient recipe! This one's called Shrimp Fan.
Side_XYHTZST_2_6: See this? They're all handwritten recipes I've collected from people. Careful! The paper's thin.
Side_XYHTZST_2_7: I travelled the world collecting them when I was young man. As a gourmet, I can never refuse a delicacy.
Side_XYHTZST_2_8: Since we're celebrating the festival now, I thought it would be nice to whip up some new dishes.
Side_XYHTZST_2_9: Panhua and Mahe have their own business to attend to and can't be here in person, so I brought some of their dishes along.
Side_XYHTZST_2_12: Not bad, hm? I prefer eating over cooking, but it doesn't mean I can't cook.
Side_XYHTZST_2_13: Golden Sesame Tofu, Roasted Stuffed Chicken, Osmanthus Pork Stew... All traditional dishes! Try some, won't you?
Side_XYHTZST_20_1: A sharp mind is all you need to solve the riddles. Come on, you can do this!
Side_XYHTZST_21_1: Ling from the Academy usually organizes these activities. But this year, she wanted to join in on the fun, so I asked Professor Bosong to take her around.
Side_XYHTZST_21_2: Ling is a student at the Academy. Something happened to her family... and ever since then, Professor Bosong has been looking after her.
Side_XYHTZST_21_3: They get along great, but they hardly ever get a break at the Academy. So I stepped in and let them take off to enjoy the festival.
Side_XYHTZST_21_4: Besides, for a poet of my talent, writing a few riddles is a piece of cake!
Side_XYHTZST_24_1: Would you prefer landscapes or calligraphy on your fan?
Side_XYHTZST_25_1: You see, the brushstrokes in this landscape capture the essence of these towering mountains with such precision.
Side_XYHTZST_25_2: My uncle used to say that mastering just one aspect of a painting takes a lifetime.
Side_XYHTZST_25_3: Now I see what he meant.
Side_XYHTZST_25_4: I guess I'll have the chance to appreciate more artwork at this year's Fair.
Side_XYHTZST_27_2: You're a researcher from Huaxu Academy...
Side_XYHTZST_27_4: Yes, that's me. I'm glad you still remember.
Side_XYHTZST_27_5: Oh don't worry, I'll introduce myself again. I'm Zhixiu, a researcher at Huaxu Academy. We met before, remember?
Side_XYHTZST_27_6: Long story short, interested in trying out "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"?
Side_XYHTZST_27_7: In this game, participants race as Gulpuffs.
Side_XYHTZST_27_8: Jinzhou's Echo technology might not be as popular as Rinascita's, but I think it has great potential.
Side_XYHTZST_27_9: Entertainment is key here. Plus, it's good for collecting research data.
Side_XYHTZST_27_10: Besides this swimming challenge, I've got some other events lined up. Hope you enjoy them, {PlayerName}.
Side_XYHTZST_28_1: Gulpuffs are so soft... Hmm, they do have an interesting texture.
Side_XYHTZST_29_1: Using Echoes for entertainment could be pretty cool.
Side_XYHTZST_29_2: At Huaxu Academy, we focus on what works best in practice.
Side_XYHTZST_29_3: But… not everything we study has to be practical, I guess. Research that brings laughter also has its value.
Side_XYHTZST_29_4: What do you think, {PlayerName}? Aren't Gulpuffs just adorable?
Side_XYHTZST_3_1: Welcome! What can I get you? You can't enjoy the festival with an empty belly.
Side_XYHTZST_31_1: Combine the Silver Dragon with this one… and the Thunderstorm…
Side_XYHTZST_31_2: Oh, {PlayerName}, it's you! Welcome! Just give me a moment to check the inventory here.
Side_XYHTZST_31_4: So many different kinds of fireworks.
Side_XYHTZST_31_5: You know what, I'll sort them out later.
Side_XYHTZST_31_6: Yep, and some experimental ones too, hehe…
Side_XYHTZST_31_7: Sorry for the wait, {PlayerName}. See any fireworks you like? I've got pretty much every type here.
Side_XYHTZST_31_8: Skyrockets, sparklers, smoke flares… you name it.
Side_XYHTZST_31_9: Oh, I also provide recipes for making your own custom fireworks.
Side_XYHTZST_31_10: Who knows, maybe yours will steal the show at the Moonlit Fair!
Side_XYHTZST_32_1: Come on up, come on in! Have a look at the fireworks!
Side_XYHTZST_33_1: Hmm… so sleepy. Eh, what's new?
Side_XYHTZST_33_2: With the hours I've been pulling, it's a miracle I'm still awake. Reminds me of my Lollo Logistics days.
Side_XYHTZST_33_3: I promised my daughter we'd set up the firework stall at the Moonlit Fair. Gotta keep that promise.
Side_XYHTZST_33_4: I'll design the patterns, and you deal with the hands-on stuff. Together, we'll create something memorable!
Side_XYHTZST_33_5: All this work… Well, as long as my girl loves it, it's no trouble at all.
Side_XYHTZST_37_1: …Let's see, we've got 21 fireworks and the full moon on the 15th. Together, that makes 36! Six times six! Such a lucky number!
Side_XYHTZST_37_2: A good omen for a lucky life!
Side_XYHTZST_37_3: ...I don't understand a word you're saying.
Side_XYHTZST_37_4: Hehe, it's numerology. It's a bit of a mystery, so don't worry about it.
Side_XYHTZST_37_5: How about you draw a fortune stick, {PlayerName}? These are Sentinel Fortune Sticks, each one corresponding to a specific Sentinel prophecy.
Side_XYHTZST_37_6: A good draw will bring you luck and fortune.
Side_XYHTZST_37_7: What if I get a bad one?
Side_XYHTZST_37_8: Just laugh it off! It's only a divination, no big deal.
Side_XYHTZST_37_9: Besides, with the Sentinel's blessings on this special day, how could you possibly get a bad draw?
Side_XYHTZST_37_10: ... Don't tell me they're all good draws.
Side_XYHTZST_37_11: Well, well, if you say it out loud, the luck might not work.
Side_XYHTZST_38_1: Draw a fortune stick for luck and blessings! See into the future, see for yourself!
Side_XYHTZST_39_1: I got into divination from watching those plays about our heroes.
Side_XYHTZST_39_2: You know, they always start as nobodies until they meet a divination master who sets them on the right path.
Side_XYHTZST_39_3: An opportunity, isn't it? That's why I decided to learn divination myself.
Side_XYHTZST_39_4: I thought I was getting pretty good, so I tried using divination to find my lost glasses.
Side_XYHTZST_39_5: First try said they were under the bed. The second try, on the rooftop. The third try, in my pocket.
Side_XYHTZST_39_7: Well, I couldn't find them anywhere, so I just bought a new pair.
Side_XYHTZST_39_8: That's when I realized divination isn't as magical as in those hero plays.
Side_XYHTZST_39_9: It's mostly for fun. No need to take it too seriously. But hey, it's not bad to believe in something… Maybe I just need a bit more practice.
Side_XYHTZST_4_1: Back in my Pioneer Association days, I was quite the young adventurer.
Side_XYHTZST_4_2: But as time flew by, I settled down here in Jinzhou. Life's good now, but sometimes I find myself dreaming about all the wonderful places I once explored.
Side_XYHTZST_4_3: Even in the furthest of lands, there's people. And where there's people, there's food.
Side_XYHTZST_4_4: Take the different regions of Huanglong, for instance—no Wuthercake is the same. They've each got their own unique taste!
Side_XYHTZST_4_5: Try this one. It's the Jinzhou Wuthercake! It's authentic, I promise.
Side_XYHTZST_41_2: You watched the show, right? What did you think?
Side_XYHTZST_41_5: Hehe, sweet of you to say.
Side_XYHTZST_41_6: Most of my puppet shows were missions before. One wrong move and my target could escape, or worse.
Side_XYHTZST_41_7: But now, I can just relax and perform as I like. Feels kinda nice, to be honest.
Side_XYHTZST_41_8: Opportunities like this are rare. Duty calls, and I must answer. Sometimes, you might not be able to reach me.
Side_XYHTZST_41_9: I know you won't, but don't feel lonely when I'm away.
Side_XYHTZST_41_10: I pity the next criminal who gets in your way.
Side_XYHTZST_41_11: Fighting crime is everyone's duty in Huanglong.
Side_XYHTZST_41_12: You work hard to maintain the hard-won peace. Admirable.
Side_XYHTZST_41_13: Of course. After all, I've got... certain people to protect.
Side_XYHTZST_41_14: Well said. The safety of everyone is important to me.
Side_XYHTZST_41_15: Hehe, it feels good to have my efforts recognized.
Side_XYHTZST_41_16: Anyway, thanks for inviting me to the Moonlit Fair, {PlayerName}. I'm glad you did.
Side_XYHTZST_49_4: You're a household name in Jinzhou, and undoubtedly a strong warrior.
Side_XYHTZST_49_5: In the name of the Ghost Hounds, I present my respect to you.
Side_XYHTZST_49_6: If you ever need my blade, or require some... clean and discreet work done, feel free to come find me anytime.
Side_XYHTZST_49_8: Thanks... but I don't think it's neccesary.
Side_XYHTZST_49_10: You know where to find me if you change your mind.
Side_XYHTZST_51_3: These riddles are so interesting, especially the ones about plants.
Side_XYHTZST_51_4: Mr. Xieyang must be really dedicated to this activity.
Side_XYHTZST_51_6: He even set aside his favorite poetry for this.
Side_XYHTZST_51_7: Looks like the visitors are enjoying these riddles too.
Side_XYHTZST_51_8: I might try writing some myself to introduce more plants to everyone.
Side_XYHTZST_51_10: Just make sure they're not too difficult.
Side_XYHTZST_51_11: Understanding plants is crucial for an adventurer!
Side_XYHTZST_51_12: Don't worry, I'll make them easy and fun!
Side_XYHTZST_53_1: Watching these young men practice reminds me of my days as an apprentice.
Side_XYHTZST_53_2: Back then, all I cared about was strength and victory. Every drop of sweat I shed held such significance.
Side_XYHTZST_53_4: Now? Hmm, I realize the world is much more complicated than I thought.
Side_XYHTZST_53_5: But if I had the chance to do it all over again, I wouldn't hesitate. After all, I learned a lot from the mistakes of my youth.
Side_XYHTZST_55_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. Here for the Moonlit Fair too?
Side_XYHTZST_55_3: Hehe, in that case, let's make sure we soak up all the fun.
Side_XYHTZST_55_4: So much to see and do at a grand festival like this. If you're not careful, these moments slip away like whispers in the wind…
Side_XYHTZST_55_6: Can't believe how fast time's going!
Side_XYHTZST_55_7: Yes, so it makes perfect sense to enjoy the Moonlit Fair to the fullest.
Side_XYHTZST_55_8: If you're tired, maybe sneak in a little nap. Speaking of which… Hmm, I'm feeling a bit sleepy myself now…
Side_XYHTZST_57_1: Hello there. You must be {PlayerName}. Your name is often spoken of throughout Jinzhou.
Side_XYHTZST_57_2: Allow me to introduce myself. My name's Danjin. I'm currently visiting all the different regions of Huanglong.
Side_XYHTZST_57_3: Nice to meet you. What are you doing here?
Side_XYHTZST_57_4: Oh, I'm sending off a lantern.
Side_XYHTZST_57_6: Yes. You see these delicate lanterns here? People say they'll carry your wishes to a faraway land.
Side_XYHTZST_57_7: In that land, free from pain and evil, wishes will manifest and eventually return to us here.
Side_XYHTZST_57_10: Yes. Maybe you can try sending off a lantern yourself. You must have wishes to make, right?
Side_XYHTZST_6_3: The Liondance Troupe performed on the Main Street earlier, on those Plum Blossom Poles, and the crowd loved it.
Side_XYHTZST_6_4: So I was thinking, why not do it again at the Moonlit Fair? Everyone could give it a try.
Side_XYHTZST_6_5: After all, festivals are all about having fun, right? The more, the merrier!
Side_XYHTZST_9_1: Have you ever met Xiuyi, {PlayerName}? He used to perform on the Main Street.
Side_XYHTZST_9_2: We're both in the Liondance Troupe. If you've seen his performances, you might recognize the Plum Blossom Pole dance.
Side_XYHTZST_9_3: We haven't celebrated the Moonlit Fair in so long. This year is our chance to set up a stall to promote our troupe's services.
Side_XYHTZST_9_4: Ahem... It's not just about business. It's also about introducing more people to the Liondance.
Side_XYHTZST_9_5: When I get some free time, I'll show you the dance myself! I need to keep my skills sharp.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_1: Seek salvation from where all began... What's that supposed to mean?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_1: Is there anything else you'd like to know about Ragunna? I'll do my best to answer your questions.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_6: Our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. They are the lord of the sky and seas, protector of the land.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_7: They freed us from division and conflict, treating all equally and uniting us as one.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_8: Legends say the Sentinel's breath becomes a gentle breeze, blessing Ragunna's ships and guiding them safely to their destinations.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_9: Their radiant gaze pierces the darkness, illuminating the way forward. In reverence, people built lighthouses across the island.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_10: The Sentinel never boasts of Their deeds but bestows miracles in subtle ways, as it is written.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_11: "I am the gentle breeze that caresses you in green meadows. I am the unseen guardian as you walk in the valley of shadows."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_12: "I am with you, steadfast and unwavering, from the past, through the present, and beyond the future."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_13: The Order of the Deep is Ragunna's de facto authority, handling everything from city management and disputes to diplomacy.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_14: We revere our Sentinel and act on Their behalf, overseeing all Common Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_15: The La Guardia, the armed Echoes you saw before you entered the city, are part of the Order, working alongside us to keep Ragunna safe and orderly.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_16: By the Sentinel's will, all citizens of Ragunna can use Common Echoes by simply registering their information with the Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_17: If you face any issues during your stay, please report them to the Order. We are here to ensure your stay is comfortable.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_18: The Carnevale is Rinascita's grandest annual festival, lasting seven days. Its theme is said to be "transcend the flesh to the divine realm."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_19: The outer seas of Rinascita were once plagued by Tacet Discords and Lament occurrences, making sea travel impossible. Isolated on the island, the Ragunnesi found solace in the epics recited by limping poets and ballads sung by blind singers.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_20: Stories from many lands were shared, forming a cradle of culture and art. The people mingled, dreaming of the world beyond, envisioning a different life for themselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_21: These dreams came to life during the spring rite in honor of the Sentinel. People dressed in costumes, setting aside their positions and prejudices to come together for a grand parade—this is the origin of today's Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_24: A stage will be set on the first day of the Carnevale. Wear a mask, and you can be part of the show.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_25: The masks set people free, allowing everyone to shed their usual roles and revel in the celebration. We haven't had a Carnevale in many years, so this one is poised to be pretty special.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_27: The streets will be alive with spectacular performances. Vendors from far and wide will showcase unique items.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_28: Even without a mask, you can still take in the atmosphere and pick up some souvenirs.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_29: In Rinascita, anyone can summon Common Echoes from the Nexus, whether they're a Resonator or not.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_30: It has been modified by our Sentinel to allow Echoes to appear in physical forms.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_31: However, not all Common Echoes are available for personal use. For example, La Guardia are armed guards managed exclusively by the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_32: Echoes affiliated with the Order are identified by their halo and respond only to its members, so please be aware of this.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_34: If you have any further questions, please feel free to ask. It's our duty as Acolytes to assist every visitor.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_12_2: Let's go get our money first.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_12_3: The invitation mentioned we could pick it up from Averardo Bank.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_7_1: Follow this road and you'll reach the Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_7_2: To the Ragunnesi, the Sentinel is the Divinity, a holy beacon guiding our way.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_7_3: We hold the Sentinel and all Their gifts in the highest reverence, especially the Echoes, which bear profound significance to both the Order and the people of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_7_6: (...You've been hiccuping for a while. Do Echoes get indigestion as well?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_2: Yes. Most newcomers to the city are amazed by the spectacle.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_3: Now we're talking! This is what the Land of Echoes should look like! I thought all of Rinascita's Echoes were like that grumpy poker face we met at the docks...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_5: Eh... Hi! I'm Abby. Nice to meet ya!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_6: Ah! Hello, I'm Phoebe! Nice to meet you, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_8: A little Echo holds up a gift and presents it to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_9: They look different from the Echoes we just saw.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_11: Yes, thanks to the Sentinel's blessing, most of the Common Echoes in Rinascita are friendly and approachable.
RogueBuffPool_11012001_BuffDesc: After defeating a certain number of enemies with Resonance Skill, casting Resonance Skill summons Hypercubes.
RogueBuffPool_11012001_BuffDesc_1: Gain the following effect after defeating <color=#ff5454>3</color> enemies with Resonance Skill: Casting a Resonance Skill summons Hypercubes to attack the target, dealing <color=#3cea36>1000%</color> DMG in total. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
RogueBuffPool_11012001_BuffDesc_0:
"With top-notch strength, plasticity, toughness, and corrosion resistance, this low-density, lightweight material can adjust its magnetic and electrical properties with temperature changes and has an extremely high melting point..."
Principal Investigator Xiangli Yao's prosthetic arm has sparked widespread discussion among researchers, who all agree that it is made from "a perfect material." It can not only transform swiftly but also perform as effectively as standard tools in practical applications.
RogueBuffPool_11012002_BuffDesc: After defeating a certain number of enemies with Resonance Skill, casting Resonance Skill summons an Ivory Herald.
RogueBuffPool_11012002_BuffDesc_1: Gain the following effect after defeating <color=#ff5454>3</color> enemies with Resonance Skill: Casting Resonance Skill summons an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing <color=#3cea36>500%</color> DMG in total. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
RogueBuffPool_11012002_BuffDesc_0:
"Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away; the painted world fades, forgotten today."
Upon arriving in Jinzhou, Zhezhi resided in Xiehua Village for a while. Inspired by the scenery outside her window, she captured it in a painting.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc: ATK increases after clearing a certain number of Memory Zones with [Phantasm Partita] enemies.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc_1: Gain <color=#3cea36>40%</color> ATK increase after clearing <color=#ff5454>2</color> Memory Zones with <color=#ff5454>[Phantasm Partita]</color> enemies.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc_0:
Once in a moment of despair, Sanhua witnessed a golden snowfall, dazzling like petals cascading from the heavens.
Drawn to the sight, she forgot her pain and predicament.
Only later did she realize they were actually fallen Bodhi blossoms.
To this day, that ethereal scene enchants her dreams, where swirling snow transforms into a golden deluge of petals. These dreams bring her solace, giving her the strength to face her anomalous visions with calm determination.
RogueBuffPool_11012005_BuffDesc_0:
In Jinzhou, Mortefi is the creative force behind 80% of popular children's toys and entertainment facilities. From the Spinning Bloop to the Swinging Loongboat and the Sabyrboar Scooter, his designs always captivate young minds. Surprisingly, he doesn't charge any patent fees for these designs. 

For Mortefi, it's not about money; it's about seeing the joy, wonder, and admiration in children's eyes. 

Or perhaps, it's a way for him to recapture his own lost childhood.
RogueBuffPool_11012006_BuffDesc_0:
Ali, a classmate of Chixia's, once described to her how poignant their migration was: a time marked by relentless disruptions from the Tacet Discords, when hunger forced them to eat grass or tree bark. Yet, Chixia also remembers savoring this green grass cake, always roasted crusty and seasoned with spicy sauce. It remains a delightful treat etched in her memory.
When she asked her mother about their journey to Jinzhou after school, her mother playfully responded that it was a story open to Chixia's imagination.
RogueBuffPool_11012007_BuffDesc: Reduce DEF for the next few Memory Zones, then increase ATK.
RogueBuffPool_11012007_BuffDesc_1: Reduce DEF by <color=#ff5454>80%</color> in the following <color=#ff5454>3</color> Memory Zones. After successfully clearing them, remove this effect and gain <color=#3cea36>60%</color> ATK increase.
RogueBuffPool_11012007_BuffDesc_0: The foe, nearing its complete form, views this as the most potent weapon, which relentlessly sows seeds of destruction and awakens humanity's primal fear of war.
RogueBuffPool_11012008_BuffDesc_0: Emerging from the bright moon, it threatened to engulf the earth, casting a shadow over the people in Jinzhou.
RogueBuffPool_11012009_BuffDesc_0: It serves as the shadowy pawn of unseen adversaries and heralds the onset of ceaseless woes of war.
RogueBuffPool_11012003_BuffDesc: After defeating a certain number of enemies with Basic Attacks, summon occasional Judgment Strikes when dealing DMG.
RogueBuffPool_11012003_BuffDesc_1: Gain the following effect after defeating <color=#ff5454>10</color> enemies with Basic Attack: Upon dealing damage, there is a <color=#3cea36>25%</color> chance to summon a Judgment Strike that deals <color=#3cea36>200%</color> DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 1.5s.
RogueBuffPool_11012003_BuffDesc_0: Yinlin is accustomed to walking in shadows, much like the threads of lightning in her hand. These threads silently ensnare her prey, delivering an unexpected fatal blow. With the charge gathered at her fingertips, she metes out punishment to those who deserve it. Once the myriad threads are lifted, everything in her grasp becomes nothing more than lifeless puppets.

Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_2: Ciao, Zani! Knocking off early today, huh?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_4: Is that so? You seem alright, considering. So, what will it be today? The "Adios, Workdays" or the "Thank Goodness It's the Holiday" platter?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_3: *Sniffs* Oh what's that smell... it's so good!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_5: Hi there... Gosh, this tastes amazing...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_7: Did not expect to see an Echo residing in a Resonator's body... Interesting.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_8: Even someone from the Land of Echoes finds it surprising?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_9: Have you ever seen Echoes like Abby？
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_10: Well, foreign Echoes aren't exactly a daily sight here.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_11: ...Can't say I have. Why do you sound like you're helping a lost kid find their home...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_12: Told ya! I'm always the most special one! Mmm, this is so good!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_14: You will enjoy the food, of course. We Ragunnesi take pride in our food traditions.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_15: For instance, never overcook seafood, or you'll ruin its natural taste. Always serve freshwater fish before sea fish, or its tender flavor will be masked.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_16: I'd start with this appetizer. It complements the main course—hearty but not too heavy, perfect for those burning the midnight oil.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_17: And don't forget the aperitif. As we say, "If you can't appreciate good wine, you don't deserve good water."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_18: Now, try the Nectarwine from Egla Town. It's aged in oak barrels from the Fagaceae Peninsula, known as the "Harvest Spirit" or "Gocce di Divino" for its exceptional flavor.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_19: So this is the Gocce di Divino.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_22: ...and my vacation that never seems to come.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_23: Phew... nothing beats a good meal... Wait, what's the buzz over there?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_24: Probably the Montelli's Echo show. They've been rehearsing for days, getting ready to perform it for the Sentinel at Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_25: Intrigued, are we? The formal event will be even more spectacular.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_22_6: Thou hast come at last... I am the Imperator. Aid me, O Arbiter... that we may return the Lost unto the earthly realm!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_22_7: The other one's gotten loose... Hey! It's getting away!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_2: The Vitreum Dancer suddenly lost control... Luckily, no one got hurt.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_5: You brief her on what you just saw.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_7: Now that I think about it, the frequency vibration I sensed felt a lot like... empathy.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_9: Well, maybe telepathy? Not sure. It's hard to explain…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_10: Telepathy… Yes, according to legend, the Sentinel speaks directly into the mind of the Laureate. Could that be what happened?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_11: So the "Imperator" is the Sentinel. But who's the "Lost"? Plus, it said it needs your help, but… a Sentinel shouldn't need to ask for help, wouldn't ya say? Eh, something's not adding up, what a headache...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_12: We need to learn how the Sentinel talks to people.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_13: That Vitreum Dancer was trying to tell me something…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_14: (The Sentinel has countless ways to send a message, and through the Order is apparently the most convenient one, but why did they go through all the trouble...?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_15: (Maybe I'm wrong. Maybe calling for help was the only option?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_16: (With that message left on Tethys… Could the Sentinel here be in a situation similar to Jué's?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_17: (But it seems like the locals haven't laid eyes on their Sentinel. Everything feels off. That Echo might be our only lead right now.)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_18: Was the Echo performance hosted by the Montellis?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_20: Sorry to keep you waiting. That was Mr. Alberto from the Montelli family. Also my employer.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_21: Come to think of it, that Echo... it was looking at you. It seemed to target you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_24: Hmph, I won't pry into my ward's privacy. I only remember what I need to get the job done. Anything else I accidentally overhear just slips my mind.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_25: My orders are to guard and to guide. I do my job. Nothing more, nothing less. So if you want to investigate, I'll stick with you until you're done.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_28: Don't thank me, thank the family who hired me. Their generosity is beyond what you can imagine.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_29: Thank you for trusting in my abilities.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_31: Let's find that Vitreum Dancer first.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_32: It was complete chaos, but I spied the direction it fled… We can try our luck at the Pioneer Association.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_33: I know someone there whose Forte might help us uncover some details we missed.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_34: Sure, let's head to the Pioneer Association first.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_2: Excuse me, do you know anything about the Echo that lost control?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_3: Oh, the Sentinel is in a great rage! They are warning us, reminding us of our follies.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_4: We shouldn't have forgotten... Ten years ago, it was our unbridled indulgence that brought about divine punishment!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_5: We should have heeded Primus Fenrico's words…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_8: Oh, dear visitor from afar, you may not know. Ten years ago, the Carnevale angered the Sentinel and brought forth divine punishment. Primus Fenrico foresaw the shadow beneath the revelry and halted its spread!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_9: Simply put, many terrible accidents happened during that Carnevale, like Echoes losing control. Since then, the Primus ordered the Carnevale to stop.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_10: Most Ragunnesi don't like to talk about that tragedy, so it's understandable you haven't heard of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_11: Echoes are messengers of the Sentinel. They lost control and attacked people because they were corrupted, reflecting our transgressions against the Sentinel!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_12: This year, the Order has approved the Carnevale. We will return to our traditions… Dear visitor, please join us in praising the Sentinel. Only then can our misguided souls be forgiven…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_13: How will that Echo be handled?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_14: It may be a divine blessing, but it has committed an assault against the Sentinel's people. The corrupted will be purified under the holy light of the Genesis Nexus. As for the one that escaped, the Order will retrieve it as soon as possible to prevent further harm.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_1: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_2: Ms. Zani! It's been some time! Have you finally decided to join us?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_3: No, I'm here for something else. This is Mr. Fulmine from the Pioneer Association.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_4: Oh, hello! You've brought a new friend! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Fulmine, head of the Wutherium Film Studio under the Pioneer Association in Ragunna. How should I address you?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_6: Your name rings a bell… Oh! Y-you're the legendary Rover?!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_7: Savior from a foreign land, the dark thunderbolt streaking across the world… I've longed to meet you! By the Sentinel, let me seize this extraordinary moment!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_8: They're just titles, not worth bragging about.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_10: Wait, you're actually some kind of celebrity?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_11: Ha, indeed {Male=he;Female=she} is. Ragunna's routes have only recently opened, so {Male=his;Female=her} feats haven't made it here yet. Should you perform a great deed, trust me to ensure your name echoes throughout Ragunna!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_12: I had a nagging feeling I've met someone important... But let's get back to what matters.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_13: We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_14: It fled in this direction, and we're wondering if you can recreate the scene for us.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_15: Ah, I know the one you mean. Saw it streaking out of the city with a few Order fellows in tow.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_16: As for recreating the scene… C-MOSS, my friend, it's time to get to work!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_18: Alright, where is it? My memory of that Vitreum Dancer… Ah, I've found it!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_19: Mr. Fulmine's Forte is Celluloid Chronicle. He can convert events into film, recording all that happens within a span of time.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_20: His partner, C-MOSS, uses a "Memory Projector" Forte to show these captured moments.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_21: There it is! Take a look!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_22: So it did leave the city… This complicates matters. The area beyond is too vast to search effectively. Plus, Tacet Discords are hampering our investigation. We can't start searching just yet.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_24: (…What do you think I am? Not a chance! And I'm too sleepy to help, just wake me if there's any progress…)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_25: I'm sorry. I can only record what is plain to the eye.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_26: Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But {PlayerName}, we need a new plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_29: …Give me a moment. Ah, yes! Look at this!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_31: His garb suggests he's from the Montelli family. Could they be involved in this turmoil?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_34: Indeed. But it's rare to wear a mask before the Carnevale. He must have wanted to hide his face.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_35: Speaking of, the mask is not the typical Montelli style, and wearing it now is unusual.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_36: With their eagerness to promote Reserved Terminals, the Montellis would be the last to invite trouble now. If he's tied to the disturbance...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_37: Then perhaps we should seek Ms. Nyarla's expertise. She's known for her intricate masks, and this one seems custom.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_38: Good idea, but nobles are secretive. Direct questions might lead to unwanted attention.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_40: I'll arrange for a custom-made mask myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_41: Ah-ha, Excellent. Let's make for the Masked Reverie.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_43: Thank you for your assistance, Mr. Fulmine.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_45: We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_1: Has the perfume, compact, and jewelry set arrived?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_2: Yes, they have. Would you like them now, or shall we deliver them to your residence before tonight?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_3: Tonight… No, I'll take them now.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_4: …Of course. I'll have someone fetch them immediately. It won't take long.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_5: Welcome to Masked Reverie. From masks to elegant garments and splendid stage props, we craft it all to order. How may I help you today, my dear?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_7: Hehe, so eager to skip the pleasantries, are we? I'm right here. Do I seem invisible, or are you simply ignoring me? I am... right behind you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_8: Madame Nyarla, I saw you. Your mask gave you away.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_9: Hehe, don't spoil my secret so soon. It's not every day I get such a charming visitor.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_10: Besides, only by "hiding" oneself can the true beauty of a mask be revealed, don't you think?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_11: But scaring the guests is just your twisted sense of humor, isn't it?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_12: I hope this didn't bother you. <ano=Ombra Elusiva>Invisibility</ano> is Madame Nyarla's Forte. Madame Nyarla, this is the distinguished guest invited by the Montellis, {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} is very interested in Carnevale masks.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_13: Yes, I'd like a custom-made mask.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_14: You elaborate on the mask design you saw in Fulmine's memory to Nyarla.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_15: Hmm? That's quite a detailed description, even covering the smallest intricacies... I admit, I'm surprised.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_16: Not long ago, we customized a mask just like the one you've described.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_17: If the Carnevale is a dream shared by all Ragunnesi, then a well-crafted mask is the key to it.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_18: When faces are hidden, souls break free from the shackles of everyday life. That's why we love balls and plays, eagerly awaiting the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_19: Masks liberate our spirits. We believe they reveal what lies within. It is our honor to help our customers express their innermost selves.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_20: So, are you certain you want to custom order this particular mask?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_22: (She's suspicious... Will I be forced to reveal my hand...?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_24: If I remember correctly, the one Mr. Gilberto picked up last week looked very similar. If it's your first mask, a unique design might be more fitting?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_26: I'll be on my way now.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_27: Ahem, we spotted a fellow on the street with a mask that caught our eye… I didn't expect it to be Mr. Gilberto from the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_29: Yes, they're one of the oldest families in Rinascita. Their ancestors once ignited a war here, but they were defeated and driven out of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_30: The Fisalias are a mixed lot—while some hold honor, others bring disgrace to the name.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_31: They show new ambitions. Lately, they've taken to more prominent roles in the city, flaunting their mining ventures and acting with increasing arrogance.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_32: Speaking of which, I revised Monsieur Gilberto's mask twenty-three times…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_33: I see why it's left a deep impression…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_34: Anyway, given your standing with the Montellis, I'd advise against this design.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_36: Rumor has it the Montellis plan to push for Reserved Echoes at the Carnevale. It's stirred tension with the Fisalia family. Best avoid any association.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_37: That incident with the Montelli's Echoes going berserk... Unfortunate timing. Who knows how this will affect their promotion.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_41: So, the trail leads to the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_42: Thank you for the lead, Madame Nyarla. Oh, and we will reconsider the mask's design. Thank you for your time.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_43: Hehe, you're too polite, Mademoiselle Zani. You're my special guest, after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_44: Isn't it interesting how a small mask can both hide and reveal? I can't wait to see the "face" you'll choose to show.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_45: I look forward to your next visit. This splendid reverie is always open for you.

Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_1: Ha, Antonio, surely you know how things work here. It's always about who pays more. Is there a problem?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_2: Do you Fisalias even honor contracts?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_3: Ha, since when do Montellis fret over such trivialities?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_4: Instead of whining, maybe focus on cleaning up the mess your Echoes caused. Ha ha ha...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_5: The Fisalia man walks away, leaving Antonio fuming.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_8: Greetings, Sir Antonio. I'm Zani from the Averardo Bank.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_9: This {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here is a distinguished guest of your family, {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} was attacked by a rogue Vitreum Dancer while dining, and we're investigating.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_10: Ah, so you're… Please accept my apologies! It's a relief to see you unscathed. We're as puzzled as you are about the Echo's behavior.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_11: It's okay, but there's something else I want to know.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_12: Miss Carlotta asked me to hold nothing back, so ask away.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_13: Tell me about Reserved Terminals and Reserved Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_14: Well, before I do, a little context first.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_15: In Ragunna, the Order controls all Terminals for Echo use. They store Echoes in their Data Bank and only grant access after thorough screening.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_16: Only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a Reserved Terminal.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_17: You see, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, with little need for the special access types.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_18: However, things have changed with Ragunna opening up to the greater Solaris. People want to travel, making Reserved Terminals essential for safety outside the Order's reach.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_19: You see why demand is up. The Montellis saw an opportunity and started to develop them. After all, necessity is the mother of invention, hm?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_20: It should be celebrated, but some think we disrespect the Order's authority or even the Sentinel by doing this. The path forward has been... resistant.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_21: Heh, if you ask me, I suspect the Fisalia family has been spreading slanders about us.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_22: We back the Carnevale to showcase our Reserved Terminals to the people. It's our chance to prove their worth and attract investors.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_23: And the Fisalia family has been standing in your way?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_25: Sigh… The Fisalias have coerced our miners to break their contracts, seizing our largest vein and cutting off our Terminal supply.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_26: And it gets worse. With the Carnevale nearing and our Echoes malfunctioning, the family's Executor might have to step in.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_27: The Carnevale is at risk. While we hope it brings fortune, the festival itself is what truly matters to us, just like the rest of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_28: We must uncover why the Echo lost control. We cannot let the Fisalias use this to tarnish our reputation any further!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_29: I can help you with the investigation.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_30: That would be good for us, but it hardly seems proper to involve our esteemed guest in our troubles...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_32: Ah, understood. Thank you! But I'm afraid we can't spare any of our own to assist you. Rest assured, the Montellis are always generous. Here's an advance. Once the matter is resolved, you'll be well-rewarded.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_33: Take it. In Ragunna, if you want help, you must offer a reward and one only declines a reward when they refuse to help.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_37: Yes, that's right. Please accept it. If that's all, I must be on my way. There are many matters to attend to...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_38: Antonio departs with a sigh. The weight on his shoulders seems heavier than before.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_39: From what we know, the Montelli family has no motive for such incidents. They've been anticipating the Carnevale's arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_40: But the Fisalia family is another story. They've been against the celebration from the start, perhaps they could be behind everything? But I don't understand, what could they hope to gain by stopping the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_42: Maybe it's related to the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_43: Why do I feel like I've gotten myself into something above my pay grade…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_28_45: They say the Fisalias have been seen frequenting the Cathedral of Mercury. They must be in league with the Order. How else would they dare to seize our mine so boldly?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_29_1: Ciao, we need to get to the Cathedral of Mercury.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_1: We are now in the Fisalia Residencies territory. We should... Wait, look over there…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_2: He looks like the man we saw in Mr. Fulmine's memory. Isn't that Gilberto?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_8: Ah, more seekers. What brings you to these halls?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_9: We're here to visit Sir Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_10: Sir Gilberto...? Oh, Gilberto from the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_11: A pious soul, frequently here in prayer. But not today, it seems.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_12: I've heard whispers of you. An Acolyte mentioned your desire to meet the Sentinel. I assume you must be interested in following Their path.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_13: But I don't think you truly understand the significance of the Carnevale. Allow me to explain.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_16: You've probably heard about the connection between the Carnevale and the Sentinel, but do you know why the Carnevale hasn't been held for years?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_18: Is it because of the accident a decade ago?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_19: In the last Carnevale, a sea fog shrouded the entire city. Echoes paraded like lost souls, a dragon roared above, and a beast in the sea stirred up towering waves…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_20: It was sent as punishment and warning against our indulgence and division.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_21: This is our Primus, Fenrico, the Enlightened One.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_22: Amidst that chaos, he stepped forward and quelled the Sentinel's wrath.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_23: Ragunna's greatness was forged from its battles with the sea. It inspired a common goal in all our hearts.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_24: Without everyone working together, land cannot be cultivated, islands cannot unite, and dams cannot be built. A nation's strength lies in its unity.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_25: You see, this is why we preach restraint and control over our desires. Only through rituals can we strengthen our resolve, our unity!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_26: This is why we must banish those who stray from the right path and impose restrictions on those who threaten the common good.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_27: We've dedicated ourselves to this cause.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_28: It seems like you disapprove of holding the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_30: I simply mean that the Order's actions are always made with great deliberation.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_31: Guided by the Sentinel, we strive to unite and lead the people. We hope to build a kingdom on high, a land of the blessed… As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_32: I trust you'll have faith in the Order's judgment. We handle all matters that come to our attention.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_33: ...What did you say? How could the Montelli family...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_34: Forgive me, I must attend to pressing matters.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_35: If you have further questions, seek answers in the cathedral. We are always open to those in search of truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_36: But I remind you to keep your distance from the sacred relics and honor our customs. Otherwise, we will have no choice but to address any act of disrespect.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_33_1: What's got him so rattled that he'd leave us like that?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_33_2: He's hiding something. We saw Gilberto enter the cathedral with our own eyes. He couldn't have vanished into thin air.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_33_3: Could there be a hidden chamber or secret passage within the cathedral?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_33_4: Now that you mention it, something's not sitting right.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_34_1: I didn't expect the Order to have such a grand garden hidden here.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_34_2: But where could Gilberto have gone? Let's split up and see what we can find.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_2: What burdens weigh upon your soul?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_4: Bless me, for I have transgressed.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_5: Are you certain? Search your heart.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_6: Truly, I have nothing to confess.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_7: What do you wish to confess?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_8: I sleep too much, eat too much, and squander my days in idleness.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_10: May the Sentinel grant your absolution. Go in peace, and transgress no more.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_11: Now, I shall open the path to your ascension.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_1_1: The weather is so good today. You're my Jewel Boba!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_1_2: Huh? Hahaha, so I'm a boba tea to you?

Side_NPCZYJWBTH_10_1: Your plan for the Moon-Chasing Festival events was so perfect.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_10_2: It's all because you gave me such good suggestions.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_10_3: It's because you had such good ideas in the first place.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_2: Hello, can I help you with anything?
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_3: Were you guys talking about the Moon-Chasing Festival?
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_5: Yes, the Moon-Chasing Festival is an important festival here in Huanglong.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_6: It is when families in Huanglong come together to celebrate their reunion and enjoy drinks under the moon.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_7: The Magistrate said she hoped everyone would have a joyful Moon-Chasing Festival this year.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_8: So, besides taking care of the Moon-Chasing Festival event registrations, I also volunteered to help with the event planning, hoping to make the festival even better for everyone.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_9: Luckily, Dingfeng shared a ton of great ideas with me, and everyone really loved the improved plan.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_11_10: We all just want everyone to have a great time!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_12_1: I told you that the Liondance Troupe's Liondance would be popular. I've heard there's been a massive crowd lining up at the Plum Blossom Pole stall at the Moonlit Fair lately!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_12_2: Was it also your idea to set up the stall?
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_12_3: Not exactly. I just mentioned it when I was chatting with everyone in the Liondance Troupe.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_12_4: I suggested that they could let the audience experience the Liondance from a different perspective, and they gladly accepted.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_12_5: It's thanks to their careful and detailed planning that the event is doing so well right now.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_2_1: Sigh, the weather looks bad. It feels like it's going to rain soon...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_2_2: It won't stop us from chatting though. Want to do something together later?
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_2_3: Shall we go to the Moonlit Fair? I've heard it's very lively there, with fun things to do.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_1: A new day means another day of hard work!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_2: The city really does get a lot more crowded during the Moon-Chasing Festival...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_3: I need to be more vigilant to keep the people safe. That's what Chixia said!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_4_1: Ah... I'm really a bit worn out after a full day's work.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_4_2: After work, I'll grab a bite at Climbing Flower Eatery, then head to the teahouse to chat with the boss before...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_4_3: Oh, right! I need to watch the Hero Play. How could I forget that?
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_4_4: I heard that the special performances for the Moon-Chasing Festival have been announced. I've got to check them out as soon as I'm off work!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_5_1: Hehe, the Moon-Chasing Festival just isn't complete without reuniting with your loved ones...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_5_2: My grandson who's been away at school is back home!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_5_3: I'll look for those missing stuff later. After all, it's just more important to spend time with him.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_5_4: He doesn't get to come back often, so I'm going to make lots of Loong Whiskers Crisp for him and take him out so we can enjoy the festival together.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_5_5: I'm so glad he still cares about me and came back just to see me... Hehe... This year's festival is simply perfect.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_1: Hey there! Be sure to check out the lanterns on the street when you get the chance!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_2: Hehe, all the lanterns at the Moon-Chasing Festival have been improved based on my idea!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_3: I experimented for ages, but it wasn't until I studied the devices from the Ministry of Development that I found the inspiration I needed to create a special exterior for the lanterns.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_4: The people at the Ministry of Development acknowledged my skills and actually put my little invention to use! They even said that one day I would be even more amazing than them!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_5: And now these lanterns can withstand any weather without getting blown over all the time!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_6_6: People might not notice this detail, but I know my invention was a huge success! Hahaha, I'm so happy!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_1: The winding river flows so free, by cypress tall and evergreen. With a basket on my back, I return home to the joy that awaits...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_3: Hehe, this is a folk song from my hometown. I've loved singing it since I was a young man living in there.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_4: For some reason, I can't seem to find my strength unless I sing a few lines while working. If I finish my work early, I can head home sooner to celebrate the festival with my family.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_5: This is my tenth year here in Jinzhou. I left my hometown to come here because of a disaster that struck, so this year is especially special to me and my family.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_6: I really want to spend more time with my family during this year's Moon-Chasing Festival. Well, I've rested enough, so it's time to get back to work.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_7_7: With a basket on my back, I return home to the joy that awaits...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_1: Happy Moon-Chasing Festival! The Moonlit Fair will be held in Taoyuan Vale this year, and special performances will take place at the theater on the east side of the city. Make sure you don't go to the wrong place!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_2: I'm here to help if you can't find the venue for the Moon-Chasing Festival's events!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_4: With the festival upon us, more and more people are coming in and out of Jinzhou every day because of the festival, and naturally, more people are asking for directions too.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_5: Many people visiting Jinzhou for the first time don't know their way around and end up asking for directions. Well, I'm usually the first person they come across.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_6: I've repeated the same things so many times that I know them by heart now, hahaha.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_7: Oh, right! This is your first time celebrating the festival in Jinzhou, isn't it? Let me know if you need any help finding a venue!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_8: Thanks, I'll definitely ask you if I need any help.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_8_9: Great! I hope you have a good time!
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_9_1: This is wonderful. With all the leave I saved up by working overtime, I can finally spend some time with my baby now.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_9_2: I bought him the toys he asked me to get him ages ago and took him to eat his favorite foods...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_9_3: Hehe... I haven't seen him this happy in a long time...
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_9_4: I should take him to see the lanterns again tomorrow. I need to make it up to him after letting him down during last year's Moon-Chasing Festival.
Side_NPCZYJWBTH_9_5: After that... I'll find a way to spend more time with him.
NPC_JSJD_10_1: Combat isn't just about strength. You need skills and wisdom too when facing enemies on the battlefield.
NPC_JSJD_14_2: You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.
NPC_JSJD_15_5: Combat skills and tactics. Or anything you're willing to learn, as long as I have it.

Cosmos has shown up near a strange gate, asking you to go inside and assist with some kind of test.
