HelpText_100_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17 and complete "Ominous Star."

[Event Rules]
1. Participate in By Moon's Grace and help prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Meet the Popularity goals to claim the corresponding rewards.
4. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent by mail upon your first login within 30 days after the event ends.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_1: This song... where is it coming from?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_2: That's Lorelei's song, guiding ships through the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_3: But her singing sounds a bit different today. There are hints of... sorrow and agony...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_4: Perhaps it's merely my fancy. Regardless, her melody will guide us through fog and storm to the heart of the Nimbus Sanctum.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_1: It seems we have some time before the train arrives. How about a little chat to pass the time?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_3: Well, then. Where shall we begin?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_4: "The city, an abomination of chaos, claims its first death at birth. Its mortality has become our sustenance, like a whale that slowly sinks into the abyss."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_5: This comment on Ragunna comes from Rosselli, a painter from the past. Tragically, he died in poverty, his work overlooked. Now, ironically, even a mere sketch of his commands over a million Credits.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_6: Now. What is your impression of Ragunna so far?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_8: A profit-driven place full of corruption.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_11: Passionate... Indeed. Passion is a quality the Ragunnesi possess in abundance. It's also why the Carnevale is so eagerly anticipated.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_12: Indeed. Ragunna is not as glamorous as it seems. Beneath the veneer of prosperity, avarice reigns supreme.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_13: Indeed, faith is Ragunna's crown jewel. Our devotion to the Sentinel stands unrivaled throughout Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_14: A most prudent response. Perhaps you're still acquainting yourself with Ragunna, or you simply prefer discretion. Either way, I take no offense.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_15: Ragunna has many facets. Most people only see one side of it, but for me—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_16: It's like two sworn enemies are forcibly bound together. That's Ragunna—a city where tradition and innovation, openness and isolation, ceaselessly wrestle for dominance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_17: That is why the Montelli and Fisalia families are in a constant clash, as you may have seen.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_18: The Montellis champion innovation, staking all on the Carnevale. Meanwhile, the Fisalias cling to tradition, colluding with the shadows that lurk in Ragunna's depths.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_19: Fortunately, this long struggle behind the curtains will soon come to an end. Not because of the two families, but because of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_21: Yes, you. The Fated One. Perhaps you're not merely entangled in Ragunna's conflict, but are, in fact, the very eye of the storm. The city's fate may well rest upon your shoulders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_24: You may have not noticed it yet, but we are... and have been in the same boat for a long time.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_25: Ah. There's the train. It's time to say goodbye now.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_27: I'll tell you next time. As for now, let's keep it a mystery.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_1: So this is what's become of the seminary? I never expected this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_3: No, but I've seen paintings of the seminary in the Cathedral. It had an enormous dome and spires that seemed to touch the heavens.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_4: Then the Order was forced to abandon it when the sea of clouds swallowed it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_1: Have you also come to repent and seek forgiveness?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_2: The Sentinel has revealed a path to resist temptation and corruption. We need only devote ourselves wholly... to Lorelei.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_3: We're just here to see Lorelei.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_4: Patience. I see your eagerness for enlightenment, like our new brothers. You've removed your masks, but your hearts… they're still veiled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_5: Everyone here wears a mask. Everyone in Ragunna. Without exception, never unmasked. This is the source of our suffering. The mask veils our hearts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_6: Like our new brothers, they wear peculiar masks of madness. Poor souls tormented by evil desires. May they find peace in Lorelei's embrace.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_9: Yes, their masks are filled with madness, but even wrongdoers can seek redemption from Lorelei. The Sentinel granted Lorelei this authority, and no one can take it away.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_10: Follow Lorelei's song and your heart, and you may meet our lady. But if your transgressions are... beyond redemption, you'll be lost in the sea of clouds forever.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_11: So what should we do to see Lorelei?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_12: Do you seek an audience with Lorelei? Sadly, you've come at a bad time. Lorelei is furious, and our mortal bodies can't withstand her wrath. We've sealed the path to her domain.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_13: We appreciate the explanation, but we believe Lorelei is in danger... We're here to help her. Someone's planning to exploit her powers...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_14: The path has been closed. You must leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_15: (Sigh) Doesn't look like we'll be talking our way past him. Let's find another way, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_1: Oh. I have been cleansed of impure thoughts. I can finally escape from my wrongdoings.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_2: Sing, dance! For we have been granted peace and freedom!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_3: Yes, we only need to relish this moment!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_5: Oh! You've also come to rid yourself of your misdeeds? Then join us! Sing! Sing with us!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_6: The door has been shut. Simply sing along and it will open before you!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_7: (Just "Sing"? Doesn't look like we'll get more out of them. Let's go check somewhere else.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_1: But most of these are worn out and don't look like modern Rinascita script. Phoebe, can you read any of it?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_2: Let's see... This seems like an ancient holy script dedicated to recording the deeds of Sentinel Imperator. As for its content...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_3: "I shall grant this power to... the Night... Queen. May she... during the day... sea of clouds..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_4: Ugh. Much of this text is illegible. However, the adjacent drawing is mostly intact. It shows Sentinel Imperator speaking to a massive creature.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_5: And the creature slowly shifts from an immense, amorphous form into a humanoid shape.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_6: Could it be Lorelei? After all, no other being that large lives above the sea of clouds....
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_7: Actually, I'm not sure if the other figure is the Sentinel. It looks a little different from the Cathedral statues. Maybe it's just the lack of clarity in the drawing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_8: Anyway, does it mean... Lorelei and the Sentinel are somehow connected to each other?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_9: Nothing about the barrier though. Are there any other clues?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_10: These inscriptions and markings on the stela seem to say something.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_1: A veil of mist shrouds the Atrium, radiating an aura of resistance. This must be the entrance that the believers refer to as "the path to audience."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_3: Small words are carved beside it: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_4: Is this some kind of hint?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_4: This is Misteltein. One of the missing Echoes. They probably followed the singing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_5: Misteltein, do you know how to remove the barrier?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_6: Now how would an Echo know that, Phoebe—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_1: I guess "singing" is our only option for clearing that barrier.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_3: The stela we saw mentioned the Sentinel, and we're in the ruins of the seminary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_4: Meaning it should be a "chorale"? There are also the inscription in front of the barrier: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_5: Any chorales you know ring a bell, Phoebe?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_6: The martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden... Could this be the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"? It's a chorale rarely used these days. I doubt most Priests even know of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_8: The Blessed Maiden? We met a playwright named Cristoforo earlier. He shared some stories about her.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_9: Phoebe, if you know this chorale, why not give it a try? It might just clear the barrier.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_11: O-okay then. I suppose it's our best option at the moment. I'll give it a try. Ahem...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_1: A song of false nature. Masking... A twisted view... Tear it to shreds...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_2: Did you get the chorale wrong?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_3: I'm sure I sang the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_4: Not good... She doesn't seem too pleased with that one.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1: That flower... looks like the petals we found in Whisperwind Haven.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_6: It's the Fractsidus. I've dealt with them before, and I've seen a flower just like this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_7: How long have I been in slumber... This nightmare... How long was I trapped in it?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_8: Are you also part of the dream?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_9: No, we are not... Might you be Lorelei?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_10: I am. Travelers from afar, I sense… the kindness pulsing in your hearts. You must be the ones who broke the chains of my nightmare.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11: The oathbreakers, hiding behind their Masks of Madness… They tainted the Nimbus Sanctum with corrupted blooms, drowning me in rage and sorrow. Endless nightmares became my prison.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_12: Masks of Madness... I recall those people at the entrance of the Atrium mentioned it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13: Had you not freed me from my nightmare, I would never be able to fulfill the Sentinel's task… The tides of the Nimbus Sanctum would have engulfed the whole of Ragunna, just as they once claimed the sacred temple now lying in ruins beneath you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_14: Wait. The Sentinel? Does that mean...?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_15: Yes, the Sentinel molded me from a mindless being to the form you see, and bestowed upon me the most precious gift... A soul.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_16: They commanded me to restrain the clouds and prevent the Remnant Energy within it from... dissipating.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_17: Can you contact Imperator? I need to meet with the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_18: Unfortunately, it lies beyond my power. The Sentinel's link to the mortal realm is severed. Only through collective prayer, and a rite, at the height of the Carnevale, only then can mortals briefly commune with Them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_19: A rite... You mean the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_20: No, that's impossible! The current Primus, Fenrico the Enlightened One, was given a direct oracle from the Sentinel. The Sentinel has always been with the people!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_21: I'm afraid the Sentinel's current state... transcends mortal understanding. Your Primus is no exception.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_22: Should doubt linger in your mind, I implore you to await the rite's completion. The Sentinel will surely answer the people's call—not your so-called… Enlightened One.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_23: One last thing. Those oathbreakers wearing Masks of Madness you mentioned, do you know who they are?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_24: All that I know is that they are not from Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_25: In the whispers between dreams, I heard them speak of their leader, a woman they called…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_28: It is time I return to my slumber. Their wicked acts have scarred the sea of clouds, and I must mend it… within my dreams.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_29: The song shall guide you out of this domain. Farewell, visitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_1: What a wild turn this job's taken… Seeing the legendary Lorelei up close? Almost makes it worth the trouble.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_3: Hmm? Are you all right, Phoebe?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_4: Huh? I-I'm fine. I'm just… processing Lorelei's words. Forgive me, I… I need a moment to reflect.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_5: In any case, we managed to stop their plot in time and found the missing Vitreum Dancer.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_6: Speaking of that Vitreum Dancer… What brought it here? Lorelei's song, or maybe the Sentinel's guidance?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_9: But those wearing the Masks of Madness... The Fractsidus, right? I'm curious about their role in all this. I think they supplied Gilberto with the flowers to turn Echoes into Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_10: Yeah, the Fractsidus is behind this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_11: Their actions remind me of something...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_14: You're right... Those snakes lurked in the shadows, using Gilberto as their fall guy. We can't expose them just by ourselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_15: Oh, another thing. Since the Fractsidus is conspiring with the Fisalias, that makes them an enemy of the Montelli family.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_16: There happens to be an auction at Averardo Vault today. The top members of the family will be there.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_17: We should tip off the family about the Fractsidus' scheme. The Montellis can't afford to ignore this threat.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_20: I intend to return to the Order first. While I believe Lorelei is truthful, I can't imagine the Primus would deceive our people. He is, after all, the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_21: According to Lorelei, the Sentinel will deliver an oracle during the Carnevale. That's when the truth will come to light.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_22: Speaking of which, are all Primuses called the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_23: No, only Lord Fenrico has ever directly communicated with the Sentinel. Previous Primuses were merely indirect representatives, not the Enlightened One...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_24: Silence and composure are gifts from the great Imperator. I'll keep today's events between us, locked away in my heart.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_50_1: It's the same Echo boat we were on earlier... Was it also attracted by Lorelei's singing?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_50_4: Noah... Well, I can't understand what it's saying, but it's a perfect timing. We can have it take us to Averardo Vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_51_1: That's a really big waterfall... Is there no way up?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_51_3: Whoa, really? You can take us upstream?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_1: Averardo Vault is just up ahead. It seems this is where we part ways, Noah.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_3: I'm sure it can find its way back to the harbor. Don't worry. Now, we just need to follow this path to reach the vault. Let's go.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_1: Welcome to Averardo Vault. Do you have an appointment?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_2: My name is Zani. I'm an employee of the bank. Here's my ID.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_4: Ah, this invitation… My apologies. Welcome to Averardo Vault. How may we assist you today?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_5: We're not here on business. We've come to brief the family on the Echo incident from the recent Carnevale rehearsal.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_6: I'll arrange that immediately. Please proceed to the main entrance. A staff member will greet you there.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_1: These Echoes... Are they guarding the vault?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_2: Yes. But I've never seen them in action before. The "Averardo Bank Employee Manual" says they can easily take out a whole squad of Resonators.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_3: Of course, this doesn't apply to someone powerful like you, {PlayerName}. Still, their combat skills are formidable. Their mere presence is enough to make everyone feel safe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_4: This facility houses nearly half of Rinascita's wealth. It serves all of Ragunna's citizens, even including the Fisalias.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_5: Despite our feud, no one in Ragunna can refuse the services of Averardo Vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_6: What the... I thought they only responded to hostility!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_7: Steady now. Don't move. It's on high alert but won't attack unless provoked. At least, that's what the Employee Manual says!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_9: I apologize for the small mishap on behalf of the Montelli Family. And...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_10: What a pleasant surprise to see you again so soon.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_12: Yet your expression betrays no surprise, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_13: Allow me to properly introduce myself. My name is Carlotta, Carlotta Montelli.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_15: The second daughter of the Montelli Family, yes. Please feel free to call me Carlotta.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_16: Also, I trust the renumeration meets your satisfaction, Ms. Zani?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_17: It was you who tasked me with receiving {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_18: Surely a distinguished guest such as {PlayerName} deserves the attention of our most trusted employee.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_19: I'm aware of your purpose here. On behalf of my family, allow me to extend our deepest gratitude for your endeavors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_20: Your eyes show curiosity about me and my role in this… drama. However, this isn't the place for such discussions. Please follow me.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_1: Please accept my apologies, {PlayerName}, for withholding my true identity before.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_2: Rinascita's affairs have grown… intricate. The Fisalia family, the Order of the Deep…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_3: You've likely noticed that many desire the Carnevale to fail. We Montellis, having tied our future to its success, became their target.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_4: …But, let's not dwell on that for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_5: Here we are. Welcome to Averardo Vault—the Montellis' heart and glory.
Quest_145000004_ChildQuestTip_145_359: Clear the corrupted data and head to the lower level
Activity_102200001_Desc:
To ensure the Moonlit Fair's success, you and Xiangli Yao are gradually advancing festival preparations while fulfilling others' wishes. 
Along the way, you may encounter challenges in uncovering people's true desires.
"Don't worry. Just like you said, there are always connections between people, helping them progress despite any difficulties."
"Our journey began at the Moontree Lodge. Together, we explore truths and immerse ourselves in the bustling crowds. I'm grateful to be the one experiencing all of this with you."
(Reach 6,000 Popularity to claim 5-Star Resonator: Xiangli Yao)
Quest_140000011_QuestDesc_140_2: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Pentinent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...
Quest_140000011_QuestName_140_2: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_2: I'm not exactly one for formal introductions, Pero.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_4: I know this isn't the first time seeing them...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_8: Uh... Hello, I'm Roccia. We've met before on Brant's ship. I was... in this box.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_9: This is Pero, the actual owner of the box. Pero takes good care of me and lets me hang out in it all the time.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_10: I've never seen Pero warm up to someone so quickly. It must be something in your frequency that it finds interesting.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_11: Anyway, what brings you to this beach? It's not exactly a place for a stroll.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_12: You explain what happened to Roccia...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_13: So, you were attacked by that dragon and fell off the bridge...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_14: I'm guessing it was Abby who saved you. It probably exhausted itself and retreated back into your body to rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_15: I can still sense Abby's frequency, even if it's faint.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_16: (What triggered Abby to come out? Something it could absorb? But then, why didn't it work?)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_17: That dragon's behavior is odd. It never leaves its territory.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_20: Long ago, this place was a sacred spot for the Order's pilgrims. Then the Dark Tide hit, and all those Reverberations left behind twisted things up.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_21: The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_22: This "Dragon of Dirge," is a local Tacet Discord. It grows by feeding on the others.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_23: We were supposed to pick you up like Ms. Carlotta planned, but... things went sideways.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_24: The truth Ms. Carlotta wants to show you lies somewhere on the isle.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_25: But this is not the best place to talk. The mist is thickening... and rain is coming.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_26: The mist is dangerous here. It traps Reverberations, and when it collects enough, they quickly form into Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_27: The Captain—I mean Brant... He went into the mist to rescue people, but he hasn't returned. We think he might be in danger.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_28: I plan to go find him. Once I'm in the mist, my frequency will draw the creepies and crawlies away, so you'll be safer here.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_29: Just in case, take this to mask your frequency and defend yourself.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_30: Ta-da! Fireworks Pistol! One shot, and it'll send the Tacet Discords packing.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_16_1: What's that ahead? It seems to be glowing with a different color.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_16_2: Don't worry. They're just Reverberations—potential Tacet Discords in the making.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_16_3: Some of them are actually our friends... We can follow them to find our way out.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_17_1: Come... Play with me... Look for me... I'm here...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_2: I'll always find you, but maybe don't do this again next time.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_3: Why? Isn't this your favorite game... I... I wanted to play with you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_4: I know, but as your friend, I worry about your safety.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_6: Excuse me. Are you Roccia's friend?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_8: Not yet, but I think we will be soon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_14: Fly, fly to the high heavens. We are born free, and our souls will soar even in death.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_17: Golden phantoms are... Reverberations mixed with the frequencies left behind by people who've passed away.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_18: When someone dies, their Reverberations linger. Usually, they merge into the same cacophony of frequencies that spawns Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_19: But sometimes, a trace of their final will remains, and the mist shapes this into phantoms.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_20: This lingering will helps the phantoms resist becoming Tacet Discords and instead guide the lost through the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_21: If the mist clears, they'll vanish. If the mist lingers, their fate is sealed. It will only be a matter of time before they merge with other Reverberations and become Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_22: Their final frequencies tend to cling to certain objects... like this Luceanite here. I collect them as proof that they once lived.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_1: A Pilgrim's Sail? Why is it here?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_2: In Ragunna, those who break the law are sent to the Order Tribunal for sentencing. Those who violate the sacred doctrines are branded as Fools and sent away on the Pilgrim's Sail.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_3: Now, the Fools retrace the Primus's journey, reflecting on their mistakes along the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_4: There's a strong undercurrent around this isle, likely caused by that first Dark Tide. It drags all Pilgrim's Sails here unless the ship's course is altered.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_22_1: Looks like our brief intermission is over. Time to let the "ghosts" have their moment on stage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_22_2: Come on, then! Let the flames of battle ignite our souls!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_22_4: Only Brant would call them ghosts with that kind of flair... It must be him, but I can't tell where he is in the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_22_5: Anyway, let's deal with the trouble here first before we go look for him.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_1: The show's over, ghosts! Time to take your final bow!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_3: A marvelous shot! You've earned your stripes, First Mate.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_4: You're welcome, but if you'd tilted your head just ten centimeters to the left, it wouldn't have been the Discord's head that got popped—it'd be yours.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_5: Not on your watch. Besides, fortune always smiles on me. Except in bets.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_6: And we've crossed paths with the Rover again! Can't get luckier than that!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_7: We shouldn't have let {PlayerName} get caught up in this mess.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_8: {Male=He;Female=She} was worried about us and insisted on coming.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_9: Is that so? Then our gratitude to you is even greater for your timely aid, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_10: I'm here to uncover a buried truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_11: We're all alive, and that's what counts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_12: I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for that dragon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_13: To find the brightest truth, one must delve into the deepest shadows. Such bravery deserves to be hailed, my friend.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_14: Where is everyone on the Pilgrim's Sail?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_15: I was patrolling the coast earlier when I saw their ship drifting into the mist. Time was against us, so I departed alone without alerting the crew.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_17: Don't be afraid. You're safe with us. You've got some skill, you know, holding your own for so long in the trial against the Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_18: Trial? Ha, I don't buy into the Order's nonsense.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_19: I've worked hard all my life and stayed true to the Order's teachings about forsaking earthly pleasures for divine favor. And what do I get in return? Heavier taxes.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_21: I stood before the Sentinel's statue, asking if my suffering was really Their will, but all I got was... silence.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_22: Why should I wait for peace in the afterlife when I could be living for today? How is that a crime?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_23: As for salvation... I don't believe in it, and I certainly don't need it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_24: Here's a proposal. How about joining our troupe?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_26: We are wanderers adrift upon the seas. Or perhaps you're more familiar with the name—the Troupe of Fools.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_28: Yes. We are, like you, by the Order's decree... marked as Fools.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_30: Maybe it's luck that brought you here so swiftly, and unharmed at that.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_31: Look around. This is all that remains of the Pilgrim's Sail... This is always their final destination, where the Fools meet their end.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_32: Yes. The pilgrimage is nothing but a banishment in disguise. The path to salvation they speak of doesn't exist.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_39: Wait, sacred place? No wonder the others were talking about it on the ship. They believed the Order's promise that prayers at the Sacrificial Arena would grant them forgiveness... They must be heading up the mountain now.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_41: I didn't expect their faith to lead them that far.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_42: If only they knew it was just one of the Order's lies.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_43: Captain! First mate! We're here to help!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_44: More hands make light work. I called in some help to escort him back to the base once the mist cleared.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_45: Ah, the first mate's foresight is unmatched! Then the three of us can head up the mountain.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_46: But beware my friend, by the end of this pilgrimage, you will witness the Order's cruelest deceit. The dangers ahead will only intensify.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_18: They're like reflections of who we each are.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_25: And... that was it. I was sent here with all the other performers.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_26: The play was about freedom, love, and hope. How could something so beautiful be considered taboo? I... I don't understand.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_21: Some will eventually leave to follow the call of their hearts, their silhouettes forever etched into the mist.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_24: Beriarti the Fire Eater, Toscanini the Night Watcher, Fernando the Fish Killer... Their stories remain vivid in my memory. One day, I'll compile them into a book. Mark my words.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_25: Over the years, we've bid farewell to many and welcomed countless new faces... It seems this cycle will never end.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_29: On the Pilgrim's Sail, I was cared for by other Fools who shared what little they had and shielded me from the grim reality with their kindness and smiles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_30: But all I could do was watch... as they passed away, one by one. From that day forward, I swore to wipe away the tears of the innocent.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_31: Every adventurer needs a rest, and every ship must find a port. For us, that meant finding a sanctuary.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_21: The Montelli traitors used Lycoris in experiments to turn Echoes back into Tacet Discords... If they were successful, the "ghosts" seen ten years ago may have also been created this way.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_22: "Ghost" is just a dramatic name given by the Ragunnesi for Tacet Discords. They look nearly identical to Echoes, especially in the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_23: With your help, Grandfather has thwarted their plan. No corrupted Echoes will appear at this year's Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_24: The Order has allied with the Fractsidus to control the dragon... From what I saw when I connected with its frequency, they might be planning to command it to attack Ragunna during the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_25: After the Tacet Discords took over this isle, the Order used them as an excuse to forbid any entry. It might be their way of concealing the dragon's existence.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_26: But without the Lycoris, the Dragon of Dirge is now off the table.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_27: The Remnant Clouds spreading, experiments to turn Echoes, and the dragon's manipulation... The Order plans to recreate these disasters at this year's ceremony.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_29: The Order and the Fractsidus are allies. To prevent the Carnevale's sabotage, we must stop them. But... what is their motive?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_31: Let's consider the implications. If the Carnevale proceeds unhindered, how would it affect the Order?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_32: (Bring up the prophecy about the Holy Maiden's coronation)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_33: (Bring up the Sentinel's inability to communicate with mortals)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_34: The current Primus claims to be the Enlightened One, the Sentinel's Resonator. However, based on the prophecy we found in the ruins, this role is meant for the young maiden who is destined to heed the divine oracles during the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_35: The Carnevale is the only time humans can directly communicate with the Sentinel. Normally, it's the Primus who conveys the Sentinel's words.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_36: A successful Carnevale offers a chance for citizens to meet the Sentinel in person. But for the Primus, and possibly the Order, it poses a threat if they've been fabricating the oracles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_39: The Primus called it a divine punishment and took the opportunity to appear as a savior. A perfect way to build legitimacy.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_40: The Order relies on the people's faith in the Sentinel. With the Sentinel's ten year absence, faith in the Order has waned. They must be desperate to restore that trust.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_41: It is for this reason that the Order has been forced to revive the festival.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_42: To sabotage it while still maintaining their authority... they partnered with the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_43: The Fractsidus will cause chaos during the Carnevale, and the Order will swoop in as the saviors, restoring public trust just as they did before.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_44: So far, you've helped us crush three of their schemes, but one remains...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_45: The sea behemoth summoning towering waves...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_48: We have evidence that the Cetus is being manipulated, and the Fractsidus are setting up their final plan. With their whereabouts unknown, we'll need to adapt our strategy as the Carnevale unfolds.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_49: {PlayerName}, the Carnevale is likely where you'll find clues about the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_50: From what I've noticed, you're not one to act passively or pin your hopes on others. You prefer to strike first and steer events in your favor.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_51: Winning the Laurel might give you the chance to talk with the Sentinel. The Sentinel's Resonator may also be present. So...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_52: You've guided me this far for it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_53: You want me to join you in stopping the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_54: You want me to join the troupe's performance at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_55: Our aim has always been clear—to restore the Carnevale to its former glory with a performance for the ages.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_56: If the divine truly exists, would they wish to see their people living without freedom or witness a festival twisted into a tool for tyrants?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_57: If we win the Laurel, we'll show that such punishment is absurd. But if that's truly their design... we shall break those divine shackles ourselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_58: Whether divinity exists or not, we will fight for Ragunna's freedom, where everyone has the right to live and pursue a future of their own choosing!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_59: The Montellis share this vision. Only in a free society can a fair and open market thrive.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_60: However, the troupe alone is too weak, the family is under close watch, and our enemy hides in the shadows... We need your strength to find our way forward.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_62: We're united by the same goal.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_63: Seems there's no other way to meet the Sentinel than at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_64: Thank you. I'm pleased we've reached an agreement once more.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_1: Our rehearsals are rather straightforward. No scripts, just pure intuition and our senses guiding us! That's what makes Commedia Improvviso truly come alive!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_2: For our improvised comedy, we start with a theme. From there, we build our lines and act on the fly, responding to the unfolding show and audience reactions.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_4: But with the limitless capacity for human creativity at play, the plot can sometimes veer into the... well, unconventional. To prevent things from spiraling too far, we set an "anchor" for the performance.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_5: Pardon my interruption, but I'm quite curious. What sort of bizarre plots have you encountered?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_6: Well, something like "A humble craftsman from a small town sets sail on a rainy night, stumbles upon ancient ruins, is reincarnated with super powers, and then decides to conquer the galaxy, becoming the Emperor of the Stars..."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_7: So, we draft a basic outline that assigns roles and guides the plot's direction.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_8: And this time, our outline is: "A kingdom is attacked, monsters run rampant, and the Demon King has kidnapped the Holy Maiden. A few brave heroes accept the minister's quest to defeat the Demon King and rescue her."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_12: This outline holds special meaning. We want to pay tribute to the play once performed by the Blessed Maiden herself, which was also about a hero facing a Demon King.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_13: Good people have their wishes fulfilled, heroes appear in a time of crisis, justice triumphs over evil, and united friends are undefeatable.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_14: This is the tale the Blessed Maiden once told, and it's a universal story we want to portray.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_16: To me, the world is a stage, and performing is much like combat. Coordinated movements, quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and, above all, trust in your allies.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_17: What I'm getting at is that you both are very skilled and capable. We don't have many dos and don'ts, so relax and express yourselves freely on stage!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_18: This rehearsal is to help you get familiar with basic stage movements, techniques, and the troupe's style, and to build good rapport.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19: Exactly. I'll handle the stage lighting, Brant will narrate, and the rest will take on the role of the audience.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_2: So this is what a Commedia Improvviso feels like.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_3: How did this suddenly turn into a musical?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_4: Haha, seeing your chemistry, I decided to take a little creative liberty with the story. Anyway, it didn't stray too far from the outline, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_5: The thrill of improvisation is in its unpredictability. There's always a rush of excitement with every twist and turn.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_6: Your movements were seamless, elegant, and powerful. I'm confident you'll shine at the Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_7: Thank you. It was all thanks to {PlayerName}. You inspired me and kept my spirits high.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_8: Am I blushing, or is that just the spotlight?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_9: Carlotta is the real genius here.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_11: You'll master it in no time, I'm sure! Alright, that's enough for today. Let's save the grand reveal for the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_13: Oh, and speaking of which, there's still something we need to prepare for you, isn't there, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_1: Ms. Zani, do you mind handling the cleanup? I'm sorry. I just promised you a vacation... but looks like it will have to wait.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_2: Oh it's fine. Just a bit of extra work. I can't stand by and watch my colleagues getting hurt.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_3: Besides, you have bigger things to worry about. Just let me handle this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_4: We can always count on you, Zani.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_5: Be sure to get that overtime pay.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_6: Yeah, yeah… That's the burden of being good at my job.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_7: There's more to this attack than it seems.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_1: This is where my family first found the Vitreum Dancer.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_2: What do you see in the shattered stained glass?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_3: It seems to be telling a story.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_4: Is there a way to piece them together?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_5: This seems to chronicle a legend of the Sentinel and the tale of how the first Primus founded the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_6: I've learned of this history before but many details have faded over time.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_7: How do you know all this?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_8: Well, art investment is one of our family's key ventures, so I've naturally picked up a thing or two along the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_9: There is a stone tablet over there. It might offer some clues about these stained glass images.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_1: This ancient stone tablet bears inscriptions in the ancient Rinascita language.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_3: …Once whole, the Divinity was rent by warring creeds. From Their holy wounds sprang the curse of Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_4: …On this day shall I depart. Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure, the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_5: …On the grandest of days, the maiden, crowned with golden laurel, shall commune with the Divinity. Thus she becomes the prophesied "Enlightened One," through whom Rinascita's woes shall end.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_6: It seems to be some sort of prophecy… We might have to piece together the clues from both the stone tablet and the stained glass to unravel the secrets.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_76_2: Looks like these stained glass images recount a tale about the Divinity. Wait...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_1: Together with the inscriptions on the tablet,
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_2: In the earliest days of Rinascita,
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_3: One rules the sky and the other the seas,
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_6: The Dark Tide—so was it known.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_10: "Once whole, the Divinity was rent by warring creeds."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_11: Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure,
Main_Linaxita_2_2_77_12: On the grandest of days, the maiden,
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_1: Rinascita has two divinities? I've never heard of such a thing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_2: The Montelli family archives hold many documents on Rinascita's past, yet none mentioned two divinities.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_3: In Ragunna, the common belief has always been that Sentinel Imperator is the only divinity of Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_4: But if the images on the stained glass windows were fabricated, why would the Order deface them and declare this tower forbidden?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_5: There's only one explanation. These are not fabrications but buried truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_6: If this is indeed the Order's doing... we must leave here immediately.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_8: North of this tower is an island.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_9: It should be beyond their reach. Once we get there, you will discover another truth the Order has buried—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_11: They surely know when to show up.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_13: You go first. I'll cover you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_14: …Interesting, they're here even faster than I anticipated.
HelpText_107_Content:
[About]
The Moon-Chasing Festival is a Huanglong traditional festival that features various origin stories, with the most popular being the tale of The Fox and the Moon. On this special night, families and friends come together to admire the moon and make wishes, expressing their hopes for a brighter future.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17. For the best experience, complete "Thaw of Eons" before participating in this event.

[Event Rules]
1. Help Xiangli Yao prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Invite Companions to assist in preparations by completing the corresponding Side Quests, and earn higher Wish Ratings and Funds.
4. Achieve the festival goals to claim and redeem rewards.
5. After the event concludes, unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days and will be reissued via Mail when you log in during this period (Note: Rewards that have not been redeemed will not be reissued.)
HelpText_101_Content:
1. During the Moon-Chasing Festival, you can increase Popularity via the activities in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> and <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> to make the Moonlit Fair more lively.
2. Popularity ranges from Level 1 to Level 6.
HelpText_102_Content:
1. Build or upgrade stalls to increase Popularity, gain buffs, and unlock Companions.
2. Building or upgrading stalls requires Funds, which can be earned by completing Wishes in Lodge Wishes.
3. Stalls can be upgraded multiple times, with higher levels providing greater buffs.
4. After building a stall, you can participate in the stall's activities and may earn unexpected rewards, with additional daily rewards for Thus Says the Moon, Hsin's Fortuity, and Riddle Twiddle.
HelpText_103_Content:
1. You can spend Preparation Credits and Funds to fulfill people's Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Each Wish has its own resource cost.
2. Fulfilling Wishes will earn you Funds and Wish Tags. Setting new records will boost Popularity.
3. Send the right Companions to fulfill the Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. You can view their detailed stats on the Companions page.
HelpText_104_Content_1:
There is a preferred Companion Stat for each Wish. Selecting your Companions accordingly will earn you a higher score.
To boost your Companions' stats, interact with them on the Companions page.
HelpText_104_Content_2:
Preparation Underway: Your Companions act in turn, earning scores based on their stats.
Scoring Rules: Scores fluctuate each round, as your Companions can't always perform at their absolute best. Nevertheless, Companions with higher stats have the potential to earn higher scores.
HelpText_104_Content_3: During preparation, Companions may experience a "Eureka" moment. The likelihood of this occurring varies for each Companion.
HelpText_104_Content_4: "Eureka" allows for additional investments. Higher risks yield greater rewards. Make your choice wisely.
HelpText_104_Content_5: Results: A Wish Rating depends on the combined scores of your chosen Companions. Higher Ratings earn you more Funds and Wish Tags.
HelpText_105_Content:
1. Companions can help you fulfill Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.
2. They have three stats: Knowledge, Action, and Teamwork. Higher stats and better matches with the Wish's recommended stat lead to higher Wish Ratings.
3. Build and upgrade <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> and complete the <color=#8c7e51>Festival Journal</color> quests series to unlock more Companions.
HelpText_106_Content:
1. You can interact with Companions to boost their stats and Bond Level.
2. Each Interaction has its own cost of Wish Tags. A higher cost results in greater enhancements.
3. Complete Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> to earn Wish Tags.

Main_Linaxita_2_2_79_1: Keep it safe. I'll handle the rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_79_2: Speak, who gave you the order?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_1: Look at what you have done, distorting history, usurping the Sentinel's authority, and... colluding with wretches.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_2: Who are your accomplices? The Fractsidus, the Fisalias, and even some of the Montellis, am I right?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_3: Ahem… I'm afraid I don't understand, Miss Carlotta. It seems you too are lost to madness and hallucination…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_4: If you find yourself confused and desire the Sentinel's guidance, I would gladly arrange... a personal Pilgrim's Sail for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_5: So this is how you treat those truth-seekers? Banish them in the name of pilgrimage?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_6: —Please, lower your weapon. There is still room for discussion, is there not, Miss Carlotta?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_1: Stand down. Enough blood has been shed today. Imperator would not revel in senseless sacrifice.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_2: And the Pilgrim's Sail is for the transgressors to seek rebirth, not for you to threaten our friends. Repent for your reckless words.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_4: Ah, honored guest. You have been misinformed, as the truth is not what it seems. My lord Fenrico has arranged your audience with the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_5: Why not hear the Sentinel's wisdom for yourself?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_6: Of course, if Lord Fenrico is the true "Enlightened One."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_7: However, the prophecy speaks of a maiden as the "Enlightened One." Is that why you destroyed the stained glass? To pass Fenrico off as the Enlightened One? So he can seize the Sentinel's power and rule Ragunna?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_8: Oh, you stubborn people of little faith. You've surely been tempted by evil and swallowed its lies. Lord Fenrico is the undeniable Enlightened One and will guide us all.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_9: Well, I see no point in debating doctrine with you. Let's move on to a more concrete subject. Now, Miss Carlotta, which one do you think is more important to the Montelli family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_12: How… that's… Uncle Capollo's pendant? What did you do to him!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_13: Good question. What did we do indeed? Quite a faithful one he was.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_14: Wouldn't hand over this pendant, the emblem of his faith... but we managed to persuade him.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_15: Whether he should be deemed faithful now depends entirely on your actions. And you know what will become of him if we decide his devotion is weak and unworthy.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_16: …My actions? What do you want me to do?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_17: Raise your weapon, faithful Carlotta. Choose wisely now… Where shall you aim? Whose heart will taste your bullet?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_82_1: Whew, that was close… I really thought the bullet was coming for us.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_82_2: So… was it all part of your plan?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_82_4: Then you two sure have great chemistry… Anyway, those bad guys are still after us, so let's get out of here.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_82_5: Didn't Carlotta say something about an island up north? Let's go check it out!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_84_1: Wait, heads up! Something huge's coming at us!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_84_2: Watch its flames! Quick, get to that clearing!
Quest_114000029_ChildQuestTip_114_4: Check in to Palazzo Agrotta hotel
Quest_114000029_QuestDesc_114_2: The long-awaited Carnevale is finally set to begin. Together with your friends, you are ready to thwart the Fractsidus' schemes during the celebration...
Quest_114000029_QuestName_114_2: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_1: Oh, dear Lady Carlotta, thank the Sentinel, you're finally back! I was just about to close up shop to prepare for tomorrow's Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_2: You have completed my request, haven't you?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_3: Of course, Lady Carlotta. You should have more faith in my skills. Here you are.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_4: A small token of my appreciation. Abby, I have something for you as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_5: Wow, really? I get a gift too? You're so nice!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_6: Ah, so that's why Lady Carlotta was so insistent on using only the finest materials and meticulous craftsmanship for this piece.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_7: For a moment, I feared she'd lost faith in my skills and was plotting to hand over the shop to someone else...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_8: But now, I see why this little creation was so important to you, Lady Carlotta. Hehe...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_9: Nyarla, you do have a flair for dramatics. Ahem! Anyway, why don't you unwrap it?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_11: I took the liberty of having Nyarla custom-make this mask based on my impression of you. I hope it suits your taste.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_12: Thank you. I like it very much!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_13: A gift so fine? Does the Montelli family happen to be hiring?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_15: The Montelli family shares its wealth and opportunities freely, but I see your stage lying beyond the cutthroat games of power and fortune—toward a world that's far more boundless and free.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_16: "The Carnevale is a splendid reverie, and the mask is its passport." May it help you navigate the Carnevale with ease and let you enjoy it to your heart's content.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_18: May I take up a bit more of your time? Walk with me through Ragunna tonight. I have some additional information to share with you.
Character_ZheZhi_75_2: It's just a prank, I bet.
Character_ZheZhi_76_1: You see my arm here? The monsters mauled me.
Character_ZheZhi_76_2: I heard laughter, voices with them. Will there be half-human Tacet Discords? Like... hybrids?
Character_ZheZhi_76_3: Stop. You're giving me the chills...
Character_ZheZhi_76_4: Stop being so paranoid. Remember last time, when that guy was collecting laundry on a skateboard and you thought it was a ghost? You need to calm down.
Character_ZheZhi_77_1: What, a new urban legend? Man, our mine is really cool...
Character_ZheZhi_78_1: Our mine is full of urban legends and strange stories. Strange comm message from a mysterious train? A certain survey team's bizzare discoveries underground? And now, a new tale has surfaced!
Character_ZheZhi_78_3: About the Arcane Artist, of course! A legendary tale with paintings, monsters, and humans? I can already smell the suspense and surprises.
Character_ZheZhi_78_5: What a fascinating place! So much character and charm. I must write down this story right away.
Character_ZheZhi_79_1: No. The paintings came first, then the monsters and humans followed.
Character_ZheZhi_79_2: No. The humans came first, then the monsters and paintings followed.
Character_ZheZhi_79_3: No. The monsters ARE the humans.
Character_ZheZhi_80_1: I've been seeing her around here often.
Character_ZheZhi_80_2: She said she's here for inspiration.
Character_ZheZhi_80_3: But I bet she's hiding from something.
Character_ZheZhi_81_1: Wasn't someone standing there with the painter before it happened?
Character_ZheZhi_82_1: Wasn't someone standing there with the painter before it happened?
Character_ZheZhi_82_2: Really? Should we go tell the Patrollers about it?
Character_ZheZhi_82_3: Maybe, but I don't even remember what that person looked like...
Character_ZheZhi_82_4: Was that her partner in crime, maybe?
Character_ZheZhi_82_5: They were arguing over something... The painter looked ready to snap...
Character_ZheZhi_82_6: That sounds concerning. We should tell the Patrollers.
Character_ZheZhi_87_1: These legs still ache from hauling that last shipment.
Character_ZheZhi_87_3: ...Nevermind, I'll just go back and rest. That'll only make me more tired.
Character_ZheZhi_88_1: I should be able to sneak a painting out, right? Bet they won't notice.
Character_ZheZhi_89_1: Hey, I'm thinking... Have we been demoted? Is that why they've sent us here?
Character_ZheZhi_89_2: You don't get it. This is how we really learn the business. They're setting us up for a promotion in the future!
Character_ZheZhi_89_3: Oh, I see! Then I better work harder!
Character_ZheZhi_91_1: You gotta strike faster! Like this! Hah!
Character_ZheZhi_91_2: Waaahhh, please go easy on me!
Character_ZheZhi_92_1: You done with the paint we're using?
Character_ZheZhi_92_2: Of course not! Just ran outta material again. I'll go see if we still have some left in the camp.
Character_ZheZhi_92_3: Be quick. We can't afford to miss the deadline.
Character_ZheZhi_96_1: Hmm, what's for dinner today... Hey! My pot! Who the hell messed it up?
Character_ZheZhi_97_1: Our current plan is weak. Too slow, not secret enough. We need to step up.
Character_ZheZhi_97_2: Let's lock up all the artists somewhere, and assign them each a piece to complete.
Character_ZheZhi_97_3: We'll control their breaks and work them around the clock. It's gonna double our output for sure.
Character_ZheZhi_98_1: You know, I reached out to one of our customers the other day...
Character_ZheZhi_98_2: Shh! You can't just bring that up out loud!

Side_XYHTZST_42_2: Nice to see you again, Zhezhi.
Side_XYHTZST_42_3: Nice to see you! Ah, I-I have something to tell you...
Side_XYHTZST_42_4: Those photos you took last time were really helpful. T-thank you so much!
Side_XYHTZST_42_7: You helped me a lot, so I want to thank you properly… Though I'm not sure what to give you in return.
Side_XYHTZST_42_8: Ah... Did I make a mistake? I'm sorry...!
Side_XYHTZST_42_9: I'm just kidding. I'm happy to help at any time.
Side_XYHTZST_42_10: O-okay. You helped me a lot, so I want to thank you properly… Though I'm not sure what to give you in return.
Side_XYHTZST_42_11: Ah, I know! Let me... paint a fan for you, {PlayerName}!
Side_XYHTZST_42_12: I'll let you know once it's done... Please come to my stall to pick it up.
Side_XYHTZST_43_1: Ah, your fan… It's here, already finished!
Side_XYHTZST_43_2: Please, take a look… Do you like it?
Side_XYHTZST_43_3: As you unfold the fan, the Taoyuan Vale reveals itself. Painted from a nearby mountain, the village glows under a dark night sky lit with vibrant fireworks.
Side_XYHTZST_43_4: You can see the effort Zhezhi put into this painting.
Side_XYHTZST_43_5: Thank you… I really like it.
Side_XYHTZST_43_7: Really? I'm... so glad you like it.
Side_XYHTZST_43_8: But why did you choose to paint the Moon-Chasing Festival?
Side_XYHTZST_43_9: Because… Well, this year's festival is special to me.
Side_XYHTZST_43_10: This painting isn't perfect, but it really captures how I feel.
Side_XYHTZST_43_11: It's a way for me to hold on to a few fleeting, precious moments.
Side_XYHTZST_43_14: The festival will come around again next year. I hope… we can enjoy it together.

Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_1: Could you do me a favor, Ms. Zani? Please secure the evidence in the property room and... fetch me the "jewelry" and "perfume."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_3: Ahem, yes. You know where to find our… "dressing room," I presume? Inform the "stylist" it's my request. She'll prepare everything. Meet us at the vault's side entrance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_4: Got it. I'll go right away.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_6: Surely you've sensed it—a darker force lurks behind both the Order and the Fisalias.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_8: Correct. We Montellis have had some… unpleasant encounters with them. Their motives remain shrouded, yet the Order and the Fisalias clearly benefit from them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_9: The Montelli family's interest aligns with yours. An uninterrupted Carnevale for you… an unfettered Ragunna for us.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_10: The invitation we sent was meant to be a token of goodwill.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_11: I'd appreciate it if you could return the favor.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_12: Splendid. So we are in the same boat, again.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_13: I must first deliver the evidence you and Ms. Zani collected to my uncle, Mr. Capollo.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_14: He oversees Carnevale affairs and liaises with the Fisalias. I'm sure he'll find the Fractsidus information… most intriguing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_15: I'm afraid I must take my leave. Please, feel free to explore the vault at your leisure.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_58_2: It's around 3.7% higher than yesterday. I double-checked it, should be correct.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_58_3: The Carnevale is really packing this place...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_1: Good day! Are you here for the Ducat Auction? I'm afraid we've closed entries for today's session. We would be delighted to see you at our next auction though.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_3: The Ducat Auction is held regularly in the Auction Hall.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_4: Here at Averardo Vault, we pride ourselves on our transparent and fair auctions where only bids matter. We welcome all lawful Ragunna citizens to make their offers. Any item appraised by our agents is eligible for auction.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_5: Be it selling collections or hunting for prized possessions, this is the place to be.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_6: Here's the catalog for our next auction. Please take a look.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_7: If you cannot attend in person, simply use our Terminal service, and our Averardo professionals will handle all your bidding and selling needs.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_1: I'm sorry, Lady Carlotta. I've just confirmed with the office that Mr. Capollo is not in the vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_3: That's quite alright. Please inform me the moment he returns.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_6: Oh, {PlayerName}. I'm afraid we've hit a slight snag.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_7: I just learned that Uncle Capollo was called away on pressing matters, so we won't be able to see him at the moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_8: This does alter our plans, but worry not. I already have some other surprises up my sleeve.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_9: Please come with me. We need more privacy.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_11: The noble from the Fisalia family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_12: Yes, thanks to you and Ms. Zani, he could not escape and is now in our custody.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_1: ...Everything has been taken care of, Lady Carlotta. Here is the "jewelry" and "perfume" you requested.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_3: But I have one more task for you, one of utmost importance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_4: I need you to guard the property room and stop anyone who attempts to break in, whatever it takes—by force if necessary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_8: Leave it to me. I'll make sure no one touches the evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_9: {PlayerName}, we've implemented a two-tier security system. Once inside, please hold your position until I signal. I'll clear the path for you from above.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_10: Then, you may need to use the Terminal to unlock the path on my side.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_11: Two-tier security system? Could it be…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_12: …Sadly yes, our family built this vault with the foresight of possible betrayal.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_13: Most family members only know how to pass one of the two layers. And alliances forged amid all these locks tend to breed treachery and mistrust.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_14: To enter the vault without being trapped to death, two people must have absolute trust in each other. So... do you trust me, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_15: Not really, but we have the same goals.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_17: We are already in the same boat, after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_19: Oh, I appreciate your trust. It will not be abused.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_20: Ha, very good. I can work with that.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_64_3: Just a moment, I need to access the upper control room to unlock the door on your end.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_1: So, can you figure it out?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_2: Let's try again. The frequency of the Tacet Discords… What a genius idea, but I can't reverse-engineer the frequency it's using.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_3: Seems like the key is not these flowers, but their creator. She must be an insanely powerful Resonator to be able to… shatter and recontruct these frequencies.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_4: Then we'd better speed up. Once their plan succeeds, there won't be another chance like this!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_6: It's me. Most likely by mistake. I apologize for interrupting your work.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_7: La…Lady Carlotta? How… what brings you here?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_8: Oh, nothing, just curious what you are working on, locked away in this tuning room…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_9: The flowers. No doubt they're from the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_10: Care to defend yourselves? While you still have the chance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_11: Lady Carlotta, we… we're just following orders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_12: Following orders, you say? Do you recall the very first "oath" we all took upon joining the family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_13: None… shall h-harm the family's interests.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_17: You've appropriated family assets and turned these Echoes into… ticking time bombs.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_18: Once they detonate, the countless efforts and fortunes spent on the Carnevale will all vanish instantly, taking the Montelli's name and future with them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_19: Lady Carlotta, p-please, we can explain...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_20: What's going on here? Oh, Lady Carlotta…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_21: Just in time. I've found some family traitors. But hold on, I have a few more questions for them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_22: I will only ask once. Who are you taking orders from?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_23: I only know he's one of the top brass in the family… always using encrypted channels and ordering us to pick up flowers from masked strangers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_24: How many of these Echoes have you made?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_25: …A lot. The first shipment reached the venue as early as a week ago. They look so identical to regular ones that even we can hardly tell them apart.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_27: Take them away and scrutinize all their recent transactions, including the source of every last credit. Then handle them as per the family rules.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_30: I knew those <ano=Frequency Specialist>tuners</ano> wouldn't dare do this alone. Someone far more dangerous is pulling the strings.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_31: Using Echoes to disrupt the Carnevale, having family weakness on a silver platter… enemies within are far more deadly than those without.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_32: Their schemes won't prevail. I will not sit idly by and watch them ruin the long-awaited Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_33: We're done here. Let the guards take care of the rest. So, Ms. Zani mentioned you heard the Sentinel's oracle when you met the Vitreum Dancer?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_34: Yes. Not directly, but close enough.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_35: The seasoned artisans in our family restored the Vitreum Dancer you retrieved and discovered something fascinating in its records.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_36: Come with me. This might answer your questions.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_1: Here we are. The true splendors of Montelli's heritage.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_2: Are these all Echoes in the cases?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_3: Yes, and no. They are Echoes but also the promise of Rinascita's future—and, above all, freedom.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_4: Rinascita may be a fledgling country, but it boasts centuries of history. Its foray into the wider world, however, only began a few years ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_5: Don't you find it peculiar? Rinascita, the Land of Echoes… leads the world in Echo technology, yet stands so insular and unadventurous.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_6: What do you suppose is behind all this?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_8: Sharp as always. Rinascita's Common Echoes are bound to Genesis Nexus, making seafaring with them almost impossible.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_9: But their power is essential for dealing with Tacet Discords and other threats at sea. You could say the reliance on Common Echoes has shackled our ambitions to venture beyond our borders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_10: To break these shackles, the Montelli family has invested in Reserved Terminals. It's not about short-term benefits, but the future for the whole of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_11: The Order has monopolized the use of Common Echoes and kept a tight leash on Reserved Terminals, claiming that individual ownership would sully the sanctity of the Echoes they so fervently preach about.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_12: But you see their real objective, don't you? To keep Rinascita isolated so they can shape its entire narrative.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_13: And the Fisalia family has covertly aligned with the Order, aiming to crush our efforts and therefore the prospect of Reserved Terminals. They've even gone so far as to seek Fractsidus' aid.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_14: Such is the reality of the Land of Echoes—whoever controls the Echoes controls Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_15: My forebears began collecting these Echoes long before the Vault existed, when the Montelli family was nothing more than a third-rate house ridiculed for its adventurous spirit.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_16: They ventured out to sea for trades and got their hands on Terminals of the most basic model. From there, they've been tirelessly collecting Echoes and advancing the technology. Brick by brick, they built this enterprise that you see today.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_17: You are probably wondering, how does this relates to the Vitreum Dancer? Well, the one that came to you at the Carnevale rehearsal is among our family's earliest Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_18: As both the first Vitreum Dancer and the prototype for the frequency tuning of all subsequent models, its value is truly unparalleled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_19: It was never meant to be deployed and should have been preserved here in a case forever. But somehow, it found its way to the Carnevale… just to meet you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_1: I trust you've read the files. The original Tacet Discord for the Vitreum Dancer emerged from the frequencies of shattered stained glass in the tower ruins, a place forbidden by decree of the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_2: Before the Codex era, those stained-glass windows were used to depict the tales of the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_3: Out of all of the Echoes, they chose the Vitreum Dancer to deliver Their message because—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_4: It will lead me to the Order's hidden truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_5: It will lead me to the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_6: Hmm... my thoughts exactly. The Order's secrets must somehow be connected to the Sentinel's fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_7: How do you know all this?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_8: The Montellis have long pursued the buried secrets of Rinascita—the Order's tampering with the Codex, and the mysterious erasure of the "Age of Ignorance" and the "Age of Conflict" from our history.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_9: If anything can break the chains around Rinascita and grant freedom to all, it must be the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_10: And the quest for this truth is also part of our endeavor to restore connection with the wider world.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_11: Well, that's all I have to offer. Did you want to visit the ruins? Though I'm not sure what there is to uncover.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_14: In that case, I'll accompany you. The family will take care of everything else.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_1: Oh, you're back. I've done everything you asked, Lady Carlotta. All the thugs trying to storm the room were handled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_2: So, they walked straight into the trap.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_3: Yes, we set a bait the traitors could never refuse. You aren't injured, are you, Ms. Zani?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_4: Of course not. I saw a squad of security guards charging into the vault. Did anything happen in there?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_5: Wait… no, never mind. Best I don't know. Whatever's going on in the vault must be family business.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_6: Anyway, it's all sorted now, yes?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_7: Yes, now you can take a break. I've spoken with Mr. Alberto, and he's agreed to grant you a very generous vacation.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_8: Oh, I don't really mind. My pay already came through… but vacation is always a bonus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_9: Thank you. These adventures beat office life by a mile.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_10: What? Is that... the central alarm of the vault?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_11: Could be a backup plan from the traitors.

Flow_313700000_99: A sudden floral scent pulls you into Verina's dream. You realize the scent might be the key to entering her dream.
Flow_313700000_100: One candle, two candles... Right, that's seven. Daddy, mommy, and Star, let's blow the candles together and wish me a happy birthday!
Flow_313700000_101: The candles on the cake are lit up. Bear toys sit around the square table, with cards on their chests reading "Daddy" and "Mommy." You wonder if you might be another bear toy here.
Flow_313700000_102: You watch as the girl closes her eyes and makes a wish with anticipation all over her face.
Flow_313700000_103: Surprised, Verina comes close to you and exclaims that this is life's miracle.
Flow_313700000_104: Is this... my birthday gift? Then I don't have to eat up the whole cake alone.
Flow_313700000_105: She excitedly gives you a slice of cake. As the sweetness hits your tongue, you notice all the clocks in the room are frozen, pointing at the same moment.
Flow_313700000_106: The TV next to you keeps repeating the same news: "Today, a famous explorer couple went missing at…"
Flow_313700000_107: She blows out the candles, cuts the cake into neat slices, and presents them to the dolls around her. Looking at the cake, you join her in silently wishing...
