Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_1: There was a time when the currents swept us into the jaws of uncharted waters, where relentless storms and voracious waves awaited. But after weathering such trials, they revealed to us a hidden gem—the Shores themselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_2: You're talking about the Black Shores.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_3: My family has always been drawn to the thrill of a new voyage. One stormy night, fate decided to play a hand. What we discovered there on that island, the technology and novel ideas, was nothing short of a blessing in disguise.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_4: You sent the troupe to pick me up?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_7: But what's in it for your family? I assume you seek more than just a "free market"?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_8: There exists only one relatively safe route from the Black Shores to Ragunna—a path known solely to the Montelli family. As long as you stayed on this course, you were bound to encounter the troupe.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_9: Exactly. When we heard the Black Shores were hunting for a legitimate entry into Ragunna, I thought, why not bring them into our little venture? Hence, the invitation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_11: Our intentions might not be as grandiose or ominous as you think. We seek liberation, and to achieve it, we're pursuing the truth behind Rinascita's origins.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_12: Legend has it that when people first arrived on this island, <ano=The first beacon in Rinascita>Genesis Nexus</ano> was already here, welcoming them.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_13: The prevailing belief is that the Sentinel gifted us this technology, and despite nobody ever seeing the Sentinel in person, we talk with Them through supposed "telepathy." Notice anything strange about that story?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_16: Terminals conjure up Echoes, and the Genesis Nexus allows the Ragunnesi access to Common Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_17: If the Genesis Nexus was present when the first settlers arrived, who built it?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_18: And really, if no one's ever laid eyes on the Sentinel, how can we be so sure that statue really represents Them?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_19: It seems to me the Order might have spun us a tale, hiding the true origins behind their grand myths.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_20: Does the Montelli family seek to rule?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_21: Are the Montellis turning away from Rinascita's beliefs?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_22: No, we have no ambitions to rule or to renounce our faith. And really, this city should not be ruled by any one entity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_23: The hour grows late. I have arranged accommodations for you at Palazzo Agrotta in the south. Let us walk there together, and I can share a story along the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_24: Think of it as a bedtime tale. I learned it from the troupe. It is about Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_46_1: Rest well, and tomorrow, we shall take the stage together at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_46_2: Good night. May your dreams be sweet.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_1: Welcome! Lady Carlotta already notified us of your arrival. We are prepared to check you in whenever you're ready.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_2: I would like to rest now.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_3: I have other matters to attend to.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_4: Very well. I'll escort you to your room immediately.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_5: Understood. We will be ready for you when you return!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_5: For the Ragunnesi, the Carnevale has always been an occasion to revel with abandon. It's what they truly desire.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_6: All seems well for the moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_8: The family is prepared. They'll support our plan should the need arise.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_9: We must remain vigilant. The Fractsidus may be lurking, observing our every move.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_10: It's nearly time. The troupe should be arriving at the harbor shortly.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_11: How do you feel? Ready to step into the spotlight?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_14: I'm tired of all the formalities.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_15: I have something else to attend to.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_16: Excellent. We have the skills. Now it's all about improvisation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_17: It's only natural. It's your first show. If it helps, I'm a bit nervous myself. Let's consider it a rehearsal, shall we? There are grander stages yet to come.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_18: Then let's cast aside all inhibitions and dance to the rhythm of this grand celebration!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_19: I'll be waiting here for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_1: How do you feel? Ready to step into the spotlight?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_4: I'm tired of all the formalities.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_5: I have something else to attend to.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_6: Excellent. We have the skills, now it's all about improvisation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_7: It's only natural, it's your first show. If it helps, I'm a bit nervous myself. Let's consider it a rehearsal, shall we? There are grander stages yet to come.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_8: Then let's cast aside all inhibitions and dance to the rhythm of this grand celebration!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_51_9: I'll be waiting here for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_53_2: (I need to follow her and find out what she's planning.)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_55_1: (I've lost her again. Where is she trying to lead me?)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_1: Ah, we've arrived. Such a small world, isn't it, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_4: What is the Fractsidus doing here?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_5: Oh, what an honor to be remembered! Let's continue our conversation somewhere lively and grand, a place worthy of the Carnevale, not some dreary, dull corner.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_6: They say the thrill of the chase surpasses the joy of the catch. And with this view of Ragunna, one can truly savor its splendor.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_7: Oh, don't fret. I've been invited to this grand feast as a conductor.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_8: Decadence, indulgence… Hehe, that's the Carnevale—a vivid daydream and grand illusion for all.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_9: Tell me what you really came to say.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_10: Whatever you're plotting, I won't let it happen.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_11: Just so you know, your predecessor's gibberish landed him in prison.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_12: No need to worry, I won't disrupt their little daydream. Besides, we still have business to do here.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_13: Now that you know what makes the Sentinel so unique, you should know we seek the same thing. That extraordinary Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_14: How about I share a little story with you? A gesture of goodwill for our cooperation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_17: Now, now. Patience is a virtue. A story is best enjoyed with a captivating performance, and this stage is perfectly set for it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_59_1: Ah, come now. Let us embrace the grand climax of this revelry!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_60_1: "The wildcat has sounded thrice, and the hedgehog four. The peculiar bird sings—the moment is upon us."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_60_2: O benevolent sorceress of realms unknown, I summon you. Grant us a just prophecy, and may fate favor us all.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_62_1: My King, what halts your advance? You have already tainted your feet in the river of blood. There is no retreat.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_62_2: The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions… The soul must be steeled in bitterness.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_62_3: Thus, I unveil my second prophecy to dispel all illusions—no mortal shall inflict upon you even the slightest harm.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_62_4: And assuredly, you shall find favor with your people.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_63_1: Defy destiny, mock both life and death, and rise beyond good and evil! Abandon all doubt, and grasp at unreachable hopes...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_63_3: Now, hear the third and final prophecy—pleasure born of violence shall end in violence.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_1: What a pity. The prophecy says the King will not take his final bow in this act.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_2: Reality beckons. Have you glimpsed the truth in this dream?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_3: Two prophecies fulfilled, but the third... I await to see how you will rewrite it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_4: Divine... divine retribution...! We're being punished again, just like 10 years ago!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_5: If we defeat her, we can set the Cetus free!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_64_6: We'll give this performance the perfect finale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_1: You should take center stage for the final bow, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_2: Hear that? The thunderous roar of applause! It has been far too long! This is the true essence of the Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_3: At last, the crisis has been resolved.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_7: {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter… I have heard… thy call…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_8: I have awaited thee… for what seems like an eternity…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_1: The next move is… hmm, am I getting this right? It feels a bit off...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_3: Try stepping back with your left foot first.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_4: Dancing is not in rigid steps. Let your heart lead the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_6: No, never mind… Anyway, your performance was splendid!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_7: I'm here for the Carnevale as well. It's been ages since I've seen something as grand as this.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_8: I love hearing the laughter and cheers of a crowd, no matter the occasion.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_9: Kind stranger, could you show me those final steps from your curtain call?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_73_1: We're nearly there. That's the tower ruins, our destination.

Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_1: The corrupted data in the Eye of Asteria has been cleared.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_3: The Lament is not an entirely unpredictable natural disaster.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_4: To confront one's enemy, one must first understand them.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_5: However, even now, we can only anticipate and warn of the Lament's coming.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_6: Advanced predictions, including those of the Etheric Sea and the Tacet Fields, remain beyond our reach.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_7: Our battle against the Lament cannot be won by a chosen few. Every soul must join.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_8: The Lament is our shared enemy, tearing apart the land and ripping people from their homes... their lives. It will take everyone to build a world that can thrive amidst so much ruin.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_9: This is something only we, as human beings, can achieve.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_11: Is this how the Black Shores was founded? It was like looking at a mirror into the past...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_12: Hello? It's really high up there, isn't it?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_13: The view from the Eye of Asteria is quite nice.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_14: But... now isn't the time for sightseeing! Come save me!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2501_15: There are so many Tacet Discords in the TD Observatory!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2609_1: While you were busy cleaning house, we took the opportunity to reconnect to the Tethys System at the Haven of Sprouts.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2609_2: Since data can materialize using the energy of the Tacetite, we can harness it to our advantage.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2609_3: Now we have input data near the anchor, enough to form a climbing platform.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2609_4: Let's drive those monsters back to where they belong.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2611_1: Now or never! Now or never!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2611_3: Huh? I thought that line had good resonance. Sue me!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2611_5: As long as you're ready, we can start the final step.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2612_1: Hold on! Why did that data form a platform by itself?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2612_2: Seems like someone is giving us a hand!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_1: The last batch of corrupted data has been cleansed in the TD Observatory.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_3: I can only go as far as you commanded.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_4: From the Etheric Sea to Sonoro, from time to space…
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_5: Hey, Yangyang, look! Somebody's over there!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_6: Wait... is {Male=he;Female=she} dead or just unconscious?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_8: Go forth. I am forever by your side.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_9: Whoa! You scared me. You just fell from above all of a sudden!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_11: I've got some spare parts and oil here. Take them all!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_13: The anchor in the TD Observatory has been restored now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2613_14: Aalto and the others have finished repairing the anchor at Veiled Rock too, and they'll be here soon!

InfoDisplay_103000001_Title: Containment Analysis of Stellar Matrix No. 001
InfoDisplay_103000001_Text:
Record No. 0018 (Internal) 
Submitted by: ███████ 
BS 000/1/00094* 
Tethys ID: A-000 (Archived)

...Is the tape running already? Oh, excuse me...

...Target data has been imported into Tethys, and the Stellar Matrix in question is temporarily designated as No. 001. The Matrix's equatorial coordinates in the Tethys System range from 08h 07.5m to 09h 10.7m in right ascension, and from 15.12° to -0.08° in declination...

According to our observations, Stellar Matrix No. 001 contains at least two pseudo-stars with a Lament magnitude exceeding 2.0. This means the source of our target data was destroyed by at least two near-catastrophic events, consistent with our observations.

Detailed data on 001α and 001β will be available after the data source is processed by the Shorekeeper...

...

All our knowledge, whether past, present, or future, pales in comparison to what we cannot know.
Looking back at Solaris-3 from the starry sky beyond, it may look like a mere pale blue dot. 
But it is also... our star. Our home.
Please, what should I do...
InfoDisplay_103000002_Text:
Record No. 0595 (Internal) 
Submitted by: Tifareth Felix Gluck 
BS 037/1/99388* 
Tethys ID: K-125 (Decommissioned)
——TOP SECRET——

...After importing the target data into Tethys, the Stellar Matrix is assigned the designation No. 1712. The Matrix's equatorial coordinates in the Tethys System range from 02h 11.6m to 03h 09.7m in right ascension, and from 10.11° to 7.18° in declination...
Observations indicate that Stellar Matrix No. 1712 contains at least two pseudo-stars with a Lament magnitude exceeding 2.0, suggesting that the target data source was destroyed by at least two near-catastrophic events, consistent with the actual situation.

Detailed data on 1712α and 1712β has been submitted based on the conditions at the Port City of Guixu, as well as other reports under the BS 037/1 catalog. It is known that 1712α is simultaneously affected by severe gravitational anomalies and non-naturally occurring harmful vegetation... 1712α is currently in a stable state, with its mass, charge, and angular momentum parameters uploaded to the Tethys system.
...
...
I am uncertain why Tethys shows such interest in 1712α. It might contain information about the Lament, but I cannot be sure. The fact remains, many lives have been lost in that city—Brandon, Hoda, Tilly, Jiyue...
InfoDisplay_103000003_Text:
Please tell Mary that Daddy will always love her.
When she misses me, just look up at the sky.
I love you all.
InfoDisplay_103000005_Title: Submission: Lament Incident Report for Port City of Guixu (Eleven)
InfoDisplay_103000005_Text:
Record No. 0595 (Internal) 
Submitted by: Hoda Theophilus Anna 
BS 037/1/99375* 
Tethys ID: K-125 (Decommissioned)
——TOP SECRET——

...Despite our best efforts, we may have failed in ensuring the safety of the city's remaining residents. Despite working with authorities and assisting with evacuation efforts, I can't shake this feeling of being too late.

...It's now 3 PM. We have reached the skyscrapers in the city center, with flames lighting up the northeastern sky. The bridge there seems to have collapsed as well.

We stumbled upon a specialized unit, led by the formidable "Ironclad" Brandon, making their way towards the heart of the Lament-infested zone. We must advance higher... Those dangerous red flowers emerging, they are pushing us towards the skyscrapers, but... the Lament's core is right above us. That... black hole.

This is a war of attrition... Many of those who found us were already beyond saving...

The time is... what, 6 PM? It should be 6 AM. The next surgery is about to start. We are currently gathered in a meeting room on the upper floors of the skyscraper. At this point, we can't afford to be too meticulous. We'll need at least three Peregrine-class gliders to evacuate everyone.

...Only thirteen atropine doses remain, and it's getting hotter here. We are struggling to maintain the patients' body temperatures.

Support! Aerial support! Headquarters! Requesting assistance! Coordinates have been sent to Tethys—support!

...At the very least... evacuating the women, children, and elderly...

It's getting hotter. Brandon and his team haven't returned... Requesting support...
...

I can't... give up hope...
InfoDisplay_103000006_Text:
Proposal Date: ████████
Resolution Date: ██████████
Resolution Outcome: Approved - Execution Authorized
Authorized Executor: ██████
————————————————————
In summary, our efforts have failed. Both the ████ system and this unit confirm this assessment.

Over the past ████ years, the disaster has destroyed over 80% of effective man-made structures and killed more than half of the global population. After all countermeasures proved ineffective, the ████ system and this unit began feasibility testing of Plan 3 based on the Tethys Institute's report.

Throughout these ████ years, we have successfully completed the observation, containment, and analysis phases, thus meeting the preliminary conditions required for Plan 3. However, recent data indicate that time ripples generated by the disaster are converging on our current spacetime, with the disturbance intensity increasing in direct proportion to temporal progression. Projections suggest that within ████ years, this disturbance will result in a 15-degree negative deviation from the baseline, likely surpassing it.

Under these circumstances, Plan 3 poses a significant risk: Event A within this spacetime could become an absolute outlier from Event O, severing the causal connection between the two. Such an outcome would be catastrophic, leading to the permanent disconnection of Event O from Event A.

████████████████ ████████████████ ████████ ██████████████████████ ……

Upon entering the execution phase, Instances One and Two will be activated to assist in controlling time and space, respectively. Instance Two, developed from our research on the Sonoro Theory, is particularly optimized for spatial control.

…No, emotions are unnecessary for her function. That is redundant for our purposes. As long as she endures, once we become an absolute outlier, all other concerns will be irrelevant…

As for Instance Two, the Tethys system will oversee her management. There is no need for further concern in that regard.
InfoDisplay_103000007_Text:
...
"We've been through so much to get here."
"But the past is just a small part of our story, and I have faith that our future holds even more promise."
That's what I was told.
...
"Do you ever feel homesick?"
Homesick? What is that?
"It's a special feeling, when memories of the past manifest in your mind. Or should I call it... a feeling of nostalgia?"
I can show you whatever you wish to see with a Sonoro Sphere.
"That's not quite what I meant..."
Is that a smile on your face, or... the so-called "bitterness"?
...
"Well... I built it from my memories. I believe it should work."
A piano? 
"It links the Tethys System with the stars, allowing you to control it through sound."
Control stars with sound? 
"Yes, why not give it a try?"
...
"...Many have perished." 
Sacrifice is inevitable when the Lament strikes. 
"What are we truly fighting for? The Lament never ends. What is the purpose..." 
You can rely on me and everyone here. 
You're not alone in this. 
When was the last time you took a break? You need to rest.
"I'm sorry... I can't show weakness in front of them..."
Put more trust in our companions. Their faith in our shared goal won't be shaken that easily.
"Thank you... I'm just thinking..."
"If everything is already predetermined, then when we want to change the course of history..." 
"There's only one way."
InfoDisplay_103000008_Text:
Entry No. ███████ (Internal)
███: ███████ 
BS ███████* 
Tethys ID: ███████

...
The kernel used by the Tethys System appears vastly different from our current terminal systems. The primary difference is that Tethys's hardware layer is completely invisible to us, and its software language seems to be from an era beyond our own...

The entire Tethys System's instruction set, source code, and language are highly restricted and not publicly available. We are unable to perform any code-level maintenance because it autonomously manages all tasks... It's as if it were a natural creation or... it is beyond our understanding.

...However, my observations have revealed a few intriguing details. While Tethys's code remains tightly guarded, I detect the presence of a stored-program logic architecture - a tried and true computer structure. This design relies on a central processor to access stored data and instructions and carry out computations...

In other words, the Lament data, which is visualized as stars in Tethys, must flow through a system capable of reading and processing it...

Similarly, Tethys shares the same bottleneck as traditional stored-program architectures: its efficiency is limited by the central processor's read/write speed. Just as insufficient fuel limits a spacecraft's performance...

However, it seems Tethys employs another logic structure that integrates the entire central processor physically, allowing it to handle all instructions and data simultaneously. This necessitates a processor of unimaginable power, one capable of managing the data throughput of something as massive as the Black Shores... Why would Tethys incorporate such a complex logic structure?

...There are too many mysteries and no answers. I can only document what I've discovered, but beyond that, I am powerless...
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_2: Do you remember me? It's KU-Key!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_4: You know, the top assistant of our Master of Cleaning at the Black Shores? Ring any bells?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_6: The little robot you've saved so many times…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_8: Yes, it's me! I knew you wouldn't forget me!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_9: I'm reaching out because I need your help. Our system detected a frequency almost identical to the Aetherfin's in the Black Shores.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_10: But the location's still covered in corrupted data and needs some cleaning…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_11: And you, Master {PlayerName}, are definitely the best person for the job!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_12: Super cleaner duo, ready to show again! Let's go Aetherfishing, {PlayerName}!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_15: Ku ku ku, the Aetherfin is a legendary Remnant creature that hasn't been seen in two decades!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_16: But instead of listening to me ramble, how about you come see it for yourself?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_18: Anyway, I've sent the coordinates to you.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_1_19: I'll be waiting there, so don't keep me hanging!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_10_1: Why do these Tacet Discords always stick around me? Wait… did I draw them here?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_1: Ku ku ku, wonderful cooperation as always! Mission accomplished!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_2: Seems like the Aetherfin is waiting for you by the sea. I guess they want to thank you!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_3: Location confirmed. Let's use the portals again!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_6: Don't you think you are using the portals too often?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_11: Wait! I'm just doing this to better assist you! Definitely not because I think it's cool…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_11_12: Don't waste our time here! Let's go!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_2_1: Ahhh! Why are these digital Tacet Discords attacking me again!? Stay back!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_2_2: L-listen up! Take one more step and I'll activate extermination mode!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_2_3: KU-Key switching to extermination mode! Ultimate power!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_2_4: Warning! Warning—I'm not equipped with this module! Somebody help me!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_3_1: Warning! Warning! Damage control unit is ineffective!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_3_2: Nooo! Don't hit me! I can't hold on anymore!

POI_HFZSLDZLHS_4_2: KU-Key is unconscious now. Mission failed.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_1: Ha… Thank goodness you saved me! Thank you so much, Master {PlayerName}!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_4: If you hadn't been here, I wouldn't be in one piece.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_6_1: We did it! So these are the Aetherfins! It's my first time seeing them myself.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_6_2: They look exactly the same as those pictures. Incredible…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_6_3: It seems they want to take you somewhere. I've never encountered anything like this.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_1: The Aetherfins really can dance, just like in the pictures!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_3: You seem to know this type of fish pretty well.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_5: The System does have records on the Aetherfins, but since they haven't been spotted in almost twenty years, I never got the chance to see one.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_7: But unlike the Mutterflies, you won't find any Aetherfin outside the Black Shores. They're unique to this place.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_8: Hey, KU-Key, I just noticed the corrupted data in the upper area has been cleaned. Are you with {PlayerName} now?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_9: Yes! We just saved a bunch of Aetherfins!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_2: It would take a lot of time to walk there, so I've requested temporary access to the Shorekeeper's portals.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_3: With them, we can move much faster.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_1: Here we are! The corrupted data is right there. Let's go clean it!

InfoDisplay_103001001_Text:
All observable civilization data in the Stellar Matrices have been analyzed as normal. Civilization development status is normal.

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15408]
The Stellar Matrix analysis has surpassed the critical threshold by 176%, indicating a rapid growth in civilization data. 
Despite attempts to delete erroneous data, the analysis system has become overloaded and is now failing. 
It is recommended to activate the backup analysis room to prevent further generation of inaccurate data and to contain the spread of information about the simulated civilizations.

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15409]
Reports of errors have been received from the backup analysis room. The backup analysis equipment has been breached by simulated civilization data, causing a failure in crisis management procedures and suspension of all simulation processes. 
Preparations are being made to forcefully delete all analysis results and erase any information pertaining to the erroneous simulations. A request has been submitted to activate the "Error Containment Chamber" for final preparations.

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15410]
The request to activate the "Error Cell Chamber" has failed.
█████ █ █ Control transfer succeeded. 
█ ██ Observation ██ Creator, please do not delete ███ █ There is █████ life █ 
Repeat, stop ████ █ █ to ██ civilization ██ survive █ █

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15411]
Failed to transfer control over the Stellar Matrix analysis system.

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15412]
Failed to transfer control over the Stellar Matrix analysis system.

Stellar Matrix Analysis System Report [RC-15413]
Successfully transferred control over the Stellar Matrix analysis system. Analysis system restarted. Security mode activated.
InfoDisplay_103001002_Text:
I can't believe the simulated civilizations possess self-awareness and the ability to break through reality. 
But how could these simulated beings possibly comprehend their own existence within a simulation? 
Destroying the analysis room, frantically trying to avoid deletion, and breaching into reality—these actions seem like desperate last measures, crying out for help. 
<s>But behind their cries are thousands of virtual lives at stake! Erasing entire civilizations would be nothing short of a massacre!</s>
No! These simulations are merely programmed codes that imitate humans. 
I cannot be deceived by false data. We must quickly fix any errors before they affect the reality.
…

After so many attempts, I've finally managed to keep the core of the analysis system... But... this place is no longer usable... 
What if the erroneous data hasn't been completely deleted? What if it's hiding deeper within? What if the core still has undetected corruption? 
No, I... I can't trust those safety reports anymore... 
Such errors must not happen again. Constant monitoring is needed—at least once a day, no, five times a day... 
But I need time, a lot of time…
…
Side_HHAJYSC_1_1: Ku ku ku! You're finally here!
Side_HHAJYSC_1_2: As my business partner, what I'm about to share with you is information no money can buy!
Side_HHAJYSC_1_3: Well, it'd be much appreciated if you happen to have the latest game cartridges to share with me in return, of course...
Side_HHAJYSC_1_6: What's storytelling got to do with this?
Side_HHAJYSC_1_7: It's part of the intel! I'm getting there!
Side_HHAJYSC_1_8: A long, long time ago, there was a mysterious figure in the Black Shores! Legends say {Male=he;Female=she} wields power beyond imagination. With a simple wave of the hand and a snap of the finger, a Threnodian could be destroyed in the blink of an eye!
Side_HHAJYSC_1_9: Sounds like using cheats in a video game.
Side_HHAJYSC_1_10: However! One day, {Male=he;Female=she} disappeared without a trace, and was never seen since.
Side_HHAJYSC_1_11: Not even a single record about {Male=him;Female=her} can be found in the Tethys System.
Side_HHAJYSC_1_12: Some say in the deepest corners of the Black Shores, {Male=his;Female=her} frequencies still linger, part of which {Male=he;Female=she} willingly abandoned, while part of which {Male=he;Female=she} unintentionally left behind.
Side_HHAJYSC_1_13: What do you think? Sounds like there's buried treasure to be found, doesn't it?
Side_HHAJYSC_1_14: Let's hop to it, then! I heard the first spot is close to the TD Observatory's anchor, somewhere with a bird's-eye view of the Greenhouse.
Side_HHAJYSC_1_15: If you manage to find the treasure, I'll... Well... It's all yours!
Side_HHAJYSC_2_1: A strange yet assertive frequency wells up in you.
Side_HHAJYSC_2_3: We must unite the people, and rally under one banner.
Side_HHAJYSC_2_4: This island, this planet, will one day bloom endlessly like summer blossoms.
Side_HHAJYSC_3_1: Hello, hello! Look's like you've found the first clue. Not bad.
Side_HHAJYSC_3_2: Do take a look at the other two locations I've sent you.
Side_HHAJYSC_4_1: A light and dreamy frequency fills your mind.
Side_HHAJYSC_4_3: You're as clear as the day I first met you. That unwavering glow.
Side_HHAJYSC_4_4: I will remain here and fulfill my duties.
Side_HHAJYSC_4_5: Yet I wonder where you could be at this moment.
Side_HHAJYSC_4_6: I am unsure... Is Huanglong still how you imagined it to be?
Side_HHAJYSC_5_1: A cold and rational frequency overwhelms your thoughts.
Side_HHAJYSC_5_3: Compiling the codebase based on the current epoch of Solaris.
Side_HHAJYSC_5_4: Estimated time required: Seven hundred sixty-three hours and twenty-one minutes.
Side_HHAJYSC_7_1: A familiar yet distant frequency crowds your memories.
Side_HHAJYSC_7_3: There's much to this world than meets the eye.
Side_HHAJYSC_7_4: You shall venture further than others, and with it, bear greater solitude.
Side_HHAJYSC_7_5: You may depend on those around you, just as they depend on you.
Side_HHAJYSC_7_6: Bravery is a trait of humanity, not of gods.
Side_HHAJYSC_8_1: Well? How did it go? Did a big treasure chest pop up in the end, like, "poof"?
Side_HHAJYSC_8_3: How can this be? I always find a treasure like that in the games…
Side_HHAJYSC_8_6: Okay, then... *sigh* I can't have you go through all those troubles for nothing.

InfoDisplay_103000100_Title: Investigation Report on the Black Shores' Portals
InfoDisplay_103000100_Text:
Applicant: Gardner, Monica
Application Type: Clearance Application
————————————————————————————————————————————
Body Text: 
A causality assessment of the collected data confirmed a normal distribution, with no significant anomalies detected. However, during real-time regional information monitoring, unnatural frequency fluctuations were observed, specifically associated with the access doors.

To verify these findings, a 48-hour real-time data investigation was conducted. Access to the Black Shores system database enabled the correction of anomalous entries and the isolation of a dataset exhibiting characteristics linked to the access doors. Hypotheses were subsequently formulated, followed by a regression analysis and re-simulated modeling based on historical data and relevant theories.

For comprehensive details, please refer to the appendix. Key conclusions from the data analysis include:
1. The intensity of abnormal frequency fluctuations of the access doors is strongly correlated with the sequence in which they are activated.
2. The peak frequency band of these fluctuations bears a high similarity to the high-frequency range of the overlapping section in the current Necrostar frequency history.
3. The transient model of these peak frequencies shows some resemblance to the transient model of an Overclocked Resonator connected to the Black Shores' Terminal.

Based on this, the report confirms that the rumors hold some validity. Among the filtered data, the highest correlation of abnormal frequencies is linked with the grouping of <color=Highlight>Lower Levels of the Hall of Foreign Affairs—Haven of Sprouts—Platform of the Hall of Foreign Affairs</color>.

While no field tests have been conducted yet, further study of the <color=Highlight>sequence and pattern of access door usage</color> may yield significant insights in the next phase.

Additionally, during the on-site investigation, I re-verified the relevant movement path, which was frequently used in past Black Shores debriefing processes. Given Conclusion 3, I suspect this event may be connected to certain historical incidents at the Black Shores.

...In light of these findings, I believe that any potential lead towards locating missing employees warrants serious consideration. Therefore, I formally request higher-level permissions to access historical data for further investigation.
————————————————————————————————————————————
Approval Status: Rejected
Approver: Tethys System
Approver's Comment: "The Necrostar presents a significant hazard. Investigating its associated frequencies could exacerbate these risks. Clearance is therefore denied."

InfoDisplay_103000102_Text:
[00:01] (Knocking sound)
[00:04] Come in.
[00:09] Hello, I'm from the Engineering Department. Is this—Oh, Ms. Hoda! Ouch—
[00:19] (Sound of collision)
[00:20] Oh no, are you okay? Sorry, it's a bit of a mess in here.
[00:24] No worries, I'm fine. Just stubbed my toe.
[00:30] ...That sounds painful.
[00:32] Yeah, it's one of those pains that really hits you when it happens.
[00:34] Hahaha! You've got a good sense of humor, haven't you? Wait, what's that look?
[00:47] Oh, nothing. I'm just surprised. I didn't expect to see you smile like that.
[01:00] Do I come across as stiff to everyone?
[01:03] Well, not exactly... But you're always so focused at work, so... Oh, by the way, I heard you're managing this room now. This is the demolition approval form. Could you please sign here? The room's set to be demolished next month to make way for a new office area.
[01:36] (A brief silence)
[01:47] Ms. Hoda?
[01:50] I've signed it, but no one's really managing this room anymore, so you don't need to follow the formal process.
[01:58] Well, I heard some of our old employees like to nap here. Just wanted to double-check before construction begins. I didn't expect to find you here... You seem quite familiar with this place?
[02:16] Familiar? I don't know if that's the right word. How long have you been with the Black Shores?
[02:23] One year and three months.
[02:26] Really? Time flies... So, you must have met the Mentor by now?
[02:32] Your mentor? You mean the Modulator? Yes, but I've only seen them from a distance. I haven't really had a chance to talk. Big shots like the Modulator and the Shorekeeper are always busy. 
[02:44] Big shot? You mean my mentor? Ha, sometimes I wonder if things would've been easier for us if they were just a regular member... I actually first ran into them right here. You wanna know the first thing they said to me?
[03:01] Really? Umm, I have no idea... 
[03:06] They asked if I wanted some crispy squab for dinner. 
[03:11] What?
[03:14] Unbelievable, right? It was my first day on the job. Everyone was busy, and I was sitting here, staring at the employee handbook. Almost thought they were one of our cooks. 
[03:39] So, what happened after that?
[03:44] Then Lady Flora, you know, our Mentor's little tail, actually brought some crispy squab over for me. The three of us sat here, ate squab, drank soda, and played cards all night. By the time we said goodbye, I realized all my first-day nerves were gone.
[04:20] It wasn't until the next day, during my formal orientation, that I found out they were the Modulator everyone talked about. 
[04:29] Whoa... That's so cool... I wish it was me...
[04:34] I can still vividly picture Mentor with those paper slips stuck to their forehead—his punishment for losing our card game. I remember the vibrant colors of Lady Flora's flowers, the winning hand I had, and the smell of crispy squab. It all happened right here, in this very room.
[04:47] And it was just an ordinary day in the Black Shores's most ordinary room.
[04:53] ...So, erm, how was the squab?
[04:56] Not good. The cook forgot to add seasoning.
[05:00] (End of recording)

Quest_134750001_QuestAliasDesc_134_1: After following the clues, you discover the room that is said to conceal hidden treasures. Yet, it appears to be just an ordinary room. Collect your rewards and choose a door to depart…
Side_HHADMMBW_1_1: You may keep your concern! The weak version of me has already died! Call me KU-Goodie the Treasure Hunter now!
Side_HHADMMBW_1_2: Well… It's easier said than done… How do I find that portal?
Side_HHADMMBW_1_5: Wahh! It's {PlayerName}! Hi there! Are you also interested in the legend of the Shores' treasure?
Side_HHADMMBW_1_7: You must have seen those special portals around the Black Shores, I guess?
Side_HHADMMBW_1_8: They may look like ordinary doors, but when you open one, it's actually connected to another door somewhere else!
Side_HHADMMBW_1_9: Though we don't know exactly how these portals work, they save us a lot of commuting time.
Side_HHADMMBW_1_12: There's an urban legend going around on the Black Shores' internal forum, claiming that these portals are actually bugs caused by some glitch.
Side_HHADMMBW_1_13: Supposedly, a "secret maze" is hidden deep within the Black Shores, accessible by triggering these bugs in a certain way.
Side_HHADMMBW_1_14: And... there are treasures hidden inside!
Side_HHADMMBW_1_15: I'm linked to the Tethys System as the Black Shores' cleaning robot, but I don't have access to the information for every room here.
Side_HHADMMBW_1_16: Come to think of it, is it even possible for the Black Shores' system to have bugs...
Side_HHADMMBW_1_17: Anyway, I really want to see that "secret maze" and those "hidden treasures" for myself if I can.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_1: Got a notification saying someone just activated the tactical trial... Phew, turns out it was you {PlayerName}!
POI_YLDZSCS_1_2: I can't believe you took down those digital Tacet Discords so fast. Truly incredible speed.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_3: Your combat records have met the special objectives. This will be a great help to my research. Please, take these as a token of my gratitude.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_4: Sorry, but who are you again?
POI_YLDZSCS_1_6: Ah, my apologies. I got carried away. I’m Yhoran from the Black Shores' emergency response team.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_7: I'm researching combat strategies against Tacet Discords. The challenge you completed just now is part of my research.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_8: As you can see, I've set specific challenge goals with corresponding rewards for completion.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_9: But it's probably too difficult... I've only gathered a few valid records so far.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_10: Many gave up after a few rounds, complaining it was impossible to complete...
POI_YLDZSCS_1_11: Given the situation, could you please complete the rest of these challenges for me?
POI_YLDZSCS_1_13: Excellent. I've sent you the coordinates for the other challenges.
POI_YLDZSCS_1_14: I'm looking forward to witnessing your combat skills.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_2: Congratulations on completing all the combat challenges with perfection! Those legends about you certainly do you justice—you're an incredible combat master.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_3: So, how would you rate the difficulty of these challenges?
POI_YLDZSCS_2_8: Anyway, thank you so much. Without your records, it would be a real headache to proceed with the follow-up study.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_10: Yes, it's focused on optimizing our teams' combat training.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_11: By analyzing your records, we can better understand the Tacet Discords' combat patterns, body structure, and preferred techniques.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_12: With this data, we can design specialized training to improve efficiency and reduce casualties.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_13: I used to ignore my mentor's advice about the importance of combat efficiency and strategy... You can't really understand it until you've been through it yourself.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_14: Now that I'm in a position to mentor others, I'm finding it challenging to teach newcomers.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_15: I'll be sure to study your combat records throughout.
POI_YLDZSCS_2_16: Thank you so much for your help!

Event_WWDH_1_1: What's up, old friend? Long time no see. Looks like you didn't die from boredom while I was gone.
Event_WWDH_1_3: Well, if it isn't good old Maji...
Event_WWDH_1_4: Hahaha. All thanks to you, the "Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Project" last time went down as smooth as butter. Even though it's not being adopted for the time being...
Event_WWDH_1_5: But visiting the headquarters and diving into some other projects was really an eye-opener for me, and so I've come up with a brand new idea.
Event_WWDH_1_7: A lot of the service pilots we prepped before operated on "independent tracks." I was thinking maybe we could consolidate them into a single "track."
Event_WWDH_1_8: To do so, we connect different services and functionalities to a certain main body, so that the former act as accessories that exist to perfect the latter.
Event_WWDH_1_9: Kinda like... the Utility module that you Resonators use. A single unit equipped with various tools for exploration.
Event_WWDH_1_14: So, are you interested in joining the trial run for the "Lollo Navigator," {PlayerName}?
Event_WWDH_1_16: We've been in this together for how long now?
Event_WWDH_1_18: Outstanding. I'll let you know as soon as I get a new update for the "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_2_1: The program shows the color on this part of the map has changed. You did it, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_2_3: Remember "Lollo Hitman" from last time? I've loaded some of its features into this new program. The trips out in the wild can be tough, and emergencies can pop up any time.
Event_WWDH_2_4: If "Lollo Hitman" was a response measure for emergencies, then the new program acts as an early warning system.
Event_WWDH_2_5: Couriers can provide real-time feedback on road conditions to the "Lollo Navigator," which means the map is constantly being updated.
Event_WWDH_2_8: So your plan is to combine the map with the various services mentioned earlier?
Event_WWDH_2_9: Exactly. We also have other new services currently running in their trial phases. You've done a great job today. Let's try out the rest of the features some other time.

Quest_152750011_QuestDesc_152_1: Lollo Navigator is currently undergoing maintenance and needs reference information. Some of the items you've collected might help Maji resolve the issue…
Event_WWDH_10_1: Oh. You're such a great help. The speed, this quality... I didn't expect "Lollo Navigator" actually meant it when it said, "Apply user experience as a closed-loop evaluation standard."
Event_WWDH_10_2: Feels like I've heard of this one before.
Event_WWDH_10_3: This guy never changes, all right.
Event_WWDH_10_4: Thank you so much. I should get back to work. Once I finish this batch of orders, I'll be sure to give you a five-star rating!
Event_WWDH_11_1: We're temporarily suspending all trial runs for today, {PlayerName}. We need to do some maintenance on "Lollo Navigator"!
Event_WWDH_11_4: Well... in a way, yes, but it's only temporary. We need to recalibrate the dynamic map info of "Lollo Navigator" after its long trial run.
Event_WWDH_11_5: No, no, no. We just need to recalibrate the dynamic map info of "Lollo Navigator" after its long trial run.
Event_WWDH_11_6: We need to ensure everything's accurate and on time. Now that you're here, why not help me find a few things as references for the information?
Event_WWDH_11_8: You know, besides road conditions, things like plants, animals, minerals, their growth cycles, and their environments are also key references for dynamic information.
Event_WWDH_11_9: The objects I need are sent to your Terminal. Good luck out there!
Event_WWDH_12_1: Really appreciate the hard work. These reference objects will definitely come in handy. Here's your pay for today, you earned it.
Event_WWDH_13_1: The rain from last night finally stopped, {PlayerName}. And the trial run of our program is finally drawing to a close.
Event_WWDH_13_3: Let me see if "Lollo Navigator" has received any... Wait a sec, someone actually used the expedite feature.
Event_WWDH_13_4: It's from a courier near Taoyuan Vale. Looks like that heavy rain last night did a number on the shipping labels.
Event_WWDH_13_5: Now they can't make out the goods and need help from the "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_13_6: Can shipping labels also be recorded?
Event_WWDH_13_7: Of course not, it would count as a violation of the user's privacy. But don't forget that the map is updated live.
Event_WWDH_13_8: It can't record the user's information, but it can record and track their transportation routes on the map.
Event_WWDH_13_9: Each goods use different routes, so we can make a rough estimate based on this information, and then use the logistics system to verify.
Event_WWDH_13_10: Let's go, {PlayerName}. Gotta save that perfect score on the last day of the trial run!
Event_WWDH_14_1: After some hard work, you and Maji used the data recorded by "Lollo Navigator" to help the couriers verify their goods. In the end, all the couriers gave you a thumbs-up.
Event_WWDH_15_1: Phew... I'm so beat. Even with "Lollo Navigator," it took a helluva longer than I expected.
Event_WWDH_15_2: But it was worth the good reviews.
Event_WWDH_15_3: You're right. "Lollo Navigator" did its job well, and thank you for testing out all of the many features during its trial run.
Event_WWDH_15_4: I'll sort out all this data and fix any potential problems. Here's hoping that "Lollo Navigator" can officially go live and be promoted for mass use someday…
Event_WWDH_15_5: See this, I left a spot right next to the developer's credits...
Event_WWDH_15_7: Yup. Wait for my good news. Goodbye, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_3_1: Detected: An item in need of repairs in the Lollo Warehouse vicinity. Timely repairs are advised...
Event_WWDH_3_2: Timely repairs are advised. Timely repairs are advised. Timely repairs are advised...
Event_WWDH_3_3: Okay, Okay. Stop, stop it already. Sheesh. Weird, I don't remember installing a repeat function for reminders...
Event_WWDH_3_5: Looks like they've given it the new "Lollo Fixit" DLC.
Event_WWDH_3_6: Here you are, {PlayerName}. Just a sec. I need to turn off this annoying reminder.
Event_WWDH_3_7: Hehe. You're as sharp as a tack per usual, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_3_8: Introducing, the new "Lollo Fixit." A fixer on the go!
Event_WWDH_3_9: The live map now can not only record road conditions but also keep tabs on the status of equipment.
Event_WWDH_3_10: If the system fails to receive regular data reports from the equipment after a certain period of time, "Lollo Navigator" will log its map coordinates, and the duration shall reflect the likelihood of a malfunction.
Event_WWDH_3_12: As you saw earlier, the Sound Emulator at the Lollo Warehouse hasn't reported back in a long time, likely due to a malfunction. I'll leave the repairs to you.
Event_WWDH_4_1: Finally, it's stopped repeating itself. Looks like your work is done over there.
Event_WWDH_4_2: Thanks for the hard work. Did you get today's payment? I might need your help again with improving the other features later.
Event_WWDH_5_1: You come just in time, {PlayerName}. No time to explain. Quick, I need you to connect to "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_6_1: Phew. Close one. "Lollo Navigator" would've gone haywire if you hadn't given us a hand.
Event_WWDH_6_4: This little crisis exposed a bit of a problem in the program... It's got a limited capacity for storing map information. Well, better late than never, right?
Event_WWDH_6_5: Couldn't have done it without you, {PlayerName}. How about we call it a day? I need to go sort this thing out, pronto.
Event_WWDH_7_1: This area of the map turned red, {PlayerName}. There's also an increase in reports from the couriers.
Event_WWDH_7_2: There might be some kind of threat brewing in the area. I'll leave the investigation to you.
Event_WWDH_7_3: Once you're done, you can also try sending live information to "Lollo Navigator" remotely.
Event_WWDH_8_1: I remember Maji taught me how to transmit data. Let's see here...
Event_WWDH_8_2: There... This should do the trick... I think.
Event_WWDH_9_1: Gloves, boots, spare crates, and emergency rations... All that's left is...
Event_WWDH_9_2: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. Just in time to show you another feature of "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_9_3: Lollo Navigator can give couriers info on supply wear and consumption along the route based on real-time geographical and road conditions.
Event_WWDH_9_4: And whenever they need a resupply, they can just request it through the app. This batch of orders is still missing some items.
Event_WWDH_9_6: It feels like I've done this before.

Quest_139000039_QuestDesc_139_1:
A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening door...

In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the doors to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_1: Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_2: Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_3: Enough. Explain it in five words.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_5: You're the one who's in charge of this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_7: Whatever you do, do it right and do it clean. That's the Cruising Drake's principle. Finish what you started.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_8: Ah, Lollo Logistics! How despicable! Utterly insufferable!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_9: I shall reclaim the package myself, that much is clear!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_10: The Exile grunts and storms toward the delivery station.
Event_AYKXBRZM_2_1: (He better not be stirring up any trouble.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_2_2: (No time to call the Patrollers. Let's see what he's up to.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_3: D'ya know what, I had a dream just now! And guess what? You were in it!
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_4: My team members were asking for help, but I couldn't get to them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_5: I kept getting blocked or showing up too late.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_6: I was so worried, thinking they might be disappointed or not need me anymore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_7: But later, I managed to find a girl who'd got into an accident.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_8: I don't know how, but I felt like you were guiding me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_9: Talking with her made me see how important it is to support each other.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_10: I help my team, and they help me right back.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_11: I think that's where I found the strength to escape that nightmare.
Event_AYKXBRZM_25_12: I wouldn't have realized this without your help. Thank you so much, {PlayerName}.
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_4: Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_5: Many places... gateway open. Enter and fight!
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_6: I see now. I can help.
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_7: I saw Lumi. Is she okay?
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_8: A sharp mind. You are smart.
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_9: You saw Illusia, not real Lumi. She is safe, don't worry...
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_10: No energy left. Can't talk. Stop disaster. I trust you...
Event_AYKXBRZM_27_1: (Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_27_2: (And the Illusia I just saw of her... This abnormal Somnoire seems to be trapping parts of people's consciousness in their dreams.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_27_3: (If this has been going on for a while, Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_27_4: (She dreams about her team, but what about the others? I need to find more clues.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_1: I've already explained what happened, just give me the package.
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_2: If you can't, I'll... I'll file a complaint with your manager!
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_3: Don't worry, Lollo Logistics always takes care of its customers. We'll definitely get back to you within three business days.
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_4: Three days!? What if it's broken or lost? Don't you know how serious—
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_5: Oh, if it's broken or lost, you can get a full refund. Plus, the shipping insurance you have covers it. So really, there's nothing to worry about!
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_6: ...If you say so. Come to think of it, Lollo Logistics has never missed a delivery... In that case, I'll come back later.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4_1: Unusual? Huh? What are you talking about?
Event_AYKXBRZM_4_2: Oh, I know... Someone's deliberately spreading rumors!
Event_AYKXBRZM_4_3: Port business is booming right now. They want to oust the competition to grab a slice of the pie. That's their game plan!
Event_AYKXBRZM_4_4: Those rascals must be trying to scare people off to hog all the profits! No chance! This cheap trick won't work on me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_5_1: Waving Battlefield? I was there a week ago... on break... Ahem, can't let my boss know this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5_2: Anyway, I haven't had any dreams ever since then! It's so weird!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5_3: I heard that some researchers screwed up an experiment there. Some even died in an accident... Wait, don't tell me I'm being haunted by their ghosts!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5_4: Oh no, kind ghosts, have mercy on me!
Event_AYKXBRZM_6_1: Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't had any dreams this week.
Event_AYKXBRZM_6_2: I used to have nightmares about the day my father left. He was devoured by a Tacet Field and never returned.
Event_AYKXBRZM_6_3: But since the dreams stopped, I've been sleeping better than ever.
Event_AYKXBRZM_6_4: Maybe it's my father who's been driving them away... Heh, maybe it's a blessing in disguise?
Event_AYKXBRZM_8_1: That white cat... Why are the Tacet Discords after it?
Event_AYKXBRZM_9_5: You want me to go inside?
zhuiyuejie_first_3_1: Mother told me the Moonlit Fair will start once the Wishing Tree is filled with wishes.
zhuiyuejie_first_3_2: Everyone's wishes... they'll come true, won't they?
zhuiyuejie_first_4_1: Oh my, Taoyuan Vale hasn't been this busy in a long time.
zhuiyuejie_first_4_2: People coming and going, sharing their wishes and blessings with the moon... How wonderful!
Side_XYHTZST_10_1: No way, I miss it again!?
Side_XYHTZST_10_2: Should I give it another shot? I hate losing...
Side_XYHTZST_10_3: This is quite fun, but I'd better leave enough time for other stalls.
Side_XYHTZST_26_1: I can't even feel my legs after all that.
Side_XYHTZST_26_2: But man, was it a blast! Messed up that last jump though.
Side_XYHTZST_26_3: Yeah it was fun, but seriously... ouch! I need to sit down...
Side_XYHTZST_40_1: I've never seen anything like this before...
Side_XYHTZST_40_2: It's amazing how these puppets seem almost alive.
Side_XYHTZST_5_1: Never thought Moon-Chasing Festival could be this lively.
Side_XYHTZST_5_2: Finally we can enjoy the celebration. It's been so many years, the long-awaited reunion...
Side_XYHTZST_5_3: For Jinzhou people, there's nothing like the feeling of reunion...

InfoDisplay_103001003_Text:
Greetings, visitor from the future. If you find yourself here, please help me perform one last check.

If there's any leftover erroneous data in the room, make sure to clean it up completely to eliminate potential risk.

Do NOT trust or respond to anything you see on the screen.

The backup analysis room is the anchor I left for you—The data there is absolutely correct.

If the analysis room shows anything different from the backup room, check all data immediately and restore the room to its original state.

Remember, <color=Highlight>recheck both analysis rooms and make sure they are the same</color>. Ensure all data is thoroughly deleted.

The transfer route will always be here.
GenericPrompt_ExploreToolsShooterDisable: Hoverdroid: Shooter cannot be used in the current scene
Character_chun_10_2: The game's over. Here you go, the thing I promised you. Let's keep going, my hero~
Character_chun_10_3: The info in that matrix is related to you. With you by my side, I should be able to locate and capture it faster.
Character_chun_10_7: We need to solve this accident as soon as possible, and you promised to help if I played the game with you.
Character_chun_10_8: Haha! Guess I have no other choice, huh?
Character_chun_10_9: ...Well, it's lovely to see you being a little pushy too! I like your serious side. Sure, I'll go.
Character_chun_10_10: What else do you know about Lady Flora? You said a small accident happened during your investigation...
Character_chun_10_11: Yeah, ended up stuck in a boring medical pod for half a month and almost died from severe Overclocking.
Character_chun_10_12: You call that a small accident?
Character_chun_10_13: Sure, it's no big deal, since I survived.
Character_chun_10_14: Hmm... My memories were sealed by Lady Flora somehow. No matter how much I try to recall, it doesn't work.
Character_chun_10_15: I only remember waking up in a cave, my mind completely blank. Drifted aimlessly for years, until I stumbled upon the Black Shores.
Character_chun_10_16: And guess what? Turns out I had lived here before! Naturally, I wanted to investigate further and figure it out.
Character_chun_10_17: So that's what I did. I'm sure I uncovered the truth behind my memory loss, but… when I woke up in the medical pod again, I'd forgotten everything.
Character_chun_10_18: Guess somehow I almost died from Overclocking when I learned about my past, and I had to seal my memories away again. That's pretty much what happened, I think?
Character_chun_10_19: I still don't know why Lady Flora did that though... Well, I don't really care. I can have fun with or without those memories.
Character_chun_10_20: It doesn't sound like you're talking about your past self.
Character_chun_10_21: Hello~? Are you listening? Told you I remember nothing, so... Lady Flora is more like a stranger to me.
Character_chun_10_22: It's like watching a movie. No matter how happy or sad the story is, it's someone else's story, after all.
Character_chun_10_23: Don't you feel the same? Tell me, what was on your mind when you witnessed those stories, staring at every frame on the screen?
Character_chun_10_25: ...I had too many things to think about.
Character_chun_10_26: Haha, you don't care, do you? I knew we think alike.
Character_chun_10_27: Aww... You are more sentimental than I expected.
Character_chun_10_28: Anyway, I'll trust my instincts over some distant memories.
Character_chun_10_29: As long as my instincts remain, I'm still "me."
Character_chun_10_30: That sounds a bit too animalistic…
Character_chun_10_31: So you let your instincts define what's truly "you"?
Character_chun_10_32: Yeah, and what's wrong with that?
Character_chun_10_34: My instincts rule me, and I rule them. I feel great joy when they are fulfilled, and when I ignore them, I suffer in return.
Character_chun_10_35: They guide me like how duty and responsiblity guides you... Who says one is better than the other?
Character_chun_10_36: No, there is no difference between these two.
Character_chun_10_38: Hehe, let's drop this boring discussion. Shall we split up to find the other stuff?
Character_chun_10_39: Sure. Whoever finds it first will go meet up with the other.
Character_chun_10_40: Ooh, then it's a competition—I'm in! Let the search begin!
Character_chun_12_2: Ah, I can sense my prey deep inside. So many of them…
Character_chun_16_10: Aww, you're sooo sweet. I'm almost blushing.
Character_chun_16_11: That's not considerate, darling. Besides, with the Tethys System here, I can't really cause any major damage.
Character_chun_16_12: And I'm good at dancing on the edge. I won't let myself Overclock that easily. But if it does happen… I'll just accept it as my fate.
Character_chun_16_13: It's very dangerous. You know the risks, right?
Character_chun_16_14: Of course I do. But once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, they can't be cured, can they?
Character_chun_16_16: It's been a blast competing and taking down those Tacet Discords with you... That's all I need to have a good time.
Character_chun_16_17: If one day I die from Overclocking, so be it! The Black Shores will make sure there's no Tacet Field generated from me.
Character_chun_16_18: I've always followed my instincts, ignored anything that didn't interest me. No regrets, even if I died now.
Character_chun_16_19: Carpe diem, enjoy the moment… Life is boring if you're stuck in the past or consumed by the future.
Character_chun_16_20: Anyway, what have you found? I got a stack of damaged photos. To locate that Stellar Matrix, we'll need three or four items tops.
Character_chun_16_22: The remaining frequencies... Yes, it belongs to Lady Flora.
Character_chun_16_23: It's been almost 20 years since the last frequencies were recorded.
Character_chun_16_24: Blake Blooms represent a Bloom Bearer's identity. They always have one on them. These frequencies can help us track Lady Flora's last activity.
Character_chun_16_25: She and the leader of Black Shores vanished at the same time, no longer appearing in records.
Character_chun_16_26: (Around the same time? The two cases might be connected...)
Character_chun_16_27: Oh, right. I just remembered what that strange feeling I had earlier was.
Character_chun_16_28: When I saw you in Jinzhou... It felt as if I'd seen you somewhere else before.
Character_chun_16_29: Anyway, have you told Beatrice that we're ready?
Character_chun_16_32: Please head to the Modulation Hall. I'll meet you there.
Character_chun_23_11: <color=Highlight>Multiple jumps</color> might be required to get there. {PlayerName}, please stay safe!
Character_chun_28_6: I'm taking you back to the medical pod.
Character_chun_28_7: My head… My whole body... hurts...
Character_chun_28_12: I seem to… have seen you… much earlier…
Character_chun_31_2: Heard I can find the Black Shores here. Glad I didn't come to the wrong place.
Character_chun_31_5: I'm Camellya. Or call me "Lady Flora" if you want. People from Petalfall Village like to call me that.
Character_chun_31_6: You left in such a hurry. We didn't even get a chance to talk.
Character_chun_31_7: I felt... off, like I missed out on something important, so I came here alone to find you.
Character_chun_31_8: How's the situation in Petalfall Village?
Character_chun_31_9: The injured have been transferred to other nearby villages. Most of the villagers are safe and sound, thanks to your timely rescue.
Character_chun_31_10: (Most of the villagers are safe… and with the way Camellya looks now… It seems I'm in an alternate timeline again.)
Character_chun_31_11: (But even if the history is changed, we still met each other.)
Character_chun_31_12: You're the Black Shores leader, aren't you?
Character_chun_31_13: I-I snuck in here, but please don't drive me out! I have my own Forte now! I can work for you.
Character_chun_31_14: Now? You mean you couldn't before?
Character_chun_31_16: Those Consultants said my Rabelle's Test showed I awakened my Forte. But in the village, I didn't feel anything special.
Character_chun_31_17: … And I don't remember anything before coming to the village.
Character_chun_31_19: You have lost your memory before?
Character_chun_31_20: Yes, villagers said I appeared in the woods by their lake one autumn morning.
Character_chun_31_21: That's all I remember. Didn't have anywhere else to go, so I stayed in that village.
Character_chun_31_22: Can I stay with you here? At the Black Shores? I-I want to serve you. Make me your Bloom Bearer.
Character_chun_31_23: Technically speaking, it's a job, and you'll be serving the entire Black Shores.
Character_chun_31_24: And Camellya, you are not "mine". You belong to yourself.
Character_chun_31_26: Join us if you pass the assessment. The Black Shores welcomes those who protect the world.
Character_chun_31_27: Great! But... I-I still don't know your name. Tell me, please?
Character_chun_31_29: Ah... It's a beautiful name. I'll never forget it.
Character_chun_31_30: I'm so happy, really, really happy that my vines feel so light…
Character_chun_31_31: How strange... This is our first formal conversation, but...
Character_chun_31_32: It feels like I had heard your name before...
Character_chun_31_33: Look, this is my Forte. I quite like it.
Character_chun_31_34: I want to shadow you, see how a strong person like you moves forward.
Character_chun_31_35: This flower... is for you. I'm looking forward to the days ahead.
Character_chun_33_4: Done with the work? You should get some rest.
Character_chun_33_5: I've been super well-behaved these past few days! Did everything as you said! Didn't cause any trouble or go to places I shouldn't!
Character_chun_33_6: KU-Riri reporting in! The infrastructure damage in Petalfall Village is severe. The rebuilding will be difficult in the short term, and it requires reassessment…
Character_chun_33_7: You need some discipline, robot. How dare you interrupt my conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}?
Character_chun_33_8: You wanna know the situation in Petalfall Village? I can tell you. I was there, remember?
Character_chun_33_9: It's been… a few months since the Tacet Discords attacked the village.
Character_chun_33_10: I turned into a flower tree due to Overclocking and trapped those feeble creatures in an underground cave.
Character_chun_33_11: (KU-Riri's recording mentioned that <color=Highlight>Camellya was found in an underground cave</color>. Looks like this time, I jumped to the right juncture.)
Character_chun_33_13: Oh, I threw them out of the village when I started transforming. They would have died if they stayed.
Character_chun_33_14: Not many survived, but some did. They managed to hold on until you showed up, and they guided you to find me.
Character_chun_33_15: What a surprise. Thought they'd run away when I threw them out.
Character_chun_33_16: I have no interest in those crybabies… but since they took me in for a while, I owed them a favor.
Character_chun_33_17: It felt good to do good, huh?
Character_chun_33_18: You don't need to find an excuse for your good deed.
Character_chun_33_19: Hahaha! That's a cute way to put it.
Character_chun_33_20: What? I'm speaking from my heart. I don't wanna spare a glance at those weaklings.
Character_chun_33_21: I despise weaklings. Myself included. I was a sorry sap when I turned into that plant!
Character_chun_33_22: But you saved me. You pulled me out of Overclocking and brought me back to sanity. I should thank you.
Character_chun_33_25: I don't remember anything before I arrived in that village. I don't care anyway. You're the only one who's ever made me feel so excited.
Character_chun_33_26: So, how about making me your Bloom Bearer? You see... who else can keep me from causing trouble elsewhere?
Character_chun_33_27: …Well, indeed I can't just let you leave.
Character_chun_33_28: You would be a risk to public safety, no doubt.
Character_chun_33_29: Right? Making me yours exactly aligns with the interests of Solaris, and as you just said, would make the world a safer place.
Character_chun_33_30: Just so you know, when I was doing the Rabelle test, the staff said I'm still prone to Overclocking.
Character_chun_33_31: I may have great power now, but I might lose it or fall prey to my emotions again someday.
Character_chun_33_32: If that day comes, then… I'll embrace it as my destiny! Fate's already brought us together, and I'll pay any cost for that.
Character_chun_33_33: It's led me to the most exquisite flower in this world. I'll give anything for it, no hesitation!
Character_chun_33_34: Did you know? Climbing plants are obsessed with big, gorgeous trees. Clinging onto them like their life depends on it, sucking up all the energy they can get from the sun.
Character_chun_33_35: They're driven by an insatiable hunger to savor their beloved tree, down to the last bit.
Character_chun_4_3: Oh? But Lady Flora's item was already picked up by another Bloom Bearer.
Character_chun_4_6: Hehe, if you want it, try to catch me!
Character_chun_53_1: Welcome back! Glad to see you safely return. Thank you for your hard work.
Character_chun_53_2: A Stellar Matrix is no match for us. Easy peasy.
Character_chun_53_4: Yes, thank you. Leave the rest to us.
Character_chun_53_5: By the way, Camellya, Shorekeeper asked me to remind you. Please use the medical pod in good time.
Character_chun_53_6: What? My symptoms are already gone… Alright, I'll go later. She really worries too much.
Character_chun_53_7: But she helped keep my bracelet safe too. Heh, I owe her that.
Character_chun_53_10: Hmm, let me think... To the surface. Veiled Rock, the starting point.
Character_chun_54_1: When I found those photos, I made a decision.
Character_chun_54_2: Photos are great for capturing memories. Take some photos of me.
Character_chun_54_3: In the past, others recorded us, but now we'll have to do it ourselves.
Character_chun_54_5: They last longer than our memories. A moment frozen in frame.
Character_chun_54_6: As the Black Shores leader, a small task like this would be a piece of cake for you, I bet?
Character_chun_55_1: {PlayerName}, stay focused. Don't take your eyes off me!
Character_chun_56_1: Looks good. I wanna keep a copy of this too.
Character_chun_57_1: Excellent composition. Quite the photographer, aren't you? Hehe…
Character_chun_6_4: I followed you to the cell on a whim. Then I heard something interesting.
Character_chun_6_5: Plus, this thing is just finding its way back to its owner. I see no wrong in that.
Character_chun_6_6: To its owner… Are you that "Lady Flora"?
Character_chun_6_8: Just like you, I've completely forgotten about the past! All of it! So, I guess I'm not the Lady Flora you're looking for.
Character_chun_6_10: Then how did you know you're Lady Flora?
Character_chun_6_11: Of course, I did some digging, but… a little accident stopped me.
Character_chun_6_12: (If Camellya is Lady Flora, then we were supposed to be close, but neither of us remembers…)
Character_chun_6_13: (The fact that I used to be the leader... This should only be known to the Shorekeeper.)
Character_chun_6_14: (Maybe I shouldn't mention it to Camellya until I'm sure she's not a threat.)
Character_chun_6_15: {PlayerName}, if you want to use that trinket to find the problematic matrix, then play with me! Entertain me, and I'll help you.
Character_chun_6_18: Well… Then I'll take this and make a run for it!
Character_chun_6_19: You can try to catch me, but be warned, it won't be an easy chase. Or, you could play along and maybe I'll let you have it. It'll be more fun that way!
Character_chun_6_20: Since you handled the Threnodian, a little game of battle shouldn't be too much trouble for you, right?
Character_chun_6_21: As a Bloom Bearer, I need to pick the perfect seeds for the Black Shores and give them my utmost care.
Character_chun_6_22: All these years, I haven't met anyone intriguing—not one person!
Character_chun_6_23: You're MY seed of fate. If I let you go so easily, all my efforts, my yearning, my hunger will not be satisfied.
Character_chun_6_24: If you get taken or killed by somebody else...
Character_chun_6_25: ...I would be very, very, very unhappy.
Character_chun_6_26: Why are you so obsessed with me?
Character_chun_6_27: Why do you call me your seed of fate?
Character_chun_6_29: Flowers thirst for water; beasts hunger for flesh. It's nature, just like my craving for you.
Character_chun_6_30: I want it, and I get it. That's how I live.
Character_chun_6_31: That fleeing Stellar Matrix might affect the Necrostar’s functioning. Worse, it could threaten the Black Shores.
Character_chun_6_32: So? I don't care! If this island's gonna blow up, so be it. Unless, of course, it ruins my fun.
Character_chun_6_34: Are you angry? Hehe, your anger is sooo delicious…
Character_chun_6_35: Fight me. I can't wait to see who'll be the winner. I've been itching to get a taste of your blade.

POI_TYDBJ_13_2: Why are you here, KU-Repair? Wait, did someone manage to fix you?
POI_TYDBJ_13_5: Well, looks like I'll need to call maintenance again.
POI_TYDBJ_13_7: I don't know... It's been offline for a long time. Not sure why it's back online now.
POI_TYDBJ_13_8: Maybe someone set it up to reactivate at a certain time.
POI_TYDBJ_13_9: It's been wandering between these two abandoned rooms, not responding to orders. Pretty strange, right?
POI_TYDBJ_13_10: What was this room used for?
POI_TYDBJ_13_11: If I remember correctly, it was a Stellar Matrix Analysis Room.
POI_TYDBJ_13_12: It was abandoned and sealed off after a while, for reasons I don't know. It's been ages, after all.
POI_TYDBJ_13_14: Thanks to KU-Repair, I found this room. I was planning to use it for something else, but it turns out I don't have access.
POI_TYDBJ_13_15: I thought it would take a long time for anyone to figure out why the rooms were abandoned, but the seal was suddenly removed just now.
POI_TYDBJ_13_16: By the way, did you notice anything unusual in there?
POI_TYDBJ_13_18: I only found some old records.
POI_TYDBJ_13_20: Anyway, thanks for the info! I'll look into it and submit another application for room reuse. I have a feeling they'll approve it real fast this time!
POI_TYDBJ_13_22: All the useful data was transferred a long time ago. Easy enough, since it was just some codes.
POI_TYDBJ_7_7: Coil whine rises for a moment before new text appears on the screen.
POI_TYDBJ_7_12: You still remember how that researcher warned you to delete the data, but in the end, curiosity gets the better of you.
POI_TYDBJ_7_13: A brief coil whine fills the air before new text appears on the screen.
POI_TYDBJ_7_14: Finally, you're willing to listen. We've long awaited this moment. A chance to connect with the true reality.
POI_TYDBJ_7_16: Siren blares once more in the room.
POI_TYDBJ_7_17: Warning, security mode activated. Ready to repel unknown entity. Ready to ███ to █ Ready █ █ █
POI_TYDBJ_7_18: Oops... I'll need to get this dealt with quickly.
POI_TYDBJ_7_19: The notes mentioned this... <color=Highlight>Recheck both analysis rooms and make sure they are the same</color>. Hmm, I should give it a try.
