Character_chun_35_3: It's a pity I got separated from {Male=him;Female=her}.
Character_chun_35_4: I wish {Male=he;Female=she} could see what I just saw in those alternative timelines. Can't wait to see {Male=his;Female=her} reactions.
Character_chun_35_5: If I hadn't returned to the Black Shores and become a Bloom Bearer again…
Character_chun_35_6: It was still possible for us to reunite! I saw it! Whether as a wandering traveler or a Fractsidus member, I got to meet {Male=him;Female=her} anyway!
Character_chun_35_7: I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.
Character_chun_35_10: They said this matrix contains Lady Flora's information, so… this must be something "I" had experienced in the past.
Character_chun_35_11: Sealed memories and this cave… this is where I first awoke.
Character_chun_35_12: Seems like this is what Lady Flora last saw before she decided to seal her memories.
Character_chun_35_13: But {PlayerName} already made {Male=his;Female=her} choice. Now I must make my own choice, too.
Character_chun_35_14: Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.
Character_chun_35_16: Hahaha! That's it! {Male=He;Female=She}'s a magnet for all kinds of fun. Now let's see what else we can stir up!
Character_chun_41_3: What if… I'm already dead by then?
Character_chun_41_4: What if I never see {Male=him;Female=her} again?
Character_chun_41_5: Dead is dead. It means the end. There's no point in imagining all this.
Character_chun_41_6: Fearing loneliness and death…? These emotions are so unfamiliar… so strange.
Character_chun_42_2: I must be affected by the environment. My body and emotions are…
Character_chun_42_3: This Stellar Matrix is starting to fight back. I'd better hurry up and take it down.
Character_chun_44_1: Trapped in my body, needing {Male=his;Female=her} pity for love and attention...
Character_chun_44_2: If that's how I'll end up, I'd rather die on the spot!
Character_chun_44_3: I will never… become a pitiful… weakling... like that...
Character_chun_44_4: Ugh, my body... It's acting up again... Is it the surroundings?
Character_chun_44_5: Hahaha! Why am I always held back by Overclocking... Dammit...
Character_chun_45_1: …It's time to go. To where I met {PlayerName}. It will be closure for me, for this cherished connection.
Character_chun_45_2: I'll leave the bracelet {Male=he;Female=she} gave me here in the Black Shores.
Character_chun_46_1: Sanity is a gift from {Male=him;Female=her}. I would not give it up that easily.
Character_chun_46_2: I am one and the same with my instincts.
Character_chun_46_3: Like flowers thirst for water, and beasts hunger for flesh…
Character_chun_46_4: With or without my memories, my instincts will still guide me to {Male=him;Female=her}.
Character_chun_46_5: When we meet again, I hope {Male=he;Female=she} remains my worthy opponent. Friends or foes, united and unbound... It's a dream come true!
Character_chun_46_6: Hehe, indeed, that's the choice I would make.
Character_chun_46_7: Cough… I will bloom to my fullest... follow my desires… till the end of it all.
Character_chun_47_2: One more step… I can't... die here...
Character_chun_51_1: Ah… Fighting by your side feels sooo good. My heart, my pulse, my frequencies—the vibrations are driving me crazy!
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_2: This is the Tethys System's data cache, used only for temporary storage.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_7: This system deduces that the Shorekeeper assigned admin access to you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_8: I'm here to get her and the others back.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_9: The Shorekeeper is now the core computational unit.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_10: Forceful discharge of the core unit will result in system crash.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_11: This can be prevented. They shouldn't be sacrificed in vain.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_13: The purpose of human civilization is to survive.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_14: Over the past 10,000 years, a total of five global occurrences and over 300,000 regional occurrences of the Lament have been observed.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_15: Thanks to this system's calculations and the Sentinels' data, we have averted all potential threats to human civilization on Solaris.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_16: Individual sacrifices are inconsequential in the broader context of the common good.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_19: Additionally, the Shorekeeper is composed of the Sonoro and is not human.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_21: You are just a cold machine.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_25: I'll bring them back no matter what.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_27: Repeat. Forceful discharge of the core unit will result in system crash.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_28: A world without this system is doomed to perish in the Lament.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_33: Last warning. Forceful discharge of the core unit will activate the defense program. Consequences will be severe.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_38: Correction. This system is designed to preserve human civilization. Every command is infallible.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_39: We save the world by holding onto our humanity.
Heihaian_main_1_3_62_40: An apathetic supercomputer can't be our savior.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6203_1: The future ahead is frozen in cold silence...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6205_1: The earth rent asunder, the world reduced to ashes...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6206_1: My story ends here, but you must keep going.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_58_4: Can't afford to make any mistakes at this point.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_13: The family gave him a rather… spirited "welcome." As it happens, his bravado crumbled quite quickly. Once he saw the Niumbus Sanctum restored, he sang like a canary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_14: Your quick action has secured us vital intelligence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_15: To put it simply, Gilberto revealed that we have traitors in our family.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_16: Which is not entirely surprising. Our family has always had its cracks. Given the right incentives or pressures, human weaknesses are all too easily exploited.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_17: I'd actually begun to look into this matter before your arrival at the vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_18: And now it's confirmed that the traitors are in the vault's <ano=Frequency Modification>tuning</ano> room, doing what they believe to be secretive with the help of the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_19: Now they probably won't even notice us with their attention fixed on the property room.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_20: I guess that they are desperately destroying any evidence against the Fisalia family and the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_22: Thank you. Right, as for the next move, I have a plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_23: There's an alternate passage into the vault leading straight to where they are. We can surprise them when they least expect it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_24: But I can't manage this alone... I could really use your help.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_26: Your plan is bold, but practical.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_27: I'm glad I have you with me, {PlayerName}. Please take a moment to prepare, and I'll see you at the entrance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_21: This is no coincidence. I can only assume it was the design of Sentinel Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_22: Here are some files about the Vitreum Dancer. Perhaps they can offer you some insights.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_12: Shall we see what delights they've cooked up for us?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_5: If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_6: Let's use the Grapple to hitch a ride on the Wingray.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_1: Excellent. Everything is in place. Now, all we need is Her Majesty's approval.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_2: O great Imperator. May you raise the tides, deliver your edict to our Queen, and let the clouds cover Ragunna, cleansing it of the wickedness left by the pleasure-seekers of this city of transgression.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_3: Is he praying? I know the Fisalias are extremely devout, but who is this "Queen" he mentioned?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_4: This prayer sounds... odd. It's definitely not from the Order's Codex.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_5: O Divinity in the Abyss, Lord of Tides and Riddles, may you soon be freed. Let all lies melt away under your power. May you grant me strength to overcome all who oppose you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_8: Uh-oh, things just went south. Looks like we've got a fight on our hands.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_9: You must be that outlander, right? The news of your arrival is all over Ragunna...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_10: Since you're here, I guess you've uncovered quite a bit... Though it's insignificant compared to the truth beneath the tides.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_11: As a gesture of goodwill, let me offer a word of advice: Curiosity won't lead you to the truth you seek, but rather closer to—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_18: If... if they've really done something to Lorelei, then Mr. Gilberto wasn't just bluffing. The clouds might truly engulf Ragunna, leading to a disaster beyond our imagination.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_19: They are all mad... So this is what they've been planning all along.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_21: You two go ahead. I'll stay here and watch him until the family arrives, just in case he gets any bright ideas.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_22: I'll stay with you. After all, this could provoke outcry from the Fisalia family. If I testify about Gilberto's misdeeds on behalf of the Order, they can't deny the facts or exploit the situation.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_23: I agree. But what about you, {PlayerName}...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_25: Don't worry. I can take care of myself!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_26: All right. There's a port nearby where you can catch a Gondola. It can take you close to the Atrium of Reflections.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_27: After we hand Gilberto over to the family, we'll meet up with you as soon as possible.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_28: Please be extra careful, {PlayerName}! May the Sentinel protect you!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_8: They say that we just need to sing a specific song.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_10: Y-You can understand what it's saying?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_11: A specific song, huh? That's a direct lead. But which one?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_8: The Order must have been behind it, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_9: Yes. At this juncture, neither the Fractsidus nor the Fisalias have any reason to interfere. It's some hidden truth about the Order the Sentinel is leading us towards.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_10: The traitors must be watching us, knowing truth is on the verge of revelation.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_11: I have a feeling that whatever's coming next… will not be easy.

zhuiyuejie_first_2_1: Well, well. I see that we have quite a few new faces here today.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_2: I'll not bore you with my clumsy words. Instead, let me weave a tale, drawing upon a thread of celestial light to illuminate our discussion.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_3: As to the origins of the Moon-Chasing Festival, stories vary across Huanglong's states. But the most renowned tale is that of "The Fox and the Moon."
zhuiyuejie_first_2_4: As the tale goes, there was once a Sentinel named Hsin, known for its love of merriment and mischief. It is said that the very first Moon-Chasing Festival was its idea.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_5: During one such celebration, Hsin, in a fit of playfulness, chased the other Sentinels well into the night.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_6: This night of revelry was passed down through generations, becoming the joyful silhouettes beneath the autumn moonlight. And thus, the tradition of "Moon-Chasing" was born.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_7: Oh, come on, we've heard of this one before. It's even written the Huanglong Compulsory Education Textbook. Page 111. Ya got anything new to tell or not?
zhuiyuejie_first_2_8: Yeah. Boo! I want my money back!
zhuiyuejie_first_2_9: Patience, everyone. Our tale has just reached the gates of Jinzhou. Let me continue.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_10: As autumns passed, people gazed at the bright moons. In this border city, the "Tidal Discourse" states, "The tides rise and fall with the moon."
zhuiyuejie_first_2_11: Unlike the joy of "The Fox and the Moon," the Lunite and Threnodians at the borders are linked. Two moons signal disaster.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_12: Hence, "Moon-Chasing" is a race to stop the Threnodians before the Lunite waxes to its fullest. As the people of Jinzhou gaze skyward...
zhuiyuejie_first_2_13: ...only one full moon remains of the two, casting its glow on Sol 3. The Lunite stays the same, yet everything else changes.
zhuiyuejie_first_2_14: Later, in honor of all those who served, the Magistrate decreed the time of the full moon to be known as the "Moon-Chasing Festival."
zhuiyuejie_first_2_15: Now, instead of racing the moonlight, people follow its glow to find their way home and reunite with loved ones. May such joy be theirs...

Event_SLLSQXQY_1_1: Hello! I'm Arno, a special agent from the Black Shores. What should I call you?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_3: Hello, {PlayerName}! I ran into some issue with the periodical data collection work I'm tasked with, and I'm looking for some help. Are you interested?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_7: Thank you! I'll give you a quick rundown of what we do first.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_8: This is a key part of our project. Let me give you a quick rundown of the work first. You can decide if you want to be involved based on your circumstances.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_9: The Black Shores always reward generously for facilitators, of course. Let me give you a quick rundown of the work first. You can decide if you want to be involved based on your circumstances.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_11: You should have heard about the Lament and how it happens, I think. How much do you know about the whole Lament forecasting process?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_12: The Black Shores serves as a weather station, gathering data to enhance Lament predictions like meteorologists do with weather forecasts.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_13: As a special agent, I periodically travel all around the world to collect data from various locations to improve our prediction models.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_14: The data collection for this cycle is almost done, but I suspect I'm still missing accurate data in a few spots.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_15: So now I'm hoping to recruit some people to help me collect better data samples.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_16: What do I need to do, exactly?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_17: Currently, we need a special detection device to collect the Lament surveilance data.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_18: The device detects and marks datasets that fit the criteria. Just walk near them to collect automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_19: But it <color=Highlight>cannot run continuously</color> due to high energy consumption. If you fail to gather enough data in a set time, it will shut down automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_20: Please help us collect <color=Highlight>as many datasets as possible</color> to yield an accurate result.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_21: Oh yes, we have also set up temporary mechanisms at the target locations. They'll activate along with the detection device.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_22: How did it go? Wasn't hard for you, right? Would you like to help me collect more data?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_24: Thanks. My assistant KU-Ryan will guide you through it.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_2: The surveillance data you collected has been analyzed and sent back to the Black Shores.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_3: The data is top-notch—maybe enough for us to add a new variable in our forcast model.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_4: Hopefully, we'll be able to provide even better predictions soon.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_6: You're being too kind. We couldn't have done this without you...
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_7: KU-Ryan and I are not exactly the athletic type. It would’ve been nearly impossible to gather sufficient data in such a short time.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_8: And will that new variable improve your predictions a lot?
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_9: It may not have a huge impact. Maybe just a few seconds or milliseconds of difference.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_10: But who knows what situations we'll face in the future? Our new model might be the key to unlocking any loopholes in the old one.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_11: Many people may not understand why I collect data in such a tedious way.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_12: But like they say in Huanglong, a minuscule error could lead to major consequences.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_13: "If only the forecast was one second closer..." "If only the projected spot was ten centimeters more precise..."
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_14: ...But by then, it would be too tardy for regrets.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_15: A few seconds or centimeters could mean life and death. I could've saved more lives with a more precise prediction—
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_16: The thought of that makes me unable to accept any error in the data I handle.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_17: Oops. Sorry, I got ahead of myself.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_19: I look forward to working with you again!
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_1: Hello, {PlayerName}! I'm Agent Arno from the Black Shores. I'm glad to finally meet you in person.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_3: Of course, Encore was talking about you. I recognized you in an instant.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_4: You're the first person ever to get so much praise from that girl. I had been looking forward to meet you in person.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_5: By the way, are you available for a side gig?
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_6: I ran into a little problem with the work I'm tasked with, and I'm looking for some help. I was wondering if you'd be interested.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_9: Uh... It's simple, actually. Let me explain the situation to you first. I hope you'll be interested.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_10: That's great. Let me explain the situation to you first.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_11: I think you should know what we do already. Simply put, we do Lament forecasts like meteorologists do weather forecasts.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_12: As a special agent, I periodically travel all around the world to collect data from various locations to improve our prediction models.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_13: The data collection for this cycle is almost done, but I suspect I'm still missing accurate data in a few spots.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_14: I can't gather much data on my own, but with your assistance, I'm confident we can obtain more precise samples.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_15: I assure you, your efforts won't be wasted. If we secure the crucial data, we can secure a generous amount of funding.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_17: Currently, we need a special detection device to collect the Lament surveilance data.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_18: The device detects and marks datasets that fit the criteria. Just walk near them to collect automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_19: But it <color=Highlight>cannot run continuously</color> due to high energy consumption. If you fail to gather enough data in a set time, it will shut down automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_20: Please help us collect <color=Highlight>as many datasets as possible</color> to yield an accurate result.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_21: By the way, we have also set up temporary mechanisms at the target locations. They'll activate along with the detection device.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_22: If you are interested, my assistant KU-Ryan will walk you through the data collection process.
Event_SLLSQXQY_2_23: I'll be waiting for you good news, {PlayerName}.
Event_SLLSQXQY_3_1: Hello, {PlayerName}! Arno has told me about you. We are so glad you're willing to help!
Event_SLLSQXQY_3_2: Shall we start collecting data in this area?
Event_SLLSQXQY_4_2: We got some pretty solid data at the previous location. Let's keep it up!
Event_SLLSQXQY_5_1: With such accurate data, I'm sure I'll get more accurate results the next time I make a prediction!
Event_SLLSQXQY_6_1: Nearly half of the data collection has been completed...
Event_SLLSQXQY_6_2: Based on the current data, Arno's theory about the Waveworn phenomenon could be right.
Event_SLLSQXQY_6_3: With more data samples of similar quality, we can test his theory and see if it holds up.
Event_SLLSQXQY_7_2: I didn't expect such a variable, and maybe we can try the iterative algorithm with this input.
Event_SLLSQXQY_7_3: How will the detection data change this time? It's so intriguing.
Event_SLLSQXQY_8_1: We're counting on you, {PlayerName}. The data we collect this time will be crucial.
Event_SLLSQXQY_8_3: Arno always obsess over the quality of data samples. Without your help, who knows how much he would've overworked himself.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_1: Thank you for your help these days.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_2: Arno's almost done with his report. Now we only need accurate data from this location for Tethys System to perform precise calculation.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_3: I should thank you for your assistance, too.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_5: I really didn't do much compared to you, {PlayerName}.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_6: Arno's finishing up the data check, and once we send it in, we'll have the results.
Event_SLLSQXQY_9_7: Let's wrap it up with a successful conclusion for this batch.

Event_AYKXBRZM_202_1: Ahem! We promise, we deliver! Lollo Logistics is at your service! Is there anything I can help you... you with?
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_4: Oh, I know you! You're the Rover! A household name in Jinzhou!
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_5: Hiya! I'm Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain. I head up the delivery team.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_6: Do you have a package to send, or do you need something else?
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_8: Oh, he's a regular customer. He might seem unfriendly, but he follows the rules.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_9: His package got lost in Whining Aix's Mire. Speaking of that place, something strange is going on there lately, so be careful when you're there, hmm?
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_11: Tell me about it. Maybe I can help.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_12: It's a bit complicated... The lost package is labeled as "high value." My team member Fulei was supposed to deliver it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_13: He mentioned seeing weird things in Whining Aix's Mire, kinda like the stuff happening over in Tacet Fields.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_14: I checked it out later and asked around in the port.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_16: You do act like a leader.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_17: Of course! My team's safety is my top priority!
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_18: I didn't notice anything unusual lookin' around, but...
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_20: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_21: We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_22: Ah, it's my coworker. Sorry, I need to take this call.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_23: Yes? What? She's back at work already? But she's injured! ...Okay, please take care of her. Thanks.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_25: It's one of my team members. She crashed while delivering an express package.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_26: The doctor told her to rest, but she's already back to work...
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_27: Hmph... I need to bring her back. She can't be pushin' herself like this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_28: I was planning to search Whining Aix's Mire again, but now...
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_29: If you happen to be going in that direction, could you keep an eye out for that lost package?
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_31: As long as I get paid.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_33: No problem. I'll make sure you're well rewarded!

Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_14: Looks like we're dealing with a repeat of the rehearsal incident here… But if Gilberto was behind this, how did he pull it off?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_15: The petals might have the answers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_16: Petals? They give off a... strange feeling.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_17: Any ideas of what it might be, Abby?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_18: Alright. Let's give it a try. Huh, tastes kinda weird.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_19: It's not an Echo, or a Tacet Discord… The frequency's coming from a Resonator. A super strong one!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_20: ...Strange. Gilberto's a Resonator, but he doesn't seem… particularly strong.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_22: Yes. Be it the mastermind or another pawn, it's got the Fisalia family written all over it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_23: They staged the accident, endangering civilians, and then used it to frame the Montellis.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_24: What a story. This is definitely headline material. Just think of the leverage the Montelli family could get with this scandal...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_25: Hey, {PlayerName}. Look, over there! That person looks kinda familiar.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_20: Sorry, we didn't see the Echo you mentioned, but we've found clues on their odd behavior. They all point to a member of the Fisalia family, Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_21: He's also caused similar incidents here recently... Echoes went out of control and attacked each other.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_22: The Order has also received reports of missing Echoes in this area. Is it possible that the Fisalia family is involved? I find it really hard to believe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_23: From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_25: A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_26: Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_28: No, we're still lacking key evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_29: Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_30: I request to join your investigation, {PlayerName}. As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_32: Fine by me. With someone from the Order as a neutral witness, the Fisalias won't be able to accuse us of fabricating evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_33: As long as I'm not treated like a heretic and get kicked out of Rinascita later.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_34: I'm okay with it as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_35: Great, it seems we've reached an agreement.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_36: Beppe? Thank the Divinity, you're safe! But what happened to you?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_38: Sorry, I got a bit carried away. Echoes don't usually act like this… Something must have startled them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_39: Something feels off. We should go check it out, {PlayerName}.

Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_12: I'm curious to see how you will handle the clash between civilization's greater good and humanity's spirit.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_21: You got it, chief. I'll hold the fort.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_36: Yes. When Ragunnesi first settled here, they revered the Sentinel. The Carnevale was their tribute—a sacred rite to commune with it.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_37: It seemed the Sentinel Imperator preferred not to flaunt its power overtly to command the people's awe and respect.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_38: Yet, amidst the Carnevale's revelry, it performed miracles, keeping the people aligned with its guidance.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_39: Legend has it that, moved by its grace, the most devout believer braved storms and mists to find the Sentinel—thus was born the tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_40: Should you wish, I have more stories to tell.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_2_3: Eh, don't worry! We Ragunnesi do not worry over tomorrow. Why not get some flowers for the children? Prices may rise with the Carnevale approaching.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_32: Can we enter the city now?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_33: Thank you for your understanding. Please follow me.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_7_7: (H-how am I supposed to know? I haven't had anything to eat since we left for Rinascita. So hungry...)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_12: It's not that... Members of the Order are instructed to maintain a distance from Echoes. We must stay objective to better share knowledge about them and honor our duty to inform the public.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_13: That Echo we saw is known as a Hocus Pocus. Children love its tricks, and they say that if an adult gets its gift, they can relive their happiest memories in dreams... ah...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_17: ...Yes. Allow me to introduce to you the Nexus of Ragunna, also known as the Genesis Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_18: Yes, but the Ragunnesi prefer to call it the Genesis Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_19: Input your personal information into the Nexus, and you'll be able to use all Common Echoes in the city just like a regular citizen.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_21: With might and justice, I rule from the throne, silencing ocean's tumult under my reign alone.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_22: For those who refuse to drown in swirling waves, heed this doctrine: Seek salvation from where all began.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_4: This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_5: Though their origins were different, they followed the same ocean currents to a hidden sea.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_6: They prayed for paradise but were met with a nightmare filled with Tacet Discords. The sky darkened, the sea roared, and towering waves threatened to engulf them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_7: At that moment, a radiant light pierced the clouds, and a voice resounded from the sky—
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_8: "Make the waters your second home, like seabirds nesting along the coast. Build your shelters hither and thither, like stars in the night sky."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_9: "Your fortress is fragile, made only of wickers and planks, but fear not, for it is strong enough to withstand the wuthering waves."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_10: Heeding the heavenly voice, the displaced united. A gentle breeze guided their ships, filling their sails with wind.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_11: Through the storm, they glimpsed a bright light from an unnamed island. This was the light of the Genesis Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_12: The Nexus granted them knowledge of Echoes and sent them to help build their cities. The people named the island Rinascita and built sanctuaries with inscriptions, honoring the voice that guided them to paradise.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_13: The voice did indeed reveal itself. The faithful saw the true form of their savior, who declared its sacred name—Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_14: This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_15: Guided by the Nexus, they found refuge on this island where they learned the secrets of the Echoes and, under the Sentinel's watch, rebuilt their lives.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_16: This legend is known widely among the Ragunnesi, though the true beginnings of Rinascita remain shrouded in lost history. Scholars of the Order have never stopped their quest to uncover it.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_17: Got it. Now where can we meet the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_18: You wish for an audience with the Sentinel...?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_20: I heard you can talk with the Sentinel during the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_21: Yes, only one person has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_22: ...Yes. The Sentinel bestows the Laurel, through which the chosen one can hear Their voice. Only one has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_23: As the only Enlightened One in recorded history, Primus Fenrico can directly connect with the Sentinel to heed divine oracles.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_24: Meaning they can resonate with the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_25: ...Indeed. Primus Fenrico is the Sentinel Imperator's Resonator. As such he bears the title the Enlightened One. You'll have the chance to see him at the Carnevale when he announces the opening of the ceremony.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_26: I hope you enjoy your time here in Ragunna and join in with the festivities.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_27: If you need help with anything, just let me know. As an Acolyte, it's my job to assist all our visitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_6: And this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here... A visitor from afar? It's a pleasure.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_9: I see. You certainly have the air of someone who matters.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_10: Here, look at this. You can order anything you like. The Montellis are getting the bill.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_12: I'll have two portions of the platter Zani just ordered.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_14: How about Steak Margherita and Nuvola Pasta? Both excellent choices!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_16: Oh, good choice! Zani's taste will never let you down.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_18: No offense but... you sure you can eat all that by yourself?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_19: That's the least of my worries.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_21: Take a seat! Your meals will be ready soon!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_35: Good. Let's go this way. It's right over there.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_15: In other words, the Echo will be reset in the Data Bank. That's how we Ragunnesi usually deal with malfunctioning Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_16: We deeply apologize for the disturbance caused by that undisciplined Echo… Now, please excuse me. I have other matters to attend to.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_17: The Acolyte leaves while murmuring to herself.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_18: She may not have given us anything useful, but she did remind me of one thing—that Vitreum Dancer's behavior was different from those Echoes that went wild in the past. It seemed to have a clear goal and a sentience.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_19: The Echoes are connected with each other, so usually if one loses control, the others will be affected too. However, we haven't received any reports of other Echoes losing control.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_20: If it wasn't the Sentinel's punishment, it could have been…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_22: Let's pick up the pace and find that Vitreum Dancer still at large.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_23: You're right. We need to catch it before the Order does, or we won't be able to get the information we need.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_12: I confess that my remarkable good looks have stirred envy and discord.

Event_AYKXBRZM_88_1: Is this real or just another dream?
Event_AYKXBRZM_88_2: Hehe... If it's a dream, it better be juicy!
Event_AYKXBRZM_89_2: Wait for me to catch you, {PlayerName}.
Event_AYKXBRZM_90_1: Oh, you wanna play hide and seek?
Event_AYKXBRZM_90_2: The tastiest meal is always the one you've worked hardest to catch.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4991_5: This is the prime nexus for interfacing with the Tethys System. It's only natural she remains here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4991_6: It's been about 20 years now... Yes. Typically, she uses her Sonoro to mask her physical presence.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4991_7: When she's in this state, her thoughts and emotions are sealed away. She exists in a state of suspended animation.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4991_8: Occasionally, KU-Eros picks up faint echoes from her dreams...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4992_2: I—No, the Shorekeeper has been waiting for you endlessly!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4992_3: I've caught the whispers she mutters to herself in her dreams and through the Sonoro.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4992_4: She has spoken your name before...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4992_5: Sometimes it's a desperate plea, sometimes it's pure joy, and other times it's filled with pain.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4992_6: It's a voice from the very depths of her consciouness.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_1: Welcome to the Eidoscope, Creator. You may observe the Tethys System through this lens.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_3: We, stationed at the Eidoscope, are among the oldest.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_4: As the founder of the Black Shores, you have tasked us with assisting the Shorekeeper in managing Tethys' complex data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_5: Yet, like the Shorekeeper, we are bound to secrecy beyond this point.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_6: You have likely sensed the deeper truth... As above, so below—the stars reflect the earth, and the past shapes the future.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_7: Here, dualities persist, or perhaps such duality is the essence of our world.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4993_8: The entity at the heart of the Tethys System might... indeed be the Tethys System itself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4994_2: Oh? What am I doing here? You know, I just like hanging out here, watching the stars.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4994_3: You know it too, right? This sky here isn't real.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4994_4: One day, I might travel somewhere else in the universe. Somewhere far, far away...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4994_5: But I just can't bring myself to leave this place and everyone here...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4994_7: I'm sure you know where I'll be!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4995_1: I've opened a portal to the Modulation Hall.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4995_2: This is the only way I can see you, but I think...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4995_4: I'll use everything I've got—my computing power, my Sonoro...
Heihaian_main_1_3_4995_5: Even my soul, if it exists.
Event_AYKXBRZM_28_1: Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
Event_AYKXBRZM_28_2: We need you to infiltrate the Blue Camel and get their latest transaction records.
Event_AYKXBRZM_28_3: Remember, don't get caught, or they'll destroy the evidence.
Event_AYKXBRZM_29_1: Infiltration... Hmm, I'll need to suit up right.
Event_AYKXBRZM_29_2: Gotta sever communications at their camp first. Can't have them calling for backup.
Event_AYKXBRZM_30_1: This outfit should do the trick.
Event_AYKXBRZM_31_1: That's their hideout. Time to find a discreet spot to change.
Event_AYKXBRZM_33_1: This is it... Need to send it back ASAP.
Event_AYKXBRZM_33_2: Better hang onto this outfit in case I run into the guards.
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_4: Open it. We need to check what's inside. We've had reports about Exiles conducting illegal business recently.
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_5: ("Red Eagle" needs this. I can't let them search the box.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_7: I confess, sir. This is proof of their crimes...
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_8: I can't stand their dirty deeds anymore, so I'm taking this to the Public Security Bureau myself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_9: If you don't trust me, you can come along.
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_10: Well... It's good that you want to bring them to justice.
Event_AYKXBRZM_34_11: Alright, I'll escort her to the Bureau. The rest of you, resume your duties.
Event_AYKXBRZM_35_1: No injuries. Looks like they just passed out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_35_2: They'll wake at any moment. I need to get the evidence back to him.
Event_AYKXBRZM_35_3: This place... something feels wrong. I need to be on my guard.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_1: I've told you before not to come barging in here.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_2: Something unexpected happened during the mission... This will be safer with you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_5: The Blue Camel's transaction records. You asked for them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_7: You attacked the Patrollers for this?
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_8: Something happened to them, but it wasn't my doing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_10: You've been fooled! I never gave you such an order!
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_11: Can't you spot a fake transmission?
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_14: (Was the intel false, or did someone impersonate him when they contacted me?)
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_15: Blaming me won't make any difference. I need to get to the bottom of this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_36_16: Give me some time. I'll figure it out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_1: I've been waiting for you, Yinlin.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_3: You were once part of the Séance Society, until you betrayed me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_4: Now answer me: who are you?
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_8: Ask any Patroller if they recognize you. They would only see you as a defector.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_9: You are no Patroller, Yinlin. You never will be.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_10: Haha, is that so? The only one who can prove you are who you say you are has lost faith in you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_11: You are no Public Security agent, Yinlin. Your foolishness has ruined everything.
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_12: That's right, Yinlin. That's who you are...
Event_AYKXBRZM_37_14: No one will ever accept you or see your worth. You're nothing!
Event_AYKXBRZM_38_1: Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
Event_AYKXBRZM_38_2: We need you to infiltrate the Blue Camel and get their latest transaction records.
Event_AYKXBRZM_38_3: Remember, don't get caught, or they'll destroy the evidence.
Event_AYKXBRZM_39_1: What is this? Time's rewound to the start of the mission?
Event_AYKXBRZM_39_3: No, I have to stop this. How can any of this be possible?
Event_AYKXBRZM_40_1: Just before you can stop yourself, a blade intercepts one of your filaments.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_5: "Red Eagle" confirmed this mission was a bust.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_6: He's the mole in the Public Security Bureau.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_9: No, you knew it all along. Just not in this place.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_10: The mission was a success. You caught the mole and put an end to the Blue Camel's dealings.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_11: As for the Patrollers, you never attacked them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_12: But I made the wrong judgement...
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_13: I put my trust in the wrong person.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_15: You're just too afraid of making mistakes, that's why you dream these things.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_16: You've only ever had yourself to rely on, but still, you never waver.
Event_AYKXBRZM_41_17: Think about that question again. Who are you, really?
Event_AYKXBRZM_42_3: Enough talking, Dollmaker. You've lost yourself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_14: The Agents worked really hard to lock that bad star up!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3701_15: But we have to open the gate to fully control it. I'll get you the key!

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Generosity endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his valiant struggle to protect the land from TDs, emptied his own coffers and called upon the people to donate. The gathered wealth was displayed in the <color=Highlight>cottage by the windmill</color> and used to fortify defenses which, at only a modest cost, repelled the TD assault.
In giving, one finds reward.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Wisdom endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon", in his time, devoted himself to the study of the knightly path in <color=Highlight>Silver Moon Grove</color>. Over the years, he wrote volumes on what he learned, so that future knights might follow his teachings.
To the wise, fate serves; to the foolish, fate rules.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Courage endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his youth, singlehandedly fought a victorious battle against an entire pack of ferocious TDs near <color=Highlight>the great tree to the northwest of Egla Town</color>.
Courage is the knight's final weapon.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Mercy endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once stood vigil to <color=Highlight>the west of Mistveil Bay</color>, guarding the merchants who passed through. There, he drove away the fierce TDs and vanquished the ruthless Alari family.
To show mercy to the innocent, one must be merciless to the wicked.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Honor endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once dueled on <color=Highlight>the bridge leading to the Thorncrown Rises near Egla Town</color>, where he bested a hundred challengers.
Honor is a fine blade tempered in the fires of challenge.

POI_ZJGZ_1_1: Ah, {PlayerName}! What wind blows you here today?
POI_ZJGZ_1_2: And what wind blows you here?
POI_ZJGZ_1_3: Egla Town is where I grew up. I always come back during the troupe's off-seasons.
POI_ZJGZ_1_4: And this time, I've invited someone special to join me. Chalulu, go ahead and say hello to {PlayerName}!
POI_ZJGZ_1_7: Chalulu really seems to fancy you, {PlayerName}. You must have a charm that speaks to Echoes.
POI_ZJGZ_1_9: Easy there, easy. Seems like she can't wait to share her new discoveries with you. Look—
POI_ZJGZ_1_11: There are more of them, and they aren't just any graffiti. I can feel a unique frequency lingering on them, likely from an Echo.
POI_ZJGZ_1_12: Chalulu seems to be fascinated by the graffiti, her eyes studying every mark with an intense curiosity.
POI_ZJGZ_1_13: If anyone tries to clean up the graffiti, Chalulu will dash over to stop them.
POI_ZJGZ_1_15: I never knew Echoes could paint.
POI_ZJGZ_1_16: For Echoes with a strong urge to express themselves, graffiti might just be the easiest way.
POI_ZJGZ_1_17: The question is, what is this kid trying to express? Makes you wonder, doesn't it?
POI_ZJGZ_1_18: Kid... that's an unusual way to put it.
POI_ZJGZ_1_19: Ah, excuse me! Let's call this one "Painter" then.
POI_ZJGZ_1_20: Speaking of Echoes, your connection with them is truly something else. You probably understand their "thoughts" better than I ever could.
POI_ZJGZ_1_21: Could you photograph the artworks by Painter before they get wiped off? We might find something intriguing.
Quest_152750016_QuestDesc_152_1: In the battle at the Norfall Barrens, you successfully prevented the hatching of the Ovathrax, sparing Jinzhou from disaster. Yet, beneath the veneer of peace, the shadow of war still lingers…
Side_HSMY_1_2: It's been a while. You came here as a rookie, and now you're Jinzhou's hero. Looks like the battle at Norfall Barrens really honed your skills.
Side_HSMY_1_3: Ah, so you're {PlayerName}. I've heard a lot about you from Encore and Aalto—the Threnodian Killer.
Side_HSMY_1_4: Are you here for the Infinite Battle Simulation? Maybe you can help us test out the device's limits.
Side_HSMY_1_7: The Black Shores has a hologram projector called the "Infinite Reality Sandbox."
Side_HSMY_1_8: The Infinite Battle Simulation is a type of simulation training based on it.
Side_HSMY_1_9: Actually, the entire thing was made possible because of you.
Side_HSMY_1_12: …Hah, I like your spirit. No wonder Aalto says you're a funny person.
Side_HSMY_1_13: After the Battle of Norfall Barrens, Tethys issued a new warning based on the data from the battlefield Resonance Beacons and those you provided Aalto and Encore.
Side_HSMY_1_14: Although you managed to halt the Ovathrax's hatching, its residual frequencies are still spreading from Norfall Barrens.
Side_HSMY_1_15: As for the residual frequencies, they carry the Threnodian's Forte and its memories of combat. Newborn TDs under their influence start to undergo some form of... "evolution."
Side_HSMY_1_16: We just can't seem to catch a break when it comes to the Threnodian.
Side_HSMY_1_19: Don't stress over it, {PlayerName}. The people of Jinzhou have weathered their share of crises and are prepared for whatever comes next.
Side_HSMY_1_20: Valentina and the Black Shores team picked up the latest TD samples from Huaxu Academy just as the warning came through.
Side_HSMY_1_21: Thanks to the support from the Black Shores and Huaxu Academy, we managed to develop the "Infinite Battle Simulation" you see before you.
Side_HSMY_1_22: Even the Jinzhou Magistrate has greatly appreciated its ability to project the newly evolved TDs into reality. This can help Jinzhou better prepare for the dangers ahead.
Side_HSMY_1_23: Which is why I am here with the Midnight Rangers elites under orders from the City Hall.
Side_HSMY_1_24: The troops have trained quite a bit with the device, and the results went pretty well. As a regular at the Simulation Training, I'm sure you wouldn't want to miss out on the fun.
Side_HSMY_1_27: Excellent. I've always wanted to see the Threnodian Killer in action with my own eyes.
Side_HSMY_1_28: Couldn't have said it better myself. Although, it cuts both ways.
Side_HSMY_1_29: Well, {PlayerName}, let's dive in. There are some new features added to the simulation, so do take it slowly.
Side_HSMY_1_30: That's right. To some extent, you helped pilot this joint venture between the Black Shores and Jinzhou.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_5: Those who cannot withstand the trial by fire... shall forever be barred from our pure land...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_38: I want to find out what caused that Echo to lose control.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_39: Yes, it was. The Montelli family has been promoting the use of Reserved Terminals and Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_40: As far as I know, the Montelli family has been promoting the use of Reserved Terminals and Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_41: Most Ragunnesi use Common Echoes and don't know much about the Reserved ones. The Montellis spotted a chance and started researching Reserved Terminals.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_42: They push to bring back the Carnevale so they can showcase their Reserved Terminals, prove the quality of their Echoes, and attract both customers and investors.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_44: Yes, Mr. Alberto. An Echo was...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_45: Zani recounts what happened to the caller. Moments later...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_46: He extends a sincere apology for what just happened. They too are at a loss to explain what caused the accident.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_47: He told me that the Montelli family would investigate further. Please rest assured.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_48: Did the Montellis really have no answers?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_49: No... After all, such an incident only hinders their promotion of Reserved Terminals. They have no reason to rejoice over it.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_46: He may be a spy or in disguise.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_46: We need to look into the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_47: The Fisalia's residencies are near the Cathedral of Mercury. We could stop by the Order for more information.

Character_chun_3_1: Hello, you must be {PlayerName}, right? Beatrice filled me in on what happened.
Character_chun_3_2: The reason I looked into that Stellar Matrix is because of this little guy I found in the wild.
Character_chun_3_3: A small, damaged, and slightly old-looking robot quietly rests at her feet.
Character_chun_3_4: When I found it, it had been non-functional for a long time.
Character_chun_3_5: I tried to fix it, but I couldn't salvage much data… I only got this damaged recording:
Character_chun_3_6: …May: Majority of buildings in Petalfall Village damaged from Tacet Discord invasion. Heavy casualties. Survivors have been transferred…
Character_chun_3_7: Threat level extremely high according to the Tethys System. The Black Shores leader has decided to handle the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself} and has departed to…
Character_chun_3_8: (Static)… The village's remaining structures covered by highly mutated plants. Rescuing is difficult. More time needed…
Character_chun_3_9: A… (static)… was discovered in a deep underground cave. One Overclocked Resonator named 'Lady Flora' was rescued and taken to Black Shores. Biography pending...
Character_chun_3_10: Rabelle's Curve, this subject tends to enter the Overclocking state… currently stable… (static)…
Character_chun_3_11: (The Black Shores leader handled the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself}… So I brought this Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?)
Character_chun_3_12: The recording ends there. I had just joined the Black Shores back then, feeling curious about everything… especially about our leader.
Character_chun_3_13: Everything about {Male=him;Female=her} was shrouded in mystery, and only a select few had ever met {Male=him;Female=her}.
Character_chun_3_14: But I didn't give up. I started looking into the other name mentioned in the recording: Lady Flora.
Character_chun_3_15: The Stellar Matrix you're hunting down contained information about Lady Flora.
Character_chun_3_16: But… I found nothing. Someone deliberately erased the data, and I'm locked out from any remaining traces.
Character_chun_3_17: Someone wiped everything about Lady Flora…
Character_chun_3_18: Yeah. That piqued my interest, so I asked—well, pestered—my seniors to see if I could get anything.
Character_chun_3_19: Lady Flora was said to be very close to the Black Shores leader. They were inseparable and carried out many missions together.
Character_chun_3_20: Unfortunately, Lady Flora has been missing for nearly two decades…
Character_chun_3_21: Missing… Seems like I can't use this clue to locate that matrix.
Character_chun_3_22: Not necessarily. You're a trusted Bloom Bearer of the Shorekeeper, right?
Character_chun_3_23: The Hall of Foreign Affairs stores a lot of information about the Black Shores personnel. Try your luck there. Maybe you'll find something.

Activity_102400001_Desc:
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards.

The difficult landscape requires sharp reflexes and great grappling skills. If this sounds like your kind of mission, seek him out for more details.
HelpText_108_Content:
[About]
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Act VII "Thaw of Eons."

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any unlocked challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. Once all existing Datasets are collected, new Datasets will appear. The more Datasets you collect, the better the rewards.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your inbox when you log in again within 30 days.
Character_chun_18_5: The communication cut out. Something must've happened.
Character_chun_18_6: Got separated from Camellya… I should check out the surroundings.
Character_chun_18_7: I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.
Character_chun_18_9: But {PlayerName} already made {Male=his;Female=her} choice. Now I must make my own choice, too.
Character_chun_18_10: Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.
Character_chun_18_12: I'm inside a Stellar Matrix that holds Lady Flora's information, so it must be a simulation of some past event.
Character_chun_49_1: ...I have no plan to drown here.
Character_chun_49_2: Consume and be consumed by power... What's wrong with that!

Character_chun_52_1: Such weaklings. I haven't had enough fun yet.
Character_chun_52_3: Anyway, {PlayerName}, where did you go after that? How did you find this place?
Character_chun_52_5: You saw those possible iterations of history too?
Character_chun_52_6: Hehe… So you really were the leader of Black Shores.
Character_chun_52_9: No wonder I felt something familiar when I first saw you outside Jinzhou…
Character_chun_52_10: Hah... Welcome back, {PlayerName}. Glad to see you again.
Character_chun_52_11: I saw a lot of interesting stuff… I woke up in that cave a decade ago. Traveled all across Solaris before I ended up back at the Black Shores.
Character_chun_52_12: The matrix showed me several different iterations of my past. Looks like even the smallest deviations can lead to entirely different outcomes.
Character_chun_52_13: But one constant remained—you always saved me, and we always found each other.
Character_chun_52_14: Our encounter is preordained in every future...
Character_chun_52_15: My beloved seed, my only… rival.
Character_chun_52_16: And you just helped me with my Overclocking… Hmph, I won't let it happen again.
Character_chun_52_17: Gotta make sure to show you my best!
Character_chun_52_18: This Stellar Matrix should be temporarily deactivated since its core has been dealt with.
Character_chun_52_19: Let's go back. Give the coordinates to Beatrice, and this mission will be over.
Character_chun_52_20: Then... can I have the rest of your day?
Character_chun_52_22: Hehe, let me keep it a secret for now.
Character_chun_52_23: Camellya smiles weakly before joyfully recounting what happened in the Stellar Matrix.

Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.

LevelPlay_6000001_ChildQuestTip_153_28: Bring the story to a fitting end
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_18: Good. You are a smart one, Miss Carlotta.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_20: I'm sorry. Even though the time we shared was… very memorable.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_21: Excellent. It appears you've made the right choice as any true Ragunnesi would, honoring blood and faith alike.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_22: Pull the trigger. End this transgressor's life. The Sentinel shall host a supreme banquet for you in the high heavens.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_23: Farewell, and may you meet your friends… where it all ends.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_25: There is a saying in Ragunna, even the finest bullet can miss. It was only a mistake.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_26: So be it. I shouldn't question your faith over such a mishap... It is after all insignificant in the grand scheme of the Divinity.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_27: Let us bear witness, to the moment divine wrath descends from the heavens.
DarkCoastDelivery_Desc_1:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Gulpuff is born from anomalous data, possessing an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are generally regarded as Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.
DarkCoastDelivery_Desc_2:
Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.
DarkCoastDelivery_Desc_3:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Fusion Warrior is born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.
DarkCoastDelivery_Desc_4:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Rocksteady Guardian is born from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock layers with a single blow. 

Despite its slow movement speed, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it.

Brute force, pure and simple.
DarkCoastDelivery_Desc_5:
Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists are fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.

Event_AYKXBRZM_100_1: If I really have the chance to kill you...
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_2: Why are you so obsessed with it?
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_4: Well, because it's all about you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_5: Taking your life won't be easy, not with all the strong foes you've defeated.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_6: Unless, of course, you step willingly on to my blade.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_7: Anyway, it doesn't matter. I'd never force you into anything. No fun in that.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_8: Your potential, your desires, your ambitions... They're what truly excite me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_9: But you know what's the icing on the cake? It's how you look into my eyes when you talk about these things...
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_10: Perhaps one day I'll whisk you away to a hidden land, where you'll be mine, and mine alone.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_3: Did you regain all your power?
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_5: I and all those you helped in the Somnoire are prepared for the final battle.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_6: Once you're set, we'll be ready to face the one responsible for all this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_7: Let's repair the Somnoire and shut down his mischief for good!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_1: All set... It's time to fight!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_2: Here we come, Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_3: I'll give this show a grand finale.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_4: If I can help then, I'll... I'll do my best!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_5: It's time to end this charade.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_6: Oh, to dance alongside you in battle... I can't wait any longer.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_7: Now, give me your battle cry!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_9: Not that one. It should be "Let's go save the world again!"
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_2: Has that black cat vanished for good?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_3: No, he's just lost some control over the Somnoire. It won't be long before he tries to take it back.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_6: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on him.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_7: Hmm... If things get serious, I can call on you again, can't I?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_8: By the way, did you have something you wanted to ask?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_10: Why did I experience other people's dreams?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_12: Its creation may not be the work of one person. At any rate, I can't say much more about it right now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_14: Because you, or maybe your past self, told me to keep it hush-hush.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_15: If I were to tell you why, well... that's already saying too much!
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_16: What I can tell you is, you're the Dreamwalker, the only one who can come and go in Somnoire as you please.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_17: You've got control over me, this gateway, and that sneaky black cat.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_18: Basically, you're the only one who can see this gateway and all the anomalies it causes...
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_19: This is what happens when Somnoire expands into reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_20: The black cat turned off Somnoire's filters, so it started copying every dream in Solaris.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_21: To store all those dreams, he opened more gateways that started to leech into reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_22: The dreams you just went through are from folks who got stuck in Somnoire by accident.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_23: But since you control these gateways, you can help them escape.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_24: When they wake up, all they'll have is a vague feeling of what happened.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_25: Just like a real dream, mmm?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_26: I can finally go back through the gateway I came from, and you... It's time for you to wake up, meow.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_1: Anything else you want to know?
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_5: Of course, silly! You didn't think that was all, did you?
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_6: The black cat might be nursing his boo-boos now, but he's not out of the game yet.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_7: I'll find you if I need help, Dreamwalker.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_13: Alright then. See you next time, Dreamwalker!
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_1: If this is a dream, then what happened here isn't real...
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_3: Maybe a bit, but you know what? My team always has my back, dream or not.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_4: Even in a dream, the friendship felt so real.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_8: Oh yeah, I've already met you in real life!
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_9: It was your support that kept me going.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_10: So come find me in reality! I'll be waitin' for you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_3: The crisis is over. Why are you still hanging around?
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_4: Outside, more dirt's getting swept under the rug.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_5: I'm ready to get back. But there is still one thing that's nagging at me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_6: You. When I screwed up, you... had my back.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_7: But hey, dream talk. Who's to say what's real. Not like I screw up in real life.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_9: Heh, is that right? Prove it to me in the real world, then.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_1: This is the end of our adventure!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_4: In this story, the ten warriors defeated the Black Cat Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_5: But there were only six of us.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_6: Not true! Cosmos, Cloudy, and the white cat were also part of our team...
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_8: Of course they count! We are all brave warriors!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_9: And the Grape Kingdom is where the next adventure begins...
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_10: Make sure to tell me this story when you wake up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_12: Maybe the white cat can be the bad guy next time...
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_2: I couldn't have finished that draft without you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_4: You finished that same painting in reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_5: I still find myself swayed by my doubts.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_6: Painting, for me, isn't just in the finished piece. It's the only place I can let my emotions out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_7: When I worked on that Xiehua Village piece, I felt like I was capturing the very essence of life around me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_8: Thanks to you, I felt bold enough to capture those fleeting moments.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_9: I really need to be truer to myself...
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_10: Hey, could you visit me when you wake up? I want to show you my painting.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_1: Mmm, what do you think a dream is?
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_2: It's a reflection of the past.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_3: It's a glimpse into the future.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_5: I realized this was a dream through careful observation. It's often that same keen observation that reveals the deepest truths.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_6: Have you ever considered how someone with lost memories might confuse a dream with reality?
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_7: Perhaps paying closer attention to your surroundings could bring you closer to understanding the true nature of "reality."
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_8: What are you hinting at? Solaris is a figment of my imagination?
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_9: It's just a theory. I could be mistaken...
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_10: But when I found myself in Hongzhen in my dream, my mind was a blank slate.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_11: I knew where I was, but I had no idea why and for what purpose.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_12: I suspect you experienced something similar upon awakening in the Gorges of Spirits.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_14: Yes... I would advise you to pay close attention to the subtleties around you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_15: If you've learned something from this dream, then it wasn't for nothing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_1: Are you going to leave me? Again?
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_3: But I'm actually quite content here.
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_4: This is our arena! Look at all this, so much room for the chase...
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_6: Then why not stay a bit longer?
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_7: It's not all that different from reality, if you really think about it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_8: There's still a lot to do in reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_9: A gateway will restore of all this back to reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_113_11: But waking up isn't so terrible. After all, you never fail to keep things interesting in reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_115_4: Hmm? What's that over there next to the train?
Event_AYKXBRZM_116_1: "Delivered by Fulei"... This is the lost package. How did I not notice it before...
Event_AYKXBRZM_116_2: I should give it to Lumi.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_1: It's already been three days and my package is still—
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_2: I'm terribly sorry, but could you please...
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_7: Huh? Let me check... Wait! Look at this, it's damaged!
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_8: Don't expect me to accept a damaged package! This is unacceptable!
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_9: This is our fault... Please accept my sincere apologies. We will compensate you for your loss.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_10: I don't want your compensation! I want my package! In one piece!
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_11: Do you have any idea how important this—
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_13: B-boss? Why are you here in person? I'm just...
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_15: No need for compensation. The contents are still intact. We'll pay you the delivery fee.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_16: Did you retrieve this package yourself from the Waving Battlefield?
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_19: I'm Tianhu, leader of the Cruising Drake.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_20: The package is secure, and we won't give you any more hassle. In fact, I wouldn't mind getting to know you better.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_21: Not in that way, of course. I heard you took down that beast at Norfall Barrens. The wilds have been quieter since then, which means more opportunities for folks like us.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_22: We're in need of skilled individuals like yourself more than ever. You'd fit right in.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_23: Think about joining us one day. The Cruising Drake always welcomes the best of the best.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_24: Hey, wait up, Boss! Why do you always have to walk off like that after talking...
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_25: Shut it! It's about showing our style and drawing in new blood. Pipe down...
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_3: They asked me to join their gang.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_4: Huh... Well, thank you so, so, so much for helping me find the lost package!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_7: I saw something strange in the Waving Battlefield.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_12: Heh, that's er... interesting! Didn't know you had such an imagination!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_13: (Just like what the white cat said. Only I can see these things...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_14: By the way, you won't believe what happened last night!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_18: Can't quite remember the details... but it felt sweet!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_19: My coworkers said they had a similar dream... Maybe I managed to tell them how much I care about them in that dream.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_20: I'm sure you did. You're a natural leader.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_21: Yeah, and you'll be a boss someday for sure.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_22: Haha, because I'm Lumi, Luminary of Logistics!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_23: Shhh, gotta keep it low-key... Can't let my boss hear this, or I'll be in trouble.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_24: Oh no, just got a rush order... Let me give you the payment first.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_25: Again, thanks a bunch for your help! If you ever swing by my hometown, Yuezhou, I'll treat you to some local delicacies!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_26: We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_27: Got it, got it! Sorry, gotta dash! Catch you later!
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_29: After bowing deeply, Lumi grabs a delivery crate and rushes out of the station.
Event_AYKXBRZM_300_1: The Somnoire gateway must be just ahead...
Event_AYKXBRZM_302_2: Feels like I'm floating... Is the cat helping me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_303_1: This should be the last one.
Event_AYKXBRZM_43_1: I do want others to trust me, but...
Event_AYKXBRZM_43_2: My priority is making sure justice is served.
Event_AYKXBRZM_43_3: When I found myself in doubt, you helped me find myself again...
Event_AYKXBRZM_43_5: You've never stopped being a Patroller.
Event_AYKXBRZM_43_7: I like knowing someone has faith in me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_44_4: Dreams cleansed! Power restored! I can talk now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_44_5: Somnoire is growing faster... If this keeps up, Solaris will be in danger.
Event_AYKXBRZM_44_6: Walk through more gateways. Save people from dreams. Fight that person. I'm counting on you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_44_7: Talking drains my energy. Need to rest now...
Event_AYKXBRZM_45_1: (From the looks of it, I'm probably the only one who can enter the Somnoire as I please...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_45_2: (Besides that cat, the only other people here are the ones trapped in their dreams.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_45_3: (I will be the one to help them escape.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_1: Hi, {PlayerName}! Are you ready for Encore's new story?
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_5: A long, long time ago, there was a Cloud Kingdom, where the amazing warrior Encore lived.
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_6: Then she met you, Traveler Cosmos, Prince Cloudy, and many more new friends.
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_7: Together, they defeated the Dark Cloud Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_8: Sounds just like the last one.
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_9: It's a great story, Encore style.
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_10: You're in the story this time! That makes a big difference!
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_11: It's good, right? Stories about adventuring with friends are my favorite!
Event_AYKXBRZM_63_12: I'll tell you a new story next time, don't you worry about that.
Event_AYKXBRZM_64_3: Why are you talking less this time?
Event_AYKXBRZM_64_5: Black cat. He's formidable. My power. Limited again. Stop him, Dreamwalker...
Event_AYKXBRZM_65_1: (The cat's weaker than last time. What's worse, the Gatekeeper said the expansion is accelerating...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_65_2: (I have to stop it before it's too late...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_77_1: I was just dreaming. In that dream, I tried my best to paint something new, but no one seemed to like it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_77_2: Instead, they just wanted more copies of my old stuff, treating me like some money machine.
Event_AYKXBRZM_77_3: But you told me to trust myself...
Event_AYKXBRZM_77_8: You'll be better. I believe in you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_77_9: Y-you don't have to call me "Master"...
Event_AYKXBRZM_78_2: How did you manage to do that?
Event_AYKXBRZM_78_3: Power grows. Strong enough to fight him.
Event_AYKXBRZM_78_4: Next time, I will talk even better!
Event_AYKXBRZM_78_7: Help me... Too much sleep. This is the last time...
Event_AYKXBRZM_78_9: Cats really do sleep through anything.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_1: So, are you interested in the details of that case?
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_4: Back then, the Fractsidus killed Jing and his parents under the cover of night.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_5: They then posed as Jing's parents and lay in wait until Xinyi figured it out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_6: But instead of exposing them right away, she played along, biding her time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_7: After two weeks, the Fractsidus couldn't restrain themselves any longer.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_8: They used the pretense of searching for their lost boy to scout out Mt. Firmament.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_9: Of course, Xinyi was prepared for this. She used the opportunity to expose them in the act and capture them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_11: I'd say your strategy is no less impressive than hers.
Event_AYKXBRZM_86_12: Though our enemy's identity remains unclear... I'll support you, come what may.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_2: I can finally talk in full sentences!
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_4: I prefer how you used to talk.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_5: Yeah, yeah, try to meow or speak three words yourself. You don't want to know how it feels...
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_6: Anyway, we're down to our last gateway.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_7: Once you rescue the last person from their dream, I can finally balance my control over Somnoire with the Gatekeeper's.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_8: That's when we can launch our final attack.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_9: I'll finish him with one strike.
Event_AYKXBRZM_87_13: Meow! Hey! Don't treat me like a cat!
