Main_Linaxita_2_0_10_2: The enigmatic giant wraps you in a bear hug. A peculiar yet friendly energy washes over you.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_13_2: Bear with me, Lario... We are nearly through this fog.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_13_3: Rage on, tempest! Your fury is but a breeze against our righteous course!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_13_4: Time to fight, my friends! I will hold the ship steady! Let the deluge descend, our vessel stands firm! Our clarion call shall pierce the tempest's roar!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_16_1: This will be another long trip.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_16_3: I'll be here guarding the Black Shores until you return.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_17_1: Yeesh, this fog is giving me the creeps. I've got a bad feeling about this...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_17_2: Huh… Wait, what's that huge shadow under the water?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_18_1: Thank you for your aid, my friends!
Main_Linaxita_2_0_18_2: Onward to Ragunna we sail. Rest well as we journey forth.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_18_3: Settle in and take a good look around! No need to be shy, you hear?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_19_1: It's been some time... Have you been well?
Main_Linaxita_2_0_19_2: I'm calling because I have news about Abby's situation.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_19_3: When you have a moment, could you return to the Black Shores? I'll be here whenever you're ready to visit.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_1: A righteous soul with humble curiosity... Just as I expected.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_3: Fenrico, the Enlightened One, present Primus of Ragunna, uncovered the path that leads to the high heaven, where the Sentinel imparts Their teachings to mortals.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_4: Under his permission, pilgrims set sail for the Promised Land, their voices a symphony of hymns, hearts aflame with unwavering piety and hope.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_6: That... doesn't seem like what I just saw.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_7: I sense your doubt, and it's not unfounded. These pilgrims have little choice. After all, they are not counted among the Righteous but instead deemed the Fools by Ragunna's laws.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_8: Whether a righteous soul clinging to hope amid hardship, or a lost fool floundering in waves of confusion, the audience always favors the former.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_9: I'm working on a play. Tells of pilgrims striving to reach the Sentinel's promised land.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_10: But to captivate, there must be twists. Perhaps, what awaits them is not the sweet salvation promised by their Sentinel, but...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_12: Hehe, who knows? Maybe treasures beyond count, or an unnamed beast lurking in the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_13: Or perhaps nothing but a forsaken shore. These are just initial musings. I need time to refine them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_14: Would you care to share your thoughts on the ending?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_15: Should the story depict them as lost Fools facing their end in despair, or as wronged Righteous finally finding justice and redemption?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_16: What is more compelling to you, {Male=sir;Female=miss}?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_20: Ah, I see... Your comment is noted.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_21: Until the Carnevale, guest from afar. I hope you enjoy the show.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_22: Cristoforo gives a courteous nod and takes his leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_23: I'm honestly baffled... Was all that real or just a story?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_24: Hmm, that one gives off a mysterious vibe...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_1_28: Ah, who cares? The Carnevale sounds like a blast! Everyone's raving about it. You might even catch a chat with the Sentinel!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_1: We've been expecting you, {PlayerName}. Welcome to Averardo Bank, {Male=sir;Female=miss}.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_4: I'm Zani, a staff member here. The Montelli family ordered me to welcome you and assist with accessing your fund.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_5: May I ask where your companion is...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_8: Your fund is ready. Please follow me.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_11: I believe this is your first time using our service. As the Montelli family's esteemed guest, we're upgrading your account to Gold Membership.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_12: Mercurio here will sort out your subscription. He's about as lively as a cash machine, so give him a moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_13: Is this Mercurio also an Echo?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_14: Even the cash machine is an Echo...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_15: Yes, all Echoes here belong to the Montelli family. Mercurio's designed to provide self-service banking.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_16: The Montellis also put me in charge as your bodyguard and tour guide for Ragunna. If you want to see the city before the Carnevale, I can arrange a travel itinerary. Perhaps a Thundering Mephis type of outing may suit you, hm?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_17: It's a popular choice for visiting all the tourist attractions quickly, though I wouldn't bother with it personally.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_18: ...This assignment was very last-minute. I apologize if I am not familiar with your personal travel preferences. Please excuse any oversights on my part.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_19: No need to be so formal...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_20: Don't worry, I like to find my own way.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_21: Not at all. The Montellis always treat their guests with hospitality. I'm simply following their lead.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_22: Understood. I am here to assist if you change your mind.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_24: The fund has been deposited into your account. Is there anything else you need help with?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_25: Are there any good restaurants nearby?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_26: Yes. The nearest one is Trattoria Margherita. I personally recommend Pizza Tropicale. Would you like to dine there?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_27: Sorry, I have some work to handle. Please excuse me for a moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_28: The last lots for the auction have arrived and will be escorted back by designated Echoes. Make sure you get them on time.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_29: Keep an eye on No. 23 and 56—they're foreign curiosities insured by Mr. Lombardi. Don't screw it up.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_30: All the details are in the memo... Okay, I'll leave it to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_32: Sorry to keep you waiting. I'll take you to the restaurant now.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_33: Seems like a packed schedule... Is everything alright?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_34: Yes, thank you for asking. The Bank is short-staffed due to secondments, so I'm handling a few extra things.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_35: Normally, I wouldn't take on extra assignments, but my manager promised some paid days off, and the Montellis can be very gener—
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_36: Ahem. Sorry, too much. I'll do my best to meet your needs during your stay here.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_37: You can loosen up a bit.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_39: Don't worry about me, I can handle myself without involving the Montellis. I'm not one for formalities, so let's keep it relaxed.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_41: Thank you, {PlayerName}. All that formality was starting to feel like exercise.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_42: Let's go get something to eat, shall we?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_46_2: At the end of the garden… is that a confessional?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_47_1: Are you alright? It's strange. Why did that Echo suddenly lose control…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_47_2: I'm fine. Something's off with those Echoes. Let's try calming them down.

Character_chun_19_1: {PlayerName}, do you still have that bracelet?
Character_chun_19_2: Good. You can keep it, so... a piece of me always stays with you.
Character_chun_19_3: Since the past between us is a secret now, consider this bracelet our witness.
Character_chun_19_5: Hehe, it's an old one. It was… a gift.
Character_chun_19_6: Got it for monitoring my Rabelle spectrum, as an Overclocking warning device.
Character_chun_19_7: But I don't really need it anymore. Told you I'll never lose control again.
Character_chun_19_8: Except in a special situation like this, in most cases, nothing can even leave a scratch on me.
Character_chun_19_9: I hit jackpot finding the matrix. It was a blast! But that's all in the past now.
Character_chun_19_10: You aren't going to get your memories back?
Character_chun_19_11: You said your memories are sealed by Lady Flora…
Character_chun_19_12: No, I'm quite happy with things as they are right now. No need to risk opening the floodgates and winding up in another medical pod.
Character_chun_19_13: Since Lady Flora—the past me—chose to seal away those memories, I'm fully behind my decision.
Character_chun_19_14: As for the memories we used to share, if fate decides to reveal them, they'll resurface naturally as we continue our journey together.
Character_chun_19_15: Plus… does it really matter? No, it doesn't!
Character_chun_19_16: Fate has already brought us back together.
Character_chun_19_17: I bet we'll have more wild stories to share, and more games to play.
Character_chun_19_18: No point dwelling on the past. I'd rather live in the moment.
Character_chun_19_19: …Speaking of which, I have a question for you.
Character_chun_19_20: {PlayerName}… Are you happy now? Having lost all memories, living a new life...
Character_chun_19_24: Is that so? Good to know. I'm happy too. Every moment <ano=Sparring>dancing</ano> with you brings me immense joy!
Character_chun_19_25: Then... If one day you get tired of all this saving-the-world stuff, I'll whisk you away to a place where no one can find us!
Character_chun_19_26: Heh, same here. But you'll be fine, because you have me now. We can take our time figuring out this life, together!
Character_chun_19_27: This is where I first set foot on this island, where everything began. The stars lie beneath our feet, where the Tethys System resides.
Character_chun_19_28: Tethys records all data on Solaris, capturing countless possibilities born and fading away.
Character_chun_19_29: But in every possible scenario, we always find each other.
Character_chun_19_30: All paths in the stars converge towards this single endpoint, so—
Character_chun_19_31: The universes where we didn't meet must have all perished! Only this one survived!
Character_chun_19_32: If the universe were a flower, then yes…
Character_chun_19_33: ...This must be the perfect world for a gardener like me.
Character_chun_17_1: {PlayerName}, please give me the things you just found… Oh, you want to come along, Camellya?
Character_chun_17_2: {PlayerName} begged me to go with {Male=him;Female=her}, and it looked fun, so I agreed.
Character_chun_17_3: Well, that's rare. The Camellya I know was only interested in going out to find candidates.
Character_chun_17_4: {PlayerName}, kudos to you for being able to get her to cooperate with you. Awesome.
Character_chun_17_7: Yeah, normally, Camellya doesn't seem to care about anything.
Character_chun_17_8: Hehe, that's quite a confident statement, but you do have the skills to back it up.
Character_chun_17_9: With Camellya on this mission with you, you should be safer.
Character_chun_17_10: Don't worry. I'll be keeping a close eye on you.
Character_chun_17_11: You hand the three items to Beatrice. She records the information and then returns them to you.
Character_chun_17_12: Hold on. I need some time to process the data. Once that's done, you can dive into the Stellar Matrix with our portal.
Character_chun_17_13: Past, present, future… All the possibilities in the universe change within this swirling starry sky.
Character_chun_17_14: I'm starting to get a bit interested~! What kind of "me" is hidden in there?
Character_chun_17_15: Let's go, {PlayerName}. A new adventure awaits.

HHACZST_1_1: I've never seen a plant rooted in the Tacetite before.
HHACZST_1_2: Ku—Plants that grow on the Tacetite will slowly lose their pigmentation until they turn purple or white.
HHACZST_1_3: No matter what you do, you can't find plants in any other colors here.
HHACZST_1_4: Maybe your hair would turn purple or white too. Ku ku ku...
HHACZST_1_6: Just kidding! You're human, not a plant. Ku ku ku...
HHACZST_1_7: But actually, without protective gear, humans could be affected by the Tacetite's frequency and start showing symptoms like ataxia.
HHACZST_1_8: However, the Black Shores members don't seem to experience that issue.
HHACZST_1_9: Ku—That's because we have the Anchors. Without them, the Black Shores would just be a barren island.
HHACZST_1_10: And a barren island would have no use of a gardener like me, ku ku...
HHACZST_1_11: So… the Anchors are like one giant protective device for the Black Shores?
HHACZST_1_12: Ku... Help me water these flowers first, and then I'll answer your questions in exchange. And you over there, wanna give it a try too?
HHACZST_1_14: Turning over rocks for Astrites is more of my thing.
HHACZST_10_3: Oh yes. I'm waiting for Camellya—the Bloom Bearer covered in vines.
HHACZST_10_5: She usually handles the "germination test." It's the test we give to new candidates.
HHACZST_10_6: The Gardeners organize their personal info, and the Tethys System decides how they'll be evaluated.
HHACZST_10_7: I've heard Camellya takes care of all the combat-oriented tests. She always grabs the candidates' profiles without notifying us and does her thing.
HHACZST_10_8: By the time we find her, the test is already over, and she just smacks the results in our faces.
HHACZST_10_10: Not exactly. She's gotten a lot of complaints... Honestly, I don't know how to talk to her about it. It's just too awkward...
HHACZST_10_12: Mostly that she's more interested in fighting than actually running the tests…
HHACZST_10_14: Her methods can be a bit intense, but they're great for pressure tests or for vetting candidates in dangerous regions.
HHACZST_10_15: If you can pass her test, it means you've got the physical and mental strength to handle extreme situations.
HHACZST_10_16: Overall, she's a solid tester. I just wish I didn't have to clean up the mess she leaves behind...
HHACZST_11_1: Greetings. I'm Paranora, the Bloom Bearer responsible for human resources at the Black Shores.
HHACZST_11_2: Are you the new recruit? May I check your itinerary, please?
HHACZST_11_3: It looks like you haven't been assigned a "germination test" yet.
HHACZST_11_5: Sorry, that's a bit technical. It's just a general test we arrange for candidates who want to become Consultants or Bloom Bearers.
HHACZST_11_6: How do you gather their personal info?
HHACZST_11_7: The Tethys System is linked to all Nexus on the planet, constantly monitoring for abnormal frequencies.
HHACZST_11_8: The frequencies generated when a new resonator appears, uses their Forte, or gets Overclocked will be captured by the Nexus and uploaded to Tethys.
HHACZST_11_9: Using the computing power of the Stellar Matrices, the data we extract from these frequencies is as detailed as DNA analysis.
HHACZST_11_10: We build our candidates' profiles with this info and store them in our talent pool.
HHACZST_11_11: And how do you choose the right candidate?
HHACZST_11_12: We Gardeners visit each candidate in person, check their background, and bring that information back to Tethys.
HHACZST_11_13: Tethys then determines the test content for each individual.
HHACZST_11_14: In other words, every test is tailor-made.
HHACZST_11_15: Based on what I see in you, I think you'll make a great tester.
HHACZST_12_1: Hello there. Can I help you with something?
HHACZST_12_2: You and that Gardener I just met…
HHACZST_12_4: Haha, that's my sister, Paranora. We're both Gardeners.
HHACZST_12_5: People often mix up our names, so sometimes her documents end up with me.
HHACZST_12_6: My sister handles the talent pool, and I focus on finding the right people from that pool to form the support teams.
HHACZST_12_8: Exactly. The support teams monitor the Waveworn, issue alerts, and then dispatch pre-organized action teams to assist various countries in preventing potential disasters.
HHACZST_12_9: Of course, this requires cooperation from those countries. We need to be granted the right to collect and analyze Reverberations in their local disaster zones.
HHACZST_12_10: Good cooperation is crucial for our work's success and will be a huge benefit to them as well.
HHACZST_12_11: After all, disaster prevention is just as important as disaster relief.
HHACZST_13_1: No entry beyond this point. Please leave.
HHACZST_13_2: The emergency response team is clearing abnormal frequencies.
HHACZST_14_1: Stop dragging me! The binding code is gonna snap!
HHACZST_14_2: Just come over here and stand where Adrian told us! Even if you break, the code will hold!
HHACZST_14_3: Adrian said to guard this area. It doesn't matter exactly where we stand. Don't get hung up on the details. Wait, someone's coming.
HHACZST_14_4: Excuse me. No entry beyond this point. Please leave.
HHACZST_14_7: The surface of the Black Shores has been invaded by abnormal frequencies, creating multiple data wormholes.
HHACZST_14_8: The emergency response team is clearing the indoor area. No one is permitted to enter now.
HHACZST_14_10: What? I was just about to say that!
HHACZST_16_1: I saw that charging station first!
HHACZST_16_5: This KU-Haha here stole my charging station and pretended it didn't! It even made the station explode!
HHACZST_16_6: It wouldn't have blown up if you hadn't barged in while it was running! And KU-Heehee wouldn't have gotten hurt and needed factory repairs!
HHACZST_16_7: Wait, your argument caused someone else to get hurt?
HHACZST_16_10: Adrian docked our allowances for it and told us to guard this room.
HHACZST_16_11: He wanted us to learn to cooperate, so he input a code that binds us 24/7.
HHACZST_16_13: But I can't stand being around this guy! Not for another second!
HHACZST_16_14: ...Looks like you haven't learned the lesson.
HHACZST_17_1: Ms. Leclerc, could you check when KU-Join's maintenance will be finished?
HHACZST_17_2: Hmm, you've been asking about KU-Join a lot lately. Missing it? Don't worry, I'll find out for you.
HHACZST_17_3: Ms. Leclerc, help! Adrian says he's upgrading me tomorrow! Last time he did that, I lost a whole year's worth of memory!
HHACZST_17_4: Ugh, that man! Always doing whatever he feels like... Don't worry, I'll talk to him for you.
HHACZST_17_5: Ms. Leclerc, KU-Leto and KU-Svan are fighting.
HHACZST_17_6: Those two? Really? I'll go check on them in a bit.
HHACZST_17_7: Oh, hello there. Sorry, I didn't see you.
HHACZST_17_9: Ms. Leclerc is our best friend!
HHACZST_17_13: I'm a cognitive behaviorist, and I've been studying the Tethys System robots. Maybe they trust me because I talk to them a lot.
HHACZST_17_14: So, you study how they think and behave?
HHACZST_17_15: Yes. Their personalities were originally assigned by the Tethys System to help with tasks.
HHACZST_17_16: But now, they're expressing themselves, with their own thoughts and worries.
HHACZST_17_17: I believe with some guidance and education, their logic program can evolve and form more developed identities.
HHACZST_17_18: Just look at them—they've already gone beyond what the system initially gave them. It's a different kind of life, but it's still life, isn't it?
HHACZST_17_21: You should try talking to the robots more. Perhaps you'll even make friends with one of them.
HHACZST_17_22: I get your concern, but I think instead of curbing it, we should find ways to adapt and move forward.
HHACZST_18_1: Update failed? Why is this the only robot that's incompatible?
HHACZST_18_3: The components of its control system got an error. I'm repairing it and updating the system.
HHACZST_18_6: It can't be. These robots don't feel pain. What you're hearing is just the language module reacting to the repairs.
HHACZST_18_7: Their personalities are also functions added by the Tethys System, something that needs regular maintenance.
HHACZST_18_8: Upgrading their systems and chips is the best way to improve them.
HHACZST_18_9: Trust me, I'm the best engineer here. This robot will be better than ever when I'm done.
HHACZST_19_1: How many moons are there in the sky?
HHACZST_19_2: One... Can you stop asking me these weird questions? My head hurts...
HHACZST_19_5: Is the Shorekeeper male or female?
HHACZST_19_6: How am I supposed to know? I've never met them before!
HHACZST_2_1: I've made up my mind, Ms. Eleanor.
HHACZST_2_2: I see. Artemisia, I want you to know that I respect whatever decision you make.
HHACZST_2_3: Indeed. Resonators assigned to collect Reverberations tend to have actute senses that allow them to detect even the minuscule amount of residual frequencies.
HHACZST_2_4: It's our gift... also our burden.
HHACZST_2_5: Are you saying that before you assumed the role of Gardener…
HHACZST_2_6: ...I'd felt the weight of those lingering emotions myself, yes. So if you feel like you need someone to talk to, I'm here for you.
HHACZST_2_7: Thank you, Ms. Eleanor. It's just that… the moment I touch those Reverberations, the emotions and last wishes contained within them flood my mind…
HHACZST_2_8: I know my work helps many, but the I simply can't take in all the pain, despair, and regret I feel…
HHACZST_2_9: The heaviness of it all has been wearing me down, leaving me torn between my urge to end the suffering and my sense of responsibility—
HHACZST_2_10: I joined the Black Shores to free the world from suffering, didn't I?
HHACZST_2_11: Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
HHACZST_20_1: W-wait a second... Is this person here real or simulated?
HHACZST_20_6: Your treatment isn't finished yet. Please stay still.
HHACZST_20_8: Amamiya, field agent. The preliminary diagnosis is mild reality perception disorder. In other words, the patient may feel like their surroundings aren't real.
HHACZST_20_9: Most of our members are experiencing this because the Tethys' reality Anchors are unstable.
HHACZST_20_10: No wonder I've had a stomachache and headache ever since I got out of the underground area.
HHACZST_20_11: Wait... Is this pain even real, or...?
HHACZST_20_13: Darn it! I've only been to the Black Shores for a few days... Useless me!
HHACZST_21_1: All the supplies are here. Now, what's next...
HHACZST_21_2: Hm? Oh, hi there. I'm Weyl, with Lollo Logistics. Got a package to send?
HHACZST_21_3: Lollo Logistics can even send packages to the Black Shores?
HHACZST_21_4: Absolutely. Wherever our clients are, we make sure their packages get delivered safe and sound.
HHACZST_21_5: I handle all the shipments to and from the Black Shores. If you have any issues with deliveries or transportation routes, just let me know anytime.
HHACZST_21_6: So that's how the Black Shores gets its supplies.
HHACZST_21_7: But how did you get onto this island?
HHACZST_21_8: Not everything comes this way, but yeah, Lollo Logistics is working with the Black Shores.
HHACZST_21_11: And how do the ships even find this place?
HHACZST_21_12: Haha, just messing with you. But honestly, I can't share that—it's a company secret.
HHACZST_21_13: No offense, but is there some misunderstanding here? Oh, I forgot to wear my Blake Bloom. No wonder you're asking all these questions.
HHACZST_21_14: I'm also a Black Shores Consultant, but I usually don't wear the Blake Bloom outside this island.
HHACZST_21_16: Most places are indeed accommodating to Consultants, but some people aren't too happy with us. They even disconnected the local Nexus from the Tethys System.
HHACZST_21_17: Since the Black Shores isn't exactly popular everywhere, it's better to go low-profile when delivering. People tend to open up more that way, too.
HHACZST_21_19: Anyway, I've got to check the inventory. If you have any packages to send, just come find me.
HHACZST_22_1: The abnormal data here is clearing at a normal rate.
HHACZST_22_2: Detection results have been uploaded to the system. Let's move on to the next spot.
HHACZST_23_2: We can take a break once the mechanics arrive.
HHACZST_24_1: Someone once brought back a scarlet flower. I've never seen anything like it before—it's stunning.
HHACZST_24_2: I heard it's a rare species. Only the experts know where to find it.
HHACZST_25_1: You have 48 hours to assist the locals and evacuate everyone to the designated safe zones before the Lament strikes.
HHACZST_25_2: The disaster relief will last for one week. After that, I'll issue new orders based on the situation.
HHACZST_25_3: Report any unexpected events immediately. No unauthorized actions or disobedience will be tolerated within the emergency response team.
HHACZST_25_6: It seems you're not familiar with our team. While I wait for my next communication, let me give you a quick briefing.
HHACZST_25_7: I'm Valentina, the remote commander of the emergency response team. This is a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.
HHACZST_25_8: Every member here has been rigorously trained and selected.
HHACZST_25_9: They're the backbone of the Black Shores, each with extensive experience in handling TDs and rescues.
HHACZST_25_10: Final preparations are underway. This team will deploy shortly.
HHACZST_25_11: Don't you worry about us, Commander! You know we've got this. We'll be back with a victory, no question about it.
HHACZST_25_12: ...This is not the time for jokes. Stay focused.
HHACZST_26_1: Valentina is communicating with the dispatched members of the emergency response team.
HHACZST_26_2: The TD Outbreak will hit your position in 30 minutes. There's almost no time left for a rescue operation.
HHACZST_26_5: You've never been wrong, Yuri. That's why I've always trusted your judgment.
HHACZST_26_6: I've never regretted the decisions I've made, and I hope this one won't be an exception.
HHACZST_27_1: Okay, to tighten the scanner on the Anchor, we need...
HHACZST_27_3: ...It's really not funny to keep joking about my name.
HHACZST_27_4: But you can't do this without a screw, Drew.
HHACZST_28_1: I'm so tired… When are we going to finish clearing all this corrupted data?
HHACZST_28_2: Checking every device does take time.
HHACZST_28_3: But it's the most efficient way to eliminate potential risks.
HHACZST_28_4: I checked your progress today. You're almost done, so hang in there.
HHACZST_29_1: KU-Baski is lying on the ground. It seems to be mimicking humans by resting.
HHACZST_3_1: Don't leave the Black Shores with such a weight in your heart.
HHACZST_3_2: What I meant to tell you is that you've done an outstanding job.
HHACZST_3_3: You've protected many from harm and contributed significantly to the Black Shores' understanding of the Lament's origin.
HHACZST_3_4: Please have faith that the things you did have left a positive impact, no matter how intractable at first. The momentum of change you've started will tilt the track of history for the better and leave a mark on your life.
HHACZST_3_5: These changes will endure, even if you leave the Black Shores.
HHACZST_3_7: Did you notice? The seed you brought from your hometown has fully bloomed now.
HHACZST_30_1: Check this out, Gedao! Pastries from Xiehua Village! Aalto and Encore brought it back from Jinzhou for us.
HHACZST_30_2: I've been handling Jinzhou-related affairs, but I've never actually been there myself. All I know is data, just data.
HHACZST_30_3: Remember Xiehua Village? I once sent an alert to the Wutherological Climate Studies Center at Huaxu Academy, warning them about a potential Waveworn in that area.
HHACZST_30_4: I never expected to get a gift from that village. It feels like the locals are acknowledging my work.
HHACZST_30_5: Speaking of which, I wonder how things are in Jinzhou now...
HHACZST_30_6: Still under observation, but we don't have time to dwell on it. With Tethys affected by corrupted data, we've got a ton of data to process.
HHACZST_31_1: Mmm, the pastries are so good! Want some?
HHACZST_31_2: Thanks, but I'm not in the mood. My task is due tomorrow. Gotta burn the midnight oil. Maybe you should just eat me so I'll never have to work again.
HHACZST_31_3: Nice joke. But seriously, you should eat something. It's easier to work on a full stomach, don't you think?
HHACZST_31_4: Next time we're on vacation, we should go to Jinzhou and try the local dishes!
HHACZST_32_1: Hope I can see it sprout one day...
HHACZST_32_3: Uh, are you asking me? I-I'm just watching the seed I planted... Sorry, am I bothering you?
HHACZST_32_4: Not at all. I'm just wandering around.
HHACZST_32_6: I see. Do you enjoy these flowers too?
HHACZST_32_7: Every plant here carries the experiences of its owner. Some are pleasant, some regretful. They're like living memories of our past.
HHACZST_32_8: Did you plant anything here? If so, I wonder what stories it might tell.
HHACZST_32_9: I come here often, praying for my platycodon seed to bloom someday.
HHACZST_32_10: It's platycodon, a flower from my hometown. When I planted it here, I didn't realize it would be the last of its kind.
HHACZST_32_12: It was destroyed in the Lament. This seed is all that's left now, the only proof of its existence.
HHACZST_32_13: Do you think... the Lament can truly erase everything?
HHACZST_32_14: I returned to the ruins of my hometown as an agent, hoping to collect leftover Reverberations, thinking I might uncover the truth of the disaster or find traces of the past.
HHACZST_32_15: But I was wrong. Everything I knew is gone, existing only in my memories.
HHACZST_32_16: However, what if those memories fade with time? What if I forget them, and start to believe they never existed at all...
HHACZST_32_17: No... As long as I have this flower, I'll never forget them.
HHACZST_34_1: Adrian, are you planning to upgrade KU-Miki?
HHACZST_34_2: Yeah, its system's been acting up since the last update. I think the new component isn't compatible, so I need to make some adjustments.
HHACZST_34_3: But you can't just change things like that. The last time you upgraded KU-Miki, it lost a whole year of memories!
HHACZST_34_4: That was a temporary side effect—things like discomfort, memory loss, or cognitive issues can happen sometimes. Once I'm done, everything will be fine.
HHACZST_34_5: But you're interfering with its natural growth. It has its own way of adapting.
HHACZST_34_6: We should guide these little ones based on their development, not just force changes on them.
HHACZST_34_7: It's more efficient if we handle the adjustments ourselves to improve their programming.
HHACZST_34_8: Don't you think your approach is a bit too harsh? They hide from you every time they see you.
HHACZST_34_9: It's okay. I've got a remote controller to track them down.
HHACZST_34_10: I... I just can't reason with you!
HHACZST_4_2: "Did you know? If one chooses to plunge into the torrent of data, they choose to be disintegrated as bits of digits, becoming a dot in a boundless atlas of stars..."
HHACZST_4_3: "The discrete computational representation of me shall evolve and iterate with the Stellar Matrices of the billions of stars, until 'I' am present everywhere and yet nowhere to be found."
HHACZST_4_4: "After the end of the shifts, conversions, and merges, the odds for the fragments of 'me' to reintegrate into a new me, even for the split of femtosecond, are almost zero."
HHACZST_4_5: "Yet, should that infinitesimal chance arise, I would open my eyes as if newly born, seeing everything one last time before dissolving again into the ceaseless flow of stars."
HHACZST_4_6: "This journey of mine has no way back, but fear not, my love—whether it's in a distant afterlife or across the light years..."
HHACZST_5_1: Confirm with the Eye of Asteria if the Reverberation samples from the New Federation have been compiled.
HHACZST_5_2: The Stellar Navigator team is ready. Prepare to simulate Lament-stricken areas on the Sand Table.
HHACZST_5_3: Reverberation data received. Searching for logic units within Tethys for Sand Table simulation.

HHACZST_6_2: Close monitoring of nearby Matriced is required. Report the Matrices closest to Hearth χ3.

HHACZST_6_4: Request access to the mechanical arm for capturing and pulling Hearth χ3.

HHACZST_7_4: The Tethys System once dedicated its entire computational capacity to simulating the civilization development within Stellar Matrices.
HHACZST_7_5: It generated numerous potential futures based on various decisions to predict the impact of critical choices on the trajectory of a civilization.
HHACZST_7_6: Nonetheless, these simulated futures within the Stellar Matrices were either doomed to collapse or became breeding grounds for errors.
HHACZST_7_7: What if we introduce a new variable?
HHACZST_7_8: A new variable brings the potential for an unknown future.
HHACZST_7_9: It could be a force of change, or simply nothing.
HHACZST_7_10: You alone hold the answer, don't you? Hee hee hee...
HHACZST_7_12: This dream continues... Good night... Hmm... Eh...
HHACZST_7_14: Ah... I feel dizzy. What is this? A nightmare? Wait, who are you? When did you...
HHACZST_7_15: Oh, I remember you! You're the Bloom Bearer who guided us through the crisis!
HHACZST_7_16: Nice to meet you. I'm Villeneuve. Do you need any help?
HHACZST_8_2: Me? I'm picking a Stellar Matrix for the new recruits' training session, as the basis of projection.
HHACZST_8_4: Yes, it's what we do with the Infinite Reality Sandbox here at the Black Shores. It projects data from the Stellar Matrix into reality.
HHACZST_8_5: Using digital samples of the Tacet Discords, the Tethys System can analyze and predict their possible evolutionary models.
HHACZST_8_6: But some of the models that evolved from errors are just too out-there to show.
HHACZST_8_7: Can't have anything too hideous or messed up... It's challenging to choose a decent one...
HHACZST_9_1: Hello, what brought you here? Did something happen to the biological tanks?
HHACZST_9_3: You don't know that? Oh, you must be the new Bloom Bearer! I'm Chengshi, the plant breeder here at the Black Shores.
HHACZST_9_4: In those tanks, we're cultivating a special plant called "Mambo Grass." It's closely connected to the Tethys' Space Anchors.
HHACZST_9_5: You've probably seen the four giant Anchors that help neutralize the Tacetite's frequencies.
HHACZST_9_6: If something goes wrong with the Anchors, the frequencies can become unstable.
HHACZST_9_7: That's where the Mambo Grass comes in. It's super sensitive to even the slightest changes in frequencies and reacts by moving its leaves, almost like it's dancing.
HHACZST_9_8: The tanks are set up to detect these movements and send alerts to the nearest engineers and KU-Roros.
HHACZST_9_9: What if there are noises nearby...
HHACZST_9_10: Don't worry. The tanks filter out any random disturbances, so the Mambo Grass won't react to just any noise.
HHACZST_9_11: Wait, is that why you're lowering your voice?
HHACZST_9_12: No need for that! You can speak at a normal volume.

ItemInfo_80000039_BgDescription: A thick soup made with fish and dried Sea Flytraps simmered in milk. People in the coastal areas love this hearty and rich dish. With the cold wind blowing in from the sea, what dish could beat a bowl of hot soup?
ItemInfo_80000040_BgDescription: A cake filled with honeysuckle paste, offering a subtle floral aroma and a distinctly sweet taste.
ItemInfo_80001039_BgDescription:
A thick soup beloved by the Shorekeeper made with nothing fancy but the freshly caught seafood commonly found in coastal households. The secret is to add in heavy milk and reduce the soup slowly.
It's little known that the soup was a result of the Shorekeeper's effort to recreate a soup that used to bring her so much comfort. She tried to replicate it to the best of her recollection, but through numerous attempts, she ended up with a recipe with her personal touch. The sweetness of the seafood blends well with a freshly toasted slice of bread. Its warmth soothes fatigue and soul... Maybe that's what that person meant by a "simple but certain" happiness.
ItemInfo_80001040_BgDescription:
Snacks kept by Youhu in her ice cauldron, always cool to the touch. 
It’s difficult for Youhu to find food and accommodations while she travels around Solaris hunting for antiquities. These tasty cakes are what keep her from starving at times like these.
Youhu likes to put fruits in the cauldron too. As a result, the moist crusts of the cakes always gives off the faint fragrance of the seasonal fruits.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_33: Thanks, but guns aren't my thing.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_34: It's easy to use. You want to see the upgraded version? Ta-da! Magnum Fireworks Pistol!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_35: Not your style? I have more where that came from... Ta-da! Celebratory Fireworks Bomb. Wait, that's meant for our dinner. Oops, sorry, Pero grabbed the wrong one. Though, at a pinch, it might prove useful…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_36: Alright, try this instead... Ta-da! Captain's Parley Saber!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_37: Use it to protect yourself. Our troupe will bring you to our base soon and tell you the truth we've uncovered. I'll join you once I find Brant.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_38: I want to see the truth for myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_39: I can hold my own in a fight.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_40: I can't let a child do this alone.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_42: No, that's not what I meant. Just... this is going to be risky.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_43: Don't worry. I know this place inside out. For a first-timer, though, it might be a bit much.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_44: Alright, fine. It's better you see it for yourself. I'll be glad you don't have to fend for yourself alone.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_45: See that lighthouse? It's the only safe place in the mist. We'll head there. Brant might have taken shelter there, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_46: Once we find him, we'll find the truth you're after.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_23: Otherwise... the dragon will devour every last trace of their frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_24: The mist is thinning. That stranded ship ahead looks like...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_12: It's said that when the first Dark Tide ravaged Rinascita, the first Primus followed the currents on a rickety boat and met the Sentinel in person. That's where the Pilgrim's Sail tradition came from.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_7: No Reverberations on the ship, nor in the mist...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_8: The people must have escaped, but with the mist this thick, we need to stay on guard.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_10: This way. Head to the lighthouse.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_11: I hear the sounds of fighting. Watch out. Tacet Discords are gathering.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_48: No time for doubt. Lives are at stake.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_49: I've got a score to settle with that dragon anyway.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_50: Please, save them... I hope it's not too late.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_51: Don't worry. There's more to our troupe than you think.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_52: This Wingray can fly us up the mountain.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_53: You two go first. You'll find I'm very convenient to bring along.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_54: Alright then... All hands, prepare to ascend!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_11: It's time to pay for what you've done, Dragon of Dirge.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_11: Is it because of your condition?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_12: Your condition is definitely getting worse.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_13: Exercising more might help with that.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_14: That's not the point! The real deal is, I found something crazy in its frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_15: You said you somehow experienced empathy with a Tacet Discord back in Jinzhou, right? How about trying that again with this guy?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_16: Trust me! This could be our big break!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_32: When we finally reached this forsaken isle, the destination of our pilgrimage, we fought the Tacet Discords to claim our territory and scavenged what we could from the ship's wreckage. From that, we built all this...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_35: Though the night may be long, the dawn always follows! That, my friend, is what we should set our sights on.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_15: Though, to be honest, life here ain't too different from a pirate's, except we're not hunting for treasure but for smiles and cheers from our punters!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_16: Yeah. I borrowed the reel for my fishing rod.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_17: We scavenge all sorts of stuff from the beach and fix them up as needed. Nothing goes to waste! Don't be fooled by appearances, this stuff can be pretty versatile!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_25: Then again... neither of them ever actually wins, do they? Betting might be a waste... Eh, who cares? It's the fun that matters!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_16: The Order may scoff at such stories, but they're real, human stories—full of ambition, dignity, and everything that makes us human.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_17: Traveling with the troupe, I've learned to see the beauty in the small things, and I've met people facing similar and unique life struggles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_18: Only those who walk in the fields can really see how the crops grow. It's the same with music. You can't truly know it until you've listened.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_19: That's why I'm always chatting with the crew, gathering ideas for my ballads and shanties—the true rhyme of our time.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_20: The Cloudcaster... Oh, I use its base as a desk. Our first mate lent it to me so I could write more comfortably.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_21: Here it is. Careful, it's heavy.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_40: One day, our voices will echo across every land, our words will reach every corner of the world, and by then, even the Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea will know our names.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_45: That's the spirit, boy! Even if I can't earn myself a proper title, I'll become Rinascita's most enigmatic legend. When I'm gone, I'll leave behind a coffin that sings, or maybe turn into a lark, singing every day and night...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_20: If you're ready, let's begin! Everyone, a big round of applause to welcome the Rover and Ms. Carlotta on stage!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_14: You mean the essential item for the Carnevale performance?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_15: Don't worry. I've taken care of everything.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_16: Oh, so it's handled then? I can't wait to see it!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_19: I have a small gift for you. Let's head back to Ragunna together, shall we?

[About]
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act III "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Traces of Tides ends.
POI_ZJGZ_2_2: This one seems to be depicting the "Night Reveries" of Egla Town.
POI_ZJGZ_2_3: At night, the villagers lock themselves away, while the knight Tacet Discord rises, sword in hand, under the pale moonlight.
POI_ZJGZ_3_1: A sparkling eye... with a sword at its center?
POI_ZJGZ_3_2: The sword must mean something important to Painter.
POI_ZJGZ_3_3: And the sparkling eye might be a symbol of hope, or admiration.
POI_ZJGZ_4_1: A knight's mask and swords on one side, a black mask and brushes on the other.
POI_ZJGZ_4_2: The knight is the only hero in the story, and the black mask likely stands for the side characters.
POI_ZJGZ_4_3: I'd bet three Pizza Classica that the black mask symbolizes the evil giant's underling.
POI_ZJGZ_5_1: A knight's mask, with crossing brush and sword.
POI_ZJGZ_5_2: It seems to mean a face-off. The knight has to defeat the underling before the final battle with the giant.
POI_ZJGZ_6_1: A crying black mask, yearning for the brush it holds to turn into a sharp sword.
POI_ZJGZ_6_2: Chalulu is trying to wipe the tears from that mask.
POI_ZJGZ_6_3: That brush is fashioned to look like a sword. Very interesting.
POI_ZJGZ_6_4: That's all the graffiti Chalulu wanted you to see. Let's meet at the usual place, {PlayerName}.
POI_ZJGZ_7_1: What kind of role do you imagine Painter plays in the "Night Reveries"?
POI_ZJGZ_7_2: A villain who clashes with the knight.
POI_ZJGZ_7_5: Glad we agree on that. Painter here is the classic villain in this story.
POI_ZJGZ_7_6: Turns out the Cuddle Wuddle that plays the giant's underling is Painter himself...
POI_ZJGZ_7_8: Well… I was lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the "Night Reveries."
POI_ZJGZ_7_9: A valiant knight, an evil giant, and a crazed, cunning underling. The Echoes played their part so vividly. It all felt real.
POI_ZJGZ_7_10: Eventually, as the first light of dawn broke, the knight felled the giant and his cursed underling. The Echoes then escorted the knight out of the town in cheers.
POI_ZJGZ_7_11: But in a shadowed corner, the "felled" underling slowly rose, fumbling to remove his simple costume. Beneath it was no crazed minion—just a large, lonely Cuddle Wuddle.
POI_ZJGZ_7_13: Through tireless practice, day in and day out, Painter mastered the role of the villain, so convincingly that even the Mad Knight was fooled, believing he faced the true underling.
POI_ZJGZ_7_14: However, flowers, applause, and cheers... are never meant for those who play the villains.
POI_ZJGZ_7_15: "If I could be the knight, the hero, would they cheer for me, too?"
POI_ZJGZ_7_16: Troubled by these thoughts, the Cuddle Wuddle picked up a brush and painted his feelings.
POI_ZJGZ_7_17: The desire to play the knight and become the hero is but a reflection of something deeper. So, tell me, {PlayerName}, what do you think the Cuddle Wuddle truly wants?
POI_ZJGZ_7_19: And maybe a heartfelt "Your performance was brilliant."
POI_ZJGZ_7_20: {PlayerName}, would you help me find our dear Painter?
POI_ZJGZ_7_21: We'll find him and shower him with compliments.
POI_ZJGZ_8_3: (Chalulu seems to have explained your intentions, and the Cuddle Wuddle waves its hands bashfully.)
POI_ZJGZ_8_4: "A villain is never a shadow on stage; it's the spotlight cast upon the hero." Your performance as the villain was brilliant, dear Painter.
POI_ZJGZ_8_5: You were fantastic in your role!
POI_ZJGZ_8_6: I'd be honored to be your audience.
POI_ZJGZ_8_8: Painter flushes, then rummages through a tear in his body, looking for something.
POI_ZJGZ_8_9: Suddenly, he pauses, as if he has found what he sought. He clenches the item tightly in his palm, carefully extending it toward you—
POI_ZJGZ_8_10: In his hand lies a flattened piece of candy, possibly a Carnevale giveaway. He tries, awkwardly, to speak like a human—

Event_AYKXBRZM_11_6: These dreams... I no longer wish to have them, to remember anything.
Event_AYKXBRZM_11_7: But I do remember things about you...
Event_AYKXBRZM_12_1: You're the only one who can restore everything to its rightful place. That's what he said to me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_12_2: Farewell, Dreamwalker. May your thoughts remain unclouded.
Event_AYKXBRZM_13_1: What is this? I've never seen this in the Somnoire before.
Event_AYKXBRZM_13_2: I should look around for more information.
Event_AYKXBRZM_14_1: (This is... a delivery checklist. The name signed here is "Fulei.")
Event_AYKXBRZM_14_2: (The rest is smudged. Someone must have lost it here.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_15_1: (Some kind of fragment lodged between those rocks. Something from a delivery crate?)
Event_AYKXBRZM_15_2: (This is probably where Fulei lost the package, but where is it now...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_16_1: (Is that... Lumi? The Tacet Discords are after her!)
Event_AYKXBRZM_17_4: Make sure she gets back safely... help with the express order...
Event_AYKXBRZM_17_6: Organize a welcome party for the new recruits...
Event_AYKXBRZM_17_8: Work finished... Best get movin'. Too many tasks, too little time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_20_2: The paper's all smudged, can't read a thing...
Event_AYKXBRZM_20_3: This fragment is from the delivery container... Ugh, where's the package? What if it's been damaged...
Event_AYKXBRZM_20_4: Where could it be? Hopefully, I'll find a clue ahead.
Event_AYKXBRZM_21_2: Ah! Where did those Tacet Discords come from?
Event_AYKXBRZM_21_3: Can't waste my time with them...
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_1: Phew... made it out at last. But why did those monsters stop chasing me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_2: Ugh, I keep getting sidetracked. Focus, Lumi! Think about what you're gonna do next.
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_4: Second, make sure Tangtang gets back safely and help with the express order...
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_5: Third, organize a welcome party for the new recruits... get my own work finished...
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_6: Best get movin'. Too many tasks, too little time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_22_7: I'm their leader. Got to act the part. They're counting on me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_23_1: This must be where Tangtang crashed... I need to find her first, Fulei's package can wait.
Event_AYKXBRZM_23_2: Why are there Tacet Discords here? Where is Tangtang? Is she...
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_1: You're here, Lumi! I've been looking for you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_2: Looking for me? I should be the one saying that. I heard you had an accident...
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_4: I was worried you might run into a Tacet Discord, so I came looking for you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_5: Thanks, I'm fine. Let me help you with the delivery.
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_6: It's okay. The address is around here somewhere. It won't take long.
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_7: But you're hurt. You relax and let me handle it, alright?
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_8: I can manage, really. You have your own tasks to do. I can even help you later when I'm done!
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_9: It's my job to look out for you... That's what a team leader should do.
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_10: I know, and you've been doing great. I just want to lighten the load.
Event_AYKXBRZM_24_12: Don't worry! I'll catch up with you after I finish this order!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_1: What do you want to do?
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_2: Somnoire has tens of millions of gateways that lead to numerous realms... but it's still too small compared to Solaris.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_3: I need more space to store these precious dreams and memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_4: That's why you're expanding the Somnoire to break into reality itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_5: Are you planning to expand Somnoire to encompass all of Solaris?
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_6: Those gateways that appeared by the Whining Aix's Mire... It's all because of you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_7: Yes, those places will become part of Somnoire, to merge with the other dreams.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_8: Just think of it! They will be forever saved and remembered!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_9: Not every dream holds the key to saving the world... Most are personal, trivial, even selfish.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_10: But still, they should not be erased.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_12: They live on in people's memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_13: People may eventually forget them, but Somnoire won't!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_14: You saw that girl and how deeply she felt about her dream. It holds significance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_15: That doesn't justify what you're doing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_17: Tell me, have you ever erased another's dreams? Their memories?
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_18: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_19: For millennia, I've been doing this tirelessly.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_20: Those dreams and I are no different in nature, yet I've done nothing but extinguish them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_21: I don't expect you to understand me. We're not in the same position.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_22: Just know that even the great Rover cannot stop me now!
Event_AYKXBRZM_46_1: A long, long time ago, there was a brave warrior in the Magical Kingdom. Her name was Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_46_2: One day, she met her good friend, Cloudy.
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_1: The Big Bad Demon sent its minions to attack the Magical Kingdom.
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_2: Everyone hid at home, and the stage was empty and quiet.
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_4: But then, Warrior Encore stood up and said she would fight the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_5: To bring the crowd back, Cloudy the great performer also joined Encore's team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_48_1: But not everyone in the Magical Kingdom was very nice...
Event_AYKXBRZM_48_2: One day, Warrior Encore met Cosmos.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_1: I used to live in the Magical Kingdom, but I went on a big adventure far away.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_2: When I came back, no one knew me, and they wouldn't play with me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_3: If you're not Cosmos's friend, I'll just go join the Big Bad Demon and cause trouble!
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_4: But I want to be your friend.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_6: Really? That's so nice of you! Sob, sob...
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_1: Warrior Encore and her friends marched to find the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_2: The sly Demon sent its monster squad to try to stop them!
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_3: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventurer Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_4: In the end, Encore's super team took care of the monsters! But the Woolies got hurt...
Event_AYKXBRZM_51_1: To help them feel better, Warrior Encore climbed all the hills and swimmed all the rivers.
Event_AYKXBRZM_51_2: She walked a long way and finally found the magic Golden Sprout!
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_1: The Big Bad Demon sent more monsters to stop Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_2: But every one of them was defeated by her super team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_3: Their amazing feats made lots of people in the Magical Kingdom excited.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_4: More and more people wanted to join Encore's team.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_5: After careful picking by Warrior Encore, they chose the Candlestick Fairy, who breathes fire.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_6: Encore also picked Gray Ear the Rabbit, who can slice bread into 100 pieces, and the Stool Spirit, who likes to zoom around on four legs.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_7: Then came Miss Clover, Uncle Broom, and Grandpa Coal...
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_8: With more friends joining, Encore's team got bigger and stronger, becoming the super-duper awesome team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_4: On the big battle day, Adventurer Cosmos led the super-duper awesome team to dodge traps and face the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_6: Miss Clover blew wind, Grandpa Coal and the Candlestick Fairy made fire.
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_7: Gray Ear the Rabbit held Uncle Broom and rode the Stool Spirit to charge at the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_1: Hmm... Huh... You beat me today, but there'll always be more demons in this kingdom...
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_2: Someone's gotta be the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_3: But why did you have to pick this path?
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_4: Before I was big and bad, nobody paid any attention to me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_6: But you could be a hero like me!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_8: I don't have your bravery. More importantly, I don't have any friends...
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_10: Being a hero isn't just about fighting or going on adventures.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_11: Uncle Broom keeps the castle spotless. Candlestick Fairy keeps things bright.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_12: They don't need to be on my team to be heroic warriors. They already are.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_13: Just do your best at everything and have fun! That's how heroes do lots of cool stuff!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_14: Don't worry. You can do it too!
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_1: Okay, the Magical Kingdom is now called the Warriors' Kingdom!
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_4: Now it's time for a new adventure.
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_5: Hooray! I'll tell a new story next time!
Event_AYKXBRZM_56_1: Didn't I just leave the Somnoire... Why am I still here?
Event_AYKXBRZM_56_2: Encore's not here. Did she leave already? Let me see if I can find another gateway.
Event_AYKXBRZM_57_1: The Gatekeeper? Who's the one beside him?
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_1: Excuse me, sir. Is this all real? Are you the god of this realm?
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_3: I don't know... I was supposed to be at my Grandma's funeral.
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_4: I was watching over her and lost track of time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_5: The next moment, I was here... Maybe I fell asleep?
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_1: That happened in the past... I was looking at their Illusias.
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_2: The Gatekeeper showed this to me... What is he trying to tell me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_3: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Event_AYKXBRZM_60_1: It's about to collapse... Better leave now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_1: It has been some time, hasn't it {PlayerName}?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_2: So, it was you who did this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_3: Why are you showing me this?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_4: I already told you the first time we met: Somnoire is unstable.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_5: You didn't say it's because of you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_6: It isn't. It's due to Somnoire's innate design.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_7: Tell me, what do you think Somnoire was created for?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_10: It appears so, but the answer is something more fundamental.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_12: Such a large and complex creation is necessary to save a world torn apart by the Lament.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_13: The dreams it stores contain countless possibilities...
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_14: Millions upon millions of dreams converge in Somnoire... Perhaps within one lies the key to vanquishing the Lament.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_15: It may not be the most efficient or practical strategy, but even as a mere spark of hope... I believe it's worth pursuing with all the power I have.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_17: They're closely connected to you... But that's not important right now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_18: One day, you'll find out who they are.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_19: Compared to you, who is of immense significance to them, I am just a tool they created to get rid of useless data.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_21: Why are you getting rid of it?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_22: Every day, people dream, but Somnoire's capacity is finite.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_23: Dreams that don't aid in defeating the Lament are deemed worthless.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_24: My duty is to erase them, like a heartless executioner.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_25: By this reasoning, the two dreams you just witnessed should also be erased—they offer no solution to save our world.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_26: What do you think? Are they useless?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_27: They mean a lot to the ones who dreamed them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_28: Regardless, every dream has its own meaning.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_29: Indeed... those dreams are truly precious.
Event_AYKXBRZM_62_1: This realm is about to collapse...
Event_AYKXBRZM_62_2: I need to wrap this up quickly and get out of here.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_2: For a second there, I thought you were actively ignoring these calls and would just walk away.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_3: Gotta look out for "shady robot dealers," they always say.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_4: Oh, the word "shady" is a rather harsh way of putting it. I thought we were friends! Did KU-Money leave you with a bad impression?
Side_HHATSSJ_1_5: As business people, we're just helping the Black Shores make a profit with reasonable methods. As for the few little tricks before sealing the deal…
Side_HHATSSJ_1_6: Well, I only use them when I'm at a disadvantage, to reclaim what's rightfully ours. Speaking of deals, hehe, I happen to have one just for you.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_10: No need. This deal doesn't require Shell Credits. I'd like you to help me find something. Some kind of cartridge.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_11: Ever heard of The Tenth Art? I stumbled across info about it in a ruins while searching for data on past civilizations during an expedition.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_12: It seems to have been a very popular term back in the day. After returning to the Black Shores, I recovered what was left of the data and projected it onto a display.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_13: And then... the pixels began to bounce around, and as I recovered more data, the images on the screen kept changing.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_14: From simple flickering pixels, to being a "cowboy" roaming the western plains, and then to someone like a Lollo Logistics courier rushing to various locations after a disaster.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_15: I never imagined a tiny cartridge could pack in so many sounds, scenes, fabled stories, and projected hopes. If we're to search for civilizations of the past…
Side_HHATSSJ_1_16: I believe these are also part of their many traces, reflecting the scenes of their era, and their thoughts...
Side_HHATSSJ_1_17: Even in a time so distant, we can still explore the end of that era through these cartridges.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_18: However, after the last earthquake hit the Black Shores, the cartridges I collected are now scattered everywhere.
Side_HHATSSJ_1_19: So if you manage to find any cartridges, {PlayerName}, be sure to return them to me. I'll give you a fair reward for them.
Side_HHATSSJ_2_1: It's you, {PlayerName}. Have you collected any "KU-Cass Cartridges" lately?

Main_Linaxita_2_2_100_1: I think we've been spotted... Or maybe it's just paranoia.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_100_2: Either way, we must stay on our toes.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_101_1: Steady. The alarm's moments from triggering.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_102_1: Hurry, take cover! We're almost exposed!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_103_1: Seems we're in the clear now.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_104_1: The Vitreum Dancers shouldn't be patrolling here. Someone's heightened vault security. I wonder who.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_105_1: The good news is they don't seem aggressive.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_105_2: But they could still trigger the alarm. Better stay away.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_106_1: Even the surveillance cameras have increased. This bodes ill.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_107_1: Quite a few cameras here... Could the prisms be of any help?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_108_2: I'll use them to pass through.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_110_1: I'm in the control room, just a moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_110_2: Switching view to your side now.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_111_1: Done... The door before you should be open.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_111_2: Beyond the door you should find the other control room. Beware of the patrolling Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_112_1: {PlayerName}, there should be a monitor you can operate.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_112_2: Let me know once you find it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_113_2: Give me a moment. I'll upgrade your access so you have control of the vault's systems.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_113_3: Looks like some Echoes are approaching. Stay alert.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_114_3: I need to cross the hall from above. People might spot me if I make too much noise.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_114_4: So could you maneuver these chandeliers to form a pathway for me?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_120_1: The door should be open, {PlayerName}, and we will soon meet—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_121_1: {PlayerName}? Looks like the signal has been jammed…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_121_2: Thank the Sentinel, it didn't set off the central alarm. I should still be under the radar.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_123_1: The path is blocked… Wall-dashing seems to be the only option.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_124_1: Is that a screen?... Perhaps I can use Grapple to pull it over.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_125_1: These scatter prisms might come in handy.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_129_2: The comms are cut off. She must be in trouble.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_130_1: The blockdown is lifted. I need to keep moving.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_131_1: Need to get rid of them fast.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_3: I notice surprise in your eyes. Let me guess…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_4: "That's quite some skill for a lady of nobility."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_5: In fact, beyond being the second daughter of the Montelli family, I have a even more... significant title.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_7: Be it a traitor within the family or a threat from outside, I locate, observe, and address these risks in secret and with tact.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_8: Say, the ones hiding in the tuning room.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_9: The room is that way. Time to see what kind of mischief they are up to…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_139_1: The future of Rinascita... rests with all of us.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_139_2: And the Montellis will make sure everyone has a equal share of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_139_5: Ragunna will enter a new era united.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_139_6: United under the promise of our Terminals.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_1: Ah, my dear friend, we meet again!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_4: Haha, indeed, fate has its way of bringing people together.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_5: Ah, of course not. If my pocket was too full, a bank would suffice.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_6: I'm here for a bit of inspiration, that's all.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_8: Why not? Given that the Carnevale performances always revolve around Order lore, perhaps… a touch of secular themes might be refreshing?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_9: Maybe, a tale of a shrewd moneylender, undone by a trite legal technicality?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_12: True, but that's why where some inspiration could be useful.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_13: Is it really why you are here?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_14: Well, I suppose I can't hide it from you. I'm here for the auction, hoping to acquire some rare, ancient manuscripts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_15: Oh, speaking of scripts! Did you have the chance to read mine? The one with the maiden? Please, I'd love to hear your thoughts.…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_16: The martyrdom of the maiden is quite moving.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_17: There's something more behind the tale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_19: It's the climax of the play. Ha, I'm glad you enjoyed it!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_20: Indeed? You have a discerning eye. My research did unearth some… intriguing rumors, but they did't find their way into the script.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_21: You see, those stories might be too much for the Carnevale crowd.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_22: Ah... I see. So my script wasn't quite up to par.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_23: Anyway, I appreciate your thoughts... Let's hope I outdo myself with the next one.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_24: Until the Carnevale, traveler from afar.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_1: Lady Carlotta, we have a situation. The guardian Echoes deployed outside the main entrance... have gone rogue for unknown reasons.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_2: We've initiated Security Protocol Four, evacuating civilians and non-combat staff. Our security teams nearby are trying to suppress the Echoes. But…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_3: We are short-handed. Even the bank staff have been whisked away to the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_4: Y-yes, ma'am. If possible, could you authorize access to the vault's Echo Collection…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_5: That won't be necessary. I'll address this personally.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_7: Don't worry. I've got her back. I'm with the bank's security team, and I've handled my fair share of these emergencies.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_9: I'm also up for some action.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_10: Thank you both… Now, let the show begin.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_94_1: Cameras here. Good thing I came prepared. Recall the "jewelry" I asked for?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_94_2: In family parlance, it's this handy little tool that generates crystals to cover these cameras and blind them for a while.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_95_1: Done, but it won't last long. I have to keep moving.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_96_2: Luckily, they can be trapped with the crystals as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_97_2: But I must be careful, the security level ahead will increase.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_1: So, if "jewelry set" means this gadget... what about "perfume"?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_2: Just another weapon… For my family, many things must be kept discreet.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_3: And it's not always verbal. Sometimes a glance or a gesture can speak volumes, which, of course, demands a deep mutual understanding.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_99_1: I'm seeing some scatter prisms here. Ornaments, that's what they were designed to be.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_99_2: But they can also amplify my Resonance power… Might be useful at some point.

Character_Encore_38_1: Check this one out, Cosmos. It's all golden and shiny, just like Rover's eyes!
Character_Encore_39_1: You wanna pick this one, Cloudy? True... This one does kinda lighten up the mood, doesn't it?
POI_LGNJR_1_1: Greetings, {PlayerName}. What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
POI_LGNJR_1_3: It feels like it's been so long since we last crossed paths at the Carnevale.
POI_LGNJR_1_4: Though belated, congratulations on receiving the Laurel. Your performance that day... was truly unforgettable.
POI_LGNJR_1_7: Guess I'm rather talented at this!
POI_LGNJR_1_8: Thanks to your splendid performance, the Carnevale, which hadn't been held for a decade, came to a perfect conclusion. Ragunna is now filled with joy and laughter.
POI_LGNJR_1_9: You played yourself? Hehe, you truly are a brave and sincere soul.
POI_LGNJR_1_10: Perhaps it is this very honesty that allowed you to claim the Laurel and set the stage alight.
POI_LGNJR_1_11: Thanks to your splendid performance, the Carnevale, which hadn't been held for a decade, came to a perfect conclusion. Ragunna is now filled with joy and laughter.
POI_LGNJR_1_12: Oh! I didn't expect you to take that compliment so well...
POI_LGNJR_1_13: But I suppose that is why you shone as the brightest star at the Carnevale.
POI_LGNJR_1_14: Thanks to your splendid performance, the Carnevale, which hadn't been held for a decade, came to a perfect conclusion. Ragunna is now filled with joy and laughter.
POI_LGNJR_1_15: With such joyous songs echoing throughout the city... Surely even the Sentinel can hear them.
POI_LGNJR_1_16: Speaking of the Carnevale's conclusion, as the Laureate, what do you plan to do now?
POI_LGNJR_1_17: I'm taking a tour around Ragunna.
POI_LGNJR_1_18: I'm looking for traces of the Sentinel.
POI_LGNJR_1_20: That sounds lovely. By the way, I'm on vacation and planning to visit some sacred sites myself.
POI_LGNJR_1_21: If you're interested, would you like to join me?
POI_LGNJR_1_22: Seeking traces of the Sentinel... I see.
POI_LGNJR_1_23: I'm actually on vacation and plan to visit some sacred sites myself.
POI_LGNJR_1_24: Some of them are rich with legends about the Sentinel. If you're interested, would you like to join me?
POI_LGNJR_1_25: Really? Planning to confront the powerful Tacet Discords in Ragunna?
POI_LGNJR_1_26: In that case, you might find some formidable ones lurking in certain remote, forgotten ruins.
POI_LGNJR_1_27: By the way, I'm on vacation and plan to visit some sacred sites myself.
POI_LGNJR_1_28: If you're interested in the ruins and ancient buildings of Ragunna, I'd be glad to show you around. Would you like to join me?
POI_LGNJR_1_29: Wonderful! I'd love a free tour guide!
POI_LGNJR_1_30: Of course, I'll do my best to be a good guide.
POI_LGNJR_1_31: Well then, {Male=Signor;Female=Signorina} {PlayerName}, please look this way.
POI_LGNJR_1_32: Cross this bridge, and we'll arrive at Thessaleo Fells.
POI_LGNJR_1_33: There you'll see rolling highlands and coastal plains, along with grand architectural marvels built by the ancient nobility in partnership with the Order.
POI_LGNJR_10_2: Let's take down these Tacet Discords first, {PlayerName}.
POI_LGNJR_2_1: Look over there! Just ahead is the famed Thorncrown Rises, built by the old nobility.
POI_LGNJR_2_2: It was originally constructed to honor the oracle that guided people through storms, symbolizing the Ragunnesi's reverence for the sea.
POI_LGNJR_2_3: After many years, the old nobility, led by the Fisalia family, eventually left Thessaleo Fells.
POI_LGNJR_2_4: The great Thorncrown Rises, once a proud emblem of the Fisalia family, was then abandoned, much like their fading glory.
POI_LGNJR_2_5: To this day, it remains a testament to a bygone greatness.
POI_LGNJR_2_7: Weren't they the troublemakers in the Carnevale incident?
POI_LGNJR_2_8: Indeed, they were involved in the Carnevale incident, and there are still many unanswered questions... I wonder how they view the Sentinel?
POI_LGNJR_2_9: I remember Gilberto mentioning something about...
POI_LGNJR_2_10: No, that can't be right... Oh, I'm sorry for rambling. Please, forget I said anything.
POI_LGNJR_2_11: So, now that we're here, what do you think of Thessaleo Fells?
POI_LGNJR_2_15: I'm glad you enjoy it here.
POI_LGNJR_2_16: By the way, I've noticed you've been staring at something for a while...
POI_LGNJR_2_17: If you wish to explore further, be wary of unexpected dangers. It's best to be fully prepared.
POI_LGNJR_2_18: By the way, I've noticed you've been staring at something for a while...
POI_LGNJR_2_19: Huh? Visual effects? What do you mean?
POI_LGNJR_2_20: Turn around, and you'll see it.
POI_LGNJR_2_22: Oh my... Wh-what are those? Are they dangerous Tacet Discords that need purification? How did I not sense anything...
POI_LGNJR_2_24: C-calm down, Phoebe. Breathe. The greater the danger, the more we must hold on to the Sentinel's wisdom.
POI_LGNJR_2_26: I feel like I've seen them before...
POI_LGNJR_2_27: Oh? Really... I suppose the wisps don't appear hostile...
POI_LGNJR_2_28: {PlayerName}, do you know what these are?
POI_LGNJR_3_1: Perfect! I've saved the necessary data for further study. Thank you so much for your assistance.
POI_LGNJR_3_2: But why do unique phenomena from Penitent's End appear here in Thessaleo Fells?
POI_LGNJR_3_3: Wait, be careful {PlayerName}! Tacet Discords are approaching!
POI_LGNJR_4_1: {PlayerName}, are you alright? What are Tacet Discords doing here...
POI_LGNJR_4_2: Were they drawn by the wisps too? Usually, there shouldn't be so many around this area.
POI_LGNJR_4_3: I think I just saw a...
POI_LGNJR_4_6: I think I saw an Echo out there.
POI_LGNJR_4_7: Eh? Did you... Perhaps the fighting has taken a toll. Would you like to stop for a short break?
POI_LGNJR_4_8: We'll be heading east. Beyond Thessaleo Fells lies Averardo Vault.
POI_LGNJR_4_9: It's going to be a long journey, so please, do let me know if you feel like resting at any point.
POI_LGNJR_4_10: Wait, you saw an Echo? What was it like? Its color? And type? I'm curious!
POI_LGNJR_4_11: Ahem... My apologies. I got a little carried away.
POI_LGNJR_4_12: Well, let's keep going. We're heading east, and once we cross Thessaleo Fells, we'll reach Averardo Vault.
POI_LGNJR_4_13: It's going to be a long journey, so please, do let me know if you feel like resting at any point.
POI_LGNJR_5_1: Averardo Vault wasn't one of the Order's commissioned projects, but it never ceases to amaze me whenever I see it.
POI_LGNJR_5_2: If only the Montelli family could hold the Sentinel in the same regard as they do their riches…
POI_LGNJR_5_3: Look over there! Aren't they the same type of will-o'-the-wisps we encountered at the Thorncrown Rises?
POI_LGNJR_5_4: I never expected to see it again... What's really happening here?
POI_LGNJR_6_1: Watch out! Tacet Discords are approaching again! Wait...?
POI_LGNJR_6_2: They seem to be hunting something... Is that an Echo they're chasing?
POI_LGNJR_6_3: I've never seen an Echo like that before... I must help it!
POI_LGNJR_7_1: Oh dear... I'm so relieved... Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}!
POI_LGNJR_7_2: How frightened it looks... The Tacet Discords must have hurt it terribly.
POI_LGNJR_7_3: I... I want to help it.
POI_LGNJR_7_6: Encouraged by your support, Phoebe reaches out her hand toward the Echo.
POI_LGNJR_7_7: Hello, I mean no harm. I promise I won't hurt you.
POI_LGNJR_7_8: My name is Phoebe, and I'm an Acolyte of the Order. May I take a look at your injuries?
POI_LGNJR_7_9: The Echo watches Phoebe warily as she gets closer.
POI_LGNJR_8_1: Here we are! You can now see the outline of Oakheart Highcourt, nestled deep within the Fagaceae Peninsula.
POI_LGNJR_8_2: In ancient times, the ancestors of Rinascita discovered a sacred shrub growing in Oakheart Highcourt.
POI_LGNJR_8_3: It grew from the roots of a grand oak at the court's center, its fruits a rich russet, its flowers vibrant. The branches were said to be a medium for communing with the Sentinel.
POI_LGNJR_8_4: Legend has it that it was on that magnificent oak tree that the Sentinel inscribed the very first oracle.
POI_LGNJR_8_5: Since then, the fruit was regarded as a holy offering, used by the Order in rituals to commune with the Sentinel.
POI_LGNJR_8_6: The people of Ragunna crafted barrels from this oak to brew fine wines, offering this joy as a tribute to the Sentinel.
POI_LGNJR_8_7: In those days, the bond between the people and the Sentinel was much stronger.
POI_LGNJR_8_8: Oh, wait! I see it, {PlayerName}! More wisp traces...
POI_LGNJR_8_9: Let's photograph them first. From the looks of it, the Echo should be nearby.
POI_LGNJR_9_1: Thank you, {PlayerName}. These photos will greatly aid my research when I return.
POI_LGNJR_9_2: But unfortunately, we still haven't found that Echo.

HHACZST_35_1: Ku, this charging station… It won't explode, right?
HHACZST_35_2: Okay, deep breath. What happened that day was just an accident. It won't happen again today.
HHACZST_36_1: Corrupted data... Hic... I can't take it anymore...
HHACZST_36_2: Request... Request to clear the disk sector...
HHACZST_37_2: Wake up! It's my turn to charge now—
HHACZST_37_3: Ku... Just five more minutes... I worked overtime yesterday.
HHACZST_37_4: Adrian updated my hardware yesterday, and now I only have access to this charging station.
HHACZST_37_5: Alright, we can share. Just leave me some space.
HHACZST_37_6: W-why are you blushing!? Somebody come fix this guy! ADRIAN—
HHACZST_38_2: I'm not the ultra-long standby model... Arrgh, why did I take on this task in the first place?
