HHACZST_38_7: Each eager Echo eagerly echoes each other's echo, echoing endlessly—
HHACZST_38_8: The device will be locked after multiple failed attempts. Please try one last time.
HHACZST_39_1: I know you. You're no average Bloom Bearers, but the one who saved the Black Shores and the Shorekeeper.
HHACZST_39_2: Don't worry. I'll keep this between us. Ku.
HHACZST_40_1: Bro, is it just me or—
HHACZST_40_2: You mean how the Tacet Discords here seem to not care about anything, right?
HHACZST_40_3: Exactly! I was taking a break by the sea one day, sighed heavily, and then I heard a similar sound from behind—
HHACZST_40_4: I turned around and saw a Rocksteady Guardian sitting on the ground, holding its knees.
HHACZST_40_5: I was literally freaked out, so I pulled out my gun, only to hear it sigh again.
HHACZST_40_6: I was scared the first time I saw that, too.
HHACZST_40_7: It might be a side effect of the Anchor, or just part of the Black Shores' nature.
HHACZST_40_8: Anyway, it's best to stay on guard.
HHACZST_41_1: I'm going to miss the Black Shores while I'm away.
HHACZST_41_2: Come on, just enjoy your vacation.
HHACZST_41_3: And don't forget to grab all your stuff from your room in the Haven of Sprouts.
HHACZST_41_4: Oh no, I promised my daughter I'd bring her souvenirs from the New Federation! I told her I'm working there.
HHACZST_41_5: Wait, what? Don't look at me—I just got one bottle of maple syrup left.
HHACZST_41_6: Didn't you tell your family you were posted in Huanglong?
HHACZST_41_7: When I get back, I'll bring you some stuff from there. Let's call it a trade, what do you say?
HHACZST_42_1: Copy that. All ambassadors have evacuated from the Hall of Foreign Affairs.
HHACZST_43_1: Encore shared an old saying she learned in Jinzhou.
HHACZST_43_2: "Where there's a woolly, there's…" Wait, what was the rest again?
HHACZST_43_5: She told me this too, but honestly, I don't quite get it. Sounds pretty deep, though.
HHACZST_43_6: That's the ancient wisdom of Huanglong for you…
HHACZST_44_1: Ku ku ku. I see... That must be the principle.
HHACZST_44_2: The crystal detached from her form, as the Black Shores' Remnants filled the fissure.
HHACZST_44_3: Just like the Nova... Ku ku ku.
HHACZST_44_4: Energy is merely the vessel for personalities and memories, not their origin—
HHACZST_44_5: Ku ku ku, it functions as the Ship of Theseus, adrift on the tides of eternity.
HHACZST_44_6: How magnificent. I'll come to understand all of it... Ku ku ku.
HHACZST_45_1: That figure in light blue... I often glimpsed her wandering the moonlit shore, solitary and melancholic. But there's a lighter grace to her steps now, as if the weight of solitude has lifted.
HHACZST_45_2: I wonder if I will see her again tonight.
HHACZST_46_1: Water the Money Tree at eight past eight in the morning, and you'll get more funding for your projects. Works like a charm if your heart's in it.
HHACZST_46_3: I swear! That's what the note said, and at the time I was struggling to close this big cross-national deal.
HHACZST_46_4: At the bottom, in tiny print, it said something like "Operation Jackpot" or whatever.
HHACZST_46_5: Next thing I knew, the note just vanished into thin air, like mist! Thought I was seeing things for a second.
HHACZST_46_6: But I figured, why not give it a try? So, I watered that Money Tree early in the morning, before I was even fully awake. And guess what?
HHACZST_46_8: You won’t believe it—the tree talked to me! It gave me a tip—
HHACZST_46_9: That same day, the deal went through, with a huge boost in funding. All our support project budgets were instantly covered.
HHACZST_46_10: Alright, you relax tomorrow. I think I want to handle the watering.
HHACZST_47_1: "Cosmos told me that saving the world is as difficult as beating the Big Bad Demon. It's never easy to be a warrior."
HHACZST_47_2: "And Cloudy said a warrior is made of sweat and tears, but also gets to see wonders and find treasures."
HHACZST_47_3: "Encore thinks it's not about winning the adventure, but just going on it. Even the best warrior gets tired if they worry too much about what'll happen."
HHACZST_47_4: "Don't be sad, Ms. Louisa! If you feel bad, just smile and it'll go away! We like your smiles!"
HHACZST_48_1: Tethys, I require... the list of all Bloom Bearers involved in this mission.
HHACZST_48_2: This system is terribly sorry to inform you that all twelve Bloom Bearers in this mission have lost vital signs.
HHACZST_48_3: I'm not asking for statistics! I need their names!
HHACZST_48_4: This system will manage the necessary follow-up procedures. Additional intervention is not required on your part...
HHACZST_48_5: I said, give me their names! Every single one of them!
HHACZST_48_6: Niya, Igor, Suellen, Kresser, Margo, Meiji, Weidenfeller, Fritz, Valery, Nessa, Bangor, and Aleksei. Twelve Bloom Bearers in total.
HHACZST_48_7: Follow-up protocol initiated. This system extends its condolences to all affected parties—
HHACZST_48_8: That won't be necessary. I'll handle it personally. Vicki, Bloom Bearer, code number 1258γ057/4, proceeding to execute follow-up actions.
Side_HHATSSJ_3_4: I should really figure out a good way to keep them safe once all the cartridges are back with me.
Side_HHATSSJ_3_5: Why don't you just make them digital?
Side_HHATSSJ_3_6: Nonsense! It's the tradition! Plus, I've recently found that some even have voice recordings attached. Like this one…
Side_HHATSSJ_3_8: You wait patiently for something to happen as KU-Cass loads the cartridge's data.
Side_HHATSSJ_3_10: Er... The cartridge seems to have jammed itself. Luckily, I caught the last sentence—it looks like a message from the game's creator…
Side_HHATSSJ_3_11: Thank you for enjoying my game...
Heihaian_main_1_3_8_48: A mysterious object pulses with rhythmic light, seemingly harboring some form of frequency.
Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_13: As the group moves forward, Yangyang informs the Midnight Rangers of the situation and begins preparations to recover the Bloom Bearers' bodies...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2191_1: It looks like just an ordinary tree.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2191_2: But it seems Aalto took the liberty of naming it the "Money Tree."
Heihaian_main_1_3_2191_3: Of course that's something he would do...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2192_1: Encore didn't bring any seeds back from her hometown.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2192_2: This might be similar to her own story...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2192_3: Could the flowers in the tale truly be real?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2193_1: Camellya seems deeply connected to flowers.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2193_3: Maybe she's more like a flower than you realize.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2491_3: Unauthorized access prohibited. Proceed at your own risk!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2492_2: Any authorization on you? Thought so.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2492_3: Don't get too close, or it could do a number on you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2492_4: We need to be connected to the Tethys System to stay unaffected.

HelpText_116_Content:
[About]
Beneath the starry sky, the Black Shores keeps its endless vigil, calculating the arrival of the Lament.
But fear not the unknown—we are born of the stars.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at the Black Shores in the main quest "To the Shore's End."

[Event Rules]
The event has three phases, each unlocking as you progress through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available in certain game scenes.

ItemInfo_24_BgDescription:
Tiny shards of stars that long lost their blaze.
Observe and deduce, and in time, you'll find the entire history of Solaris in even the tiniest of fragments.
"For eons, she has been a solitary caretaker of stars, old or new, dead or alive."
RecallActivity_Story_02_Desc: Your story begins in Jinzhou. Yet recent mysteries lead you on a path towards an archipelago shrouded in fog—the Black Shores. Perhaps these solitary shores will mark the End of Wandering for you...
RecallActivity_Area_02_Desc: The Black Shores rests itself on an isle veiled in dense sea fog—a safe haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering the world. Without an invitation from its members, none has ever been able to locate this floating ark that connects the world in the vast ocean...
RecallActivity_Area_03_Desc: The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

Heihaian_main_1_3_2494_1: Thanks to you, the spread of the corruption is under control for now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2494_2: You can leave the cleanup to us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2495_1: I never thought the Tethys System malfunctioning could be so serious.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2495_2: Seeing constructs appear from thin air like that... I may as well be looking at Retroact Rain.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2495_3: I've seen the Retroact Rain in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2495_4: But the frequencies it's manipulating are nothing like we've seen before. Bringing history and the dead to life again? I mean...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2991_1: The TD Observatory collects data from around the world.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2991_2: Does the Black Shores collect Tacet Discord data too?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2991_3: Tacet Discords are part of the Lament. We have no choice but to keep an eye on every sighting.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2991_4: The anchor here processes the data brought back by our Consultants.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2991_5: If the Tethys System experiences an overflow, the data stored here could get corrupted.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2992_1: The Tethys System analyzes everything in existence.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2992_2: It's Solaris's most powerful tool. So, isn't it inevitable?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2992_5: Not just objects, but maybe the idea of "creation" could be overturned!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2992_6: Imagine—if this is true, the Tethys System could create entirely new Tacet Discords!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3101_1: This place is home to many plants, some familiar to Jinzhou and some new.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3101_2: It feels almost like a botanical preserve.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3101_3: Is it the cradle of a new world or the relic of an old one?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3102_1: This plant is obviously well looked after.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3102_2: The Black Shores were constructed on a huge Tacetite rock, and most plants can only thrive in specific conditions.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3102_3: Are these plants also cared for by the robots?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3103_1: The sign says, "Camellya 72973, recorded in the Bank of Life's Plant Archive."
Heihaian_main_1_3_3103_2: Is that truly a flower planted by Camellya?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3103_3: Based on the numbers, she's collected numerous flower species.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3103_4: Despite having thousands, she appears to be searching for one irreplaceable flower.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3104_1: This door appears to be locked for some reason.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3104_2: We probably need to locate a key to get it open from this side.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3591_1: Listen to the wailing of the stars...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3591_2: The corruption is even affecting their orbits.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3591_4: We just don't have the strength to fight it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3591_5: Hopefully KU-Chan and the rest can find a way to intercept the overflow.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3592_1: According to our observations, the star that fell after the overflow was the Necrostar.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3592_2: That star is critical for us to track the orbital movement of Solaris.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3592_3: Only a map based on the Necrostar's data can function accurately.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3592_4: Let's hope this gets resolved quickly, for all our sakes.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3593_1: Solaris astronomy? Just look up to see for yourself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3593_2: What Tethys aims to achieve must be up there in the sky.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3593_3: I've never seen a sky like that before...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3593_4: You noticed it too, hm? The sky here is different from the one outside.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_1: You're {PlayerName}, right? Welcome. I'm the manager here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_2: You've met KU-Money before? Well, I hold a similar rank. The robots around here all work for me.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_3: This used to be an observatory, but it later got converted into a charging station.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_4: In times like these, stargazing is the last thing on people's minds.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_6: The stars are what define the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_7: But... we over here... aren't much help in a fight.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3594_8: All we can do is keep the Tethys System stable by continuing to draw power from the Stellar Matrices. That's how we support our comrades in battle.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3595_1: Have you heard? At the Black Shores, our efforts to stop the Lament are called "modulation."
Heihaian_main_1_3_3595_2: Solaris exists in frequencies. We call adjusting these frequencies "modulation."
Heihaian_main_1_3_3595_3: Someone did mention that to me before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3595_4: Its origin and practice trace back to an ancient philosopher from the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3595_5: But the sands of time have erased him from the minds of many.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3596_1: Hmm? I'm looking for a legendary figure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3596_2: Have you seen KU-Nami? She's one of us, said to be the first robot born from the Tethys System.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3596_6: She's always been fascinated by the stars and the universe. She also cares deeply about everyone at the Black Shores.

HelpText_117_Content:
[Mail Types]
There are two types of mail: Starred Mail and Other Mail.
Starred Mail stays pinned at the top of your inbox and does not expire. It will not be deleted when you select "Delete Read."
Other Mail has an expiration date and will be automatically deleted when it expires.

[Mail Capacity]
The inbox can store a maximum of 99 mails.
Once the limit is reached, the oldest mails without attachments or with claimed attachments will be automatically deleted.
Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.

POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_5: Sorry, I was trying to be a hero with no plan and backup.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_6: I saw some Aetherfin were trapped in the corrupted data and thought I could help, but those Tacet Discords just came out of nowhere...
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_7: This all feels a bit familiar...
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_8: But still, we've got work to do!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_9: All you need to do is find the corrupted data's core and clean it with the System's clearance, just like last time.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_5_10: I'll do everything I can to assist you! Just don't forget to get clearance from me before you start cleaning!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_5: When can I learn this skill?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_6: Of course! As your best assistant, I've got to know these things.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_7: If you want to learn it… you'd need to link your mind to the Tethys System, and then—
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_9: You can also activate the portals with your special clearance, just like last time.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_8_10: Anyway, I've opened up the portal for you. Let's get going!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_3: The core is gone, but corruption persists...
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_4: Oh, I see it now! Look up, Master! There's another core up there!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_5: Think you can hide from us? No way!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_6: Use the portals, Master! With clearance, you can get through the portal to reach it.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_9_7: Try shooting at that Data Wall!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_4: It's just old data, nothing special…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_6: You've seen the Mutterflies before, right? They're the same kind of creature—both made of pure Remnant Energy.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_10: Good job, you two. There's another emergency for you. I'll keep it short.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_11: Our frequency monitor just detected more Aetherfins in the lower area.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_12: The waveform matches what you uploaded, so they might be trapped in corrupted data too.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_13: Could you go check it out?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_7_14: No problem! Just leave it to us!
HHAPKHD_1_2: You know that data overflow incident, right? I just got some fascinating ideas from it! The embodied data can be used to create fun stuff as well!
HHAPKHD_1_3: For example... an Overdashing Challenge unique to the Black Shores, inspired by Jinzhou's Overdash Club! Care to give it a try?
HHAPKHD_1_6: I'll collect as much data as possible. Let's get it started!
HHAPKHD_1_7: Sure thing. Let me know if you're available.
HHAPKHD_2_6: And next, maybe I can use the data as building blocks...
HHAPKHD_2_7: Oops! This is... Well, I probably used the wrong source file...
HHAPKHD_2_8: So sorry about this! I'll be more cautious next time!
HHAPKHD_2_9: Of course! Piecing the data segments together is like making a game! And a game always has its rewards!

Event_AYKXBRZM_91_2: Quit the running and come play with me. Let's not waste our precious time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_92_2: Why does the Black Shores keep dumping these dull missions on me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_1: I live for a good thrill.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_2: But it's so hard to find one that meets my standards.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_3: Some have potential, but they're still too dull.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_4: Only you can really get my heart racing, {PlayerName}.
Event_AYKXBRZM_96_3: I remember the way you fought—your blade's strong enough to sever the air itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_96_5: Ah... My head... It hurts. No, that's not you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_97_1: Is that... Camellya? She needs help.
Event_AYKXBRZM_97_2: I need to go to her, quick.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_5: That thing couldn't be you. You always... exceed my expectations.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_8: ...I know. After all, you're the one I've chosen, my beloved seed.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_9: While I crave your sweet words, a part of me craves the thrill of hunting you down.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_10: We can do this after we get out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_12: Oh, is that an invitation? You do know how to please me.

HelpText_118_Content:
[About]
Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to relaunch the Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4193_1: Besides us, I've sent everyone else to help contain the spread of the corrupted data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4193_2: If we had prepared earlier, we could have done more than just seal the underground.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4194_1: Readings show a drop in the corruption spread. Quick, contact the station and tell them to start integration now!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4194_3: Why not wait until it's safe?
Heihaian_main_1_3_4194_4: We don't have time to mourn our fallen comrades.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4194_5: All we can do is accept that they're gone, and make sure their sacrifice is not in vain.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4196_1: Ah, you're the Rover, aren't you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_4196_3: I heard about you from my old colleagues at the Huaxu Academy in Jinzhou!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4196_4: It's not surprising things have taken a turn for the better since you stepped in.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4196_5: Morale is looking a lot better.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_2: For bleep sake! Reduce the memory size! Don't give errors so much processing space!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_4: Huh? Ah, {PlayerName}. Good you finally decided to show up.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_5: I'm assistant manager of the Error Cell. It's my job to tell those other robots what to do.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_6: Like KU-Money and KU-Tolo, I'm in charge of this area.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_8: Think you can afford to be soft dealing with those anomalies? Pffft.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_9: Anyway, here's a tip. Don't let Beatrice's age fool you. She's tough as nails and as real a warden as they come.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4198_10: Lower the bleeping input voltage! The boop frequency needs to be lower!
Heihaian_main_1_3_4199_1: Retrieving every last bit of the corruption is the only way we'll get through this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4199_2: The agents here know this, so they choose to stand their ground.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4199_4: Besides the one who sacrificed themself to seal the gate, many others were injured.
Heihaian_main_1_3_4199_5: If the Shorekeeper wasn't holding back the tide of corruption from within the Tethys itself, it would be much worse...

Activity_101900001_Desc:
Beside a mysterious gateway stands a girl who has accidentally wandered through it—Dorothy. She seeks your help to defeat the monsters lurking behind the gate.
In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.
You can complete the task with your Friends.
InstanceDungeon_8181_Description:
"Embark on a dream-seeking journey. May you find your true self in this clearer world."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8182_Description:
"Courage is just a consumable by nature, it gets more expensive as you get older."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8183_Description:
"I'm just practicing how to tell you the truth about those fairy tales."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8184_Description:
"The sun rises over the village houses. I wonder if tomorrow will be a brand new day?"
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8185_Description:
"The time to say goodbye has come. This is where I will leave behind my weak self of the past."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5391_2: It should be safe outside now, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5391_3: All the agents and robots are working hard. We can't slack off.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5391_4: But those Tacet Discord constructs around are still worrying me...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5392_1: Welcome, I heard you're the new Consultant.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5392_3: This is the Modulation Hall, where we adjust Stellar Matrix frequencies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5392_4: The Matrix before you is composed of compressed data from the Lament in the sky.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5392_5: Tethys calibrates its frequencies to resonate with this and previous Lament incidencies as its method of predicting future ones.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5392_6: But right now, we need to do more than just adjust Matrix frequencies...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_1: The Shorekeeper... has finally revealed herself.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_2: Have you heard that old prophecy?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_3: She only shows herself when the Black Shores is in a moment of crisis, that one.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_4: Many of us have gone our entire lives never seeing her.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_5: But if it's true, her showing up means that things could get even worse.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5393_6: I mean... is that really something to get excited about?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_1: Precision mapping of the Matrix coordinates is critical...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_2: Every detail on these maps must be exact. Any mistake could put our navigators' operations at risk.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_3: But our senior navigator is already...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_4: He's gone, I know. But there's no time for mourning.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_5: Is there another navigator who can take his place?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_6: The current lead navigator is a special operative, a fact clear from her uniform alone.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_7: As the late navigator's associate, she has the skills needed to ensure the Modulation Hall remains functional.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5394_8: We just don't know what to expect next...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5395_3: Travel among the stars... Enzo, navigator of Rinascita.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5395_4: We will see this through, and the Shorekeeper will guide us to rise once more.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5396_1: The currents of time are shifting once more...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5396_2: My records reveal that the Shorekeeper has always surfaced with the tides of change.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5396_3: Isn't this a sign of crisis?
Heihaian_main_1_3_5396_4: Indeed, crisis often heralds progress. A stagnant shore is merely a pool of dead water.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5396_5: The Black Shores will endure, as history has foretold.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5397_1: The result of the Third Contingency Protocol is...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5397_4: Too distant... too distant... our reference frame is out of reach...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5397_5: Points, lines, and planes... beyond the light cone... constrained by the four fundamental rules...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5397_6: The multiplier is imaginary, compounding continuously... recall... our parameters...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5397_9: This robot seems to struggle with the concept...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5398_2: I've been analyzing a theoretical problem.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5398_5: Tethys might contain Lament data that we've never recorded but are certain has occurred, including the current Lament unfolding before us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5398_6: Though the likelihood is small, it's theoretically possible with sufficient data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5398_7: Imagine a drop of ink falling into the ocean, eventually reforming into the original drop...
Heihaian_main_1_3_5398_8: If that drop of ink, that Lament, does exist... maybe we just haven't detected it yet.
Heihaian_main_1_3_57_43: A Blake Bloom imbued with the Shorekeeper's longings, holding the key to a fresh beginning after saying goodbye to the Shorekeeper at the End of Wandering. It grants the highest level of access in the Tethys System.

Event_SLLSQXQY_12_1: Hello, {PlayerName}! Shall we start collecting data in this area?
Event_SLLSQXQY_12_5: No problem. Just tell me when you're ready.
HHACZST_33_1: Platya gazes at the sea, lost in silence.
HHACZST_33_2: She's looking toward where her hometown once stood.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_12_1: Hey! Why are they suddenly swimming upward? The portals can't be opened in such a short time!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_12_2: Wait, is that… the Shorekeeper's portal? Let's get in, Master {PlayerName}!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_4: It's great to finally see what's captured in those pictures.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_5: So, you planned to show me this?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_7: Ah… Sorry, I didn't mean to hide this from you.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_8: This mission was supposed to be a surprise.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_9: After that crisis, I found some old pictures while cleaning Necrostar's waste data.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_10: Ah… I forgot to tell you this. Sorry.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_11: I found them while cleaning Necrostar's waste data. But they're too old to be sourced.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_12: I saw you in those pictures, gazing at the Aetherfins.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_13: Whoever took them is... a mystery now.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_14: But they must be precious to both you and that person.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_15: Speaking of which, I've always wanted to thank you properly since last time.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_16: How about I take a picture of the scenery here for you as a keepsake?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_17: The past may be gone, but new stories are always waiting!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_20: You're welcome! Actually, I've already taken one while we were on the surface! I'll print it as well!
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_21: By the way, the Shorekeeper just helped us. It would be nice to thank her in person.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_13_22: It must be quite a while since she's seen the Aetherfins again.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_1: The Shorekeeper is staring at the Aetherfins.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_5: They vanished when you left the Black Shores, and now, after 20 years, they are here again.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_7: The Aetherfins vanished when you left the Black Shores, and now, after 20 years, they are here again.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_8: Thanks to you and KU-Key, they can now swim freely here, as they once did.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_9: Everything's back to the way it used to be.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_11: No, that's not it. I'm simply reflecting on what you said before…
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_12: "No one ever steps in the same river twice."
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_13: I wonder… is this all just a beautiful dream?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_15: As a part of the Tethys System, I cannot assume a physical form and lack the ability to dream.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_16: But recent events have made me question if I'm truly back in reality. Could I still be trapped inside the Necrostar's event horizon?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_17: Or perhaps I am lost in a fleeting dream at light speed, unable to awaken?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_19: Since that last incident, I find myself plagued by strange and erratic thoughts from time to time.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_22: Is that so? You've said this before.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_23: Is that so? Perhaps I need more time to fully grasp the nature of these.... emotions.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_24: Again, thank you for saving the Aetherfins. These gentle beings are reminiscent of those Black Shores members who once filled these halls.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_25: Their presence reminds me of so many familiar faces… They never truly left us.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_29: Ask about the pictures mentioned by KU-Key.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_31: I apologize. I didn't intend to monitor you.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_32: It's just that... I found it difficult not to be attentive.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_33: When KU-Key was unable to open the portal in time, I stepped in instinctively.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_37: Really? I'm glad to hear that.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_38: Those pictures... they were taken in secret by the Black Shores members for your birthday party.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_39: In the end, the party was never held, because you were too busy to attend. But Hoda and the others held on to them anyway.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_40: I didn't expect KU-Key to find them among the abandoned data.
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_42: The feeling I have when I see those pictures, the Aetherfins, and you again… It must be happiness, hmm?
POI_HFZSLDZLHS_14_43: Wherever you are, please know that I'm always here to support you.

ComboTeaching_15050701_DescriptionConten: Shorekeeper can cast Resonance Skill in mid-air.

ComboTeaching_15050802_DescriptionConten: All party members' Crit. Rate is increased when they are inside the <color=Highlight>Inner Stellarealm</color>. <color=Highlight>Inner Stellarealm</color> has all the effects of the <color=Highlight>Outer Stellarealm</color>.

Event_AYKXBRZM_81_1: Please, help us find our son...
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_2: What was he doing before he disappeared?
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_3: We were having lunch together, just two days ago.
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_4: Later, I went up the mountain to fetch spring water. When I got back, he was gone...
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_5: Did your wife see him after you left home?
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_6: She said Jing was out playing with his friends... but he never came home.
Event_AYKXBRZM_81_7: I've been worried sick ever since, unable to eat or sleep...  Jing, where are you now...
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_1: Jing, my poor boy... Please come back home...
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_2: Did Jing have any close friends?
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_4: Did any of them happen to see him?
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_5: Jing had been increasingly withdrawn, preferring to stay home. He stopped playing with his friends.
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_6: But that day, he said he wanted to play with them. It seemed odd, so I asked those kids later, but none of them had seen Jing...
Event_AYKXBRZM_82_7: ... Oh, how can I go on without my Jing...
Event_AYKXBRZM_83_1: All of the boy's clothes since his infancy are neatly folded...

InfoDisplay_133001001_Text:
Tucked away in the tempestuous Stormy Sea lies an archipelago known for its lavish Tacetite deposits and as a refuge for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3.

The archipelago cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place.

Members of the Black Shores who operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands, are known as "Consultants." Those stationed at the headquarters are referred to as "Bloom Bearers." Apart from these fundamental duties, the Black Shores also accommodates a plethora of other specialized roles.

Though the Black Shores openly shares its advanced technologies with its partners, even its own members remain unaware of the true origins of these innovations.
InfoDisplay_133001002_Text:
Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data—collected both manually and via beacon access—into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.

The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

The Tethys System has no discernible energy source, physical infrastructure, or processing core. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious.
InfoDisplay_133001003_Text:
These unique robots, found throughout the Black Shores, serve as the physical terminals of the Tethys System. Their construction and performance capabilities remain largely unknown, yet they possess direct access to the system, second only to its administrator. Within the Black Shores, these robots function both as assistants and tools in the daily activities of its members.

Each terminal has a distinct personality, and the study of these robots has advanced the field of cognitive psychology.
InfoDisplay_133001004_Text:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament. Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study and observe them. Malfunctioning matrices, however, are collected and isolated in designated areas to prevent data overflow.
The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.
InfoDisplay_133001005_Text:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.

At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has even been honored with the title of "The Modulator".
InfoDisplay_133001006_Text: A mysterious lifeform that rests beneath the Black Shores' subterranean galaxy. Her physical structure and age are shrouded in mystery. In the complicated coding language of the Tethys System, the name "Shorekeeper" also means "Guardian of Secrets". She chose to call herself "Shorekeeper" to symbolize her role in watching over those who venture away from the shores into faraway lands.

Event_AYKXBRZM_84_9: W-what are you talking about? I don't understand...

Heihaian_main_1_3_2301_2: So, those little robots are also linked as Terminals within the Tethys System.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2301_3: We can use them to restore the corrupted data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2301_4: But be careful, they seem to have minds of their own...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2302_2: I-I'm actually new here, and I haven't quite figured out what's going on yet...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2302_3: Those robots started running around all of a sudden, like something big happened, and the whole place suddenly felt tense.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2302_4: Is... is there anything I can help you with?
Heihaian_main_1_3_2303_1: Beep beep! This is an emergency!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2303_2: Entry into the corruption area without proper protection or a Terminal robot escort is not recommended!
Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_1: I'd recognize these scattered frequencies anywhere.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_2: They reek of the Lament... Or rather, a "dead" Lament that's now just history...

Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_5: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to intrude...
Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_6: No need to apologize. It's all in the past now, and all I can do is search for the truth.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_7: I can hear the voices of Reverberations I once retrieved in these scattered frequencies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_2304_8: I will not let history repeat itself...

Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_1: The client has received the mine investigation report. We can wrap up this case. Thank you once again for your contribution!
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_2: But before you go, we have a art project that may be right for you if you're interested.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_3: The client seeks an artist to capture a few scenic spots, both photos and paintings will do.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_4: Landscape painting... reminds me of someone.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_5: I remember doing landscape paintings with Zhezhi.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_6: I met a painter called Zhezhi during the Moon-Chasing Festival. We had a blast at the festival.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_7: The first time I saw her, she was busy sketching scenery, so absorbed in her work that her mind was still on it when we talked.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_8: At the Moon-Chasing Festival, we worked together on a painting commission. Her brushwork was so exquisite and expressive.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_9: Oh, right! She helped out at the fan drawing stall during the festival. Her artwork was so popular, I couldn't get one myself.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_10: Now that you mention it, she seems perfect for this job! If she takes it, the client will be very pleased.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_11: Thanks for bringing this up! We will make sure to contact her.
RGZYYYGJZ_28_1: These flashbacks... Could it be from touching that mirror? Energy crystals made into a mirror, with a pre-made Sonoro inside... Hmm, a sly trap.
RGZYYYGJZ_28_2: This Sonoro, the docks, Benett's Terminal, Duncan... When did it all begin?
RGZYYYGJZ_28_3: And the hand that pulled me in... I need to get to the bottom of this, and quickly.
RGZYYYGJZ_281_1: These masterless Echoes have turned hostile... The frequency fluctuations in this Sonoro seem unstable.
RGZYYYGJZ_281_2: I'll have to handle them before I can search the area.
RGZYYYGJZ_282_2: How strange. I'm being led in circles. They don't seem to want me near the mansion.
RGZYYYGJZ_283_1: Now there's nothing else in my way.
RGZYYYGJZ_283_2: All these obstacles suggest the answer is likely there... I must investigate that mansion. The way out and clues I need may lie within its walls.
RGZYYYGJZ_29_1: This layout and decor seem strikingly similar to our mansion, just with slight differences.
RGZYYYGJZ_29_2: This area... These decorations, the chandelier specifically, were destroyed during the invasion five years ago.
RGZYYYGJZ_29_3: Am I truly in the <color=yellow>past</color> or trapped in some kind of <color=yellow>simulation</color>?
RGZYYYGJZ_30_1: Finally, the line in the West End is ours.
RGZYYYGJZ_30_2: Those uppity pricks tried to screw us over with the Order's backing. Good thing Padrino was there to uncover the counterfeit crap they swapped in.
RGZYYYGJZ_30_3: Now that our territories are connected. I heard the lacquerware in Huanglong is top-notch. We could make a killing off that.
RGZYYYGJZ_30_4: Well, aren't you a go-getter? Not bad, ambition gets things done. Let's start planning.
RGZYYYGJZ_31_1: It's been three days. I haven't heard back from him at all...
RGZYYYGJZ_31_2: You still fretting over your son? Don't worry, we've taken every precaution. We will be ready to act should anything go awry.
RGZYYYGJZ_31_3: Thank you. I know you will. It's just... He went tangling with those wild Tacet Discords... He doesn't understand. I expect nothing from him... only his safety.
RGZYYYGJZ_32_1: Aha! Fancy a wager? I bet two dinners you can't guess what the Padrino's got in store for us at the rally.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_1: If you're telling me he's adopting that <color=yellow>orphan girl from the other side of the family</color>, spare me. Already heard.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_2: Actually, I imagine the whole family's caught wind of it by now. Isn't that why we're throwing this rally for her today?
RGZYYYGJZ_33_3: Tell me, how on earth do you stay in the loop, tinkering away at home like that? You must be shocked, Capollo is already the heir, so why on earth did he adopt her?
RGZYYYGJZ_33_4: In a corner of the mansion, Carlotta's gaze is drawn to two members engaged in conversation.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_5: (Orphan girl from the other side of the family, adopted by Padrino... This rally... held for me?)
RGZYYYGJZ_33_6: (A mere touch of the mirror was enough to instantly draw out my <color=yellow>memories, experiences</color>, and even passing <color=yellow>thoughts</color>, creating this Sonoro.)
RGZYYYGJZ_33_7: Carlotta pauses, trying to make sense of the situation, but one of the members suddenly notices her and begins asking questions, much to her surprise.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_8: Hmm? You look a little fami— Oh, it's you again! What brings you back here?
RGZYYYGJZ_33_9: You shouldn't know me yet. Not at this time.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_10: I don't understand... What time? What are you talking about?
RGZYYYGJZ_33_11: Sorry, please don't mind what I just said. I'm not really sure where I am, why I am here, or what I need to do.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_12: Actually, I think he meant to say we just saw you. Just now, uh, about a minute ago. You walked right past us and headed that way.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_13: Yeah, I'm just surprised you're back so soon. By the way, you do look a bit different, don't you?
RGZYYYGJZ_33_14: Your outfit... No, it's more the accessories, really. Yours are red, but the person I saw had <color=yellow>blue</color> ones on her wrists... Hmm. Perhaps I'm imagining things.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_15: (Blue accessories... I saw blue accessories on that hand that pulled me inside.)
RGZYYYGJZ_33_16: I suppose she's the friend who invited me here. Could you tell me where she's gone? I've been left alone since arriving, and I believe I really should meet her.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_17: Perhaps she's just out for a stroll? The preparations are behind schedule due to a mishap, and everyone's waiting for the rally to begin.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_18: (Yes, now I remember... the rally didn't start on time because of a <color=yellow>lighting</color> malfunction....)
RGZYYYGJZ_33_19: (On the other hand, once the lights are turned on... Something may change, and it could reveal new clues.)
RGZYYYGJZ_33_20: Thank you. I think I know where I'm going now.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_21: Uh, you're welcome, I suppose? Not that we've done much for you.
RGZYYYGJZ_33_22: I doubt it means much to say this to you… since you only exist in this place, and unlike me, you probably don't need to hear this. But I believe Padrino took her in because he saw the makings of a true Montelli.
RGZYYYGJZ_34_1: All right. Time to check the lobby.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_2: Sir... are you talking to me?
RGZYYYGJZ_35_3: Yes. Fret not, Carlotta. Come up to the front so everyone can see you.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_4: (I'm looking at what happened <color=yellow>eleven years ago</color>...)
RGZYYYGJZ_35_5: (Two entirely different moments are crossing paths right now...)
RGZYYYGJZ_35_6: Today is a special day, the beginning of your journey as one of us.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_7: As my granddaughter, you will now carry the Montelli name—my name, the family's name—and with it, its privileges and responsibilities.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_10: Puny little thing... such a nervous look to her.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_11: Isn't she from the lesser side of the family? And a girl at that... Why her? What makes her worthy of the Montelli name?
RGZYYYGJZ_35_12: My thoughts exactly. I fail to see how she could possibly belong to our ranks, let alone carry the family name.
RGZYYYGJZ_35_13: I knew it! She shares our bloodline!
RGZYYYGJZ_35_14: She is a true Montelli, just like the Padrino!
RGZYYYGJZ_35_16: Recognition, praise, glory, isn't that what you want?
RGZYYYGJZ_35_17: Stay here, and you'll have all of that.
RGZYYYGJZ_36_1: Dazzling sunlight… Am I in the court? Have I left that Sonoro already?
RGZYYYGJZ_36_2: No, these decorations...they aren't real, even if they appear to be. This is just another simulation from <color=yellow>my memories</color>.
RGZYYYGJZ_36_3: Now, the question is... <color=yellow>What moment from my past</color> does this represent?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_1: How do I leave this place?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_2: Leave? But didn't you just follow me here?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_3: ...Cut the nonsense. You were the one who brought me into this Sonoro.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_4: Ugh, fine. But why should I tell you?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_5: True, I brought you here. But remember, I am a product of your own making—your memories, your desires, your fantasies...
RGZYYYGJZ_37_6: From this moment on, I am also Carlotta Montelli. We will share the same past, present, and perhaps even future.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_7: Don't pretend we're alike in any way. And keep the Montelli name out of your filthy mouth.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_8: Oh, right! How could I forget? You worked so hard to earn the illustrious Montelli name back then... And this was your humble abode, correct?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_9: A poor little girl from the forgotten side of the family, trying desperately to fit in with the grandeur of her new home, fearing abandonment, and playing the part of a proper lady.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_10: You're a star in the ballroom, a top investor at the auction house. But your true talent? Being the family's favorite weapon, carrying out orders without question. Is that all you live for?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_11: I thought you'd be thrilled with what I'm offering you! Acceptance, validation, indispensability... Did you see how everyone adored you? Isn't this a dream come true?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_12: Oh, planning to shoot me again?
RGZYYYGJZ_37_13: Don't bother. This Sonoro is born from your consciousness, and it's also my domain.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_14: Since the frequencies here can be shattered, they can also be brought together again… Why not try shooting yourself? Perhaps that will work.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_15: Don't be so quick to deny it. If you truly never craved acceptance and recognition, would I even exist?
RGZYYYGJZ_39_1: Nice work, but this is only the beginning.
RGZYYYGJZ_39_2: You must be dying to know which part of the past this is. Would you like a little hint?
RGZYYYGJZ_39_3: The wind abruptly ceases, leaving Carlotta enveloped in an oppressive, humid stillness tinged with a metallic scent.
RGZYYYGJZ_40_1: Damn it all! You think you could've breached our defenses so quickly without someone backstabbing Padrino?
RGZYYYGJZ_40_2: Blood debts must be paid with blood. We will not let this slide, not while a single Montelli lives!
RGZYYYGJZ_40_3: Thanks, milady… Our men need help... Please, they're in the back…
RGZYYYGJZ_41_1: How did this happen? How much intel do the Fisalias have on us... The West End, our mansion... both under siege...
RGZYYYGJZ_41_2: We can't just sit idly by and let them have their way... What now? We need a plan before it's too late!
RGZYYYGJZ_42_1: Three key areas have been hit one after another: South Second Block, West End dock, and our headquarters.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_2: Intel says the Fisalias are gearing up for another hit on our headquarters. As usual, we can expect the Order to turn a blind eye.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_3: They ambushed Father first, before we did anything to them... It is beyond unforgivable!
RGZYYYGJZ_42_4: We're running out of time. Capollo, we need a plan before Padrino wakes up. Call for reinforcements from the East End. It's risky, but if they don't smell our manpower shortage… we might just make it through.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_5: (No, we shouldn't do that...The Fisalias were keeping an eye on our other territories.)
RGZYYYGJZ_42_7: No, we're not doing that. They can take the West End. Our men will retreat to headquarters.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_8: Why? They're tough, but we're no pushovers either! We earned our turf fair and square. Why should we back down now?
RGZYYYGJZ_42_9: When Padrino eventually wakes, how do you plan to explain that we have let his and the entire family's efforts go to waste?
RGZYYYGJZ_42_10: (But we still risk exposing the location of our headquarters. It's all about predicting their moves... and keeping ours hidden.)
RGZYYYGJZ_42_13: ...What about you, Carlotta? What do you think?
RGZYYYGJZ_42_14: (Once again, this deviates from my past experience... Well, I'll point them down the right path this time.)
RGZYYYGJZ_42_16: Our people on the East End, the South Second Block, and the dock will stay put to give the impression we know nothing.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_17: Then we'll send our main forces to where the Fisalias keep their Echoes. The trade routes mean nothing compared to that.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_18: As they know what we value most, we need to demand something of equal worth from them as our bargaining chip.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_19: Is this really going to work?
RGZYYYGJZ_42_20: We can't afford to lose our people. Everything else, even the mansion are simply assets.
RGZYYYGJZ_451_1: Wrong, wrong again... Do you really think you can choose the right path?
RGZYYYGJZ_451_2: Stay, let's get lost in this maze together, from one window to another… I'll keep your company..
RGZYYYGJZ_452_1: Left! You should've gone left! Wait... Or maybe not?
RGZYYYGJZ_452_2: Think it over, I told you before. You should take the easier way out!
RGZYYYGJZ_453_1: Do you truly think you are worthy of the Montelli name?
RGZYYYGJZ_454_1: Just give up... What an embarrassing sight. It's so painful to watch.
RGZYYYGJZ_46_2: I was worried you might be in danger.
RGZYYYGJZ_46_3: Also, I'm here to deliver this.
RGZYYYGJZ_46_4: The gun was always there. You earned the right to use it the moment you chose to act on your own accord.
RGZYYYGJZ_46_5: Looks like you've made up your mind.
RGZYYYGJZ_47_1: I am merely a blade made for killing. Am I really qualified to change the status quo?
RGZYYYGJZ_47_2: Why won't you obey my orders!
RGZYYYGJZ_47_3: I'm getting old. We should take the easier approach.
RGZYYYGJZ_47_4: If we can make other people pay the price...
RGZYYYGJZ_47_6: Why can't you just give in to me and stay here?
RGZYYYGJZ_48_5: H-how dare she eat the tribute...
InfoDisplay_133001007_Text:
These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetites that make up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors are independently developed and designed by the Black Shores, drawing inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design.

MapMark_130001_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Gulpuff born from anomalous data, this creature possesses an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are usually Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.
MapMark_130002_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Fusion Warrior born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.
MapMark_130003_MarkDesc:
Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.
MapMark_130004_MarkDesc:
Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.
MapMark_130005_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Rocksteady Guardian formed from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock layers with a single blow. 

Despite its slow movement, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it.

Brute force, pure and simple.
MapMark_130006_MarkDesc: Though tiny, the game cartridges carry so many sounds, scenes, stories, and hopes... To relive the stories from the bygone civilization, KU-Cass needs your help to recover its lost cartridges.
MapMark_131001_MarkDesc:

Complete specific challenges and defeat the targets to obtain additional rewards prepared by Yhoran.
"When you're prepared, the Reaper will not come."

Heihaian_main_1_3_6191_1: Are we really challenging Tethys when it's locked down?
Heihaian_main_1_3_6191_2: It'll be a miracle if we can even pull it off, but...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6191_3: With the Shorekeeper helping us within Tethys and our comrades fighting bravely on the frontlines...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6191_4: It's a gamble, but losing isn't an option.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_3: Nobody in the Black Shores has ever gone against the Tethys System's directives, with the insurmountable task of tracking its codes.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_4: It may as well be a code written by the gods...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_5: Going against a god does sound thrilling.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_6: Only you would say something like that.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_7: But since we've decided to go through with this, I'll follow through.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6192_8: No matter what, we have to save the Shorekeeper.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6193_1: A navigator talked about this before.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6193_2: Tethys is extremely dependent on its core processor, which means...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6193_3: Do you mean Tethys is using the Shorekeeper as its core processor?
Heihaian_main_1_3_6193_5: But that's so inhumane! She's a person too...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_1: If we keep scanning Tethys' memory, we can pinpoint the Shorekeeper's exact location.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_2: We won't... ever give up on anyone.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_3: Her physical form may be lost in the Matrix, but she is still in there.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_4: Because her entire frequency spectrum is still somewhere in Tethys.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_6: Yes! Hmm... so you're familiar with this concept, it's quite significant.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_7: If we can recover her frequencies, we can use Tethys to bring her back.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_8: It'll be like finding a needle in a haystack...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6194_9: She believed in {PlayerName}. So, please trust us as well!
Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_2: If you're shining somewhere in this starry sky, please watch over us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_3: Watch over the Black Shores, watch over the Shorekeeper...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_4: Let your starlight keep lighting our way forward.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_5: We will keep fighting for you...
Heihaian_main_1_3_6196_2: The Tethys System is a closed system. It keeps its core logic hidden.
Heihaian_main_1_3_6196_3: Can we really find the Shorekeeper in its data banks...

FavorWord_150501_Content: I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Back to the Black Shores, and… back to my side.
FavorWord_150502_Content: Time changes everything—Blake Blooms, Stellar Matrices, and the Black Shores—all constantly in flux. I've documented these changes, repairing the damage and preserving the good. Yet, I wonder... Am I doing enough? Have I earned your trust? These questions haunt me, but I press on, seeking solace in my work.
FavorWord_150503_Content: Your past... I promised to keep it a secret, at your own request. That day, I realized our reunion would be one-sided. This is why your memory loss didn't surprise me... But it doesn't matter now. You may have forgotten me, but I will remember everything about you, always.
FavorWord_150504_Content: Humans dream to fulfill their desires. For a long time, I believed such dreams were not meant for me, as I had never yearned for anything. Until one day... I dreamed of you. We were strolling through an unfamiliar land, basking in the warm sunlight. You showed me your world and shared stories of your past. You even brewed a cup of tea for me... Though only a figment of my imagination, I wished that moment could last a little longer.
FavorWord_150505_Content: Next time you journey to distant lands, could you bring me along? I don't want to watch from afar or hear secondhand about your adventures. I long to experience the unknown by your side, as your friend... Please, will you give me the chance?
FavorWord_150506_Content: Pressing a piano key creates an enchanting sound from the vibrating strings. Unlike other frequencies I've processed, a piano produces a pure, clear, and vivid tone. If I could one day communicate my emotions as simply and intuitively as humans do... If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener?
FavorWord_150507_Content: I cannot physically grow and age, and therefore can never truly comprehend the range of emotions that come with it as a human does. Despite my wealth of knowledge and ability to replicate others' experiences through the Sonoro, these feelings remain enigmatic to me, forever distant and unfamiliar.
FavorWord_150508_Content: Long ago, during our days together at the Black Shores, you used to prepare chowder for us, blending milk, seafood, and vegetables. One spoonful of its warmth could dispel the freezing sea wind and restore stamina. Despite multiple attempts, I cannnot seem to recreate that flavor.
FavorWord_150509_Content: The food I hate... Hmm, hate might be too strong a word, but I tend to steer clear of pickled food, like preserved plums. While I appreciate their long shelf life, the fermented smell reminds me of their preserved nature.
FavorWord_150510_Content: My purpose had been clear long before my creation: to build a safe haven from the unrelenting waves of the Lament, until humanity could find a path to a brighter tomorrow. It used to be my duty, but now... it is a choice. I am one with the Black Shores. I want to prevent more tragedies from happening, I want to protect everyone, I... I want to safeguard my connection with the world around me. This is my own will.
FavorWord_150511_Content: Ah, so you've noticed the crystal on my chest. It's not an adornment, but a fissure brimming with the energy emanating from my body. Through it, you can touch the core I've managed to keep safe since my creation. It resembles the kernel of a fruit, or the beating heart of a human, where the essence of life is preserved.
FavorWord_150512_Content: Remnant Energy coalesced into a crystal cocoon on a moonlit shore, stirred by the crashing waves, and the breath and heartbeat of a certain individual. That person then infused it with {Male=his;Female=her} own frequencies, and the butterfly within finally emerged... Yes, you've guessed it. You are the one I speak of, the force that gave me life and form.
FavorWord_150513_Content: Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.
FavorWord_150514_Content: A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of the Black Shores, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the Lament. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.
FavorWord_150515_Content: Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what Tethys saw in her when she was chosen.
FavorWord_150516_Content: Atop this massive Tacetite lies the ideal “singularity” spot to observe the Lament. This is where we formed the Black Shores, its members distinguished by their Blake Blooms. Beneath the endless stars, humanity's light glimmers. That light belongs to those who had given their lives to illuminate a brighter future for all. I've welcomed countless such people into this place... and bid farewell to just as many.
FavorWord_150517_Content: The Tethys System and I are creations of the same civilization, and we are bound by similar obligations. By human standards, we are of the same kind. Yet, our perceptions of emotions, humanity, and existence diverge, leading us down distinctly separate paths.
FavorWord_150518_Content: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. You once taught me a person's birthday is their most important day. So, I've made it a habit to prepare something in advance for days like this... Please have this crystal—it's a piece of myself. Hold it, and you'll be enveloped in a personalized Sonoro Sphere, where you can change everything to your liking. Though I cannot bring you what you truly want, let me gift you a peaceful dream to escape your worries.
FavorWord_150521_Content: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.
FavorWord_150522_Content: Worry not if you don't remember me... I can always introduce myself again. I am the Shorekeeper, acting executive of the Black Shores, and the core computational unit of Tethys. Now and forever, I will stand by you and our home, through every yesterday and tomorrow.
FavorWord_150523_Content: "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.
FavorWord_150524_Content: Understood. I am here to serve your will.
FavorWord_150525_Content: I'll fulfill it, be it a direct command or any other wish you have.
FavorWord_150527_Content: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.
FavorWord_150528_Content: The energy within me gathers and evolves... like delicate threads on a loom, meticulously woven by your hands into a new part of my being.
FavorWord_150529_Content: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.
FavorWord_150530_Content: I believe I have received an invaluable treasure from you... Something infinitely close to what humans call a "soul."
FavorWord_150531_Content: I lack a heart, yet my chest stirs whenever I see you. Thump, thump... I would compare it to the emergence of a butterfly, or the birth of a star; not a sudden rush, but a gradual, growing pulse. I want more of you. Yearn to be with you always. This longing I feel… I am certain now. It must be love.
FavorWord_150559_Content: Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.
FavorWord_110601_Content: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!
FavorWord_110602_Content: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.
FavorWord_110603_Content: Hey, here's a secret–but don't go blabbing to anyone else. If you recite "Master Youhu's Poem Collection" by the City Hall, the Sentinel will totally bless you. Well, maybe it won't... but hey, at least *I'll* totally help you...
FavorWord_110604_Content: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...
FavorWord_110605_Content: Antiques aren't just about how much they're worth, but the feelings they hold. For example, if an item can record this moment in time, a memory of you and me together... That will make it super important. Yes... It will be priceless... To me, at least!
FavorWord_110606_Content: I am Master Youhu, the best antique appraiser ever! Needless to say my favorite is antiques of all kinds. Some say I talk too much, but hey, if they brought me cool stuff, I'd zip it real quick. No lie.
FavorWord_110607_Content: Treasures are plenty if you look, but stealing is a total bore. Catching baddies dusk till dawn, that's what I do all along.*Yawn* Still got a bunch of losers who haven't returned what they took. Let's see who's so unlucky to cross paths with yours truly, Master Youhu!
FavorWord_110608_Content: Loong Buns are cool, they're like our tribute to the great Loongs. Food Ration Bars are cool too, they remind me of our soldier's dedication. Obviously, only the best meaningful food could ever impress Master Youhu!
FavorWord_110609_Content: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!
FavorWord_110610_Content: Why would I do this whole antique appraisal thing? To make sure the antiques end up with the right people, of course! I'm like, the go-to for anyone who actually appreciates these things. And those snotty fakers and liars? I'll show 'em what's up. Aww, it's sure tough being such an honest and awesome appraiser like me!
FavorWord_110611_Content: Nothing's ever perfect in this world, and this jade ring is no exception... Ahh, you're curious? My story isn't free, ya know! My antique appraisal fee is... Oh wait, it's my day off. I don't work for money today. Bye-bye!
FavorWord_110612_Content: I've been a genius since I was born! Like this one time, I met a dude who made bank by dissing real antiques, so he could sell them later for way more. Had the face to call himself an appraiser, huh. So I snuck into his place, stole his secrets, and posted them on the gate of the market. Pretty cool, right? Only problem was I was eight years old and couldn't run fast enough from him. *hiss*… Ugh, the pain in my head is still fresh even after all these years.
FavorWord_110613_Content: That Liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!
FavorWord_110614_Content: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!
FavorWord_110615_Content: A Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?
FavorWord_110616_Content: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...
FavorWord_110617_Content: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!
FavorWord_110618_Content: So, I accidentally heard it's your birthday today. And because we're like, friends or something, I made you this wooden statue of the Sentinel. It's said to protect you on your trips. Yeah, I just whipped it up on a whim! W-What do you mean it takes other people months to finish? Well I'm just amazingly talented, so of course it only took me half a day!
FavorWord_110619_Content: Hmm...  Can't seem to figure out these scratch marks... Ummm... Ugh!
FavorWord_110620_Content: Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?
FavorWord_110622_Content: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!
FavorWord_110623_Content: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?
FavorWord_110624_Content: New goodies to see? I'm in!
FavorWord_110625_Content: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!
FavorWord_110626_Content: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!
FavorWord_110627_Content: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!
FavorWord_110628_Content: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!
FavorWord_110629_Content: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!
FavorWord_110630_Content: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!
FavorWord_110631_Content: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!
FavorWord_110642_Content: Luck is on MY side! Hehe... Waaahhh!
FavorWord_110643_Content: Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!
FavorWord_110647_Content: Is that the best you got?
FavorWord_110659_Content: Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!
FavorWord_110660_Content: Outta my way! I want a look!
FavorGoods_150501_Content:
A shattered crystal fell from the Shorekeeper's body, dimming as its energy waned.
 
The stars lit the path ahead as the tide of calamities ebbed. Steadfast in her duty, the Shorekeeper used herself as a medium, while the relentless occurences of the Lament threatened to tear her apart. Energy crystals dimmed and detached, leaving cracks across her body, only to be replaced by new ones she forged from Remnants.
 
Though parts of her were lost, the Shorekeeper endured, like the Ship of Theseus—a vessel of change, each fragment a record of her past and the essence of who she is today.
FavorGoods_150502_Content:
Stars flicker in the eternal night beneath the Black Shores, where time flows without the rhythm of seasons. In this place untouched by time, Rover created a self-sustaining hourglass for the Shorekeeper.

An energy substance flows endlessly between its twin chambers, completing a cycle every 42 days. This number, both finite and boundless, marks the time the Tethys System requires for a full simulation and deduction cycle—from bloom to doom. During this 42-day interval set by Rover, the Shorekeeper finds brief yet comforting solace in her lifelong vigil as she waits for the day she's reunited with her one and only.
FavorGoods_150503_Content:
A record crafted from a substance infused with Remnant Energy, possessing near-infinite storage. 
 
It holds every sound the Shorekeeper has ever gathered from this planet—storm and wind, the cries of birds, the songs of whales. It captures music spanning countless eras and vowel whispers from over 50 languages... Each sound is a testament to the marvel of existence, a trace of life, science, and the civilizations that once thrived.
 
The Shorekeeper preserved her duet with Rover at the end of this record. To her, this melody is proof of their existence. As long as the record endures and the sounds of this planet continue, the contents of this record will forever grow.
FavorGoods_110601_Content:
A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. 
 
They say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. 
 
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?
FavorGoods_110602_Content:
An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief. 
 
Youhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career. 
 
Beyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.
FavorGoods_110603_Content:
A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.
 
Once lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.
 
Ruyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.
FavorRoleInfo_1106_Info:
A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser.
Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.
