RGZYYYGJZ_6_2: So, they found nothing, but assumed Uncle wasn't concerned?
RGZYYYGJZ_6_3: That makes no sense. Everything that happened recently ties back to the vault. If Uncle wished to protect his position, he'd be quick to retrieve the items and resolve the situation.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_5: Maybe he's in control all along.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_7: Curiously, Benett was last sighted in the vicinity of <color=yellow>Liberty Square</color>, where you met Uncle.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_8: Last night, I was investigating the area before I happened upon your private meeting.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_9: That explains why you were there...
RGZYYYGJZ_6_10: But when I brought this up to him afterward, he didn't seem privy to any details.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_11: As for my search of Benett's home, nothing of note turned up, just as the two agents reported.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_12: I found no spoils, not even the faintest trace of them being stored or moved... Everything about his living space fits the profile of a typical junior vault employee.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_13: I've also asked around about Bennet after our previous collaboration. He was ambitious, but never greedy. I was even told he refused the bribe offered by a business associate during an operation.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_14: The Montelli family is ever generous with wealth and opportunities, welcoming all who aspire to make their mark in Ragunna. Mere profit would never make him betray us.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_17: For now, more evidence is required. The entire matter might need to be approached from a different angle...
RGZYYYGJZ_6_18: Shh, hold still... See that man over there, the one that looks like a gray dove?
RGZYYYGJZ_6_19: Without making a movement, you follow Carlotta's line of sight. Not far away, a man, partially hidden, is frequently glancing in your direction. He seems to be observing you and Carlotta.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_20: Noticing your gaze, he immediately starts running.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_1: The rain's back. I remember telling Grandfather how I hated the rainy season.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_2: I once saw rain as a bad omen in Ragunna.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_3: When it rains, it's easier to wash away blood stains. That's why acts of revenge usually happen on such days.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_4: But today's rain feels different. As it falls, the troubles of yesterday are washed away. I feel calm, like I've found my true self again. My present and my future are now in my own hands.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_5: Well done, Carlotta. And thank you, {PlayerName}.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_6: My girl could not have accomplished this without your assistance.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_7: She personally invited and vouched for me, after all.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_8: She is capable enough in her own right.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_9: I had faith in you two, but you surpassed my expectations.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_10: It appears I underestimated the potential that you possess when working together.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_11: What he just said... Looks like someone has been keeping secrets from me, huh?
RGZYYYGJZ_61_12: I've been curious, you entered that Sonoro and delivered his gun to me. How did you earn my grandfather's trust so soon?
RGZYYYGJZ_61_13: That's a story between the two of us.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_15: Hm, the nerve... Fine, since we make such a good team, I'll let it slide for now.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_17: Capollo and his lackeys will face the consequences of their actions. Our code is simple—vengeance for blood, death for life. No one is exempt.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_18: There's a lot at play here. It will require some effort and a true Montelli at my side to handle it.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_19: I see. I'll take care of the rest.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_24: Yes, I'll miss you. Who knows when I'll see you again.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_26: "No need to feel sad about parting, for each goodbye brings us closer to the next hello."
RGZYYYGJZ_61_27: That's my favorite way to think of it—a countdown to our next reunion.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_28: With Capollo ousted, the family needs someone to fill his shoes. I must assist my grandfather through this tumultuous transition. There is no one else to do it.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_29: Thank you, {PlayerName}. As my grandfather said, things couldn't have gone so smoothly without your help and support.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_30: Now that the dust has settled, you no longer need to stay with me as Cat's Eye of the Montelli family, but still... I want you to have this.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_31: As I said, every member gets a token that matches their codename.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_32: Though you already have a pair of Cat's Eyes, please accept this as a token of my appreciation. No, this gem wasn't crafted by my Forte. I chose it just for you.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_33: I know someone like you won't stay just for me, and joining the Montelli family might not be in your plans just yet.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_34: But I'll keep this codename for you, Cat's Eye—the first and only member to receive my personal invitation.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_1: Nowhere to run. Now it's time for a proper chat.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_2: Hah... These old, creaky bones of mine.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_3: Did I offend you? Or are you just chasing down every passing soul... Never thought the Montellis would grow so aggressive.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_5: Just a glance and you can tell we're Montellis?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_6: He had no choice but to run, to escape his past and sever any ties with the Montellis.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_7: No one knows the family's ways better than its members, even though... he is no longer one of us.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_9: Ha, hahaha... I must admit, you have an annoyingly good memory.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_10: It's remarkable that someone of your rank would remember a man such as myself.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_11: I will never forget that <color=yellow>stormy</color> night, nor any of the members who were caught in it.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_12: Sadly, I've no desire to be remembered. To me, Montelli is only a name of the past.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_13: There were moments of joy, but they cannot make up for my loss... now I only feel tired.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_14: If that's true, why are you here?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_15: You say one thing, but do another.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_16: Why go back to what you claim to have left in the past? Unless there's something you can't ignore.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_17: You were standing across from Benett's doorway, and your clothes are still damp from the rain... You weren't simply passing by, you were watching. What were you looking for? Or should I ask, what did you hope to find?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_19: To grieve for my last friend in the family? To blame him for being so reckless and greedy?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_20: Or to figure out how this fool ended up in such a mess, hoping to find the lost items and settling his debts, so he may rest in peace?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_21: I tried to persuade him to leave with me, but failed. In Ragunna's game, the Montelli family has only two options.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_22: We either play to win, or are forced to leave with nothing.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_23: Every Montelli has a chance at their desires, but what's the price... They stake everything they hold dear—family, love, faith, principles, and even their life.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_24: Now... his ambition and greed have cost him everything.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_25: But you can decide when to leave the table.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_26: Is that why you left the family?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_27: Most people find acceptance easier than change, as change demands the bravery to face uncertainty. No great endeavor is without its perils.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_28: So yes, if the Montellis are to drive the change and push past current barriers, the path ahead will be anything but easy.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_29: The family exists to withstand what an individual cannot, and accomplish what might otherwise be unattainable.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_30: But within the family, each Montelli still enjoys the freedom of choice. Your leaving is a testiment to this, is it not?
RGZYYYGJZ_7_31: If you're willing, there is still much to be done for Benett. His Terminal, the alleged stolen goods... everything but his body remains missing.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_32: Given your familiarity, you might help us in locating these items...
RGZYYYGJZ_7_33: Benett's death may not be as simple as it looks.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_34: We were also looking for more clues in his home.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_35: ...In that case, you might want to speak to Scarlet Velvet.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_37: The leader of a network of commoners seeking freedom in Ragunna City. They had close ties with Benett. If he was really stealing, I'd wager they were complicit.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_38: That said, with their recent fallout with the family, I can't guarantee you'll find them, let alone talk to them.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_39: We have little choice but to try.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_40: Now... let's go, {PlayerName}. We're off to the most reliable source of information in Ragunna.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_2: The best place for information... is a pub?
RGZYYYGJZ_8_3: I don't think Scarlet Velvet would hide somewhere so public.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_4: She may not be here, but I have my ways of reaching her people.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_5: In Ragunna's market, they say fortune seldom favors those who lack a taste for fine drinks.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_6: Among traders, there's a secret <color=yellow>"code"</color> in the way drinks are mixed.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_7: A base of bitter almond and mint, for instance, usually signals danger and death. But some have devised their own, more private codes.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_8: So they send messages by what they order.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_9: So it's not just a drink, it's a conversation.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_10: Yes. This area is essentially a neutral zone in the city. No affiliations, no restrictions.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_11: With the ongoing feud between Scarlet Velvet and the Montellis, finding her will be difficult. But I've heard they have eyes and ears here.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_12: So all that remains is to order the right drink, watch the crowd, and let their reactions lead us to Scarlet Velvet's contact.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_13: Greetings, what will it be today?
RGZYYYGJZ_8_15: Scarlet Velvet... An uncommon choice. Perhaps the one you seek is waiting just as patiently. May you both find what you've come for.
RGZYYYGJZ_9_1: The wild desires, they swallow me like the roaring waves. Oh, how maddening is your tender love! I'd forsake all, just to be forever lost in your embrace...
RGZYYYGJZ_9_3: But is this amber drink... a deadly poison, or a healing tonic?
RGZYYYGJZ_9_5: No, leave me be! Don't bother me!
RGZYYYGJZ_9_6: The void... the endless void has consumed me. I want no part in anything... Who are you, and who am I?
RGZYYYGJZ_9_7: Montelli, Fisalia, the Order, the commoners—without these names, what sets us apart? But reality is cruel, and we have no refuge!
RGZYYYGJZ_9_8: Seems like the alcohol has brought out his inner bard.
RGZYYYGJZ_9_9: Is he just drunk or completely out of it...
RGZYYYGJZ_9_10: For a moment, you sense a pair of eyes on you from where you picked up your drink. But as you turn to look, the feeling quickly fades away.
RGZYYYGJZ_9_11: Let's go. Clearly he's not the one we are looking for.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_1: With unyielding determination, the heroes accept the challenge!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_94_1: The Demon King summons its foul army, poised for a climactic battle with the heroes... The victor will soon be revealed.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_1: Amidst the clashing swords and the cries of the minions, the heroes face the Demon King—victory belongs to the righteous and the brave!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_2: And now, we await the Holy Maiden's return...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_3: And so we arrive at the "happily ever after," yes?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_4: But we do not live in a fairy tale. There is no playwright to script a happy ending for us... What lies behind the curtain is but a cruel jest, a dark satire.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_5: Let me reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending. The Holy Maiden has long succumbed to darkness, drawing power from a heretical force and leading her people into depravity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_6: And the minister, having uncovered this truth, has vowed to root out this corruption himself.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_13_1: (There are Fisalia markings on these crates. What's inside?)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_13_2: (Something's being wrapped in these strange frequencies. I should clear them out first.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_1: The cloud continues to spread. You may be right. This could be Imperator's test, but we must leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_2: Do as you please! I'm not leaving. The relic of the Ancient One is here somewhere. I must...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_3: How intriguing. These seem to be Reverberations hidden in the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_4: Perhaps you've heard that this was once the Order's seminary. It appears that even after the clouds consumed it, the Reverberations of its members linger on.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_5: Maybe the anomalies in the sea of clouds are stirring them to life once more.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_6: You seem very knowledgeable about all this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_7: Why yes, I've long been fascinated by Ragunna's history and art. After all, to chart our future, we must first understand our past. Is that not true?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_8: We're likely to encounter more Reverberations on our way. They may even contain vital information. You can search for more if you're curious.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_1: Lo! Foul monsters, taste my steel!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_2: "The Blessed Maiden smote the fiends who dared ascend the hallowed stairs. Yet the Dark Tide surged on, as more monsters poured forth from the mist."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_3: "In this fateful moment, the Blessed Maiden beheld her destiny's end. Moved by the Divinity, she chose to yield her life, for the Sentinel's cause and Rinascita's people."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_5: Wait, wait. Your tone sounds a bit off. The Blessed Maiden should be more determined.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_7: "In Imperator's name! Vile monsters! I swear your behinds shall be met with the end of my boots!"
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_8: I meant determined, not angry... You've got it all wrong!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_1:
Soft twilight hushes the day,
Moonlight dances, shadows sway.
Tranquil whispers fill the night,
Slumber's veil falls in quiet.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_2:
Twinkling stars, a celestial choir,
Sing softly to realms ever higher.
O Fair Lorelei, let your sorrow fade away,
May the good night forever stay.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_3:
Before the darkness falls, come sail with me,
Find haven in my boat upon the sea.
For soon the dawn will paint the sky anew,
And peace will find your heart, like morning dew.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_89_2: (Looks like someone's pulling their strings, just like at the rehearsal.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_89_3: (Need to find a way to stop them first.)
Entity_2bbaf7c358707b9146b0d8216ca3312a9: I'd like to deliver KU-Cass Cartridges.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_1: The upstairs parlor is off-limits, reserved for a private event.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_2: We gave you the heads-up before.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_3: Boss wanted a batch of gifts for our business partner.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_4: Hmm... Now that you mentioned it, yes, they did tell me about that. But weren't you supposed to arrive half an hour later?
RGZYYYGJZ_51_5: Half an hour is enough for me.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_7: Oh, I mean, I thought it was good to come here half an hour early.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_8: We can get ready sooner this way.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_9: You do have a point, but it's a special day. I need to confirm everyone's identity. What's your codename? Show me your token.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_10: (A token?... Tsk, I don't have one.)
RGZYYYGJZ_51_11: (Where's the promised handler? He should be here by now...)
RGZYYYGJZ_51_12: Hey, Tulip! Why are you still standing there? Come here! Boss just asked for you.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_13: The visitor slyly palms a Tulip coin, hiding the gesture in his shadow. You discreetly accept it and present it as proof of identity.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_14: Ah, Tulip coin... Oh! I remember you. You work at the vault, don't you? We had a drink at Margherita's.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_15: Don't tell me you've already forgotten me?
RGZYYYGJZ_51_16: No wonder you arrived early. You people at the vault are always one step ahead.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_17: Yeah, yeah, we can talk after getting the job done. Now hurry up, we'll deliver the gifts together.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_18: Huh? Uh, well... Yes, it's been awhile!

POI_HSBD_13_1: Scattered debris from a Lumiscale Construct lies on the ground.
POI_HSBD_13_2: Why would a Lumiscale Construct be here?
POI_HSBD_13_3: There's something carved on the ground...
POI_HSBD_13_8: Hey! I've been on guard this whole time!
POI_HSBD_13_9: These scraps look just like that thing we saw back on Mt. Firmament. The name is… right! Lumiscale Construct!
POI_HSBD_13_10: Except… this one smells different, like it's been broken since a long time ago.
POI_HSBD_13_12: "…Once Their people were safe, Imperator left the old capital and journeyed northeast…"
POI_HSBD_13_13: "...On the shore, the faithful watched as Imperator rode the waves and wind, until Their presence dissolved into the clouds…"
POI_HSBD_13_14: "Dissolved into the clouds"… if this inscription speaks true, then this shore is where Sentinel Imperator was last seen?
POI_HSBD_15_1: This pattern on the ground is identical to the one we found near that Lumiscale Construct.
POI_HSBD_15_2: Looks like the work of those Order folks.
POI_HSBD_16_2: Maybe we should light it up like last time?
POI_HSBD_17_1: These steles are even more worn out than the last ones…
POI_HSBD_18_1: {PlayerName}, the smell of those scraps has changed… I don't like the feel of this.

RGZYYYGJZ_44_1: Wow, look at you with your brilliant plan. So clever. It could have saved us from our humiliating defeat.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_2: And of course, you didn't just come up with it because you knew what happened... No, that idea has been brewing in your mind since that very day.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_3: How does it feel to finally have your dismissed plan validated?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_4: Back then... No one bothered to ask for your input, did they? The big shots like Capollo and those old timers couldn't care less.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_5: The family ended up making the worst possible choice. They called for reinforcements, depleting resources in both headquarters and the East End.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_6: No, Cynthia! Look at me, please... Why is this happening? The West End... It's all my fault. I should've been more careful...
RGZYYYGJZ_44_7: You're the only family I have left... "The Montelli's motto is Enterprise," huh... But there's no end to this enterprise, no end to the ambition, no end to chasing wealth…
RGZYYYGJZ_44_23: How much more do we have to lose?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_8: In the end, your dear grandfather had to step in and fix the mess you all made. The plan advanced, but the dead were forever gone. It stands as the greatest tragedy in our family's history.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_9: With that blood debt haunting you, you became the sharpest blade, working harder than ever to protect the family's interests.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_10: And Capollo... Did he think of seeking the Order's protection after that? When it became painfully clear that his power alone couldn't secure his ambitions.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_11: Come to think of it, what's so wrong with that? Sacrifices are inevitable, and someone must bear the burden.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_12: By doing so, the family's interests can be preserved. Is this not the balance you wish to maintain?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_13: You were never meant to make decisions for the family. Do you really have what it takes to reshape the order of things?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_14: No matter what you say, I must... stop him.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_15: Why? Didn't I just show you a better future than what you face now?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_16: Merely an illusion of your making! My choices may have altered the outcome, but it's impossible to prove now.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_17: The past is set in stone. We only have one path before us.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_18: Yes, the cold rain from that night still haunts us. But we cannot be shackled by the past.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_19: I might not be in charge, but my principles are clear. Every action I take is for the benefit of the family.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_20: I must leave here and stop Capollo. Whatever the consequence.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_22: Hmm... You're unshakable, aren't you? So you've made up your mind already?
RGZYYYGJZ_44_21: Our negotiations have reached a dead end. Then I'll need to try something else to make you stay.

POI_HSBD_14_1: What happened? An earthquake? Ugh, I feel giddy...
POI_HSBD_19_1: Ahhh! Why is it moving now?!
POI_HSBD_21_1: This inscription says the Order believes this is where Imperator was last seen.
POI_HSBD_21_2: So, they made these steles to honor the Sentinel... That's pretty impressive!
POI_HSBD_21_3: But the wind is really strong here. We need to watch our steps.
POI_HSBD_22_1: Can we slow down a bit? Seriously, I'm feeling dizzy...
POI_HSBD_22_2: How about you just get off me and fly on your own?
POI_HSBD_22_3: No, never mind. Wouldn't wanna get swept away by the wind...
POI_QSMG_1_1: With humility, justice, and bravery... I vow never to use force against women, children, or the defenseless. I will stand against injustice until my last breath.
POI_QSMG_1_3: How's that, Mr. Cosimo? I didn't miss a word. Can we start the knighting ceremony now?
POI_QSMG_1_4: Well, you recited it perfectly, but... I'm no longer part of the Order. What you have before you now is only a simple innkeeper. I'm afraid... I've no right to knight you.
POI_QSMG_1_5: I do have some old friends still in the Order. If you can wait a bit longer I can...
POI_QSMG_1_6: No right? I can't wait any longer! Every time we get this far, Mr. Cosimo, you always come up with one excuse after the other to delay the ceremony.
POI_QSMG_1_8: Watch your words, Carlow! Accusations like that betray everything you just swore to uphold. And to say such things in front of an outlander?
POI_QSMG_1_10: I... forgive me. But... Mr. Cosimo, tell me the truth. You don't really believe I saw a knight when I was a child, do you?
POI_QSSLD_1_2: {PlayerName}, I smell something weird, right under our feet!
POI_QSSLD_1_3: (Could there be something hidden under the water? I should look around.)
POI_QSSLD_14_1: What is this? An empty sword pedestal? There are more of them nearby.
POI_QSSLD_14_3: So, we need to find those swords to get things moving, huh? But where are we gonna find them?
POI_QSSLD_14_4: On the pedestal, there's a tale about a knight called "Silver Moon." Maybe we can discover something at the places recorded.
POI_QSSLD_2_1: When the scorching sun falls, the silver moon shall rise again.
POI_QSSLD_3_1: That knight's truly somethin'! But what happened between him and the five knights we met before? And why did they take his swords?
POI_QSSLD_3_2: My guess is that the five knights represent the trials this knight once faced. After he died, those memories transformed into Tacet Discords.
POI_QSSLD_3_4: Then… did this knight pass his trials or not?
POI_QSSLD_3_6: Maybe only the "Silver Moon" himself knows.
POI_QSSLD_3_7: The truth behind the legends can often be misleading.
POI_QSSLD_3_8: Maybe. Being a knight sounds super exhausting, one challenge after another...
POI_QSSLD_3_9: It's those challenges that made his title truly worthy.
POI_QSSLD_3_10: I see! So if we keep facing every challenge, our names will have a lot more worth as well! Alright then, we've got a long journey ahead!
PKDSJ_HHA_1_1: Woo-hoo! Master, is there any other place you want to go?
PKDSJ_HHA_2_1: Use the portals to connect the device and the core.
PKDSJ_HHA_3_1: Master, there seems to be a powerful enemy on the other side of this mysterious portal. Would you like to check it out?

YYYHZG_1_1: Great Sentinel above, can you hear me?
YYYHZG_1_2: Please guide me out of this treacherous land!
YYYHZG_1_4: Ahhh! Don't come any closer! The Sentinel will not spare you!
YYYHZG_10_1: Ah? Why are there so many Gondolas here?
YYYHZG_10_2: Could they be attracted by the music?
YYYHZG_10_3: We don't need your assistance, Divine Envoys of the Sentinel.
YYYHZG_10_4: It wouldn't be good if my little trial were to disrupt the duty the Sentinel has entrusted to us all!
YYYHZG_10_5: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, please, help me persuade the Gondolas to leave! We Acolytes must refrain from being too close to the Echoes!
YYYHZG_10_7: Let them enjoy this music, too.
YYYHZG_10_9: We cannot allow our personal goals to interfere with the workings of the Sentinel's envoys!
YYYHZG_10_10: "Crystal Sky" is a hymn of praise for the Sentinel's supreme power, a reminder that each breath, each heartbeat, is watched over by Their loving gaze.
YYYHZG_10_11: If the waterways fall into disorder because of the Gondolas' idleness, surely the Sentinel will be displeased!
YYYHZG_10_12: Maybe the Sentinel is just giving you directions.
YYYHZG_10_13: Not trying to control every aspect of your life?
YYYHZG_10_14: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, why do you entertain such blasphemous thoughts? To question the Sentinel's authority… even an outlander could be sent on a pilgrimage for that!
YYYHZG_10_15: I'll pretend I didn't hear anything. No, no—I mean, you didn't say anything at all!
YYYHZG_10_16: You tell Lenore about the two times you saw the white phantoms.
YYYHZG_10_17: So... you saw white phantoms lingering in Nimbus Sanctum, preaching blasphemous thoughts?
YYYHZG_10_18: This is the first time I've heard of such things.
YYYHZG_10_19: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, let me accompany you this time!
YYYHZG_10_20: Don't you need to stay here?
YYYHZG_10_21: No. Whatever my personal ambitions, stopping this blasphemy is of far greater importance.
YYYHZG_10_22: Follow me, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}—we'll need a Gondola to reach the third location.
YYYHZG_10_23: Oh, you're offering us a ride? Thank you, Divine Envoys of the Sentinel. See? I told you the Sentinel has been watching over us!
YYYHZG_10_24: I don't even know what to say.
YYYHZG_10_25: You literally just told me to drive them away.
YYYHZG_13_1: Looks like the Tacet Discords are here to hunt down the phantoms.
YYYHZG_13_2: How dare they… I cannot fathom anyone so blind to the Sentinel's grace, even before the rise of the Order of the Deep.
YYYHZG_13_3: Those people... They lived beneath the Sentinel's watchful eye without acknowledging Their kindness. They even claimed the miracles of the Sentinel as their own!
YYYHZG_13_4: It was this kind of blasphemy that angered the Sentinel and brought forth the Dark Tide! This is why the world needs the Order's guidance now more than ever, don't you see?
YYYHZG_13_5: Is the Sentinel you believe in truly so unforgiving and cruel?
YYYHZG_13_6: Remember, these are the same people who composed the Nimbus Chorale.
YYYHZG_13_7: I... but I... No! This isn't it!
YYYHZG_13_8: Verse 10, Chapter 2 of the Tenets, "Though your spirit trembles, you must not forsake piety. Though your spirit trembles, you must not forsake piety..." Calm down, calm down, calm down!
YYYHZG_13_9: Who wrote this "Tenets of the Deep"? You've been reciting it over and over.
YYYHZG_13_10: The Tenets are a code of conduct for all who follow the Order with true devotion. They were meticulously refined by the Primus himself to guide us through the ages.
YYYHZG_13_11: After the Dark Tide twenty years ago, His Holiness Fenrico stated that the Order's leniency toward disorder had invited the calamity. In response, he revised the sacred text and urged all faithful to live by it always.
YYYHZG_13_12: I feared the book would become worn from constant use, so I memorized every word, every line!
YYYHZG_13_13: So, the current version of your Tenets...
YYYHZG_13_15: To be honest I don't know myself. The older prints have all been confiscated and destroyed.
YYYHZG_13_16: Do you still have other questions, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}?
YYYHZG_13_18: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, I am not the brightest among my peers, but I do understand what you've been hinting at. You are a kind person, that I can tell.
YYYHZG_13_19: But let's turn our focus to listening to the Nimbus Chorale. Perhaps the music itself will speak where words cannot. Come, let's listen!
YYYHZG_14_1: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, something feels amiss... Do you feel it too?
YYYHZG_14_2: I think it lacks that human touch.
YYYHZG_14_3: I guess you'll say it needs to praise the Sentinel more?
YYYHZG_14_4: Human touch? No, it should be praising the Sentinel!
YYYHZG_14_6: The Carnevale is a holiday for everyone to gather and give thanks to our beloved Sentinel. I'm certain there's another part of the Chorale that shows our true reverence.
YYYHZG_17_2: This is the site of the Order of the Deep's Major Forbidden Archive—well, the former site.
YYYHZG_17_3: After the Dark Tide, it was buried beneath Nimbus Sanctum along with all of its secrets.
YYYHZG_17_4: I thought you've always wanted to go to the Major Forbidden Archive?
YYYHZG_17_5: Do you want to go in and have a look?
YYYHZG_17_6: Me? No, no. I can't go in there.
YYYHZG_17_7: It holds the most dangerous books and ideas, and only the most devout believers are allowed inside.
YYYHZG_17_8: I-I'm not ready yet… O Sentinel, please forgive me.
YYYHZG_17_9: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, would you be willing to defeat the beast within and bring back the Nimbus Chorale's final part? It will surely celebrate the glory of the Sentinel.
YYYHZG_17_11: I'm taking all the treasure, you know.
YYYHZG_17_12: Thank you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! I swear by Lenore—the name given to me by His Holiness the Primus—that I will repay this kindness with all my heart.
YYYHZG_17_13: Haha, that's all right, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! As Verse 9, Chapter 1 of the Tenets of the Deep says: "The great Sentinel has scattered Their blessings upon Rinascita, satisfying the needs of Their people in full measure."
YYYHZG_17_14: You could say the treasures within are waiting for a righteous hero like you to claim them!
YYYHZG_17_15: I'll pray for you here and ask the Sentinel to guide you, just as They guided the first believers.
YYYHZG_2_1: It's a miracle! The great Sentinel heard my prayers!
YYYHZG_2_2: I was the one who heard you.
YYYHZG_2_3: I don't understand, kind {Male=sir;Female=lady}... Weren't you sent by the Sentinel to save me?
YYYHZG_2_4: My sense of justice guided me here.
YYYHZG_2_5: I just heard someone in distress.
YYYHZG_2_6: I see... Please pardon my rashness, Righteous One. Thank you for your sense of honor.
YYYHZG_2_10: Why do you look like you're getting ready to become a martyr?
YYYHZG_2_11: It's called the Minor Forbidden Archive. We have two: one big, one small. The Major Forbidden Archive is where we store all the really dangerous books, tales, and ideologies. Only the most devout servants of the Sentinel are permitted to serve there!
YYYHZG_2_12: As for the Minor Forbidden Archive... well, it's where we keep the expired or incomplete documents, notes, and such...
YYYHZG_2_13: But of course, it still takes a truly devout follower like me to be assigned to work there!
YYYHZG_2_14: That's right, I am Dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive! Although, for the past eight years, it's just been me...  But I have read and recited the Dean's code of conduct over and over again. I hold myself to the highest standards a dean can!
YYYHZG_2_15: Verse 15, Chapter 6 of the Tenets of the Deep declares, "Those who aspire to achieve extraordinary deeds must bear extraordinary resolve."
YYYHZG_2_16: What I'm about to undertake is the unprecedented restoration of the Nimbus Chorale. I am prepared to give up my life for it!
YYYHZG_2_17: I will cross the treacherous Nimbus Sanctum, battle ferocious Tacet Discords... and, well, I may have to face the wrath of the Queen of the Night herself... Uhh...
YYYHZG_2_18: It sounds like a suicide mission.
YYYHZG_2_20: But I have to do this. I've spent eight long years working at the Minor Forbidden Archive. If I linger any longer, Phoebe and the others will surpass me. I must set a good example for them!
YYYHZG_2_21: Oh, I nearly forgot. "Do not gnaw on a fool's worries." Yes, off I go!
YYYHZG_2_22: Hold up. What if I said I can help?
YYYHZG_2_23: I cannot accept such a thing! The Tenets of the Deep solemnly instruct, "A trial that is aided by an outside hand is no true trial." Verse 9, Chapter 12.
YYYHZG_2_24: Consider it a collaboration. The musical records are yours, but the rest of the finds belong to me.
YYYHZG_2_25: Uh, I mean... I'm sorry, but may I ask why you're offering to help me?
YYYHZG_2_26: Phoebe once helped me. Think of this as me returning the favor.
YYYHZG_2_27: I think there will be plenty of treasures to be found on this trip.
YYYHZG_2_28: Well... I think you're kinda cute.
YYYHZG_2_29: So you're Phoebe's friend. How time files... That young girl who once hid behind me has grown into a capable Acolyte. O Great Sentinel, is this part of your grand design as well?
YYYHZG_2_30: Good. We both help each other, that way, it won't feel like relying on outside aid. Let us join hands then! And of course, I will repay you for saving my life once this is over!
YYYHZG_2_31: Cute? Me? I... I'm just an ordinary woman! If we passed each other on the street, you wouldn't even give me a second glance.
YYYHZG_2_32: People always say Phoebe's the cute one. You saying that... well, it makes me a little embarrassed. I haven't even...
YYYHZG_2_33: Ugh! What am I even thinking! Please... forget I spoke of this at all.
YYYHZG_2_34: Ahem. Well, Righteous One, we still need to discuss how we will recover the Nimbus Chorale.
YYYHZG_2_35: First of all, please just call me {PlayerName}.
YYYHZG_2_36: Secondly, what exactly is the Nimbus Chorale?
YYYHZG_2_37: Ah, silly me, I almost forgot!
YYYHZG_2_38: The Nimbus Chorale is a symphony that was once played during the ancient Carnevales of Rinascita, but it was lost to time after the arrival of the Dark Tide.
YYYHZG_2_39: I've been studying all sorts of historical records within the Order for the last few months, alongside journals of our ancestors' lives in Rinascita. With this research, I've narrowed down the possible locations.
YYYHZG_2_40: Lord Primus just announced the Carnevale is to be revived this year. If I can recover this ancient symphony in its entirety, it will surely add a touch of grandeur to the festivities! The others, Phoebe especially, will look at me with newfound respect, hehe!
YYYHZG_2_41: Ah, but wait... I'm getting ahead of myself. Sorry, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, let's get moving!
YYYHZG_2_42: I understand. As the Tenets reveal, "To know oneself is paramount; to overstep is perilous." Verse 2, Chapter 2. I shall remain here, awaiting your return.
YYYHZG_2_43: May the blessings of the Sentinel be with you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}!
YYYHZG_4_1: You're back so soon, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! I am in awe!
YYYHZG_4_2: It was easier than I expected.
YYYHZG_4_3: It was more difficult than I expected.
YYYHZG_4_4: May I join you next time? I wouldn't want the Sentinel to think me... soft, allowing you to shoulder all the burden.
YYYHZG_4_5: Forgive me! It must've been when I faltered in my prayers. The Sentinel saw my distraction... I will stay focused next time!
YYYHZG_4_6: Now, shall we listen to the record you've recovered? It's a part of the revered Nimbus Chorale, after all!
YYYHZG_5_1: How splendid! So this is the first section of the Nimbus Chorale, "Soil of Abundance"... What a beautiful depiction of the Sentinel's mercy!
YYYHZG_5_3: I don't think it's anything special.
YYYHZG_5_5: Hmm... Maybe it's because you're not native to Rinascita, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}.
YYYHZG_5_6: As stated in the Tenets, "The Sentinel granted abundance to Rinascita, and we must bow low, our foreheads kissing the earth in gratitude."
YYYHZG_5_7: For believers such as us, a piece of music dedicated to the fertile soil is proof of the Sentinel's boundless mercy!
YYYHZG_5_8: I don't think this fertile soil was a gift from on high.
YYYHZG_5_9: Your ancestors worked hard over the ages to make it fruitful.
YYYHZG_5_10: Wh-where did you hear such audacious words?! How could anyone dare to place the strength of mankind above the will of our Sentinel?
YYYHZG_5_11: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, please, you must not speak of this in the presence of others!
YYYHZG_5_12: Long ago, someone dared to profane the Order by spreading rumors about the Sentinel. That's why the current Primus Fenrico has forbidden even private discussions about the Sentinel. It's considered dangerous heresy now!
YYYHZG_5_13: You are an outlander, but I fear your views might be misinterpreted...
YYYHZG_5_14: That sounds like an extreme policy.
YYYHZG_5_15: Are they so strict even with outlanders?
YYYHZG_5_16: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, do you know of the Dark Tide? It was a calamity from the heavens, an abyss that consumed all. The tide of desecration destroyed countless families, including my own.
YYYHZG_5_17: In our darkest hour, it was the Blessed Maiden who gave her life to seal away the darkness. It was His Holiness the Primus who beseeched the Sentinel's mercy. Our unwavering faith saved us all.
YYYHZG_5_18: As His Holiness Fenrico once said: "Faith is the cornerstone of Rinascita, and any questioning of our faith and the Order will lead to another Dark Tide."
YYYHZG_5_20: But we have more pressing matters now. I'll send you the coordinates of the next location.
YYYHZG_5_21: Perhaps you should join me this time.
YYYHZG_5_23: I'm getting tired of running back and forth.
YYYHZG_5_24: The Tacet Discords only seem to target those holding the musical record.
YYYHZG_5_25: Oh, I'm so sorry for my negligence!
YYYHZG_9_1: Phew! {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, I was worried to death. Is everything all right?
YYYHZG_9_3: I ran into a little trouble.
YYYHZG_9_4: Whew! That's great. Seems I was too rattled by the earlier attack.
YYYHZG_9_5: I see... I must confess, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, in my nervousness, I failed to pray for you just now. But I'm relieved you're unharmed!
YYYHZG_9_6: Now then, let's listen to the second part together. I believe it's called "Crystal Sky."
YYYHZG_9_7: Wait, before we continue... According to my research, the correct way to listen to the Nimbus Chorale is to play the multiple parts layered on top of each other at once!
YYYHZG_9_9: I'm sure there's a reason, but let's keep it short.
YYYHZG_9_10: According to the Order's Ancestral Records, the Nimbus Chorale can only be experienced fully through the collaboration of many.
YYYHZG_9_11: The performers normally hail from various parts of Rinascita and only come together during the Carnevale. It's the one time it's ever performed in full!
YYYHZG_9_12: Much of the official records were lost during the Dark Tide, but I've painstakingly reconstructed the fragments from every available source to reach this conclusion!
YYYHZG_9_13: Each record includes just one instrument's part. Only when all of them are played together can the true Nimbus Chorale be heard.
YYYHZG_9_14: Phoebe would've loved a detailed explanation. If only she were here...
YYYHZG_9_15: Anyway, let's listen to it now!

Speaker_50139_Name: A Segment of Davide's Voyage Log
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_2: The Demon King reveals itself at last, exposing its hideous visage and sharp fangs. The final showdown is nigh!
POI_QSMG_12_1: My sword stands ready! The gods blessed it, so it will always be sharp. By the knight's code, I hereby challenge you to a duel!
POI_QSMG_12_2: ...No, no! That sounded weak. Let me try again!
POI_QSMG_12_4: A black armor, a well-crafted sword in hand... and a flying servant. Are you the foreign knight and the sword spirit passing through Egla Town?
POI_QSMG_12_9: Ah, say no more. If you want to prove you mean no harm, we must duel! A duel settles everything!
POI_QSMG_12_10: The boy playing knight seems to have nothing but dueling on his mind. You have no choice but to walk away.
POI_QSMG_13_1: Greetings, honorable chevalier from afar. I presume you wish Egla Town to be your starting point to distant horizons?
POI_QSMG_13_2: Well, you're in luck! I offer a range of... services that might just pique your interest.
POI_QSMG_13_4: Oh, you know—sharp blades, swift steeds. A promising knight like yourself deserves only the finest gear for the road ahead.
POI_QSMG_13_5: Is this little flying fellow your servant? Well, it could certainly use a more dashing ensemble. Perhaps I could have something tailor-made...
POI_QSMG_14_1: The craftsmanship of this wax seal is simply exquisite. And is that a floral scent?
POI_QSMG_14_2: Don't get too cocky. You're not the only one with an invitation. It seems like one of those Ragunna nobles is hosting a banquet to recruit new knights for their household.
POI_QSMG_14_3: A banquet... That means plenty of nobles will be attending. Perhaps...
POI_QSMG_14_4: You might want to polish up on your basic etiquette first. I wouldn't want to see you make a fool of yourself in front of all those fussy Ragunna nobles.
POI_QSMG_14_5: Fine, Fine. It's just... a matter of remembering how it goes, right?
POI_QSMG_16_1: Ah, outlander. You're up rather early in the hour, aren't you? What can I do for you?
POI_QSMG_16_2: It's about a knight, Mr. Cosimo. Have you ever heard an oath that goes like this...
POI_QSMG_16_3: "In the name of Korlacchi, I pledge to show mercy and kindness to the weak. Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all..."
POI_QSMG_16_5: You observe Cosimo closely as Abby delivers its spot-on impression of the Mad Knight. The slight dilation of his pupil gives away the answer you need.
POI_QSMG_16_10: Hmm, there's a line missing. In the name of Korlacchi, I will remain true to all that I love and protect until my last breath.
POI_QSMG_16_11: Where did you learn those words? Was it from Carlow?
POI_QSMG_16_12: Carlow? No, no, we only met him yesterday. It's from the night...
POI_QSMG_16_14: Oh, it's from... it's from a knight who loves the night. He was the one who told us.
POI_QSMG_16_15: This knight you speak of. Where did you meet him? Is he still around town?
POI_QSMG_16_17: ...So, Carlow really did meet a knight. It's just like the day he came dashing over to me, reciting those same words you did.
POI_QSMG_16_19: I thought he read those in a book. But he insisted that he heard it from a knight passing by.
POI_QSMG_16_20: I had a feeling that Korlacchi might be a family name and that the knight's oath reflected his path of service, so I asked Carlow about the knight's livery.
POI_QSMG_16_21: Carlow described how the knight dismounted from a weathered warhorse, clad in silver armor. He removed his helmet and laid his hands on Carlow's head.
POI_QSMG_16_22: Then he pulled a ring from his pocket and told Carlow he would continue his journey into the depths of Whisperwind Haven, seeking distant horizons.
POI_QSMG_16_23: He asked if Carlow wanted to be a knight and gave him this ring as a keepsake, telling Carlow to rewalk his path one day.
POI_QSMG_16_24: To reach the end where he had arrived, and then... to journey even further.
POI_QSMG_16_25: But this ring is made from coarse steel. Nothing like what Carlow described.
POI_QSMG_16_27: So I had my doubts about Carlow's tale. I thought he'd gotten lost in those knightly stories and made it all up.
POI_QSMG_16_29: He... At this hour, I imagine he's roaming the outskirts of town, searching for the knight's trails.
POI_QSMG_16_30: He intends to find the knight and the family he serves to complete the knighting ceremony in Korlacchi's name and finally become a true knight.
POI_QSMG_16_31: There's a large tree not far from town, where he said he found the first trail. Do you plan to go after him?
POI_QSMG_16_32: Do you think you can catch up with that knight? If you can, please help the poor boy find the knighthood he's been dreaming about.
POI_QSMG_2_1: The young man politely bids you goodbye and leaves in silence...
POI_QSMG_3_1: What a boy... Sorry about the ruckus, outlander. Are you checking in? If not, it's getting late. You wouldn't want to be caught out there during the Night Reveries.
POI_QSMG_3_4: Yes. You probably noticed the graffiti, statues, and signs all scattered across town, no?
POI_QSMG_3_7: Now that you mentioned it, we did see a bunch of kids running around with wooden swords and bedsheets for capes.
POI_QSMG_3_8: Ah, those youngsters are just reenacting the knight's play. The Night Reveries are a kind of a performance, too. They can be traced back to the legend of a brave knight who slayed a giant in Whisperwind Haven.
POI_QSMG_3_9: Since then, the legendary knight has become an irreplaceable symbol of humility, honor, and bravery for the town. The oath the boy just recited is one of the legacies the knight left us.
POI_QSMG_3_10: Knights from far and wide would gather here before setting off to the depth of Whisperwind Haven in search of the legend's origin.
POI_QSMG_3_12: As more knights filled our streets, an odd one emerged. These days, folks like to call him the "Mad Knight."
POI_QSMG_3_13: He only shows himself after dusk. Folks say he roams the outskirts, hunting down Tacet Discords. Get too close, and you might find yourself on the sharp end of his blade!
POI_QSMG_3_14: That's how he became the "Mad Knight," the talk of the town. We reckon he's cursed now from wrestling with those wretches for so long.
POI_QSMG_3_16: To placate this restless soul, the town created the Night Reveries—endless dramas of the knight enacted by the Echoes. Townsfolk and visitors alike were advised to stay indoors at night.
POI_QSMG_3_18: But... there's one lad who stands apart. Fancies that the knight isn't mad at all. He believes a true knight would never betray their oath, no matter the cost.
POI_QSMG_3_19: For him, every swing of a knight's sword must carry meaning. To prove his theory, the boy is hell-bent on becoming a knight and challenging the Mad Knight to a duel.
POI_QSMG_3_23: Yes, Carlow. We all thought it was just another childhood fantasy, but he's held onto that dream to this day.
POI_QSMG_3_24: Becoming a knight doesn't sound too bad. Hehe, you get all the cool points plus who can resist that suit of armor?!
POI_QSMG_3_25: True, but those are knights who have earned their reputations. Maintaining <ano=purity>"knighthood"</ano> is a thing of the past now.
POI_QSMG_3_26: Oh, look at the time! Apologies for rambling on, traveler. If you need a place to stay, just let me know.
POI_QSMG_3_33: (Could it be a symptom of Overclocking?)
POI_QSMG_4_3: So you're thinking that knight-guy's Overclocked, huh? I don't know, but one thing's for sure I'm picking up a bunch of familiar smells all over this place.
POI_QSMG_4_4: Come on, it's not far now. The Echoes are getting ready for their opening act, all set to welcome the star of the night.
POI_QSMG_5_1: Sheesh. Look at 'em go! They look like they're gearing up for a loony party instead of a proper knightly display.
POI_QSMG_6_1: A Tacet Discord... To its credit, that's not a bad knight impression.
POI_QSMG_6_2: What's all that about? Is it challenging us to a duel?
POI_QSMG_7_2: "Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all..."
POI_QSMG_8_1: That voice just now... Did you hear that, Abby?
POI_QSMG_8_2: And also... What was that in the end...?
POI_QSMG_8_3: TDs usually mumble the stuff they're trying to say. It might've learned it from somewhere, or maybe the frequencies it absorbed had strong emotions and desires.
POI_QSMG_8_4: In the name of Korlacchi... seems like something a knight might say before charging into battle.
POI_QSMG_8_9: I can't wait to see the townsfolk's faces when they find out the legendary Mad Knight is actually a TD.
POI_QSMG_8_11: Let's ask Cosimo about those mumblings in the morning. He might know a thing or two.
POI_QSMG_8_12: Sure thing. Come to think of it, I feel like we're being pretty knightly ourselves right now, don't you think?
POI_QSMG_8_13: I, Abby, and the great knight {PlayerName}, two heroes who solved a legendary mystery with humility, justice, and bravery... Heh, a knighting ceremony would make it even cooler.
POI_QSMG_8_15: Titles don't hold much value for me.

POI_QSMG_17_1: Sounds like something is going on between the Mad Knight and the knight Carlow met as a kid. But one of 'em is a TD while the other one's a human. How are they...?
POI_QSMG_17_2: The Mad Knight's trails may lead us to the truth. Let's keep it between ourselves for now until we find Carlow.
POI_QSMG_18_1: Why's he just sitting here like a statue? Hey, Carlow! Can ya hear me?
POI_QSMG_18_2: Abby, there's something strange about this floating Echo...

Flow_134000001_322: With the Anchor at the TD Observatory restored, a true frequency rises from the depths, bringing a voice to your mind. It reveals that your awakening in the Gorges of Spirits was no mere coincidence. Before Yangyang found you, a mysterious figure had been watching your every move...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_18: It's fine. I do appreciate the noble lady's sentiment—a wise investment often bears fruit in the most unexpected ways.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_19: We're simply spreading the truth through a tale. I'm certain it will pique your interest, so consider this a heartfelt invitation to you and your companions.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_20: Join us, pour your essence into this endless play, and use your humble strength to defy the raging current of fate!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_9: I have many questions for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_13: Beyond the clouds and among the stars... thou shalt find an inverted tower suspended in the sky—I am there, watching over Solaris from above.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_14: The Lost... doth wander briefly amongst thy kind...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_15: Seek her out… She, too, doth move within the folds of this festival...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_11: I'm sorry, but I can't stay here any longer. I must return...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_12: Can you tell me your name before you go?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_14: Fl… No, I'm Cartethyia… Yes, that's right. Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_15: Farewell, Laureate! I hope that someday, I might stand on stage with your troupe.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_16: Are you alright, {PlayerName}? Some family members mentioned you were speaking to a wall… I'm worried you might still be under Phrolova's spell.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_17: A wall? You didn't see her?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_18: See who? Are you truly alright?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_19: There was a girl here just now. She called herself Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_20: The Sentinel led me to a girl just now.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_21: Cartethyia… I'll make a note of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_22: If she was indeed here, she is likely still in Ragunna. I will have my family start searching.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_23: Let's not alarm the public just yet.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_24: We should let the Carnevale continue as planned.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_25: There are still many unresolved questions regarding the Order and the Sentinel. We need time to sort through what we've gathered.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_26: Rushing into action now might only alert the Order's spies and disrupt what we've worked so hard to protect.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_28: Cartethyia... I will have my family find out more about her.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_29: If we find anything, I'll contact you, and we can discuss our next steps together.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_3: Come closer, Righteous One, there's no need for hesitation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_4: I am Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep. Your deeds have reached my ears, and I have long wished to meet you. Alas, the burdens of this world delayed our meeting until now. I beg your pardon for the wait.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_5: Please accept my respect for you—you and your troupe have shown great talent and ambition, breathing new life into Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_6: I ask you to deliver this message to your companions: from this day forth, the troupe shall have permanent rights to perform within the city.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_9: All mortals stumble, but through pilgrimage, they have cleansed their souls and atoned for their transgressions. They have earned their right to return to this divinely blessed land.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_10: I understand that questions weigh on your heart. In the presence of a just Divinity, speak freely, and I will answer with all the honesty I possess.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_11: By the great Sentinel Imperator, I swear to you. There shall be no deceit in my words.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_12: I want to meet the Sentinel Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_13: You have walked a path similar to Theirs. Indeed, you have the right to meet Them.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_14: However, due to the Dark Tide two decades ago, the Sentinel's body was gravely wounded and remains in a state of recovery.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_15: If you wish to meet Them, I will convey your request.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_16: I see the thirst for truth in your eyes. It is clear that doubts still linger in your heart. Please, voice your concerns.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_17: Tell me about the Blessed Fleurdelys.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_18: Fleurdelys... She was the emissary of the Sentinel, and we are grateful for her contributions.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_19: Twenty years ago, during the Dark Tide, she sacrificed herself to seal the calamity. She fulfilled her duties in this world and returned to the <color=yellow>divine embrace</color>.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_21: Do you know how the Dark Tide came into being?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_22: In Rinascita, wars were waged in the name of faith, tearing apart the Sentinel as our faith divided, weakening Their divine power.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_23: The Dark Tide's true essence is the divine blood shed from the Sentinel's wounds.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_24: That tragic past left deep scars, and with Their divine power drained, They could not prevent the Dark Tide's surge twenty years ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_25: The Blessed Maiden chose to martyr herself. She <color=yellow>once again</color> resonated with the Sentinel and, through her sacrifice, restored some of Their divine power, bringing an end to the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_26: Yet, the Sentinel remains in a state of healing and still requires a mortal representative. Following the Blessed Maiden's departure, I was granted new authority to cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_27: I received the Divinity's blessing and became the new Enlightened One. By Their will, I fulfill the tasks left unfinished in this world.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_28: Therefore, we must unify all beliefs, ensuring the purity and unity of our will to prevent another tragedy...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_29: (Reflect on the Blessed Maiden's Second Resonance with the Sentinel.)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_30: (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_33: I swear, my words are without deceit.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_34: I see in your eyes that you have walked further on the path of justice than I anticipated.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_35: O dear Sentinel… please forgive my transgressions.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_36: The Dark Tide brought us a bloodstained lesson. To keep our people from faltering, I bound myself to silence, locking away what I witnessed on that fateful day.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_38: Fleurdelys, the Unrighteous, deceived us all. She was not the Blessed Maiden chosen by the Sentinel... The true maiden has yet to reveal herself.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_39: Why did people believe she was the Blessed Maiden?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_40: Where did her power to seal the Dark Tide come from?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_41: You must know that a being capable of rivaling our Divinity exists in this world—humanity's eternal adversary, the evil of all civilizations... the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_42: As the Sentinel has Their Resonator, so does the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_44: Fleurdelys was shaped—both body and spirit—by our ancient enemy. Her actions were intended to plunge this city into fear and chaos.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_45: This is the truth I witnessed—Fleurdelys was the <color=yellow>Threnodian's Resonator</color>.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_47: Never before have I seen a day so steeped in both shadow and light.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_48: The birds sing, the flowers bloom… yet this world knows neither true joy nor eternity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_1: Phrolova, you do have a knack for indulging in... pointless little chores.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_2: Why, there's no rule against an actor making good use of the intermission.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_3: Besides, I haven't disrupted your arrangement, have I?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_4: "The one from a faraway land who discerns the truth dares to raise their sword against the divine. In response, the slumbering gods break free from their shackles, revealing their true forms..."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_5: The possibility of the Second Resonance Awakening is now a certainty. So we just need to see if that special Resonator truly exists.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_6: Was the Blessed Maiden a Resonator for the Sentinel or the Threnodian?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_7: Or both? If so... Oh, a Resonator capable of wielding both powers... I am eager to see how this story ends.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_8: Cristoforo, if you don't want to spoil the next act, I might have to give your carefully crafted plot a little nudge.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_9: Speaking of which, {PlayerName} shines brighter than anyone else in your play. Do you find {Male=him;Female=her} interesting as well?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_10: Phrolova, it seems we walk different paths. I don't share your fondness for that sort of... puppet theater.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_11: I merely place the characters on their stage and they act out their fates, driven by their own volition.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_12: To remain courageous amidst absurdity, to pursue a spark of divine grace—this, to me, is the truest essence of humanity, don't you think?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_13: Even the most pristine cadence of death pales beside the untamed, fervent, and tenacious spirits of the living.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_14: In their journey, they resolutely overcome all obstacles: they pursue, they tear, they burn—simply because they desire to.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_15: I think you should leave your secluded mansion. Take a walk and listen to the voices scattered across the world.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_17: From Huanglong to Rinascita, {Male=he;Female=she} has indeed added a few unexpectedly beautiful notes to my symphony.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_18: I am certain that, even without any direction, {Male=he;Female=she} will walk the path that destiny has laid before {Male=him;Female=her}.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_19: All things ascend towards a singular point of convergence, and what awaits at the end is... immortality.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_20: Before the tides of fate, we are all but…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_1: Raise your glasses! Shout it loud, friends!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_2: To us, to the Carnevale, and to our very own Laureate, {PlayerName}!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_3: A name that echoes through the world, destined to roam the skies before shaking the earth!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_5: Please, stop. You're making me feel embarrassed…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_7: Don't be fooled by how he looks. Brant is already deep in his cups, drunk as a skunk.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_8: Oh, let him enjoy himself. The taste of victory is still fresh, and after such a battle, we should celebrate to the fullest!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_9: Drink your fill, everyone! This round's on me!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_11: Hmm, I see… Someone's been eavesdropping.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_12: Looks like we've attracted some unwanted attention.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_13: Aren't we in your family's safe house?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_14: A devout Acolyte wouldn't enter such a place without a good reason.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_15: The Montelli family is known for its hospitality, but freeloaders... will not find us so welcoming.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_16: Friends, let's keep the mood lively!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_17: Come, let's discuss the information we've gathered so far.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_18: During the Carnevale, you heard the Sentinel's voice and found a girl named Cartethyia. We've dug up some information on her.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_19: In the Order, every high-ranking Acolyte is given a new name.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_20: We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_21: So, she is the Sentinel's Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_22: The family will uncover the truth. The only remaining clue is the "inverted tower" you mentioned hearing about from the Sentinel, but even that feels elusive...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_23: Judging by your expression, you must have discovered something new, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_24: Do you recall what we learned from the stained glass in the Tower Ruins? There were two divinities at the dawn of Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_25: If one refers to the Sentinel, then the other, who could stand alongside Them, might be the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_26: The two are undoubtedly linked, so uncovering one could lead us to the other.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_27: Remember Gilberto, from the Fisalia family? It took a lot to get him to talk, but we finally got some information from him.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_28: As he tells it, the Fisalia family's long-revered deity is none other than... Leviathan, the Threnodian from the sea's depths.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_30: It's hard to believe, I know. But recent events have only reinforced what we discovered from the stained glass.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_31: The Fisalia family has been on this island since the founding of Rinascita, so their worship of the Threnodian may have persisted for centuries.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_32: We will attempt to establish contact with the Fisalias to build an alliance and gather more intelligence.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_33: Do you think they'll be willing?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_34: Rest assured, negotiation is what we do best. If necessary, we'll present them with an offer they can't refuse.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_35: Excuse me for the interruption. Greetings, esteemed guest.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_36: The Primus wishes to invite you for a conversation at the Cathedral of Mercury. Would you be so inclined?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_37: How curious. Since when has the Primus become so interested in social calls?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_38: It could very well be a trap.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_39: I'm merely conveying the Primus' invitation. The choice is yours.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_40: Don't worry, he wouldn't dare do anything to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_41: Perfect timing. I have many questions for him.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_42: Remember, you're not alone. If anything happens, just let us know.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_43: Very well, please follow me to the Cathedral of Mercury.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_44: But the Blessed Maiden... she martyred herself twenty years ago...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_45: There must be more to it than that...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_47: Did someone pretend to be her?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_48: Did the Blessed Maiden suddenly come back from the dead?

LoadingTipsText_1401_TipsText:
An ancient, secluded town nestles within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure white snow, create a scene of serene beauty. 
For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.
LoadingTipsText_1402_TipsText:
A sanctuary in the southeastern seas of Jinzhou, sealed away beyond the reach of common folks in thick fogs.
According to ancient records, Mt. Firmament is the ancestral home of Jinzhou's earliest settlers. Sentinel Jué once descended upon this land, using the power of Temporal Mandate to protect it from Tacet Discords. Consequently, the flow of time within Mt. Firmament diverges from that of the outside world. 
In earlier times, scholars from the Court of Savantae were fortunate enough to uncover the mountain's hidden mysteries, leaving behind research facilities and invaluable records before vanishing without a trace.

LoadingTipsText_1404_TipsText:
The capsule that descended with the Sentinel upon Mt. Firmament now lies concealed in the depths of Loong's Rest, known to the people of Hongzhen as the Mianloong Chamber. 
The townsfolk believe that Sentinel Jué may hail from a distant star, and that the Mianloong Chamber served as its hibernation capsule. This site marks the end of the pilgrimage and the gateway to Jinzhou's true future.

Character_chun_1_33: You encounter Camellya at the Black Shores' Greenhouse. As usual, she appears nonchalant but pleased nevertheless to chat. Your conversation is interrupted by Beatrice, who needs you to handle a problem at the Error Cell.
Character_chun_2_23: A corrupted Stellar Matrix has escaped and could endanger the Black Shores. To retrieve it, you seek out the Consultant who previously accessed the Matrix's data.
Character_chun_4_7: At the Hall of Foreign Affairs, you discover that Camellya has already taken Lady Flora's belongings. Now, you must find Camellya.
Character_chun_6_38: After catching up with Camellya, she reveals that she is Lady Flora, but like you, she has lost her memories. She appears indifferent to everything except you and proposes a game in exchange for handing over Flora's items.
Character_chun_10_41: Camellya enjoyed the game and gives you the bracelet as promised. Recognizing that her help is vital to resolving the current crisis, you ask her to stay. Camellya finds your assertiveness intriguing and agrees to help. In a discussion about self and her lost memories, Camellya claims her instincts define who she is. To gather more of Lady Flora's items, you decide to split up.
Character_chun_11_2: You continue searching and find a forsaken Blake Bloom in a cave.
Character_chun_16_33:
Camellya shows signs of Overclocking from battle, yet she appears unconcerned. She is accustomed to enduring pain and explains that savoring each present moment is her way of coping.

From the Blake Bloom's frequency, you discover that Lady Flora disappeared around the same time as the Black Shores leader. With enough items gathered, you head to the Modulation Hall.
Character_chun_28_15: You find Lady Flora covered in vines, struggling against her Overclocking. As her condition eases, she gazes at you with a faint smile and offers you a flower.
Character_chun_31_37:
Crossing the Stargate again, you meet another version of Lady Flora at the Black Shores. Unlike the previous Lady Flora, she appears healthy and slightly bashful, yet her admiration for you remains unchanged. She mentions that meeting you feels familiar.

Thanks to your timely arrival, Petalfall Village has survived the disaster in this juncture, even though that is not how it truly happened. Like she did before, Lady Flora smiles and offers you a flower.
Character_chun_33_36:
After passing through the Stargate for the third time, you finally reach the correct timeline juncture.

The Lady Flora you meet resembles Camellya in the real world and, like the others, she does not hide her feelings for you.
Character_chun_19_34:
Once trapped in a labyrinth of memories and possibilities, Camellya has lost much. But now, she tells you she no longer wishes to recover her lost memories, believing the seal left by Lady Flora will naturally break when the time is right.

What matters to her now is enjoying this reunion with you.

Just as she did in previous timeline junctures, Camellya smiles and extends her hand, offering you a flower.
Character_chun_22_8: You learn that Lady Flora sealed her memories because of a choice your past self made. Bewildered, you return to the Modulation Hall with Beatrice's help.
Character_chun_39_8: I didn't care. As long as we were both happy when we crossed blades, I was happy.
Character_chun_39_9: But now, {PlayerName} wants to leave… and even abandon {Male=his;Female=her} memories?
Character_chun_39_10: Doing all of this for what? A so-called better outcome?
Character_chun_39_7: Lady Flora explains that the past duties imposed on the one she yearns for led to their decision to leave the Black Shores. Camellya listens to her past self, surprised by her depth of emotion. Through Lady Flora's words, Camellya realizes that you are the leader of the Black Shores.
Character_chun_41_8: Rest won't help… I've lost my anchor. {Male=He;Female=She}'s no longer here to rein me in.
Character_chun_41_9: I've started remembering things from before I came to Petalfall Village.
Character_chun_41_10: Hehe, was our encounter there a gift from fate… or a curse?
Character_chun_41_7: Lady Flora's condition has gradually worsened ever since she lost her Anchor. As memories from before her arrival at Petalfall Village resurface, her Overlocking symptoms intensify. Camellya struggles to understand what it means to care about others.
Character_chun_44_7: I can feel my energy and power draining away, day by day...
Character_chun_44_8: Even if {PlayerName} one day returns, what will I be able to do for {Male=him;Female=her}?
Character_chun_44_6: Lady Flora refuses treatment, fearing it will leave her with nothing. Without her power, she would feel forever inferior to the one she cherishes, a fate she cannot accept. The heavy atmosphere triggers Camellya's own Overclocking symptoms to flare up.
Character_chun_46_9: I can't just sit here and rot away, clinging to old memories.
Character_chun_46_10: There is... another way, to keep Overclocking from eating me inside out.
Character_chun_46_11: A way to control my emotions... Stop the past from haunting me. A way to forget it all.
Character_chun_46_12: I will abandon my memories like {PlayerName} once did, sealing them away.
Character_chun_46_8:
To put an end to her severe Overclocking, Lady Flora decides to abandon her memories, including all those of you. She believes that her connection to you is intrinsic to her nature and will ultimately guide her back to you. When that day arrives, she hopes to stand as their equal.

Watching her past self, Camellya acknowledges and accepts this choice.
