Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_10: It seems they've left a little surprise for us. But if they think this will stop you and me...
Character_chun_76_1: Cracked bricks line the room, where massive vines coil through the space, their roots plunging deep into the walls and floor.
Character_chun_76_2: As you observe more closely, you notice the vines subtly pulsating, as if they were veins.
Character_chun_77_1: Debris and broken equipment are scattered across the floor, the aftermath of uncontrolled chaos.
Character_chun_77_2: Unlike the composed Camellya you once met in Jinzhou, her current, uncontrolled state has left her struggling to manage her Forte.
Character_chun_78_1: A malfunctioning screen flickers, displaying a log of recent visitors to the Black Shores.
Character_chun_78_2: From the data, you discover that Lady Flora was brought here only recently, and her condition has deteriorated rapidly over the past days.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_2: I'd rather be a wild flower, ignored by all, in my own power. Than a rose that bends and sways, bathed in grace, but lost in dismay...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_5: Did you borrow some of the Cloudcaster's parts?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_6: Isn't it obvious? I'm practicing for the Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_7: I'm the troupe's soprano and helmswoman. Steering Rinascita's Echo ship isn't just about strength, it's about resonating with the Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_8: After years at sea, I've learned that some Echoes are sensitive to our songs and will react to them in different ways.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_9: The Order warns of sirens lurking in the Stormy Sea's mists, but they don't scare me. I'll show them who the real siren of these waters really is!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_10: Who knows? Ask the Order and they'll give you a hundred reasons.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_11: I can't even remember how long I drifted on that Pilgrim's Sail, but the troupe found me just in time and took me in.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_12: What's past is past. It's the present that counts. Let go of the bad days and enjoy the moment. This is the way to live, hm?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_13: Cloudcaster... Hmm, it does ring a bell.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_14: Here, the resonance unit. It helps me find the right pitch and rhythm. Works like a charm! You should give it a try too.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_103_2: Let's position a Cloud Cushion beneath Mr. Bardolino. Then, we'll pop the balloons to bring him down safely.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_103_3: Although, we might need a bigger cushion.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_103_4: The Cloudcaster's resonance unit responds to song. The louder our singing, the more powerful the effect.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_103_5: In that case… Alright, friends, old and new, come and join this sing-along!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_104_1: Ah, what a joyful chorus! It almost brings back the splendor of that Carnevale from years past…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_104_2: I know you're excited, Mr. Bardolino, but try to stay still.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_1: Thank you, dear {Male=boy;Female=girl}! You helped me complete this performance and fulfill one of my dearest wishes. Please, I'll gladly give you my most prized possession!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_2: Apologies for my late arrival to such a magnificent performance. Did I miss anything?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_3: Oh my, oh my! What an honor to witness the beauty of our generous benefactor! Thank you, my lady, for rescuing this humble soul in his moment of need...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_7: You flatter me. The family's protection extends to all who stand by us.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_10: Might I say what a pleasure it is to see you again, Ms. Carlotta! You have my heartfelt gratitude!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_1: Alright, what should we do now? Any plans?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_2: Since the Order intends to sabotage the Carnevale and incite chaos amongst the guests, confronting them directly only plays into their hands.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_3: You've seen the troupe's unique approach to combat, haven't you? That's precisely why we're allies with them. We will turn any disturbances into a theatrical performance.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_4: Haha, I can see our friend here is still a bit confused. No worries, my dear {Male=boy;Female=girl}. We'll have a quick rehearsal before the Carnevale begins.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_5: Speaking of which, Ms. Carlotta, would you honor us by joining our performance?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_6: Me? I do have some stage experience, though I must confess I may be a bit out of practice...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_9: I'm not familiar with stage performance, and I need your guidance.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_10: We don't know what challenges we'll face, so your help will be needed, Ms. Carlotta. Plus, it's a chance for you to get to know our methods.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_12: Wonderful! As the festivities continue, if you're both ready, please join us on the stage of the troupe liner.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_108_2: No... Don't let them enchant you...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_202_1: Bullseye! How about showing off that aim again with the rest of the balloons?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_1: What say you, Brant? Do you like this stage design? It could be used for this year's Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_4: Have you considered how you're going to get down?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_5: Our little chat reminded me of those good old days, so why not relive that scene I just mentioned? I still remember that famous line: "Even without wings, we can still soar to the heavens!"
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_6: Now that you mention it, that's a very good question! Hahaha...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_7: Please don't mind him. We like our performances big and bold, after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_8: We might need your help with this, {PlayerName}... Pero should have some useful items in her box.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_9: We've got a Cloudcaster that can conjure up some fluffy Cloud Cushions. They'd make the perfect stairs to reach Mr. Bardolino, or catch him for a soft landing.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_10: But some of its parts have been borrowed by other troupe members...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_12: That fight with the dragon probably messed with the mountain's stability. If Bardolino keeps moving around up there, it could get dangerous. We need to find a way to get him down, and fast.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_2: The Order found a way to control the dragon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_3: Tacet Discords' frequencies are perpetually fading, inching toward their end.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_4: Their only way to maintain their existence is to consume other frequencies as food.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_5: The Dark Tide and mist enveloping this isle have drawn in countless Tacet Discords. Their frequencies should have been enough to feed the dragon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_6: If what you saw is true, then...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_7: The Order must've used some trick to control the dragon, making its frequency fade away faster than it should.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_8: That means they could be responsible for why the dragon began attacking all living beings, including humans...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_9: In time, it ended up becoming a harbinger of death.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_10: I found this during the previous battle.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_11: It seems the Fractsidus had their hand in this case as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_15: Mm? So you know them too. Seems we have much to discuss.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_16: Our troupe usually earns a living by performing on the nearby islands. Sometimes, we take on escort missions for merchant ships as well. That's how we first got acquainted with the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_17: At first, they were just lurking about, raiding ships. But as the Carnevale drew near, their actions grew suspicious. We noticed them lingering around a certain sea.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_18: Remember Cetus the Tidebreaker, the creature that attacked you when we first met?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_19: After we parted ways, we went searching for it to find out what had gone wrong.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_20: This is what we found on its tail... another Lycoris.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_21: Alas, the Tidebreaker slipped away into the deep, beyond our reach. Still, this bloom leaves no doubt. The Fractsidus is behind its strange behavior.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_22: We saw what they did to the dragon. The Cetus's violent outburst must be their doing as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_23: They could wreak havoc at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_24: What if their true target is the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_25: They say the Carnevale is a ceremony to resonate with the Sentinel. Those who claim the Laurel may be graced with a miracle—a direct communion with the divine.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_26: At first, we thought you were merely a curious traveler, intrigued by the Carnevale and our Sentinel. But now, seeing how far you've come, there's more to your quest, isn't there?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_27: Our troupe has always sought the Laurel, and we won't sit back while others threaten the Carnevale. If they're your foes, then our paths align!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_28: Remember I mentioned one of ours who once claimed the Laurel?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_29: He wasn't with us when we first met. But once we reach our base, you can speak with him about the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_30: It won't be long now. After such an adventure, a well-earned rest awaits.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_1: Alright, next, I'll spin the prologue of our tale, setting the scene for how our brave heroes first crossed paths...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_2: Once upon a time, a hero roamed the world. Undaunted by the lack of a divine vessel, {Male=he;Female=she} embarked on a perilous journey across tempestuous seas...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_3: Alone in the dark, a young girl of untethered spirit, soared against towering barriers with wings of defiance...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_4: The winds of fate brought them together...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_5: As the world teetered on the brink of absolute darkness, they found solace in each other's gaze...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_6: Together, they became unshakable allies, standing strong against the tides of fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_41_7: Even if light were to fade from the world, and the stars cease to shine, they would still blaze like the sun, forever...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_76_1: The area up ahead is where the sea mist is thickest.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_76_2: We need to pass through it to reach the lighthouse. Stay close and keep your wits about you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_76_3: Try to avoid the "Dark Phantoms" in the mist. They could turn into Tacet Discords at any moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_77_2: What? I can't control my Forte.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_78_1: The path splits here. Which way should we go?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_78_3: I know the left path looks safer, but…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_78_4: Let's go right. It's a friend of ours. Let's trust what it's saying.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_2: Did it lead us this way because it sensed the dragon?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_3: Possibly. Phantoms are sensitive to frequencies, so navigating the mist is second nature for them.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_4: The game isn't over. Here... Come quickly...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_5: I think... I've figured out what they're doing.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_6: We'll be out of the mist soon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_80_1: Stay with us… We are your family, your friends… Why abandon us?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_80_2: We see your loneliness. You, the quiet and solitary one, always making props on her own...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_80_3: But you have a kind heart, so much to give… Stay with us… You'll never be alone again…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_80_4: Focus. Those are just the Tacet Discords whispering. Don't let them trick you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_2: Your trust means a lot, Priest Alessio. The "Flower" has been quite... effective.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_3: A word of caution. Don't overstep. We can't afford unwanted scrutiny.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_5: Our sanctuary isn't infinite. Some murmurs are getting harder to quiet.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_6: I understand. That's why we seek "unity" and "integration."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_7: Our beliefs are already one. This is also the destiny They intend.

Guide_FSZLX_1_1: Excuse me, {PlayerName}. A moment of your time, please.
Guide_FSZLX_1_2: We're running a new testing phase for the research project you previously participated. Are you interested in joining us again?
Guide_FSZLX_1_5: Great. Allow me to introduce our research once more.
Guide_FSZLX_1_6: No need to decline just yet. Allow me to introduce our research once more.
Guide_FSZLX_1_7: I'm sure you have experience with Instructor Yhan's simulated training grounds.
Guide_FSZLX_1_8: It's where our warriors go to train against holograms of enemies and improve their combat skills.
Guide_FSZLX_1_9: A while back, the Academy began testing an improved "projection" technology to simulate even stronger enemies.
Guide_FSZLX_1_10: If the technology is proven effective, we can provide more comprehensive training for our soldiers. This means better results for their overall needs.
Guide_FSZLX_1_11: We managed to make significant technical breakthroughs from the previous test, but many minute details still need ironing out.
Guide_FSZLX_1_12: Would you be willing to test it out for us and help with our research again?
Guide_FSZLX_1_16: I knew I could count on you.
Guide_FSZLX_1_17: The access to the simulation is right beside me. Best of luck to you.
Guide_FSZLX_1_18: Rest assured, having been our top participant in the previous testing, your efforts will be supported by the best resources the Academy has to offer.
Guide_FSZLX_1_19: The access to the simulation is right beside me. Trust me, the rewards will not disappoint.
Guide_FSZLX_2_1: The data from this experiment looks positive as well...
Guide_FSZLX_2_3: Hi {PlayerName}. Have you given our latest technology a whirl yet?
Guide_FSZLX_2_6: Everyone back at the lab was really excited when they heard you would be assisting our research again.
Guide_FSZLX_2_7: With your assistance, I have faith that our technology will soon reach its full potential for our soldiers to utilize.
Guide_FSZLX_2_8: Ah, please remember to go check it out at some point. I've already signed up for you.

InfoDisplay_201001001_Text:
Day 15.

Some have begun to question the worth of this endeavor, and the very honor we strive to uphold for Fisalia. Such whispers should have no place here.

We have crossed the ridges of Thessaleo Fells, weathered storms, and dared currents to reach this place, losing a ship on the way. Now, it's time to claim our rewards. The "relic" that has been kept from our family by the Order lies somewhere within these forsaken ruins, and treasures glimpsed only in dreams seem at last within our grasp.

Dario will stay behind. His legs were pierced by a TD and he can no longer walk. We've left him with enough provisions.

The rest of the knights will press on, toward the ruins in the <color=Highlight>southwest</color>.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
InfoDisplay_201001002_Text:
Day 16.

The pilgrimage chapel is nothing but another empty shell. The knights smashed windows and overturned altars, but not one sign of the relic has been found.

Renzo seems to have lost his wits, staring at the torches and babbling—perhaps a result of the drowning earlier. We can't afford to wait for his recovery. Ennio wishes to keep him with us, but such sentiment would only slow us down.

Our cause allows no room for the weak. Now, a ruin lies to the <color=Highlight>west</color> of this island. That shall be our next destination.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
InfoDisplay_201001003_Text:
Day 17.

We waded through marshland to reach this waterlogged ruin, only to find more disappointment. The knights are losing faith—some doubt we'll ever find this so-called relic. Ennio, who's as close as family to me, stood against my decision to move on. He accused me of straying from the righteous path.

There was no other way to settle it; we dueled, as the knight's creed demands. He cast the gauntlets over to me, his mentor. Our duel ended amidst a strange howl from afar. When he fell, a part of me fell with him.

Ennio... He was set on the ideals of knighthood but was blind to the cold reality facing our branch of the family. I can feel it now—fortune and glory lie to the <color=Highlight>north</color>. Porto-Veno Castle will have to honor our deeds.

At this point, there's no turning back.
InfoDisplay_201001004_Text:
(The edges of the yellowed page are charred)

Day ██.

Our search stretched on and on, and all we found in the storeroom was a worn-out weapon schematic, probably left behind by the Order. Silently, we gathered anything of worth, not speaking a word about the relic. No one needed to—everyone knew. This quest has failed, and all our sacrifice has been in vain. But I don't accept it. The Order must have hidden something here on this island. Where is it?

(Rushed handwriting follows as if penned in great urgency)

Those damned TDs are coming for us. It's only a matter of time before they break through. But I've finally found it.

How absurd! The relic was always here, right before our eyes.

At the grand altar of ██, circled by towering Tacetites.

The howls are drawing closer. Forgive me.

LevelPlay_226800006_ChallengeConditionMa: Destroy the weird swim rings before the attempts run out
POI_GTDYBR_1_2: If they've hurt Liel, I'll skin 'em alive...
POI_GTDYBR_17_1: I'm dreaming... this must be a dream!
POI_GTDYBR_19_2: Those specters are right. We're trapped in this maze.
POI_GTDYBR_19_3: Going round and round in circles. Let's split up and look for clues.
POI_GTDYBR_2_1: Liel where are you, you little brat? Eh?
POI_GTDYBR_2_3: Ahoy there... You don't look like a Fanatic Shark. Name's Insula. Didn't expect to find another soul wandering these parts...
POI_GTDYBR_2_4: And I didn't expect Exiles in Rinascita.
POI_GTDYBR_2_5: Not from here. Live on an island far off the coast.
POI_GTDYBR_2_6: Took my crew out to sea a few days ago to plunder merchant ships, or catch fish if we couldn't find any ships.
POI_GTDYBR_2_7: We got close to this merchant fleet, but then the Fanatic Shark ambushed us.
POI_GTDYBR_2_8: And a storm hit when we were fighting... the kind that could tear ships apart. Waves taller than a mast.
POI_GTDYBR_2_9: My crew and I were knocked out by one of 'em. We came on to that beach by yonder...
POI_GTDYBR_2_10: And if that ain't bad enough, those damned Fanatic Sharks also got washed up on this island.
POI_GTDYBR_2_11: Why the bad blood between you?
POI_GTDYBR_2_14: Why, they butcher every sailor on every ship they loot.
POI_GTDYBR_2_15: Me and the boys' been busy fortifying our encampment, in case the Fanatic Shark attack. Haven't paid much attention to where we are...
POI_GTDYBR_2_19: Small wonder this place's crawling with strange critters and Echoes... I just hope none of 'em get to Liel.
POI_GTDYBR_20_1: You push the bookcase. Nothing happens.
POI_GTDYBR_22_1: Captain, there's something under the elevator.
POI_GTDYBR_22_2: That's enough... We can't leave... We can never leave...
POI_GTDYBR_31_3: Our sworn enemies... They washed up onshore with us.
POI_GTDYBR_35_1: Hah, those fish nuts are better off dead than alive. Now their specters show us the right path.
POI_GTDYBR_38_1: Let it go. We still need to press on, my friend.
POI_GTDYBR_7_1: Got away again. Ah, blast it...
POI_GTDYBR_8_1: So many bodies. Those Fanatic Sharks bit off a little more than they could chew.
POI_GTDYBR_9_1: Are these the specters of the dead Fanatic Sharks? Am I hallucinating?
Side_TJQL_1_2: Hi, What are you doing here?
Side_TJQL_1_3: Feel the briny wind from the sea? A perfect day for a voyage with the calm waves, eh?
Side_TJQL_1_4: See, that's my Gondola over there. As long as she's with me, there is no place in Rinascita we can't reach.
Side_TJQL_1_5: Ah, where are my manners? Name's Davide, Captain Davide, or... boatman perhaps. Doesn't matter which to me.
Side_TJQL_1_7: But you don't look ready to retire just yet.
Side_TJQL_1_8: You've got that right. I can still run a full trip to Septimont, singing shanties and puffing on my pipe the whole way.
Side_TJQL_1_9: No storm's ever bested me and my Gondola, and none will.
Side_TJQL_1_10: But every tale needs a proper ending. I reckon it's time for my last grand voyage.
Side_TJQL_1_14: Nah, it's alright. All I want is one last sail to somewhere I've never been to, before I settle down for good in the city.
Side_TJQL_1_15: I've crossed Nimbus Sanctum, seen Lorelei dancing among the stars, and ventured to forbidden lands, through reefs sharp as daggers.
Side_TJQL_1_17: From the dread lurking in the abyss to the beauty of fantasy islands, I've seen more than enough.
Side_TJQL_1_18: There's only one place left in all of Rinascita that I haven't conquered—the sky.
Side_TJQL_1_23: Aye! Now you probably think I've got a few bolts loose, eh? Older and crazier than the lot on Pilgrim's Sails.
Side_TJQL_1_24: But this is no joke. There were nights I dreamed of my Gondola and I gliding on the wind.
Side_TJQL_1_25: We would pass the rainbow bridge and see birds flashing beneath the boat like fish in a coral reef. Imagine that—a voyage like no other.
Side_TJQL_1_27: But can a Gondola really fly?
Side_TJQL_1_28: I've got faith in her. All she needs is the right push, and she'll take me up there.
Side_TJQL_1_29: I know what I'm talking about. In fact, we did come close one time.
Side_TJQL_1_30: We were out at sea when we got caught in a... what do they call it? Tornado? Felt like a giant hand grabbed us and flung us into the air.
Side_TJQL_1_34: Ah, no need to worry. That was just a starter compared to the worst I've seen. Now, you seem like a kind soul. Think you can help me find something as powerful as that tornado?
Side_TJQL_1_36: Naturally, there's something in it for you. Whatever treasure I find on this journey is yours.
Side_TJQL_1_38: There's a treasure in the sky?
Side_TJQL_1_39: They say, "At the end of the rainbow lies gold." The same goes for the clouds. In Rinascita, there's a tale of a ruin from the Dark Tide, said to be filled with treasure.
Side_TJQL_1_40: But for me, steering my Gondola toward treasures lost to time is worth more than any treasure itself.
Side_TJQL_1_41: So, what do you say? Not a bad offer, eh?
Side_TJQL_1_42: What kind of power do you need?
Side_TJQL_1_43: Let me think... I remember, in Ragunna, there's a TD built like a giant stuffed toy but packed with raw strength.
Side_TJQL_1_44: If we can turn it into an Echo, it should be strong enough to launch us into the sky. Then I'll just leave the rest to my Gondola—I trust her.
Side_TJQL_11_1: It worked! We're flying! Keep it steady, partner! Take us to the clouds!
Side_TJQL_11_2: See that, my friend? We made it! Want to join us for a view of the heavens?
Side_TJQL_11_3: Wait… how do I control this thing… no, no, how do I stop it?
Side_TJQL_12_1: So we meet again, my friend.
Side_TJQL_12_3: Me? Couldn't be better. The view above the clouds was exactly like what I dreamed.
Side_TJQL_12_4: For a final voyage, it was everything I ever wanted, and deeply satisfying.
Side_TJQL_12_5: Allow me to thank you once more. My dream has finally come true.
Side_TJQL_12_7: Oh, don't remind me. That Wingray had a mind of its own—it wouldn't change course or land.
Side_TJQL_12_8: Eventually, hunger got the better of me, so I jumped into the sea, watching my partner and the Wingrays fade into the horizon...
Side_TJQL_12_11: That's alright. She seemed happy as could be. My partner loved the thrill of adventure as much as I do—we're two of a kind.
Side_TJQL_12_12: She'll continue that grand, mysterious voyage, and I'm sure she'd find plenty of joy along the way.
Side_TJQL_12_13: And, well, I did manage to find a little surprise.
Side_TJQL_12_16: It's that chest over there. I stumbled upon a floating platform in the clouds, and it was sitting right on top. No idea who left it there.
Side_TJQL_12_17: No, not really. Just a chest resting on a platform in the clouds. No idea how it got there.
Side_TJQL_12_18: It could be the origin of that tale, even if it turned out, well, less impressive than I imagined.
Side_TJQL_12_19: Anyway, as we agreed, everything in it is yours.
Side_TJQL_12_21: Me? I'll go back to Ragunna and live the quiet life of a retired captain, telling my tales to anyone who'll listen.
Side_TJQL_12_22: A captain who flew his Gondola to the sky… Well, who'd believe that?
Side_TJQL_12_23: Farewell, my friend. May the Sentinel always bless you.
Side_TJQL_13_2: Give it all you've got, big fella!
Side_TJQL_14_2: Hold on... these Fae Ignis are acting strange.
Side_TJQL_2_1: Ah-ha! That's the Echo! Thank you, young one!
Side_TJQL_2_2: Ahem... though I do have one more favor to ask.
Side_TJQL_2_4: I'd like to share with you this moment of thrill as I break free from the earth and reach for the sky.
Side_TJQL_2_5: Would you do me the honor of witnessing my voyage?
Side_TJQL_3_1: Ugh... guess my old bones weren't ready for that.
Side_TJQL_3_3: *Coughs*... Oh, it's you. Gave you a bit of a laugh, did I?
Side_TJQL_3_4: But for me and my Gondola here, this is nothing at all. Right, partner?
Side_TJQL_3_6: If you'd seen us take on the raging seas, you'd know this is smooth sailing.
Side_TJQL_3_7: We've ridden down waves taller than mountains without a scratch. This drop's barely worth mentioning.
Side_TJQL_3_10: It clearly didn't go as planned. What's holding us back?
Side_TJQL_3_11: Maybe Gondolas aren't built for flight, eh? Even with a boost, all we'd get is a short glide.
Side_TJQL_3_13: Short glide? More like a nose dive.
Side_TJQL_3_14: Alright, alright, I may have put too much faith in my old partner. She's always been unstoppable in my memory.
Side_TJQL_3_15: Hard to believe there are things she can't do...
Side_TJQL_3_17: Easy there, partner. I'm not griping. Just saying we need a new plan.
Side_TJQL_3_18: Let me see... Ah, yes. There's a flying TD in Penitent's End called Fae Ignis.
Side_TJQL_3_19: If we turn them into Echoes and load them aboard, there's a fair chance they'll give us the lift we need.
Side_TJQL_3_20: Now that sounds like a plan.
Side_TJQL_3_22: So, mind making one more trip for this old man?
Side_TJQL_4_2: Thank you. I'll be ready in a minute!
Side_TJQL_4_4: I've got bad feelings about this...
Side_TJQL_4_6: Rest easy! No storms can get the best of me!
Side_TJQL_4_7: Brace yourself—you're about to see us conquer the sky!
Side_TJQL_5_1: Well, it's good to see you again, my friend.
Side_TJQL_5_4: *Coughs*... No need to worry. Just a minor setback, nothing I can't handle.
Side_TJQL_5_5: Rough landing aside, I'd say things went fairly well.
Side_TJQL_5_6: At least my partner and I managed to fly, though it was not the voyage I had in mind.
Side_TJQL_5_7: Maybe I'm just getting old, old enough to forget Fae Ignis can go off like firecrackers...
Side_TJQL_5_8: Are you giving it another go?
Side_TJQL_5_10: For sure! Even if I wanted to quit, my partner would never allow it.
Side_TJQL_5_11: Not a chance. Even if I wanted to quit, my partner would never allow it.
Side_TJQL_5_13: Hah! That's right, partner! We'll be above the clouds!
Side_TJQL_5_14: Could you do me one more favor, my friend? I swear this will be the last one.
Side_TJQL_5_16: I believe we are on the right track. Echoes can make a Gondola fly, but only the right ones can make a Gondola soar.
Side_TJQL_5_17: If, just if, we could get our hands on a calm flying Echo like a Wingray...
Side_TJQL_5_18: Come to think of it, there used to be Wingrays here, but they've all vanished recently.
Side_TJQL_5_19: Could it be… those masked fellas in red uniforms?
Side_TJQL_5_21: Ah yes, the Fractsidus! They've got a camp around here. Haven't been there, but I've spotted them firing at the sky.
Side_TJQL_5_22: Are they… poaching the Wingrays? By the Sentinel, those transgressors will answer for this!
Side_TJQL_5_23: Would you mind heading over to take a look? If they've taken the Wingrays, please save them.
Side_TJQL_7_1: The Fractsidus has locked up the Wingrays.
Side_TJQL_7_2: These doors look flimsy. Perhaps a heavy blow may break them down.
Side_TJQL_8_2: Let's bring this Wingray to Captain Davide.
Side_TJQL_9_1: A Wingray! Thank you, my friend.
Side_TJQL_9_2: So, you taught those poachers a lesson, eh? The Sentinel will smile upon that.
Side_TJQL_9_3: Now let's see if it would give me and my partner a ride to the sky.
Side_TJQL_9_4: I can feel the wind beckoning us from afar... urging us to start our voyage.
Side_TJQL_9_5: Thank you for everything. Now, I hope you'll stay to witness the moment we take flight!
HHACZST_7_17: Nothing. Just taking a walk here.
HHACZST_7_18: You're the one who may need some help.
RiskHarvest_ActivityEnd: The event is concluded. Please claim your rewards via the in-game mail later.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_1: A Consultant? Why haven't you evacuated yet?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_2: When the Tethys System issued the order to evacuate, everyone else left for the Modulation Hall.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_3: So why are you still here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_4: To protect the seeds in the Bank of Life, seeds collected from all over the world.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_5: It's imperative that the plants on Solaris be categorized systematically, you see.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3301_6: Besides, as long as the Tethys System stands, so will we.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_1: Hmm, hmm... The Great Chain of Being...
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_2: Sorry, I was miles away. Welcome, Knowledge Seeker!
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_4: You've met KU-Money, then. He is the robot administering the Black Shores Archipelago.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_5: Similarly, each area of the Black Shores' underground has been assigned an administrator.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_6: I'm KU-Irwin, administrator of the Bank of Life's Center for Species Conservation. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_7: Things are hectic at the moment. The fate of the Black Shores' underground is in your hands and the Shorekeeper's now.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3303_1: The numbers are a complete mess! They should've been arranged using a phylogenetic tree.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3303_2: You want to help? Keep yourself safe, that's your first priority.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3303_3: Oh, by the way, you're from Jinzhou, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_3303_4: I hear there is a Jinzhou scholar by the name of Verina who is well versed in botany.
Heihaian_main_1_3_3303_5: I hope I'll get the chance to meet her soon…

Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_1: Were you awake, {PlayerName}? I trust you had a restful sleep?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_2: We have uncovered some new information about the Sentinel. Please join us at the family's safe house.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_3: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_1: How can that be? That Blessed Maiden... could she really be the Threnodian's Resonator? What if the Primus's words were a bunch of baloney?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_2: But we saw Cartethyia following the Sentinel's instructions... They wouldn't mix up Their own Resonator, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_3: Ugh, now my head hurts... Who was she really with? The Sentinel? Or the Threnodian?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_4: He didn't seem like he was lying.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_5: He definitely seemed like he was hiding something important.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_6: Ugh, my head is starting to hurt too...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_7: Well, probably won't get any more answers from him...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_8: All the clues we've gathered so far point to the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_9: And the Fisalia family worships the Threnodian. We'll have to wait for Carlotta to arrange an audience with them.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_10: Something tells me this Carnevale is just the beginning. There's more ahead, I'm sure of it.

POI_SLZY_1_1: Something about these ruins feels oddly familiar… What's that lying over there?
POI_SLZY_1_3: Hey, look! Someone carved a message here on the ground!
POI_SLZY_10_1: Another piece of new info. What happened next for the knights?
POI_SLZY_12_1: Sounds like whoever kept this journal was losing it. Dueling his own student? Ugh...
POI_SLZY_12_3: They could have just talked things through.
POI_SLZY_12_4: The journal says "north"... There's no way we turn back now.
POI_SLZY_13_1: So this is the northern ruin. It's much larger than the others.
POI_SLZY_13_2: Stay sharp! I smell danger in the air.
POI_SLZY_14_1: Hmm? Did the TD drop something different this time?
POI_SLZY_16_1: Oh, so this was the end of their quest. Did they really find the relic after all?
POI_SLZY_16_3: {PlayerName}, why are you looking up like that?
POI_SLZY_16_5: We witnessed the final fate of those knights.
POI_SLZY_17_1: Seeker… This place is not the beginning of your quest…
POI_SLZY_2_1: Beneath the firelight, shadow loses its refuge.
POI_SLZY_2_2: Huh? Is this some sort of riddle?
POI_SLZY_2_3: "Firelight"... Maybe it's related to the torches around here? And the "shadow" could be—
POI_SLZY_3_1: Did you see that? Something just fell off that spooky knight!
POI_SLZY_3_2: It seems to be a scrap of paper.
POI_SLZY_5_1: Wait a minute... You think the TD you fought was the same one in this journal?
POI_SLZY_5_2: "Ruins in the southwest," let's check it out.
POI_SLZY_6_1: It's the same kind of knight TD. These ruins must be connected.
POI_SLZY_6_2: And here come more bits and pieces!
POI_SLZY_8_1: Things were really going downhill for them! What relic were they after that was worth all this?
POI_SLZY_8_2: It's still too soon to tell.
POI_SLZY_8_3: There's a mark on the map for a third ruin. Let's continue following their trail.
POI_SLZY_9_1: Hey, remember how those Fae Ignises lit up the torches at the other ruin?
POI_SLZY_9_2: Maybe we can use that to our advantage.

Flow_313700003_5: It tastes juicy and pleasant. Enjoying a moment of peace, you slip into the dream as the Gatekeeper murmurs comforting sounds.
Flow_313700003_6: It tastes sweet and balanced. Enjoying a moment of peace, you slip into the dream as the Gatekeeper murmurs comforting sounds.
Flow_313700003_62: It tastes cool and refreshing. Enjoying a moment of peace, you slip into the dream as the Gatekeeper murmurs comforting sounds.
Flow_313700003_64: It tastes clean and moderate. Enjoying a moment of peace, you slip into the dream as the Gatekeeper murmurs comforting sounds.
Flow_313700003_75: Right. What you are looking at is just like the "Milky Way in a Cup."
Flow_313700003_84: Maybe try your luck one more time?
Flow_313700003_87: Don't give up. You are getting close to the ultimate prize.
Flow_313700003_90: Can you hear the applause? Everyone is cheering for you now. Have another try?
Flow_313700003_93: Take the reward. May the luck bring you more joy.
Flow_313700003_96: You stop yourself. Something tells you this is not your day.
Flow_313700003_102: As the rod shakes, a big fish leaps out of the water with a Blake Bloom in its mouth. So it's real! You wonder what being unique might imply...
Flow_313700003_105: You reel in as the rod shakes, but the grain is already gone.
Flow_313700003_118: You hear the engine buzzing, but can't find the Echo.
Flow_313700003_119: Don't get anxious. This is part of the training where you follow the sound to find it. I think it is called... Inferno Rider.
Flow_313700003_128: Now follow the clues in the booklet. Good luck finding the Echo.
Flow_313700003_155: You hear a melody that sounds kind of familiar, but can't find the Echo.
POI_QSMG_19_2: You were stung by a Primordia Bloom hidden in this Echo and were in hallucination.
POI_QSMG_19_3: I see. That explains why I was seeing... Thank you! You are the outlanders from the inn, right? I'm sorry you had to witness my embarrassment again.
POI_QSMG_19_4: You should also thank Ms. Margherita...
POI_QSMG_19_5: In the name of Korlacchi, I...
POI_QSMG_19_7: "Wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all..."
POI_QSMG_19_8: You... you know these words. That means you've met the knight!
POI_QSMG_19_10: The knight told us he plans to travel further and hopes we can follow his trail to meet him one day.
POI_QSMG_19_11: Exactly! He spoke those very words to me. Maybe he's traveling to uphold his family's values of chivalry and recruit new knights!
POI_QSMG_19_12: Are you also here to look for him? If you seek his trail, you're standing on it.
POI_QSMG_21_1: This must be where he made camp. I can see signs he was here.
POI_QSMG_21_2: This was just one stop along his quest. Since you've come here to find him, will you join me for the rest of the journey?
POI_QSMG_21_3: I still have more leads we can follow. By the way, we haven't been properly introduced yet, have we?
POI_QSMG_21_5: Hey, what about me? You can call me Abby. {PlayerName} here is pretty tough and all, but...
POI_QSMG_21_6: Hey, I wasn't finished! Wait for me...
POI_QSMG_23_1: Sorry, I was just... stunned. Back at the camp, I started to see the resemblance of the knight in you.
POI_QSMG_23_2: Just like the knights of legends, you charged forward... with humility, honor, and bravery.
POI_QSMG_23_3: But you're different from the knights I've met in town. They don't venture far into Whisperwind Haven, nor do they dare set up camp in the wild. They loiter around town before heading back to the city...
POI_QSMG_23_4: "What kind of knight should I be?" I catch myself asking that question from time to time.
POI_QSMG_23_6: My choice... I-I don't know... We... Let's keep going.
POI_QSMG_24_1:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. The name Korlacchi... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
POI_QSMG_25_1: Just a bit further and we'll reach Windmill Lodge. That's where all traces of the knight vanish.
POI_QSMG_25_2: I must have overlooked something! This time, I swear I'll find what I'm looking for!
POI_QSMG_26_1: Mr. Millkeeper, it's been some time. You seem to be in a good mood today.
POI_QSMG_26_2: Let me introduce my guests from a foreign land. They also had the pleasure of encountering the knight...
POI_QSMG_26_6: Don't worry, {PlayerName}, Mr. Millkeeper doesn't mean to be unfriendly. He's been acting like that from the day I knew him.
POI_QSMG_26_7: He's not much of a talker, but he always laid out tea and snacks for me during my search for the knight.
POI_QSMG_26_8: Never mentioned his name. Seeing that he lives right here, I began to call him Mr. Millkeeper considering the townsfolk call people like him Windmill Keepers.
POI_QSMG_26_11: I can't say for certain. Stories about them vary. Some say Windmill Keepers are a mysterious part of Egla Town's history tasked with maintaining the Windmills.
POI_QSMG_26_12: It's also said that the Windmill Keepers are outcasts—people who have nowhere else to go after returning from the sea. They choose to make their homes in the abandoned windmills.
POI_QSMG_26_13: Whichever the case, their presence never disrupts the peace in Whisperwind Haven. I doubt anyone would want to be the troublemaker.
POI_QSMG_27_1: We're gettin' close. What's the matter, {PlayerName}? Run out of gas already?
POI_QSMG_27_2: I don't know. I feel like after leaving Egla Town, the Mad Knight's Echo became... restless.
POI_QSMG_27_3: Restless? The knight... Right, maybe it's just following its oath? I remember Cosimo and Carlow both said a true knight would never betray the path of service he swore.
POI_QSMG_27_4: I mean, wouldn't they fight TDs out of instinct? Maybe if we used its power in the right way, it could help us out...
POI_QSMG_35_1: Aw, don't worry, Abby! Just follow these steps and {PlayerName} will wake up in no time. See?
POI_QSMG_35_2: Hi ya, it's been a while. Do you remember me? Or... do you still know where you are?
POI_QSMG_35_5: Right as a nut! That means you're A-okay! Just sit tight and get some more rest.
POI_QSMG_35_6: Good, you still remember my name! That means you're A-okay! Just get some more rest and you'll be up and at 'em again.
POI_QSMG_35_7: You really scared the crap out of me, {PlayerName}! You froze up like Carlow when you touched that thing. Luckily, Margherita came by and snapped you out of it.
POI_QSMG_35_8: You must have touched a Primordia Bloom that hid itself under the Echo. They bring weird hallucinations to anyone who touches them.
POI_QSMG_35_9: I touched one when I was little, and a strange knight taught me how to break free from it.
POI_QSMG_35_11: Yep, and he wasn't like any knight I've ever seen in the city. He was handing out these knight rings to everyone and asking if they wanted to be a knight and explore the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
POI_QSMG_35_12: But being a knight was never my dream, you know! Since I was a child, I wanted to open a restaurant in the city. Nothing makes me happier than seein' the smiles on my customers' faces!
POI_QSMG_35_13: After I told him that, the knight took the ring away and plopped his helmet on my head, sayin', "Maybe you don't need this ring after all."
POI_QSMG_35_14: Oh... I'd better be off now! I came to Egla Town to find some inspiration for new recipes. Something with a knightly twist, I think...
POI_QSMG_35_15: I'm glad I could lend a hand! As for that chipper young lad over there, he's been in it longer than you, so it might take him a wee bit to come around. But don't fret, it's not serious!
POI_QSMG_35_16: As Margherita waves goodbye, you both wait patiently for Carlow to wake up from his hallucination.
InfoDisplay_201001101_Text:
The aromatic fat from the grilled fish glistens as it drips down, adding to the flames of the campfire below.

Mmm! The fat has infused the fish beautifully, and if you savor each bite, you can still taste the freshness of the fish itself. Delicious! A perk of being a fisherman, I'd say!

Nothing slips past you, does it, Joanna? A few days ago, I was actually thinking about quitting. It gets too lonely traveling alone. The Haven's scenery here is stunning, and I thought about building a hut here and waiting to die of old age. Last night, you found your way into my dreams...

Don't worry, I've nearly forgotten your face and your voice. What I haven't forgotten is the promise you made. The one about moving forward and seeing unseen views.

Besides fish, there are so many other delicacies I haven't had the chance to try yet, and places I want to visit. I can't just let it end like this. I'll set off at first light tomorrow.
InfoDisplay_201001102_Text:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. Korlacchi. The holy name... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...

InfoDisplay_131000001_Text: Tonight's banquet is a big deal. It's my first time handling something this important. The higher-ups even had me and Barolo set the password for the lighting controls. But how do I make sure everything goes according to plan? Aha, I've got it—keep the enemies close, just like with secrets. For the <color=yellow>first two digits</color>... I'll go with the <color=yellow>number of trees and chandeliers in the hall</color>. As for the last two digits, that's on Barolo. He took forever setting up the balloons in the hall yesterday. Maybe he was hiding the password in the <color=yellow>balloons</color>? Ugh... still feels a bit off. Better go check everything again.
InfoDisplay_131000002_Title: A Memo with No Important Info
InfoDisplay_131000002_Text: You know, as you get older, your memory starts to slip... But here's the good news—I'm only in charge of the last two digits for the light control password. Well, I'll just go with August 9th. It's an important day for me—it's my wedding anniversary with my dear Mathilde, and also the day Padrino baptized our Charlotte. <color=yellow>August 9th</color> it is, then. Perfect for the last digits of the password.
