Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_5_44: At Gourmet Street, you discuss your dream involving the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament. A fellow diner shares insights about the mountain, and Abby senses a strange aura emanating from the southeast. Together, you resolve to seek information about the Sentinel at the City Hall.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_44: In City Hall, Sanhua reveals that the Magistrate ventured to Mt. Firmament days ago, concerned for the Sentinel's safety. You express your intent to follow and Sanhua offers to contact a guide for the treacherous journey. She arranges a meeting with the Wayfinder at Whining Aix's Mire.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_30_56: In the pouring rain, you encounter Changli, the Wayfinder, at the ferry. She describes the peculiar nature of time at Mt. Firmament, where it flows erratically. She notes your resemblance to a historic visitor who was immune to this temporal distortion and offers to accompany you into this dangerous realm.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_40_18: You and Changli come to a damaged bridge that leads to Mt. Firmament. You find a Chronosorter in the vicinity, a Court of Savantae creation believed to have the power to restore objects by rewinding time. Perhaps it can be used to repair the bridge?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_60_18: Upon entering Mt. Firmament, you find that the flow of time has spiraled out of control, with many creatures falling victim to it. Leaving the mountain now could lead to unpredictable aging. Changli finds her Terminal is not working and suggests hurrying to Hongzhen, a town that Jinhsi must pass through in her search for the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_70_22: Hongzhen resembles a place from your dreams. Changli speculates that your dreams might be a glimpse into your past and a light guiding you into the future. Here, you meet the Fractsidus and discover traces of Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, and you decide to follow them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_16: You and Changli enter a hidden chamber. Xinyi greets you. She is an old acquaintance of Changli's and once held a prominent position in City Hall before retiring to Hongzhen. She asks you to follow her.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_41: You learn that the Sentinel may be trapped in its resting place—the Mianloong Chamber. The Fractsidus invasion has activated the defenses built by the Court of Savantae, sealing the chamber. Jinhsi left shortly before to go to Truthseeker's Pass to retrieve the Cipher Key needed to unseal it. You and Changli continue to trace her steps.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_12: At Truthseeker's Pass, you find another Chronosorter alongside three Photonvaults. Changli marvels at how the Court of Savantae managed to manipulate time to create such sophisticated mechanisms, noting that no other civilization has been able to replicate this technology. She speculates that this knowledge must have originated from the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_16: In the depths of Truthseeker's Pass, you find the Cipher Key needed to unlock the Mianloong Chamber. Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_41: You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber. You discover that the Fractsidus has used a Court of Savantae creation to generate a special force field that prevents Jué from drawing energy from the chamber, effectively trapping it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_290_9: Upon entering the Mianloong Chamber, you find a body of water frozen in time. Can you walk across the water's surface to get to the other side?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_380_65: You meet Jué in the depths of the Mianloong Chamber. Jué calls you "Arbiter" and invites you to step in as Jinzhou makes a historical turn and witness the transformations to come. Knowing that it is dying, Jué is willing to use its remaining life force to freeze Jinzhou in time, so that future generations may have a chance to save it. Jinhsi refuses to accept this and decides to fight the Sentinel, even at the cost of her own life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_395_20: On the summit of Mt. Firmament, Jué waits in the Sonoro Sphere for a challenger. Jinzhou's fate is in Jinhsi's hands, and she will fight for it in her own way. You support her decision and open the door to the Sonoro Sphere, ready to witness this key moment in Jinzhou's history.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_405_51: As the dust settles, Jué meets with you as promised. You learn that you were once Jué's master and established Jinzhou with its assistance. Jué notices something usual about your Tacet Mark just as Abby appears and the two confront each other. Even Jué is uncertain of Abby's origins, but suggests that you visit the Black Shores, the starting point of your journey in this world.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_410_16: The flow of time has returned to normal. Mt. Firmament thrives once more, and you journey to Hongzhen to meet with Changli and Xinyi. All is not what it seems, however. The Fractsidus is planning its next move...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_176_14: The stone gate, marked with the Flare Crest, has stars that correspond to Flare Stones. To unlock the gate, you need to find and activate the other two stones. Changli discovers traces left by Jinhsi nearby and deduces that she may be on the verge of Overlocking.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_36: The documents show that the Court of Savantae used Chronosorters to test the Second Resonance Awakening hypothesis, which suggests that colliding frequencies can unlock greater potential within a Resonator. You theorize that the prophesied conflict between Jinhsi and the Sentinel is intended to allow Jinhsi to acquire the ability to manipulate time through this Second Resonance. However, the experiments indicate that the Resonator's Overlocking may be necessary to attain this power.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_215_62: You finally find Jinhsi, who appears greatly weakened. She has learned from the Court of Savantae's records that the Sentinel was injured upon arriving at Mt. Firmament, and its worsening condition is causing the increasingly unstable flow of time. With Jinzhou endangered, Jinhsi intends to verify the Court's claims for herself. If necessary, she is prepared to engage the Sentinel in battle to trigger a Second Resonance, even if it means risking her life.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_360_44: You learn about Jinhsi's past. Jinhsi is adamant about fulfilling her duty. The prophesied battle between her and the Sentinel was meant for the distant future, but she is willing to confront the Sentinel now if it is the only way to keep everyone safe. She expresses her gratitude for your companionship.
Character_ChangLi_1_41: In Hongzhen, an elderly storyteller shares the legend of a hidden Weiqi game on Mt. Firmament that is said to grant immortality. While listening, you notice Changli nearby. She hands you an accessory and a note before quietly leaving. The note hints at a secret meeting, and to decipher its meaning, you decide to ask around.
Character_ChangLi_5_40: The people you speak with have varying opinions on Changli, but you deduce the meeting location from their insights. You encounter Xinyi, who identifies the accessory as one of Changli's prized possessions, suggesting that understanding her intentions will require personal involvement.
Character_ChangLi_8_79: At the pavilion mentioned in the note, you meet Changli. She shares the full story behind the "unfinished Weiqi game"—an enigmatic visitor once hid the Secret of Immortality in the last Weiqi game she played with her master. This game might be tied to the Temporal Mandate and your lost memory. Changli asks for your help in uncovering the truth.
Character_ChangLi_10_18: You meet Changli again and she shares that she has pinpointed the most likely location of the game record. Together, you prepare to search for it.
Character_ChangLi_12_18: As you and Changli enjoy the view from the pavilion in Hongzhen, Abby senses the mixed frequencies of Tacet Discords and humans from a cave. Someone may be in danger...
Character_ChangLi_19_34: You rush to rescue an adventurer under attack by Tacet Discords. The adventurer, claiming to seek Mt. Firmament's secrets, faints. Changli suspects he is hiding something and plans to gather more information once you return to Hongzhen.
Character_ChangLi_21_70: At the hotel, you meet Fuling, the gravely ill girlfriend of the adventurer Wuli. He had gone into the mountains seeking a way to slow her condition but mistakenly believed that the Temporal Disruptions held the key to immortality. Accepting her fate, Fuling pleads with you to put a stop to the dangerous Disruptions.
Character_ChangLi_22_53: Through discussions with Xinyi, you begin to question Wuli's motives and his sources of information. You suspect that the Temporal Disruption might be part of a larger scheme and could be connected to the Weiqi record you are searching for.
Character_ChangLi_27_26: While investigating Wuli's camp, you learn that Fuling has accepted her fate and doesn't want Wuli to sacrifice his future as an adventurer for her. Wuli's diary reveals ties to the Fractsidus, suggesting someone is trying to connect the Temporal Disruption to the Weiqi game.
Character_ChangLi_32_7: You encounter Xuanmiao, Changli's master, across time. When you touch the old Weiqi board, it glows in response, and you spot the Fractsidus Artificer following you.
Character_ChangLi_34_12: A portal to the Sonoro Sphere opens, and the Fractsidus Artificer rushes through, convinced that the power of the Temporal Mandate lies within. After defeating his minions, you and Changli enter the Sonoro Sphere together.
Character_ChangLi_59_62: You and Changli manage to escape the burning Sonoro and reunite with Xinyi, Wuli, and Fuling. The remaining members of the Fractsidus have been captured by the Midnight Rangers, and the Temporal Disruptions have ceased. Wuli and Fuling understand each other's true feelings and plan to explore more places together, continuing their pursuit of shared dreams. Changli asks you to rest while she assists Xinyi in wrapping up loose ends.
Character_ChangLi_60_17: Two days later, you visit Xinyi in the Meeting Room, learning that the Fractsidus was indeed seeking the Temporal Mandate referenced in the Weiqi game legend. However, their scheme was thwarted by you and Changli. The Fractsidus Overseer who had entered the Sonoro has vanished. As for Changli, she awaits you at the pavilion.
Character_ChangLi_62_65: When you meet Changli at the pavilion, she reveals everything. You were the "golden-eyed visitor" who played Weiqi with Master Xuanmiao. Back then, you foresaw a disaster striking Mt. Firmament and left the Sonoro as a contingency plan. Changli admits that while she is not concerned about her lifespan, she feels a deep sadness at the thought of leaving behind the world's beauty. Now, she wishes to play that long-anticipated game of Weiqi with you.
Character_ChangLi_36_36: Inside, you find a young girl surrounded by Tacet Discords. She uses flames to fend them off but injures herself in the process. She resembles Changli, raising suspicions about their connection. Concerned for her safety, you decide to venture deeper into the Sonoro with her.
Character_ChangLi_40_8: The girl reveals her entire village was destroyed during a TD Outbreak. She only survived because some villagers hid her in a fireproof basement.
Character_ChangLi_41_31: She confides that despite the toll her abilities take on her life, she uses them frequently to survive. Her dream is to grow up and become someone strong enough to help others. To bring peace to this world, she must find a skilled mentor to guide her.
Character_ChangLi_53_17: Changli recalls her master Xuanmiao's farewell before he passed away, during which he imparted wisdom on navigating life and instructed her to assist someone capable of truly changing the world. Seeing this memory, Changli now understands what must be done.
Character_ChangLi_55_19: After solving the puzzle, Changli spots you and the girl's mirage from afar. Meanwhile, the girl recalls that she has been searching for something important. She feels an odd familiarity with you, despite never having met before. Suddenly, a missing part of the device needed to open the gate appears in her hand.
Character_ChangLi_46_9: You and the girl encounter a mirage of Changli, while elsewhere, Changli sees multiple reflections of her past self. She ponders over it and resolves to find you at all costs.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_1_29: Outside Panhua's restaurant, the creature within you, drawn by the food's aroma, emerges from your Tacet Mark. Baizhi's tests reveal that the Threnodian energy it absorbed has completely fused with you, forming a mysterious symbiosis, or Convergent Codependency.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_2_46: This small, rare Echo has no memory of its origins or the events in the Norfall Barrens. Intrigued by the concept of names, it asks you to bestow one upon it, having forgotten its own.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_3_56: The little one rejects Chixia's grandiose names, prompting you to suggest "Abby." To your surprise, it loves the name, saying it sounds just right. Curious about Abby's origins, you ask it to demonstrate its abilities hoping to learn something.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_39: Abby tries and fails to showcase its abilities. Maybe it has yet to learn how to activate its power. The answers may lie within your lost memories. Perhaps you can uncover hints during your meeting with the Magistrate and Sentinel Jué.
Character_ZheZhi_2_45: You meet Zhezhi at the entrance of the Public Security Bureau. Relieved to see you, she gathers her courage and decides to speak the truth about the art forgery case during the hearing.
Character_ZheZhi_3_36: As the hearing unfolds, Baici, the founder of the Shanyun Art Exchange, casts doubt on Zhezhi's statement with his slippery arguments. Nervous and shaken, Zhezhi finds it impossible to refute him. You decide to step in and explain the events of three days ago. Your support gives Zhezhi the confidence to continue, and she uses her paintbrush to paint an image of the scene.
Character_ZheZhi_4_23: Three days earlier, Gupan had entrusted you with investigating the "Arcane Artist" in the Tiger's Maw. You then decide to track down witnesses and begin gathering information.
Character_ZheZhi_5_23: Huaijin reveals that the monsters lurking around the mine have been acting strangely, and hints that they might be linked to some painting scrolls. Huaijin also warns you that there is likely more than one person involved in the case.
Character_ZheZhi_6_16: Jifeng elaborates on more key details of the attacks, leading you to suspect that they are not random events, but something far more deliberate.
Character_ZheZhi_9_37: While investigating sightings of the monsters and the Arcane Artist, you run into Zhezhi. She explains she is also investigating the chaos caused by the Arcane Artist. Realizing you are after the same thing, you suggest asking a local mineral merchant for more information.
Character_ZheZhi_10_55: With the merchant Shilang's encouragement, Zhezhi drums up the courage to ask to be your friend and is relieved by your response. To shift the conversation away from Shilang's friendly teasing, she mentions the Arcane Artist. You learn that some suspicious individuals had purchased heaps of leftover ore and even stole from Shilang at night. To confirm the details, you check Shilang's transaction records.
Character_ZheZhi_12_40: Your discussion is interrupted by Chixia's arrival. Zhezhi, feeling shy and a little awkward, is unsure how to decline Chixia's invitation to return to the city. Just when she is about to give in to Chixia's friendly insistence, you politely excuse both of you from the gathering. Chixia mentions she is also investigating the Tacet Discords that have been acting strangely. Just then, a loud noise nearby interrupts your conversation and you all decide to check it out.
Character_ZheZhi_13_50: Regretting her earlier hesitation, Zhezhi promises to speak up more decisively as you make your way to the scene.
Character_ZheZhi_15_16: You learn from Chixia and a researcher that the Tacet Discords had gone wild due to a frequency fluctuation from a painting scroll found at the site. The scroll's power came from the artist's nearly Overclocked Forte.
Character_ZheZhi_16_15: While investigating Mingyan, the artist in question, you discover she had once studied art alongside Zhezhi. Although Mingyan's fragmented speech suggests that she may be guilty, her expression hints at a more complicated story. However, she is unwilling to reveal more.
Character_ZheZhi_19_12: From the witness Su, you learn that Mingyan appeared lost, waving her paintbrush moments before a swarm of Tacet Discords emerged from nowhere. It also seemed like she had tried to stop the monsters from harming anyone.
Character_ZheZhi_20_7: Yinfeng, another witness, claimed that Mingyan created the dangerous painting purely for personal gain.
Character_ZheZhi_21_45: After piecing together the clues, you uncover the truth. Mingyan used her Forte to create temporary phantasms in her art that attracted Tacet Discords. The "monsters" reported by witnesses were merely distorted phantasms seen by frightened people in the dark. Zhezhi insists that Mingyan was not motivated by personal gain, and asks that you continue to search for evidence to clear her name in her art studio.
Character_ZheZhi_24_24: In Mingyan's studio, you discovered pieces of "White Jade Paper." Zhezhi introduces its unique qualities with an artist's keen eye. Drawing from her understanding of the paper and Mingyan's habits, Zhezhi begins to build a theory about what happened prior to Mingyan's incident.
Character_ZheZhi_26_16: Among Mingyan's drafts, Zhezhi recognizes copies of the "Serenity of Xiehua Village," each painted in subtly different ways. As you examine the details, Zhezhi notices pigment stains on her clothes and quickly realizes that the quality of the paint is lower than usual.
Character_ZheZhi_27_17: A find a stained piece of clothing, prompting Zhezhi to recall how she used to use her clothing as makeshift canvases. She suggests that Mingyan might have done something similar.
Character_ZheZhi_29_28: You find Mingyan's notes that reveal her struggles as an artist and the pressure she felt while painting against her true desires. Zhezhi reflects on how common this feeling is among creators. Having once faced the same confusion, Zhezhi expresses her determination to uncover the truth and help save Mingyan.
Character_ZheZhi_30_13: You stumble upon medicinal herb residue. Zhezhi, inexperienced with such materials, initially thinks it is just leftover pigment. Finding this makes you realize that Mingyan had not been feeling well before the incident.
Character_ZheZhi_33_26: Zhezhi speculates that a Gulpuff might have escaped from the studio. While the theory seems questionable, you appreciate her effort, spurring Zhezhi to try again. Impressed by her Forte use, you learn that Zhezhi rarely uses her Resonance abilities. Zhezhi confesses that her Forte, which closely resembles Mingyan's, may somehow be connected to Mingyan's uncharacteristic outburst.
Character_ZheZhi_37_15: At an Exile camp, you find piles of ore fragments and handmade pigments. The amount perfectly matches what you saw in Shilang's transaction records. This confirms that these Exiles were the ore thieves and that Mingyan had purchased their low-quality pigments.
Character_ZheZhi_38_34: The Exiles admit to knowing Mingyan and admiring her exceptional art. They claim they tried to stop her from creating dangerous paintings, but their efforts had been in vain.
Character_ZheZhi_39_16: Zhezhi senses that neither the Exiles nor Mingyan are being truthful. She notices that some Exiles have blackened hands, a sign they are secretly producing pigments and inks for some unknown purpose. Suspicious of their deception, you decide to sneak into the camp at night to uncover the truth.
Character_ZheZhi_41_10: During your infiltration, you overhear a conversation revealing that these supposed Exiles are actually employees of the Shanyun Art Exchange. This confirms that the Art Exchange is involved in Mingyan's plight and hints at their involvement in churning out art forgeries.
Character_ZheZhi_44_20: From their conversation, you discover that Yinfeng, the witness from the crime scene, had signed Shilang's transaction record. Yinfeng had framed Mingyan to cover up their illegal activities. To verify Zhezhi's suspicions about a certain "batch of paintings" mentioned in the Exiles' conversation, you decide to disguise yourselves and investigate further.
Character_ZheZhi_43_45: During your infiltration, you overhear a conversation revealing that these supposed Exiles are actually employees of the Shanyun Art Exchange. This confirms that the Art Exchange is involved in Mingyan's plight and hints at their involvement in churning out art forgeries. You also learn that Yinfeng, the witness from the crime scene, had signed Shilang's transaction record. Yinfeng had framed Mingyan to cover up their illegal activities. To verify Zhezhi's suspicions about a certain "batch of paintings" mentioned in the Exiles' conversation, you decide to disguise yourselves and investigate further.
Character_ZheZhi_56_13: You find a recording of Mingyan asking to leave the Art Exchange's schemes, only to be threatened by Yinfeng. It appears that Yinfeng has also been reporting all of Mingyan's actions to Mr. Baici, his boss.
Character_ZheZhi_57_19: Inside the camp's warehouse, you find countless copies of famous artworks, proving that Mingyan had been coerced into creating forgeries for the Art Exchange. You immediately share this information with the Patrollers. Meanwhile, Zhezhi discovers the original "Serenity of Xiehua Village," the stolen masterpiece. She begins to explain how she recognized it amidst all the forgeries, but is interrupted by a horde of Tacet Discords.
Character_ZheZhi_58_18: After defeating the monsters, you realize that the painting's frequency had attracted them. Zhezhi laments that her presence must trigger the emotional frequencies in Mingyan's paintings and that her Forte may have played a role in inciting Mingyan's obsession. You reassure Zhezhi that the blame lies neither with her nor the painting.
Character_ZheZhi_60_22: Yinfeng dismisses the value of an artist's passion and tries to silence you with money. Outraged but resolute, Zhezhi stands her ground, determined to expose the dark side of the Shanyun Art Exchange and save all the artists who are been coerced into producing forgeries.
Character_ZheZhi_61_37: In the hearing, you present the evidence—the recording, art forgeries, and the low-quality pigments—to prove how the Art Exchange coerced painters into producing counterfeit works. However, Baici defends himself with different excuses. At that moment, Zhezhi gathers her courage and reveals a hidden truth: she is the original creator of "Serenity of Xiehua Village."
Character_ZheZhi_63_10: Zhezhi faces her past and takes control of her Forte, preparing to use it to back up her claim and embrace the responsibility that comes with her talent.
Character_ZheZhi_68_14: The painting Zhezhi creates during the hearing, combined with the message you sent to the Patrollers, leaves Baici no choice but to confess. The Public Security Bureau announces they will re-evaluate Mingyan's charges and launch a full investigation. Victory is yours.
Character_ZheZhi_72_20: After the hearing, Zhezhi thanks you for your unwavering support and expresses her relief at the outcome. Together, you plan to visit Mingyan.
Character_ZheZhi_73_22: When Mingyan learns about your efforts, she expresses her deep gratitude and apologizes to Zhezhi. She admits that the incident makes her question whether she is truly meant to be an artist. Zhezhi encourages her to follow her heart, gifting her a painting she had once received from Mingyan. Staring at her own work, Mingyan grows emotional, lost in thought.
Character_ZheZhi_74_26: Happy for Mingyan's change of heart, Zhezhi tells you that solving this case isn't just about helping Mingyan, but also about living up to your expectations. Touched by your reassurance, Zhezhi playfully teases you for the first time. While it may still be difficult for her to open up around others, she has made great strides thanks to your support.
zhuiyuejie_first_1_17: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you receive a call from Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi who invite you to join the celebration at Taoyuan Vale.
zhuiyuejie_first_5_56: After catching up with the trio there, you share your recent experiences at Mount Firmament, while they fill you in on the tale of Moontree Lodge—where every wish made beneath its branches is said to come true. Chixia suspects that an unsung hero might be making these wishes happen and playfully suggests you try your luck under the Wishing Tree before you part ways.
zhuiyuejie_first_6_6: On your way to the Wishing Tree, a peculiar red robot catches your eye.
zhuiyuejie_first_7_9: You ask around and learn that this little robot might have some connection to the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_first_9_95: When you reach the Wishing Tree, you encounter the robot's owner, Xiangli Yao, Principal Investigator at the Huaxu Academy. Xiangli Yao explains that his robot, "Patty," is malfunctioning, and its nonsensical speech makes you realize that Xiangli Yao might just be the unsung hero Chixia mentioned. Xiangli asks you to keep that a secret. After learning you are there to make a wish, he suggests stopping by the Wishing Stall for a chat.
zhuiyuejie_first_10_124: Xiangli Yao reveals that Patty has encountered some technical difficulties, likely due to four unreadable wishes, which he believes are causing the malfunction. Wanting to ensure everyone enjoys the festival, you offer to help Xiangli Yao resolve the issue.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_52: The first wish is from a researcher, though you are unsure who they are. Xiang-LEE, a silver robot created by Xiangli, provides a reasonable analysis, helping you begin your search for the wisher's true desire. Just as you prepare to investigate, Xiangli Yao receives an emergency call—a prototype's core has gone out of control, and he must leave immediately, entrusting you and Xiang-LEE with the investigation.
zhuiyuejie_first_14_47: Outside the Academy, Xiang-LEE analyzes the characteristics of the wisher, and they seem to match a young woman nearby. She introduces herself as Zhezhi, a painter, but it turns out she isn't the person you're looking for after all.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_44: You overhear two researchers discussing something called "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" and decide to ask one of them, Shifan, about the wisher you are looking for. During your conversation, Xiang-LEE accidentally detects a connection between the wisher and the syndrome. As the robot processes the information, Shifan seems flustered for a moment and quickly bids you farewell.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_43: Just then, a researcher named Jiuli, who had been eavesdropping, approaches and tells you that Shifan is indeed the wisher. Jiuli reveals that he and Shifan were once close friends, united by their passion for Echo research, but they've since grown distant. Jiuli is eager to understand what caused the rift between them and suggests you pique Shifan's interest by gathering Echo-related research data.
zhuiyuejie_first_21_73: After collecting the necessary data, Xiang-LEE suddenly speaks in Xiangli Yao's voice. It turns out Xiangli Yao is remotely controlling Xiang-LEE to assist you in uncovering Shifan's true desire.
zhuiyuejie_first_22_84: When you speak with Shifan again, he opens up about his true wish, confessing that he has been burdened with guilt ever since Jiuli was injured in a lab accident. At that moment, Jiuli appears, expressing his feelings. Though the two seem to argue, you can tell that their friendship is strong, and you are certain Shifan's wish will eventually come true.
zhuiyuejie_first_25_25: The second wish involves a difficult choice. Following the same approach as with Shifan, you decide to track down the wisher, Ms. Heying, and hear her story.
zhuiyuejie_first_27_33: During your conversation, Ms. Heying shares the promise she made to her late son, Xiuyuan. Wanting to ease her pain, you take her to Taoyuan Vale to experience the festival's joy.
zhuiyuejie_first_32_37: While at the Moon Shooter Stall, you encounter some Midnight Rangers whom Xiuyuan once mentored. They speak fondly of Xiuyuan and his legacy, gradually helping to soothe Ms. Heying's grief.
zhuiyuejie_first_35_51: With the second wish resolved, you hear two children, Li and Momo, arguing over something related to the Hero Plays. From their conversation, you discover that the third wisher, Mahn, is hiding in his secret base.
zhuiyuejie_first_37_45: When you find Mahn, he is in awe of your past victory against the Tacet Discords and considers you the super Resonator from the Hero Plays. As you chat, you come to understand why he made his wish, and you decide to teach him what it truly means to be a hero. Naturally, the best way to do this is by finding a real-life hero to serve as his role model.
zhuiyuejie_first_38_37: You return to the Wishing Stall and discuss potential candidates for Mahn's hero with Xiangli Yao. As you weigh the options, Xiangli Yao suggests that you are the best choice. To solidify this idea, Xiangli adjusts your Terminal to record your daily life, intending to use it as a reference for Mahn.
zhuiyuejie_second_2_39: At Panhua's Restaurant, you receive a call from Chixia inviting you to the upcoming Moonlit Fair.
zhuiyuejie_second_52_13: Back in the real world, Xiangli Yao needs to check on Patty's condition and suggests meeting up later. You decide to spend time at Taoyuan Vale.
zhuiyuejie_second_53_44: You meet Mahn and his friends, who, after watching the reference video, gain a better understanding of what it means to be a true hero.
zhuiyuejie_second_54_51: You encounter Shifan and Jiuli, who reconcile and restart their Echo research.
zhuiyuejie_second_55_61: You find Ms. Heying and some Midnight Rangers, who, having learned to cook from Xiuyuan, make pastries for her. Ms. Heying feels less lonely and lost.
zhuiyuejie_second_56_17: You meet Zhezhi, who is drawing the scenery of the Moon-Chasing Festival. Despite her shyness, she seems uplifted by the festivities.
zhuiyuejie_second_5_23: Under the Wishing Tree, Xiangli Yao informs you that Patty has become a portal to a Sonoro Sphere, and the abnormal data likely hides within the fourth wish. To ensure the Moonlit Fair runs smoothly, you, Abby, and Xiangli Yao decide to enter and investigate this Sonoro.
zhuiyuejie_second_58_70: When you finally meet up with Xiangli Yao, you discuss Pascar's obsession with the ultimate truth. Xiangli Yao worries about being consumed by the same obsession and abandoning everything. You reassure him by emphasizing the enduring bonds between people. To prove your words, you offer your hand to Xiangli Yao and invite him to enjoy the festival together.
zhuiyuejie_second_12_38: Separated from Xiangli Yao by a turbulent data torrent, you and Abby find yourselves in a room resembling a studio. After investigating, you realize the space is based on Xiangli Yao's childhood memories. You encounter young Xiangli Yao, who is waiting for his father while his friends Pascar, Modi, and Ryan invite him to make wishes at the Moontree Lodge.
zhuiyuejie_second_23_37: In the next room, you discover a Wishing Stall with decorations that don't match this year's theme. Xiangli Yao and Pascar, now more mature, discuss the paths intellectuals should take and each makes their own choice.
zhuiyuejie_second_25_13: You uncover Xiangli Yao's connection with the Moontree Lodge and continue exploring to reveal the hidden truth.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_66: After defeating the Twisted Obsessions, Pascar's illusion appears and reveals the truth, surprised by Xiangli Yao's comments about how his research inspired many and laid the foundation for the "Pascar Spectrum" theory. With his wish fulfilled, Pascar's illusion asks Xiangli Yao to witness the world they have protected before disappearing.
POI_QSMG_28_1: Whoa! I knew it be strong, but not that strong.
POI_QSMG_28_2: Does this mean it really is...
POI_QSMG_29_1: Phew... We finally caught up with you. You move too fast. What happened just now... Was it another TD?
POI_QSMG_29_2: Hmph, that's right. But {PlayerName} and I took care of it with the old one-two. No biggie.
POI_QSMG_29_5: Yes, they sure are... Huh? Mr. Millkeeper... did you just say something?
POI_QSMG_29_8: ...Are you both warriors drawn here by the knight's legend?
POI_QSMG_29_9: Haven't seen such fools in a long time. Watching you two charge in like that... exactly like the ones that came before you.
POI_QSMG_29_10: You mean there were others? I don't think I've ever seen any besides you, Mr. Millkeeper.
POI_QSMG_29_11: Of course there were. Some choose to move on, and some... well, they just aged out.
POI_QSMG_29_13: The so-called Windmill Keepers in today's language. But back in the day, I... We were called knights too—though more accurately, we were considered fake knights who excelled at deception.
POI_QSMG_29_14: We were outcasts, people in distress, and many ordinary folks who were drawn in by the legend. We'd find an old horse and cobble together some makeshift armor, and fashion a sword.
POI_QSMG_29_15: We clung to our notions of the knight's oath, laughingstocks wherever we went, dreaming of exploring Whisperwind Haven and even venturing beyond its limits.
POI_QSMG_29_16: Legends of knighthood continued to spread, but over time, the knights in these stories grew more noble and refined with every retelling...
POI_QSMG_29_17: When the people of Egla Town finally realized that there were newcomers settling in Whisperwind Haven, the nameless knights had already become the Windmill Keepers.
POI_QSMG_29_18: S-So what you're saying is… the Windmill Keepers weren't protecting the Windmills. They were watching over... Whisperwind Haven.
POI_QSMG_29_19: It wasn't till we arrived that we realized the many dangers lurking throughout the land. Moving forward wasn't as simple as we thought.
POI_QSMG_29_20: Then a knight tossed a ring made of rough steel onto the table and said briskly, "Let's carve out a path ahead."
POI_QSMG_29_21: "Soon enough, others will follow and reach the same place we have..."
POI_QSMG_29_22: My younger self wouldn't dare believe words spoken so lightly. A new path meant risking everything, even our lives.
POI_QSMG_29_23: That knight might have noticed my hesitation. He came over to talk to me and recited his oath.
POI_QSMG_29_24: "In the name of Korlacchi, I hold fast to humility and justice... Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all..."
POI_QSMG_29_26: He was right. This was the path we all swore to... and he stuck to it until the very end, right here in Whisperwind Haven.
POI_QSMG_29_28: B-But how were you so sure that more people would come? What if...
POI_QSMG_29_29: Ha... Remember the ring? We were knights skilled in deception, so why not make it all one grand performance?
POI_QSMG_29_30: He would travel far and wide with those rings, and in the name of Korlacchi, preach the knightly way to anyone who dared dream of becoming one.
POI_QSMG_29_31: Regardless of wealth, title, or position...
POI_QSMG_29_33: Funny you ask. Despite his vigor, he was just an ordinary farmer from the countryside...
POI_QSMG_29_34: An ordinary farmer... A knight of deceit... Korlacchi. Never really existed...
POI_QSMG_29_38: Carlow runs away in a hurry. As Mr. Millkeeper looks confused by Carlow's outburst, you explain that Carlow has been chasing after the knight.
POI_QSMG_30_1: ...I see. That must be a bitter pill for the boy to swallow. All this time chasing after a dream only to find out it was an illusion all along.
POI_QSMG_30_2: This wasn't where he lost the knight's trail. It's where his journey ended.
POI_QSMG_30_3: People love to romanticize the past, don't they? The knight in shining armor we saw as children was really just an ordinary farmer in tattered rags riding a frail old horse.
POI_QSMG_30_4: Please, apologize to him for me. We are liars, nothing more. But... once he's cooled off, he will come to understand. He's been seeking what we once sought, after all.
POI_QSMG_30_5: Everyone who made it here left their marks. The trails they walked, the words they spoke, the tales of the ones who explored the furthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven...
POI_QSMG_30_6: These things shine brighter than any life and are more genuine than any knightly title.
POI_QSMG_30_7: Have you... ever felt lonely on this path?
POI_QSMG_30_8: Haha, perhaps this path of chivalry we uphold is always meant to be walked alone. Besides, "he" is always there.
POI_QSMG_30_9: You must have met him, right? The Echo that you used in the battle just now was displaying his sword skills.
POI_QSMG_30_11: Mad Knight? So that's what the townsfolk call him. Not bad... At least he's got a title now.
POI_QSMG_30_14: "He" appeared around the same time as the Windmill Keepers. There's no doubt "he" is a Tacet Discord.
POI_QSMG_30_15: But the swordsmanship, the way he speaks, and his stance against other TDs all remind me of him.
POI_QSMG_30_16: People say that TDs can absorb lingering frequencies...
POI_QSMG_30_17: I believe he exists because the essence of knighthood has taken root deep in Whisperwind Haven.
POI_QSMG_30_18: He swings his sword against enemies to protect the things he loves. When he points his sword at the common folk he meets, I think he's challenging them to a duel... He hopes someone will accept his challenge.
POI_QSMG_30_19: He is showing that to be a true knight, one must abandon uncertainty, confront fears, and wield their sword with courage.
POI_QSMG_30_22: Can you tell me your name, and the others?
POI_QSMG_30_23: I'd like your name to remember you.
POI_QSMG_30_24: Names... Hmm, no one's asked that before. What's wrong with using a common title?
POI_QSMG_30_25: Oh, I know. {PlayerName} is great at picking names. Come on, do your magic!
POI_QSMG_30_28: Like the wind, it leaves a trail that's difficult to trace, yet it journeys to distant lands...
POI_QSMG_31_1: Carlow has probably made it back to town by now. What are you going to say when you see him...?
POI_QSMG_31_2: He should have had enough time to think things over. Let's go speak to him.
POI_QSMG_32_1: What do we have here? Our little pretend knight isn't out chasing footprints today. Just standing there like he's lost his spark.
POI_QSMG_32_2: By the way, have you received the invitation? We're just about to buy the attire for the ceremony. Why don't you join us?
POI_QSMG_32_3: Not every day you get to have a "real" knight be as your guide, after all...
POI_QSMG_32_4: Come on. We've wasted enough time here already...
POI_QSMG_32_5: Hey... Those are the two we met earlier.
POI_QSMG_32_7: Forget it. You may as well be a rock if you've nothing to say. Off we go on...
POI_QSMG_32_9: In the name of Korlacchi, I pledge to show mercy and kindness to the weak...
POI_QSMG_32_10: I will remain true to all that I love and protect until my last breath.
POI_QSMG_32_11: Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...
POI_QSMG_32_12: What's got into you? Reciting your little fantasy knight's oath now?
POI_QSMG_32_13: Right here, I, Carlow, swear to the knight's code and challenge you to a duel.
POI_QSMG_32_14: Do you know which part of the fish is the best? Can you practice your sword skills with just a simple wooden pole? Do you know the best path deeper into Whisperwind Haven...?
POI_QSMG_32_15: Have you ever truly helped someone without expecting anything in return, or charged toward a giant with no thought for yourself?
POI_QSMG_32_16: This duel... it all comes down to an apology. The loser must apologize to the victor...
POI_QSMG_32_17: Hey, check it out. I think Carlow's got that wannabe tough guy acting all scared.
POI_QSMG_32_21: Huh? What if Carlow gets bullied...
POI_QSMG_32_22: Let knights handle their own matters. In the name of Korlacchi...
POI_QSMG_32_23: So, what does Korlacchi mean anyhow?
POI_QSMG_32_24: Someone needs to visit the library more often.
POI_QSMG_32_25: Huh? No way. Not happening. Reading makes me nauseous. Just tell me the answer already!
POI_QSMG_32_26: Korlacchi, in the Rinascita language, means courage.

Reach SOL3 Phase 3.

You can consume a double amount of Waveplates to claim double rewards after completing certain challenges.

Heihaian_main_1_3_5601_30: You and the Shorekeeper finally arrive at the simulated Port City of Guixu. This magnificent city teeters on the brink of destruction with two Laments looming, sealing the city's fate. Though history cannot be altered, you can only relive the harrowing moments of the city's destruction and the despair that engulfed it.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5605_17: For the first time, the Shorekeeper savors the taste of tea and resolves to keep a special reserve of leaves for you within her Sonoro.
Heihaian_main_1_3_5613_41: In the Stellar Matrix of the Port City of Guixu, you find Hoda tending to the injured. She reveals that the Tethys System's handling of the Lament is the root cause of the current crisis. Before she passes, she imparts that gravity is the key to resolving the situation.

EVENT_LGNDPW_1_2: But Ragunna doesn't even have that population.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_3: That's 3 copies each Ragunnesi? I doubt they sell as much pizza over there...
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_5: I heard you were hiring a consultant.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_6: (Upon hearing your voice, Alannah turns her back and lowers her voice.)
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_7: Understood. I'll come up with a plan. I'll report once I've made progress, sir!
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_10: Oh, sorry about that. Haven't introduced myself yet. My name's Alannah, I'm with the Product Development Team at the Pioneer Association.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_11: You know, all the merchandise and souvenirs you get from the Association are our handiwork!
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_13: Oh, that... I'm recently brought onboard a merch project from our Ragunna division in Rinascita.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_14: And our manager just gave me a sales target of three million copies.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_15: Is that why you're hiring a consultant?
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_16: Yes, it'll be one heck of a job.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_17: If it's the release of something as highly anticipated as the Second Coming of Solaris, sure... But some average merch can never hit those sales figures.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_18: Still, I gotta figure something out.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_19: Everyone thinks I'm never gonna pull it off. But maybe, just maybe, there's a chance I might make the sale.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_20: From what I know, information in and out of Ragunna is pretty limited, so it takes time for people there to learn what's happening on the outside.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_21: I thought they might find designs from outside their culture intriguing, so I came to Jinzhou for inspiration.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_22: {PlayerName}, Ms. Maqi told me you know the ins and outs of Jinzhou. Would you like to be my consultant?

Chilled, diced fruit is put in ice water and sweetened with fresh nectar. The clinking ice cubes produce a clear, melodic sound. 
Camellya made this fruit tea to her liking, with just a hint of milk and grapes as the base, subtly balanced by a splash of gooseberry juice.

Event_TCTL_1_1: A Lollo Logistics vehicle with a strange paint job. Wonder who parked it in front of the Pioneer Association?
Event_TCTL_1_4: The loudspeaker on the vehicle is playing an advertisement with funny music.
Event_TCTL_1_6: "Take out your Terminal—your trusty wish-granter! It's time to dive into some juicy perks again with Lollo Logistics' 10-billion-worth subsidies. Available to all Pioneers and couriers!"
Event_TCTL_1_7: "Victory at the Norfall Barrens, return of Mt. Firmament, and a successful Moon-Chasing Festival... One remarkable event after the other, Jinzhou is slowly presenting its unique brilliance across Solaris!"
Event_TCTL_1_8: "As a way to encourage our Pioneers and couriers to further share their Jinzhou explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves!"
Event_TCTL_1_9: "Be it a journey to mountains, valleys, the bustling city, or quiet towns, just upload your Adventure Logs in Jinzhou to this courier truck, and you'll receive an 'Adventure Package' for the corresponding location filled with surprises!"
Event_TCTL_1_10: "But that's not all. Enjoy same-day delivery across the Jinzhou area with upgraded Lollo express shipping services to better tailor to all your traveling needs during the campaign! Tiered discounts included!"
Event_TCTL_1_11: "A friendly reminder: While lovely views and rewards are up for grabs, remember that safety always comes first! In the case of an emergency, please call the nearby Midnight Rangers for assistance!"

EVENT_LGNDPW_1_23: If the pay is good, sure.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_25: It'll be an uphill battle, but on the plus side they gave me a huge budget, so I'll definitely make it worth your while.
EVENT_LGNDPW_1_26: Then I'll start brainstorming some plans myself. Come find me when you're ready!
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_2: Allow me to give you a run-down on how to operate the Resonance Nexus.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_3: First, place your Pangu Terminal on the Nexus, and it will start loading the relevant information.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_4: Then, you can check your map and fast-travel to Jinzhou through the Nexus.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_5: Last but not least, thank you for choosing our services.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_6: I gotta say, whoever invented the Terminal was a genius.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_7: You can connect it to Beacons for information, use it for comms, and absorb Echoes with just a single button press.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_10: However, most of the people in Ragunna can only use the public Terminals. You'll need the Order's permission to have one for yourself.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_12: Well, maybe. But they've probably gotten used to it by now I guess.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_13: Speaking of which, Ragunna Terminals come in the shape of lanterns! They look really pretty.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_14: I imagine they'd find the gourd-shaped design of the Huanglong Terminals interesting.
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_15: Let's make scale models of the Pangu Terminals for merch!
EVENT_LGNDPW_10_16: I'll start working on it straight away. With a real Gourd at hand, it should be a quick one!
EVENT_LGNDPW_11_1: Ohhh... Moments like this always give me goosebumps. Do you think they‘ll like the Terminals?
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_1: "It has an interesting shape." "The color is too dark for my liking." "The Order's not going to give me troubles for owning a model of a private terminal, right?"...
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_2: The feedback this time—is actually pretty favorable!
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_3: Aside from a few reviews that I don't quite get, the Gourd is quite popular among most of our consumers!
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_5: The sales department says if we get it into mass production, we're looking at an estimated total sale of at least...
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_6: A very optimistic three million copies?
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_7: A very modest one million copies?
EVENT_LGNDPW_12_9: Oh, man. I've given it all I got. Am I ever gonna make that sale?
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_1: {PlayerName}, do you like cars? Or automobiles in general?
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_4: Yes, but I can't afford one.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_6: Come on, nothing beats the sound of the engine roaring as you zoom down the open road with the wind in your hair. It's a feeling you don't get to enjoy anywhere else.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_7: You should give it a try when you get the chance. You'll love it!
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_8: Same here. But, yeah, they aren't cheap to get. Hahaha.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_9: Sorry, I digress. During my time in Ragunna, I noticed their road infrastructure isn't the finest.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_10: You won't find many roads in the countryside, and even the city roads aren't friendly for driving.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_11: Why don't we explore the market for scale model cars in Ragunna? We might discover some potential automobile enthusiasts there.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_13: If there's no demand, we'll create one.
EVENT_LGNDPW_13_14: How about we go to Lollo Logistics for some pointers? They use a variety of vehicles, which can help us figure out what's best for making models!
EVENT_LGNDPW_14_2: What seems to be the trouble?
EVENT_LGNDPW_14_3: I finished loading all my cargo and was getting ready to leave, but the darn engine wouldn't start for some reason...
EVENT_LGNDPW_14_4: Let me give it a look.
EVENT_LGNDPW_14_5: You know, I'm something of an auto mechanic myself.
EVENT_LGNDPW_15_3: Fantastic, for a while there I thought I was gonna miss my delivery. I can't thank you enough. Time for me to hit the road. See you both around!
EVENT_LGNDPW_15_4: The courier starts the engine. You watch as the vehicle slowly disappears into the distance.
EVENT_LGNDPW_15_5: I never know you are an auto repair expert, {PlayerName}! So you know every nut and bolt inside that truck?
EVENT_LGNDPW_15_7: Like the back of my hand.
EVENT_LGNDPW_15_8: Then it'll make our model-making job a cakewalk. So, without further ado, let's get to work!
EVENT_LGNDPW_16_1: Drum roll, please. It's that time again. Let's see how our truck model was received over at Ragunna...
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_1: "And the 'Ugly Car Award' goes to..." "Did someone get tired of the Cloudpuffers? Or are Tubpups not cute enough?" "Who would ride in crappy metal containers when we have Gondolas around?"...
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_3: Probably not many car people over there.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_4: So they don't really need cars.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_5: I get it now. You can't expect to open a shoe store and make sales when the locals are running around barefoot.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_6: They've got cute-looking Echoes that can be used for transportation. There's no reason for them to have cars.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_7: *sigh* Getting that three-million-copy sale feels nothing more than a pipe dream now.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_9: It was an impossible sale to begin with.
EVENT_LGNDPW_17_11: Gotta do my research and learn more about their actual preferences. I can't be just making up a market willy-nilly...
EVENT_LGNDPW_19_2: How did you get surrounded by TDs?
EVENT_LGNDPW_19_3: Well, as a member of the Pioneer Association, I should be out in the field doing actual research.
EVENT_LGNDPW_19_4: So I came all the way out here for some inspiration. But I didn't expect this...
EVENT_LGNDPW_19_5: Wait, there's a TD right next to that person over there. He might be in trouble. We need to help him!
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_1: Oh, yeah. They'll be flying off the shelves!
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_4: You see, Rinascita is comprised mostly of islands out at sea, with Ragunna City on one of the isles.
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_5: On the other hand, Huanglong is made up of large areas of land, as far as the eye can see!
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_6: I'm sure most people in Ragunna have yet to ever lay eyes on some extraordinary mountains and rivers like the ones in Jinzhou.
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_8: Let's make good use of that. I shall name this set of merch Huanglong From Above!
EVENT_LGNDPW_2_9: Whaddya say, {PlayerName}? Time to capture Jinzhou in all its glory from high up in the skies, and give the Ragunnesi something that will knock their socks off!
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_1: Look out! There's a TD right next to you!
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_2: Oh? You mean Slowly? Slowly won't hurt anyone.
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_3: You gave a TD a name?
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_4: That's right. Slowly, it strolls. Slowly, it lives.
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_7: I'm here, just watching Slowly, chilling. Slowly's here, chilling, watching the scenery. We both take each other slowly.
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_9: Why don't you join us and enjoy some sunshine?
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_11:
By the young man's invitation, the three of you begin sunbathing with Slowy.
After getting plenty of sunshine, you see Alannah in deep thought. She then says goodbye and returns to Jinzhou on her own.
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_12: What do you think? Felt good, didn't it?
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_13: It doesn't mean us any harm.
EVENT_LGNDPW_20_15: Quite nice living life this way, don't you think? Slowly, we stroll. Slowly, we live.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_3: I did! The way that guy treated the TD made me think about the relationship between humans, TDs, and Echoes.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_4: In Jinzhou, people fear and despise Tacet Discords because they have decimated countless homelands in the past.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_5: As for Echoes, they're mostly for utility purposes. Resonators defeat TDs and transform them into Echoes to enhance their capabilities.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_6: But in Ragunna, Echoes aren't just tools of warfare.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_7: Children buy Echo toys, and you see Echo marching bands in the streets. There are even octopus Echoes that strike the bells in bell towers.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_10: Then it dawns on me that since the Ragunnesi love Echoes so much, making plushies of Jinzhou Echoes would definitely work!
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_14: After some hard work, Alannah manages to send a shipment of Jinzhou-styled Echo plushies to Ragunna.
EVENT_LGNDPW_21_15: Ohhh, I have a good feeling about this one! I can't wait for the results!
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_1: "What a cute Gulpuff stuffed toy!" "Why are they so spiky?" "I'd say our plushie Echoes are a lot cuter."...
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_2: Hmm... The reviews are kinda mixed.
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_3: There are all kinds of Echoes over in Ragunna, so it's understandable they can get pretty picky about them.
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_4: It went better than it could've been.
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_6: Yep! Can't expect any product design to be a banger right out of the bat. We need to come up with even more and better ideas to attract the Ragunnesi's attention.
EVENT_LGNDPW_22_7: I'll message you when something hits me again! Thanks for dropping by today, {PlayerName}!
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_1: I'm at the end of my rope, {PlayerName}.
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_2: The project's deadline is coming up, and if I can't get it right this time... I suppose I'm not really fit for the job.
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_4: Let's give it one last effort.
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_6: As I'm slowly reduced to ashes among the flames of my career, you are my saving light at the end of the tunnel...
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_7: For our final topic of merch, I'd like to approach Jinzhou's culture and people's daily lives.
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_8: Jinzhou's distinctive culture and traditional values are completely novel to the Ragunnesi.
EVENT_LGNDPW_23_9: Let's go chat around with some Jinzhou residents!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_1: Jinzhou has plenty of plays, but it's people who truly understand them that are lacking.
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_2: Back in my day, those actors were real gluttons for hard work. And that made them great performers.
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_3: Nowadays, people would cheer for just about anything. None of 'em knows what makes for a good play!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_4: So you're saying the plays aren't as good as they were before, sir?
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_5: Not even close. Those youngsters are way off on their deliveries!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_6: You young people need to have your eyes wide open to enjoy the really good stuff!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_7: You seem very knowledgeable about plays.
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_8: If foreigners were to visit Jinzhou, would you recommend that they watch plays here?
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_10: Jinzhou's hero plays have been around for so many years that they've formed a style of their own!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_11: This old theater buff may sound picky sometimes, but I'll say the plays are more than enough to feast the foreigners' eyes on!
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_12: Thank you for sharing these with us, sir.
EVENT_LGNDPW_24_13: I think I got another idea, {PlayerName}! Let's head back!
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_1: That mister was pretty critical of those actors. However, I do have a feeling that deep down, he's really proud of them.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_2: He genuinely believes that Jinzhou's play culture is something the whole world should witness.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_3: Ragunna also has its own unique culture and traditions.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_4: For example, during the Carnevale, people will wear traditional clothing and masks with designs that represent their ancestry.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_5: It's a way of commemorating their homes and loved ones lost during the Lament.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_7: I'd like to see it if I get the chance.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_8: See? Just as the mister said, one place's unique culture will definitely impress someone from a different land.
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_9: For example, you got really hooked when I told you about the Carnevale!
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_10: Now let's snap some hero play highlights and send them over to Ragunna!
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_11: A while after the hero play merch was sent to Ragunna...
EVENT_LGNDPW_25_12: {PlayerName}! I have the reviews! Moment of truth!
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_1: "Interesting stories." "I hope I get to see a live performance one day." "I want to be like Fiamma."...
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_4: Finally, our efforts paid off, and that's the end of my work!
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_5: So we hit the three-million-copy sale?
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_6: Hahaha. Not even close. The salespeople say the hero play merch will sell 30,000 copies at most.
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_7: Actually, I was just informed that the manager who gave me the sales target was removed.
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_8: The main office put someone new in charge, and she's really satisfied with what I achieved.
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_11: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I wouldn't have done it without you.
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_12: If you hadn't been there for me till the end, I would've been in total meltdown a long time ago...
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_13: Here, I got you a little something. Please take it!
EVENT_LGNDPW_26_14: I'll be counting on you again if I land on another big project next time!
EVENT_LGNDPW_3_1: They're gorgeous, {PlayerName}! I'd even recommend you for an exclusive photographer with the Association!
EVENT_LGNDPW_3_2: Our product testing survey from Ragunna just came back. Let's see what they have to say.
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_1: "Boring image spam." "Lacks the unique angles of humanist photography and the diverse styles of oil paintings."...
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_2: Well, that's unexpected. Does this mean the Ragunnesi prefer art galleries over photos to enjoy their landscapes?
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_3: At least we know their taste now.
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_4: At least these photos were well received in Jinzhou.
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_5: Yes, you're right! We're heading in the right direction towards success.
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_6: All we need to do is learn from our mistakes, and the next one will be bound to impress!
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_7: Since the locals really like them, I'll save up these photos of Huanglong From Above and pass them out in the office for everyone to enjoy.
EVENT_LGNDPW_4_8: Let's come up with something else tomorrow, {PlayerName}!
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_1: Who do you think is the richest person in Jinzhou, {PlayerName}?
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_5: The Magistrate does hold significant authority, but she's not the one.
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_6: Yuanwu has his own boxing gym and is secretly the proprietor of the Liuxian Teahouse. A good guess.
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_7: Still not the richest in Jinzhou even with all of that, though.
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_8: Hahaha. So you're saying you've got a hefty saving, huh? But don't feel disappointed when I reveal the real name.
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_9: I heard a rumor that this mysterious tycoon dwells in this Gourmet Street...
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_11: Exactly! Mahe's that No.1 rich guy in Jinzhou's urban legends!
EVENT_LGNDPW_5_12: Why don't we pay him a visit? A documentary showcasing Jinzhou's richest person will definitely catch the attention of those in Ragunna!
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_1: Excuse me, Mr. Mahe. Do you mind revealing to us your net worth, please?
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_3: Word is, you're Jinzhou's top rich.
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_4: Impress us, richest person in Jinzhou.
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_5: Well, see the shops and vendors on the street? They've all been around for decades, simple and honest.
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_6: And I'm just another humble grocery store owner like them. How could I be the richest person in Jinzhou?
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_7: I heard a guy say he couldn't even afford 10 eggs with his monthly salary at your place...
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_8: Nonsense. If he's tight on money, I wouldn't mind giving him a few eggs for free.
EVENT_LGNDPW_6_9: But going broke over a few eggs? That's just ridiculous.
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_1: Mahe says he's not the richest person in Jinzhou. Well...
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_3: Do we have a Plan B?
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_4: Hmm... We'll just run with it and continue working on this merch.
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_5: I know Mahe may just be an ordinary grocery shop owner, but making him the man who has Jinzhou's lifeline in the clutches should make for a more interesting story.
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_6: Once I have all this information in fine print, it's gonna blow Ragunna away!
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_7: Later, by adding a few edits here and there, Alannah finishes compiling a printout called Mahe's Spicy Secret.
EVENT_LGNDPW_7_8: Haha. The product testing survey just came back from Ragunna. Time to dive into the reviews.
EVENT_LGNDPW_8_1: "A grocery shop owner is actually the richest guy? Yeah right." "A month's worth of salary for just 10 eggs? Life must be hard over at Jinzhou."...
EVENT_LGNDPW_8_2: I guess the Ragunnesi don't really buy into mysteries of family secrets...
EVENT_LGNDPW_8_5: I'm sorry... Unreasonable sales target shouldn't be our excuse for bad journalism.
EVENT_LGNDPW_8_6: As a member of the Pioneer Association, I should always strive to uphold honesty and integrity in everything I create.
EVENT_LGNDPW_8_7: Thanks for reminding me that, {PlayerName}! I should go work on my next idea!
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_1: {PlayerName}, have you ever noticed that your Terminal's design is different from the Jinzhou standard and the ones you find in the Black Shores?
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_4: As a matter of fact, the Terminals used in Ragunna, including their Resonance Nexus and Beacons, are all different from Jinzhou's.
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_5: And you don't really get to see many Reserved Terminals over there.
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_6: Stuff like this might come as extraordinary to the Ragunnesi. I was thinking maybe...
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_9: How'd you guess that? Bingo! Jinzhou's Resonance Nexus and Terminals boast Huanglong's unique design elements.
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_10: Items with never-seen-before designs like these might pique their interest.
EVENT_LGNDPW_9_11: Why don't we go take a look at the Resonance Nexus, {PlayerName}?

HelpText_132_Content:
[About]
A train crashes from the dreamscape into reality, ripping open a gateway to the realm of illusions.
A looming shadow greets you with a grim prophecy: the world will succumb to this nightmare, and night will reign eternal.
You struggle to awaken from this terrifying vision, desperately clinging to shreds of reality left in the shattered dreams...
Thankfully, a white cat appears and guides you back on track, helping you find the lost allies trapped in the realm of dreams. Together, you battle against the darkest terrors of chaos.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17.

[Dreamscape Odyssey]
Join the strange white cat in rescuing your Resonator companions from their Dreamscapes. Together, you will delve deep into the Somnoire to uncover the truth behind the nightmares. Each of the 6 Dreamscapes offers unique rewards upon completion.


[Rift Runner]
Nightmares have torn through the veil of reality, wreaking havoc across the world. It's down to you to restore the crumbling order to the land, with the mystic boon of Illusive Sprint received from the strange white cat.
Compete "Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits" to unlock "Rift Runner."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Nightmare Revisits]
The looming shadow stares at you with its fiery eyes, as if trying to draw you back into the endless darkness. Enter the Somnoire with your trusted companions, link your minds and spirits, and relive your epic battle against the ever-lurking nightmare. Fight the Black Cat again with Resonators of your choice. This time, the combat challenge will feature new exciting twists. Use the power of Dream Link to gain an upper hand!
Complete "When the Night Knocks" to unlock "Nightmare Revisits."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Dream Shards]
Complete Rift Runner, Nightmare Revisits, and the quest "When the Night Knocks" to earn Dream Shards.
Collect the required quantities of Dream Shards to unlock the corresponding milestone rewards.
Dream Shards are obtainable at any time by participating in the event.

[Limited-Time Rewards]
Complete the Limited-Time Rewards objectives to earn exclusive rewards, including the Featured 4-Star Weapon "Somnoire Anchor" and Featured Weapon Projection "Projection: Somnoire Anchor."

[Tips]
The Limited-Time Rewards objectives will expire when the event ends, but you can continue challenging the stages afterward to earn the permanent rewards.

HelpText_136_Content:
[About]
The looming shadow stares at you with its fiery eyes, as if trying to draw you back into the endless darkness. Enter the Somnoire with your trusted companions, link your minds and spirits, and relive your epic battle against the ever-lurking nightmare.

Revisit the epic battle with Resonators of your choice. Use the power of Dream Link to gain an upper hand in this fight!
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Team Comp]
Select 1 Main Resonator and 2 Support Resonators to start the challenge.
You will only control the Main Resonator, while the Support Resonators will stay on the battlefield and automatically fight alongside you.
During this event season, Resonators available include: Rover-Spectro, Encore, Yinlin, Changli, Zhezhi, Camellya, and Lumi.

[Dream Link]
"Dream Link" is available in Nightmare Revisits challenges:
When your Sync Energy is full, cast every team member's Resonance Liberations in a row to activate the Link Field.
When the Link Field is active:
1. All team members' ATK, Crit. Rate, Crit. DMG, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed are significantly boosted, while Resonance Skill Cooldowns are greatly reduced.
2. A Stagnation Zone is generated, immobilizing enemies within the Link Field.
3. Nearby enemies are pulled toward your Resonators upon activation.
4. When the Link Field ends, your team gains continuous HP regeneration.

[Sinister Calling]
Defend the [Dreamscape Telephone] until you defeat all the nightmares.
Points are calculated as follows: Remaining Time × Time Coefficient + [Dreamscape Telephone] Integrity × Integrity Coefficient + Points earned from defeating enemies.
Eliminate all enemies in a wave before the countdown ends to earn extra Time points.

[Terror Reborn]
Eliminate all the deep dream nightmares.
Points are calculated as follows: Remaining Time × Time Coefficient + Points earned from defeating enemies.
Eliminate all enemies in a wave before the countdown ends to earn extra Time points.

[Rewards]
The point challenges are available permanently. Reach milestone goals to earn a variety of rewards.

Preheating_Finish_Desc_01:
Huanglong consists of a capital and six cities, renowned for its vast lands and rich history, whereas Rinascita is known for its archipelagos embraced by the sea.
(Clipped to the page is a landscape painting of Ragunna brought by Alannah.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_02:
For Jinzhou citizens, buying everyday essentials on Gourmet Street makes up a big part of their living expenses... When it comes to personal finances in Ragunna, most people handle their money through the wealthy Montelli family's prominent bank service.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the interior of a Ragunna bank.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_03:
While Terminals are crutial tools for Resonators, Reserved Terminals are a rare sight in Ragunna.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a Ragunna Terminal.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_04:
In contrast to Jinzhou citizens, who are accustomed to manmade vehicles and vessels, transportation in Rinascita is mostly Echoes.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the special transport Echo Gondola in Ragunna.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_05:
Echoes can be found throughout the city of Ragunna.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a special Echo in the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_06:
The leisure activities of Jinzhou people revolve around watching plays in theaters and chatting in teahouses, while in Ragunna, there is a longstanding tradition of celebrating Carnevale...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the streets of the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_07: A vague figure flashed across the sea of clouds, leaving behind a mellow melody...
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_01: It seems the Ragunnesi prefer art galleries over photos to enjoy their landscapes...
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_02: I once interviewed an artist from Ragunna who said, "Money is meant to be earned, not saved."
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_03: In Rinascita, people use Common Terminals, while owning a private Terminal requires registration.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_04: Gondola tours are a favorite pastime in Ragunna, enjoyed by people from all walks of life.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_05: In Ragunna, children buy Echo toys. There are even octopus Echoes that strike the bells in bell towers.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_06: During the Carnevale, Ragunnesi wear traditional clothing and masks with designs that represent their ancestry.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_07: This nightmare... How long was I trapped in it?
Preheating_Question_01: Do you prefer the land in "Huanglong from Above" or the archipelago of Rinascita?
Preheating_Question_02: If you suddenly obtained a large sum of Shell Credits, what would you do?
Preheating_Question_03: Do you think Resonators should be allowed to use their own Terminals freely?
Preheating_Question_04: Which kind of transportation would you prefer to travel with?
Preheating_Question_05: Do you believe humans and Tacet Discords can coexist peacefully?
Preheating_Question_06: How would you like to spend an afternoon when visiting an unfamiliar city?
Preheating_Task_Desc_01: Alannah invites you to Jinzhou's summits to take photos for the "Huanglong from Above" merch.
Preheating_Task_Desc_02: Alannah invites you to Gourmet Street to interview the reportedly richest person in Jinzhou.
Preheating_Task_Desc_03: Alannah wants to discuss if Terminals and Beacons would make good model merchandise.
Preheating_Task_Desc_04: Alannah invites you to Lollo Logistics to find the ideal vehicle for model merchandise.
Preheating_Task_Desc_05: Alannah seems to have run into some trouble while seeking inspiration in the wild...
Preheating_Task_Desc_06: Alannah invites you to talk with Jinzhou citizens to learn about their culture and daily life.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01: "Huanglong from Above" was well received in Jinzhou, but it fell flat in Ragunna. Guess we'll need to tailor it to their tastes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01_L: The land with a vast expanse.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01_R: The archipelago caressed by sea breezes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_02: Sounds like he's just trying to justify not managing his money properly...
Preheating_Viewpoin_02_R: Deposit it at a safe place.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03: I see... but I feel like most Resonators would rather have their own personal Terminal.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03_L: Terminals are a necessity for Resonators and should be allowed.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03_R: Abuse of Terminals brings many risks, and they should be regulated.
Preheating_Viewpoin_04: Fishing while sitting on a "fish"? That sounds like such a fun idea!
Preheating_Viewpoin_04_R: Echo Gondolas that cut through the wuthering waves.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05: Echoes seem to be an integral part of Ragunnesi's life.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05_L: No, they can't. Tacet Discords have an instinct to destroy and devour.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05_R: Yes, they can, after being converted into Echoes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_06: So that's how they pay tribute to their homelands and loved ones lost in the Lament...
Preheating_Viewpoin_06_L: Enjoy the local plays at a theater.
Preheating_Viewpoin_06_R: Experience the local festivals with the crowd.

InfoDisplay_104000901_Title: A Letter Written on Torn Paper
InfoDisplay_104000901_Text:
My dear boy,
 
Leaving you is the last thing I want, but these troubled times force my hand. All I can offer now are a few words on this torn paper.

Stand tall and live your life with pride. Your parents gave their lives for the dignity of art, and you carry the same blood in your veins.

I've sacrificed my freedom in pursuit of the endless mysteries these Echoes hold, but I believe in you—you have a strong heart. Hold on to hope and keep moving forward.

One day, the treasure we have valued deep within the Averardo Vault will bring forth new hope.

With Love,
Ash

InfoDisplay_103000011_Text:
Landmark Building Faces Environmental Concerns? Expert Assures Central Spire is Safe

With the completion of the Central Tower, many worry that this over one-thousand-meter skyscraper might harm the environment or cause structural issues. Professor Anderson, an expert from the Architecture Institute, provides some clarity.

“We conducted a ten-year study on the site's soil and groundwater,” says Anderson. “For such a massive building, we had to ensure the site could support its weight long-term. Our research shows the geological conditions here can sustain the building for over a century, with minimal tilt and settlement.”

Anderson also mentions the use of new materials, allowing the foundation to support a building up to two thousand meters. “However, the current height meets all needs.”
Regarding concerns about shading, Anderson adds, “We ensured a fifty-meter distance between the tower and nearby buildings. The upper levels are designed in a spiral to maximize natural light.”

InfoDisplay_103000013_Text:
...Mom! This building is so tall!
Today, our school took us on a tour. The guide told us that this is the tallest building in the world!
Tonight, the view from the top will be even better! But our class won't get to visit the rooftop until tomorrow night, so we have to wait another day.
Mom, do you think that when I stand on the rooftop, I'll be closer to Dad?
Will he be able to see me from up there as a star?
I asked the guide about it today, but she didn't answer.
The food tonight is delicious. It's my first time eating in a restaurant this high up! The utensils here are different from the ones we use at home...
Event_DSJDYCF_3_1: I didn't expect to cross paths with you here, {PlayerName}.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_2: This place... it's quite amazing. As I walked through, I felt as if I was drifting between past memories and, at times, into the fantasies of others.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_4: I see. That would explain a lot.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_6: Dreams always stir mixed emotions in me. For a long time, I was plagued by nightmares.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_7: Sleepless nights filled with images of my people displaced, shivering in the cold, and facing hunger. We were all so small before the might of the Lament.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_8: Yet, those nightmares serve as a constant reminder of the complex challenges our people face, the burdens I bear as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_9: It's okay to take a rest sometimes.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_10: Let go of your responsibilities! You're in a dream!
Event_DSJDYCF_3_11: But aren't you working just as hard to protect what you hold dear?
Event_DSJDYCF_3_12: This ear of millet... it holds deep meaning for me, but now, I'd like you to have it. May everything go smoothly for you on your journey.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_3: I just had a dream from my past.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_4: Simple dishes—plain noodles and soft steamed buns—but even in the dream, they appeared irresistible.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_7: Surprised? In my childhood, I wandered the streets, often plagued by hunger. Each time I passed a restaurant or a food stall, my steps felt heavier.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_8: Back then, all I longed for was a decent meal—so much so that it echoed even in my dreams.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_9: That must have been tough for you.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_10: It's behind me now. Look at me, healthy and well, am I not?
Event_DSJDYCF_5_11: When peace is finally enjoyed across the land, no one will have to starve as I once did.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_12: When we wake, let's go grab a meal together.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_13: I'll treat you to a feast in reality.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_14: Hehe, I won't say no to that. Then, it's a promise.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_15: Here, take this journal. It contains some recommendations. I hope you find it useful.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_5: You faintly hear the sounds of waves crashing against the shore—they seem distant, yet stirring emotions within you.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_6: Those sounds always take me back to the moments we shared—bathed in soft moonlight, with fine sand beneath us, and the rhythm of your breath and heartbeat filling the air.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_7: You really cherish those memories, don't you?
Event_DSJDYCF_6_8: ...It reassured me that I have indeed kept our memories for you.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_9: We'll create even more memories together.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_10: Let's explore more of the world together.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_11: Indeed, our connection will only grow stronger.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_12: Let these bright stars guide you on your journey.

Event_WGZM_8_1: As expected, our paths shall always cross, even in dreams.
Event_WGZM_8_3: I'm surprised that you also dream.
Event_WGZM_8_4: Yes. Your arrival provided an opening for me to enter this realm.
Event_WGZM_8_5: Yes, and in the few dreams I have, your presence is always there.
Event_WGZM_8_6: You have probably noticed that this place looks similar to the Black Shores.
Event_WGZM_8_7: Will the Black Shores be affected in reality?
Event_WGZM_8_8: Not at this moment, but this dreamscape is on the brink of collapsing.
Event_WGZM_8_9: Dreams of the Black Shores are gathering, mingling with those from other realms.
Event_WGZM_8_10: I sense those wishes, memories, and obsessions are turning into something familiar yet dangerous.
Event_WGZM_8_12: The existing data isn't enough to provide a clear answer...
Event_WGZM_8_13: In the worst case, this dreamscape could collapse under their impact.
Event_WGZM_8_14: But don't worry. I will use my power to stabilize this realm, and I will stay by your side until the end of your journey.
Event_WGZM_8_16: Our goal is to resolve this crisis, right?
Event_WGZM_8_17: Yes. {PlayerName}, if you ever lose your way, call my name.
Event_WGZM_8_18: Remember, I am always here, right by your side.
