Event_DSJDYCF_1_1: {PlayerName}... I-I think I just saw someone else's dream.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_2: It was in a small, dim room. A child, with her parents watching so warmly, blew out the candles on a tiny cake... and smiled.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_4: Yes... It was such a simple, ordinary moment, but it felt so full of happiness.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_5: Maybe I had moments like that when I was little too.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_6: But I can't remember anymore... I've gotten so used to being alone. And in my dreams, my parents always seem so... stern, so far away.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_9: N-no... I'm not strong... but if that's how you see me, I-I'll try to live up to your expectations.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_10: Um... t-thank you... It makes me really happy to hear that, b-but... I don't know how to respond...
Event_DSJDYCF_1_11: I've probably taken up too much of your time. Please, take this painting with you.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_12: Even if it was just a dream, it holds a lot of my feelings... a-and I want to share them with you.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_1: Ah, you're here. Speaking of which, I've stumbled upon quite a few... intriguing nightmares lately.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_3: Yes. I encountered different dreamers, but they all feared the same figure—though her appearance varied from one dream to the next.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_4: Sometimes she appeared as a stern office worker, sometimes a lowlife street thug, and other times... a lone Exile wandering the wilds.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_5: Ah, I see. That person... it was you, wasn't it?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_6: Those were criminals' nightmares about you, right?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_7: Well, I rarely reveal myself during a mission, but it's amusing when the "lucky few" get a glimpse.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_8: If they're haunted by a little... trauma, it might make them hesitate the next time they think of causing trouble.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_11: Hehe, trying to console me, are you, darling? Playing these sinister roles is simply part of the game. It's only natural that I appear in their nightmares.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_12: But I see the real you—not the masks you wear.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_13: I always see you as who you are.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_14: You certainly know what to say, don't you?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_15: Then come closer. I want to reward you with... a memory that tingles just right.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_1: So, it really is you. I owe you my gratitude.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_4: I was trapped in yet another endless dream, fighting Tacet Discords alone. No matter how many I vanquished, they continued to rise.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_5: The voices of the fallen cursed my every step, assailing my spirit. Yet, amidst the chaos, a radiant, golden light broke through the darkness.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_6: It was fleeting, but soon after, you appeared.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_8: You're the one who endured to the end.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_9: Before, such dreams felt eternal, persisting until I awoke.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_10: Yet, ever since we've crossed paths, I haven't been haunted by them again.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_11: That dream will never become reality.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_12: If you ever falter, I'll stand beside you and support you.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_13: Thank you... If you're heading to somewhere perilous, take this lance.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_14: May it grant you safe passage through every trial, and may it help you prevail the lasting night.

Speaker_800088_Name: Fallacy of No Return: Dream of Desperation
Event_WGZM_1_2: I didn't expect to see you again so soon.
Event_WGZM_1_3: I liked you better as that white cat.
Event_WGZM_1_4: Well, like I said before, there are still many things to handle within the gateway.
Event_WGZM_1_5: Ahem… I'm back in action now, so let's not dilly-dally with all of that
Event_WGZM_1_6: Since your last visit, the Somnoire has stopped expanding into reality and is gradually returning to its normal state.
Event_WGZM_1_7: However, those extra dreams haven't all been released yet…
Event_WGZM_1_9: The overloaded Somnoire started "packing" those dreams to save space.
Event_WGZM_1_10: Like creating a big "zip file" of dreams?
Event_WGZM_1_11: Exactly! It's a workaround for the space issue, but now those compressed dreams have turned into abnormal masses.
Event_WGZM_1_12: They're wreaking havoc around here. They keep absorbing other dreams to grow stronger, causing even more chaos.
Event_WGZM_1_13: Can't you stop them from merging?
Event_WGZM_1_14: I tried, but I don't have the right clearance. The Somnoire's self-cleaning function is also currently disabled.
Event_WGZM_1_16: I'm still searching for him. He may still be in deep slumber, recovering his strength…
Event_WGZM_1_17: Dreamwalker, keep exploring and restoring the Somnoire. Stay alert, there's no telling what you'll encounter.
Event_WGZM_1_18: Of course, you can count on me.
Event_WGZM_1_21: Meow… Hey! I'm not a cat anymore!
Event_WGZM_1_22: This will help you on your journey. Use it wisely.
Event_WGZM_1_23: Is this the Ebony Gatekeeper's work again?
Event_WGZM_1_24: No, quite the opposite, actually. This is happening because he lost most of his power and influence.
Event_WGZM_2_2: There are many terrifying things ahead. They are devouring every dream they find.
Event_WGZM_2_3: I can see them... all the dreams, both sweet and nightmarish, trapped inside those giant masses...
Event_WGZM_2_4: Free those dreams, just like you did before…
Event_WGZM_2_5: Dreamwalker, may your mind stay lucid, and may your steps be light.
Event_WGZM_23_1: Huh... it seems like we find ourselves together in this dream again.
Event_WGZM_23_3: We just said our goodbyes, and here we are again so soon. Is it because I can't stop thinking about showing {PlayerName} my paintings...?
Event_WGZM_23_5: Oh! Um… W-well, actually, I'm really happy to see you again.
Event_WGZM_23_8: P-please don't tease me! Um… By the way, I remember you have something urgent to attend to, right?
Event_WGZM_23_10: A-anyway. You have something urgent to attend to, right?
Event_WGZM_23_11: While you were away, I went on a field trip to gather inspiration and do some sketching.
Event_WGZM_23_12: I didn't have time to perfect all the details, but... I-I hope you can take this with you. Maybe it'll be helpful!
Event_WGZM_24_4: This time, the big bad guy is the White Cat Demon King! It's taken over the palace in the Kingdom of Grapes and is turning everyone's dreams into a mess!
Event_WGZM_24_5: You do know the Demon King is standing right beside you, right?
Event_WGZM_24_6: Humph! I can't believe the mighty Demon King actually came to the Warrior's Village to stop the hero before {Male=he;Female=she} even sets out!
Event_WGZM_24_7: But don't worry! Mayor Encore was ready for this!
Event_WGZM_24_8: O brave Warrior, take our strongest Echo—it will help you on your quest!
Event_WGZM_25_1: I hear trouble is brewing in the dreams, huh?
Event_WGZM_25_2: That's just how things go in the dream world.
Event_WGZM_25_4: Looks like dangers are lurking in this dream world, just like in reality…
Event_WGZM_25_5: If you let your mind wander for a second, you never know what might jump out at you.
Event_WGZM_25_6: So, are you here to help?
Event_WGZM_25_7: Of course, darling. We share the same goal, after all.
Event_WGZM_25_8: By the way, I found this nearby. Here, take it.
Event_WGZM_25_9: Let's finish up here quickly, and in return for my little gift... Promise me you'll save some time for me in the real world, okay?
Event_WGZM_26_1: Well, well, I didn't think we could have this kind of fun here.
Event_WGZM_26_2: Do whatever you want—let's make it more intense, more fiery, more electrifying than the real world…
Event_WGZM_26_4: You're next once I've handled things here.
Event_WGZM_26_5: Are you going to keep me waiting again? Why can't we fight right now?
Event_WGZM_26_6: Because I have something urgent to take care of.
Event_WGZM_26_7: Fine… I'll behave. There's still plenty of time for us, hehe.
Event_WGZM_26_8: I can feel it... Those chaotic energies are gathering somewhere. Looks like there's a big surprise in store for you.
Event_WGZM_26_10: Hehe, take this little cutie with you and hurry back, my seed of fate.
Event_WGZM_27_1: {PlayerName}, I was musing about their relationship.
Event_WGZM_27_2: Do you mean the dynamics between the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeepers?
Event_WGZM_27_3: Yes, the Somnoire's guardians. Are they rivals or allies?
Event_WGZM_27_4: I think it's a bit of both.
Event_WGZM_27_5: Sometimes they work together, and other times they clash.
Event_WGZM_27_6: Hmm… They're like two sides of the same coin—interdependent yet counterbalancing. The Somnoire reflects that balance.
Event_WGZM_27_7: The recent disturbances were the result of a series of actions that tipped the scales, rather than the fault of one side going off track.
Event_WGZM_27_8: So, we need to restore the balance.
Event_WGZM_27_9: Are you suggesting I shouldn't favor the Ivory Gatekeeper?
Event_WGZM_27_10: Just my humble opinion. No need to dwell on it. Here, take this pouch. It may prove useful on your journey.
Event_WGZM_27_11: By the way, I'd love to hear about your adventures when you're back, if you have time.
Event_WGZM_3_4: It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.
Event_WGZM_3_5: Why can't I be here? Are you worried that I might be someone else?
Event_WGZM_3_6: There are still lots of messes to clean up, and besides, the dream's not over yet.
Event_WGZM_3_7: You remember what happened before, right?
Event_WGZM_3_8: Of course! We teamed up and took down that big cat, right?
Event_WGZM_3_9: Don't ya know dreams can pick up where they left off? Must be thanks to that Ivory Gatekeeper, huh?
Event_WGZM_3_11: He helped a lot, didn't he?
Event_WGZM_3_12: Anyway, now that we're back, let's shake things up! No regrets when we wake up!
Event_WGZM_3_13: Oh, by the way, I ran into this quiet lady on my way here. She asked me to deliver this package to you.
Event_WGZM_3_15: Yep! Just sign here, and—another satisfied customer!
Event_WGZM_12_1: So this is how it is... I see...
Event_WGZM_12_4: The dreams of the Black Shores act like a gravitational center, pulling in other dreams to form entities of extreme density.
Event_WGZM_12_5: Those perished members of the Black Shores… Their thoughts linger and evolve within the dreams.
Event_WGZM_12_6: Their unshakable longings and aspirations lie deep within layers of volatile frequencies.
Event_WGZM_12_7: But why are they trying to destroy the Somnoire?
Event_WGZM_12_8: No, it's not destruction they want. They're trying to break free.
Event_WGZM_12_9: They are trying to escape from this space and return to the real world they once strove to save.
Event_WGZM_12_11: It's futile to try to bridge the gap between dreams and reality.
Event_WGZM_12_12: …But they dove headfirst into the Lament, fully knowing they were likely to fail. Maybe it was that same determination that drove them to take this path.
Event_WGZM_12_15: This is the only thing we can do for them.
Event_WGZM_13_1: We are not here to prove that resistance is futile, but to mark that… we don't go down without a fight…
Event_WGZM_14_1: When those who follow see our gravestones, they will understand… humanity never surrenders…
Event_WGZM_15_1: We won't retreat… ██. This is our final task… Not everyone is lucky enough to bear this responsibility…
Event_WGZM_16_1: We're so close to getting the accurate modeling of ██… Just give me a bit more time, as long as it's before the Lament strikes…
Event_WGZM_17_1: Gravity... is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still holds true today…
Event_WGZM_18_1: {PlayerName}, you've helped them break free from their hopeless quest to return home.
Event_WGZM_18_3: Those scattered dreams will still wander this realm, but they won't be burdened by those overwhelming desires anymore.
Event_WGZM_18_4: Do you regret putting an end to those longings and obsessions?
Event_WGZM_18_6: They will live on in our memories, won't they?
Event_WGZM_18_7: You are right. The time has come.
Event_WGZM_18_9: The Black Shores in a dream is not where I truly belong… I must go.
Event_WGZM_18_10: With the help of those two Gatekeepers, you will surely surely help to restore this place back to normal.
Event_WGZM_18_13: It's just… who knows when we'll meet again in our dreams.
Event_WGZM_18_14: Let's meet one day when we wake up.
Event_WGZM_18_15: Yes, when we wake up... tomorrow.
Event_WGZM_19_1: You sorted out those dream masses. Well done.
Event_WGZM_19_4: He's trying to contain those scattered dream fragments.
Event_WGZM_19_5: But it's not an easy job to retrieve them all in such a vast realm as the Somnoire.
Event_WGZM_19_6: You're not to blame for that.
Event_WGZM_19_7: Don't worry, I'll come up with a plan...
Event_WGZM_19_8: Never stop exploring, Dreamwalker. Only in dreams will we find the answers we need.

Character_chun_80_1: So this whole place has been covered in mist... that explains a lot.
Character_chun_81_1: So what, just sit here, doing nothing?
Character_chun_81_2: Seems like it. The Gardener mentioned someone might've slipped in unnoticed...

Quest_154000000_QuestDesc_154_1: The always calm Roccia reaches out to you with an urgent request. Go to the Strand and check on the banished "pilgrims."
Character_Rococo_1_2: Do you mind dropping by the Strand when you have time?
Character_Rococo_1_5: Umm... Brant and Bardolino are away, and they put me in charge of the welcoming proceedings.
Character_Rococo_1_6: I'm feeling a bit nervous about it. Part of me just wants to crawl into my box... Pero is all stressed out because of me.
Character_Rococo_1_8: I tend to fumble with words when talking to people... I'm worried I won't do a good job accommodating everyone.
Character_Rococo_1_9: If the Laureate {Male=himself;Female=herself} were here, I wouldn't be so nervous. It would make things easier.
Character_Rococo_1_11: So, {PlayerName}, as our new Laureate, we need your help.
Character_Rococo_10_2: What took you so long? Come on, grab a big bowl of pasta while it's still steamin'.
Character_Rococo_10_3: Give it to {PlayerName}, I'll eat later.
Character_Rococo_10_4: Roccia remarks as she hurries back to the tent.
Character_Rococo_10_7: It can wait. I'll go see if Roccia needs anything.
Character_Rococo_10_8:
You accept the bowl of pasta from Tina. The homecooked flavors seem especially comforting in the moment.
Maybe it's because of all the energy you burned earlier, or maybe food just tastes better when enjoyed with company.
Character_Rococo_10_9: You put down the plate and go inside the tent to help.
Character_Rococo_10_10: I'll come with you. I'm sure they'd appreciate the extra hand.
Character_Rococo_10_11: I'll come with you. I'm sure they'd appreciate the extra hand.
Character_Rococo_11_2: Wait, I didn't mean it like that! Back when we checked the ship's cabins, we thought she was already...
Character_Rococo_11_3: Ugh, I can't believe myself right now!
Character_Rococo_11_4: It's all right. We can still save her.
Character_Rococo_11_5: We should disinfect her wounds before removing the splinters... No rush, nice and steady.
Character_Rococo_11_6: Tina and Roccia manage to treat the little girl's wounds. Her breathing gradually steadies.
Character_Rococo_11_8: She's past the worst part. She'll recover soon.
Character_Rococo_11_11: Even though they're just kinda staring at the ground.
Character_Rococo_11_12: Well, they've been drifting at sea for so many days, and now they've washed up somewhere completely new.
Character_Rococo_11_13: They're like a sponge that's been soaked in water. All heavy and waterlogged. It'll take a while for them to bounce back.
Character_Rococo_11_14: What do you think we should do...?
Character_Rococo_11_15: Why don't we try talking to them?
Character_Rococo_11_16: Yes. We should see if anyone needs anything.
Character_Rococo_12_2: Feeling much better. Thanks for patching me up.
Character_Rococo_12_3: Filippo's hand is now covered in bandages and is no longer swollen.
Character_Rococo_12_4: Those pain relievers you used are from Rosemary's Apothecary, right? My family used to live not far from them. I'd recognize that smell anywhere.
Character_Rococo_12_5: Sometimes I think about home. Other times, I'd rather not.
Character_Rococo_12_6: I miss my soft couch and the smell of herbs wafting from the apothecary. But those Order activities? Those boring plays full of Codex verses? No thanks.
Character_Rococo_12_7: You know, I bet if the Blessed Maiden were still around, she'd loathe this form of penitance.
Character_Rococo_12_8: "A thousand stars light up the air. Freedom blooms like flowers wide." That was her favorite line from an opera.
Character_Rococo_12_10: Exactly. It's about a world where people can choose their own beliefs instead of blindly following some rigid creed.
Character_Rococo_12_11: Mandatory gatherings, worship, enforced codes of conduct... They even dictate what plays we can watch and how we should laugh and smile.
Character_Rococo_12_12: Oh, I want to go home, I really do... but Ragunna isn't the same place anymore.
Character_Rococo_12_13: During our so-called pilgrimage, people played lunachords and flutes. Everyone on board gathered around a "star" to sing opera and uplift each other's spirits.
Character_Rococo_12_14: In those moments, I felt that as long as we could sing freely together, the Pilgrim's Sail could become my new home.
Character_Rococo_12_15: But as we drifted farther out to sea, we faced more dangers, and fewer of us survived. Even our instruments got wrecked.
Character_Rococo_12_16: And now... there's no way to perform again with what's left of us.
Character_Rococo_12_17: I'm lost now. Nowhere to go, and no home to return to.
Character_Rococo_12_18: The brief smile that once graced his lips has vanished, leaving his face shrouded in sadness.
Character_Rococo_13_1: Hello, sir. Are you feeling better?
Character_Rococo_13_2: Much better. Thank you for the pasta.
Character_Rococo_13_3: Oh, that warmth… that taste of home. For a moment there, I thought I was dreaming.
Character_Rococo_13_4: It took me back to Margherita's, having the usual from their brunch menu... Oh, that's something I thought I'd get to enjoy for the rest of my life.
Character_Rococo_13_5: But... here I am, simply because I sang a few lines from Pegasus...
Character_Rococo_13_7: That's right. Folks on the ship used to perform together, letting the day's mood pick the song. Just had to keep an eye out for the Order.
Character_Rococo_13_8: That one was an all-time favorite.
Character_Rococo_13_9: Would you ever get tired of it?
Character_Rococo_13_10: Get tired of it? No, why would we do that?
Character_Rococo_13_11: It's a real gem, that one. Lifted everyone's spirits during the hard times.
Character_Rococo_13_12: If only the world were like that, where everyone lives freely. I wouldn't have to endure so much at this age...
Character_Rococo_13_13: They called it a "pilgrimage," but Tacet Discords pursued us the entire journey... We lost so many. The truth is clear to everyone now.
Character_Rococo_13_14: Sigh I survived, while so many young souls did not...
Character_Rococo_13_15: I didn't even have the strength to take their cherished belongings with me...
Character_Rococo_14_1: Everyone has been through so much...
Character_Rococo_14_2: All those rules on how to live, forced exile, friends gone missing...
Character_Rococo_14_4: Is there anything we can do to cheer them up?
Character_Rococo_14_8: Well, pain relievers are a start. We've already handed those out. That'll help with the physical pain part.
Character_Rococo_14_9: True, food is always an essential. But bellies are full, and spirits are still in the gutter.
Character_Rococo_14_10: Oh, what would I do without the Laureate around?
Character_Rococo_14_11: Medicine for the body, sure. But for the soul? We need something grand.
Character_Rococo_14_12: Everyone we talked to kept mentioning the Pegasus opera. Maybe we could arrange a little performance with them and their companions...
Character_Rococo_14_13: It's decided then. The welcoming opera will be Pegasus.
Character_Rococo_14_15: But most of their companions are already...
Character_Rococo_14_16: Well, traditionally the troupe always puts on a show for newly rescued pilgrims.
Character_Rococo_14_17: It's our way of saying, "Congrats, you survived!" We hope it sets the tone for something better for them.
Character_Rococo_14_19: Pero and I searched through the ship and found what must be their companions' belongings.
Character_Rococo_14_20: Some are a bit damaged, but nothing I can't fix. I'll patch them up and we'll use them in the performance.
Character_Rococo_14_21: That way, they can be together again… on stage.
Character_Rococo_15_1: A lunachord, a prop gun, ship debris, Luceanites...
Character_Rococo_15_2: Would you look at that! Well done, Pero.
Character_Rococo_15_3: I didn't know Pero could carry so much.
Character_Rococo_15_5: Not only that, Pero could swallow an entire ship if she wanted to. She can even analyze frequencies and give me the full backstory on all this stuff.
Character_Rococo_15_7: You see, objects carry people's thoughts and feelings. And what better way to share those than through an opera?
Character_Rococo_15_8: What do you think, {PlayerName}? When is someone really gone?
Character_Rococo_15_10: When what they stood for fades away?
Character_Rococo_15_11: Well, there is some truth to that. But as long as Pero and I are here, whoever owned these items will never be forgotten.
Character_Rococo_15_12: Well, there is some truth to that. Unless, of course, you have a troupe like ours. We'll weave what they stood for into operas and pass them down. Their memories will live on.
Character_Rococo_15_13: "Beyond high walls we fly, through mist where dangers lie. Over wrecked bows and ships adrift, I chase the Golden Fleece's gift, under the North Star's light."
Character_Rococo_15_14: If only life could be as grand as the opera scripts.
Character_Rococo_15_15: Anyway, I'll fix these items up, give'em a good shine, and voilà—everyone gets to perform together again.
Character_Rococo_16_1: The frequencies lingering in this lunachord tell me that its owner never stopped playing, not even during her exile.
Character_Rococo_16_2: She tried lifting everyone's spirits with song, right up until those nasty Tacet Discords got her...
Character_Rococo_16_3: Now all that's left is this lunachord, minus the strings.
Character_Rococo_16_5: The lunachord was used for helping others.
Character_Rococo_16_6: Yeah, she kept strumming away, supporting those around her...
Character_Rococo_16_7: Wait, I've got an idea! Even without the right strings, we can rig up something else. It can still be used to help people.
Character_Rococo_18_1: These bits of ship debris may not look like much, but they were once part of countless Pilgrim's ships.
Character_Rococo_18_2: They carry all the fear and confusion people felt.
Character_Rococo_18_3: But they also hold onto their strength.
Character_Rococo_18_5: Mm-hmm, this debris will make a good backdrop material.
Character_Rococo_18_6: Or we can scatter them around the stage to help set the mood.
Character_Rococo_18_7: Come on, Pero. Let's get them up there.
Character_Rococo_18_11: But the troupe doesn't make its honored guests carry heavy stuff.
Character_Rococo_23_1: Luceanite can be found pretty much everywhere across the Strand, either buried in the sand or washed up by the tide.
Character_Rococo_23_2: Legends say each piece is a soul trapped in the Strand. After facing wind and rain, day after day, they start to lose their shine.
Character_Rococo_23_3: We need to collect them before that happens.
Character_Rococo_23_6: Yes, the Luceanite's glitter is what makes them charming.
Character_Rococo_23_7: We can use them as stars that shine in the night sky.
Character_Rococo_23_8: As for where they fit onto our stage... Let's set them around the center.
Character_Rococo_25_2: Flower petals... No, wait. They're pieces of a wreath.
Character_Rococo_25_3: The residual frequencies hint that it was once a little boy's favorite. He was shoved into a crowded cabin with no idea what he had done wrong.
Character_Rococo_25_4: He never survived the sail... He didn't grab the prop gun in time. The wreath got blown away, leaving only a few petals.
Character_Rococo_25_5: These petals are very delicate. I need some time to think about how to work them into the opera. For now, I'll have Pero hold onto them.
Character_Rococo_26_1: All right. Now that all the items are in place, the stage is pretty much set up.
Character_Rococo_26_2: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'm sure the sentiments tied to these items will make their grand entrance into everyone's hearts.
Character_Rococo_26_3: Hmm... But I feel like we're still missing something.

Character_YinLin_1_20: Chixia contacts you to say that several Jinzhou citizens have recently gone missing. She asks you to stay alert for anything suspicious.
Character_YinLin_10_36: You are both questioned by the Patroller, but the two of you conceal what happened. During the conversation, you discover that the woman is actually a Patroller named Yinlin. After the Patroller leaves, Yinlin reveals that "Yuanyuan" is, in fact, a puppet.
Character_YinLin_11_55: Yinlin tells you that the Séance Society is a dangerous organization that lures people in by promising to bring back their loved ones. They appear to be linked to the Fractsidus, and her mission is to gather evidence against them and identify the mastermind behind it all. Currently, she is investigating the prototype puppets in the hope they hold clues about their creator. Eager to recover your lost memories, you decide to assist Yinlin by following Lirong to the puppets' storage location.
Character_YinLin_14_22: Furious with the Fractsidus for their disdain toward the puppets, Lirong breaks their deal and attempts to escape with the puppets. You quickly follow him.
Character_YinLin_18_21: Yinlin explains that the Séance Society is behind the recent disappearances in Jinzhou. They provide lifelike puppets in place of lost loved ones, and many desperate people join the Society for this reason. However, frequent interaction with these puppets greatly increases the risk of Overclocking. Yinlin is on the trail of those responsible and invites you to meet her outside the city if you want to learn more about the case.
Character_YinLin_19_27: Determined to protect the puppets from becoming Fractsidus experimental subjects, Lirong attempts to hide. He reveals that the leader of the Séance Society is known as the Dollmaker. As the Fractsidus closes in, putting them all in danger, you and Yinlin step in.
Character_YinLin_20_14: Yinlin tries to mediate between the Séance Society and the Fractsidus, but the negotiations fail.
Character_YinLin_21_35: She admits she tracked you using a positioning device placed on you earlier, explaining that her undercover role makes it hard for her to trust anyone. With Lirong and Yuanyuan no longer providing new leads, your only hope lies in the prototype puppets, so you decide to gather as many of them as possible.
Character_YinLin_26_15: After collecting all the prototype puppets, Yinlin plans to take them to a safe place for further investigation. She learns from a fellow Patroller that there is a safehouse nearby for undercover agents, and you both head there.
Character_YinLin_37_30: You soon discover that it was Yinlin who trapped you here. She reveals that this is the Séance Society's base and invites you once more to join the organization, offering to introduce you to its members.
Character_YinLin_39_11: You discover that Jinlu met his fallen comrade He Chang here and chose to stay because of their strong bond.
Character_YinLin_4_25: An anonymous email leads you to Lirong and his daughter, Yuanyuan. Lirong is a member of the Séance Society, a group that claims to reunite members with their loved ones. He invites you to join, but becomes agitated when asked about his daughter's fate, refusing to accept that she is no longer truly alive.
Character_YinLin_40_14: You learn that Lianyue, who also reunited with her deceased child with the Society's help, refuses to let anyone disrupt their current life.
Character_YinLin_41_23: Wu Sheng tells you that even the best doctors can't save everyone, just as he was not able to save his wife. The Dollmaker's puppets gave them a second chance, something no doctor could offer. While Wu Sheng understands the dangers of the puppets, he also knows how much they mean to the people here.
Character_YinLin_42_30: Yinlin reveals that she empathizes with these people who just want to see their loved ones again. She reveals that she was once a member of the Séance Society herself. She grew up alongside the Dollmaker and knows that his experiments are aimed at creating two special puppets. However, she keeps the details of this final experiment from you.
Character_YinLin_44_11: When the Patrollers besiege the base, Yinlin takes you hostage but secretly passes you a message: "Trust me… Come this way."
Character_YinLin_5_34: A mysterious woman arrives and convinces Lirong to leave. After he departs, a fight breaks out between you and the woman over Yuanyuan. The confrontation only ends when a Patroller shows up. To uncover the truth about the Séance Society and the missing persons, you decide to cooperate with the woman, starting by cleaning up the scene.
Character_YinLin_55_20: You learn from Chixia that the injured are recovering, but the Dollmaker still refuses to cooperate. She thanks you for your help, and you hint that the real thanks should go to a mysterious partner. However, you make sure to keep the partner's name a secret.
Character_YinLin_58_50: When you meet Yinlin again, she tells you that the Dollmaker attempted to extract your memories but failed. The cause of your memory loss is far more complex than you thought. She thanks you for your help and coyly suggests that your next meeting may be under a completely different guise.
HuanglongXZ_13_65: Upon leaving the Gorges of Spirits, you encounter a newly-formed Tacet Field. In its center stands a woman named Baizhi, who appears to be engaged in an investigation. You decide to glide down there to meet her.
HuanglongXZ_15_14: As soon as Baizhi sees you, she runs a diagnostic check on you. She urges you to leave the site immediately, but events unfold much faster than you expect...
HuanglongXZ_18_44: The Tacet Discord you defeated leaves behind a lingering golden shadow. Chixia explains it is what's left behind when a Tacet Discord is destroyed, and it can be absorbed by a Pangu Terminal as an Echo to help in combat. You try to absorb it with your Terminal, to no avail.
HuanglongXZ_20_48: Your ability to absorb the Echo with your own body leaves Chixia in awe. Ancient records, predating the founding of Huanglong and the invention of the Terminal, tell of a mysterious celestial being capable of absorbing the remnants of Tacet Discords. Legends speak of their influence in heralding the dawn of Huanglong's history.
HuanglongXZ_21_20: With the disrupting Tacet Field subdued, a holographic broadcast reaches all of Jinzhou. Jinhsi, the Magistrate, awaits an esteemed guest at City Hall and extends an invitation for a conversation.
HuanglongXZ_22_37: Your companions think you are the one whom Jinhsi is waiting for. The path ahead beckons towards Jinzhou, where your destiny will unfold.
HuanglongXZ_25_8: You attempt to absorb another Echo with your body but fail. Confusion settles among everyone about the nature of your abilities.
HuanglongXZ_28_7: As you approach the city, you have an uneasy feeling of being watched. A mysterious girl stands from a hidden vantage point, her gaze fixed upon you.
HuanglongXZ_4_31: Awakening alongside Chixia and Yangyang, you find all your memories have been stripped away. You are a rover in this strange land, and this is the name they give you. As you try to gather your bearings, Yangyang invites you to join them just as a foreboding Tacet Field begins to unfurl its dark presence.
HuanglongXZ_9_25: As you gaze at the statue, a vision of the Sentinel flickers in your mind. Just when you are about to ask Yangyang for an explanation, a cry of alarm sounds. Chixia is being attacked by an Elite Class Tacet Discord!
HuanglongM1_1_1_40: Upon arriving in Jinzhou City, the group prepares to part ways. You leave with Chixia for the Nexus Tower and make plans to meet Yangyang at City Hall later.
HuanglongM1_1_10_6: You overhear the sound of Weiqi pieces clicking against a board from behind a door, but find the door is locked.
HuanglongM1_1_11_52: You ask Sanhua about Jinzhou, Jinhsi, and the tokens.
HuanglongM1_1_12_82: You tell Chixia and Yangyang that Jinhsi will meet you in three days and show them the tokens. They recognize the candy, but cannot recall its significance. After deliberation, the three of you decide to seek answers from Baizhi at the Academy.
HuanglongM1_1_13_12: You ask a little girl if she has seen the candy before, with no luck. To welcome you to Jinzhou, however, the little girl gives you a candy of her own.
HuanglongM1_1_14_13: Your investigation yields little leads. The three of you head for the Academy to find Baizhi.
HuanglongM1_1_22_42: Sanhua tells you that Jinhsi will meet you in three days time. When asked why she is certain you are the guest Jinhsi awaits, Sanhua replies that she can perceive frequencies, and yours, like Jinhsi's, is pure and untainted.
HuanglongM1_1_23_74: Sanhua upgrades your Terminal. You now have permission to travel to any region of Jinzhou without hindrance.
HuanglongM1_1_3_8: Chixia tells you that the Nexus Tower functions as a navigation, defense, and regional information system. You try connecting your Terminal to the Nexus Tower.
HuanglongM1_1_5_3: Yangyang has made all the necessary arrangements and is waiting for you and Chixia to join her.
HuanglongM1_1_7_58: A crowd has gathered outside City Hall. They are all eager to meet Jinhsi, but each is turned away by her bodyguard, Sanhua. With questions swirling in your mind, you bide your time and hope for answers.
HuanglongM1_1_9_6: Sanhua instantly recognizes you as the guest Jinhsi is expecting. She informs you that Jinhsi is currently away but has left a welcome gift and some mysterious tokens for you.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_45: At the city gate, you encounter Jianxin, a Taoist who is being denied passage. After learning she is searching for a missing person, you use your authority to help her leave the city.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_32: Jianxin explains she is searching for a boy named Zhiyuan. He vanished after leaving the city, and his grandfather tasked her to find him. Sadly, she has no information about the tokens you are investigating.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_18: A Midnight Ranger reveals details about Zhiyuan's disappearance, and you agree to check on the Detection Beacons that have been disconnected.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_42_8: As you near the first Detection Beacon, you stumble upon some shifty-looking "civilians." You move to confront them.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_43_17: You offer assistance to the "civilians" responsible for damaging the Detection Beacon, but they repay your kindness with violence. You have no choice but to teach them a lesson.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_41: Upon subduing the Exiles masquerading as civilians, you reclaim the stolen components and head for the next Detection Beacon.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_48_30: Upon arriving at the Rearguard Camp, you are greeted by a scene of chaos, revealing the grim state of the ongoing conflict. There, you meet logistic coordinator Xiulan and agree to help tend to the wounded.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_49_10: A severely wounded soldier begs to return to battle, insisting that resources should be reserved for those in greater need. You treat him, despite his loud protests.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_39: The quartermaster reveals Zhiyuan's likely whereabouts. Jianxin leaves to continue her search for Zhiyuan. You show the quartermaster the mangosteen, which he mistakes for a grenade. After the misunderstanding is resolved, he tells you about the dire situation in the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_50_8: A wounded soldier is in distress. You summon a medic to his side.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_51_19: With the soldiers tended to, you start looking for the quartermaster as advised.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_58_5: Inspired by Yangyang's words, you close your eyes and tap into your intuition, pinpointing the last token's location: Qichi Village in the Central Plains.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_32: Reuniting with Jianxin, you learn she has successfully found Zhiyuan and convinced him to return to Jinzhou. This journey has been enlightening for her, and she looks forward to seeing you and Yangyang again.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_31: You recount the visions to Yangyang. She can't explain it but senses a connection between you and something on that battlefield.
Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_18: You now know the mangosteen has something to do with the war. But in what way? What is Jinhsi trying to tell you? As you ponder these questions, vivid images flood your mind.
Huanglong_main_1_4_106_27: You encounter an unusual Tacet Discord chirping out nonsensical phrases. Yangyang theorizes that it must have consumed a human frequency.
Huanglong_main_1_4_198_72: Scar reveals the moral of the tale he has spun for you. He believes himself to be the rule-breaking black lamb. It is clear where his allegiances lie, and you decide you have heard enough...
Huanglong_main_1_4_2_53: Yangyang can't communicate with the Tacet Discord, but she senses complex emotions flowing within it. A tragic event happened here not long ago, with danger surely lurking nearby.
Huanglong_main_1_4_3_66: From cards discovered at the scene, Yangyang deduces that the tragedy is likely the work of the Fractsidus, an extremist group obsessed with merging humans and Tacet Discords. The cards belong to Scar, one of the organization's Overseers.
Huanglong_main_1_4_4_2: Following the surprise attack, Yangyang disappears and a mysterious man clad in red appears in front of you.
Huanglong_main_1_4_60_65: The mysterious man, whose name is Scar, doesn't attack you. He invites you to investigate the village with your own eyes to uncover the truths beneath the surface.
Huanglong_main_1_4_61_29: You demand the truth, but Scar refuses. Clearly, revealing it to you directly holds no thrills for him.
Huanglong_main_1_4_62_14: You find a diary page that once belonged to a little girl, a wanderer who finally found refuge in this village. The entries hint at unsettling truths. Scar, with an air of detachment, shares a fable of wolves and sheep.
Huanglong_main_1_4_63_19: You find more notes. Scar continues with his tale about a shepherd providing for the lambs in exchange for their loyalty. He asks whether you would bow to authority to get what you want. You tell him that all are equal.
Huanglong_main_1_4_64_15: Your investigation continues. The tragedy that befell the village starts to unravel and Scar persists in trying to sway your judgment.
Huanglong_main_1_4_66_11: After gathering all the clues, you learn that the black lamb who told the truth about the shepherd met with a tragic fate. The white lambs sacrificed it to continue to have their wishes fulfilled.
Huanglong_main_1_4_68_44: You conclude that the white lambs succumbed to temptation despite knowing the cost of their wishes, while the black lamb was sacrificed for revealing the truth.
Huanglong_main_1_4_70_50: After Scar's defeat, a mysterious woman in red comes to his aid. You share the events with Yangyang and realize that you need to find the actual location of Scar's tale to determine its truth.
Huanglong_main_1_4_72_19: Your adventure in Qichi Village concludes. As an Outrider tasked with keeping the peace, Yangyang is deeply saddened by the village's tragedy. With all the clues gathered, it is time you return to the city.
Huanglong_main_1_7_1_9: The Retroact Rain falls in Desorock Highland as Jiyan's forces prepare to advance on the Norfall Barrens.
Huanglong_main_1_7_10_23: Shaking off the vision, Jiyan hears a soldier report that the skies look just like they did that fateful battle three years ago. Spotting the approaching Tacet Discords, he suspects a mastermind is orchestrating their actions.
Huanglong_main_1_7_12_12: The moon is waxing, an omen of imminent danger. A message from Jinhsi reveals Jinzhou is preparing to face the threat.
Huanglong_main_1_7_19_61: You find Taoqi overseeing border defenses. Aalto is also present. The protective barrier against the Retroact Rain is under urgent repair, but the onslaught of Tacet Discords continues. Aalto and Encore must return to the Black Shores to warn of the impending revival of the Threnodian, while those remaining prepare for battle.
Huanglong_main_1_7_21_59: After fending off another wave of attacks, Jinhsi contacts you, announcing reinforcements are on the way. The moment foretold by Jué has arrived. She expresses her gratitude for your defense of Jinzhou and wishes you victory and safe passage through the long night.
Huanglong_main_1_7_38_48: With Jiyan's aid, you successfully vanquish the Thundering Mephis. Jiyan is aware of Jué's prophecy and has been awaiting your arrival. As the Retroact Rain falls, the group heads back to camp.
Huanglong_main_1_7_42_18: You are surprised to find Jianxin at camp. Jiyan decides to allocate roles and tasks for the looming battle against the Tacet Discords.
Huanglong_main_1_7_43_68: With your input, Jiyan quickly draws up the battle strategy. The ranged units will secure the high ground to support the close-combat troops in the valley as they break through the Tacet Discords' ranks, creating a passage for you, Yangyang, Jiyan, and Jianxin to launch a commando assault on the Threnodian.
Huanglong_main_1_7_44_48: The strategy is set, but the Disruptor is needed to break through the Threnodian's barrier. You and Yangyang assume responsibility for reclaiming it and repairing its power connector.
Huanglong_main_1_7_46_27: A Midnight Ranger breathes his last. This strengthens your resolve to finish charging the Disruptor and use it to face the Threnodian.
Huanglong_main_1_7_49_24: With the Disruptor now operational, Jinhsi grants permission to fire it, stating that she alone will take responsibility for the fallout while urging you to press ahead.
Huanglong_main_1_7_8_31: As the Retroact Rain pours, Jiyan is confronted by the ghostly figure of Geshu Lin, the general from the Battle Beneath the Crescent. The phantom challenges Jiyan, questioning how he intends to honor the lives lost and whether he will follow in the footsteps of the past.
Huanglong_main_1_7_89_20: Despite taking antidotes, many soldiers are still haunted by nightmares of the Battle Beneath the Crescent three years ago. The rain has brought to life their fallen comrades who now fight against them. Jiyan strives to boost morale with a rousing speech.
Huanglong_main_1_6_14_43: Resonator Verina identifies the black flower in your photo as a specially cultivated variety. This inspires the idea of wearing a Blake Bloom to draw out members of the organization. But how does one go about conjuring a Blake Bloom from thin air?
Huanglong_main_1_6_15_6: Verina uses her Resonance Abilities to conjure a black flower that perfectly matches the one in the photo.
Huanglong_main_1_6_21_51: You apprehend the mysterious young woman stalking you, only to discover she is a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores. She shows a strong interest in you and reveals she has been helping you from afar. In a flash, she manages to escape leaving only her name—Camellya.
Huanglong_main_1_6_22_15: Yangyang calls to inform you that she and Chixia have spotted a suspicious figure on Main Street.
Huanglong_main_1_6_23_17: You meet Yangyang who points out the enigmatic man.
Huanglong_main_1_6_31_52: You track them down and discover they are Consultants for the Black Shores. Aalto strikes a deal to reveal what he knows about you in exchange for your help in recovering a Resonance Beacon from the Court of Savantae Ruins, in Whining Aix's Mire.
Huanglong_main_1_6_32_18: After Aalto and Encore depart, Chixia and the others arrive. You brief them on your deal. Yangyang warns that Whining Aix's Mire hasn't been visited in ages due to treacherous weather and urges caution.
Huanglong_main_1_6_33_29: After meeting Aalto and Encore, you learn that the Beacon is hidden within the Court of Savantae Ruins, a once-revered institution known for its groundbreaking research in Automata Mechanics and strange experiments. Its members vanished without a trace, leaving behind only damaged Resonance Beacons.
Huanglong_main_1_6_4_23: You reunite with Chixia and Yangyang outside City Hall, where the tension hangs in the air. Mentioning Jiyan's name prompts Yangyang to recount a tale about him as told by a certain storyteller...
Huanglong_main_1_6_53_11: Noticing you are being followed, you decide to send Chixia and Yangyang with the Blake Bloom to search for Black Shores members in the city while you confront your mysterious stalker.
Huanglong_main_1_6_54_12: Aalto is amazed to learn that the Court of Savantae had once attempted to recreate Retroact Rain, speculating on what they sought to achieve.
Huanglong_main_1_6_55_59: Upon defeating the monster, Aalto discloses shocking truths about you, the Black Shores, and Camellya. You learn this is not the first time you have awakened from a long slumber—the last happened at the Black Shores. Before you can ask more, he suddenly flees sensing something amiss.
Huanglong_main_1_6_6_38: After hearing the story, you express your desire to find members of the Black Shores before heading to the Norfall Barrens. Yangyang suggests starting with the Blake Bloom, the organization's symbol.
Huanglong_main_1_7_55_11: After a fierce charge, you arrive at the Suspended Ruins. The Threnodian is now within reach.
Huanglong_main_1_7_65_8: Massive stone boulders block your path. With the Disruptor ready, you prepare to clear a path forward.
Huanglong_main_1_7_77_26: At the final confrontation, Yangyang stays behind to deal with the surrounding threats. You concentrate, sensing the Threnodian's location, then aim at the Crownless statue's chest and give the order to fire.
Character_YinLin_45_32: Yinlin brings you to meet the Dollmaker, maintaining a façade of hostility due to a bug the Dollmaker planted on you. Through a hidden panel, she explains that this factory produces puppets designed to trigger Overclocking for the Fractsidus in exchange for resources. She needs your help to gather evidence against the Dollmaker's involvement in all this.
Character_YinLin_48_34: You speak to the Dollmaker and discover that the two final puppets he intends to make are Yinlin's parents—his former mentors. He captured you to get experimental data, hoping to create perfect puppets with the Fractsidus's backing. Now, with the Public Security Bureau involved, he's rushing to relocate both the puppets and his research data.
Character_YinLin_49_13: The Dollmaker confronts Yinlin after learning of her betrayal. She asserts that, like her parents, she has always been a Patroller and has never forgotten her true identity and duty. She declares she cannot accept the Dollmaker harming others to recapture the warmth of the past.
Character_YinLin_51_24: In the face of the Dollmaker's twisted obsession, Yinlin argues that puppets cannot replace real family and that it is wrong to take advantage of others' happiness to cope with one's own misfortune. The Dollmaker retorts that he has erased her Patroller records, making it impossible for her to prove her identity. But Yinlin asserts that even without this identity, she will continue to fight evil. That is the spirit her parents instilled in her, and the one that motivates her to pursue her goals in her own way.
Character_YinLin_53_14: After the Patrollers secure the scene, Chixia updates you on the Séance Society's other members, but by then, Yinlin has already disappeared. You promise Chixia that you will go to the Public Security Bureau to provide a formal statement of what happened.
Character_YinLin_61_8: Yinlin reminds you to use your Terminal to record the prototype puppet data.
YYYHZG_12_1: Dance! Everyone, the time to celebrate is now!
YYYHZG_12_2: This looks like a recording of an ancient Carnevale celebration. Since there's no Acolyte in sight… could it be from before the founding of the Order of the Deep? This is a marvelous discovery, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}!
YYYHZG_12_3: Let us raise our thanks to the Sentinel, who has guided us to safety and protected us on this journey!
YYYHZG_12_4: Yes, that's right! The Sentinel is truly a great and wondrous being!
YYYHZG_12_5: And let us thank our hardworking farmers whose toil has transformed the soil, bringing us an abundant harvest!
YYYHZG_12_6: Let us honor the brave warriors who vanquished Tacet Discord and beast alike so that we might sleep soundly at night!
YYYHZG_12_7: No, no! The Sentinel blessed us with fertile soil. The Sentinel gave us a home.
YYYHZG_12_8: How dare they claim the Sentinel's blessings as their own!
YYYHZG_21_1: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, you're back! Are you all right?
YYYHZG_21_3: This... this is the last part for the Nimbus Chorale! Wonderful! I knew you could do it!
YYYHZG_21_4: Now, the last section should represent our ancestors' reverence for the Sentinel… Wait. It's titled... "Glory to Humanity"?
YYYHZG_21_5: But… why? Why does the most important part of the Chorale have nothing to do with Sentinel?
YYYHZG_21_8: Maybe your ancestors knew the Sentinel was important, but they also knew that the ones who crossed the sea, the generations who built all this, deserved gratitude too.
YYYHZG_21_9: Of course our ancestors are important! Without their devotion, how could we have ever won the Sentinel's favor?
YYYHZG_21_10: They lived in a time when the Sentinel was closer to us. Why couldn't they see Their grace as we do?
YYYHZG_21_11: Maybe it's because they understood the Sentinel's true nature better than you do, and they knew what it took to create the kind of life you now enjoy today.
YYYHZG_21_12: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}… do you think I've strayed from the path of my ancestors?
YYYHZG_21_13: No, you're just following the Tenets of the Deep.
YYYHZG_21_15: All I know is that the Sentinel gave us Rinascita as a home and the Common Echos that help us live our lives. The Order, guided by the Sentinel, saved me from the Dark Tide and gave me a name, a new life, and a place to belong.
YYYHZG_21_16: What you've been told has been twisted by the Order to suit its own ends. The true song of your ancestors is locked away, and you, like so many others, choose not to see it.
YYYHZG_21_18: The Order uses everyone's belief in the Sentinel to manipulate, deliberately erasing the history of Rinascita's first people.
YYYHZG_21_19: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, this is very serious slander against the Order! According to the Tenets of the Deep...
YYYHZG_21_20: Hasn't your Primus told you everything he wants you to do in Tenets of the Deep? You've followed those rules without question.
YYYHZG_21_21: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, why do you speak of the Order as if it were evil?
YYYHZG_21_22: Twenty years ago, the Order's Acolytes saved me from the Dark Tide, and the Order's orphanage became my second home. They gave me a name, a new life, a place to belong.
YYYHZG_21_23: Even when I wasn't wise enough to contribute much, the Order established the Minor Forbidden Archive just for me.
YYYHZG_21_24: They never asked for thanks. Only that I praise the Sentinel, pray daily, and live righteously. If that's the Order's manipulation… then I'm glad to be manipulated!
YYYHZG_21_25: As the opening line of the Tenets states, "All that the Order reveals is truth, and our duty is simply to follow."
YYYHZG_21_26: I suppose, to you, I must seem like a blind follower of faith. I'm sorry for taking so much of your time, trying to convince me when I wouldn't listen.
YYYHZG_21_27: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, whether or not the Nimbus Chorale is heretical doesn't matter. It's not the music I wish to play at the Carnevale.
YYYHZG_21_28: I will never forget your kindness. If you ever need me, come to the Minor Forbidden Archive. I've had a long day, and now I need some time alone.
YYYHZG_22_2: Because this is the real song of Rinascita's people.
YYYHZG_22_3: Because this song was always buried deep within you.
YYYHZG_22_4: O Sentinel, please forgive this humble, wandering servant. Forgive me for being moved by such a forbidden thing.
YYYHZG_22_5: {PlayerName}, does the Sentinel here care about such little problems?
YYYHZG_22_7: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, what should I do? Should I report this music as heretical to the Order? Why do I hesitate? Am I losing my faith?
YYYHZG_22_8: Why don't you ask yourself this time?
YYYHZG_22_9: How about we listen to this song a few more times?
YYYHZG_3_1: Ugh, the crops are all dead.
YYYHZG_3_2: Grandpa's notes mentioned the soil was too salty, but the pages with the solution got ruined during the TD Outbreak. If only Grandpa had lived longer...
YYYHZG_3_3: Ugh, why didn't the Sentinel guide us to a better land...
YYYHZG_3_4: Don't be so ungrateful. If it wasn't for the Sentinel's help, our fleet would have been wiped out.
YYYHZG_3_5: From here on out, we must rely on ourselves. If one generation can't do it, we'll try with two. The land of Rinascita will be fertile again, I know it!
YYYHZG_7_1: All-knowing and all-powerful Sentinel, please bless me with smooth sailing tomorrow!
YYYHZG_7_2: Instead of praying here every day, why don't you go fix the fishing boat?
YYYHZG_7_3: Grandma, how can you say such a disrespectful thing in front of the Sentinel!
YYYHZG_7_4: That's not the Sentinel. It's nothing more than a pile of stones you've gathered.
YYYHZG_7_5: The Sentinel guided us here to build a new home, yet you would dare lay every little misfortune at Their feet. It is you who dishonor the Sentinel.

Guide_YMJH_1_1: The gateway to the Somnoire is open again… Did something happen?
Guide_YMJH_2_1: Ah, there you are! I owe you my thanks for helping us clean up the mess.
Guide_YMJH_2_2: Were you intercepting those dream fragments?
Guide_YMJH_2_3: Exactly. Those dream masses broke apart into countless dream fragments.
Guide_YMJH_2_4: They scattered like leaves in a forest, making it difficult to retrieve them all.
Guide_YMJH_2_5: The Ebony Gatekeeper mentioned he's working on a solution.
Guide_YMJH_2_6: Is that so? Well, I guess he would've been more suited for this task than me...
Guide_YMJH_2_7: Dreamwalker, I have a favor to ask. Can you continue to restore those chaotic Memory Zones?
Guide_YMJH_2_9: Sure, as long as you pay me.
Guide_YMJH_2_10: Haha, I figured you'd say so! Thank you. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.
Guide_YMJH_2_11: Rest assured. The Somnoire has always been generous. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.
BossRushRewardText: Reach {0} points in the current stage
Event_WGZM_20_1: Watch out! Those dream fragments were drawn here and are now forming into a mass!
Event_WGZM_20_2: We have nowhere to go… and you have nowhere to run…
Event_WGZM_21_1: One after another, I see them leave… How many more goodbyes must I endure? Oh, how I wish I could go home…
Event_WGZM_22_1: The crisis has finally come to an end. I can't thank you enough for your help.
Event_WGZM_22_2: Are you sure it's really over?
Event_WGZM_22_3: I am certain this isn't the end of it.
Event_WGZM_22_4: I... can't make any guarantees. The world inside this gateway always finds a way to create new problems.
Event_WGZM_22_5: By the way, have you noticed our surroundings?
Event_WGZM_22_6: This is where we had our showdown with the black cat.
Event_WGZM_22_7: Exactly. The Ebony Gatekeeper created this Memory Zone to draw in all those abnormal dreams, forcing you to confront them all at once.
Event_WGZM_22_8: As a trade-off... he probably needs to sleep for a while.
Event_WGZM_22_9: So, this is the "plan" he talked about.
Event_WGZM_22_10: Looks like he's capable of doing the right thing after all.
Event_WGZM_22_11: Both he and I are Observers of the Somnoire tasked with maintaining its stability. If either of us goes unchecked, it's bad news for the entire realm.
Event_WGZM_22_12: If there ever comes a day when I lose control, please, stop me.
Event_WGZM_22_14: Are you saying you might go rogue someday?
Event_WGZM_22_15: Just a jest. But now, it's time to say farewell—
Event_WGZM_22_16: To thoroughly investigate the faults in the Somnoire, we'll need to temporarily sever its connection to the real world.
Event_WGZM_22_17: We'll see each other again, right?
Event_WGZM_22_18: Absolutely. No matter how long the night lasts, we shall always reunite in the light of day.
Activity_101300003_Desc:
Starlight streams through your fingers as you mount the expedition into the depths of the universe.
The gentle twinkles silently chant a song of gratitude, a tribute to the treasured gifts you once bestowed upon them.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_6: (It's taking longer for Abby to react...)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_7: Hey, there's nothing to worry about... I'm just a little beat, that's all... Oh! Earlier when I was half-asleep, I came up with this great idea for finding the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_9: Didn't the Sentinel say They're locked up in some kind of tower in the sky?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_10: Well, how about I just fly up there and look for it? Easy as pie!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_11: The tower is either too far to see or it's totally covered by clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_12: Otherwise, we would've seen some sign of it on the ground.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_13: In the shape you're in... are you sure you could fly that far?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_14: C'mon, it won't hurt to try. The cliff at Egla Town would be a perfect launch pad.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_11_1: (The aroma from these plants... It's the same scent that was in the study.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_11_2: These are Violacas. They produce a unique fragrance, wouldn't you say?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_11_3: Violacas are a vital ingredient for our elixirs. It even has a soothing effect on its own.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_1: Just as I expected... The Threnodian "took notice" of you the moment you learned the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_2: {PlayerName}, what you see in this sanctuary is the Sentinel in Their true form.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_3: A majestic steed that galloped with the wind, not a creature of the ocean's depths.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_4: The Order worships a half-horse, half-sea creature Divinity, a form the Sentinel assumed only after being corrupted by the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_5: Although the Sentinel's will has yet to fade, who knows how much longer They can endure.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_6: {PlayerName}. I wish to ask you to persuade the Sentinel of Jinzhou—Jué—to come to Rinascita. To save Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_7: That's much easier said than done.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_8: What makes you think I can do that?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_9: In return, I will agree to whatever condition or request you make.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_10: Both Jinzhou and Jué owe you their future. That makes you the only person capable of this task.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_11: A Sentinel cannot leave its commissioned region.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_12: Jué leaving Jinzhou would be a betrayal of duty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_13: Jué is still in the middle of a recovery.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_14: I understand the position you are in. Word has it that you're currently staying at a hotel and are at odds with the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_15: Perhaps a stay at my estate would suit you, for the remainder of your time in Rinascita?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_16: I can offer you a glimpse into Rinascita's past, and you'd be spared the Order's unwelcomed attention.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_17: Don't lose hope just yet. There might still be a path forward.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_18: Carlotta once helped me interpret some stained glass images. The story it told was very similar to what you've described.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_19: Only more biased towards the Order. It mentioned a maiden who would emerge as the Sentinel's Resonator and later save Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_20: Do you think that's also a lie?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_22: (Describe to Cantarella what was portrayed on the stained glass.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_23: The part regarding the maiden isn't entirely fiction.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_24: The Sentinel does indeed appoint a maiden to be Their Resonator, though not in the way the Carnevale would have you believe. No, it's through resonance with a very particular artifact.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_25: That's not how Jué found Their Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_26: That's because Imperator wields the power to split and manipulate space.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_27: With it, They can withdraw a portion of power. That power's frequency will match the Imperator's own.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_28: This is how the Sword of Divinity—Tyrvine—came to be. A blade sealed with the very powers of the Sentinel, and the artifact used to select Their Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_29: To resonate with the sword is to resonate with the Sentinel. Only the chosen one may hope to draw it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_31: The Martyred "Maiden"...? The nature of her resonance is unclear to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_32: Perhaps she resonated with the Threnodian, or perhaps with the Sentinel in its corrupted form.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_33: But choosing her could not have been the Sentinel's will. That's because...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_36: Are you saying the real Maiden was already chosen?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_37: In the past, each year the Fisalia family would hold the Divine Trials to select those with the strongest will. These young women would attempt to resonate with Tyrvine's powers—while Overclocked, of course.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_38: Though none succeeded, some saw fragments of the truth hidden within the resonance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_39: I was one of them... There was a moment, where I glimpsed the Sentinel's corrupted form and the inverted ruin suspended in the sky.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_40: I also learned that only Tyrvine can break the barrier of that Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_41: When I awoke from that vision, I discovered a line of words inscribed onto my hand.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_42: I would never mistake my own handwriting. That is precisely why I am searching for other possibilities.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_43: The words were—"The Maiden is dead."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_44: (An inverted ruin suspended in the sky... her and Cartethyia's descriptions bear many similarities.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_45: (If Tyrvine is the key to entering the Sonoro Sphere, it stands to reason that Imperator may have played a role in the Sphere's creation.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_46: (If I can confirm that Tyrvine was truly left by Imperator, at least it would prove that neither are lying.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_47: (Cantarella said she was Overclocking when she tried resonating with Tyrvine.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_48: (That's exactly what happened with Jinhsi. Could Imperator be trying to restore Their power through a Second Awakening?)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_49: (If that's the case... my permission should cause a reaction. That's one way to confirm what they're saying.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_50: Can I get a closer look at the sword?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_51: Would you mind if I tried to pull out the sword?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_53: ...I suppose all that's left is its symbolic value.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_54: However, do handle it with care. It is a family heirloom... I've heard of your unique methods and formidable strength.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_15_1: There is a cable car in the lower levels of the Fisalia estate that leads directly to the Sonoro Sphere. The mechanism beside that wall can activate the lifts.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_15_2: Are all these mechanisms really necessary?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_15_3: Convenience isn't the only reason for having them. Some were specifically built in case an outsider decided to visit.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_1: You seem perturbed. Are you still gathering your thoughts?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_2: Everything that's happened has all lined up so perfectly. It makes me think it's too good to be true.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_3: I'd like to share a different perspective.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_18_1: Outside, they call me "The Bane." But historically, every head of the Fisalia family has carried such a title.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_18_2: It just so happens that I am the most potent one yet.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_19_1: We've reached the old seminary's undercrypt. The gateway into the Sonoro Sphere itself lies at its center.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_19_2: We shall continue on foot from here.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_1: Music itself holds no emotion. It's the heart that grants it meaning. So, dear listener, tell me. What feelings did my piece evoke in you?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_5: Wow... A very valuable insight! Thank you, that brings me closer to completing my piece.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_6: Salutations, {PlayerName}. My name is Ciaccona, a wandering bard. I'm glad to have met you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_8: I was sent by Lady Carlotta to find you. As I passed that abandoned house, I suddenly felt this... well, you know, rush of inspiration that just can't be ignored! So, I stopped to compose a piece...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_9: Surprise, surprise, the melody led me right to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_10: Well... I suppose this won't count as me getting distracted, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_11: If Carlotta asked you to find me, has something happened?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_12: Lady Carlotta told me you encountered the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_13: She dispatched search teams soon after, but there's been no sign of Cartethyia since.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_14: That's why she asked me to use my Forte to recreate the frequency you experienced at the time, to see if any details you might have missed become clearer.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_16: Well, it's a little tricky to explain in words... Think of it like being in an immersive portrait. Can you tell me about your meeting with Cartethyia?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_17: The more details the better. Even the smallest things count.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_18: Let's see here... Tweak a few notes here. Some emotions there. Textures... That should do it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_19: Now then, {PlayerName}. Time for you to "tune in" to your memories.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_20_3: This area was clear of Tacets Discords on my last visit, and there's no Tacet Field nearby.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_20_5: Could they have come from the Sonoro Sphere itself?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_22_1: Didn't think there would be Gulpuffs here.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_1: The road ahead will not be an easy one.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_3: The second Dark Tide... It occurred right here, at the Avinoleum. The largest seminary ever built by the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_4: It arrived on the very day the Blessed Maiden passed her trials and was crowned by the Order. A day when belief burned brighter than ever.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_5: And when the darkness came, none escaped.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_6: These days, what most people remember is the seminary disappearing into the sky. But in truth, the Dark Tide that should have spread across Rinascita vanished, along with it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_7: Yet due to a lack of records, the second Dark Tide slowly faded from memory.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_8: I was there when it all happened. Still an ordinary member of the family, watching it unfold from a boat just outside the seminary.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_9: It wasn't until later when I attempted to resonate with Tyrvine, that I gained a partial glimpse of the Sonoro Sphere's interior.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_10: Sounds like someone inside the seminary did something to stop the spread.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_11: Precisely. It could very well have been Cartethyia's doing. But, as with the first time, there's also the chance it was the Sentinel who turned the tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_12: I can sense the conflict within you, the temptation to trust your Maiden. But it's best to keep those thoughts to yourself, for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_13: The Threnodian knows where the heart is weakest and it is there it strikes the hardest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_15: Of course, it's never too late to place your trust when the evidence is clear.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_23_16: But... now is not the time, is it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_1: ("Tune in" to my memories... Does that mean I'm supposed to see the past from another perspective?)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_3: Our Tacet Marks are glowing again. It appears there is a special connection between them.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_4: What is the meaning of this?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_5: Someone used their Resonance ability to help me relive this moment, but this seems... unexpected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_6: How did you first come to notice me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_7: The Sentinel—Imperator's voice guided me to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_8: You heard the Sentinel's voice? Then tell me, am I Their Resonator?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_2: To think the head of the Fisalias approached you when I was still in negotiations with her emissaries. Was it meant to be a diversion all along...?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_5: They invited you and you alone. As a Montelli, I'm in no position to intervene.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_6: That being said, if the Fisalias try anything against you, I'll get you out, even if it means storming through their front gates.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_10: In the meantime, I'll keep looking for more information and the person Cartethyia mentioned to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_11: I'll call you as soon as I find anything.

Event_WGZM_10_1: Impressive work, Dreamwalker. That was quite a formidable foe, but it was still no match for you.
Event_WGZM_10_2: Looks like that's not all of it.
Event_WGZM_10_3: Yes, many more dream masses are lurking in the depths of the Somnoire...
Event_WGZM_10_4: They're getting stronger as we speak, targeting the Somnoire's weak points. It's almost as if they have a mind of their own.
Event_WGZM_10_6: Keep exploring, Dreamwalker. You will find the truth in a dream.
Event_WGZM_11_1: The frequencies I sensed earlier are still there. "They" are hiding in the depths of all of these dreams.
Event_WGZM_11_2: So, that's what a dream mass looks like?
Event_WGZM_11_4: It's likely reflecting a form we're already familiar with, or maybe... it resembles a certain "something" inside the mass.
Event_WGZM_11_5: There are things I need to see for myself. This is the duty you have entrusted to me.
Event_WGZM_11_8: Rest assured, I will not put myself in danger again.
Event_WGZM_11_9: See you soon. You have my word.
Event_WGZM_4_1: Sigh, you must have noticed the Ebony Gatekeeper by now, right? I finally found him.
Event_WGZM_4_2: We were supposed to keep the balance in the Somnoire together… but now, things have spiraled out of control.
Event_WGZM_4_3: There are dream masses just up ahead.
Event_WGZM_4_4: Dreamwalker, please stay vigilant. I wish you the best of luck.
Event_WGZM_5_2: Don't you have anything to say?
Event_WGZM_5_3: These masses are devouring other dreams, threatening the stability of the entire Somnoire…
Event_WGZM_5_4: With what power I have left in me, I'm afraid I can no longer rein them in. I need your help.
Event_WGZM_5_5: You don't sound like you're asking for help.
Event_WGZM_5_6: I know I made a few missteps in trying to save more dreams. I don't expect you to forgive me.
Event_WGZM_5_7: But I am as devastated as anyone to see the Somnoire collapse. You have to believe me.
Event_WGZM_5_8: I'm… sincerely begging for your help.
Event_WGZM_5_9: Alright, but I'm not doing this for you.
Event_WGZM_5_10: Meow three times, and I'll think about it.
Event_WGZM_6_1: Impressive work. These dream masses are disintegrating.
Event_WGZM_6_3: Well, they're breaking down into dream fragments now. In time, they might form something new. I'll track them down, but...
Event_WGZM_6_5: You really need to finish your sentences.
Event_WGZM_6_6: Our actions had unexpected repercussions. More dream masses are escaping the Somnoire. The boundary between reality and dreams is rapidly deteriorating.
Event_WGZM_6_7: I cannot predict what will happen next.
Event_WGZM_6_9: Don't worry. I can handle whatever comes.
Event_WGZM_6_10: That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
Event_WGZM_7_1: Abandoned buildings and platforms… I didn't see anything like this before.
Event_WGZM_7_2: Looks like things are shifting again inside the Somnoire…
Event_WGZM_9_1: An entity like this shouldn't exist in a dream… But now that I'm here, let me be of use to you.

GuideTutorialPage_33013_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. Collect enough Crests to earn hefty rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_3301302_Content: The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color>, and <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing all challenges in a Zone unlocks the next Zone.
GuideTutorialPage_3301303_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' <color=#c19f51>Vigor</color> by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can <color=#c19f51>no longer take part in new challenges</color>. Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.
GuideTutorialPage_3301304_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, environmental effects affect your combat tactics. Use them strategically to gain an advantage.
GuideTutorialPage_3301305_Content: Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can be claimed only once. However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are <color=#c19f51>periodically reset</color>, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and <color=#c19f51>claim fresh rewards.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_3301306_Content: Complete the challenges and meet their challenge goals to obtain Crests. Collect a certain number of Crests to get various rewards, including Astrites and Hazard Records. Hazard Records can be exchanged for Phantom Echoes, Premium Tuners, and more at the Adversity Exchange.
GuideTutorialPage_34071_Content:
Deal damage to accumulate Sync Energy. When the Link Energy is full, get ready to activate Dream Link.
Successful <color=#ffd12f>Dodges</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> provide a lot of Sync Energy.
GuideTutorialPage_3407102_Content: When Sync Energy is full, cast any Resonator's Resonance Liberation to enter the Illusive Sync state.
GuideTutorialPage_3407103_Content: The Illusive Sync only lasts 10 seconds. If you don't cast the next Resonator's Resonance Liberation within that time, you'll lose all Sync Energy, and the sync will end.
GuideTutorialPage_3407104_Content:
Casting Resonance Liberation while in Illusive Sync triggers the Dream Link state and activates the Link Field.
When the Link Field is active:
1. All team members' ATK, Crit. Rate, and Crit. DMG are significantly boosted, while Resonance Skill cooldowns are greatly reduced.
2. A Stagnation Zone is generated, immobilizing enemies within the Link Field.
3. Nearby enemies are pulled toward your Resonators upon activation.
4. When the Link Field ends, your team gains continuous HP regeneration.
GuideTutorialPage_34072_Content: Hold Dash to enter the Illusive Sprint state after picking up the white cat's blessings.
GuideTutorialPage_3407202_Content: In the Illusive Sprint state, attack to dash toward enemies and deal significant damage.

Character_chun_35_17:
After losing contact with you, Camellya crosses the Stargate and finds herself in the cave from the past. Like you, she has jumped through many simulated worlds and witnessed different possibilities, but her path always crosses with yours.

Intrigued by the Lady Flora illusion in front of her, Camellya decides to follow.
Character_chun_52_24:
You find yourself reunited with Camellya. Considering the years apart, this reunion has been ten years in the making. In every world, you and she have met, parted, and reunited again. If this is your fate, Camellya embraces it willingly.

With the Stellar Matrix defeated, the two of you return home.

Event_AYKXBRZM_4001_1: Zhezhi quickly completes yet another copy of the Winter's Serenade in Bloom. However, her manager soon requests another one.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4002_1: Zhezhi loses track of how many times she recreates the same painting, the stack of scrolls growing ever taller.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4003_1: Perhaps I'm nothing more than a tool for copying paintings.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_1: What do you really want to paint?
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_2: Do you remember when you painted the first Winter's Serenade in Bloom?
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_3: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_4: You worked really hard on it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_5: And... that hard work should be noticed.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7501_1: Believe in your judgment, your brush, and yourself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7502_1: (Zhezhi musters her courage and continues to work on the unfinished draft.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_7502_2: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away, the painted world fades, forgotten today...
chun_shengtai_1_2: After we dealt with that troublemaking Stellar Matrix…
chun_shengtai_1_4: Hehe, you must really care about me, don't you? Well, noisy places irritate me, but here… it's perfect. Quiet.
chun_shengtai_1_5: Every time I watch the sea… it makes me feel happy.
chun_shengtai_1_6: No thoughts, no distractions… just silence.
chun_shengtai_1_7: I've never shared my little haven with anyone. But you? You're different. You're special.
chun_shengtai_1_8: Camellya hums a tune as here eyes drift back to the sea. The melody stirs a sense of familiarity in your heart.
chun_shengtai_4_1: Look at that, the morning sun over the sea… It's always that beautiful.
chun_shengtai_4_2: Rising silently, cutting through the darkness… It's the only time it's glow is tender and soft.
chun_shengtai_4_3: So, you come here for the sun?
chun_shengtai_4_4: Flowers thirst for light and water. It's their instinct.
chun_shengtai_4_6: But I can't always linger here. Being a Bloom Bearer means I have my own responsibilities.
chun_shengtai_4_8: Oh, you're curious? But that's a secret, hehe.
POI_HSBD_1_1: Can't believe they built this colossus out here in the middle of nowhere...
POI_HSBD_1_3: Right after you walked into this place! Those Order folks must be loaded to build it.
POI_HSBD_1_4: Maybe… but what does this inscription mean?
POI_HSBD_1_5: "Depths of the garden…" Sounds like there's a secret in there. Let's go take a look!
