Quest_880000036_QuestName_880_1: Love in the Time of Fishing
Quest_880000037_QuestDesc_880_1: Here, all fish gather—and since whales are also considered "fish", then...
Quest_880000038_QuestDesc_880_1: In a storm long ago, a captain and a whale sank beneath the waves together. Now, a similar storm rages, and the whale roams the sea once more…
Quest_880000039_QuestDesc_880_1: The sea has calmed, but Captain Ahab and his crew are gone. Ishmael, who first brought you to the Riccioli Islands, seems to be studying the relics left behind by the legendary captain…

DYHD_1_1: Ah, call me Ishmael. Well, well! The Laureate, I presume? Have you ever tried fishing before?
DYHD_1_2: The trick to it is a flexible line and a subtle lure.
DYHD_1_3: Fancy trying your hand at deep sea fishing? It's one of Rinascita's many lasting traditions, like the Carnevale.
DYHD_1_4: Sure, I want to become a pro angler.
DYHD_1_5: I'd like to give it a try.
DYHD_1_6: Wonderful, then I've got a good place for you. Riccioli Islands, north of Ragunna. It's right where the currents of the Stormy Sea meet, drawing in swarms of fish.
DYHD_1_7: And if you're alone, angling on a fishing boat would suit you better. A net will just get you tangled up in trouble.
DYHD_1_8: Once you reach the islands, go visit an old captain called Ahab. He'll be more than glad to show you the ropes.
DYHD_1_9: I've got to make my way back to the islands myself. There's a boat at the harbor that'll take you straight there. Just let the boatman know you're off for some fishing!
DYHD_11_2: No one else knows. It's just between us.
DYHD_11_3: Wait for my return, my darling... fiancée...
DYHD_11_4: Er, excuse me, sir? Are you the one who witnessed Cetus the Tidebreaker?
DYHD_11_5: Hmm? Yes, that's me! Are you here to witness our union? Marvelous! Come, according to tradition, a wedding witness must be present.
DYHD_11_7: A wedding witness? Well, the Codex does allow Acolytes to serve as witnesses during weddings.
DYHD_11_8: What makes you want to marry a fish?!
DYHD_11_9: He's certainly not acting like himself...
DYHD_11_11: Is he... under some kind of enchantment? I've read of symptoms like this in the Order's archives before.
DYHD_11_12: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...
DYHD_11_14: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...
DYHD_11_16: Golden white... Jellyfish... Pitch black... A large fish... Huh? You're human... I'm a fish... No wait... My fish...
DYHD_11_17: Ow, my head hurts... Who are you?
DYHD_11_19: Mind if I give him another smack?
DYHD_11_20: Where the hell's my boat? And how did I get here... What?
DYHD_11_21: The fish... My, oh, my... From Serene Bay... The fish... Heeheehee...
DYHD_11_22: He's at it again! Here I go!
DYHD_11_27: I treated their broken leg from a Gondola accident back at the market.
DYHD_11_29: Did... Mr. Coffin ask you to come here?
DYHD_11_30: I think they're trying to say that Mr. Starbuck's Gondola might know something. They're stranded on a reef nearby.
DYHD_11_31: And Mr. Starbuck has been like this for two weeks now...
DYHD_11_33: You want us to use these to free the Gondola?
DYHD_11_34: Hmmm, I fear Mr. Starbuck might not withstand any more of the Order's disenchantment tricks anyway.
DYHD_11_37: In that brief moment when Mr. Starbuck seemed to recover, he mentioned his Gondola and a place called Serene Bay.
DYHD_13_2: The rescued Gondola appears to be shouting something.
DYHD_13_3: You came across a "siren"? A creature with a human body and a fishtail?
DYHD_13_5: Isn't she supposed to be in Nimbus Sanctum?
DYHD_13_6: Could there be another being like Lorelei?
DYHD_13_8: I suspect that the fish we saw earlier is connected to this "siren."
DYHD_13_9: There's got to be a reason it stayed fresh after all these weeks.
DYHD_13_10: This means we need to think of a way to get that fish out of Mr. Starbuck's hands.
DYHD_13_12: It's time for a little switcheroo.
DYHD_13_13: We catch one that looks similar and call it a day.
DYHD_13_15: We're running low on options here.
DYHD_13_17: Well, only one way to find out.
DYHD_14_2: Oh? My dear witness, have you seen my fiancée around?
DYHD_14_3: Hehehe... You… What are you up to?
DYHD_14_9: Who are you? What am I doing with this fish?
DYHD_14_10: Mr. Starbuck? Captain Ahab asked us to come find you.
DYHD_14_11: Old Ahab? Wait, what's going on here?
DYHD_14_12: Do you know anything about this blue fish?
DYHD_14_13: Do you remember what happened to Cetus the Tidebreaker?
DYHD_14_14: All I remember is being out at sea fishing not long ago.
DYHD_14_15: But all I could hear was a song, drawing me in. It felt like my whole body was being beckoned to follow that tune.
DYHD_14_16: The next thing I knew, I was drifting right out of Serene Bay, where the Tidebreaker is said to slumber.
DYHD_14_17: The singing was still there, like it was rising from the depths. I swear I caught a glimpse of the Cetus's shadow... then another shadow of a massive fish.
DYHD_14_18: Oh, the curves of that shadow. A true beauty...
DYHD_14_19: I tossed everything I had into the sea, anything that could serve as bait, but still, it wouldn't bite.
DYHD_14_20: Then, I felt a tug on the line as the singing grew louder... and everything went blank after that.
DYHD_14_21: Did you catch this blue fish?
DYHD_14_24: Key! The key... Blast it, where'd that key go?
DYHD_14_25: The key... I used it as bait...
DYHD_14_29: Aha! I knew it! Molto bene! Got gobbled up by the fish!
DYHD_14_30: Old Ahab had me keep it. You'll be needing it too, yes?
DYHD_14_31: A key covered in rust. Seems like it's seen better days...
DYHD_14_32: I can't recall much after that, but no doubt the Tidebreaker did make an appearance in Serene Bay.
DYHD_14_33: If you're looking for it, go take a look around the bay. Oh, and thanks for the help...
DYHD_14_35: I'm forty-seven years old this year. After all these years at sea, I've caught more fish than you can imagine.
DYHD_14_36: But the right fish and the right person have yet to cross my path.
DYHD_14_37: Oh, but this beautiful lady here—
DYHD_14_41: I wish you the best! May Imper... May the sea bring you blessings!
DYHD_15_1: Let's light up the lighthouses on this island as Captain Ahab instructed.
DYHD_15_2: After that, we should go visit that Serene Bay Mr. Starbuck talked about.
DYHD_18_2: The octopus Echo waves its tentacles around as it hands you a note from Ahab.
DYHD_18_3: "Once it's safe, Planck can swim over to Serene Bay."
DYHD_18_4: "Since the lighthouse on Starbuck's island is up and running, we can set sail again. We're counting on you and Miss White Hat."
DYHD_18_5: "There'll be monsters swarming in those waters, ever since Cetus went missing."
DYHD_18_6: "Word is, the key to Serene Bay's lighthouse got lost long ago. We only know it's somewhere at the bottom of the sea."
DYHD_18_7: "I'll keep poking around and see what else I can dig up. I'll have Planck send word once I've got news."
DYHD_2_1: Are you the one looking for a ride to Riccioli?
DYHD_2_4: Take a seat, and we'll be on our way!
DYHD_4_1: Seeking out old Ahab, are you? He should be at the harbor over there.
DYHD_4_2: He's no ordinary man, I tell you that. You'll spot him a mile away.
DYHD_5_2: Huh? Hmm... All right, cut it out...
DYHD_5_3: Oh! Ahoy! A fish! We have a bite!
DYHD_5_4: Well, don't just stand there, {Male=laddie;Female=missy}! Gimme a hand with this thing!
DYHD_5_6: That's gotta be one hefty fish...
DYHD_5_8: A big fella like that? He won't be gettin' away from me, just a matter of time, no bother at all.
DYHD_5_9: Oh, that? Pah, that was nothing. Back in me youth, I could hunt a whale for a whole day, I could!
DYHD_5_10: You must be that young'un Ishmael mentioned.
DYHD_5_11: Yes, I'm here to become a pro fisher.
DYHD_5_12: Yes, I'm here to try deep sea fishing.
DYHD_5_13: Aye, good! You've come to the right place. The name's Ahab, and I've been tied to this harbor longer than most.
DYHD_5_14: That octopus merchant over there is Planck. It has all you need, from fishing gear to boat repairs.
DYHD_5_15: But... I see you don't have a boat. We can fix that! You can use mine!
DYHD_5_17: The ones we use here for fishing are different from what you'll find in the city. We treat 'em like family—live and die together, we do.
DYHD_5_18: She's called Rachel. Gettin' on in years, but she's still got some fire in her.
DYHD_5_19: Since I retired, it's been a while since she and I crashed some waves. I reckon she misses the old fishing days as much as I do.
DYHD_5_20: Well, now that we've shared a bit of fishing, I'd say we've forged a bond, eh?
DYHD_5_21: What do you say we chase that big fella that gave us the slip? Let's head straight out to sea!
DYHD_5_22: I'd like to see what kind of fish dares to run away from old Ahab!
DYHD_6_1: Ahoy! That was some mighty fine sailing back there!
DYHD_6_2: You picked it up quickly. Good, good！
DYHD_6_3: Ah, don't forget to stop by the market when ye've got time to spare.
DYHD_6_4: Minding the helm is only half the battle. You've got to know how to trade, too!
DYHD_7_1: …Oi, the Order's got no authority here. Now, bugger off, will ya.
DYHD_7_2: Come on, Mr. Coffin. Didn't she just help you fix your Echo...
DYHD_7_3: Oh, pipe down, Coffin. The wee lassie was just asking you for some directions, for Imperator's sake.
DYHD_7_6: I'm only looking for Cetus the Tidebreaker. They were injured in Ragunna…
DYHD_7_7: Cetus the Tidebreaker, you say? Well…
DYHD_7_8: Hey, look. Isn't that the Resonator who showed up in Ragunna a while back? The Laureate…
DYHD_7_9: The Order is not welcome around these parts! Yer hear me?
DYHD_7_12: The Order's left us alone for years. If they really wanted to meddle in our affairs now, you think they'd just send one little girl?
DYHD_7_14: We owe our trade to the blessings of Cetus the Tidebreaker and these very seas. Ye're tellin' me we can't accept a wee lass in an Acolyte hat?
DYHD_7_15: Right then, that's enough of that. Business has been hard as it is lately. Break it up, folks.
DYHD_7_16: If ye've got more complaints, toss 'em my way. Happy now? Off you go.
DYHD_7_18: I'm here because I want to talk to the villagers about the Tidebreaker. No one has seen them since the Carnevale...
DYHD_7_22: All right, then. But know this—the Order's let these islands drift without a guide, so the folk around here aren't too keen on seeing someone wearin' that kind of hat wanderin' about.
DYHD_7_24: Anyway, just say ye're here on personal business and ye'll be fine. Now, I hear ye're lookin' for Cetus the Tidebreaker. Well, lucky you, 'cause so am I.
DYHD_7_25: Yes! The Tidebreaker showed unnatural signs during the Carnevale not long ago. I think I sensed their pain and anger...
DYHD_7_26: Well, sail around in these waters and ye're bound to run into it, sooner or later. But if you want the simple way... See that lighthouse down yonder?
DYHD_7_27: There are four of 'em across Riccioli Islands. As long as their lights are on, the Tidebreaker will answer our pleas as gently as ever.
DYHD_7_28: Three of them went dark when the Tidebreaker vanished. Getting them lit again should do the trick.
DYHD_7_29: You know what? Why don't you take Miss White Hat here on a wee boat ride, {PlayerName}?
DYHD_7_32: W-what? I've only ever read about Riccioli Islands' fishing trade in the Order's library before, but I've never actually fished on the sea...
DYHD_7_33: How do you expect the sea to answer yer calls if you don't embrace it yerself?
DYHD_7_34: Oh, and hold onto yer "hat" during the ride. If anything else comes up, just come find me.
DYHD_7_35: What did he mean by that, {PlayerName}?
DYHD_7_38: Then I'll help however I can with catching fish while we locate the Tidebreaker!
DYHD_8_1: My leg... Where's my leg... Fetch me the harpoon...
DYHD_8_3: Ahoy. How did it go? Pull in a pretty big haul, did ye?
DYHD_8_4: I'm gettin' closer to findin' the Tidebreaker meself. Just head over to the Helm Village and look for... What's his name again...?
DYHD_8_6: The man's lost a couple of his marbles these past few weeks. People say he only started actin' up after catchin' a glimpse of the Tidebreaker. Anyway, tell him I sent ye.
DYHD_8_8: If you want to catch yourself a real prize, ye'll be needin' that one. She's still waitin' on repairs, but the watermen can fill ye in on that.

HelpText_143_Content:
Eligibility
Reach Union Level 8

Event Rules
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim the sign-in rewards. The sign-in record refreshes daily at 4:00 a.m. server time;

Character_Rococo_56_1: Nice and easy. We're right on track.
Character_Rococo_78_2: The Dragon of Dirge? No, wait.
Character_Rococo_57_5: Err... Looks like they were trying to sneak away with the star, but hit the light switch by accident.
Character_Rococo_57_10: They're saying, "We're not going down without a fight!"
Character_Rococo_58_1: Golden Fleece, a worn playbook, old instruments...
Character_Rococo_58_2: Are they supposed to be the Archdemon?
Character_Rococo_58_3: Or the Fools hiding from the Tacet Discords?
Character_Rococo_60_1: Are these Echoes the Archdemon in the opera?
Character_Rococo_60_2: Oh, no. They're just abandoned Echoes.
Character_Rococo_60_3: They used to have homes and their own masters. They still don't understand why they got kicked out all of a sudden one day.
Character_Rococo_60_4: Even after being abandoned, they never forgot about their masters and managed to find their way home... but their masters were no longer there.
Character_Rococo_60_5: They scoured the whole of Rinascita, refusing to give up and accept the truth... But even now, when they've reached this Land of the Banished, they still couldn't find a single trace of their masters.
Character_Rococo_60_6: Just when they were about to lose hope, they found solace in the emotional frequencies left on personal items.
Character_Rococo_60_7: So they made this place their home. Little by little, they scavenged things to bring the home from their memories to life.
Character_Rococo_60_8: That's how they came across the "star."
Character_Rococo_60_9: Right when the Tacet Discords attacked the ship.
Character_Rococo_60_10: So they just snatched it and ran.
Character_Rococo_60_11: Yes. They're not really the brawling type. The Tacet Discords scare them, so they sneak around, grabbing anything not nailed down while trying not to get caught.
Character_Rococo_60_12: With so many Tacet Discords wandering around the Strand, all they can do is scatter Golden Fleece, spooking the Tacet Discords to give them the chance to sneak out.
Character_Rococo_60_13: They're willing to risk it all to find trinkets to make this place... feel more like home.
Character_Rococo_60_14: Whether you're a person or an Echo, everybody needs a place to call home.
Character_Rococo_60_15: They heard the Pegasus opera from their masters.
Character_Rococo_60_16: That's why they went for the star when they saw it rolling away. They wanted the good, hopeful frequencies it was radiating.
Character_Rococo_60_17: These Echoes knew the star wasn't theirs, but they weren't keen on giving it up, either. So they cooked up all those spooky tricks to scare us away.
Character_Rococo_60_18: Turns out, this maze wasn't hiding an Archdemon or a hero. Just a bunch of Fools.
Character_Rococo_60_19: Fools, huh? Let's welcome them to the Fool's Troupe then.
Character_Rococo_60_20: They want a home? They can join the troupe.
Character_Rococo_60_21: Good idea. Let's bring these Echoes along. Plus we could use some extra help with the opera.
Character_Rococo_60_22: And all this stuff they worked so hard to collect... Let's bring it with us too. It must mean a lot to them.
Character_Rococo_63_1: Pero and I are almost done packing everything up.
Character_Rococo_63_4: I still need to check around.
Character_Rococo_63_5: All right. Back to the troupe.
Character_Rococo_63_6: Okay. We'll be here when you're ready.
Character_Rococo_63_7: Roccia asks Pero to bring along the Echoes and their items as they all return to the Troupe.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4201_1: {PlayerName}, you came because you were worried about me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_4201_3: Hehe, no rush. They'll be leaving soon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4202_1: You betrayed the Patrollers. You betrayed me! Who will ever trust you after this?!
Event_AYKXBRZM_4202_2: I know who I am. I have my own path to walk.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4600_2: Cloudy said she was a princess from a wonderful play. Everyone loved her performance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4601_1: But then, out of nowhere... a Big Bad Demon appeared!

Event_AYKXBRZM_5100_1: She picked it up carefully, and ta-da! She made medicine that healed the Woolies!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5100_2: Then, the super team marched on their way to fight the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_1: At last, it was time to fight the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_2: Gray Ear the Rabbit made yummy bread for everyone so they wouldn't fight on empty stomachs.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_3: Cloudy put on a show about a brave princess the night before to cheer everyone up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5300_1: Finally, Warrior Encore and the Woolies teamed up for the final blow!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5301_1: They defeated the Big Bad Demon! Encore's team stopped his evil plan and brought peace back to the Magical Kingdom.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_6: A part of your consciousness entered Somnoire when you fell asleep.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_7: Somnoire? What's that? Some kind of Sonoro?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_8: No, but you can think of it that way.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_9: Well... just now, I met a girl around my age. She had the same name as Grandma.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_10: She lived in the same town, had a group of friends, and liked to catch dragonflies in the mountains.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_11: The only difference is, the temple that should be demolished by monsters was still there, east of the town...
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_12: Grandma used to say that people would pay tribute to their ancestors in that temple every year. The ceremony would be as grand as the Moon-Chasing Festival.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_13: As much as she loved that town, she never stopped wanting to explore the world outside it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_14: Um, I heard the Sonoro Sphere can keep memories of people or even a place's history. Is that true?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_15: What I saw just now, is it real? Is that girl my Grandma?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_16: My apologies, but I cannot answer that.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_19: What happens when I wake up? Will this place and my memory of it disappear?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_20: Everything you saw here will be erased, except your memory. That I have no control over.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_21: That's a relief... Thank you, kind sir. That's given me some hope.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_22: In my memories, Grandma always took care of everyone in the family.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_23: She raised her children and they left home, then her grandchildren, repeating this cycle her entire life in that old house.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_24: I always wanted to travel, but I couldn't bear to leave Grandma alone.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_25: This dream showed me a different side of her. She was once a young girl with dreams... just like me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_26: She dreamed of traveling, meeting new people, and starting a family.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_27: Now I feel grateful to be part of such a family. And even more grateful to have this side of Grandma live on in my memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_28: I used to think she was old and lonely, but she really glowed with her hopes and dreams.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_29: Thank you, sir. Thank you for showing me this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8200_1: Beyond the wolves' howls, there's another sound lurking in this storm.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8200_2: Hehe, if you truly are the untamable beasts you claim to be, then why have you let yourself to be so easily at someone's disposal?
Event_AYKXBRZM_8201_1: There's more to this case than meets the eye...
Event_AYKXBRZM_8201_2: How about we start by investigating the missing person's home?
Event_AYKXBRZM_8300_1: Now that we know who the real culprit is, it's time to act.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8300_2: Madam, let's not be hasty. The time hasn't yet come.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8301_1: Finding the culprit is simple. The real challenge is capturing them all at once.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8301_2: Fully prepare and wait for the right moment—that's a wise strategy, Changli.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8500_1: Hehe, he's not the same as the one we faced before.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8500_2: If they lost back then, they'll lose again today.
Event_AYKXBRZM_8500_3: Don't worry. While my flames can't destroy this Somnoire, they're more than enough to handle these pests.
HelpText_139_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra II, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]
Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank, while successful Dodges, Dodge Counters, and Counterattacks provide a greater boost. However, getting hit significantly lowers your Combat Rank.

Starlight streams through your fingers as you mount the expedition into the depths of the universe.
The gentle twinkles silently chant a song of gratitude, a tribute to the treasured gifts you once bestowed upon them.

This is a leveling event where you will receive awesome rewards for reaching the milestones in 4 themed leveling activities: Resonator leveling - "Stellar Journey," weapon leveling - "Cosmical Forge," Echo leveling - "Consonant Echoes," and skill leveling - "Unison Resonance."
All unclaimed rewards will be sent via Mail the next time you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

DYHD_19_2: They're heading towards that island to the west!
DYHD_20_2: Let it take out the Albatross... This time I'll...
DYHD_20_4: That island Tidebreaker ran off to is also known as Reyes Ruins. They say it's filled with old mysteries.
DYHD_20_5: The storm ragin' over it seems to keep folks from settin' foot there. Its own protection, if ye will.
DYHD_20_6: But not to worry, I've already found a way to get past it.
DYHD_20_7: If Starbuck isn't pullin' my leg, that storm and the siren are in cahoots. Which means...
DYHD_20_8: Come on, let's move out! You and Miss White Hat will team up, and I'll be with Starbuck.
DYHD_20_9: There's a wee island just east of the ruins. We'll meet there.
DYHD_21_1: You see, Captain. What did I tell you?
DYHD_21_2: It says here, "Riccioli, shower Neptunia with your light. The usurper slumbers in the depths of Reyes. Offer your love to Reyes' descendants and the eternal life of the sea."
DYHD_21_4: Riccioli corresponds to Neptunia in Rinascitan astrology. In other words, the island is surrounded by the deepest waters in all of Rinascita.
DYHD_21_5: Ho, ho. You know your astrology well, Miss White Hat.
DYHD_21_6: I'm just stating what everyone in Rinascita knows. It's also mentioned in the legends of the Sentinel Imperator.
DYHD_21_10: So it's asking us to fall in love with somethin'? That's just plain odd!
DYHD_21_12: O great, noble descendants of Reyes, hear my words! I offer ye me love!
DYHD_21_13: Umm... I shall offer ye my love! The ceaseless waves shall be my pledge of loyalty to you for all eternity!
DYHD_21_14: Bah, I'm gettin' too old for this! What dunderheaded idea is this, anyway!
DYHD_21_15: Go on, {Male=laddie;Female=missy}. You give it a go!
DYHD_21_17: Aye, you. Just a few words, for the love of the sea! What, need a pen and paper, do ye?
DYHD_21_18: O great, noble descendants of Reyes...
DYHD_21_20: No, no, no! You're all doing it wrong!
DYHD_21_21: What do you take love for? Is this a joke to you?
DYHD_21_25: My love. You are the light of my life.
DYHD_21_26: No storm can keep us apart, for in your presence, the might of my love can withstand any tempest, for it is even stronger!
DYHD_21_27: My soul yearns to break free, for it has found its direction, yet I am tormented by my inability to reach you...
DYHD_21_30: That's enough of that! Let's move out! We've got no time to dawdle!
DYHD_22_1: Splendid! Now that we got rid of that storm, Planck can swim over here!
DYHD_22_2: Can't say the same for Queequeg, though. The repaired Pequod is awaitin' her new captain before she can set sail.
DYHD_22_3: Let's take a look around. Don't know much about the lighthouse here in Reyes, but I'll have that siren hangin' from the tip of me mast by day's end, ye mark me words.
DYHD_22_5: Not everyone can survive the weight of the sea. She's a merciful mistress, but she can be merciless, too.
DYHD_22_6: Even in dreams, I see meself hurlin' sharp harpoons into the water. They must sink deep before they strike with true power and precision.
DYHD_22_7: Though we are blessed by the sea, we stand ready to point our harpoons at it... and at that fella.
DYHD_22_8: Strife, chaos... endless conflict. This is the fate of those who live with the tides.
DYHD_22_9: How nice... Did you know? Some people die at the tide's ebb, some at low water...
DYHD_22_10: Some at the full of the flood. And I'm just a billow that kisses the storm.
DYHD_22_11: Go, Captain. Do what you must and whatever your heart desires.
DYHD_23_2: Oh, actually, I should thank you.
DYHD_23_3: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have gotten this far.
DYHD_23_4: Well... Captain Ahab has his own ambitions. So do I.
DYHD_23_5: *Sign* My beloved. Wait for me, will you?
DYHD_24_1: {PlayerName}, have you noticed that something doesn't feel right about Captain Ahab?
DYHD_24_2: I can't say what it is for certain... But I just have a feeling that he's hiding something from us.
DYHD_24_3: Why don't we split up the search?
DYHD_24_4: If there's a connection between this island and Tidebreaker, I'm sure we'll find something, especially with all the scattered ruins.
DYHD_24_5: I can decipher these ancient Rinascitan texts. We'll have the truth soon enough.

FavorStory_160304_Content:
She awoke from her dream.

The interval between unconsciousness and consciousness became shorter with each passing day. Lady Flora was starting to find it hard to tell where her dreams ended and reality began. She couldn't even recall when this disorientation had started.

Memories surged like turbulent waves, crashing into her mind and wreaking havoc on her senses. Pain ripped through her body, relentlessly and unforgivingly. She opened her mouth to scream, but Overclocking had turned her throat into a gnarled, coarse root, silencing her cries. 

After struggling to take just a few faltering steps, she collapsed onto a muddy riverbank, trembling, her fingertips spasming uncontrollably.

How many times had this happened? She stared blankly at the dark night sky above.

A void of chaos swirled within her, yet there was one thing that stood out in sharp relief: {PlayerName}.

She remembered everything now.

Who she was, who {PlayerName} is, the reason for her being, Solaris, and the Lament…

Before the madness of Overclocking engulfed her, those memories were always buried deep, locked in the depths of her being. Each time she awoke, she lost all recollection, left only with an aching void. As time passed and her body weakened under the strain of Overclocking, glimpses of her mission and roots would resurface, only to vanish again in an endless cycle.

How many times had it happened? Lady Flora had no answer.

Civilizations crumbled into dust, only to rise anew; life faded, only to blossom once more. 

She was witness to the ebb and flow of Solaris, yet remained forever a wanderer in her own mind.

"{PlayerName}…" The name slipped from her lips like a prayer. 

They had never truly met or exchanged words, and now, with her memories fading, she couldn't even tell if they were friends or foes. Yet somehow, the next time she awoke she knew her instincts would lead her to seek {Male=him;Female=her} out. It was not a tender yearning. It felt more like the weight of a heavy chain, one Lady Flora could not resist. 

Yet she felt no hatred for this chain. 

The rustle of leaves shattered her reverie. Wearily, she blinked, and the red camellia unfurled, its vines piercing through the Tacet Discords lurking in the shadows. Yes, this was her instinct, her essence, the core of her being... Even as she teetered on the edge of forgetting everything, she could always rely on her instincts.

In truth, beyond her instincts, there was nothing left for her to hold onto. 

"Next time, if only I could truly get to know {PlayerName} and share a conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}."

Lady Flora mused hazily. Perhaps the Tethys System would lead {PlayerName} to her since she had already revealed herself in this mission.

Lady Flora closed her eyes and surrendered to the darkness as the pain peaked.

The lake's cool water swelled across her cheek, the camellia withering as its vines retreated into her body.

The autumn night breeze blew through the leaves, caressing her as she lay by the lake. To the north, the villagers of Petalfall Village would soon awaken from their dreams, calling to one another as they prepared to set out on a new day of fishing.
FavorStory_160305_Content:
She awoke from her dream.

The wind howled fiercely at the rooftop's edge as she stretched, squinting down at the lively streets below. Vehicles crisscrossed the roads, their taillights forming a vibrant, fiery chain. Resting her chin on her hand, she began to hum.

It was a song she had learned from {PlayerName}.

Of course, she hadn't heard it directly from {PlayerName} {Male=himself;Female=herself}, she had picked it up secretly. 

They might not be enemies, but their relationship was far from friendly—at best, it was a one-sided acquaintance. {PlayerName}'s presence had caught the eye of various factions, including her own organization. Yet, that hardly concerned her, nor was it something she could afford to contemplate.

She was merely a "chosen seed," a "flower" that bloomed for the sole purpose of hunting {PlayerName} down. Most days, the injections left her in a fog, drifting through a semi-conscious haze, with only her instinctual yearning for a certain person carved deep into her heart.

The substance she was administered had a sharp, acrid scent, dragging her reason into a mire, robbing her of clarity and self.

Her thoughts whirled chaotically, like a bomb on the brink of detonation, forced to reset just before the countdown expired. 

But she didn't care. 

Outside of {PlayerName}, little else piqued her interest. Sometimes, {Male=he;Female=she} felt like a mere silhouette against a blank canvas, an outline of a stranger. The portrait was drawn from fragments of information she had painstakingly gathered—they were so close yet had never truly met. She didn't know what {Male=he;Female=she} looked like.

It was said this distance was necessary to evade the Tethys System's tracking. Contact was forbidden.

But how she longed to meet {PlayerName}!

Perched dangerously on the edge of the building, she laughed at the fantasy. Vines entwined around her arms, climbing higher, their delicate buds slowly unfurling at their tips.

Suddenly, a thought struck her.

"I'll give {Male=him;Female=her} a flower."

The moment the thought emerged, it consumed her entirely. She envisioned the moment she would find {PlayerName} and present this gift—a blossom sprouted from her very being. It would neither wither nor decay unless she perished. But just as quickly as it came, the thought vanished into the chaos of her mind, leaving no trace behind.

Little did she know, centuries later, the scene before her would vanish in the Lament. She would wander endlessly through a labyrinth of memories until one autumn morning, by a lake in Petalfall Village, where she would finally meet {PlayerName}, there to rescue the village from Tacet Discord attacks. From there, she would join the Black Shores and share a few hundred years together before {Male=he;Female=she} would eventually leave her. She, too, would leave the Black Shores, only to be reunited decades later in Jinzhou. All those futures had yet to unfold, just as possibilities slumbered within seeds, waiting for fate to blossom.

She leaped from the building, her vines weaving through the city's structures, searching for {Male=him;Female=her}.
FavorStory_150402_Content:
"Tuesday, clear skies. I watched the sunset from Caidong Peak! But Zhangzhang didn't come… She seems to have lost interest in this kind of thing..."

Lumi paused and closed her notebook in the golden light of the setting sun.

It was a thick hardcover notebook—a birthday gift from her parents, one she had chosen herself. Once a diary, it had transformed into an exploration journal as she grew older. As a child, Lumi was content wandering the pebble paths of Changzhuang, but now, those paths felt too small. Her curiosity stretched beyond the borders of the village. She longed for the roads that led to the world outside. 

The only problem was—no one had found those roads in a long, long time.

Her father once told her about the many failed attempts. Over the years, many had tried to find a way beyond the mountains, but all had returned empty-handed, lost, or worse. Eventually, the villagers gave up, their focus shifting to more immediate concerns. Life in Changzhuang was demanding—farming from spring to autumn, then bracing for the long winter when the mountains would disappear under a blanket of silver frost, making exploration impossible.

Lumi understood the demands of life, yet her curiosity and yearning for adventure burned even brighter. She quickly gathered a group of friends and formed a small exploration team, determined to find a way out. But despite their excitement, failure kicked in—the aftermath of the Lament had seemingly twisted the terrain, eliminating every possible way out, just like it had their forebears.

At first, the setbacks didn't bother them. They were kids, after all, full of energy and hope. But as time passed, they drifted away. The older ones joined the labor teams, others lost interest. Lumi's once lively group dwindled, and today, her exploration ended earlier than planned as everyone was eager to hurry home before dusk settled in.

Lumi sighed. 

She knew that for most of her friends, this was just a way to pass the time. 

She stood up, cupped her hands around her mouth, and shouted toward the mountains, her voice echoing against the rocks and trees before fading into the evening air.

The sunset blazed across the sky, casting the horizon in shades of red and gold before melting into the soft kiss of the night. 

Lumi smiled, patting her cheeks lightly. It didn't matter. The thrill of discovering something new, something unknown, still filled her with excitement.

"…Oh! I'll tell Zhangzhang all about the view when we meet for ice pops tonight. And Beihai, Ming…"

She whispered the names of her friends as she waved goodbye to the mountains, then turned and made her way down the hill, alone but content.
FavorStory_150403_Content:
"You're awake? Here, drink this."

As her eyes fluttered open, her parched lips met the cool, sweet droplets of water. Her hand instinctively gripped the container, and she eagerly gulped it down.

"Easy now, don't rush," the voice urged, gentle and concerned. "You'll choke if you drink too fast."

As the last drop slipped down her throat, Lumi blinked, her mind finally clearing. She looked up at the faces of her rescuers—a small squad, three of them, dressed in similar clothing. Their leader, a girl with a kind smile, helped her sit up.

"Are you from around here? That's a surprise. We were told there's no one living in these parts," the girl said, a hint of curiosity in her voice. "Guess we'll need to update our map."

"Thank you… for saving me," Lumi whispered, her words faltering. The world she knew was small, confined to the mountains and the narrow boundaries of Changzhuang. "A-are you from the outside?"

The squad exchanged glances, and it was then that Lumi noticed the emblem on their uniforms—a chubby hamster wearing a straw hat, grinning adorably.

A hand reached out, helping Lumi to her feet. 

"Sorry for the late introduction. We're from Lollo Logistics, a delivery squad."
 
Months later, Chengxiao smiled, setting down the comb and patting Lumi's shoulder. 

"Take a look. How do you feel?"

Lumi stared at her reflection, stunned by the unfamiliar face in the mirror. The girl staring back at her had neat curls and wore a clean, fitted Lollo Logistics uniform—looking every bit the city dweller she had become.

Chengxiao, the leader of the squad that had rescued her, had taken Lumi from the quiet of Changzhuang to the bustling city and taken her under her wing. She was quick-witted, reliable, and now Lumi's mentor at Lollo Logistics.

"I look… different," Lumi muttered, scratching her head shyly. "Thank you, Chengxiao."

"None of that formality now," Chengxiao laughed. "I'm off to deliver some documents. Cafeteria later?"

"Sure!"

As the door closed, Lumi returned to stare at the mirror, her gaze lingering on her reflection for a while. 

Having just passed the Lollo Logistics assessment, she was still adjusting to city life. The city was a whirlwind compared to the quiet village she had left behind. The streets buzzed with life, day and night. Even in the dead of night, lights flickered, and voices filled the air. Walls and doors were everywhere, and restrictions at every corner. In Changzhuang, she could run free, straight through the open land for as long as she wanted. Here, every step had to be measured carefully. The crowded markets left her both energized and overwhelmed.

"Take it slow, Lumi," she murmured to herself. "No rush. No rush…"

Grabbing her straw hat, Lumi took a deep breath and opened the door, ready to face the city once more.
FavorStory_150404_Content:
"Squeakie, I'm feeling dizzy…" 

Lumi murmured, leaning against the edge of the bed as the ship rocked beneath her. The waves crashed against the hull with a roar, and the violent turbulence made one feel like it might drag them into the depths. She clutched her hamster plushie tightly, closing her eyes, waiting for this tortuous journey to end.

Days later, the port finally came into view, where the sea met the sky. Seagulls squawked in the distance, and Lumi exhaled a breath of relief as she stepped onto solid ground. "Thank goodness," she muttered. Her two companions, Tangtang and Fulei, staggered behind her, still pale from seasickness. 

"You two okay?" Lumi ran her fingers through her curls and led them to a nearby bench for rest.

"Lumi, was it this bad when you first came to Rinascita?" Tangtang, his head still drooping, asked.

Lumi chuckled. "Oh yeah! That's why I told you to stay fit. There are places way harder to reach than this."

Tangtang groaned, nodding. "Why did you recover so quickly? You were just as seasick as us a moment ago..."

Lumi grinned, remembering her first trip here with Chengxiao. "Trust me, I was just as bad. My legs felt weak, I wanted to throw up, and I almost swore never to set foot on a ship again!"

Fulei nodded in agreement, "The ship did rock hard. It was terrifying…"

Tangtang and Fulei were newbies who just joined Lollo Logistics and were assigned to Lumi's team for training. Lollo Logistics had entrusted her with guiding them through the ropes, but leading a team? Lumi wasn't so sure she was ready for that kind of responsibility. It wasn't because she hated caring for others; she was just worried that she might not meet these hopeful newcomers' expectations. Chengxiao had always made it look easy—could she really do the same?
 
"Lumi," Tangtang said, interrupting her thoughts, "You always talk about Chengxiao, but I've never seen her at the branch. Where is she?"

"She doesn't work in the field anymore," Lumi replied softly.

"What? But didn't you say she was an 'Outstanding Navigator' every year? Why would she quit?" Fulei asked, wide-eyed.

Lumi gazed up at the blue sky, the expanse above Ragunna remarkably clear. 

"Because... of life," she explained, as she had once before in her childhood. "Sometimes life leads you down different paths. Solaris is huge, and being in Lollo Logistics means traveling year-round. Chengxiao wanted something more stable, so she moved on."

Tangtang tilted her head. "And what about you? Did your family mind you doing this?"

"They had their concerns," Lumi admitted. "But this is my life, and I love it—traveling, seeing new things, connecting people across Solaris. That's what Lollo Logistics is all about. Chengxiao taught me a lot, and I'll do my best to pass it on to you both."

Her words hung in the air as the two newcomers considered them. 

Lumi smiled. "Life is full of comings and goings," she continued. "Some people get off the ship, others get on. But as long as there are those willing to carry the torch, our 'We Promise, We Deliver' motto will keep going strong."

Lumi stood up and gave a good stretch, Squeakie perched on her shoulder, nuzzling her cheek. "Rest for another ten minutes, then we're off. Oh, you want some famous Ragunna's triple scoop ice cream? My treat!"

"Yes!"

"Please!"
FavorStory_150405_Content:
Ever since its connection to the outside world resumed, Changzhuang had experienced a dramatic change. New buildings and amenities were everywhere, yet when Lumi returned home, she felt a deep wave of nostalgia.

Perhaps those who longed for change had already departed, like Lumi once before, while those who remained had maintained their old habits and daily rhythms. The sun was dipping low, and as she walked through the village, smoke from cooking fires curled lazily into the sky, mingling with the sounds of laughter and the hum of evening insects.

Her parents welcomed her home, placing a steaming bowl of noodles in front of her—the meat was generous, the broth rich, supplemented by a spoonful of fragrant chili oil. 

Lumi dug in, the heat making her cheeks flush as she slurped the noodles eagerly. Her mother chuckled softly, passing her a glass of water.

"Slow down, Lumi, no one's going to steal your food," her mother teased.

After a deep sip of water and broth, she leaned back, letting out a contented sigh.

Her father, seated nearby, tapped his pipe. "Been away for a long time, huh? How's your work?"

Lumi smiled. "It's been tough, but things are getting better. Someone really helped me out—a hero from Jinzhou, actually!"

Her mother raised an eyebrow, amused. "Oh? Our little Lumi rubbing elbows with big shots now?"

Lumi laughed, her eyes bright. "It's true! I was struggling with some work stuff, but thanks to {Male=him;Female=her}, I turned it all around. Here's what happened…"
 
The next morning, with the village still shrouded in the quiet calm of dawn, Lumi left home to enjoy the morning landscape of the fields. It hadn't changed beyond recognition. It still bore the vestiges of the place that had shaped her. 

She wandered without aim, lost in thought until a gentle pat on the shoulder brought her back to the present.

"Lumi? What are you doing all the way out here?"

Lumi blinked and turned to see Zhangzhang, her childhood friend, standing behind her, smiling.

"Oh, Zhangzhang! I was just… reminiscing. It's been a while." Lumi's gaze drifted to the newly paved road winding through the hills. "I can't even tell where we are."

Zhangzhang laughed. "Yeah, it just got finished recently—much smoother than before, huh? It was once your favorite place, you remember?" She shifted her gaze to the road and continued, "Not many people come through, though. But I hear your Lollo Logistics team visits regularly." Zhangzhang paused, intrigued, "Speaking of which, have you been to any cool places lately? Anything to share? You see, I've been thinking about leaving to see the world for myself as well…"

Lumi nodded and began recounting her latest adventures, sharing the tales of distant cities and unknown lands with her childhood friend.

When they parted ways, Lumi found a stone by the road and sat on it, propping her chin up as she gazed at the sky. She knew that she had to move forward—only then would she see new things, bring about change, and make a difference for others.

As night faded, the first light of morning washed over the slumbering mountains. 

There in the distance, where the mountain path met the sky, the familiar silhouette of a Lollo Logistics vehicle, glimmering in the sun, was approaching Changzhuang.

FavorWord_150405_Content: I never left my village growing up, but once I did, I became a restless traveler. Riding my bike with the wind in my ears just feels amazing. I keep meeting new people, and saying goodbye to them… it's all part of the journey, isn't it? I bet you're the same, always on the move. Great way of living, right? I think... we'll surely meet again somewhere down the road. And when we do, let's grab some local food and catch up on our adventures!
FavorWord_150406_Content: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!
FavorWord_150407_Content: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！
FavorWord_150408_Content: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!
FavorWord_150409_Content: Hmm... What did they call it? Some local speciality noodle I tried during a delivery, with this golden fish broth and green veggies. Did NOT taste as good as it looked—ugh, it was so bitter! Never again!
FavorWord_150410_Content: Wow, ever since we got a road in our village, things have been crazy! We've built so much new stuff. I've been keeping an eye on my team, making sure everyone's good—some want promotions, some need more cash for their fams, and some wanna travel. Hehe, busy days, but it feels great to be needed... I should keep it up!
FavorWord_150411_Content: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!
FavorWord_150412_Content: That day, I left my village, hiked over the mountain, farther than anyone else had gone before. I soon found myself in a vast field, the air fresh and damp with dew. I was so pumped that I started to glow, and the light attracted Tacet Discords... Did everything I could to fight them off, then I blacked out. Next thing I knew, a Lollo Logistics team saved me, their lights cutting through the darkness, the brightest I've ever seen.
FavorWord_150413_Content: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...
FavorWord_150414_Content: Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, Patroller Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room!
FavorWord_150415_Content: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.
FavorWord_150416_Content: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...
FavorWord_150417_Content: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.
FavorWord_150418_Content: Auntie Panhua's letting me use her stove today. In my village, we celebrate birthdays with steaming longevity noodles like this, topped with two braised eggs! Hey, you gotta slurp it all in one go, no biting allowed! Hehe… Happy birthday! May your journey ahead always be bright.
FavorWord_150421_Content: Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!
FavorWord_150422_Content: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!
FavorWord_150423_Content: Don't worry, my light's got you!
FavorWord_150425_Content: A new page in my journal!
FavorWord_150427_Content: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?
FavorWord_150428_Content: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.
FavorWord_150429_Content: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!
FavorWord_150430_Content: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!
FavorWord_150431_Content: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

FavorGoods_150401_Content:
Crafted by Lollo Logistics, this pen has journeyed alongside Lumi throughout Solaris. She uses it to sign logistics documents and chronicle her adventures in her travel journal. 
In her travels, Lumi has crossed paths with fascinating and kind-hearted strangers, savored local delicacies and quirky snacks, and documented bizarre Tacet Discords that remain uncharted... even the lighthearted anecdotes shared by her colleagues find their way into her travel journal, recorded with joy and enthusiasm.
FavorGoods_150402_Content:
When Lumi first joined Lollo Logistics, she faced challenges in mastering her Forte. 
Under the guidance of a seasoned mentor, she fashioned this field command baton, which became her steadfast companion through her most anxious days. It witnessed her transformation from a trembling novice into a skilled navigator, and eventually, a trusted team leader. 
In the dark of night, the baton's shimmering hue casts a reassuring glow, a symbol of Lumi's growth.
FavorGoods_150403_Content:
A stress-relief squeeze plushie, designed by Lumi in the likeness of her beloved companion, Squeakie.
As life unfolds, Lumi faces many unexpected challenges. While she adeptly navigates her own challenges, the struggles of others can be quite a handful—each person's wishes and expectations are as varied as the packages she manages.
While she's alone, Lumi sometimes squeezes the plushie tightly, letting the weight of her worries dissipate with each squeeze.

DYHD_11_41: Heehee... Yes, we must have fireworks at our wedding ... "Sweetened fireworks"...
DYHD_12_2: Huh? Why is there a sweet scent in the air...？
DYHD_1701_4: The Tidebreaker attacked us! Thank Imperator none of us were hurt.
DYHD_1701_5: Quick, let's check if anything was lost!
DYHD_1701_7: You find a bizarre fish, its color all wrong, and its eyes glow with an unsettling shimmer.
DYHD_1701_8: Nothing's lost, except now we've got this...
DYHD_1701_10: How about we take it to Planck? Maybe it knows what this is.
DYHD_18_8: "Oh, I reckon you'll be greeted by a few strange fish along the way."
DYHD_1801_1: There are rocks in the way.
DYHD_1801_2: {PlayerName}, we can clear it with Echo skills!
DYHD_23_6: But then again, not too late is it, even now, to desist... Behold!
DYHD_23_7: Ahab, you old fool! It seeks you not! It is you, you, that madly seeks him!
DYHD_2401_1: It says here that the key to the lighthouse among the ruins is sealed within the treasure of this island.
DYHD_2402_1: "Present the trinity gifts of the sea, and thus the light shall burn eternally."
DYHD_2402_2: So this means... we need to find three "gifts" from the sea to break this seal?
DYHD_2403_1: Where the Reverberations converge. May they rest in peace.

DYHD_29_28: Of course it is! Look at it live and kicking. It's never been better.
DYHD_29_29: You were tricked and deceived during the Carnevale... I know that an Acolyte like me is in no position to represent the Order...
DYHD_29_30: But I still wish to offer you an apology, Cetus the Tidebreaker, even if it's only my own.
DYHD_29_32: You've been following its trail all this time, helping fishermen and receiving gifts of the sea yourself. It's trying to protect that stuff, too.
DYHD_29_33: Oh! It also wants me to tell you great job on catching that big fish earlier!
DYHD_29_35: "Just be yourself, whether it's giving or receiving, belief or hope," it says.
DYHD_29_36: I see. Thank you for telling me that!
DYHD_7_39: Hell if I know what she's playin' at!
DYHD_7_40: Besides, do you really think she's helping you out for some devious reason? Being ungrateful isn't our way, is it?
InfoDisplay_104000902_Text:
I've learned what happened in the Vault. 

Now, I have another secret to share with you. I've left something special for you here, and I trust it will please you.
 
You're welcome to keep the clearance device. It will grant access to the "hidden challenge" I've prepared for you. 

You'll find our "employment agreement" won't be so easily concluded.
 
Oh, and the Acolyte also has something for you. I've included it here with this note.
