POI_JINKU_1_1: Am I early? Where's that person Carlotta sent...
POI_JINKU_1_2: We can clock out now? I didn't know Treasurer Pacino had taken up charity work!
POI_JINKU_1_3: Yeah whatever, it's a paid day off. I could do with a nap anyway...
POI_JINKU_1_4: Ah, there you are. It's been a while since we last worked together.
POI_JINKU_1_5: I was not expecting you to take this job.
POI_JINKU_1_7: I expect a favor in return.
POI_JINKU_1_8: Carlotta promised a generous reward once it's done.
POI_JINKU_1_9: Ah, well worth the trip then.
POI_JINKU_1_10: An opportunity like this doesn't come round often.
POI_JINKU_1_11: The family's favor is more precious than money. Remember to use it on something worthwhile.
POI_JINKU_1_12: Now about the job—Lady Carlotta must have briefed you in her letter. I'm curious what the Order is thinking stashing their relic in the Montelli vault.
POI_JINKU_1_13: At any rate, my job here is to keep you safe. Take this pass, it's the only one that allows visitors access to the vault's interior.
POI_JINKU_1_14: Time to go. The Order's rep is waiting for us.
POI_JINKU_11_2: So, it seems this "Ash," whoever they are, messed around with the display cases, took the module, and triggered the lockdown that trapped us here.
POI_JINKU_11_3: Does each display case have its own log?
POI_JINKU_11_4: Ah, you know how it is. Some thieves have made "sneaking into the vault" their sole purpose in life.
POI_JINKU_11_5: Let's hope this Ash isn't after the "secret cache."
POI_JINKU_11_7: Ah, I've heard rumors that the Montelli vault holds the most valuable treasure in all of Ragunna.
POI_JINKU_11_8: I doubt it. Not even the most senior Montelli employee knows anything about this so-called treasure.
POI_JINKU_11_9: But that ridiculous tale still draws in idiots trying to break in—hundreds of them every year.
POI_JINKU_11_10: They think a stolen ID will let them waltz into the vault, but as I said, each depository has its own security module. When the vault is in lockdown, it's impregnable.
POI_JINKU_11_11: Not even a single Shell Credit can be taken, let alone any of the vault's artifacts and collections.
POI_JINKU_11_12: Amazing, but we've got work to do.
POI_JINKU_11_13: Let's head up to the monitoring room on the top level and check if the old lady we saw in the surveillance footage is "Ash."
POI_JINKU_11_14: Some of the defense systems have been activated. We should tread carefully from here on out.
POI_JINKU_12_1: How beautiful... but why was it covered?
POI_JINKU_12_2: Really? You don't know this painting?
POI_JINKU_12_4: Be my witness, {PlayerName}—what I'm about to say is purely to satisfy our Acolyte's curiosity. No hidden agenda.
POI_JINKU_12_7: What's so special about this painting?
POI_JINKU_12_8: This piece, titled "Ballad Beneath the Stars," may appear simple at first—just a shepherd tending his flock under a vast sky. However, the pattern on the shepherd's clothes resembles the Order's emblem, only flipped upside down, and the number of stars matches the recorded blessings bestowed by our Sentinel Imperator.
POI_JINKU_12_9: What's more, the number of sheep is the same as the Sentinel's wings. Given that some fanatics claim the Sentinel's divine messages are fabrications, when you connect the dots, doesn't it seem like this shepherd is hinting at something?
POI_JINKU_12_11: According my interpretation of the Codex, I don't see how this painting implies anything untoward.
POI_JINKU_12_12: Maybe not to you or some of your fellow Acolytes, and certainly not to the Montellis or the painter. But there are others who don't share that view and their voices are often the loudest.
POI_JINKU_12_13: That's why this painting is covered—to avoid stirring up trouble.
POI_JINKU_12_14: Very prudent, but it's still a shame people can't admire its beauty anymore.
POI_JINKU_12_15: What about the risk of people slandering the Order? Doesn't that bother you?
POI_JINKU_12_16: Just like some will appreciate a piece of art, others will hate or misinterpret it. The same goes for the Order.
POI_JINKU_12_17: People's views are shaped by their backgrounds and experiences. What's precious to one might be another's poison.
POI_JINKU_12_18: Everyone is entitled to their opinion. As long as they genuinely believe it, I don't see a problem.
POI_JINKU_12_19: Locking this painting away is perhaps the best option for now, but I believe it will eventually return to where it belongs, for everyone to see.
POI_JINKU_12_20: If more people thought like you, we'd see a lot less trouble in the world.
POI_JINKU_13_1: There's a covered vase here. What's the story behind this one?
POI_JINKU_13_2: Beautiful or ugly, what do you say?
POI_JINKU_13_5: The Montellis think so, which is why they don't want to share it.
POI_JINKU_13_6: The Montellis disagree, but they keep it hidden for people of your taste.
POI_JINKU_14_2: Excuse me, ma'am, do you work here?
POI_JINKU_14_3: Sorry, if this sounds odd, but... I'm a bit confused. I don't remember why I'm here.
POI_JINKU_14_4: All I know is that I do work in the vault, and my name is... Lily.
POI_JINKU_14_5: But this isn't the section I oversee. Why am I here... Why are you here?
POI_JINKU_14_6: Lady Carlotta has tasked us with a special delivery. May I see your ID, Ms. Lily?
POI_JINKU_14_8: Thank you. Hmm... Confidential Researcher? The vault does have that position, but a researcher shouldn't be in this section.
POI_JINKU_14_9: The ID is real—the anti-counterfeit features check out.
POI_JINKU_14_10: She doesn't look like she could be a thief's accomplice, either.
POI_JINKU_14_11: That thing you're carrying seems to disagree.
POI_JINKU_14_12: The Order's relics are kept a secret from everyone, including an Acolyte like myself. I can't say what it's reacting to.
POI_JINKU_14_13: But... I do have a strange feeling about Ms. Lily.
POI_JINKU_14_15: We should bring her with us.
POI_JINKU_14_16: She could accidentally trigger something dangerous if left alone. That's the last thing we need.
POI_JINKU_14_17: Agreed. And if she is somehow involved, we'd save a lot of effort by taking her with us.
POI_JINKU_14_18: I'm sorry, ma'am, but you'll need to come with us.
POI_JINKU_14_20: I understand your hesitation, but with the vault sealed, you'll be safer with us.
POI_JINKU_14_22: Good. Time to use your clearance, {PlayerName}. Let's find out what's really going on in this vault.
POI_JINKU_15_6: The longer the vault stays in lockdown, the more defense systems and Echo guards get activated.
POI_JINKU_15_10: Ma'am, does the name "Ash" mean anything to you?
POI_JINKU_15_11: Old Ash? He used to say he wanted to sleep among the Echoes to study their behaviors. What a stubborn man.
POI_JINKU_15_12: So the real Ash did exist. As for that man hiding over there... he might have stolen Ash's ID and gotten stuck here.
POI_JINKU_15_13: Ash's ID was stolen? Outsiders couldn't have done that—we've been in here for at least twenty years. Even with my fuzzy memory, I know that much.
POI_JINKU_15_15: Is this a vault or a prison?
POI_JINKU_15_16: Twenty years in this vault... Sounds like a living hell...
POI_JINKU_15_17: If it were me, I could maybe last... Well, ten years tops.
POI_JINKU_15_18: But... no one should be working in such awful conditions, Ms. Zani.
POI_JINKU_15_19: Yeah, well, personally I just hope to live long enough to make the most out of my retirement someday. Anyway, we've got an imposter on our hands posing as "Ash."
POI_JINKU_15_20: Let's take the train to the Echo depository. We must find this thief and retrieve the security module. After that, we can decide what to do next.
POI_JINKU_17_1: Stay alert, everyone. During training, I was told to avoid the Echo Depository unless absolutely necessary.
POI_JINKU_17_2: Each Echo is unique, and trust me, you don't want to know what happens if one gets damaged.
POI_JINKU_18_1: Don't worry about us, {PlayerName}! Just focus on operating the train Echo!
POI_JINKU_18_2: Hold tight! It's just the safety mode kicking in!
POI_JINKU_19_1: Ha... I didn't expect this fella in the vault.
POI_JINKU_2_1: Mmhmm, I see. You've done a great job—
POI_JINKU_2_2: Oh, {PlayerName} and Ms. Zani! Nice to see you again!
POI_JINKU_2_5: It's been a while. Mind if I ask what you were doing just now?
POI_JINKU_2_6: Oh, we're just chatting. They seemed lonely. Not many people talk to them.
POI_JINKU_2_7: This train Echo? It's been running since the vault was built. It chugs along, doing its thing in silence.
POI_JINKU_2_8: But I do believe your company has made its day.
POI_JINKU_2_9: But if I remember correctly, you are not the representative the Order informed me of.
POI_JINKU_2_10: Yes, it was supposed to be another Acolyte. But she's busy with the Order's work, so I volunteered.
POI_JINKU_2_11: Huh. Did the thought of working with the Montellis scare her away?
POI_JINKU_2_12: Perhaps, Ms. Zani, but I'm sure she'd think differently if she met a Montelli employee like you.
POI_JINKU_2_13: Seeing as the Montelli family and the Order are both blessed by the Sentinel, our paths were bound to cross eventually.
POI_JINKU_2_14: ...I'm glad you see it that way. Now, do you have it?
POI_JINKU_2_15: Certainly, as you requested, the escorts carried an empty case while the relic stayed with me.
POI_JINKU_2_19: It's an important relic entrusted to the Montellis. That's all I know.
POI_JINKU_2_20: Same here, but it doesn't matter. Lady Carlotta gave me this job. I just follow orders, no questions asked. That's how you work for the Montellis.
POI_JINKU_2_21: Our top priority is to get the job done, nice and clean.
POI_JINKU_2_22: By the way, {PlayerName}, the device from Lady Carlotta should have top security clearance, so you'll be able to operate the train Echo. I hope you enjoy driving.
POI_JINKU_20_1: Tsk, the imposter just ran away.
POI_JINKU_20_2: There's a book. What is this...
POI_JINKU_22_1: It looks like a letter sent to his grandson. And this paper... was it torn from a book?
POI_JINKU_22_3: It must be from this book.
POI_JINKU_22_4: Hmm... I can't understand a word.
POI_JINKU_22_5: I can make out a little. It seems connected to cryptography.
POI_JINKU_22_6: It's an Echo book, young lady, and it seems fond of you. You think you're reading it, but it's actually the book communicating with you.
POI_JINKU_22_8: Yes. It doesn't speak, but it responds to the questions you ask. The more time you spend with it, the more you'll understand it.
POI_JINKU_22_9: Old Ash carried this book everywhere. I heard it even helped him design a coded lock for the vault.
POI_JINKU_22_10: That letter you saw is indeed a page from this book. I remember Ash tearing it out in a fit once. We all made him clean the bathroom as a punishment, hehe.
POI_JINKU_22_11: So, Ash left this letter to tell his grandson about that mysterious "secret cache." Turns out it really does exist.
POI_JINKU_22_13: He probably found out about the cache from the letter and is attempting to steal it.
POI_JINKU_22_14: Exactly. It's just like Acolyte Phoebe said. He triggered the lockdown to get to the depths of the vault without interference.
POI_JINKU_22_15: If he'd acted like a professional and stuck to the plan instead of messing around, we wouldn't be in this mess.
POI_JINKU_22_16: We need to find him before he puts himself or others in danger. Plus we need the security module to leave. Let's head to the lower control room and check the surveillance cameras.
POI_JINKU_22_17: Since this book belongs to the Montellis, I'll hold onto it for now.
POI_JINKU_23_1: A mask? Is this also an Echo?
POI_JINKU_23_2: Let me check... It says the wearer can see their true self through the mask's eyes and bring it to life.
POI_JINKU_23_3: Its last owner was rumored to steal other people's "desires" at will.
POI_JINKU_23_4: Hmm... but why did I only see myself?
POI_JINKU_24_2: Just a strand of hair. Nothing special.
POI_JINKU_24_3: The label says, "A strand of hair that once made a contract with the devil."
POI_JINKU_26_1: Ha... what a pain in the neck...
POI_JINKU_27_4: The Echo Depository is in complete disarray. Make sure to keep your distance from all the Echoes.
POI_JINKU_27_5: The security clearance should give us control over the defense systems… I'll figure it out.
POI_JINKU_3_1: I'm amazed it's so steady on tracks this steep!
POI_JINKU_3_2: Perhaps your earlier encouragement did wonders, miss.
POI_JINKU_32_1: {PlayerName}, can you hear me? The room to get the clearance is right ahead... Wait.
POI_JINKU_32_2: I see a group of Echoes heading your way. I'll operate the controls and try to block them.
POI_JINKU_32_3: Mind your step—research value aside, these are worth a fortune. Breaking one could land you a hefty bill from Lady Carlotta.
POI_JINKU_32_4: Besides their worth, I'd rather we handle this without hurting them... Watch out!
POI_JINKU_33_1: They just keep coming… We need to stop them.
POI_JINKU_33_2: I'll do my best to block them. Acolyte Phoebe, are you with us? This isn't the time for prayers!
POI_JINKU_35_1: It's finished. We can get the clearance now.
POI_JINKU_35_4: I'm fine, really. It's just like hauling the Codex around back at the Order... But, uh, {PlayerName}, why are you staring at me like that? Is something wrong?
POI_JINKU_35_5: Stunning work, miss. If I hadn't seen this myself, I'd never believe your staff was meant to be used like that.
POI_JINKU_35_7: Striking with an appropriate level of force clears the mind, enhancing one's purification.
POI_JINKU_35_8: Well, well... since when did our Acolyte start cracking jokes? Looks like {PlayerName}'s humor is rubbing off on you.
POI_JINKU_35_13: Ahem. Maybe you should grab that clearance before they wake up.
POI_JINKU_37_1: Great, it's working now. One moment... Okay, take the nearby shortcut to the train station. We'll meet you there.
POI_JINKU_4_4: The vault's security mode has been activated. Someone touched something they shouldn't have.
POI_JINKU_4_6: Unlikely. All personnel were sent home at the start of this assignment. The highest security protocols are in place too.
POI_JINKU_4_7: Should we ask for outside help?
POI_JINKU_4_8: We can't, not while the vault's security Echo is there. It's capable of sensing danger.
POI_JINKU_4_9: Once it detects a threat, it locks down the vault, jams all signals, and activates a bunch of troublesome Echo guards.
POI_JINKU_4_11: That means there's no way out and no hope for backup...
POI_JINKU_4_12: Any backdoors? The Montellis must have designed one.
POI_JINKU_4_13: There is, but it's a bit tricky. Anyway, we need to access the security room first. Your clearance might come in handy.
POI_JINKU_4_14: Don't worry. Keeping you safe is part of my job.
POI_JINKU_40_1: Everything's under control now. The vault schematics show the next stop is the terminus. That man has nowhere to hide.
POI_JINKU_40_2: But I'm not sure where the terminus is exactly. The Employee Manual only states that the Echo Depository is located at the vault's depth, without any further information about the station.
POI_JINKU_40_3: My memory is hazy... I do remember something dangerous out there, but that's all. I'm sorry.
POI_JINKU_40_4: It's alright, Ms. Lily. May the Sentinel guide our way.
POI_JINKU_40_5: Whatever it is, we have no choice but to move forward.
POI_JINKU_40_6: Right. Let's get this done quickly, {PlayerName}.
POI_JINKU_41_2: Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We're all here with you.
POI_JINKU_42_1: Well, Sentinel above, if you can hear this, please keep us safe.
POI_JINKU_43_2: Thanks to the train Echo, we're still in one piece, though I have no idea where we are now.
POI_JINKU_43_3: There should be other train Echoes available, right?
POI_JINKU_43_4: We'll need it to get to the terminus.
POI_JINKU_43_5: Please wait... Ma'am, are you hurt?
POI_JINKU_43_7: She seems lost in her thoughts.
POI_JINKU_43_9: I'm fine, child. This place feels so familiar. It's like I've lived here for a long time.
POI_JINKU_43_10: Any details you can remember would be useful. Since employee training didn't touch on this area, we'll be going in blind in search of the exit.
POI_JINKU_43_11: Hmm... this place. I've been here before with many others, but their faces are a blur...
POI_JINKU_43_12: Yes, we rarely left this place, but I do remember taking the train somewhere very dark...
POI_JINKU_43_16: Are you suggesting that people used to live in the vault?
POI_JINKU_43_17: Yes, if I'm not mistaken, a group of scholars made a home for themselves here.
POI_JINKU_43_18: It seems the vault's structure is more complicated than we thought.
POI_JINKU_43_19: I take it that this "very dark" place you mentioned is the terminus.
POI_JINKU_43_20: ”Somewhere very dark"... What kind of place could that be?
POI_JINKU_43_21: We'll be just fine. Ms. Lily, take your time remembering. We'll take it slow.
POI_JINKU_43_22: Plus, we need time to find the exit.
POI_JINKU_43_23: Let's get going. We need to retrieve the stolen security module. That's our key to getting out.
POI_JINKU_44_1: "In memory of those who persist in the dark to keep the light. Though our names shall be removed from history, the truth we seek will one day dawn on Ragunna."
POI_JINKU_44_2: So, people actually lived here before... Ah, Ms. Lily's name is on it, and the name "Ash" too.
POI_JINKU_45_1: These look like diaries. It's not very polite to read them without permission—
POI_JINKU_45_2: "When the green leaves turn red, everything will be back to normal."
POI_JINKU_45_4: We need to be thorough. I'm sure the Sentinel will forgive my intrusion. Anyway, it's just some person's diary.
POI_JINKU_46_1: Your conclusion might be a bit far-fetched, Ash.
POI_JINKU_46_2: Far-fetched? For the Sentinel's sake, I've been in the Echo Depository for seven straight days gathering data!
POI_JINKU_46_3: Even so, incorrect is still incorrect. Here, take a look at this control group...
POI_JINKU_46_4: Acolyte, should we bring these Reverberations back to the Order Tribunal?
POI_JINKU_46_5: I think your misunderstanding of the Order runs deeper than you realize, Ms. Zani...
POI_JINKU_46_6: My apologies. But why is that thing in your pocket still flickering? Did I say something wrong? Or is it because I haven't prayed to the Cathedral in three months?
POI_JINKU_46_7: It's just flickering, not burning or reacting in any other way. It should be fine, I think...
POI_JINKU_47_1: When will all this end? Any ideas, Ash?
POI_JINKU_47_2: I suggest you ask those artists. The day they stop tearing up drafts, we can finish the research.
POI_JINKU_47_3: I'm not talking about the research. I mean us—when will we finally get out of here?
POI_JINKU_47_4: And you're believer, right? Why not just ask the Imperator when we can leave?
POI_JINKU_47_5: ...Until the Sentinel gazes upon Their land again.
POI_JINKU_47_6: It won't be long. I've heard the situation is improving. The Montellis even promised to send letters to our families.
POI_JINKU_48_1: Are you available now, Lily? There's a problem with the results you gave me.
POI_JINKU_48_5: I'm all right child. We shouldn't dawdle here.
POI_JINKU_49_1: Bad news. I know nothing about deciphering passwords.
POI_JINKU_49_2: You might want to try the Echo book. It's an expert at this sort of thing.
POI_JINKU_5_2: I find it comforting. There's no idle chit-chat here—just work, plain and simple.
POI_JINKU_50_1: Can you pray to the Sentinel on my behalf, miss? I'd rather not run into any more trouble.
POI_JINKU_50_2: With you and {PlayerName} here, there's no need to worry!
POI_JINKU_51_1: Be careful, it's on alert now! You need to force it to stop!
POI_JINKU_53_4: If you stole anything else from the vault, I advise you to surrender it immediately.
POI_JINKU_53_5: Hmph, you Montelli dog! I couldn't care less about that so-called "secret cache"! I just want this place destroyed for good!
POI_JINKU_53_6: Open your eyes! This isn't a vault. It's a nightmarish prison!
POI_JINKU_53_7: You locked up my grandfather, and now you want to do the same to me!
POI_JINKU_53_8: You must be the young Ash. I've seen your picture, child. Old Ash spoke a lot about you.
POI_JINKU_53_9: As for this vault... Yes, it's nothing but a prison.
POI_JINKU_53_11: But we chose this imprisonment—not just our bodies, but our very souls. Freedom was never an option.
POI_JINKU_53_12: We had to erase every trace of our existence to survive, to discover, to create.
POI_JINKU_53_14: We followed in the footsteps of our predecessors, but one day, we unexpectedly uncovered a hidden chapter of the Order's history.
POI_JINKU_53_15: They hunted us down in the name of preserving stability, stripping us of our rights as researchers and artists.
POI_JINKU_53_16: The Montelli family took pity on us and came to our rescue. They feigned loyalty to the Order and locked us in this vault, but in reality, it became a refuge for outcasts like us.
POI_JINKU_53_17: Five years, ten years, twenty years...
POI_JINKU_55_1: So, the Montellis didn't imprison Grandpa... he chose this path himself...
POI_JINKU_55_2: That thing he mentioned in the letter... I...
POI_JINKU_55_3: Please cheer up, Mr. Ash. Everyone was blind to the truth as you once were, but now, we know everything thanks to you.
POI_JINKU_55_5: Very touching, but I'm not as forgiving as our Acolyte. You have a price to pay for breaking into the vault.
POI_JINKU_55_6: The exit is open. You're free to go now. I'll stay to tie up any loose ends.
POI_JINKU_55_7: Thank you for helping us again, {PlayerName}. I thought this would just be a routine job.
POI_JINKU_55_10: Here's the reward Lady Carlotta promised. Naturally, she did not forget to include a little "overtime pay" for your efforts.
POI_JINKU_55_11: By the way, miss, I'm sorry but I'll need to take that relic from the Order. Don't worry, the rules still allow you to come and go as you please.
POI_JINKU_55_12: Of course. I need the Sentinel's enlightenment on certain matters... but I'll still be around if you need me.
POI_JINKU_57_3: No... not really. Just bidding them farewell.
POI_JINKU_57_4: A resolute soul needs no guidance. I simply want to understand the future they've paved the road for.
POI_JINKU_58_1: You've been a great help. Thank you. Lady Carlotta mentioned she left you a special bonus downstairs.
POI_JINKU_58_2: I have other matters to attend to. Until next time.
POI_JINKU_59_2: She will find the path worth her devotion.
POI_JINKU_6_1: Greetings. The Averardo Vault is in lockdown. Please proceed to the train Echo station and take Line 1 to evacuate the vault.
POI_JINKU_6_2: We need to go to the evacuation site. When will the train depart?
POI_JINKU_6_3: We won't be taking the train for now.
POI_JINKU_6_4: Understood. Current train Echo passengers: 0. You may depart at a time of your choosing.
POI_JINKU_6_5: Perfect. Do we need anything to board the train?
POI_JINKU_6_6: We won't be taking the train for now.
POI_JINKU_6_7: To depart on Line 1, please present your employee ID, or temporary ID, and a valid emergency pass issued by the security room.
POI_JINKU_6_9: We won't be taking the train for now.
POI_JINKU_6_11: Please present your emergency pass to board the Averardo Vault's train Echo. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
POI_JINKU_6_12: How can we get this emergency pass?
POI_JINKU_6_13: We won't be taking the train for now.
POI_JINKU_6_14: Please demonstrate lawful vault entry by presenting an emergency pass issued from the security room located in the next depository. It may be accessed by the train Echo.
POI_JINKU_6_15: Once you obtain an emergency pass, you will be authorized to board. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
POI_JINKU_6_17: We won't be taking the train for now.
POI_JINKU_6_18: Are you seriously telling me that I have to go deeper into the vault to get out of here?
POI_JINKU_6_19: Processing... Please present your emergency pass to board the train Echo of the Averardo Vault...
POI_JINKU_6_21: ...It seems I won't be taking the train.
POI_JINKU_6_22: I ought to take you to the scrap yard.
POI_JINKU_7_1: Security lockdown… That's odd. The Employee Manual says this mode can only be activated by...
POI_JINKU_7_2: Um, miss. If I may, what are you doing?
POI_JINKU_7_3: Me? Oh, this Echo seems to have a headache. I'm trying to help.
POI_JINKU_7_4: Wait, even if it is malfunctioning, you shouldn't hit it with your—
POI_JINKU_7_6: Depository One security module malfunction. Lockdown detected. Emergency pass override activated. Line 1 temporary access granted. Please evacuate via the nearest exit.
POI_JINKU_8_1: The security control room in this depository is right ahead. You can put your device to good use there.
POI_JINKU_8_2: Each depository has its own security room. Just verify your device here to obtain security clearance. It's only valid for this depository, though.
POI_JINKU_8_4: Necessary for the vault's security, but yes, it's a hassle.
POI_JINKU_8_5: We're stuck here for now, and the only way out is to get clearance from each of the depositories. That means going deeper into the vault.
POI_JINKU_8_7: Beats me. The security room only controls the depository it's in and grants access to the next.
POI_JINKU_8_8: So, aside from a handful of senior members of the Montelli family, no one knows the full layout of this vault?
POI_JINKU_8_9: I don't know. Maybe a handful of people who've worked here for over thirty years might.
POI_JINKU_8_10: Let's get clearance first. It might help us avoid most of the defense systems triggered by the lockdown.
POI_JINKU_9_5: Do the Montellis have a love for building labyrinths?
POI_JINKU_9_6: Not really. It's all for the security of the vault.
POI_JINKU_9_7: With top clearance, you should be able to disable some of the cameras. Give it a try.
POI_JINKU_9_8: Maybe we can make a detour from this side...
POI_JINKU_9_9: Wait... something's off with this thing. Has it been tampered with?
POI_JINKU_9_10: Let me see... Tsk, someone removed the hidden security module.
POI_JINKU_9_11: Check the log file with your clearance... There it is, it was taken by "Ash." The name rings a bell...
POI_JINKU_9_12: Yes, the Employee Manual mentions an old employee named Ash who designed most of the vault's security features. But he passed away.
POI_JINKU_9_13: This is only speculation, but what if this "Ash" stole from the vault and took the security module? That would explain why a complete lockdown was triggered.
POI_JINKU_9_14: What's a hidden security module? Is it like a key?
POI_JINKU_9_15: Pretty much. It's the monitoring core that powers this entire depository. If we don't get it back, we'll be stuck here for good.
POI_JINKU_9_16: A vault employee could easily access the module, but nobody would dare steal it. Everyone knows that'll trigger a lockdown of the entire vault.
POI_JINKU_9_17: But what if that's exactly what they want?
POI_JINKU_9_18: Think about it. There's no one in the vault except for us, and all comms are blocked. It's the perfect opportunity for a thief.
POI_JINKU_9_19: Don't tell me they're searching for... Never mind, we need to catch this rat before they cause us more trouble.
POI_JINKU_9_20: It seems this "Ash" also had access to the control room. Could it be... that old woman?

POI_JINKU_49_4: Ms. Zani, the book says the password is "0622," those numbers refer to...
POI_JINKU_49_5: The date when an innocent truthseeker was wrongfully convicted by fools. I remember, but the memories hurt.
POI_JINKU_49_6: They never hesitated to sacrifice for the truth. They shouldn't have had to carry such a burden.
POI_JINKU_49_7: Faith tells me that the truth you sought will eventually come to light, Ms. Lily.

Side_TJQL_11_4: N-no matter! This is my last voyage! Onward! Nothing can stop me now!
POI_ZJGZ_14_1: Mom, can't we keep the drawings on the big tree?
POI_ZJGZ_14_2: I know. It feels wrong to erase them. Hmm, what should we do then...
POI_ZJGZ_14_3: Such fine strokes and daring colors. Who could be the artist?
POI_ZJGZ_14_4: I say we just leave them as they are.
POI_ZJGZ_15_1: Remarkable... it's almost as if the expressive graffiti has brought these dull stone walls to life.
POI_ZJGZ_15_2: Grandpa, isn't calling graffiti "remarkable" a bit much? And it's in such a dangerous spot!
POI_ZJGZ_17_1: Chalulu seems to have sensed "Painter"—better keep up with her!
POI_ZJGZ_9_1: Fascinating… They're likely graffiti by an Echo...
POI_ZJGZ_9_3: I was thinking the same. They might have something to do with the "Night Reveries" in our town.
POI_ZJGZ_9_5: You're right. I can't uncover the full story behind these graffiti by myself.
RGZYYYGJZ_390_1: Blood debts will catch up with those who have to pay. The storm is coming...
RGZYYYGJZ_390_2: Ah, now you remember. I knew you'd never forget. The rain that night never ceased in your heart.
RGZYYYGJZ_390_4: Damn it! This is a trap! They've taken what's ours! In the name of the Montellis, this won't go... unpunished...
RGZYYYGJZ_390_5: Did you hear that? Oh, the panic in their voice! How they must be begging for a capable leader to come and save the day?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_1: In the presence of the just Divinity, feel free to express your doubts. I shall speak without reservation.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_2: I swear by the great Sentinel Imperator there will be no deceit in my words.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_3: Why do you banish people in the name of pilgrimage?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_4: Why do you oppose the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_5: Why did you work with the Fractsidus?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_7: We must create a land that aligns with the Sentinel's vision. We must purge this land of individuals who stray from the righteous path to ensure that our collective will remains unified and pure.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_8: However, we honor the deeds of Napoli II, the founding Primus, and offer those who have strayed a chance for atonement.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_9: The Pilgrim's Sail follows Napoli's path. He too once endured this arduous journey, yet emerged victorious, earning an audience with the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_10: The trials are not mere sufferings but steps toward redemption. The penitent who confront the trials with sincerity will be allowed to return to the divine's embrace.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_11: Unity is our shield, bound by the law of eternal continuity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_12: Though we revel in the joy of the Carnevale, we must also be vigilant.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_13: For division is a chronic disease plaguing this city. The growing indulgence among our citizens has already invited divine punishment.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_14: We, as stewards of divine will, must guide the people, erecting barriers of reason against the floods of passion. This is the only way to withstand the ever-changing tides.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_15: We uphold the Sentinel's principles of justice. The gates to our divine land remain open to all who seek it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_16: This is a city of inclusiveness, welcoming all visitors… including those who try to overstep their bounds.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_17: These charlatans misled our people with lies and flattery, diverting them from the divine will.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_18: But your timely intervention corrected their course, sparing them from a ruinous fate. Once again, I offer my sincerest gratitude.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_75_19: May the Divinity bless you, and may you always walk the path of righteousness.

ItemInfo_42601010_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601010_BgDescription:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
ItemInfo_42601010_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601020_BgDescription:
Golden Thiefbat's talon.
Golden Thiefbats have dexterous claws and like to steal anything that shines. The Thief's Talon is considered a lucky charm in Rinascita.
It is not unusual for a Ragunnesi businessman to put a Thief's Talon in their pocket in the hope of cutting lucrative deals.
ItemInfo_42601030_BgDescription:
Refined animal fat, rich with savory aroma.
In expert hands, it creates a perfectly golden crisp crust, delivering indulgent flavor without a hint of greasiness. 
One bite and your taste buds will be in pure bliss.
ItemInfo_42601040_BgDescription:
Sea Bunny Meat, rich in protein with a tender, succulent texture.
This delicacy requires careful preparation. The Heliobane Fungia, along with other poisonous glands and fluids, must be removed, and the meat cooked to just the right temperature to neutralize any toxins. Whether it becomes a delicious delicacy to die for, or one that costs you your life, depends entirely on the chef's skill.
ItemInfo_42601050_BgDescription:
Thick, soft fur, gentle to the touch, and warming to the very core.
Why strip their coats bare, you ask? Well, haven't you heard of the law of conservation of energy? The warmth hasn't disappeared, it's simply been transferred from them to you.
ItemInfo_42601060_BgDescription:
A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.
ItemInfo_42601070_BgDescription:
A type of poisonous algae that forms a symbiotic relationship with Sea Bunnies. Heliobane Fungia is rich in gelatine, an important ingredient in many desserts.
Gelatin extracted from Heliobane Fungia has a subtle sweetness and gives desserts a silky, springy texture.
ItemInfo_42601080_BgDescription:
A species of crab that makes its home in miniature bells. 
Bell Crabs feed on fish, shrimp, clams, and other small sea creatures. They can scuttle about quickly, emitting a jingling sound as they go. At night, they avoid predators by hiding beneath the decaying hulls of beached boats.
ItemInfo_42601090_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601090_BgDescription:
A creamy resin produced by Nuvola trees, shaped like a cloud and carrying a unique fragrance.
The Nuvola tree is a symbol of healing and renewal. If such a tree is cut, it produces resin to seal the wound until it fully heals. The Ragunnesi call Mastic Nuvola "Healer's Tears."
ItemInfo_42601090_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601100_BgDescription: A type of strawflower that grows in clusters. Sunflare Everlasting has pinnate leaves and disk-shaped flowers. Once picked and air-dried, the flowers retain their golden hue, described as "sunlight that never fades."
ItemInfo_42601110_BgDescription:
Legend says the first divine oracle given to Ragunna was carved into a tree trunk, and from the mark, a green branch grew.
The Viscum Berries that sprout from this branch are known as the "Fruit of Wisdom." It is believed that eating them grants spiritual enlightenment.
ItemInfo_42601120_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601120_BgDescription:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
ItemInfo_42601120_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601130_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601130_BgDescription:
The delectable fruit of a wild olive shrub that grows in fertile soil. Felicitous Olives are a favored food for certain animals.
Herders often raise herbivores with a keen sense of smell to help track down these prized olives.
ItemInfo_42601130_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601140_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601140_BgDescription:
A cluster of golden sulfur crystals, often found in caves rich in geothermal activity. They resemble their mythical namesake—the Golden Fleece guarded by a venomous dragon.
When ground into a fine powder and combined with a hint of molten copper, Golden Fleece transforms into stage-worthy fireworks.
ItemInfo_42601140_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601150_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601150_BgDescription:
A tall flower with a firm stem, crowned by delicate flowers.
Sword Acoruses are often used by instructors to teach swordsmanship to young nobles, replacing real swords with these harmless blooms. The children, entranced by the beauty and fragrance, find their attention captured far more easily than by cold, menacing blades.
ItemInfo_42601150_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601160_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601160_BgDescription:
A vividly colored flower shaped like an unfurling firework.
Give a Firecracker Jewelweed a gentle shake, and its swollen capsules will burst open...
The seeds scatter in all directions, resembling the colorful burst of a firecracker.
ItemInfo_42601160_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601170_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601170_BgDescription:
A fluorescent flower often found in the crevices of ruins. In the past, Seaside Cendrelis wreaths were used in the rite of initiation for infants and the inaugurations of new Fisalia family heads. As a result, it became a symbol of the power once held by the old nobility.
Ever since the tower's fateful ascent to the sky, the Seaside Cendrelis has been considered extinct, for it has never been seen again.
ItemInfo_42601170_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601180_BgDescription:
A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.
ItemInfo_42601190_BgDescription:
A versatile, bronzed iron ore often mistaken for gold, though it's not hard to tell the difference upon closer inspection.
In the past, con artists would craft Fool's Gold into jewelry and sell it as real gold.
Though such tricks are long obsolete, the name "Fool's Gold" endures to this day.

POI_JINKU_28_1: Okay, let's sort out the clues.
POI_JINKU_28_2: The lockdown is still in full effect, triggered when "Ash" removed the security module. To escape, we need to retrieve the module and use our clearance to reach the vault's depth.
POI_JINKU_28_3: On top of that, thanks to him, we're stuck dealing with the defense systems.
POI_JINKU_28_4: So, for both his sake and ours, we need to catch him as soon as possible.
POI_JINKU_28_5: How about we do it the other way around?
POI_JINKU_28_6: What if we approach this from another angle...
POI_JINKU_28_7: There must be a smarter way to go about this.
POI_JINKU_28_8: He's running blind, getting more desperate as the lockdown escalates. But there's only one way he can go.
POI_JINKU_28_9: And only one thing that can take him there.
POI_JINKU_28_11: Makes sense. He has no choice but to go to the train Echo's terminus. So...
POI_JINKU_28_12: We beat him to the vault's depth and wait.
POI_JINKU_28_13: We wait for him at the final stop.
POI_JINKU_28_14: Without us chasing him, he'll follow the main route and trigger fewer defense systems.
POI_JINKU_28_15: That would save us a lot of trouble. I can help manage the security systems. With the clearance, I should be able to override some defenses and open shortcuts.
POI_JINKU_28_16: That should work. {PlayerName} and I will go retrieve the clearance. Ms. Lily, could you stay here and assist Ms. Zani?
POI_JINKU_65_1: Take them. They're the "personal bonus" Lady Carlotta arranged just for you.
POI_JINKU_66_1: These Echo guards are controlled by the security system. You can also command them with your clearance.
POI_JINKU_66_2: The higher your clearance is, the more obedient they become.
POI_JINKU_68_1: Be careful, {PlayerName}! Something's coming our way!
POI_JINKU_68_2: It's a special Echo guard. Tsk, I didn't expect it to follow us this far. We gotta lose it!
POI_JINKU_69_1: Once we activate the clearance, we should be able to access the elevator.
POI_JINKU_70_1: Perhaps it can help us deactivate the alarm.
POI_JINKU_71_2: Somehow, the silent Echo seems to respond to the gentle mumbling.
POI_JINKU_73_1: Here it comes again. Watch out, its attacks are getting faster.
POI_JINKU_75_1: Interesting. It's labeled as a donation from the Order, but the cabinet is empty.
POI_JINKU_75_3: Ha, it might have some research value if it's real.

Event_AYKXBRZM_1_11: You unexpectedly overhear two Exiles discussing a lost package during transit, with one of them intent on confronting Lollo Logistics about it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_7: The Exile stresses the package's importance, and after a member of Lollo Logistics assures them it will be retrieved, he leaves in reluctance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_3_8: Upon arriving at Lollo Logistics, you notice the Exile departing after receiving the promise that his package will be retrieved.
Event_AYKXBRZM_202_34: You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.
Event_AYKXBRZM_9_7: In the Whining Aix's Mire, you encounter a white cat that escaped the Somnoire by train. It asks you to enter a mysterious gateway...
Event_AYKXBRZM_26_15: After aiding Lumi in resolving her issues, you discover that the white cat can now speak. It explains that gateways have emerged across various regions, and it has lost its control over the Somnoire. It requests you to help reclaim its clearance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_27: Back on the train, the white cat reveals why you are the only one that can help those trapped in dreams—you hold the highest control over the Somnoire. It also informs you that those you rescue will forget everything that happened in the Somnoire once they wake up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_117_26: You return to Lollo Logistics with the package, only to find the Exiles furious about its damage and ready to pick a fight. Just then, Tianhu, the leader of the Cruising Drake, arrives and swiftly calms his subordinates. He then extends a genuine invitation for you to join his gang.
Event_AYKXBRZM_118_30:
After Tianhu and his subordinates depart, Lumi expresses her heartfelt gratitude. You ask if she remembers what happened in the Somnoire, and as expected, she has forgotten everything upon waking...

Now, you are the only person in Solaris who still remembers this adventure.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_1: The gateway into the Sonoro Sphere is just on the other side of this bridge. This is the furthest I've ever managed to venture.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_2: Judging from the bits of information the Sentinel gave me, Tyrvine is the key to entering the Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_3: And who can wield the Sword of Divinity but a Blessed Maiden?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_4: But you said you left yourself a message saying that the Maiden was dead.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_2: Greetings, I am Cartethyia. And you are?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_4: Oh, a Fisalia... It seems your ties with the Order are more complicated than they appear.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_5: I had the privilege of watching the Blessed Maiden's performance at the Carnevale once.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_6: I'm rather surprised. After all this time, you still look exactly as you did that day.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_7: But you and I should be around the same age.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_8: I'm also unsure of what's happened to me... I've been searching for answers.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_9: This must be the Sword of Divinity—Tyrvine, the one with the Sentinel's powers sealed within.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_10: You shouldn't have knowledge of this sword.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_11: Memories flowed into my mind just as you entered the Sonoro Sphere, granting me information about the sword's origins.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_12: (Cantarella said that only those who resonate with Tyrvine are granted glimpses of its knowledge...)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_13: Would you mind if I tried touching it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_14: The question of whose Resonator I am... is now perfectly clear.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_15: If I am not the Sentinel's Resonator. Then that must mean...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_16: Don't jump to conclusions just yet. That doesn't prove you're the Threnodian's Resonator, nor that you aid Its cause.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_18: Things are more complicated than you expected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_19: This connection formed between the Sentinel and the Threnodian, the second Dark Tide, and the forming of this Sonoro Sphere...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_20: Right now, you're the sole survivor of whatever happened that day. You really don't remember anything?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_21: As you spoke, I remembered a few more things. There are two other swords.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_22: The Sword of Discord—Hognis, and the Sword of Virtue—Haultir.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_23: Do you remember three pedestals as well?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_24: Yes, did you see them too?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_25: Placing the three swords on their respective pedestals should break the seal over the main tower...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_26: But why would this information be revealed to me now...? Is this the Threnodian's doing?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_27: If we do nothing, we'll never get any answers.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_26_1: What you said to Cartethyia back there...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_26_2: Rather effective on someone of her personality, wouldn't you agree?
POI_QSMG_16_33: That tree... I remember you can see it from the highest point in town. That may be your best bet. I'll leave Carlow to you, then.

Daily_JYQSZM_1_1: Come on! Show your fangs and claws, you monsters! A knight of justice and righteousness will never back down!
Daily_JYQSZM_1_2: Wait... No way, they're too fast...
Daily_JYQSZM_1_3: (Looks like someone's in trouble nearby... I'd better go check it out.)
Daily_JYQSZM_10_1: Sorry, I messed up again. I didn't help at all and just had you protect me once more…
Daily_JYQSZM_10_3: Yeah, just a few bruises. A good rest will heal them.
Daily_JYQSZM_10_4: I need to practice more. I couldn't even catch your moves!
Daily_JYQSZM_10_5: That happens a lot for beginners.
Daily_JYQSZM_10_7: Just give me a little more time, and I'll prove myself to you!
Daily_JYQSZM_11_1: Wow! That was so smooth! A solid rock like this crumbled like a crispy cookie under your strike!
Daily_JYQSZM_11_4: Understood! I'll work hard and become a master of rock breaking!
Daily_JYQSZM_11_5: Haha, after seeing your moves, I'll work hard and become a master of rock breaking!
Daily_JYQSZM_11_6: ...I recall you wanted to be a knight, right?
Daily_JYQSZM_11_7: Under your guidance, Faro has fully trained his strength…
Daily_JYQSZM_12_2: So… I… I actually did it? I defeated it?!
Daily_JYQSZM_12_4: This is my first time defeating a Tacet Discord! My very first step forward!
Daily_JYQSZM_12_5: But the Sword in the Rock you gave me is broken now…
Daily_JYQSZM_12_7: And now it's time for you to get a new one.
Daily_JYQSZM_12_8: I'll keep it as a memento. By the way, do you have any feedback on my performance in that battle?
Daily_JYQSZM_12_9: You want me to be honest?
Daily_JYQSZM_12_11: Your backhand is weak! So is your forehand! Your legs too! And your reactions! You've got a lot to learn.
Daily_JYQSZM_12_12: O-okay! I'll practice harder! I promise!
Daily_JYQSZM_12_14: Under your guidance, Faro has fully trained his strength…
Daily_JYQSZM_13_1: The people who were attacked by the Tacet Discords express their gratitude for your help and leave the scene.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_2: Phew! Thank you for your help. Otherwise, I might've gotten myself into trouble again.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_5: I was just overstretching myself… I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_6: Yeah, I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_7: Just facing Tacet Discords at this level was already overwhelming for me.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_8: But you still did your best to protect them, didn't you?
Daily_JYQSZM_13_9: I swore during the "Sword Bestowment Ceremony" to lend a hand to those in need.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_10: Just like the knights in the legends. Even when they knew the battlefield held more than just victory and glory, they marched on without regret.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_11: You're getting more and more like a knight.
Daily_JYQSZM_13_12: Ahem, it's all thanks to your guidance. Without you, my dream of becoming a knight could've ended long ago.
Daily_JYQSZM_14_1: Oh, dear Imperator, I'll always remember that knight's bravery…
Daily_JYQSZM_14_3: Indeed. On that fateful day, I ran into a fierce Tacet Discord outside the town. A brave young man rushed to help me, fighting the monster with something like a pitchfork.
Daily_JYQSZM_14_4: Once we were safe, I asked for his name, and he told me that he was the squire of that "Roving Knight who wanders between the realms of day and night."
Daily_JYQSZM_14_6: It appears that knights still exist in this era…
Daily_JYQSZM_14_7: Well, I think I've met him before too.
Daily_JYQSZM_14_8: Is that so? He left in such a hurry, and all I could do was watch him go.
Daily_JYQSZM_14_9: This brief encounter brought comfort to my broken heart. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday?
Daily_JYQSZM_15_1: I'm ready, so what do we have for today's training?
Daily_JYQSZM_15_2: It's you! Squire of the Roving Knight!
Daily_JYQSZM_15_3: Oh… Haha, how did you know that?
Daily_JYQSZM_15_4: Why did you leave my title when you were the one doing good deeds?
Daily_JYQSZM_15_5: I'm sorry for doing that without asking. It's just that your guidance has brought me closer to my dream.
Daily_JYQSZM_15_6: Just as the tales of knights inspired me, I hoped that by spreading the name of the Roving Knight, others might also find motivation.
Daily_JYQSZM_15_7: People would see that knights who uphold justice and righteousness are still active, in Whisperwind Haven and even in other places in Rinascita, not lost to time.
Daily_JYQSZM_15_8: You'll earn your own title one day.
Daily_JYQSZM_15_9: Leave your own title next time.
Daily_JYQSZM_15_10: I will! But there's still so much to learn, so I hope you'll keep training me!
Daily_JYQSZM_15_12: Under your guidance, Faro begins a new level of real combat training.
Daily_JYQSZM_16_1: Oh, dear Imperator, I'll always remember that knight's bravery…
Daily_JYQSZM_16_3: Indeed. On that fateful day, I ran into a fierce Tacet Discord outside the town. A brave young man rushed to help me, fighting the monster with something like a pitchfork.
Daily_JYQSZM_16_4: Once we were safe, I asked for his name, and he told me that he was just a nameless knight who happened to pass by.
Daily_JYQSZM_16_6: It appears that knights still exist in this era…
Daily_JYQSZM_16_7: Well, I think I've met him before too.
Daily_JYQSZM_16_8: Is that so? He left in such a hurry, and all I could do was watch him go.
Daily_JYQSZM_16_9: This brief encounter brought comfort to my broken heart. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday?
Daily_JYQSZM_17_1: I'm ready, so what do we have for today's training?
Daily_JYQSZM_17_3: Oh… Haha, how did you know that was me?
Daily_JYQSZM_17_4: You're probably the only knight who fights with a pitchfork.
Daily_JYQSZM_17_5: I was on my way to help with some farm work when I heard someone calling for help. So I grabbed my tool and rushed to assist.
Daily_JYQSZM_17_6: Why didn't you leave your name?
Daily_JYQSZM_17_7: Well… I thought names weren't as important. What truly matters is that the deeds of knights are passed down by people.
Daily_JYQSZM_17_8: Besides, I'm far from being worthy of a knight's title… So I really hope you'll continue to guide me in my training.
Daily_JYQSZM_17_10: Under your guidance, Faro begins a new level of real combat training.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_1: Phew, I'm really glad you were here. Dealing with those Tacet Discords alone is still a bit much for me.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_3: Don't worry! I'll immediately run away if things get too tough. I just wanted to buy some time for those passersby.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_4: Seems like I'm not that afraid of those monsters anymore, but I still need the strength to protect others.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_5: On that note, it's time for your training.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_6: Then let's kick off today's session.
Daily_JYQSZM_18_8: Under your guidance, Faro begins an intensive and comprehensive training session.
Daily_JYQSZM_19_1: Phew… You're here. I managed to defeat those Tacet Discords, and the people were only a little shaken.
Daily_JYQSZM_19_2: I thought you needed my help.
Daily_JYQSZM_19_3: Oh no, I may have used too much force and broken my weapon again. It took me quite a while to find one as suitable as that.
Daily_JYQSZM_19_4: Out with the old, in with the new!
Daily_JYQSZM_19_6: You're right. What matters most is the chivalrous spirit of protecting others, right?
Daily_JYQSZM_19_7: I will keep moving forward, following in your footsteps.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_1: Phew! Thank you so much! Without your help, I'd have been in real trouble!
Daily_JYQSZM_2_2: I'm Faro from Egla Town, by the way. I'm training to become a knight. How should I address you, hero?
Daily_JYQSZM_2_3: (For some reason, you feel that your response will leave a lasting influence on this young man.)
Daily_JYQSZM_2_4: I'm the Roving Knight, a wanderer between the realms of day and night.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_5: Just call me {PlayerName}. I merely passed by and did what I could.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_7: No wonder you fought with such skills! So you really are a knight. I thought knights... no longer existed.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_8: Oh, you're as mighty as the noble knights in the stories. No, you've surpassed them all!
Daily_JYQSZM_2_9: Well, I know a thing or two about fighting.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_10: You flatter me. But I like it.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_11: It's truly an honor to meet you! Actually, I've been searching for someone skilled in combat.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_12: I know this is a sudden request, but could you be my mentor and train me for a while? I want to be stronger, a knight who can protect others.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_13: Why do you want to be a knight like that?
Daily_JYQSZM_2_14: Well, it's a long story. When I was little, I got lost in the wild and ran into some scary Tacet Discords at night. Just when I thought I was done for, someone showed up with a sword and saved me.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_15: I can't remember his face or voice, but I still vividly recall his figure—a knight shielding the weak from danger.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_16: That moment inspired me. I want to be a "shield," not a coward who trembles at the sight of Tacet Discords.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_17: But confronting Tacet Discords is dangerous for ordinary people.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_18: I know. It may be hard to tell, but I'm also a Resonator.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_19: (Though very subtle, you do sense a hint of Resonance power in him.)
Daily_JYQSZM_2_20: Please, will you be my mentor and guide me?
Daily_JYQSZM_2_22: I'd love to, but I'm quite busy right now. Maybe sometime later?
Daily_JYQSZM_2_23: Thank you. Ouch, seems like I twisted my arm while fighting those monsters…
Daily_JYQSZM_2_24: We can start your training once you've recovered.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_25: No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.
Daily_JYQSZM_2_26: That's fine! I'll focus on my practice while you handle your business!
Daily_JYQSZM_3_1: Thank you for saving me again. I was so close to being overwhelmed by those monsters.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_2: You really need to stop putting yourself in danger like this.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_4: But if I stay in safe places, my dream will slip away from me.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_5: A-and my efforts aren't in vain! I can feel myself getting more familiar with their fighting styles.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_6: But you may keep getting hurt.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_7: I know. Just the thought of a future like that sends shivers down my spine and makes my legs tremble when I face those monsters.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_8: But think of the knight who ventured deep into Whisperwind Haven and faced the Giant alone. He must have encountered something far worse.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_9: Even in the darkest moments, he endured until the end. I wish to follow his example.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_11: You're quite stubborn, but that can be a good thing.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_12: Do you remember the favor I asked before? Will you train me this time?
Daily_JYQSZM_3_14: I have to excuse myself for now.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_15: That's great! You finally agreed! Thank you! Ouch, seems like I twisted my ankle in the last fight.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_16: We can start your training once you've recovered.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_17: No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.
Daily_JYQSZM_3_18: I see. Goodbye then. I'll keep practicing on my own until you're willing to teach me.
Daily_JYQSZM_4_1: HELP!!! IS ANYONE OUT THERE? CAN ANYBODY HEAR ME? PLEASE, HELP!!!
Daily_JYQSZM_4_2: That voice sounds familiar… Could it be…?
Daily_JYQSZM_5_1: Phew! I'm finally out! I thought I'd be stuck in that dark cave forever!
Daily_JYQSZM_5_2: How did you get trapped in there?
Daily_JYQSZM_5_3: Well, I wanted to find a proper weapon before the official training started.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_4: I heard that the Mad Knight's sword was hidden around here, so I came to look for it.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_5: And there it was! Just like the legends said, stuck in a rock!
Daily_JYQSZM_5_6: You mean that giant rock over there?
Daily_JYQSZM_5_7: That's right! But no matter how hard I pulled, it wouldn't budge.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_8: I must've spent ages trying! Then suddenly, I heard rumbling and loud crashes from outside. Before I knew it, I was trapped by falling rocks.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_9: Let me give it a try.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_10: Maybe you are the one that can really pull it out…
Daily_JYQSZM_5_11: Legend says this Sword in the Rock chooses its owner, and only those with true courage and integrity can wield it.
Daily_JYQSZM_5_14: The stage is yours now. Oh, I can almost hear it whispering to me—"You don't have the right, O you don't have the right."
Daily_JYQSZM_5_15: The sword looks like part of the rock now…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_1: Congratulations on retrieving the long-lost Sword in the Rock! I never expected you could just break the rock to get it…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_3: Well, after all those years, I guess it's a bit weathered…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_4: But look at its blade! It's so slender, and it definitely has a unique texture compared to an ordinary sword.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_5: It's not a pipe, is it?
Daily_JYQSZM_6_6: How could that be? It is… Well, fine, it's just a piece of pipe.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_7: Maybe some prankster decided to follow the legend and stuck it in that rock?
Daily_JYQSZM_6_8: *Sigh* I'm becoming more gullible. I once searched for the Sword in the Rock with Carlow for ages, but we found nothing…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_9: All these mysteries of knighthood... who knows which is real and which is not? I just didn't want to dig deeper and end up disappointed…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_12: Can you swear to this sword that from now on, you will only fight for justice and righteousness, and help those in need?
Daily_JYQSZM_6_13: Absolutely! I, Faro, swear to this sword that I will only fight for justice and righteousness from now on.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_14: Good, then this Sword in the Rock belongs to you now.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_15: You pick up the weathered "sword" and hand it to the young man before you with sincerity. He stands there, surprised, and after a moment, he accepts it with trembling hands.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_16: But it's just a piece of pipe…
Daily_JYQSZM_6_17: Even if the legend isn't real, your vow is.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_18: What makes a knight isn't their weapon but their spirit.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_19: You're right. When I was a child, I used to play knight with a stick.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_20: Whether it's a weathered pipe or a magnificent sword, a knight's responsibilities remain the same.
Daily_JYQSZM_6_21: Thank you. This looks sturdy and should last quite a while.
Daily_JYQSZM_7_1: So, today's training's about breaking rocks? I remember I once heard from a Pioneer Association member that…
Daily_JYQSZM_7_2: Breaking rocks with your chest is quite popular somewhere outside of Rinascita.
Daily_JYQSZM_7_3: I think you might have misunderstood.
Daily_JYQSZM_7_4: Well then, today's training is "breaking rocks with your chest."
Daily_JYQSZM_7_5: Haha, you're right. It's impossible for an ordinary person to do that!
Daily_JYQSZM_7_6: What? Really? But that sounds impossible!
Daily_JYQSZM_7_7: Alright, chit-chat's over. Today, we simply focus on fundamental strength training. We'll be shattering the rocks with our weapons.
Daily_JYQSZM_7_8: Just like how you got the Sword in the Rock? I'm ready. We can start any time!
Daily_JYQSZM_7_9: No rush. I'll show you how it's done first.
Daily_JYQSZM_7_10: Understood! I'll watch and learn carefully!
Daily_JYQSZM_8_1: What? A Tacet Discord in the stone?!
Daily_JYQSZM_8_2: Looks like today's strength training just turned into a real combat session.

Guide_LSJ_2_3: What seems to be wrong with this Echo?
Guide_LSJ_2_4: Oh my gosh, it's starting to transform!
Guide_LSJ_2_5: Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.
Guide_LSJ_2_6: Transform? Melody can't do that, I'm afraid... Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.
Guide_LSJ_2_7: Melody possesses the ability to capture every melody it hears and orchestrate its surrounding "Melody Ensemble" to replay them.
Guide_LSJ_2_8: I have known Melody for many years, and it is thanks to its presence that I can savor those fleeting melodies, with an endless stream of inspiration flowing to me each day.
Guide_LSJ_2_9: We often venture out together to gather inspirations, but lately, with preparations for the Carnevale, I've been caught up and had to leave Melody to handle it alone in the city.
Guide_LSJ_2_10: Once I finally finished my work, I realized Melody had already ended up like this...
Guide_LSJ_2_12: It can no longer perform entire melodies. Even its voice shows signs of "distortion"... Melody... without you, how am I supposed to live?
Guide_LSJ_2_13: Maybe it's because it has listened to too many different things...
Guide_LSJ_2_14: All work and no play makes even the sharpest mind dull...
Guide_LSJ_2_15: Sure... It seems likely... Ah, my friend, judging by your posture and attire, you must be a seasoned adventurer.
Guide_LSJ_2_16: Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?
Guide_LSJ_2_17: Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...
Guide_LSJ_3_1: Friend, during our adventure, have you ever heard or recorded any music that left a particularly deep impression on you?
Guide_LSJ_3_2: Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...
Guide_LSJ_4_1: Oh... oh! Yes! This is the sound Melody was meant to have! This... this is true music!
Guide_LSJ_4_2: Thank you! Traveler from afar! This… "Melody Box" in your hands, where did you find it? Such wondrous music, captured on a tiny disc like this...
Guide_LSJ_4_5: I am merely a porter in this world.
Guide_LSJ_4_6: I once heard a saying: All the music in this world is prewritten by the divine, scattered across the land. It is the duty of musicians to discover and record them.
Guide_LSJ_4_7: It seems Melody and I should venture beyond Ragunna City and explore the wider world.
Guide_LSJ_4_8: In the cacophony of the world's sounds, the lifelong challenge for every musician is to distill the purest melodies... and "Aria Mummers" are no exception.
Guide_LSJ_4_9: Perhaps within Rinascita, you may encounter other "Aria Mummers." They might be facing similar challenges.
Guide_LSJ_4_10: I have always believed, alongside Melody, that great music has the power to touch others and inspire change.
Guide_LSJ_4_11: Please accept these as a token of my gratitude for your help!
Guide_LSJ_4_12: Hmm... So, what you're saying is, these are the things you've gathered through countless adventures in this vast world? Like a... response from the world to you?
Guide_LSJ_4_13: During your adventure, if you happen to gather other "Melody Boxes," please lend a hand to the other "Aria Mummers" as well.
POI_JINKU_76_1: Please note that no Echoes were harmed in this quest.
POI_JINKU_80_1: Attention all staff. Please cease work at once and leave the vault. We wish you a pleasant day.
POI_JINKU_80_2: Don't worry, it's already been approved by the higher-ups. They see this as a valuable opportunity to work with the Order and as such requested your assistance.
POI_JINKU_81_2: Are you alright, Phoebe? Do you need a break？
POI_JINKU_82_1: "A mysterious scroll painting that leads to a secluded retreat."
POI_JINKU_82_2: I heard a tiger ironsmith wielding a greatsword lives inside this scroll.
POI_JINKU_86_1: Is this the right way to do this?
POI_JINKU_87_1: It worked! Let's go, shall we?
POI_JINKU_88_2: Now we need to find the train Echo station. Once we reach the depths of the vault, we'll catch that fool.
POI_JINKU_89_1: What the hell is this thing!?
POI_JINKU_89_3: Watch yourself. It's coming at us.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_5: That's why I sought aid from the other Sentinels. It's a shame they all refused.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_24_6: Luckily, you've brought me a new hope.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_28: Instead of speculating, we should use the clues we've gathered so far.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_50_1: Up ahead is the Tower of Salvation. That's where the first pedestal is located.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_50_3: Yes. A name taken from the Order's Codex.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_1: I should go back for Cantarella. Will you wait here for us?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_3: I hope you won't mind the extra trip, Phaom.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_5: It doesn't take long for Cartethyia to return and the three of you regroup.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_6: I saw signs of battle along the way. Is anyone injured?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_9: My life is flashing before my eyes...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_10: You're not hiding anything from me, are you?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_52_13: Well, you seem to be in perfect shape to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_53_1: There's no knowing what will happen once Tyrvine is placed on the pedestal. It's best we prepare ourselves.

Guide_YXQJCZ_1_2: I've been here waiting for you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_5: What do you mean? I don't understand.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_6: (Something's not right... It's like he has no memory of our battle.)
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_7: You can call me Gatekeeper for now. My name isn't important—what matters is this gateway.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_10: Is that so? It leads to the Somnoire, a place where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_11: You know about the Somnoire? It's where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 are stored.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_12: It knows the taste of a child's favorite candy and the wild schemes of a dictator. It understands the beauty and darkness hidden in the subconscious of life.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_13: In other words, it holds the dreams of everyone, forever recorded.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_14: Why are you waiting for me?
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_15: The Somnoire records everything about our planet, and your presence is key to keeping it running smoothly.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_19: Before your reawakening, something that shouldn't have been there infiltrated the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_1_20: Now, the Somnoire is in chaos, and your assistance is much needed to restore its stability—Wait, something's not right…
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_3: The monsters in there weren't that hard to beat.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_4: You seem calm. Good. That means the Somnoire's effects haven't gotten to you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_5: Keep up with the good work, will you?
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_6: Well, that clears this area nicely.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_7: As you've probably already noticed, the Somnoire's size is near incomprehensible. This is just the tip of the iceberg,
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_8: There is still much work to be done if we are to prevent the Tacet Discords from escaping again.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_10: Don't forget the rewards you promised me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_11: I knew you weren't one to just sit back and watch.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_12: Of course, I haven't forgotten the reward I promised you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_13: Let's wrap things up for now. Next time, we can go deeper into the Memory Zones together.
Guide_YXQJCZ_19_14: …But when that day comes, maybe the real "me" will be taking charge, don't you think?
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_2: With you on board, I'm confident we can restore the Somnoire to its normal state.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_3: What do you need me to do?
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_4: Looks like the problem isn't solved.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_5: I can't explain it further to you just yet. Not before you regain your memories.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_6: The Somnoire needs authentic memories and experiences, and I shouldn't tamper with them.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_7: At least now you know that these gateways are kind of like Tacet Fields. Tacet Discords can escape from them.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_8: If you can help us fix the Somnoire, we may be able to prevent more Tacet Discords from spawning. Think of it as dispelling a Tacet Field.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_9: Of course, you will be adequately compensated. What do you say?
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_10: Even if you didn't ask, I'd do it anyway.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_11: I'll consider it if the rewards are generous.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_12: Yes, you've always been like this. Maybe that's why the gateway chose you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_13: Yes, you've always been like this. But don't worry, I can guarantee they will be.
Guide_YXQJCZ_6_14: Time is ticking. Let's go inside, then.
Guide_YXQJCZ_10_3: Are you that white cat from before?
Guide_YXQJCZ_12_4: Come on, I know you can talk.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_3: The Ebony Gatekeeper didn't recognize me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_4: Didn't we just have a grand adventure together? I know, you haven't managed to wrap your head around it yet, have you?
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_5: Yes, you see… he's in a bit of situation.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_6: That fella who greeted you at the gateway wasn't actually the real Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_9: After your battle in the Somnoire, he lost control over that realm for a time. To fill his unforseen absence, the Somnoire activated his backup.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_10: The backup only retains limited memories from a certain point in the past, so it makes sense he doesn't remember what happened.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_11: He asked for my help in restoring the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_12: So... is there another problem brewing?
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_13: At the moment, that fella is just a backup, so he's probably just doing his job, plain and simple.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_14: Behind this gateway lurks all sorts of mysteries. The chaos in the Somnoire hasn't been fully resolved, and I'm continuing my investigation.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_15: I'll be here to help you along the way, just as I did before.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_1: I hope it will make a difference.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_3: You can follow "his" guidance and carry on with your exploration.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_5: You mean to complete this beginner's guide?
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_6: Thank you, this will help to restore some of the Memory Zones.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_7: Exactly. "He" has mistaken you for a newcomer to the Somnoire and laid out a special route for you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_8: But the real Ebony Gatekeeper's power is gradually being restored. Before long, that backup of his might be decomissioned...
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_9: But that's for another day. For now, your path is already set.
Guide_YXQJCZ_16_1: What took you so long to leave that Memory Zone?
Guide_YXQJCZ_16_4: But you handled them like it's second nature... Truly impressive.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_1: As you can see, we are now inside the Somnoire. What do you think of it?
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_5: After all, it's made up of the memories and dreams of countless individuals.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_6: Dreams often take us beyond what we can imagine.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_7: Back to the point, in the Somnoire, you'll encounter other entities apart from me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_10: She is a virtual entity, a fusion of countless consciousnesses within the Somnoire, and the one experiencing this dream.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_11: Just think of her as someone dreaming, but she doesn't truly exist. She's just an Illusia created by the gateway to the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_13: Because there has to be someone dreaming for a dream to exist, doesn't there?
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_14: In fact, she will be a valuable ally as you navigate the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_15: You cannot bring anything inside here. If you need anything in battle, you'll need to manifest them from the dreams recorded in the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_16: Such as... the Echoes you use in battle.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_17: Go talk to her. She'll give you some important things for your dream.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_1: Ah, hello. Are you dreaming too?
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_4: Hi, please give me an Echo or two.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_5: Yes, I've been dreaming forever. You wouldn't believe the things I've dreamed.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_6: Haha, hello to you! I've never seen anyone as lively as you here.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_7: There is no need to rush…
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_8: Now that you've found me, I'm guessing you want to hear about my dreams? I've been dreaming up some amazing things!
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_1: So, what do you think? Aren't my dreams exciting?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_2: There are some powerful things in your dreams.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_3: Thank you for sharing your dreams with me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_4: Hehe, I didn't lie to you, did I?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_5: You're welcome! I really enjoyed sharing that with you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_6: I've had so many amazing dreams, but sadly, there's no one here to listen...
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_7: I'd be happy to share my dreams with you anytime you want!
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_9: Because I understand you're here for business, not my dreams.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_10: You know that something's gone wrong here, right?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_11: Strange things have been gathering in the Somnoire lately, and I've been having nightmares too...
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_12: So I won't keep you much longer. If you can help restore things to normal, we'll have all the time in the world to chat.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_1: No longer shall you bear these thorns as a reminder. Forged from primordial seas... this crown shall grant a new identity.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_2: Fleurdelys. Child of Divinity. The Immaculate One. Will you uphold the sacred teachings of the Order of the Deep?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_4: Salvation. Unity. Ascension... Of these three doctrines, which do you choose?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_5: I choose Salvation. I wish to be the Master's blade, striking evil, upholding virtue, and offering salvation to those in peril.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_6: In the name of Divinity, I bestow upon you this crown. May the blood of justice never run dry.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_7: Through this sacred rite, you become the bridge between the heavens and the living.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_55_8: From this day forward, you shall be the Master's sole receiver and herald.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_1: Well, this is where our paths must part.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_2: You're here for the Sentinel, why would you leave now?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_3: What I saw yesterday caught my attention. It may be tied to the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_4: And besides, I'd rather not spend the day twiddling my thumbs, seeing as your Gondola only holds two.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_5: Are you sure you want to go alone?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_6: Such concern for me. I do hope to see the fruits of your labor when I return.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_63_1: If only I could still fight...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_63_2: Everyone's doing their part. Don't worry, nobody's perfect.

Quest_122000011_QuestDesc_122_2: The incident concludes with Zani reporting to Carlotta, while Phoebe appears lost in thought. If intrigued, follow the statue's guidance on the upper tier of the vault to uncover the final "secret cache."
POI_JINKU_56_1: The secret cache... So this is it... Grandpa's true wish...
POI_JINKU_56_2: So, you managed to find this place, {PlayerName}.
POI_JINKU_56_3: We sifted through all the documents on old Ash and the vault before finally locating it.
POI_JINKU_56_4: Here it is. This tree—the one where "the green leaves turn red."
POI_JINKU_56_5: When the persecuted entered the vault, they would take the elevator to the upper levels for a background check before continuing.
POI_JINKU_56_6: For them, the last glimpse of what could be called "scenery" was just this tree on the island.
POI_JINKU_56_7: But this tree, fed by barren soil and still waters should never have been able to turn red.
POI_JINKU_56_8: By the way, the Order is still up to no good. That relic the young Acolyte brought was a bomb. It reacted to the Reverberations here in the vault... Ha, looks like I'll have to investigate the matter myself. If this keeps up, I might never retire.
POI_JINKU_67_1: You actually fixed it. What a genius move, miss.
POI_JINKU_67_2: Oh, that's nothing. If they relapses, I'll be back to perform more percussive maintenance.
