LevelPlay_111900006_HandInItemsDesc_111_:
Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Decay of Time.
Decay of Time: The Lifer gains 200% Glacio, Fusion, Electro, Aero, Spectro, and Havoc Resistance. Its Max HP is increased by 25%.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Desire for Escape.
Desire for Escape: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 25%. Additionally, DMG dealt by the Lifer is increased by an additional 25% every 20s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Growing Loneliness.
Growing Loneliness: The Lifer recovers 10% of its Max HP every second after not being attacked for over 2s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Impending Stalemate.
Impending Stalemate: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 20% each time it deals DMG, stacking up to 4 times. If the Lifer deals no DMG within 6s, all stacks will be cleared.
InfoDisplay_102801044_Text:
The Lifer's Fragility (can be removed with the Stake of Imbalance):
- Growing Loneliness: The Lifer recovers 10% of its Max HP every second after not being attacked for over 2s.
- Desire for Escape: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 25%. Additionally, DMG dealt by the Lifer is increased by an additional 25% every 20s.
- Impending Stalemate: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 20% each time it deals DMG, stacking up to 4 times. If the Lifer deals no DMG within 6s, all stacks will be cleared.
- Decay of Time: The Lifer gains 200% Glacio, Fusion, Electro, Aero, Spectro, and Havoc Resistance. Its Max HP is increased by 25%.

The Lifer's Stability (cannot be removed):
- Chains of Confinement: The Lifer gains interruption immunity when its HP is above 50%.
- Endless Game: The Lifer's Immobilization state duration is decreased by 50%.
- Divine Garden: After taking DMG above 25% of Max HP in a single hit, the Lifer repels nearby enemies and deals DMG to them.

"The Divinity disappeared within the walls one day, leaving only the anguished lifer."
"Follow the paths revealed across the board, where you shall find the Stakes of Imbalance—the shackles that hold the prisoner."
InfoDisplay_102801045_Text:
You who have answered the summon, can you glimpse Rinascita's reality from this board?

"The summoned one sees the black and white pieces moving as though they hold a life of their own."
"The white pieces seem to follow a certain presence, while the black pieces scatter along their own courses across the board."
InfoDisplay_102801046_Text:
Lifer, the imprisoned soul, you shall wield the pieces in my stead, unceasing for all eternity.
My will endures in the board, the pieces, and the shackles that bind you. Rinascita shall tread the sacred path, now and forever.

"Before the summoned one, a shackled prisoner sits across the board."
"In the game between black and white, the summoned one and the lifer, all strive for freedom."

POI_HSBD_2_1: Wow! It's a massive board game!
POI_HSBD_2_2: But there are only nine circles. Doesn't look like the kind of game you played with Changli.
POI_HSBD_2_3: Yeah, it's more like… some kind of puzzle.
POI_HSBD_3_1: Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
POI_HSBD_3_2: Why do you still refuse to place your faith in our great Sentinel?
POI_HSBD_3_3: For we place our trust in blades, shields, and in the resolve to command our own fate.
POI_HSBD_3_4: Then hear me, and hear me well—Ragunna will never welcome the likes of you.
POI_HSBD_3_5: Fine by me! I'd sooner choke than breathe the same air as you, sniveling Ragunnesi!
POI_HSBD_3_6: Such profanity… Those who worship at the altar of worldly desires will find no blessings from Imperator!
POI_HSBD_4_1: Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
POI_HSBD_4_2: How dare you bring these Echoes into the divine garden, without the Primus' or my permission! Do you grasp the weight of your transgression?
POI_HSBD_4_3: By the Sentinel's grace, I swear I acted with pure intentions! These poor things… I just encountered them on my way to the garden! Please, I'm telling nothing but the truth!
POI_HSBD_4_4: Reckless! Do you not see the danger you bring upon the Primus? Enough chicanery. A pilgrimage to the north awaits you—for true reflection and atonement.
POI_HSBD_4_5: The north… to the Shores of Last Breath? No one has returned from there! Please, I need to see the Primus!
POI_HSBD_4_6: Such an audience is beyond you now, for you have wandered too far from righteousness. Go forth. This is your last chance at salvation.
POI_HSBD_4_7: No! Please, let me see the Primus! I'm begging you! O Sentinel above, have mercy on me...
POI_HSBD_5_1: Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
POI_HSBD_5_2: These Echoes... How do you intend to handle them?
POI_HSBD_5_3: They shall reveal the truth of this world to us.
POI_HSBD_5_4: This one will serve as the black piece, embodying mortal desires and worldly needs.
POI_HSBD_5_5: This one will serve as the white piece, guiding the faithful of Ragunna on the right path.
POI_HSBD_5_7: The board has no room left for it. Therefore, it shall remain here as the Lifer, to continue this game on my behalf.
POI_HSBD_5_8: Lifer, I command you: you will never leave this garden, never stray beyond this board.
POI_HSBD_5_10: From this moment on, you are bound to this secret, now and forever.
POI_HSBD_6_1:
You strike at the phantoms before you, but before your blade could reach them, they dissolve into thin air. 
Somehow, you feel as if you've finally emerged from deep water, breathing in fresh air anew.
POI_HSBD_6_2: That feeling… Have I been hallucinating? When did it even begin? When I entered this maze, perhaps?
POI_HSBD_6_3: Those must be the Echoes who were accidentally brought to this garden.
POI_HSBD_6_4: Black piece, white piece, and the lifer… what do they represent, exactly?
POI_HSBD_8_1: Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
POI_HSBD_8_2: Have you ever tasted the Viscum Berry?
POI_HSBD_8_3: No, Primus… How could I do this to the divine embodiment of our Sentinel?
POI_HSBD_8_4: Fear not, Acolyte. I am certain They will not be displeased.
POI_HSBD_8_5: The revered Quercus They have manifested leans upon the windows and domes, its blossoms and fruit both beautiful and divine.
POI_HSBD_8_6: Born from prophecy, the Viscum Berry is etched in the inscriptions. Consume it, and the gaze of our Divinity you've deeply yearned for shall rest upon you.
POI_HSBD_8_7: Primus… Are you saying you've granted those people's request?
POI_HSBD_8_8: They would make barrels from the Quercus, brew wine with the Viscum Berries… How can we allow such a desecration?

HelpText_147_Content:
[About]

A mysterious combat simulation program has gone viral on the Academy's Huaxu Hive. Researcher Lizhu, an active user, seems to have insights on this intriguing program...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.

POI_LGNJR_7_10: I haven't seen you at the Order. You're not a registered Common Echo, are you? Where did you come from?
POI_LGNJR_7_11: You don't seem well. Please let me help... Ah!
POI_LGNJR_7_12: As Phoebe takes another step closer, the Echo transforms into a will-o'-the-wisp and flees.
POI_LGNJR_7_14: Yes, I'm fine. But it ran away. Why...
POI_LGNJR_7_15: Its frequency is becoming more unstable. If it doesn't get tuned soon and encounters more Tacet Discords...
POI_LGNJR_7_16: It's my fault for scaring it off... I was too reckless. How could I mess up something so simple...
POI_LGNJR_7_18: I'm sorry you had to see that, {PlayerName}. I... I messed up again...
POI_LGNJR_7_21: It's nothing. Please forget it. Let's move on, {PlayerName}.
POI_LGNJR_7_22: Thank you. I'm fine, {PlayerName}. Let's move on.
POI_LGNJR_7_23: I'm sorry for worrying you. I've just been a little off these past few days.
POI_LGNJR_7_24: You're on vacation. You should relax!
POI_LGNJR_7_25: Hehe, you're right. The truth is, I took this break to clear my mind and gather myself.
POI_LGNJR_7_26: But I feel more lost than ever... If this keeps up, I won't even be a good guide for you.
POI_LGNJR_7_30: Haha, that sounds like something Zani would say. Thank you for comforting me, {PlayerName}. Now, let's move on.
POI_LGNJR_7_31: That Echo fled north, and north of Averardo Vault is the Fagaceae Peninsula, which just so happens to be our next destination.
POI_LGNJR_7_32: Those wisps are its traces, right? That means...
POI_LGNJR_7_33: As long as we continue to follow them, we should be on the right track.
POI_LGNJR_7_34: According to doctrine, all Echoes in Rinascita exist and thrive due to the Sentinel's blessings.
POI_LGNJR_7_35: They're the Sentinel's envoys, conveying Their blessings and proof of the bond between Them and the people.
POI_LGNJR_7_36: I've never seen an Echo like that... but now it's appeared before me. Could this be a sign from the Sentinel?
POI_LGNJR_7_38: I'll do my best to be a good guide for you.
POI_LGNJR_9_3: I wonder how it's doing now. Is it alright? Oh no, could it be hiding from me?
POI_LGNJR_9_6: It must be having a good time somewhere else.
POI_LGNJR_9_7: If I can't even find an Echo...
POI_LGNJR_9_9: Even so, it's still in a dangerous situation.
POI_LGNJR_9_10: Don't worry Phoebe, you have done a lot.
POI_LGNJR_9_11: But I... {PlayerName}, do you remember Lorelei? We encountered her in Nimbus Sanctum with Zani.
POI_LGNJR_9_12: She said that the Sentinel could no longer deliver Their oracles...
POI_LGNJR_9_13: Since then, I've poured over countless texts. But the more I search, the more lost I feel. It's as if I've been blindfolded and tossed into the sea...
POI_LGNJR_9_14: Perhaps I'm not devout or wise enough to uncover the truth... I often wonder how the Sentinel is faring now.
POI_LGNJR_9_15: Every time I think of your stunning performance at the Carnevale, I feel as though I've missed something right in front of me.
POI_LGNJR_9_16: But what is it? I still haven't figured it out.
POI_LGNJR_9_17: Before today, I thought the sight of Oakheart Highcourt would offer me a revelation, just like the sages in the legends.
POI_LGNJR_9_18: But the oracles on the stone walls and the oak branches feel so silent and distant...
POI_LGNJR_9_20: Oh, I'm not doubting my faith. I suppose... I'm doubting myself.
POI_LGNJR_9_21: My apologies. I didn't mean to show you this side of me again.
POI_LGNJR_9_23: It's the Echo we've been searching for.
POI_LGNJR_9_24: Yes, it seems to be trying to avoid being noticed by Tacet Discords.
POI_LGNJR_9_25: It's fleeing northwest... toward Penitent's End.
POI_LGNJR_9_26: Is it trying to go home?
POI_LGNJR_9_29: You're right. Let's hurry and catch up.

Event_QXJZWSB_1_1: Come on, Lizhu! The project deadline's coming up—you can't keep loafing around like this.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_4: Oh, hi {PlayerName}. You're here just in time.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_5: Nonsense! I've been collecting data all day, so I think I deserve a tiny little break.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_6: Now… have you heard of Pincer Maneuver Warriors?
Event_QXJZWSB_1_9: It's a simulation program that's gone viral on the Huaxu Hive. It simulates combat scenarios using data from digital entities and Tacet Discords.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_10: You control two teams to perform a "pincer maneuver" and fight off endless waves of enemies in a limited time.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_12: It's a bit awkward for an ad.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_13: Anyway, that's what the anonymous uploader posted. I know, a lot of the game ads are kind of fake, but this one intrigued me. So I gave it a try after work.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_14: Apparently, it's based on a tactical simulation project co-developed by the Academy and the Black Shores. They added some fun little features that make it surprisingly relaxing.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_15: That's why I may have squeezed in A LITTLE free time from my research to play it. Can't blame me for this.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_17: No, I'm not! Don’t tell my mentor or I'll be in trouble.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_18: Since you're here, I'm trusting you with my Huaxu Hive account so I can stay focused.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_19: And if you're not too busy, why not try the program yourself? It's actually pretty fun! I promise!
Event_QXJZWSB_1_21: If it's boring, I'm leaving a complaint on the feedback form.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_22: I knew I could count on you! Here, let me set up your terminal.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_23: No problem. Wait, how do you know there's a feedback form... Anyway, let me set up your terminal.
Event_QXJZWSB_1_24: Lizhu takes your terminal and operates on it for a while...
Event_QXJZWSB_1_25: All set. Now you can log in with my account.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_1: There you are! How's the program? Let me check your progress.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_2: Final stage cleared with such a high score? I knew it! You've got a knack for combat simulations.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_4: It's simulated, after all—real combat's a different story.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_5: By the way, the thread about the program has been trending nonstop.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_6: Someone even dug into this internal program and found it connects to the Academy's public database. The protocol seems solid, so no risk of data leaks.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_8: No clue. The anonymous poster keeps releasing new patches on the Huaxu Hive, but no other details.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_9: Though, I have a feeling they've got a lot of free time on their hands.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_11: Sounds like someone I know… right in front of me.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_12: Ahaha... Nice try, but don't forget, I've got a thesis to write.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_14: ...Come on, seriously? It's not me, I swear.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_15: You see, this program may seem entertaining, but it actually <color=blue>simulates a variety of experimental scenarios to test certain combat theories</color>, don't you think?
Event_QXJZWSB_2_16: Plus, while you're enjoying those <color=red>fiery and exciting</color> battles, you might also notice the UI is so <color=red>elegant and well-designed</color>.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_17: And the use of <color=white>Remnant Ecoacoustics data</color> in this program shows the developer has... ahem, a deep understanding of that research field.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_18: I think I know who they are.
Event_QXJZWSB_2_19: Are you hinting at something on purpose?
Event_QXJZWSB_2_20: Well, well... If there's nothing else, I'll get back to my research. Catch you later!

POI_LGNJR_11_17: I'm sorry for prying into your past, but this is how I can help you.
POI_LGNJR_11_18: Your misfortune, your fear, and your long journey for survival... I'm so sorry.
POI_LGNJR_11_19: I can't say, "I completely understand you." That wouldn't be true.
POI_LGNJR_11_20: But as an Acolyte of the Order, I promise you that I will give my all to help you.
POI_LGNJR_11_21: If you want to return home, I will help you find a way to cross the ocean to Penitent's End...
POI_LGNJR_11_22: You can feel the Echo's wariness and hostility gradually fading away.
POI_LGNJR_11_23: But before that, please let me check your frequencies, or let me try tuning you...
POI_LGNJR_11_24: You were hurt by those Tacet Discords, and if your injuries are left unattended it could be dangerous.
POI_LGNJR_11_25: The Echo nods in agreement. With Phoebe's help, its injuries are quickly healed.
POI_LGNJR_11_26: Thank you for trusting me. Your injuries are healed, and you no longer have anything to fear.
POI_LGNJR_11_27: Now, all that's left is to find a way to send you back home... Hmm...
POI_LGNJR_11_28: Typically, you can only reach Penitent's End by taking the Pilgrim's Sail. But now that we're here, that means...
POI_LGNJR_11_29: The Echo shakes its head and approaches Phoebe.
POI_LGNJR_11_31: You want to return to Ragunna with me?
POI_LGNJR_11_32: Oh my, thank you... Thank you so much for trusting me. I...
POI_LGNJR_11_36: (Take out your camera and capture this moment)
POI_LGNJR_14_1: Alright, that's about it. Thank you so much, {PlayerName}. These pictures are wonderful.
POI_LGNJR_14_2: Made in Jinzhou. We make believe.
POI_LGNJR_14_3: Zoom Camera: delight you as always.
POI_LGNJR_14_4: Well, it's not just about the photos…
POI_LGNJR_14_5: It's about… your performance at the Carnevale, and this journey we've shared…
POI_LGNJR_14_6: Ever since we met, I feel like whenever I feel lost, you've been there to encourage me in some way.
POI_LGNJR_14_7: It's almost like you are one of the Sentinel's revelations...
POI_LGNJR_14_8: Ahem, moving on now... Penitent's End is the final stop in our Ragunna tour.
POI_LGNJR_14_9: I remember you've been here before? Have you heard any of its stories?
POI_LGNJR_14_10: Legend has it that long ago, before the Dark Tide, Penitent's End wasn't the forbidden land it is today.
POI_LGNJR_14_11: The Echo beside Phoebe nods in agreement.
POI_LGNJR_14_12: Back then, the Ragunnesi worshipped here and made pilgrimages to this place. By its sandy beaches, flocks of white birds would soar across the sky.
POI_LGNJR_14_13: Falcons would swoop down from the cliffs, startling the gulls into spirals of white as they took flight.
POI_LGNJR_14_14: If only I could see that with my own eyes.
POI_LGNJR_14_15: Well, the actual scenery serves as the standard...
POI_LGNJR_14_16: It was a total travel fraud!
POI_LGNJR_14_17: Hehe, after all, it was only after the Dark Tide that this place became forbidden... transformed into what it is now.
POI_LGNJR_14_18: But I want to know, {PlayerName}, after what you've seen, how do you feel about Ragunna?
POI_LGNJR_14_19: Is it... a wonderful place to you?
POI_LGNJR_14_21: It has a lot of strong monsters.
POI_LGNJR_14_22: It's a place with a great tour guide.
POI_LGNJR_14_23: Exactly. That's how I feel too.
POI_LGNJR_14_24: Huh… that's a unique perspective. I'm glad you appreciate it, even if it's for a strange reason.
POI_LGNJR_14_25: Oh... If you think I've done well as a tour guide, I'm relieved...
POI_LGNJR_14_26: Growing up in the Order, there are many things I never really considered. I-I can't even name my exact feelings for Ragunna.
POI_LGNJR_14_27: In the past, the Sentinel bore all my confusion and responsibilities.
POI_LGNJR_14_28: But now, through this journey with you, I'm beginning to understand myself.
POI_LGNJR_14_29: I realize now that to me, Ragunna is the most wonderful place in the world. Nothing compares to it.
POI_LGNJR_14_30: Along the way, we've captured stunning sights, revisited pieces of Ragunna's history, and even rescued this little one.
POI_LGNJR_14_31: The Echo beside Phoebe nods in agreement.
POI_LGNJR_14_32: I believe all these experiences are the revelation the Sentinel intended for me.
POI_LGNJR_14_33: The true meaning behind the Sentinel's oracles lies in the happiness found in purity and unity.
POI_LGNJR_14_34: Honestly, I didn't fully understand these words, so I took a long leave to go on this pilgrimage in search of meaning.
POI_LGNJR_14_35: Though I'm still not entirely clear…
POI_LGNJR_14_36: I won't let confusion hold me back any longer.
POI_LGNJR_14_37: Perhaps it's because I've met the legendary "Righteous One"?
POI_LGNJR_14_38: Thank you from the bottom of my heart, {PlayerName}.
POI_LGNJR_14_39: This has been a wonderful trip. I believe this brief but meaningful experience will stay with me forever.
POI_LGNJR_14_40: As an Acolyte, I'm not supposed to express my feelings so openly…
POI_LGNJR_14_41: But if you ever want to hear more stories about Ragunna, you're always welcome to visit me at the Cathedral.

Side_BYHDDZX_1_8: But later, my brother confided in me his desire to chase his dreams. He boarded a Pilgrim's Sail seeking distant shores.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_9: Since then, we've had no contact. When I heard the rumors about the Pilgrim's Sails, I thought...
Side_BYHDDZX_1_10: It wasn't until the Carnevale, when the troupe's melodies washed over me, that I felt a sense of deep familiarity.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_11: I just knew it was his voice, his music. He had become a great composer!
Side_BYHDDZX_1_12: I know him better than anyone. He's always chased his dreams, and I'm so proud of him. It made me wonder...
Side_BYHDDZX_1_13: It made me wonder about my own dreams long buried and a childhood lost in the tides. So, I wrote it all in this bottle.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_14: A bottle filled with your entire world.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_15: Yes, but I have second thoughts. Should I really cast this bottle into the sea and chase after my own dreams?
Side_BYHDDZX_1_16: You should go after your dreams.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_17: I think you already know the answer.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_19: I think I do want to give it to the sea.
Side_BYHDDZX_1_20: Would you mind if we place it in the water together?
Side_BYHDDZX_1_21: I hope it can carry my world far, far away, reaching wherever my brother is now. With that in mind, we should find a spot with a favorable wind.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_1: You watch Nannerl gently place the bottle into the water. A gentle breeze sweeps by as you watch the waves carry the bottle out to sea.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_2: Drift away. Drift away. Take with you the world I convey...
Side_BYHDDZX_3_3: Along with my forgotten childhood and the dreams I abandoned.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_4: Find your way to my brother, so that he may know of his sister's love.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_5: And tell him, following his music, Nannerl has put her world into this bottle.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_6: Now, she will pursue the dreams she once cast aside. She will continue to learn music and compose!
Side_BYHDDZX_3_8: You're already on a path of your choosing.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_10: I hope one day my brother will find this bottle.
Side_BYHDDZX_3_11: Then he will realize how proud his sister is of him, and there will be a day when he will listen to Nannerl's own music.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_1: Hey there, {PlayerName}! Come over and meet Julien. He's a cat that just can't resist the harbor life.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_2: Every time I give him a fish and try to talk about his grand feline aspirations, he meows back at me.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_6: He vows to achieve peak cat greatness—catching all the critters! Isn't that right, Julien?
Side_BYHDDZX_4_9: Sounds like he's disagreeing with you.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_10: No doubt about it! If he fufills his birthright, he'll have all the fish he can eat!
Side_BYHDDZX_4_11: Impossible... There's no doubt in my mind he aims to fulfill his birthright. He'll have all the fish he can eat!
Side_BYHDDZX_4_12: Upon hearing the word "fish," Julien begins to meow in excitement. His true feline aspirations are suddenly clear.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_13: He only meows at you hoping for fish.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_14: He only hangs around the harbor looking for fish.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_15: He craves total dominion over all fish.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_16: Outrageous! I thought he saw something in me...
Side_BYHDDZX_4_17: How could that be?! It's the cat's dreams we're talking about here. It can't just be about fish!
Side_BYHDDZX_4_18: There's some truth in that. Fish are the crown jewel of a cat's life!
Side_BYHDDZX_4_19: Oh, Julien, tell me it's not true! Is it really just about the fish?
Side_BYHDDZX_4_21: Go on. Give him a fish and see.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_22: Good idea... But I haven't managed to catch a single one today!
Side_BYHDDZX_4_23: I've got some fish on me.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_24: I don't have any on me either.
Side_BYHDDZX_4_25: Oh, really? Would you mind giving me—Ah no, giving Julien a fish?
Side_BYHDDZX_4_26: I see... Well, if you find any fish, would you share some with Julien?
Side_BYHDDZX_4_27: Julien will pay you for it! Well, I'll be the one paying, but you know...
Side_BYHDDZX_5_1: Well? Did you catch any fish?
Side_BYHDDZX_5_4: Oh, thank you, I'll give it a try right now! Oh, Julien. Come here, Julien. Come get your fishy.
Side_BYHDDZX_5_6: Julien happily takes the fish and devours it in seconds, leaving nothing but bones. He then rubs himself against your hand to show his gratitude.
Side_BYHDDZX_5_7: Oh, did you see the way he was munching at that thing?
Side_BYHDDZX_5_8: Can't say no to a snack.
Side_BYHDDZX_5_9: It's their crown jewel, after all.
Side_BYHDDZX_5_10: Yes, yes! Thank you so much. You helped me realize Julien's real feline aspiration!

Quest_159900014_QuestDesc_159_1: The tasks is complete. Wicktorio wants to discuss your... fees.
Quest_159900014_QuestName_159_1: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men—Epilogue
Event_JSZZV_1_1: Alright, time for a coin toss again...
Event_JSZZV_1_3: So, that settles it. Praise be to Imperator... I shall punish the wicked and fulfill the divine will.
Event_JSZZV_2_1: Ahem… Apologies, friends from afar. Didn't realize you were watching.
Event_JSZZV_2_3: Just a pain in the neck… When you get old, trouble finds you everywhere.
Event_JSZZV_2_4: Last night, some thugs broke into my house looking for documents. Daisy caught them in the act...
Event_JSZZV_2_5: She rang the alarm and tried to wake me up, but they were armed. Tried to cover their tracks… Daisy didn't make it.
Event_JSZZV_2_7: That's awful! How could they?! Jerks!
Event_JSZZV_2_8: Daisy's been with me for twenty years... twenty whole years. If someone told me back then that people would harm the Order's Echo, I'd simply call them crazy.
Event_JSZZV_2_9: So Daisy was an Echo? Wait, I'm an Echo too! How dare they hurt a poor little Echo!
Event_JSZZV_2_10: I lost everything after my wife passed away twenty years ago—until Daisy showed up at my doorstep. She was my wife's last gift to me… and now she's taken away too.
Event_JSZZV_2_14: I'm old now, but in my younger days, the Primus always told me: "Wicktorio, there is no need for extreme measures."
Event_JSZZV_2_15: "As an accountant of the Order, you must act professional and decent..."
Event_JSZZV_2_17: Do it long enough, and you'll understand. It's all about the numbers. As long as the books balance, anything's fair game.
Event_JSZZV_2_18: After I retired, my buddy Cosimo once told me I couldn't just "shoot" my problems away.
Event_JSZZV_2_19: But when the problems kept piling up, I thought: why not deal with the people who created those problems?
Event_JSZZV_2_20: I get the logic… but it's a stretch...
Event_JSZZV_2_21: Anyway, my friends... how about joining me for a little adventure? I can tell you've got potential. And don't worry, my savings will make it worth your while.
Event_JSZZV_2_22: Nothing complicated, just some debt collecting.
Event_JSZZV_2_24: Good. I'll show you where they're hiding. You can handle them however you like. The reward will be worth it.
Event_JSZZV_3_4: Well, we've both had a busy day. Time for a drink, don't you think?
Event_JSZZV_3_5: So, care to share what you found inside?
Event_JSZZV_3_7: The gold coins they hoarded were old currency that was meant to be issued but abandoned after a currency swap.
Event_JSZZV_3_8: Given Ragunna's trade history over the past two decades, they probably planned to exploit the information gap and run cons overseas. That's why they needed those documents.
Event_JSZZV_3_10: What did you do to those people?
Event_JSZZV_3_11: They made too many. Way more than the market could handle.
Event_JSZZV_3_12: People always believe more money is better, but there's a limit. Once it's breached, everything spirals—a chain reaction.
Event_JSZZV_3_13: As you can see, Ragunna eventually adopted Shell Credit as its stable currency.
Event_JSZZV_3_14: Them? Heh. Let's just say I hope the coins I placed on their eyes cover their fare to the underworld.
Event_JSZZV_3_15: Sentinel above, forgive the violence. But for those blinded by greed, it was the only fitting end.
Event_JSZZV_3_16: Wow… like a scene straight out of that Ragunnesi play.
Event_JSZZV_3_17: By the way, here's the reward I promised. As for the extra Shell Credits, consider them a handling fee for converting that outdated currency.
Event_JSZZV_3_18: In life, you either handle the people or settle the score. Peace doesn't come easy, even after retirement.
Event_JSZZV_3_19: Anyway, this old man's heading back now. Stop by Egla Town anytime. You're always welcome.
RGZYYYGJZ_455_1: Yes, that's right... Keep moving forward, you're getting close.
RGZYYYGJZ_455_2: You have to press ahead. Don't doubt yourself.
RGZYYYGJZ_456_1: Don't you see? This is what happens when you choose the wrong path and back the wrong horse!
RGZYYYGJZ_456_2: The cost... will be far greater than you thought. Why do you always end up on the losing team?

InstanceDungeon_8613_Name: Pilgrim in the Sea of Fog
InstanceDungeon_8610_Description:
Painted on a bright summer morning, this piece captures a Lottie Lost strolling under her parasol, the breeze flowing gently around her. 
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
InstanceDungeon_8611_Description:
In the absence of the Carnevale, restless dreams drift through Ragunna's starry night.
"Starry, starry night. Paint your palette blue and gray."
InstanceDungeon_8612_Description:
A portrait hailed as the pinnacle of Ragunna's artistry, yet the Divine Envoy's smile on the canvas remains an enigma.
"I'm not good at photography, for it holds no value to a painter."
InstanceDungeon_8613_Description:
Through the pilgrim's eyes, the turbulent sea is the very embodiment of virtue and passion.
"Try to imagine something you've never seen and let your hand flow across the canvas."
InstanceDungeon_8614_Description:
Adorned with pearl earrings, the acolyte on the canvas casts her eternal gaze upon the painter, her silence echoing.
"Was it my golden youth that vainly gave me the roses?"

Event_AYKXBRZM_203_23: To preserve every dream within the Somnoire, the Ebony Gatekeeper resolves to use the real world—the entire Solaris—as a new vessel for dreams. He opens numerous gateways throughout Solaris, allowing dreams to invade and consume reality itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_6: You believe you've left the Somnoire, only to discover yourself in a new dream. Here, you witness the Ebony Gatekeeper conversing with a young girl.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_31: In the dream, the girl encounters her grandmother in her youth, gaining a deeper understanding of her. This heartfelt experience brings her solace, easing the sorrow of her grandmother's passing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_31: The Ebony Gatekeeper stands before you, revealing that the Somnoire acts as a vessel for storing dreams, and he is on a quest to find a way to confront the Lament. He explains that his role involves clearing the Somnoire by erasing what is deemed "useless dreams." Yet, despite this duty, he struggles with the idea. His conversation with a young girl leads him to the realization that he, too, is just a string of data, and that these so-called "useless dreams" hold the power to inspire and motivate people. Determined to change his course, he resolves to preserve every dream within the Somnoire.

A mysterious combat simulation program has gone viral on the Huaxu Hive at the Academy. And Lizhu, a chronically online researcher, asked you to take over her forum account.

HelpText_148_Content:
[About]

It seems that someone has just updated the mysterious combat simulation program that's going viral on the Huaxu Hive at the Academy...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.

Quest_880000042_HandInItemsDesc_880_1: You got Every Flavor Bell-less Crab for me?

Side_BYHDDZX_10_1: It's done. I should tell David it's safe now.
Side_BYHDDZX_11_2: It was just a Fae Ignis.
Side_BYHDDZX_11_4: A Fae Ignis! Never thought I'd catch a TD...
Side_BYHDDZX_11_5: When my rod took a nosedive, I thought I had hooked a whopper!
Side_BYHDDZX_11_6: Anyway, I can't thank you enough for dealing with that beast! Please, take these as a token of my gratitude.
Side_BYHDDZX_11_7: Huh, huh. With that beast gone, I'll keep fishing!
Side_BYHDDZX_11_9: You won't try your luck in a new spot?
Side_BYHDDZX_11_10: Ah, not to worry. I've already said my prayers. This is my lucky spot today.
Side_BYHDDZX_11_11: I'll have a fine fish in my bag when all is said and done. Now, off to the beach with me!
Side_BYHDDZX_6_1: Hello there! Have you ever tried "Every Flavor Bell-less Crab" before?
Side_BYHDDZX_6_4: You've actually tried it? Wow, that makes you a real hero!
Side_BYHDDZX_6_5: It's a dish made with Bell-less Crabs! I think anyone who's brave enough to eat that is a true hero!
Side_BYHDDZX_6_6: Eugene says he wants to be a great hero, so I told him he needs to pass the "Every Flavor Bell-less Crab" test.
Side_BYHDDZX_6_7: But since we don't know how to cook it, Eugene's not becoming a hero any time soon.
Side_BYHDDZX_6_8: So much for becoming a hero...
Side_BYHDDZX_6_9: Excuse me, but do you know where we can try that dish? We can pay for it!
Side_BYHDDZX_6_10: I can find it for you.
Side_BYHDDZX_6_11: Really? Thank you so much, {Male=mister;Female=miss}. We'll wait for you here until you're back!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_1: How did it go, {Male=mister;Female=miss}? Did you find the dish?
Side_BYHDDZX_7_5: I wonder what this "Every Flavor Bell-less Crab" tastes like. I hope it's not like raw Sunfish...
Side_BYHDDZX_7_6: It might taste like a Gooberstar. Come on then!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_9: It tastes like a Bell-less Crab.
Side_BYHDDZX_7_11: Huh... Sounds like it'll be pretty chewy...
Side_BYHDDZX_7_12: That doesn't really answer the question...
Side_BYHDDZX_7_14: I-I can't do it. I don't want to be a hero no more.
Side_BYHDDZX_7_15: Oh, no, you don't, Eugene! You said you wanted to be a hero!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_16: Hmph, Eugene's such a chicken. But I've got an idea!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_17: Let's try it first. We'll show him how good it is and then he'll want to try it too!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_20: The children stare at you with anticipation as you take a bite of the "Every Flavor Bell-less Crab."
Side_BYHDDZX_7_21: You taste the fresh flavors of the sea, salty and slightly fishy. Overall, it's quite enjoyable.
Side_BYHDDZX_7_22: How is it? What does it taste like?
Side_BYHDDZX_7_26: Sarah hesitates for a moment before finally taking a big bite.
Side_BYHDDZX_7_27: Hmm... It's not bad, you know. It tastes like the sea!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_28: Are you sure? Let me have a bite...
Side_BYHDDZX_7_30: You and Sarah watch as Eugene makes funny faces while chewing, but in the end, he finishes his bite. He's a hero now!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_31: Phew... That was delicious. Thank you, now I'm a hero!
Side_BYHDDZX_7_33: Don't go too hard at once.
Side_BYHDDZX_7_34: Thank you very much, {Male=mister;Female=miss}! Take these. You made Eugene's dreams of becoming a hero come true!
Side_BYHDDZX_8_1: Oh, what am I to do now... I need help, and I need it quickly!
Side_BYHDDZX_8_3: Oh... Just thinking about it makes me shudder! I was minding my own business, fishing away, when I reeled in something downright bizarre.
Side_BYHDDZX_8_4: Our eyes met for a heartbeat before it lunged at me! Took me right back to when I was a boy, the day I got off from school and came across... oh, the terror!
Side_BYHDDZX_8_7: It was by the beach over there. It was some kind of ghostly bird with a mask... Terrifying, I tell you! I didn't know I was fishing for feathered fiends...
Side_BYHDDZX_8_8: It's still wandering about over there. I daren't go fishing now...
Side_BYHDDZX_9_1: So he reeled in a Fae Ignis. I'd better get rid of it.

Character_LingYang_26_39: Lingyang asks you to keep his beastly side a secret. After hearing about your efforts, Bei Ji opens up about his conflict with Bei Shi, sharing his true feelings.
Huanglong_main_1_2_1_14: As you approach the Academy, Chixia's Terminal suddenly rings. She rushes off, leaving you and Yangyang to enter the Academy alone.
Huanglong_main_1_2_11_46: You deliver the parts to Mortefi. Meanwhile, Baizhi completes her analysis of the mysterious tokens. The mangosteen is ordinary, the purple leaf shows signs of exposure to Waveworn phenomena, and the Sugar Pearl is a vaccine that expired over 20 years ago. As you piece together Baizhi's findings and the restored sundial's ancient Sexagenary Cycle, a revelation dawns.
Huanglong_main_1_2_128_3: In the unsettling realm you find yourself in, an unknown entity attacks you. It seems to be saying something, but before you can decipher what it means Yangyang's voice pulls you back to reality.
Huanglong_main_1_2_131_20: Baizhi listens to your account but remains unsure of the cause. She needs more data before drawing any conclusions. The good news? Every test shows you are in perfect health.
Huanglong_main_1_2_134_4: Yangyang is relieved to see you unharmed. Baizhi, however, wastes no time and asks you what happened in the simulated training ground.
Huanglong_main_1_2_16_79: You find information about the Sugar Pearl's origin. Jinzhou's past begins to unfold before you—a past that may be intertwined with your own. At the same time, you begin to understand the deeper, more pressing reason behind Jinhsi's cryptic messages.
Huanglong_main_1_2_17_45: It's late at night when Chixia meets up with you again. With the day's discoveries weighing heavy, you decide to rest before tackling tomorrow's challenges.
Huanglong_main_1_2_39_40: Baizhi suggests running a full analysis on the Sugar Pearl and sundial to uncover more information. Before parting, she encourages you to have a medical examination when time allows.
Huanglong_main_1_2_4_17: You cross paths with a researcher named Mortefi. After learning the purpose of your visit, he leaves to inform Baizhi of your arrival.
Huanglong_main_1_2_5_70: You see Baizhi for the examination. Before she begins, she shares key insights about Echoes, Resonators, Threnodians, and your place in all this.
Huanglong_main_1_2_60_50: Mortefi ends the call. The caller was Xiangli Yao, an Automata Mechanic expert and a Principal Investigator at the Academy. Mortefi will draw up a design for you, but he doesn't have the parts to rebuild the item. He needs you to fetch them from Xiangli Yao's workshop.
Huanglong_main_1_2_9_51: Mortefi has cracked the sundial's secrets. He explains what it looks like inside and how it works, but is interrupted by a call. You and Yangyang decide to explore the room until he is free.
Huanglong_main_1_5_73_78: Back in Jinzhou, you reunite with Chixia and share your findings from Desorock Highland and Qichi Village. You suspect Jinhsi intentionally led you there after learning of the Fractsidus' plan, but her true intentions remain unclear until you solve the sundial puzzle.
Huanglong_main_1_5_74_52: You solve the sundial puzzle. A note appears that directs you to the Grand Library at City Hall. Noticing something unusual about the sundial, you decide to go there alone.
Huanglong_main_1_5_78_37: You defeat Scar, but he appears unbothered over what will happen to him. He is more curious to know when you and Jinhsi hatched this trap.
Huanglong_main_1_5_79_103: The sundial holds two puzzles. Solving the second unveils a message from Jinhsi, inviting you to a meeting under the cloak of night. When she arrives, she reveals secrets about Jinzhou and the Threnodians, shedding light on your identity, and hints that you might be a legendary figure mentioned in ancient records.
Huanglong_main_1_5_80_52: You ask Scar why the Fractsidus is holding Jué captive and attempting to awaken the Threnodian. He explains their goal of creating a new world order and invites you to join them. Before being taken away, Scar whispers a secret to Jinhsi that visibly unsettles her.
Huanglong_main_1_5_81_44: Jinhsi reveals a prophecy from Jué foretelling your quest to find Commander Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a time when raindrops fall upstream. Until that day comes, she advises you to seek out an organization known as the Black Shores.
Huanglong_main_1_5_83_43: After your departure, Jinhsi reaches out to her mentor, Changli. Jué prophesied a showdown between Jinhsi and itself at Mt. Firmament, a place where time stands still. Determined to protect Jinzhou's future, Jinhsi vows to face Jué alone. Changli, impressed by her growth, pledges her support.
Character_LingYang_1_65: You run into Lingyang chatting with some children. He introduces you to the Liondance Troupe and tells you about some of Jinzhou's traditions. He asks you to accompany him in preparing for the upcoming Liondance—and also offers to grab a bite en route.
Character_LingYang_10_54: A courier tells you that locals have been paying "The Savages" to fend off the "Jingle Beast." With this clue, you head to the area where the beast is often spotted.
Character_LingYang_12_34: Near an Exile's camp, you overhear that "The Savages" are exploiting the "Jingle Beast" legend. You also learn that a new member has joined their ranks hoping to find the Beast.
Character_LingYang_14_36: Everything points to "The Savages" spreading rumors about the "Jingle Beast" and selling spoiled ingredients. You discover the new recruit is Bei Ji. To keep you safe, Lingyang volunteers to investigate "the Savages" himself while you and Bei Shi focus on finding Bei Ji.
Character_LingYang_16_36: Bei Shi shares that Bei Ji has been feeling guilty about her. She also opens up about her fear of the "Jingle Beast," which stems from a past encounter out in the wild.
Character_LingYang_17_49: Lingyang tells you that "The Savages" have taken Bei Ji to a cave. Sensing danger, he suggests you join him in the rescue while Bei Shi alerts the Patrollers.
Character_LingYang_27_20: With the Patrollers' help, you catch "The Savages" and the Bei siblings are finally reunited.
Character_LingYang_28_58: You learn that Bei Ji had originally planned to kill the "Jingle Beast" to prove his courage and earn his sister's respect. Though he feels like he has failed, Lingyang reminds him that true bravery lies in overcoming one's weaknesses for those we care about. Bei Ji gains Bei Shi's understanding, but her fear of the "Jingle Beast" remains. To help her, Lingyang invites the siblings to watch the Liondance, believing it may help dispel Bei Shi's fear.
Character_LingYang_3_19: After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.
Character_LingYang_32_8: Lingyang asks you to check backstage for props that might help Bei Shi form a new opinion about the "Jingle Beast."
Character_LingYang_34_24: Before the performance, Lingyang shares the origin and meaning of the Liondance, suggesting that it might help Bei Shi overcome her fear of the "Jingle Beast."
Character_LingYang_37_33: Thanks to the Liondance performance, Bei Shi can recall how the sound of a bell saved her during a previous attack in the wild. Her fears begin to shift as her courage is restored.
Character_LingYang_38_58: In the end, Lingyang reveals the truth about the "Jingle Beast"—it is the last "Suan'ni." Moved by humanity's bravery against the Lament, this creature longed to become one of them. It had been trying to understand what it means to be human and ultimately discovered that the answer lies in the "heart." Since that day, it has sought to express the beauty it sees in humans in its own unique way.
Character_LingYang_5_27: After talking with the clients, Lingyang agrees to include the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony in tomorrow's performance to celebrate their wedding.
Character_LingYang_7_48: Lingyang treats you to some local Jinzhou specialties at a food stall, suggesting the stall owner—one of his clients—offer snacks during the performance as a way to advertise. However, the owner explains they are short on ingredients due to the disruption caused by a creature known as the "Jingle Beast" and a gang called "The Savages." Hearing this, Lingyang appears deep in thought.
Character_LingYang_8_77: At the teahouse, you find Lingyang discussing a mysterious request with Bei Shi. They suspect the request came from Bei Shi's brother, Bei Ji, who has been missing for a week and may be involved with "The Savages." To find out more, you and Bei Shi start investigating Bei Ji's packages.
Character_LingYang_87_16: Lingyang heads to a teahouse to take care of an unresolved request. The stall owner expresses concern about Lingyang's tendency to prioritize others over himself and asks if you can check on him. You agree to help.
Character_JiYan_2_39: At the Riverside Games, you gather details from Jiyan and Wenshu as you prepare to assist with the event.
Character_JiYan_3_40: You find out that two members of Lingyan and Ganquan's team are injured and unable to race. To fill the gap, you join the team, but you still need one more member. After discussing it with Wenshu, you both agree that Jiyan is the best fit, so you decide to invite him to join.
Character_JiYan_33_26: Jiyan gives Mortefi the recorded frequency samples, and Mortefi promises the Academy will use them well.
Character_JiYan_35_26: Wenshu shares the full story of the temporary team and gives you a photo of you and Jiyan's team as a keepsake.
Character_JiYan_4_33: You invite Jiyan to join the team. He agrees to be a substitute after careful consideration.
Character_JiYan_43_37: At Knell Square, you see the flowers Jiyan planted for the fallen soldiers. Together, you plant an "Emortia" seed, hoping the souls you met in the Sonoro find peace and return home. Jiyan asks you to plant an Emortia for him if he cannot return home someday.
Character_JiYan_44_33: Once the injured are safe, you and Jiyan learn from Mortefi that the manic Gulpuffs were affected by abnormal frequency fluctuations upstream. The timing of this accident strikes Jiyan as suspicious, so you decide to investigate upstream.
Character_JiYan_5_58: Jiyan gives a pep talk before the race. You learn that the fastest race record was set by a temporary team a decade ago. You finalize your team name and relay order.
Character_JiYan_9_30: The race is halted due to a disruptive incident. Jiyan points out something strange. But before investigating, you need to evacuate the spectators for their own safety.
Character_JiYan_19_23: You enter the Sonoro Sphere with Jiyan and find illusions discussing the temporary team from ten years ago. Jiyan seems to know the story but chooses to avoid the subject. Then, before you can act, the illusions turn into Tacet Discords and attack.
Character_JiYan_20_17: Jiyan explains these Tacet Discords are reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago and reveals he was a member of that record-breaking team. He believes the anomalies are linked to them. You hear the Knell Square's bell and continue exploring.
Character_JiYan_23_33: Jiyan speculates that the Sonoro Sphere is composed of the Reverberations of his late comrades who have been trapped here and forced to relive their memories. Their frequencies are stuck in a past battle against the Tacet Discords and they implore you for help. Guided by the bell, you venture further in the Sonoro.
Character_JiYan_27_26: Jiyan is struck by how the Tacet Discords are mimicking the Midnight Rangers' tribute to fallen soldiers, finding it absurd as these monsters shouldn't have been able to understand the ceremony's meaning. As the bell rings again, the Tacet Discords move slowly towards the fog. You and Jiyan are ready to bid them a proper farewell.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_4: Legends say the Sentinel quelled the storm and stilled the waves, sparing countless lives at sea.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_5: To show their gratitude, people place candles around the statue, keeping them lit both day and night. Every boat that passes pays their respects.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_6: It may seem fanciful, but it's best to show respect as we pass by.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_7: So is this the statue of the Sentinel? Why does it feel weird...

InfoDisplay_142000002_Title: A Segment of Davide's Voyage Log
InfoDisplay_142000002_Text:
Day 16.
They all say that Rinascita's outer sea is riddled with dangers—storms, mist, reefs, and TDs that could swallow a ship whole. Some even claim that the world beyond Rinascita had already died in the Lament long ago, with only our isles left under Imperator's protection.
Pure rubbish.
They've let fear of the unknown take over. They think I'd never dare take a Gondola out to the open waters, saying I'm just a river rat full of big talk. Well, I'll prove I'm no coward like them!
Today I caught a fine fish. A good sign, I'd say, and a nice meal. Now I have the stars above to guide my way, what's to fear? Storms? Waves? Bring them on! As long as I have my Gondola, there is no place in Rinascita I can't reach.
InstanceDungeon_2507_DungeonDesc:
As twilight falls, all things return home.
Something tells you that an indescribable presence awaits.... anticipating the arrival of ships, people, and the setting sun. It is waiting for a world where light fades and silence reigns. It will step into the darkness, swallowing all in its wake.
InstanceDungeon_2508_DungeonDesc:
Where do schools of fish swim? 
Above the towers, into the silent night sky...

LNXTSXYD_1_1: So, even Rinascita has Sonance Caskets, huh?
LNXTSXYD_1_2: I wonder if someone here would buy them, like Uncle Chenpi back in Jinzhou.
LNXTSXYD_1_3: We should keep an eye out!
LNXTSXYD_2_1: This message is from the Pioneer Association to all members currently exploring the Rinascita region.
LNXTSXYD_2_2: Marino, one of our Association photographers, is asking for help from any members with strong combat skills. You can find the location on the map marked for your reference.
LNXTSXYD_2_3: (Looks like someone needs a hand. I should go take a look when I'm around.)
LNXTSXYD_3_1: You look familiar... Are you THE Rover? The great hero who singlehandedly saved Jinzhou?
LNXTSXYD_3_2: No one can do that singlehandedly.
LNXTSXYD_3_4: Oh, sorry, you're right. Mr. Fulmine also taught me that "It's the glimmer of each and every soul that forges the glories in history."
LNXTSXYD_3_5: That's awesome! I'm in need of a savior right now.
LNXTSXYD_3_6: I'm Marino, an intern photographer of the Pioneer Association. Well, this may seem a bit too much to ask from a stranger, but could you lend me a hand? Only a hero like you can handle this!
LNXTSXYD_3_7: I seem to have heard the line pretty often lately...
LNXTSXYD_3_9: It's a bit complicated, but you can start by touching those Plushies over there to get a better sense of the situation.
LNXTSXYD_4_2: Yes. By using the Sonance Caskets, the morph painting can stabilize the masterless Echoes here with its Sonoro Sphere, keeping them from fading or becoming hostile.
LNXTSXYD_4_3: Mr. Fulmine and I have been grabbing as many Caskets as we can, but it's still not enough to power the painting fully. That's why we need your help.
LNXTSXYD_4_4: That's a lot of work to do.
LNXTSXYD_4_6: We will definitely make it worth your while.
LNXTSXYD_4_7: Every time the painting opens its Sonoro Sphere, the Plushies take some resources from it to keep the village going.
LNXTSXYD_4_8: In fact, there's still a ton of treasure left in the Sonoro Sphere. I'm sure the Plushies would be happy to haul out a few pieces as a reward for you!
LNXTSXYD_4_9: Fair enough. I have no use for Sonance Caskets anyway.
LNXTSXYD_4_11: We're counting on you to collect more Sonance Caskets to power the painting. I'll also keep an eye out for any Echo weirdness and let you know if something comes up.

A gaze from the other side transforms into a full moon, filling her hollow right eye—thus, the still moon shifts, awakened by her stare.

ItemInfo_71210003_BgDescription: Once repaired by a technician, it can provide information about the movements of its previous owner. However, further repairs are required to unlock more data. Though the deceased cannot speak, this Terminal serves as his voice. Complete the restoration to uncover the mystery—those covered data may hold the key to the truth you seek.
ItemInfo_71210003_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The Reserved Terminal owned by Benett, a deceased member of the Montelli family.
ItemInfo_71210004_AttributesDescription: A Cat's Eye brooch from Carlotta, reflecting your golden eyes—also a personal token from her.
ItemInfo_71210004_BgDescription: In Montelli, each member has an item corresponding to their code name. Carlotta might begin preparing this gift for you from the very moment she was captivated by your golden eyes and offered you the code name "Cat's Eye." Although you don't intend to officially join Montelli, you know that she will forever keep this code name for you—Cat's Eye, the first and only member to receive Opal's personal invitation.
ItemInfo_71210004_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A Cat's Eye brooch from Carlotta.
Huanglong_main_1_6_10_33: You inquire about the Blake Bloom from Grandma Lin, who has not seen it but knows a Resonator skilled in botany. This Resonator is currently in the mountains, where you set off to find her.
Huanglong_main_1_6_24_30: He introduces himself as Aalto, an information broker. He claims to be searching for a little girl who suddenly appears.
Huanglong_main_1_6_26_28: The girl's name is Encore, and she is Aalto's associate. Just when she is about to divulge a crucial secret, Aalto snaps his fingers and they both vanish in a cloud of mist.
Huanglong_main_1_6_47_18: You come across a hologram of an aged man, lamenting his unfulfilled research and hoping for a savior 'from both past and future.' A beautiful woman's specter briefly meets your gaze, stirring a sense of familiarity that eludes you.
Huanglong_main_1_6_51_9: Emerging from the ruins, you find the sky dark and heavy with Retroact Rain. Yangyang calls to tell you Jinzhou is under attack by a horde of Tacet Discords.

Activity_103000003_Desc: O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the stormy sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of the Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.
POI_LGNJR_15_2: Why are they here? Could they be linked to the old nobility?
POI_LGNJR_15_3: The old nobility... What did Gilberto mean back then...
POI_LGNJR_16_1: These wisps are the same as the ones we encountered before...
POI_LGNJR_16_2: But why are they here in front of the vault? Could it mean that both the old and new nobility are...
POI_LGNJR_16_3: Or does it mean that such will-o'-the-wisps are all traces of something?
POI_LGNJR_17_2: Its form and those wisps... From what kind of Tacet Discord did it transform?
POI_LGNJR_17_3: If only I had been more composed and devoted—would that have made a difference...
POI_LGNJR_18_1: So this was its true form all along?
POI_LGNJR_18_2: The Sentinel's Envoys seem to be more diverse than I thought...
POI_LGNJR_19_1: Stories about the Divine Envoys in the Codex of Holy Rituals don't mention anything about wisps like this...
POI_LGNJR_19_2: In the The Golden Bough, the author compared the Divine Envoys to the Sentinel's eyes. If that's true...

YYYHZG_11_2: Then you must have met Jinzhou's magistrate! I hear she's young, younger than I am, in fact, and with hair as white as snow. They say she's wise, brave, and cares deeply for her people, just like the Blessed Maiden in the hymns. I really admire her!
YYYHZG_11_4: By the way, you call yourself Rover, but... why do you choose to rove? Why not settle somewhere and take on stable work like the rest of us?
YYYHZG_11_5: If you're looking for work in Rinascita, be sure to come sign up at the Order. We offer a monthly talent subsidy!
YYYHZG_11_8: Oh no, am I bothering you with my chatter? You've been so quiet.
YYYHZG_11_9: Apologies, I can only chat with the Acolyte responsible for disposing archived records on the 15th of each month. Also, Phoebe hasn't been visiting me as often lately...

Main_Linaxita_2_1_13_2: Haha, there are so many stories about the Carnevale…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_50_1: Forgive me, honored guest… In our eagerness to share the faith, we may have caused you some discomfort.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_50_2: Ragunna is a city rooted in devotion, and to us, Imperator, our dear Sentinel, is the guardian over all of Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_50_3: This is something every native knows well. Yet we forgot that you come from afar, unfamiliar with our traditions.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_50_4: Therefore, please accept my sincere apologies, and do enjoy yourself in the city. Should you have any questions about Ragunna, Acolyte Phoebe will gladly help you.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_51_1: Would you like to look around? I'll be here.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_52_2: Thank you for gifting us "the source of light," and for gracing us with "kind Echoes."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_53_1: So, this is Ragunna's Genesis Nexus? Magnificent...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_53_2: It looks so different from those Nexus we saw in other places...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_54_1: Identity confirmed… Does this mean I now have access to use the Common Echoes?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_54_2: Yes. Please remember that these Echoes are the Divine Envoys of the Sentinel and must be treated with utmost respect. Any transgression will result in disciplinary action.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_55_2: Yes. We're inspecting everything every few hours.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_1: All security measures checked? The Carnevale is only days away.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_2: Yes. We're inspecting everything every few hours.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_3: Good. We need this Carnevale to be absolutely perfect.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_4: Of course. Holding the Carnevale is a wish we Montellis share with the people.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_5: Indeed. Joy has been absent in this city for too long...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_6: By the way, sir… do you believe in the Sentinel's existence?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_7: Well, the Order speaks of Their grace, how They graced us with this land for shelter and provided us with countless blessings.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_56_8: While I’m grateful for all that the Sentinel represents, I believe humanity is meant to shape its own future. Whether They exist or not, we each have a role to play in this world.

Character_Rococo_61_4: She says this accordion was from her master.
Character_Rococo_61_5: Even though she hasn't found her master yet, this accordion left her with many fond memories.
Character_Rococo_61_6: "As the mist fades, so shines the star's unbound light—"
Character_Rococo_61_7: Her master used to sing this to lift the spirits of people who had been wronged, and naturally, she picked up the tune.
Character_Rococo_61_8: The misty maze we just went through was her attempt to recreate the opera. She used the misty coastline as a stage, with the help of her Echo friends, of course.
Character_Rococo_61_10: I guess she was trying her best to protect all her memories with her master.
Character_Rococo_61_11: But protecting your own shouldn't come at the cost of everyone else's memories and hopes.
Character_Rococo_61_12: For anyone who's been hurt, we're probably better off sticking together than dragging each other down, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_14_1: Did the Montelli family invite some kind of… traveling troupe for the Carnevale? Never heard of a group like that around Rinascita...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_14_2: Hah, interesting. I knew the Order canceling the Carnevale wouldn't kill people's love for theater. Now that it's back, everyone's after that Laureate title.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_14_3: I wonder what their style is like. With the Montellis sponsoring them, I bet their costumes and staging will be over-the-top.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_14_4: Oh, come on! Don't let that throw you. It's not money or connections that make a great performance. By our founder's name, the Guinizello Troupe is gonna present the most unforgettable show!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_14_5: You're right. Plus, it's not like we can predict what the Sentinel's looking for in a Laureate. The most important thing is that we get across what we want the Sentinel to see.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_1: Heard the news? The Order's bringing in a "Conductor" for this year's Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_2: A Conductor? Yeah, I bet they just want to control the whole thing again.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_3: No way... People have been really pushing for more freedom this year, and the Order said we could organize our own performances during the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_4: Sure, they said that, but when have they ever kept their promises? In the end, they'll do whatever they want, and probably bring up that incident from ten years ago to justify it.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_5: I just hope it's not more of those boring hymns… They're all the same! I'm so over them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_15_6: Shh! The Order's guards are coming this way…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_24_8: But isn’t the Montelli family hosting the Carnevale this year?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_24_9: Doesn’t matter. They’re businesspeople. Who knows what they’re really up to.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_24_10: Keep blathering on about this without a shred of evidence and you could end up before the <ano=The Secular Court> of the Order's Tribunal</ano>.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_40_1: That was so scary! I really thought Bakie was gonna lose control just like that Vitreum Dancer…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_40_2: Anyway, you really shouldn’t have had to go through such a rough experience on your first visit to Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_40_3: Here, take these dishes—they’re on the house! Hope this keeps your day on the bright side!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_2: Well, there are so many stories about the Carnevale…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_3: At first, it was a festival to thank the Sentinel. Back then, people had just escaped the sorrow of the Lament. They’d lost their homes and felt a deep respect for the Sentinel, so the ceremonies were always very serious.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_4: One day, the Sentinel’s voice came down from the heavens:
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_5: "Solemnity is not the only name of gratitude or remembrance." The Sentinel wanted people to build a future with joy and hope, to honor the past by living fully in the present.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_6: Since then, everyone began following the Sentinel’s guidance. They put on their fine clothes, sang their favorite songs, and put on plays. Gradually, the Carnevale turned into the celebration we know today.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_7: Every year, the Sentinel chooses the best performer and gifts them the Laurel as a sign of encouragement.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_8: One of my old friends was actually a Laureate, hehe...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_9: For kids like you, this festival is a time to hang out with friends and eat all kinds of special treats.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_10: Wow! So… does that mean I don't have to do homework as well?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_11: Hooray! Carnevale! Why can’t we have it more often, Grandpa?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_57_12: Ah, that's a bit complicated, dear. But don't worry, Grandpa will explain it all to you one day…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_58_1: A traveling troupe? Never heard of a group like that around Rinascita...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_58_2: Oh, come on! The Guinizello Troupe is gonna win the Laurel at this year's Carnevale for sure!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_59_1: Heard the news? The Order's bringing in a "Conductor" for this year's Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_59_2: A Conductor? Yeah, I bet they just want to control the whole thing again.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_1: Carnevale, delicious Carnevale… Oh wait, I mean gelato…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_2: Hey there! First time in Ragunna? Well, let me tell you this—Carnevale isn't just for partying! It's our big chance to make enough money to last us all year!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_3: Plus, what the Laureate says about food can totally be a game changer!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_4: Take the Laurus Salad, for example. It used to be just a plain ol' salad, nothing fancy.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_5: Then, one day, a Laureate casually mentioned that the Sentinel liked it, and bam! It became the most popular dish in town!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_6: They say the Sentinel's always watching over us, especially during Carnevale. Who knows, maybe They'll even show up as one of us!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_61_7: And if They try our gelato… well, it might be just the thing to hit the spot!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_63_1: Hmm... something's wrong with that Vitreum Dancer...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_64_1: An Echo lost control? H-how could that be possible?!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_66_1: What… just happened? How could a Common Echo harm people like that?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_66_2: A Divine Envoy doing this… it doesn't make sense…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_66_3: Wait, is that one of the Montellis' Echoes? I heard theirs aren't exactly considered "Common Echoes"…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_67_1: Alert the Servitude Hall now! We need that Vitreum Dancer under control!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_67_2: We must get security tightened around the Montelli Quarter.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_68_1: Nooo! My pizza! I didn’t even get a bite! D-do you think the Sentinel’s gonna punish me for wasting food…?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_68_2: Oh, don’t be silly. It was just an accident. No way the Sentinel would care about that...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_69_1: O Sentinel above... Is this your fury? Are you trying to warn us...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_71_1: An Echo attacking humans? Right before the Carnevale? That’s wild…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_71_2: Rumor has it, the Montelli family’s Echoes are "filthy"...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_72_1: So the Montellis are behind this mess? Ha! Now that would be top-shelf entertainment!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_1: Hmph, isn’t the Montellis the one pushing this whole Carnevale? And they can’t even control their own Echoes? A Vitreum Dancer show? Really, that’s their big idea?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_2: They keep saying it’s for the people, but who actually buys that? It’s all about the money, fame, and power for them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_3: Ignoring past "truths," shrugging off the Order's warnings, disregarding public safety!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_4: Are they just going to ignore divine will, or worse, go against the Sentinel? Heh, classic Montellis! Always "bold and pioneering"…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_5: Or maybe… they just want to humiliate themselves at the Carnevale. Haha, that’d be top-shelf entertainment!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_73_6: Just wait. Once the Order hands down their verdict, the Montellis’ so-called glory days will be over.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_74_1: A Lycoris petal lies on the ground, emanating an ominous aura...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_74_2: You vaguely remember seeing this kind of flower before...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_75_1: A private gathering is currently underway ahead, and entry is restricted to members of the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_76_1: Greetings, esteemed guest. There is a private gathering underway ahead, and entry is restricted to members of the Order. We apologize for any inconvenience.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_76_2: The Primus is currently unavailable for an audience. If you have matters requiring the Order’s consideration, please consult with Priest Alessio.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_76_3: Should you wish to enter the Cathedral of Mercury, please proceed through the main door.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_1: Before you stands a man clad in pure white—or rather, a hologram of him—and his grand throne.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_2: Though merely a projection, there is an undeniable gravity and majesty to his presence.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_3: This must be Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep, just as Priest Alessio described.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_4: From what you’ve gathered and experienced, it seems clear that he is the Resonator of the Sentinel, Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_5: You take a moment to study his figure. A golden mask conceals half of his face, while the other half reveals a deep furrow in his brow. His gaze lowered, carrying an unreadable expression. What lies behind it? Compassion? Or perhaps something deeper, such as... an unspeakable grief?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_6: Why would he leave this projection in the Cathedral?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_9: (Or simply to impress, because it looks… cool?)
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_10: As you mull over these questions, a sudden chill creeps over you. For a fleeting moment, you feel as if his gaze has shifted, directed straight at you. But when you look again, his face is unchanged.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_11: Was it an illusion? You can’t be sure. But for now, you’d best focus on tracking down the channel Gilberto used to make his escape.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_78_1: Was that… Mr. Gilberto from the Fisalia family? Why was he in such a rush?
Main_Linaxita_2_1_78_2: The way he went, looks like he’s off to"seek forgiveness."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_78_3: Ah, may the Sentinel guide him to "salvation"…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_79_1: I don’t think I’ve seen these two before. Judging by their outfits… they don’t really look like the Order’s followers.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_79_2: Probably some guests invited by Priest Alessio. Can’t put our fingers on the higher-ups’ business, anyway.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_79_3: That’s true. Under the Sentinel’s sheltering wing, we’re all kin as long as we walk in righteousness.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_79_4: But if they break the rules… well, that’s a different story.

WDSXD_17_2: I'd still be dozing out in the wild if it weren't for your help.
WDSXD_17_4: I stocked up on all these supplies back when I used to worry too much, but I don't need them anymore.
WDSXD_17_5: Now that I'm joining the Pioneer Association, it's time to gather my courage and face the unknown!
WDSXD_18_1: Ah, it's you—the strongest in the world!
WDSXD_18_2: Since you're here, take these suppliers. They were meant for my special training, but I no longer need them. Thanks to you, I've realized how limited my strength alone is.
WDSXD_18_3: But with my brothers by my side, I bet even someone as tough as you won't be able to take us down in one go, haha!
WDSXD_18_4: I can't wait to join the Pioneer Association!
WDSXD_19_2: Thanks for helping me organize those pages earlier. Please accept these rewards.
WDSXD_19_3: There should be more, but I can't remember where I left them. I hope you don't mind.
WDSXD_19_4: Now that my brothers are here, I can leave the management to Fratellone!
WDSXD_19_5: Anyway, we'll definitely join the Pioneer Association! Your support won't go in vain!
WDSXD_20_2: We were just chatting and realized you've actually lent a hand to all three of us!
WDSXD_20_3: Yeah! You are on fire! No wonder you're the strongest in the world!
WDSXD_20_6: Well, I need more than just compliments.
WDSXD_20_7: Such modesty! Joining the Pioneer Association is a dream come true, and you've helped us so much! We'll thank you properly for sure!
WDSXD_20_8: Of course! Joining the Pioneer Association is a dream come true, and you've helped us so much! We'll thank you properly for sure!
WDSXD_20_9: The strongest deserves the finest! We'll give you something blazing!
WDSXD_20_10: Hear hear! We're planning to commission a <color=Highlight>statue</color> in your honor, and it will be placed right here!
WDSXD_20_11: Alright, hit us with your coolest pose!
WDSXD_21_1: Ah... here you are. L-look at the "statue" we prepared for you! Hahaha...
WDSXD_21_2: This isn't a statue at all.
WDSXD_21_3: It was supposed to be a statue, but, well, something went a little wrong.
WDSXD_21_4: After the stone arrived, I was worried someone would steal it, so I stayed here and had Fratello deliver your portrait to the sculptor.
WDSXD_21_5: That's right. I almost ran my life out delivering it, and then... I got lost! Haha!
WDSXD_21_6: I figured Fratello was lost when he didn't come back, so I grabbed the backup portrait and went to find the sculptor.
WDSXD_21_7: But I dropped the portrait somewhere along the way...
WDSXD_21_8: With the stone gone, we had no choice but to use the commission fee to buy a projector and display your pose here instead.
WDSXD_21_12: Well, we spent all of our savings on this, so making a new statue might be a bit too much to handle...
WDSXD_21_13: Or maybe we should put our plan to join the Pioneer Association on hold for now and focus on saving up!
WDSXD_21_14: If everything goes smoothly, we should have enough money in three or four years to build your statue!
WDSXD_21_16: Thank you for your understanding, haha.
WDSXD_21_17: Now, if you'll excuse us, we're heading off to the Association. Till we meet again!
WDSXD_22_1: Oh, it's you. What can I do for you?
WDSXD_22_2: Why do you want to join the Pioneer Association?
WDSXD_22_3: Me? Honestly, I don't want to. I can't stand the uncertainty it may bring. But since my two reckless brothers insist on joining, I have to follow.
WDSXD_22_4: I don't understand why people in the Association wander all over the world—places without the Sentinel's blessings are far too dangerous to venture into.
WDSXD_22_5: It's natural to be curious about the world.
WDSXD_22_6: Maybe you'll get it after you join them.
WDSXD_22_7: Curiosity is natural, but so is the instinct to avoid dangers. I just want my brothers to be safe.
WDSXD_22_8: I'm not that interested. I just want my brothers to stay safe.
WDSXD_23_1: Oh, do you need something from me?
WDSXD_23_3: Of course! My training never stops, not even for a moment!
WDSXD_23_4: Just wait and see. One day, I'll become the strongest in the world!
WDSXD_24_1: Hey, lifesaver! Is there something else you need?
WDSXD_24_2: Why do you want to join the Pioneer Association?
WDSXD_24_3: Well, don't tell anyone, but I suspect the Order has something to do with the Dark Tide!
WDSXD_24_4: At first, it was just a feeling, but the more I dig through these unofficial records, the more suspicious it looks.
WDSXD_24_5: It seems like someone's been fueling the chaos, using the Dark Tide to keep us terrified... and it's clear that the Order stands to benefit the most from it!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_148_3: Curse those monsters... curse the Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_148_4: I... will carry on... Teacher's wish... to the very end.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_1: The explorers have retrieved a sword from the sea of clouds, along with the remains of an Acolyte, likely one lost to the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_2: The sword appears to be an artifact passed down by our sages. Judging by its form, it seems crafted not for combat but for Carnevale rituals.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_3: I suspect it may have once belonged to a Primus. Regrettably, all records of this sword were lost to the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_1: In honor of the Acolyte who once safeguarded this relic, we've decided to place it in a small chapel untouched by the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_2: The chapel stands beneath the cliffside, near the remnants of the broken bridge. It should be easy to find.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_3: We've stored the relic in the bell tower, with the hope that future pilgrims will remember and honor its presence here.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_1: An ancient stone tablet worn by the passage of time. It bears inscriptions in the ancient Rinascita language, faintly legible. A prophecy, perhaps.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_2: "Once whole... the Divinity was rent by warring creeds..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_3: "From Their holy wounds... sprang the curse of Dark Tide..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_4: "Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure... the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_5: "On the grandest of days... the maiden, crowned with golden laurel... shall commune with the Divinity..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_6: "Thus she becomes the prophesied 'Enlightened One'... through whom Rinascita's woes shall end..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_7: "Then... the Divinity shall return to its true form..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_8: "and Rinascita, under its glory... shall be a paradise free of suffering..."
