Quest_159900015_QuestDesc_159_1:
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos... he beseeched the Laureate for help.
Side_LGNPZ_1_1: Here you are! Actually, I've come to ask you for a favor today...
Side_LGNPZ_1_2: The deadline for the new issue of Wutherium Film Studio's publication is approaching, and this time, we plan to capitalize on a trending topic.
Side_LGNPZ_1_5: Oh! No need to be modest, of course it's about you—the latest Laureate in Ragunna!
Side_LGNPZ_1_6: Of course, you are the latest Laureate in Ragunna after all!
Side_LGNPZ_1_7: As you know, publishing is tough these days, and if sales keep lagging, headquarters will probably cut our budget again.
Side_LGNPZ_1_8: We've been following your work in Ragunna and thought if you, the Laureate, photographed a travelogue of Ragunna, it would surely be a hit!
Side_LGNPZ_1_9: So we'd like to commission you to take a series of photos for this issue to help boost sales.
Side_LGNPZ_1_10: Any profit from this will go entirely to you. Please, we're counting on you!
Side_LGNPZ_1_12: All you have to do is ask.
Side_LGNPZ_1_13: Thank you so much! We've already set the coordinates for some of Ragunna's landmarks. I'll send them to you now!
Side_LGNPZ_2_4: What a perfect shot! Brilliant composition, exquisite colors!
Side_LGNPZ_2_5: Please, don't limit yourself to photography. What I mean is, your aesthetic should not be confined by the camera!
Side_LGNPZ_2_6: This is where my good partner comes in! Mr. C-MOSS! With your permission, it can capture the scenery you envision. Please, roam Ragunna freely and collect the scenes that speak to you.
Side_LGNPZ_2_7: Have you taken the first photo yet? Let me take a look!
Side_LGNPZ_3_1: Forward, the knight's mission is to move ahead... I understand.
Side_LGNPZ_3_2: But the knight's attire has been with me for half my life. Now, who can give meaning to the knight's path forward?
Side_LGNPZ_4_1: This land is no longer where I belong. If the art I seek is truly a sin beyond redemption, then... where should I go?
Side_LGNPZ_5_1: This is the final location for the last photo. Thank goodness you agreed to help — this issue will surely be the most brilliant since the magazine's inception!
Side_LGNPZ_5_2: But your story with Ragunna is still unfolding, and I truly look forward to witnessing more of your legacy here.
WDSXD_1_1: Ah...No! I can't fall asleep... Mmm...
WDSXD_1_3: I wanted to capture a Nightmare Cloud for research, but I accidentally got hit... Quick, use that to help me...
WDSXD_1_4: Oh no... the nightmare's about to start...
WDSXD_1_6: Go to those Nightmare Clouds... and then...
WDSXD_1_7: Capture one... give it to me...
WDSXD_2_1: Ugh, I think I had a really long nightmare...
WDSXD_2_2: Are you okay? What are you doing here?
WDSXD_2_3: Oh, hello! I'm Fratellone of the Fratellis. My two brothers and I are training to join the Pioneer Association.
WDSXD_2_4: I was hoping to prove myself by catching a Nightmare Cloud, but I got attacked instead. Thank you for helping me!
WDSXD_2_5: By the way, once my training is over, come visit me in Egla Town. I'll repay you properly!
WDSXD_2_7: What exactly is the Nightmare Cloud?
WDSXD_2_8: The elders say that Nightmare Clouds are formed by the murmurs of people lost in nightmares.
WDSXD_2_9: They're filled with all the frightful thoughts that appear in people's minds while they sleep.
WDSXD_2_10: I... I'm really nervous about joining the Pioneer Association. There are just so many unknowns ahead! But I'm also worried about my two younger brothers. That's why I need Nightmare Clouds to train my willpower!
WDSXD_2_11: The Pioneer Association isn't as dangerous as you think.
WDSXD_2_13: No way! Going to strange places and eating unfamiliar food—I get stomach cramps just thinking about it!
WDSXD_3_1: Ah, it's you! Wait... does that mean I got attacked again?
WDSXD_3_2: I wonder if someone like me really belongs in the Pioneer Association...
WDSXD_3_4: You can do it! You're already ahead of most people!
WDSXD_3_5: If you say so... I'll give it another shot!
WDSXD_4_1: It feels like I'm getting used to being saved by you lately...
WDSXD_4_3: You know, I think I dreamt through every single problem I might face after joining the Pioneer Association.
WDSXD_4_4: It feels like I've already had enough.
WDSXD_4_5: But you haven't even joined yet!
WDSXD_4_6: Come on, Fratellone! You've got this!
WDSXD_4_7: Alright, since you say so, I'll keep pushing forward!
WDSXD_5_2: Looks like you slept pretty well, huh?
WDSXD_5_3: Yeah, seems like the Nightmare Clouds can't give me bad dreams anymore.
WDSXD_5_4: Maybe I've already had all my nightmares?
WDSXD_5_6: Can you actually run out of nightmares?
WDSXD_5_7: Haha, I'm heading back to Egla Town for a bit. Maybe we'll meet there! I still owe you a big thanks!
WDSXD_6_1: Ugh... if we get surrounded by the Plushie Squad... each of us would have to fight 1.3 Plushies...
WDSXD_6_2: Please, don't make me eat Baton Bread again! They're so dry and hard...
WDSXD_6_3: Nooo... don't pick me to be the Blessed Maiden — I don't want to wear a dress!
WDSXD_6_4: The Dark Tide! Fratellino, don't go skinny-dipping in the Dark Tide!
WDSXD_6_5: Wait, I have to fight Lorelei? Are you serious...
WDSXD_6_6: Boil the great dragon into soup? Spare me, please...
WDSXD_6_7: I thought we were heading to the Pioneer Association, not boarding the Pilgrim's Sail!
WDSXD_6_8: Stop making me take baths, Lord Tubpup... My skin's wrinkled...
Character_Cantarella_12_1: Welcome. Would you like to reach for the brightest star in the sky, or indulge in the greatest joy of the mortal world?
Character_Cantarella_12_2: Or maybe… nothing could ever satisfy your endless desire?
Character_Cantarella_12_3: Always so playful, Mammon. Unfortunately, my friend here isn't driven by greed.
Character_Cantarella_12_4: All we seek is the first riddle of the "ghost girl" to set the tone for tonight. After all, even the smallest catch can serve as a splendid entrée for a grand feast.
Character_Cantarella_12_5: I see, but nothing comes for free. If you want it, you'll have to trade me something entertaining.
Character_Cantarella_12_6: Perhaps a loaf of bread that speaks, oil that melts into water, or... a glimpse into Fisalia's hidden past.
Character_Cantarella_12_7: How about a special performance from a Laureate?
Character_Cantarella_12_8: Oh, just for me? That would be an honor I'd truly relish.
Character_Cantarella_5_1: What a pleasure to meet you again, {PlayerName}.
Character_Cantarella_6_1: Offer your soul, surrender your flesh. Give all you have, call the lost from their rest...
Character_Cantarella_6_3: Oh, sorry. Forgive me if it unsettles you. It's an old folk song about the Night of Remembrance. They say its eerie melody has a strange frequency that can draw the attention of ravenous "demons."
Character_Cantarella_6_4: Ah… I can feel it now. There it is—the first stall.
Character_Cantarella_6_5: Cantarella steps forward with unwavering certainty, her movement ethereal, drifting like a ghost. At this moment, she seems capable of summoning demons herself. Without hesitation, you follow her lead.
Character_Cantarella_7_1: Will the lost souls truly return home?
Character_Cantarella_7_3: Sometimes, it feels like they actually return to us on the Night of Remembrance.
Character_Cantarella_7_4: Yes, but only on this special night...

WDSXD_10_1: You've shattered my record like it was nothing!
WDSXD_10_2: Hahaha! I see, I still need to burn brighter!
WDSXD_10_3: Just you wait, world's strongest for now! I'll be back!
WDSXD_11_1: As expected, I still have a long way to go.
WDSXD_11_2: Am I getting ahead of myself? I encouraged my brothers to join the Pioneer Association, yet I lack the strength to protect them from danger...

WDSXD_11_6: How enlightening! I'd say you're not just the strongest, but also the smartest. I'll head back to Egla Town to meet my brothers. See you!

InfoDisplay_311000009_Text: Bloom Bearer Field Report No. 10826 Authored by: Ariosto Attention Rinascita-based Bloom Bearers: Please follow the advice below in the interest of your safe being. Failure to do so may result in unpleasant repercussions. 1. Rinascita has no center of politics, instead a collection of city-states governs the region. The southern coastal city of Ragunna is the recommended port of entry for Black Shores Bloom Bearers. The "Stormy Sea" between Black Shores and Rinascita is treacherous, exercise extreme caution. Stay on the approved navigation route. If found to be deviating, correct course at once. 2. Strange aquatic TDs inhabit the Stormy Sea. Our current understanding of them is limited as they appear incapable of coherent thought. Do not interact, approach, or touch them. Take evasive action at once should one move towards your vessel. 3. Ragunna, a city-state by the sea, is the city with the strongest link to the Sentinel. This connection is maintained by the Order of the Deep, an organization claiming to act as the Sentinel's representative. The citizens of Ragunna equate Sentinel Imperator to "god," and have erected numerous statues in Their image. Bow and lower your gaze when in the presence of such statues. Do not stare at any one statue for over 30 seconds. 4. Ragunna has one cardinal rule regarding pizza: it does not, and will never, tolerate crownapple topping. Do NOT in any circumstance, add crownapple or gemberry to any pizza served at a Ragunnesi restaurant. This rule must—and I repeat—must be adhered to. Comments Comment 1: I knew sending you to investigate the Somnoire was a mistake! If I read another useless do's and don'ts listicle you'll be re-writing the whole thing. And say goodbye to your performance bonus! Posted by: Mistman Comment 2: Living by the sea… Do the Ragunnesi eat rice from a coral bowl? Posted by: SheepGoBaah Everything I've shared above is based on firsthand experience—gathered by shedding blood, sweat, and tears! In all seriousness. Other than its Common Echoes, the city of Ragunna is also renowned for its "faith" centered around the Sentinel, reinforced via mythologies created by The Order of the Deep to justify the post-lament state of affairs. Personally, I find their mythologies not entirely baseless, as the worldviews espoused are similar to that of the Tethys System. The first inhabitants of Rinascita were refugees displaced by the Lament and Waveworn disasters. Guided by the Sentinel to settle in Rinascita, these refugees were of vastly different backgrounds, cultures, and ideologies. Ragunna's religious and political systems were likely structured around a unifying mono-faith to increase civil cohesion. I encourage Bloom Bearers to approach Ragunna's many rituals and customs with a critical but open mind. I was born in Rinascita, but after years with the Black Shores, upon my return, the change was far greater than I had anticipated. Most notably, the Order now holds absolute authority in Ragunna. I advise all Bloom Bearers to maintain cordial relations with the Order, respect their rules, and avoid confrontation. Given the Order's current stance towards the Black Shores, Bloom Bearers must exercise utmost discretion while in Ragunna, To help Bloom Bearers earn the trust of Order members, I've compiled a few useful examples of how to phrase sentences so they resemble clauses from their Codex. Let me demonstrate: -Oh, mighty lord in black, the founder and ruler of the Black Shores! May I one day be worthy of your talents and devote myself fully to your service! -Greedy KU-Money, reflect upon the error of your ways before the lord's altar and seek redemption. -Praise to Shorekeeper, Guardian of the Black Shores! Your starlight scatters the darkness and banishes all evil. With your light to guide us, we are delivered to salvation! Comments Comment 1: Even if you said that, I do not accept a delay in the report. Posted by: Shorekeeper

Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_13: What the... who are all these people?!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_14: I think I must be hallucinating.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_15: Huh? Now that you mention it, I'm feeling a bit dizzy too, and my heart won't stop racing.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_16: Maybe skip the special ingredients next time?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_17: I'm terribly sorry! It won't happen again!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_1: Sorry, I'm afraid there's no taste test today.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_3: I did! Today was supposed to be Margherita Pizza, but...
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_6: Are you sure? Okay… don't say I didn't warn you.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_7: What lies before you can barely be called a pizza. Most of its surface is charred, with only a few spots that look remotely edible.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_8: Carefully, you break off a piece that looks safe and take a bite.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_12: I know you're just being kind. It's all right. I won't let this stop me from trying again.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_13: It's all my fault. All these good ingredients have gone to waste.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_14: Guess I still need more practice with Bakie. I left it in for too long this time.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_16: Maybe set a timer next time?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_17: Got it. I'll take note of the cooking time for every single dish.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_18: A timer sounds like a good idea. I always get distracted watching the fire and overcook the food.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_19: From now on, my goal is to master the art of not burning the food!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_20: Shouldn't you try to aim a little higher?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_1: Good to see you! I tried out a family recipe today.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_3: What do you have in store for me today?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_4: Papa used to make this for me when I was little, and I wanted to recreate those flavors. It's called Sweet and Tangy Risotto. Let me know what you think!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_5: You take a bite of the steaming risotto, feeling like you've swallowed a ball of flames. A searing, intense heat ignites your mouth.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_6: Um… your face is turning red. Are you alright?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_9: Oh no! I mixed up the gemberry jam with chili sauce!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_7_10: Be careful about mixing up your sugar and salt next time, alright?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_1: Hello... um... I made this new dish. Would you like to try it?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_4: It's just that… I've messed up so many times. I was afraid to disappoint you again.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_6: No harm in one more try.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_7: I experimented with so many recipes, but never truly committed to any of them. Maybe it's time to go back to where I began.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_8: I put my whole heart into this Nuvola Pasta. Please give it a try.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_11: The soft noodles, velvety sauce, and subtle aroma work together so well that you can't resist taking another bite.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_12: Um, well? If you don't like it, I can always try again.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_15: Oh, thank the Sentinel! I really thought I ruined it again!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_17: It's all thanks to your support and guidance! But I just realized I've never even asked about your food preferences...
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_18: What do you usually go for?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_8_23: I'll keep that in mind. Maybe I could cook for you again sometime?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_1: I've been waiting for you. The dish I made should be just to your liking.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_3: Let's see if your cooking has improved.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_4: Umm, before you start, there's something I need to say. This is not to test my skills, but...
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_7: Thank you for being there as I learned to cook. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have come this far.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_8: It's all thanks to your own effort.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_9: Then pay me back with delicious food.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_11: Each layer of the soft, flaky pastry blends with sweet fruit jam, filling the air with a delightful aroma. You savor every bite of the mille-feuille.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_12: How does it taste? I was a bit heavy-handed with the sugar, so I hope it's not too sweet.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_13: It's just sweet enough. It tastes amazing!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_14: Do you have more? I could eat a whole tray of this.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_15: Great! I think I'm finally starting to get the hang of it!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_16: Maybe you should consider becoming a chef here.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_17: Me, a chef? I only started as a server not long ago.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_18: You have the skills for it.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_19: You have the passion for it.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_20: You've always been so supportive. Alright, I'll give it some thought.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_9_21: I want my food to make people smile and deliver joy in every bite.

LGNCZST_145_1: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
LGNCZST_145_2: No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your parcels!
LGNCZST_16_1: Hey, have you heard of the Fool's Troupe that sails across the sea? Haha, well, that's us!
LGNCZST_16_2: We're not after treasure—we're here to steal... your joyful laughter!
LGNCZST_17_1: I've made up my mind—I will call you Pero from now on.
LGNCZST_17_2: What? You say you're just an ordinary chest, and that name is already taken?
LGNCZST_17_3: Don't say that. My friend, you're anything but ordinary.
LGNCZST_18_1: Hey, get down! It's too dangerous!
LGNCZST_18_2: If you keep messing around, the Order Penitentiary will come and take you all away!
LGNCZST_22_1: The Carnevale is finally coming... which troupe will take home the Laurel this time I wonder?
LGNCZST_22_2: Hmph, if I were that old lord, I would never allow my daughter to marry the son of my enemy... I'd rather stay on a deserted island.
LGNCZST_22_3: Why are you still going on about a performance from ten years ago? What are you trying to say?
LGNCZST_22_4: If I remember correctly, you were the first to agree to Silvia marrying that young lad, weren't you?
LGNCZST_43_2: You're lying! How can you prove it?
LGNCZST_43_3: My mom gave it to me...
LGNCZST_43_7: I-I don't want it anymore! Take it!
LGNCZST_6_1: Isn't the Carnevale coming up soon? I just passed by Gondola Market and saw lots of exotic flowers and decorations there.
LGNCZST_6_2: I'm going to decorate our windowsill nicely for the festival this time.
LGNCZST_6_3: I heard that this year's Carnevale is being organized entirely by the Montellis.
LGNCZST_6_4: No wonder there are so many imports in the market. The Montelli family has money to spare and trade routes everywhere. Only they could pull off such a huge event.
LGNCZST_6_5: My little Pietro just started at Averardo, and after only two days, he came home saying that the Montelli family had a hand in all of Ragunna's trade, both imports and exports.
LGNCZST_6_6: Pietro really knows it all! He's so lucky to have a perfect job. Shame that his childhood friend, Gavino, hasn't been as fortunate.
LGNCZST_6_8: Did you know he joined an underground troupe some time ago? He got arrested by the Order Penitentiary recently, so he might be heading to the Pilgrim's Sail soon.
LGNCZST_6_9: Poor boy... I hope he can clear his name and return repented.
LGNCZST_6_10: Sentinel's grace, Giovanna! Please don't say that. Gavino is a good child, and there is no sin in him.
LGNCZST_61_1: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
LGNCZST_61_2: No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your shipments!
LGNCZST_61_3: Look at these freeze dried jerkies—fresh from Rinascita to Huanglong. Kitties in Jinzhou love it!
LGNCZST_61_4: Huh? Isn't that a Hound? Why would a Hound be called "Kitty"?
LGNCZST_61_5: Uh... well... that's not the point here!
LGNCZST_61_6: The point is, how can a Hound be called Kitty? Kitty is clearly a name for a cat—it must be a misdelivery.
LGNCZST_61_7: Right! This goes against common sense. Is Lollo Logistics really reliable?
LGNCZST_61_8: Exactly! By this logic, Lollo Logistics should be renamed to "Chichi Logistics."
LGNCZST_61_10: See, the Lollo Logistics mascot is a hamster! Hamsters don't go "lo-lo-lo," they go "chi-chi-chi"!
LGNCZST_61_11: Well... I can explain! Everyone, let me explain!
LGNCZST_61_12: When a hamster's cheeks are full of food, it makes a "lo-lo" sound.
LGNCZST_61_13: And do you see the deep pockets on our vests? They're super spacious, and super efficient!
LGNCZST_61_14: No matter how oddly shaped the shipment, Lollo Logistics can "swallow it whole!"
LGNCZST_61_15: So, in summary, if you need courier services, Lollo Logistics is the way to go!
LGNCZST_80_1: I feel like I've seen that "Drama Maniac" from Egla Town somewhere before...
LGNCZST_80_2: He's a bit odd... but his stories about the Fool's Troupe are rather captivating!
LGNCZST_80_3: Eccentric Roccia the First Mate, free-spirited Captain Brant...
LGNCZST_80_4: Batti, don't you think the "Drama Maniac" looks a lot like Uncle Lorenzo?
LGNCZST_80_5: But his hair color is different, his clothes have a different style, and he wears a mask, so you can't see his face...
LGNCZST_80_6: But when he performs, his gaze always drifts toward us.
LGNCZST_80_7: Almost as if he's telling the story for our sake...
LGNCZST_80_8: Uncle Lorenzo went on a pilgrimage, didn't he... The adults looked so strange when he left.
LGNCZST_80_9: So I haven't dared mention this to Gisle—just hearing Uncle Lorenzo's name makes him sad.
LGNCZST_80_10: How about... we investigate it ourselves!
LGNCZST_80_12: I bet a Monnaie he's not Uncle Lorenzo!
LGNCZST_1_1: "You are the best thing that's ever happened to me."
LGNCZST_1_2: "You get my heart racing and give me butterflies."
LGNCZST_1_4: Oh, sorry! I was just practicing for a romantic confession.
LGNCZST_1_5: What do you think of those lines?
LGNCZST_1_7: Oh, my word. That's absolutely it! You must be someone who really knows their romantic talk. Please, give me some tips!
LGNCZST_1_10: "I tried to pluck two stars from the sky for you, only to find they were nowhere near as bright as your eyes."
LGNCZST_1_11: Much better, but still too cliché.
LGNCZST_1_12: Cliché? So you're saying I should make my confession feel like it's tailor-made for my love?
LGNCZST_1_13: Yep. And don't forget that trick with the eyes.
LGNCZST_1_15: "{PlayerName}, you always glide past me, yet seem more distant than the moon itself."
LGNCZST_1_16: "I yearn for tomorrow to bring you back, yet you remain unaware that my tomorrows fade into shadow without you."
LGNCZST_1_17: Not bad. It sounded like you meant it.
LGNCZST_1_18: "I wove webs to tighten the bond between our souls, only to end up ensnaring myself."
LGNCZST_1_19: "At this very moment, your fleeting words intensify my pain while granting me a brief, sweet happiness."
LGNCZST_1_20: Err. I think that's enough... You're doing great.
LGNCZST_1_21: "Go ahead and mock my recklessness, for I want to kiss your heart and leave my mark on your chest."
LGNCZST_1_22: "I want to breathe in the fragrance between your fingers, reaching right into your heart's desires."
LGNCZST_102_1: O sacred waters... reveal to me the path of my destiny...
LGNCZST_103_1: O sacred waters... reveal to me the path of my destiny...
LGNCZST_103_2: Is this where I can try water divination?
LGNCZST_103_3: What's so interesting about this well water, anyway?
LGNCZST_103_4: Of course! Ah, you must be here for the famous "Arito Well," right? They say it's as ancient as the Rinascita Archipelagos themselves.
LGNCZST_103_5: Oh, there's more to it than meets the eye. They say it's as ancient as the Rinascita Archipelagos themselves.
LGNCZST_103_6: The well was once blessed by the Sentinel. Back when Ragunna City was founded, people used to get their fresh water from it. There are also legends that say the well is bottomless, which connects to the depths of the ocean...
LGNCZST_103_7: Although Ragunna's freshwater woes are a thing of the past, the well's power wasn't withdrawn by the Sentinel.
LGNCZST_103_8: People still visit to honor the Sentinel, and over time, Ragunnans discovered another of its mystical powers—
LGNCZST_103_9: Toss in a Monnaie, and ask a question with a sincere heart, and you will get the answer that you need: be it the telling of your future or the truth of your past you seek.
LGNCZST_103_10: But bear this in mind—never use the well to pry into forbidden matters. Someone did this once and the well's waters turned black as night, flooding all of Ragunna's streets!
LGNCZST_103_11: Thus was the sea's retribution against humanity for defiling the sacred waters—Oh, my Sentinel, I must refrain from such emotions. Must keep a peaceful mind...
LGNCZST_103_12: O sacred waters, tell me—will today be a good day for a little slacking off at work?
LGNCZST_103_14: Oh no, it's my boss! Looks like they caught on to me sneaking out of the shop! Maybe today really isn't a good day to slack off...
LGNCZST_103_15: Arito Well, isn't it amazing? Haha...
LGNCZST_104_1: Sacred water... please listen to my confession...
LGNCZST_105_1: Sacred water... please listen to my confession...
LGNCZST_105_2: Are you here for a divination again today?
LGNCZST_105_4: Shh... I didn't come here for fortune-telling. After that day, I had an epiphany from that brief experience with water divination...
LGNCZST_105_5: If water divination is so accurate, revealing all uncertainties and leading them to definite outcomes...
LGNCZST_105_6: Then, as long as I don't divine, I exist in a superposition of getting caught slacking and not getting caught... my fate, is forever undetermined...
LGNCZST_105_7: Divination reveals your fate. It cannot change it.
LGNCZST_105_8: I think you might have a point.
LGNCZST_105_9: Oh, taking a little lazy break never hurt anyone!
LGNCZST_105_10: If you wish to perform water divination, simply toss a Monnaie into the sacred well and silently ask your question with a devout heart.
LGNCZST_105_11: They say good things will happen if you come for divination daily. Perhaps this is also a form of blessing for the pious from the Sentinel.
LGNCZST_15_1: Thief! Pickpocket! You should be ashamed of what you did!
LGNCZST_15_2: Ah, an Acolyte from the Order Penitentiary! You are just in time—take this urchin and throw her onto the Pilgrim's Sail! She tried to steal my pocket watch!
LGNCZST_15_3: Sir, please, calm down. The Pilgrim's Sail is for people of false faith to seek repentance.
LGNCZST_15_4: This child is no heretic, so she can't be banished.
LGNCZST_15_5: Is the Order covering for criminals now?!
LGNCZST_15_6: No, you misunderstood. Theft falls under the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Discipline, but since she is a minor, I believe it would be more appropriate for the Chamber of Enlightenment to handle her case.
LGNCZST_15_7: Child, tell me why you stole. Do you need help?
LGNCZST_15_8: No! I want to go on the Pilgrim's Sail! I'm a heretic! I'm a bad kid who stole for no good reason! Mr. Acolyte, please arrest me!
LGNCZST_15_9: But child... do you really understand what it means to be a heretic?
LGNCZST_15_11: See? I know you are not one.
LGNCZST_15_12: Wait! I have to board the Pilgrim's Sail to find my brother! He was banished!
LGNCZST_15_13: Banished? You've misunderstood the purpose of the Pilgrim's Sail... Listen, you will be rewarded for your patience.
LGNCZST_15_14: Just stay home and wait, and stop making poor choices. If you behave... he may return safely from his pilgrimage.
LGNCZST_19_1: {Male=Mister;Female=Miss}, take it. I don't need it anymore.
LGNCZST_19_3: Toss it into the well, it'll tell you if things will go well or not.
LGNCZST_19_4: I've tried many times, but the results about Dad are always bad... When will he come home?
LGNCZST_19_6: A few months ago, he boarded the great pilgrim ship to visit the Sentinel at sea.
LGNCZST_19_7: Isn't this something to be proud of? Why does Mom always look so sad whenever she mentions it?
LGNCZST_20_1: I wonder... when will Dad return from the pilgrimage?
LGNCZST_23_1: Underground troupes put on such amazing performances... it's just a shame that I can't catch them every time...
LGNCZST_23_3: Curious? Shh... Can't let the Order hear this.
LGNCZST_23_4: Ever since the current Primus, Fenrico, took over the Order, many plays have been banned. All performances must be approved, or else you risk being arrested.
LGNCZST_23_5: In response, the dissatisfied have secretly formed underground troupes to perform classic plays and create new ones freely, as they did in the past.
LGNCZST_23_6: Liberty Square serves as the stage for these impromptu performances; they often start without warning and quickly pack up before the Acolytes arrive.
LGNCZST_23_7: Are there many of these troupes?
LGNCZST_23_8: Oh, there are plenty of them of all kinds, to the point where rumors say that the Montelli family sponsors them.
LGNCZST_23_9: Are there any particularly interesting troupes?
LGNCZST_23_10: Absolutely! Among these underground troupes, my favorite—and the one I want to join—is the Mourning Theater, whose motto is "Chasing Romance and Love in Ordinary Life."
LGNCZST_23_11: There's also a mysterious underground troupe called "Avon," whose members can create projections with their words. However, it's rumored that they've been banished for breaking the taboo.
LGNCZST_24_1: We can't afford to mess up at such a crucial moment... Is the film reel misaligned?
LGNCZST_24_3: Oh, as you can see, I'm adjusting the photography equipment. The entire studio is preparing for the long-awaited Carnevale after ten years.
LGNCZST_24_4: Many of these were transported through Lollo Logistics with the Montelli family's help. I heard cutting-edge photography equipment from the New Federation is on its way too.
LGNCZST_24_6: That must cost a lot, right?
LGNCZST_24_7: This is a first for me as well... In any case, the Pioneer Association will capture this milestone festival with the most perfect imagery.
LGNCZST_24_8: Haha, well, money shouldn't be an issue for the Montellis...
LGNCZST_24_9: In any case, the Pioneer Association will capture this milestone festival with the most perfect imagery.
LGNCZST_29_1: Hello, young one. Is there something you need help with?
LGNCZST_29_3: Thanks to the Order and Imperator's grace, La Guardia is here to protect us when needed.
LGNCZST_29_4: I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to poor villagers, which is why this one is with me.
LGNCZST_29_5: If you need help from the Order in Ragunna or seek Imperator's guidance, just look for La Guardia like this one.
LGNCZST_29_6: They also bear Imperator's blessings, as indicated by the halo above their heads, which is a mark of the Order.
LGNCZST_30_1: These children are still too young to understand that these Echoes are blessings from Imperator.
LGNCZST_30_2: Ragunna's unity today relies on the assistance of these Common Echoes.
LGNCZST_30_4: Children see a Mercurio and think it's just that—a toy.
LGNCZST_30_6: If we don't treat them as family and friends, how can we expect Imperator's mercy?
LGNCZST_30_7: So please, stop riding on it...
LGNCZST_58_1: Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
LGNCZST_58_3: I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
LGNCZST_58_4: Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
LGNCZST_58_5: I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
LGNCZST_58_6: So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
LGNCZST_58_9: No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
LGNCZST_58_10: You think I'm joking, don't you?
LGNCZST_58_11: Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
LGNCZST_58_12: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
LGNCZST_58_14: If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
LGNCZST_58_15: But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
LGNCZST_58_16: You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!
LGNCZST_66_1: How do you reveal your feelings for someone in a way that's romantic yet sincere...
LGNCZST_66_2: Lady Rita still waits for my confession... Oh, the torment of love!
LGNCZST_69_2: Now this... this is true theater—
LGNCZST_7_1: The rainy season in Ragunna seems to drag on longer every year... Ugh, how much longer do I have to sort through these soaked goods?
LGNCZST_7_2: Are you looking to buy something? Ugh, look at me, getting ahead of myself! No one's going to want these now that they look like garbage.
LGNCZST_7_3: Is this because of the rainy season?
LGNCZST_7_4: Yeah. But you haven't seen the worst. There was a year when the rising seawater flooded the main streets of the city, nearly up to my waist.
LGNCZST_7_5: Many Gondolas got stuck in the streets, and we spent two sleepless nights trying to salvage the soaked goods.
LGNCZST_7_6: Did you not receive any help?
LGNCZST_7_8: Surprisingly, the Order and the nobles sent out a fleet of Gondolas to rescue those in the lowlands, taking them to higher ground in the Order and Fisalia district for shelter.
LGNCZST_7_9: That was the first time I saw the usually quiet Fisalia district so lively. Even though they acted all high and mighty, they still did their best to help.
LGNCZST_7_11: Yeah, after that, I realized that some people from Fisalia can seem tough on the outside but are actually kind-hearted. They're not as malicious as we often think.
LGNCZST_8_1: Maybe adding a bit more crimson here will make it look fancier. But... would it still perfectly highlight my style?
LGNCZST_8_2: Hmm... what can I do to make it more interesting?
LGNCZST_8_4: My costume and mask designs were rejected by the Masked Reverie. Nyarla is so harsh...
LGNCZST_8_5: You see, it's utterly disrespectful to attend the Carnevale without the perfect outfit.
LGNCZST_8_6: Besides, I have to dress to impress so that my handsome face leaves a lasting impression on everyone.
LGNCZST_8_8: She said that simply having Shell Credits isn't enough to make someone a customer at her shop.
LGNCZST_8_9: She requires an engaging character and extraordinary artistic vision to spark her creative passion.
LGNCZST_8_10: My my... all those harsh words. She was implying that I was too ordinary for her taste!
LGNCZST_8_11: Why don't you try another shop?
LGNCZST_8_12: No way! Nyarla is the best, and no one has her eye for detail! If I go to someone else for a custom design, I'd be at a disadvantage before the Carnevale even begins!
LGNCZST_8_13: She gave me a ton of feedback on the character designs and style guides. Just wait and see—I'll find a way to impress her!
LGNCZST_9_1: One day, you'll see that my mind is much more profound than those who just know how to put on a show.

LGNCZST_49_9: I... I have a family to feed.
LGNCZST_49_10: Amedeo, forget it, forget you saw those words.
LGNCZST_49_11: Is there anything I can do to help?
LGNCZST_49_12: O merciful Imperator, I have fallen into the depths of unforgivable sin...
LGNCZST_49_13: Forgive my family, forgive this innocent stranger!
LGNCZST_59_1: Yes, good sir, Lollo Logistics is a trustworthy business partner.
LGNCZST_59_2: We excel in confidentiality, timeliness, and security.
LGNCZST_59_3: Yes, I understand your concerns. Data shows that Lollo Logistics has the lowest cargo damage rate in the industry for international shipping.
LGNCZST_59_4: Averardo Bank has increased the insurance coverage for your collection by 40 million Shell Credits. What do you think?
LGNCZST_59_5: I'm pleased you accepted our proposal. Looking forward to working with you, Lord Francois.
LGNCZST_60_1: Some of your business jargon confuses me.
LGNCZST_60_2: Feel free to ask me anything!
LGNCZST_60_3: For example, what does "combination moves" mean? Does it refer to a self-defense technique used by your staff?
LGNCZST_60_4: Uh... here it refers to various measures working together to achieve a common goal.
LGNCZST_60_6: You can think of it as the level of detail... How do I put this... Right! Just like ground pepper—you can grind it to coarse or fine!
LGNCZST_60_7: Got it. Thank you for explaining. This "Maggie" fellow has a rather interesting way of putting things.
LGNCZST_60_8: Maggie...? Oh, oh! You mean my colleague, Maji!
LGNCZST_60_9: I'm quite interested in his work. I'd appreciate it if you could introduce me sometime.
LGNCZST_60_10: It would be my pleasure. I'll let him know.
LGNCZST_71_1: Hector, I'll grant you two days of free time in the Septimont.
LGNCZST_71_2: Return to Ragunna on time in two days and report to me at the bank.
LGNCZST_71_3: Aunt Joanne... you're drilling this into my ears...
LGNCZST_71_4: That's not how you address me! Mr. Hector.
LGNCZST_71_6: Before we set sail, you swore to Imperator.
LGNCZST_71_7: Hail Imperator. I, Hector, swear I'll never again bet on gladiator fights in the Septimont's underground casinos—
LGNCZST_71_8: Or let me perish at sea, never to return home!
LGNCZST_71_9: If you're going to perish, fine. But don't drag down your colleagues or the cargo; they've done nothing wrong.
LGNCZST_71_10: You can watch matches, but if I find you at the betting tables again—
LGNCZST_71_11: —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
LGNCZST_71_12: I promised your mother I'd take care of you. Don't make her shed any more tears.
LGNCZST_79_1: Hail Imperator, I wish to confess...
LGNCZST_79_2: I... accepted a Fisalia deal... deceiving a Montelli alongside him.
LGNCZST_79_3: I only wanted an "elixir" to save my beloved Lanishi.
LGNCZST_10_1: We will leave in ten minutes!
LGNCZST_10_4: Hi there! I'm Moriarty, an employee at Averardo Bank. The Echo train will be loaded in ten minutes, and I need to make sure these treasures get transported safely.
LGNCZST_10_5: You've probably seen those Echo trains gliding through the Nimbus Sanctum, right? They're responsible for delivering treasures for the Montelli family's bank and vault.
LGNCZST_10_6: But enough chit-chat! It's time for my prayer!
LGNCZST_10_7: Prayer? Are you part of the Order?
LGNCZST_10_8: Not exactly! I just pray that I get to record the song when we are in Nimbus Sanctum during this trip.
LGNCZST_10_10: Yeah! Sometimes when I'm riding through the Nimbus Sanctum, I can hear this beautiful song coming from the water.
LGNCZST_10_11: It's hauntingly sad, unlike anything I've ever heard, so I want to use my recording device to capture it for everyone to enjoy.
LGNCZST_10_12: But here's the thing: after the train leaves the Nimbus Sanctum, the song will just disappear, leaving only static noise in the recorder.
LGNCZST_10_13: I've been wondering lately... could it be that the Lorelei in Nimbus Sanctum doesn't want that song to be shared with more people?
LGNCZST_142_2: That bastard Barbosa made me count every old Monnaie sent to the vault.
LGNCZST_142_3: The more incompetent the boss, the more fragile their ego. I warned you not to go against him. He'll just make an example out of you.
LGNCZST_142_4: People in high positions care the most about saving faces. Show them attitudes, you only get a taste of your own medicine.
LGNCZST_142_5: But I do agree with you on one thing.
LGNCZST_28_1: If this keeps up, Averardo Vault will turn into an Averardo General Store.
LGNCZST_28_2: The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament, from New Federation—what kind of art is just a rusty tin can?
LGNCZST_28_3: The Scented Banana on the Wall, from Rinascita—this nearly rotting banana is taking up an entire wall!
LGNCZST_28_4: The Acolyte's Breakfast, from Rinascita—it's a safe...
LGNCZST_28_5: We're only responsible for storage. We can't judge their artistic value.
LGNCZST_28_6: But can these really be considered art? Maybe next time, I'll frame a leftover slice of pizza.
LGNCZST_28_8: If only I were an artist. Making money would be too easy.
LGNCZST_28_9: The pieces you mentioned are highly valued on the market. Please make sure you take good care of them.
LGNCZST_28_10: Remember to lower the storage room temperature for The Scented Banana on the Wall.
LGNCZST_32_2: What? Running low on cash, buddy?
LGNCZST_32_3: What's a few lousy coins? The real treasure is those delicate hands at the counter.
LGNCZST_32_4: Gold and jewels dance like silk across her fingers—so enticing.
LGNCZST_32_5: A charm is impossible to resist...
LGNCZST_32_6: I heard she's the youngest daughter of the Montelli family, future heiress to the bank.
LGNCZST_32_7: Whether she's a lady of Septimont or the Montelli heiress...
LGNCZST_32_8: This alluring treasure will be mine, one way or another.
LGNCZST_5_1: Argh... My feet are killing me from all the walking...
LGNCZST_5_2: Damn! You scared me! I thought I had run into my boss again.
LGNCZST_5_4: I'm just getting into work mode. Hello, I'm Francesca, a representative from Averardo Bank.
LGNCZST_5_5: What does a bank representative do?
LGNCZST_5_6: Well... in short, I evaluate and quote clients' collections on-site, then offer services related to collateral, insurance, and storage based on the appraised value.
LGNCZST_5_7: I know what you're going to ask next: yes, our bank stores more than just currency.
LGNCZST_5_8: From artwork to Echoes, we store anything that meets our valuation requirements. Once your assets are deemed valuable, they can be kept in Ragunna's safest place—Averardo Vault.
LGNCZST_5_9: But how do you value a piece of artwork?
LGNCZST_5_11: Art is subjective, and everyone interprets it differently, so there isn't a universal standard for measuring its value.
LGNCZST_5_12: Unfortunately, from the bank's perspective, we need to impose some universal criteria to assess them.
LGNCZST_5_13: The rarity, prominence, provenance, and history of a collection are key factors. Items with a story often receive a higher appraisal.
LGNCZST_5_14: I remember that the business began with currency operations. Maybe it started as just a hobby for Signore Francesco.
LGNCZST_5_15: I didn't expect Montelli to be so passionate about art.
LGNCZST_5_16: Well, Montelli's no longer motivated by passion alone.
LGNCZST_5_17: Analyzing the market flow of collectibles reveals clients' recent financial movements, which is crucial intelligence for the Montelli family.
LGNCZST_53_1: I'm so tired. My eyes can barely stay open...
LGNCZST_54_1: Phew... I've been busy all morning, and I still have to keep counting this afternoon. I need to pull myself together...
LGNCZST_54_2: Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. Zani.
LGNCZST_54_3: Tell Ms. Zani I said thank you.
LGNCZST_55_1: Hic... Hmph, without the Fisalia, where would Ragunna be today?
LGNCZST_55_2: What do they know? All I wanted was to reclaim everything... Hic! That belongs to me...
LGNCZST_55_3: So what if I had to take the low road and play dirty!
LGNCZST_55_4: Yet they kicked me out of the family and accused me of tarnishing Fisalia's reputation.
LGNCZST_55_5: But this time is different. I will find a way to win over the Montellis. I know I can do it!
LGNCZST_55_7: Already, no more drinks for you tonight.
LGNCZST_56_1: Francesca has discovered a batch of potential collectibles and provided an initial valuation.
LGNCZST_56_2: Among them is one item I believe will interest you.
LGNCZST_56_3: The clean and vibrant color palette is emblematic of the creator. All proceeds from the auction will be donated to the Order of the Deep.
LGNCZST_56_6: It's already arranged, Davi—I mean, anonymous buyer.
LGNCZST_2_1: Here are the ingredients you ordered. Do a run down and I just need you to sign here when you're ready.
LGNCZST_2_2: Giovanni's the one that usually handles our deliveries. How come he's not here today?
LGNCZST_2_3: Don't get me started. Giovanni got nailed in the back by a Tumbleyak at the ranch. Takes him forever to even get off the bed.
LGNCZST_2_4: Weird, the animals at Egla Ranch have gotten really frantic lately.
LGNCZST_2_5: Speaking of him, it just hit me—doesn't Rosemary's potion work really well for injuries?
LGNCZST_2_7: But I've heard she's a Fisalia...
LGNCZST_2_9: Ha, no wonder Giovanni didn't want to go see her by himself and wanted me to tag along...
LGNCZST_2_10: Don't worry. You have no reason to fear her. Rosemary is really nice, and not everyone from the Fisalia family is bad.
LGNCZST_25_1: Is your luggage all set up in your room? As your guide, let me share some important travel tips for Ragunna.
LGNCZST_25_2: Alright... Is this going to be about the Order and the Sentinel again?
LGNCZST_25_3: I won't cover that topic since you should already know it. This time, I'll focus on dining customs.
LGNCZST_25_4: Don't add ice to your espresso, don't use scissors to cut your pasta at the table, and definitely don't order cappuccino at dinner...
LGNCZST_25_6: And for Sentinel's sake, don't just eat the center of the pizza and leave the precious crust! The last person who did that ended up on the Pilgrim's Sail.
LGNCZST_25_8: I would never do that! Besides, is the consequence really that severe?
LGNCZST_25_9: There's a dish at the trattoria on the first floor of this hotel called Pizza Tropicale. Just remember, <color=red>it's called pizza, but it's definitely not one.</color>
LGNCZST_25_10: Once you leave that trattoria, don't mention it to any local. Even if someone asks, don't answer.
LGNCZST_3_1: Hi there! I'm Ulma, an inspector for the Mochelin Dining Guide, and I'm currently working on the Ragunna Food Guide.
LGNCZST_3_2: Whoa! Welcome! Welcome! Ragunna has an endless array of culinary delights! We have Margherita Steak, Nectarwine, Pizza Classica, and Nuvola Pasta...
LGNCZST_3_3: Uhh, sorry to interrupt you. I actually wanted to ask how you feel about modified local dishes, like the Pizza Tropicale I just ordered.
LGNCZST_3_4: Hey! You! Watch it. That thing you just mentioned. IS. NOT. A. REAL. PIZZA!
LGNCZST_3_5: It's a demon that nearly destroyed Ragunna, a Threnodian trying to wipe out our culinary culture.
LGNCZST_3_6: Is it really that serious? But it looks just like any other pizza...
LGNCZST_3_7: We Ragunnesi would never consider Pizza Tropicale to be a real pizza! It's just a fruit tart that looks like a pizza!
LGNCZST_3_8: We're asking the Order to differentiate traditional pizza from this import in writing and pronunciation.
LGNCZST_3_9: That's a bit over the top...
LGNCZST_3_10: Over the top? Tell me, where are you from?
LGNCZST_3_12: What would you think if someone tossed canned fruit into Jinzhou stew?
LGNCZST_3_13: Oh my god, yuck! Okay, I see your point.
LGNCZST_4_2: Mamma mia, forgive me, Imperator! For we have failed Rinascita.
LGNCZST_45_1: I heard that Montelli's golds flow on every river in today's Ragunna.
LGNCZST_45_2: Simple rule of supply and demand. The market calls and we're only answering their needs.
LGNCZST_45_3: And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
LGNCZST_45_4: Some folks are eager to work with us in their pursuit of wealth and self-actualization. We're simply providing them with the platform.
LGNCZST_45_5: Since we're on that matter, do you have financial needs we can assist you with? I couldn't help but notice the lofts in Fisalia Residencies seem... out of repair.
LGNCZST_45_6: If you're planning on a renovation, rest assured—I have some connections in construction and design.
LGNCZST_45_7: Hmph—I would not waste my breath lecturing you on defending the longstanding traditions and principles of Ragunna, and of Rinascita.
LGNCZST_45_8: We Fisalias would never disrespect our values and beliefs. But you Montellis wouldn't wait to walk away from these for your grand "course", would you?
LGNCZST_45_11: We're simply adapting to the times. Even the Order is willing to guide us toward ascension. Only fools would drown in old dreams.
LGNCZST_45_13: In the past, it was you who controlled the Order and the path of ascension. But now...
LGNCZST_45_14: Mind you, though we may have past our prime, our family still stands stronger than yours.
LGNCZST_45_15: There, you said it yourself, Fisalia is history now.
LGNCZST_46_1: Please keep your Echoes down, gentlemen, and avoid causing unnecessary disturbances in the restaurant.
LGNCZST_46_2: Would you like to put away your Echoes, or should I bring each of them a dish to match yours?
LGNCZST_46_5: Ms. Margherita won't step in as long as they don't disrupt other guests from enjoying their meals.
LGNCZST_46_6: But, honestly, I'd really prefer if they could take their arguments somewhere else.
LGNCZST_133_1: Nah. The tuning is flat... Might as well send it back to the "dock" for remodeling.
LGNCZST_133_2: Huh? Who's there listening in? Are you trying to steal my <ano=Echo tuning>tuning</ano> skills?
LGNCZST_133_5: Do you not know who I am?
LGNCZST_133_6: Franciscus of Fisalia, chief musician of the Order, a one-in-a-million musical genius, with all Vox Sancti under my command!
LGNCZST_133_9: You little uncultured—Oh, calm yourself Franciscus. Must keep it together for the honor of the Fisalia family...
LGNCZST_134_1: Must keep it together for the honor of the Fisalia family...
LGNCZST_136_2: You were a true genius. And me? A mere mediocrity... a petty person even. I betrayed you...
LGNCZST_136_6: ...Never mind. Friend, if you have a moment, could you indulge me in a brief confession?
LGNCZST_136_7: Do you know Levito? He was once the Order's lead musician.
LGNCZST_136_8: I saw him as my primary rival for the chief musician position and went head to head against him on every matter.
LGNCZST_136_9: To ensure I got the spot, I publicly disparaged his work. I stooped so low as to spread rumors that his work broke the Order's doctrines. All the slandering I did... They worked. Led to his downfall.
LGNCZST_136_10: I did these things because I was simply jealous of his talent. I couldn't compose such beautiful pieces, nor conduct the Vox Sancti to perform in such perfect unity...
LGNCZST_136_11: To this day, I still cannot surpass him.
LGNCZST_136_12: Then words came suddenly one day that he boarded the Pilgrim's Sail. I never heard from him again... only later did I learn that the appalling truth of the pilgrimage.
LGNCZST_136_13: If anything happened to Levito during his pilgrimage, my part in this shall not be pardoned...
LGNCZST_136_14: You should say these words to Levito yourself.
LGNCZST_136_15: If I could, I would tell him in person of my remorse...
LGNCZST_136_16: Every night, I repent and punish myself with unbearable guilt. But when daylight comes, I put on my mask again.
LGNCZST_136_17: Thank you for listening. As you can see, my arrogance... is just a facet of my self-loathing and guilt...
LGNCZST_136_18: I fear my secret being revealed, yet my heart can't stop whispering it in the night...
LGNCZST_136_19: This guilt... it's nearly crushing me...
LGNCZST_138_1: It's you. I'm currently tuning these Vox Sancti.

Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_1: We're finally connected, {PlayerName}. Can you hear me?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_2: (What is this feeling... is it... the Somnoire?)
Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_3: Don't worry, it's just me, the White Cat from the Somnoire. I'm reaching out to you in your dream...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_4: There are things best discussed face-to-face. Could you come to Ragunna City if you have the time? I need a favor from you, meow...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_1: Hello, {PlayerName}... This city is quite peculiar, meow. To be honest, it's my first time in Ragunna.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_4: Ahem... never mind. The reason I contacted you, {PlayerName}, is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_5: I am not a mere cat! Ahem, let's set that aside for now. The real reason I contacted you, {PlayerName}, is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_6: Originally, I couldn't leave the Whining Aix's Mire or collect dreams from other regions due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_7: Especially in Rinascita, which has been veiled by a network of countless nodes, making any connection impossible... until just recently, when one of its nodes suddenly linked up.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_9: Exactly. I believe you've unintentionally picked up a unique frequency, {PlayerName}. With the Somnoire obtaining samples from Ragunna, I was finally able to connect with you.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_10: Ever since the last incident, I've been working on the Somnoire, getting it to resume the task of dream backup.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_11: But I'm completely powerless when it comes to Ragunna's dreams. So, I'd like to ask you to keep completing those challenges, {PlayerName}.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_12: Most of the Dreamscape Nodes should be directly accessible to you, {PlayerName}. Some are special Tacet Discords linked to the Somnoire, while others are corrupted Dreamscape Nexus.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_13: However, in the Fagaceae Peninsula and the Penitent's End, the Dreamscape Nodes appear to be veiled by an unknown force.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_3_1: I see... so, that's what was lurking deep within the network of Dreamscape Nodes.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_3_2: There's something actively collecting people's nightmares and negative emotions...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_3_3: Well done, {PlayerName}. For now, the Somnoire connection has seen some progress. Let's discuss it further in person.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_1: {PlayerName}, do you think that special TD is similar to some of the memory fragments in the Somnoire?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_3: And it reminded me of an old acquaintance...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_4: Yes, if you look closely, it's very similar to those corrupted dreams.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_5: I'm talking about the corrupted dreams, meow.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_6: Dreams are visions from the subconscious. Even when they solidify into memory fragments, they still carry all the joy and sorrow of the dreamer.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_7: But those special TDs... it's as though people's subconscious have been unified by a single concept, carrying nothing but one desire.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_8: I tried to peer into the depths of the network to see what lay beyond. For a brief moment, I saw a single frame of image and almost drowned in the tidal sound, losing myself.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_10: I saw a pitch-black abyss, where people were neatly lined up, crawling, performing the same gestures, murmuring the same words, trapped in the same dream.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_11: In the next moment, they noticed my presence and turned to meet my gaze... Their eyes... Their pupils were stained with the same substance...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_12: And in the darkness behind them, a pair of enormous eyes slowly opened... I've never seen a dream like this before.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_14: They all turned to look at you?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_15: Yes. Just thinking about it gives me an uneasy feeling.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_16: It wasn't normal, meow... Just thinking about it gives me an uneasy feeling.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_17: That dream was far too dangerous and unsettling. What could be lurking in the darkness beneath Rinascita's waters? Have the people of Ragunna always been living with such a threat?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_4_18: So, {PlayerName}, I'd like to ask you to keep eliminating those TDs hidden within the network. Only then will the dreams housed in the Somnoire be safe.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_5_1: Well done, {PlayerName}. I can feel that all the Dreamscape Nodes are now connected.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_5_2: The hidden threats have been cleared... I've prepared your rewards, meow. Let's discuss the details in person.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_1: Good job, {PlayerName}! I knew you could do it.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_2: Now the dream frequency in the Ragunna region is stable... Hmm, how should I say this... It feels very... Rinascita.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_3: Just like people from Jinzhou often dream of the Moon-Chasing Festival or Loong Whiskers Crisp, the most common dreams in Ragunna are about prayers, pizza, opera, and the Carnevale.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_4: From these dreams, it seems the people of Ragunna live quite happily... So why is there such a turbulent subconscious lurking beneath the surface?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_5: Are deep-sea monster stories popular lately?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_6: Maybe the Order is hiding something...
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_7: I really don't get it, meow, why would anyone like such terrifying things?! The deep sea is so dark, and I can't even swim, meow.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_8: I'm not sure about that... but there are surprisingly few dreams from Order members in these samples... What's going on?
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_9: Let's leave that for later. In time, the Somnoire in Ragunna will be fully established.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_10: Thank you again for all your help, {PlayerName}. By the way, in addition to the agreed reward, I want to give you this as a keepsake.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_12: This is a unique sample I found in a Dreamscape Node. I'm not sure what it's for yet, but it certainly looks exquisite.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_6_13: Maybe one day it will come in handy.
Character_Cantarella_13_1: How marvelous! I hear the sounds of birth and doom, of everlasting mountains and seas, and the fierce pulses of life!
Character_Cantarella_13_2: This is life's symphony, each note threaded by the loom of time, more alluring than any Siren's call!
Character_Cantarella_13_3: As promised, here is the first riddle: The Siren's Song.
Character_Cantarella_13_4: "Long ago, a group of girls followed the Siren's call out of town. They journeyed to the 'crown' atop the mountain and to the waterfall that cascaded into the depths."
Character_Cantarella_13_5: Beyond this riddle, I, Mammon, have yet another gift to offer for your performance.
Character_Cantarella_13_6: Please take this music box. It's dusty with age, but it might just sing again with a song like you just played.
Character_Cantarella_14_1: That person does seem a bit extra...
Character_Cantarella_14_2: It's understandable. Hearing a Laureate perform is an honor, a blessing for everyone in Rinascita.
Character_Cantarella_14_3: Even this music box should be humming along in admiration…
Character_Cantarella_14_4: Cantarella taps the music box, but it doesn't work as expected.
Character_Cantarella_14_5: Oh, so that's why this little thing isn't behaving… Someone must have silenced it, leaving it unable to sing.
Character_Cantarella_14_6: Cantarella's fingers move deftly as she tinkers with the music box, but it remains silent.
Character_Cantarella_14_7: As Cantarella examines it, you notice the music box has a unique shape.
Character_Cantarella_14_8: If you look at this music box from above, doesn't it resemble a big apple?
Character_Cantarella_14_9: Hmm, now that you mention it… Indeed, it does.

FWNPC_AGLXZMP_1_1: It's not fair! Why am I always the one playing the villain?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_1_2: Does it only need luck to become a knight?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_1_3: Bruno, I'll correct knights like you!
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_10_1: Mayor, where on earth did those knights bury the treasure...?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_11_1: Why is it that only my wish is not unfulfilled... Could it be that I haven't offered enough Credit?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_12_1: Who cares about The Order? Bringing happiness, huh? I could do that too.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_12_2: Mom doesn't understand anything. All she does is listen to the sermons from the Order every day... Dad's not coming back anymore.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_13_1: Lyon, do you think those knight legends are true?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_13_2: They're probably true. I saw one of the Order's knights when I was young.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_13_3: Really? So who's better, you or those knights?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_13_4: If I can shoot them in the back, me.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_14_1: Matina, children shouldn't always be thinking about fighting and violence.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_14_3: Stop brushing me off with "fine" all the time.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_2_1: I've heard that the legendary Mad Knight appears in this town at night...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_2_2: Oh? Sounds like it would make a great thriller script.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_2_3: I've had enough of thillers. How about turning it into a revenge comedy? Picture a knight lost in a forest called Revenge...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_3_1: Knight games... They look so fun...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_3_2: I wonder if I could join them... It would be amazing to play the dark knight...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_4_1: My old Roberto is getting on in years, and the harvests aren't what they used to be.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_4_2: If only we could apply for some Echoes from the Order to help with the farming…
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_4_3: Applying for Common Echo assistance now comes with a hefty fee. Can you believe it?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_4_4: If we could afford the fees, who would even bother farming?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_5_1: This bread is so hard. You could wield it as a weapon... Who on earth put it in a gourmet guide?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_5_2: Stay calm, Orlando, and whatever you do, don't let Giovanetta hear this...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_5_3: There is a unique way to eat it. You can't just bite it like that...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_5_4: Ouch! My tooth! Why didn't you say that sooner?!
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_6_1: If we sincerely pray to Imperator... Primus will bestow Their grace upon us.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_6_2: Oh Imperator, how can my wish be fulfilled?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_1: Twenty years ago, it was only through the Enlightened One, Lord Fenrico, that Ragunna was able to survive the Dark Tide.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_2: Devout believers will be protected by Imperator, as Lord Fenrico is the embodiment of the Sentinel's will!
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_3: Whatever your obsessions or desires may be, as long as you confess to the Sentinel, Lord Fenrico will bring a response!
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_4: Praise be to Their name! We are bound together! Praise be to Their name! And we shall be saved!
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_8_1: I pray to the Sentinel every morning... Do wishes have to wait in line too?
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_8_2: How much Credit do I need to donate for the Sentinel to hear my wish...
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_1: In the second year since I started praying to the Sentinel, my sister, who had been lost for twenty years, returned home.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_2: In the third year, I joined The Order. It was through Lord Fenrico's guidance that I was able to understand the Sentinel's benevolence.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_3: Keep your faith as I do, and you too can make your wishes come true.
FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_4: Praise be to Their name! We are bound together! Praise be to Their name! And we shall be saved!

Activity_1100_Description: Casting Intro Skill summons a Shockwave that pulls enemies in and deals Havoc DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1101_Description: The Shockwave causes an Explosion shortly after, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1102_Description: Defeating a target with Shockwave or Explosion recovers 20 Concerto Energy for the caster.
Activity_1103_Description: Performing 2 Coordinated Attacks or 5 Basic Attacks grants a stack of Electric Spark. Stacks from each type are counted separately. When either reaches 2 stacks, attacks will consume all the stacks to summon 2 Lightning Bolts that strike the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1104_Description: Lightning Bolts deal an additional Electro DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK within 3s of hitting the target.
Activity_1105_Description: Lightning Bolts trigger a Magnetic Storm, dealing Eletro DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1106_Description: Performing Mid-air Attack summons a Meteorite, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
Activity_1107_Description: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 10% every second while in mid-air, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1108_Description: The Meteorite explodes on hit, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK and creating a flaming zone that deals Fusion DMG equal to 380% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1109_Description: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 2 times increases the active Resonator's Crit. DMG by 5% (triggered once every 0.1s), stacking up to 20 times.
Activity_1110_Description: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 5 times generates an Iceblast (triggered once every 0.1s), dealing Glacio DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1111_Description: Increase the Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack by 50%.
Activity_1112_Description: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 500%
Activity_1113_Description: Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG by 10%, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1114_Description: The DMG of Dodge Counter is increased by 100%. Performing Dodge Counter summons a Swirl Burst that deals Aero DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1115_Description: Successful Dodge increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% for 10s, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1116_Description: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. Taking DMG reduces Crit. DMG by 100% for 3s.
Activity_1117_Description: Attacking the target again within 2s of the last attack increases the Resonator's ATK by 3% for 5s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
ItemInfo_80110101_AttributesDescription: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.
ItemInfo_80110101_BgDescription: A cherished item among the Rinascita people, it is said to hold music within, crafted by skilled artisans. However, due to internal damage, it no longer fulfills its original purpose.
Character_Cantarella_15_1: I know what you came for.
Character_Cantarella_15_2: Without exceptional insight and unparalleled courage, all you'll end up with are mere scraps.
Character_Cantarella_15_3: If you lack what I seek, then just swallow the scraps with the ashes.
Character_Cantarella_15_4: Good enough for the fishes, perhaps, but hardly something to serve at the table.
Character_Cantarella_15_5: This distinguished friend of mine deserves nothing less than the finest dish and the freshest apple.
Character_Cantarella_15_6: Well then, give it a try. May you find the freshest apple.
Character_Cantarella_18_1: People of Rinascita often use coin tosses for divination.
Character_Cantarella_18_2: Heads up signifies good fortune, a sign of following the sacred path. Tails up, however, invites misfortune, a mark of defiance against the Divinity.
Character_Cantarella_18_3: The front of the coin features a doll in a red hat, while the back shows one in blue. The coin has an unusual appearance, with uneven, ribbed edges.
Character_Cantarella_18_4: Are these dolls blessed or cursed?
Character_Cantarella_19_1: Hmm, which is the most beautiful among these dolls?
Character_Cantarella_19_2: This one has bright eyes, that one has a nice nose, and that one there has red lips… Wait, this one's gotta be a bit less pretty. Can't let it outshine me!
Character_Cantarella_19_3: Ugh, so frustrating. They're all gorgeous, but none quite live up to my standards!
Character_Cantarella_19_4: Now tell me, what do you think? Which doll stands out the most?
Character_Cantarella_19_5: (Pick the doll in a red hat)
Character_Cantarella_19_6: (Pick the doll in a blue hat)
Character_Cantarella_19_9: They all look the same to me.
Character_Cantarella_19_10: The lucky red hat! Exactly! Following the divine will is always a wise choice.
Character_Cantarella_19_11: Defying the divine will is a reckless gamble with your very life at stake—one I wouldn't advise.
Character_Cantarella_19_12: Without waiting for your response, Invidia hands you a doll with a red hat.
Character_Cantarella_19_16: Cantarella's gaze seems to reflect a stormy sea, veiled in layers of mist that hide her feelings. After a moment, she picks up a doll with a red hat.
Character_Cantarella_19_17: If we obey the divine will, does that really bring us luck?
Character_Cantarella_19_18: Haha, I like your honesty! Yes, they're all pretty much the same, aren't they?
Character_Cantarella_19_20: Invidia tosses the red-hat doll your way.
Character_Cantarella_19_21: Wonderful! As long as you follow the Divinity, luck will surely be on your side!
Character_Cantarella_19_22: Now, for dessert, I present you with fortune cookies.
Character_Cantarella_19_23: This is the last riddle: The Round Hat.
Character_Cantarella_19_24: "A girl dons her red dancing shoes and wears a scarlet hat, ready for the final act of her performance."
Character_Cantarella_19_25: Now, all the riddles are in your hands! Whether the answers will rise like bubbles from the witch's cauldron, well, that's up to you.
Character_Cantarella_20_1: Now all the riddles are here, like fish returned to the sea. However, they are entangled in a maze of seaweed.
Character_Cantarella_20_2: How would you free them from the maze?
Character_Cantarella_20_3: Analyze the keywords of each riddle.
Character_Cantarella_20_4: Find the connection between these items.
Character_Cantarella_20_5: The Siren's Song, the Red Apple, the Red Shoes and the Round Hat…
Character_Cantarella_20_6: Among the tales of Rinascita, all these three end bitterly.
Character_Cantarella_20_7: However, with the Laureate's aid, we may see a different ending tonight.
Character_Cantarella_20_8: Since all stories are rooted in reality, perhaps we should take a closer look at the three items we've collected.
Character_Cantarella_20_9: Let's see... A dusty broken music box, a cog-like "lucky coin," and a doll in a red hat.
Character_Cantarella_20_10: Let's see... A dusty broken music box, a cog-like "lucky coin," and a doll in a red hat.
Character_Cantarella_20_11: They're all out of production now. None of the music boxes these days use this kind of cog.
Character_Cantarella_20_12: Looks like these little trinkets are relics from the past.
Character_Cantarella_20_13: They can be assembled into a ballerina music box!
Character_Cantarella_20_14: How about we put them together?
Character_Cantarella_20_15: Good catch. As a girl, I used to while away those endless, quiet hours in the castle by playing with such things.
Character_Cantarella_20_16: Perhaps some part of me still remembers what to do… No, I'm certain I still do.
Character_Cantarella_20_17: Cantarella places the doll on the music box's pedestal and slides the cog-like coin into the slot. Click—the missing cog clicks back into place. Just like that, the fish breaks free from the maze of seaweed.
Character_Cantarella_20_18: It seems all we need is the Laureate's performance to breathe life back into this old relic.
Character_Cantarella_22_2: Hope this can help you feel better.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_15: It's truly a headache, meow. Penitent's End is completely shrouded in a thick, eerie fog, and some of the nodes in Thessaleo Fells are shielded by a strange energy.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_16: To fully connect the Dreamscape Nodes, these obstructions must be removed. Complete the challenges, and I'll reward you accordingly, meow.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_18: Alright, then. I'll mark the locations. I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}.
Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_19: But... something tells me there's more hidden behind the Dreamscape Nodes. {PlayerName}, make sure to stay vigilant after completing all the nodes in a region, meow.

Activity_103200001_Desc:
After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms.
The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember.
Character_Cantarella_10_1: That woman is… Why would a Fisalia be here?
Character_Cantarella_10_2: How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!
Character_Cantarella_10_3: Come on, those rumors aren't even confirmed…
Character_Cantarella_10_4: She's a noble with real power, and we're just commoners.
Character_Cantarella_10_5: Are you scared? Well, I'm not!
Character_Cantarella_10_6: Hey, keep it down! You want to get us in trouble?
Character_Cantarella_10_7: Just calm down and make it through the night…
Character_Cantarella_10_8: After all, tonight's the only time we can mourn for them.
Character_Cantarella_11_1: Tonight's theme is the ghost girl, right?
Character_Cantarella_11_2: Yeah, I heard it's related to something that happened in the town a few years ago…
Character_Cantarella_11_3: Is this what they mean by "based on a true story"? Ugh, that gives me the goosebumps!
Character_Cantarella_11_4: What's there to be afraid of? It's just a folk tale.
Character_Cantarella_11_5: Every place has their own. I think they're all made up to scare people and hype up the festival!
Character_Cantarella_11_6: I'm not scared of any ghost girl. Not even a ghost lord would faze me! I'm definitely getting that elixir!
Character_Cantarella_11_7: Is that elixir really as powerful as they say?
Character_Cantarella_11_8: Of course, I've seen it myself. Uncle Rick got one before.

POI_JRDSL_1_1: A Trial Invitation letter? Looks like this was meant for someone else. How did it end up here?
POI_JRDSL_1_2: Something about a trial... and a miraculous elixir? Smells fishy. Better take a trip to Porto-Veno Castle and see what's really going on.
POI_JRDSL_10_1: At long last... after the skies had wept their fury, the fleet spied a new island on the horizon.
POI_JRDSL_11_1: Upon this island, the people tamed its wilderness and built new homes.
POI_JRDSL_12_1: That makes all four badges. But I haven't seen Chloe...
POI_JRDSL_12_2: Maybe she's back at the castle? Time to find out.
POI_JRDSL_13_5: I now present to you these four medals!
POI_JRDSL_13_7: Huh? I was the one who passed the trials...
POI_JRDSL_13_8: You are too kind, my lord... Does this mean I am to be accepted as ██?
POI_JRDSL_13_9: And the elixir mentioned in the letter. Please, I need it to cure Jojo's illness...
POI_JRDSL_13_10: Is that all there is to the trials...?
POI_JRDSL_13_11: Could such a miraculous elixir really exist...?
POI_JRDSL_13_12: Hmm? I see. So the trials before were only the beginning...
POI_JRDSL_13_13: Yes. I will give everything to pass the remaining trials, my lord. I will become ██!
POI_JRDSL_13_14: Jojo needs that elixir to get better!
POI_JRDSL_13_15:
With her decision made, you watch Chloe walk towards Porto-Veno Castle without any hesitation.
Instead of opening the gate, she passes right through it.
POI_JRDSL_14_1:
You give the gate a push, but it won't budge.
For some reason, you get the feeling of a swiming above water for a breath of fresh air, the moment you placed your hand on the gate.
POI_JRDSL_15_1: This feeling... Was everything just an illusion? Did it begin the moment I met Chloe? Or was it when I received that letter?
POI_JRDSL_15_2: Chloe must've been the first to face whatever trial this was at some point in the past.
POI_JRDSL_15_3: If what I saw in that illusion is true... then she entered Porto-Veno Castle afterward.
POI_JRDSL_15_4: But did she finish the trial? Did she even make it out...?
POI_JRDSL_2_2: I will give everything to pass this trail!
POI_JRDSL_2_4: Are you one of the candidates?
POI_JRDSL_2_5: I believe this letter belongs to you.
POI_JRDSL_2_6: My lord said there are four trials scattered around Porto-Veno Castle. Each one holds a medal... I need to complete them all!
POI_JRDSL_2_7: I've got to get that elixir and become ██ to save Jojo!
POI_JRDSL_2_10: I can't waste another moment. I must go.
POI_JRDSL_2_11: Chloe disappears into the distance just as she finishes her sentence.
POI_JRDSL_3_1: Was that an illusion? Or some vision from the past?
POI_JRDSL_3_2: Hmm... I should probably find those trials she mentioned to understand what this it about.
POI_JRDSL_4_1: Here lies the Trial of Swiftness.
POI_JRDSL_4_2: As ██, wherever you wish to go, you shall arrive; whatever you seek to accomplish, you will see through. No obstacle can stand before your great purpose.
POI_JRDSL_4_3: Use the puzzles along the path to defeat your foes and reach the objective. Only then will you pass this trial.
POI_JRDSL_5_1: Here lies the Trial of Bravery.
POI_JRDSL_5_2: O great ██, wield your sword and strike down all who stand before you.
POI_JRDSL_5_3: Make a stand here, and the heretics will bow before our might! Defeat all foes to pass this trial.
POI_JRDSL_6_1: Here lies the Trial of Perception.
POI_JRDSL_6_2: Rinascita will be greeted by an inevitable storm. O great ██, find the calm within its eye.
POI_JRDSL_6_3: Amid a battlefield of constant change, find a safe passage and avoid rampaging foes to pass this trial.
POI_JRDSL_7_1: Here lies the Trial of Wisdom.
POI_JRDSL_7_2: The chaotic world is steeped in murmurs... Do not be led astray by the chaos of falsehoods. Seek the truth that history hides.
POI_JRDSL_7_3: Decipher the hidden meaning in these paintings, and restore them to their rightful places to pass this trial.
POI_JRDSL_8_1: Floods surged as the earth cracked and fell away. Islanders were torn from their homes.
POI_JRDSL_9_1: Through the raging storm, a handful of ships fought their way through the storm's wrath.
POI_LGNJR_20_1: Speaking of which, there's a Wingray over there. If you'd like to try flying one, we can take it to Averardo Vault.
POI_LGNJR_21_1: {PlayerName}, look, there's a Wingray over there.
POI_LGNJR_21_2: We don't have much time, so let's take a Wingray and go.
