Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_19:
To your surprise, the Order's "confessional" turns out to be a freight elevator. 
After leaving it behind, you arrive at Whisperwind Haven and meet Zani. Together, you set off to trace Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_7:
Gilberto's traces end here. Zani speculates that he must have left using a <ano=Flying Echo>Wingray</ano>.
It seems Gilberto never anticipated that you two could also follow his lead and take the Wingray to where he was heading.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_37:
You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys." 
As for Gilberto, he tells you that a Fisalia member has been frequenting Whisperwind Haven, and Echoes have been mysteriously vanishing. 
Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_28:
Upon reaching the area where Echoes have gone missing, you're attacked by out-of-control Echoes. After quelling them, you notice that they seem to be manipulated, just like the Vitreum Dancers in Ragunna. 
Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face—Acolyte Phoebe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_40:
Phoebe reveals that she's searching for a missing Echo. You share your findings, and she realizes Gilberto's actions are blasphemy against the Sentinel, which calls for a punishment. With shared goals, Phoebe joins your team. 
Suddenly, the missing Echo appears, fleeing as if being pursued. You decide to catch up to uncover what's behind its panic.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_16:
You finally pin down Gilberto, who is reciting eerie prayers. 
On seeing you, he transforms the nearby Echoes into Tacet Discords with a Lycoris flower. A fierce battle ensues.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_29:
Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. 
Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_9:
Upon reaching the port near the sea of clouds, you prepare to board a boat to the Atrium of Reflections, but the port's services are suspended due to the anomaly. Fortunately, the harbormaster lets you take a Gondola yourself.
With no other options, you search the port for an available Gondola.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_12:
While searching for an available Gondola, you encounter the noble lady you once met at the Masked Reverie.
She asks to travel with you to catch the train in the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_29:
You arrive at the Echo train station and wait for its arrival. 
During the wait, the noble lady shares her thoughts on Ragunna City, the Montelli and Fisalia families... and you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_8: You reunite with Zani and Phoebe at the Atrium of Reflections。
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_16: At the Atrium of Reflections, a masked believer tells you that the path to Lorelei's domain is sealed. Unable to reason with them, you begin investigating the place to find an alternative way forward.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_12:
Through investigation, you realize that the key to unsealing Lorelei's domain is a "chorale." 
With encouragement from you and Zani, Phoebe gathers the courage and sings the melody. The song unlocks the sealed passage before you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_30:
You defeat the "Queen of the Night," Lorelei's corrupted form under the Lycoris's influence, and restore her to her true self. Besides, you also find the Vitreum Dancer that fled away, but it is damaged while protecting you. Zani keeps it in the Montelli's Terminal.
Lorelei, a remnant creature enlightened by the Sentinel, reveals a shocking truth: the current Primus of the Order is not the legendary <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>. The Sentinel's link to the mortal world has been severed, and only the Laureate of the Carnevale gets a chance to communicate with Them. 
Lorelei also discloses the identity of the one causing Echoes to lose control—the Conductor.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_28:
Shaken by Lorelei's revelations, Phoebe decides to return to the Order to seek answers and bids farewell to you.
With Lorelei's information, you are certain that Fractsidus is behind the chaos among Echoes.
You and Zani head to Averardo Vault, the heart of the Montelli family, to seek allies and repair the damaged Vitreum Dancer Echo.

Spring_MailContent1:
Magistrate Jinhsi insists that I take some time off work. The streets tonight are bustling with life. Since I have little to do, I imbibed some... floral brew. My body is warm yet my heart longs for someone to confide in.

It is a common practice to don monster masks as part of a ceremonial dance ritual. Folks here believe their reenactment of monsters from the legends of Huanglong may ward off evil and invite good fortune. As for me... I do not need the reenactment, for I have worked hard to suppress the monster within, which is already a perfect mask for me.

Those strange sights and sounds in the cold wind and snow are the past that I cannot sever. But because of you all, I see the silver lining behind these macabre scenes. You give me the strength to pray for the return of spring.

The fate you've sown will bear fruit in the coming years. Should you leave on another journey, please remember to take my... and our blessings with you.

Sanhua
Spring_MailContent2:
This year's ceremony is different—it is the first one free of the Threnodian menace. People are finally able to laugh and rejoice from the heart, and I truly enjoy seeing everyone smile.

I've told Sanhua and Taoqi to take a break. After working all year, they deserve leisure time to bask in this hard-won warmth. When I see others happily reunited with their families, I can't help but yearn for your presence. I knew you had matters to attend to, but your absence during the most festive days in a year would have made everyone a bit lonely.

So, when you came back with guests from Rinascita, I was truly happy—you really do miss Jinzhou enough to spend time with me. Perhaps, in your heart, Jinzhou has become your home.

I wrote a song to express my gratitude, and it seems I'll finally get to sing it. Wearing the ceremonial dress still makes me a bit shy, but if you like, I'll wear it properly after I finish work and sing just for you.

Jinhsi
Spring_MailContent3:
I hope this letter finds you well.

Jinhsi and Sanhua were overjoyed by the glowing reviews of the Hero Play from the guests of Rinascita. After a year of hard work, they can finally set aside their duties and enjoy a well-deserved respite.

Your Rinascitan friends were eager to share thrilling tales of the Laureate with me, and I found their stories about you both delightful and heartwarming. It is truly gratifying to see the profound impact your journey has had on the lives of others.

However, I believe it is time for you to take some proper rest now, after the busyness of the Hero Play and the joy of welcoming your friends. During your absence, several notable events transpired in Jinzhou. If you are interested, I would be happy to recount them to you at your leisure.

The day before your return to Jinzhou, the winter's last snowstorm breathed a delicate layer of snow on our Go checkerboard, on which I wrote a wish.

By the time you receive this letter, it will have already come true.

Changli
Spring_MailContent4:
(A neatly penned letter bearing a wobbly and crooked signature)

Hmph, this is a letter I wrote you. Surprised? Yeah me too. I mean, if there's something I need to say to you, I could just tell you in person, right? But everyone else was scribbling away so I asked Sanhua to write down what I was saying.

When I think about it, we've really been through a lot, haven't we? From Huanglong to the Black Shores and then onto Rinascita. From Loong Buns and Coral Bowl to Pizza Tropicale. Although our trip had its rough patches, in the end, nothing could hold us back.

<s>Mmmh...hmm, so what do I wish for...? Wait no, don't write that down!</s>

I wish from this day on we'll always be well-fed and happy. Oh, and if you ever run into trouble, don't forget to call me. Your business is my business too.

Abby
Spring_MailContent5:
This is a letter from Carlotta Montelli. I hope this did not come as a surprise.

It wasn't until I lifted my pen that I realized this was not the first time I had written to you. You had known me through my invitation to you to Rinascita, long before we met in person. That was where it all began.

Fate brought you before me. Together, we captured the traitor within my family and took part in Ragunna's grandest Carnevale. Breaking conventions and revealing all to an outsider was a first for me, but with you, everything came so naturally.

This time, when I received your invitation, I did not hesitate to accept. The cultures of those beyond Rinascita are fascinating, and I'm thoroughly intrigued by the Hero Plays of Jinzhou. But what really captivates me are the aspects of you that I have yet to explore.

If my initial invitation led you to reciprocate, then perhaps a heartfelt expression of sincerity might elicit an equally precious response. 

Would you dance with me if I took the first step?
Spring_MailContent6:
I wrote this letter after watching the play. Pero was happily stuffed after she ate all the petals on stage. She was as satisfied as everyone else.

The waves bring many things—sometimes a discarded bottle, sometimes a broken sail, and sometimes a precious Luceanite. Then one day, you and the captain braved the waves and reached our troupe. At the time, I never imagined you would be such a joy and inspiration to me and Pero.

I took the funny stories you told me and turned them into commedia to give hope and courage to our happy troupe. I hope you will be the first audience for my new play, since it's about your travels. I haven't decided on the finale yet, but perhaps, like your journey, it should have no end.

May the wind always be at your back and the sun upon your face. Next time we meet, regale me with dazzling stories.

Roccia
Spring_MailContent7:
My dearest friend, thank you for the invitation. I had heard much about Huanglong's Hero Plays, but attending one in person has truly revealed their magnificence!

There's magic to a great performance where actors pour their very souls into their craft. A tale told from the stage can grow to encompass the world! And the audience too becomes part of that world, immersed in the character's joys and sorrows.

I am always fascinated by performances that evoke such feelings. Therefore, the troupe and I have prepared a new play. Care to guess the plot? Well, think back to when we first met—how one hero braved the sea to conquer the storm and be crowned with the Laurel of the Carnevale!

A hero's journey always deserves flowers and applause. We want people to know of your thrilling exploits and to feel the passion and romance of a roving life. Come, my friend! You must not miss the show!
(Enclosed are two front-row tickets)

Brant

SpringTalkContent_1_1: The Asura in the Hero Play wears a mask forged by her sinister thoughts. She struggles to resist it, yet sometimes uses its power for her own ends.
SpringTalkContent_1_2: Occasionally, I fall into a trance on stage, as if I am the Asura exorcising evil spirits.
SpringTalkContent_1_3: Maybe it's because you two share some similar pasts?
SpringTalkContent_1_4: Maybe... The falling petals remind me of my past. I can't help but think that one day, the burning wishes I defend with my ice-cold blade will become a reality.
SpringTalkContent_2_1: The theater audience seems captivated. They do appreciate a good Hero Play.
SpringTalkContent_2_2: Winter shall come to pass, and the spring thaw will bring all things back to life... Perhaps that is the moral of the play.
SpringTalkContent_2_3: Your goddess cameo in the final scene was spectacular.
SpringTalkContent_2_4: Because you helped me rehearse. Would you like to have a stroll with me later?
SpringTalkContent_3_1: This Hero Play is thoughtfully presented, and the characters have been carefully crafted with underlying symbolism.
SpringTalkContent_3_2: The incorporation of so many nostalgic elements makes me wonder who the director is.
SpringTalkContent_3_3: Well, you have a good eye for detail.
SpringTalkContent_3_4: It doesn't really matter anyway. What matters is the joy of people {Male=he;Female=she} wished to see with this play. Don't you agree?
SpringTalkContent_4_1: Heh, I like how you can snack in open-air theaters while the actors perform.
SpringTalkContent_4_2: So, why'd you ask me to come here? Oh, I get it! Are you gonna treat me to some great meals for all the hard work I put into scattering those flowers?
SpringTalkContent_4_4: What do you mean by typical? I'm one of a kind! Wait here. I have something for you.
SpringTalkContent_5_1: I like how Asura chooses to defy the prophecy, her weapon of destruction becoming a vessel of blessings.
SpringTalkContent_5_2: That scene was delightful. You've presented another precious opportunity to me.
SpringTalkContent_5_4: Yes, an opportunity to explore something yet to be assessed with you. Speaking of which, how do you feel about a future collaboration?
SpringTalkContent_6_1: Clearing the petals on stage must take a while, but I'm here to help.
SpringTalkContent_6_2: Pero says she enjoyed that play. The story reminded her of all of us and made her feel warm and fuzzy.
SpringTalkContent_6_3: Good, I thought you might have found it boring.
SpringTalkContent_6_4: A play of hope is never dull. I'm feeling inspired. Want to hear my ideas?
SpringTalkContent_7_1: With the blade in her hands, Asura cuts through her confusion to face the trials of destiny. Truly a grand adventure!
SpringTalkContent_7_2: The performance is excellent and merits applause, but...
SpringTalkContent_7_4: We still have to drink a toast to another better day! Are you up for a round, my friend？

Character_Brant_1_1: So, Captain, how about it? Fancy a wager on who hooks the first fish?
Character_Brant_1_2: A bet to start the day? Oh, Battier, you do know how to charm a man.
Character_Brant_1_4: Is that Brant...? What are those two doing? Better find out.
Character_Brant_10_1: Leave the paperwork to Brant. It's part of his responsibilities.
Character_Brant_11_1: There's still time before dinner! Smiles are all around. Why not wander about and soak it all in?
Character_Brant_11_3: Battier did say the winner would be the captain, but of course, the choice is yours. So, do you want the helm?
Character_Brant_11_4: What does being captain actually involve?
Character_Brant_11_5: Simply put, you chart the course and steer the ship. The crew will be ready to sail on your order at moment's notice.
Character_Brant_11_6: Might seem easy enough, but there's more to being captain of the Troupe of Fools.
Character_Brant_11_7: These seas are full of thrilling quests and glittering treasures.
Character_Brant_11_8: That's where a true captain shines! Leading their crew to uncover lost legends, revel in the crowd's cheers, and sail boldly through the Stormy Sea toward glory.
Character_Brant_11_11: I feel like there are easier ways to find glory...
Character_Brant_11_12: That's true. But you know the greatest legends are forged in the fiercest storms.
Character_Brant_11_13: True, but every drop of sweat brings laughter, and every adventure leads to a chest full of treasure.
Character_Brant_11_14: But none of this is possible without a captain, and the same goes for every member of the troupe.
Character_Brant_11_15: Take Battier, for example, he's our best fisherman. Tina? She knows every inch of the sea. And Lavito's stories could stretch on to fill a hundred nights.
Character_Brant_11_16: Everyone's unique talents make this troupe what it is. Each soul plays an important role.
Character_Brant_11_17: Ah, but duty calls, Captain. Oh, time to scrub the decks before dinner, as promised.
Character_Brant_11_18: Dinner's at six. Good... there's still time. Until then!
Character_Brant_12_1: Six o'clock, dinner! Six o'clock, dinner!
Character_Brant_12_2: There's still some time before dinner. A little stroll could be a good idea.
Character_Brant_13_1: A bottle of Troupe Strength, just for you! Around these parts, this stuff is as good as gold.
Character_Brant_13_2: Oh, and look what I found while gutting the fish!
Character_Brant_13_5: Odd, right? Found it just like this. It might even be a relic from the old days.
Character_Brant_13_9: Is that a letter? Does it mean anything to you?
Character_Brant_13_10: Hmm, yes. On these seas, there is only one legend about "D."
Character_Brant_13_11: The story of Drake, the Golden Captain.
Character_Brant_13_12: Captain Drake! That adventurer everyone talks about?
Character_Brant_13_13: I thought that was just a fanciful story…
Character_Brant_13_15: What do they say about him?
Character_Brant_13_16: Captain Drake, the famed hero of Rinascita. Legend has it he assembled a crew with naught but a single coin and amassed great riches from the wealthiest of men.
Character_Brant_13_17: He then embarked on a quest to chart a safe passage across the Stormy Sea. A feat worthy of being remembered forever!
Character_Brant_13_18: But there was a price. Only one crew member returned, and he had been driven mad. What happened out there is still a mystery.
Character_Brant_13_19: You seem to know the story well.
Character_Brant_13_20: Such tales were my bedtime stories.
Character_Brant_13_21: Back when I just boarded the Pilgrim's Sail, with no family and nightmares that could raise the dead, Toscanini would share such stories to comfort me.
Character_Brant_13_22: At the time, I swore that if I ever became a captain, every crew member would come back safe. No exceptions.
Character_Brant_13_23: Ah, Toscanini, the Night Watcher. Hahaha. You're one of the few who still remembers him.
Character_Brant_13_24: Did he ever tell you the rest? That mad sailor who raved about his captain's coin, saying it would lead to untold treasures.
Character_Brant_13_25: Perhaps it's the very coin our Captain here is holding.
Character_Brant_13_26: Untold treasures, eh? Well, aren't we lucky. If we had the whole thing, imagine the riches we'd claim...
Character_Brant_13_28: Any idea where the other half of the coin might be hiding？
Character_Brant_13_29: Oh, they exist, alright. The Golden Captain conquered every sea known to man. The wealth he amassed could give us all lives of leisure and luxury.
Character_Brant_13_30: You raise a fine point. Where is the other half…
Character_Brant_13_33: Now that I think of it… I lost a half-coin just like this not long ago.
Character_Brant_13_35: Yes, almost identical! There was a man yapping about its value. I thought he was just bluffing.
Character_Brant_13_36: Didn't take him seriously... then I lost it to Bella.
Character_Brant_13_37: Bella… Since the pirates started stirring the waters around Ragunna, she's been hiring us to guard her family ships.
Character_Brant_13_38: Aye! She's a regular at Trattoria Margherita. Loves their pizzas. I run into her all the time!
Character_Brant_13_39: Well then, our next stop is clear. Fortune has a way of smiling on us, Captain. Shall we try our luck at the restaurant?
Character_Brant_13_40: What say you? Ready to check it out?
Character_Brant_13_41: Don't have to ask me twice.
Character_Brant_13_43: Aye, aye, Captain! Our course is set! Ready the sails, and let the wind carry us!
Character_Brant_14_1: I've had dealings with Bella before. She's alright in my books, but she's got an odd obsession with good luck charms.
Character_Brant_14_2: The last time we encountered a thick fog, she was a bundle of nerves, convinced I needed to be tied to the mast to ward off any siren beguilements.
Character_Brant_14_3: Wait, you didn't actually go along with it.
Character_Brant_14_4: Naturally! It was quite the spectacle. Ridiculous, but we all love a good show. Once we were deep in the fog, I managed to wriggle free. Ha, you should have seen her face!
Character_Brant_15_1: There she is. It's rare to see her drinking alone… Let's go talk to her.
Character_Brant_16_1: Bella, my friend! Why so down? It's not like you to drink alone.
Character_Brant_16_2: Ah... spare me the pleasantries. My luck has taken a turn lately. Nothing seems to be going my way.
Character_Brant_16_3: Pirates are strangling our shipping routes, and if that weren't enough—look at this pizza! No olives!
Character_Brant_16_4: Margherita says they're out for a few days. Can you believe it? Even the simplest pleasures conspire against me!
Character_Brant_16_5: And that lucky coin I fought tooth and nail to get? Stolen! Some wretched thief made off with it. I've been cursed ever since.
Character_Brant_16_6: Unlike you, Brant. You could disappear into a fog and emerge glittering like a diamond. If only I could borrow just a pinch of your luck…
Character_Brant_16_7: I'm sorry to hear that, Bella, but I've got news for you: I'm not the captain today. If you need good luck, you'll have to ask this one here.
Character_Brant_16_8: It might surprise you to learn that Brant lost a bet.
Character_Brant_16_9: Sorry to disappoint, but I'm the captain today.
Character_Brant_16_10: Yes, I lost a bet, fair and square. Now I'm but a humble deckhand.
Character_Brant_16_11: You never know what the tides will bring, huh?
Character_Brant_16_12: Margherita, two glasses of Nectarwine please, and top off Bella's drink. On my tab.
Character_Brant_16_14: No luck charm beats a good glass of Gocce di Divino. Cheers to shaking off that bad luck!
Character_Brant_16_17: The three of you raise your glasses in unison and down the drink. To hell with bad luck and cheers to a great, memorable night!
Character_Brant_16_18: Ah, that's fine wine. By the way, Bella, where exactly did that coin of yours get stolen?
Character_Brant_16_19: Right here, in the restaurant. A few days ago, I placed it on the table while I was chatting. Next thing I know, poof, it vanished.
Character_Brant_16_20: A lot of diners have been losing things lately… I can't say who's behind it, but it seems to be happening more frequently...
Character_Brant_16_22: Seems they've set their sights on this place.
Character_Brant_16_23: Hmm, a common thief… Captain, I have a plan, but I'll need you to steer the ship this time.
Character_Brant_16_24: ...Oh, really? I've only just started on mine!
Character_Brant_16_26: ALL EYES ON ME! I, Brant of the Troupe of Fools, have a grand announcement to make!
Character_Brant_16_28: Is this supposed to be part of their show?
Character_Brant_16_29: Friends, gather 'round! Have you ever heard of the legend of the lucky coin?

Character_Brant_53_7: Fool! Didn't you hear the captain? "If anyone dares to get in our way, make 'em regret it!"
Character_Brant_53_8: If we don't give 'em what they want, Captain won't sleep a wink. He'll be plagued with nightmares of this menace!
Character_Brant_53_9: Besides, Captain's already off with the key we found. He promised to share the loot with us, and soon I'll be swimming in barrels of wine!
Character_Brant_53_10: A-and I can get a gold tooth...
Character_Brant_53_11: Oh, what a generous captain you serve… truly selfless.
Character_Brant_53_12: And yet somehow, these two were left behind to stop us?
Character_Brant_53_13: Well then, let's head to the next isle.
Character_Brant_54_1: Ah, we're nearly there at last.
Character_Brant_54_2: I'm very excited. There's something magical about the end of a journey, don't you think?
Character_Brant_54_3: That's when the real excitement kicks in, just before the final curtain call.
Character_Brant_54_4: So, Captain… ready for what comes next?
Character_Brant_55_1: It's Aldric. Right there, just as we thought.
Character_Brant_56_1: Brant. I didn't think you'd show up so soon.
Character_Brant_56_2: And I didn't think you'd still be here.
Character_Brant_56_3: Hm… where's all that treasure, then? Your crew is itching for the grand return of their selfless, heroic Captain Aldric.
Character_Brant_56_4: …Useless fools. Couldn't even slow you down.
Character_Brant_56_5: Fine, you want the key, don't you? I could give it to you, but—
Character_Brant_56_6: Ah, I see! You want an honorable duel with my captain? A proper sea knight's duel, full of valor and—
Character_Brant_56_7: No, no! Must we always resort t-to violence? See that? It takes two keys to unlock!
Character_Brant_56_8: You have one, and I have the other.
Character_Brant_56_9: We both want the treasures, right? So how about this, I'll give you my key, but we split the treasure. Sixty-forty… No, wait, I-I'll be generous. You take the sixty, and I'll settle for forty.
Character_Brant_56_10: You've seen my crew. Those poor souls… I'm doing this for them, to give them the life they deserve. A-a happy, peaceful life.
Character_Brant_56_11: What do you say, Captain of the Troupe of Fools? A fair deal, wouldn't you agree?
Character_Brant_56_12: (He sounds sincere. Can I really trust him?)
Character_Brant_56_13: (Regardless, agreeing to his deal to get ahold of the other key is in my best interest. Even if it's a trap, we can handle it. In that case...)
Character_Brant_56_15: (Think about it for a bit longer.)
Character_Brant_56_18: Come on, we don't have all day! Make a decision, or none of us will get the treasure!
Character_Brant_56_20: Alright, we accept. Hand over the key.
Character_Brant_56_21: Here you go. The gate's right over there.
Character_Brant_56_22: Time to claim our treasures... Wait! What's that!
Character_Brant_56_23: Ahhhh! You, uh, stay here and defend our great cause! Show them the true might of the Fool's Troupe. FAREWELL!
Character_Brant_57_1: Well, the gate's closed. Looks like our friend left us with these two Chop Chops for company.
Character_Brant_57_2: Just what you'd expect from a pirate.
Character_Brant_58_1: There's an opening over there. Let's check it out.
Character_Brant_59_1: Hah! I knew there'd be a way forward.
Character_Brant_6_1: The Returned sailed through scorching flames, back to the stage's brilliant light… "Hoist the jib and set sail," he cried. "We shall conquer the raging sea..."
Character_Brant_60_2: It's badly eroded. Let's take a closer look.
Character_Brant_61_2: He's got a scale in one hand and... wait, that coin in his other hand, it looks just like the one we found.
Character_Brant_61_3: One side holds treasure, and the other… a broken heart. What do you think it means, Captain?
Character_Brant_61_4: It's hinting at how to get the treasure.
Character_Brant_61_5: It's a warning to be cautious.
Character_Brant_61_7: Hmm… so you're saying we may need to trade something precious, like our heart, for the treasure?
Character_Brant_61_8: Could be. In stories like these, there's always a catch. Treasure hoarders love setting traps for any would-be thieves.
Character_Brant_61_9: No worries. We might find more clues ahead to piece it together.
Character_Brant_61_10: You know, there are stories about a place at the edge of the ocean, a nation where people use scales to measure everything.
Character_Brant_61_11: Souls, wealth... nothing escapes the balance. Perhaps this painting nods to that—everything has a price. Classic quid pro quo.
Character_Brant_61_12: Fascinating, isn't it? Maybe even Drake had a sense of fairness when it came to treasure. Anyway, let's keep moving, Captain. I have a hunch we'll uncover more soon.
Character_Brant_62_1: You find distinct carvings, though much has been worn away by time.
Character_Brant_62_2: "Let me out… That's why I wanna leave…"
Character_Brant_62_3: Oh... Someone was once trapped here.
Character_Brant_63_1: You find more carvings, but most are illegible.
Character_Brant_63_2: "No... hope. I pray for this to end… Ghh…"
Character_Brant_63_3: Lost by seafarers, no doubt. Likely got caught in the sea fog and couldn't find their way out, poor boys.
Character_Brant_64_1: You find more carvings. They are hard to read, but you can make out a few sentences.
Character_Brant_64_3: "They lost their minds at the sight of the treasures, fighting like madmen. It was terrifying..."
Character_Brant_64_4: Curses, huh? I guess that's why no one's ever managed to bring back Drake's treasures.
Character_Brant_65_2: "Oh sea, curse equally all who dare to steal the treasure!"
Character_Brant_65_3: "Remember the law of quid pro quo. Remember the law of quid pro quo…"
Character_Brant_65_4: Curse all who steal the treasure?
Character_Brant_65_5: Remember the law of quid pro quo?
Character_Brant_65_6: Looks like to claim Drake's treasure, one must pay a price equal to its worth. Maybe that's why no one's succeeded.
Character_Brant_65_7: The treasure demands something in return.
Character_Brant_65_9: Every reward comes with a price.
Character_Brant_65_10: Exactly. If we want something from the sea, we have to offer something in return.
Character_Brant_65_11: Ignore that rule, and greed will swallow us whole. Likely with our lives as the main course.
Character_Brant_65_12: Captain, I know what we need to do. Do you trust me?
Character_Brant_65_13: Do what you have to do.
Character_Brant_65_14: Your captain is right by your side.
Character_Brant_65_15: That's all I needed to hear. Let's head for the treasure!
Character_Brant_66_1: Ah, my dear friends! What a joy to see you both in one piece!
Character_Brant_66_2: I-I was absolutely quaking back there. Just the thought of that <ano=Chop Chop>monster</ano>… it still gives me the shivers!
Character_Brant_66_3: When I finally came to my senses, I found myself here, all alone. Quite... quite unsettling, I must say.
Character_Brant_66_4: But look at you! You took down that beast faster than I could blink.
Character_Brant_66_5: Still working on that "grand cause" of yours?
Character_Brant_66_6: Grand…? Oh yes! My grand cause! I'm this close to realizing it, you see. Look! Drake's treasure is right there, so brilliant, so-so dazzling…
Character_Brant_66_7: But as a man of principle, I could never hoard such wealth all to myself.
Character_Brant_66_8: So, in the spirit of fairness, I'd like to give you the honor of opening it first. Please go ahead, the first pick is yours!
Character_Brant_66_9: Leave your bluster at the door.
Character_Brant_66_10: You're just afraid of the curse, aren't you?
Character_Brant_66_11: C-curse? Hahaha! Do I look like the kind of man who fears mere legends? No, no, my offer comes straight from the heart.
Character_Brant_66_13: In accordance with the law of the sea…
Character_Brant_66_14: This is just a teeny tiny curse. Nothing more, nothing less.
Character_Brant_66_16: Hahahaha! Curse? Turns out it's as harmless as a kitten!
Character_Brant_66_17: I fretted for nothing! Yes, now all this treasure is MINE!
Character_Brant_66_20: Grand cause? My crew? Oh right…
Character_Brant_66_21: I'll toss a modest pouch to each of my loyal mateys, and the rest? ALL MINE! Hahaha!
Character_Brant_66_22: When I left the Pilgrim's Sail, there was only one thing that stayed with me—to chase my desires without chains.
Character_Brant_66_23: And after all these years, I've cracked the code… Money! Hahaha! That's my one true calling. Hahaha!
Character_Brant_66_24: But everything comes with a price, Aldric.
Character_Brant_66_25: And now, it's time to pay yours.
Character_Brant_67_2: Curse… This is the curse! My gold… My gold is moving!
Character_Brant_67_3: No Aldric, this is the price of your greed.
Character_Brant_67_4: Did you forget? "The law of quid pro quo."
Character_Brant_69_2: You hear no response, only the sound of waves crashing against the shores.
Character_Brant_7_1: Six o'clock, dinner! Six o'clock, dinner!
Character_Brant_7_2: Greetings! Captain Brant sends his regards!
Character_Brant_7_7: It happens a lot, doesn't it?
Character_Brant_7_10: Captain, Pan Cake at your service! At your service!
Character_Brant_70_2: I… I never thought he'd pick those treasures over his own life…
Character_Brant_70_4: Back then… When Toscanini first told us about Drake's story, I said I wanted to be a captain who led the crew to countless triumphs so that everyone gets to carve out their own destiny.
Character_Brant_70_5: Aldric just laughed, calling it foolish. He said, "You fool! With Drake's treasure, you can crush anyone and make everyone's life better by force!"
Character_Brant_70_6: I never bought into that. For me, it's not about riches or power. It's about freedom—the freedom to sail your own course.
Character_Brant_70_7: That's why we parted ways. He left the Troupe of Fools and became a pirate.
Character_Brant_70_8: The two of you became very different captains.
Character_Brant_70_9: Amidst all your theatrics, you always remain true to your code.
Character_Brant_70_10: As a captain, you're quite different yourself.
Character_Brant_70_11: Certainly one I'd be proud to follow.
Character_Brant_70_12: You accept your crew for who they are, understanding and respecting their choices.
Character_Brant_70_13: I've had my share of adventures, but I must admit—this one with you has been a breath of fresh air.
Character_Brant_70_14: By the way, look at this.
Character_Brant_70_16: What? It looks like an ordinary scroll.
Character_Brant_70_17: This is Golden Captain Drake's map, a record of his life.
Character_Brant_70_18: According to this, he and his crew did indeed brave the treacherous Stormy Sea and return with immense wealth, but not without paying dearly.
Character_Brant_70_19: Heavy fog, disease, getting hopelessly lost, each entry could have sunk an entire fleet. By the time they made it back to the isle, only a handful survived.
Character_Brant_70_20: Most of them never left. In the end, only one sailor remained with this coin.
Character_Brant_70_21: Remember what that note said? "Remember the law of quid pro quo."
Character_Brant_70_22: I believe it means if you want Drake's treasure, you have to offer something in return. The price I paid for this scroll was that coin.
Character_Brant_70_23: So, you gave away the coin…
Character_Brant_70_24: And got this scroll in return?
Character_Brant_70_25: Yes, but isn't it fascinating? A single coin can lead to both dreadful curses and priceless treasures.
Character_Brant_70_26: Who would have guessed that Drake's most valuable treasure would be a map worth just one coin?
Character_Brant_70_27: Honestly, when I made the trade, I wasn't sure what I'd get.
Character_Brant_70_30: Hahaha! I had faith in you, my friend, and the spirit of adventure.
Character_Brant_70_31: And this story is far more compelling than the saga of the Flaming Returned, don't you think?
Character_Brant_70_32: Didn't expect that title to come up again…
Character_Brant_70_33: Tell me what all that is really about.
Character_Brant_70_34: Ah, you remember those pirates who said I was always on the run?
Character_Brant_70_35: Every time a bounty was placed on my head, I'd work with my crew. They'd turn me in for the reward, and I'd handle the escape.
Character_Brant_70_36: The rumors spread faster than I expected. Hahaha…
Character_Brant_70_37: Anyway, if you're up for it, the trip back is long enough for me to tell you all about it.
Character_Brant_70_38: So, Captain, the adventure's come to a close. Ready to sail back home?
Character_Brant_71_1: Ah, what a journey. It feels good to be back.
Character_Brant_71_2: Seems like my captaincy is over, too…
Character_Brant_71_3: I'll leave the paperwork to you.
Character_Brant_71_5: Paperwork? Why wasn't I warned about this?
Character_Brant_71_6: Haha, jokes aside, you can count on me for that!
Character_Brant_71_9: Exactly! I figured it would be a good memento of our adventure.
Character_Brant_71_11: Oh, and due to your stellar performance, I'm officially naming you our troupe's "Honorary Captain," as witnessed by this map!
Character_Brant_71_13: That depends on when the next adventure calls! You know that I'll be ready to join you, just say the word.
Character_Brant_72_1: I'm proud to announce that you are now our troupe's Honorary Captain.
Character_Brant_72_2: Whenever the next grand adventure calls, count me in. I'll be ready!
Character_Brant_8_2: Normally, Captain Brant calls the shots, but since the helm is yours, I'm all ears!
Character_Brant_8_3: Finally! Now this feels like a captain's job.
Character_Brant_8_4: I'll leave it to the First Mate.
Character_Brant_8_5: The Fools are always eager to know where we're headed. So a captain must light the way!
Character_Brant_8_6: The First Mate's opinion does matter, but it's up to the captain to set the course.
Character_Brant_8_7: For those of us who've left our pasts behind, a guiding star is everything. I don't know what the troupe would do without a captain.
Character_Brant_8_8: (I see. I'll do my best to live up to that! Then, let us—)
Character_Brant_8_12: Splendid! Brant took us to Septimont once, so we know that route well.
Character_Brant_8_13: That might be a challenge. We've never gone that far before, but I've heard about Huanglong's famed Hero Plays. Maybe we'll get to see one!
Character_Brant_8_14: The Black Shores…? I've never heard of that place. What's it like? Can't wait to see it for myself!
Character_Brant_8_15: Now that I know the plan, I'll go tell the others and get things ready.
Character_Brant_8_17: Just another day in the life of the Troupe of Fools!
Character_Brant_8_18: Haha! We've braved wuthering waves and stared down every tide! We're seasoned sailors, {PlayerName}!
Character_Brant_8_19: Captain Brant might be whimsical at times, but when the chips are down, he always pulls everyone through.
Character_Brant_8_20: Surprises are just part of our life, so we've gotten used to this "improvised" way of sailing.
Character_Brant_8_21: Speaking of which, we've been busy with convoy assignments lately as pirates have been causing trouble, intercepting trade routes, so we should stay sharp, Captain.
Character_Brant_8_22: After today's performance, I'll check the sea conditions again.
Character_Brant_8_23: Tina! Where are you? Rehearsal is starting soon!
Character_Brant_8_25: Well, Captain, duty calls! I hope you're finding your footing here. Catch you later!
Character_Brant_9_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. I heard you're the captain today. Don't forget to wrap up the paperwork!
Character_Brant_9_2: I thought I was running a ship, not a ledger!
Character_Brant_9_3: I came for the high seas, not a list of to-dos!
Character_Brant_9_4: Haha, don't worry. It was a joke. I hope you've been enjoying yourself today.
Character_Brant_9_5: Leave the paperwork to Brant. Pero will keep an eye on him to make sure it's done by tomorrow.
Character_Brant_9_6: Brant might not look like your typical captain, but he gets the job done.
Character_Brant_9_8: He does things in his style.
Character_Brant_9_9: Hehe, all in a day's work for a captain, right?

Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_47:
On the bridge to the island, you're ambushed by the Dragon of Dirge. You fall off the bridge and land on a beach, surrounded by swarms of Tacet Discord. Roccia, the Fool's Troupe first mate, arrives to help. You find her to be the mysterious person sleeping in her box on the troupe liner.
Roccia tells you that Brant went into the mist alone to rescue survivors. She suggests you wait here for someone from the troupe to pick you up, but you figure that following her might be the faster way to uncover the "truth" Carlotta mentioned. Besides, you can't let a young girl face such danger alone. 
Meanwhile, you wonder if Abby intervened to absorb the Dragon's attack because it detected a compatible frequency. But why did the absorption fail? Fortunately, you can still sense Abby's presence within you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_7: Following the Golden Phantom, you and Roccia narrowly escape the Dragon of Dirge's ambush in the mist...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_20_25: Guided by the Golden Phantom, the two of you reach the end of the beach. You realize the Golden Phantom is actually a Reverberation—a blend of frequencies from Roccia's fallen friends. It's here to lead her out of the mist with a game she loves. Once its mission is complete, you and Roccia watch it fade away, and the mist around you thins slightly. Together, you continue forward.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_13:
As you journey through the mist, you spot a "Pilgrim's Sail," the ship you saw when you first arrived in the city. Roccia explains that all Pilgrim's Sails eventually end up here, carried by the undercurrents to this island—Penitent's End, a place both destination and grave for every Pilgrim's Sail.
The ship appears abandoned. Its passengers must have ventured deeper into the island. With the mist still thick and danger lingering around, you decide to head toward a nearby lighthouse, hoping to find any scattered survivors along the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_23_57:
After battling through swarms of Tacet Discords in the mist, you reunite with Brant, who saved a survivor named Andreas from the Pilgrim's Sail.
Brant and Roccia reveal the grim truth of the pilgrimage: it's a banishment in disguise, and all exiles are marked as "The Fool" by The Order. Brant, Roccia, and their troupe are among those given this title, having been cast out as "The Fools."
Unfortunately, the Order's lies run deep. Andreas tells you in despair that some pilgrims have been misled, believing they will find salvation by reaching the Sacrificial Arena at the island's peak. But that arena is actually the lair of the Dragon of Dirge, a TD that answers not to prayers but devours all frequencies without mercy. 
Determined to save those deceived by The Order and to settle your own score with the Dragon, you all set out for the Sacrificial Arena.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_12: In the Sacrificial Arena, you find a devotee praying for the Sentinel's forgiveness. She is met instead by the Dragon's deadly claws. Fortunately, you manage to save her just in time. Time to make this monster pay.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_17:
After a hard-fought battle, you defeat the Dragon of Dirge. Just as you're about to finish it, Abby emerges from within you again. Abby quickly explains that it tried to absorb the Dragon's frequency earlier but something was wrong with its absorption ability—a sign that Abby's condition may be worsening.
Still, Abby says that's not the main issue. During the absorption, it sensed something unusual in the Dragon's frequency. Abby urges you to empathize with the Dragon before its frequency fades.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_6: As you tap into the Dragon of Dirge's memories, a vision unfolds: a man in The Order's uniform places a halo on the Dragon, commanding it to deliver a final judgment to all who approach.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_32:
You share your vision with Brant and Roccia. They theorize that the Dragon of Dirge was once a simple Tacet Discord that fed on frequencies. But now it becomes a harbinger of death under The Order's control and attacks anything in its path. During the battle, Brant also found a Lycoris on the ground, suggesting that Fractsidus is again behind this.
Brant explains that his troupe has faced Fractsidus at sea before. After they parted ways with you, they kept tracking Cetus the Tidebreaker and found a Lycoris on its tail as well. You suspect Fractsidus's plans may involve the Carnevale and the Sentinel of Rinascita. Since Brant's troupe is here for the Carnevale, they are determined to confront Fractsidus with you.
Brant also mentions that a member of their troupe once won the Laurel of Carnevale. He might know about the connections between the Carnevale, the Laurel, and the Sentinel. You decide to seek him out for answers.
Then, you head to the troupe's base together for a brief respite.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_10: The troupe's base is, surprisingly, hidden in a cavern beneath Penitent's End. The thick mist provides a natural cover, but it remains a perilous environment. Brant and Roccia tell you how to find Bardolino, the former Laureate, and then set off to handle the lingering impact of the mist. They'll meet you again once their tasks are done.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_22: After talking to the troupe member, you managed to retrieve one of the Cloudcaster's parts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_46:
You finally meet Bardolino, the former Laureate, and learn that the rumors are true: the Laureate has the ability to communicate directly with the Sentinel. 
As Bardolino speaks, he fondly recalls Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden, and her reign. He disapproves of Fenrico, and Brant and Roccia join him, using the moment to share the troupe's ideals with those gathered around.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_207_13:
Excited by the conversation, Bardolino suddenly pulls out a bundle of balloons, ties them to himself, and floats up into the air—a recreation, he claims, of his old performance. "Even without wings, we can still soar to the heavens," he passionately quotes. However, he hasn't quite figured out how to land.
Concerned, you start thinking about how to bring him down. Roccia suggests using Cloud Cushions created by a device called the "Cloudcaster." Unfortunately, she admits that some of its parts have been borrowed by other troupe members, so you'll need to retrieve them first.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_18: After talking to the troupe member, you managed to retrieve one of the Cloudcaster's parts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_100_15: After talking to the troupe member, you managed to retrieve one of the Cloudcaster's parts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_103_6: You assemble the Cloudcaster and generate Cloud Cushions beneath Bardolino. The next task is to pop the balloons and bring him safely down. The Cloudcaster's resonance device responds to songs, so the troupe members sing together to expand the Cloud Cushion.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_105_11:
Bardolino lands safely and bows in thanks. Just then, a piece of rock falls from the cavern ceiling, headed straight for him. Carlotta, who has arrived at some point, steps forward and shatters the rock before it can strike him. 
She approaches you, and you acknowledge each other with a simple nod. The Montelli family's protection extends to all who stand by them.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_39_67:
Carlotta tells you that the Montelli family's trouble is temporarily resolved. She and you then piece together recent events. You realize that The Order intends to recreate the crisis that wrecked the Carnevale ten years ago. 
The Order has maintained its power through communication with the Sentinel, but with the Sentinel's absence for ten years, faith in the Order has waned. Also, Primus Fenrico does not match the description of the "Enlightened One." Desperate to restore public trust, the Order has been "forced" to revive the festival. However, if the Carnevale enables direct communication with the Sentinel, The Order's deceptions will be exposed. 
Their plan seems clear now: by causing chaos through Fractsidus, The Order can then intervene as "saviors" and regain the people's trust without undermining their authority. Although you've foiled some of Fractsidus's schemes, threats still loom. The troupe has discovered that Cetus the Tidebreaker is still under their control, and it's likely that a Fractsidus Overseer will make an appearance at the Carnevale. 
To reach the Sentinel, winning the Laurel—which grants a chance to communicate directly with the Sentinel—may be your best option. 
With a shared goal, Carlotta becomes your ally. Now, you just need to decide how to carry out your plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_106_13:
The Order's goal is to disrupt the Carnevale, sowing fear and unrest. But if you confront them directly, you risk fueling the crisis they hope to exploit. 
Carlotta proposes working with the Fool's Troupe to turn any potential disturbance into a staged performance, stripping chaos of its impact.
Brant and Roccia see your hesitation and invite you to join their upcoming rehearsal and get comfortable with the troupe's style. 
Don't forget to bring Carlotta along. If you're ready, take your place on the troupe liner's stage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_21:
Brant and Roccia introduce you to Commedia Improvviso, the troupe's improvisational show. 
Although the performance is largely unscripted, they've prepared a simple outline—a classic story of "a hero's victory over the Demon King," the very tale that Fleurdelys once performed to win the Laurel. 
The world is your stage, they tell you, so relax and express yourself freely. Actions speak louder than words—now, take the stage!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_42_21:
Brant and Roccia praise your performance with Carlotta, expressing confidence that you'll master the art of acting by the time the Carnevale begins. 
But before that, Brant brings up that you still need one final thing to participate in the festival.
Fortunately, Carlotta has it all prepared. Follow her back to Ragunna City.

Quest_167900017_QuestDesc_167_1:
The Fisalia family's heir seems to have a request.
In Thessaleo Fells, a mysterious Terminal is flickering with ominous light. What secrets of the past might it hold?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_1: Lately, Ms. Margherita has been sharing all sorts of cooking tips with me.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_3: Hmm, like this: "Simple is best! Don't be crammin' every flavor into one dish."
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_4: Or "Seasoning isn't just one or two steps. It should be added from start to finish."
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_5: You even picked up her way of talking.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_6: Oops! I guess I've been going over her tips so much that it's starting to rub off on me...
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_7: But the best lesson I learned was from you—"be brave and take that first step."
Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_9: For you it was probably just a kind word, but for me, it meant everything.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_17_1: Don't avoid eye contact… always ask about their preferences… and don't mention Pizza Tropicale unless they do first.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_17_3: Oh, nothing. Just some reminders for taking orders.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_18_1: Ah, why do I keep messing up! All those ingredients, just wasted…
Daily_MGLTJRTC_18_2: Learn from it and try again.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_18_4: You're right! I'll be more careful!
Daily_MGLTJRTC_18_5: Why I started... I want to make food that puts smiles on people's faces.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_18_6: I feel like I've found my courage again. Thank you.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_19_1: I'll put everything I've learned into the next dish I make for you.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_19_2: I'm not completely sure of myself yet, but could I ask you to look forward to it just a little bit?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_20_1: You... recommended me to Ms. Margherita?
Daily_MGLTJRTC_20_2: Yes, but only if you are up for it.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_20_3: Just the idea of cooking during peak hours gets me so nervous I start to shake.
Daily_MGLTJRTC_20_4: But you taught me not to let opportunities slip by. So if the manager agrees, I'll be there.
GuideLZDG02_1_1: Honored guest from afar, I am relieved to finally see you.
GuideLZDG02_1_2: I'm afraid it's not right to burden you with such a troublesome matter, but I can't think of anyone else capable of handling it.
GuideLZDG02_1_4: Heh, lucky for you, you came to the right persoon.
GuideLZDG02_1_5: This isn't as complicated as it seems.
GuideLZDG02_1_6: I knew you would be willing to help.
GuideLZDG02_1_7: Recently, my family entrusted me with managing an ancestral site, where a handed-down "Terminal" still remains.
GuideLZDG02_1_8: This thing... it has a certain malevolence to it, you understand?
GuideLZDG02_1_9: Shadowy monsters frequently emerge from within, causing chaos before disappearing on their own.
GuideLZDG02_1_10: I'm asking for your assistance in dealing with these shadows, and rest assured, you'll be well compensated.
GuideLZDG02_1_12: I entrust this task to you, and I shall await your triumph here.
GuideLZDG02_2_1: (Something's off here. Traces of the Dark Tide's power linger...)
GuideLZDG02_3_1: Hello, one who has passed the trial.
GuideLZDG02_3_2: I don't know what kind of person you are, but your strength is undeniable, among the world's finest.
GuideLZDG02_3_3: Drawing on the mechanics of the Thorncrown Rises and the Remnant Energy within Nimbus Sanctum, I have recreated powerful frequencies from various dimensions.
GuideLZDG02_3_4: To amplify these frequencies to the necessary strength, we even risked harnessing the power of the Dark Tide.
GuideLZDG02_3_5: We have taken on the job from Fisalia, exerting great effort and even collaborating with those from the Order, all to harness these "phantoms of salvation" and bring forth a true "savior."
GuideLZDG02_3_6: Savior, no matter which family you hail from, we have prepared a generous welcome gift for you!
GuideLZDG02_3_7: The "Savior's Proof," obtainable only here and forged into crest coins from the wealth of Fisalia, will bring you endless riches!
GuideLZDG02_3_8: To obtain them, you must become stronger and embrace continuous challenges!
GuideLZDG02_3_9: I await here, eagerly anticipating the emergence of the "Savior"!
GuideLZDG02_4_1: You've returned, Victor! How did it go?
GuideLZDG02_4_2: I'm not going to lie, they've entrusted this place to me, but I truly don't know how to handle that Terminal.
GuideLZDG02_4_4: It's better not to tell him.
GuideLZDG02_4_5: (He genuinely seems unaware... Should I tell him the truth?)
GuideLZDG02_4_6: You told Botim everything the phantom revealed...
GuideLZDG02_4_7: It all makes sense now... So that's what it is... Yes, I understand.
GuideLZDG02_4_8: Esteemed Savior, thank you for sharing the truth with me.
GuideLZDG02_4_9: Certainly, anything you gain from the Terminal is well-deserved. If you wish, you may proceed to the Terminal at any time to undertake the trials.
GuideLZDG02_4_10: I have personal matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave for now.
GuideLZDG02_4_11: Botim left, weighed down by his worries.
GuideLZDG02_4_12: (He really seems unaware... It's probably best not to tell him.)
GuideLZDG02_4_13: I'm on it. Just a few dangerous monsters left to handle, but I'll see it through.
GuideLZDG02_4_14: I'm... I'm not sure how to express my gratitude... but truly, thank you so much!
RGZYYYGJZ_1_20:
At midnight, you arrive at Liberty Square, responding to an invitation from Carlotta's uncle, Capollo.
Though the invitation seems genuine, you remain wary of his true intentions. You and Abby suspect he has ulterior motives beyond mere gratitude.
RGZYYYGJZ_101_49:
Standing before you is Capollo, Carlotta's uncle, son of the Padrino, and the next head of the Montelli family.
While expressing gratitude for your cooperation, he warns that your deep involvement may destabilize the family's delicate balance and disrupt future plans. Capollo offers to take Carlotta's place as the family's representative in your alliance but makes it clear that, if you decline, you should avoid meddling further in Montelli affairs.
As the tension escalates, Carlotta intervenes, leaving you a cryptic message, "Meet me at the rendezvous. Beware the eyes."
Seeing you off, she brings up the recent betrayal involving Benett, the family's vault manager, who was caught stealing from the vault.
RGZYYYGJZ_121_21: You and Carlotta quickly deduce that the bartender is the contact for Scarlet Velvet. Though he may not understand all of the cryptic messages, nothing of importance escapes him. While the bartender is not optimistic about your meeting with Scarlet Velvet, he doesn't stop you as you followed the rules and found him. It also seems that he has heard of Carlotta's character from Benett. Therefore, he promises to arrange a meeting for you with Scarlet Velvet at Whisperwind Haven at dask.
RGZYYYGJZ_15_49:
Realizing that retrieving the Reserved Terminal is impossible, the Acolytes attempt to further sever the relationship between Scarlet Velvet and Montelli before departing.
According to Scarlet Velvet, it is not her group that severed ties but Montelli themselves. The family revoked their rights to purchase Reserved Terminals and weapons, as well as their protection. This revelation surprises Carlotta, as it contradicts Montelli's philosophy of proactive expansion. She asserts her stance to resume trading and assure that Montelli, which once broke the monopoly, will never become a supporter of it.
Regarding Benett, Scarlet Velvet denies the possibility of him stealing from the vault and reveals that Benett foresaw his own death, leaving something behind at the coast, hoping it would never come into handy.
RGZYYYGJZ_16_47:
Deciphering the wine code, you and Carlotta piece together the cryptic message Benett sent on the night of his death. The message points to a collection requiring the highest level of authority in the vault. At the same time, you also receive good news from Duncan—he successfully retrieved Benett's Terminal, though it is severely damaged and requires repair. 
A chilling possibility begins to form in Carlotta's mind: all the suspicious details seem to be pointing to Capollo. To uncover the true traitor, you need to return to Montelli headquarters, repair the terminal, and locate the collection indicated by Benett.
RGZYYYGJZ_18_20: Benett's Terminal is severely damaged, so only basic data are restored. The recovered data shows  Benett's movements, and you notice two suspicious coordinates: one points to the Liberty Square that Carlotta previously investigated, and the other is Capollo's private dock.
RGZYYYGJZ_20_45:
The collection the message points to turns out to be the family's custom-made Reserved Terminal, and all clues suggest that Capollo was the one who removed the core data module from the Terminal, and Benett was framed for embezzlement.
During communication, Carlotta rejects Capollo's proposal to move past the matter, unable to ignore Benett's death and the hidden threats within the family.
Time is pressing, so Carlotta quickly decides to split up, with you taking Benett's Terminal to an expert named Pierre for a thorough repair, while she heads to Capollo's private dock to find out more clues or retrieve the missing core data module.
RGZYYYGJZ_25_9: Carlotta arrives at the dock as planned. Following a strange energy fluctuation, she finds a stained-glass mirror buried under cargo. At that moment, a hand adorned with a blue-black ornament suddenly reaches out from the mirror, pulling her inside—the coordinates are a trap in disguise.
RGZYYYGJZ_26_52:
Standing beside Pierre is the elderly man you once saw admiring the painting—Francesco, the current head of the Montelli family, also known as ""Padrino."" His words are not just about the painting but also about Carlotta. Rather than relying on his own plan, he hopes that Carlotta and her companions can offer their own solution.
Then he entrusts you with a crucial item to be given to her at the right time.
After fully restoring the Terminal, you uncover hidden data—it turns out that Capollo deliberately handed this Terminal to Duncan to lure Carlotta into the trap at the dock.
With Carlotta now missing, you must rush to the location to save her.
RGZYYYGJZ_3_35:
You arrive at the rendezvous before Carlotta and notice Montelli members, dressed in the family's attire, quietly departing one by one. Left behind is an elderly man who is appreciating a painting.
When you approach, he reveals himself as an art-loving investor, simply waiting for the rain to stop. 
He explains that now is not the time to cling to the existing balance, but to embrace the unknown and seek change... You feel there is a deeper meaning behind his thoughts on the painting.
RGZYYYGJZ_301_55:
When the rain stops, the elderly man quietly leaves the scene. Freed from the watchful eyes, Carlotta successfully meets with you.
She apologizes for Capollo's rudeness and confesses that she has no interest in becoming the family head. Her true concern lies with the traitors lurking within the family. She reveals that Benett, the trusted vault manager, was caught embezzling and subsequently killed by Tacet Discords outside the city. However, on the night of his death, Carlotta received a cryptic message from him.
Once again, Carlotta asks for your help to uncover the truth as you are an outsider that once aided her in capturing the initial traitors. To avoid alarming your targets, she offers you a new identity: Cat's Eye, a provisional member under her patronage.
Believing that Benett's death holds key to unraveling the truth, you decide to investigate his residence.
RGZYYYGJZ_4_13:
Outside Benett's residence, Capollo's subordinates, Sage and Acorn, are searching for the stolen items on his order, as Capollo is in charge of the vault.
After some discussion, you and Carlotta decide to split up: she sneaks in through the back, while you confront them for information.
RGZYYYGJZ_49_20:
It would be unwise to directly confront the Order, but staying passively behind Capollo and aimlessly searching for the core data module isn't a reasonable choice either.
You and Carlotta decide to force Capollo into handing over the item by giving them an unforgettable response in two days.
RGZYYYGJZ_5_34: You successfully gather information from Sage and Acorn, learning they found nothing in Benett's residence. They express little hope of retrieving the stolen items as Capollo didn't allocate enough resources for investigation and they also believe that Benett had already sold the items off for quite some time.
RGZYYYGJZ_51_19: With the help of a mysterious figure, you disguise yourself as a family member delivering a gift for Capollo and successfully escort Carlotta into the venue.
RGZYYYGJZ_58_17: Trust built on deception will eventually be shattered by reality. You, Carlotta, and Duncan, who decided to help you, change the location and time of the deal without Capollo noticing. Even though both the trading partners and cargo are lost, Capollo refuses to back down. The two Montellis, now on different paths, finally arrive at their confrontation. The key to winning this duel lies in the whereabouts of the core data module.
RGZYYYGJZ_6_22:
Sharing this information with Carlotta, you both notice some suspicious aspects: when Carlotta brought up Benett's betrayal, Capollo had remained calm, but the series of recent family troubles seem to be all linked to the vault he directly manages. If he is eager to secure his position as the next family head, he should have put more efforts in resolving these incidents. Besides, Benett was not a man who would be easily swayed by greed...
While discussing these points, you notice an elderly man observing you from a distance. Realizing he is exposed, he immediately flees, and you pursue him.
RGZYYYGJZ_61_35:
As the evening rain falls, washing away everything from the past, Carlotta tells you that today's rain brings her peace. She has finally found her true self and feels in control of both her present and future.
When the rain stops, Carlotta bids you farewell. To build a new, true Montelli, she needs to handle the aftermath of Capollo's betrayal. Before parting, she hands you a Cat's Eye brooch, telling you that the codename "Cat's Eye" will forever belong to you, as you are the only member she has ever recommended.
RGZYYYGJZ_7_41:
Carlotta identifies the man as Duncan, a former member of the family who had long left. Duncan attributes Benett's death to insatiable lust and ambition. He shares that like Carlotta, he experienced that "stormy night" and believes all those who inherit the Montelli name are doomed to lose everything.
Carlotta respects Duncan's views, but she also sees through his inner conflict—though he wishes to sever ties with the Montelli family, he returned to Ragunna after hearing Benett's death.
You confide in Duncan about your doubts regarding Benett's death and ask him to join your investigation as his friend. After some hesitation, Duncan agrees and provides you information about Scarlet Velvet and her possible connection to Benett as the recipient of the stolen items.
RGZYYYGJZ_8_16:
Carlotta explains that Scarlet Velvet and her group not only may be in contact with Benett but had recently severed ties with Montalli, ceasing all transactions with the family.
Growing more suspicious, you decide to contact Scarlet Velvet. Following Ragunna's code, you and Carlotta use alcohol as a signal to find her contact.
Event_SRSCWX_1_1: Hmm... Sentinel in the sea. The Golden Bough. Is that... ah... so you've been with me all along...
Event_SRSCWX_1_2: Mm... Where are you taking me... So many mirrors, crows, like writing desks...
Event_SRSCWX_1_3: Fisalia... The Dark Tide. Stay away. Mother, save me...
Event_SRSCWX_2_1: A painting bursting with chaotic, indistinct colors radiates a distinct frequency...
Event_SRSCWX_2_2: You sense something familiar from it.
Event_SRSCWX_3_1: A finely dressed girl sleeps before the painting, her brow furrowed, beads of sweat trailing down her face. She seems ensnared in a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_3_3: Mmm... I... Where am I? Am I awake? Or is this another dream... Oh, did you wake me up?
Event_SRSCWX_3_4: It seems like you had a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_3_5: Yes, I did... Thank you for your help. I'm Claudia, a traveling artist capturing inspirations and the history of artworks.
Event_SRSCWX_3_6: I fell asleep after touching the painting and had a long nightmare. It felt like I became someone else in the dream... How embarrassing for you to see me like that.
Event_SRSCWX_3_7: By the way, my foreign friend, are you familiar with morph paintings like this one?
Event_SRSCWX_3_8: I know it's a painting that links to another dimension.
Event_SRSCWX_3_9: Is that a pocket that pulls out magical tools from another dimension?
Event_SRSCWX_3_10: I see, you must have glimpsed some of the mysteries hidden within these paintings.
Event_SRSCWX_3_11: What? They can do that? No wonder the senior line possesses so many secret treasures of mysterious origin...
Event_SRSCWX_3_12: Anyway... despite the danger, the memories I glimpsed in my dream may be connected to the artist of this painting.
Event_SRSCWX_3_13: Unfortunately, I can't recall the dream's details. If only I could investigate again... But since I'm not a Resonator, I can't grasp the essence of this morph painting.
Event_SRSCWX_3_14: Could I entrust this quest to you? I hope you can uncover the secrets hidden within the painting and reveal the fragments of past memories it holds.
Event_SRSCWX_3_16: Thank you. I will prepare a reward for your help. Oh, and please take this talisman. The world inside the painting will be dangerous, and it should help you.
Event_SRSCWX_3_17: It is a gift from my ancestors, believed to be a fragment of the beacon that once guided people to Ragunna.
Event_SRSCWX_3_18: With its aid, should you lose your way within the painting, the light of the Sentinel will guide you.
Event_SRSCWX_4_1: Claudia sleeps before the painting, her brow furrowed, beads of sweat trailing down her face. She seems ensnared in a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_4_3: Mmm... I... Where am I? Am I awake? Or is this another dream... Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. Did you wake me up?
Event_SRSCWX_4_4: It seems like you had a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_4_5: I... I fell asleep after touching the painting and had a long nightmare. It felt like I became someone else in the dream. Wait, did I speak in my dream?
Event_SRSCWX_4_7: ...Ahem. I hope I haven't made a fool of myself.
Event_SRSCWX_4_8: By the way, {PlayerName}, are you familiar with morph paintings like this one?
Event_SRSCWX_4_9: I know it's a painting that links to another dimension.
Event_SRSCWX_4_10: Is that a pocket that pulls out magical tools from another dimension?
Event_SRSCWX_4_11: I see, you must have glimpsed some of the mysteries hidden within these paintings.
Event_SRSCWX_4_12: What? They can do that? No wonder the senior line possesses so many secret treasures of mysterious origin...
Event_SRSCWX_4_13: Anyway... despite the danger, the memories I glimpsed in my dream may be connected to the artist of this painting.
Event_SRSCWX_4_14: Unfortunately, I can't recall the dream's details. If only I could investigate again...
Event_SRSCWX_4_15: By the way, would it be possible for you to investigate the secrets within the painting for me, {PlayerName}? I want to uncover what's hidden within those past memories.
Event_SRSCWX_4_17: Thank you. I'll prepare a proper reward for your help. And please take this talisman. The world inside the painting will be dangerous, and it should help you.

Event_SRSCWX_4_19: With its aid, should you lose your way within the painting, the light of the Sentinel will guide you, {PlayerName}.
Event_SRSCWX_5_1: That color... I want to learn more about it, no matter what... Thank you for the help.
Event_SRSCWX_6_1: These magical morph paintings... Are they really created with just brushes and paints?
Event_SRSCWX_6_2: If so, what was going through the creators' minds when they painted them?
Event_SRSCWX_7_1: What did you see in that painting, {PlayerName}?
Event_SRSCWX_7_2: What? A different world every time? The painting is filled with monsters? My talisman turned into an Echo? How quaint...
Event_SRSCWX_7_3: But thank the Sentinel you're safe and sound, {PlayerName}, and that's the most important thing. I'm actually curious about your thoughts, {PlayerName}. What did you feel in the worlds inside the painting?
Event_SRSCWX_7_4: It feels like a dream from the Somnoire...
Event_SRSCWX_7_5: I felt a vortex of heartfelt emotions from many creators.
Event_SRSCWX_7_6: I was exhilarated, as if something was calling me to battle.

Event_SRSCWX_7_14: The worlds within the painting are fascinating, but being trapped in them prevents me from creating my own work... I should shift my focus outward and observe more.
Event_SRSCWX_7_15: {PlayerName}, thank you for your assistance in completing this investigation and for sharing your feelings.
Event_SRSCWX_7_16: Please take this talisman, if you don't mind.
Event_SRSCWX_7_17: After all, it can only serve its purpose in those worlds.

Activity_101000007_Title: If On a Rainy Night a Family
Activity_101000007_Desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.
Activity_101000008_Desc: What do the exiled "pilgrims" truly need? Food? Shelter? And perhaps, a ray of starry light, a symbol of hope? Now, with Roccia by your side, the time has come to seek out that light...
GNNPC_LGNC_1_1: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association of Ragunna.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_7: The Pioneer Association of Ragunna operates under our visual production division, the Wutherium Film Studio.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_8: We're dedicated to capturing reality through our lenses, showing not just the devastation of disasters but also the transformations they bring.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_9: Our mission here is to capture and preserve these changes to offer people a new way to see the world.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_10: Whenever you need it, C-MOSS and I will be ready to capture every important moment for you.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_11: I'm confident that we'll create many treasured memories here in Ragunna.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_12: Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_13: Umm... Did you happen to pick up any film on your way here?
GNNPC_LGNC_1_15: Well, like the ones on my head.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_16: My Resonance power, "Film Memory," lets me turn memorable moments and dreams into strands of film-shaped hair.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_17: Nifty, right? Sometimes even lost ideas resurface in the film!
GNNPC_LGNC_1_18: But lately, all those late nights have started taking a toll... I'm losing hair, and along with it, some of my precious film.
GNNPC_LGNC_1_19: Some of it is a bit... personal. If anyone ever saw them, I'd just die of embarrassment—ahhhh!
GNNPC_LGNC_1_20: So, {PlayerName}, if you come across any of my films lying around, could you please return them to me?
GNNPC_LGNC_1_21: ...And um, promise me you won't peek, okay?
GNNPC_LGNC_1_24: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Until we meet again!
GNNPC_LGNC_10_1: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.
GNNPC_LGNC_11_1: I look forward to your next visit. This world of wild dreams is always open to you.
GNNPC_LGNC_13_1: Chop, chop, chop, the orders are coming in hot, hot, hot!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_2: The pizza paddle is firing sparks!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_3: Bakie, it's time for a break! Don't overwork yourself, I'll squirrel these orders away!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_4: Ding! Banker's Boost Platter, fresh out of the oven!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_5: Ding! Gondola Tea and Pastry Tower!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_6: Ding! Margherita's Victory Feast, served up with flair!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_9: Feeling hungry? I'll whip up the Gold Star treatment for you anytime you like!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_11: Are you sure? I heard you've been very busy running around today!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_12: I appreciate it, but I'm okay.
GNNPC_LGNC_13_13: Make sure you eat well, no skipping meals, you hear!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_14: Bakie's stove will be crackling and ready for you whenever you want it!
GNNPC_LGNC_13_15: Also, no cappuccinos after lunch, or I'll be mad at you!
GNNPC_LGNC_14_1: Phew... finally done for the day, and it all went smooth as butter!
GNNPC_LGNC_14_3: Bakie! Fire up a special treat, quick!
GNNPC_LGNC_14_4: So late, my friend! Your stomach must be growling.
GNNPC_LGNC_14_7: Margherita's doors are open for you anytime.
GNNPC_LGNC_14_8: And don't forget, no going hungry in Ragunna!
GNNPC_LGNC_15_1: Welcome to Margherita's! Your pizza will be hot and fresh in no time!
GNNPC_LGNC_16_1: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.
GNNPC_LGNC_17_1: Come by more often—don't be a stranger!
GNNPC_LGNC_18_1: Mercurio extends his hands confidently, as if to say, "How may I help you today?"
GNNPC_LGNC_18_2: I'm here to deliver some Monnaie I found.
GNNPC_LGNC_18_3: Thanks. I'm good at the moment.
GNNPC_LGNC_19_1: Mercurio applauds, as if to say, "Thank you for returning these Monnaie. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude. On behalf of Averardo Vault, we thank you."
GNNPC_LGNC_2_1: The line between poison and medicine is all in the dose and intent.
GNNPC_LGNC_21_1: The usually arrogant Mercurio treats you with courtesy, prompting whispers about your connection to the Montelli family.
GNNPC_LGNC_22_1: The Gondola lowers itself slightly, making it easier for you to browse the wide array of goods on its back.
GNNPC_LGNC_23_1: The Gondola snorts happily, sending up a spray of water that creates a rainbow.
GNNPC_LGNC_24_1: The Gondola snorts happily, sending up a spray of water that refracts the moonlight.
GNNPC_LGNC_26_1: The Gondola swishes its tail, causing the money pouch at its stern to emit a series of soft clicks, as if expressing gratitude for your visit.
GNNPC_LGNC_27_1: A good player must know how to listen—what kind of music will you bring to Ragunna today?
GNNPC_LGNC_28_1: Melody humbly greets you and wishes you a most wonderful day in Ragunna.
GNNPC_LGNC_29_1:
May you discover all that you seek within the vivid canvas of gladiatorial combat.
Today, we pay tribute to the legendary gladiator, Hadrian.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_1: That aroma, it's pretty soothing... I'm starting to relax.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_3: My apologies, I sensed your fatigue and took it upon myself to help.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_5: It caught me off guard a little...
GNNPC_LGNC_3_7: There's no need to be afraid. This is just my regular "Mist Therapy."
GNNPC_LGNC_3_8: Wonderful. This treatment of mine is called "Mist Therapy." I'm glad it serves you well.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_10: Yes. By extracting medicinal essences and blending them with aromatic substances, we create a special "Mist Potion."
GNNPC_LGNC_3_11: With each breath, the mist alleviates discomfort, almost imperceptibly. It's a secret art of the Fisalia family.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_12: Poison or cure, harm or heal—it lies entirely in the user's intention.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_14: I'm only trying to help those in need.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_16: As you may have gathered, I'm a Fisalia pharmacist. Our name isn't exactly welcome here in Ragunna...
GNNPC_LGNC_3_17: Rumors about the family echo through the streets—people call us "The Poison of Ragunna."
GNNPC_LGNC_3_18: It's sad... they seem to find tales of the Fisalias more interesting than the truth.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_19: If someone sees you here, you may find yourself entangled in their rumors as well.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_20: I do hope this won't weigh on your mind during your time in Ragunna. You have more pressing matters to attend to.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_21: I'm not one of those people.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_22: I'm not bound by Ragunna's rules.
GNNPC_LGNC_3_23: The only rumor that's true—you really are special.
GNNPC_LGNC_32_1: (It seems to be cheering you on!)
GNNPC_LGNC_4_1: Welcome to Rosemary's Apothecary, where your perfect potion awaits.
GNNPC_LGNC_5_1: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.
GNNPC_LGNC_6_1: If anything feels off, I'll be here to assist straight away.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_3: I want to know about you.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_7: What I crafted for Carlotta, I can certainly craft for you.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_12: But you, mon chou, you wouldn't disappoint me with you request, would you?
GNNPC_LGNC_8_16: You could say that their imaginations have given me a thousand different visages.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_17: What about you? What am I in your mind's eye?
GNNPC_LGNC_8_18: I sense that, from you, I might finally hear the truth I've been waiting for.
GNNPC_LGNC_9_1: Welcome to the Masked Reverie. Allow me to adorn you with a new identity.
