Quest_114000029_ChildQuestTip_114_135: Investigate the trace left by the mysterious girl
MapMark_136000_MarkDesc:
The collapsing morph painting constantly devours and absorbs frequencies and energy from its surroundings to sustain itself. Stones, plants, and even animals stripped of their frequencies are left in a silent, frozen state, as if drained of all life and color.

The stolen colors manifest as chaotic color blocks within the painting. Remove the incorrect color blocks to release these trapped colors, restoring the scenery to its original splendor.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_23_41: The liner continues to glide through the waves. Before long, distant coastlines emerge from the horizon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_222_1: You see that?! There's no such thing as divine punishment!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_222_2: Hah... I see... I'm starting to understand everything...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_223_1: Did you see that!? There's no such thing as divine punishment. It's all a lie! That sea behemoth from ten years ago? Just a whale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_223_2: Yeah... Why didn't we think of that before?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_223_3: Probably because of the fog that year, and all that strange talk from the Order that had everyone on edge...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_223_4: So then, the ghosts, the dragon, even the fog... Could they all be something else entirely?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_223_5: Yeah! What do you say we team up afterward and head out to the sea to investigate? Maybe we'll uncover some incredible secrets. And who knows? We might just become famous!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_224_1: Oh... Was that all a dream?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_224_2: I bet it was just some special effects!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_225_1: Oh... Was that all just a dream? The sky was nothing like it is now...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_225_2: I think it was just the "special effects" the troupe uses for the show!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_225_3: Is it...? But the effect felt so... real...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_225_4: Well, their actors are clearly a bunch of Resonators. And with so many Echoes helping them, it's not impossible to pull off something like that.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_225_5: Think of it as a dream! And honestly, there's nothing wrong with that. The Carnevale is supposed to be dreamy like that!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_226_2: Where do these actors come from? They're amazing...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_227_1: Again! Again! That was a great show!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_227_2: Where do these actors come from, though? I heard the Montelli family invited them, but I've never seen them at the previous Carnevales!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_227_3: How many years has it been since we last held the Carnevale? There must've been a lot of people preparing for this during these years, right? It's not unusual to see fresh faces we don't recognize.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_228_1: Oh, this is the kind of photo I'm gonna cherish for life! Gotta send a copy to Rover soon...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_1: Hi Rover! Have you received the photo?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_2: It was me who captured it—the moment of your grand curtain call! I've already sent it to you from my Terminal!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_3: What an incredible show! I could practically feel the heat of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_4: By the way, your performance... "Commedia Improvviso," right? What a bold and innovative style of acting...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_5: When I get the chance, I'd love to make a documentary about your troupe... Wait, scratch that—opportunities are what we make of them, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_229_6: I'll be working on the shooting plan soon, and when the time comes, I'd really appreciate your help in reaching out to the troupe.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_230_1: Carlotta has really found a gem this time, hasn't she? Hehe...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_231_1: Well, well, if it isn't our Laureate for this year! How did you like the mask?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_231_2: If you enjoyed it, don't be a stranger. Be sure to visit us more often! Hehe.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_231_3: We're truly honored that you won the Laurel wearing one of our customized Masks. I must be the first to thank you for that. It's the best kind of publicity we could ask for.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_231_4: This dream of ours is about to shine even brighter, all thanks to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_231_5: Carlotta has really found a gem this time, hasn't she? Hehe...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_232_1: This is where the blonde girl stood. Even now, you can sense faint fluctuations in the air. You scan the surroundings, but the mysterious maiden has vanished, leaving no trace behind.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_232_2: From Carlotta's reaction, it seems that no one but you can perceive her presence.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_232_3: Who is she? Or what is she? Did she only show up for this year's Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_232_4: The path to answers will certainly be treacherous. But regardless, you possess the will, the determination, and the courage to seek the truth. These qualities will see you through.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_233_1: Cartethyia... I will have my family find out more about her.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_233_2: If we find anything, I'll contact you, and we can discuss our next steps together.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_234_1: Ah, I can't be happier than now!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_234_3: It's times like these that make me want to sing!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_235_1: Hi there! Haha, if it isn't our esteemed Laureate! Finally made it, huh?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_235_2: It's a celebratory dinner hosted by Ms. Carlotta in our honor. And let me tell you—she's quite generous with her money!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_235_3: By the way, have you heard? The Order has granted our troupe free passage in and out of the city. It sounds like a good deal... but there's something about it that doesn't sit right with me.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_235_4: Look, there's an Acolyte over there. He's probably keeping an eye on us... Hah.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_235_5: But enough of that! Here's to you, my friend! To our new Laureate!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_236_1: Raise your glasses! Shout it loud, friends!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_237_1: Remember, you're not alone. If anything happens, just let us know.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_238_1: Hey, you! Yes, you, the {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} in black clothes! Over here! In the alley!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_238_2: Yeah, don't look around. I'm talking to you! There's something I'd like to tell you... I'll be waiting for you in this alley.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_239_1: Hey, you! Yes, you, the {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} in black clothes! Over here! In the alley!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_1: Ah, finally. I can tell at a glance that you are not an ordinary person.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_2: You... You must be a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_3: Who are you? How did you know?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_4: You are a Bloom Bearer, more Bloom Bearer than I.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_5: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_6: Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself first. My name's Ariosto, and I am the undercover Bloom Bearer sent here to investigate Rinascita's recent issues.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_7: Are you the only one they sent here?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_8: Are there any other Bloom Bearers here?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_9: The Black Shores has also sent other Bloom Bearers to Rinascita, but to keep things under the radar of the Order, we decided to split up.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_10: If you head southeast toward Septimont, you'll likely run into some of our colleagues. Compared to Ragunna, Bloom Bearers enjoy a bit more freedom there—less surveillance and fewer rules to follow.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_11: But... how should I put it? Things aren't quite as smooth in Septimont. Our operations face their own set of challenges, and the Bloom Bearers' work there hasn't been progressing as well as we'd hoped.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_12: As you know, the Black Shores is a neutral organization, so we don't have the right to meddle in their affairs without the consent of the local officials.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_13: Our relationship with Rinascita's city-states is… well, "delicate" is one way to put it. We've been providing warnings about the Lament crisis—Ragunna being the prime example, of course.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_14: By the way... Come closer, gotta keep our voice low for this... Have you run into any... obstructions from the Order during your mission?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_17: I see. It happened to me as well. On the surface, Ragunna appears peaceful, but behind the scenes, the Order has been plotting something.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_18: People from the Order was hot on my tail when I was investigating this matter, and even had my Terminal taken from me. Luckily the Montellis extended a helping hand...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_19: It was the same Ms. Carlotta who told me that a member of the Black Shores would be arriving in Ragunna soon. I decided to find {Male=him;Female=her} quickly and share the information I have.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_20: I borrowed this costume and a mask from the Montelli to blend in with the crowd, so I could get back to the city during the Carnevale. Well, at least my hard work finally paid off.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_22: How could they treat us like this!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_23: Us Bloom Bearers, we endure hardship, but the Lament must be stopped at all costs! That's our Bloom Bearer Creed!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_24: You must already have some sense of Ragunna's situation. Now, let me share a wild thought with you...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_25: You saw that Sentinel statue in Ragunna, right? That statue is strikingly different from the appearance of Sentinel Imperator we recorded in the Tethys System.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_26: Now, take a deep breath—because I'm about to say something big. What if, just what if... the people of Ragunna have been believing in a false Sentinel all along?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_27: Wait... Enough talk for today. I can't shake the feeling that we're being watched.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_28: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.
GuideTutorialPage_32027_Content: Fae Ignis explodes when defeated, damaging nearby targets. This effect won't be triggered if it's defeated <color=#ffd12f>in mid-air</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32028_Content:
Chop Chop: Headless attacks with laser beams, which can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
Successful Counterattacks deal great DMG to Chop Chop: Headless.
GuideTutorialPage_32029_Content: Chest Mimic can be instantly defeated by <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32030_Content: Cuddle Wuddle can team up with Diggy Duggy, Hocus Pocus, or Lottie Lost to perform combo attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32031_Content:
In defense mode, the Sentry Construct gains high DMG Reduction and slowly restores its Vibration Strength. <color=#ffd12f>Attacking it from behind</color> disables its defense mode.
If attacked while in mid-air, it loses more Vibration Strength and becomes easier to immobilize.
GuideTutorialPage_32032_Content: Lorelei summons special water balls that float toward her. These water balls grant buffs when absorbed by Lorelei or the active Resonator.
GuideTutorialPage_32033_Content: Hecate's whip is an extension of herself and can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32034_Content: When Chop Chop: Headless combines with a windmill, their attacks can be Counterattacked using <color=#ffd12f>Questless Knight's Echo Skill</color>, dealing great DMG.
GuideTutorialPage_3203402_Content: Chop Chop: Leftless/Rightless are invulnerable until Chop Chop: Headless is Immobilized.
GuideTutorialPage_33014_Content:
A remnant creature with an intense fixation on music. <color=#ffd12f>When struck</color>, it drops the Melody Box it has collected.
Deliver the Melody Box to Aria Mummer to add the corresponding track to your collection list.
GuideTutorialPage_3301402_Content: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.
GuideTutorialPage_3301403_Content: Visit the Aria Mummer to access the Archive of Melodies feature. Select a track in an album to play. You may set a selected track as the background music around Aria Mummer by enabling <color=#ffd12f>Set As Background Music</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_33015_Content:
You can steer the Gondola using movement controls. Use Dash to speed up.
Hold Exit to exit the steering mode.
GuideTutorialPage_3301502_Content: When steering a Gondola in Single Player mode, you can open the Cruise Share menu by pressing the <color=#ffd12f>Cruise Share button</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_33016_Content: Check the obtained mask in your Backpack.
GuideTutorialPage_3301602_Content: Select a mask to wear it or take it off.
GuideTutorialPage_33017_Content:
A <color=#ffd12f>beacon</color> you once set for yourself, imbued with the strength and faith to keep moving forward.
<color=#ffd12f>Rover: Spectro</color>'s abilities have been enhanced. Resonance Liberation <color=#ffd12f>Echoing Orchestra</color> and Resonance Skill <color=#ffd12f>Resonating Spin</color> now inflict <color=#ffd12f>Spectro Frazzle Effect</color> on the target while retaining their original effects.
Check the Resonator's Forte interface for more details.
GuideTutorial_34082_GroupName: Plushie Village in the Garden of the Lost
GuideTutorial_34100_GroupName: Dream Patrol: Fae Ignis from Dreamscape
Tutorial_34082_Title: Plushie Village in the Garden of the Lost
GuideTutorialPage_34076_Content: Flying along the Wind Trail allows you to <color=#ffd12f>automatically</color> follow the wind's direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34076_02_Content: Follow the Wind Rings to stay on course. Pass through them to earn challenge points!
GuideTutorialPage_34077_Content:
Across Rinascita, you may stumble upon these fragile containers scattered around. Shatter them to uncover hidden treasures within.

Keep a close eye on those bearing the Montelli family crest, as they contain Monnaies—an old currency that can be redeemed for rewards at Averardo Bank.
GuideTutorialPage_34077_02_Content: Smash the floating containers with the Gondola or your attacks and collect the treasures within!
GuideTutorialPage_34078_Content:
These collapsed morph paintings drain frequencies and energy from their surroundings to maintain their forms, causing the minerals, plants, and even animals nearby to lose their vibrancy and color.
The absorbed colors transform into chaotic color blocks on the Overflowing Palette. <color=#ffd12f>Adjusting all the blocks into a designated color</color> will restore the environment's former vibrancy.
GuideTutorialPage_34078_02_Content: Select a color on the right and apply it to the blocks on the palette to the left. The new color will spread to all connected blocks of the same color.
GuideTutorialPage_34078_03_Content: Different Overflowing Palettes have different move limits. Plan your moves carefully to return the land to its former vibrancy!
GuideTutorialPage_34079_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.
GuideTutorialPage_34079_02_Content:
After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus or Resonance Beacon to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_34080_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34081_Content:
The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.
Use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
GuideTutorialPage_34082_Content: A village of Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost. The villagers are gathering Sonance Caskets throughout Ragunna to unlock the Sonoro Sphere within a morph painting.
GuideTutorialPage_34083_Content:
While steering a Gondola, you can use Waterfall Surge to swim up a waterfall.
<color=#ffd12f>(Please note that this function can only be used in safe waters. Protect your Gondolas, and protect yourselves.)</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34084_Content:
A special Gondola that cruises along the most scenic spots in Ragunna City, often called the city sightseeing water bus.
Board the Gondola to relax and enjoy the voyage.
GuideTutorialPage_34085_Content: Aim your Grapple at the Wingray. When the visual cue appears, cast Grapple to link yourself to the Wingray. It will carry you upward.
GuideTutorialPage_34085_02_Content:
The link will automatically break once you reach the highest point.
The Wingray will return to its starting point after a short time.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_Content:
You can use <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> in your Utility after reaching certain heights off the ground.
Flight is a Utility specific to Rinascita regions. Available only while not in combat.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_02_Content:
When in Flight, use movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend or dive.
As you dive, you gain momentum for the Echo Wings, allowing you to ascend higher.
Try diving to restore momentum when it depletes.
GuideTutorialPage_34087_Content: Once the challenge begins, follow the ground cues to avoid the Vitreum Dancers dashing toward you.
GuideTutorialPage_34088_Content:
When you reach a Leap Spot, using Utility will activate Echo transformation automatically. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and jump.
Aim your camera to the next Leap Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to leap again.
GuideTutorialPage_34089_Content:
When you reach a Climbing Spot, the Utility will automatically become Echo transformation. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle for the climbing challenge.
Aim your camera toward the next Climbing Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to climb again.
GuideTutorialPage_34089_02_Content: Reach the final Climbing Spot to perform the Leap for the Top!
GuideTutorialPage_34090_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and smash the Seamrock. Ready to throw this Plushie Punch!
GuideTutorialPage_34090_02_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the button while the pointer is in the highlighted section to speed up the progress. The rock will break once the progress bar is full.
GuideTutorialPage_34090_03_Content: When the pointer enters the orange zone, activate Powerful Punch mode. Rapidly {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the left and right buttons to speed up the smashing.
GuideTutorialPage_34091_Content: Press the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and break the Friable Rock with a single punch!
GuideTutorialPage_34092_Content:
Ordinary Nightmare Clouds can be absorbed into Lottie Lost's picture book, transforming them into beautiful paintings.
Absorb Nightmare Clouds to earn rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_34092_02_Content:
Nightmare Clouds of ghostly flames. 

Observe the number of flames and absorb Nightmare Clouds <color=#ffd12f>in the correct order</color>. Absorbing them in the wrong order will reset the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_34092_03_Content:
Nightmare Clouds that keep multiplying.
 
Lottie Lost must use the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the Enhanced Absorption button to <color=#ffd12f>absorb</color> and eliminate all Nightmare Clouds at once.
GuideTutorialPage_34093_Content:
Lottie Lost draws power from the stories in the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, enhancing her ability to absorb Nightmare Clouds.
 
<color=#ffd12f>Hold the Enhanced Absorption button</color> to absorb all Nightmare Clouds within her radius.
 
The Enhanced Absorption state lasts for a limited time and can be refreshed by reading the Finished Book again.
GuideTutorialPage_34094_Content: Lottie Lost can resonate with the Unfinished Book, sensing the trail of its lost pages.
GuideTutorialPage_34094_02_Content:
Guide Lottie Lost to collect the lost pages by following the sensed trail as closely as possible.
Once all the pages are collected, the Unfinished Book will be fully restored.
GuideTutorialPage_34095_Content: Stand right before the monument base, then use Grapple to pull the misplaced monument back to its base to restore the monument.
GuideTutorialPage_34095_02_Content: Restore all the monuments, and you might uncover something unexpected!
GuideTutorialPage_34096_Content:
Approach the base and interact with the flickering point to read the <color=#ffd12f>inscription</color>.
Find the painting mentioned in the text and use Levitator to place it on the <color=#ffd12f>matching base.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34097_Content:
Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.

Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all <color=#ffd12f>challenge goals</color> to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
GuideTutorialPage_34098_Content: Some special Dreamscape Nodes feature <color=#ffd12f>enhanced</color> Nightmare Tacet Discords.
GuideTutorialPage_34099_Content: The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies <color=#ffd12f>reduces the remaining defense time.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34100_Content: Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.
GuideTutorialPage_34101_Content: Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.
GuideTutorialPage_34101_02_Content: Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's <color=#ffd12f>HP drops below 30%</color>, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.
GuideTutorialPage_34102_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacking</color> the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.
GuideTutorialPage_34103_Content: Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
GuideTutorialPage_34104_Content: Face the Nightmare Clouds and use Utility to transform into a Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Hold the button</color> to absorb the Nightmare Clouds with her picture book!
GuideTutorialPage_34105_Content: When the Roseshroom charges for shooting a laser, shoot the core at its head to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_Content: Select a piece to preview its landing point, then select the point to move the piece.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_02_Content: When a black piece lands on the outer circle, it <color=#ffd12f>opens all gates and maze walls in that direction.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34106_03_Content: You can pause the game at any time, and <color=#ffd12f>all pieces will stay in place.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34106_04_Content: Press the <color=#ffd12f>Reset button</color> to restart the game.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_05_Content:
The game ends when either side's pieces form a straight line.
<color=#ffd12f>If black pieces connect, you win</color>; if white pieces connect, the Lifer wins.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the Terminals granting buffs to the Lifer.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_02_Content: Submit a <color=#ffd12f>Stake of Imbalance</color> at a Terminal to remove the buffs.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_03_Content: After submitting the Stakes, you can freely <color=#ffd12f>turn The Lifer's buffs on or off</color> through the Terminal.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_Content:
Each of the three altars is connected to the Discipline Steles around it.
Stand on the altar platform to charge the steles, but <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords will appear</color> to disrupt the effort.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_02_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When only the player is within the altar's range</color>, the steles charge most efficiently.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_03_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When there are Tacet Discords within the altar's range</color>, the steles stop charging.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_04_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When the player is out of the alter's range,</color> the steles stop charging, and the energy begins to drain.
GuideTutorialPage_34109_Content: In the dark area not illuminated by the Macare Torch, Tacet Discords are enhanced, entering the Shadow state that makes them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all attacks.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34109_02_Content: The Macabre Torch's light can dispel the Shadow state of Tacet Discords, making them vulnerable again.
GuideTutorialPage_34109_03_Content: There are certain enemies who will try to extinguish the nearby Macabre Torch after taking specific amounts of damage.
GuideTutorialPage_34110_Content: Use Levitator to collect the stained glass pieces.
GuideTutorialPage_34111_Content:
Go through the Tacet Mark protruding from the ground to enter the Tacet Field in another dimension.

After clearing the Tacet Field, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and collected Echoes of the corresponding Sonata set.
GuideTutorialPage_34112_Content: Surveillance cameras are used to scan for suspicious activities. Staying within their view increases Alertness.
GuideTutorialPage_34114_Content: Vitreum Dancers patrol the Vault, charging at intruders and dealing DMG on impact.
GuideTutorialPage_34115_Content: Scatter Prisms greatly enhance Carlotta's Forte. Shooting them with the "jewelry set" disables the surveillance cameras and Vitreum Dancers within a large area permanently.
GuideTutorialPage_34116_Content: Alertness indicates how alert the Vault's security system is to your actions. It increases when you are detected by Vitreum Dancers, spotted by surveillance cameras, or engage in combat. You can lower it by disabling security systems or defeating enemies. If Alertness reaches 100, you will be forced to retreat and restart from the previous area.
GuideTutorialPage_34117_Content: Defense Lasers block certain pathways and deal DMG to anyone who touches them.
GuideTutorialPage_35001_Content: Immune to interruption when HP is above 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35002_Content: RES to all Attribute DMG is increased by 200%.
GuideTutorialPage_35003_Content: When hit by a Counterattack, Vibration Strength Reduction is increased by 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35006_Content: Damage dealt by allies within the range is increased by 100%.
GuideTutorialPage_35007_Content: ATK is increased by 100% every 20s. This effect can stack unlimited times.
GuideTutorialPage_35008_Content: Immobilized state duration is reduced by 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35009_Content: Explode upon being defeated, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
GuideTutorialPage_35010_Content: After taking no DMG for 2s, restore 10% of their Max HP every second. This effect resets upon taking DMG.
GuideTutorialPage_35011_Content: Dealing DMG increases ATK by 20%, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks will be removed if they don't deal any DMG in 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35012_Content: Knock back nearby enemies when taking DMG equal to or greater than 25% of their Max HP in 1s, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
GuideTutorialPage_35015_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35016_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Electro Flare on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35017_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35018_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Fusion Burst on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35019_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35020_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Havoc Bane on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35021_Content: This type of enemy has much higher HP and ATK. Dodge Counter and Counterattack can additionally decrease their Vibration Strength and HP.
GuideTutorialPage_35023_Content: Restore 20% HP for nearby allies upon being defeated.
GuideTutorialPage_35024_Content: Deal Fusion DMG equal to 2% of the target's Max HP per second to the nearby enemies. This effect does not stack.
GuideTutorialPage_35025_Content: Immune to Electro DMG when HP is below 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35026_Content: Receive 100% more damage when inflicted with Spectro Frazzle.
GuideTutorialPage_35027_Content: Increase nearby allies' ATK by 60% for 15s upon being defeated.
GuideTutorialPage_35029_Content: Receiving DMG increases DMG dealt by 10% for 8s, stacking up to 10 times.
ItemInfo_70050053_AttributesDescription: A painting gifted by the traveling painter Claudia, capturing a scene from the tower ruins.
ItemInfo_70050053_BgDescription:
According to legend, the Thorncrown Rises, located in Thessaleo Fells, holds the lost glory of the Fisalia family. 
Through the painter's delicate brushstrokes, one can sense her upset and confusion.
ItemInfo_70050053_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A painting gifted by the traveling painter Claudia, capturing a scene from the tower ruins.
ItemInfo_70050054_AttributesDescription: A toy made from unknown materials, emanating a faint but warm frequency.
ItemInfo_70050054_BgDescription:
Proof of successful completion of all the challenges in "Although Colors Have No Form."
A talisman from Claudia, rumored to be a fragment of the Genesis Nexus. It emits a faint but warm frequency, though its true purpose remains uncertain.
"...They longed for the sky above, yearning for it more desperately than any soul in this world."
ItemInfo_70050054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Proof of successful completion of all the challenges in "Although Colors Have No Form."
LoadingTipsText_200001_TipsText:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 
The Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."
LoadingTipsText_200002_TipsText:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.
LoadingTipsText_200003_TipsText: The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator and holds de facto rule over Ragunna. According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word. Under the leadership of the current Primus, Fenrico, a series of laws were enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.
LoadingTipsText_200004_TipsText: At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.
LoadingTipsText_200005_TipsText: The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.
LoadingTipsText_200006_TipsText: Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.
LoadingTipsText_200007_TipsText: This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish.
LoadingTipsText_200008_TipsText: The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.
LoadingTipsText_200009_TipsText: The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.
LoadingTipsText_200010_TipsText: This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...
LoadingTipsText_601001_TipsText: Simulation Training takes place in an artificial Sonoro Sphere dedicated to combat training. Clear the challenges within for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_601101_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_601201_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_601301_TipsText:
The music persists, and the crimson curtains are set to rise once more.
Will you share another dance with her in this long, unfolding drama?
LoadingTipsText_601401_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601501_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601601_TipsText: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
LoadingTipsText_601701_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601801_TipsText:
The Sonoro Sphere of Phrolova.
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
LoadingTipsText_601901_TipsText: The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
LoadingTipsText_602001_TipsText:
A hall set for a banquet, grand enough to dazzle, yet secret enough to conceal.
At this very moment, a trade initiated by one Montelli is being undone by another.
LoadingTipsText_602101_TipsText: Behind the mirror lies a realm where the illusions of the past intertwine with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an completely different destiny.
LoadingTipsText_602101_Title: Realm of Ego: Mirrors in the Mirror
LoadingTipsText_602201_TipsText: A prison built of power and fear is strong enough to chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from within people's hearts.
LevelPlay_151900014_ChallengeConditionSu: Use Sensor to locate nearby Supply Chests

InstanceDungeonEntrance_1511_Description: The vault houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Upholding the principle of "Inviolability of Property," it is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1514_Description:
Phrolova's Sonoro Sphere. 
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1004_Description: At the end of the labyrinth lies a bizarre cave, seemingly the source of the mist. In the pitch darkness, twisted shadows flicker, accompanied by low, unsettling growls...
InstanceDungeonEntrance_6003_Description: An institution where the Order sealed all forbidden books and records, now lost beneath the depths of the lake during the Dark Tide.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2510_Description: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2051_Description:
Lingering frequencies left by a fierce clash between two formidable forces, now shaped by your memories and taking the form of Lycrosis.
The singer from beyond still awaits on the stage.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_303000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. In a darkness untouched by day or night, can a single glimmer of light deliver what the heart yearns for?
InstanceDungeonEntrance_304000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. They spread saintly wings, like the tender embrace of a lover's arms.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_305000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. It is not a surrender to the Order's authority, but a confession of the world's suffering.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_306000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere records an ancient ceremony eroded by the Lament. At the end of suffering, may all transgressions be forgiven.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_307000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere records an ancient ceremony eroded by the Lament. The harbor draws near, the bell rings clear. O captain, have you heard the people's cheers?
InstanceDungeon_1511_DungeonDesc:
The vault, controlled by the Montelli Family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork.  Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
Inside, the vault features numerous depositories guarded by a formidable array of Echo Guards and advanced security devices, making it the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita. It defies any ordinary means of intrusion.
InstanceDungeon_1514_DungeonDesc:
The final stage, constructed from Lycorises, is stained with deep crimson sap that seeps into every corner. The singer from beyond has long waited here.
Join her in this endless play, and use your humble strength to defy the raging current of fate!
InstanceDungeon_1004_DungeonDesc: At the end of the labyrinth lies a bizarre cave, seemingly the source of the mist. In the pitch darkness, twisted shadows flicker, accompanied by low, unsettling growls...
InstanceDungeon_6003_DungeonDesc: A prison built of power and fear can chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from the heart. Just as the barren desert cannot bury the spring of life, and the darkest night cannot smother the stars.
InstanceDungeon_2510_DungeonDesc:
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
The upper water chapel connects to the sea that flows through Ragunna City, with its waters rising and falling with the tides as if breathing in time with the Sentinel. Thus, it is known as the Tidal Sanctuary.
InstanceDungeon_2051_DungeonDesc:
The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
Will you dance again with her in this endless drama?

InfoDisplay_133002001_Text:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 

As an island nation reborn from the Lament, Rinascita was long isolated from the rest of the world by relentless disasters and vast distances. It wasn't until recent times that the Rinascitans opened new maritime routes. Ships laden with their spices and minerals began to sail across the world, and in turn, new treasures and wealth began flowing back to Rinascita, enriching its shores.

Rinascita is famed for its unique "Common Echo" technology, which allows Echoes to persist in physical form within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. Through this technology, the Rinascitan people have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."

Rinascitans place great value on the identity derived from bloodlines, and their society is built upon a deep reverence for family ties. For them, the welfare of the family always takes precedence over individual fate.
InfoDisplay_133002002_Text:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will.

In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. The city is adorned with magnificent sculptures and paintings at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life. Under the leadership of Fenrico, the current Primus of the Order of the Deep, a series of laws have been enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.

At present, Ragunna's daily affairs are overseen by the Order of the Deep, while prominent families such as Montelli and Fisalia also hold significant influence over the direction of the city.
InfoDisplay_133002003_Text:
The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, where the masquerades never end, wine flows like rivers, and music pulses through the night. During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.

The Carnevale's origins trace back to Sentinel Imperator, who once guided the people of Rinascita. It began as a tribute to Their grace, a celebration where laughter and performance became the purest form of reverence.

At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel." This honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.

Yet, a decade ago, the Carnevale was brought to ruin. A monstrous sea beast, rogue Echoes, and Tacet Discords swept through the festival, turning revelry to ruin. Only when Primus Fenrico intervened did the chaos subside. He proclaimed it was Sentinel Imperator's divine retribution for the Ragunnesi's indulgence and forsaking of their faith. Since then, the Carnevale has not been held again.
InfoDisplay_133002004_Text:
Those deemed faithless by the Order of the Deep are sent to voyage upon the Pilgrim's Sail, following the ancient path of those who once braved the mist and maelstrom seeking the Sentinel's guidance.

The Order claims that only Imperator can grant absolution to these transgressors. They must endure a grueling pilgrimage, suffering both body and soul until their repentance is complete. At the journey's end, it is said Sentinel Imperator will offer them forgiveness and the promise of new life.

But no one in Ragunna has ever heard of a faithless "pilgrim" returning from this sacred journey. The Order asserts that they reach Imperator's place of dwelling and devote themselves to Their service for eternity. While many still harbor doubts, few dare to openly challenge the Order—none wish to suffer the same tragic fate as those branded Fools.
InfoDisplay_133002005_Text:
A common boat-shaped Echo in Ragunna.

Ragunna's intricate network of waterways, coupled with its narrow streets and rugged terrain surrounding the city has made Gondolas the preferred choice for transporting both people and goods. For most Ragunnesi, they offer a peaceful, smooth alternative to the discomfort of navigating crowded streets or bumpy countryside roads.

Beneath their unassuming exterior, Gondolas are highly intelligent and deeply emotional. They communicate through distinct vocal frequencies, expressing their moods or responding to the command of their gondolier. Some, through specialized training, can even climb waterfalls.
InfoDisplay_133002006_Text:
The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator. In Ragunna tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly envoys, entrusted with guiding the people in Their divine word.

The Order is led by the Primus, and the current Primus, Fenrico, has declared himself the "Enlightened One," the Resonator of the Sentinel. After the last Carnevale, he proclaimed to have discovered the way to commune directly with the Sentinel.

Beneath the Primus, the Priests oversee the rites and sacred duties of the Order, while the common clergy, known as Acolytes, spend their days poring over the Codex, spreading the Sentinel's teachings throughout Ragunna.

To uphold divine order, the Order commands three distinct branches:

Order Tribunal: The Order's secular judicial body that handles civil and criminal matters between families and commoners.

Chamber of Discipline: The Order's executive arm that commands the military to enforce the law. The Chamber heavily employs Echoes in combat, and its enforcers are often called "Inquisitors."

Order Penitentiary: The Order's religious court that trials heretics and faithless who question and defy the divine teachings of the Sentinel.
InfoDisplay_133002007_Text:
One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit. The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.

The Montelli family also took the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna. While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.

Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche with Shell Credits running through their veins," the Montellis take no offense—on the contrary, they wear the label with pride.
InfoDisplay_133002008_Text:
One of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison. Their devotion to Sentinel Imperator is clear to all who know them.

A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means, shaking the family's longstanding image of dignified respectability. Yet, the head of the Fisalia family residing in Porto-Veno Castle seems disturbingly indifferent to the repercussions of these bold and provocative actions.
InfoDisplay_133002009_Text:
The Sentinel of Rinascita. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish.

According to Ragunna's legends, Imperator guided its settlers to this promised land, offering them sanctuary from the threat of the Lament.

Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They maintain a connection with the people of Ragunna through the Laureate of the Carnevale, delivering divine guidance in the form of oracles.
InfoDisplay_133002010_Text:
In Rinascita, most Echoes can exist independently from Reserved Terminals within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. They are known as Common Echoes.

In Ragunna, the Order of the Deep governs the allocation and use of these Echoes. The people of Ragunna revere them as divine gifts, even as envoys of Sentinel Imperator. They treat them as friends and trusted allies, incorporating them into every aspect of daily life. This deep, symbiotic bond with Common Echoes is what has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."
InfoDisplay_133002011_Text:
Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty.

Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.
InfoDisplay_133002012_Text:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field.

There have been two significant Dark Tides in Ragunna's history. The first, according to the Order of the Deep, was stopped by Napoli II, the first Primus of the Order. The second was quelled by the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys.
InfoDisplay_133002013_Text:
The Nimbus Sanctum is the only Sonoro Sphere that exists in the physical world, where mist and clouds are formed by concentrated Remnant Energy.

The sea of clouds that envelop the Sanctum is believed to be the lingering aftermath of the first Dark Tide. As the mist rose, it gradually submerged the former headquarters of the Order of the Deep, the Seminary of the Forgotten, forcing them to relocate to the Cathedral of Mercury in Ragunna City.

Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. Many pilgrims, drawn by this tale, journey here in search of inner peace.
InfoDisplay_133002014_Text:
The Remnant Creature dwelling within Nimbus Sanctum. Legend holds that it was Lorelei's power that restrained the violent sea of clouds, sparing Ragunna from flooding.

Lorelei has the ability to cleanse the dark frequencies within the clouds, but she is not immune to their corrosive influence. As they accumulate to a breaking point, Lorelei will eventually become the Queen of the Night, unleashing her wrath upon all life that comes near.
InfoDisplay_133002015_Text: A vault built by the Montelli family on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.
InfoDisplay_133002016_Text:
The Fools who survived the dragon's assault—whom the Order refers to as the "pilgrims"—drifted on the warm currents, eventually finding refuge in a vast cavern on Penitent's End.

There, the Fools formed a troupe, determined to one day expose the truth hidden by the Order and return to their home. To achieve this, the troupe wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

For years, they have awaited the return of the Carnevale, hoping to expose the Order's secrets through their performance, claim the Laurel, and earn the chance to commune with the Sentinel.
RecallActivity_Area_04_Desc: Scattered islands give rise to united civilizations. Their bonds are woven through bloodlines, their purpose driven by the welfare of their families. What changes might a roving warrior bring to their shores?
RecallActivity_Story_03_Desc: A masquerade that never ends, with music that never sleeps... During the Carnevale, people cast off the chains of society and reveal their truest selves. But now, the city is drowned in silence. Will your arrival lift the veil of quiet, and bring back the joy and song to the streets?

POI_HSBD_5_12:
Suddenly, the inscription texts before you begin to swell and rise, like bubbles breaking the surface of water…
And the next moment, the phantom of texts raises a blade against you.
CJBOC_19_1: Oh, aren't those the cute little Plushies from the village? Nice composition, and the shot really makes the most of the scenery!
CJBOC_19_2: You really captured them in action during their adventure. Have you ever thought about doing some part-time photography for us?
CJBOC_19_3: {PlayerName} didn't take this picture. Anyway, the Plushies got super moody when they saw it. Any idea why?
CJBOC_19_4: Ah, I see. Well, just from the photo, I can tell the photographer is pretty skilled. But if you want to know more...
CJBOC_19_6: *Humphs unwillingly*... *Humphs in thought*... *Humphs in painful thought...*
CJBOC_19_9: C-MOSS makes sad noises and runs away.
CJBOC_19_11: That's the first time I've seen him like that. Let's follow him and see where he's going.
CJBOC_2_1: Oh, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, you're here! Thanks to you, much of the painting's power has been restored. And look, a new friend has joined our little village!
CJBOC_2_4: Bubble used to live in Egla Town, but its master moved to the city. Unfortunately, it was too costly to bring a Tubpup along.
CJBOC_2_5: It's probably not a good idea to leave Bubble wandering around, so I brought it here instead.
CJBOC_2_6: (It's understandable to want a new tub for a new home. But it seems that Echoes are more than just furniture for people in Rinascita.)
CJBOC_2_7: Are you going to find a new owner for Bubble?
CJBOC_2_8: I can help you deliver it there.
CJBOC_2_10: The most important thing in a community is looking out for each other's needs, and the Plushies just happen to need a proper tub. Bubble is meant to be here!
CJBOC_2_11: True enough. Bubble suits the Plushies well.
CJBOC_2_12: Bubble is too small for that big fella over there.
CJBOC_2_15: Haha, take it easy, big guy. I'll clean you up myself!
CJBOC_2_16: Now, we still need your help to collect more Sonance Caskets. The Plushie Village is only just getting started!
CJBOC_2_18: As long as I get paid.
CJBOC_2_20: No problem at all! The more power we restore to the painting, the more rewards it will be able to give out—guaranteed!
CJBOC_21_1: You see C-MOSS and the Plushies gather in a ring, as if old friends reuniting after a long time apart.
CJBOC_21_4: It was C-MOSS who took that photo.
CJBOC_21_5: It appears so. I met C-MOSS near the village many years ago. He was practically fading away at that time.
CJBOC_21_6: Now come to think of it, C-MOSS must have left the village willingly to sustain it.
CJBOC_21_7: How amazing! I never imagined Echoes could have such lasting, genuine friendships!
CJBOC_21_8: Maybe humans are just a special kind of Echo?
CJBOC_21_9: Perhaps Echoes and humans are the same in nature?
CJBOC_21_10: Ha, {PlayerName} the philosopher... but this question is too deep for me.
CJBOC_21_11: Right now, I'm more focused on getting the perfect shot. Come on, let's take a picture together!
CJBOC_23_1: (The frequency feels warm and strong. It seems the painting has been fully restored.)
CJBOC_23_2: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, happen to have any time to spare?
CJBOC_23_3: Thanks to all your hard work, Plushie Village is completely restored! I'm throwing a party for the Echoes in two days. Be sure to come!
CJBOC_25_1: Hey, don't waste food, you naughty Plushies!
CJBOC_25_2: Old Bake is not coming back with you.
CJBOC_25_3: Oh, it's you. No need to be so serious—I'm just here to thank you for bringing Old Bake to this place the other day.
CJBOC_25_4: I was worried Old Bake might feel bad for not being able to make bread, but it turns out I was overthinking it.
CJBOC_25_5: This is great! Now it can really enjoy its retirement, living with the Plushies in the village like a grandpa surrounded by his grandchildren.
CJBOC_25_6: Anyway, please take all the Baton Bread, or the Plushies are just gonna waste it all.
CJBOC_26_2: Are you doing this remotely now?
CJBOC_26_3: You see, some Echoes are still acting strange, even though we've restored the painting to its full power. I'm asking HQ to send more field investigators to get it sorted out.
CJBOC_26_4: Honestly, things could have been a lot worse without your help!
CJBOC_26_5: The Sonance Caskets you've collected have kept the village from falling apart along with the weakening painting. Otherwise, a lot more Echoes would be acting weird.
CJBOC_26_6: You gave me the chance to witness this beautiful scene where humans and Echoes live together in harmony.
CJBOC_26_7: No, I need to look at it with a new perspective.
CJBOC_26_8: Maybe it's a bit arrogant to think Echoes need to be tied to humans. The Echoes in Plushie Village have been supporting each other and have already found their own purpose in life.
CJBOC_26_9: Oh, by the way, I have something for you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}.
CJBOC_26_10: The Bells of Echoing Heart. The Plushies found them in the morph painting today.
CJBOC_26_11: They're a pair. When you ring one, the other will echo, no matter how far apart they are.
CJBOC_26_12: Somehow, the Plushies are gathering around you.
CJBOC_26_13: Oh, looks like these little ones have figured out you're about to leave.
CJBOC_26_14: I think they gave you these bells to remind you that they’ll always be here for you, no matter how far you go. The bells will keep echoing the bond between you.
CJBOC_26_15: You're really making me cry now!
CJBOC_26_16: Come on, this is not the last goodbye.
CJBOC_26_17: Haha, perhaps it's Rinascita's plays that have made me a little more dramatic.
CJBOC_26_18: Anyway, Plushie Village will always welcome you.
CJBOC_26_19: For now, let's just enjoy the party together!
CJBOC_6_1: (What's this? The Plushies brought back a recipe for Baton Bread?)
CJBOC_6_3: Yeah. I see a new member in the village. An oven Echo?
CJBOC_6_4: Oh, you've got sharp eyes. It's called Old Bake, an Echo for the apprentices in a bakery.
CJBOC_6_5: I happen to have a bread recipe. Can I ask Old Bake to make me some?
CJBOC_6_7: The villagers said Old Bake's been making bread for almost 60 years. It was only after the old baker passed that it was turned into a teaching oven.
CJBOC_6_8: But there's an issue with its valve—it can't control the fire properly. Seems like the apprentices didn't use it with care.
CJBOC_6_9: It was a lonely stray Echo when we first met. Figured it would be safer for him to stay in the village.
CJBOC_6_10: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, could you do me a favor and go to Egla Town <color=yellow>during the day</color> and find out why Old Bake would leave the bakery in the first place?
CJBOC_7_1: Hello, did Old Bake once work in this bakery?
CJBOC_7_2: Oh, yes. Did you see it somewhere?
CJBOC_7_3: It's recovering in a safe place. Did you guys break it?
CJBOC_7_4: Oh, it's not really our fault… The old baker was rough on Old Bake for the past 60 years, so by the time it got to us, it was pretty much already worn out.
CJBOC_7_5: We wanted to use a better oven too, but we were worried it might hurt Old Bake's feelings, so we just made do. Then Old Bake's valve broke and it just ran away.
CJBOC_7_6: Then why are you dawdling around here?
CJBOC_7_7: I'm actually trying to figure out a way to fix Old Bake. I grew up eating the Baton Bread it baked, though what it makes can only be called a baton now...
CJBOC_7_8: Since you've sent it off to recover, could you send it back to us once it's fixed?
CJBOC_7_9: That old baker wore it down all these years, and now we're just tossing it aside? I can't do that... it feels wrong.
CJBOC_7_10: But you know, it's better not to square a peg into a round hole.
CJBOC_7_11: But do you really need Old Bake?
CJBOC_7_12: I... Anyway, I'll tell my fellows in the bakery what happened first. Please take good care of Old Bake.
CJBOC_8_1: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! You've come at the right time! Look over there!
CJBOC_8_2: You look where Fulmine points to—some Plushies are playing as knights, wielding the rock-hard, dry baton bread Old Bake made as swords.
CJBOC_8_3: Who would've thought that dry bread could still be of use.
CJBOC_8_4: Well, I think Old Bake would fit right in with this village now!
CJBOC_8_5: Indeed. It's like a gentle grandpa to a bunch of children.
CJBOC_8_6: Indeed. The Plushie Knights need a master to forge their swords.
CJBOC_8_7: Haha, no better way to put it!
CJBOC_8_8: It's all thanks to you. Never in my life would I be able to find that many Caskets.
CJBOC_8_9: No need. I'm happy to witness this lovely scene.
CJBOC_8_10: I can definitely bring you more if I get more rewards!
CJBOC_8_11: Yeah, I feel you. These Plushies aren't humans, but they share our feelings.
CJBOC_8_12: Speaking of this, the Sonoro Sphere within the painting is far smaller than its recorded potential size, which means more rewards await to be claimed!
CJBOC_9_2: With a careful examination, you find it to be a group photo of four Plushies in Plushie Village.
CJBOC_9_3: (Did Fulmine help them take this photo? I should ask him about this.)
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_1: I didn't expect the troupe's secret base to look like this...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_2: What are you planning to do next?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_3: Honestly, I... I'm still not sure.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_4: The Order is only banishing the so-called "heretics" for now, but... will they really stop at this? I can't bring myself to imagine the possibilities...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_5: They control everything. Fighting them with our strength alone would be impossible.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_6: Maybe I should leave the troupe... Or perhaps I'll stay and gather strength here with others who believe in our cause.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_2401_7: I share the troupe's ideals. We'll breathe freedom into Ragunna, a wind that will one day shake its walls of lies.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_101_1: Good, we have all the parts now. Time to work, Pero.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_9: A question I have yet to answer myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_10: Well, Imperator called you "the Lost," and Primus Fenrico claims you are the Resonator for Leviathan, the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_11: But you really don't have any idea?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_12: I... I've actually been searching for the answer to this question, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_13: My memories are fragmented. I remember becoming a Resonator, and the moment I was given the name Fleurdelys.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_14: I also remember fighting... something. But the details and the outcome of that battle are lost to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_15: You seem deeply concerned about the Sentinel. Tell me, why is that?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_18: Whoa! Check it out! Our frequencies got split apart.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_20: Right now, are we kind of like apparitions?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_21: Basically, we're sorta in that "hover mode" you once joked about. Nothing new to me though.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_23: This must be the frequency that's entangled within you. Is it some kind of Echo?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_25: Yes... I'm experiencing a similar kind of frequency split. Though there is little that remains of my Resonance powers.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_26: I feel its frequency weakening... I understand why you're eager to find the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_27: You said you heard the Sentinel's voice. Was there anything else They said?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_28: They spoke of being ensnared in an inverted tower suspended in the sky.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_29: Ensnared? Does that mean behind the seals there's...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_31: I'm sure you've noticed that "I" was drawn here only as a frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_32: My true form currently resides inside an inverted Sonoro Sphere suspended high in the sky. At its center stands a tower, its gate locked by three seals.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_33: I've sensed a voice calling out to me from behind them... Could it be the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_34: Say, it's really faint so I barely noticed earlier... Is that a Threnodian smell I'm getting from ya?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_35: The scent of a Threnodian...? You can perceive the Threnodian?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_37: It's not an exact one-to-one with that big "Ova-thracula" meatball I had, but I'd never mix up a flavor I've already tasted.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_38: Abby has a nose for these sorts of things. We came across Threnodian powers before in Jinzhou.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_39: So it's safe to say Abby can be trusted.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_40: Do you think I'm the Threnodian's Resonator?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_41: If we're making assumptions, let's err on the optimistic side first.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_42: Given your current situation, it is possible you were affected by the Threnodian's powers during your battle alongside Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_43: That could be the reason behind losing all your power, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_44: Hmm... I take it this theory would benefit you as well?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_45: After all, that unique Echo of yours needs the Sentinel's powers for treatment, does it not?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_46: Even in adventure tales, it's not always the witch who loses her memory, it could also be a Blessed Maiden trying to regain her powers!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_47: In that case, it appears we share the same goal of finding the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_50: Spending so much time alone in the Sonoro Sphere gave me plenty of time to consider countless possibilities.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_51: I've braced myself for whatever may come until I find the answers I'm seeking.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_52: I want to know what's going on with Imperator in that tower. And I want to speak with you in person.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_53: How can I reach your Sonoro Sphere?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_54: A part of the Sonoro Sphere is actually on land, though its outer perimeter is surrounded by a barrier.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_55: I cannot leave, and no one can enter.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_58: That barrier also acts as the power source that maintains the Sonoro Sphere's integrity. If it's destroyed, the entire Sphere will collapse.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_59: And the ruins along with the Tacet Discords it houses would come crashing down on Ragunna. It would be catastrophic.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_60: You said no one can get in. Has anyone tried?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_61: Yes, I've occasionally sensed someone wandering outside the barrier as if searching for a way inside.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_64: Emm... Almost like a deep-sea jellyfish?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_65: I-I wasn't able to get a clear look. I can only describe the feeling I got from her as a Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_66: It would seem this Resonance ability can only last for so long.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_67: I'll look for a way to find this person you mentioned.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_68: Something tells me you will keep your promise.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_69: No matter the outcome, this may be my chance to find the answers I've been looking for.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_2: Oh, thank goodness... You're finally awake!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_3: How are you feeling? Any headache? Tingling feet? Upset stomach?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_4: Phew... I tried everything, but you just wouldn't wake up. I thought you were...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_5: Wait a second, did you actually fall asleep listening to my music? Oh... It kind of breaks my heart to know you reacted like that when it wasn't even a lullaby.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_7: Helpful for your sleeping troubles, hmm?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_10: So my Forte created a special connection that led to some unexpected developments...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_11: The girl, is she friend or foe...? What truths lie behind the seal...? And who is that mysterious wandering figure...?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_12: I have a feeling this is going to be a very exciting song!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_13: Ahem... I'll pass this information on to Lady Carlotta. So, what do you plan to do next?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_15: My name is Sebastian. As per Milady's instructions, I have been entrusted with the honor of inviting you to the Fisalia estate for a discussion.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_16: (The Fisalia family? The one that's likely worshipping the Threnodian?)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_17: Why does she want to talk with me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_18: Milady has expressed a desire to clear up some unfortunate misunderstandings that occurred previously.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_19: Tell her I accept the invitation, but at a later time.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_20: I will convey your message to Milady.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_21: Didn't expect the head of the Fisalia family to come looking for you, especially while they're still in the middle of negotiations with Lady Carlotta.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_22: She's just as unpredictable as the rumors say.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_24: I suppose you would want to know more about her before taking up her invitation, hmm?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_25: She's known to be a recluse and rarely makes public appearances. No one outside the family even knows her real name. They just call her the "head of the Fisalia family."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_26: I've heard quite a few rumors. Which one would you like to hear first?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_27: I have "Shadow of the Ancient," "Lady Bane," or maybe "Entangler of Hearts"?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_28: They all sound like clickbait titles to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_29: Hello... That's why they're called rumors. I'm just doing my due diligence by being faithful to the source material.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_30: So, ready to dive right in?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_31: I don't have much time. How about a shortened version?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_32: Give me a quick summary. I'll get into the details later.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_33: Well... Long story short, the Fisalia family was one of the first to set foot on these islands and establish order in Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_34: Their lineage even predates the Order of the Deep, and their craft of extracting toxins from aquatic plants is a legacy passed down through generations.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_35: Word is, they select the new head of household by having candidates ingest each other's poisons and wait to see who's still breathing when it's all over.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_36: Stories about the current head of the Fisalias get even wilder. They say she didn't go through the usual selection process. Instead, she took the throne by poisoning her predecessor.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_37: Others say she's a master in the art of manipulation, drowning her victims in hallucinations until they agree to her terms without even realizing it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_40: In any case, the Fisalia family aside, she's someone you definitely want to handle with care.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_41: If you're set on meeting her, I'd be extra careful if I were you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_42: (The way she describes the head of Fisalia... reminds me of how Cartethyia spoke about the wandering figure by the barrier.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_43: (Can't rule out the possibility that they're the same person. Looks like I'll need to pay her a visit.)

HelpText_168_Content:
[About]
As spring draws near, a group of visitors from Rinascita have visited the Jinzhou Theater. Before a brand-new stage setting, you enjoy "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura," a new Hero Play together. A familiar figure takes the spotlight as the Asura and performs a mesmerizing dance of blessings, offering warm wishes for the coming year with her ice-cold blade.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can invite one Companion to join you in the event every day. After the invitation, you can claim the corresponding rewards on the event page. Complete all invitations to claim Sanhua's exclusive Outfit, "Exorcistic Adjuration."

Invitation attempts reset daily at 4:00 a.m., with any unused attempts expiring at that time. Please be sure to use all your attempts promptly.

ItemInfo_70140027_AttributesDescription: Before the battle begins, Carlotta places a handful of crystals in your hands. These are crafted from her Forte, akin to the texture of the bullets she uses in combat. Could there be a hidden message within this gesture?

In the Montelli family, it's common to pass on messages through coded language, gestures, and postures. By handing you her weapon and bullets, Carlotta assures you that you are safe—she has no intention of harming you during the upcoming action. 
Trust her, and follow her lead in this performance.
ItemInfo_70140028_AttributesDescription: An invitation with a faint fragrance. The Montelli family crest embossed in the sealing wax.

In a world of advanced technology, sending such an invitation via traditional letter speaks to the sincerity of the sender, highlighting their desire to forge a genuine and lasting connection with the invitee.
