Main_Linaxita_2_0_1_18: You receive a message from Shorekeeper about a possible solution to Abby's weakening frequency. Before going into more detail, Shorekeeper insists that you first visit the Black Shores to review a past record stored within the Tethys System...
Main_Linaxita_2_0_10_3: The giant Plushie wraps you in a bear hug. A peculiar yet friendly energy washes over you.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_16: A mysterious chest on the liner catches your eye. Brant explains that it is the personal haven of the liner's first mate, who seems timid around strangers. Yet, despite her shyness, she gathers the courage to offer you a rare antique coin as a gesture of goodwill.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_43:
You finally arrive at the docks of Ragunna. The troupe bids you farewell, promising to make their grand entrance during the opening of the Carnevale.
As you and Abby search for a way into the city, you witness deacons from the Order sending "the Fools" on a pilgrimage. A mysterious playwright named Cristoforo notices your confusion and begins to explain the origins of this practice.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_18_4: You successfully fought your way through the mist, but Ragunna is still some distance away. Now is the time to get to know the troupe members who offer a glimpse into the vibrant culture that awaits in Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_2_14:
In Tethys' data space, you see a projection of your past self who recounts your prior actions and motives. The past you reveals that {Male=he;Female=she} left this projection as a beacon to guide {Male=his;Female=her} future self— namely you.
If you have already resolved the Black Shores data issue and awakened Abby, go find "Imperator," whom "You" made a pact with long ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_43:
Shorekeeper explains that "Imperator" is the name of the Sentinel of Rinascita, who might hold the solution to Abby's weakening frequency.
Rinascita, known as the Land of Echoes, is famed for its advanced Echo technologies and is home to many Echoes like Abby. This region may also hold vital clues as to Abby's origins.
Shorekeeper gives you an invitation letter from the Montelli family, which allows you to enter Rinascita through the port city of Ragunna.
Even as the Threnodian's revival spreads chaos across other regions, Rinascita remains strangely unaffected and is gearing up to celebrate the Carnevale grand festival. This unusual calm belies what could be a rough journey.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_22:
Aalto has prepared your ship on the Black Shores. Before you set sail, he advises you to be mindful of Ragunna's customs—its people worship their Sentinel as a god.
When you are ready, you may embark on your voyage to Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_8_47:
Your smooth sailing meets a sudden disruption as you come under attack from Cetus the Tidebreaker. Just when things seemed most dire, Brant, the leader of a traveling troupe, comes to your rescue and brings you aboard his liner.

Brant tells you he and his troupe will take part in the upcoming Carnevale, where the Sentinel Imperator will make a rare appearance to crown the festival's finest performer with the Laurel, an honor that grants the Laureate the privilege of hearing the Sentinel's voice.

As you converse, a Waveworn Phenomenon rises as a mist over Rinascita's seas. Hidden within are many TDs, ready to attack any passing ship. To survive this mist, you fight alongside the troupe.
Main_Linaxita_2_0_9_11: You greet the behemoth Echo carrying the liner, even though you are uncertain if it understands your language...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_28:
Phoebe recounts the legend of Rinascita, which explains why people view Sentinel Imperator as a divine figure.
 
When asked how to communicate directly with the Sentinel, Phoebe mentions that the Primus of the Order, Fenrico the Enlightened One, is the only non-Laureate to have ever talked with the Sentinel. However, he, like the Sentinel, only appears during the Carnevale.
 
With some time before the festival, you decide to enjoy your stay in Ragunna for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_43:
Following the instructions on your invitation, you head to the Averardo Bank to collect the funds prepared by the Montelli family.

Zani, a bank employee, has been expecting you. Acting on the Montelli family's orders, Zani serves as both your guide and bodyguard during your time in Ragunna.

After some brief introductions, Zani suggests it‘s time to try some local delicacies. After all the twists and turns on the way, it's high time to reward your stomach.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_22:
You’re taken to Trattoria Margherita, the most popular restaurant in Ragunna.
Zani tells you to order whatever you like, as the Montelli family’s covering the bill.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_21_26:
As you are enjoying the meal, the cheers from nearby catch your attention. 
According to Zani, it is a rehearsal for the Echo Dance performance prepared by the Montelli family…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_23_50:
During the Carnevale rehearsal, one of the Vitreum Dancers suddenly loses control and charges into the crowd. Amid the chaos, your mind connects with the Dancer's and you hear the voice of the Sentinel. They ask for your help in bringing the Lost back to the earthly realm.

After pondering these words, you suspect that Imperator, like the Sentinel of Jinzhou, might be in a vulnerable state, relying on Echoes to communicate. But all your questions could only be answered by that Vitreum Dancer.

You ask Zani about the Dancer and the rehearsal. She explains that it's not a Common Echo, but a private one owned by the Montellis. They're pushing the use of Reserved Terminals, and this Carnevale is their opportunity to promote them. The incident with the dancer could cause a major setback for them.

The Vitreum Dancer you connected with has already escaped. Zani suggests finding a Resonator from the Pioneer Association if you want to track it down. But if you'd like to investigate the scene first, she's happy to help.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_47:
Fulmine from the Pioneer Association has a unique skill: he can turn his memories into special film reels, and assisted by the Echo, C-MOSS, he can project those memories for others to see.

In one of Fulmine's memories, you see someone dressed in Montelli attire, wearing a mask and lurking suspiciously behind the Vitreum Dancer. Since the Carnevale hasn't started yet, it's odd for someone to already be masked up—as if they're deliberately hiding their identity.

With this clue, you decide to head to Masked Reverie, a mask shop, in search of leads…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_48:
At Masked Reverie, you pose as a customer interested in bespoke designs, hoping to gather information about the mask you saw earlier. The shop owner, Nyarla, quickly sees through the ruse. Just as you consider revealing your true motive, a noblewoman steps in to assist you.

You learn that the mask in question was commissioned by a member of the Fisalia family—a man named Gilberto. Rumor has it that the Fisalia Family has been at odds with the Montellis family over issues related to Reserved Terminals.

Since the Fisalia estate is near the Cathedral of Mercury, you decide to pay them a visit and stop by the cathedral to gather further insights from the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_8: As you reach the upper level of the Cathedral of Mercury, you spot Gilberto just ahead, slipping inside…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_32_37:
At the Cathedral of Mercury, you're welcomed by Priest Alessio. He denies any connection to Gilberto and instead tells you about the events of the last Carnevale ten years ago: the city was shrouded in thick sea fog, the Vitreum Dancers acted like ghosts, a dragon's roar echoed through the sky, and giant sea monster stirred the waves.

The Order believes it was "divine judgment" on the Carnevale—a warning against people's selfish indulgence. It's clear they don't want you getting involved in the Montellis' recent Vitreum Dancer incident.

Just as you're left uncertain about your next move, news arrives that the Montelli family is making a move. Alessio steps out, leaving you alone in the cathedral…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_33_5:
Since Alessio has granted you the freedom to explore the Cathedral, you decide to take full advantage of this rare opportunity.

With Zani by your side, you begin investigating the cathedral, searching for leads...
Main_Linaxita_2_1_36_16:
Zani's clues lead you to the cathedral gardens where there is a room that resembles a confessional. To gather more clues, you enter the room.

Meanwhile, Phrolova, the mysterious Overseer of the Fractsidus quietly watches and waits for you to uncover "the path to ascension."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_4_7:
At the dock, you plan to ride the Echo boat "Gondola" into the city.
Maybe you'll see a whole flock of Echoes like Abby along the way!
Main_Linaxita_2_1_48_8: Within the Cathedral of Mercury, you see Gilberto secretly discussing something with Alessio, a Priest from the Order…
Main_Linaxita_2_1_6_35:
Before entering the city, you go through The Order's customs checkpoint. It seems they have additional regulations for Reserved Terminals. Fortunately, the Montelli family has already arranged a guarantor for you.

During the inspection, the Order members' elusive words confuse you, until Acolyte Phoebe arrives to clear up your questions.

With her guidance, you finally step into the city of Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_8_23:
As you follow Phoebe through the city, you notice that she's holding back a fondness for little Echoes. She explains that the Order discourages its members from becoming too attached to them.

RGZYYYGJZ_35_19:
The scene before Carlotta mirrors memories from eleven years ago, but the events veer in an unexpected direction. The family members who once rejected her as Padrino's adopted granddaughter and opposed her taking the Montelli name now welcome her with open arms. Acknowledged, praised, and elevated—everything she ever craved is within reach if she chooses to stay.
Yet, Carlotta fires a shot at the mirror. The bullet shatters her mirror self, creating a new passage, leading to a different place.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_4: Rivers eventually converge into the same ocean. If a goal is mutual, then it is only a matter of time before they meet.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_5: Our very choices and our will have led us to this situation. Not the wishes of fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_6: You are quite different from what the rumors say.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_7: Oh. And what rumors have you heard?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_8: That you're a recluse, a mystic, obsessed with the crafting of poison, oh... and that you poisoned your predecessor. Those kinds of rumors.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_9: A recluse? On the contrary, I've been searching for a solution to the Sentinel's plight and rarely return to Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_10: After most of my leads fell short, a friend at Mingting in Huanglong introduced me to the stories they were telling of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_12: All the affairs of Huanglong's states eventually land in one person's hands. Would you care to take a guess at the identity of this friend of mine?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_13: ...Why not put the other rumors to rest?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_14: Because the rest of them are all true.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_15: (Chuckle)... I see it'll take more than that to rattle you, hmm?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_16: I assure you, this is no jest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_17: We Fisalias have lived under the Threnodian's whispers for generations. Once the soul fractures, the mind will follow until only a puppet remains.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_18: When the soul of the ruling head falters, Fisalia tradition dictates that the successor... usher them into eternal slumber, with a poison of their own making.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_19: My succession ritual… well, an unforeseen incident gave rise to whispers that sparked those rumors.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_17_20: ...How long has this been going on?

Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_1: One moment, please. I shall inform Milady of your arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_3: To keep our honored guest waiting would be… most improper.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_4: Especially when it was I who extended the invitation.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_5: Cantarella Fisalia—36th matriarch of the Fisalia family. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_6: Honorable Laureate. The new Crown of the Carnivale.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_8: Have you seen my crown, by chance?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_9: Very well. If you insist, I see no reason to refuse.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_10: You may also call me Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_11: Hmm... the Laurel is a gift of the Divinity. What claim have I to crown one as distinguished as yourself?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_12: Sorry, that was a bad joke.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_13: I should be the one to apologize for not understanding our guest's attempt at lightening the mood.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_15: Very well. You may also call me Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_16: Now. Shall we proceed to my study?
RGZYYYGJZ_1007_1: Any recommendations? Isn't the drink you ordered enough for now?
RGZYYYGJZ_1007_3: I'm a fan of good alcohol. Bring me more!
RGZYYYGJZ_1007_5: Ha, well, whether you're indulging in your desires or giving in to them, I'm here for both.
RGZYYYGJZ_1007_6: We've got a menu on the table for newcomers. Maybe you'll find something that catches your eye, or you'd prefer to find someone who shares your taste for a <color=yellow>Scarlet Velvet Ribbon</color> first. What do you think?
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_3: I still remember the last time I saw him. It was raining, heavily. He gave me his only umbrella with that bright, reassuring smile, told me he was fine, then walked straight into the downpour...
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_4: Had he already started stealing the goods and secretly selling them for money then?
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_5: Was it really worth it? To betray the family... for money? Was it so tempting that he could abandon the vows he swore and the values he held?
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_6: What if... what if there's more to it, though? After all, no one's found the stolen goods yet. Maybe he never sold them...
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_7: Don't fool yourself, Adriana. This is the result of a full investigation by Mr. Capollo and the higher-ups at the vault. It's as certain as it gets.
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_8: Think about all the other traitors we've caught from the vault. Those tuners. Who'd thought they were hiding their true selves until it was too late?
RGZYYYGJZ_1001_9: Does it even matter why he betrayed us?
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_1: Something tells me the next head might be someone else.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_2: Ha, well, if you're so sure, how about you tell me if we can get that special Margherita pie? I hear they're only making thirty of them today.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_3: Hey, you should trust my intuition! It's saved me from the reaper more times than I can count!
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_4: But seriously, not long ago they caught another traitor from the vault, and then Benett's betrayal hit... It's no surprise people are starting to question Mr. Capollo's ability to lead. And I heard he hasn't been looking too well lately...
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_5: Meanwhile, Lady Carlotta's reputation has been growing. She's helped a lot of people in the family with her actions and words.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_6: True, but you're missing the most important point—the will of Lady Carlotta herself.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_7: You know she's never wanted to put her relationship with Mr. Capollo or Padrino at risk. As an adopted member of the family, she's always felt she doesn't deserve a position like that. But, of course, opinions differ on why she's reluctant to take the role.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_8: But one thing's clear—Lady Carlotta has no interest in becoming the next head. If she did, the family‘s balance would’ve been disrupted a long time ago.
RGZYYYGJZ_1003_9: So, for now, just save that intuition of yours for the pie, alright?
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_1: If only I were Lady Carlotta! I'd love to have the power to create gems whenever I wanted!
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_2: They're so dazzling and mesmerizing. If I were her... actually, just giving me the chance to pick them up would be enough, hehe.
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_3: But... don't you know those aren't real gems?
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_5: Nope. Someone who thought they could make a fortune from those "gems" tried, only to find out that they couldn't even sell them, let alone use them for anything useful.
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_6: Those "gems" are actually a medium for deconstruction and reconstruction. They're capable of collapsing and disintegrating the target's frequency they hit before the target vanishes completely.
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_7: So they just look like gems. When needed, they can transform into the shape of firearms or bullets.
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_8: W-well... what happened to those who actually got their hands on them?
RGZYYYGJZ_1005_9: Hard to say. Maybe they ended up as sparkling fragments... Haha.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_1: Benett... where could I dig up more of your secrets?
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_2: Oh, it's you. What happened? Need my help?
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_9: Everyone's got things they'd rather not share. For me, it's that rainy night. Not now, not with you. All I'll say is that the night was bitter cold, and the rain—merciless.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_10: Rain like that reeks of rust. It poured down in torrents, smothering cries for help. Convictions we thought unshakable blurred like ink on waterlogged parchment.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_12: Ha, it's just a cheesy story.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_13: Benett and I—we were partners. Missions, mischief, even a dog we shared. We knew each other's families. It's the kind of story you hear about anyone who's faced life and death together.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_14: If our roles were reversed, he'd have done the same for me without a second thought.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_15: I'm old, but I've still got a few strings to pull.
RGZYYYGJZ_1234_16: Whether it's a casual contact from years ago or the family's next head, I've got to try my luck.
RGZYYYGJZ_1012_1: Whether you want to look around or head to that shelter, the choice is yours.
RGZYYYGJZ_1000_1: But why... why would Bennett betray us?
RGZYYYGJZ_1000_2: Maybe, because he was in charge of the vault. Another soul lost to the greed for money...
RGZYYYGJZ_1002_1: If Padrino steps down, do you think Mr. Capollo will be our next head? What's your take?
RGZYYYGJZ_1002_2: Well, I thought that was already settled, isn't it? Why bring it up now?
RGZYYYGJZ_1015_3: But… this is the Order we're dealing with, and it's strictly forbidden by Padrino.
RGZYYYGJZ_1015_4: Exactly, which is why we just need to ensure Padrino doesn't find out. Once the deal's done, it'll all be behind us.
RGZYYYGJZ_1015_5: Besides, Capollo is Padrino's own son. Following his lead is bound to benefit us in the long run.
RGZYYYGJZ_1015_7: What's the use of worrying now? Everyone involved knew the risks going in.
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_2: Why you suddenly want to change your codename? Did you get yourself into trouble?
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_3: Trouble? In our line of work, trouble is part of the package. Look at this mess…
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_4: *curses* Why is this city such a nightmare? Problems everywhere! Seriously, who cares about the Order or Fisalia?
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_5: Anyway, I'm not retiring yet, but I'm burned out. A new codename and a new environment might give me a fresh perspective and keep my passion for my career.
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_6: Ah, I see. Sounds like someone's having a midlife crisis. By the way, if you're changing your codename, I'll change mine too. Let's make it a team effort.
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_7: What?! I'm not having a midlife crisis!
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_8: Sure, sure. Oh, and I hear Septimont is short on people. Maybe we could...
RGZYYYGJZ_1022_9: Coming up with new codenames is tough. I'll leave that part to you.
RGZYYYGJZ_1018_1: The Montelli memeber before you is deeply immersed in his work of safeguarding, observing every movement around him. He impatiently waves at you, signaling that he has no time to deal with you.
RGZYYYGJZ_1018_2: You decide to check other areas of the trading venue.
RGZYYYGJZ_1019_1: The Montelli member before you stares blankly at the entrace. A flicker of hesitation and conflict flashes across his eyes, and his finger unconsciously tap lightly.
RGZYYYGJZ_1019_2: It's clear that this Montelli member, caught in his own emotional turmoil, won't give you any further response. You decide to check other areas of the trading venue.
RGZYYYGJZ_1020_2: The deal hasn't started yet. Get back to your post.
RGZYYYGJZ_1014_1: Do you think someone will find out what we're doing?
RGZYYYGJZ_1014_2: That's the sixth time you've asked in three minutes. Just breathe and calm down. No one's going to find out.
RGZYYYGJZ_1016_1: It's almost time, but why did the Order suddenly change the location and schedule?
RGZYYYGJZ_1016_2: This isn't just any ordinary deal. The Order is notoriously cautious, always looking over their shoulder. They were probably worried about a leak.
RGZYYYGJZ_1021_1: Once this is over, I'm getting myself a new codename.
RGZYYYGJZ_1021_2: A new codename? Why? I thought the one you have now suits you.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_1: Hey, {PlayerName}. Good to see you again.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_4: Well, I owe that to you and Carlotta. Thanks to your efforts, we've been able to restart our cooperation with the Montelli family, along with others whose ties had been severed.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_5: The Reserved Terminal is still a sensitive subject in public, but at least now, people here are free to explore in the wild and gather Echoes as they please.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_6: Honestly, I was shocked when Carlotta asked if I'd be interested in joining your plan. I never imagined you'd outmaneuver the Order and strike a deal with Capollo, forcing him to hand over the core data module.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_7: But in hindsight, trusting you, Carlotta... and Benett's judgment turned out to be the right decision.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_8: Capollo's been removed and dealt with by the family. Carlotta's busy managing the aftermath alongside Padrino while also focusing on charting a new sea route.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_9: A new sea route? Where to?
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_10: Looks like Montelli's ambitions are growing.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_11: The exact route hasn't been finalized yet, but it's rumored to span three or four countries.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_12: Carlotta told me it was your brilliance that made this possible. Your performance at the Carnevale was so inspiring that more and more people are rallying behind Montelli, eager to explore a bigger, grander world.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_13: We're still figuring out what ventures to take on and what we truly want to achieve. This time, I'm determined to make the right call too.
RGZYYYGJZ_1013_14: {PlayerName}, just sit tight—we'll bring you some good news soon!
RGZYYYGJZ_1024_1: Oh no, look at the time... Sorry, but I've gotta head home for dinner.
RGZYYYGJZ_1024_2: Seriously? Come on, don't be a buzzkill. Your mom's not gonna lose it if you eat out just once.
RGZYYYGJZ_1024_3: Maybe not, but she made it clear: no matter what I'm up to, I have to be home for dinner every weekend. If I don't, she'll "break my legs with a spatula and stuff my head into a bowl of spaghetti." Her words, not mine.
RGZYYYGJZ_1024_4: By the Sentinel, Gustavo, a Montelli, scared of his mommy! How interesting!
RGZYYYGJZ_1024_5: Hey, watch it! I'm not scared of her—I'm respecting her. Family comes first, always. No matter what.
RGZYYYGJZ_1025_1: Returning here once again, you finally understand the deeper meaning that Francesco had not directly stated that day.
RGZYYYGJZ_1025_2: "They say in art, we glimpse pieces of our own soul... True artistry lies not only in what is painted, but in what is left unsaid."
RGZYYYGJZ_1025_3: Glory in Decay is the name of the painting, as well as the motto this elder man has gifted to himself—he feels honored by his own exit.
RGZYYYGJZ_1026_1: Passing by Benett's former residence, you discover a bouquet quietly placed at the door.
RGZYYYGJZ_1026_2: Looking at the bouquet, with the signature "DC," you almost instantly realize who is mourning Benett—Duncan, the man who had chosen to leave, yet still returns for his dear friend.
RGZYYYGJZ_1026_3: He helped deliver the false message about the schedule and location change to the Order and helped you successfully infiltrate the trading venue... In your and Carlotta's plan, he was an important piece.
RGZYYYGJZ_1026_4: Now, for his own safety, he must temporarily leave under Carlotta's arrangement.
RGZYYYGJZ_1026_5: But no matter when, no matter in what indentity, as long as he chooses to return, Ragunna and Montelli will always welcome him with open arms.
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_1: "The rain poured relentlessly, cloaking the world in a shroud of gloom, stripping away its pretense of grandeur to reveal its barren core."
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_2: "Under the storm's shadow, people were fighting at each other's throats—fragile yet ferocious, like... like beasts cornered in a cage." No, no, Tornatore, that's far too trite! Think, man! You can craft something better!
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_3: You're the playwright of this drama. Give it an ending that lingers, and echo that won't fade!
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_4: "As she fell, her trembling hand raised the gun. The old acquiantance, a traitor to his ideals, stared down the barrel. One last shot. Addio." Hmm, does that come across too... passive?
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_5: Ah, I see. Rumors, ripe and waiting, a wellspring of inspiration at my fingertips. Let's see... "Can I really trust {Male=him;Female=her}? She wondered. Yet instinct urged her forwar. She clasped {Male=his;Female=her} hand firmly, then turned her back, offering it wholly to her new companion." Yes, yes, that has promise!
RGZYYYGJZ_1028_6: The creator in front of you is completely consumed by the tale of storm and betrayal he's spinning. Perhaps it's best to let him remain in his trance.
RGZYYYGJZ_1611_1: It's so quiet here... It seems like nobody has set foot in here ever since Benett left.
RGZYYYGJZ_1611_2: Stay vigilant, {PlayerName}. We're in the wilderness, and anything could happen while we investigate. Promise me you'll take care—I don't want to have to worry about you.

InfoDisplay_121000006_Text: In Ragunna, becoming a lover of spirits is far easier than steering clear of them. Every recipe holds a tale, and every tale is traded for a drink. You'll always find something that speaks to your soul—if you can decipher the "codes" of wine. *What follows is an exclusive selection of wines from Montelli *Drinks and Descriptions "Blues Hour" Hey, I've got a deal to talk about with you, but we must wait till the night falls to bring it up. "Crimson Mambo" A burning pain, a spreading warmth, and numbed senses. You're not battling colossal beasts but waging war against life's tribulations. Raise your glass to our hero; at least you've earned this toast. "Golden Years" The past has undergone a long fermentation, turning into this sweet, lingering, taste in your throat. Speechless, you sign and then take another sip, reminiscing the good old days that will never return. In moments like these, I'm the best listener you could ever have. "The Rules of Silence" The very first rule that all Montelli members must adhere to, something etched in their bones and blood, as cherished and unshakable as their beloved families. Alas, you've ordered this; it seems someone needs a "kind" reminder. *You may have noticed that there are no prices on the menu. Nah-uh, that's no oversight. Here, drinks are measured beyond mere coin. *At the right moment, with the right person, come see me here. Remember, the bars in Ragunna are forever open to whoever wants to order.
InfoDisplay_121000007_Text: In Ragunna, becoming a lover of spirits is far easier than steering clear of them. Every recipe holds a tale, and every tale is traded for a drink. You'll always find something that speaks to your soul—if you can decipher the "codes" of wine. *What follows is an exclusive selection of wines from Montelli *Drinks and Descriptions "When She Steps Into the Garden" A breeze of joy stirs, carrying the warmth shared between us... Let me revel in the bloom of the flowers you nurtured. The gate of fantasy swings wide; let me admire the weight of those lush, dropping buds. Soft murmurs and whispers intertwine, leaving your mind adrift. Indulgence, ecstasy… Isn't that what you've been yearning for? "Love and Elixir" Tell me—what truly separates a potion from love? Both weave illusions, mend shattered hearts—and leave their share of scars. "Night of Terror" If you weren't already deep in your cups, would you dare order this? What are you truly seeking? A savior? A saint? An angle? Very well—you've sent your cry for help. "The Emperor's New Clothes" The cleverest deal you'd made, though the glass looks completely empty. Take it to your companion, the one who has everything—share, and you'll both have a drink. "TF10" True or false, 1 or 0. While sharing this drink, we pledge honesty—a moment when everything must be laid bare. *You may have noticed that there are no prices on the menu. Nah-uh, that's no oversight. Here, drinks are measured beyond mere coin. *At the right moment, with the right person, come see me here. Remember, the bars in Ragunna are forever open to whoever wants to order.
InfoDisplay_121000008_Text: Feeling a bit tired of drinks? Ragunna's bars also offer a selection of delightful snacks to refresh your palate. Unlike those drinks full of "codes," these are snacks are simple—and complimentary with drinks. Snacks and Descriptions *St. Domingo Chocolate Smooth and rich, this chocolate teases your taste buds with the bittersweet harmony of orange jam and wine, leaving a lingering aftertaste. *Earl Grey Cake The black tea-infused base, combined with the refreshing scent of citrus, delivers a mellow flavor that lingers without a hint of bitterness. *Wine-Soaked Cherry Sabayon Ripe, crimson cherries bathed in a creamy blend of eggs and sweet wine, lightly caramelized for a smoky finish. The dance of warm and cold, sweet and fresh, tipsy and revitalizing… an unforgettable harmony of flavors. Thank you for your generosity and patronage.

InstanceDungeon_8701_Tips:
Gunshot in the Motel
Default Buff: All team members gain 20 Concerto Energy every 2s and cannot be downed during the challenge. Casting Intro Skill increases the ATK of all team members by 15%, stacking up to 10 times.
Primary Buff: Casting Intro Skill summons a Shockwave that pulls enemies in and deals Havoc DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Enhanced Buff: The Shockwave causes an Explosion shortly after, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Ultimate Buff: Defeating a target with Shockwave or Explosion recovers 20 Concerto Energy for the Resonator.
InstanceDungeon_8702_Tips:
Justice to be Served
Default Buff: All team members' Basic Attack DMG is increased by 60% and they cannot be downed during the challenge.
Primary Buff: Performing 2 Coordinated Attacks or 5 Basic Attacks grants a stack of Electric Spark. Stacks from each type and each Resonator are counted separately. When either reaches 2 stacks, attacks will consume all stacks to summon 2 Lightning Bolts that strike the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Enhanced Buff: Lightning Bolts deal an additional Electro DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK within 3s of hitting the target.
Ultimate Buff: Lightning Bolts trigger a Magnetic Storm, dealing Eletro DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
InstanceDungeon_8703_Tips:
Crash and Burn
Default Buff: All team members' ATK is increased by 50% while in mid-air and they cannot be downed during the challenge.
Primary Buff: Performing Mid-air Attack summons a Meteorite, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
Enhanced Buff: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 10% every second while in mid-air, stacking up to 10 times.
Ultimate Buff: The Meteorite explodes on hit, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK and creating a flaming zone that deals Fusion DMG equal to 380% of the Resonator's ATK.
InstanceDungeon_8704_Tips:
Smash 'Em All
Default Buff: All team members' Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 50% and they cannot be downed during the challenge. Hitting a target with Heavy Attack recovers 10 Concerto Energy.
Primary Buff: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 2 times increases the Resonator's Crit. DMG by 5% (triggered once every 0.1s), stacking up to 20 times.
Enhanced Buff: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 5 times generates an Iceblast (triggered once every 0.1s), dealing Glacio DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Ultimate Buff: The Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack is increased by 50%.
InstanceDungeon_8705_Tips:
Right of Self-Defense
Default Buff: Successful Dodge summons a Swirl, dealing Aero DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. All team members cannot be downed during the challenge.
Primary Buff: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 500%.
Enhanced Buff: Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG by 10%, stacking up to 10 times.
Ultimate Buff: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 100%. Performing Dodge Counter summons a Swirl Burst that deals Aero DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
InstanceDungeon_8706_Tips:
Play It Safe
Default Buff: Taking no damage for 5s increases the Resonator's Crit. DMG by 50%, stacking up to 5 times. Lose 1 stack each time taking DMG.
Primary Buff: Successful Dodge increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% for 10s, stacking up to 10 times.
Enhanced Buff: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. Taking damage reduces Crit. DMG by 100% for 3s.
Ultimate Buff: Attacking the target again within 2s of the last attack increases the Resonator's ATK by 3% for 5s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_671_1: With the crisis behind you, you and your companions spend the day basking in cheers and applause.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_671_2: Later, back at the Palazzo Agrotta, you drift off to sleep, replaying the day's memories from the Carnevale.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_1_1: I've prepared a shipping plan based on the client's needs.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_1_2: Can you double-check it? This piece might need special handling, given its dimensions.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_1_3: A fossilized whale skeleton? You must be kidding...
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_1_4: Looks like we'll need a few extra Gondolas for this one.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_2_1: Allow me to introduce our latest "Worry-Free Plan."
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_2_2: The best offer you can get at this price! Perfect for families.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_2_4: Mommy, can I keep my teddy bear in the safe?
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_3_1: Ah, if it isn't the esteemed guest of the Fisalia family.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_3_2: What, am I not welcome here? Or are you challenging me to a duel?
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_3_3: Haha, you're still as humorous as ever. Averardo Vault welcomes guests from all over the world!
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_3_4: Whatever our differences, as long as you're here...
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_3_5: You are our most honored guest.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_4_1: Have they delivered the dancer that needs maintenance?
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_4_3: Great. Make sure they fill out the form.
GNNPC_AFLDJKMP_4_4: No problem. Wait... the form... Where did I put it?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_1: Welcome back, honored guest of the Montelli family. It is my pleasure to see you again at Averardo Vault.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_2: Thank you for everything you've done for the Montellis and the Vault.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_3: How may I help you today?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_4: What kind of services do you offer here?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_5: Well, as you can see, the Vault houses a special collection of rare items collected by the Montelli family.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_6: From tangible relics like fine art, precious metals, and advanced technologies, to more elusive assets—Reserved Echoes, Remnants, and even abstract concepts. If it holds value, we store it.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_7: You are welcome to store your valuables in our safes—for a small fee, of course.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_8: Rest assured, the security we provide is well worth every coin.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_9: Alternatively, if you wish to part with any of your items or Echoes, we can assess their value. Should they be deemed worthy, we will make you an offer based on their worth.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_10: By the way, we're currently refining our auction process to align with best practices from other regions.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_11: As such, the auctions will be on hold for the time being.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_1_15: It's my pleasure. Should you require anything else, do not hesitate to ask.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_1: Greetings. How may I assist you today?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_3: I'm afraid the auction is temporarily on hold while we refine our procedures.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_4: If there's a particular item you're interested in, feel free to register your preferences on the Terminal. We'll notify you as soon as the auctions resume.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_5: That's a shame. I came prepared with quite a few credits.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_6: You might be losing out on some considerable profits.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_7: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_8: Yes, but it's a small price to pay to improve the experience for our clients in the future.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_2_9: Thank you for your continued support of the Ducat Auction. We look forward to your next visit.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_1: Hello, {Male=sir;Female=ma'am}. This area leads to the private offices.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_2: Only authorized Vault personnel are allowed.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_5: I'm afraid Mr. Capollo has recently strengthened security here at the Vault. Unless I get direct word from Miss Carlotta, I cannot grant you access.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_6: Allow me to confirm your authorization. One moment, please.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_7: Apologies, but Ms. Zani isn't an employee of the Vault. She doesn't have clearance for this section.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_3_8: (Guess I'll try my luck somewhere else.)
GNNPC_AFLDJK_4_2: Heading to the offices? This way, please.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_1: Hello there! Are you looking to sell any collectibles?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_2: What kind of items do you collect?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_3: Oh, all kinds. Literature from before the Lament, old currency, electronics, contemporary art, and precious metals.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_4: Averardo Vault values anything of significance—anything that speaks to Ragunna's past or whispers of its future.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_5: Of course, value is subjective. Different eyes see different worth.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_6: So we evaluate each collectible to determine its value.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_8: Ha, you needn't worry. A few years back, we paid quite a sum for a sealed metal canister.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_10: Nothing. We believe it's a pet food can manufactured before the Lament, but due to a production error, it was never filled with anything.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_11: I understand your confusion. But that's precisely why we set such a high price. It's one of the last known artifacts from before the Lament.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_12: As I said, we consider value from every angle, often going contrary to popular belief.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_13: To us, these items are unquestionably priceless.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_14: Enough small talk. Do you have anything you'd like us to evaluate? Artifacts? Maybe a Reserved Echo?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_16: I've got a backpack full of things I don't need.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_18: ...Do you mean the Echo with human-level intelligence and communication skills?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_19: Honestly, we've never encountered something quite like that in the Vault!
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_20: If you're willing to part with it... We'll be sure to come up with an offer you'll like!
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_21: You tell Ludvika you're just kidding and decline her offer. She looks a little disappointed.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_22: Yes... these are rare items indeed.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_23: But if I'm being honest, they likely hold far more personal meaning to you than they ever could to us.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_24: We'd hate to take something so dear from you. Perhaps you'll reconsider?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_25: Memories of these collectibles flash through your mind. You decide to keep them as mementos of your journey.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_26: I understand. Shell Credits aren't the most important things in this world.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_27: If you ever change your mind, don't hesitate to stop by anytime.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_1: Today's loss... Hmm, twenty-three crates. Cause: Discovered they were past their recommended usage date during inventory.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_2: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. Anything I can help you with?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_3: Crates? Are they used for transporting collectibles?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_4: Yes. We have specially designed crates for transportation.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_5: They're filled with thick padding tailored to the size and shape of the item, keeping everything snug and secure.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_6: This minimizes the risk of damage during shipping.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_7: We regularly discard crates once they reach their recommended life span, just to be safe. Wouldn't want them to fall apart in transit!
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_8: Fall apart? Has it ever happened before?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_9: Well, I'm new here. I haven't seen anything like that firsthand, but from what I've heard… it's happened before.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_10: I didn't think much about the whole "discarding crates" thing until Ludvika mentioned all the past accidents—
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_11: Everything from minor mishaps like drops to fires, robberies, and even Tacet Discord incursions.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_12: The Vault has learned from these incidents over the years, and our procedures have become much more stringent as a result.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_6_13: I suppose I'm standing on the shoulders of those who came before me... but hey, better safe than sorry, right?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_1: Hello, my dear friend. Are you here for business too?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_4: You're not from Rinascita, right? Where are you from?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_8: Ah, such bravery to cross those vast seas, facing the storms and the lurking Tacet Discords...
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_9: Haha, reminds me of the Montelli family's motto. I'm not one of them, but as a Ragunna native, I respect their courage.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_10: They sailed far and wide bringing back Terminals, Shell Credits, and mountains of wealth to Rinascita.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_11: The Order wasn't too happy about it, and I doubt the Primus would want people lured by wealth, straying from the path of the Sentinel.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_12: What do you think about it?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_13: Me? I'm not leaving Rinascita. Wealth or legends, none of that matters to me.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_14: Even if I wanted to "fall from grace," there's very little chance of that happening. So I don't think about it much.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_7_15: As a humble merchant with no great lineage, I'm content with what I have.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_3: Ah, yes. I know a few people here in the Vault. I've heard about your generous assistance to both the Vault and the Montelli family.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_4: Speaking of which, have you ever heard about the Vault's secret tales?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_6: Yes, stories I picked up from the Vault staff. But don't go spreading it around that I told you.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_8: One of the stories is about a mysterious room in the Vault. My friend says it's an area the cameras can't capture.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_9: They say it's like a formless monster, wandering the Vault as though it has a mind of its own.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_10: Every year, some Vault employees disappear in there. The fortunate ones return... but they're never the same afterward.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_12: And there's another tale! About the Vault's "hidden treasures."
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_13: Don't ask me what it is. I have no idea. A place? An Echo? A collectible? Or maybe... a treasure map?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_14: According to the story, it's been here since the Vault was built. It holds great importance to the Montelli family.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_8_16: Haha, just rumors. But a Vault with so many treasures and no secrets would be strange, wouldn't it?
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_1: ...Record the data carefully, Dimitri. I'm going to restart the <ano=Echo tuner>tuning console</ano>.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_2: Right, I need to check for anomalies in the return signals from the third, fifth, and eleventh groups... I've got this.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_4: Hey, {PlayerName}. As you can see, those damn traitors have messed with our tuning console.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_5: It still boils my blood thinking about it. Turning on the Montellis is one thing, but...
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_7: Ahem, that's not what I meant, Alfred. Betrayal is, of course, unforgivable.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_8: I mean, the tuning console is delicate machinery. I can't bear to leave it on for more than six hours at a stretch.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_9: But those fools... they left it running all day! Tuning bizarre frequencies, no less!
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_10: Sorry, {PlayerName}. I got a little carried away.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_11: Anyway, we're adjusting the console now to make sure those traitors didn't cause any permanent damage.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_12: Uh, don't listen to him, {PlayerName}. The console isn't that fragile.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_13: Our main task is to check for and get rid of any remaining Fractsidus frequencies, in case they contaminate our Echoes, like a virus.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_14: The console was designed to run for seventy-two hours straight, so it's not nearly as fragile as he claims.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_15: To only run it for six hours at a time... The Vault would be overflowing with Echoes waiting for maintenance.
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_16: Enough, you uncultured fool! You don't understand the elegance of this beautiful machine, nor the finesse of the tuning work!
GNNPC_AFLDJK_9_17: All right, "great artist"... If you still want to fix this machine, we'd better get back to work.

In Oakheart Highcourt, tree roots intertwine with every stone wall. Legend has it that the first divine oracle was etched here, and from that sacred wound, the very first green branch grew.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_8700_Name: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men
ZXZTC_1_1: As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.
ZXZTC_1_2: Yangyang and Chixia found you unconscious at the Gorges of Spirits. Together, you decided to head to Huanglong's Jinzhou City, marking the beginning of your journey.
ZXZTC_1_3: Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong, had long been a battleground against the Threnodian Ovathrax. The Midnight Rangers, led by General Jiyan, fought tirelessly against the waves of Tacet Discords—nightmarish entities created by the Threnodian—near the Norfall Barrens...
ZXZTC_1_4: Meanwhile, a mysterious organization known as the Fractsidus operated covertly within Jinzhou. They were aiming to resurrect the Threnodian. Somehow, they seemed especially interested in you, going so far as to extend an invitation...
ZXZTC_1_5: You met Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. She explained the double threats Jinzhou was facing: external attacks from the resurgent Threnodian, and internal turmoil caused by the mysterious disappearance of Jinzhou's Sentinel.
ZXZTC_1_6: As the Magistrate and the Sentinel's Resonator, Jinhsi resolved to travel to Mt. Firmament and uncover the truth about Jinzhou's missing Sentinel, Jué. A confrontation seemed unavoidable...
ZXZTC_1_7: The rise of the TD Outbreak unleashed Ovathrax's latest creation: the Dreamless, an incomplete entity. With Jinzhou City under siege, you joined the battle, eventually defeating the Dreamless and absorbing it with your bare hands.
ZXZTC_1_8: Jinzhou's immediate crisis was averted, but Magistrate Jinhsi was nowhere to be found...
ZXZTC_1_9: You sought guidance from Sanhua, who directed you to a ferry near Mt. Firmament. There, you encountered Changli, your "Wayfinder" into the mountain.
ZXZTC_1_10: This secret realm, where the flow of time warped and twisted, required a price for entry. However, you seemed curiously unaffected by the temporal distortion, while Changli seemed unbothered by its effects...
ZXZTC_1_11: Within Mt. Firmament's Hongzhen settlement, you discovered that many animals and residents had been frozen in time, trapped by the erratic temporal flows. The Fractsidus had also infiltrated the area.
ZXZTC_1_12: Xinyi, the mayor of Hongzhen, informed you that Jinhsi had only recently departed for Mt. Firmament's peak, in search of the Sentinel. Due to the temporal distortions, what had been days to you was merely moments inside the mountain.
ZXZTC_1_13: Deep within the Mianloong Chamber, you finally found Jinhsi. Together, you faced the Sentinel, Jué. Jué explained its dilemma: to keep its power from spiraling out of control, it had chosen to remain confined within Mt. Firmament.
ZXZTC_1_14: If the situation continued, its only recourse would have been to freeze time across all of Jinzhou, hoping future generations could find a solution to undo the damage...
ZXZTC_1_15: At the mountain's peak, you stood by Jinhsi as she endured Jué's trial, proving the strength of human will. With your help, she stabilized and inherited the Sentinel's power, finally bringing an end to the temporal chaos on Mt. Firmament...
ZXZTC_1_16: Jué revealed the truth: You were none other than its Arbiter, the founder of Jinzhou.
ZXZTC_1_17: Jinhsi's unyielding resolve, coupled with the Temporal Mandate granted by Jué with your approval, allowed her to make it through the impossible trial.
ZXZTC_1_18: Following Jué’s guidance, you set out on a new path, seeking answers to the mysteries of your origins. Your next destination is the base of an enigmatic organization known as the Black Shores.
ZXZTC_1_19: You confronted a crisis in the Port City of Guixu alongside Yangyang. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper guided you to the Black Shores, a place shrouded in mystery. The Tethys System of the Black Shores had suffered a catastrophic failure, unleashing data-based pollution that corroded everything it touched.
ZXZTC_1_20: Once again guided by the Shorekeeper, you delved deeper into the Black Shores, determined not only to save this ravaged place but also to recover memories of your past...
ZXZTC_1_21: The Shorekeeper revealed that you were once the leader and founder of the Black Shores, an ancient organization spanning ages, with her serving as your loyal assistant.
ZXZTC_1_22: The current crisis, it seemed, was intricately tied to your forgotten past, and the Lament recorded by the Tethys System during the disaster in Port City of Guixu held crucial secrets...
ZXZTC_1_23: To resolve the chaos caused by the Tethys System, you and the Shorekeeper entered a simulation it had created, reliving the final hour before the Lament struck Port City of Guixu.
ZXZTC_1_24: As the disaster drew near, the Tethys System tried to absorb you as its new core. In a desperate bid to protect you, the Shorekeeper was sucked into a black hole...
ZXZTC_1_25: You reclaimed the mantle of leadership, steering the Black Shores toward redemption. You broke free from the mistakes of the past, liberated the innocent trapped in endless suffering, and rescued the Shorekeeper from the Tethys System's grasp.
ZXZTC_1_26: Now free from the burden of her mission, the Shorekeeper revealed another clue. She suggested that the key to understanding your connection with Abby—and Abby's recent strange symptoms—might lie within Rinascita.
ZXZTC_1_27: Rinascita is a nation to the southeast of the Black Shores, making the Black Shores archipelago the perfect starting point for your journey...

FavorRoleInfo_1606_Info:
Assistant, prop master, and improv comedian, Roccia is always there to make sure the Fool's Troupe is at the ready.

The Magic Box she carries appears to hold the world, or perhaps she had recreated a world inside the box.
FavorRoleInfo_1107_Info:
The second daughter of Montelli and an art investor unbound by convention, Carlotta moves seamlessly through social circles and business transactions while quietly handling the family's unspeakable "troubles" in secret.
The blooming of a "gem," the taking of a life—In her own name, she reshapes reality, giving it a new dimension.
MapMark_138001_MarkDesc: You encounter the three Fratellis who are traveling in Ragunna. Help them grow stronger and resolve their troubles.
POI_GTDYBR_30_5: You've seen him? Skinny lad, loves sticking his nose where it doesn't belong.
POI_GTDYBR_30_6: Said he saw a tower we could move into for better protection. Went to scout it and hasn't come back since.
POI_GTDYBR_30_9: Heck no. We're from a sunny little island far away.
POI_GTDYBR_30_10: We do a little bit of ship raiding during the trade season. And we fish when the pickings are slim.
POI_GTDYBR_30_11: Our fearless leader spied a grand merchant fleet off in the distance.
POI_GTDYBR_30_12: But our tiny ship was never meant for the deep water and couldn't catch up.
POI_GTDYBR_30_13: Then a storm hit and wrecked our ship. Next thing I knew, I woke up here, on this beach.
POI_GTDYBR_30_14: So you're not from around here..
POI_GTDYBR_30_15: Yeah... Speaking of here, where are we?
POI_GTDYBR_30_17: Rinascita... I've heard of this place.
POI_GTDYBR_30_18: You know I love to fish. I could catch enough to feed a whole crew.
POI_GTDYBR_30_19: But I hear there are Echoes in Rinascita that could haul in a bigger catch than I ever could.
POI_GTDYBR_30_20: Ehh... but that's not important. I just want my little brother back.
POI_GTDYBR_30_21: I think he's in that tower. Went in myself before, but it's a labyrinth inside, and there're monsters everywhere.
POI_GTDYBR_30_23: I'll help if you give me some fish.
POI_GTDYBR_30_25: Once we find Liel, you can have the supplies I scavenged. See ya at the tower.
POI_GTDYBR_30_26: Done. I'll give you five... no ten fish.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_10_1: (It's thick with dust. Hard to believe they're truly worshipping it.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_10_2: Curious about that statue? It represents the unbroken friendship between the Fisalias and the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_10_3: But in the eyes of outsiders, it is more a symbol of defeat and submission.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_2: I hope you'll accept this tea as my way of apologizing for the incident with Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_3: Members of the family may have troubled you, but there is no stain that can't be washed away. Every sorrow has its own way of fading, don't you think?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_4: You still hold a grudge. Won't you accept my apology?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_7: This tea... Is it from Jinzhou?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_8: I see. Let's set aside such past unpleasantness for the time being.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_9: I invited you here to ask that you might serve as a mediator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_10: Before we get into that, there's something I want to know.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_11: I imagine it concerns... the Fisalia family's true beliefs?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_12: It would seem Gilberto's mind is beyond saving.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_13: But let's not dwell on that. What is your opinion on the current state of Ragunna, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_14: Peaceful, in a way that feels... wrong.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_15: So you've noticed something is amiss. As expected from someone who's felt the weight of a Threnodian invasion firsthand.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_16: And what exactly do you find most unsettling?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_17: Why haven't the Threnodian and the Sentinel ever shown themselves?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_18: Because the Threnodian's invasion of Ragunna... has long since concluded.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_19: The Threnodian, so named Leviathan, possesses the power to merge and assimilate. It uses distorted beliefs to spread a spiritual plague that slowly devours civilizations from within.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_20: Though the previous two attempts were thwarted, the tall mast of the galleon that is Ragunna has already been snapped in half.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_21: Now the blissfully ignorant masses walk hand in hand toward an abyss they cannot see.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_22: Friend or foe? As a newcomer to this land, can you really tell them apart?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_23: Are you implying the Order worships the Threnodian?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_24: You're one to talk, given how strange your family's been acting.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_25: Yes and no. On one hand, there's the truth of the Order's beliefs…
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_26: On the other, there's our family. The Threnodian doesn't take kindly to those who know the truth. We've always been under Its whispers.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_27: Once the soul fractures, the mind will follow until only a puppet remains.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_28: Now that we've come this far, there's nothing for me to hide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_29: My only hope is that once you learn everything, you will carefully consider my request.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_9_1: Come. The truth you seek lies in the deepest part of the castle.
FavorRoleInfo_1606_TalentDoc:
[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]
 
After watching Roccia on a few occasions and studying her behaviors, it seems like our first mate has a way of communicating with that strange creature, Pero. With Pero acting as a translator, Roccia can even talk to other Echoes. What's interesting is that her ability seems to be growing—at first, she needed to speak with the Echoes, but now it looks like she can communicate through frequencies.

This only started after she joined the troupe and met Pero, so I'm guessing it's some sort of resonance between them, something she picked up along the way. We'd probably call her an Acquired Resonator.

P.S. All this is just my best guess, though. With the tools I have, I can't pin down exactly what type she might be. There's a small chance Roccia isn't actually a Resonator, but just so happens to be able to sync up with certain frequencies. Wouldn't that still count as being a Resonator? I'll have to think on it.
FavorRoleInfo_1606_TalentCertification:
[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]
 
During the examination, Roccia chose white clams, seaweed, pink salt, and filtered water to make a pot of clam soup. It turned out nice and clear, with the shells intact. Right when it was done, the clams and seaweed looked a bit like a tiny island—or maybe even a little box.
 
From the way the soup came together, it's clear Roccia's senses are sharp, her mind is calm, and that she has a strong bond with the troupe. No sign of Overclocking here.

P.S. Roccia had the brilliant idea of replacing the teacup assessment with a soup assessment. After all, soup is more filling, and after the examination, there's enough for everyone to have a meal. It doesn't taste too bad, either.
FavorRoleInfo_1107_TalentDoc: [Extracted from the Internal Records of the Montelli Family - Access Shared] Codename: Opal This member's Awakening occurred over a decade ago and she possesses great control over her Forte. This member's Tacet Mark is located in the lumbar area, and no significant physical changes were found after Awakening. She can generate infinite brilliant crystals resembling opals, which can be reconstructed into firearms and ammunition as needed. While using her Forte, Opal's hair also exhibits a crystallized effect. Enemies hit by the generated crystals will also undergo crystallization. It is worth mentioning that some individuals tried to profit by collecting these "gems," only to find them impossible to liquidate or circulate. Judging from the appearance, they are akin to precious gems, but in essence, they are some medium that triggers structural reconstruction, capable of causing the frequency of the hit target to collapse and disintegrate until complete vanishment. This member's Resonance Spectrum Pattern shows certain similarities to stained glass decorations and natural snowflakes. It is suspected that this may be related to her proactive behavior of breaking tradition and using decorations as weapons when her Forte first awakened. Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve, and thus this member is classified as a Mutant Resonator with an incubation period.

The Time Domain pattern is regular, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results are assessed as being within the normal phase. Resonant Criticality: High.
