Quest_159900023_QuestDesc_159_1:
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos... he beseeched the Laureate for help.
Character_Cantarella_1_6: Nope, I can't take it… Gotta take a break…
Character_Cantarella_1_7: Ew, why do I still smell it down here? Wait, this weird frequency… It's coming from that message!
Character_Cantarella_1_8: Ugh, my head… so dizzy… I'm gonna lie down. Just... just holler if you need me…
Character_Cantarella_1_9: Looks like we've been hit by the weird frequency in that message. I should check out what's going on in Egla Town.
Character_Cantarella_11_9: He couldn't use it himself, but sold it for a nice profit!
Character_Cantarella_11_10: Then… if we get our hands on it, let's keep it for ourselves!
Character_Cantarella_11_11: I want to stay young forever. That way, you'll always see me at my best!
Character_Cantarella_11_12: Nah, I want the one that turns stone into gold! Then we can live a wealthy life together.
Character_Cantarella_14_10: Perhaps Mammon has offered us a little aperitif.
Character_Cantarella_14_11: Alright, I know where we need to go next… The second riddle is waiting for us.
Character_Cantarella_18_5: Perhaps the last riddle will give us a clue.
Character_Cantarella_21_2: The melody evokes a sense of familiarity, reminding you of that place—<ano=Castle of Fisalia>Porto-Veno Castle</ano>。
Character_Cantarella_21_3: It only strengthens your suspicion that the "ghost girl" must be connected to the Fisalia castle.
Character_Cantarella_21_4: A sharp headache interrupts your thoughts, the distorted frequencies intensifying. Through the pain, you find a reason to visit the Fisalia castle.
Character_Cantarella_21_5: Ugh… what was that…? My head… This pain's getting worse. I need a break somewhere…
Character_Cantarella_21_6: You've been under this influence far too long, especially in a place filled with spirits. I should have warned you sooner.
Character_Cantarella_21_7: You need a proper rest… and we're not far from Thessaleo Fells.
Character_Cantarella_21_8: Come to my castle. I have potions there that can help ease the strain.
Character_Cantarella_22_5: This potion is crafted from freshly crushed Barnacle Leaves, mixed with the sap of Violaca, Sea Okra, and Sea Apple, all fermented in a glass vial.
Character_Cantarella_22_6: Each of these lovely plants is cultivated here, hand-picked, sorted, and blended by my own hands.
Character_Cantarella_22_7: As the poisonous ingredients entwine, their toxins soften over time, like nightmares transforming into the sweetest dreams.
Character_Cantarella_22_8: Don't worry, it's perfectly safe and even delightful. Drink up, and rest a while.
Character_Cantarella_22_9: Though I may not be able to lift the "curse" binding you just yet, I can certainly help tame it for now.
Character_Cantarella_22_11: Ah... Excuse me for a moment. It's time I tend to the flowers.
Character_Cantarella_5_2: So, what brings a distinguished Laureate to this ghostly place?
Character_Cantarella_5_3: Tired of heavenly views, are we? Hehe, are you here to savor the underworld's wonders and dance with its spirits?
Character_Cantarella_5_4: What brings the head of Fisalia here?
Character_Cantarella_5_5: Why not? What harm could there be in a ghost of the deep reveling among spirits?
Character_Cantarella_5_6: So you're also a ghost of the deep.
Character_Cantarella_5_8: You show the strange message to Cantarella.
Character_Cantarella_5_9: On the Night of Remembrance, it's only natural that the departed return to the mortal realm for their unfulfilled wishes.
Character_Cantarella_5_10: Still, it'd be best if they didn't stir up trouble for the living.
Character_Cantarella_5_12: In my humble opinion, lost souls find peace only when their wishes are fulfilled. Then, perhaps, they'll stop haunting people.
Character_Cantarella_5_13: Since fate has brought you here, why not offer your aid to those poor, restless souls? I'll join you, of course.
Character_Cantarella_5_14: I don't usually do ghost work.
Character_Cantarella_5_15: Why would you offer to help me?
Character_Cantarella_5_16: Ah, the familiar confusion of a first-timer. But fret not, for I will be your guide through this unforgettable night. Step by step.
Character_Cantarella_5_17: Shhh, no need to jump to conclusions. Who knows, it might actually be you doing me a favor.
Character_Cantarella_5_18: Every Night of Remembrance brings its own theme. And this year, it's the "Ghost Girl."
Character_Cantarella_5_19: Imagine this: an innocent girl lost in the dark sea, fear ripping her apart as her soul drifts away, while her body sinks ever deeper into the abyss. Despair consumes her, bit by bit, until she transforms into a monstrous phantom.
Character_Cantarella_5_20: A thrilling story, don't you agree? Like savoring a medium-rare lamb chop served with oysters. One tender slice, and the crimson juice spills, adding just the right flavor to the already exquisite dish.
Character_Cantarella_5_24: Huh… So we share similar tastes. How wonderful.
Character_Cantarella_5_25: Oh, really? Then consider it a simple "appetizer" for tonight.
Character_Cantarella_5_26: Oh, is it too much for an innocent lamb like yourself? Hehe, my apologies. I hope this doesn't dampen your spirits.
Character_Cantarella_8_5: Just look at her dress! Such elegance! She's not even eclipsed by the Laureate. She must be someone of great importance.
Character_Cantarella_8_6: I've heard the Fisalias are super secretive. Never thought we could actually see one here.
Character_Cantarella_8_7: I know, right? How lucky are we to meet them both tonight!
Character_Cantarella_8_8: Wait a second… If people like them are showing up, could the rumor about the elixir actually be true?
Character_Rococo_5_9: The elderly man's belly growls as he speaks.
Character_Rococo_5_10: Ah, please excuse me... I haven't eaten in days...
Character_Rococo_5_11: Roccia instructs Pero to bring out some water and rations from her box for the elderly man.
Character_Rococo_5_12: Oh, thank you... This is the best meal I've had since boarding that ship.
Character_Rococo_5_14: Pero says there'll be more tasty treats waiting for you back at our base.
Character_Rococo_31_11: Hmm, the air is so humid. It's like the mist is standing right next to us, waving hello.
Character_Rococo_31_12: "A sea covered in veil, lay beasts of howling wail—"
Character_Rococo_31_13: According to Pegasus, we should be careful when there's mist close by.
Character_Rococo_31_14: We need to find the star before it rolls in...
Character_Rococo_54_6: Err... These frequencies are made up of deception and lies. They smell awful.
Character_Rococo_54_8: Pero senses the "star" inside the cave and... something else she can't describe.
Character_Rococo_54_9: We're approaching the end of this path. It seems like the center of the maze is just ahead.
Character_Rococo_54_10: Soon we'll find out what lies at the core.
Character_Rococo_54_14: You're right. We should keep going.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_1: Tell me, what role do you feel like playing today?
GNNPC_LGNC_8_4: Take a look, darling. The Masked Reverie has every prop your heart could desire.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_5: Or perhaps these don't quite tickle your fancy? Yearning for something a bit more... fantastical, mm?
GNNPC_LGNC_8_6: A perfume grenade, a pistol ring, or... a luxurious velvet bomb?
GNNPC_LGNC_8_8: I have to say, the requests I've been getting recently... Ugh, so dreadfully uninspired!
GNNPC_LGNC_8_9: A blade in the shoes? Boring.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_13: Whispering Mask, Echo in Finery, Regal Songbird...
GNNPC_LGNC_8_14: The names and titles the people in Ragunna have for me far exceed the roles I've ever played.
GNNPC_LGNC_8_15: Oh, how many eyes have danced on this invisible shell, weaving tales of my true face?

WDSXD_41_1: I'm done for. The Order will definitely punish me this time. Fratellone, Fratello, I love you! "sob"
WDSXD_41_3: Ah! Lifesaver, help me! Those pages are the only surviving copies of the Order's pamphlet. All the other copies were destroyed. Please, we need to find them!
WDSXD_42_1: Not enough fire! If I can't push my flames higher, how can I surpass that person?
WDSXD_42_2: Oh, I was just wondering when you'd show up!
WDSXD_42_3: I've set a new record again! Come accept my challenge!
WDSXD_43_1: Whoa! It's you! Come on, let's get stronger together!
WDSXD_43_2: Why are you so driven to become stronger?
WDSXD_43_4: The reason doesn't matter! All that matters is I'm not there yet!
WDSXD_43_5: Haha, I see what you're doing — you've never given it your all against me, have you? That simply won't do!
WDSXD_44_1: Ha, we meet again! Come on!
WDSXD_44_2: You've already earned your place in the Pioneer Association, so why are you still so obsessed with getting stronger?
WDSXD_44_3: Are you... also the most curious person in the world?
WDSXD_44_5: Wait, alright, I'll make it quick.
WDSXD_44_6: You know about the Dark Tide, right? Twenty years ago, the Dark Tide claimed my parents. Since then, my older brother has raised me and my younger brother.
WDSXD_44_7: That's why I've always wanted to join the Pioneer Association to uncover the truth behind the Dark Tide!
WDSXD_44_8: I must train myself to get strong—strong enough to push back the Dark Tide with a single strike! Otherwise, how can I protect my brothers?
WDSXD_44_9: Heh, now I'm feeling a bit embarrassed! Come on, let's see if you can break my record this time!
WDSXD_45_1: Hey, we meet again! Ready? The challenge starts now!
WDSXD_45_2: You mentioned you have an older brother, right?
WDSXD_45_3: That's right, the name's Fratellone! He's out there looking for the Nightmare Clouds, something about conquering his fears.
WDSXD_45_4: Fratellone used to be famous in town for his bravery! But ever since the Dark Tide, he's been plagued by nightmares and has become incredibly cautious.
WDSXD_45_5: I know it's because he's so afraid of losing me and our younger brother! In the end, it all comes down to me not being strong enough. Enough talking, let's go!
WDSXD_46_1: This aura... you seem stronger now! Amazing!
WDSXD_46_2: Is your younger brother out there training too?
WDSXD_46_3: That's right! My Fratellino—he said he was going out to collect some documents or what. I wonder if he's taking good care of himself.
WDSXD_46_4: When the Dark Tide hit, we lost our parents and our house. He's always blamed himself for our parents' deaths. No matter how much we tried to comfort him, it never made a difference and he grew up scatterbrained.
WDSXD_46_5: Honestly, it's my fault. If I'd been stronger back then... Well, enough talk, let's go!
WDSXD_47_1: Hey, look at me! Do you feel it? I've gotten stronger!
WDSXD_47_2: You know that joining the Pioneer Association doesn't mean you'll fully understand the Dark Tide, right?
WDSXD_47_3: Yeah, I know. But the key is to take the first step, isn't it?
WDSXD_47_4: Sometimes, it feels like my brothers and I have never escaped the Dark Tide. It seems our lives were frozen at that moment.
WDSXD_47_5: So when I heard Fratellino say he wanted to join the Pioneer Association, I immediately thought, "Ah, this is my first step!"
WDSXD_47_6: You must understand how I feel, being the world's strongest!
WDSXD_47_7: Alright! Enough small talk — come and break my record, world's strongest!
WDSXD_48_2: This is the final challenge, world's strongest! With defeating you as my goal, my training has progressed faster than expected. But I know I'm still far from your level, right?
WDSXD_48_3: After all, {PlayerName}, you are the Rover, the great hero who saved Jinzhou. Your reputation has spread even to these distant mountains.
WDSXD_48_4: So, if I can't become as strong as you, I might still fail to protect my brothers during a disaster, right?
WDSXD_48_7: Come on, this is the final challenge!
WDSXD_49_1: Lifesaver, help me! I accidentally scattered the precious notices from the Plushie Association!
WDSXD_49_2: If I don't gather them quickly, the Plushies fans will be furious!
WDSXD_50_1: Where did it go, where did it go? Hey, lifesaver, please help me!
WDSXD_50_2: I accidentally shook loose the pages in an important knight's biography! I haven't even finished reading the stories in it yet!
WDSXD_51_1: Oh no, how could I mess up something so important?
WDSXD_51_2: My lifesaver! You've arrived just in time! I accidentally undid the binding of The Deep: Old Chronicles, and it contains crucial records about the Order's Primus!
WDSXD_52_1: The Deep: Old Chronicles... The Deep: The Good Book... Oh no, did the binding come apart again?
WDSXD_52_2: Ah, lifesaver, thank goodness you're here! Can you help me gather up the pages that scattered over there?
WDSXD_53_1: Lifesaver, please help me! I lost a very important article about the Dark Tide!
WDSXD_53_2: The pages should be scattered over there. Please, I need your help!
WDSXD_54_1: Lifesaver, look, I just got my hands on a piece about Gondola's... wait, where did it go?!

InfoDisplay_201001103_Text: On the forty-second full moon of my knighthood, a young man stabbed the right of my abdomen. In retaliation, I took his life. The Order rewarded my killings and celebrated my bloodlust. Yet Sentinel, if my words reach you, I beg for clarity: is mercy the path to saving grace or a swift descent into an early grave?
InfoDisplay_201001104_Text: On the first full moon of my knighthood, I was defeated by a band of Plushies. The big Plushie was more terrifying than I imagined—a slight hesitation almost cost me my life. I was lucky to survive. But Sentinel, I ask you to witness how I conquer my fear and become unyielding. Under your divine gaze, I will forge myself into the very embodiment of the Five Knightly Virtues!
InfoDisplay_201001105_Text: On the hundred and forty-fourth full moon of my knighthood, I was ordered to write a book on an island—despite my illiteracy. I wanted to share my techniques for fighting Tacet Discords, but the Acolytes suggested I center my words around the Five Knightly Virtues. O Sentinel, perhaps you can't hear this, but in all my supposed wisdom, I might be the most foolish of all.
InfoDisplay_201001106_Text: On the ninetieth full moon of my knighthood, I was assigned to duel on the great bridge. Day after day, knights came to challenge me, only to fall again and again—all to hasten my so-called glory of a hundred victories. O Sentinel, do you hear me? The weight of honor grows heavier, yet my sword feels ever more brittle.
InfoDisplay_201001107_Text: On the ninety-fifth full moon of my knighthood, I managed to gather fifteen crates of donations. After giving dues to the Order and the family I serve, only five remained. Even with the three crates I donated... No, it's not enough. It's nowhere near enough! O Sentinel, please enlighten me: why do the greediest souls always hide behind the banner of generosity?
POI_QSSLD_12_1: Eek! Who are you?! Leave me alone!
POI_QSSLD_12_3: Plushies! Hordes of them, with pointy horns!
POI_QSSLD_12_4: You look like a mighty one. Could you drive them all away, please?
POI_QSSLD_12_5: Please, I beg of you! Chase away those Plushies and I'll give you everything I have, even my sword!
POI_QSSLD_9_1: Now I understand... I understand it all...
POI_QSSLD_9_2: There's no need for thinking whatsoever! I'll simply do whatever they command!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_57: You can call me the {Male=Blessed One;Female=Blessed Maiden}.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_59: No... you're likely a far more special entity.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_60: Well, I have some information and theories of my own. Care to hear them?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_22_2: Interesting. I've never seen such little creatures before. Would you mind sparing a few for me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_22_3: (I'd better not ask what she plans to do with them...)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_30: Please. Cartethyia would suffice. I am but a fake after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_31: I've waited for this moment, this chance to save the Sentinel... and my family.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_32: I will not turn back, even if this does turn out to be a trap.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_33: If the thought of the final answer troubles you, then I suggest you step aside. {PlayerName} and I will take care of this matter.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_34: Since you are willing to overlook the possibilities of a trap, then there's no reason for me to worry and turn away.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_35: I underestimated your resolve. I'm sorry.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_36: So, how do we get up there?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_37: Simply place Tyrvine on the pedestal behind me and this tower will elevate itself.

MapMark_5033_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

A dragon-like Remnant creature haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately. Twisted by the frequencies of decay and death it consumes, it now appears as a dreadful, skeletal beast.

Once a sacred place, this island is now a grave of sorrow, and any who come for redemption must face its fire of judgment.

Such is Gehinom, the Dragon of Dirge, whose flames burn to the bone, whose pain echoes, yearning for a final release.
MapMark_5034_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

Once a creature born of Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through the Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the “Queen of Night,” seeking to cloak the Nimbus in endless darkness to clear all sins.

With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within her garden, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.
MapMark_5035_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>

Refitted with special technology, this Echo has transformed into a precise and powerful battle machine, carrying out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. An unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat, and when needed, unlocks a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.

The Montelli Family, voyaging from distant shores, has seen a wider world—and they are willing to pay any price to gain the strength needed to revive their homeland.
POI_HSBD_103_1: Is it... offering us a ride?
POI_HSBD_11_2: Those moving pieces got me so confused... Let's get this over with!
POI_HSBD_12_1: Seems like this Echo has been locked up here since forever…
POI_HSBD_12_2: According to those inscriptions, it doesn't matter who wins or loses the game. It's stuck here guarding this board forever either way.
POI_HSBD_12_3: Maybe it never wanted this at all.
POI_HSBD_12_4: I wonder what kind of life it had before being trapped here…
POI_HSBD_200_1: You who have answered the summon, do you have enough respect for your opponents?
POI_HSBD_200_2: Answer these questions to prove yourself.
POI_HSBD_200_3: How many Chop Chop's hands you just defeated?
POI_HSBD_200_7: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_8: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_9: Very well. How many types of Plushie Echoes you just encountered?
POI_HSBD_200_13: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_14: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_15: Impressive. And here comes the last question—what type of Plushie Echo appeared twice just now?
POI_HSBD_200_20: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_21: All correct... You've proved yourself to be a respectful person.
POI_HSBD_200_22: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_200_23: No respect at all... You should leave now.
POI_HSBD_201_2: It seems these patterns on the altar light up gradually when you stand in this giant circle.
POI_HSBD_201_3: Is this some kind of ritual...
POI_HSBD_202_2: Ugh, these pesky Tacet Discords... Stay away from us!
POI_HSBD_203_2: Let's finish this in one go!
POI_GTDYBR_10_1: There's no way out... No way out!
POI_GTDYBR_16_1: We're... we're back where we started.
POI_GTDYBR_18_1: The people we robbed have come for us... Last year at the inn, and the village before that!
POI_GTDYBR_18_2: We can't leave... We can never leave...
POI_GTDYBR_21_1: You find a slip of paper with a scribbled message: "Sorry little sis, the birthday present I got you couldn't be delivered."
POI_GTDYBR_23_1: This place is built so weirdly...
POI_GTDYBR_23_2: Last time I was here, I also kept doubling back.
POI_GTDYBR_23_3: Friend, any luck on your end?
POI_GTDYBR_23_7: Fine, I'll keep looking as well.
POI_GTDYBR_24_1: Friend, any luck on your end?
POI_GTDYBR_24_4: Under the elevator... Look, a secret passage. Reminds me of this story...
POI_GTDYBR_24_5: A secret passage under an elevator. Reminds me of this story...
POI_GTDYBR_24_6: One time, a guy from the Mad Mutts nicked this thing off me and hid it on top of an elevator compartment.
POI_GTDYBR_24_7: ...Eh, now's not the best time for stories. Let's just get outta here, fast.
POI_GTDYBR_24_8: Point is... lemme show you how I got my stuff back.
POI_GTDYBR_24_9: Insula steps into the elevator and rips all the safety brackets out. The elevator drops down the shaft with a clang, and you peer into the gaping shaft.
POI_GTDYBR_25_1: See friend, I'm fit and strong.
POI_GTDYBR_25_2: We can keep looking for a way out.
POI_GTDYBR_28_2: I got a feeling he might've run into that monster.
POI_GTDYBR_28_3: Anyway, thanks for your help so far.
POI_GTDYBR_28_4: I found some supplies while I was exploring. Not a lot, but here, take 'em.
POI_GTDYBR_28_5: If that's not enough, find us back at camp. Itzel can catch fish for you.
POI_GTDYBR_28_10: I had a strange feeling in the tower...
POI_GTDYBR_28_11: Felt like I was being stalked by a Tacet Discord, but it moved with purpose.
POI_GTDYBR_28_12: ...As if someone sent it here to guard the tower.
POI_GTDYBR_28_13: Friend, this big tower, who built it and why? You curious at all?
POI_GTDYBR_28_15: It must be linked to that monster.
POI_GTDYBR_28_16: I bet we'll find Liel once we get to the bottom of this mystery.
POI_GTDYBR_28_17: Friend, I'm gonna continue looking around on my own. We'll meet again soon.
POI_GTDYBR_29_2: Oh, where did you run off to?!
POI_GTDYBR_3_1: Can't be. Fanatic Shark, in here?
POI_GTDYBR_32_1: This loot belongs to the Fanatic Shark!
POI_GTDYBR_33_1: The Fanatic Shark tried to attack this place...
POI_GTDYBR_33_2: We should keep an eye on their specters. Might be helpful.
POI_GTDYBR_4_1: They're all dead in a poof! Good riddance!
POI_GTDYBR_4_2: Oh, I hope Liel didn't run into that monster.
POI_GTDYBR_41_1: It's that thing again, attacking from a distance. Gutless cur.
POI_GTDYBR_46_1: Looks like none of the Fanatic Sharks made it out alive.
POI_GTDYBR_47_1: These drawings might tell us something about the tower's past.
POI_GTDYBR_47_2: The four bases beneath them seem to have markings. Could they be clues for how to restore them to their rightful positions?
POI_GTDYBR_48_1: Beneath these steps, the heir of Fisalia was called to serve the cause.
POI_GTDYBR_49_1: He traveled west into Thessaleo Fells, where the three towers of destiny loomed in the distance.
POI_GTDYBR_5_1: Ha! What comes around goes around those fish freaks!
POI_GTDYBR_50_1: Reaching the towers, only shadows of the Fisalia's heir remained as he fulfilled his duty.
POI_GTDYBR_51_1: Where do the schools of fish swim? Over the tower, into the silent night sky above...
POI_GTDYBR_52_1: You solved the riddle... and you've never been here before?
POI_GTDYBR_54_1: One of the tower's barriers seems to have weakened.
POI_GTDYBR_55_1: Where could that lad have run off to...?
POI_GTDYBR_55_2: After I get you back, Liel, you'll be eating fish gut rations.
POI_GTDYBR_55_3: I told him to stay out of trouble, but he never listened. But oh, he'll start listening after a return voyage of nothing but fish guts!
POI_GTDYBR_55_5: A stern lecture ought to be enough.
POI_GTDYBR_55_6: Speaking of fish, see that gaping hole outside in the sky? Look at all the fish swimming into it.
POI_GTDYBR_55_7: Sends a chill down my spine... Like a maw that spawns unholy monsters.
POI_GTDYBR_55_8: Ones larger and more terrifying than what we've faced up till now...
POI_GTDYBR_55_9: You think monsters will emerge from that hole?
POI_GTDYBR_55_10: Perhaps those monsters are from inside the tower.
POI_GTDYBR_55_11: Whatever it is, I'm sure it has something to do with Liel's disappearance.
POI_GTDYBR_55_12: And I won't give up before I find him.
POI_GTDYBR_55_13: What do you plan to do?
POI_GTDYBR_55_14: Not sure if you've noticed, but I'm a Resonator. For some reason, my Tacet Mark reacted when I got close to that monster.
POI_GTDYBR_55_15: I'll use my Tacet Mark to track the monster down. With luck, that'll lead me to Liel.
POI_GTDYBR_55_16: We didn't find Liel, but nevertheless, I appreciate your help, friend.
POI_GTDYBR_55_18: A few extra fish and we're even.
POI_GTDYBR_55_19: I won't forget you. Till next time!
POI_GTDYBR_55_20: Of course, here you go. Well, this is where we part. Till next time!
POI_GTDYBR_56_1: What did I tell ya, Itzel? There's our destination.
POI_GTDYBR_56_2: Shut up... We'd be running around like headless chickens if I listened to you. It was I who pinned that tower down!
POI_GTDYBR_56_3: Hey, don't make a fuss... Oh, hi friend! You're here!
POI_GTDYBR_56_5: Of course. Itzel says she feels the monster's frequencies from within that tower.
POI_GTDYBR_56_6: Unlike the decoys in the other two towers, this one there is probably real.
POI_GTDYBR_56_7: Come on. Time to bring Liel back.
POI_GTDYBR_56_8: That brat had better be in one piece when we find him!
POI_GTDYBR_58_1: Like the last two towers, this place is filled with poisonous gas. We might see visions of the past here as well.
POI_GTDYBR_58_2: Let's look at the vision here... Oh crap, the Fanatic Sharks captured Liel.
POI_GTDYBR_59_1: Those fish nuts... Watch out friend, something's attacking us from above.
POI_GTDYBR_6_1: That thing again? Watch out, friend!
POI_GTDYBR_60_2: Out of the way! I'll slaughter you all to get Liel back!
POI_GTDYBR_62_1: Argh, the path is broken. Wait, what's that floating in the air? It's Liel's vision!
POI_GTDYBR_62_2: He got away from the Fanatic Shark? Can't be. When did he learn to fly?
POI_GTDYBR_62_3: He's not flying. He's running on something... Are those bookcases on the right?
POI_GTDYBR_64_1: Look at that little rascal scamper....
POI_GTDYBR_64_2: Takes after his sister. Hahaha! He might even be a secret Resonator!
POI_GTDYBR_65_1: These Fanatic Sharks all got skewered!
POI_GTDYBR_65_2: They were ambushed. Everyone stay alert.
POI_GTDYBR_66_1: Even if Liel got away, he's no match for that prowling monster.
POI_GTDYBR_66_2: Don't worry, he's a smart kid, and he's wearing your jammer. He can handle a few Tacet Discords.
POI_GTDYBR_66_3: I hope so... You'd better not be dead, you idiot...
POI_GTDYBR_67_1: Those archers again! And look, Fanatic Shark specters... They met their end here!
POI_GTDYBR_67_2: Oh Liel, I hope you made it out alive.
POI_GTDYBR_69_1: End of the line, fish face!
POI_GTDYBR_70_3: Itzel, you don't look too well. Didn't you see? Liel dealt with that Fanatic Shark.
POI_GTDYBR_70_4: But how was he getting out?
POI_GTDYBR_71_1: Sis... Chief... I'm not gonna make it...
POI_GTDYBR_73_2: I was kidding about the fish guts. Don't go Liel, I'll serve you the plumpest side of the fattest fish we have.
POI_GTDYBR_73_3: You know... Liel's love of fish was what got me into fishing.
POI_GTDYBR_73_4: You can have all my catch once we're out of here. They're meaningless to me now.
POI_GTDYBR_73_5: But before we leave, that monster at the top of the tower must die.
POI_GTDYBR_74_1: Liel... I was training him to lead our crew someday.
POI_GTDYBR_74_2: Come friend, let's go... whatever's in our way will get smashed to a pulp.
POI_GTDYBR_75_1: Blinky's here. It's summoned a bunch of copies！
POI_GTDYBR_75_2: Damn, their frequencies show only one copy is real.
POI_GTDYBR_79_2: I can't bring Liel back from the dead, but I've avenged his death by destroying his killer. That's all I can do.
POI_GTDYBR_79_3: So, you got any questions for me?
POI_GTDYBR_79_7: We sailed Sentinel knows how many seas. I always thought the ocean would be our grave.
POI_GTDYBR_79_8: Never thought Liel would meet his end on land... in the depth of an icy tower...
POI_GTDYBR_79_9: I've got a theory for the tower.
POI_GTDYBR_79_10: I saw small devices hidden away in most corners back there... much like the fractured halo at the top of the tower.
POI_GTDYBR_79_11: My guess is the tower is a lab, and those devices were used as some kind of experimental Echo control.
POI_GTDYBR_79_12: Those controlled Echoes were extremely dangerous... the exact opposite of the cuddly Echoes I heard about in Rinascita.
POI_GTDYBR_79_13: Someone in the Land of Echoes sought to weaponize them...
POI_GTDYBR_79_14: The tower's broken halo must have been the largest and most powerful of their devices.
POI_GTDYBR_79_15: I shudder to think of the horrors that'd be unleashed it ever got completed...
POI_GTDYBR_79_16: The only thing I have left of Liel is this compass pendant.
POI_GTDYBR_79_17: It was my gift to him after we divvied the spoils from our first job.
POI_GTDYBR_79_18: Whenever we got lost at sea, it always guided us back home.
POI_GTDYBR_79_19: But Liel was so afraid of losing it, so he left it with me for safekeeping.
POI_GTDYBR_79_20: After we leave this tower, Insula and I will repair our ship and leave this wretched place.
POI_GTDYBR_79_21: Once we return to familiar waters, I'll throw this compass out at sea.
POI_GTDYBR_79_22: Maybe, just maybe, Liel will follow our ship's course, find the compass, and let it guide him home...
POI_GTDYBR_80_1: Thank you for helping us, friend.
POI_GTDYBR_80_2: Have you spoken to Itzel? She could use a kind ear.
POI_GTDYBR_80_3: What a day. The life of an island Exile, robbing just to survive... People like us die every day.
POI_GTDYBR_80_4: But Liel... Liel was different. He was too kind for this kind of life. He did the sailing for us, never the plundering.
POI_GTDYBR_80_5: I really liked that kid... Had dreams of training him to be the next captain. Ha, an odd choice now that I think about it...
POI_GTDYBR_80_6: If he became captain, maybe we'd stop being Exiles and turn a new leaf—as legitimate traders and such.
POI_GTDYBR_80_7: But that's all a pointless dream now... The fate of the crew still rests with me. I have to guide them through this muck.
POI_GTDYBR_80_8: It's over now, friend. Itzel and I thank you for accompanying us.
POI_GTDYBR_80_9: What's next for you and your crew?
POI_GTDYBR_80_10: We'll fix our ship and leave this place of sorrow behind.
POI_GTDYBR_80_11: None of us want to stay in Rinascita after what we've been through.
POI_GTDYBR_80_12: I guess we should say our goodbyes. So long, friend!
POI_GTDYBR_80_13: Oh, and if you're ever on a ship we've captured, you get to keep your stuff, haha!
POI_GTDYBR_80_14: But Insula's laughter is hollow. His expression is stony, and he sinks into silence.
POI_GTDYBR_81_1: Itzel mutters to herself while squeezing the compass pendant.
POI_GTDYBR_82_1: Insula appears downcast as if everything he sees and hears means nothing.
POI_GTDYBR_83_1: You find some fish left by Insula and Itzel, neatly laid in a box on the shore.
POI_GTDYBR_83_2: You figure they must have patched up their ship and sailed off with their crew.

MusicDes_40000011_Text:
It all began with the melody from that distant memory.
Through the long stretch of waiting, she played it over and over again, hoping that one day she could create a piece of her own.
She dreamed of composing something meaningful, something to help her unravel the mysteries of the human soul.
Every time her fingers brushed the keys, a familiar figure emerged from the depths of her memories—never truly gone, always drawing closer, like the lingering afterwords of a story that never ends...

Main_Linaxita_2_3_44_19:
Carlotta takes you to the "Masked Reverie" shop, where she has customized Carnevale masks for you and Abby. 
As you walk together under the night sky, Carlotta seems to have more she wishes to discuss...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_45_26:
During your conversation, Carlotta mentions the Black Shores, revealing that the Montelli family's intentions are more complex than they seem. 
The family isn't seeking to usurp the Order's power or undermine the faith. Rather, Carlotta explains, they're pursuing a truth about the origin of Rinascita.
As you walk to Palazzo Agrotta in the southern part of the city, where Carlotta has arranged a room for you, Carlotta shares an old story about Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_26:
After finishing her tale, Carlotta confides her deeper thoughts: "If the Sentinel indeed permitted such a girl to serve as their spokesperson, it suggests that all this joyous revelry is not something They disdain." 
The Carnevale, she says, is meant to be a celebration of people's true selves. Yet now, it has become a tool for those who use faith to control others. But Carlotta believes that this year's Carnevale can will spark a flame fierce enough to burn down that cage.
Tomorrow, you and Carlotta will take the stage at the Carnevale. Tonight, all you need to do is rest and prepare.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_47_6:
Get some rest tonight for the Carnevale tomorrow.
Good night. May your dreams be sweet.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_48_13:
A large crowd has gathered in front of Trattoria Margherita. Curious, you approach and spot Zani, who's still hard at work during the festival. After a quick check, she concludes that the Echo "Bakie" is just overloaded with all the work.
After things settle down, Zani assures you that she and the Montelli members will be on duty here, ready to assist you if needed.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_49_10:
A short distance away, you notice C-MOSS, the Pioneer Association's Echo, looking downcast. Phoebe points out that it's probably disappointed it hasn't been able to capture a photo of itself at the Carnevale. 
Snap a picture of C-MOSS and Phoebe together to cheer it up.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_12:
With C-MOSS's wish granted, Fulmine arrives to thank you for your kindness. Phoebe, however, is bound by her duties to the Order. She needs to maintain order at the festival and can't join you for the rest of the Carnevale. 
You can see the excitement and joy in her eyes, though. With her blessings for you in mind, you decide to help keep the Carnevale safe.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_50_20:
Carlotta has been waiting for you. The troupe is set to arrive at the port any moment, and your performance is about to start. 
If you're ready, it's time to join Carlotta and prepare for the stage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_56_21:
The Fool's Troupe makes its grand entrance to thunderous applause, and the city's excitement reaches a fever pitch. 
Amid the celebrations, you spot Phrolova, one of the Fractsidus Overseers, moving through the crowd.
You follow her trail to a rooftop, where she invites you to join her. Phrolova reveals that you're both searching for the same "special Resonator." As a gesture of goodwill, she offers to exchange a story with you, one that holds a hidden truth. 
Her tale needs a stage, and there is no better stage than Ragunna City at this moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_58_20:
With Phrolova's opening cue, your performance begins. 
Each of your allies plays their part to enhance the show, while the main stage is set for you and Carlotta to shine.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_86_3: Phrolova summons a wave of Tacet Discords to block your path, but you and Carlotta manage to break through the obstacle and press on toward her location.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_88_3: Once again, Phrolova conjures a deadly swarm of Tacet Discords...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_8: You and Carlotta are surrounded by TDs, but Roccia arrives in time, diving headfirst into the fight to aid you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_3: Facing Phrolova's taunts, you stand firm and accept her challenge, ready to face the powerful Tacet Discords she has summoned.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_7: At last, you reach Phrolova. It seems like the story should end here, but she has one last surprise. Unleashing her powers, she tears through the fabric of space itself, adding yet another twist to your tale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_60_3: You enter the Sonoro Sphere crafted by Phrolova. Here, she intends to tell you a story about a prophecy...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_66_16:
You and your companions defeat Phrolova and free Cetus the Tidebreaker from her control. The gloom that had shrouded the Carnevale lifts, and the crowd erupts into applause for your performance.
As daylight breaks through the clouds, a golden Laurel descends over your head, a reward as promised. The Sentinel's voice then echoes in your mind, directing you to Their location. If you wish to find Them, head to the Inverted Tower suspended in the sky, from where They watch over the world.
You notice a hint of vulnerability in the Sentinel's voice. They leave you with a final clue: a "lost" person, someone connected to Them, is currently among the people enjoying the festival.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_67_32:
Following the Sentinel's lead, you meet a girl named Cartethyia. Something unusual about her frequencies catches your attention, but she disappears into the crowd before you can learn more.
Later, Carlotta arrives and remarks that no one else seems to notice Cartethyia. She offers to have her family members search for the girl in Ragunna, but you urge caution. Too many mysteries surrounding the Order and the Sentinel remain unsolved. Hasty moves could draw unwanted attention from the Order and disrupt the Carnevale. Besides, you need time to piece together the clues you already hold.
For now, you decide to enjoy the festivities.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_49: Hahaha! There you are, my friend! A compliment, if too subtle, loses all its charm!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_73_50:
Carlotta invites you to the Montelli family's safe house for a celebratory dinner. You and your friends raise a glass and share a rare moment of laughter. During the gathering, Carlotta reveals that Cartethyia is actually Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden. This new information helps you piece together the clues you've uncovered.
Carlotta also shares a shocking revelation from Gilberto regarding the history recorded in the ruins: The Fisalia family actually worships the Threnodian known as the "Leviathan" from the deep sea, a belief that may date back centuries. Rinascita's Sentinel and the Threnodian are connected, and if the situation demands, the Montelli family might seek a conversation with the Fisalia family.
Meanwhile, the Montellis will keep investigating the mysterious Inverted Tower, the other clue left by the Sentinel.
Soon after, you receive an invitation from the Primus, Fenrico, to the Cathedral of Mercury.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_69_49:
At the Cathedral of Mercury, you meet Fenrico. He apologizes for Alessio and others' deeds and promises to answer your questions as best he can.
In his words about the Sentinel, you catch a mention of the "Second Resonance Awakening." This raises suspicion—such a transfer of power from the Sentinel would require your permission.
When you press Fenrico about the true fate of Fleurdelys, he finally reveals a long-held secret: Fleurdelys was the Threnodian's Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_74_11:
After leaving the Cathedral, you discuss the findings with Abby. Every clue now seems to point back to the Threnodian mysteries, and you'll have to wait for Carlotta to contact the Fisalia family.
Gazing out over the tranquil sea of Rinascita, you feel a shiver of foreboding. The Carnevale is only a prologue... Everything is just beginning.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_70_22:
Not far away, Phrolova watches your every move. Beside her stands another Overseer, Cristoforo the "Playwright."
It seems his script is only starting to unfold...
POI_GTDYBR_75_3: We'll destroy the real copy to kill it for good.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_133_3: At the site, you're forced to subdue the rampaging Echo guards by force.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_21:
You are stopped by Echo guards at the outer part of Averardo Vault. Just as tensions rise, the noble lady you met before shows up, commanding the guards to stand down. 
She formally introduces herself as Carlotta Montelli, the second daughter of Montelli.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_71_12:
After defeating the Echo guard, Carlotta asks Zani to handle the cleanup.
You both head quickly to the tower ruins.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_74_10:
Arriving at the tower ruins, you find shattered stained glass telling the Sentinel's legend and the Order's founding by the first Primus. 
An ancient stone tablet stands nearby, waiting to be deciphered.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_75_9:
Carlotta successfully deciphers the prophecy inscribed on the stone tablet. 
To fully understand it, you may need to piece together the information from the tablet and the stained glass.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_76_5:
You restore the frequencies of the stained glass using your Sensor. 
With that, Carlotta tells you a legend about Rinascita's divinity.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_78_15: Carlotta is stunned by the revelation: the legend speaks of two divinities in Rinascita, with the Enlightened One depicted as a young girl—a sharp contrast to the Order's teachings. She suspects the Order destroyed these ruins to conceal this truth. She hints that another secret lies on a northern island, but before she can elaborate, the Order's pursuers arrive.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_80_7: Carlotta swiftly defeats the pursuers and tries to pry out more information, but Priest Alessio soon arrives with reinforcements.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_81_28:
Unable to persuade you to give up, Priest Alessio shows Capollo's pendant—proof of his capture—and uses the family tie to force Carlotta to "make the right choice." 
Carlotta quickly forms a silent plan. She pretends to aim her gun at you but instead shoots to dislodge debris, blocking the pursuers and opening an escape route for you. 
Now, it's time to head to the northern island and uncover the Order's buried secret.
Side_DSDMJR_1_1: Enough staring. Come on, let's go.
Side_DSDMJR_1_3: I heard her ranting about her {Male=brother;Female=sister}...
Side_DSDMJR_10_1: You're back. I've been keeping a close eye on her, just in case she gets any... wild ideas about hurting anyone.
Side_DSDMJR_10_2: Funny enough, she's been holding it together. It's like she really has been waiting on you.
Side_DSDMJR_10_4: You're finally back! Now I won't ever go hungry again! You must be exhausted from that trip, I'll prepare something for you to eat!
Side_DSDMJR_10_5: Dana takes the fish and quietly begins to skin it with her bare hands.
Side_DSDMJR_10_6: She's starting to lose her grip again. But now that you're back, no offense, but I'll be taking my leave... Good luck.
Side_DSDMJR_10_7: Hold on, do you know any of the people she talked about?
Side_DSDMJR_10_8: Those fancy Mister and Madam types? Ha! You think I know any toffee-nosed snobs like that? You might try asking Ahab, he knows just about everyone!
Side_DSDMJR_10_10: Dana serves up a plate piled high with messy fish pieces. She gazes at you like she's serving a feast.
Side_DSDMJR_10_11: How about we go to Madam Claire's first, Dana?
Side_DSDMJR_10_12: Oh, she wants to see us? Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go!
Side_DSDMJR_12_1: Oh, dear Madam Claire. Where could you be?
Side_DSDMJR_12_2: Do you... not wish to see me?
Side_DSDMJR_12_3: Ah... Madam Claire went out fishing, Dana.
Side_DSDMJR_12_5: Wait. Is this a note from Madam Claire?
Side_DSDMJR_12_6: "The folk from the city grow stranger by the day..."
Side_DSDMJR_12_7: "Why don't you craft a few specimens to sell, Ronald? It could be a profitable venture."
Side_DSDMJR_12_8: So you've been to see Uncle Ronald, haven't you? Madam Claire. I'm coming for you!
Side_DSDMJR_2_1: Here, {Male=brother;Female=sister}! I finally caught it! Look how pretty it is!
Side_DSDMJR_2_2: Best keep your distance, friend. There's something off about her. Best not to get too close.
Side_DSDMJR_2_3: It's a strange one. She seemed fine when I offered her some food not long ago...
Side_DSDMJR_2_6: Haven't the slightest clue. Doesn't seem to be from the Riccioli Islands the way she's dressed. Maybe the promise of adventure drew her from the city.
Side_DSDMJR_2_7: Something must've shaken her up. She seems all scrambled in the head.
Side_DSDMJR_2_9: Unusual fish seem to flock to these waters. City folk love coming here in hope of adding another rare trophy to their exotic collections.
Side_DSDMJR_2_10: These unknown waters are perilous. Those who lack respect for them are sure to invite misfortune. Every day, fools set out, never to return, yet still, the lure of adventure continues to draw in newcomers.
Side_DSDMJR_2_11: I overheard someone say that she and her {Male=brother;Female=sister} arrived asking about fishing some time ago.
Side_DSDMJR_2_12: I wonder why it's just her now...
Side_DSDMJR_2_13: I can't convince her to leave, and I have no idea who her family might be. Perhaps you could try talking to her again.
Side_DSDMJR_3_1: I can't wait to see the look on their faces once I bring this pretty little fish back, {Male=brother;Female=sister}.
Side_DSDMJR_3_2: Dana extends her scarred arms, revealing the broken pieces of a wine bottle she was holding.
Side_DSDMJR_3_4: Oh, marvelous! Do you remember Uncle Ronald spoke of peculiar fish here that are drawn to people's wounds?
Side_DSDMJR_3_5: Hurry, we need to head out to sea. We must catch one, even if it costs us our lives! Imagine showing it to everyone in the city!
Side_DSDMJR_3_6: Do you promise to return to the city after we catch this fish?
Side_DSDMJR_3_7: Absolutely! I shall be the first to present this fish, and then no one will ever be able to deny that I am truly the greatest collector there is!
Side_DSDMJR_3_9: You don't remember? I'll make a sketch for you.
Side_DSDMJR_4_1: The wind is too strong! We're taking on water, {Male=brother;Female=sister}. I need your help!
Side_DSDMJR_4_2: Dana stamps her feet impatiently, her empty hands seeming to tug at something invisible.
Side_DSDMJR_4_3: I found the fish you're looking for.
Side_DSDMJR_4_4: A new fish! A fish no one's ever laid eyes on! Oh, don't you dare die on me now. I won't let you rot away...
Side_DSDMJR_4_5: Uncle Ronald. I have to find Uncle Ronald, he's the finest taxidermist I know. He'll preserve your beauty forever.
Side_DSDMJR_4_6: Dana skips away happily with the fish clutched in her hands.
Side_DSDMJR_5_1: My fish, Uncle Ronald, you promised me you would help me. Where's my fish?!
Side_DSDMJR_5_2: W-Who in tarnation are you?! Get away from me!
Side_DSDMJR_5_3: It hurts... My face hurts... Please don't bite my face... Save me, {Male=brother;Female=sister}. {Male=Brother;Female=Sister}?
Side_DSDMJR_5_4: Dana? What are you still doing on the island?
Side_DSDMJR_5_5: My fish. The fish you gave me. I can't find it...
Side_DSDMJR_5_6: You notice the fish you caught for Dana dangling from her waist, exuding a foul, rotten stench.
Side_DSDMJR_5_7: I'm so sorry! Please don't be angry with me! I'll find your favorite fish and make it up to you!
Side_DSDMJR_5_9: Dana quickly scribbles a drawing of a fish.
Side_DSDMJR_5_10: This one! You told me it was your favorite fish when we were children! It still is, right? Please tell me I didn't get it wrong.
Side_DSDMJR_5_11: You don't need to go look for it. I already have it.
Side_DSDMJR_5_12: What? Where? Did you go out to sea without me? What treasures did you find? Show it to me!
Side_DSDMJR_6_1: No, stop. Don't eat me. Get off! Get off me!
Side_DSDMJR_6_2: Why are there so many? Ack! My legs... My arms... You're not taking me too!
Side_DSDMJR_6_3: Dana swings her arms wildly trying to dodge you, as if she's in the water.
Side_DSDMJR_6_5: Ah. {Male=Brother;Female=Sister}... How are you...? I saw you were... I saw it with my own eyes...
Side_DSDMJR_6_6: I've found the fish. We should go back.
Side_DSDMJR_6_7: So you managed to escape from all those fish. Not only that, you also found your favorite fish!
Side_DSDMJR_6_8: Yes, yes. Now that we have everything we want, it's time to return home and enjoy their beauty together.
Side_DSDMJR_6_9: Haha... Haha... You... You'll be a better collector than I'll ever be once we're back... I'm so thrilled for you!
Side_DSDMJR_7_1: Fishy... Oh, fishy, fishy... Come out, come out, wherever you are. I got a little treat for you.
Side_DSDMJR_7_3: Why the long face? There's plenty of room inside this fish tank, and look at all the lovely little fish keeping you company.
Side_DSDMJR_7_4: Hey... Did you throw your own {Male=brother;Female=sister} into the sea...?
Side_DSDMJR_7_5: Oh, don't cry. I'll help you find it. Anything for my dear {Male=brother;Female=sister}... Yes, anything...
Side_DSDMJR_7_6: (Trying to convince her to leave isn't getting anywhere. I should find her family and see if they can bring her home.)
Side_DSDMJR_7_8: {Male=He;Female=She}'s still in the sea. It's so cold there... I want to find {Male=him;Female=her}.
Side_DSDMJR_7_10: I can't go home alone! We made a promise! This is what {Male=he;Female=she} looks like. No, more like... this. I must bring {Male=him;Female=her} back.
Side_DSDMJR_7_11: Dana scribbles frantically on the ground. She draws a fish.
Side_DSDMJR_7_12: Suddenly, Dana panics and bolts toward the sea. You catch her just in time.
Side_DSDMJR_7_13: Get your hands off me! Who do you think you are?! I am a noble! An invitation bearer! A true collector! Let me go this instant!
Side_DSDMJR_7_14: We're here bringing gifts for Mr. Doria. Quick, {Male=brother;Female=sister}. Show him the gifts we prepared.
Side_DSDMJR_7_15: (If there's a chance she'll mistake that fish for her {Male=brother;Female=sister}, maybe bringing it back will convince her to leave?)
Side_DSDMJR_7_17: Hmph. Just you wait and see, peasants!
Side_DSDMJR_8_2: Dana reaches out to the fish in surprise and begins stroking its scales.
Side_DSDMJR_8_3: Oh, {Male=brother;Female=sister}! I'm sorry... I'm sorry... I didn't mean to kick you into the water... They just liked your taste better...
Side_DSDMJR_8_4: I didn't want to die... You reached out to pull me in, right? It was either you or me...
Side_DSDMJR_8_6: I saw those fish first! You can't take them from me! I'm the better collector! I'm the one and only genius!
Side_DSDMJR_8_7: If I bring these back to Madam Claire, she'll let me into her salon, right? No one will ever look down on us again.
Side_DSDMJR_8_8: (Let's hope she stays in this delusion until she makes it back to the city.)
Side_DSDMJR_9_1: Dana holds the fish tightly, thrusting it toward the fishermen who recoil in discomfort.
Side_DSDMJR_9_2: Take a good look at this fish, Mr. Doria. It's a species thought to be extinct! I spent three days and nights at sea searching for it.
Side_DSDMJR_9_3: Oh, Madam Claire, may I join your salon now? I've completed all the extra tasks you set for me. You promised...
Side_DSDMJR_9_5: What she got in her hands...? Is that a rotten fish...?
Side_DSDMJR_9_6: I don't understand a word she's saying. Isn't that just a normal fish?
Side_DSDMJR_9_7: You gave me your promise! Why would you all lie to me?! WHY?! WHY?!
Side_DSDMJR_9_8: Whoa! Easy there, miss! Someone find a way to calm her down!
Side_DSDMJR_9_9: Dana, it's me. Just breathe, please!
Side_DSDMJR_9_10: As Dana notices you, her frantic energy shifts. Tears begin to stream down her face.
Side_DSDMJR_9_11: {Male=Brother;Female=Sister}. Oh, {Male=brother;Female=sister}... I'm so sorry... I let you down... I went looking for them, but...
Side_DSDMJR_9_12: They... They kept changing their promises. They never intended to accept us into the family...
Side_DSDMJR_9_13: Don't cry. We'll figure something out.
Side_DSDMJR_9_14: Do you really think there's hope? If we offer them another rare fish... will they accept us then?
Side_DSDMJR_9_15: They will. What kind of fish do you have in mind?
Side_DSDMJR_9_16: I-I was thinking... What about this one? You can only find it around the Riccioli Islands. It's extremely rare.
Side_DSDMJR_9_17: If we catch this fish, does that mean we'll finally bear the family name? Imagine, they might even fetch us in a carriage!
Side_DSDMJR_9_18: Exactly. I'll go get the fish, and you stay here and wait for me, okay?
Side_DSDMJR_9_19: Okay. I'll be a good girl. Please be careful, {Male=brother;Female=sister}.

PlotType_111_TypeDescription: Rinascita - Chapter II: Through the Sea Thou Break
Character_Cantarella_27_1: You find Cantarella finishing a dance under the moonlight. Her graceful movements seem meant to regulate certain frequencies.
Character_Cantarella_27_2: Ah, you've made it here. I'm glad to see you're feeling better. Now we can finally have a proper conversation.
Character_Cantarella_27_3: Did you come all this way for me, or are you in search of the secrets slumbering in the deep?
Character_Cantarella_27_7: Oh, I'm flattered… Don't worry, with someone as precious as you here in my castle, I'm not going anywhere.
Character_Cantarella_27_8: Hehe, clever little fish… Have you figured it out? The answer has been right here, waiting to be discovered.
Character_Cantarella_27_9: Hehe, such greed… Rest assured, I'm here to unravel the secrets with you, as I promised.
Character_Cantarella_27_10: What exactly are the Sea Apples and the Jellyroses in the garden used for?
Character_Cantarella_27_11: The crimson Sea Apple, also called "the alluring reaper," is a dangerous plant. A single bite can lead to paralysis, suffocation, or the excruciating pain of a burnt throat and torn organs—ultimately bringing its victim an agonizing death.
Character_Cantarella_27_12: As for the Jellyroses, their blooms will transform into Jellyrose Medusae. These little ones can produce a neurotoxin that induces intense hallucinations, and in extreme cases, causes the body to seize and twist in a violent, uncontrollable dance of death.
Character_Cantarella_27_13: The two lethal plants have been meticulously nurtured by generations of the Fisalia family, flourishing within the gardens of Porto-Veno Castle for centuries.
Character_Cantarella_27_14: So my guess was correct. The "Red Apple" in the second riddle refers to the Sea Apple, and the "Round Hat" in the last riddle points to the Jellyrose Medusa.
Character_Cantarella_27_15: As for the first riddle, "Siren's Song," the "crown atop the mountain" and the "waterfall that cascaded into the depths below" clearly points here—a crown-like castle that sits atop a jagged cliff, with a waterfall rushing down.
Character_Cantarella_27_16: It seems the girls in the riddle were lured into the Porto-Veno Castle.
Character_Cantarella_27_17: The strange frequencies coming from the music box probably reflect the suffering of the "ghost girls," who were poisoned and tortured in the castle.
Character_Cantarella_27_19: I don't believe you'd engage in such senseless cruelty or take pleasure in others' suffering.
Character_Cantarella_27_20: There should be a reason behind this… Wait, there's one Fisalia tradition that might explain it. The Divine Trials.
Character_Cantarella_27_21: It's a ritual to select a maiden of extraordinary willpower, a Fisalia who can withstand the Threnodian's whispers. I assume such extreme methods were needed for the trials.
Character_Cantarella_27_22: Well… I never imagined you'd solve the mystery so quickly. You never cease to amaze me.
Character_Cantarella_27_23: The truth behind the "ghost girl" riddle is none other than the grim secret of the Divine Trials.
Character_Cantarella_27_24: The blood and tears shed in these trials throughout the years have seeped into this castle and concocted what we now call <ano=Sonoro Sphere>the Sea of Ghosts</ano>.
Character_Cantarella_27_25: There, past and future intertwine, and Fisalia's ancient secrets cling to the cracks of time like grotesque scabs.
Character_Cantarella_27_26: With you by my side, I would relive that trauma, and unfold the layers of forsaken time for a closer look.
Character_Cantarella_27_27: And if… you find these scabs have somehow crept unto my very flesh and feel the need to cut them away, I'll place my full trust in you and leave it in your hands.
Character_Cantarella_27_28: Why do you trust me so much?
Character_Cantarella_27_30: Ever since I guided you to the sanctuary… you've seen through me and all that the Fisalia family conceals.
Character_Cantarella_27_31: I've witnessed you cleanse the chaos of the Inverted Tower, restoring order to the heavens and seas. If you are the one to pass final judgment on me… it would be the highest honor.
Character_Cantarella_27_32: Absolutely. Remember my promise? Whether it's elixir or poison, I'm ready to explore it with you.
Character_Cantarella_27_33: I, Cantarella Fisalia, value every promise I made to you and vow to see them through.
Character_Cantarella_27_34: Now, the answers we seek lie in the depths of fierce undercurrents… Will you join me and dive into the deep sea?
Character_Cantarella_27_36: Of course. I've seen it all.
Character_Cantarella_27_38: Yes. We must free those ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_27_39: Yes. I have to remove the influence on me.
Character_Cantarella_27_41: You're like a pearl from the deepest sea, but… I'd never let such a flawless gem endure even the smallest scratch.
Character_Cantarella_27_44: Your wisdom, courage, and kindness… no matter how deep the waters, always shine through.
Character_Cantarella_27_45: Mmm, the strange frequency you carry is indeed from the Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_27_46: That message with the distorted frequency is no doubt a creation of this Sonoro.
Character_Cantarella_27_47: I don't know why it reached you, but the answer is hidden within. After we uncover the truth, its influence on you will fade.
Character_Cantarella_27_48: Once we enter the sea, I'll be right by your side, tightly. No poisonous creature shall harm you.
Character_Cantarella_27_49: For you are the one I've chosen.
Character_Cantarella_27_50: I think I'm ready to go now.
Character_Cantarella_27_51: I need some time to get ready.
Character_Cantarella_27_52: Excellent. Together we dive into the Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_27_53: Of course. It's wise to ready yourself before diving into such perilous depths.
Character_Cantarella_27_54: I'll be waiting for you in the garden, whenever you're ready.

Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_1: Teacher, the Seminary will soon be engulfed. What should we do?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_2: We have to leave… but we can't go without the relic. We can't let it be lost to the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_3: The Seminary is but stone and tile. It can always be rebuilt. My days are numbered, but until my last breath, I will protect the sage's relic, no matter the cost.
Side_SSDYC_1_1: I heard a fascinating tale while we've been here, {PlayerName}. Would you care to listen?
Side_SSDYC_1_3: It's a fishermen's legend passed down for generations on this island. It speaks of Rinascita during the ancient Age of a Thousand Islands, when the Riccioli Islands were ruled by a sailor driven from his homeland.
Side_SSDYC_1_4: This sailor possessed untold riches, yet no one knew the source of his fortune.
Side_SSDYC_1_5: He used his vast wealth to build a citadel that brought peace and prosperity to the people of the land.
Side_SSDYC_1_6: Just when they prepared to build a monument to honor him, he vanished without a trace.
Side_SSDYC_1_7: Whispers claimed he sailed away to seek revenge for a dark past.
Side_SSDYC_1_8: Before he departed, he left behind his most cherished treasures on these islands and set forth on a path of revenge, never to return.
Side_SSDYC_1_9: I'm curious what kind of treasure a man like that would leave behind. It must've held great significance to him.
Side_SSDYC_1_10: Shall we set out to uncover it?
Side_SSDYC_1_11: I can hear the treasure calling to me!
Side_SSDYC_1_12: I knew you'd be intrigued! Perhaps we could seek out someone well-versed in these legends? They may hold the key to our quest.
Side_SSDYC_2_1: The Acolyte? Back again so soon?
Side_SSDYC_2_2: Mr. Toretto, we're here to learn more about the "Sailor's Treasure."
Side_SSDYC_2_3: Since when did the Order start caring about treasure?
Side_SSDYC_2_5: Ah, spare me the details! Treasure hunters come and go, you lot are a dime a dozen. You'll end up empty-handed like the rest of 'em anyway.
Side_SSDYC_2_6: Maybe we'll find it. You never know.
Side_SSDYC_2_7: Awfully sure of yourself, aren't ya? You know how long ago the Age of a Thousand Islands was. Besides that old legend, there's not a sliver of evidence proving any of it is true.
Side_SSDYC_2_8: Without real clues, it's just a wild goose chase. The islands have already been turned upside down by those treasure hunters, and not a single coin has been found.
Side_SSDYC_2_9: Are there any other stories about the sailor?
Side_SSDYC_2_10: Other stories, you ask? Lemme see... There's the Wandering Gondola. Or there's the Master of the Fish King...
Side_SSDYC_2_11: Tell us about the Wandering Gondola.
Side_SSDYC_2_12: Tell us about the Master of the Fish King.
Side_SSDYC_2_13: I don't have any more to ask.
Side_SSDYC_2_14: Legend has it a sailor arrived here in a Gondola. Even after he disappeared, it still drifts among these islands waiting for his return.
Side_SSDYC_2_15: The Fish King is a notorious foe for any fisherman. Legend claims that once a sailor caught one in these very waters.
Side_SSDYC_2_16: No one has caught one since. They say a Fish King only heeds the call of someone as great as that sailor.
Side_SSDYC_2_17: All right, you already know what you need to know. Off you go, then. I'll be watching to see if you can find that treasure, ha!
Side_SSDYC_3_1: What do you make of the clues, {PlayerName}?
Side_SSDYC_3_2: Finding that Gondola might be a good start.
Side_SSDYC_3_3: Good idea. The sailor may have vanished, but if his Gondola is still here we may be able to find some clues.
Side_SSDYC_4_1: Phoebe attempts to communicate with the Echo and decipher what it's saying.
Side_SSDYC_4_2: They seems to know something! It may be trying to guide us in a certain direction... Shall we go take a look?
Side_SSDYC_5_1: I never expected to actually find something... This appears to be...
Side_SSDYC_5_2: Looks like a treasure map. A piece of one at least.
Side_SSDYC_5_3: There looks to be something inscribed inside the chest. Hmm... It's hard to make out. The script is unfamiliar to me.
Side_SSDYC_5_4: Let's ask a reliable local for advice.
Side_SSDYC_6_1: Ah, well met, friends! What's this ye've got there?
Side_SSDYC_6_2: Phoebe shares the story of your treasure hunt with Ahab and shows him the chest with the inscriptions.
Side_SSDYC_6_3: So, ye're telling me this here chest is from that legendary sailor?! Let me have a look.
Side_SSDYC_6_4: Hmm... there's a seal coverin' up these inscriptions. Can't get a good look at 'em. Heh, but watch me!
Side_SSDYC_6_5: Ahab searches the surrounding area and returns with a unique plant. He squeezes it to extract its sap and applies it to the chest. Almost immediately, the inscriptions become clear.
Side_SSDYC_6_6: See that? It's an old trick we used to write hidden messages. Now we can read what it says.
Side_SSDYC_6_7: "No victory is instant. The truth must be pieced together bit by bit."
Side_SSDYC_6_8: It seems like... we need to gather the rest of this map to find the treasure.
Side_SSDYC_6_9: Let's keep our eyes peeled from now on, {PlayerName}.
Side_SSDYC_6_10: I wonder what that sailor left behind. Endless riches? Ancient relics?
Side_SSDYC_6_12: Huh? Hahaha. Never thought I'd hear that from an Acolyte!
Side_SSDYC_6_13: Thanks, Ahab. We'll make sure to share the treasure with you once we find it.
Side_SSDYC_6_14: That's mighty generous, but I'm content with me lot in life. Whatever you find, keep it for yerselves!
Side_SSDYC_7_1: "Someone has surely found that legendary sailor's treasure by now."
Side_SSDYC_7_2: "If you can't see it, just try squeezing some waterweed juice onto it."
Side_SSDYC_7_3: "What? Any waterweed will do. Do you think a sailor has time to be choosy?"
Side_SSDYC_7_4: "No victory is instant. The truth must be pieced together bit by bit."
Side_SSDYC_7_5: "Search for all the scraps of that treasure map. Piece it together, and who knows what you might discover?"

HelpText_174_Title: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men
HelpText_174_Content:
[About]

John Wicktorio, a retired Acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.
Determined to settle the scores and avenge his old pal, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during the Main Quest: "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you will enter a special sphere to battle waves of enemies within a set time limit, with the aid of unique buffs.

2. You will collect Coins by dealing damage to enemies, but taking damage will cause you to lose Coins.

3. Progressing through enemy waves unlocks more special buffs to give you the support you need.

4. The Coins you have collected by the end of the countdown will be your Coins record of this stage.

5. Defeating each enemy wave grants additional time.

Character_Rococo_3_18:
You repel the Tacet Discords, saving both the pilgrims and the troupe members. 
Roccia thanks you and explains the origins of the pilgrims.
Character_Rococo_5_15:
Together, you and Roccia rescue the pilgrims. 
Some are badly injured, others are starving, and none are in good shape.
Character_Rococo_77_19:
The pilgrims need better shelter, so Tina takes them back to the troupe. 
Roccia volunteers to stay behind for a final checkup, and you decide to accompany her.
Character_Rococo_9_5: Pero discovers a dying little girl in the cabin.
Character_Rococo_10_12:
You return to the troupe, where Tina is preparing pasta. 
Meanwhile, Roccia is busy patching up the little girl. You decide to go lend a hand.
Character_Rococo_11_17:
Roccia carefully tends to the little girl. She then asks about the condition of the other pilgrims. 
Tina informs you two that the others have been fed and are recovering from their injuries, though they remain mentally drained. 
You encourage the introverted Roccia to ask the pilgrims directly about their well-being and explore how else she can help.
Character_Rococo_12_20:
Filippo’s arm has mostly recovered, but he remains deeply depressed. 
He recounts how Ragunna, under the Order's rule, strictly regulated theatrical performances. 
He and others were exiled for performing the banned opera, "Pegasus." 
During their exile, many of their companions perished in perilous encounters, leaving the survivors unable to continue the beloved opera.
Character_Rococo_13_16: Giulio, another exile, shares his longing for the freedom celebrated in "Pegasus" and his deep nostalgia for his departed partner.
Character_Rococo_14_22:
After speaking with the pilgrims, Roccia concludes that their biggest wish is to perform "Pegasus" with their companions once again. 
As a stage prop maker, Roccia resolves to collect and repair the objects left behind by her partners so she can participate in the welcoming opera alongside them.
Character_Rococo_15_16: Roccia begins setting up the stage and preparing props for the welcoming opera. You help her inventory the items Pero brought back to determine how they can best be used.
Character_Rococo_18_12:
Roccia reflects on the ship debris. These fragments once belonged to a Pilgrim's Sail—a vessel that carried everyone’s fear and confusion, while also recording their resilience and defiance. 
The debris is large and well-suited for use as scene props for the stage.
Character_Rococo_23_9:
Roccia shares with you the significance of Luceanites. 
Legend has it that each Luceanite is a soul trapped on the Strand. 
If left exposed in the wild, the stone loses its light and must be collected in time. 
Bright Luceanites are ideal for creating star clusters to decorate stage ceilings.
Character_Rococo_25_6:
Roccia tells you about a petal—a fragment of a wreath that once belonged to a little boy who didn’t survive the shipwreck. 
The petals are soft and fragile, and Roccia carefully considers how they might be incorporated into the welcoming opera.
Character_Rococo_26_8:
The initial stage setup is complete, but Roccia notices that the stars aren’t shining brightly enough. 
The North Star, a symbol of hope in "Pegasus," should shine even brighter. 
Roccia recalls Filippo mentioning that people sang under a star on the boat and decides to ask him for more information.
Character_Rococo_27_7: Filippo reveals that the star belonged to Luca. Pero, sensing that Luca may have woken up, goes to investigate.
Character_Rococo_28_15:
Luca cries upon realizing her star is lost. 
She believes it has always been the star that blessed everyone and that misfortune strikes when the star is gone. 
You and Roccia comfort the weak Luca and promise to help her find the star.
Character_Rococo_29_9:
You and Roccia search the ship but find no star-like objects. 
Objects imbued with emotional frequencies resonate with their users, so Roccia decides to use familiar items to help the pilgrims. 
She resolves to create a new "star" to perfect the "Pegasus" ensemble. For Roccia, "possibility" means "hope."
Character_Rococo_31_15:
Roccia notices an unusual mist rising around her and goes on guard. 
The play Pegasus warns to be careful in misty conditions. You decide to hurry up.
Character_Rococo_34_9:
You discover some clams. 
The troupe isn't high on budget and often has to eat whatever they can find nearby. 
Roccia takes the clams to make a pot of clam soup for everyone.
Character_Rococo_35_6:
You find a Luceanite, which Roccia carefully stores away. 
Meanwhile, Pero suddenly perks up, as if it's made an important discovery.
Character_Rococo_36_6:
Pero finds footprints that emit star frequencies, though they’re jumbled and hard to decipher. 
You volunteer to investigate further.
Character_Rococo_38_3:
As you venture deeper, the rising mist surrounds you, forming a maze. 
The open door seem to invite you in.
Character_Rococo_39_18:
Roccia realizes the misty maze resembles a scene from "Pegasus." 
Together, you conclude that the maze must be man-made and decide to explore what lies within.
Character_Rococo_54_15:
At the end of the maze, you find a cavern shrouded in mist. 
Inside, the pitch-black cavern is filled with stars and something you can't recognize.
Character_Rococo_64_10:
You return to the troupe with the Plushies. 
Roccia suggests letting them to help set up the stage. You tell Luca that her star has been found.
Character_Rococo_65_9: Luca, overjoyed, lets you lend her star for the welcoming opera.
Character_Rococo_66_21:
Back at the stage, the Plushies reveal a startling truth: their owners never abandoned them—they were exiled. 
To protect their Echoes from the Order, which sought to erase their frequencies entirely, the owners made the painful decision to leave them behind. 
At the theater, some Plushies are joyfully reunited with their owners, while others discover cherished items their owners once held dear.
Character_Rococo_69_13:
After the show, Roccia returns the borrowed stage props to their rightful owners. 
The audience leaves, satisfied with their reclaimed belongings. 
As the stage empties, only one Luceanite remains.
Character_Rococo_70_5: You recognize it as Roccia’s Luceanite.
Character_Rococo_72_21:
Roccia, sensing something different in you, invites you to join the Fool’s Troupe. 
Together, you performed the perfect welcoming opera, giving everyone the freedom to bring laughter back to Ragunna. 
Your ideals and the troupe’s ideals align, making them your steadfast allies and support.
Character_Rococo_76_12:
Thanks to your efforts, Roccia’s first orientation and return-to-sail event was a success. 
In addition to paying you for lending a hand, Roccia has a special gift for you.
Character_Rococo_16_8:
Roccia reflects on a lunachord left behind by the Pilgrim’s Sail. 
Its owner sought to ease everyone’s hearts through music, and they performed till the last second of their life. 
Though the lunachord has lost its strings, Roccia replaces them with something new, transforming it into a stage prop to inspire others.

Character_Cantarella_124_2: Now that we're leaving, you'll be left alone here…
Character_Cantarella_124_3: You should never have had to bear such a heavy burden.
Character_Cantarella_124_4: I still remember what you told me back then, during the trials. You said you wanted to leave this place behind, go somewhere far away where no one knew you, and live freely...
Character_Cantarella_124_5: But now, you're staying in this cold castle, bearing it all alone…
Character_Cantarella_124_6: As long as I am the head of Fisalia, what happened here remains buried. No more trials, no more innocent lives caught in this web.
Character_Cantarella_124_7: My freedom for theirs—a fair exchange, wouldn't you say?
Character_Cantarella_124_8: It's time to leave, my dear.
Character_Cantarella_28_4: Excellent. Together we dive into the Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_28_5: Take your time. I don't mind lingering here a little longer with my beloved Violacas.
