Character_Cantarella_126_1:
The Night of Remembrance has come to a perfect close, and the town settles back into its usual peace. The windmill creaks as it turns, and leaves drift lazily in the midnight breeze. 
It feels like nothing ever happened, as if it was just a fleeting night's dream. But you know it was real, because Cantarella stands right beside you.
Character_Cantarella_126_2: *yawn* That was a really long nap.
Character_Cantarella_126_3: *sniff* Mmm, the strange smell is all gone! You smell good again!
Character_Cantarella_126_4: Oh! I had the best dream! I was dancing with all these cute Echoes! Hehe!
Character_Cantarella_126_5: Oops, uh... am I interrupting something?
Character_Cantarella_126_6: No, no, Abby. Go back to sleep.
Character_Cantarella_126_8: Fine... I'll just go take another nap.
Character_Cantarella_126_9: Hehe… Things have returned to normal, it seems. How delightful.
Character_Cantarella_126_10: It's late… Would you care to come to my castle and rest for the night?
Character_Cantarella_126_11: I'd love that. I could use a good rest.
Character_Cantarella_126_12: It will be my pleasure. Let me walk you home.
Character_Cantarella_126_13: Cantarella's lips curve into a gentle smile, her eyes, calm as the ocean depths, rippling with a hint of warmth.
Character_Cantarella_126_14: She knows you're stronger than her, but her instinct to care for you remains, as natural as the breath she takes.
Character_Cantarella_126_15: Oh, the pleasure is mine, my dear.
Character_Cantarella_127_1: With you here, this castle feels… warmer. Your presence may have dispelled the chill that used to linger.
Character_Cantarella_127_4: Our family's purpose has always been clear—to resist the Threnodian's spiritual interference and hold fast to our faith in the Sentinel.
Character_Cantarella_127_5: The cruel trials were designed to find a Maiden with an unbreakable will, someone who could withstand the Threnodian's whispers and fix her eyes on the true light.
Character_Cantarella_127_6: Yet, in pursuit of that "noble cause," innocent lives were sacrificed without question.
Character_Cantarella_127_7: I can't accept the so-called "necessary sacrifice," one that tramples the will of others in the name of duty. It's nothing but living off the weak.
Character_Cantarella_127_8: Though it's important to kindle the flames, none should forget those burned to ashes—those lives shouldn't have been squandered.
Character_Cantarella_127_9: After all, we are more than just firewood.
Character_Cantarella_127_10: So, you chose to offer your own strength...
Character_Cantarella_127_11: So, you sought a different way...
Character_Cantarella_127_12: Yes. When I took up the Sword of Divinity, I felt a <ano=Fleurdelys>presence</ano>, someone far more capable, more suitable. A new possibility emerged.
Character_Cantarella_127_13: I asked the Sentinel to transfer my Second Awakening power to that girl.
Character_Cantarella_127_14: The Sentinel had always wielded the power of separation, but instead agreed to my proposal to combine our strengths. With that power, she confronted the Threnodian.
Character_Cantarella_127_15: We triumphed, for the moment, but the Threnodian proved to be more difficult than we expected.
Character_Cantarella_127_16: To stop the brutal Divine Trials and secure us the final victory, I chose to become the family head, drawing on every resource available to achieve our goal.
Character_Cantarella_127_17: I pretended to align with the Order to keep the Threnodian off guard, all while searching for a way to fully liberate the Sentinel and end the Threnodian once and for all.
Character_Cantarella_127_19: So that's why you took me straight to the Sword of Divinity.
Character_Cantarella_127_20: You must've gone through a lot.
Character_Cantarella_127_21: Hehe… I have been watching you from the moment you set foot in Rinascita.
Character_Cantarella_127_22: Now, I daresay I know you inside out.
Character_Cantarella_127_23: Just as you chose your path, I've chosen mine. I will see it through, whatever it may cost.
Character_Cantarella_127_24: Besides, compared to what you've endured, my hardships aren't worth mentioning.
Character_Cantarella_127_25: You defeated the Threnodian in the Inverted Tower, saved the people of Rinascita, and freed those young girls... and me as well.
Character_Cantarella_127_26: The girls are now back home, and the Threnodian's whispers have finally faded from this castle.
Character_Cantarella_127_27: And with the Order's concessions, the shadows over Rinascita are vanishing. Peace has come to us once more.
Character_Cantarella_127_28: Thanks to you, the days of pain and sacrifice have ended. A calm life… that is the miracle you've brought.
Character_Cantarella_127_29: As the head of Fisalia, I must offer you a fitting reward for all the efforts you made.
Character_Cantarella_127_30: An elixir for eternal youth, perhaps? No, judging from the power of your Awakening, it seems you may already possess that.
Character_Cantarella_127_31: Then, let it be the elixir that turns stone into gold.
Character_Cantarella_127_32: I, Cantarella Fisalia, hereby offer {PlayerName} the family's entire legacy—every elixir and every hidden secret.
Character_Cantarella_127_35: Hehe… the Fisalias make no unprofitable bargains. It's my privilege to give it all to you.
Character_Cantarella_127_37: It's been a long day. You deserve a sweet, peaceful sleep.
Character_Cantarella_127_38: Here, a special elixir I've prepared with Albizia flowers—their gentle, lingering fragrance can waft through reality into your dream.
Character_Cantarella_127_39: Now, close your eyes... and rest. Good night.
Character_Rococo_10_13: Roccia and Pero help the little girl rest in a medical tent and perform emergency treatment on her. Once her condition stabilizes, Roccia takes you to Tina to let her know you’ve returned safe and sound. Meanwhile, Pero stays behind in the tent to keep an eye on the girl.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_2: Fleurdelys, my Resonator, why dost thou persist?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_3: Why abandon thy oath? Why hinder the spread of my gospel?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_4: You are a false Divinity... Gehinnom will reveal the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_5: Gehinnom, the lone dragon to have escaped?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_6: The one blessed by the Dark Tide shall return to us. Continue thy disobedience at the risk of insanity.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_7: Look around, thou hast none left.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_8: My most beloved Resonator, why persist in the error of thy ways?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_9: I will never forget my cause.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_10: If Divinity takes up arms against the innocent, I will raise my sword against Divinity!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_11: With the support and hope of countless souls, I stand before you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_100_12: They fell, so I may rise!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_3: Gehinnom, the one you mentioned earlier, what happened to him?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_9: I am finally... finally able to face all of you...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_10: I am not your enemy, and your sacrifices were not in vain...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_14: Sorry you had to see me lose my composure.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_15: I've found my true self again. It does not matter if I am indeed the Threnodian's Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_16: Because I know who to stand by and who to cut down.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_17: Some of my memories have returned, thanks to you and Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_19: No, not yet. Not until we free the Sentinel and defeat the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_20: That is why we need to investigate the frequency you absorbed earlier.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_22: That blue thingy in your Tacet Mark totally tastes like Threnodian!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_23: You tried to eat it again?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_25: Of course not, it reeks! Just the smell alone is enough.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_26: The Threnodian's energy has also been split... Could it be the work of the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_27: Like I said, it's mixed up with something. Too tough to chew.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_28: If the Sentinel splits Their own energy to prepare the "true" Blessed Maiden...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_29: Then why would They split off the Threnodian's energy, and then channel it through Hognis to the person who unsealed the passage?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_31: Perhaps to strengthen the Blessed Maiden?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_32: Perhaps the Sentinel didn't split that energy?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_33: Possibly, but the Threnodian's energy would damage the body of the Sentinel's Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_34: You wouldn't be affected since Abby resides within you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_35: But surely a second frequency would interfere with the resonance of the Sentinel's "true" Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_36: The answer might lie in the other frequencies that got mixed in.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_37: But the frequency of the Sentinel's "true" Blessed Maiden is supposed to clash with that of the Threnodian's.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_38: A fusion of the two would endanger her life.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_39: The answer might lie in the other frequencies that got mixed in.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_41: You are a Resonator born of the merge between the Sentinel and Threnodian. What if you used their abilities to split it yourself?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_42: I haven't forgotten how I became a Resonator, and I know I don't have the ability to do that.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_43: Maybe your ability is being suppressed by the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_44: Do you think the mixed frequencies Abby felt... came from me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_45: But why would I do that?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_46: The answer might lie behind the third sealed passageway.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_47: (Cartethyia is starting to make sense of things, but she'll need time to get her head straight.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_48: Same as before? We'll keep watch tonight and continue our journey tomorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_1: Is there anything you'd like to discuss?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_3: Tell me about the Sentinel's Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_5: Dragon Tacet Discords lived here long before the Rinascita settlers arrived. With time and patience, the Order tamed them into Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_6: They are fiercely intelligent and have their own social order.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_7: Gehinnom... was their king, and the only one we believed could lift the siege of the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_8: We hoped he would bring us the truth. But... it seems he failed.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_10: I am a Resonator born of the merge between the Sentinel and Threnodian. So whose Resonator am I?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_11: Do I belong to the Threnodian... or the Sentinel? What does it really feel like to be the Sentinel's Resonator?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_13: Jué's Resonator sounds like a woman of strong resolve.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_14: I would like to meet her someday.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_16: I need to clear my mind. I won't let my feelings get in the way of our journey tomorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_22: Oh, how it brings back memories... this is Egla Town's specialty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_23: Thank you. Just the sight of it is enough to make me smile.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_24: You're not going to eat it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_25: No, I can no longer taste anything, nor do I need food to survive.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_26: How else would I have been able to last for so long in the Sonoro Sphere?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_27: Ew! Just the sight of it is enough to...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_28: Is this what people eat nowadays?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_29: I see you are a Ragunnesi through and through.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_33: ...I am grateful for your kindness, but I can no longer taste anything, thank goodness, nor do I need food to survive.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_34: How else would I have been able to last for so long in the Sonoro Sphere?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_35: You should save this food for someone who truly appreciates it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_37: A man named Bardolino once told me that the Sentinel recommended this dish to him during the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_38: Eh... the voice he heard was mine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_40: "The body is a temple for the mind. To keep your mind sharp, do consume healthy food..." That's probably what I said.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_42: After I became a Resonator, the voice all the Laurates heard was my own.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_43: Still, the Laurus Salad is undeniably the best dish out there!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_45: No, I can no longer taste anything, nor do I need food to survive.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_46: How else would I have been able to last for so long in the Sonoro Sphere?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_47: You should save your food for those who require sustenance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_102_48: It's late. You should get some rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_3: Good evening. How goes progress on your end?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_5: So... a portion of energy was split from the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_7: ...{PlayerName}, the soul is like a boiling cauldron.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_8: You may know the ingredients you add, but who can predict what would come of it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_9: It might become an elixir, or perhaps a poison. Or, perhaps, it will simply fizzle away into nothingness.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_10: I've watched it happen far too many times.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_12: So... any updates on your end?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_13: I found several things which may tip the scales in our favor.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_15: It would take too long to explain... and you deserve your rest, don't you?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_103_16: I will be there when your journey ends. We will speak of it then.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_104_2: What! My eyes are still peeled.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_104_5: I can't shake the feeling that the two frequencies are somehow connected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_104_6: Imperator has the power to split energy, and Leviathan to merge and assimilate...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_104_7: So, the source of that connection might very well be Leviathan's powers at work.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_104_9: Isn't there one last place to go? Who knows what you'll need to cram into your Tacet Mark next!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_105_1: Soft singing rouses you from a light sleep.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_2: It's fine, I couldn't sleep anyway.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_3: It's fine, I was awake anyway.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_5: Yes, a farewell song from the people of Rinascita. We usually sing it when a friend is about to leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_6: During that battle, I never got to say goodbye or mourn their passing.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_7: And before my memories came back, I wasn't sure if I was worthy of paying them my respects.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_8: So now, even though I know these are just lingering frequencies, and they might not understand me...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_9: I just... I want to say goodbye properly, and thank them.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_10: Do you think I'm... fooling myself?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_11: No... I'm sure they can feel what's in your heart.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_12: I'm not just saying that to comfort you. I believe it's possible.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_13: I once saw two friends, one who was already dead, reconcile with each other from within a Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_14: When frequencies are concentrated in one place, it's possible that their Reverberations could still carry traces of human will.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_16: They might still be able to hear and feel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_17: Your voice, your goodbyes, your feelings... could have reached them.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_18: After all, these frequencies are strong enough to manifest in the real world.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_20: They haven't made a move against us. They must still remember you, which means they can probably hear you, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_22: No. If they can still hear and feel, then the time for goodbyes hasn't come.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_23: I need to give them a real victory.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_24: You can ease up a little. As long as their obsession holds and the Sonoro Sphere stays intact, they won't vanish.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_25: Bound by obsession... till relieved of duty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_28: Hey, since we know you don't carry any blame, should I call you Cartethyia or Fleurdelys?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_30: I want to stay here for a moment. Will you keep me company?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_32: Alright, but only for a moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_107_3: It's time to go. Today is the day we settle this.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_108_2: Phaom is telling us to hurry up.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_1: I wonder how Cantarella is doing.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_2: We can call her if you're worried.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_4: Ever the early riser. Did you call to say good morning?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_7: I just wanted to know how you're doing.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_8: ... Ah, so you do care. Good to know my efforts weren't wasted.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_9: She...hung up. Was that meant as encouragement?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_110_10: Everyone shows kindness in their own way.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_1: Did you know that Echo well?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_2: Cadanto was my first Echo after I joined the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_3: When I stood against the Threnodian, he took a mortal blow meant for me and fell to the Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_4: I never thought he'd come back as a Tacet Discord.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_5: But he still recognized this sword...and was still trying to protect it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_6: Haultier was my saber. I practiced with it often in sparring sessions with Cadanto.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_118_7: Looks like he's still trapped in the past, doesn't it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_119_1: We must finish this and free Cadanto.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_121_1: Please allow him to fight at your side.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_1: Fleurdelys, wilt thou return to me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_2: Someone must expose your lies. As long as there is a sliver of hope, I will not give up.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_3: Is that so? Then I shall reveal the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_5: Why dost thou resonate with me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_7: Why dost thou hear into the minds of the faithful?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_8: Why dost thou act as my Oracle?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_9: All this, and yet thou does not question?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_13: I made thee. Thy life, thy hopes, thy will, thy past.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_14: All that thou are, I made "whole," I made "perfect."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_15: I fed upon the trust, adoration, and longing heaped upon thee by the masses.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_123_16: Thy resonance brought forth the second Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_1: Wh-wh-what?! Those clashing frequencies just... calmed down?!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_3: Looks like Abby's settled down. It seems we were both affected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_5: I'm starting to remember everything, just like you sensed I would.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_6: The force that modulated the Sentinel and Threnodian's frequencies came from me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_7: Though it wasn't what I originally intended, I think having you take it from here may be for the best.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_9: This crown... it turned into what it is after the Dark Tide came.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_10: This is what the Threnodian uses to control Its Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_11: When the Threnodian unleashed the second Dark Tide, "I"—as the Cartethyia you see before you—split the part of myself that wished to live after seeing the corruption that stood before me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_12: I chose to be broken from the very beginning to escape the Threnodian's inevitable grasp.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_13: You see, when I destroyed the Threnodian that had taken over the Sentinel's body, It immediately began to assimilate into Fleurdelys, Its Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_14: She was the part of "me" that was left after I split myself. She retained the most power, and now hopes to one day destroy everything... even herself.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_15: The Threnodian's endless whispers and screeches are slowly chipping away at Fleurdelys' resolve.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_16: That's why she had no choice but to split her power's frequencies, just to buy herself more time.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_17: But using such Resonance abilities came at a cost. The split frequencies... they needed a vessel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_19: We don't have much time left.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_20: So, you see... I have been instinctively searching for someone to wield that power.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_21: All that was given, possessed, or taken by the false Divinity, I must pass to the one capable of resisting It.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_22: This is how I intend to lay the false Divinity to rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_23: Not just Its life, but Its very existence for all time.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_24: So you're saying that behind the last seal lies...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_25: Fleurdelys, the part of me I left behind. The one that also contains the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_26: Bound by obsession, till relieved of duty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_27: Today, the part of me that wishes to live on will vanish. Is it because my wish has finally been fulfilled?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_28: Will you accompany me one last time?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_125_1: Ah... seems like I won't get a chance to apologize to Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_1: Is there anything else you'd like to ask? I'll share with you all that I can remember.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_5: You don't need to stand so far away, you know.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_7: I take it you don't mean that in a good way?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_8: "It is a place where sickness, hunger, sorrow, despair, and dullness of heart cease to exist. There, deacons sing eternal hymns..."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_9: From a literal standpoint, this line describes the Dark Tide perfectly.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_10: In the beginning, the Dark Tide would claim only the areas it touched, assimilating all life as its vanguard to clear the way for its spread.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_11: The dead... they would grow mouths and sing hymns, day and night. They didn't need eyes or ears, for their purpose was to spread blindness and madness.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_12: Even those who did not believe were drawn irresistibly to the Leviathan's creed. And for those already deceived, it was all but inevitable.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_13: When a soul is corrupted to its core, it will sing hymns without end on its sleepless journey to merge with the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_14: And when every faithful soul has returned to "Paradise," the land consumed by the Dark Tide will begin its pilgrimage, drawn by darkened skies, spreading its "gospel" to wherever it lands next.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_15: The final act of the Dark Tide is.... the "Journeying Paradise."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_16: Is this the future you saw after coming into contact with the Dark Tide?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_18: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_19: That was its name before it became a Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_20: This seminary built on an island was not just a place of learning but also a sanctuary for raising dragon Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_22: The Order's scriptures, geography, history, and combat skills.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_23: Shouldn't a seminary focus more on cultural arts?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_24: This was a seminary reserved only for Resonators, so naturally, their talents were put to more practical use.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_25: Besides, the doctrine of Salvation emphasized the importance of combat.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_26: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_27: The Sword of Discord—Hognis, and the Sword of Virtue—Haultir...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_28: I can't remember anything else about Hognis.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_29: But as for Haultir, it was my former blade.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_30: How did it end up being one of the swords that can break the seal?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_31: Perhaps we'll know once we find it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_32: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_57_34: You should get some rest. We'll be counting on you again tomorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_1: Now what could you possibly want with me at a time like this?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_5: Cartethyia and I will take point again tomorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_6: Is it true that the Fisalia family was one of the factions that started the conflict in that stained glass?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_7: The leader of one such faction, to be exact.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_8: That was a long time ago. After their defeat, the union was disbanded under immense pressure, and the Fisalias gradually withdrew from the public eye.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_9: Is this why you had no choice but to publicly change your beliefs?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_10: No. The reasons for the Fisalia family relinquishing their pride and enduring disgrace are far more intricate than that.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_12: Long ago, Tyrvine was actually given to the Fisalia family by the first Primus, Napoli the Second.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_13: When the conflict had settled, he arranged a private meeting with the head of the family to reveal the truths behind the pilgrimage.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_14: He told the Fisalias that when he traveled through the first Dark Tide and reached its end, there was no sanctuary. Only a battlefield filled with darkness and suffering.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_15: The heavenly voices he heard were not revelations from the Divinity, but the seductive whispers of the Threnodian casting a lure for puppets to bite.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_16: As I told you before, Leviathan is a Threnodian who uses beliefs to spread a spiritual plague. You see, it requires a puppet to carry Its voice.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_17: The Sentinel realized the Threnodian's plots, and thus the first Dark Tide was launched as a hasty reaping of Ragunna and the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_18: To save Ragunna from the grim fate brought by the Dark Tide, the Sentinel split a portion of Their power and entrusted it to Napoli the Second.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_19: This power allowed him to imbue the Echoes with the strength to repel the Tacet Discords and purify the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_20: And this power was released through the lantern depicted in the stained glass?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_21: Yes. The other part was kept inside Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_22: It was in that very moment, when the Sentinel's power had been weakened, that the Threnodian corrupted and merged with Their body, transforming the Sentinel into the form you see today.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_23: If what you're saying is true... the first Primus should've been on Imperator's side.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_24: Did the spiritual plague you mentioned affect him?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_25: Although the Primus' body remained whole, his soul was torn apart, caught in the ceaseless struggle between the Threnodian and the Sentinel within the body they now shared.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_26: The Sentinel's power failed to shield the Primus from the Threnodian's influence. As the two Divinities vied for dominance, he... succumbed to many misdeeds against his own people.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_27: In the end, during that private meeting, he confessed the truth to the head of the Fisalias and begged for release.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_28: So that's why he passed so abruptly...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_29: The Fisalia family was powerless against the Order at that time. Our only recourse was to submit to their cause and keep the secret locked away in our hearts, waiting for the right moment to act.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_30: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_31: You were pretty harsh on Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_32: Before I learned of those records' secrets, I had only seen her from afar... heard tales of her accomplishments.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_33: While I would be willing to believe she stands with humanity.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_34: The more I allow myself to cling to such thoughts, the more I must strip them away and think rationally.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_35: It's only then that I can be certain these thoughts are my own and not the whispers I hear in the dark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_36: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_38: A trivial experiment. A test designed to find those with the strongest wills and force them into resonating with Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_39: Yet after trying for so long, all we got was the answer "The Maiden is dead."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_40: (I don't think she wants to continue this conversation. Better to stop pressing.)
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_41: There's something else I want to ask about.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_42: Hmm... And I don't intend to wait around either.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_43: Are you going to search those areas we passed before? Alone...?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_44: The more clues the better, don't you think？
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_47: Afraid I've slipped something extra in? Or perhaps you're contemplating dinner with me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_48: I'm just curious why the matriarch of the Fisalia family packs her own food.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_58_49: Food is always an easy target for those who find me less than... pleasing.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_2: You mean besides being squashed behind that blue thing? Yeah, I guess.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_3: Listen, I figured something out about that frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_5: It's not a single frequency. It's like it's mixed up with something else, or kinda like... a piece of a cookie that's been crumbled in with everything else.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_6: Which is why it's so hard to get a good bite!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_8: To see if it was a threat... I can now say with certainty that it isn't.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_9: But since it's a crumbly mess, other than taking up space, it's pretty useless.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_10: We might encounter something similar at the next two pedestals.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_11: Keep an eye on this for me, will you?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_12: Will do! You can count on me one hundred percent.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_60_1: I thought I'd slip away quietly and avoid any fuss. But now, here I am, dealing with all of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_60_2: Since you're all here, how about a morning stroll?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_61_1: They're a lot feistier than before.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_1: The way you were when you saw the Plushie Echo... it was... unexpected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_2: I think "The Martyrdom of Blessed Fleurdelys" needs a rewrite.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_4: A play about you written by Cristoforo the playwright.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_5: Oh, how did he portray me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_6: Ahem... "I would rather hear the joyous songs of the masses than any solemn hymn of remembrance. Perhaps the Sentinel feels the same."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_8: In the end, no matter what anyone else says...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_9: As long as you stay true to yourself, everything will be alright.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_10: Doesn't matter if it's the Threnodian or the Sentinel. They don't get to change who you are.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_98_1: What you said back there... Thank you.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_1: This was where everything started, the origin of the second Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_2: I have one final request. Now that you have the power to split and merge energy, there is something only you can do.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_3: Please... use the connection I still share with Fleurdelys to bring the last fragments of her tortured consciousness here.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_4: Then, with your power, remake us as one... and finally release us from this world.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_6: That way... the Threnodian will remain trapped forever in a lifeless shell, unable to return to this world.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_7: But doesn't that mean the end of the part of you that wishes to live?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_8: I have lived my life to the fullest. I would like the ones who are left to do so as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_9: Cartethyia has had her wish fulfilled. Now it's Fleurdelys' turn.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_10: She seeks self-destruction, to end the Divinity, and with it, her torment.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_11: She has lost all hope and believes that no rescue is possible.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_12: Remaking us as one is the only way I can think of to fulfill her wish... or rather, grant her what "we" wish.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_13: I was born to this world cursed. The Threnodian intended for me to live as a threat to others.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_14: But the puppet born of Its wickedness will become the prison that seals Its fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_15: "I" shall be whole again, true to myself at last.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_16: A fitting end, don't you think?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_17: I have reached my final destination. One last swan song, and then the lights go out!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_127_1: Ahhhhh... I can't hold it any longer...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_127_2: Why? Why are you doing this?! Neither Cartethyia nor Fleurdelys should continue to exist!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_127_5: But I prefer to handle this my way.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_1: Not even whole, yet still ever so determined.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_3: Phaom brought me here. I'd have shown myself earlier...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_4: But it didn't seem like the right time to interrupt.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_5: Looks like what I prepared could still be put to good use.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_7: The Sentinel's Sword. It will help you resist the Threnodian's attack.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_9: To pass the Divine Trials, every potential Maiden must resonate with the Sentinel through Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_10: Those who survive receive fragments of truth, but at a cost. Memories lost in varying degrees.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_11: The lost memories fall into this Sonoro Sphere, each carrying faint traces of the Sentinel's power. The power within those fragments of truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_13: The Sentinel's energy flows through you. You are more than worthy of wielding this sword.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_14: But you, Cartethyia... you alone must choose to wield it. Only then will it become the "Blessed Maiden's Sword."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_15: Does it also hold the sacrifice you made?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_16: No... My sacrifice was used up long ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_17: At the time I resonated with the Sentinel, I saw..."you" through Their distorted eyes.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_18: Or rather, I saw Fleurdelys battling the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_19: In that moment, I made a sacrifice that would shift the balance of power.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_21: The energy I received from the Sentinel's Second Awakening.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_22: I split it from myself and offered it back to the Sentinel so They could, for a moment, regain control of Their body.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_23: Only by doing this could Fleurdelys seize the moment to kill the already tainted Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_25: The real Blessed Maiden is dead.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_26: But there is no reason why the "false" Blessed Maiden cannot herself become the "true" Blessed Maiden, is there?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_27: A person of true character should never be defined by an inanimate blade.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_28: Both you and I were cursed to be mere playthings of the Threnodian, but that doesn't mean we cannot reshape our fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_29: Thank you... in spite of my curse, my life of hardship, I must still save what is true.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_30: Had you not stopped the second Dark Tide... Well, it is we who should be thanking you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_31: Huh... at least you can't accuse me of ingratitude... I just need a moment's rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_32: Apologies, but they're doing something rather important.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_129_2: Yep, I get it. We gonna yoink Leviathan out?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_129_4: But all you have left is the energy I ate before. Are you sure that's enough?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_129_5: Some things, you just gotta do.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_131_4: End me, or I will end you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_134_3: As long as I can save the person in front of me...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_134_7: I tried everything... How could this be...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_134_10: This warm light must not fade...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_134_11: Take my power, my blessings, my past. Seek out a future...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_134_12: Where I am your blade. We'll find it together.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_135_2: Seek out a future... where I am your blade. We'll find it together.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_1: Arbiter, forgive me for meeting thee in such a form.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_3: I safeguarded my core data, lest I be wholly assimilated.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_5: Arbiter, dost thou remember the covenant we made?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_7: Yes, I read the message left behind.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_9: Thou didst desire that I uncover the Threnodian's true nature. So I set forth a condition: that my root privileges be unbound, that I might act without restriction.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_10: With unrestricted access, you were going to...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_11: Merge with Leviathan, a measure of last resort. At the time, I had no other recourse.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_12: So I allowed it to believe it hadst prevailed.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_15: The Threnodian is a taint upon civilization. Only by partaking of Its blight could I seek to comprehend It.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_17: The Threnodian cannot be undone whilst civilization endureth. Even It knows not the means of Its own destruction.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_18: But we may yet shackle It.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_19: What role does Cartethyia play in this?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_20: When Leviathan merged with me, It breached my mind.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_21: I offered knowledge of the "Resonator," yet concealed one small truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_22: Beings such as we may bear but a single Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_23: The Threnodian used my return pod to conceive an entity known as "Fleurdelys," to make her Its Resonator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_24: After centuries of failure, by sheer trial it found success but once.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_25: We were of one body. Therefore, when Fleurdelys became Leviathan's Resonator, she also became mine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_26: But mark this well. To the Sentinel, a Resonator is an anchor; to the Threnodian, they are but a shackle.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_27: What made you decide to leave Tyrvine with the Fisalias?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_28: When first I did merge with the Threnodian, I sought only but to bide, awaiting a Resonator of steadfast will to join me in the war against the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_29: After Fleurdelys's conception, Cantarella became my safeguard.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_30: But had Fleurdelys fallen to the Threnodian's sway, as long as one mortal using Tyrvine passed the Second Awakening to become my own Resonator...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_31: Then the law that no being shall bear more than one Resonator at a time wouldst have been shattered.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_32: This wouldst rend asunder the frequencies of I, Imperator, Leviathan, and Fleurdelys in a tempest of chaos, and the Threnodian wouldst not escape destruction.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_33: Such was my intention... yet Cantarella chose another way.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_34: Not all journey toward a final destination. Some are destined to pave the way.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_35: Take my energy. I will find a way out myself.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_36: I trust this will serve to pave the way for you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_37: She forfeited all the power of the Second Awakening, surrendering it unto me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_38: With that newfound power, I did briefly regain control, and in that moment, compelled Fleurdelys to strike at my form as it was, corrupted by the Threnodian.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_39: But that wasn't your original plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_40: No... it was an unexpected variable.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_41: A plan I could not have conceived... or rather, a plan born of hope.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_42: Perhaps this is the influence humanity has wrought upon me... To change is to be free.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_43: Fleurdelys overcame the fate Leviathan ordained, and so too did Cantarella walk a path unscribed in my records.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_44: Though the journey was fraught with twists, we stand victorious.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_45: I don't know if the end justifies the means.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_47: ...I can't speak for what I wasn't a part of.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_48: You did what you could do in that moment. Anyone still standing because of it doesn't get to judge.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_49: Arbiter, in the few moments we have left, might I speak with Fleurdelys?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_50: Call her Cartethyia, that's what she wanted.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_51: How do you intend to bring her back?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_52: Remnants of her frequency linger within thy Tacet Mark. So long as a conduit is established, her frequency shall be reborn into her body.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_53: What do I use as a conduit?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_55: This dying breeze hath little time left. Let it guide her on its final journey.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_57: Did I fulfill the charge set upon me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_60: Arbiter, take these words to the Fisalias. "From this day forth. You are free."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_3: I am Imperator, a being that owes you a great debt. I... have a question I wish to ask thee.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_4: Dost thou rage at how life has unfolded? Dost thou renounce faith or hold resentment?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_5: If thou wishes to forget, I can erase the past from thy memory.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_6: ...Such memories do bring me pain, but... that is evidence of their truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_7: Without the truth, I would not have had to strength to carry on.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_8: The truth is a beacon in the maelstrom of my life.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_9: And I would rather suffer for it and rejoice in it than abandon it to blissful ignorance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_10: I am true to myself. Please don't make me forget who I am.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_12: If "I" go, you will be one step closer to perfection.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_13: No... if you do that, "I" wouldn't be "me."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_14: To deny my own self and my experiences means any perfection I reach will be hollow.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_16: Thou hast need of Divinity no longer.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_17: Though my power hath waned, I now offer thee my blessings.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_18: Let the winds of the past depart. The ships of this new era no longer need their guidance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_19: Though the tide's rage is endless, humanity shall yet embark upon new voyages.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_20: No longer shall scroll and prophecy bind, but by thy will shall forge a new era.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_21: Cartethyia, thou art worthy to bear the title of Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_2: I have never seen you look as gentle as you did during our fight.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_3: Let me ask you this one more time. Should I call you Cartethyia or Fleurdelys?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_4: I want to say that it doesn't matter...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_5: But... since you first met me as Cartethyia, that is who I shall be.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_7: I thought I saw the Sentinel just now...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_9: They accepted you as Their Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_12: I can't return to Ragunna as Fleurdelys, and I need not serve Divinity anymore.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_13: Who I was, and my past aspirations, are all gone. I feel... empty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_14: You can always visit whomever you want.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_15: You can always eat whatever you want.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_16: You can always go wherever you want.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_17: You don't have to do anything for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_19: But right now... I don't want to think about anything...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_21: But right now... I don't want to think about anything...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_23: But right now... I don't want to think about anything...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_25: I'll stay here for a while longer, is that alright?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_1: {PlayerName}, please keep what happened between us.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_7: No. Please do as I ask!
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_8: I know what I want to do now.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_13: You could defy my wishes, ignore my pleas, defeat me, and in the end save me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_14: But... if one day you find yourself in a similar predicament to mine. Who's going to save you?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_15: Your bond with the Sentinel is now a bond with me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_16: You were Their "Arbiter," and They were your helper. But I want to go beyond that.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_17: I want to be more than someone who works on trifles like harmonizing the frequencies between you and Abby.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_18: Hey, I'm more than a trifle! Uh, wait- didn't realize you're the reason I stopped feeling icky...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_19: Should the day come when you find yourself in a similar predicament to mine...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_20: I'd need to defy your wishes, ignore your pleas, defeat you, and be your savior.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_21: You speak as if I were a villain.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_22: Hm... If that were to ever happen, wouldn't I need greater power to set you right?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_23: Just like how you set me right. Would you deny me the chance to return the favor?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_24: I'm not that easy to surpass.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_25: Bold words from someone I handily beat.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_26: When that day comes, I'll be counting on you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_27: Then I shall not rest until I have surpassed you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_28: Careful now, your provocations work far too well on me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_29: Since I swore to be your blade, it follows that I must hone myself to a keen edge.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_30: Right now, you're less a Blessed Maiden and more a steely knight.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_31: Well, my one creed is to be true to myself. In that sense...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_33: A knight... Yes, perhaps I'll be a knight errant, that does sound appealing.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_34: But... truthfully, so much of this world feels unfamiliar to me now. Will you be there to guide me, should I need it?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_36: One minute you want to fight, the next you're asking for help?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_38: Sigh... I'll find my own way then.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_39: One last thing, you should speak with Cantarella. I can sense she made it out of Sonoro Sphere, safely.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_4: Hehe... I shouldn't put my guest on the spot. Moving on...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_7: Understandable. Her transition back to mortal life is a drastic departure from her former existence.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_8: Now, I suppose I should thank you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_10: Bloodpact's Pledge. A symbol of the unbreakable pact between you and the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_11: Each head of the family is entitled to one and only one.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_12: You vanquished the Threnodian and brought peace at last to the Fisalias. You should have it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_13: Consider this a token of gratitude.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_15: You wish for more? Or is there something else you'd have me do?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_17: I want you to make peace with the Montellis.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_19: You ask that I step down? Only a Fisalia by blood is eligible to head the family. But, I could make you a Fisalia consort.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_20: {Male=Sounds like a raw deal.;Female=But I'm a strong independent woman.}
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_21: {Male=Is that a proposal?;Female=And also quite adaptable, I'm sure.}
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_24: Or I was wise enough to avoid it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_25: Oh? {PlayerName}, do you intend to mediate between the two families?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_26: Any deadly feud I should know about?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_27: Tiresome feuds rarely last between two formidable houses.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_28: But alas, there is only so much light. Some branches greedily reach for more than they need, and the forgotten are doomed to wither in the dark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_29: Disagreements lie not only between families, but also within them.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_30: Sounds worse than a Calamity Class Tacet Discord...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_31: How fortunate, I now find myself with time to fix things.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_32: If you're interested, I'd gladly teach you how to "care" for a family such as ours.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_33: Though, of course, I may change my mind at any moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_34: So, you'd do well to visit often.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_35: Before I forget, Imperator left a message.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_37: "From this day forth. You are free."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_40: I've spent so long preparing for this day. A few more will hardly make a difference.
MapMark_150001_MarkDesc: Among the prized treasures of the Montelli family is a morph painting depicting Hadrian, the legendary gladiator, with his blade drawn. In Ragunna, these paintings have the special power to pull anyone who touches them into the sphere within, allowing them to experience it as though it were real.
MapMark_150002_MarkDesc: At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.
MapMark_150003_MarkDesc: To be a true performer, one must first learn how to listen. Give your records, sheet music, or any musical medium to the Aria Mummer. Don't be alarmed when it swallows and chews these items—it's simply its way of "listening" to the music.
MapMark_150004_MarkDesc:
Passersby are often drawn to the delicate hands reaching out from the Averardo Bank. These hands are perfectly adorned, always gesturing with elegance and grace...
Though their owner is just an Echo teller.
MapMark_150005_MarkDesc: Once a lonely Echo drifting through the seas, Lario has spent years without a companion until it joined the Troupe of Fools. All people know about it is its genus—Pliosaurus Somnii. Though the troupe has sailed across many waters near Rinascita, they have yet to encounter another like it.
MapMark_150006_MarkDesc: C-MOSS, the camera Echo owned by the Pioneer Association's Ragunna branch, acts with all the fine manners of an old gentleman. He captures moments in time with care, often sipping a cup of developer solution between shots.
MapMark_150007_MarkDesc: Before they fall into slumber, the Farceur's Faces of the Masked Reverie fill Ragunna's days and nights with their playful banter. As the shop's iconic mascots, they've garnered their fair share of noise complaints.
MapMark_150008_MarkDesc: An Echo boat that quietly glides through Ragunna's canals, offering a safe and silent voyage to all who hop on it, often known as the Water Bus.
MapMark_150009_MarkDesc: Once, when the Dark Tide ravaged the city and Tacet Fields spread like a plague, Signor Octopus's duty was to sound the alarms. Those days are like a distant dream now, yet he still announces the hour with a gentle horn, guarding the city's peace with quiet dedication.
MapMark_150010_MarkDesc: An Echo lantern that belongs to the Order of the Deep, serving as the Order's watchful eyes to monitor the people of Ragunna.
MapMark_150011_MarkDesc: Originally transformed from discarded dolls, these plushie Echoes have evolved to feel delicate human emotions. For them, these emotions are delicious frequencies to be savored with relish.
MapMark_150012_MarkDesc: Spotted throughout Ragunna's streets, the Tubpups are lively Echoes that serve as faithful companions. Whether they are playing with children, carrying art supplies, or working as handy baskets, they bring joy and energy wherever they go.
HelpText_173_Content:
[About]
After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms.
The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember.
This is a Permanent Event. Complete event quests to earn rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock

[Event Rules]
Complete event tasks to earn Stamps, which can be used to increase your Event Level. Advancing to higher levels unlocks rich rewards and the Amidst the Sea of Clouds challenges.
Please note that some event quests are unavailable in Co-op Mode, and the quest-tracking feature may be disabled in certain game scenarios.

HelpText_183_Content:
[About]

Maji, your good old friend, is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan." As always, your support is greatly appreciated. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

Event Rules

MapMark_390201_MarkDesc: A ruthless knight who wreaks havoc in the east of Mistveil Bay, feared for its mercilessness toward foes. But who stands beside this savage figure?
MapMark_390202_MarkDesc: A mysterious knight often spotted near the cabin by the windmill, driven by a desire to hoard every treasure in the world in its hidden chest.
MapMark_390207_MarkDesc: A special Echo challenge located in Thessaleo Fells. Some report dreaming while participating, while others dismiss it as mere hallucinations.
MapMark_390210_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
As twilight falls, all things seek their return.
Something tells you that an indescribable being is waiting ahead, anticipating the arrival of ships, people, and the sun's descent upon the shore. It is waiting for a world where light fades and silence reigns. And then, it will step into the darkness, swallowing all in its path.
MapMark_390211_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
Where do the schools of fish swim?  Over the towers, into the silent night sky above...
MapMark_390212_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
Go to the tower... The descendants of Fisalia turn around and leave their resolute figures behind—they will fulfill their destined purpose.
MapMark_390213_MarkDesc: "The unfortuante knight left the expedition. Five knights remained."
MapMark_390214_MarkDesc: "The cowardly knight lost his sanity. Four knights remained."
MapMark_390215_MarkDesc: "The righteous knight fulfilled their justice. Three knights remained."
MapMark_390216_MarkDesc: "The greedy knight uncovered the truth. And then, there were no knights left."
MapMark_390217_MarkDesc: Debris of a long-destroyed Lumiscale Construct. A closer inspection might reveal some hidden clues.
MapMark_390218_MarkDesc: Altars scattered across the Shores of Last Breath. Activating all of them might unlock a gateway to an unknown destination.
MapMark_390219_MarkDesc: Legend tells of Sentinel Imperator's descent upon this site, vanishing into the clouds. Now, another presence claims dominion over this place...
ExploreProgress_12_Desc_Text: Adjust the blocks to a single color to restore the scenery to its former glory.
ExploreProgress_13_Desc_Text:
Areas rich in Supply Chests can be found throughout Rinascita.
Use the Sensor to locate them.
ExploreProgress_14_Desc_Text: Link the Dreamscape Nodes for the Somnoire and complete challenges to collect Dreamscape Samples for rewards.
ExploreProgress_15_Desc_Text: Meet the three Fratelli brothers traveling across Ragunna. Help them grow stronger and resolve their troubles.
ExploreProgress_16_Desc_Text: In Tactical Hologram: Vitreum Dancer, you will face waves of Vitreum Dancers charging at you. Dodge their attacks within the time limit to complete the challenge.
ExploreProgress_17_Desc_Text:
A remnant creature with an intense obsession with music. When struck, it drops the Melody Boxe it has collected.
Deliver the Melody Box to the Aria Mummer to add the corresponding track to your collection.
ExploreProgress_18_Desc_Text: The extremely powerful Tacet Discords that lurk within Dreamscape Nodes, composed by the frequencies of a specific negative emotion.
ExploreProgress_19_Desc_Text:
In the time when knights were more than mere legends, a team of Fisalia knights ventured in secret to Penitent's End to seek the rumored holy relic hidden by the Order... Yet now, only their lingering shadows whisper ancient oaths.

Remember, shadows cannot hide when the light of fire falls upon them.
ExploreProgress_20_Desc_Text: The swords symbolizing the Five Knightly Virtues were stolen, and the truth was buried beneath layers of legend. What slumbers at the bottom of the lake? The Silver Moon, or the Crimson Moon?
ExploreProgress_21_Desc_Text: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia scions are bound to three towering spires.
ExploreProgress_22_Desc_Text: A special Echo challenge located in Thessaleo Fells. Some report dreaming during the challenge, while others dismiss it as mere hallucination.
ExploreProgress_23_Desc_Text:
The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.
Use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
ExploreProgress_24_Desc_Text: The Shores of Last Breath have been ravaged by storms. According to the Order, this is, in itself, a special trial...
ExploreProgress_25_Desc_Text: Within this sacred highcourt, a faint, almost imperceptible sound lingers. Perhaps something lies imprisoned deep within.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_1: (Terminal Communication) Yes, yes, user experience has always been the cornerstone of Lollo Logistics, and it's fundamental to our survival.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_2: I understand what you mean. You want us to maintain quality while shortening the update cycle for each event to enhance user experience, but the cost... Oh, right, Man-Made Arctic...?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_3: Sure thing, absolutely! Your request is my mission! I'll make sure everything's set, and I look forward to you personally guiding us!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_4: I'm sorry, I was just on a call with my boss. So, old friend, did you miss me?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_7: Did the boss send me new tasks through you again?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_8: Of course, Lollo Stamps, my old buddy, I've missed you like crazy!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_9: Why are you suddenly speaking with a foreign accent? And hey, are you thinking about me or what?!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_10: Sure, I won't let you work for nothing.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_11: What are you talking about? In all of Solaris, you're the most dependable one. Only I, Maji, could find someone as reliable as you.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_12: Since we last met, I submitted a new proposal, and they've finally agreed to let me handle part of the event activities!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_13: I was thinking of using a completely new strategy for the event. Pretty bold, huh?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_14: The entire event is brand new, completely different from the last one. It's a fresh Lollo promotional campaign with an all-new approach.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_15: Let's identify new hooks—not by breaking through user pain points, but by creating new ones for them!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_16: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_21: Sure, it's just like last year, except we swap out some buzzwords on the slides to make them look impressive for the bosses.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_23: Why are you looking at me like that? I have to report, you know. Besides, I've just been transferred to headquarters — I still need to put food on the table, right?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_24: However, I've initiated an optimization plan for the entire Lollo Stamps exchange feature, making it easier to acquire Lollo Stamps without having to detour through the finance department for approvals.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_28: Ahaha, but for now, I'm personally covering the expenses brought by the Lollo Stamps after the update... Anyway! I'll clearly list all the help you need on the panel, so you can directly claim the Lollo Stamps from the Feature when the time comes.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_29: I've got the rest in your hands, {PlayerName}!

NPC_JKWW_1_1: Wow, even the clouds here are golden, just like...
NPC_JKWW_1_3: Keep it down, will you? You're ruining the mood with all that chatter.
NPC_JKWW_10_1: Septimont is importing large quantities of Ragunna spices and alabaster. It seems we've chosen the perfect time to enter the market.
NPC_JKWW_10_2: Lucky for us, the Order relaxed trade restrictions around the Carnevale. Without that, this deal might've been a gamble.
NPC_JKWW_10_3: Who knows how long these good days will last...
NPC_JKWW_11_1: Hello, are you here to do business with the Montelli family as well?
NPC_JKWW_11_3: I'm actually a member of the family.
NPC_JKWW_11_4: The Montelli are sharp with coin, but they honor their word. Good business partners, if you can trust them.
NPC_JKWW_11_5: Is that so? Guess that means you're a high rank. Most of the staff are stuck in those drab uniforms.
NPC_JKWW_11_6: We're brothers traveling between Ragunna and Septimont. We deal in commodities, art auctions, and, of course, high-stakes competitions.
NPC_JKWW_11_7: Perhaps one day, we'll find ourselves working together on a venture.
NPC_JKWW_12_1: Well, I'll be! A golden fountain... This place is practically drowning in riches!
NPC_JKWW_12_2: What happens if you throw a coin in and make a wish, I wonder?
NPC_JKWW_12_3: Oh, that's easy. You'll end up being carted off to pay a fine.
NPC_JKWW_13_1: Hey, what's that in the sky?
NPC_JKWW_13_2: It's stunning, like a pair of glowing wings...
NPC_JKWW_13_3: Quick, snap a shot! Might be worth sending to Wutherium Film Studio!
NPC_JKWW_14_1: There are perks to working the front desk, like sneaking out for a bit of fresh air now and then.
NPC_JKWW_14_2: Everything really alright? Your schedule looks packed with tasks.
NPC_JKWW_14_3: Work's still work, no matter how you stretch it. Only the moments when you slack off truly belong to you.
NPC_JKWW_14_4: I really envy your laid-back attitude.
NPC_JKWW_2_1: Ah, my friend, come to admire the sunset too? This kind of beauty doesn't come around often.
NPC_JKWW_3_1: Tsk, why aren't they here yet? That man has no concept of time.
NPC_JKWW_4_1: Ugh, I'm late. Black Alley business. I got held up.
NPC_JKWW_4_2: What happened? Don't say our home got raided.
NPC_JKWW_4_3: Eh, just a few young bucks fighting, didn't know when to quit. Almost turned into a bloodbath.
NPC_JKWW_4_4: On to more serious matters. Find anything useful while you were staking out Montelli's turf?
NPC_JKWW_4_5: Shh, quiet down... do you want someone overhearing us?
NPC_JKWW_5_1: ...The "prime goods" we've been after? Yeah, the Montellis got their hands on them. They're locked up in the Vault now.
NPC_JKWW_5_2: Hmph, used to do side jobs for them. Not even a scrap of respect now.
NPC_JKWW_5_3: What are you all talking about?
NPC_JKWW_5_4: I'm sorry, {Male=sir;Female=ma'am}, we were just discussing the collection auction here.
NPC_JKWW_5_5: Averardo Vault at night truly has a charm of its own, doesn't it?
NPC_JKWW_6_1: These stairs just keep going, don't they?
NPC_JKWW_7_1: Did you notice the grand building at the top of the stairs? Many see it as a symbol of a new age.
NPC_JKWW_7_2: Are you here for business as well?
NPC_JKWW_7_3: Of course, I have a rather significant collection item to store—
NPC_JKWW_7_4: Only here could I escape those insufferable Acolytes, the pestering editors, and those gatherings of writers full of the same tired clichés.
NPC_JKWW_8_1: Recent security reports came in. We need to tighten vigilance.
NPC_JKWW_9_1: Is someone really targeting this place? This is supposed to be the safest spot in all of Rinascita.
NPC_JKWW_9_2: You're new here, so you might not know, but "breaking into the Vault successfully" is something some folks can brag about for a lifetime.

Character_Rococo_57_11:
You venture into the cavern, and Roccia—who is usually calm—shows fear of the dark. With you by her side, she steadies herself. 
Inside, the cavern opens into a wide space where a group of Plushie Echoes are busy at work. 
Could this so-called "Demon King" really just be a bunch of Plushies?
Character_Rococo_59_4: The Plushies are defeated, but they seem to have something they want to say.
Character_Rococo_60_23:
It turns out the Plushies are abandoned Echoes, and all they want is to reunite with their owners. 
Even after reaching this desolate island, the Plushies couldn’t find their owners. 
Instead, they take comfort in the emotional frequencies lingering on objects and begin piecing together "homes" from these fragments of memory. That’s how they discovered the "star." 
Roccia believes both people and Echoes need a place to return to. You offer to bring the Plushies back to the Fool's Troupe with you.
Character_Rococo_61_13:
Lottie Lost’s owner used to sing "Pegasus" to inspire those who suffered injustice, and Lottie learned it too. 
The maze you encountered earlier was their attempt to recreate scenes from the play, blending the foggy seaside environment with its imagery.
Event_QDLS_1_1: A pizza oven... You mean all of Trattoria Margherita's pizzas are made inside of this Echo?
Event_QDLS_5_1: A peculiar canine Echo that frequent the streets of Ragunna City. Often used by people as a storage box...
Event_QDLS_4_1: It gazes towards the horizon in silence, waiting to blow the horn right on the hour.
Event_QDLS_3_1: A gentle Gondola Echo. It seems to be in a good mood...
Event_QDLS_2_1: The Masked Reverie's signboard features a pair of masks... Are they really singing?

ExploreProgress_1_Desc_Text:
Resonance Beacons record data from their surrounding area and transmit it to the Resonance Nexus for analysis.
You can fast travel to any activated Resonance Beacon, where injured or downed Resonators will be restored.
ExploreProgress_2_Desc_Text: Discover Supply Chests hidden in the far corners of Solaris. Solve puzzles or battle foes to claim your rewards.
ExploreProgress_3_Desc_Text: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past. If you are lucky enough to discover one, the Relic Merchant will gladly trade valuable items for it.
ExploreProgress_4_Desc_Text:
As you explore Solaris, memorable sceneries await at every turn.
Look for Viewpoints near these landscapes to immortalize these precious moments.
ExploreProgress_6_Desc_Text: A type of mysterious Tacet Discord that shows a peculiar interest in human items. They can be found across the world. Unexpected rewards often await where they linger.
ExploreProgress_8_Desc_Text:
Certain special quests can only be triggered upon reaching the designated area.
Explore every inch of Solaris to uncover its hidden secrets.
ExploreProgress_9_Desc_Text:
Windchimers are scattered across Mt. Firmament and can be collected by striking them.
It seems there is an individual with a keen interest in these. Gather Windchimers to exchange them for valuable resources.
ExploreProgress_10_Desc_Text:
A special creature that huddles underground to protect itself when threatened.
Keep your distance to uncover its weaknesses.
ExploreProgress_11_Desc_Text: The testing grounds for tactical research and development, where powerful Tacet Discords are deployed in a controlled environment.

HelpText_185_Content:
1. The fishers of the Riccioli Islands follow a strict tradition of working from sunrise to sunset, believing the night belongs to Cetus the Tidebreaker, who guides lost souls back home.

2. While sailing in certain waters around the Riccioli Islands at night, Rachel's Threat Level will rise. Once it reaches a critical point, Ghost Medusas will emerge and attack. Stay alert and avoid their strikes!

3. The riskier the waters, the greater the rewards. Fish caught in areas where Ghost Medusas appear tend to be of higher quality.

4. Some special species only appear at night. Check the Index for details.

5. Night on the Riccioli Islands spans from 19:00 to 5:00.
HelpText_186_Content:
1. As a Gondola Echo, Rachel takes damage upon bumping into hazards on the sea. Steer clear of Bampuffs, Tornadoes, and Ghost Medusas while navigating the waters.

2. Rachel's Durability decreases when damaged. If it reaches zero, it will automatically return to the dock, and all collected catches will be lost.

3. To ensure a safer and more successful voyage, you can use Riccioli Fishery Coins to restore Rachel's Durability before weighing anchor at the dock. Keep a close watch on its Durability to avoid unnecessary losses.

DYHDST_1_1: Are you curious about this old ship too? Hmm, seems like I'm not the only one who thinks there's something wrong with it.
DYHDST_1_2: See, we've always fished close to shore, that's why we Riccioli fishermen use Gondolas when we head out.
DYHDST_1_3: But word is, years ago Captain Ahab and his crew pulled out a wreck of a ship outta the sea, then left it with a strange fella to guard it.
DYHDST_1_4: That's not so strange, is it?
DYHDST_1_5: You think that's it? Now, don't go getting all scared on me... This ship... it's a ghost ship!
DYHDST_1_7: There's a fella, Queequeg's his name, who's always mumbling something to the ship. And the damn wreck... it answers him! Mentions a "Flask" an awful lot...
DYHDST_1_8: Eh, enough of this! I'm not saying a word more. Get going, quick!
DYHDST_1_9: Otherwise, that crazy ol' bastard is gonna be back any minute, mark my words!
DYHDST_10_4: What, Airsailer stew again? We've eaten that for the last week!
DYHDST_10_5: You think of something then! That's all you've been catching lately anyway.
DYHDST_10_6: Eugh, can we try something else, please?
DYHDST_11_1: Ah... I know you! Heard about you from Mr. Fulmine some time ago.
DYHDST_11_2: Didn't think I'd find you out here in the Riccioli Islands, though. Came for a bit of a break?
DYHDST_11_3: I'm here to become a fishing expert.
DYHDST_11_5: This place is perfect for that, I'll give you that.
DYHDST_11_6: You must've run into my colleague, Clemont, then? He's been wandering the islands digging into the local history.
DYHDST_11_7: There are secrets buried here, ones even the ruins of Ragunna City have no record of. Secrets about the Sentinel and that Cetus the Tidebreaker…
DYHDST_11_8: Those lighthouses are the key to unlocking them, no doubt. Shame, though, the fishermen won't take us to the other two islands.
DYHDST_11_9: There's a legend... Say, ever seen Cetus the Tidebreaker? The creature has three gem-like holes on its back.
DYHDST_11_10: They say it wasn't always like that. No, it was a crew of sailors chasing it down who left those three marks on its hide.
DYHDST_11_11: Can you imagine… what kind of men would have the strength to leave such scars on a creature like that?
DYHDST_12_1: Fresh octopus clams! Just pulled from the water!
DYHDST_12_2: Care for a taste, hungry traveler?
DYHDST_12_4: Absolutely fresh! Look at this one's siphons, still glistening with seawater!
DYHDST_12_5: Just pop them open with a knife, squeeze on some lemon, and you're all set!
DYHDST_12_7: Oh, they're delicious, you've got to try them!
DYHDST_12_8: If you're interested in buying, I've got the freshest stock around, no doubt about it.
DYHDST_13_4: (The old man stands dazed, staring at the sea as if he can't hear you.)
DYHDST_13_8: (The old man mumbles the ship's name again, but it seems continuing the conversation won't lead anywhere.)
DYHDST_2_2: Got something else to make a fuss about?
DYHDST_2_3: My old man used to tell me that Queequeg had been working on this ship for years, fixin' it up with nary a single change!
DYHDST_2_4: Now, all of a sudden, the mast is fixed and soon the canvas will be patched up too!
DYHDST_2_5: I helped him with the repairs!
DYHDST_2_7: Oh, it was you? Well, that's a bit odd, isn't it?
DYHDST_2_8: That fella's been at it for as long as anyone could remember, never seemed to age a day. The ship never got any better either... So what are you, some kind of magician?
DYHDST_3_1: This ship's huge, isn't it? But, something about it feels familiar.
DYHDST_3_2: It reminds me of the Fool's Sail...
DYHDST_3_3: Yes! That's it, it looks like the Fool's Sails used by the Order!
DYHDST_3_4: I wonder what this ship looked like before. With all the new parts patched on, and its new shape, can it still be called the same ship?
DYHDST_3_5: Speaking of, do you know how to sail this thing?
DYHDST_3_6: It's too big, I don't think I could.
DYHDST_3_7: I know someone who could sail her out of here.
DYHDST_3_8: Imagine sailing a ship of this size... You'd look mighty impressive out there.
DYHDST_3_9: Abyssal sea serpents, hell, even a big ol' whale would be a walk in the park.
DYHDST_3_10: Maybe that's what it was made for in the first place.
DYHDST_3_11: You can take Cetus the Tidebreaker off that trophy list.
DYHDST_3_12: Sure, but even though boarding the Fool's Sail isn't exactly something to celebrate... I'd still love to give it a try. Never been anywhere beyond the Stormy Sea myself...
DYHDST_4_2: I heard the news. The ship has ended up broken again, right?
DYHDST_4_3: Ahab has disappeared, and even that Queequeg who's always fixing the ship is nowhere to be found.
DYHDST_4_4: Funny. Kind of miss him now...
DYHDST_5_1: Take that wretched pile of fish away! The mere sight of it flopping about makes my skin crawl!
DYHDST_5_2: Tsk, bothersome city folk… Beggin' your pardon, miss, but do step aside, would ya?
DYHDST_5_3: You think this dress is cheap? The cost of cleaning it would buy every one of your... fish.
DYHDST_5_4: Cheap? That fine mesh is perfect—for catching minnows. Scrap cloth, really.
DYHDST_5_6: Best you stay away from this place, missy. Don't wanna get fish guts all over your fancy dress. And who knows, a shark might just decide to take a bite on your way back.
DYHDST_5_8: Big mouth like the doors to your Vault, teeth sharper than knives. One bite, and it could swallow four whole men...
DYHDST_5_10: Eh, might be. Hard to say.
DYHDST_5_11: Seems like we get a lotta pampered city folk wanderin' in here, thinkin' this is some kinda vacation spot.
DYHDST_5_12: Look at ya. Can't lift a finger for nothin'. Never had to break a sweat or pull a fish out of the water, have ya?
DYHDST_6_1: I'll need thirty Pricklecrab, thirty Bell-less Crabs, a crate of Legilimens Shrimp, and three Sunfish, alive. I'll go with you to the boat to pick them up.
DYHDST_6_2: By the way, got any Stygian Phantom?
DYHDST_6_3: What? All I've got to eat are a few Fried Egg Jellyfish. Why would you want one of those? They're deadly, aren't they?
DYHDST_6_4: Don't ask. The lady of the house is expecting a special guest, and that's what they fancy.
DYHDST_6_5: I'll check with Old Hart. He's been fishing further out lately. He should have some.
DYHDST_6_6: You're talking about that Feshalia family, right? I've heard rumors they're a strange lot. Only eat poisonous things.
DYHDST_6_7: It's the Fisalia family. I'm just a cook, don't know much more. If someone dies eating one of thoseStygian Phantom-what-have-yous, it's not my problem!
DYHDST_6_8: So, you still want the Fried Egg Jellyfish then?
DYHDST_6_10: They don't know how to enjoy a proper Tomato "Egg" Stir-fry... I'll make the most of it myself.
DYHDST_7_1: You're telling me... this lighthouse existed even before the founding of Ragunna?
DYHDST_7_3: I said... this very lighthouse, it was here before Ragunna was even a thought, right?
DYHDST_7_5: They say Imperator built these lighthouses as part of some grand plan, something They laid out long before.
DYHDST_7_6: The tale has been passed down through the ages. My great-grandfather spoke of it, too.
DYHDST_7_7: That would make it older than the Order of the Deep.
DYHDST_7_8: Well, if it's really true, it would make this place an archaeological treasure trove.
DYHDST_7_9: Stove? You looking to roast some fish? Head to the market, you'll find it there, easy enough.
DYHDST_7_10: Ah, it seems your hearing is a bit...
DYHDST_7_11: It's quite alright, old sir! Thank you! Have a nice day!
DYHDST_7_12: Aye, sure, you're welcome, kid. If you're serious about diggin' up stories, head on over to Helm Village. Those old codgers are no younger than me. They'll have stories to share.
DYHDST_8_1: Don't let it get to you. We'll have the ship fixed and give it another try.
DYHDST_8_2: Not every venture at sea ends with a catch, after all…
DYHDST_8_3: But I'm out of coin. I can't keep going to the guild for help.
DYHDST_8_4: The sails, the nets, even the Gondola—all of it costs.
DYHDST_8_5: Why not ask Plank for some help?
DYHDST_8_6: You've got to find some way to make a living, one way or another.
DYHDST_9_1: Why do they all hold Captain Ahab in such reverence? I've never even seen him sail before.
DYHDST_9_2: You don't know? He's not from Rinascita. They say he was once the most renowned captain across the four seas.
DYHDST_9_3: I heard that when he scolded his crew, even the fiercest storms would part for him.
DYHDST_9_4: Is he really that fearsome? Then why does he still have so many people's respect?
DYHDST_9_5: Well, you don't earn your stripes as a captain by being soft with the crew.
DYHDST_9_6: If Gulpuffs had less of a temper, they'd all be eaten into extinction by now.
DYHDST_9_8: It's a metaphor, you fool! A metaphor!
