HelpText_187_Content:
[About]

Beside a mysterious morph painting, you find a painter named Claudia, trapped in her nightmares. 
Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22, unlock Co-op mode, and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during Main Quest "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]

Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman. Within the painted world, the talisman transforms into various Echoes to assist you.
Clear all enemies in the investigation area to advance. The Echoes transformed by the talisman will boost your Resonators' power as you progress.
Clearing enemies before the countdown ends earns extra points. Reach the required stage points for Stage Rewards and the required total points for Point Rewards. The Match feature is available for all challenges, allowing you to team up with other players.

※Only specified Echoes can be equipped in this event. The Echo will replace your main Echo Skill, but activated Sonatas remain effective.

YYYHZG_23_1: Verse 9, Chapter 9 of the Tenets reminds us, "Seek out the truth, for all that is good, the Sentinel shall grant unto you, and all that is beautiful, the Sentinel shall embrace."
YYYHZG_23_2: Stranger, this beautiful song belongs to you, too. Have a good time at the Carnevale!
YYYHZG_24_1: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! What a surprise to see you again so soon!
YYYHZG_24_2: Is this little pavilion the Minor Forbidden Archive?
YYYHZG_24_3: Haha, you always have such a way with words. The Minor Forbidden Archive is underground, you won't see views like this down there. No, I'm actually at the Tidal Sanctuary to finalize my transfer.
YYYHZG_24_4: You're leaving the Minor Forbidden Archive?
YYYHZG_24_6: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, I owe you an apology for how I acted that day... I was stubborn.
YYYHZG_24_7: Rinascita's civilization was planted by our ancestors, and the Order is just one of its many fruits. I shouldn't have been frightened by the ancient music; I should've been delighted!
YYYHZG_24_8: In that moment, I felt the spirit of my ancestors resonate within me, didn't I?
YYYHZG_24_10: I'm glad you've found some peace within yourself.
YYYHZG_24_11: Do the Tenets permit you to speak so freely?
YYYHZG_24_13: Of course it's... Ahem! {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, let's keep this conversation our little secret!
YYYHZG_24_15: Maybe I'll go find Phoebe. She hasn't visited in some time, and I wonder what she's busy with.
YYYHZG_24_16: Or perhaps I should go further… to the Montelli vault, or even to the Septimont? Hmm, I suppose I wouldn't need to wear my uniform...
YYYHZG_24_18: I say you should go wherever you like.
YYYHZG_24_19: I say you should meet the people you want to meet.
YYYHZG_24_20: Ah, I aspire to have your confidence one day!
YYYHZG_24_21: "True faith is born from the heart, and Sentinel's guidance speaks through my voice." From the bottom of my heart, I thank you for your help, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}.
YYYHZG_24_22: Which chapter of the Tenets is that from?
YYYHZG_24_23: Hahaha! I said that. I am quoting myself!
YYYHZG_25_1: That must be the spot Lenore said the record would be. What are the Vitreum Dancers doing over there?
YYYHZG_26_1: More of those white phantoms... and Vitreum Dancers.
YYYHZG_26_2: I, I... I'll go find a place to hide!
YYYHZG_27_1: Is that a musical note from the Chorale? {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, let's follow it!
YYYHZG_28_1: I never imagined it would lead us here. Twenty years ago, during the Dark Tide, the kind old Acolyte who took me in brought me to this place—our final refuge. But he returned to the seminary alone and never came back.
YYYHZG_28_2: Still… now is not the time to dwell on the past. Let's press on!
YYYHZG_29_1: Huff… How much longer must we keep chasing… Huff... Sitting in the basement every day doesn't exactly prepare one for such exertion.
YYYHZG_29_2: {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}, Huff… Please, go ahead. I'll catch up soon!
YYYHZG_30_1: To question the Sentinel in such melodies of blasphemy... A history of insurrection and blind folly... They must be destroyed.
YYYHZG_31_1: What am I supposed to do…? This feeling within me…
YYYHZG_31_2: I want to listen to the Chorale again… just a few more times…
YYYHZG_32_1: If you seek repent and forgiveness, know this, only during a night filled with "Starlight” can you meet <ano=Queen of the Night>Lorelei</ano>.
YYYHZG_33_1: You patiently wait, as night draws near...
Mail_400010_Content:
Dear Rover,

Dances For Spring's Return is about to end. Don't hesitate to join in and claim your event rewards. Thank you for your support! 

Please note that Sanhua's Outfit "Exorcistic Adjuration," currently claimable as part of the event rewards, will be sold at its original price in the Outfit Store after the next version update.
Character_Rococo_18_14:
Pero emerges out of her box and sweeps up the debris on the stage like a whirlwind under Roccia's command.
Through a process of disassembling, mixing, matching, and reassembling, the debris pieces transform into stage props.
Character_Rococo_18_15: There. That pretty much covers the basics.
Character_Rococo_23_10:
After placing the Luceanites, Pero emerges from her box, extending countless tentacle-like arms. She scatters the Luceanites into the air and swiftly ties them with ribbons.
In quick succession, the dark stage is filled with brilliant sparkles.
Character_Rococo_23_11: Perfect. Now we have a glimmer of light to illuminate the darkness.

Character_Cantarella_134_1: Now, back to our topic. Hidden among the stalls set up for tonight are three riddles entwined with the tale of the "ghost girl." Yet, these stalls are rather elusive. Rumor has it that they might even be run… by demons.
Character_Cantarella_134_2: But of course, there are no demons in this world, only distorted frequencies or men cloaked in disguise, driven by their unmet desires.
Character_Cantarella_134_3: Dealing with them requires no money. Instead, they sift through your desires, choosing what to claim for themselves.
Character_Cantarella_134_4: Isn't that enchanting? There's no thrill in simply buying all your heart's desires with mere money.
Character_Cantarella_134_5: And now, we have the "main course" for tonight: whoever solves all three riddles and uncovers the mystery of the "ghost girl" can ask the host for an elixir.
Character_Cantarella_134_6: Whether to turn stones into gold, grant eternal youth, or even bring the dead back to life… Whichever you want, this potion is here to make it real.
Character_Cantarella_134_7: I want the one that turns stones into gold.
Character_Cantarella_134_8: I want the one that brings the dead back to life.
Character_Cantarella_134_9: I just want to get rid of whatever effect that message had on me.
Character_Cantarella_134_11: Well then, might I suggest we collaborate to secure this reward?
Character_Cantarella_134_12: I am after a particular elixir myself.
Character_Cantarella_134_13: Well then, might I suggest we collaborate to secure this reward?
Character_Cantarella_134_15: Such admirable restraint. However, it's too late to withdraw from this game, as the ghosts have already begun to shadow your every step.
Character_Cantarella_134_16: According to that message, bringing those ghosts back to the mortal realm might clear the effects weighing on you.
Character_Cantarella_134_17: So, might I suggest we collaborate to win the elixir that brings the dead back to life? I could also use that elixir myself.
Character_Cantarella_134_18: In that case, why not unravel the lies and find the truth yourself? It could be quite enjoyable.
Character_Cantarella_134_19: Come and join me in this game. I know you won't let go of any potential clues.
Character_Cantarella_134_20: Besides, there are certain places that only you may be able to reach.
Character_Cantarella_134_21: I happen to need a special elixir myself.
Character_Cantarella_134_22: I thought someone as talented as you could make any potion.
Character_Cantarella_134_23: Well, it requires more than you might imagine: the finest ingredients, precise procedures, impeccable techniques, and, of course, the proper mood.
Character_Cantarella_134_24: But with you at my side, even the most intricate elixir would be a delight to create.
Character_Cantarella_134_25: I'd love to explore this with you, be it elixir or poison.

Main_Linaxita_2_2_132_12:
As Carlotta falls from a great height, you reach the depths of the vault just in time to catch her safely.
Her agility raises questions in you, and she finally reveals her hidden identity: she is the family's Executor, tasked with handling disputes and eliminating traitors. 
Just then, traps set by the traitors activate, calling guards to stop you—but none can stand in your way.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_57_16:
Carlotta leads you into Averardo Vault, explaining that her family is aware of the Fractsidus's evil doings and is willing to help. 
She plans to deliver the evidence you've collected to her uncle, Capollo, who will arrange a formal meeting to exchange information about Fractsidus. 
Before the meeting, you take time to explore the vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_28:
After waiting for Carlotta for a long time, you search for her and discover she's in trouble—Capollo has vanished. 
In private, she reveals information from Gilberto's interrogation: there are traitors in the family who have been bribed by Fractsidus.
Carlotta requests your help to reach the traitors' hideout deep within the vault via an alternate passage. She hopes to capture and interrogate them to gain more information.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_22:
Before you enter the alternate passage, Carlotta assigns Zani to create a diversion by drawing attention of the traitors' helpers in the property room. 
With everything in place, you and Carlotta prepare to venture into the depths of Averardo Vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_37:
You and Carlotta reach the tuning room in the depths of the vault and catch the <ano=Frequency Specialist>tuners</ano> tampering with the family's Echoes using Lycoris. 
Intimidated by Carlotta, they confess their betrayal: they altered the Echoes and sent them to the rehearsal venue. 
While the traitors are taken away, Carlotta suspects an even more dangerous traitor is involved. 
To thank you, she offers to take you to the family's Echo Collection Room, where you might uncover connections between the Sentinel and the Vitreum Dancers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_23:
In the Echo Collection Room, Carlotta proudly presents the family's treasured collection of Echoes, symbols of freedom and the Montelli commitment to developing Reserved Terminals for exploration beyond Rinascita. Common Echoes rely heavily on beacons and can't be used at sea, limiting exploration outside Rinascita.
Here, you find the first Vitreum Dancer, the prototype for all other Vitreum Dancers—the same one that had empathy with you in the city. 
Carlotta suggests this is no coincidence. The Sentinel may be using this Vitreum Dancer to send a message. 
You decide to delve into the archives on Vitreum Dancers for further insight.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_15:
The archives reveal that the original Tacet Discord for the Vitreum Dancer emerged from the frequencies of shattered stained glass in the tower ruins, a place forbidden by decree of the Order. The stained-glass windows were used to depict the tales of the Sentinel.
Carlotta is also intrigued by the Sentinel's message, which seems to be guiding you to hidden truths about the Order and the Sentinel's location.
Together, you prepare to venture to the tower ruins.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_13:
Passing through the Averardo Vault lobby, you see that Zani has completed her task. 
However, the vault suddenly shifts into full lockdown—perhaps a backup plan from the traitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_11:
At the reception desk, you learn that the Echo guards outside the main entrance have lost control. With most staff reassigned for the upcoming Carnevale, Carlotta decides to handle the situation personally.
You volunteer to help her deal with the emergency.
kamola_shengtai_101_4: Well, now I suddenly feel like giving it a try.
kamola_shengtai_101_5: Aha. You turned me down without a second thought earlier... Yet, here you are now, and I'm glad for it.
kamola_shengtai_101_6: You came back of your own accord—that alone is enough to make me happy, at least for the moment.

Character_Cantarella_9_1: Blue and purple clothing inspired by the sea… Is she a Fisalia?
Character_Cantarella_9_2: Fisalia? Ancient nobility, known for their fondness for poison, power plays, and their ties to the Order. One of their own even made it to Primus, if I'm not mistaken.
Character_Cantarella_9_3: Wait, how do you know all this?
Character_Cantarella_9_4: Novels, of course! Mysteries brew imagination, you see.
Character_Cantarella_9_5: I'm not a noble myself, but I can definitely read about them. Just think of it as a fun tidbit.
Character_Cantarella_9_6: But the Fisalias aren't just any nobles to gossip about… What if they poison us?
Character_Cantarella_9_7: Relax! They can't know who we are with our masks on...
Character_Cantarella_9_8: It doesn't matter if you're wearing a mask or not. With just a wave of their hand, they can unleash a deadly smog and finish us off!
Character_Cantarella_9_9: Seriously? You're joking, right? Even those novels didn't mention anything like that!
Character_Cantarella_9_10: They've allied with the Order to control the Common Terminals. Plus, they might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine! We'd better watch ourselves!
Flow_226750000_1: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!
Flow_226750000_2: Understood. I am here to serve your will.
Flow_226750000_3: The skylark's song is about to sound.
Flow_226750000_5: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.
Flow_226750000_6: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.
Flow_226750000_7: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.
Flow_226750000_8: You can trust me to keep you safe.
Flow_226750000_9: Would you like a fun game... between the two of us?
Flow_226750000_11: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.
Flow_226750000_13: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?
Flow_226750000_14: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.
Flow_226750000_15: Anything I can help you with?
Flow_226750000_16: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.
Quest_162700001_QuestDesc_162_2: The ominous sound drifting from the fog lures the lost seafarers, drawing them into the land of death where Tacet Discords run wild.
Event_HXMC_1_1: Sails of the departed drift on and on, souls above the clouds, hearts claimed by the sea...
Event_HXMC_1_3: Is that one of your new songs?
Event_HXMC_1_4: It is... this one came from a rather unusual experience.
Event_HXMC_1_5: Tell me, {PlayerName}. What do you think of the sea?
Event_HXMC_1_9: Someone once said the sea is a city of the dead. You can hear the endless cries of the wind and waves, but never the voice of anything living.
Event_HXMC_1_10: When you spend days, weeks, maybe even years adrift, loneliness creeps in and twists despair into something monstrous. And yet, when you see a flicker of light out there—something you dare call "hope"…
Event_HXMC_1_11: That's when people stop thinking straight.
Event_HXMC_1_12: Is this from someone from the Fool's Troupe?
Event_HXMC_1_13: No, it was someone who's long gone now.
Event_HXMC_1_14: He died ten years ago in a shipwreck. I wasn't there to see it happen, and his face has almost faded from my memory. But...
Event_HXMC_1_16: On my last voyage, I saw him. He was on another ship. A lively one if I might add. I could hear the laughter and clink of glasses.
Event_HXMC_1_17: Hold on. Didn't you just say it's rare to see anything living on the sea?
Event_HXMC_1_18: Exactly. That's what makes it unusual. When I saw him, he looked just as he was all those years ago, not a single day older. And in that moment, everything I'd forgotten about him came rushing back.
Event_HXMC_1_19: Are you saying… he might still be alive?
Event_HXMC_1_20: Surviving ten years on the sea, without even a scratch? What do you think, {PlayerName}? How likely is that?
Event_HXMC_1_22: Almost impossible, right? My thoughts exactly.
Event_HXMC_1_23: Yet when the light of "hope" is right in front of you, you can't help but chase after it. No matter how violent the waves or impossible the odds, you have to see it for yourself.
Event_HXMC_1_24: Sadly, when we got closer, Battier and Brant reported back the waters were teeming with Tacet Discords.
Event_HXMC_1_25: If another ship were to stumble across that area…
Event_HXMC_1_26: It would end badly. No doubt about it.
Event_HXMC_1_27: That's why I need your help, {PlayerName}.
Event_HXMC_1_28: I'll admit, this seems more of a personal request from my side. But when you're out there dealing with those Tacet Discords or trying to find the man, regardless of the results your safety comes above all else.
Event_HXMC_1_29: What does this man look like?
Event_HXMC_1_30: He had the same blue hair and eyes as me. He used to call it the color of the sea, a blessing from the ocean itself.
Event_HXMC_1_31: After he died, I stopped believing in nonsense like these. Most sailors still prefer to hold onto their superstitions though, as a way to boost their spirits before heading off to sea.
Event_HXMC_1_32: {PlayerName}, I wish you safety... and the best of luck.
Event_HXMC_2_1: {PlayerName}, welcome back. How did it go out there?
Event_HXMC_2_2: The place was overrun with Tacet Discords.
Event_HXMC_2_4: I didn't see the man you mentioned.
Event_HXMC_2_5: Ah, I see... Thank you for trying, {PlayerName}. Can you tell me more about what you saw?
Event_HXMC_2_6: You describe what you saw to Levito.
Event_HXMC_2_7: Sea fog, never-ending tides of TDs, distant voices on the wind... {PlayerName}, it reminds me of an old story I heard as a child.
Event_HXMC_2_8: Sailors, weary and broken after battling storms and endless waves, find their minds playing tricks on them. As I said before, loneliness can evolve into something unbearable.
Event_HXMC_2_9: In those moments, if a door appeared before them. Bright, warm, and inviting. Even if it led straight to death, many would still choose to walk through it. All for a glimpse of happiness that feels so real they'd gladly give everything for it.
Event_HXMC_2_11: So these waters… is a trap. The TDs are luring people in.
Event_HXMC_2_12: I believe so. And the longer those monsters are left unchecked, the more lives they'll claim.
Event_HXMC_2_13: I'd like to ask another favor of you, though I understand you've got plenty of other tasks to tend to...
Event_HXMC_2_14: I do have a lot going on.
Event_HXMC_2_15: But it's not like I can't make time.
Event_HXMC_2_16: I've learnt about your reputation of being quite a busy person. So don't feel pressured in taking on the task. Feel free to come by whenever you have the time to spare. I'll think of other ways to handle it in the meantime.
Event_HXMC_2_17: That said... I do prefer that you make use of that time on some relaxation.
Event_HXMC_2_18: Are you planning on a reward for me?
Event_HXMC_2_19: Of course, if that's what you hope for. I do not want anyone else to have to experience the loss of hope any longer.
Event_HXMC_2_21: Don't worry. I've made my peace with the idea that he did die ten years ago. Maybe that's not such a bad thing after all.

ZX_BOXDLXJ_1_1: Hello, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}. It's been so long! Ever since you helped with the restoration, more and more Echoes have been flocking to the Plushie Village.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_1_2: I can't remember the last time everyone's gotten so cheery and zippy.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_1_4: Yes, yes. And on behalf of those whose names I shall keep a secret for now, I would like to extend a formal invitation to you…
ZX_BOXDLXJ_1_6: You suddenly hear the delicate sound of silvery chimes. As you try to pinpoint the source, you realize it's coming from the Bell of Echoing Heart gifted by the Plushie Echoes before.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_1_7: Sounds like they want to see you as soon as possible. Well then, we'll be waiting for you at the Plushie Village!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_10_1: Riding a Gondola in a sea of clouds is really something else, huh?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_10_2: Feels kinda like we're... drifting on the clouds. Err, how else can you put it?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_10_3: It really is a unique experience.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_10_4: We should be getting close, right? Hold on, lemme check with...
ZX_BOXDLXJ_10_6: Hey, this is it! Let's take our picture here, {PlayerName}!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_11_1: What a view up here... Hmm? What's that?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_11_3: They're asking if this is where you beat that dragon and if you were the one who put together this place the way it is now.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_12_1: Whoa... What's with all this wind!? Keep her steady now, {PlayerName}!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_12_3: I didn't know you guys could handle heights!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_1: Wow. Everything's slowly coming back to me now...
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_2: Zargon Garden. Didn't really get a chance to enjoy it after putting it all together.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_3: Well, there we go then. I'm gonna enjoy every detail of this place as much as I can!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_4: With the swing of {PlayerName}'s blade, Echoes appeared out of nowhere!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_5: It's like the scene is happening again right in front of me! Wait a minute...
ZX_BOXDLXJ_13_6: ...Where did these Echoes come from!? I didn't know I could summon Echoes!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_1: Hey, this painting... It just started glowing for some reason.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_2: You know, it's actually kinda pretty... Look at how the stars are lighting up too. What do you think is inside? You don't suppose there's Echoes waiting to jump on us again, do you?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_3: How about you go take a look?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_5: ...I might be Solaris's No.1 Echo, but I thought we're supposed to stick together when it comes to adventuring! Plus, who's gonna look after the Plushies while I'm gone?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_6: If you say so. I guess Solaris's No.1 Echo has nothing to worry about with {PlayerName} on the case…
ZX_BOXDLXJ_14_7: The glowing painting might be some kind of hint. Either way, we'll need to check it out.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_1: Now, settle down everyone. I've already told you {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName} is on their way... Oh, you're here!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_4: At last! The hero of the Plushie Village graces us with {Male=his;Female=her} presence yet again.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_5: Oh, no. Not at all. We were all waiting for you to start the adventure.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_7: It's our first bloom of the morning! These little guys wouldn't want anyone close to it until it finally blossomed.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_8: They said they wanted you to have the very first flower.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_10: Thanks. It means a lot to me.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_12: They're really glad you like it! By the way, there's something else I'd like to ask you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}. Have you ever seen a Seaside Cendrelis before?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_13: As you can see, the rebuilt Plushie Village is now thriving, and the Echoes have been trying out new things every day.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_14: Especially after the Plushies overhead Enzo and I chatted about the Cendrelis, which are flowers that glow like jellyfish, a few days back. They got really curious and excited, they wanted to see it for themselves!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_15: You don't happen to have some of those magical-looking flowers on you, do you?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_16: You find a Seaside Cendrelis from your bag and hand it over to Fulmine.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_17: This is it... This is the kind of beauty you find once in a lifetime. Oh, thank you. Thank you so much, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! Enzo swore that Seaside Cendrelis were long extinct, and I almost believed that until now!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_18: Where did you find it, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}? Can you show the Plushies? If that's okay.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_19: Our Plushie Squad, made up of the best of the best Echoes, was chomping at the bit for a new adventure ever since the Plushie Village was reborn from the ashes!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_21: Sounds like a lot of work.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_22: That's right! This is all inspired by the stories of your greatest adventures. They'll have a present ready for you at the end of this new adventure!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_23: No, no, no. Exploring new views is just part of it. They also want to witness the valiant {PlayerName} in action with their own eyes. And, there will be a present ready for our hero at the end of it as well!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_25: Why yes! While you're at it, do you mind helping them take a few pictures along the way?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_27: Instead of hanging around the village all day, there's nothing more exciting than discovering exotic lifeforms and visiting exciting places!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_28: Bubble and Old Bake always get cold feet when it comes to visiting new places. Maybe seeing some of the unique views beyond the village would help them change their minds.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_1: Fulmine wants me to take pictures of unique views... Wonder where the Plushies want to visit first?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_3: They say they want to go check out around the entrance!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_5: Hehe. Heard you needed someone who can speak Echo. So here I am!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_4_1: Hell yeah, this is the place!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_4_2: This view is great. A perfect shot with everyone right in the middle.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_5_3: They really like the picture you took, and they never knew such a large area existed behind the clouds. Hmm, you mean you guys couldn't see it before?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_5_4: Maybe the Sonoro Sphere chooses who can and cannot see.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_5_5: {PlayerName}, the Plushies want to get a closer look. They want to take a clearer picture to share with everyone back in the village. Let's go!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_6_1: A Wingray. Up there! Maybe we can fly over there.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_7_4: Can't really hear over all this wind... But I can tell they're enjoying it that's for sure!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_8_2: That's maybe... a bit too up there.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_8_3: Wow. Would you look at that... This place is massive from up close.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_9_1: How did a Gondola get up here?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_9_3: What are you waiting for, {PlayerName}? Hop in!

InfoDisplay_311000010_Text: Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition) Many non-initiates misunderstand the Order of Deep and feel overwhelmed by words in the Codex such as "grace," "salvation," "mercy," and "faith." Indeed, never has the Sentinel Imperator revealed Their true form. So why then, are we to believe in Their existence? The chronicles of Rinascita record numerous battles of the Sentinel against the Lament. The ruins and wonders across Rinascita bear witness to Imperator's divine authority. Their destined path created a better world for mankind, leaving us to shape a new future, while They, silently watch over us. We are grateful for Their blessings. We honor Their teachings. We follow in Their deeds by disseminating wisdom that guides all towards good—such is the mission of the Order of Deep. Under Cassilin the Knowledgeable, we have compiled this introduction to elucidate upon the meaning of the Sentinel and our Order. This we hope inspires followers on the path of virtue. We begin with some frequently asked questions: 1. Who is Sentinel Imperator? Sentinel Imperator embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. It is important to note that we acknowledge other divine beings, for They have spoken of Sentinels in distant lands, with powers that control day and night, the flow of time, or all knowledge and wisdom. Without exception, all Sentinels selflessly guide humanity and shepherd civilization. As such, all Sentinels are great divinities. However We believe Sentinel Imperator holds foremost power to "Split." That is, They split the ocean, granting humanity land on which to "breathe." By right of Their providence, Imperator is elevated among all Sentinels. 2. What is the Order's doctrine? This mortal world is a boundless sea in which every soul must swim up to the divine. Life flows in waves, and only by reaching the shore do we reach the dawn of civilization. Our Sentinel is salvation from the gales and tides, is the unity from which Rinascita was born, and is ascension for our souls. The Order's doctrines are thus: “Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity." - Salvation: By the grace of the Sentinel, Their followers must deliver salvation to others. Nary are we blind to injustice or suffering. We labor to save others from sin. To the wicked, the Order provides salvation, and for the unrepentant, may we exact penitence. - Ascension: To find salvation is to seek ascension. Members of the Order will not indulge Their favor in idle pleasures or desires. All must elevate their spirit through self-discipline or risk sinking into the abyss. - Unity: After granting us Their representation on earth, Sentinel Imperator left Rinascita in our care. Members of the Order are "brothers and sisters," who unite people of faith, regardless of origin or background. Only as one can we fortify ourselves from the perils of the deep sea. The first Primus, Napoli the Second, received a prophecy from the Sentinel: in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. Those saved must "breathe," to "ascend" in "unity" on new land, just as we once answered the Sentinel's call and made landfall on Rinascita. 3. Is there evidence to support the doctrine of the Order? Theology is a science humanity has not yet fully understood in theory or practice. The Sentinel guides civilization, and we trust Their word. Throughout the generations, the Order has established the following philosophical precepts. Excerpts from The Philosophy of the Order: Sacred Knowledge (Volume 1: Water): On Origin: Genesis in "Water." In nature "Water" is infinite as it is universal. In the beginning, Sentinel Imperator "split" this world, once a formless ocean, into the realm of land and sea. On Motion: Movement through "Water." The motion of "Water" heats and cools, wets and dries the realm of land. From water, all life was created in the "First Wave" and will end in the "Last Wave." On Revelations: Refractions of "Water." Man's image reflected by "Water" is a strange reality unto himself. So too applies to all reality when water refracts the world unto the Sonoro Sphere. Through reforms by successive Primuses, we have come to emphasize the scientific and practical application of our philosophical understanding. Readers may visit Arito Well in the Square of Liberty to experience the mysteries of "water divination": toss a coin into the well, make a heartfelt wish, and answers you shall receive. We would be greatly honored if this Codex engenders interest in the Sentinel's teachings, and we welcome all to the Order's library, where supplementary literature is available to borrow. While words are a paltry means to express the Sentinel's grand purpose, we nonetheless hope to have adequately conveyed fractions of divine essence. Let miracles recorded in the Codex be "symbols" of infinite, communicable power. Through narratives of common understanding, we envision a world of unwavering faith. Even as the Lament threatens to return, we reaffirm our place and purpose. We pray that believers and non-believers alike will view the text herein as an invitation for communion and reflection. May these words offer insight to us adrift at sea. The paths are many, but with virtue in our hearts, we illuminate a way amidst the waves.

Guide_QDMFDYX_1_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. Can you hear me...? It is I, the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_4: Hello, and I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_5: Ahem. I am the Administrator of the <ano=domain of dreams>Somnoire</ano>, the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_6: Well... to see you about matters concerning Somnoire naturally.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_7: Ahem. Maybe save the jokes for later, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_8: I was wondering if you have noticed... A gateway to the Somnoire has started to appear in Rinascita.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_12: The dreamscape seems to be experiencing some kind of interference... Ah, there, it's working again.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_13: If possible, I'd like to speak with you in person. I'll be expecting you, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_2: Emm... I gather you must be puzzled by my current appearance. I can assure you I am the Ebony Gatekeeper who contacted you earlier.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_4: ...I see how it is. It was you who I spoke to that time!
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_5: I'm afraid Ms. Encore has no involvement in this. This entity is a replica of memory fragments from the Somnoire. I am merely borrowing its appearance for the time being.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_7: Now, then. This is unrelated to the topic we're about to discuss.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_9: That time when I used Echoids against the TDs.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_10: Ahem... Well... Yes, you're absolutely correct. It was me who you spoke to.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_11: I indeed owe you an apology for engaging you in the experiment to test out the new Gateway through a false identity. It was all part of my plan to save those dreams... One which you've thwarted.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_12: Okay, out with it. What are you up to this time?
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_13: Please, Dreamwalker. I assure you that I have no secrets to hide.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_14: I've been optimizing the memory storage logic of a few Memory Zones, and if all goes accordingly the Somnoire should be able to house more dreams with its current space.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_15: Yet I've discovered impurities lingering within the dreams of Rinascita. When the Dreamscape Nodes in Rinascita were activated, these impurities flooded in Somnoire along with the dreams.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_17: Unlike what we've handled before, they are composed of something more sinister than negative emotions in nightmares. Something that's close to a spiritual plague. However, I have yet to achieve a definitive answer.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_18: More Memory Zones fall under their influence as we speak. If left untreated, they could not only put my work on hold but also undermine the integrity of the Somnoire itself.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_19: Dreamwalker, I wish to seek your aid in handling these impurities. But not for me, for the entire Somnoire.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_20: Fine. Not the first time I've done this.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_22: Rest assured, there will be plenty of rewards waiting for you inside the dreamscapes. I will also be available to assist you in any way my abilities allow.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_23: About the Somnoire gateway in Rinascita I mentioned to you earlier... In order to prevent further spread, I have sealed the impurities in the Memory Zones behind it.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_24: As you progress, I will periodically open more gateways located across various areas. The Somnoire will also have necessary utilities in place at your and your comrade's disposal.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_25: Proceed to the gateway and restore Memory Zones affected by impurities, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_1: Dreamwalker, to the Somnoire you are a variable of incredible weight. You bring about a change...
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_3: A change for the better. After years of lying dormant, the colossus is now experiencing transformation. Together, we shall preserve even more... treasures.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_4: Whilst deep inside the Memory Zones, I'm sure you came across plenty of familiar views and occurances.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_5: Go, Dreamwalker. In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.

Quest_161000002_QuestDesc_161_1: As your adventure comes to an end, you learn that the Plushie Village still has another surprise waiting for you.
DYHD_5_24: With Ishmael's guidance, you manage to find the old captain, Ahab, at the dock. Ahab gladly lets you borrow his old Gondola, and you can go fishing at sea with it.
DYHD_7_42: After you've recaptured the escaped fish, Ahab suggests you check out the market. To your surprise, Phoebe is there too. You find her in a sticky situation because of the locals' fraught history with the Order of the Deep. After You and Ahab help her out, Phoebe reveals she came here searching for Cetus the Tidebreaker. Ahab remarks that you'll run into the beast eventually just by going out fishing.
DYHD_11_42: Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment. To help Starbuck come to his senses, you decide to locate his Gondola for clues.
DYHD_13_18: You and Phoebe find Starbuck's lost Gondola. Having theorized that Starbuck's enchantment has something to do with the fish he was holding, the two of you begin brainstorming a plan to get it off his hands.
DYHD_14_44: You and Phoebe finally manage to grab the fish from Starbuck, and the First Mate's sanity is restored. Starbuck claims he once saw Cetus the Tidebreaker at a place called Serene Bay, with a large fish swimming alongside it. He hands you the lighthouse key Captain Ahab entrusted in his care before you departed.
DYHD_19_4: The Tidebreaker has indeed been wandering in Serene Bay. After the lighthouse was relit, the beast swam towards a small island covered in storm...
DYHD_21_31: As you find it impossible to pass through the storm looming over Reyes Islands, you head towards the nameless island Ahab mentioned. You attempt to dispel the storm following the inscription on the ancient steles, but to no avail. In the end, it's Starbuck's peculiar method of "offering his love" to the island that finally calms the storm.
DYHD_25_7: When the last lighthouse becomes operational once more, Cetus the Tidebreaker returns to its usual gentle self. Meanwhile, Phoebe has also made progress in her investigation of the island.
DYHD_29_37: As the storm subsides, you meet the Tidebreaker again after it carried you back from the depths of the sea. Phoebe wishes to express her apology to the beast for what happened during the Carnevale, but the Tidebreaker holds no grudge. Maybe one day in the future, as a pro angler, you might be able to reel the big guy in...
DYHD_2502_14: After deciphering the ancient tablets, Phoebe believes the Tidebreaker is tasked to guide the lost souls to the realm beyond, and the "siren" invading these waters may be a creature similar in nature to Lorelei. With the information at hand, the two of you seek Captain Ahab's aid to deal with the "siren."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_168_1: Just moments ago, you lost contact with Carlotta when she fell underground.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_1: If the Threnodian created the Dark Tide, maybe Abby can absorb it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_2: Abby is still unwell, perhaps we shouldn't burden it further.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_1: Vines, over there. And that statue...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_2: I can feel strong Remnant Energy coming from it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_3: The Order's Remnant Spark must be inside the statue. Legends speak of how the first Primus used it to purify the first Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_4: ...I see now. The lingering remnants of the Dark Tide must be trapping the Spark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_5: To release it, we'll need to clear away the remaining remnants binding it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_6: Once we have the Remnant Spark, we can use it to burn through the vines.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_153_1: Hurry. We need to purify the other statues before the Dark Tide's corruption returns.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_157_3: Just catching my breath. You go get the Remnant Spark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_37_1: This calibrator seems to be operational.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_37_3: That should do it... Why don't you give it a try?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_38_2: Rotate the Gravity Calibrator to change the direction of the gravity's pull.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_38_3: If we use this we should be able to reach areas we previously couldn't.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_44_1: Obstacles ahead. Let's get off here.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_2: Can you use your ability from somewhere in between to clear them all at once?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_3: I might not have that range...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_4: But there may be Tacetite devices nearby that can help amplify my Forte. Let's see if we can find one.
YYYHZG_2_45: Of course! One of the musical records is buried deep within the sea of clouds. Without me as your guide, you'll surely get lost.
YYYHZG_2_46: Just tell me where to go. I never lose my way.
YYYHZG_2_47: Great danger awaits. Are you certain you want to come?
YYYHZG_2_48: I'm Lenore, the dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive in the Order of the Deep. If I make it back alive today, please find me at the Minor Forbidden Archive. I'll do everything I can to repay you!

HelpText_193_Content:
1. After unlocking Fishing Ability: Wonder Bubble, you can purchase Wonder Bubbles of the area from Planck, the dock merchant. Upon purchase, a Wonder Bubble will be automatically generated near the current dock, gradually catching crabs and urchins in the area.

2. The Wonder Bubble has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. Steer Rachel to the Wonder Bubble and interact with it to claim your catches.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Wonder Bubble's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.
HelpText_194_Content:
1. After unlocking Trawl, it will be automatically equipped to Rachel and help you catch previously fished species in the area.

2. The Trawl has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. The Trawl can only be accessed at the Dock interface, where you can manage your catches from the Trawl.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Trawl's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.
HelpText_195_Content:
1. After unlocking Quick Sale, a dashed Quick Sale area will be automatically generated in the Cargo every time you open the Dock interface. Place your catches within this area during sailing for Quick Sale.

2. When the Quick Sale area is fully occupied, you can immediately sell all catches within or partially occupying the area.

3. Catches sold through Quick Sale fetch higher prices compared to dock sales.

4. Quick Sale is only available during sailing.
HelpText_196_Content:
1. You can store your catches in Rachel's Cargo.

2. The Cargo has a limited capacity. Catches exceeding this limit cannot be stored, and stacking is not allowed.

3. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Cargo's capacity.

4. While storing catches, you can Place, Rotate, Discard, or Return them as needed.

5. Upon reaching the dock, Coast Flax, Palm Tree Log, Metal Debris, and Bampuff will be automatically converted into regular items.
HelpText_197_Content:
1. Deliver the required fish based on the profile provided. Only normal species can be delivered—mutants are excluded.

2. To complete a delivery, place the fish onto the corresponding profile and rotate it until the shape and angle align perfectly.

3. If multiple deliveries are required, you can submit some required species and complete the remaining deliveries in future attempts.

FishActivity_80121101_ItemInfo: What's the difference between a coconut-flavored urchin and an urchin-flavored coconut? Nevertheless, one thing's for sure: both hurt like a charm when they hit your head.
FishActivity_80121102_ItemInfo: It is a common belief among the Riccioli fishers that the crystal cavities on Cetus the Tidebreaker were pierced by a crew of godless sailors, incurring divine wrath. Then, the fragments of the shattered crystals transformed into the Black Pearls—though Captain Ahab firmly dismisses this tale as fanciful nonsense.
FishActivity_80121103_ItemInfo:
A variant of the Gulpuff, often found near the Riccioli Islands. Unlike its docile cousin, the Bampuff is highly aggressive and is used to make "Sweet Puff."
During the day, a threatened Bampuff will explode, dragging predators—or even fishing boats—into mutual destruction. At night, however, it can be fished like any ordinary catch.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
FishActivity_80121104_ItemInfo:
A type of flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
FishActivity_80121105_ItemInfo:
A type of tree log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
FishActivity_80121106_ItemInfo:
Metal debris found in the Riccioli Islands territory. Despite being eroded by the sea, it's still usable as rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
FishActivity_80121201_ItemInfo: As is well known, octopuses don't naturally grow inside clams. These small octopuses actively seek out suitable clams, devour the original residents, and claim the shells as their new homes.
FishActivity_80121202_ItemInfo: During their brief breeding season, Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells in search of mates. Fishers humorously call them "Bell-less Crabs" during this time. Their meat is said to become exceptionally flavorful, attracting food enthusiasts from Ragunna eager to savor this seasonal delicacy.
FishActivity_80121203_ItemInfo: Found across Solaris, this fish occupies a mid-tier position in the food chain. It is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide for short distances.
FishActivity_80121204_ItemInfo: True to its name, this jellyfish resembles and tastes like a fried egg. It is one of the largest exports of the Riccioli Islands.
FishActivity_80121205_ItemInfo: Are they fish? Yes, yes, they are. Did I finish them? No, no...
FishActivity_80121206_ItemInfo: At a distance, it resembles a drifting vegetable leaf, but up close, it brings to mind the legendary ancient dragon of Rinascita. Despite their grand dreams of becoming the mighty Pelagic Wyrm, their tiny size dooms their ambition to stay only a fantasy.
FishActivity_80121207_ItemInfo: Most biologists in Rinascita agree that "Rainbow Eel" would better suit this creature than "Yarn Eel" based on their vibrant appearance. However, due to their timid nature, these eels are often found tangling with one another for survival. While "a cluster of timid Rainbow Eels" might be accurate, "Yarn Eel" is far less of a tongue-twister.
FishActivity_80121301_ItemInfo: This octopus might not pack much nutritional value, but its charm is off the charts. With a cute appearance and a soft, graceful body that dances through the water, it has won the hearts of Ragunna's noble ladies, becoming a sought-after ornamental pet.
FishActivity_80121302_ItemInfo: In the Riccioli Islands, misbehaving children are often warned about the Giant Gulper, a deep-sea predator said to snatch naughty kids at night. While this creature fuels many childhood nightmares for the islanders, the Sob Blobs, as its helpless prey, truly live in its shadow.
FishActivity_80121303_ItemInfo: In the lightless depths of the sea, these clustered salps are a common meal for many deep-sea creatures—except Giant Gulpers. It seems these predators find the salps too small to bother with. To date, there have been no reported sightings of Giant Gulpers chowing down on salps.
FishActivity_80121304_ItemInfo: It sobs for its insignificance in the vast ocean and its vulnerability to the gaping maw of its predators.
FishActivity_80121305_ItemInfo: The Pokey Moray once vowed to leave behind its slow-paced life—only for its ambition to be cut short the moment it ended up on your line.
FishActivity_80121306_ItemInfo: Food, shelter, and fashion are no concerns for a Gooberstar. It spends its days lounging in carefree bliss, untouched by predators thanks to its unappetizing taste. Its life is nearly perfect—if only it could find a sponge to make things even better.
FishActivity_80121307_ItemInfo: Armed with a coat of sharp thorns, a Pricklecrab is a bold and aggressive predator of the deep sea. One fisher is said to have fended off a Tacet Discord by hurling a Pricklecrab at it. A creature of great ferocity indeed.
FishActivity_80121401_ItemInfo: Known as the "Sea Angel," this delicate creature is as enchanting as a butterfly fairy. Many believe it serves as the envoy of Cetus the Tidebreaker, tasked with retrieving lost souls from the ocean's depths. Yet, given its diminutive size, one can't help but question its suitability for such a daunting mission.
FishActivity_80121402_ItemInfo: These ancient sea flowers thrive in Solaris, fostering a harmonious bond with Seabed Snows. Their appearance resembles the decorative feathers often seen on performers' hats during the Carnevale, earning them the nickname "Star's Feather Crown."
FishActivity_80121403_ItemInfo: The Stygian Phantom, a highly toxic jellyfish cherished by the Fisalia family, stands in stark contrast to Cetus the Tidebreaker. While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.
FishActivity_80121404_ItemInfo: Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.
FishActivity_80121405_ItemInfo: During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.
FishActivity_80121406_ItemInfo: If you ever venture into the depths of the Riccioli waters, beware of any glimmers in the darkness—no matter how enchanting their colors.
FishActivity_80121407_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
FishActivity_80121408_ItemInfo: A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.
FishActivity_80121501_ItemInfo: Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"
FishActivity_80121502_ItemInfo: This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.
FishActivity_80121503_ItemInfo: A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.
FishActivity_80121504_ItemInfo: Wait, is that... Astrite!? Holy crab!!
FishActivity_80121505_ItemInfo: This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.
FishActivity_80121506_ItemInfo: Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."
FishActivity_80121507_ItemInfo: As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.
FishActivity_80121508_ItemInfo: A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.
FishActivity_80121601_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.
FishActivity_80121602_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.
FishActivity_80121603_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.
FishActivity_80121604_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. It is said that after Threnodian Leviathan was defeated by Sentinel Imperator, its subordinates were stripped of their power, left to barely survive in the depths. Draco Cobia, once a loyal servant of the Leviathan, has long lost the power granted by the Threnodian, yet it still remains a deadly predator to smaller sea creatures.
FishActivity_80121605_ItemInfo:
A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.
"In the Underworld palace, the archdemon sits on its throne, awaiting souls delivered by the ferryman. With a thousand grasping arms, it rises to seize the heart of the condemned. From that moment, the wretched soul is bound to serve the archdemon for a thousand years, a fate from which neither Cetus the Tidebreaker nor Imperator can deliver them."
FishActivity_80121606_ItemInfo: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This creature is a top predator who has survived thousands of years in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands. Surviving the Lament might sound impressive, but facing its razor-sharp fangs is an even greater challenge.

Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.
Once the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
LoadingTipsText_200102_TipsText: A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times.
LoadingTipsText_200103_TipsText:
Collections housed in this area are often referred to as "vessels of creativity and ingenuity."
For artists and inventors laboring under the patronage of a wealthy family, all their creations, tangible or intangible, are considered assets of the patrons.
The act of creation becomes a measure of worth, by which these creators' value is defined.
LoadingTipsText_200104_TipsText: Located within the depths of Averardo Vault, off Echo train network, this tower is known to few. What dark secrets does the place hide?

Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
LoadingTipsText_602301_TipsText: The deepest point of the Averardo Vault. Lower ranking staff might not even be aware of its existence. Legend say an intruder would meet their end at the hands of the Echo guard, descending from a height to deliver their fate.

HelpText_190_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra III, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges. Use different buffs to defeat enemies to complete the challenge objectives in Bonus Challenge and obtain additional rewards.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]

Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank. Defeating enemies provides a significant boost.

InfoDisplay_102000607_Text:
... very few people, including those within the Montelli family know when the Vitreum Dancers first appeared, even though these unobtrusive, unremarkable Echoes have long served the family. In fact, most of the Montellis do not know of Vitreum Dancers as anything other than their domestic security detail. Thus it remains easily overlooked that no two Vitreum Dancers are alike.

Knowledge gleaned from the stained-glass artwork found in the ruins around Ragunna suggests that Vitreum Dancers were once Tacet Discord frequencies. They appear in stained-glass art along with general depictions of The Order's religion. To this day Montelli explorers have yet to find two identical panes of stained glass. The Order's artists took pains to alter the composition of panes that depict the same story or motif. This suggests that the frequencies of modern Vitreum Dancers each contain unique information, much like their Tacet Discord forbearers.

According to the book "The Wealth and Legend of the Montellis," the origin of the Vitreum Dancer dates back in history to a time when a Montelli ancestor received the Laurel during the Carnevale from Imperator who then instructed him to go to a tower abandoned by The Order. Upon his return, he would not divulge what he saw and forbade all Montellis from approaching the tower again. Undoubtedly this Montelli ancestor brought back the very first Vitreum Dancer. On his deathbed, his last words were that the Sentinel's Oracle would not exert influence over Montellis at present, but would determine their future course of events.

And with that the tower was barred to all subsequent Montelli, and as the family's cohort of Vitreum Dancers expanded, the legend of their origins faded into obscurity.

JKXCCZST_2_1: Ah, Ragunna... I miss the noise and bustle of the city. And the blue skies, not this ceiling overhead...
JKXCCZST_2_2: Working in a place like this is no different than being locked away by the Chamber of Discipline.
JKXCCZST_2_3: It's still the Carnevale, isn't it? How about we take a little time off and head back to the city?
JKXCCZST_2_4: If we're lucky, we might even get a glimpse of this year's Laureate.
JKXCCZST_3_1: I'd like to deposit a new collection of items.
JKXCCZST_3_2: It is our pleasure to assist you, Mr. Tiberio.
JKXCCZST_3_3: As our lifelong patron, your collection will receive additional insurance for safekeeping.
JKXCCZST_3_4: But if you don't mind me asking, you came in person today instead of using a Terminal for delivery. Is there something else you require?
JKXCCZST_3_5: My grandfather stored a painting here. I'd like to check on it.
JKXCCZST_3_6: Alright. The Precious Metals and Artworks Despository is in this direction. Please follow me.
JKXCCZST_5_1: Have you gone over the shift change checklist? I see there's a new entry in the precious metals section.
JKXCCZST_5_2: Nothing to be concerned about. The serial number is already in the system.
JKXCCZST_6_1: The alarm on Display Case 376 in the artworks depository just went off. Looks like the humidity level got too high.
JKXCCZST_6_2: Just the humidity detector acting up. I've already notified Maintenence.
JKXCCZST_6_3: Write up an incident report for the higher-ups, will you?
JKXCCZST_6_4: With such high-value pieces, we don't want any liability on our heads.
JKXCCZST_1_1: I'm telling you, there's something wrong with that statue we dropped off...
JKXCCZST_1_2: How is the whole thing still intact, except for a scratch on the base? Could it be some kind of trigger for a nobleman's hidden chamber?
JKXCCZST_1_3: And the statue itself... Frostscourge Stalkers are symbols of death and vengeance, you know! Maybe there's a rebellion brewing in that secret chamber...
JKXCCZST_1_4: Oh, shut it. If you've got time for daydreaming, go take up volunteering at the Order.
JKXCCZST_1_6: We haul these treasures down the express every day. It's a golden opportunity to uncover all the nobles' dirty little secrets.
JKXCCZST_1_7: You know the vault monitors everything, right? Cameras and audio, all synced to record every word you say.
JKXCCZST_1_9: What I'm saying is, they're watching the items... and listening to you.
JKXCCZST_1_10: And if you so much as slip and reveal one of their "secrets"? Well, that could turn very ugly for you.
JKXCCZST_10_1: Please help me... calibrate my knowledge module.

JKXCCZST_10_8: Answer... recorded. The Sentinel of this land is named Jué.

JKXCCZST_10_10: Wait, no! Forget what I said!

JKXCCZST_11_15: I see... then, c-could you please tell me the answer again...?

JKXCCZST_12_2: All you need to do is tell me the name of this Vault, okay?

JKXCCZST_12_7: If my creator had given me lips, I would be kissing you in gratitude!
JKXCCZST_12_8: Lollo Logistics... Oh, what a fascinating answer...
JKXCCZST_12_9: Ahh, I feel it coursing through me... Oh yes, make it stronger! Tear me apart with it, I beg you!

JKXCCZST_13_2: What is the name of the city famous for the Carnevale in this land?
JKXCCZST_13_9: No matter. You can still try again.
JKXCCZST_13_10: Why are you so full of yourself?
JKXCCZST_13_11: My creator programmed me not to waste time on trivial matters. Please try again.

JKXCCZST_16_1: Same as always today. No irregularities in the Echoes' frequencies.
JKXCCZST_16_3: Greetings, my name is Valerius. I am the surveyor here at the Echo Depository.
JKXCCZST_16_4: This area of the depository uses cutting-edge technology developed by the Montelli family. Echoes are secured on mountings, allowing them to be preserved without requiring dedicated Terminals.
JKXCCZST_16_5: That said, it's still new technology. We still need to be monitoring their resting frequencies around the clock so any anomalies can be dealt with swiftly.
JKXCCZST_16_8: Haha, well, from what I know of the Montellis, the chances of that happening are about as likely as the entire population of Ragunna suddenly developing a taste for Pizza Tropicale!
JKXCCZST_16_9: Still, imagine if all these magnificent specimens—frozen in place—suddenly came to life. Now that would be a sight to see.
JKXCCZST_16_10: Many of the Echoes here are types I could never hope to see in my lifetime. Some of them are extinct, officially declared as such by the outside world.
JKXCCZST_16_11: To witness them move, even once... That's all I could ever ask for as a researcher in the field of Echoes.
JKXCCZST_17_1: I'm quitting... I have to quit...
JKXCCZST_17_3: Ugh! Just look at this place. There's nothing but creepy Echoes and oddballs. I don't know anyone can put up with this.
JKXCCZST_17_6: Yes, the Echoes here in this section of the depository! They've all got that spooky look on their faces. What are they even for anyway? They're nothing like the ones in Ragunna City.
JKXCCZST_17_7: I just don't get it. What do those rich folks even want with this stuff?
JKXCCZST_17_8: Look at that guy over there by the bookshelf. The so-called caretaker.
JKXCCZST_17_9: He's either buried in books or pacing around the Echoes... I even saw him reach out and touch one of their wings! He was muttering to himself the whole time, too.
JKXCCZST_17_10: Come on, these Echoes are alive! What if he's performing some kind of ritual to release them?!
JKXCCZST_17_11: I'm quitting... I have to quit...
JKXCCZST_18_1: Don't come any closer, don't come any closer…
JKXCCZST_18_6: Wait. I think I just saw something flash and for a second there I thought one of those Echoes came to life.
JKXCCZST_18_7: Working here is just terrifying. I'm quitting... I have to quit...
JKXCCZST_4_1: Welcome to Averado Vault. Is there something I can help you with?
JKXCCZST_4_3: I'd like to store a hundred Gulpuffs.
JKXCCZST_4_4: How's my ton of gold coming along?
JKXCCZST_4_5: I'd like a bowl of fried rice.
JKXCCZST_4_6: Averardo Vault operates under the principles of "utmost respect for all private properties." It is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.
JKXCCZST_4_7: You are currently in the lower level of Averardo Vault. Any items you choose to deposit will be stored here.
JKXCCZST_4_8: The underground is divided into three main areas: The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository, the Echo Depository, and the Talent Depository. Whether you're storing valuables or showcasing creativity, Averardo Vault is here to help you make the most of them with unmatched service.
JKXCCZST_4_9: I'll be here should you require any more assistance.
JKXCCZST_4_10: Alright. Thank you for choosing Averado Vault's Echo storage services.
JKXCCZST_4_11: Gulpuffs are classified as low-value Echoes. If you wish to store them, you will need to purchase insurance yourself and pay a storage fee based on their storage unit.
JKXCCZST_4_12: If you'd like to sign up for this service, we'll have the Echo Depository contact you regarding further details right away. Our team will create a custom plan to meet all your storage needs, ensuring your Gulpuffs are carefully looked after during their time with us.
JKXCCZST_4_13: I'll be here should you require any more assistance.
JKXCCZST_4_14: One moment, I'll verify your identity details.
JKXCCZST_4_15: I'm sorry, but it appears your account doesn't currently show an order of one ton of gold.
JKXCCZST_4_16: But I see your account has been verified by Lady Carlotta and currently enjoys premium services.
JKXCCZST_4_17: Should you wish to store a ton of gold in the future, we'll provide an exclusive plan and ensure your assets receive the most professional management and protection.
JKXCCZST_4_18: I'll be here should you require any more assistance.
JKXCCZST_4_21: (Quietly) How many more of these wackjobs are we going to get every day...
JKXCCZST_4_22: Ahem, apologies. I mean I'm afraid we don't offer dining services here.
JKXCCZST_4_23: If you're looking to eat, you can visit the Ducat Hall upstairs. Their banquet hall offers a wide variety of delicious options.
JKXCCZST_4_24: I'll be here should you require any more assistance.
JKXCCZST_7_1: Heard the latest? Another one's tried to make off with the "secret cache."
JKXCCZST_7_2: After all these years, you'd think one of them would actually succeed. Honestly, I'm a bit curious myself about what it actually is.
JKXCCZST_7_3: The Montelli family's most scandalous secret? Something like... Lady Carlotta was actually born to a Fisalia, but her Resonance abilities got her sent to the Montellis!
JKXCCZST_7_4: Ugh... your imagination is something else.
JKXCCZST_7_5: But you reminded me of a tale. Years ago, the Vault had a legendary employee. The loan manager pulled the funding on his family business and ruined him. The man vowed vengeance against the Vault itself after that.
JKXCCZST_7_6: I heard he vowed to pay back the man who did that to him a hundredfold, come hell or high water.
JKXCCZST_7_7: Maybe the "secret cache" is his way of finally getting even?
JKXCCZST_8_1: Oh, if only I could see them again...
JKXCCZST_8_3: Hi there. What do you want to see?
JKXCCZST_8_4: Hello! Are you one of the Vault's customers?
JKXCCZST_8_5: I'm an appraiser here. I've been valuing collections for years.
JKXCCZST_8_6: Well, but something's been bothering me for a long time. Once, the head of the Montellis brought in some items for appraisal. I evaluated them the usual way.
JKXCCZST_8_7: At the time, I was sure it was the most valuable collection I'd ever handled. But to my surprise, many of the pieces seemed... almost worthless when judged by market value.
JKXCCZST_8_8: Not long after, the collection was sealed away and has never been seen since.
JKXCCZST_8_9: Could I have overlooked something? Oh… if only I could examine those items once more, I would be certain to appraise them with the clarity they deserve.
JKXCCZST_9_2: Allow me to... show you... show you the wire!
JKXCCZST_9_3: You mean show me the way?
JKXCCZST_9_5: Apologies. Our creator, the one who gave us speech, has been gone for a long time. Our knowledge module... needs fine-tuning.
JKXCCZST_9_6: If you can help us... We will... Thank you.
JKXCCZST_9_7: That person... Taught us... The one who helps... Tell them thank you, big thank you.
