Character_Cantarella_101_1: Let me think… the switch should be in the other room.
Character_Cantarella_102_1: Light floods the room again, but your keen senses tell you something is different.
Character_Cantarella_103_1: We've scoured every inch of the backstage, including every shadowed corner.
Character_Cantarella_103_2: It seems the Round Hat isn't here.
Character_Cantarella_104_1: Various paintings pile up in the art room, their pigments emitting a gentle glow. They all appear to have been painted recently. But... does someone as busy as Cantarella have the leisure to paint them?
Character_Cantarella_105_3: The doll thrusts a Round Hat into your hands with no further explanation.
Character_Cantarella_105_4: The red velvet of the hat gleams, as if coated in a girl's shimmering tears. It's like a maraschino cherry on a frosted cake. Sweet, yet bitter.
Character_Cantarella_106_1: At long last, the final performance.
Character_Cantarella_106_3: The Maiden's crown will soon appear—
Character_Cantarella_106_4: And rest upon one among you.
Character_Cantarella_107_4: Go. The front. Closer… clear… reassured.
Character_Cantarella_107_5:
The doll's broken words seem to suggest you step closer to the stage for a clearer view. 
But "reassured"… Who should feel reassured? You? Or the doll? The answer may lie ahead, once the performance begins.
Character_Cantarella_108_2: The doll's face is expressionless, yet its gaze lingers unmistakably on the lamp in your hand.
Character_Cantarella_109_1: The frequencies... are in such a disarray... It will be hard to switch between worlds now...
Character_Cantarella_113_2: And also Girl A, who couldn't speak but managed to send me that message.
Character_Cantarella_113_3: You want me to find her, right?
Character_Cantarella_114_1: We'd better watch ourselves! They might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine!
Character_Cantarella_114_2: How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!
Character_Cantarella_114_3: Will the lost souls truly return home?
Character_Cantarella_116_1: All those years of lying and scheming, and what have you gained?
Character_Cantarella_116_2: A tarnished reputation? You could have walked away from this, Cantarella.
Character_Cantarella_116_3: I still remember the little you. The youngest, the most neglected of all the Fisalias. You always lingered by your cauldron, and only smiled when a bird fluttered past the window.
Character_Cantarella_116_4: You despise this place, don't you? But the blood in your veins... it binds you, holds you prisoner in this endless nightmare.
Character_Cantarella_116_5: You loathe our rules, yet they have already seeped into your very existence.
Character_Cantarella_116_6: Tell me, have you ever considered leaving? Let go of this burden that crushes you, and you'll be free as air, free to live the life you've longed for.
Character_Cantarella_116_7: My dear lord, I've already gifted you the sweetest of dreams. But why do you still cling to this earthly burden?
Character_Cantarella_116_8: You watched with satisfaction as I climbed over the fallen, ascended the steps to glory, and wore the thorned crown... Was that not enough for you?
Character_Cantarella_116_9: Illusions are no match for poison, Cantarella. False bubbles burst, and here we are—the end of it all.
Character_Cantarella_116_10: Well, you see, illusions can also lead to true beauty.
Character_Cantarella_116_11: Your obsession, corrupted by whispers, has become a shadow over the castle… A deluge of delusions that shouldn't exist in this world.
Character_Cantarella_116_12: I can feel the pain those whispers inflicted upon you. Allow me to free you from them... once more!
Character_Cantarella_117_1: The abyss may reside in shadows, but even the deepest darkness cannot endure the touch of light.
Character_Cantarella_117_2: Your trust strengthens the lamp. It now burns brighter.
Character_Cantarella_118_1: Now is the time. Let the light shine brighter.
Character_Cantarella_119_1: Now! Free him from the Threnodian's whispers.
Character_Cantarella_120_1: We haven't fully banished the whispers. Watch out. The twisted obsession is returning to the shadow.
Character_Cantarella_121_2: My lord, I offered you the sweetest of dreams and safeguarded your legacy when you departed.
Character_Cantarella_121_3: I have entrusted Fisalia's true faith to one most deserving, and the Threnodian's deceptions in the Inverted Tower have been laid bare.
Character_Cantarella_121_4: No more whispers shall haunt us. Our children are freed from the cruel burdens of those trials.
Character_Cantarella_121_5: Now, you too shall find release from the Threnodian's whispers.
Character_Cantarella_121_8: Heh, nothing escapes your eyes, does it?
Character_Cantarella_121_10: In that hellish duel, Cantarella shielded us with illusions.
Character_Cantarella_123_1: Once Cantarella took charge of the family, she shielded us, keeping us safe in the castle's depths.
Character_Cantarella_123_2: The Order's members were always prying, eager to find out the truth... I knew if we went out recklessly, we'd only invite danger.
Character_Cantarella_123_3: Though... I really miss my home, more than I can say.
Character_Cantarella_123_4: Fortunately, Cantarella holds the Night of Remembrance every year. With our masks, we can slip away, even just for a while, back to our village.
Character_Cantarella_123_5: It's always a great comfort to see Jojo living happily and in good health.
Character_Cantarella_123_6: My dear, from this night forward, you're free to be with your families.
Character_Cantarella_123_7: The {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here has solved the riddles. Together, {Male=he;Female=she} and I will craft the elixir of revival.
Character_Cantarella_123_9: I think I'm getting the picture now.
Character_Cantarella_123_10: Since the Threnodian's lies were unraveled, the frequencies and situations on the outside have shifted.
Character_Cantarella_123_11: Thanks to you, the Order is now entangled in its own troubles, too distracted to reach into the Fisalias.
Character_Cantarella_123_12: Most deeply affected by the Threnodian's whispers was the castle—where the former head was trapped, where innocent girls were lost to the trials... As the Threnodian fell, all these frequencies broke out at once.
Character_Cantarella_123_13: The long-standing fear, pain, resentment, and repression—all that the whispers had suppressed burst free, becoming a new cage.
Character_Cantarella_123_14: The shackles of one's spirit were heavier than those from the outside. Yet, thanks to you, we shattered those shackles together.
Character_Cantarella_123_15: I knew then... the time had come for the girls to finally go home.
Character_Cantarella_123_16: I never meant to draw you into this. I was planning to shoulder it all alone. That's why for this year's Night of Remembrance I took part myself, and as host, I chose "ghost girls" as the theme.
Character_Cantarella_123_17: My plan was to break through the Sea of Ghosts, claim that I've solved the riddles and won the elixir of revival, and then use it to send the girls home when the Dance of the Dead begins at midnight.
Character_Cantarella_123_18: What about the letter I received?
Character_Cantarella_123_19: What about the influence on me?
Character_Cantarella_123_20: Your arrival, seemingly by chance, was perhaps destined.
Character_Cantarella_123_21: The letter wasn't my doing, but I think I know who brought you to my side.
Character_Cantarella_123_22: She had no intention of hurting you with the abnormal frequencies, but she had been in the twisted Sonoro for too long... long enough that she was nearly one with its frequencies.
Character_Cantarella_123_23: When I saw that letter and sensed something unusual about you, I realized you could no longer stay out of this matter. With a special constitution, you were affected by the frequencies overflowing from the Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_123_24: Looking back, my arrogance blinded me... Ah, forgive me, for showing you this weak side of myself.
Character_Cantarella_123_25: The currents here run deep, and the tangled seaweed is thick. Even I can easily become ensnared.
Character_Cantarella_123_26: But you… you helped me untangle these knots and weathered the torrents by my side.
Character_Cantarella_123_27: Thanks to you, the elixir was much easier to make. That's why I said, a skilled brewer is far more important than the ingredients or the process.
Character_Cantarella_123_28: Please, accept my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you for being here, and for staying by my side.
Character_Cantarella_123_29: Cantarella, you don't have to bear it all alone anymore! You've got someone you can truly count on now.
Character_Cantarella_123_30: Hehe, you're right. I have one last favor to ask, {PlayerName}. Could you take the elixir and see the girls home on my behalf?
Character_Cantarella_123_31: The Fisalia doesn't enjoy a good reputation, and some villagers would resist my presence. At this point, causing any complication is the last thing I want.
Character_Cantarella_123_32: You, however, as the Laureate who exposed the lies and turned the impossible into the possible, will carry a weight they can't ignore. If you're the one to handle this, the people will be convinced.
Character_Cantarella_123_33: Besides, even if the Order intends to look into this "miraculous revival" later, your status and capabilities will hold them back.
Character_Cantarella_123_34: But putting all that aside, it's with your effort that this elixir was possible. I can think of no one more fitting for this task.
Character_Cantarella_123_35: I'll help until all is settled.
Character_Cantarella_123_36: Don't you want to clear your name?
Character_Cantarella_123_37: Thank you. Both I, and the entire Fisalia family, will aid you in any way we can.
Character_Cantarella_123_38: Names are like sea foam that easily fades away. It hardly matters to me. Besides, it may not be a bad thing for people to stay wary of the Fisalias.
Character_Cantarella_123_39: After all, we're a large family, with deep-rooted issues. Change takes time.
Character_Cantarella_123_40: Girls, gather your things. It's time to go home.
Character_Cantarella_29_1: Is this still Porto-Veno Castle? Something feels… off.
Character_Cantarella_29_2: Yes and no. The past has spilled into the present here.
Character_Cantarella_29_3: The overflowing frequencies have enveloped the entire castle, forming this Sonoro, the Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_29_4: The voices of the ghosts rise faintly from the depths, like the soft pop of a bursting bubble. Listen closely to these whispers of the past.
Character_Cantarella_29_5: Piece together these fragile clues, and the answers will emerge on their own.
Character_Cantarella_29_6: But do take caution. One wrong step in these murky depths, and we may be drawn into an endless abyss…
Character_Cantarella_29_7: With a bit of light, though, we can hold back the darkness.
Character_Cantarella_30_1: Though the black of the sea is overwhelming, I've managed to preserve the last ray of light.
Character_Cantarella_30_2: You see, light is something that darkness can never fully devour.
Character_Cantarella_30_3: As long as it flickers, it can guide us out.
Character_Cantarella_30_4: I, Cantarella Fisalia, hereby grant {PlayerName} unrestricted passage through Porto-Veno Castle.
Character_Cantarella_30_5: Let us explore and weave through the past and future together.
Character_Cantarella_31_1: We are now in a fragment of the "past"… You've done well.
Character_Cantarella_31_3: The past that emerges from the Sea of Ghosts is not entirely real.
Character_Cantarella_31_4: It only reveals what it chooses to show, which means we must uncover the hidden truth ourselves.
Character_Cantarella_32_1: Spirits bound in the cracks of time, wander no more.
Character_Cantarella_32_2: Please, set them free with the light.
Character_Cantarella_32_3: They've been trapped here for far too long.
Character_Cantarella_33_1: A few written lines appeared on the surface, seemingly the last message left before the frequencies dispersed.
Character_Cantarella_35_1: It seems this little lamp has something to say. You may go ahead and touch it.
Character_Cantarella_36_1: See how it glows? It's time to use its power.
Character_Cantarella_37_1: Perhaps we need to switch to the right time.
Character_Cantarella_38_1: The dark sea is where treasures often hide.
Character_Cantarella_38_2: It's like how precious memories drift in the cracks of time.
Character_Cantarella_38_3: You may use your lamp to locate them.
Character_Cantarella_39_1: A pearl that shimmers but is out of reach is not necessarily an illusion.
Character_Cantarella_39_2: Let the lamp work its magic… for light can travel through time.
Character_Cantarella_40_1: In the depths of darkness, forgotten treasures await.
Character_Cantarella_40_2: Light holds the power to reveal their resting place.
Character_Cantarella_42_1: They've lingered here too long, tormented by agony and anger.
Character_Cantarella_44_1: Off you go, trapped little fish.
Character_Cantarella_45_1: Born of water, returned to water.
Character_Cantarella_47_1: The fluctuations you create can bring a brief calm to these restless frequencies.
Character_Cantarella_47_2: In other words, when you swiftly dodge their attacks or block with your weapon, the ghosts lurking in the cracks will be momentarily exposed before you.
Character_Cantarella_48_2: Just put it back on the right shelf, like how you did before.
Character_Cantarella_49_1: Well done. You never disappoint me.
Character_Cantarella_49_2: They say most questions can be answered in books, but can they really?
Character_Cantarella_50_1: The Divine Trials stand as a hallowed tradition of the Fisalia family, a ritual that demands every family member to offer their daughters to face the ordeal.
Character_Cantarella_50_2: Yet tales of these perils have driven some to seek out young girls resembling their own and use them as substitutes.
Character_Cantarella_50_3: These girls' parents are often offered a generous sum of money or sweet promises as compensation.
Character_Cantarella_50_4: Behind this intricate web stands the late head of Fisalia. To him, the Fisalia daughters who had been replaced were nothing more than "useless stones."
Character_Cantarella_50_5: The substitutes, however, he considered "rough gems" that could be polished into dazzling jewels through suffering.
Character_Cantarella_50_6: For him, regardless of blood, the Maiden must be a Fisalia. To this end, no sacrifice was too great.
Character_Cantarella_51_1: There are many footprints of varying sizes in the hall, all seem to belong to women, but only one is clear enough. Cantarella's footprints are among them.
Character_Cantarella_52_1: To avoid the watchful eyes, the girls formed secret pacts in whispers.
Character_Cantarella_52_2: "Hum a special tune," "use the right color," "knock on the door three times every two seconds"…
Character_Cantarella_52_3: In the cold, unfathomable sea, they clung to each other, seeking warmth and comfort.
Character_Cantarella_52_4: The little fish huddled close, unaware of who might vanish, or what tomorrow would bring.
Character_Cantarella_53_1: The Fisalia family is built on poison, and from a young age, every Fisalia child is introduced to it.
Character_Cantarella_53_2: Years of exposure gradually built up our resistance. At first, we suffered, but over time, few poisons could harm us.
Character_Cantarella_53_3: We are no longer merely the bearers of poison. We become the poison itself.
Character_Cantarella_55_3: Sweet dreams, girls. May you rest in peace.
Character_Cantarella_56_1: The answer remains submerged, yet from the ripples of the past, a familiar door rises.
Character_Cantarella_56_2: Maybe try knocking three times, as the girls once did. Knock, knock, knock...
Character_Cantarella_57_1: Hmm… It seems safe here. We can catch our breath amid the surging undercurrents.
Character_Cantarella_57_2: Even in the depths of the sea, there would be a place for resting, like the eye of a storm.
Character_Cantarella_57_3: Perhaps we should take a moment to explore this room. It seems like an ideal setting to gather our thoughts or simply rest.
Character_Cantarella_58_2: Young girls are always brimming with dreams.
Character_Cantarella_58_3: Though their bodies are caged, their hearts take flight, winging freely through realms of imagination.
Character_Cantarella_58_4: They recorded these ideas on paper, each word melting into a sweet candy to soothe their sorrows.
Character_Cantarella_58_5: I still remember there was a bookshelf that kept many such pure, sweet fantasies.
Character_Cantarella_59_2: Though time has yellowed these pages, the girls' laughter and joy still dance vividly across each line.
Character_Cantarella_59_3: But it remains trapped on paper, lost to time.
Character_Cantarella_60_4: Every girl came from different backgrounds, each with their own unique personality yet the same determination.
Character_Cantarella_60_5: Even as poison gnawed at their bodies, they never lost faith in a future where freedom might bloom.
Character_Cantarella_60_6: Little Chloe… I hope she's found peace somewhere, where no pain can reach her anymore.
Character_Cantarella_60_7: Forgive me that I can't tell you more while we remain trapped within the depths. Once we've explored the whole of this sea, the truth will rise to the surface.
Character_Cantarella_61_1: An aged diary rests before you, its pages filled with notes the girls once exchanged.
Character_Cantarella_61_2: The cute symbols, paired with messy handwriting, pull you back to those memories of long lost past—ones too painful to dwell on.
Character_Cantarella_62_1: The Sea Apples' crimson hue is so vivid that it almost burns the eyes.
Character_Cantarella_63_1: The jellyfish drift gracefully, their translucent forms gliding through the water. A Jellyrose Medusa sways its delicate tentacles, its rounded body resembling an elegant hat.
Character_Cantarella_63_2: It gestures behind you, and as you turn, an unexpected door stands in the center of the room.
Character_Cantarella_64_1: Before opening the door, have you ever imagined a scene where seawater rushes out, flooding everything before you…
Character_Cantarella_64_2: But for now, I don't think that will happen. We haven't quite reached the deep waters yet.
Character_Cantarella_64_3: Should we go now and see what the jellyfish are trying to say?
Character_Cantarella_64_5: I'd like to stay here a bit longer.
Character_Cantarella_64_6: Lovely. Don't forget to knock three times.
Character_Cantarella_64_7: Take your time. This place feels like a gentle embrace, one that makes you reluctant to leave.
Character_Cantarella_65_1: Darkness breeds the unknown, and the unknown gives birth to fear.
Character_Cantarella_65_2: In a place like this, the only anchor you can rely on is the faint light by your side.
Character_Cantarella_65_3: Trust its guidance. It will clear a path through the shadows and quell your fears.
Character_Cantarella_66_2: But can the glimmers from these delicate drifters truly light up the entire sea?
Character_Cantarella_67_1: In this spacious room, it's just you and Cantarella. Her gaze lingers on you, dark and endless, like a bottomless abyss.
Character_Cantarella_67_2: It seems like fate insists we move as one, side by side.
Character_Cantarella_67_3: In the realm of poison, none can rival the Jellyrose Medusa.
Character_Cantarella_67_4: Ah... a scent I know well. There's a Jellyrose Medusa, lying in wait just a little deeper.
Character_Cantarella_67_5: They tend to be wary when alone, their nerves quick to tingle at the slightest move.
Character_Cantarella_67_6: But worry not. I know what to do.
Character_Cantarella_68_1: The jellyfish drifts on the other side of the room, its movements slow and unhurried, as if the bookshelf's cover lends it courage.
Character_Cantarella_68_2: Ah, I know this bookshelf well.
Character_Cantarella_68_3: Today, it seems ambitious. Hungry enough to devour two books at once.
Character_Cantarella_69_1: Are we prisoners to the insatiable appetite for knowledge, or to the ever-expanding void?
Character_Cantarella_69_2: Yet I trust your eyes. They'll see through the tricks hidden within.
Character_Cantarella_70_1:
Many books seem to have been leafed through, their pages adorned with sketches and annotations in diverse handwriting styles.
Judging by the fresh ink, these touches were added not long ago.
Character_Cantarella_71_1: An empty shell... the remnants that Past has left behind.
Character_Cantarella_71_2: Just one more to go—the shadow cast by Present.
Character_Cantarella_72_1: This one isn't picky. It's a mere accident born from the twists of time.
Character_Cantarella_72_2: Offer it any book, and it may reward your courage.
Character_Cantarella_73_2: Go ahead, knock upon the door where Future lies waiting.
Character_Cantarella_74_1: Ah, frightened away... our lethal yet delicate little friend.
Character_Cantarella_74_2: Looks like we need to handle these two first.
Character_Cantarella_75_1: A gentle glimmer lingers where the jellyfish once was, as though it is trying to tell you something.
Character_Cantarella_76_1: Hebenon... She was such a timid girl, like a frightened rabbit.
Character_Cantarella_76_2: She'd peek out from behind Mandragora, her little face half-hidden.
Character_Cantarella_76_3: She cried so often... I still remember the day she brought me tea laced with mercury. Her hands trembled so much, tears spilling into the cup as she tried to serve it.
Character_Cantarella_77_1: Look. There it is, just a step away.
Character_Cantarella_78_1: Heh, it seems everyone desires the deadliest jellyfish.
Character_Cantarella_78_2: Expired obsessions rarely know when to stop.
Character_Cantarella_79_1: All roads lead to our destination. Let's explore another way, shall we?
Character_Cantarella_80_1: These walls can't withstand the erosion of water.
Character_Cantarella_80_2: Let's return to the embrace of the underwater realm.
Character_Cantarella_81_2: Mandragora, just like her name, was a bright yet lethal flower.
Character_Cantarella_81_3: Oh, please don't misunderstand. "Lethal" is the highest praise for a Fisalia.
Character_Cantarella_81_4: She clung to every teaching of the head of our family, shaping herself so meticulously that her thoughts and her very self vanished, lost to the family's cold framework.
Character_Cantarella_81_5: I saw the weight of what she gave for that trial, all for a cause that was barely worthy of her sacrifice.
Character_Cantarella_81_6: So, when she served me the scone dipped in the essence of Jellyrose, I didn't hesitate to swallow it all.
Character_Cantarella_81_7: She was much tougher than Hebenon, but still, behind her unwavering gaze, I caught a flicker of reluctance, a shadow of something almost tender.
Character_Cantarella_81_8: As for the poison, the sensation was... I felt like I was drowning in slow waves, my body twitching without control and my vision slipping into a soft blur...
Character_Cantarella_81_9: And somewhere, within that haze, I saw us transformed. Birds, perhaps, dancing on a sunlit shore, carefree and joyful.
Character_Cantarella_81_10: But then, I woke up... There was no sunlit shore around, and I lay here, as ever, in this cold abyss.
Character_Cantarella_83_1: There's nothing left here that deserves your grasp.
Character_Cantarella_85_1: Seems like this little one is ready for a "duel," trying to take your life with its venom. But I despise unnecessary fights... Hand it to me.
Character_Cantarella_85_2: Yes, just place it gently here.
Character_Cantarella_85_5: Nothing fret about, dear. I've long since made my peace with poison.
Character_Cantarella_85_6: This jellyfish, a remnant of the past, can't harm me now.
Character_Cantarella_85_7: You have such a kind heart, {PlayerName}… Always ready to take on burdens, even while carrying your own.
Character_Cantarella_85_8: But some weights belong only to those who've already weathered their storms. So, let me bear this one.
Character_Cantarella_85_10: Come now. We've more to uncover.
Character_Cantarella_86_1: Jellyfish have no voice. They simply drift in the tide, struggling to let their faint glow disperse the darkness.
Character_Cantarella_86_2: Yet here it is, a small shimmer of light, escaping the grip of the past to reach us now.
Character_Cantarella_87_1: Ah, it seems a subtle shift has taken place... I can smell danger...
Character_Cantarella_87_2: Let's look closely and see what new presence lingers here.
Character_Cantarella_88_2: The waves came crashing, eager to snuff out every spark they found.
Character_Cantarella_88_3: Poison and whispers slithered in, seeking to clip every wing.
Character_Cantarella_88_4: Sweet dreams were shelved away, locked tight… only to wither into silent, brittle tears.
Character_Cantarella_89_1: You sense an ominous presence emanating from the bookshelf.
Character_Cantarella_89_2: The next moment, it takes shape before you.
Character_Cantarella_90_1: The girls' despair seeps from the book's pages, winding around your heart.
Character_Cantarella_90_2: You press the book shut, your chest tight, and draw a deep breath to steady yourself.
Character_Cantarella_91_4: Hebenon was fragile, an easy prey to the Threnodian's whispers.
Character_Cantarella_91_5: She was never suited to be the Maiden. Truthfully, being chosen would never be an honor.
Character_Cantarella_91_6: So, it was a good thing she wasn't chosen. Both she and Mandragora vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.
Character_Cantarella_91_7: As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.
Character_Cantarella_91_8: Ah, Mandragora. She was so… rigid, so willing to bend to the rules, even if they were impossible.
Character_Cantarella_91_9: I wish she could have seen that in this world, there's more than rigid obedience. Many things are far more precious.
Character_Cantarella_91_10: Both she and Hebenon vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.
Character_Cantarella_91_11: As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.
Character_Cantarella_91_12: Why? I stand perfectly well right before you.
Character_Cantarella_91_13: Tears wouldn't grant me mercy, and I never intended to blindly follow rules that were never meant to be kind.
Character_Cantarella_91_14: I earned my place my own way. That's why I stand here now, able to share this with you.
Character_Cantarella_92_1: An old diary, with exchanged notes between young girls.
Character_Cantarella_92_2: The tiny, endearing symbols and untidy scrawls pull you into the memories of that harsh, unforgiving trial again.
Character_Cantarella_93_1: Sea Apples flourish in wild clusters. Under the shimmering water, their red hues look almost freakingly bright.
Character_Cantarella_94_1: The Jellyrose Medusa drifts lazily nearby, its long tentacles weaving strands of both fortune and misfortune.
Character_Cantarella_95_1: A doll wearing a red hat has appeared on the table out of nowhere, drawing your attention.
Character_Cantarella_95_2: You recall someone saying it is a symbol of fortune.
Character_Cantarella_95_3: "As long as you follow the Divinity, luck will surely be on your side!"
Character_Cantarella_95_5: You are lost in thought as a door silently appears behind you.
Character_Cantarella_96_1: There's a weight to the air behind. A mixture of whispers from the deep, dried tears, and the stale, lingering scent of blood.
Character_Cantarella_96_2: Behind this is the deep water zone.
Character_Cantarella_96_3: Are you ready to face the relentless surges? The place ahead is beyond the reach of light, like the night sky devoid of stars, hungry to consume everything within.
Character_Cantarella_96_5: I'd like to stay here a little longer.
Character_Cantarella_96_6: It will be dark and murky there. Please, stay close to me.
Character_Cantarella_96_7: Hmm, we do need to be well-prepared before diving into the depths... both in body and mind.
Character_Cantarella_97_1: The doll's lifeless face stares at you as a prickling unease crawls up your spine.
Character_Cantarella_97_2: Final performance. Begins soon. Hat, unfit.
Character_Cantarella_97_3: Help me. Bring the Round Hat.
Character_Cantarella_97_5: You're talking about Round Hat's final perforrmance...
Character_Cantarella_97_9: The doll remains still, offering no response.
Character_Cantarella_97_10: The doll hesitates for a moment, then lowers its head, remaining silent.
Character_Cantarella_97_12: The doll stands still, responding to your generosity with silence.
Character_Cantarella_97_13: The doll stands still, responding to your teasing with silence.
Character_Cantarella_97_16: You're affected by that jellyfish, aren't you?
Character_Cantarella_97_17: No, it's… merely some old memories resurfacing. Don't worry. I'm quite well.
Character_Cantarella_97_18: When I entered this place, I knew that certain memories would seek me out, even if I did not wish for them to.
Character_Cantarella_97_19: Seems I'm not as resilient as I thought…
Character_Cantarella_99_1: Here, the past and future, dreams and reality, are intricately intertwined, inseparably bound.
Character_Cantarella_99_2: The chaotic frequencies here might have trapped the light.
Character_Cantarella_99_3: Let's try once more, gently. Patience and encouragement always help.

HelpText_201_Content:
[Whimpering Wastes]
In Whimpering Wastes, your skills will be tested through multiple challenge stages. Completing each stage will earn you points. Earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Waters]
Whimpering Wastes features three areas: <color=#c19f51>[Forbidden Waters], [Respawning Waters: Chasm], [Respawning Waters: Torrents]</color>. Complete all challenges within the preceding area to unlock the following.

[Tokens]
In Whimpering Wastes, every team must equip Tokens which grant special effects during combat. Completing a challenge consumes one Token use. Token use can be restored by [Resetting] the challenge.

[Area Effects]
Whimpering Wastes feature special environmental effects and enemies.

[Respawn Cycle]
Rewards for [Forbidden Waters] can only be claimed once. However, <color=#c19f51>the challenges and rewards of [Respawning Waters: Chasm] and [Respawning Waters: Torrents] will reset periodically</color> with varied content and effects. When the cycle resets, your progress will be cleared, and you can challenge again to claim rewards.

RGZYYYGJZ_33_23: The world inside the mirror seems no different from reality, yet it is only a projection of memories, past, and desires. As Carlotta explores her surroundings and interacts with the family members, she realizes the hand that dragged her into this world belongs to her mirror self. To escape, she needs to find her mirror self.
RGZYYYGJZ_37_17:
Carlotta demands that her mirror self reveal the way out. However, this reflection, sharing the same memories, past, and desires, exposes Carlotta's complex emotions—her fear of abandonment, gratitude for her family's protection, and relentless drive to live as their blade, bringing honor to the Montelli name.
Why, then, does she reject the perfect life offered in the mirror?
Frustrated, the mirror self recreates the "stormy night," forcing Carlotta to prove her worth and make up for regrets once more.
RGZYYYGJZ_42_22:
During an attack by Fisalia, Padrino is gravely injured. As senior members like Capollo gather to devise a plan, for the first time, they turn to Carlotta for advice. She seizes the moment to voice what she couldn't on that fateful day, "hit Fisalia's base."
Carlotta proposes evacuating the exposed headquarters while launching an offensive against Fisalia's key locations, volunteering to stay behind and cover the retreat.
RGZYYYGJZ_44_24:
Reality is completely different—no one listened to Carlotta's opinions that day. The family's wrong decision led to the tragic fall of the headquarters. Duncan lost his last family member, and Padrino was left to hold the family together despite his injuries.
Now, Carlotta's mirror self reveals the harsh truth: she has never been trusted to lead. 
Tempted by an illusory perfect future, Carlotta steels herself against the deception, resolved to stop Capollo.
Her defiance enrages the mirror self, who then traps her in an endless labyrinth.
RGZYYYGJZ_480_5:
As Carlotta's mirror self begins to fade, she desperately questions the real Carlotta about what makes them different. 
Carlotta, however, silently walks past her and joins your side, beginning to share the beginning of her story with you.
RGZYYYGJZ_25_10: You arrive at the bank as Carlotta said, looking for the expert in Terminal studies named Pierre.

MapMark_302001_MarkDesc:
Mist rises over the sea, carrying echoes from all directions—songs, the creak of windmills, and the bustling noise of city streets. For sailors weary from the monotony of life at sea, these sounds become an irresistible siren call. Entranced, they steer their ships toward the heart of the mist, unaware they are sailing straight into the Tacet Discord's trap…
But as in every tale where despair festers, a glimmer of hope is bound to emerge. Even in these treacherous waters, someone will break the storm and waves and bring light to all.

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

InstanceDungeon_9001_Desc:
Vast and desolate, this land serves as the grave for countless Pilgrim's Sails. The colossal, dragon-shaped Tacet Discord relentlessly devours the nearby frequencies, and Remnant Clouds draw Tacet Discords to gather—never lower your guard when traversing this forsaken isle.

[Note]
Resonators of different heights in Solaris run at different speeds.
InstanceDungeon_9002_Desc:
A vault, boasting priceless Echoes and artifacts, rises above the ethereal waters. As you soar overhead, you may find yourself swimming in a sea of pure white clouds.

[Note]
Resonators of different heights in Solaris run at different speeds.
InstanceDungeon_9003_Desc:
In the chilling winds, faint, lingering tunes echo through the eternal night. Beneath the moonlight and the veil of mist, a long path to the unknown seems to unfold before you.

[Note]
Resonators of different heights in Solaris run at different speeds.
InstanceDungeon_9004_Desc:
The towering spire stands atop Thessaleo Fells like a lone swordfish, once separated from its school but ever poised to rule the deep sea. It constantly draws energy from the sea of clouds, forging a sinful crown.

[Note]
Resonators of different heights in Solaris run at different speeds.
InstanceDungeon_9005_Desc:
Sail across a serene lake embraced by dense woods, then venture across vast mountain ranges and dark caverns to witness the scenery hidden at the journey's ends.

[Note]
Resonators of different heights in Solaris run at different speeds.
InstanceDungeon_9006_Desc:
Fierce Tacet Discords circle the skies, while the remnants of fallen trees scatter the path. The air is thick with the scent of an approaching storm. Only by enduring the thunder and gusting winds can you reach the land of peace.

[Note]

HelpText_202_Content:
[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.

[Reminder]

Resonators of different heights run at different speeds.

HelpText_203_Content:
[About]

Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your exploration record at the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards! 

[Eligibility] 

Reach Union Level 14. 

[Event Rules] 

During the event, you can complete event objectives once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. 

Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards. 

There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
Character_Brant_3_46:
You find yourself stumbling into Brant and Battier's bet. Just as they get into a heated debate, you manage to catch the winning King Fish.
Now, you've become the Captain of the Day for the troupe.
Character_Brant_13_44:
While having dinner, Battier hands you half of a lucky coin.
Brant recognizes that it belongs to the legendary adventurer, Captain Drake, which may lead to treasures beyond imagination.
A troupe member, Hymer, shares information on the other half's whereabouts. You and Brant set off on its search.
Character_Brant_16_35:
You come across Bella and inquire her about the coin.
The noblewoman with an odd obsession with good luck charms grudgingly reveals a sad truth: The coin has been stolen. Brant, known for being theatrical, applies his way of responding to the circumstances. Through his unique approach, he attracts everyone's attention and shares the story of the lucky coin!
Time to join in that act with Brant and dig out that lucky person.
Character_Brant_26_34:
You make quick work of the thief and pin him down. According to your lucky gentleman, the coin was taken by a pirate named Aldric.
You also learn that this pirate is planning something big at Egla Town at midnight tonight.
That doesn't sound good! Better find out what he's up to quickly, Captain!
Character_Brant_27_18:
You and Brant find yourselves bumping into a grand gathering right in the middle of Egla Town.
As much as you'd love to stoke some fires, it's best to keep a low profile and avoid alerting the pirates.
But worry not, Brant has come up with a wonderful plan as he puts something on you, and just like that, you've transformed into the superstars of tonight's Plushie Gathering, Cuddle Wuddle and Lottie Lost!
Look out, Aldric, a surprise is coming your way.
Character_Brant_36_31:
Having lost the coin to you, Aldric makes a break for it amidst the chaos.
You finally have the map. To the treasure!
There's a troupe Gondola docked at the passenger port. Time to give the steering some spin!
Character_Brant_49_10: You run into Aldric's underlings, but they don't seem to be in a talking mood. All they care about is showing you what pirates are made of.
Character_Brant_51_10: After finding out that Brant is the Flaming Returned, the pirates immediately surrender.
Character_Brant_53_14:
The pirates reveal Aldric's next destination to you.
Time to pay him a visit.
Character_Brant_56_24:
Aldric suggests a truce and a partnership, where he'll hand you the key under a 60/40 split in your favor once the treasure is found.
You agree to this partnership while also keeping a close eye on him. You're well prepared by the time he goes back on his words and makes his move.
Character_Brant_66_28:
You reach the treasure's location and meet Aldric once again.
Aldric plays his old trick, trying to fool you into doing all the hard work of getting the treasure.
Just as Brant uses the coin to obtain the nautical chart, Aldric snatches the chest, declaring he wants all the treasure for himself. Sure, he's free to claim the treasure for himself, but such freedom always comes with a price.
Character_Brant_70_40: After finally making it back to the gondola, Brant shares with you stories of the past, the present, and the nautical chart.
Character_Brant_71_14:
As the adventure comes to an end, the troupe grants you the title of Honorary Captain.
Brant passes on Drake's nautical chart to you, insisting that if you ever come across new adventures in the future, remember to count him in the action.
Character_Brant_33_42:
Over at Egla Town square, Aldric makes a speech with the coin in hand, dreaming about having everyone kiss his boots.
To make his fantasy come to fruition, he plans to catch every Echo he can find in the area. He even considers catching you and Brant.
There's no way you're going to allow that to happen. Time for the brave Captain and the star of the show to give Aldric a taste of his own medicine!

HelpText_198_Content:
[Recommended Attributes]

On the Echo Selection page, use "Suggest" to open the filter. This allows you to check the most commonly used Mainstats and Substats for the current Resonator and quickly filter out suitable Echoes.

While switching between "All," "COST 1," "COST 3," and "COST 4" Echoes on the Echo List on the left, the recommended attributes will adjust accordingly.

[Recommended Sonata Effects]

On the Resonator - Echo page, use "Suggest" to check the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator.

Use "Auto Equip" to equip all Echoes that best match the selected Sonata Effect.

On the Sonata Selection and Sonata Gallery pages, the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator will be marked with a thumb-up icon.


[Data Updates]

The recommendations are based on data collected from recently active players and refresh every Wednesday at 00:00 (server time). Actual refresh may experience some delay.

If there is not enough data, default recommendations generated by the system will be displayed instead.
HelpText_199_Content:
Echo Presets allow you to easily save and apply customized Echo lineups for your Resonator.

[Saving Presets]

Select the "Current Setup" column and use "Save As Preset" to save the equipped Echo lineup for the Resonator.

Each preset can be named to your liking. Please ensure the names follow local laws and regulations.

You can save up to 20 Echo Presets. If you reach the limit, you will need to delete an existing preset to create a new one.

[Applying Presets]

Select any saved preset and use "Apply" to equip the preset to the current Resonator.

GuideTutorialPage_32035_Content: This Tacet Discord enters a defensive state when its Vibration Strength is low. Attack it by then to <color=#ffd12f>Break its hand defense</color> and <color=#ffd12f>immobilize</color> it.
GuideTutorialPage_32036_Content:
The Aero Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Aero</color> DMG.

It targets a nearby ally, granting itself a constant buff that enables it to keep attacking. Once the selected target is defeated, the Aero Prism ceases attacking.

The Aero Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent buff for the Herons after the absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_33020_Content:
Familiar gateways are appearing throughout Rinascita. Interact with these gateways to enter the Somnoire.

Venture into the gateway and help restore the corrupted Memory Zones!
GuideTutorialPage_33021_Content:
Interact with the Fishing Spot to fish.

Some Fishing Spots require specific Fishing Abilities. Acquire the corresponding Fishing Abilities to gain access to these spots.
GuideTutorialPage_33022_Content:
Various frequencies gather beneath the waters of the Riccioli Islands. Ghost Medusas appear at night.

As you sail and fish, your Threat Level to these waters increases. Higher Threat Level attracts fiercer Ghost Medusas.

However, on a high Threat Level, <color=#ffd12f>catch quality</color> will be higher, and the chance to catch <color=#ffd12f>Mutants</color> will increase.
GuideTutorialPage_33023_Content:
You may switch between Fishing Abilities on your voyage with the wheel.

Using this feature wisely makes your fishing trips more efficient and rewarding.
GuideTutorialPage_33024_Content:
Under the influence of the Sentinel or the Threnodian, mutants can be found among the many species in the sea.

Mutants can always be found at the Fishing Spots of their original species.

Enhancing Phoebe's Fishing Abilities or fishing in the areas where Ghost Medusas appear at night can increase the chance of catching Mutants.
GuideTutorialPage_33025_Content:
To catch the "biggest fish," you'll need a bigger ship. Captain Ahab has just one, but it really needs some repairs.

Provide Queequeg with a design print, logs, and Fishery Coins, and he'll handle the rest for you.
GuideTutorialPage_34120_Content: Board the train Echo and steer it along the tracks.
GuideTutorialPage_3412002_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Board and steer the Echo Train, choose its path, and control mechanisms along the way.
GuideTutorialPage_3412003_Content:
Some tracks within Averardo Vault are under maintenance. Use the switches to ensure the train stays on <color=#ffd12f>tracks that allow passage</color>.

If the train is on the wrong track, it will automatically return.
GuideTutorialPage_34121_Content: A device designed to switch train tracks. The displayed direction on the device shows the current track the train is following. Use the Clearance Device to change the track direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34122_Content: A Clearance Device specially prepared by Carlotta, granting you the highest level of access within Averardo Vault. Verify your clearance at designated security rooms in the vault to increase your Clearance Level and unlock additional functions.
GuideTutorialPage_3412202_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

You can control various mechanisms within the vault with this device.
GuideTutorialPage_34123_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to turn the hostile security Echoes in the vault into allies. In this state, they will prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else.
 
If an allied Echo is too far from the Clearance Device or the Clearance Device is not equipped, it will revert to its hostile state.
 
*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.
GuideTutorialPage_3412302_Content:
The Clearance Device can only control a limited number of Echoes. Once this limit is reached, you won't be able to control any additional Echoes.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to increase the number of Echoes you can control simultaneously.

*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.
GuideTutorialPage_34124_Content: Interact with the mechanisms in the security rooms to upgrade your Clearance Level and unlock more functions.
GuideTutorialPage_3412402_Content:
Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Clearance Command - Security Mechanism: Upgrade your Clearance Level to gain access to a broader range of security mechanisms.


Authorization Command - Echo Control:

Level 1: Converts the target to your ally, making it prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else. However, this effect will be revoked and the Echo will return to its default state if a friendly Echo is not within the effective range of the Clearance Device or when the Clearance Device is not equipped as Utility.

Level 2: The controlled Echoes will actively attract enemies' attacks.

Level 3: The number of Echoes you can control is increased to 2.
GuideTutorialPage_34125_Content: You can use the Clearance Device to control the movements of the silenced Vitreum Dancers.
GuideTutorialPage_3412502_Content:
Due to limited functionality, the Vitreum Dancer can only perform straight-line dashes in four directions. 

Keep it within the camera's authentication range to unlock security doors.

HelpText_204_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Phoebe, Jinhsi, Shorekeeper, Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!

Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Resonance Skill grants 50 Dreamscape Energy, and healing a Resonator with Resonance Skill grants another 50 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Damaging a target affected by Spectro Frazzle grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%.  Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

HelpText_207_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Brant, Changli, Encore, Chixia, Mortefi. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!

Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Intro Skill grants 100 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Dealing Fusion DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. InstanceDungeonEntrance_9000_Description:
[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.

[Reminder]

Resonators of different heights run at different speeds.

FavorRoleInfo_1206_Info:
Brant, the captain of Rinascita's Troupe of Fools, is a free spirit and romantic. Unpredictable and full of life, he is the beating heart of the troupe.

On stage, he slips into countless roles, donning new masks to breathe life into every story. Yet beyond the spotlight, he is unwaveringly genuine, offering nothing but true sincerity to those around him.
FavorRoleInfo_1206_TalentDoc: [Troupe Medic Benir's Notes (Unnumbered)] I still recall that night as if it were yesterday. My first real trial after joining the troupe. Storm clouds blanketed the sea, and rain pounded down in sheets while monstrous waves threatened to capsize our ship at any moment. We were tossed about like driftwood, the helmswoman lost in the chaos, the ship spinning through the tempest. I huddled in the cabin, trembling as fear seeped through me. Then I saw him. There, atop the mast, stood the captain. The Tacet Mark on his chest shone like St. Elmo's Fire, a beacon showing us the way. "Steady now, my friends!" I heard his voice cut through the howling wind, "Follow my command! Hard to starboard!" The crew rallied at once, the disarray falling away as they returned to their posts with newfound focus. I quickly jotted down in my notes: While I lack the tools to confirm it, I am certain of one thing—Captain Brant is a Natural Resonator. The flames he conjures can light our way, even in the darkest of seas! Interestingly, I often catch Captain Brant spinning in the air during combat. Is it a trick to sharpen his sense of direction, or his secret to navigating the seas? I do hope someone finds the courage to ask him. I'm dying to know!

The Time Domain pattern is regular, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results fall within the normal phase range. Resonant Criticality: High. This test subject displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking. Records indicate no history of Overclocking. ... Approval Verdict: Stable. The Troupe of Fools' application is approved. They will assume full responsibility for any unforeseen incidents during the performance. Note from a certain captain: Mark my words, not a thing will go awry!
FavorRoleInfo_1506_Info: Phoebe, Acolyte of the Order of the Deep, is a young woman of quiet devotion. With a kind heart, she fulfills her duties with unwavering diligence. Her prayers, like the light she carries, offer comfort and peace to all.
FavorRoleInfo_1506_TalentDoc: [Excerpt of Letter of Recommendation from the Order Orphanage] The moment I saw the glowing Tacet Mark on her upper left thigh, I knew immediately that this was a blessing from Imperator. ...Her Resonance Ability allowed her to manifest light, refracting it into various forms of prisms. Even on the darkest nights, when the storm has snuffed out all other light, she fills every room with a soft, radiant glow. A light so comforting it conveys the very essence of hope in the darkest of times. As written in the Tenets of the Deep, such light must have always existed in her heart, a sign of her relentless devotion... *This record has been transferred from the Orphanage to the Order of the Deep's archives. We have reason to believe that Acolyte Initiate Phoebe's unparalleled Resonance ability stems from her unwavering faith in the Divinity. This is demonstrated by the rapport between her and the Echoes, a connection that has reinforced the trust some of our faithful have in her. Her active involvement in charitable works has already earned her recognition, therefore we have voted unanimously to grant her the title of Acolyte after her novitiate. However, some within the Order believe that her closeness with the Echoes violates the Order's doctrines. The blessings of the Divine Envoys are to be shared equitably, as the Sentinel's love for Their people is impartial and untainted by favoritism. Being too close to the Divine Envoys could lead to unforeseen risks. For this reason, we do not recommend her appointment to the Servitude Hall, and believe it would be most prudent to transfer her to the Ministry of Holy Rituals instead...

Acolyte Phoebe has always strictly adhered to the teachings of "silence" and "self-restraint," making her stability unmatched among her peers. Observations show that Acolyte Phoebe's Resonance ability produces a stable frequency, strongly affecting Echoes and Remnant Creatures. Humans can also be affected to a certain degree, experiencing "healing" on a spiritual level.
