InstanceDungeon_1101002_DungeonDesc:
A precise and powerful battle machine that has been refitted with special technology. It carries out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. As an unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat. When needed, it activates a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.
InstanceDungeon_1101003_DungeonDesc:
Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins. With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.
InstanceDungeon_1101004_DungeonDesc:
A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. 

Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. 

Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix.

POI_JINKU_1_15:
You receive a letter from Carlotta inviting you to Averardo Vault as an intermediary for an escort mission.
After accepting the request, Zani gives you special security clearance prepared by the Montelli family upon your arrival at the vault.
POI_JINKU_11_15: Zani mentions rumors about a "secret cache" inside the Averardo Vault and suspects it's what the thief is after.
POI_JINKU_14_23: You encounter a vault employee who claims to be Lily, but she can't remember why she is there. Although you find Lily's identity suspicious, for her own safety, you invite her to accompany you.
POI_JINKU_15_21:
You use your access to review the surveillance footage, while learning from Lily that she has been working at the vault for at least twenty years, and the "Ash" you encountered earlier was actually an imposter with a stolen employee ID.
In order to recover the security module, you decide to take the train to the Echo depository.
POI_JINKU_2_23: You and Zani head off to meet the representative from the Order. To Zani's surprise, it is Phoebe, the Acolyte who joined your adventure before.
POI_JINKU_22_18:
You find a note left behind by Ash for his family, mentioning a treasure deep within the Averardo Vault. You make the assumption that this is where the imposter obtained clues about the "secret cache."
You must get to "Ash" before he can trigger more defense systems.
POI_JINKU_28_19: Seeing there's no end to this chase, you decide to use the vault's defense systems to guide "Ash" towards the Echo train terminus and intercept him there.
POI_JINKU_40_7:
You manage to find "Ash," but he jumps onto a train before you can grab him.
Still, everything is going as planned. The train runs on a single rail, and the final stop is where you will catch him.
POI_JINKU_43_24: You unexpectedly arrive at an unmarked area on the map. Here, Lily seems to recall some memories.
POI_JINKU_53_22:
You defeat the Echo guards and corner "Ash." Lily now remembers everything: She, along with many researchers and artists, had been imprisoned by the Order and were deprived of their rights to research and create.
The Montelli family built a sanctuary deep within the vault to protect them. They lived their final moments here.
Lily's soul can finally rest in peace. Before leaving, she urges "Ash" to check the vault's secret cache.
POI_JINKU_55_13:
Ash learns about his grandfather's fate and the truth about the vault's secret cache. He will now bear the consequences of his actions.
The path has been opened. It's time to leave.
POI_JINKU_56_9: You discover that the "secret cache" is actually a tree, and the item the Order requested the Montelli family to transport was a bomb that would react to the Reverberations in the vault.
POI_JINKU_8_11:
After finally arriving at the security room, Zani informs you that to leave the vault you must use your clearance to access its deepest area.
She suggests you utilize the vault's cameras to avoid any possible defense systems.
POI_JINKU_9_22: After reviewing all the surveillance footage, you discover that a person named "Ash" might have taken the vault's security module. You'll need to find Ash to leave.
HelpText_219_Content:
[About]

To the north of Ragunna City lies Rinascita's largest fishing ground: the Riccioli Islands, an enticing destination for an intriguing adventure. Ready your sails and prepare for the vast blue waters, Captain!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock (complete quest "Silent as a Falling Leaf" for the best experience).

[Event Rules]

During the event, join Phoebe on a captivating voyage in the Riccioli Islands. Steer the Gondola "Rachel" and fish for unique, local species to boost your Fame and become a true fishing master!

Throughout the limited-time reward period, complete special goals to earn Nameless Coins. Collect enough Nameless Coins to claim the Rectifier "Ocean's Gift" (including its weapon projection).

Nameless Coins can be used to redeem rewards at the limited-time event shop. Please make sure to claim your rewards before the event concludes.

Any unclaimed rewards will be automatically sent to your inbox if you log in within 30 days after the reward period. However, unredeemed rewards will not be delivered to your inbox.

After the limited-time reward period, you can still participate in the event and claim the Chanty Bounty permanent rewards.

InfoDisplay_21020104_Text:
Subject: Welcome aboard the Echo Train of Averardo Vault!
 
To facilitate your business within the Averardo Vault, we are pleased to offer the Echo Train service. These unique Echoes will swiftly transport you to various areas within the Vault.
 
For your safety, please adhere to the following guidelines:
 
1. The Echo Train is gentle in nature, but please refrain from feeding or attacking it. Doing so may cause it to veer off course or even fall off the tracks if startled.
 
2. During the journey, you may enjoy the view through the train's window. Please do not extend any part of your body out the window. If you find that this rule has already been violated, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
3. Averardo Vault only contains depositories, storage facilities, and small decorative sculptures. There are no statues or structures with a height of around ▇▇▇, resembling a ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇. If you encounter such a structure during your ride, remind yourself that it is merely an illusion caused by the Vault's enclosed environment and promptly avert your gaze. If you continue to perceive the structure, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
4. You may call the Echo Train via your Terminal, and it will typically arrive within three minutes. If the train fails to arrive within this time frame, leave the station immediately and report the delay to the Vault staff at the front desk. Do not board any train arriving after the three-minute window.
 
5. The Echo Train within the vault is designed to resemble a fish. It has no limbs, legs, or tentacles. If you notice that the train's appearance deviates from this, do not board it. Instead, call for another Echo Train and wait until the abnormal train has left the platform.
 
6. If you violate any of the above rules, promptly leave the platform and inform the nearest Vault staff. If you have already boarded the train, immediately throw this flyer out the window. The train will proceed to the nearest station, where Vault staff will be waiting to escort you out. Please refrain from engaging in conversation or making eye contact with the staff.
InfoDisplay_21020105_Text:
Subject: Averardo Vault Tour Guide (Underground Depository Zone)
 
Welcome to Averardo Vault! We hope you have a wonderful and unforgettable time here.
 
The main areas of the Underground Depository are as follows:
 
1. Precious Metals and Artworks Depository
This section primarily stores valuable metals and rare artworks. Some of the items are displayed to the public on a rotating basis. Below is a partial list of recommended exhibits for this month:

Stern's Ceramic Jar
The beloved ceramic jar of the famous comedian Arthur Stern! After receiving the Laurel, he retired from the stage to focus on the art of pottery. This jar is one of twelve masterpieces he personally painted.
Recommendation Rating: Five Stars!

"Deepening Stars"
The painting of an anonymous artist, depicting the starlight reflected from beneath the abyss. Critics have debated the theme of this piece for years, making it a highly controversial and discussed piece.
Recommendation Rating: Three Stars!
 
2. Echo Depository (Currently Closed)
This section primarily houses Echoes.
Important: The Echo Depository is no longer open to visitors.
 
3. [Data Deleted]
InfoDisplay_21020106_Text:
[Work Log]
 
8:30 AM: Clocked in. Today's task is to perform an inventory check of the artworks inside the depository. Great, let's get to work.
 
12:00 PM: Lunch break. A new guy tried to ask me about the rumors surrounding the "secret cache." It's honestly surprising how long these baseless rumors have managed to stick around. Even if there was some secret cache, it's not like that's something we Level 1 folks are supposed to care about.
 
5:30 PM: Work is wrapping up for the day. On the Echo Train ride back, Jason thought it'd be fun to spook the newbie with one of those corny old ghost stories. Something about a mysterious, unmanned train that only runs at midnight and takes passengers to the Vault's "underworld." There, spirits of the dead rip apart anyone who dares trespass in their domain. I've heard enough of these kinds of stories. If there really were any mysterious trains, I would've seen one by now.
InfoDisplay_21020107_Text:
Bad news. A Chest Mimic somehow managed to sneak into the Vault and has hidden itself among the storage chests.
 
I've already alerted the guards. The Chest Mimic doesn't move on its own, so I suggest you stay away from this room until the guards arrive.
 
(Below the note is a hastily scrawled line in a different handwriting)
 
Don't even think about sending an Echo to inspect those storage chests. They'll just get gobbled up by the Chest Mimic... You really don't want to know how I found that out.
InfoDisplay_21020108_Text:
[Warning: For Vault Employees with Level 2 or Higher Clearance Only]
 
Due to the security risks posed by Fractsidus activities, the Family has decided to temporarily suspend the Ducat Auction. A date for its resumption will be announced in due course.
 
During this suspension, relevant staff members will be reassigned to other duties. The auction hall will temporarily be repurposed into a banquet hall and ballroom.
 
The official public statement for the suspension will be: "The auction center is undergoing renovations in line with applicable regulations from other regions." Employees are strictly prohibited from disclosing the true reason for the suspension to outsiders. Violators will be considered to have breached confidentiality and will face appropriate penalties.
InfoDisplay_21020109_Text:
Specimen Name: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

Specimen Description: A sub-species of the Spearback Tacet Discord obtained from the ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ region. Its strength and agility far surpass that of other Spearbacks. After receiving authorization, the expedition team successfully captured this specimen, with plans to use it for further research.

Specimen Status: Active. A dedicated experimental zone has been established for this specimen by the research team.
Experiment Plan: N/A
Experiment Goal: To reconfigure the frequencies that led to the formation of the specimen's abnormal physique, and attempt to apply the findings to other Echoes in order to enhance their performances.
InfoDisplay_21020110_Text:
...We successfully isolated the frequency responsible for the mutation in this specimen. When this frequency was tuned to match another Spearback Echo, it exhibited exceptional performance, far surpassing that of other specimens.
 
Unfortunately, the frequency proved too complex to replicate. The research team plans to secure the Echo specimen within the experimental zone for further combat and endurance testing.
InfoDisplay_21020111_Text:
We found some storage chests that clearly do not belong to the Echo Depository. They likely were left behind during a previous supply transfer.

There are no records related to these chests in the Vault, so their ownership is unverified. The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository has also refused to accept them.

The Echo Depository has no use for these materials, and they take up space here… but for now, there's no other option but to continue storing them here.

(Below the note, in a different handwriting, a hastily scrawled line reads)

These are not Vault assets. Whoever wants them can take them.
InfoDisplay_21020112_Text:
(A stack of papers rests here. They appear to be part of an unfinished novel or essay.)
 
...Ziegler was stranded on his private island, with only a coconut tree for company and the occasional Bell Crab scuttling across the beach.
 
Who was he? Ziegler Senior's son? Ragunna's most successful investor? The poor soul who lost everything in a gamble, with all his wealth and titles now gone? A mad artist? A hermit? The unfortunate fool who got caught in a shipwreck?
 
He gazed at the sea, the soft breeze lifting his graying hair while stirring the waves. In the golden glint of sunlight, he seemed to see countless versions of himself scattered through time, broken and incomplete. He felt a loneliness like never before, yet a strange sense of satisfaction.
 
He had no chance of leaving this island. Maybe tomorrow, or the day after, he would breathe his last breath under the scorching sun.
 
He had exhausted all of his miracles. The thought crossed his mind but quickly vanished without a trace. He decided to take some time to observe his island—to engrave all of its details deep into his mind, to fill his fragmented memories with them, and to hope that the coming darkness would not turn them to nothingness.
 
(The writing ends here.)
InfoDisplay_21020113_Text:
—O Supreme Sentinel, the Great Imperator, I have never questioned you.
 
You led us from the farthest reaches of the sea to this land, teaching us to walk the righteous path and embrace joy.
 
Yet those who claim to be your servants have distorted your teachings. The masses remain silent, while those who stand by the truth are banished here.
 
May you forge our faith into spears, and our suffering into hardened shields. May you… grant us vengeance, or at the very least, a merciful rest.
InfoDisplay_21020114_Text:
Malfunction Report: In the event of an Echo Train malfunction or abnormal operation, there is a possibility that staff members and visitors without Level 3 clearance may be mistakenly taken to this restricted area.
 
Course of Action: All Echo Trains will undergo recalibration, which is expected to be completed within 32 working days. Prior to this operation, a temporary set of instructions for boarding the Echo Train will be issued through flyers. 
 
If any anomalies occur during a ride, efforts will be made to guide passengers to the nearest station, where staff with Level 3 clearance will be on standby to evacuate passengers out of the vault.
 
Although passengers will be unable to enter this area due to insufficient clearance, choosing to disembark here due to rumors about the existence of the "secret cache" could lead to unnecessary complications. Therefore, it is essential to direct passengers away from this section.
 
Comment:
What do you say we create a story? Spread rumors about ghost trains with no return or mutated trains. This way, if passengers notice something unusual, they'll be more likely to seek our help immediately.
 
Response:
Approved. We will include this information in the flyers.
InfoDisplay_21020115_Text:
This isolation zone was constructed after the completion of the vault. Considering that certain research and specimens might pose security risks, the Family built this isolation zone on the island to house these projects. The zone is divided as follows:
 
Underground Floor 1: Echo Experimentation Area
Underground Floor 2: Item Storage Area (Decommissioned)
Warning: Items in the isolation zone are extremely dangerous. Please do not enter without proper authorization.
InfoDisplay_21020116_Text:
We ultimately failed to find a way to mass-produce enhanced Echoes. So, this Statue Echo may be the only significant result we were able to achieve. What's worse is that our own Echoes are no match for it in combat, so we haven't been able to collect any combat data.
 
The Family has decided to abandon the research and have us return to work at the Vault. However, I can't help but feel that this deserves a better conclusion. So, I've left behind some equipment capable of collecting combat data, which will be automatically saved to the Vault's server.
 
Whoever finds this, I hope you'll try giving it a go with the Echo. This way, we'll be able to obtain crucial data… Perhaps in the future, this data could be applied to practical use within the field of Echo research.
 
I've also left some rewards behind. If you succeed in defeating this Echo, they are yours to claim.
InfoDisplay_21020117_Text:
…

Nobody can carry on after bearing such a heavy fate. The tragedy deep underground fills us with sorrow. Thus, the wings that symbolize a long journey fold, awaiting the day when the departed will finally find release.

 …

(This note, with its messy handwriting, seems to have been torn from a notebook. Who left it at the station?)

LoadingTipsText_200301_TipsText: Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds. It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
LoadingTipsText_200302_TipsText: A seminary faintly visible through a thin veil of clouds. Suspended upside down in the sky, it stands solemn and silent, as though carrying the weight of the Blessed Maiden's life.
LoadingTipsText_200303_TipsText:
"The mortal world is a vast and mysterious ocean, wherein all souls are doomed to drown and sink to the depths. Those who refuse to be swallowed must learn to rise, climbing upward until their heads break the surface. Only then shall they glimpse the realm of the divine."

This proverb, written by the Order, is preserved within the tower.
LoadingTipsText_200304_TipsText: Majestic and serene, ancient yet still sacred. This is the coronation platform prepared for the Blessed Maiden, though an aura of control lingers above. When the heavy weight of "divine right" falls upon one's head, it feels as if all choices have already been made.
LoadingTipsText_200305_TipsText:
Once the dwelling of dragons, this place witnessed those ancient, mighty beings soaring through the sky.

Now, wild vines and flowers steadily consume the garden's former glory while the buried history of dragons slumbers in cursed lairs.
LoadingTipsText_200401_TipsText:
An ancient, mysterious castle perched on the edge of a cliff in the outskirts.

Surrounded by lush flora reminiscent of deep-sea creatures, its interior houses similarly strange and wondrous treasures. Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.

DYHDST_101_1: That weird guy hasn't noticed us yet, right?
DYHDST_101_2: Ah, I'm sure this ship would be magnificent when it's all fixed-up.
DYHDST_201_1: What in the world? How did this ship get fixed up all of a sudden?!
DYHDST_201_2: It's gotta be haunted! There's no other explanation!
DYHDST_201_3: Impossible. That's not possible! I've been keeping my eyes on it for days!
DYHDST_201_4: How could it get fixed so fast?
DYHDST_301_2: I heard it's called the "Pequod." Strange name, don't you think?
DYHDST_301_3: I heard it has something to do with Old Ahab...
DYHDST_601_2: Same as usual. Only the small ones.
DYHDST_601_3: I don't know why, but the yield has been getting worse lately.
DYHDST_601_5: Oh, great Tidebreaker, please offer me your blessings.
DYHDST_601_6: I'm not asking for riches, just enough fish to keep my wife and kids fed.
DYHDST_601_7: How about we try Serene Bay tomorrow? You know, leave some offerings there?
DYHDST_601_8: Don't! What if it gets angry and swallow us whole?
DYHDST_601_9: Well... we've gotta try, right? Maybe it'll hear our prayers if we're sincere enough...
DYHDST_602_3: I know, I know. Planck is everyone's friend. We can't fish without it.
DYHDST_602_4: For all these years, it's been a diligent helping hand. You don't see octopuses like that anymore.
DYHDST_602_5: Sigh... But, come to think of it, what do you reckon grilled Planck tastes like?
DYHDST_602_6: With those flexible tentacles, it must be really chewy.
DYHDST_602_8: Hey, I'm just joking! I'd never actually eat it.
DYHDST_701_3: But they say only the Tidebreaker can lift that seal, right?
DYHDST_701_4: Huh? Where's Old Ahab and the others?
DYHDST_701_5: I guess we fish over there now...
DYHDST_702_1: Do you think there's treasure at Reyes Ruins?
DYHDST_702_2: I heard Old Ahab talk about it once.
DYHDST_702_3: Something about secrets from The Order being hidden there. But he didn't seem to care.
DYHDST_702_4: Probably because he's not from Rinascita, right?
DYHDST_702_6: Listen to his accent—it doesn't sound local.
DYHDST_702_7: Ugh, now that you've mentioned it, I kind of do want to check it out.
DYHDST_702_8: And now the storm's cleared, what better time than now?
DYHDST_702_9: I wouldn't recommend it though. I don't know why, but that place always gives me a bad feeling...
DYHD_30_3: After you set the Tidebreaker and the sea right again, Captain Ahab, Mr. Starbuck, and Mr. Queequeg all disappeared...
DYHD_30_4: I'm currently going over Captain Ahab's old journal, and it seems like they were searching for this "final harbor."
DYHD_30_5: Captain Ahab spent his whole life on the waves. He was the finest captain and fisherman this place ever saw.
DYHD_30_6: If we steer our course by Ahab's example, we might discover things, even treasures he left behind...
DYHD_30_7: Can we catch Cetus the Tidebreaker?
DYHD_30_8: It's a possibility. Captain Ahab always had an obsession with the Cetus, but why remains a mystery.
DYHD_30_9: Well then, let's press on with this as our goal!
DYHD_31_1: The sea feels ever so calm, and the whirlpools have finally settled.
DYHD_31_2: Everything's returned to how it once was… To be honest, {PlayerName}, Captain Ahab and his crew met their fate at sea decades ago.
DYHD_31_3: Their love of the sea and their promise to Cetus the Tidebreaker is what kept their spirits lingering here.
DYHD_31_4: And now, the peaceful waters of Riccioli mark their final resting place. This is their "final harbor."
DYHD_31_5: But the Rachel still sails on, and it seems to have taken a liking to you.
DYHD_31_6: I believe that Captain Ahab also hoped you'd carry on his legacy...
DYHD_31_8: Me? I'm just a simple sailor and fisherman. I was born here, and I'll probably get married and have children here too. Eventually, I'll find my peace in these very waters.
DYHD_31_10: So set sail, Captain {PlayerName}! Your journey leads to the very edge of the world.

AreaReportContent_Text43:
The Employee Manual for all staff members of the Averardo Vault. Below is the content from the first page:

Welcome to the Averardo Vault. Your arrival brings fresh energy to the Vault, and we sincerely look forward to your exceptional performance.

In keeping with the principle of "the sanctity and inviolability of private property," the Averardo Vault houses a vast collection of priceless Echoes and artworks. It is the safest and most secure place in Rinascita. Your every word and action reflect the Vault's image, and we trust this manual will help you gain a comprehensive understanding of the Averardo Vault.

Vault Overview:

The Vault is located east of Ragunna City, where it stores a vast array of Echoes and artworks. The Vault is divided into two zones: the Upper Management Zone, positioned above a chasm with a commanding view of the sea of clouds, and the Underground Depository Zone, situated beneath the clouds and connected to the upper zone by an elevator tower.

The Vault's security system is comprised of Echoes.
AreaReportContent_Text44:
Kindly Note:

Staff and Echo activity take place in the following areas:

1. Office Area (The designated workspace for staff members).
2. Underground Vault Area (Primarily housing Echoes and patrolled by armed Echoes. Do not enter this area without prior authorization and declaration).

As the most secure and reliable place in all of Rinascita, all staff members of the Vault are responsible for ensuring the safety of the items stored inside.

The deposit and withdrawal of all items must strictly follow the prescribed reporting procedures. Violations will be handled according to the rules outlined in the Employee Manual.
AreaReportContent_Text45:
A poster advertising tourism in Riccioli Islands

Discover Riccioli Islands, a hidden paradise nestled amidst Rinascita's turbulent waters.
Named after the renowned astronomer and seafarer of the Order, Sir Riccioli, this archipelago has been a sanctuary of natural wonders since its discovery during Rinascita's founding years. From the elusive Riccioli Black Pearls to the ethereal Stygian Phantoms and strange Yarn Eels, the archipelago is teeming with life and natural beauties thanks to the unique qualities of its geographic location with much more yet to be discovered.
AreaReportContent_Text46:
Embark on adventures to encounter the mysterious ancient Echo of the sea in secluded coves and hunt for pearls washed ashore. As the tide recedes in the sunset, join friendly locals in nearby Riccioli settlements for a refreshing drink.
And last but not least, don't miss out on the signature Riccioli fishing experience!
There you have it, an enchanted wonderland filled with life where infinite possibilities are immersed in aromas of the sea.
Come to the Riccioli Islands and let your heart race as you discover life's new wonders.

HelpText_225_Title: About Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways
HelpText_225_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30, and activate the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during Main Quest "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

HelpText_226_Content:
Fishing Spot Rules:

1. There are two types of Fishing Spots: Sea Life Fishing Spots and Material Fishing Spots, each offering different resources.

2. Each Fishing Spot requires a specific Fishing Ability to access. Check the Fishing Abilities page for details.

3. Each Fishing Spot has a limited number of catches. When depleted, the spot will disappear and automatically generate after a certain period, possibly at a different location.

Fishing Rules:

1. When the harpoon lands within a glowing area, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the button to accelerate the Fishing Progress. Brighter areas grant greater acceleration.

2. Once the Fishing Progress reaches 100%, 1 Fishing Attempt will be consumed, and you will have a chance to catch the target.

3. When all Fishing Attempts are used up, no further fishing can be done, and you will proceed to handle the storage for the harvest.

4. During fishing, you can access the Cargo page to manage your catches. Doing so will interrupt the current fishing attempt.

Character_Cantarella_128_2: Thanks to you, we're finally back home, safe and sound!
Character_Cantarella_128_4: Ms. Rosemary at the Apothecary gave me this special medicine! Just a tiny dab, and the pain's all gone!
Character_Cantarella_128_5: She said it was from Ms. Can… something… Oh, I can't remember. Grown-up names are always so hard to keep straight!
Character_Cantarella_128_6: Anyway, it's from a very nice lady!
Character_Cantarella_128_7: And anyone sick can use it, too! Yay!
Character_Cantarella_129_1: We survived, but at what cost? Is it a blessing? Or is it just more to carry?
Character_Cantarella_129_2: Sometimes, I wonder, when life is this heavy, could death be... an easier path?
Character_Cantarella_129_3: But if you die, you lose everything. No more chances. No paths ahead.
Character_Cantarella_129_4: Besides, as survivors, who are we to say whether the dead found peace?
Character_Cantarella_129_5: Just being here, with thoughts and worries and even fears… That's its own kind of happiness.
Character_Cantarella_130_1: Annis, O' Annis… the light in despair, the angel from the mirage…
Character_Cantarella_130_2: Hello, ma'am. Do you know Annis?
Character_Cantarella_130_3: Annis? Isn't that the name of Girl A?
Character_Cantarella_130_4: Hmm? So, everyone's heard of Annis?
Character_Cantarella_130_5: Girl A? No, no… Annis is Annis, no one else.
Character_Cantarella_130_6: Annis is the angel sung about in hymns, a gentle light that appears to those lost in despair.
Character_Cantarella_130_7: They take many forms, like someone dear, a flower, a bird… even a jellyfish, sometimes.
Character_Cantarella_130_8: So Annis is just a legend?
Character_Cantarella_130_9: Is there an Annis here in the town?
Character_Cantarella_130_10: Oh, no, child. Annis is as real as hope itself.
Character_Cantarella_130_11: Not in name, no. But the angel Annis is always near.
Character_Cantarella_130_12: When someone is in a bind, yet clings to the faintest glimmer of hope, Annis appears in the form of things they're familar with, guiding them out of the tight spot.
Character_Cantarella_130_13: If you're strong enough to hold on, Annis will come to you.
Character_Cantarella_131_1: I've conducted over a hundred visits and interviews, traveling between Thessaleo Fells and Egla Town. Finally, I think I have a theory...
Character_Cantarella_131_2: It seems that these regions are experiencing a phenomenon—mass hypochondria, if you will.
Character_Cantarella_131_3: For example, many people claim to have seen an ancient knight they believe is still alive.
Character_Cantarella_131_4: Others speak of an angel named Annis, said to answer the call of those with unbreakable wills. Annis appears in different forms, helping those in dire need.
Character_Cantarella_131_5: From the records, she's often seen as a young girl, a flower, a bird… even a jellyfish.
Character_Cantarella_131_6: Yet, after combing through records over the past few centuries, I have yet to find any concrete evidence for Annis's existence.
Character_Cantarella_131_7: Medically speaking, it seems more likely that these are hallucinations brought on by intense mental strain.
Character_Cantarella_131_8: When someone is under severe stress or endures deep trauma, the mind might create an external figure to ease the pain, like a survival mechanism.
Character_Cantarella_131_9: Think of the pressures of strained family ties, the toll of years of competition, and hallucinations induced by toxins...
Character_Cantarella_131_10: In extreme cases, one's own identity can fragment, conjuring up an imaginary figure.
Character_Cantarella_131_11: So, when an entire community is facing intense pressure...
Character_Cantarella_131_12: Hmm, but I'd say that angel or not, true salvation lies within ourselves. Don't you agree?
Character_Cantarella_132_1: I never imagined life could feel this carefree.
Character_Cantarella_132_2: Just look at this vast scenery... It brings much calm to my heart.
Character_Cantarella_132_3: Yeah, I feel the same way. A simple and quiet life. There's a beauty in it.
Character_Cantarella_132_4: We have Cantarella to thank for this peace.
Character_Cantarella_132_5: I feel reassured with her as the head of our family.
Character_Cantarella_132_6: She's… she's everything a Maiden should be, more so than I could ever be. And as the head of Fisalia? She's unmatched.
Character_Cantarella_132_7: For us, I think it's our turn to make the most of the world she saved for us. Let's live every day to its fullest.
Character_Cantarella_132_8: Yes, and let's capture the beauty we find along the way! I'm sure she'll be happy to receive these photos!

Event_JXWJ_1_2: Ugh, can't get a signal... This is bad. I'll run out of batteries soon...

Event_JXWJ_2_2: ...Hold on a sec. You're a Bloom Bearer. Can you bring me back to the Black Shores for repairs?
Event_JXWJ_2_4: I got jumped by a bunch of TDs. Barely escaped with my nuts and bolts, but I think I did bust a drive shaft.
Event_JXWJ_2_5: Let me take a look at it.
Event_JXWJ_2_6: I've worked on Sentry Constructs before.
Event_JXWJ_2_7: Oh, please do. It should be the one connecting my "feet."
Event_JXWJ_2_8: Oh, really? You mind taking a look at it? It should be the one connecting my "feet."
Event_JXWJ_2_9: Not good. I think I'm starting to lose them. Everything feels numb down there...

After a few clanks and creaks, the KU-Roro slowly gets back to its "feet."
Event_JXWJ_2_13: Ku, ku. All systems normal. I, KU-Cage, am back and ready to rock and roll!
Event_JXWJ_2_14: Thank you! You're what they call a miracle worker over in Huanglong.
Event_JXWJ_2_16: I was gathering environmental data for a combat simulator we're working on over at the Black Shores.
Event_JXWJ_2_17: It uses data from all over Solaris-3, to <color=yellow>simulate Crisis Trials that put the combat capabilities of its participants to the test under extreme conditions</color>.
Event_JXWJ_2_19: Like the TD outbreaks along the Jinzhou borders, or the mist swallowing up Penitent's End in Ragunna...
Event_JXWJ_2_20: Of course, these are all just simulations, not actual crises. No need to worry.
Event_JXWJ_2_21: Participants are free to <color=yellow>make adjustments to the simulations and customize the difficulty to suit their preferences</color>.
Event_JXWJ_2_22: All combat data collected will serve as benchmarks for future Black Shores field missions in crisis response.
Event_JXWJ_2_24: Let's see how difficult it can be.
Event_JXWJ_2_25: As a safety precaution, this simulation is only available to certain Bloom Bearers and Consultants who meet the criteria. But I can run an evaluation for you right now.
Event_JXWJ_2_26: ...There, you can now access the simulator directly from your Terminal.
Event_JXWJ_2_28: Well, yes. Records show you are an elite Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. It was an easy pass.
Event_JXWJ_2_29: Feel free to conduct a simulation whenever you're ready.
Event_JXWJ_2_30: For those looking to spice things up, there'll be a <color=yellow>selection of Stress Modules available to ramp up the difficulty and throw you in the most extreme scenarios imaginable</color>.

Event__1_1: Oh, it's you again! It's been a while, hasn't it? Hmm, no, should I say, "Nice to meet you?"
Event__1_2: I don't think we've met before.
Event__1_4: Really? That's not too surprising though... Anything can happen here! Maybe I mixed up the time, mistaking what hasn't happened with what already has...
Event__1_5: That's right! I feel like we've met somewhere else before. But... when?
Event__1_7: Oh, by the way, have you seen that large black cat?
Event__1_10: I don't know its name, but it's a super big black cat! Like bigger than a tiger!
Event__1_11: Huh... why? It's not a bad cat.
Event__1_12: There are scary monsters beyond the gate. I've seen them before, but this time, they feel... different.
Event__1_13: Something tells me they're from somewhere... "deeper."
Event__1_14: You mean, the depths of dreams?
Event__1_15: I'm not sure. They're probably from somewhere I haven't been... or even know about.
Event__1_16: They're tough. My friends and I couldn't handle them. But, thankfully, that black cat showed up out of nowhere.
Event__1_17: It carried me on its back and brought me through the gate, but then… it turned around and went back.
Event__1_18: {PlayerName}, could you help us? Please defeat those monsters and save my friends and that big black cat!
Event__1_19: Even though most of my friends are still stuck on the other side, all of us who got out will help you like always!
Event__1_22: Maybe... at some point in the future? After all, time is a closed loop.
Event__1_25: Anyway, I'll be rooting for you! Please drive those bad guys away!
Event__2_1: It's been a while, {PlayerName}. You did it. The Somnoire has returned to peace.
Event__2_3: I've sent her back to the Somnoire. She doesn't belong here. It's not good for her to stay in the outside world for long.
Event__2_4: Once again, thank you for helping us through the crisis.
Event__2_5: All that talk about balance... and look at the mess that ivory fool made. We had to clean up after him.
Event__2_7: You could say that. Though it was more of an accident than anything.
Event__2_8: He opened a gate that should never have been opened, allowing those monsters from the depths to slip into the shallower realm.
Event__2_9: The good thing is, we managed to draw their attention and buy him some time. If he's smart, he should've sealed the gate by now.
Event__2_10: Why did he open the gate?
Event__2_11: I have my suspicions, but it's too soon to reveal them. I'll have a "talk" with him first.
Event__2_12: Our paths will cross again soon, {PlayerName}... And that's when you'll once again determine the Somnoire's fate.

Character_Cantarella_76_4: Such a good girl, really. So, I couldn't bring myself to refuse her.

Character_Cantarella_76_7: Whether it was her tears that softened the poison, or my body's quiet resilience, I recovered quickly enough.
Character_Cantarella_76_8: Only through suffering could the girls of the trials steal a fleeting moment of peace.
Character_Cantarella_76_9: Forgive me. I shouldn't linger in memories. After all, it's the present and future that truly matter, wouldn't you say?

Character_Cantarella_15_7: Go on, make a choice. Let's see if this apple holds the prize you seek.
Character_Cantarella_15_10: Huh… What made you choose this one? Was it your sharp intuition, or the ability to see right through everything?
Character_Cantarella_15_11: No need to answer. There's something in you. I can tell your soul is burning like a flame that no ash could ever smother.
Character_Cantarella_15_12: Take this "luck" hidden within the freshest apple. You deserve it.
Character_Cantarella_15_13:
Cantarella gives you a reassuring glance. 
Her eyes shimmer like ripples over a moonlit sea as she gazes at the apple and gestures gracefully.
Character_Cantarella_15_15: So, the rumors are true—nothing escapes your keen gaze, Cantarella the Bane.
Character_Cantarella_15_16: This little taste of "luck" is just a starter. Now, allow me to serve the main dish.
Character_Cantarella_15_17: Here comes the second riddle: The Red Apple.
Character_Cantarella_15_18: "The girls lined up for their apples, each one in a vivid, glistening red… but why would apples appear in the deep sea?"
Character_Cantarella_15_19: Whether it brings "luck" or "misfortune," taste it and see for yourselves.

zhaidishengtai_1_1: It has been some time, honored guest.
zhaidishengtai_10_1: Do you have an interest in our morning prayer as well?
zhaidishengtai_10_2: You aren't from the Order, are you?
zhaidishengtai_10_3: Faith is not the sole domain of the Order. As long as your devotion is true and your reverence pure, the Sentinel will hear you, regardless of station.
zhaidishengtai_10_4: The Fisalia family's morning prayers come from an old tradition once followed every time we set sail. Back then, we prayed to the sea itself.
zhaidishengtai_10_5: When the Sentinel revealed Their divine miracle, They made Their name known to our ancestors.
zhaidishengtai_10_6: If you dig deeper, you'll find our morning prayer is more ancient and orthodox than the Order itself.
zhaidishengtai_10_9: That's fine. The Sentinel will still bless you.
zhaidishengtai_10_12: Knowing that the Sentinel is not a true Divinity, you are not so easily moved.
zhaidishengtai_12_4: Phew... Thank goodness. You're not Mr. Sebastian.
zhaidishengtai_12_5: Oh, I was just... you know, setting the mood! Keeping things relaxed, as is befitting the family's reputation!
zhaidishengtai_13_1: How should I prune these flowers?
zhaidishengtai_14_1: How should I prune these flowers?
zhaidishengtai_14_3: As you can see, I'm tending to these Velvet Blooms.
zhaidishengtai_14_4: Trying to fend off the drowsiness from these flowers while cutting them into perfect squares? Truly, a labor of love...
zhaidishengtai_14_5: But... aren't they already at an angle?
zhaidishengtai_14_6: You don't even have pruning shears.
zhaidishengtai_15_1: Sometimes, I wonder if they are even truly devout.
zhaidishengtai_16_1: Sometimes, I wonder if they are even truly devout.
zhaidishengtai_16_3: Have you ever seen the head of the Fisalias come to the lobby for prayer?
zhaidishengtai_16_4: Maybe she has her own private prayer room?
zhaidishengtai_16_5: But remember that noise we heard from the back?
zhaidishengtai_16_6: From that hallway, the one only a select few have access to!
zhaidishengtai_17_1: The Montellis have gone too far.
zhaidishengtai_17_2: What's got you complaining this time?
zhaidishengtai_18_1: The Montellis have gone too far.
zhaidishengtai_18_2: What's got you complaining this time?
zhaidishengtai_18_3: They've set up a holiday overtime pay that's five times the regular rate!
zhaidishengtai_18_4: Those devious devils! They're practically luring people into endless labor!
zhaidishengtai_18_5: ...Is it too late to jump ship?
zhaidishengtai_18_6: Kane, don't let the stench of Montelli greed corrupt you!
zhaidishengtai_19_1: Did I just see fish swimming by...?
zhaidishengtai_2_1: It has been some time, honored guest.
zhaidishengtai_2_2: May your day be as tranquil as the sea beneath the clear sky.
zhaidishengtai_2_3: Is this how the Fisalias greet others?
zhaidishengtai_2_4: Yes. This blessing is one of the few traditions our family carried with us before settling in this land.
zhaidishengtai_2_5: Though we have long made our home here, our devotion to the sea has never wavered.
zhaidishengtai_20_1: Did I just see fish swimming by...?
zhaidishengtai_20_5: My apologies, honored guest. It's just that the atmosphere in the mansion at night... well, I'm not as brave as Fiore.
zhaidishengtai_20_6: Probably just the shadow of some deep-sea fish kept somewhere in the mansion... Yes, that must be it!
zhaidishengtai_20_7: Is this part of the Fisalia's family business?
zhaidishengtai_20_8: Well, this is a recent side venture of ours. Our main business is still gathering deep-sea plants and extracting their essences to make medicines.
zhaidishengtai_20_9: We've practically cornered the potion trade in Ragunna and Septimont.
zhaidishengtai_20_10: You know, I overheard someone say there are... unexpected discoveries to be made while gathering the plants.
zhaidishengtai_20_12: That's right. Some of them are shipwrecks mentioned in old records. Salvage something like that, well...
zhaidishengtai_20_13: Let's just say you could fetch an amount I'm not allowed to disclose. Heh.
zhaidishengtai_21_1: Lulu, don't eat anything here, okay?
zhaidishengtai_22_1: Lulu, don't eat anything here, okay?
zhaidishengtai_22_2: Don't let the good matriarch's kindness go to waste. After all, you're the only one who can keep me company.
zhaidishengtai_22_3: She has graciously taken us in, so you must behave and bring some life to this place.
zhaidishengtai_23_1: Lulu, don't touch any plants here, even if you've already had the medicine, alright?
zhaidishengtai_24_1: Lulu, don't touch any plants here, even if you've already had the medicine, alright?
zhaidishengtai_24_2: I didn't expect the matriarch to make a new potion just to keep you from being affected.
zhaidishengtai_24_3: I heard the potions she makes are hard to come by... How much did this cost...?
zhaidishengtai_24_4: No, no, no. I can't think about that now, I've got to get back to work!
zhaidishengtai_25_1: I want to work somewhere closer to the head of the Fisalias...
zhaidishengtai_27_4: It's about this fellow, Caletto. A master of deceit. Even on his deathbed, he tricked the Acolytes into thinking he was devout. After he died, they posthumously made him an Acolyte!
zhaidishengtai_27_5: Shouldn't someone like him have been sent off on a Pilgrim's Sail a long time ago? How did he fool them?
zhaidishengtai_27_6: The book only says he did. But... uh, lying's bad, right?
zhaidishengtai_27_7: Well, the uncles from the Order always tell us that the Sentinel doesn't allow children to lie.
zhaidishengtai_27_8: Maybe because Caletto was a grown-up, he was able to tell lies?
zhaidishengtai_28_1: Sorry... if I wasn't sick, you wouldn't have missed the Carnevale.
zhaidishengtai_28_2: Hey, don't say that. The Carnevale's meant to be enjoyed together! We'll go together next time!
zhaidishengtai_29_1: We've got hemlocks... What else do we need?
zhaidishengtai_29_2: How about trying Primordia Bloom petals?
zhaidishengtai_3_1: Bartolo, you're here for Velvet Dream too, aren't you?
zhaidishengtai_3_2: Yes, I've come on behalf of my aunt.
zhaidishengtai_3_3: I still don't understand why the head suddenly decided to cut off the supply.
zhaidishengtai_3_4: Maybe she never really cared about side branches of the family like us.
zhaidishengtai_30_1: We've got hemlock, the normal and poisonous kind... What else do we need?
zhaidishengtai_30_2: How about trying Primordia Bloom petals?
zhaidishengtai_30_3: But the recipe says Gulpuff gland extract.
zhaidishengtai_30_4: The two have similar toxic properties, but Gulpuff extract has a lot of moisture, which dilutes its potency.
zhaidishengtai_30_5: If we try evaporating it to purify it, the heat will change its properties. For a stronger toxin, the petals are a better choice.
zhaidishengtai_30_6: That makes sense... But isn't this supposed to be the potion Ms. Rosemary requested? How did we end up making a new poison instead?
zhaidishengtai_30_7: …I have no idea. Anyway, since we're already here, let's test it out!
zhaidishengtai_31_1: I will become the best poisonsmith and make the head of Fisalias notice me!
zhaidishengtai_32_1: I will become the best poisonsmith and make the head of Fisalias notice me!
zhaidishengtai_32_3: Because... Ahem, sorry for making a scene in front of our honored guest.
zhaidishengtai_32_4: You mean becoming a pharmacist like Ms. Rosemary?
zhaidishengtai_32_5: Unfortunately, only those with Fisalia blood can learn proper pharmaceutics.
zhaidishengtai_32_6: For us servants, being allowed to study poison refinement is already a huge privilege.
zhaidishengtai_32_7: Even though the head once considered lowering the requirements for pharmaceutics, personally, I'd rather... Ahem. Never mind. Please excuse me.
zhaidishengtai_33_1: Why has the Sentinel's statue been left covered in dust? That's far too disrespectful.
zhaidishengtai_33_2: Since you put it that way, just have someone clean it.
zhaidishengtai_34_1: Why has the Sentinel's statue been left unattended, covered in dust? That's far too disrespectful.
zhaidishengtai_34_2: Since you put it that way, just have someone clean it.
zhaidishengtai_34_4: You're so rigid, Ms. Berta. The Sentinel isn't going to be bothered by a little dust.
zhaidishengtai_34_5: The Sentinel won't be bothered, because They are divine. But we mortals will.
zhaidishengtai_34_6: Don't let "laziness" creep into your heart, even in small things.
zhaidishengtai_35_1: Mr. Ondo, is it really okay not to clean the statue?
zhaidishengtai_35_2: Mr. Nino only said that because Ms. Berta was there.
zhaidishengtai_36_1: Mr. Ondo, is it really okay not to clean the statue?
zhaidishengtai_36_2: Mr. Nino only said that because Ms. Berta was there.
zhaidishengtai_36_4: That's a relief. Honestly, I feel uneasy every time I'm near that statue.
zhaidishengtai_36_6: Oh! You feel it too, Mr. Ondo?
zhaidishengtai_37_1: Mr. Ondo, that eerie feeling has been gone lately.
zhaidishengtai_37_2: Yes… and the head has been leaving her study more often.
zhaidishengtai_38_1: Honored guest, are you here to see the head of the Fisalias?
zhaidishengtai_38_4: She is in the study. Please, go ahead.
zhaidishengtai_38_5: If you require any assistance, please feel free to call on me.
zhaidishengtai_39_1: Honored guest, are you here to see the head of the Fisalias?
zhaidishengtai_39_4: She is not in the study at the moment, but she has given permission for you to come and go as you please.
zhaidishengtai_39_5: Would you like to enter the study?
zhaidishengtai_39_8: Please go ahead. Feel free to call on me at any time.
zhaidishengtai_39_9: If you require any assistance, please feel free to call on me.
zhaidishengtai_39_10: If you require any assistance, please feel free to call on me.

zhaidishengtai_4_2: Yes, I've come on behalf of my aunt.
zhaidishengtai_4_3: I still don't understand why the head suddenly decided to cut off the supply.
zhaidishengtai_4_4: Maybe she never really cared about side branches of the family like us.
zhaidishengtai_4_5: She's the only one who knows how to make the elixir, and now that she's stopped distributing it… I'm afraid I'll start hearing that noise again at night.
zhaidishengtai_4_6: Do you think this is her way of warning us?
zhaidishengtai_4_7: Though my aunt's having fewer and fewer nightmares...
zhaidishengtai_4_8: I wonder if I'll even get the chance to meet our matriarch.
zhaidishengtai_4_9: But if this is a warning, I'd rather heed it.
zhaidishengtai_4_10: After all, it's not the waves you see that are frightening. It's the unknown lurking in the depths.
zhaidishengtai_41_3: Oh, it's you. My apologies. I didn't notice you earlier.
zhaidishengtai_41_4: This is one of the books our head brought back from Huanglong during her recent travels.
zhaidishengtai_41_5: Like the rest of the collection here, I assume it's either a classical play or an inherited poetry anthology.
zhaidishengtai_41_6: Unfortunately, I don't understand Huanglong's script, so I'm unsure where to place it on the shelves.
zhaidishengtai_41_7: Mind if I take a look?
zhaidishengtai_41_8: The bolded title on the book reads Oh My Magistrate, with a small note underneath indicating it's an unpublished edition.
zhaidishengtai_41_9: What do you think, honored guest? What is this book about?
zhaidishengtai_41_10: Well... it looks like a play.
zhaidishengtai_42_1: May the day be as tranquil as the sea beneath the clear sky.
zhaidishengtai_43_1: May the day be as tranquil as the sea beneath the clear sky.
zhaidishengtai_43_2: Why didn't you pray to the statue?
zhaidishengtai_43_4: I was praying for our family. Offering prayers to the statue of a false Divinity might do more harm than good, don't you think?
zhaidishengtai_43_6: Our head isn't as distant or reclusive as the rumors suggest. I believe you, of all people, would know that best.
zhaidishengtai_43_7: Having watched her grow up, I have some understanding of the kind of person she would place her absolute trust in.
zhaidishengtai_43_8: I should thank you for accepting her invitation and for becoming part of her life.
zhaidishengtai_45_1: Have you noticed? Sometimes, strange noises come from the first floor...
zhaidishengtai_45_2: I heard it's the vengeful spirits of past heads, poisoned to death. Terrifying...
zhaidishengtai_45_3: Shh! Don't let Housekeeper Ermelinda hear that!
zhaidishengtai_45_4: Trust me, her glare is more terrifying than any vengeful spirit!

InfoDisplay_114514001_Text: Dearest Father, I am writing this letter to you from a corner of the library. Over time, I have slowly adjusted to life at the seminary. During my free time, I often come to this library to read the ancient texts it holds and study the doctrine of Unity. But the deeper I delve into the history of Rinascita, the more I sense that it is shrouded by an unresolved mist. There are too many unanswered questions about our faith, the grace we have received, and the disaster that once befell us. Fortunately, many publicly sensitive topics and even discussions of taboos are regarded as subjects of academic interest in the seminary. I will take time to study and explore them. Of course, I haven't neglected the swordsmanship Mother taught me. Recently, I applied for sparring practice with the Divine Envoys... Don't worry, I won't hurt myself. I remember you once told me that Avinoleum is so vast you'll always get lost. This year, I've walked everywhere in the seminary, except for those places where I'm not allowed to go. I've drawn a simple route map, which is easier to read than the one in the Order. I'll send it to you later. With my sword and lamp, I press on through the fog. My Lord Imperator from above, Rosalie

GuideTutorialPage_3302202_Content:
1. As a Gondola Echo, Rachel takes damage upon colliding with hazardous creatures. Steer clear of Bampuffs, Tornadoes, and Ghost Medusas while navigating the waters.

2. Rachel's Durability decreases when damaged. If it reaches zero, it will automatically return to the dock, and all collected catches will be lost.

3. To ensure a safer and more successful voyage, you can use Riccioli Fishery Coins to restore Rachel's Durability while sailing. Keep a close watch on its Durability to avoid unnecessary loses.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_1_1: Can you hear me...? Good, we can hear each other loud and clear. It appears you've made it inside the Sonoro Sphere projected by the Infinite Reality Sandbox.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_1_2: You've done this before. Defeat enemies in the simulation to open Supply Chests that offer <color=yellow>Tactic Points</color> and <color=yellow>Low-Capacity Variables</color>.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_1_3: Please note: <color=yellow>Low-Capacity Variables</color> greatly enhance combat capabilities. You are recommended to collect sufficient <color=yellow>Tactic Points</color> before challenging the more dangerous enemies.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_1_4: Furthermore, Remnant Energy accumulated within the clouds above the island raises <color=yellow>Alertness</color> of enemies inside the Sandbox over time—Thus increasing those Tacet Discords' ATK and DEF.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_1_5: In other words, you'd probably want to wrap this up quickly.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_2_1: To aid with our <color=yellow>Tactic Points</color> gain, we have set up <color=yellow>Restoration Stations</color> across the Sandbox. Stand within its proximity to recover downed Resonators and restore a small amount of HP.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_2_2: The current simulation will be terminated once all revive attempts are depleted.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_2_3: Use these rules to your advantage and give the Sandbox everything you've got. I look forward to your results.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_3_1: Good, that was an impressive battle. Now, open the map on the top-left corner to check fast-travel points and other TD locations.
Side_HSMY2_yindao_3_2: Plan and optimize a route that works best for you.

Character_Cantarella_29_8:
You and Cantarella enter Porto-Veno Castle, which now looks a bit different.

Cantarella explains that the twisted frequencies have overwhelmed this place, displaying a mixture of past and future.

She manages to keep the last ray of light in this dark abyss and stores it in the lamp.
Character_Cantarella_30_6:
Cantarella gives you the lamp of light and grants full access to the castle.

With this lamp, you are now able to switch between the past and the future.
Character_Cantarella_34_9:
You find an announcement of the previous Divine Trials.

The first trial requires the participants to select the three most toxic Sea Apples from the depths and bring them back by any means necessary.

It seems the twisted frequencies want you to experience the trials yourselves to uncover the mystery of the "ghost girl."
Character_Cantarella_50_7:
You find the first Sea Apple along with a note written by a worried girl, Chloe.

The Divine Trials are a hallowed Fisalia tradition, but the danger surrounding them has led some family members to seek out commoners who resemble their daughters, using them as substitutes.
Character_Cantarella_52_5:
You find the second Sea Apple and another note from Chloe that records why and how she participated in the trials.

To avoid the watchful eyes, the girls formed secret pacts in whispers, such as "hum a special tune," "use the right color," "knock on the door three times every two seconds"…
Character_Cantarella_53_4:
You find the third Sea Apple and another note from Chloe that reveals her change in mindset during the trials.

The Fisalia family is built on poison, and from a young age, every Fisalia child is introduced to it and learns to build up resistance.

The Fisalia bloodlines can develop poison-related abilities when exposed to poisons and pushed to the brink, but commoners rarely survive. However, a commoner girl named Annis also seemed to have awakened such an ability, though her throat was damaged by poison, leaving her forever voiceless.
Character_Cantarella_56_9: A familiar door appears in front of you. Just knock on it three times as those girls used to do. Maybe something unexpected will happen.
Character_Cantarella_64_8: Behind the door is another world where the jellyfish await your arrival.
Character_Cantarella_58_6:
You find a fairytale sketchbook that seems to be made by the girls.
Though their bodies were caged, their hearts took flight, winging freely through realms of imagination.
They recorded these ideas on paper, each word melting into a sweet candy to soothe their sorrows.
Character_Cantarella_59_4:
You find notes in the sketchbook.
Though time has yellowed the pages, the girls' laughter and joy still dance vividly across each line.
But it remains trapped on paper, lost to time.
Character_Cantarella_65_4: It looks like a study room, but as you look up at the ceiling, the sparkling waves there make you feel this whole place is underwater.
Character_Cantarella_67_7:
This is the second announcement of the Divine Trials.

In the second trial, participants should make a team of two, capture the most venomous jellyfish, and exchange their catch with their teammate. The one who survives the jellyfish's venom shall be declared the winner.

Since only you and Cantarella are in the castle, you decide to team up and find the Jellyrose Medusa.
Character_Cantarella_68_5: The jellyfish is right on the other side of the room, but to remove the blocking bookshelf, you need to put two books on it.
Character_Cantarella_76_12:
A note details the remorse of a Fisalia girl named Hebenon.

As the second daughter of Fisalia's senior line, she was gentle and reluctant to harm her own blood. Yet under the watchful eye of the abyss, the girls had no choice but to drink poison for fleeting moments of peace.
Character_Cantarella_81_11:
A note describes the determination of a Fisalia girl named Mandragora.

As the first daughter of Fisalia's senior line, she was carved by the family laws and clung to every teaching of the head of our family faithfully. However, beneath her cold resolve, a hint of hesitation still lingered.
Character_Cantarella_85_11:
You and Cantarella return with the most venomous jellyfish. Now, it's time to follow the trial's rule and feed each other the deadly poison.

While you know nothing of poisons, Cantarella, who is well-experienced in this field, extends her hand and volunteers to take the poison herself.

You hesitate, but she smiles and calls the jellyfish to her, explaining that she has long since become immune to all poisons.
Character_Cantarella_87_3: A subtle shift seems to have taken place in this familiar room.
Character_Cantarella_96_8: Behind the door is the deep water zone. Please be well-prepared beforehand.
Character_Cantarella_88_5: A sketchbook scribbled with the lyrics of an eerie folk song.
Character_Cantarella_90_3:
The messages jotted on the sketchbook are like soundless screams.
You can feel the despair of those girls from these words.
Character_Cantarella_97_20:
A strange doll blocks your way and asks you to find a suitable round hat for her.

Meanwhile, Cantarella seems unwell but forces herself to stay collected for your sake.
Character_Cantarella_105_5: The doll thrusts a Round Hat into your hands with no further explanation.
Character_Cantarella_107_6: The doll thanks you for bringing her the Round Hat and invites you to the stage for the final performance.
Character_Cantarella_113_4:
You figure out who this girl with a red round hat is. She must be Annis, the silent Ghost Girl A who sent you that message. But why hasn't she aged over these years? There's no time to dwell on this question now. After all, saving Cantarella comes first.

Annis offers to help. She closes her eyes and holds the lamp. A brilliant light appears, reigniting the lamp's glow, yet Annis vanishes in its wake.
Character_Cantarella_116_13:
Years ago, Cantarella used illusions to deceive the late head of Fisalia, seizing his position and ending the cruel trials. But his remaining obsession, corrupted by the whispers, has lingered in the castle and turned the place into the Sea of Ghosts.
 
Together, you and Cantarella set his lingering will free.
Character_Cantarella_121_11:
As the lingering obsession of the late head of the Fisalias fades, the Sea of Ghosts vanishes.

With the hymns rising around you, you find yourself in the sanctuary, where the girls who are supposed to be dead stand in front of you, all safe and sound.
Character_Cantarella_123_41:
You learn from Cantarella that since the Threnodian's lies were uncovered, the frequencies and circumstances around Ragunna have shifted. The time had come for the girls to finally go home.

She admits that she never intended to involve you and had planned to handle everything herself. That's why for this year's Night of Remembrance, she took part herself and chose "ghost girls" as the theme.

She had meant to dive into the Sea of Ghosts alone, claim she had solved the riddles and obtain the elixir of revival. This would allow her to send the girls home during the midnight Dance of the Dead. 

But Annis's message led you to her side to complete the plan.

It seems the Black Shores has made breakthroughs in its Infinite Reality Sandbox, now offering more immersive environments and thrilling battles. This time, the simulation takes place on Penitent's End, a desolate island where countless banished souls meet their fate.

<color=Highlight>This event offers trial Resonators.</color>
HelpText_229_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.

[Event Rules]
1. Gain as many Tactic Points as possible in the Infinite Battle Simulation.
2. Each area of the simulation contains multiple Charting Nodes.
Defeating enemies at each Charting Node will reward you with a great amount of Tactic Points.
3. Open Supply Chests after defeating enemies to claim Tactic Points and Low-Capacity Variable buffs.
4. Once you've collected enough Low-Capacity Variables, you can unlock new powerful buffs—High-Capacity Variables, which will greatly boost your combat power in the Infinite Battle Simulation.
