Main_Linaxita_2_4_1_15: As you wonder how to find the Inverted Tower Imperator spoke of, Abby suggests taking to the air, noting that the cliff near Egla Town would make a perfect launch pad.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_2_30: You encounter Ciaccona, a wandering bard sent by Carlotta to aid you. With her unique ability to recreate past experiences, she helps you relive your experience meeting Cartethyia. As you recount the meeting, you find yourself drawn into a strange realm conjured by her Resonance Ability.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_80:
Under the effect of Ciaccona's Resonance Ability, you begin to view your meeting with Cartethyia from a different perspective. To your surprise, Cartethyia also "enters" this memory.

In your conversation, she reveals that she has lost most of her memories and is uncertain about the nature of her resonance.

However, her words offer new insights. The Sonoro Sphere where her body currently resides may be the Inverted Tower the Sentinel once mentioned. A mysterious wandering figure has attempted to enter the Sonoro but has always been stopped by the barrier. Finding this person's identity may lead to new findings.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_4_50:
Ciaccona shakes you awake, and her reaction makes you realize that what happened wasn't entirely due to her Resonance Ability.

As you begin to consider your next steps, a butler from the Fisalia family arrives with an invitation to meet the head of the family.

You put off the meeting for now, opting to first learn more about the Fisalia matriarch. Ciaccona shares some of the most intriguing rumors about her, and a few details seem to match the wandering figure Cartethyia described.

Regardless of the matriarch's motives, this invitation could be the breakthrough you need. You say goodbye to Ciaccona and depart for the Fisalia estate.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_20: The current head of the Fisalia family introduces herself as Cantarella. She seems to be well prepared for your arrival and invites you to her study.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_40:
Based on what you previously learned from Gilberto, you confront Cantarella about the Fisalia family's true allegiance to the Threnodian.

Yet Cantarella unveils a more daunting truth. The Threnodian Leviathan is an entity with powers of assimilation, devouring civilizations through the spread of spiritual plague. Its invasion of Ragunna has long since concluded.

Peace is all but an illusion, blinding the Ragunnesi to the abyss they are unknowingly walking toward.

As if everything were unfolding as planned, Cantarella offers to present more evidence to back her claims.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_13_70:
Cantarella shows you Sentinel Imperator's true form and the twisted truths behind its history.

The Sentinel was originally a majestic steed, not the half-horse, half-sea creature now worshipped by the Order. This form was assumed only after the Threnodian's corruption.

With the powers of separation, the Sentinel infused the Sword of Divinity—Tyrvine with part of Their power to ensure Their Resonator, the Blessed Maiden, could be chosen in the event of Their absence. For generations, the Fisalia family held trials to find the true Blessed Maiden who can resonate with Tyrvine through Overclocking. However, after her own failed attempt, Cantarella uncovered a chilling message: "The Maiden is dead."

Cantarella now asks you to persuade Jué to help rescue the trapped Imperator.

You decline her request, but not without alternative plans. Before acting, you must first verify the truth of Cantarella's claims.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_14_30:
After confirming that Tyrvine was indeed left by Imperator through your special permission, you tell Cantarella what you know about Cartethyia.

Given past events, Cantarella quickly believes you and suggests traveling to the barrier of the Sonoro Sphere. It turns out that Cantarella is the wandering figure Cartethyia mentioned before.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_25_50:
Using Tyrvine, you and Cantarella enter the Sonoro Sphere where Cartethyia has been waiting for your arrival.

The moment you brought Tyrvine into the Sonoro, Cartethyia recalled certain information she had previously forgotten.

The seal surrounding the Inverted Tower can be broken by bringing Tyrvine, Hognis, and Haultir to their respective pedestals.

Is this a clue from the Sentinel, or a trap set by the Threnodian? Only by continuing forward will you uncover the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_28_20:
After being lifted into the sky, you finally view the Inverted Tower in its entirety, with the three seals clearly visible at the central spire.

With Cartethyia's help, you manage to keep your bearings despite the abnormal gravity conditions.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_56_50:
As soon as Tyrvine is placed on its pedestal, visions of Cartethyia's past flood your mind—moments from her coronation and the arrival of the Second Dark Tide. Cantarella, however, shares she witnessed a completely different vision.

Meanwhile, Abby detects Imperator's frequencies within your Tacet Mark, leading Cartethyia to grow even more suspicious of her own identity.

To ensure that these frequencies pose no danger to you, the three of you decide to rest for the night.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_20:
To verify her visions and improve the chances of saving the Sentinel, Cantarella decides to venture into the unknown alone.

After exchanging contact information, she sets off on a separate path with Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_101_60:
After placing Hognis on its pedestal, visions of Cartethyia's past resurface, showing her valiant struggle against the Threnodian in the wake of the Dark Tide.

A looming mystery finally has an answer. Cartethyia has always been on the side of humanity. With this revelation, the young maiden finally lets go of emotions long suppressed.

But new uncertainties arise. The frequencies of the Threnodian Leviathan glowing within your Tacet Mark...

Who split these frequencies? Was it the Sentinel or the Threnodian who gave Cartethyia these hints? It seems the answers will only be revealed once the third sword is placed.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_106_40: You follow the singing and arrive at a floating garden where Cartethyia is saying goodbye to the lost companions of her past.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_107_40: You and Cartethyia awaken in the garden. The final battle lies before you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_124_100:
After placing Haultir on its pedestal, you witness a vision in which the Threnodian reveals the truth: Cartethyia was created by the Leviathan, intended to be"whole" and "perfect." The people's adoration of her served as the Threnodian's lifeblood, and it was Cartethyia's resonance that brought forth the Second Dark Tide.

The Cartethyia before you now remembers everything. The Sentinel's corrupted form had long since been destroyed, but the Threnodian's essence lingered within Its vessel, Fleurdelys.

Your journey with Cartethyia was part of her plan to destroy Leviathan for good, taking all the things the false Divinity had bestowed and using them against It. Not only to end Its life, but also to extinguish Its future.

The Cartethyia who has accompanied you these past three days is a fragment of consciousness—the part of her that wished to live in the face of the Leviathan's corruption.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_126_100:
After arriving at the site of Cartethyia's coronation, she makes a final request. Instead of directly confronting the Threnodian's vessel, Fleurdelys, she asks that you use the connection she and Fleurdelys share to bring the last fragments of consciousness from the vessel here, so they can reunite.

This is the only way to trap the Threnodian's essence in a powerless shell, ensuring It can never return. By doing this, the cursed Fleurdelys will finally find the peace she has long sought. She asks for your help in illuminating the final path of your journey together.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_128_100:
Cantarella approaches Cartethyia with the now restored Tyrvine in hand. Within it are fragments of the Sentinel's power, remnants of failed resonances from the Maiden candidates in the past.

"The real Blessed Maiden is dead." Cantarella sacrificed her Second Awakening with Imperator for a chance to destroy the Sentinel's corrupted form.

So now, why can't the "false" Blessed Maiden become the "true" one?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_136_100:
In a realm of pure white, you encounter Imperator's final consciousness and learn the truth behind Their transformation.

In order to understand the Threnodian's true nature, Imperator was forced to allow the Threnodian's assimilation. In doing so, They discovered that while the Threnodian is indestructible, it can be bound by a human Resonator.

The journey was fraught with difficulty. Without Cartethyia's determination and Cantarella's sacrifice of her Second Awakening, the situation would have been doomed.

With the last bit of Their power, Imperator awakens Cartethyia.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_137_100:
Cartethyia ultimately refuses Imperator's proposition to forget the past and reconciles with her true self.

Now, she realizes she is whole again.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_140_100:
As Cartethyia gradually awakens, you notice a slight shift in her personality. She has become more lively and carefree, as the legends described. 

Having faced the edge of life and death together, the two of you can now savor a moment of peace.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_141_100:
Once Cartethyia calms down, she makes an unexpected vow. She vows to surpass you, so that one day she may defy your wishes, ignore your pleas, defeat you, and be your savior. Just as you did for her.

But for now, she intends to take time to reflect on her future path, and also rediscover Ragunna as it is now.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_143_100:
Cantarella thanks you for bringing the Fisalias the peace they've long sought, offering you a symbol of the unbreakable pact between you and them.

You share Imperator's message with her, along with the outcome of the Sentinel's fate. She understands that revealing these truths to others will take time and careful preparation.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_1002_1: Now, if you'll please just follow me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_302_1: Standing next to the abandoned house Ciaccona mentioned, you feel the faint breeze of the sea.
InfoDisplay_101153001_Text:
Through the initial selection, you must forge ahead. Compete, strive, and fight for your place. Show your strength, wisdom, courage, and perseverance as you journey through the depths to become the Fisalia Maiden.

The Head of the Fisalia family will offer the chosen one an elixir capable of granting any wish—be it eternal beauty or miraculous healing. All desires can be fulfilled.

Candidates:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia, Hebenon Fisalia, Cantarella Fisalia...</color>

Chloe Fisalia, Annis Fisalia, Marina Fisalia...

First Trial:
Poison is the bedrock on which the Fisalia name stands.
Let it test your willpower.
In this trial, you must select <color=RedD>the three most toxic Sea Apples</color> from the depths and bring them back by any means necessary.
Remember: The use of any external tools to determine their toxicity or aid in retrieval is strictly forbidden.

May the power of the Fisalia bloodline awaken within you.
InfoDisplay_101153002_Text:
Dear Annis,

The Trials are tomorrow! I'm so nervous… but a tiny bit excited too.

The Fisalias are really, really scary… Some of them strut around all high and mighty, while others are just… unsettling, like something out of a bad dream.

They must be really good at handling poisons, right? Just the thought of facing them makes me uneasy.…

I overheard that unsettling Fisalia girl whispering that poison can be medicine too. She said with just the right amount, it won't hurt anyone but actually save them.

Perhaps even if I don't pass the Trials, I could pick up some of their secrets about poisons and figure out the ingredients. Then maybe, just maybe, I could make something to help Jojo.

Thinking about it that way makes things a little less scary. For Jojo's sake, what's a little poison, anyway!

Be careful tomorrow, my dear Annis. We don't have Fisalia blood, and they know a lot more about poisons than we do.

Yours,
Chloe
InfoDisplay_101153003_Text:
Dear Annis,

Today I tried four different poisons…

The first one gave me a pounding headache, the second made my stomach cramp up, the third left my bones feeling all achy, and the fourth made me so dizzy I started seeing little dancing figures everywhere!

I'm still feeling a bit wobbly, and the words on this note are jumping around as I try to write.

But that unsettling Fisalia girl gave me some medicine. After I drank it, I felt a little better, just enough to write to you.

You might wonder why I'd ever drink something from a Fisalia, but don't worry. I've been keeping an eye on her. She's… different from the others. They don't seem to like her much, and she's always by herself, mumbling and grinding herbs. What she said last time wasn't a lie, and she didn't hurt me. 

Maybe… not all Fisalias are bad.

I'm thinking about asking her for help. She knows so much about medicine, and since she doesn't fit in with the rest, maybe she'd teach me how to mix the right potion to help Jojo. I know it's risky, but if there's even a small chance, I have to try.

Oh, and one last thing—security is tighter now, so be very careful, okay? If you hear three quick knocks, that'll be me.

Yours,
Chloe
InfoDisplay_101153004_Text:
Dear ████,

The Sea Apples were extremely potent. Even smelling them was enough to make it impossible to breathe, like my throat was being squeezed. I could barely get a word out. When I finally came to, I tasted something metallic in my mouth.

I didn't have the strength to touch one, let alone bring one back. All I could do was watch helplessly from afar.

They were round and red, like apples… or maybe tomatoes. Back in Egla Town, we had fields full of tomatoes…

Is it because I'm not a true Fisalia that I can't awaken any special abilities or immunity to poisons?

No, I can't give up. It must be because I'm not trying hard enough.

Annis wasn't a Fisalia either, but she made it through, even though we'll never hear her voice again. The poison destroyed her vocal cords, and she'll never speak again... 

Now's not the time for tears. I have to be strong too. For Jojo's sake, I won't give up.

Chloe
InfoDisplay_101153005_Text:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia, Hebenon Fisalia, Cantarella Fisalia...

Annis Fisalia…</color>

The above candidates have passed the trial of poison.
Please take a moment to rest and prepare for the second trial.
InfoDisplay_101153006_Text:
Knight Princess, Sorceress Princess, Commoner Princess, Noble Princess, and Angel Princess assembled before the castle!

Knight Princess atop her noble mount took the lead through the castle hedge maze and opened the castle gates.

Commoner Princess consumed poisonous mushrooms which she mistook as edible. Sorceress Princess rendered aid by brewing a curative potion.

Noble Princess, who knew the castle well, elegantly circumvented all of the hidden traps.

Angel Princess followed everyone with a faint smile on her lips.

The Princesses gathered in the castle's main hall where the Queen proclaimed their first task was to find the Gold Apple in the Appletree Forest!

Appletree Forest on the castle grounds, grows apples red and round.
A few land making a thump, knocking heads and raising bumps. 
Apples fall into the earth's hold, most are red but some are gold.
Whose head will the gold apple hit? Who will leave the forest with it?
The Queen sits with her meal in place, waiting for fruit to take its place.
As the juicy bite goes down, behold on her head the Thorned Crown.

In the end, everyone will surely find their own Gold Apple that makes their dreams come true!
InfoDisplay_101153007_Text:
Knight Princess: After the Throned Crown is mine, everyone in the castle will live better lives!

Sorceress Princess: Uh-huh... I don't want anything, I'm only here out of obligation to the family. After this is over, I plan to leave this dull place and get some fresh air outside. This time of year, the flowers in the mountains and fields should be blooming quite nicely... maybe I can find a new variety suitable for making medicine.

Noble Princess: I... I'm a bit scared, and I don't want to continue. But... but...

Knight Princess: You can't back out!

Commoner Princess: To cure Jojo, I won't back out. I will get the cure-all elixir and return home happily.

Angel Princess: Everyone's wishes shall come true.
InfoDisplay_101153008_Text:
Second Trial:

To claim the title of Maiden, one must demonstrate the strength to make decisive choices.

Excessive emotions are vulnerabilities and burdens for any candidate worthy of the title.

Each participant is required to capture <color=RedD>the most venomous jellyfish</color> from the sea and return it to this location. Upon your return, you will team up with another candidate and exchange your catch. The candidate with the more potent jellyfish shall be declared the winner.

In the event that you encounter an accident along the way, the other paired candidate will be declared the winner by default.

Use your awakened abilities to endure the depths of the sea until the end.

Trust only yourself, and remember that the title of Maiden is worthy of your pursuit.

Team Assignments:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia and Hebenon Fisalia.
Cantarella Fisalia and Annis Fisalia.
...</color>
InfoDisplay_101153009_Text:
Dear Mandragora,

My dearest sister, I cannot fathom anything more heart-wrenching than facing you in this trial, given all the years we have spent growing up together.

As the Fisalia eldest daughter, you were always sheltered, yet you took it upon yourself to welcome me into this world with such tenderness. I still recall the way you would sew my clothes, even adding that little pink bunny design. It was so soft and fluffy, far more lovely than any strange creature from the deep.

If the Fisalias can have only one Maiden, I wish it to be you.

To show my sincerity, I'll share my newly awakened ability with you. My tears are lethal. They paralyze people upon contact and then clot their blood.

I swear by the name of Fisalia that this is true.

Please think of a way to counter my power. When the time comes, I hope you can free me from this fate.

Yours,
Hebenon
InfoDisplay_101153010_Text:
Dear Hebenon,

The head of our family has always taught us that to be born into the Fisalias is to embrace coldness, decisiveness, and ruthlessness. 

For the "greater good" our family upholds, personal sacrifice holds little weight. As the eldest daughter, it is my duty to uphold these teachings. While our ways may seem harsh, they are accompanied by the weight of expectations and the honor of our name. I have resolved to relinquish all personal desires, allowing the family's code to seep into my very soul.

Our impending duel will undoubtedly bring pain, yet we have both come this far. I trust we will become exactly what the head envisions for us. You, too, are a daughter of the senior line, and I implore you not to follow in our cousin's footsteps, who defies the head's will.

Gather your strength and determination, so that when we face each other in the trial, we shall do so as equals.

Should I become the Maiden, I will honor your sacrifices. And if you are chosen, I hope you will do the same.

Yours,
Mandragora
InfoDisplay_101153011_Text:
<color=PurpleD>Cantarella Fisalia and Annis Fisalia</color> have passed the Second Trial.

The loss of two beloved family members weighs heavily on us all. However, as Fisalias, it is our duty and privilege to continue with the Trials.

For the rise of the Maiden, we stand unwavering, prepared to bear any cost.
InfoDisplay_101153012_Text:
Twelve jellyfish drift in the sea,
Floating silently as can be.
Two swim slow, their pace a crawl.
Sucked into a whirlpool, they fall.

Ten jellyfish drift in the sea,
Apple-choked they can't breathe,
Two then die, the rest are free. 

Eight jellyfish drift in the sea,
Deep down they go, quietly.
The sea's abyss demands more,
Several are eaten, all done for.

Only a few small jellyfish remain,
They panic and swim in vain.
Colliding like they've gone insane

How many jellyfish are there left?
How many are there left?
How many are left?
......................
Unimportant.
Ultimately.
They'll all get swallowed up.

RecallActivity_Story_04_Desc:
In search of Sentinel Imperator, you follow Their guidance and uncover a crucial clue: "Seek the ruins suspended above the wasteland."

As you journey toward the hidden ruins among the clouds, Cantarella, the head of the Fisalias, unveils a long-buried history. Along the way, you also cross paths once again with the mysterious girl, Cartethyia.

Ascending the stairs, the truth is finally within your grasp. However, what awaits beyond is far more unexpected...

Guid_ZJAWNL_10_3: Don't be tempted by the songs! Run! Beware the Tacet Discords!
Guid_ZJAWNL_10_4: Now is not the time to surrender. I still see the Blessed Maiden's light shining through. She hasn't given up yet!
Guid_ZJAWNL_10_5: My lamp still burns bright, and my sword remains keen enough to fell any evil that dares approach!
Guid_ZJAWNL_11_1: I, Rosalie Seneca, will never succumb to the Dark Tide.
Guid_ZJAWNL_11_2: Heh, but if luck should spare me one last time, I want to live... I have so many dreams yet to fulfill...
Guid_ZJAWNL_11_3: And then, silence falls once more.
Guid_ZJAWNL_11_5: The final words of the girl echo in the lingering frequency.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_2: (Hand him the pictures of the seminary)
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_4: This is indeed Avinoleum. These towers, these columns... They still shine with the brilliance of days gone by.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_5: …{Male=Sir;Female=Madam}, there's something I must ask, something I wasn't ready to inquire before.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_6: When the Dark Tide surged, my daughter, <color=Highlight>Rosalie</color>, was studying in the seminary. Like so many others there, she vanished from this world.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_7: Do you think it's possible that, after all these years, Rosalie still survives in those ruins, isolated from our world?
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_8: You are instinctively aware of the weight of this question. About that girl's ending...
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_9: Actually, I encountered her lingering frequencies.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_10: (Keep the truth a secret and remain silent)
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_11: ...! Did she say something? Please, tell me everything you saw and heard.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_12: You recount in detail what you saw and heard to the old man before you, her ending included.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_13: The old man's lips quivered ever so slightly. For a long, silent moment, he doesn't speak a word.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_14: I was meant to attend the coronation ceremony with her that day, but circumstances delayed me...
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_15: By the time I arrived, it was too late. I couldn't protect my own child as a father, nor could I safeguard the sacred land as an Acolyte.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_18: At least now I know that my daughter died a true Acolyte, her faith unwavering, her soul virtuous.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_19: I recall the dusk when I took Rosalie to Avinoleum. The golden light of the setting sun bathed the main tower's dome.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_20: And she asked me who built such a glorious place or if it was a blessing from the Sentinel.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_21: I forgot what I answered, but I believe she found her own answer.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_22: It was the work of those before us.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_23: It was the efforts of everyone that built this civilization.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_24: One day, on the land of Ragunna, such splendor will rise again.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_25: I promise, I'll finish this memoir and never let these precious things be lost to time.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_27: …Thank you. I believe I already know your answer. That's enough.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_28: I promise, I'll finish this memoir and never let these precious things be lost to time.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_29: This long-overdue birthday gift…I know Rosalie would have cherished it.
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_31: (You remain silent, fixing your calm gaze on the old man.)
Guid_ZJAWNL_12_32: You have left a spark of hope lingering in this old, withered heart.
Guid_ZJAWNL_13_1: (Hmm? Seems like a special frequency appeared nearby?)
Guid_ZJAWNL_14_2: (It must be that special frequency. What message will it carry this time?)
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_1: Excuse me, {Male=sir;Female=madam}, have you noticed something unusual in that sky?
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_3: Yes, just an old habit of mine.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_4: Once, Avinoleum was a marvel admired across all of Rinascita. But now, it's nothing more than an expanse of shadows, hanging in the sky.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_6: Actually, I just returned from there.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_7: What? How did you...? Ah, I can sense that you are a powerful Resonator. There's no reason you would lie about such a thing.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_8: Forgive this old man's ramblings. I've been writing a memoir… a record of Ragunna's past.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_10: Yes. Twenty years ago, the Dark Tide swept through and changed everything. It took too many things and people we held dear.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_11: Someone must write it down, lest the glory and triumphs of our past fade into nothing.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_12: But when I reached the part about Avinoleum, I realized I could barely remember what it looked like.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_13: I… My memories of the seminary are slipping away. The place where I spent my youth, where I strengthened my faith and devoted myself to self-discipline… it's all fading.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_15: I was. But as you can see, I no longer wear the vestment.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_16: The current Order deems the study of the past forbidden, erasing all past records.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_17: But now I have an idea... If you can reach the seminary, could you capture some photos for me?
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_18: Even if it has changed greatly, seeing it again might help me recall something... Anything.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_21: Thank you. I've managed to save a little over the years. You won't be doing this for nothing.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_22: Absolutely. I've managed to save a little over the years. You won't be doing this for nothing.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_23: Please take this map with you. I... no longer need it.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_24: The old man gives you a slightly yellowed map. You find some familiar places depicted on it.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_25: This was drawn back when Avinoleum was still on the ground. It marks the renowned places of that time.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_26: Even now, high in the heavens, I believe some traces of its former beauty remain.
Guid_ZJAWNL_2_27: If you can... take some time to appreciate the sights and enjoy the Ragunna of old.
Guid_ZJAWNL_3_1: When you were in Avinoleum, did you encounter... No, please forget it. Good luck on your journey.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_1: The lingering frequency turns into unfamiliar voices around you.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_2: Father… we've arrived? Is this Avinoleum?
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_3: Yes, my dear. We are here at Avinoleum.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_4: A place blessed by the Sentinel, where divine glory converges—the Avinoleum Theological Seminary.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_5: From this day forward, you shall study here and grow into an Acolyte strong enough to bear the burden, just as I once did.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_6: But Father, are you leaving again?
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_7: I'm sorry, sweetheart. There are still far-off corners where the Sentinel's blessings have yet to reach. I must continue my duties.
Guid_ZJAWNL_4_8: But know this, I'll return to you whenever you need me.
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_1: The noise and cheers of the crowd fill the air. The two sides of the watercourse are bustling.
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_2: The Ragunna City always bursts into cheers and joy at such a time, but I've never expected to see the same spirit even here at the seminary.
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_3: Acolytes watching the play crowd the sides of the watercourse, and even our stern professors are dancing without restraint...
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_4: It's Carnevale! Just forget all those titles and ranks today!
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_5: You're right. The Carnevale embraces all differences and disputes.
Guid_ZJAWNL_5_6: Hey, don't just stand there! Come join us! We might even catch a glimpse of the Blessed Maiden herself!
Guid_ZJAWNL_7_1: (A hand-drawn map of the seminary? Just like the one I carry.)
Guid_ZJAWNL_7_2: (Perhaps, this is not just a coincidence.)
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_2: That's right. It's known for its gentle, docile nature, loafing around all day. Not that it's shy. It's simply too lazy to move.
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_3: May I come closer? I just want to pet it.
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_5: Hahaha, feel free to spend as much time with it as you like.
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_6: And what about that giant dragon over there?
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_7: First time seeing it? That's the Blessed Maiden's mount, Gehinnom. It might look intimidating, but it actually has a soft soul.
Guid_ZJAWNL_8_8: Speaking of which, the Blessed Maiden's coronation is around the corner.
Guid_ZJAWNL_9_1: According to the schedule, the Blessed Maiden will be crowned under the dome soon...
Guid_ZJAWNL_9_2: But why does the air feel so heavy?
zhaidishengtai_46_1: Want to grab a drink later?
zhaidishengtai_46_2: Really? You're asking an Acolyte to drink...?
zhaidishengtai_47_1: Want to grab a drink later?
zhaidishengtai_47_2: Really? You're asking an Acolyte to drink...?
zhaidishengtai_47_3: Already preaching the rules after just a few days with the Order?
zhaidishengtai_47_4: Anyway... I hate to say it, but the timing's off. That vestment is going to be too small for you soon.
zhaidishengtai_47_5: Oh, my friend, as long as my heart remains true to the Sentinel's teachings, what does it matter what I wear?
zhaidishengtai_48_1: Don't worry, Sela! You're on the second floor after all.
zhaidishengtai_48_2: The noises are from the first floor. You're safe.
zhaidishengtai_49_1: Has something happened to our head? Her smile seems... different.
zhaidishengtai_50_1: Has something happened to our head? Her smile seems... different.
zhaidishengtai_50_2: If you really want to know, ask her yourself.
zhaidishengtai_50_3: No, no, no! How could I be so presumptuous?
zhaidishengtai_50_4: I'll just focus on my work...
zhaidishengtai_50_5: She finally solved something that had been troubling her for a long time.
zhaidishengtai_50_6: Oh, I see. Thank you for telling me. Since you know the reason, I assume you were involved?
zhaidishengtai_50_7: Having once lost everything in Septimont, I know how hard it is to keep a family stable and peaceful.
zhaidishengtai_50_8: Even if our head is as distant and reclusive as the rumors say, I believe she has her reasons.
zhaidishengtai_50_9: For those of us working here, that's what we believe.

Character_Cantarella_141_1: Knock on the door three times.
Character_Cantarella_141_3: Toss a Shell Credit at the door.
Character_Cantarella_141_4: A strange sensation creeps into your hand as you knock. You immediately sense the shift in the surrounding frequencies.
Character_Cantarella_141_5:
Your fist passes through the door. It's there, yet not there.
Like striking water, no matter how hard you try, the force is swallowed by the endless sea.
Character_Cantarella_141_6:
Nice try, but this is not a wishing well, not to mention it's reckless to make wishes to the Sea of Ghosts.
The abyss seems to have no interest in devouring you now and returns your Shell Credit.
Character_Cantarella_143_1: Knock on the door three times.
Character_Cantarella_143_3: You're tired of knocking on it.
Character_Cantarella_143_4: The cacophonies from behind the door are like high waves going to burst out of it.
Character_Cantarella_143_5:
Yes, it's the third, no, maybe the fourth time it appears. Or more likely, it just keeps regenerating itself, again and again.
Perhaps the door also recognizes you as it snaps open and drags you inside.
Character_Cantarella_143_6:
However, the abyss will never get tired of you. Since you have nowhere to run in the deep sea, your only choice is to face it.
The door opens wide anyway and pulls you into the waves.

HHYSTBC_15_1: Hello there, fancy a copy of Jellyfish in Ghostly Night?

HHYSTBC_17_1: Why do you think our head insists on holding this event every year...?
HHYSTBC_17_2: Ahem, the head said it's confidential. Did you forget?
HHYSTBC_17_3: If she's made this decision, she must have her reasons. Our job is to comply.
HHYSTBC_18_1: The brushwork, the colors, that vivid smile… yet beneath the brilliance, I can sense a trace of bitterness.
HHYSTBC_18_2: Those deep eyes… it feels as if they're pulling me into the painting itself.
HHYSTBC_18_3: Not every artist possesses such extraordinary skill. There's something familiar about this style... but where have I seen it before?

HHYSTBC_18_5: Hmm… seems like quite a few Fisalias have gathered at the venue tonight.

HHYSTBC_1_1: Night of Remembrance specials! Feast well, for only a full belly will sharpen your wits for the riddles ahead!
HHYSTBC_1_2: Bread of the Lost, Pozo Soup, Coffin Tamale, Caramel Fruit Pie... Each is prepared to satisfy both your body and soul!
HHYSTBC_10_1: Year after year... but still, they do not return.
HHYSTBC_10_2: Sometimes, I feel like they haven't gone far.
HHYSTBC_11_1: Brother, how much longer until we summon a ghost? Are you certain this is the way?
HHYSTBC_11_2: With our family steps and Joni playing the music, Nanny's bound to answer our call!
HHYSTBC_11_3: She was a medium. Maybe she can help us solve the riddles! But even if she can't, I wish I could see her again...
HHYSTBC_11_4: Take my soul, take my flesh, take everything! Take it all to bring back the lost souls.
HHYSTBC_12_1: You there! Do you think the lost souls will return tonight?
HHYSTBC_13_1: HELLO! IF YOU'RE THERE! ANSWER ME!
HHYSTBC_13_3: Ha! Yell any louder and you'll have the ghosts fleeing in terror!
HHYSTBC_14_1: The Night of Remembrance is my favorite time of year.
HHYSTBC_14_2: For someone as gloomy, reclusive, and utterly friendless as myself, I take more comfort in being around ghosts than the living.
HHYSTBC_2_1: Candles, skeletons, dim lights, swaying shadows...
HHYSTBC_2_2: Within all the strangeness, there's a certain warmth, isn't there...
HHYSTBC_2_3: I wonder if this warmth could cross the realm of illusion into reality, lasting beyond a single night... into eternity.
HHYSTBC_3_1: Take my soul, take my flesh, take everything! Take it all to bring back the lost souls.
HHYSTBC_4_1: What's taking that idiot so long?
HHYSTBC_4_2: He promised we'd solve the riddles together and get the elixir!
HHYSTBC_4_3: Hmph! I'm not scared! I'm just... worried someone else might snatch the elixir first!
HHYSTBC_4_4: Eugh! What was that noise?! Could it be... Huh?
HHYSTBC_6_1: Say, are we really going in there?
HHYSTBC_6_2: Of course! A place this mysterious must hide the key to the riddle.
HHYSTBC_6_3: Er... it's pitch dark. One wrong step, and we might end up hurt... or worse.
HHYSTBC_6_4: Ahem! For your safety, I insist we check somewhere else first.
HHYSTBC_6_5: Oh, you're the scared one, aren't you? How dull...
HHYSTBC_7_1: This way, please. Take the stairs to your right, and you'll arrive at the main venue.
HHYSTBC_9_1: Hey, I heard one of your relatives got the elixir once! That means you have a good chance too!
HHYSTBC_9_2: Well, she's a distant relative of mine... My grandfather's cousin's son's wife's sister...
HHYSTBC_9_4: Don't worry. I believe in you!
ktll_shengtai_1_2: With peace returning to Ragunna, I've finally found time to explore the city.
ktll_shengtai_1_3: Taking one's time to choose an afternoon tea like this... is quite delightful.
ktll_shengtai_1_4: Such peace is hard-earned. I would like to share it with you. Might you join me for a cup of tea at Porto-Veno Castle this afternoon?
ktll_shengtai_1_6: I'll drop by when I can.
ktll_shengtai_1_8: Heh, I know the weight of your responsibilities well. But do ensure your own needs are met before you extend yourself to others.
ktll_shengtai_2_1: Please, try the tea I've just brewed.
ktll_shengtai_2_3: A refreshing flavor. Is this a new blend?
ktll_shengtai_2_4: Oh? You have a keen palate. I procured this tea from Ragunna City.
ktll_shengtai_2_5: We Fisalias used to drink only Velvet Dream leaves to resist the Threnodian's whispers. I've always been curious about the taste of ordinary tea beyond our estate.
ktll_shengtai_2_6: The delicate sweetness and subtle fragrance of this tea remind me of a breeze sweeping the countryside, or the dew on leafy buds...
ktll_shengtai_2_7: Thank you for sharing this moment with me.
ktll_shengtai_2_8: I hope such an afternoon brings you as much tranquility as it brings me.
ktll_shengtai_3_2: What brings you to the estate today?
ktll_shengtai_3_5: Hehe, so you've made the Fisalia estate your haven of rest, have you? An honor, to be sure.
ktll_shengtai_3_6: Ah, I must say... I'm rather touched.
ktll_shengtai_3_7: Well, with you here, this afternoon will be made all the more pleasant. Even the sunlight streaming through the window feels a little softer.
ktll_shengtai_3_9: After all... we've already agreed, no need for formalities.

AreaReportContent_Text47:
A worn student handbook, its pages frayed and torn, revealing only snippets of information.

Welcome to Avinoleum. This handbook serves as a guide for new students.

 1. The academy consists of three towers. In addition to the classrooms used for daily lessons, one tower is specifically dedicated to student gatherings and social events. This tower also houses portraits of past Primuses. Both new and old students are welcome to visit and pay their respects. Afterward, visitors must leave in an orderly manner.
 2. The watchtower and garden are only accessible before curfew. Entry is prohibited outside of these hours. Students are strictly forbidden from feeding the dragons that inhabit the surrounding area. Violators will face confinement for a period of three to five days.
AreaReportContent_Text48:
3. Students who have completed the knighthood curriculum may apply to participate in the trials. Applications must be submitted with the required materials at least seven days in advance. A review process will follow, during which instructors will ensure applicants are not carrying any prohibited weapons or Echoes before proceeding to the trials.
4. The Path of Bestowal is only open to faculty and students during divine services and the Carnevale. Outside of the Carnevale, students invited to attend divine services must wear the prescribed attire and be accompanied by a member of the Order to the Path of Bestowal for their studies.
 
By the Sentinel above, may every student find enlightenment in Avinoleum.
AreaReportContent_Text49:
A journal carried by a Fisalia member, detailing the principles and taboos that all must respect.

About the Family: Trust nothing blindly, not even your own kin. As a Fisalia, blessings and protection are earned by your own efforts. If you prove your worth, the family permits you to use any means necessary to rise. Even the position of family head is a treasure to be claimed at the right price. Betrayal is a tool, and greed is a virtue. But remember, always wield them with grace.

About Visiting: Every visit to the estate must be justified. For those who dare intrude without invitation, the Fisalias will show them the Fisalia way of hospitality. "Invite" them to leave, or "invite" them to stay permanently as a warning to others. When an invitation is extended, visitors must mind their manners and maintain discretion. Never allow curiosity or fear to lead to your undoing.
AreaReportContent_Text50:
About the Castle: Visitors with matters to discuss must wait quietly in the reception room on the first floor until granted an audience with the family head. No wandering or departure is allowed during this time. Invited guests must present their invitations and proceed to the banquet hall on the right, where hospitality will be provided in accordance with their station. All other rooms in the mansion are off-limits for visitation, including but not limited to the study on the second floor and the surrounding garden.

About the Montellis: Fleeting brilliance. Remember, true glory belongs to the Fisalia family.

Character_Cantarella_1_10:
You receive a strange message from a "ghost girl." The twisted frequency within it affects both you and Abby. 

To uncover the mystery and lift its effects, you decide to attend the Night of Remembrance in Egla Town, as mentioned in the message.
Character_Cantarella_2_14:
The guide briefs you on what the Night of Remembrance is. It's an annual festival in Egla Town, dedicated to honoring those who have passed. People dress up like ghosts at night for various activities.

The guide tells you to wear a mask for the event, and you show him the mask of the Laureate, which works perfectly.
Character_Cantarella_134_14: I am after a particular elixir myself.
Character_Cantarella_134_26:
Cantarella tells you that three riddles entwined with the tale of the "ghost girl" are hidden among the stalls set up for tonight.

Whoever solves all three riddles and uncovers the mystery of the "ghost girl" can ask the host for an elixir that grants any wish. You're skeptical, but Cantarella seems intrigued. You decide to join her.
Character_Cantarella_12_9:
Mammon, the owner of the first stall, says he will only give you the first riddle if you exchange something precious.

As the new Laureate, you offer a performance, which he gladly accepts.
Character_Cantarella_13_7:
Impressed by your performance, Mammon reveals to you the first riddle: The Siren's Song.

"Long ago, a group of girls followed the Siren's call out of town. They journeyed to the 'crown' atop the mountain and to the waterfall that cascaded into the depths below."

He also offers you a music box.
Character_Cantarella_14_12:
As Cantarella tinkers with the music box, you notice its shape resembles an apple.

Inspired by your observation, she solves the first riddle and leads you to the second stall.
Character_Cantarella_15_20:
The owner of the second stall is Beelzebul, who asks you to pick the freshest apple in the stall. After you find the correct apple, Beelzebul gives you a "lucky coin" and reveals the second riddle: The Red Apple.

"The girls lined up for their apples, each one in a vivid, glistening red… but why would apples appear in the deep sea?"
Character_Cantarella_18_6:
The coin isn't perfectly round, with its edges ribbed and uneven. The front of the coin features a doll in a red hat, while the back shows one in blue.

Cantarella picks up on the clue and leads you to the third stall... But, isn't collecting these riddles going a bit too smoothly?
Character_Cantarella_19_27:
Dolls wearing red and blue hats are placed in the third stall. The owner, Invidia, asks you to pick the most beautiful one. But no matter which one you choose, she insists on giving you the doll in the red hat, claiming that the red hat symbolizes divine will and brings luck.

She then tells you the last riddle: The Round Hat.

"A girl dons her red dancing shoes and wears a scarlet hat, ready for the final act of her performance."
Character_Cantarella_20_19:
You realize that the music box, the cog-like "lucky coin," and the doll in a red hat can be assembled into a ballerina music box.

Cantarella puts the parts together and you perform once again. This time, the music box plays.
Character_Cantarella_5_27:
After reading the strange message you received, Cantarella explains that the Night of Remembrance is centered around ghost-related themes. Tonight's theme happens to be the "ghost girl."

She senses the effect on you and invites you to join the event, promising that you'll recover once you solve the riddles prepared for tonight.
Character_Cantarella_21_9:
As the music box plays, the red hat doll materializes and dances, only to abruptly stop. You realize it was all an illusion, but the music reminds you of Porto-Veno Castle. A fleeting shadow crosses Cantarella's usually calm face.

A sharp headache interrupts your thoughts, the distorted frequencies intensifying. You seize the moment and ask Cantarella if you can rest at her castle, and she agrees.
Character_Cantarella_25_7:
The girl points at a crimson plant nearby. Its shape resembles an apple, yet it seems more like a peculiar marine creature.

You realize it's a poisonous Sea Apple, which may be the key to solving the riddle of the Red Apple.

Before you can question the girl, she runs to another part of the garden.
Character_Cantarella_26_7:
The girl points to a jellyfish-like plant, its crimson bloom resembling her own round hat.

Could the round hat from the riddle be a poisonous Jellyrose Medusa? If so, the "ghost girls" are tied to the Fisalias. You need to speak with Cantarella about this.

The girl seems to understand and runs off, gesturing for you to follow.
Character_Cantarella_22_13:
Cantarella lets you rest in her garden and brings you a potion to ease your nerves. You feel much better after drinking it.

Cantarella then leaves to attend to other business, giving you a chance to search around.
Character_Cantarella_24_10: You spot a girl wearing a red round hat among the bushes. She tries to say something but can't speak, instead gesturing for you to follow her.
Character_Cantarella_27_55:
You follow the girl to the corner and find Cantarella dancing, her steps seemingly regulating certain frequencies. 

You share your thoughts with her, and she admits that the "ghost girl" refers to the cruel Divine Trials of the Fisalia family. The blood and tears from these trials have twisted Porto-Veno Castle into the <ano=Sonoro Sphere>the Sea of Ghosts</ano>.

To uncover the truth and lift the "curse" binding you, you must dive into this Sea of Ghosts.
Character_Cantarella_124_9: You prepare to send the girls back to their homes. Before you leave, they say their final goodbyes to Cantarella, thanking her for everything she's done for them over the years.
Character_Cantarella_126_16:
The Night of Remembrance ends smoothly, and the girls return to their homes. The lingering influence over you and Abby is lifted, and everything returns to its usual calm.

It feels like nothing ever happened, as if it was just a fleeting night's dream. But you know it was real, because Cantarella stands right beside you.

She acknowledges that you're stronger than her, but that doesn't stop her from instinctively caring for you. She invites you to rest at her now peaceful castle.
Character_Cantarella_127_41:
It's just you and Cantarella in the castle now. She opens up to you, sharing her thoughts.
 
The Fisalias have always fought to resist the Threnodian's spiritual interference and hold fast to their faith in the Sentinel. The cruel trials were designed to find a Maiden with an unbreakable will, someone capable of withstanding the Threnodian's whispers.
 
Cantarella can't accept the so-called "necessary sacrifice" that strips others of their free will, but she understands it's the only solution. Therefore, she transferred her Second Awakening power to find a solution where no one else but her would be harmed.
 
She pretended to align with the Order to lull the Threnodian into complacency, all the while searching for a way to liberate the Sentinel and defeat the Threnodian once and for all.
 
And then, she found you. Alongside Cantarella, you shaped this peaceful, happy ending, a miracle born from both of you.

The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane.

FavorRoleInfo_1607_TalentDoc:
Level: Public
Fisalia Apothecary Rosemary's Examination Record: Special Edition Approved by the Family Head

It is clear that the current head of the Fisalia family, Lady Cantarella, represents the pinnacle of the family's poison-related Forte. It is a great honor to have been invited to the castle to conduct her checkup, as well as to have been granted unrestricted access to the garden of Porto-Veno Castle for research purposes.

Lady Cantarella's ability is a rare form of hallucinogenic toxin, distinct from the more commonly seen lethal poisons found within the family. Unlike typical poisons, this toxin does not cause immediate death. When swarms of jellyfish emerge from her parasol, an exquisite Illusory Sea forms around her. The poisoned individual will first experience hallucinations, perhaps of their deepest desires or crafted illusions. Should they linger too long within this sea, paralysis will set in, followed by unconsciousness, and ultimately, if the effects persist, death.

Lady Cantarella's control over her ability is nothing short of masterful. At its most refined, she can induce hallucinations without causing any physical harm.

Although such power is a double-edged sword, often causing harm to the user as well, Lady Cantarella's graceful and composed manner suggests she is not overly affected by the "Dreams." Or so it seems… perhaps?

Note: Lady Cantarella is well aware of her abilities. It's a rare exception that she allowed me to examine her. To be honest, that makes me a little nervous… I hope I didn't make any mistakes.

FavorGoods_160701_Content:
The parasol carried by Cantarella.

Its round canopy resembles a soft, plump jellyfish with long, graceful tentacles that seem to float effortlessly in the air. The ribs of the parasol are crafted from deep-sea coral, meticulously shaped into perfect curves that gleam with a subtle glow, both beautifully delicate and unyieldingly strong. At the handle, a sapphire is embedded, a symbol of the unshakable authority of the family head.

Violence has never been Cantarella's first choice, but when forced to defend herself, she merely spins her parasol, and in an instant, the canopy radiates brilliant light. From it, a mesmerizing swarm of jellyfish unfurls, drifting into a phantasmal sea of illusion.

Drawing her enemies into this enchanting yet perilous sea of dreams is the signature art of Cantarella. Like its owner, the parasol may appear soft and fluid, yet when the need arises, it is always indestructible.
FavorGoods_160702_Content:
The cauldron used by Cantarella, the Sea Witch, for potion brewing. The sapphire adorned on it marks Cantarella's authority as the head of the Fisalias.

She often allows her whims to guide her, carelessly tossing in unexpected ingredients, such as jellyfish tentacles, fish scales, tears from the heartbroken, and even the murmurs that linger in the air.

Whatever she adds, the result is always a pot of sweet dreams that dissolves the bitterness of reality, gently soothing those lost in the abyss.
FavorGoods_160703_Content:
Cantarella always carries this potion vial, adorned with a sapphire as bright as the one she wears as a mark of her authority. Inside, she keeps a special brew, one she carefully prepares to ease weariness and calm nightmares.

However, ever since you brought her away from the Sea of Ghosts, the nightmares have ceased.

Now, this vial is imbued with her rare sincerity and tenderness, like a soft light piercing the abyss, reflecting the gentle murmurs hidden in the rolling waves. It is now a symbol of the trust Cantarella has placed in you, the one who has navigated the dark tides and reached the depths for her.
FavorStory_160701_Content:
The light filtered through the stained glass, casting a speckled pattern across the crimson sofa. 

Dim lamps flickered softly in the misty purple room. Around the round table sat several indistinct figures. Some lounging in the light, others half-immersed in the shadows. The lady who arranged this gathering, or at least, by her position, that's what it seemed, spoke first. She had long, silky purple hair, and her indigo eyes, veiled in a soft mist, gave her an ethereal, dreamlike vibe. Lounging lazily on the sofa, she absentmindedly toyed with the sapphire pendant on her chest, a habit she indulged whenever lost in thought.

"I've gathered everyone today to discuss one thing: where should we stay? In the 'Illusory Dream,' or in reality?"

"Since we've been wandering the edge of dreams, should we remain here, in this illusion, where everything is familiar, light and delicate as bubbles? Or should we step forward, into reality, where we might face the unknown… but also see sights we've never known?"

A lazy but resolute voice cut through her words. "How weak of you, Cantarella. You may be head of the family now, but from what I see, you're far from being capable."

A figure emerged from the shadows, a woman with long hair cascading like a waterfall. She wore the same sapphire pendant and carried an air of grace similar to Cantarella's, but with the undeniable weight of experience and authority. Her deep purple eyes glinted with an unquestionable edge.

"This meeting is pointless. Just pour the 'Velvet Dream' into the waterfall behind the castle, and let all of Ragunna fall into a dream under your control. That way, we will be queen wherever we go."

"Invalid answer. Or, if you insist, it will be counted as a vote for 'Illusory Dream.' Though it sounds a little wild and impractical, I'll still write it down for fairness. This is our discussion, after all." A young girl sitting beside them answered, opening a notebook full of strange doodles. She found a small space nearly buried under potion recipes and seriously drew a neat line.

"I abstain," she said casually. "This discussion probably won't change anything. You already have your answer, don't you? For me, it doesn't matter where we stay." She closed the notebook with a soft snap and shook out her white shawl. The light caught her blue, hazy eyes.

"Why can't we just keep it simple and follow our hearts? Cantarella, you like watching the birds outside the window and long for a life of freedom, right? Then just do what feels right," said the youngest one, sprawled on the sofa, her hands lazily chasing the dust motes dancing in the light.

"This is an important decision and should be discussed seriously," Cantarella replied, her voice tinged with a hint of helplessness. "Let's start with you then. Please explain your choice and the reasoning behind it."
FavorStory_160702_Content:
The deep purple, venomous crown, when first placed upon the brow, brings a sharp sting. Yet, the blood that seeps from the forehead nourishes it, making it shine ever brighter. Soaked in the blood and tears of countless souls, this crown of toxic thorns rises from the depths of the sea,  symbolizing those who work silently against the chaos to support the weight of the Celestial Steed's tail feathers.

Such is the glory of the Fisalia family, and its inescapable fate.

But what of each member of the family? In the dark, deep sea, they suffer the gnawing whispers, until the faintest glimmer of true faith in their hearts fades, lost to the abyss. The next in line to wear the crown will take up the duty, and so the cycle endures, unbroken, with no beginning or end.

Fragrant yet toxic blooms,
Colorless, flavorless tears of poisons,
Twisted organs and venomous breaths,
Neurotoxins,
Biotoxins,
Metallic toxins…

The poisons and toxins the Fisalias so pride themselves on and the abilities birthed from them will inevitably be undone by the whispers… In the end, they only come in handy when used to seek the end of life, either for the Fisalias themselves or their kin.

This had long been the norm until I developed the "Illusory Dream." When the thorned crown burrowed into my flesh, the blood flew in strange, shimmering hues. Black tea steeped in mercury tasted like rich, honeyed nectar, while scones soaked in Jellyrose juice had a delicate sweetness. The heat in my throat was searing, as if hastily swallowing an entire cherry, and the suffocating sensation was like drifting in an endless sea… Slowly, the pain faded, and both body and mind became light as air. The bottles of poisons shattered on the floor, and our expressions turned relieved. The whispers were powerless in the world woven by the sea of dreams, for it gently dissolved all discord. Amidst the colorful waves, the once harsh thorned crown was softened… So soft that it formed delicate folds, resting lightly on my head. It became light and pure, like the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.

That's why I cast my vote for "Illusory Dream." After all, what harm is there in this illusion? Have we not all wandered here for so long? Pour the "Velvet Dream" into the waterfall behind the castle, and let the whole of Ragunna fall into a dream shaped by my hand… Rest assured, this is but a joke. I do not seek to control but only wish for all to live more peacefully.

You see, the "Illusory Dream" flows within our veins, and whether we like it or not, it's a permanent and inseparable part of us.
FavorStory_160703_Content:
In the dimly lit room, heavy with a peculiar scent, a faint yellow light illuminated an old notebook and a strange cauldron. The young woman, wrapped in a white shawl, scribbled notes in the book while casually tossing ingredients into the cauldron. The smoke rising from it darkened her clothes, leaving patches of black and purple. Her once-clean apron was now speckled, but she wiped her face carelessly, unfazed by the mess.

Distilled water, peppermint, castor bean, barnacle fish leaves, rosemary… The scent was fresh, the toxicity mild, with soothing and analgesic effects. It could treat the common Infantile Gray Matter syndrome seen recently… I'll write this recipe on a small note and leave it for Chloe later.

Hilo grass, sea okra, barnacle fish leaves, sea apple juice… The scent was unpleasant, and the toxicity potent, though it could counteract some nerve paralysis reactions. Hmm, but the side effects… Never mind, I'll keep it.

Sea okra mucilage, barnacle fish leaves dried and crushed, a splash of sea apple juice, a touch of Jellyrose juice… The toxicity of Jellyrose is too strong. Effective, but too risky.

Crush the barnacle fish leaves, drizzle with Violacas juice, mix with sea okra mucilage, add a bit of sea apple juice, and let it ferment in a glass vial… Done. Once consumed, it soothes the spirit and neutralizes most poison reactions. I should distribute some to everyone to get through the trials in the coming days. And the name… okay, I'll call it Velvet Dream.

The ingredients, processing method, sequence of preparation, and environmental temperature… Handle each step at the right moment, and I can brew the perfect elixir. I believe the same applies to life. In the right moment, with the right steps, most problems can be solved. No matter how illogical the rules or how brutal the situation is, there is always a way to find the right approach.

Therefore, I stepped into the darkness with the lamp, facing my fears. The abyss mocked me—reclusive, weak, incapable of adapting. Its taunting howls echoed through the corridors, the twisted frequencies of past family heads surging forward, engulfing me. Serious, rigid, pale, gloomy, silent… They knew me too well, able to predict my every move and trap me effortlessly.

But still, I played my very first and last trick as I drank a large dose of Velvet Dream in advance. The moment the jellyfish's poisonous thorns pierced my skin, I pressed the Jellyrose Medusa to my head. The violent toxins clashed within my veins, nearly tearing me apart. My soul rolled between life and death, on the verge of spilling out through my burning throat. I couldn't tell if it was blood, tears, or sweat mixed with the remnants of the potion… It dripped onto the almost extinguished lamp.

A small jellyfish wobbled out from the faint light. When I raised my eyes, the darkness lifted, and my blurred vision filled with colorful, vivid illusions.

It worked.

So, like I said, any situation can be solved with the right steps at the right time, even if you're just one part of the process. Since then, I've remained in a perpetual state between life and death, between dreams and reality. I often catch glimpses of lingering illusions, like the girl in the red hat. Who is she? Is it me? Or someone else? I can't figure it out.

Anyway, I'll abstain from voting. It doesn't matter whether it's in the dream or reality. I've been used to it, and I can survive anywhere.
FavorStory_160704_Content: Since I could remember, I had always been in that big, empty house. I would walk from one end to the other, knowing every tile on the floor and every potion bottle on the shelves. The house was gray, dark, and quiet. The only time it ever felt alive was when a bird flew past the window. I would watch its white wings flutter up and down until it became nothing more than a tiny dot in the sky. Beyond that, the sky turned a clear blue, and the trees shone a bright green. It was such a beautiful sight. That was when I would wonder… what was happening in that thick forest? Maybe a princess was having an adventure. I imagined a clever princess who knew how to spot a poisoned apple. When a snake chased her, a little bird would swoop in to save her, carrying her high into the sky. There, she would find a girl in red shoes who couldn't stop dancing and save her. Then, they would dive into the sea to rescue a siren who was on the verge of turning into foam. In the end, the bird would carry them all, flying as far as it could until it could fly no more, finally landing in a castle… But what was the castle like? I only hoped it wasn't like the manor I lived in—big and boring. Sorry, that probably sounds all over the place, doesn't it? Well… Mother and Father always said that girls from the Fisalia family didn't need to read silly fairytales or have strange ideas like that. We were supposed to read books—books like The Complete Guide to Poison Recipes, The Fisalia Family's Secret Elixirs, and 108 Poisons You Never Knew About. They were interesting, but after reading them too many times, they became dull. Still, Mother and Father insisted that I memorize everything so that one day, I could save myself, or perhaps even become a Maiden or the family's leader. It sounded like a huge responsibility. I didn't really understand it yet, but I did what they told me. They were always busy, always rushing around. Whenever they left, they locked the door extra tight and checked it over and over again. I never understood why they grew busier and thinner. And why did they drink so much "water" and mumble strange words? I had learned to say those words too: "It's the glory and fate of the Fisalias." Eventually, I grew older and had to move to a different house. When I left, Mother and Father looked proud, but their eyes were full of tears. "Indeed, milord, our child has great talent, especially in brewing poisons." "Yes, becoming a candidate for the trials is the glory and fate of the Fisalias." That was the first time I ever left home. As I stepped outside, my footsteps startled the crows perched on the dead tree near the gate. They flapped their black wings and took off, flying toward a strange castle in the distance. Oh, sorry, I went off track again. What I meant to say was... after spending so long flying through dreams, you start to miss the feeling of your feet on the ground. Sure, you might step into mud or get pricked by sharp stones, but there was something comforting about taking each step on solid earth. So, when it came time to vote, I chose reality—The Other Side of the Dream, as the adults liked to call it. They always used fancy terms like that. But deep down, you already knew what your heart truly wanted, didn't you? Not just in dreams, but in reality, too. You could open the door, step outside, and go with everyone. Just fly alongside the white birds and chase after the happily-ever-after ending for everyone.
FavorStory_160705_Content:
In the misty purple room, voices blended together—the majestic and enchanting, the cold and resolute, and the genuine and innocent. They intertwined, forming a dreamlike symphony. The sapphire light shimmered with quiet authority, the pages of a book rustled softly, and the scent of freshly baked pastries mingled with the warmth of the room, creating a sweet, ethereal atmosphere.

Cantarella lifted the delicate teapot and poured the tea, a change from the usual. No longer the alluring purple hues, but a cup of tea with a refreshing clarity.

"Thank you for your invaluable opinions," she said, setting the teapot down. The fresh aroma filled the room. "Now, I've made up my mind."

"I will continue to wear the crown of thorns, for the poison has already sunk deep into my bones, and the dream is a part of me I cannot remove."

"I will keep brewing potions, for they are needed not just by the Fisalias, but by all in struggle."

"I will step outside and follow the flight of birds, into the mountains and the streets. The whispers that once trapped us are gone, and now we are free."

"I am still within the dream, but I will strive to feel the ground beneath my feet… In that fleeting moment between dream and reality, I will hold on to what is real."

Cantarella took a deep breath, slowly opening her eyes. She had just woken from a brief afternoon nap, stepping out from a hazy yet lucid dream. The sunlight at three in the afternoon filtered through the glass window, casting a quiet glow over her lonely figure in the room. The only sounds left were the gentle bubbling of the tea and her steady breathing.

She picked up her cup and took a sip. The fresh aroma soothed the restless Tacet Mark in her mouth. It no longer draws power from illusion or pain. This was the tea she had bought earlier this morning in Ragunna, just ordinary tea. The faint sweetness and subtle fragrance reminded her of a breeze in the countryside, of dew drops hanging on fresh leaves…

So, this was the taste of peace and happiness after everything had settled.

The door creaked open. She poured another cup and offered it to the guest who had just arrived. The guest had black hair and golden eyes, a presence of calm and unwavering strength that grounded the room. This quiet, tranquil afternoon was a miracle granted by no other but {PlayerName}.

The soft sunlight brushed through the room, and the refreshing fragrance lingered between them, filling the space around the two teacups. She lifted her violet-blue eyes, the mist long faded, her gaze now like a calm sea, with just the ripple of gentle feelings.

Event_WWDG_15_6: Dora's eyes widen. Before she can say anything else, a small Tubpup runs over with a loud bark!
Event_WWDG_15_7: …Dumdum! Where have you been? I've been looking for you everywhere… Where did you go…
Event_WWDG_15_8: The Tubpup, Dumdum, clumsily licks the tears from the little girl's face, whimpering anxiously.
Event_WWDG_15_9: So it was trying to find its way back to its owner… and so secretly followed me the whole way?
Event_WWDG_15_10: Thank you, thank you so much! Sorry I was unfriendly earlier, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Thank you for helping me find Dumdum… Dumdum, you should thank this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady}…
Event_WWDG_15_12: You're welcome, just be sure to take good care of your pup from now on.
Event_WWDG_15_14: I'll take Dumdum home now. Mother has been so worried… I hope you have a wonderful day, {Male=sir;Female=miss}!
Event_WWDG_16_3: I've already heard the news! You reunited the Tubpup with its owner! A feat worthy of praise. Feels like we've done something good again.
Event_WWDG_16_4: Well, it's almost time for me to head back. Before I leave Ragunna, I want to know what you think of our Lollo Errand campaign.
Event_WWDG_16_7: Ha, at one point it didn't even feel like an errand service anymore. But since everything worked out, all is well! This trip has really given me an appreciation for this Land of Echoes. Quite the fascinating place, wouldn't you say?
Event_WWDG_16_9: Your efforts never go unnoticed. It's always a pleasure working with you. I look forward to whatever adventure awaits us next!
Event_WWDG_2_1: You're back already? That was fast!
Event_WWDG_2_2: So you really can get 10 bags of flour for just 5,000 Shell Credits! The client wasn't exaggerating after all!
Event_WWDG_2_3: Ragunna might just win best city of the year.
Event_WWDG_2_4: Everyone should start selling goods like they do at the Gondola Market.
Event_WWDG_2_5: Well… I wouldn't go that far, but it's definitely the perfect place for my errand business...
Event_WWDG_2_6: Anyway, thank you for your help today! Keep the rewards, and I'll see you tomorrow!
Event_WWDG_4_1: Well, well, I didn't expect the esteemed Laureate to deliver my order in person.
Event_WWDG_5_1: {PlayerName}! Oh dear, you won't believe this!
Event_WWDG_5_3: The freight insurance of the item we're delivering today is worth a billion! I can't even imagine how much the actual item must cost... probably a number I could never earn in my lifetime!
Event_WWDG_5_5: No idea. Based on the tiny package, it could be a precious gem? We need to be extremely careful with this one...
Event_WWDG_5_6: Got it. I'll take care of it.
Event_WWDG_5_7: I wonder if my payment's going to be in the 10-digit range too.
Event_WWDG_5_9: Well, that's a bit beyond my reach... But maybe one day, when I strike it rich!
Event_WWDG_6_1: Oh, my package has finally arrived!
Event_WWDG_6_2: Here you go, the invaluable, precious package.
Event_WWDG_6_4: Let me check. Hmm, looks perfect, no damage at all...
Event_WWDG_6_5: Mr. Super Duper Rich eagerly opens his packages and pulls out a smooth, delicate egg.
Event_WWDG_6_6: Very well! This will be my dinner tonight!
Event_WWDG_7_3: Worth a great fortune, I guess.
Event_WWDG_7_5: Anyway, we need to be extra careful when delivering them, {PlayerName}!
Event_WWDG_7_7: Such "jewelry" and "perfume" should be handled carefully...
Event_WWDG_8_1: Thank you for your... Oh, it's you, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. I remember seeing you with Lady Carlotta before.
Event_WWDG_8_4: Thank you for the prompt delivery. It's exactly what Lady Carlotta needed.
Event_WWDG_8_5: Hehe, I'm just a butler from the Montelli family. Thank you for the prompt delivery. It's exactly what Lady Carlotta needed.
Event_WWDG_9_1: Oh, what should I do... Oh, {PlayerName}! Thank goodness you're here!
Event_WWDG_9_3: Why is there an Echo here?
Event_WWDG_9_4: I'm not sure. It was already here when I arrived, with this note...
Event_WWDG_9_5: Seems like this is the situation now... Any ideas?
Event_WWDG_9_8: Maybe... but are there any rules for this Averardo Vault when it comes to accepting Echoes? They can't just take in any Echoes off the street, right?
Event_WWDG_9_9: True... Are there any rules for this Averardo Vault when it comes to accepting Echoes? They can't just take in any Echoes off the street, right?

I am sincerely seeking a kind-hearted person to take me to the Echo Depository of the Averardo Vault!

If I had the choice, I would prefer to live a short but meaningful life over a long but ordinary one.

——Bakethoven the Echo

HelpText_233_Content:
[About]

Maji, a manager at Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to launch a new Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps, a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.

Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 rounds of Inventory for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
MapMark_170025_MarkDesc:
The collapsing morph painting constantly devours and absorbs frequencies and energy from its surroundings to sustain itself. Stones, plants, and even animals stripped of their frequencies are left in a silent, frozen state, as if drained of all life and color.

The stolen colors manifest as chaotic color blocks within the painting. Remove the incorrect color blocks to release these trapped colors, restoring the scenery to its original splendor.

HelpText_234_Content:
[About]
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Ragunna. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.
 
[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any activated challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. When all the datasets have been collected or when time runs out, you will receive rewards based on points obtained.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your inbox when you log in again within 30 days.

HelpText_235_Content:
[About]
A girl called Dorothy appears next to a mysterious gate. She claims a sudden crisis is taking place inside.
 
[Eligbility]
Reach Union Level 22.
 
[Event Rules]
1. In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.
2. Downed Resonators will be automatically revived after a while. 
3. You can complete the task with your Friends.
4. You can only use designated Echoes in this mode (Sonatas will remain effective and only the main Echo Skill will be replaced).
5. Point Calculation: Clearance Points + (Remaining Time x Time Coefficient).
The Total Points will be the sum of the highest points achieved in regular levels. (Points will not be awarded for challenge levels).

katixiya-shengtai_1_1: You've come to this Sonoro Sphere once again. What is it this time?
katixiya-shengtai_1_2: On a request? Procurement of a rare plant species...? To remember the past?
katixiya-shengtai_1_3: What if I didn't need a reason?
katixiya-shengtai_1_4: Why don't you tell me your reason for being here?
katixiya-shengtai_1_5: Then I take it our meeting is nothing more than a coincidence?
katixiya-shengtai_1_6: I am here to share with them... what has become of Ragunna.
katixiya-shengtai_1_8: You mean those who've passed away?
katixiya-shengtai_1_9: Yes. Unlike me, they are forever trapped in this Sonoro. Unable to witness the changes in the world they protected.
katixiya-shengtai_1_10: Thus, I must be their envoy.
katixiya-shengtai_1_11: But Ragunna has seen so much change...
katixiya-shengtai_1_12: There is so much I've never seen before. Food, dance, music, and...
katixiya-shengtai_1_17: That means every day is filled with possibilities!
katixiya-shengtai_1_18: That is a feeling I do enjoy.
katixiya-shengtai_1_19: Knowing where you want to be and where you'd like to go is a wonderful feeling to have.
katixiya-shengtai_1_20: Do you mind closing your eyes while I take you somewhere?
katixiya-shengtai_1_22: Do as I say, just this once. Let's make the journey special.
katixiya-shengtai_2_1: Well, do you accept my invitation?
katixiya-shengtai_2_2: Doesn't hurt to try, I guess.
katixiya-shengtai_2_3: I need to think about it.
katixiya-shengtai_2_5: There's still plenty of time. Take your time to consider it.
katixiya-shengtai_3_2: You are slowly lifted into the air. After landing, Cartethyia takes her hands off your eyes.
katixiya-shengtai_3_4: They are responding... Responding to you and me.
katixiya-shengtai_3_5: Just as you said, they hear everything... They can even feel.
katixiya-shengtai_3_6: The world can be cruel, but it's not completely without kindness.
katixiya-shengtai_3_7: Those who seek kindness give kindness in return. It has always been this way.
katixiya-shengtai_3_8: Thanks to you, I won't have to abandon such feelings.
katixiya-shengtai_4_2: What are you watching this time?
katixiya-shengtai_4_3: The places I've been before, and places I've yet to visit.
katixiya-shengtai_4_5: Another chance meeting like last time.
katixiya-shengtai_4_6: I'm here because of our last chance meeting.
katixiya-shengtai_4_7: Then how about you stay a little longer, same as before?
katixiya-shengtai_4_8: ...Then how about we let it last a bit longer?
katixiya-shengtai_5_1: Hmm... Is this the kind of story that's popular these days?
katixiya-shengtai_6_1: Hmm... Is this the kind of story that's popular these days?
katixiya-shengtai_6_2: Why not sit with the audience?
katixiya-shengtai_6_4: Phew... It's you. For a second, I thought someone noticed me.
katixiya-shengtai_6_5: Can you really hear and see everything from here?
katixiya-shengtai_6_8: You're not using your Forte, are you?
katixiya-shengtai_6_9: I can't exactly reveal myself just yet. Besides, in the past, the audience was never allowed to offer their opinions after a performance...
katixiya-shengtai_6_10: I'm afraid I might not be able to stop myself from standing up... I hope you don't think it's because I can't afford a ticket.
katixiya-shengtai_6_11: Admissions are free by the way.
katixiya-shengtai_7_2: Don't you want to be closer?
katixiya-shengtai_7_3: Err... This spot is more than adequate.

HelpText_237_Content:
[About]
The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.
 
[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials under a selection of Stress Modules.
Select a Stress Level for each trial. The Stress Level must meet the requirements to complete the trial.
Each trial has a default Stress Module. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Module and Support Module will be unlocked.
 
[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain high-difficulty Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing a Disaster Trial.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>
 
[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing the Challenge Objectives in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.
<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>
