HelpText_238_Content:
[About]
Suspended in the sky, Avinoleum Theological Seminary has become a shattered reflection of a glorious bygone era in Ragunna.
Step into this forsaken and forbidden land to search for the truth behind faith.
Obtain abundant rewards after completing this event.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Avinoleum Theological Seminary in Main Quest Chapter II Act III "The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier."

[Event Rules]
This event is divided into three stages, unlocking as you progress in the Main Quest.
Complete the Event Quests to obtain abundant rewards.
Unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days after the event ends and will be sent via Mail when you log in during this period.

Please note, some quests in this event cannot be completed in Co-op Mode, and Quest Tracking is unavailable in certain areas of the game.

Event_WWDG_3_3: Right on time. I just received a new order from… well, a mysterious madame.
Event_WWDG_3_4: She needs an ingredient for her skincare and happens to know that <color=yellow>Heliobane Fungia</color> is quite moisturizing, so she asked us to help.
Event_WWDG_3_5: But… is it really safe to use?
Event_WWDG_3_6: Hmm… she may have her own method for handling it. Maybe you can just see what she does when you deliver the order.
Event_WWDG_3_8: I'm counting on you, my friend!
Event_WWDG_4_2: You, of all people, indulging in skincare?
Event_WWDG_4_3: Surprised, are we? I wear masks, so there must be... something they rest upon, yes? Though not everyone is fortunate enough to lay eyes on it...
Event_WWDG_4_4: Ah, that expression again... how delightful. Hehe, perhaps there's more to me than you realize.
Event_WWDG_6_7: Is this... some kind of super expensive egg?
Event_WWDG_6_9: Ha, indeed it is! I found it so lovely when I first saw it. Too bad I couldn't get it myself since I was busy with my business. You've been a great help!
Event_WWDG_6_10: Ha, it's just an egg, but I found it so lovely when I first saw it. Too bad I couldn't get it myself since I was busy with my business. You've been a great help!
Event_WWDG_6_11: Just look at its gleaming shell and perfect size. It must taste divine... Couldn't have asked for better.
Event_WWDG_6_13: Thank you so much! This package really made my day!
Event_WWDG_7_10: Hmph, I didn't expect a robbery to happen right after launching the campaign... I'm counting on you today, as always.
Event_WWDG_7_11: The items on the list are... jewelry and perfume. But why is this package so heavy? Don't tell me the jewelry is weighed by the kilo, not the carat?
Event_WWDG_9_10: Perhaps we should ask around. Do you know anyone who works at the Vault, {PlayerName}?
Event_WWDG_9_12: I could ask my friend, Zani.
Event_WWDG_9_13: Excellent! Now we've got a chance to help Bakethoven! We'll wait here while you check with your friend!
Event_WWDG_10_15: Especially large… Well, I don't think the Vault has a shortage of large Echoes.
Event_WWDG_10_16: Smells really good, huh? An... interesting observation. Does it smell like the food it cooks?
Event_WWDG_10_17: Or maybe it's particularly talented? You see, talent is something the Vault looks for too.
Event_WWDG_10_18: Okay, I'll be sure to find out.
Event_WWDG_10_19: Sure. I'll be available tomorrow after I wrap up my current job. You can find me here if you need anything.
Event_WWDG_13_8: Bakethoven nervously starts baking the pizza. The scent of cheese and sausage gradually fills the air. By the time the pizza is ready, a small crowd of Vault employees has gathered.
Event_WWDG_13_9: Wow, this smells incredible! Is this today's special treat?
Event_WWDG_13_10: Such a tempting pizza made by such a talented Echo! I'd love to try it…
Event_WWDG_13_11: Can I have a slice? I missed lunch because of a meeting!
Event_WWDG_13_13: I think so. The appraiser has probably finished their notes… Mmm, this smells so good.
Event_WWDG_13_14: The Vault employees eagerly share the freshly baked pizza. Bakethoven, flattered by the praise, grows bashful. Its oven temperature even goes up a few degrees.
Event_WWDG_13_15: We should know the result by tomorrow. Thanks to you, we had a special and delicious meal today.
Event_WWDG_13_18: The Vault's standards for accepting Echoes are tough, but... I'm hopeful we'll hear some good news tomorrow.
Event_WWDG_13_19: Thank you all again. You're always welcome to visit the Vault next time. I'll give you a tour if I'm free.
Event_WWDG_14_8: Right? Who says an Echo's worth is determined only by "its place in the Vault?" It's the same with life, really.
Event_WWDG_14_11: Haha, thank you! Just a sudden insight. But there's another good piece of news!
Event_WWDG_14_12: Thanks to Bakethoven's case, Lollo Logistics' reputation for helping Echoes has spread far and wide. That's why our order today comes from another Echo, one who's looking for a little girl named Dora.
Event_WWDG_14_13: I've heard she's been spotted in the city. You might want to start there. I'm sure there's no one better to handle this final order than you, {PlayerName}!
ZX_YCZX_5_1: It seems to be the right direction.
ZX_YCZX_6_1: Need to follow the trail more closely.
ZX_SHZZ_15_2: Ah, my eyes do not deceive. As you may recall, over the course of the Fisalia family history, many potential Maidens attempted to resonate with Tyrvine while Overclocked during the Divine Trials.
ZX_SHZZ_15_3: To minimize the loss of life, Imperator exerted Their best efforts to divide the energy generated from Overclocking.
ZX_SHZZ_15_4: This Overclocked energy would eventually take the form of memory fragments scattered within this Inverted Tower. I have made previous attempts to collect these "fragments."
ZX_SHZZ_15_5: Just recently I sensed a surge of frequencies from this tower, so I came to investigate. It appears you were the one who freed these "trapped children" from their confinement.
ZX_SHZZ_15_6: So you're saying... you're here to gather energy Imperator split from your Second Awakening?
ZX_SHZZ_15_7: Speaking of this, if you manage to recover that energy, does that mean you can become the Blessed Maiden again?
ZX_SHZZ_15_8: Theoretically, yes. However, that is not the purpose of my visit.
ZX_SHZZ_15_9: Energy from my Second Awakening is but one of many mixed in the fragments. There are also frequencies that belong to the daughters of the Fisalia family.
ZX_SHZZ_15_10: This energy is not mine alone.
ZX_SHZZ_15_11: Not to mention, I've already made my choice of rejecting fate's coronation.
ZX_SHZZ_15_12: We deserve the freedom to shape our own destinies. The Fisalia children are no exception.

Quest_880000033_QuestAliasDesc_880_1: It's the only night in a year when the lost souls return to the mortal realm. Wear your mask and blend into this special gathering—you never know who or "what" might be hiding behind the mask...
Quest_880000033_QuestAliasDesc_880_2:
Cantarella lets you rest in her garden and brings you a potion to ease your nerves.

As the poisonous ingredients entwine, their toxins soften over time, like nightmares transforming into the sweetest dreams.
Quest_880000033_QuestAliasDesc_880_3:
The blood and tears shed in these trials throughout the years have seeped into this castle and concocted what's now called the Sea of Ghosts.

There, past and future intertwine, and Fisalia's ancient secrets cling to the cracks of time like grotesque scabs.

ItemInfo_71500028_BgDescription: "He bent down and picked up the box, salvaged from the wreckage. Its surface, stained with blood, radiated a strange, captivating glow. This eerie luster seemed to beckon him, drawing him away from the tragic aftermath of the crew's violent fights. Without a glance back, he vanished into the depths of the island."
ItemInfo_71500029_BgDescription: The traveler clung to the belief that the blood flowing through his veins was tied to a lineage from a land long forgotten by Rinascita. The visions of cold and fjords relentlessly plagued his mind. Finally, he poured all his savings into a ship, set sail, and never returned.
ItemInfo_71500032_BgDescription: "Mary, by the time you read this letter, everything will have already settled. Do not mourn for me. I have given my life willingly, alongside my comrades, to defend the glory of the Sentinel. We will ascend to the heavens and stand beside Them."
ItemInfo_71500033_BgDescription: He continued to roll the dice, silently praying that he wouldn't be forced to face the fate head-on. Yet, deep down, he understood that by continuing to roll, he had already made his choice. He was prepared to bring it all to an end.

HelpText_240_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.
 
[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Xiangli Yao, Yinlin, Calcharo, Yuanwu. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!
 
Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain a 30% Electro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Intro Skill grants 100 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Dealing Electro DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%. Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.
 
[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.
 
[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.
 
[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

GuideTutorialPage_32037_Content:
Sagittario's unique tracking arrow marks the Resonator for a certain duration after hitting them.
 
While the marker is active, Sagittario will fire a tracking arrow at the Resonator whenever they take damage.
 
Switching Resonators removes this marker.
GuideTutorialPage_32038_Content:
Sacerdos can form a link with allied enemies. 

When linked enemies take damage, a wind field is generated that repels nearby Resonators. The wind field has a delay between triggers.

The same enemy cannot be linked by multiple Sacerdos.
Tutorial_33030_Title: Head to the end of the route
GuideTutorialPage_33029_Content:
Rover gains a new ability. Casting <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=#ffd12f>holding Basic Attack</color> allows Rover to leap into the air.

Enhanced Mid-air Attacks, Intro Skills, and Basic Attacks accumulate Windstring.

Reach max Windstring to cast an enhanced Resonance Skill.
GuideTutorialPage_33030_Content: Reach the end of the route to complete the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_3303002_Content: Collect Surveillance Datasets and pass through Wind Rings to earn points.
Tutorial_34136_Title: Chasing Light Sparks in the Air
GuideTutorialPage_34128_Content:
Vines formed from remnants of the Dark Tide entangle the hovering statues. Use <color=#ffd12f>Cartethyia's abilities</color> to purify the statues.

<color=#ffd12f>Purify nearby statues</color> to clear the corruption on connected statues.
GuideTutorialPage_34129_Content: The vines block Phaom's path forward. Locate and use <color=#ffd12f>Remnant Sparks</color> to clear the way!
GuideTutorialPage_34130_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Throw the Remnant Spark</color> at the vines to purify them.
GuideTutorialPage_34131_Content: Entering the "Door of Unity" transports you to a new area and changes the direction of gravity.
GuideTutorialPage_34132_Content: The obelisks and chains are interlinked. Smashing an obelisk also breaks the chains attached to it.
GuideTutorialPage_34133_Content:
Cartethyia infuses the Gravity Calibrator with special energy. 
 
Use the Gravity Calibrator to <color=#ffd12f>change the gravity direction</color>, enabling access to unreachable areas.
GuideTutorialPage_3413302_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the direction indicator along the wheel to change the gravity. <color=#ffd12f>The yellow indicator shows the direction guided by Cartethyia</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34134_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Whistle from Utility</color> near waters with matching gravity to summon Cartethyia's companion, Phaom, for a ride.
GuideTutorialPage_34135_Content:
In certain waters, the Gondola will cruise along a fixed route.

Simply control the Gondola's left and right movement.
GuideTutorialPage_34136_Content: Use Utility: Flight to chase the light spark along the Wind Trail.
GuideTutorialPage_34137_Content:
Ride the Gondola and follow the light spark until you reach the end of the route. 
 
Pass through <color=#ffd12f>Power-up Rings</color> to maintain your cruising speed and avoid <color=#ffd12f>Obstacle Rings</color> along the way.
GuideTutorialPage_34138_Content: Twisted frequencies permeate the castle, giving birth to a Sonoro Sphere where past and future intertwine. <color=#ffd12f>Use the lamp given to you by Cantarella</color> in certain areas to travel between different dimensions.
GuideTutorialPage_3413802_Content: In the Sea of Ghosts, remnants of jellyfish float in circular areas. Use the lamp within these zones to travel to different dimensions.
GuideTutorialPage_34139_Content:
Coming in contact with the <color=#ffd12f>umbrella of a Bouncy Jellyfish</color> will <color=#ffd12f>bounce</color> the Resonator upward.
 
<color=#ffd12f>You can only interact with Bouncy Jellyfish in the current dimension</color>. Bouncy Jellyfish from other dimensions appear as visions and cannot be interacted with.
GuideTutorialPage_34140_Content:
Enemies from alternate dimensions are shrouded in shadows, granting them <color=#ffd12f>immunity to all forms of attack</color>.
 
Use the lamp and <color=#ffd12f>switch to their respective dimensions</color> to clear their shadows and make them vulnerable to attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_34141_Content:
The late head of Fisalia's obsession is in a special shadow state, making them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all forms of attack</color>.
 
During combat, the lamp's energy can be charged <color=#ffd12f>by performing Dodge and Counterattack</color>.
 
Once fully charged, the lamp will emit a powerful light to dispel the shadows, making the enemy vulnerable to attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_34142_Content: Some Overflowing Palette paintings contain Colorblocks formed by abnormal frequencies. <color=#ffd12f>These blocks cannot be colored normally</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34143_Content: Complete the Drake's challenge by evading lightning strikes within a given time period.
GuideTutorialPage_34144_Content: Without Cartethyia's aid, some Resonators' abilities will be limited under certain gravity conditions.
GuideTutorialPage_34145_Content:
The Nimbus Wraith has left special pattern hints on the ground.
 
Follow its guidance and <color=#ffd12f>walk along the highlighted path as accurately as possible</color> using Sensor to complete the pattern.
GuideTutorialPage_34146_Content: Thanks to Phaom's awesome sailing ability, you can ride up waterfalls to reach <color=#ffd12f>areas with different gravity orientations</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34147_Content: When Capitaneus adopts a defensive stance, <color=#ffd12f>attacking from behind</color> will cause the stance to break, turning the situation to your advantage.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_42_1: Did you feel any discomfort while we were clearing out the remnants?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_42_2: Nothing out of the ordinary... I felt fine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_42_3: I suppose this alone is not enough to determine whose Resonator I am.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_42_4: You've helped a lot. Don't worry about that for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_42_6: Another waterrise is coming up. You planning to hold on to something?

Main_Linaxita_2_4_43_5: In these waters, gravity isn't the only thing that's inverted. Its very essence is, too.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_34_2: The vines are remnants of the Dark Tide. Phaom won't be able to cross through them...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_34_3: Let's disembark here and find a way to clear the path.

ZX_BOXDLXJ_15_1: There are so many stars... And incredibly bright.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_15_2: I think they wanted me to head to the top.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_16_2: What a view. So many stars right beneath my feet.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_16_3: I should take a picture and share this view with the Plushies.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_2: I see our Echo interpreter is on duty.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_3: ...Oh, that wasn't them saying it, it's from me!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_4: Anyway. How was it? Everyone was so worried they were starting to pull my hair here!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_7: Well, what do we have here? Never imagined there'd be a view like this tucked away inside that painting... The Plushies really like it and say thank you!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_8: They also said they'll have a present waiting for you back at the village tomorrow afternoon... A present! Wonder if it's something yummy?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_17_10: Hurray! {Male=He;Female=She} said yes! Ow, ow, ow! I know you're all happy, but not the hair!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_4: Hahaha. We have your present ready! Thanks to you, the Plushies say they had such a spectacular adventure that they're still having dreams about it!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_5: But before the great reveal, there's another special present we like to show you.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_7: It's me while I was taking pictures of the stars. And the Plushies?
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_8: Bingo! Hehe. Although a painting in between, and shrouded in the darkness of the night, they were still able to witness every step you took.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_9: I would say there's a special connection between you. While you were taking pictures of the stars beneath, the Plushies also took a picture of you, as if they were under the very same stars as you.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_13: Hahaha. The Plushies don't really have a way of conveying their feelings, so I'm here to help.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_14: It was really an adventure to remember. Now they are brave enough to go and explore anywhere they would like.
ZX_BOXDLXJ_18_15: Thank you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! The Plushies asked around what you liked and spent quite a while putting together this present for you. Come take a look!
ZX_BOXDLXJ_8_4: We might get a better view from the top. Let's find a way up.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_67_9: Perhaps that stele over there has instructions on what to do?

Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_5: Maybe we could find a way to move them?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_6: There's no point in finding Hognis if we can't repair the waterway.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_88_6: Same as before, I'll handle it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_90_4: You've done well. Let's see if I can get a feel for how strong the gravitational forces are.

InstanceDungeon_1010_DungeonDesc:
Here, past and future intertwine. The tears and blood shed in the Divine Trials spread and twisted into what is now the Sea of Ghosts.
Carried upon its waves are silent sobs, bitter sighs, and the unspoken past of the Fisalia family...
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1010_Description:
The past stagnates, fermenting over time into abnormal frequencies that now drown the castle.
Will anyone answer the call of the ghosts? Even if their voices are as faint as the pop of a bubble?

Main_Linaxita_2_4_16_1: Why do the Fisalias have a cable car that leads directly to the Sonoro Sphere?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_16_2: Before it became a Sonoro Sphere, it was a seminary known as the Avinoleum. The Martyred Maiden once pursued her studies there.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_16_3: A superficial harmony needed to be maintained between the Fisalias and the Order, and this underground cable car was intended to send scions of the family to school.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_16_4: The elevator is merely a later addition I had built for easy access.
